Its Corporate Activities segment consists mainly of treasury operations, research & development, investment holdings, provision of management and other support services.

name: INDOFOOD AGRI RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Indofood Agri Resources Ltd. is an integrated agribusiness company. The Company’s activities include research and development, oil palm seed breeding, oil palm cultivation milling, as well as the refining, branding, and marketing of cooking oil, margarine, shortening and other palm oil derivative products. It also engages in the cultivation of rubber, sugarcane, and other crops. It operates through two segments: Plantations and Edible Oils and Fats. The Plantations segment focuses on the development and maintenance of oil palm, rubber and sugar cane plantations and other business activities relating to palm oil, rubber and sugar cane processing, marketing, and selling. It is also involved in the cultivation of cocoa, tea, and industrial timber plantations. The Edible Oils and Fats segment produces, markets, and sells edible oil, margarine, shortening, and related derivative products. Its subsidiaries include PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk, IFAR Brazil Pte. Ltd., and IFAR Trading Pte. Ltd.

name: FIRST REIT
businessSummary: First Real Estate Investment Trust (the Trust) is a Singapore-based healthcare real estate investment trust (REIT). The Trust is focused on investing in healthcare and healthcare-related real-estate assets throughout Asia. The primary objective is to deliver regular and stable distributions to unitholders and to achieve long-term growth in the net asset value per unit. The Trust has a diversified asset portfolio of 32 properties located in Indonesia, Singapore, and Japan. Its properties in Indonesia include Siloam Hospitals Yogyakarta, Siloam Hospitals Buton & Lippo Plaza Buton, Siloam Hospitals Labuan Bajo, Siloam Hospitals Kupang & Lippo Plaza Kupang, Siloam Hospitals Purwakarta, Siloam Hospitals Bali, Siloam Hospitals TB Simatupang, Siloam Hospitals Manado & Hotel Aryaduta Manado, Siloam Hospitals Makassar, Mochtar Riady Comprehensive Cancer Centre, and Siloam Hospitals Lippo Cikarang. First REIT Management Limited is the manager of the Company.

name: RIVERSTONE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Riverstone Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is a global supplier of cleanroom consumables and healthcare gloves. It is engaged in the manufacturing of nitrile and natural rubber clean room gloves used in controlled and critical environments, as well as nitrile gloves used in the healthcare industry. It specializes in the production of cleanroom and healthcare gloves, nitrile gloves, finger cots, face masks, packaging bags, and others. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of gloves and non-glove consumables, such as static shielding bags, wipers, and packaging materials. Its products are used in the hard disk drive, semiconductor and healthcare industries. It is focused on three primary geographic areas: Malaysia, Thailand and China. It has approximately six manufacturing facilities, located in Malaysia, Thailand and China, and a network of sales offices and strategic partners in Asia, the Americas and Europe.

name: BUKIT SEMBAWANG ESTATES LTD
businessSummary: Bukit Sembawang Estates Limited is a Singapore-based company, which focuses on property development, investment and other property-related activities. The Company together with its subsidiaries engages in investment holding, property development and operating of serviced apartments. The Company’s segments include Property Development, Hospitality and Investment Holding. The Property Development segment engages in Development of residential properties for sale. The Hospitality segment owns serviced apartment units. The Investment holding segment engages in holding and management of office building and investments. The subsidiaries of the Company include Bukit Sembawang View Pte. Ltd., Singapore United Estates (Private) Limited, Sembawang Estates (Private) Limited, Paterson Collection Pte. Ltd., Paterson One Pte. Ltd., BSEL Development Pte. Ltd., Bukit Sembawang Land Pte. Ltd., Bukit One Pte. Ltd., and Bukit Two Pte. Ltd.

name: SINGAPORE TELECOMMUNICATIONS LTD
businessSummary: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd is a Singapore-based communications technology company. The principal activities of the Company consist of the operation and provision of telecommunications systems and services, and investment holding. Its segments include Optus, Singapore Consumer, Group Enterprise, and NCS. The Optus segment offers mobile, equipment sales, fixed voice and data, satellite, managed services, Infocomm Technology (ICT), cloud computing and cybersecurity in Australia. The Singapore Consumer segment offers mobile, fixed broadband, voice, pay television, content and digital services, as well as equipment sales in Singapore. The Group Enterprise segment provides ICT, mobile, equipment sales, fixed voice and data, satellite, managed services, cloud computing and cyber security. The NCS segment offers ICT (including cybersecurity) and IT services, as well as professional consulting in Singapore, Australia and in the region.

name: YOMA STRATEGIC HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Yoma Strategic Holdings Ltd. is an investment holding company. The Company has nine segments: Yoma land development, Yoma Central, Yoma land services, Yoma Motors, Leasing Fleet, Mobile Financial Services, Yoma Food and Beverages, Investments, and Other. Yoma land development segment is in the business of property development and the sale of land development rights and development properties. Yoma land services segment is in the business of property leasing in Myanmar, as well as providing project management, design, estate management and estate operations. The Yoma motors segment is in the business of supplying and selling agriculture and construction equipment, passenger and commercial vehicles, and their related parts, including the provision of maintenance services. Its subsidiaries include Yoma Strategic Investments Ltd., Lion Century Properties Limited, Yoma Education Pte. Ltd., Wayville Investments Limited, among others.

name: FRASER AND NEAVE LTD
businessSummary: Fraser and Neave, Limited is a Singapore-based company that is engaged in the production and sale of beverages and dairy products, and printing and publishing. The Company’s geographical segments include Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam. Its Food and Beverage (F&B) division produces, markets and sells soft drinks, beer, dairies, juices and ice cream. Its F&B brands include 100PLUS, F&N and F&N NUTRISOY for Soft Drinks, CHANG for Beer, F&N MAGNOLIA for Dairies, and F&N MAGNOLIA and F&N KING'S for Ice Cream. Its printing and publishing brands include Marshall Cavendish, Times Printers, Print Lab, Office & Schools Solutions, Times Distribution, Pansing, Times bookstores, Kaboom and GoGuru. The Company’s subsidiaries include Emerald Brewery Myanmar Limited, F&N Foods Pte Ltd, F&N Creameries Group, Fraser & Neave Holdings Bhd Group, Warburg Group and Yoke Food Industries Group.

name: WILMAR INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Wilmar International Limited is a Singapore-based company, which is engaged in investment holdings and the provision of management services. The Company’s segments include Food Products, Feed and Industrial Products, Plantation and Sugar Milling, and Others. Food Products segment comprises the processing, branding, and distribution of a range of edible food products, which includes vegetable oil produced from palm and oilseeds, sugar, flour, rice, noodles, specialty fats, bakery, and dairy products. Feed and Industrial Products segment comprises the processing, merchandising, and distribution of products, which includes animal feeds, non-edible palm and lauric products, agricultural commodities, oleochemicals, gas oil, and biodiesel. Plantation and Sugar Milling segment comprises oil palm plantation and sugar milling activities, which include the cultivation and milling of palm oil and sugarcane. The Others segment includes logistics and jetty port services, and investment activities.

name: BANYAN TREE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Banyan Tree Holdings Limited is an investment holding company. The Company is engaged in the provision of project design and management services. The Company manages a diversified portfolio of hotels, resorts, spas, galleries, golf courses, and residences. Its segments include Hotel Investments, Residences, and Fee-based. Its Hotel Investments segment includes hotel and restaurant operations. The Residences segment comprises hotel residences, Laguna property sales and development project/site sales. Hotel residences business relates to the sale of hotel villas or suites to investors. Laguna property sales business relates to the development and sale of properties which are standalone vacation homes in Laguna Phuket. The Fee-based segment comprises the management of hotels and resorts, the management and operation of spas, the provision of architectural and design services, the management and ownership of golf courses, and rental of retail outlets and offices.

name: HENGXIN TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: Hengxin Technology Limited is a Singapore-based manufacturer of integrated antennas and feeder cables for mobile communications in the People’s Republic of China (the PRC). The Company’s segments include Digital technology and digital security, New Energy and Services, and Telecommunications. The Digital Technology and Digital Security segment mainly focuses on chip research, design, sales and supply chain services, semiconductor intellectual property authorization business, and digital security products and services. The New Energy and Services segment is engaged in the supply of electricity with a focus on the production and sales of solar power as well as the provision of development consultation and technical services of the solar thermal power generation technology. The Telecommunications segment is focused on the provision of reliable signal transmission products and services for global mobile communication operators, equipment vendors and rail transit builders.

name: NATURAL COOL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Natural Cool Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company operates through four segments: Aircon and Engineering, Paint and Coatings, Food and Beverages (F&B), and Technology. The Aircon and Engineering segment is engaged in trading of air-conditioning units and spare parts, installation services for commercial air-conditioning systems and mechanical ventilation, plumbing and sanitary works and maintenance services. The Paint and Coatings segment is engaged in the manufacturing, trading of paint and basic chemicals. The F&B segment is engaged in the operation of restaurants and stalls, manufacturing and wholesale of F&B products. The Technology segment is involved in the installation of building automated systems for remote monitoring and maintenances services. Its subsidiaries include Natural Cool Airconditioning & Engineering Pte Ltd and SFB Holdings Pte. Ltd.

name: KEPPEL REIT
businessSummary: Keppel REIT (the Trust) is a Singapore-based real estate investment trust. The Trust invests in a portfolio of real estate and real estate-related assets that are used for commercial purposes in Singapore and Asia. Its objective is to deliver stable income and long-term total return for its unitholders by owning and investing in a portfolio of income-producing commercial real estate and real estate-related assets in Asia Pacific. The Trust's portfolio comprises interests in approximately 12 commercial assets located in the business districts of Singapore; Australian cities of Sydney, Melbourne and Perth; Seoul, South Korea, and Tokyo, Japan. Its properties include Ocean Financial Centre; Marina Bay Financial Centre; One Raffles Quay; Pinnacle Office Park, Sydney; 8 Chifley Square, Sydney; T Tower, Seoul; KR Ginza II, Tokyo, and 8 Exhibition Street, Melbourne. The Trust is managed by Keppel REIT Management Limited, a subsidiary of Keppel Capital Holdings Pte. Ltd. (Keppel Capital).

name: UOL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: UOL Group Limited is a Singapore-based property and hospitality company. The principal activities of the Company are investments in properties, subsidiaries, associated companies and listed and unlisted securities. The Company's segments include Property development, Property investments, Hotel operations, Investments, Technology operations and Management services. Property development segment is engaged in the development of properties for sale. The Property investments segment is involved in the leasing of commercial properties and serviced suites. Hotel operations segment is engaged in the operation of owned hotels. The Investments segment invests in quoted and unquoted financial assets. Technology operations segment is engaged in the distribution of computers and related products, including the provision of systems integration and networking infrastructure services. Management services segment is engaged in hotel management services under the Pan Pacific and PARKROYAL brands.

name: ASIA ENTERPRISES HOLDING LTD
businessSummary: Asia Enterprises Holding Limited is a Singapore-based distributor of a comprehensive range of steel products to industrial end-users in Singapore and the Asia-Pacific region. The Company provides a range of steel products and value-added services. It has a ready inventory consisting of approximately 1,200 steel products that it supplies to over 700 active customers involved primarily in the marine and offshore, oil and gas, construction, engineering/fabrication and manufacturing industries. The Company owns two facilities in Singapore, a multi-story warehouse and a steel processing plant-cum-warehouse. The Company operates through three segments: Steel distribution, Provision of steel processing, and Corporate. The Steel distribution segment is engaged in the procurement, distribution and trading of steel products. The Provision of steel processing segment is engaged in the processing of steel materials for sale. The Corporate segment is engaged in investment and management activities.

name: OVERSEA-CHINESE BANKING CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited (the Bank) is a Singapore-based company, which is engaged in the business of banking, life insurance, general insurance, asset management, investment holding, futures, and stockbroking. Its segments include Global Consumer/Private Banking, Global Wholesale Banking, Global Markets, Insurance, and Others. The Global Consumer/Private Banking segment provides a range of deposit products, consumer loans, credit cards, wealth management products, and brokerage services. The Global Wholesale Banking segment offers financing solutions, including long-term project financing, short-term credit, working capital, and trade financing. The Global Markets segment engages in foreign exchange activities, money market operations, fixed income, and derivatives trading, and offers structured treasury products and financial solutions. The Insurance segment provides both life and general insurance products to its customers, mainly in Singapore and Malaysia.

name: MAPLETREE LOGISTICS REIT
businessSummary: Mapletree Logistics Trust is a Singapore-based real estate investment trust. The Company invests in a diversified portfolio of income-producing logistics real estate and real estate-related assets in Singapore, Australia, China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Japan, Malaysia, South Korea and Vietnam. Its properties are strategically located near to expressways and have established logistics clusters in nine geographic markets across Asia Pacific. Its portfolio stands at 176 properties, comprising 45 properties in Singapore, 14 in Australia, 42 in China, nine in Hong Kong SAR, three in India, 22 in Japan, 10 in Malaysia, 21 in South Korea and 12 in Vietnam. Its properties include 114 Kurrajong Road & 9 Coventry Place, Mount Druitt, NSW; 15 Botero Place, Truganina; 213 Robinsons Road, Ravenhall, VIC; Acacia Ridge Distribution Center; Chengdu DC Logistics Park; Mapletree (Cixi) Logistics Park; Mapletree (Chakan) Logistics Park 1; Mapletree (Farukhnagar) Logistics Park, and others.

name: CITY DEVELOPMENTS LTD
businessSummary: City Developments Limited is a Singapore-based global real estate company with a network spanning 168 locations in 29 countries and regions. The Company’s diverse portfolio comprises residences, offices, hotels, serviced apartments, student accommodation, retail malls and integrated developments. The Company's segments include Property development, Hotel operations, Investment properties and Others. The Property development segment is engaged in developing and purchasing properties for sale. The Hotel operations segment owns and manages hotels. The Investment properties segment is engaged in developing and purchasing investment properties for lease. The Others segment comprises investment in shares, management and consultancy services, and provision of laundry services. It has developed over 53,000 homes and owns around 23 million square feet of gross floor area in residential for lease, commercial and hospitality assets globally and has over 160 hotels worldwide.

name: SEMBCORP INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Sembcorp Industries Ltd is a Singapore-based renewables company and an industrial and urban solutions provider in Asia. It delivers solutions that support the energy transition and sustainable development. Its segments include Gas and Related Services, Renewables, Integrated Urban Solutions, Decarbonisation Solutions, and Other Businesses and Corporate. Gas and Related Services segment’s principal activities include the sale of energy molecules. Renewables segment’s principal activities are the provision of self-generated electricity from solar and wind resources, energy storage as well as provision of system services that support integration of renewables into grid. Integrated Urban Solutions segment supports sustainable development through its suite of urban, water as well as waste and waste-to-resource solutions. Decarbonisation Solutions segment includes trading of environmental attributes, low-carbon feedstock, power imports and carbon capture, utilization and storage business.

name: FRENCKEN GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Frencken Group Limited is a Malaysia-based globally integrated technology solutions company. The Company provides original design, original equipment and diversified integrated manufacturing solutions for multinational companies in the analytical and life sciences, automotive, healthcare, industrial and semiconductor industries. The Company's segments include Mechatronics, Integrated Manufacturing Services (IMS), Investment Holding and Management Services, and Others. Mechatronics specializes in the design and manufacture of complex electro-mechanical assemblies and automation systems for original equipment manufacturers. The IMS specializes in integrated solutions to manufacture plastic components for assembly into modules and finished products. It also designs and manufactures oil filters. The other segment comprises investments in property holding companies, and companies in the business of producing, testing and trading adhesive products and thermal management products.

name: INTERRA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Interra Resources Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in the business of petroleum exploration and production (E&P). Its E&P activities include petroleum production, field development and exploration. It has one reportable segment, namely the exploration and operation of oil fields for crude petroleum production. Its portfolio comprises three petroleum contract areas in Indonesia and Myanmar. In central Myanmar, it holds approximately 60% participating interests in two of the onshore producing oil fields in Chauk and Yenangyaung under two Improved Petroleum Recovery Contracts (IPRCs) with the Myanma Oil and Gas Enterprise (MOGE). The Company holds approximately 72.75% participating interest in an exploration block, namely the Kuala Pambuang (KP) Production Sharing Contract (PSC), onshore Central Kalimantan.

name: DELFI LTD
businessSummary: Delfi Limited is a Singapore-based company engaged in the marketing and distribution of chocolate, chocolate confectionery and investment holding. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and marketing of chocolate confectionery products under a variety of brands and distribution of a range of food and other consumer products, including agency brands. Its geographic segments include Indonesia and Regional Markets, which comprise the Philippines, Malaysia, and Singapore. It offers its own brand confectioneries and categories, which includes Delfi, SilverQueen, Van Houten, Ceres, Goya and Knick Knacks, Selamat, Cha Cha, Take-It, and others. The Company’s portfolio of chocolate and sugar confectionery brands spans over 400 products. Its products include chocolate-covered wafer bars, molded chocolate, dragees, chocolate wafer sticks, chocolate-coated cookies, and biscuits. It owns and operates two chocolate production facilities, one in Indonesia and the other in the Philippines.

name: HOSEN GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Hosen Group Ltd. is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in importing, exporting and distributing fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), specializing in processed food. The Company operates through two segments: House brands and Non-house brands. The House brands segment is engaged in the development, trading and distribution of canned seafood, canned fruits and vegetables and canned meat products, and chocolate products. Its Non-house brands segment is engaged in the importation, distribution, wholesaling and retailing of canned food and household consumable goods. The Company’s brands include Hosen Quality, Highway, Fortune, LaDiva, Sincero, Calbuco, Cocoa Grande, Living Forest, Hosen Select, Royal Select, Hula, and Fortune Tuna. The Company’s subsidiaries are Hock Seng Food Pte Ltd, Hosen Chocolate Sdn Bhd, Fortune Melinka Pte. Ltd, and among others.

name: STRACO CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Straco Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based company engaged in the development and management of aquatic-related facilities and tourism-related assets. The Company operates through two segments: Aquariums and Giant Observation Wheel (GOW). The Aquariums segment represents the operation of aquatic-related facilities and tourist attractions, including sea mammal performances, in the People’s Republic of China (PRC). Retail, food and beverage are auxiliary goods and services arising from the operation of aquatic-related facilities. Its GOW segment is in the operation of a circular giant observation structure and the provision of commercial space in Singapore. Its other operations include the operation of a cable-car facility. The Company's operating assets include Shanghai Ocean Aquarium, Singapore Flyer, Underwater World Xiamen, and Lixing Cable Car. Its subsidiaries include Infotainment Development & Management Pte Ltd, New Bay Holdings Pte Ltd, Straco Leisure Pte Ltd, and others.

name: MATEX INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Matex International Limited is a Singapore-based company. The Company is a manufacturer, supplier and marketer of quality dyestuffs and specialty chemicals, color measurement, and computer-aided systems to various global markets, such as textile, paper, leather, detergent and polymers industry. The Company's principal activities include the formulation, manufacturing and sale of specialty chemicals focusing on dyestuff and auxiliaries for the textile industry. The Company operates through three geographical segments: the People’s Republic of China (PRC), Malaysia, and Singapore. The Company offers a range of colorants, auxiliaries, and services, focusing on developing new product solutions, application development, process technologies, and related services. Its subsidiaries include Matex Holdings Pte Ltd, Shanghai Matex Chemicals Co., Ltd, Unimatex Sdn Bhd, and Matex Chemicals Technologies (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.

name: MICRO-MECHANICS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Micro-Mechanics (Holdings) Ltd. is a Singapore-based global integrated mechanics solution company. The Company designs, manufactures and markets high-precision parts and tools used in process-critical applications for the semiconductor and other high-technology industries. The Company’s segments include Consumable Tools and Wafer Fabrication Equipment (WFE) parts. Its Consumable Tools segment focuses on the design and manufacturing of miniature consumable tools used in the assembly and testing of semiconductors. Its WFE parts segment focuses primarily on making parts for semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment. Its products and solutions include Semiconductor, which include Die Attach, Wire-bonding, and Encapsulation. The Company serves a worldwide base of customers from five manufacturing facilities located in Singapore, Malaysia, China, the Philippines and the United States, and a direct sales presence in Taiwan, Europe, Thailand and Japan.

name: SINGAPORE POST LTD
businessSummary: Singapore Post Limited is a Singapore-based postal and e-commerce logistics provider in Asia Pacific. The portfolio of businesses spans from national and international postal services to warehousing and fulfillment, and last-mile delivery. The Company’s segment includes International and Singapore. The international segment comprises international cross-border distribution of mail and parcels, and logistics solutions including warehousing services. The Singapore segment comprises domestic postal services, including mail distribution and products and services transacted at the post offices; parcel distribution; eCommerce logistics and other value-added solutions; and property leasing. The Company’s subsidiaries include Singapore Post Enterprise Private Limited, SingPost Logistics Holdings Pte. Ltd., SingPost Investments Pte. Ltd., SingPost Logistics Investments Pte. Ltd., SingPost Holdings Pte. Ltd., and others.

name: COMFORTDELGRO CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: ComfortDelGro Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based land transport company. Its Public transport segment is engaged in the provision of bus and rail services for commuters traveling on public transport systems and contracted revenue for the operation of scheduled services. Its Taxi/private-hire vehicle (PHV) segment is engaged in renting out taxis, operating taxi bureau services, platform services, renting and leasing of cars, provision of vehicular maintenance and repair services, construction of specialized vehicles, assembly of bus bodies, crash repair services, engineering services, and sale of diesel and petrol. Its Other private transport segment is engaged in the provision of coach rental services and provision of non-emergency transport services to patients. Its Inspection and testing services segment is engaged in the provision of motor vehicle inspection services and provision of non-vehicle testing, inspection and consultancy services.

name: ASL MARINE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: ASL Marine Holdings Ltd. is a Singapore-based company. The principal activity of the Company is investment holding. The principal activities of the subsidiaries are those relating to shipbuilding, ship repair and conversion, ship chartering, dredge engineering and other marine related services. Its segments include Shipbuilding, Shiprepair, conversion and engineering services, Shipchartering, and Investment holding. The Shipbuilding segment is engaged in Construction of vessels. The Shiprepair, conversion and engineering services segment is engaged in the provision of shiprepair, dredging engineering products and related services. The Shipchartering segment includes provision for chartering of vessels and transportation services. The Investment holding segment is engaged in the provision of corporate and treasury services. It owns a young fleet of vessels consisting of mainly Barges, Tugs, Anchor Handling Tugs, and Anchor Handling Tugs/ Supply vessels.

name: OCEANUS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Oceanus Group Limited is an investment holding company. The Company’s segments include Distribution, Services and Others. Its Distribution segment includes distribution of a portfolio of fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) products, such as beverages, snacks, cereals, to chilled and frozen meat (beef, chicken, pork), sugar, grains, fruits and many more under its key platforms and brands. Its food production business is engaged in seafood production, processing, and trading. Its Services segment is engaged in supporting the warehousing and logistics services needed for its food production and distribution pillars. It also provides services ranging from consultation and business strategies to media solutions and corporate branding. It also offers in-house capabilities in land management services, logistics and warehouse services, marketing and branding, business consulting and matching. It exports seafood to Singapore, China, Southeast Asia, Australia, the United States and Europe.

name: CAPITALAND ASCENDAS REIT
businessSummary: CapitaLand Ascendas REIT is a business space and industrial real estate investment trust. The Company owns and manages a diversified portfolio of approximately 224 investment properties in Singapore, Australia, the United States (US) and the United Kingdom (UK)/Europe. The Company’s segments include Business Space and Life Sciences, Industrial and Data Centres, and Logistics. The Business Space and Life Sciences segment include properties located in business and science parks, suburban offices, and office properties. Life sciences properties are business spaces with lab-ready specifications. Industrial and Data Centres properties include high-specifications and light industrial properties, as well as flatted factories, and data centers. These properties offer a range of premium to basic facilities to meet the needs of various customers. Logistics properties are equipped with high floor loading and floor height. The Company is managed by CapitaLand Ascendas REIT Management Limited.

name: CORTINA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Cortina Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company provides management services to its subsidiaries and associates. The Company operates through three segments: Retail, Wholesale, and Others. The Retail segment is involved in retailing of timepieces, branded pens, and accessories. The Wholesale segment is involved in wholesale of timepieces and luxury branded accessories. The Others operation include provision of other support services. The Company hosts a collection of international brands, including Rolex, Patek Philippe, Cartier, Chopard, H. Moser & Cie, Parmigiani Fleurier, Omega, and others. Its geographical segments include Singapore, South East Asia, North East Asia and Other countries. The Company's subsidiaries include Cortina Watch Sdn Bhd, Pactime HK Limited, Pacific Time Pte Ltd, Cortina Watch (Thailand) Co. Ltd, Sincere Watch Limited, Montre Royale Distributors (Singapore) Pte Ltd, Suntime Watch Pte. Ltd., and others.

name: OKP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: OKP Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based infrastructure and civil engineering company. The Company’s principal activities are road and building construction and maintenance, technical management and consultancy services, civil engineering projects in respect of oil, petrochemical and gas-related businesses, rental services and investment holding, property development, and transport and logistics services. The Company’s segments include Construction, Maintenance, and Rental income. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction of urban infrastructure roads, expressways, vehicular bridges, airports infrastructure, and oil and gas-related infrastructure. The Maintenance segment is engaged in re-construction work performed on roads, pavements, footpaths and curbs, guardrails, and drains, among others. Its Rental income segment relates to income received for the rental of investment properties. The Company's development properties include The Essence and Phoenix Residences.

name: CAPITAMALL TRUST
businessSummary: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust (the Trust) is a Singapore-based real estate investment trust (REIT). The Trust owns and invests in income-producing assets primarily used for commercial (including retail and/or office) purpose, located predominantly in Singapore. The Trust's retail portfolio includes Bedok Mall, Bugis+, Bugis Junction, Bukit Panjang Plaza, Clarke Quay, IMM Building, Junction 8, Lot One Shoppers' Mall, Tampines Mall, and Westgate. Its office portfolio includes Asia Square Tower 2, Capital Tower, CapitaGreen, Six Battery Road, Gallileo and Main Airport Center, Germany and 66 Goulburn Street, Australia. Its integrated development portfolio includes CapitaSpring, Funan, Raffles City Singapore, Plaza Singapura, The Atrium@Orchard, and 101 - 103 Miller Street and Greenwood Plaza, Sydney, Australia. The Trust is managed by CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust Management Limited.

name: THOMSON MEDICAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Thomson Medical Group Limited is a Singapore-based company engaged in investments, investment holdings and strategic investments and other related activities. The Company’s subsidiaries are engaged in operating hospitals and clinics, and provision of healthcare services. Its segments include Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, and investment holdings. It is engaged in the provision of integrated medical healthcare facilities and services for primary, secondary and tertiary healthcare with a focus on obstetrics and gynecology and pediatric services, diagnostic imaging services, pharmacy, 24-hour outpatient services, laboratory and services provided by outpatient clinics at the hospital. Its specialized services include services provided by fertility clinics, pediatric centers, cancer centers, cardiology centers, Traditional Chinese Medicine, and others. Its brands include Thomson Women's Clinic, Thomson Paediatric Clinic, Thomson Specialists, Thomson Fertility Centre, and others.

name: UNITED OVERSEAS BANK LTD
businessSummary: United Overseas Bank Limited is a Singapore-based bank. Its segments include Group Retail, Group Wholesale Banking and Global Markets. Group Retail segment covers individual customers. Customers have access to a diverse range of products and services, including deposits, insurance, card, wealth management, investment and loan products which are available across its global branch network. Group Wholesale Banking segment encompasses corporate and institutional client segments which include small, medium and large enterprises, local and multi-national corporations, financial sponsors and property funds. It provides customers with a range of products and services, including loans, trade services, cash management, capital markets solutions and advisory and treasury products. Global Markets provides a comprehensive suite of treasury products and services across multi-asset classes which include foreign exchange, interest rate, credit, commodities, equities and structured investment products.

name: DBS GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: DBS Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company. The Company operates through its subsidiary, DBS Bank Ltd., which is engaged in commercial banking and financial services, principally in Asia. Its segments include Institutional Banking, Consumer Banking/ Wealth Management and Treasury Markets, and Others. Consumer Banking/ Wealth Management segment provides individual customers with a diverse range of banking and related financial services. Its products and services available to customers include current and savings accounts, fixed deposits, loans and home finance, cards, payments, investment, and insurance products. The Institutional Banking segment provides financial services and products to institutional clients, including bank and non-bank financial institutions, government-linked companies, large corporates and small and medium-sized businesses. Its Treasury Markets segment includes structuring, market-making and trading across a broad range of treasury products.

name: TAT SENG PACKAGING GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Tat Seng Packaging Group Ltd is a Singapore-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing and sales of corrugated paper products and other packaging products. The Company's geographical segments include Singapore and the People's Republic of China (PRC). The Company's products include corrugated paper boards, corrugated paper cartons, die-cut boxes, assembly cartons and heavy-duty corrugated packaging products. It also carries and sells a range of other packaging related products. Its customers include multi-national corporations and local manufacturers in food and beverage industry, electronics and electrical industry, pharmaceutical and chemical industry, plastic and metal stamping industry as well as other exporting related industries. The Company's subsidiaries include United Packaging Industries Pte. Ltd., Tat Seng Packaging (Suzhou) Co., Ltd., Hefei Dansun Packaging Co., Ltd., and Tianjin Dansun Packaging Co., Ltd.

name: UMS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: UMS Integration Limited is a Singapore-based precision engineering. The Company specializes in manufacturing high precision front-end semiconductor components and perform complex electromechanical assembly and final testing services. Its core business includes production of modular and integration systems for original semiconductor equipment manufacturers. The Company also cater to other industries including in electronic, machine tools, aerospace and oil and gas industries. Its segments include Semiconductor (Semicon), Aerospace, and Others. The Company’s products and services include precision machining, metal finishing process, system integration, refurbishment, prototyping, and vendor managed inventory. Its precision machining services include milling, lathe, horizontal, cleaning, and anodizing. Its Metal Finishing Process services include electroless nickel, selective nickel, anodizing, plating, parts refurbishment, and chemical cleaning.

name: HYFLUX LTD
businessSummary: Hyflux Ltd is a Singapore-based global provider of sustainable solutions. The Company is principally engaged in offering water treatment solutions and operates as desalination plant providers. The Company also provides waste-to-energy solutions. The Company operates water, wastewater, water recycling, desalination, and power plants located in Asia, the Middle East and Africa. It owns and operates Singspring Desalination Plant, Singapore; Tuaspring Integrated Water & Power Project (IWPP), Singapore; Magtaa Desalination Plant, Algeria; Souk Tleta Desalination Plant, Algeria, and Tianjin Dagang Desalination Plant, China. The Company’s products include FerroCep stainless steel tubular membranes, PoroCep hollow fiber submerged membrane, Kristal polymeric hollow fiber ultrafiltration (UF) membrane, PoroCep membrane bioreactor (MBR) packaged systems, and Hyflux standard membrane systems.

name: SINGAPORE EXCHANGE LTD
businessSummary: Singapore Exchange Limited is a securities and derivatives market infrastructure company. The principal activities of the Company are those of investment holding, treasury management, provision of management and administrative services to related corporations, provision of market data and technology connectivity services. Its segments include Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities; Equities-Cash; Equities-Derivatives; Platform and Others; and Corporate. The Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities segment is engaged in the provision of fixed income issuer services, derivatives trading and clearing services and collateral management. The Equities-Cash segment provides issuer services, securities trading and clearing, securities settlement and depository management. The Equities-Derivatives segment is engaged in the provision of derivatives trading and clearing and collateral management. The Platform and Others segment provides various services associated with the platform businesses.

name: SINGAPORE SHIPPING CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Singapore Shipping Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is a shipping group, which offers ship owning, ship management, ship agency and terminal operations, and logistics services. The Company operates through two segments: Ship owning and Agency and logistics. The Ship owning segment includes ship owning and ship management. The Agency and logistics segment includes shipping agency, terminal operations, warehousing and logistics services. The Company’s vessels include Boheme, Sirius Leader, Capricornus Leader, Centaurus Leader, and Taurus Leader. Its logistics services include international sea / airfreight forwarding, door-to-door delivery, vessel / aircraft charters, customs clearance and documentation, arrange for certificate of origin, carnet shipment, distribution, warehousing and storage, cross trade shipment, project management, and packing and re-packing of spare parts and container stuffing.

name: ADDVALUE TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Addvalue Technologies Ltd is a Singapore-based satellite communications company. The Company's principal activity is that of investment holding. The Company, through its subsidiaries, is engaged in the design and development of telecommunication systems and hardware and the distribution of telecommunication equipment and related products. Its business segments include Space Connectivity (SPC) Related Business, Advance Digital Radio (ADR) Related Business, Satcom Connectivity (STC) Related Business and Design Engineering Services (DES) Related Business. It provides satellite-based communication and other digital broadband products and solutions for a variety of connectivity for applications at seas, on land, on flight and in space. Its technologies include radio design, embedded design, defense / space design, product design and solutions design. Its products include ADRS1000, SABRE Ranger 5000, Wideye iFleetONE, Wideye iSavi, SAFARI and SAFARI 10, and SABRE Ranger M2M.

name: TREK 2000 INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Trek 2000 International Ltd is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in the ownership of a portfolio of intellectual property. The Company operates through four segments: Customised solutions, offers design solutions that incorporate its software, hardware and firmware; Interactive consumer solutions segment, provides external storage solutions; Renewable energy solutions, offers artificial intelligence solutions to manage renewable energy activities; and Corporate, comprises the corporate office in Singapore. The Company, through its subsidiaries, is engaged in research, design, development and dealing in computer hardware, software, and electronic components; marketing and distribution of computer peripherals and electronic components, and development and marketing of Web portal services, including social networking sites. Trek, ThumbDrive, and FluCard are trademarks or registered trademarks of the Company in Singapore and/or other countries.

name: SIA ENGINEERING COMPANY LTD
businessSummary: SIA Engineering Company Limited is a provider of aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) services, inventory technical management, line maintenance, technical ground handling services, and investment holdings. The Company's airframe and line maintenance segment provides airframe maintenance, line maintenance, and inventory technical management. The line maintenance program provides aircraft certification and technical ground handling services, such as push-back and towing, as well as the provision of aircraft ground support equipment and rectification work. Inventory technical management encompasses fleet technical management and inventory technical management services, which include the provision of comprehensive engineering and MRO solutions that can be customized to provide maintenance support to airlines. The Company’s engine and component segment provides component overhaul and engine repair and overhaul services.

name: SATS LTD
businessSummary: SATS Ltd. is an air cargo and ground handler empowering end-to-end network solutions, and an Asian aviation food solutions provider. Its Food Solutions segment provides mainly inflight and institutional catering, food processing, distribution services and airline laundry services. Its Singapore Hub business unit is focused on driving aviation hub competitiveness in Singapore. By focusing on Singapore, this unit supports the needs of Singapore’s Air Hub, which groups Changi Airport, Seletar Airport and the aviation industries at these gateways. Gateway Services Asia-Pacific unit will manage operations in overseas airports, including its network of overseas stations in the Asia-Pacific via its subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates to deliver a service to its customers. Its Others segment provides rental of premises and other services. It connects people, businesses, and communities seamlessly through its comprehensive gateway services for its customers.

name: STAMFORD LAND CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Stamford Land Corporation Ltd is a Singapore-based investment holding company. It is an independent owner and operator of luxury hotels in Australia, and an established real estate developer and investor. The Company has five reportable segments. The Hotel owning and management segment which possesses the ownership and management of hotels. The Property development segment which is engaged in the development, construction, and trading in properties. The Property investment segment is focused on holding of properties for rental income and/or capital appreciation. The Trading segment manages interior decoration companies and a travel agency. The Others segment manages corporate services for the Company, treasury functions and investments in securities. The Company owns and operates multiple portfolios of luxury, high-end Stamford Hotels in cities and prime locations throughout Australia, including Sydney, Adelaide, Melbourne, and Brisbane.

name: FOOD EMPIRE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Food Empire Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in branding and manufacturing in the food and beverage industry. The Company's product portfolio includes instant beverages, snack foods and food ingredients. It offers a range of branded beverages and snacks, including classic and flavored coffee mixes and cappuccinos, chocolate drinks, fruit-flavored tea, bubble tea, instant cereal blends, and crispy potato snacks. Its food ingredients business includes freeze dry and spray dry instant coffee, as well as non-dairy creamer. The Company's brands include MacCoffee, CafePHO, Petrovskaya Sloboda, Klassno, Hillway, Kracks, Hillway, CafeRite, MacTea, Kracks, Tazzanera, and others. Its geographical segments include Russia; Ukraine, Kazakhstan and CIS markets; South-East Asia; South Asia, and Others. The Company has approximately eight manufacturing facilities in five countries and 23 offices worldwide.

name: MANUFACTURING INTEGRATION TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: Manufacturing Integration Technology Ltd. is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in the design, development, manufacturing and distribution of automated equipment for the semiconductor and other industries. The Company offers its services to the semiconductor, consumer electronics, solar, healthcare & medical devices, precision engineering and automotive industries. It operates through two segments: Build-to-print and Customized automation. The Build-to-print segment is mainly engaged in contract equipment manufacturing activities. Its Customized automation segment is mainly engaged in designing, developing, and manufacturing of automated equipment. The segment offers smart automation technologies, including Industry 4.0, Robotic Assembly, Mobile Robotics, High Speed Precision Assembly and Vision Technology. Its subsidiaries include Casem (Asia) Pte Ltd, Automated Manufacturing Solutions Pte. Ltd, Semiconductor Precision Technology Pte Ltd, and others.

name: RH PETROGAS LTD
businessSummary: Rh Petrogas Limited is a Singapore-based independent upstream oil and gas company. The principal activities of the Company include trading, investment holding, and exploration and production of oil and gas. The Company operates in only one reportable segment, which is exploration and production of oil and gas. The Company and its subsidiaries operate across a range of upstream activities covering the exploration, development and production of oil and gas resources. Its assets include The Kepala Burung PSC, and Salawati Kepala Burung PSC, which are located in West Papua, Indonesia. The Kepala Burung PSC is located onshore in the Bird’s Head area of West Papua in eastern Indonesia, covering an area of approximately 1,030 square kilometers (km2). The Salawati PSC covers an area of approximately 1,137 km2 both onshore and offshore. The Company’s subsidiaries include RH Petrogas Investments Pte. Ltd., and Tri-M Technologies Inc.

name: VICPLAS INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Vicplas International Ltd is a Singapore-based holding company. The Company operates through two segments: Medical devices and Pipes & pipe fittings. Its Medical devices segment designs, develops and manufactures sterile and non-sterile medical devices. It operates Medical devices segment, through its subsidiaries, Forefront Medical Technology (Pte) Ltd, Forefront Medical Investment Pte. Ltd., and XentiQ (Pte.) Ltd. in Singapore; Forefront (Xiamen) Medical Devices Co., Ltd and Forefront Medical Technology (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd in China, and Arrow Medical Limited in the United Kingdom. Its Pipes & pipe fittings segment manufactures and distributes piping systems for industries, including waste and potable water systems for residential homes, schools, commercial and industrial buildings, and underground electrical systems. It operates Pipes & pipe fittings segment, through its wholly owned subsidiaries, Vicplas Holdings Pte Ltd in Singapore and Rimplas Industries Sdn. Bhd. in Malaysia.

name: CSE GLOBAL LTD
businessSummary: CSE Global Limited is a global technologies company. The Company is a systems integrator providing electrification, communications, and automation solutions across various industries globally. It designs and builds customised, integrated systems for its clients that solve their problems. It is a solutions provider for the design, engineering, procurement, and integration of highly complex electrical distribution and power systems for the data center, industrial, manufacturing, and utility/energy markets. Its communications solutions include two-way radio communications; very small aperture terminal (VSAT) satellite communication networks, fiber optic systems, microwave radio systems, and others. Its automation solutions include process control system, wellhead control system, supervisory control and data acquisition systems (SCADA), subsea control system, safety shutdown system, fire and gas detection system, real-time information system, and process skid system, among others.

name: SPINDEX INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Spindex Industries Limited is a Singapore-based company that carries on the business as an importer, exporter, and dealer of mechanical, electrical, and electronic parts. The principal activities of the subsidiaries are manufacturing and trading mechanical, electrical, electronic parts, precision machine parts, and other engineering materials. The Company’s segments include Imaging and printing, Machinery and automotive systems, and Consumer machinery and others (data storage, telecommunications, and others). It is a precision engineering manufacturer with core competencies in turning, machining, grinding, surface treatments, mechanical sub-assemblies. Its geographical segments include China, ASEAN (excludes Singapore), USA, Europe and others, and Singapore. It serves diverse market sectors consisting of imaging and printing, machinery and automotive systems, and consumer-related products.

name: HONG LEONG ASIA LTD
businessSummary: Hong Leong Asia Ltd. is an investment holding company. The principal activities of the Company and its subsidiaries are those relating to the manufacturing and distribution of diesel engines and related products, building materials, rigid packaging products, and investment holding and dealing. Its segments are Powertrain solutions, Building materials, and Rigid packaging. The Powertrain solutions segment is engaged in engines for on-road, off-road, genset, and marine applications. The Building materials segment consists of cement, precast concrete products, ready-mix concrete, and quarry products. The Rigid packaging segment includes plastic packaging related products and container components. It manufactures, assembles, and sells a variety of light, medium and heavy-duty engines for trucks, buses, passenger vehicles, and agricultural applications. It offers various grades of ready-mix concrete and precast concrete elements for construction.

name: INNOTEK LTD
businessSummary: InnoTek Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is a precision metal components manufacturer, providing metal stamping, commercial tool and die fabrications, and precision machining works. The Company's segments include Precision Components and Tooling, and Precision Machining. The Precision Components and Tooling segment specializes in sales of stamping components, tooling design and fabrication to a range of industries such as automotive components, office automation and consumer electronics products. It also provides die making services to manufacturers of such products. The Precision Machining segment specializes in the machining of products mainly from the television (TV) and office automation industries. This segment also has a specialty in metal-related components for customers in the TV, tablets and mobile-phone industries through advanced technologies like cold-forging, computer numerical control machining and surface decoration.

name: SBS TRANSIT LTD
businessSummary: SBS Transit Ltd is a Singapore-based company that is engaged in the provision of public transport services, such as bus and rail services. The Company operates approximately 222 bus services with a fleet of over 3,572 buses. It operates approximately 78 stations, comprising 16 MRT stations on the North East Line (NEL), 34 MRT stations on the Downtown Line (DTL), and 28 Light Rail Transit (LRT) stations on the Sengkang-Punggol LRT (SPLRT) systems. It operates through two segments: Public Transport Services and Other Commercial Services. The Public Transport Services segment is engaged in the provision of bus and rail services to commuters traveling on public transport systems. The Other Commercial Services segment is engaged in advertisements on buses and trains and at bus interchanges and rail stations, and rental collections from commercial and shop space at bus interchanges and rail stations. Its subsidiaries include SBS Transit Rail Pte. Ltd and SBS Transit Mobility Pte. Ltd.

name: SAMUDERA SHIPPING LINE LTD
businessSummary: Samudera Shipping Line Ltd is a Singapore-based company, which is primarily engaged in the transportation of containerized and non-containerized cargo through its container shipping and bulk and tanker business segments. The principal activities of the Company are the owning and operating of ocean-going ships and the provision of containerized feeder shipping services. The Company’s segments include Container Shipping, Bulk and Tanker, and Agencies and Logistics. The Container Shipping segment provides feeder services for the transportation of containerized cargo between Singapore as a hub port and other outgoing spoke ports in Asia, as well as inter-region and intra-region container shipping services to end users. The Bulk and Tanker segment provides transportation of special dry bulk, liquid and gas cargo in the international as well as Indonesian domestic market. The Agencies and Logistics segment includes forwarding, agency and other services.

name: HYPHENS PHARMA INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: Hyphens Pharma International Limited is a Singapore-based specialty pharmaceutical and consumer healthcare company. The Company's principal activities are those of an investment holding company and provision of management services. The Company's segments include Specialty pharma principals, Proprietary brands, and Medical hypermart and digital. The Specialty pharma principals segment is engaged in the business of marketing and selling a range of specialty pharmaceutical products with exclusivity in the relevant ASEAN countries. The Proprietary brands segment is engaged in the business of developing, marketing and selling its own proprietary range of dermatological products and health supplement products. The Medical hypermart and digital segment is a wholesaler of pharmaceuticals and medical supplies in Singapore, which the Company and its subsidiaries position themselves as a medical hypermart for healthcare professionals, healthcare institutions and retail pharmacies.

name: APAC REALTY LTD
businessSummary: APAC Realty Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is primarily engaged in owning and operating the master franchise rights relating to the ERA Real Estate brand for sale and licensing to sub-franchisees in the Asia Pacific region. The Company operates through three segments: Real estate brokerage income, Rental income, and Others. The Real estate brokerage income segment relates to commission and fee income from the brokerage of resale and rental of residential, commercial, and industrial properties, and new residential projects for sale by various developers. The Rental income segment includes rental income generated from properties, workstations, lockers, and furniture. Its Others segment includes incentives, referral, professional indemnity insurance, business conference income, and miscellaneous income. Its subsidiaries include Realty International Associates Pte Ltd and APAC Investment Pte Ltd.

name: ASPEN (GROUP) HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Aspen (Group) Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is principally engaged in property development and restaurants. The Company's segments include: Property Development and Others. The Property Development segment is engaged in the development of residential and commercial properties. Its Others segment includes sales of food and beverages, and investment holdings. The property development segment’s ongoing projects include Vivo Executive Apartment and Viluxe Phase 1, Vertu Resort, and Beacon Executive Suites. The Company's subsidiaries are Aspen Vision All Sdn. Bhd. (AV All) and Kanada-Ya SG Pte. Ltd. (Kanada-Ya SG).

name: UNION GAS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Union Gas Holdings Limited is an investment holding company. The Company and its subsidiaries are engaged in providing fuel products. It has three segments: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), Natural Gas (NG), and Diesel. The LPG segment is engaged in bottling LPG, and the sale and distribution of bottled LPG and LPG-related accessories and services to dealers, domestic households, and industrial and commercial customers. The Natural Gas segment is engaged in the sale and distribution of liquefied natural gas and piped natural gas to commercial customers, and the retail sale of compressed natural gas (CNG) through a CNG refueling station. The Diesel segment is engaged in the sale and distribution of diesel to commercial customers and to vehicles through a diesel refueling station. The NG segment operates a 24-hour fuel station under the Cnergy brand at 50 Old Toh Tuck Road. The station has approximately 14 compressed NG dispensers with two nozzles each and is open to the public.

name: HRNETGROUP LTD
businessSummary: HRnetGroup Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. It is a recruitment and staffing company in Asia. The Company operates in three segments: Professional Recruitment, Flexible Staffing, and Others. It provides professional recruitment services primarily under its HRnetOne, PeopleSearch, PeopleFirst, and SearchAsia brands and staffing solutions under its RecruitExpress and RecruitFirst brands. The Company sources, recommends, and hires contractors on its payroll on a back-to-back basis. It provides recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) services, including workplace analysis and planning, contract negotiation, customized recruitment process and assessment, onboarding and offboarding, recruitment marketing programs, employee liaison and management, interviews, recommendations, and selection. It has approximately 18 brands, 40 business units across 17 Asian cities, and over 900 consultants. Its subsidiaries include HRnet One Pte Ltd and Recruit Express Pte Ltd.

name: UNI-ASIA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Uni-Asia Group Limited is a Singapore-based alternative investment company. The Company is focused on providing asset/investment management services pertaining to ships and properties, as well as advisory services. The Company’s segments include Shipping and Property and Hotels. Shipping segment has three sub segments such as Uni-Asia Shipping, Maritime Asset Management, and Maritime Services. Property and Hotels segment has three sub segments such as Property Investment (ex Japan), Property Investment (in Japan), and Vista Hotel Management. The Company provides a range of services including asset/ investment management, finance arrangement, sale and purchase brokerage of ships and properties, ship chartering as a ship owner, ship chartering brokerage, ship technical management, project management, property development/ construction management, property management and leasing arrangements, and hotel operation.

name: KIMLY LTD
businessSummary: Kimly Limited is a Singapore-based coffee shop operator. The Company operates through three segments. The outlet management segment is involved in the leasing of food outlet premises to tenants as the leaseholder, the sale of food, beverages, and tobacco products, and the provision of cleaning and utility services. The outlet investment business segment involves investment in properties (freehold or leasehold) to benefit from rental income and/or capital growth. The food retail segment comprises Mixed Vegetable Rice stalls, Teochew Porridge stalls, Dim Sum stalls, Seafood Zi Char stalls, Japanese food stalls, and Western food stalls, which operate within the Company’s coffee shops, third-party coffee shops, food courts, food kiosks, and full-service restaurants. The food retail segment is also engaged in the manufacturing, processing, and sale of food products to customers. These food products are also available for online ordering through multiple delivery platforms.

name: HC SURGICAL SPECIALISTS LTD
businessSummary: HC Surgical Specialists Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company, together with its subsidiaries, are engaged in providing medical services. It is primarily involved in the provision of endoscopic procedures, including gastroscopies and colonoscopies, and general surgery services, with a focus on colorectal procedures across a network of clinics located throughout Singapore. Its businesses include facilities and clinics, and specialist surgeons and general practitioners. It operates a network of clinics located throughout Singapore, in both residential areas and central areas, which are accessible to the public for consultation. Its clinics have facilities needed to perform a range of procedures on-site, including endoscopic procedures and other minor surgical services. Its subsidiaries include Heah Sieu Min (Mt E) Pte. Ltd., Heah Sieu Min (Bukit Batok) Pte. Ltd., CKH (Farrer Park) Pte. Ltd., HC (Siglap) Pte. Ltd., HC (TPY) Pte. Ltd., Malcolm Lim Pte. Ltd.

name: EC WORLD REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST
businessSummary: EC World Real Estate Investment Trust is a Singapore-based real estate investment trust (REIT). The Company is engaged in investing principally, directly, or indirectly, in a diversified portfolio of income-producing real estate that is used primarily for e-commerce, supply-chain management, and logistics purposes, as well as real estate-related assets, with an initial geographical focus on the People’s Republic of China (PRC). Its segments include port logistics, specialized logistics, and e-commerce logistics. The Company’s portfolio comprises properties located in the Yangtze River Delta. Its properties include Chongxian Port Investment, Chongxian Port Logistics, Hengde Logistics, Wuhan Meiluote, Fuzhou E-Commerce, and Fu Heng Warehouse. The Company is managed by EC World Asset Management Pte. Ltd.

name: HAW PAR CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Haw Par Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based holding company. The principal activities of the Company are licensing the Tiger trademarks and owning and holding investments for the long term. Its segments include Healthcare products, Investments and Others. Its Healthcare products segment is engaged in manufacturing and distributing topical analgesic products under the Tiger Balm and Kwan Loong brands. Its Investments segment is engaged in long-term investing activities, mainly in quoted securities in Asia. Its Others segment includes the property division, which owns and leases out several investment properties in Asia, and the leisure division, which provides family and tourist-oriented leisure activities in the form of oceanariums. Its Tiger Balm brand offers products such as Tiger Balm White Ointment, Tiger Balm Muscle Rub, Tiger Balm Back Pain Patch, and Tiger Balm Muscle Rub. Its Kwan Loong brand offers products such as Kwan Loong Medicated Oil and Kwan Loong Refresher.

name: ANCHUN INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Anchun International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company. The Company provides integrated chemical systems engineering, environmental system engineering and technology solutions to the People's Republic of China (PRC) petrochemical and chemical industry. Its segments include Catalyst Business, which is involved in the manufacturing of a variety of catalysts for use in the process of gas-making, ammonia synthesis and methanol synthesis; Chemical Engineering and Technology (CET) Engineering Services, which is involved in providing chemical systems engineering and technology design services for the production of ammonia and methanol related products, such as agriculture fertilizers and biodiesel, which are mainly used in the agriculture and energy industries, and Chemical Systems and Components (CSC) Business, which is involved in the manufacturing of chemical equipment designed by the chemical engineering and technology consultancy services department.

name: BAKER TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: Baker Technology Limited is an investment holding company, which offers the provision of specialized marine offshore equipment and services for the oil and gas and renewables sectors. The Company and its subsidiaries, engage in the design, construction, operation and chartering of mobile offshore units and offshore supply vessels, along with the design and construction of a range of critical equipment and components for the marine offshore industry. Its products and services include offshore pedestal cranes, anchor winches, skidding systems, jacking systems, raw water tower structures and wind turbine installation equipment, among others. It has three operating segments. The marine offshore segment comprises manufacturers and providers of specialized marine offshore equipment and services for the oil and gas industry. The investments segment relates to the investments in available-for-sale investments. The corporate segment is engaged in corporate services and treasury functions.

name: A-SONIC AEROSPACE LTD
businessSummary: A-Sonic Aerospace Limited is a Singapore-based company, which is engaged in investment holding and provision of management services. The Company operates through two business segments: Aviation and Logistics. The Company's Aviation segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of aircraft and aircraft engines. Its Logistics segment is engaged in providing supply chain management services. The Company specializes in various aspects of logistic solutions, including international and domestic multi-modal transportation, warehousing, distribution, customs clearance, and airport ground services. The Company operates in approximately 28 cities in 15 countries, spanning four continents in Asia, North America, Europe, and Sub-Continent India. Its subsidiaries include A-Sonic Aviation Solutions Pte. Ltd., A-Sonic Logistic Solutions Pte. Ltd. and A-Sonic SCM Private Limited.

name: HG METAL MANUFACTURING LTD
businessSummary: HG Metal Manufacturing Limited is a Singapore-based company, which is engaged in the business of trading of steel products and investment holding. The Company's segments include trading, manufacturing and Others. The trading segment is a supplier of steel products and includes the holding of investments in subsidiaries in the business of steel distribution and provision of industrial steel services. The manufacturing segment produces construction steel products and provides related engineering services. The others segment includes those which do not fall in trading and manufacturing segment. Its subsidiaries include Oriental Metals Pte Ltd, HG Construction Steel Pte Ltd, HG Metal Investments Pte Ltd, and HG Construction Steel Pte Ltd.

name: RAFFLES MEDICAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Raffles Medical Group Ltd is a Singapore-based integrated private healthcare provider. The principal activities of the Company are those relating to the operation of medical clinics, other general medical services, and investment holdings. The Company’s segments include Healthcare Services, Hospital Services, and Investment Holdings. The Healthcare Services segment is engaged in the operations of medical clinics and other general medical services, provision of health insurance, trading in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products and diagnostic equipment, and provision of management and consultancy services. The Hospital Services segment is engaged in the provision of specialized medical services and operation of hospital and business of medical laboratory and imaging center. The Investment Holdings segment is engaged in investment holding and those relating to investment properties. It operates medical facilities in over 14 cities in Singapore, China, Japan, Vietnam, and Cambodia.

name: A-SMART HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: A-Smart Holdings Ltd. is an investment holding company. The principal activities of the Company include property development and real estate investment; smart technologies; print and media, and other investments. The Company’s segments include Print and Media, Property, Smart Technologies, and Corporate and Others. The Print and Media segment is engaged in the printing of financial research reports, annual reports, asset management reports, initial public offering prospectuses and corporate brochures, among others, as well as engaged in events management. The Property segment is engaged in the property development business. The Smart Technologies segment is engaged in the development, sale and redistribution of smart information technology (IT) solutions, gadgets, and software and hardware products. The Company's subsidiaries include Xpress Print (Pte) Ltd, A-Smart Property Holdings Pte. Ltd., A-Smart Commerce Pte. Ltd., A-Smart Investments Pte. Ltd., and A-Smart Media Pte. Ltd.

name: YHI INTERNATIONAL LIMITED
businessSummary: YHI International Limited is an investment holding company. The Company’s activities are distribution of automotive and related products and manufacturing of alloy wheels. It distributes a range of automotive products, which include tires, alloy wheels, energy solutions, buggy and utility vehicles, and other industrial products. Its segments are Manufacturing, Distribution and Rental. The Manufacturing segment includes regional areas, such as North East Asia and Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), which are engaged in the manufacturing of alloy wheels. Distribution segment includes regional areas, such as North East Asia, ASEAN, Oceania, the United States, and Europe regions, which are engaged in the distribution of automotive and industrial products. Rental segment includes regional area that covers North East Asia, which is engaged in rental activities. It has three alloy wheels manufacturing plants located in Suzhou in China, Taoyuan in Taiwan and Malacca in Malaysia.

name: EINDEC CORP LTD
businessSummary: Eindec Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based regional manufacturer and distributor of clean air environmental technology solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial customers, offering customized proprietary products and services. Its segments include Clean room equipment, Heating ventilation and air-conditioning products, Air purification integrated solutions and Others. A clean room provides an environment where humidity, temperature and particles in the air are precisely controlled. Clean room equipment includes fan filter units, air showers, clean booths, pass boxes, clean hand dryers and clean benches. Heating ventilation and air-conditioning products are essentially deflection grilles and air diffusers installed to channel and regulate the airflow into the environment within the building to ensure an even distribution of air within the confined space. Air purification equipment is electrical devices that remove solid and gaseous pollutants from the air.

name: ZIXIN GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Zixin Group Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based sweet potato biotech-focused value chain operator in China. The Company operates through four core business areas: cultivation and supply, product innovation and snacks production, and brand building, marketing, and distribution, and recovery and recycling. It operates its cultivation and supply business through its subsidiary, Liancheng Dizhongbao Modern Agriculture Development Co., Ltd, which is engaged in research and development of sweet potato varieties; cultivation of sweet potato seedlings; provide farming solutions and technique, and fresh sweet potato supply. The Company operates product innovation and food production business. It operates brand building, marketing, and distribution building of proprietary brands of healthier snacks through targeted marketing campaigns and various distribution platforms (traditional and e-commerce) throughout China.

name: GRP LTD
businessSummary: GRP Limited is a Singapore-based company that is engaged in the investment holding and rental of properties. The Company's segments include Hose & Marine, Measuring Instruments / Metrology, and Property. The Hose & Marine segment is engaged in engineering works and hose management services, such as the design and manufacture of hose fittings and couplings, and provides services to the onshore, offshore, marine, pharmaceutical, and petrochemical markets. The Measuring Instruments / Metrology segment is engaged in the trading and distribution of precision measuring instruments and equipment. The Property segment is engaged in property development activities, such as acquiring and holding property-related assets and trading in properties. Its subsidiaries include GRP Land Pte Ltd, GRP Pte Ltd, Region Suppliers (Pte) Limited, GRP Suppliers Pte Ltd, and Region Suppliers Sdn Bhd. Region Suppliers Sdn Bhd is engaged in trading of measuring instruments and scientific apparatus.

name: HAI LECK HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Hai Leck Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based company. The Company is engaged in investment holding and the provision of managerial, administrative, supervisory, and consultancy services to companies in which it has an interest. It operates two segments: Project and Maintenance Services and Contact Centre Services. The Project and Maintenance Services segment includes scaffolding erection, corrosion protection, thermal insulation, refractory services, and mechanical engineering. The Contact Centre Services segment focuses on outsourced solutions, offering professional and integrated services such as customer service support, technical helpdesk, virtual receptionist services, lead generation, live web chat, and email management. Its subsidiaries include Hai Leck Engineering (Private) Limited, Hai Leck Engineering & Construction Pte. Ltd., Hai Leck Industrial Services Pte. Ltd., Hai Leck Integrated Services Pte. Ltd., Hai Leck Services Pte. Ltd., and Tele-centre Services Pte Ltd.

name: KODA LTD
businessSummary: Koda Ltd is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The principal activities of the Company are those relating to the manufacturing and retail, trading and export of furniture and fixtures of wood (including upholstery), furniture design and service. The Company operates through two segments: Manufacturing and Retail and distribution. The Company manufactures furniture using a mix of materials such as metals, glass, fabric, wood, stone, leather, and others. It has a global presence in Europe, Asia-pacific, North America, and others. Its subsidiaries include Jatat Furniture Industries Sdn Bhd, Koda Woodcraft Sdn Bhd, Koda Indochine Co., Ltd, Koda Saigon Co., Ltd, and Commune Lifestyle Sdn Bhd.

name: JUMBO GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Jumbo Group Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is a food and beverage company engaged in the operation and management of restaurants and manufacturing of food. The Company operates in Singapore, the People’s Republic of China, South Korea, and Taiwan. Its brands include JUMBO Seafood, JUMBO Signatures, JUMBO Catering, NG AH SIO Bak Kut Teh, Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine, Zui Yu Xuan Teochew Cuisine, Chao Ting, Kok Kee Wonton Noodle, Lau Lim Mee Pok, Singapore Seafood Republic, XINYAO, and Mutiara Seafood. Mutiara Seafood is a halal Singapore-style seafood restaurant. The Company, through its lifestyle brand Love, Afare, offers a range of products comprising packaged sauces and spice mixes for its signature dishes, snacks, tea, and merchandise. Its JUMBO Catering brand provides catering services for events. Its flagship brand, JUMBO Signatures, offers multiple dining options.

name: VIBROPOWER CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: VibroPower Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in the provision of management and administrative support to its subsidiaries. The Company operates through three segments: Projects, Power plant, and Others. Its Projects segment is engaged in supplying, designing, manufacturing, installing, commissioning and servicing generators used mainly in commercial and industrial projects, as well as housing projects.
