The games offer includes titles such as: Chernobylite, Backfirewall, Exo One or Phantom Hellcat.

name: SYNEKTIK SA
businessSummary: Synektik SA is a Poland-based company active in the medical sector. It produces PACS software which allows running a diagnostic imaging laboratory. It runs a research laboratory which performs acceptance and specialist tests of X-ray equipment. The Company sells medical equipment and operates a services center for imaging equipment. Synektik SA is a partner of Siemens. On November 28, 2013, the Company raised its stake in Miedzynarodowe Centra Medyczne Inwestycje Sp z o o to 100%.

name: SELVITA SA
businessSummary: Selvita SA, formerly Selvita Cro SA, is a Poland-based integrated service company active in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. The Company is engaged in providing multidisciplinary solutions supporting customers and projects within area of drug discovery, regulatory studies, as well as research and development. It offers its clients drug discovery support at every stage of the early discovery phase up to preclinical research, from target validation up to the selection of a clinical candidate. Also, it offers services at every stage of the drug discovery process in the field of drug testing and bioanalytical analyses, from development and validation of methods, stability studies, to routine quality control testing. The Company cooperates with numerous research institutes and universities from Europe and the United States.

name: ONESANO SA
businessSummary: Onesano SA, formerly known as Skotan SA, is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in special foods and wellbeing products business industry. The Company focuses on developing new solutions in the field of human supplementation. Its products contain ultra-pure, concentrated omega-3, 6, and 9 fatty acids in the form of ethyl esters, ensuring high bioavailability and bioretention in the human body. Its offer also includes products with a combination of ingredients, combining the postbiotic Yarrowia lipolytica, food enriched with selenium, and the postbiotic Yarrowia lipolytica food enriched with chromium, with the addition of other plant extracts.

name: SKARBIEC HOLDING SA
businessSummary: Skarbiec Holding SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the field of investment management. The Company’s product portfolio comprises: open end funds, such as Skarbiec Akcja, Skarbiec Lokacyjny and Skarbiec Akcji Nowej Europy; closed end funds, including Skarbiec Rynku Nieruchomosci; fund of funds, offering investment in Skarbiec Top Funduszy Akcji, and Skarbiec Top Funduszy Stabilnych, among others; and a number of pension funds. Its products are primarily based on equities and bonds. Furthermore, It provides portfolio and asset management services that are aimed at high net worth individuals (HNWI), as well as corporate and institutional customers. The Company operates through a subsidiary, named Skarbiec TFI SA.

name: SKYLINE INVESTMENT SA
businessSummary: Skyline Investment SA is a Poland-based consulting company. As an adviser, the Company gains financial funds for entities through public share offers, mergers, takeovers and debentures emissions. Skyline Investment SA focuses its advisory activities on investing in non-public entities, in which it acts as a financial consultant at the initial public offering. The Company’s subsidiaries include Sky Energy Sp z o o, Skyline Insolvency Solutions Sp z o o, SBS Sp z o o, Skyline Development Sp z o o, Skyline Venture Sp z o o, Skyline Interim Management Sp z o o, Skyline Bio Sp z o o, Polska Grupa Odziezowa SA.

name: SHOPER SA
businessSummary: Shoper SA is a Poland-based company, which is an Internet shop using online payments. The Company's software includes all the necessary tools and integrations for a professional online sales: modern payments, bilateral integration with Allegro, courier services and magazines as well as Facebook shop.

name: SESCOM SA
businessSummary: Sescom SA is a Poland-based company engaged in construction services. The Company specializes in provision of management, technical maintenance and repair of buildings' heating, ventilation, air conditioning and electrical installation. Sescom SA provides its services into five business sectors: food trade, finance, telecommunications, construction and commerce. The Company provides services in facilities maintenance and fixed network throughout the domestic market, as well as in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania and Germany. The Company’s client portfolio includes Reserved, Mohito, Gatta, Credit Agricole, Eurobank, Panasonic, Douglas, Jysk and The United Colors of Benetton brands, among others.

name: RYVU THERAPEUTICS SA
businessSummary: Ryvu Therapeutics SA, formerly known as Selvita SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the healthcare industry. The Company is active in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology fields. It operates through two business segments. The Innovative segment develops new drugs mainly for oncology and central nervous system diseases. The Services segment is engaged in the research and development activities, such as introducing substances on the market, client service and reducing the risk. The Company’s portfolio encompasses projects, including kinesis inhibitors platform, the platform of the metabolism for the cancer and epigenetic, among others. Ryvu Therapeutics SA is active in the domestic market and internationally, such as in the United States. It operates through unit Ardigen SA and SORS Holdings Ltd.

name: SELENA FM SA
businessSummary: Selena FM SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction materials sector. The Company produces, distributes and sales construction chemicals and construction related materials. It offers polyurethane foams, including pistol and mounting foams, as well as foam cleaners; silicon and acrylic sealants, and a range of adhesives among others. Selena FM SA’s products are sold under such brands as Tytan Professional, Tytan Industry, Tytan Euro-line and Artelit, among others. The Company sells its products in Poland and it is also present on the foreign markets in Europe, North America and South America, as well as in Asia. The Company, alongside its numerous subsidiaries located both in Poland and abroad, forms a capital group. As of December 31, 2011, it owned 25 subsidiaries in Poland, Germany, Italy, Spain, the United States, Brazil, Romania, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Finland, Bulgaria, Slovakia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, China, the Russian Federation and Turkey.

name: SEKO SA
businessSummary: SEKO SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the fish processing industry. The Company’s product portfolio consists of three groups: marinated fish, including fish products based on salted or fried herring in vinegar and tomato brine; salted fish, encompassing various kinds of herrings; and delicatessen fried fish products, featuring herring, cod and mackerel specialties. The Company also offers fish salads and more than 200 assortment proposals based on herring and mackerel imported from Island, Norway, Denmark and Ireland. SEKO SA has its own processing plant located in Chojnice, Poland. The Company’s products are marketed in Poland and exported to such countries as Germany, the Czech Republic, France, Ireland, England, Italy and the United States, among others.

name: SDS OPTIC SA
businessSummary: SDS Optic SA is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in medical research. The Company’s primary research activity relates to the oncology sector. The Firm wishes to develop a method for early breast cancer diagnosis. The current method of diagnosis relies on biopsy and histopathology. The purpose of the tests is to identify cancer markers. The Company tries to implement InProbe method, which is faster and more accurate- the method should be able to provide results within 20 minutes. The Company is also engaged in research regarding different kinds of diseases such as fungal diseases. The Company cooperates with specialists from different fields such as biology, medicine, technology, and sciences related to medicine.

name: SCOPE FLUIDICS SA
businessSummary: Scope Fluidics SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the biotechnology. The Company focuses on diagnostic and med-tech solutions. It develops disposable microfluidic systems for the collection of micro-samples of blood, as well as storage of reagents for diagnostic markers. Its projects include PCR ONE system that delivers the bacterial and viral pathogen detection, and BacterOMIC system that delivers information on bacterial susceptibility to antibiotics and on the resistance mechanisms. The Company provides access to laboratories and workshops for developed projects, as well as administrative facilities and services, including financing. In addition, it cooperates with doctors, medical personnel, project managers, engineers and academics.

name: DIGITREE GROUP SA
businessSummary: Digitree Group SA, formerly Sare SA, is a Poland-based holding company engaged in the digital marketing industry. The Company provides software solutions, as well as e-marketing services and sales support in the domestic market and internationally. It organizes activities into six segments, based on the operations of the Group companies. SARE offers tools for implementing integrated and targeted communication via e-mail and mobile channels. INIS and JU specialize in e-mail marketing campaigns. Salelifter, Adepto and Cashback Services are engaged in database building, lead generation, financial intermediation and cashback services. VideoTarget provides solutions in the area of video advertising. Sales Intelligence provides marketing tools and software for the e-commerce market. Fast White Cat specializes in creating online shops.

name: SANWIL HOLDING SA
businessSummary: Sanwil Holding SA is a Poland-based holding company that specializes in the production of coated fabrics, ecological leather, and other textiles. The Company produces a range of textile products for multiple business sectors such as the clothing sector, footwear sector, automotive sector, and medical sector among others. The Company's products include knitted fabrics, such as technical cotton and polyester, fur, terry fabrics, and uncut loops fabrics. Additionally, the Firm produces leather imitations. The Company’s products are used as fabrics for furniture coverings and footwear, clothing materials, fabrics for medical and sanitary use, and others. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, including Sanwil Polska Sp z o o, Strazyska Sp z o o, and Strazyska Sp z o o. The Company operates mainly in the domestic market, also in the European Union Countries, and in Belarus and Ukraine.

name: ZAKLADY MAGNEZYTOWE ROPCZYCE SA
businessSummary: Zaklady Magnezytowe Ropczyce SA is a Poland-based company engaged in construction materials industry. The Company’s activity is diversified into two main segments: chemical segment, comprising production and sales of refractory materials; and service segment, offering services to manufacturers of refractory materials and metallurgic works and servicing in the segment of steel structures. Its product portfolio comprises of fired shaped refractories, non-fired shaped frefractories, unshaped refractories, and special products, such as gas-purging plugs, tapping sets, biceramic sets and monolithic castable elements, among others. It operates two subsidiaries, ZM Service Sp. z o.o. and Mostostal-Energomontaz SA.

name: RANK PROGRESS SA
businessSummary: RANK PROGRESS SA is a Poland-based company engaged in property investment and development. It operates in two main segments: real estate rental and real estate sales. Its business model is based on purchase of a real estate, land integration, administrative preparation for development, construction works and management or sale of a property. In addition, it also offers a rental space to shopping centers in main cities across Poland. The Company’s client portfolio includes Tesco, Carrefour, H&M, Empik, Leroy Merlin, Metro-Makro Cash & Carry, Praktiker and others. As of December 31, 2011, it operated through 34 subsidiaries. On November 14, 2012, the Company acquired 100% stake in Gemar - Umech Sp. z o.o. On November 16, 2012, the Company acquired a 100% stake in Rank Recycling Energy Sp. z o.o.

name: RAINBOW TOURS SA
businessSummary: Rainbow Tours SA is a Poland-based tour operator. The Company provides a range of tour options, including city tours, long-distance airplane trips, package holidays, last minute and last second trips, to various destinations worldwide. In addition, it offers online flight ticket reservation services. The Company has 77 branch offices throughout Poland. Additionally, the Company designs information technology (IT) solutions for tourist industry. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated sevens subsidiaries, Portal Turystyczny Sp. z o.o., Rainbour Tours Biuro Podrozy Sp. z o.o., Travelovo Sp. z o.o., Traveltech Sp. z o.o., ABC Swiat Podrozy Sp. z o.o., Bee&Free sp. z o.o. and TravelLab sp. z o.o. On December 4, 2012, the Company sold its entire stake in TravelTech Sp. z o.o.

name: FABRYKA OBRABIAREK RAFAMET SA
businessSummary: Fabryka Obrabiarek Rafamet SA w restrukturyzacji is a Poland-based company engaged in the industrial machinery production. The Company manufactures and sells machine tools for the railway, shipbuilding, steel, paper, aviation, as well as energy industries. The Company’s product range includes the special purpose machine tools, horizontal and wheel lathes, vertical turning and boring mills and milling machines, among others. The Company also runs its own iron foundry and sells its products mainly to the European countries, as well as domestically.

name: REMAK ENERGOMONTAZ SA
businessSummary: Remak Energomontaz SA, formerly know as Przedsiebiorstwo Modernizacji Urzadzen Energetycznych Remak SA (Remak) is a Poland-based company engaged in the provision of engineering services. Its main services comprise the repairs and modernization of steam and water boilers, as well as the assembly of power engineering equipment, fumes desulphurization installations, electrofilters, industrial installations and pipelines. In addition, the Company provides services related to repairs, modernizations and assembly of power engineering facilities such as water and steam boilers, pressure and non-pressure vessels, steam pipelines and repairs of pressure vessels. Remak completed numerous projects on the domestic market and abroad. It operates through its offices in Germany and the Netherlands. As of December 31, 2011, the Company’s main shareholders were Mostostal Warszawa SA, Legg Mason Zarzadzanie Aktywami SA, and PZU SA. In July 2013, the Company sold its entire stake in Rozruch SA.

name: RELPOL SA
businessSummary: Relpol SA is a Polish company specializing in electromagnetic relays. The Company is a producer and wholesaler of relays, industrial automation equipment, control systems, and radiation portal monitors. The Company’s product line is divided into four basic lines, including plug-in power relay, used in industrial applications; printed circuit board (PCB) power relays used as power components in electronic devices; interface relays for automations systems; and relays sockets for connection of relays. Additionally, the Company’s product offering includes: contactors and thermal relays, time relays, monitoring relays, motor protection circuit breakers, lighting and overvoltage protection devices, push-buttons and switches. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated eight subsidiaries, based in Ukraine, Belarus, the Russian Federation, Lithuania, France, the United Kingdom and Poland.

name: REDAN SA
businessSummary: Redan SA W Likwidacji, formerly Redan SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the distribution, wholesale and retail trade of textiles, casual clothes, shoes and accessories. The Company’s business is divided into two segments: Trade, conducting logistics operations such as purchasing goods from suppliers, storing in the warehouse, carrying out customs clearance, packaging before shipment to stores or customers and distributing apparel and clothing accessories Top Secret brand products to foreign customers, and Services segment, providing services in the field of financial management, human resources (HR) and Information Technology (IT), such as management of server infrastructure and computer networks, development of applications for internal needs and interfaces for data exchange.

name: CYBER_FOLKS SA
businessSummary: Cyber_Folks SA, formerly R22 SA, is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in offering hosting services and domain sales. The Company provides Web hosting, domain registration, and related services to help businesses and individuals establish an online presence. The Company also offers omnichannel communication services and operates through a subscription-based model, serving clients in more than 100 countries. The Company provides Website builders and auto-installers, Web hosting and domain services. The Company offers solutions such as: Website creator for Website development, using Artificial intelligence (AI), foreign and new domains registration or transfer as well as Domain Name Builder, which is a tool based on Artificial intelligence that provides domain name suggestions along with its availability status.

name: QUERCUS TOWARZYSTWO FUNDUSZY INWESTYCYJN
businessSummary: Quercus Towarzystwo Funduszy Inwestycyjnych SA is a Poland-based company active in the financial sector. The Company’s principal activities are management of investment funds, portfolio management, investment advisory, and acting as representative of foreign funds, among others. Its offer is mainly targeted at private banking customers. It consists of several subfunds of Quercus umbrella fund: Quercus Opportunity, Querqus Capital Protection, both absolute return type, as well as Quercus Aggresive, Quercus Balkans and Turkey, Quercus Russia, Quercus lev type and Quercus short type, all aggressive growth type.

name: QUANTUM SOFTWARE SA
businessSummary: Quantum Software SA is a Poland-based provider of the information technology (IT) solutions for logistics and supply chain management. The Company’s range of activities includes the software development and custom-made software design, installation and implementation, including hardware elements. Its offering also includes trainings, as well as after-sale support and services. The Company’s main product portfolio includes Qguar, a warehouse and distribution management software and SAP line of products, enterprise management applications, as well as various customized solutions. Its main customers are companies engaged in the operation of distribution centers, warehouses delivering logistic services and engaged in transport logistics. On July 15, 2014, the Company established new wholly owned subsidiary, Quantum Qguar Sp z o o. On July 2014, the Company informed that Quantum Assets sp. z o.o. has transferred its entire stake to its subsidiary, MINVESTA sp zoo.

name: POWSZECHNY ZAKLAD UBEZPIECZEN SA
businessSummary: Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen SA (PZU SA) is a Poland-based joint stock company operating in the sectors of property and casualty insurance. PZU SA is the parent company for numerous entities comprising the PZU Group. The Company provides property and casualty insurance in terms of gross written premiums, with motor insurance for retail and corporate customers as its principal product. PZU Zycie provides life insurance in terms of gross written premiums with group and individual life insurance as its principal products. PTE PZU manages OFE PZU Zlota Jesien, an open pension fund. TFI PZU offers participation units in open investment funds, including specialized open funds; investment certificates in closed investment fund; investment plans; and pension schemes, including Employee Pension Schemes and Individual Pension Accounts. On September 15, 2014, the Company acquired 100% stake in Link4.

name: COMPREMUM
businessSummary: Compremum SA is a Poland-based company which is primarily engaged in construction and engineering sector. The Company's activities are divided into five business segments: Holding activities, which provides business support and advisory services in the field of, among others, accounting and finance, Human resources (HR) and payroll, Information Technology (IT), legal, security support, marketing and administrative services; Construction services, which provides construction services in the field of general, industrial and engineering construction for institutional clients and public entities; Railway division, which provides periodic repairs, maintenance, modernization and inspection of passenger railway wagons; Renewable Energy, which is engaged in construction work related to the photovoltaic farms and sale and servicing of energy storage facilities and Real estate development services, which carries out development projects and construction works as a general contractor.

name: IFIRMA SA
businessSummary: IFirma SA, formerly Power Media SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the provision of Internet services. The Company operates a Website, named ifirma.pl, which enables users to manage business online. Its portal offers a range of business support services, such as online accounting, tool for invoices, warehouse management, financial analysis, as well as customer relationship management (CRM), among others.

name: PJP MAKRUM SA
businessSummary: PJP Makrum SA, formerly known asrProjprzem Makrum SA, is a Poland-based company active in the construction industry. Its business is divided into four segments: Docking Solutions, Steel Constructions, Industrial Construction, and Other, which includes real estate leasing and rental, among others. The Docking Solutions offering includes the production, sale and maintenance of dock levellers, loading ramps, dock shelters, sectional industrial doors and high-speed shutters, among others, under the PromStahl brand. The Steel Constructions comprises mainly industrial halls and warehouses for the power, chemical and environmental industries. The Company operates as a general contractor of construction projects, specializing in the construction of equipped production halls, and additionally delivering also office buildings, shopping centers, supermarkets and residential buildings.

name: PRIMA MODA SA
businessSummary: Prima Moda SA is a Poland-based company active in the footwear industry. It is engaged in the retail sale of men's and women's footwear, leather accessories, such as handbags, and shoe care measures, including shoe polish, shoe foams, and cleaning creams, among others. As of December 31, 2010 Prima Moda SA was selling its products through a network of 44 brand stores located mainly in shopping malls throughout Poland, in such cities as Warsaw, Gdansk, Cracow, Lodz, Poznan, Wroclaw, Szczecin, Lublin and Katowice, among others.

name: NPL NOVA SA
businessSummary: Npl Nova SA, formerly known as Pragma Inkaso SA is a Poland-based company which specializes in servicing bank receivables secured by mortgages. The Company specializes in servicing and investing in mortgage-secured receivables. Its offer include advice, mediation, and comprehensive legal audits, guiding clients through every stage of the transaction process. The Company provides services that cater to banks, individual investors, real estate agents, property owners, entrepreneurs, as well as bailiffs and receivers seeking buyers for various types of real estate, including office buildings, warehouses, land, factories, and apartments. The Company cooperates with the restructuring and debt collection departments of banks and connects them with the world of financial investors. It also helps in the restructuring of bankrupt, unfinished, neglected and abandoned real estate investments into functioning businesses.

name: BLUGO SA
businessSummary: BluGo SA w likwidacji, is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in the financial sector. The Company is operating in the field of debt collecting services. The Company specializes in acquiring debt packages. The Firm collects debt packages from various third parties, which then are proceeded by the Company. The Company purchases consumer debts from telecommunications, insurance, cable television and Internet providers, utility providers, and financial institutions, among others. The Company is also engaged in the automotive charging stations sector. The Company is developing a network of charging stations for electric automotive vehicles. The Company is planning to build approximately 2500 charging stations by 2026.

name: PROCHEM SA
businessSummary: Prochem SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the engineering and construction and environmental sectors. The Company provides such services as construction, including engineering and design, general contracting, project management, technical consulting, construction work, electrical installations and assembly services and rental of construction equipment; leas of office space; maintenance of installations and industrial plants, public buildings and facilities and housing estates; and technical consulting, development and implementation of new technology, integration of data processing systems. The Company operates several subsidiaries, including Elektromontaz Krakow SA, Teoma SA, Iryd Sp z oo, Prochem Inwestycje Sp z oo and Prochem-Zachod Sp z oo, among others.

name: PURE BIOLOGICS SA
businessSummary: Pure Biologics SA is a manufacturer of biological products. The Company was founded in August 2010 and is located in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: KCI SA
businessSummary: KCI SA is a Poland-based company principally engaged in the real estate projects. The Company focuses its activities on the housing investment, mainly located in Krakow and Warsaw in Poland. The Company leads such investments as Kamienice Herbowe and projects in Zablocie, Poland. KCI SA is a parent entity of a capital group, holding such companies as: Ponar Holding Sp. z o.o., PONAR Real Estate sp. z o.o., active in the real estate sector; KCI Centrum Zablocie sp z o.o., a property owner in Zablocie engaged in the real estate management and Ponar Corporate Center Sp. z o.o. In addition it operates through Gremi Media SA z o o and operates Jupiter SA. The main shareholder of the Company is KCI Park Technologiczny Krowodrza SA, a unit of Gremi Sp z o o, and Gremi Sp z o o. It merged with Gremi Inwestycje SA.

name: POLWAX SA
businessSummary: Polwax SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the oil and gas refining and marketing industry. The Company specializes in the production and distribution of refined and deodorized paraffin, waxes and specialty industrial paraffin compositions. Its product portfolio includes products designed for candle-making industry, specialized products used for the production of candles, anti-corrosion agents, products designed for the manufacture of grave-lights, for wood impregnation, special applications, as well as products designed for contact with foodstuffs, anti-caking agents for fertilizers, casting waxes, hot-melt adhesives, grave-lights and candles. The Company’s products are used in such industries as wood processing, production of varnishes and paints, manufacture of explosives, paper and packaging, as well as rubber and food industry, among others.

name: PAMAPOL SA
businessSummary: Foodhub SA, formerly known as Pamapol SA is a Poland-based company mainly engaged in the food processing industry. The Company's offer comprises meat and vegetable products, including ready to eat meals, canned food, tinned meat, pates, soups, poultry sausages and spices. The Company is also engaged in the wholesale trade of its product s, as well as glass and glass products production and wholesale. The Company is the dominant entity in the Pamapol Group, which consists of subsidiaries, including WZPOW Kwidzyn Sp z o o, Mitmar Sp z o o, among others. The main shareholder of the Company is Amerykanka Struktura Sp z o o SKA.

name: POLTREG SA
businessSummary: Poltreg SA is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in biotechnology and medical research. The Company conducts research in the field of autoimmunological diseases. The Company works on a method of healing, that uses t-regulated cells (TREGs). The Firm possesses its own, patented technology to obtain T-regulated lymphocytes, that are used in the therapy. The Company works on therapy for diseases such as type one diabetes, type two diabetes, and multiple sclerosis. In its research, the Company cooperates with multiple specialists from various fields of science. The Company is developing its own research center, which is intended as a basic location for conducting future research activities.

name: POLENERGIA SA
businessSummary: Polenergia SA is a Poland-based company that specializes in the development, implementation and management of electricity and heat generation projects. The Company’s services are divided into three segments: Energy Outsourcing, including renders operator services as well as production and sales of electricity and heat generated in its plants; Biomass Fuels, including production of renewable energy made from agricultural biomass; and Wind Energy, including development and sales of wind farms as well as construction and operation of wind farms. The Company also offers services in the areas of development and set-up of new projects, including technical consultancy, project financing and operational services. Additionally, it sells solid, liquid and gas fuels.

name: WISE FINANCE SA
businessSummary: Wise Finance SA, formerly Noble Financials SA, is a Poland-based holding company active in the real estate sector. It is engaged in investment, sale, lease and intermediation in renting of properties, as well as in property management and interior design. It offers management of the cycle of creation of the real property value, organization of the projects and supervision of the investments being carried outs, management of customer relations, marketing and public relations. The Company operates through a number of subsidiaries, including Mysquare.pl Sp z o o.

name: PLAYWAY SA
businessSummary: Playway SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the computer games development. The Company’s activities are divided into two business segments: Computer games and Mobile games. The Computer games division focuses on creating and distributing games for Windows and Mac operating systems. Its game titles include Hard West, Car Mechanic Simulator, Professional Farmer 2014 and Ancient Space, among others. The Mobile games division produces and publishes games, such as Car Mechanic Simulator 2014 Mobile, Cook It Up and Diner Mania, for mobile devices with Android and iOS operating systems. In addition, it develops games for consoles, including PlayStation (PS) and Xbox. The Company distributes its products mainly through online platforms, such as Steam, App Store and Google Play. The Company controls a number of subsidiaries, such as CreativeForge Games SA, Madmind Studio Sp z oo, Atomic Jelly Sp z oo and Fishing Games Sp z oo.

name: PKP CARGO SA
businessSummary: PKP Cargo SA w restrukturyzacji is a Poland-based company active in the transportation sector. The main activity of The Company is the provision of comprehensive logistics services, for which rail transport is a basic service complemented by a wide range of services related to transport, including: intermodal services, forwarding (domestic and foreign), terminal services, siding and traction services, repairs and maintenance of rolling stock and reclamation. The Capital Group, in which The Company is a parent entity, has licenses to provide rail freight services in 9 European Union countries: Lithuania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Austria, the Czech Republic, Germany, the Netherlands, Hungary and Poland. The Group also performs freight transport through the entity PKP CARGO International a.s., which performs transport mainly on the Czech market.

name: POWSZECHNA KASA OSZCZEDNOSCI BANK POLSKI
businessSummary: Powszechna Kasa Oszczednosci Bank Polski SA is a Poland-based commercial bank. The Bank’s operations comprise cash deposits, maintenance of accounts, granting loans and cash advances, granting and confirming bank guarantees, clearing cash transactions, issuance of cards and conducting transactions with the use of cards, as well as conducting forward transactions. At the same time, the Bank conducts brokerage activities through its brokerage house. It also provides specialist financial services relating to leasing, factoring, investment funds, pension funds and Internet banking. It conducts investment and development operations in the real estate sector. It addresses its offer to both private and corporate clients. On April 4, 2014, the Company acquired Nordea Bank Polska SA.

name: ORLEN SA
businessSummary: Orlen SA, formerly Polski Koncern Naftowy Orlen SA, is a Poland-based company active in the oil and gas sector. It specializes in the manufacture, distribution, wholesale and retail sale of refined petrochemical products. The Company’s business is divided into three segments: Refining, including refinery products processing and wholesale, oil productions and sale as well as supporting production; Retail segment, including sales at petrol stations; and Petrochemical segment, including production and wholesale of petrochemicals and production and sale of chemicals. Its product portfolio includes fuel and petrochemical products, as well as oil derivatives, such as petrol, heating oil, aviation fuel and plastics. It also produces and distributes electricity and thermal energy. It operates several refineries located in Poland, Lithuania and the Czech Republic and a number of gasoline stations. It operates Kicking Horse Energy Inc and FX Energy Inc.

name: POZNANSKA KORPORACJA BUDOWLANA PEKABEX S
businessSummary: Poznanska Korporacja Budowlana Pekabex SA is a Poland-based company operating in the construction and engineering industry. The company operates in the subsequent sectors: prefabrication, construction services, implementation of development projects on its own account, production services, rental services. Within the Prefabrication segment, The Company undertakes a range of activities related to the design, production, delivery, and assembly of prefabricated structures. This includes design work, followed by the manufacturing of components, as well as delivery and assembly of prefabricated structures both nationally and abroad. Within the Construction Services segment, The Company provides comprehensive contract execution services as a contractor with the participation of external subcontractors.

name: DATAWALK SA
businessSummary: Datawalk SA, formerly known as Pilab SA, is a Poland-based a software publisher. The Company specializes in the area of data analysis, offering Business Intelligence solutions. It operates DataWalk, an agile analysis platform, which enables financial and insurance institutions to discover fraud attempts, combat money laundering, as well as analyze and monitor business processes, such as sales, claim adjustment and debt collection, among other applications. The Company operates through Datawalk Inc, its wholly-owned subsidiary based in the United States.

name: PHARMENA SA
businessSummary: Pharmena SA is a Poland-based producer of cosmetics and pharmaceuticals. The Company’s products range encompasses Dermena, a line of products against hair loss; Dermena Plus, a shampoo reducing the symptoms of dandruff and preventing excessive hair loss; Accos, an anti-acne gel; Allerco, a line of hypo-allergic emollients for body care, Thermi, a gel after thermal burn and sunburn; and Revium, a line of anti-wrinkle treatment products. Pharmena SA maintains multidirectional research works and application studies in conjunction with a number of research centers in Europe, the United States and Canada. As of December 31, 2011, the Company had one wholly owned subsidiary, Cortria Corporation, based in the United States. As of December 31, 2011, Polska Grupa Farmaceutyczna SA held a 43.65% stake in the capital. The main shareholder of the Company is Pelion SA.

name: POLSKI HOLDING NIERUCHOMOSCI SA
businessSummary: Polski Holding Nieruchomosci SA, formerly Grupa PHN SA, is a Poland-based holding company that is engaged in real estate development and operations. It operates a portfolio of approximately 180 properties, which are located across Poland in such cities and towns as, Warsaw, Wroclaw, Gdansk, Pruszkow, Parzniewo, Kolbaskowo, Lucmierz and Lewandow, among others. It possesses undeveloped land of a surface around 1,300 ha. The Group's principal activities include rental, sale and administration of retail, exhibition, office and advertising space, rental of warehouses, land investment, commercial real estate development, marketing and property management and others. It operates through subsidiaries, such as PHN 5 Sp z o o acquired another subsidiaries from the Company, such as Intraco SA, Dalmor SA, Budexpo Sp z o o,Andersia Business Centre Sp z o o and Wroclawskie Centrum Prasowe Sp z o o.

name: PGE POLSKA GRUPA ENERGETYCZNA SA
businessSummary: PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna SA is a Poland-based company active in the power sector. The Company is involved in production, sale and distribution of electricity. The main areas of the Company's activity comprise six business lines: Conventional Power Generation, Wholesale, Retail, Distribution, Renewable power generation and Nuclear power generation. PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna SA is a vertically integrated group which includes lignite mines (therein KWB Belchatow), power plants and cogeneration plants (including power plants that produce energy from renewable sources, wind power and hydropower plants), distribution system operators, retail sales companies, a wholesale trading company, as well as a company active in telecommunications industry.

name: PRZEDSIEBIORSTWO PRZEMYSLU SPOZYWCZEGO P
businessSummary: Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Spozywczego PEPEES SA is a Poland-based potato processing plant. The Company is a manufacturer of natural starch products produced from genetically modified organism free (GMO-free) agricultural products. The Company is primarily focused on mannufacturing potato starch, which is used in food, pharmaceutical, paper, textile and chemical industries for giving a product proper texture, appearance, moistness, consistency and storage durability. The Company offers also maltodextrin, component of powdered products and used in food industry; crystalline glucose, used in pharmaceutical, foodstuff, and chemical industry, as well as a product for direct consumption and a sweetener; anhydrous glucose, mainly used in pharmaceutical industry for production of drugs and supplements; potato protein; glucose syrups widely used in confectionary industry and potato grits.

name: PMPG POLSKIE MEDIA SA
businessSummary: PMPG Polskie Media SA, formerly Platforma Mediowa Point Group SA, is a Poland-based company that is engaged in the media and marketing sector. The Company is a parent entity of a capital group and operates through a number of subsidiaries, including: Media Point Group Sp z o o, involved in press and Internet publications; Admobile Sp z o o, a mobile marketing agency; BTL Point Group Sp z o o, an advertising agency; Gemtext Sp z o o, a printing house; News PR Sp z o o, a public relations agency; Media Works SA, an advertising agency; Bluetooth and Marketing Services Sp z o o, broker in the field of Internet advertising; TV Point Group Sp z o o, active in broadcasting industry, and Sport24.pl Sp z o o, a company managing sport.24.pl websote, among others.

name: BANK POLSKA KASA OPIEKI SA
businessSummary: Bank Polska Kasa Opieki SA (Bank Pekao SA) is a Poland-based commercial bank. It offers services to both individual and corporate clients. The Bank’s business is divided into four segments: Retail banking, offering scope of banking activities to the individual customers, small and micro enterprises; Private banking, offering banking activities to wealthiest individual customers; Corporate and Investment banking, offering banking activities to medium and large enterprises, including activities on the inter-bank market, investments in debt securities and other instruments; and Assets and Liabilities Management and other, covering supervision and monitoring of fund transfers.

name: PCF GROUP SA
businessSummary: PCF Group SA is a Poland-based Company is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in video-games production. The Company consists of a team of specialists, which are needed for computer game development. The Firm cooperates with specialists such as programmers, graphic designers, and game planners. The Company developed games such as Painkiller Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgment, Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition, Bulletstorm: Duke of Switch Edition, and Outriders. The Company operates multiple games studios on an international level. The Firm has studios in places such as Lodz in Poland, New York in the United States of America, Newcastle in the United Kingdom, and Montreal in Canada, Besides the activities of the main company, the Firm operates through its subsidiaries such as People Can Fly Phosphor in the United States of America.

name: PCC ROKITA SA
businessSummary: PCC Rokita SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the chemicals industry. It divides its business into three segments: Chemicals that includes manufacture of such products as polyols, comprising polyether polyols for the production of polyurethane polymers, among others; chloralkali, including chlorine and soda lye; chlorobenzene, such as monochlorobenzene, dichlorobenzene and technical hydrochloric acid; phosphorus derivates; and naphthalene derivates; Energy engaged in the production and distribution of electric and thermal energy, demineralized water and compressed air; and Other Activities composed of assembly and maintenance of industrial armature, technical monitoring and consulting services, waste management, among others.

name: PCC EXOL SA
businessSummary: PCC Exol SA is a Poland based company active in the chemicals sector. The Company manufactures and sells surfactants (surface active agents) for household chemicals, personal care, textile industry, paper industry and metallurgical industry, among others. It has two manufacturing units, for anionic and nonionic surfactants in Brzeg Dolny, and for ethoxylattion in Plock. It sells its products under the brand names: ABS acid, ABSNa, Sulforokanol, Rosulfany, Sulfobursztyniany, Rokafenol, Rokanol, Rokacet, Rokamid, Rodamin, Rokopol and Rokamina. On May 26, 2014, the Company established new subsidiary, PCC Exol Philippines Inc engaged in the production of semi-products, such as alcohols and fatty acids.

name: PBG SA W RESTRUKTURYZACJI
businessSummary: PBG SA w restrukturyzacji w likwidacji is Poland-based company primarily engaged in the construction industry. The Company provides services in the field of comprehensive execution of installations for natural gas, crude oil, as well as, fuels. The Company conduct business as a general contractor, consortium participant or subcontractor in the field of: design, execution, repairs, operation and service in the areas of: extraction and transmission of natural gas and crude oil and storage of natural gas and fuels Liquefied natural gas (LNG) Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) Pentane plus (C5+) and Compressed natural gas (CNG). The Company carries investments involving both the construction of new facilities and the modernization of existing storage facilities along with the accompanying infrastructure.

name: PA NOVA SA
businessSummary: PA Nova SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction and overall design of commercial properties. The Company is structured in four departments, including Project Department, specializing in architectural and urban projects; Investment Department, offering developing services; Construction Department, offering commercial, industrial and public construction services; and IT Services, offering software for computer-aided design (CAD). As of December 31, 2011, the Company was a parent entity of the capital group, which included several subsidiaries: San Development Sp. z o.o., Galeria Zamoyska Sp. z o.o., Supernova Sp. z o.o., Park Handlowy Chorzow Sp. z o.o., Galeria Galena Sp. z o.o., and Odrzanskie Ogrody Sp. z o.o., among others. Budoprojekt Sp. z o.o. held a 34.31% stake in the capital of the Company.

name: ORZEL BIALY SA
businessSummary: Orzel Bialy SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the recycling of lead accumulators and other lead products. The Company offers pure lead, soft lead, lead-antimony alloy and lead-calcium alloy, as a result of recycle process. The Company runs its own lead refinery. The Company operates such direct and indirect subsidiaries as Pumech Sp z oo, Geen-Lead Sp z oo, Speedmar Sp z oo and Centralna Pompownia Bolko Sp z oo. The Company is controlled by Zap Sznajder Batterien SA.

name: CD PROJEKT SA
businessSummary: CD Projekt SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the leisure products industry. It is a player on the global digital entertainment market. The Company is active in four operating segments. The Distribution and Publishing in Poland segment is responsible for the production and marketing of computers game, movies on digital discs (DVD) and Blu-ray storage devices in the domestic market. The Production of Games segment, through CD Project Red, focuses on the production of video games, sale of licenses and products associated with the digital sector. The Global Digital Distribution of Games segment is engaged in the distribution of computer games through the Websites, and the Others segment focuses on the holding activities. The Company’s main products are The Witcher, The Witcher 2: Assasins of Kings and The Witcher 3: Wild HuntCyberpunk 2077 and Cyberpunk 2077. It operates through subsidiaries, such as GOG Poland Sp z o o, Brand Project Sp z o o and CD Project Brands SA, among others.

name: OPTEAM SA
businessSummary: OPTeam SA is a Poland-based information technology (IT) solutions and services provider. The Company provides IT solutions and services as well as tailor-made applications designed for businesses. Its OPTI series products range includes: corporate card system (OPTIpass), loyalty card system (OPTIcard), electronic student's card (OPTIcamp) and electronic purse system (OPTIcash). Applications of the OPTI series are implemented at client's premises or hosted at the OPTeam SA Data Centre. In addition, the Company produces and implements software that utilizes payment terminals; creates information communications technology (ICT) networks; implements data security policy solutions, management systems of the enterprise resource planning (ERP) class and cash register systems along with a comprehensive maintenance offer, and supports integration projects through training courses offered by the Company's training centre.

name: OPONEO.PL SA
businessSummary: Oponeo.pl SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the online distribution of tires and other automotive parts. The Company’s products portfolio includes approximately 100 brands of tires for cars, trucks and off-road vehicles, aluminum and steel wheel rims and other automotive parts, as well as car audio articles and cosmetics. Oponeo.pl SA provides its services in wholesale and retail trade using e-commerce tools. The Company’s products are sold through Polish Internet portals, such as opony.com, opony.pl, ogumienie.com, oponeo.pl, felgi.pl and motostrada.pl, as well as through foreign Internet portals. It operates throught Opony.pl Sp z o o, Oponeo Brandhouse Sp z o o, Oponeo.co.uk Ltd, Oponeo.com Inc and Autocentrum.pl SA, among others.

name: ONDE SA
businessSummary: Onde SA, former Przedsiebiorstwo Budownictwa Drogowo Inzynieryjnego SA, is a Poland-based construction company. It operates in the construction, road, and electrical engineering sector nationwide also providse services related to the construction of photovoltaic.

name: MOLECURE SA
businessSummary: Molecure SA, formerly known as Oncoarendi Therapeutics SA, is a Poland-based biopharmaceutical company. The Company is dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing therapeutics for neoplastic and inflammatory diseases. The Company's business model is focused on drug discovery and development, with its core strength in medicinal chemistry and preclinical biology, enhanced by scientific collaborations in specific disease areas. The Company has a platform of 3 distinct small molecule programs targeting chitinases hydrolytic enzymes with potential utility in diverse inflammatory and fibrotic diseases of high unmet medical need. Additionally, it has initiated a program focused on development of small molecule immune modulators to stop the ability of tumors to escape immune surveillance.

name: OT LOGISTICS SA
businessSummary: OT Logistics SA is a Poland-based company active in the transportation sector. The Company is primarily engaged in transportation of goods by inland navigation. It also provides services of inshore waterway transport, service supporting waterway transport, excavation of gravel and sand, renting of the real estate, warehousing and storing of goods and transshipment. The Company operates a number of floating units. OT Logistics SA concentrates its activities on the Oder river, on the section Gliwice - Wroclaw as well as in the region of Szczecin, Poland. OT Logistics is a parent entity of OT Logistics Group, which consist of several companies active in Poland, Center and Western Europe. The Company’s major shareholder is I Fundusz Mistral SA.

name: ODLEWNIE POLSKIE SA
businessSummary: Odlewnie Polskie SA is a Poland-based producer of foundry materials. The Company manufactures castings made of gray cast iron, nodular cast iron, vermicular cast iron, cast carbon steel, steel alloys and aluminum alloys for clients in such market sectors as machinery and automotive industry, plumbing and water-sewage fittings, heavy railway infrastructure, energy industry and others. The Company also runs trade activities within the foundry materials scope, including ferroalloys, foundry alloys and inoculants, steel shot, pig iron and dextrin. Odlewnie Polskie SA sells its products on the domestic market, as well as exports to Germany, the United Kingdom, Sweden and the United States, among others. As of December 31, 2011, the Company had one wholly owned subsidiary, Prima Sp. z o.o.

name: NOVITA SA
businessSummary: Novita SA is a Poland-based company that specializes in the technical nonwoven textile and carpet sectors. The Company's activities include the production and sale of carpets; the production of needle-punched floor coverings and tufted floor coverings; the manufacture and sale of spun-lace fabrics for household and industrial applications; the production of textile for medical use, such as medical dressings, swabs and personal care products; and the provision of footwear and clothing nonwovens, such as shoe pads, undersoles, linings, shoulder inserts, among others. Its products are sold across Poland, as well as exported to the United States, Germany, the Russian Federation, France and Finland, among others.

name: NTT SYSTEM SA
businessSummary: NTT System SA is a Poland-based producer and distributor of computer equipment and peripherals, as well as consumer electronics. It offers servers, computers, notebooks, and terminal adapters under its own brand, Corrino, as well as computer accessories and parts. Its product portfolio has three divisions: home series for individual users, office series for businesses and series for institutions. It distributes its product both in wholesale and retail trade.The Company cooperates with AMD, VIA Technolgies, Gigabyte, Asus, MSI, Samsung Electronics, Hyundai, Hynix, NEC, LG and Siemens. Its main customers include enterprises, institutions and sales networks such as Media Markt, Carrefour and Real, among others. It sells its products domestically through six branch offices, as well as exports them to the Czech Republic, Hungary, the Netherlands, Belarus, Ukraine and Lithuania, among others. As of December 31, 2011 NTT System SA had one wholly owned subsidiary NTT Technology Sp. z o.o.

name: NANOGROUP SA
businessSummary: Nanogroup SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the biotechnology sector. The Company focuses on the investment in, as well as development of advanced biotechnological projects in the areas of cancer prevention, early diagnosis, targeted cancer therapies and ontological rehabilitation. Its projects portfolio includes NanoVelos, which is responsible for the creation of drug delivery system for proven oncologic medicines to optimize their performance; NanoSanguis, which develops artificial blood to keep alive patients wounded in accidents, as well as a system, named Organ farm, to preserve human organs ex vivo, and NanoThea, which is dedicated to technology that detects cancer cells in early stage.

name: BBI DEVELOPMENT SA
businessSummary: BBI Development SA is a Poland-based development fund manager. The Fund was established as a part of the Program of National Privatization. BBI Development Narodowy Fundusz Inwestycyjny SA’s main activity is investing in the development projects, including the financing and managing real estate projects from the stage of acquiring land to the sale of premises, in certain cases preceded by a lease. Additionally, it invests in Polish and foreign currencies through the bank deposits. It operates on the basis of the Act of National Investment Funds. As of December 31, 2011, it formed a capital group with a number of subsidiaries, such as Realty 2 Management Sp. z o.o., Juvenes-Projekt Sp. z o.o. and Juvenes-Serwis Sp. z o.o.

name: MDI ENERGIA SA
businessSummary: MDI Energia SA, formally Skystone Capital SA, is a Poland-based company investing in enterprises operating in renewable energy sources sector. The Company is engaged in financing and co-financing investment projects in the renewable energy market by taking up shares and organizing financing by providing loans and subsidies. It evaluates, prepares and executes investment projects aimed at producing green electrical energy and heat. As of December 31, 2011, the Company was the major shareholder of such companies as Ozen Plus Sp z o o, Elektrownie Wodne Zeneris Sp z o o, Biogaz Zeneris Sp z o o and Energia Trojanowo Sp z o o. On June 11, 2014, the Company sold 54.85% stake in Viatron SA to Cresco Financial Advisors Sp z o o. The main shareholder of the Company is Ipopema 12 FIZAN.

name: OCTAVA SA
businessSummary: Octava SA is a Polish-based Real Estate Investment Fund. Initially a restructuring fund with controlling interests in over 30 companies from various sectors, in 2004 the Company entered the real estate market as a financial investor. Octava SA's main investment target are medium term, medium size real estate projects both commercial and residential. The Company pursues a goal based on the investment portfolio of up to ten medium-sized real estate projects at a time. The Company's main shareholder is Elliott Management Corp, through its member company named Beresford Energy Corp, holding a 56.8% stake in Octava SA.

name: MAGNA POLONIA SA
businessSummary: Magna Polonia SA, formerly Narodowy Fundusz Inwestycyjny Magna Polonia SA, is a Poland-based investment fund active in telecommunication sector. Its range of activities includes the purchase of valuable papers issued by Treasury, buying or taking over units or shares of the companies registered and performing in Poland, investing in other valuable papers and granting loans to other bodies registered and performing in Poland. As of December 31, 2011, it had three direct subsidiaries: INFO-TV-FM Sp. z o.o. engaged in mobile television, Zninska Kolej Powiatowa Sp. z o.o., Mediatel SA that manages a capital group consisted of Elterix SA, Telepin SA, Velvet Telecom LCC and Sieci Cyfrowe Sp. z o.o. As of March 20, 2012, Rasting Limited owned a 52.5% stake in the Company. As of January 30, 2012, it sold a 61.23% stake in INFO TV FM Sp. z o.o. to Cyfrowy Polsat SA.

name: NOVAVIS GROUP SA
businessSummary: Novavis Group SA, formerly known as Rubicon Partners SA, is a Poland-based Company engaged in Renewable Energy industry. The Company offers comprehensive services related to the implementation of renewable energy projects at every stage: from design and obtaining all formal approvals (development), through the implementation of orders, material deliveries and physical construction, to effective investor supervision, audits and consulting in the field of energy management in intelligent buildings, as well as optimizing energy-intensive processes in industrial plants. The Company is also engaged in energy storage market, offering solutions related to design and investment preparation. The Company is also providing financing services in the green energy sector and comprehensive implementation of projects on the renewable energy market.

name: SOHO DEVELOPMENT SA
businessSummary: Soho Development SA, previously Black Lion Fund SA, is a Poland-based investment company active in private equity and venture capital sector. The Company invests primarily in companies from real estate, medical, and publishing sectors. At the same time, together with the National Capital Fund, it set up a separate entity for investment in innovative companies that are in the early stages of development. The primary objective of the Company is capital investment and support for the period from three to five years, made in the projects of mid-size development, consolidation and restructuring range. The subject of Fund’s activity are also acquisition of the securities issued by the National Treasure, stocks or other securities issued by the registered entities and acting in Poland, as well as execution of the rights to shares, options of stocks and other securities. On November 20, 2012, the Company acquired a 100% stake in Recycling Park Sp. z o.o.

name: NEWAG SA
businessSummary: Newag SA is a Poland-based company engaged in heavy machinery sector. The Company operations are divided into four segments: the Electric and Diesel Multiple Units (MUs) segment produces electric MUs for electrified railway lines of passenger transportation and diesel MUs for non-electrified, regional railway lines of passenger transportation; the Electric Locomotives segment offers four- and six-person electric locomotives for freight, as well as passenger transportation; the Repair and Modernization segment provides modernization services of diesel and electric locomotives, as well as modernization of passenger carriages and electric MUs, and in addition, offers repair and maintenance of rolling stocks; the Other Services segment is engaged in design and production of accessories for electric rolling stocks, control and power systems and passenger information systems (PIS). The Company operates through subsidiaries, including Newag Gliwice SA, Inteco SA, among others.

name: NOCTILUCA SA
businessSummary: Noctiluca SA is a Poland-based company, which is specializing in the synthesis of organic compounds used in optoelectronics (diodes, displays, lasers, photosensitive dyes, solar cells). The main goal of the entiy's project is to develop OLED emitters based on a new class of organic TADF semiconductors (electroluminescence due to thermally active delayed fluorescence) for use in products such as OLED displays and lighting. This technology allows the further development of displays used in smartphones or TVs and improvement of their various parameters as well as economic and performance indicators.

name: MAXCOM SA
businessSummary: MaxCom SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture of consumer electronics. The Company focuses on the design, production and sell of mobile phones and other handheld devices under the Maxcom and Motorola brand name. Its product range includes mobile and fixed phones, Global Positioning System (GPS) navigation, baby monitoring systems, as well as walkie-talkie type of private mobile radios (PMRs), among others. The Company's mobile telecommunication devices are distributed within a number of categories, such as Comfort, Classic, Rugged and Smart. The Company also offers waterproof devices and product line for seniors. It operates after-sales service points across Poland.

name: M.W. TRADE SA
businessSummary: M.W. Trade SA is a Poland-based company that specializes in the financial and advisory support for the benefit of independent public healthcare units. The Company's services include solutions allowing for complete restructuring of liabilities, investments’ financing and assistance in adapting hospitals to the newest requirements related to the expectations of the European Union, among others. The Company provides services, such as Hospital Fund that helps the hospital to secure financial liquidity and minimizes cost connected with debt. It focuses mainly on the outstanding civil (non-governmental) liabilities. The Company's operations also include support for charities and aid in modernizing hospitals. As of December 31, 2011, Getin Holding SA held a 51.27% stake in the Company.

name: MOVIE GAMES SA
businessSummary: Movie Games SA is a Poland-based computer game developer. The Company produces a diversified portfolio of computer games aimed at the international market. The Company publishes approximately 10 new game titles a year. It covers the whole development process, from building the creative team, through development, production and testing, to publishing of the finished title, its marketing and distribution. The Company focuses on digital distribution through gaming platforms, such as Steam. In addition, the Company distributes select titles through traditional channels in cooperation with international publishers. The Company develops games in such genres as flight simulators, psychological horror, tower defense, first person shooter, survival horror and role-playing games, among others. Some of its titles include 303 Squadron: Battle of Britain, Lust for Darkness, Orbital Racer, Project Remedium, Soulblight and Treasure Hunter Simulator.

name: MUZA SA
businessSummary: Muza SA is a Poland-based publishing company. It also runs a readers' club and an Internet bookstore. The Company takes part in national and international book fairs and cooperates with foreign book issuers, translators and editors. Muza SA offers such products as books, albums, atlases, encyclopedias, lexicons, manuals, handbooks, books for children, literature, tourist guidebooks, educational books and books for lawyers. On July 21, 2014, the Regional Court in Warsaw excluded from the register the Company's subsidiary, Polska Grupa Wydawnicza SA.

name: MURAPOL SA
businessSummary: Murapol SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the homebuilding sector. The Company offers services in the scope of general execution, commercial investments, as well as interior design. The portfolio of Murapol SA’s products includes studio flats, apartments, one- and multi-family terrace and detached houses, offices and hotels. The Company distinguishes two operating segments: the development segment and the PRS segment. The development segment includes the construction and sale of residential and commercial premises. The PRS segment includes the sale of land and general contracting services in the design and build system for companies from the private rental and student housing sectors.

name: MOSTOSTAL ZABRZE SA
businessSummary: Mostostal Zabrze SA is a Poland-based holding construction company. The Company provides its project in four sectors: Industrial Construction, Power, Environmental Protection, and Transport Infrastructure. It offers contracting of facilities, industrial plants, process lines and revamp, erection of complete facilities and buildings, construction of sport facilities, transport infrastructure, and waste water treatment plants. It also provides structural steelwork and machinery constructions, radio and television masts and towers, ski lifts, cableways, aluminum elements such as curtain walls, windows and doors, commercial halls and pavilions, as well as such services as design, galvanizing of steel structure, transport and lifting equipment and training.

name: MOSTOSTAL WARSZAWA SA
businessSummary: Mostostal Warszawa SA is a Poland-based company active in the construction sector. It operates through six divisions: General Construction, which focuses on the construction of housing estates, offices and public utility buildings; Industrial Construction, specializing in petrochemical, chemical, power and cement industrial projects; Civil Engineering, active in the construction of roads, bridges, underground structures and other facilities for the municipal metro system; Road Construction, involved in rehabilitation, modernization and construction of roads, elements of municipal communication infrastructure and railway lines; Environmental Engineering, engaged in the construction of environment protection; Other Services, offering engineering services, design services, courses for welders, renting transport units and construction equipment and machines. The Company is a subsidiary of Acciona Infraestructuras SA.

name: POLIMEX MOSTOSTAL SA
businessSummary: Polimex Mostostal SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the engineering and construction sector. Its business is organized into six segments: Production, providing steel structures, platform gratings, shelving systems, pallets and road barriers, as well as galvanizing, hydraulic paintings and structure corrosion protection systems; Construction, providing industrial and general facilities construction services; Power Engineering, providing general contracting of facilities in power engineering sectors, as well as servicing; Chemistry, providing general constricting of facilities in chemical industry, as well as assembly of equipment and steel structures; Roads and railroads, providing general contracting of facilities in road construction industry; and Other operations, including hardware and transport services, rental services and leases, among others. On July 23, 2014, it sold 100% stake in Energomontaz-Polnoc - Technika Spawalnicza i Laboratorium Sp z o o.

name: MOSTOSTAL PLOCK SA
businessSummary: Mostostal Plock SA is a Poland-based company principally engaged in the construction and building sectors. It was created as a result of the reorganization of Plockie Przedsiebiorstwo Konstrukcji Stalowych i Urzadzen Przemyslowych (Plock Steel Structures and Industrial Equipment Company). The Company provides such services as manufacture, erection and design of steel structures, tanks, pipelines, and industrial plants, as well as construction, fitting, insulation and anticorrosion works. Additionally, Mostostal Plock SA offers welding services, overhaul and modernization of equipment, machinery, and industrial plants. The Company's main customers are PKN Orlen SA, Przedsiebiorstwo Eksploatacji Rurociagow Naftowych Przyjazn SA, Lotos SA and Anwil SA, among others. As of December 31, 2011, the Company's main shareholder was Mostostal Warszawa SA, holding a 48.66% stake in the Company’s share capital and 52.65% of the right votes.

name: MARVIPOL DEVELOPMENT SA
businessSummary: Marvipol Development SA is a Poland-based company. The company implements its own investment projects in the multi-family housing sector, covering the entire development process - starting with land acquisition, through design in cooperation with renowned architectural offices, to obtaining valid building permits, supervision of construction work, and forwarding of completed flats to clients and managing the whole object. The Company operates in two business areas: Property development, basic for the parent company and automotive activities in the field of import, sale, service and turnover of spare parts for Jaguar, Land Rover and Aston Martin cars.

name: MERCATOR MEDICAL SA
businessSummary: Mercator Medical SA is a Poland-based company engaged in medical supplies industry. The Company manufactures medical gloves and distributes disposable medical materials. It produces medical, latex, synthetic, surgical, diagnostic sterile, examination and protective and household gloves. Its dressing products line includes gauze dressing products, non-woven fabric dressing, medical adhesive tapes, surgical dressing, among others. In addition, the Company provides drapes such as bed sheets, sets, as well as apparel, including caps, masks, gowns, among others. It operates through subsidiaries: Mercator Medical Kft, Mercator Medical srl, Merkator Medikal TOB, Mercator Medical (Thailand) Ltd and VIVOFT LLP.

name: MERCOR SA
businessSummary: Mercor SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the production and sale of fire protection systems. It is structured into four product divisions, including fire doors and partitions offering steel fire doors, timber fire doors, profiled fire doors and partitions, as well as steel sliding gates; smoke and heat exhaust ventilation systems providing such solutions as roof lights with integrated smoke vents and window-based smoke exhaust systems; fire ventilation systems focused on production of fire dampers, smoke exhaust fans; fire-proof solutions for buildings with intumescing coating systems Pyroplast and fire protection boards system Vermiculux. The Company operates through subsidiaries, based in Poland, the Czech Republic, Ukraine, Romania, Spain, Slovakia and the Russian Federation. It is active through Dunamenti Tuzvedelem Ipari Szolgaltato es Kereskedelmi Zrt.

name: MIRBUD SA
businessSummary: Mirbud SA is a Poland-based company active in the real estate sector. It acts mainly as a general contractor for the construction sector in Poland. The scope of construction and assembly services offered by the Company covers four areas: residential properties, including detached houses, townhouses and apartment buildings; public utility buildings; production, services and commercial facilities, encompassing production halls, logistic centers and shopping centers, and engineering and road construction works, consisting of roads and construction elements for municipal transport infrastructure, among others. It also renders transport and construction equipment rental services. The Company operates subsidiaries, JHM Development SA, Expo Arena SA, Marywilska 44 Sp z o o and Przedsiebiorstwo Budowy Drog i Mostow Kobylarnia SA.

name: MOJ SA
businessSummary: Moj SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of devices and tools for the mining, power, engineering, metallurgical and cement industries. The Company’s product portfolio consists of industrial couplings, drilling equipment and small-scale mechanical equipment. It has its own engineering and technological departments, offering technical advice. The Company operates domestically, as well as exports its products abroad. As of December 31, 2011, the Company was 69.15%-owned by GK FASING SA.

name: MO-BRUK SA
businessSummary: Mo-Bruk SA is a Poland-based company involved in the production of concrete. It is also active in the area of hazardous and other than hazardous industrial waste management. Additionally, the Company operates a waste recovery plant, waste recycling plant, alternative fuel production plant and an industrial waste landfill. The Company produces alternative fuels from municipal and industrial wastes. The Company is also the owner of two open non-stop petrol stations for liquefied fuel, as well as a technical inspection station. Mo-Bruk SA is also engaged in the construction of concrete surfaces. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated one wholly owned subsidiary, Raf-Ekologia Sp. z o.o.

name: MONNARI TRADE SA
businessSummary: Monnari Trade SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the design and sale of women's apparel. The Company's product offer focuses on classical style and is addressed principally to women in age between 30 and 50. The clothing portfolio, including skirts, dresses, trousers, jackets, blouses, coats and others, is supplemented by accessories, such as belts, bags, shoes and jewelry. The manufacture is conducted on a contract basis by enterprises in Poland, Europe and the Far East. Monnari also offers seasonal collections, promotions and customer loyalty programs. The Company operates through numerous subsidiaries, including Madam Posh Sp z o o, Madam Collection Sp z o o, Madam Elegant Sp z o o, Madam Costume Sp z o o, Model Sp z o o, Modern Craft Sp z o o, Madam Prime Sp z o o, Madam Fashion Sp z o o, Madam Elite Sp z o o, Madam Perfect Sp z o o, Madam Chic Sp z o o, Madam Fancy Sp z o o, Madam Absolute Sp z o o, Madam Spring Sp z o o and Madam Joy Sp z o o, among others.

name: MENNICA POLSKA SA
businessSummary: Mennica Polska SA is a Poland-based mint. It is engaged in the production of circulation and collector coins, medals, signs, decorations, seals and related products. It is also focused on precious metal processing, including the processing of gold, platinum, palladium, iridium and rhodium for various needs. In addition, it is involved in the production of gold and platinum paints for glass and porcelain decoration; the manufacture of half-finished products for the jewelry trade sector; the production of laboratory equipment; the production of precious metal powders for the electronics industry and gold powder for polychromy; security services; electronic payments; Information Technology (IT) services; maintenance and repair; industrial waste utilization; and real estate. It operates several subsidiaries, including Mennica Invest Sp. z o.o., Mennica Ochrona Sp. z o.o., Mennica-Metale Szlachetne SA, Skarbiec Mennicy Polskiej SA and Menica FIZAN, among others.

name: ML SYSTEM SA
businessSummary: ML System SA is a Poland-based company active in photovoltaic industry. It focuses primarily on design, engineering and production of building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) cell systems, which generate electrical power from sunlight. The Company’s core business areas include: Research and Development, which includes Research and Development Centre for Photovoltaics, where research in the field of nanotechnology is carried out, including electrochemical properties of nanomaterials, electron structure of radiation converters and quantum dots efficiency, among others; Building Management System, which consist of Energy Management System, a software suite for energy gain visualisation, and Security Systems, including a number of low voltage and high power system installations, as well as Photovoltaic Insulating Glass Units (IGUs), which includes glass processing plant of flat glass and mirrors used in construction, interior furnishing and architecture.

name: MLP GROUP SA
businessSummary: MLP Group SA (Millennium Logistic Parks Group SA) is a Poland-based company engaged in real estate sector. The Company specializes in the construction and management of warehouses and production centers. MLP Group SA offers consulting and property development services. It provides solutions for domestic and international customers. The Company operates four logistics parks: MLP Pruszkow I, MLP Pruszkow II, MLP Tychy, MLP Poznan. It also develops logistics park, MLP Bierun. The Company's major shareholder is Cajamarca Holland BV, the Netherlands.

name: MAKARONY POLSKIE SA
businessSummary: Makarony Polskie SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the manufacture of pasta. It offers variety of pasta, produced with or without eggs, such as spirals, elbows, penne, farfalle, threads, shells, spaghetti, ribbons, waves and others. The Company sells its products under such brand names, as Sorenti (durum wheat pasta), Solare, Abak and Makaron Staropolski (traditional pasta). It also offers ready meals under the brand name Stoczek, as well as sauces under the brand name Sorenti. Additionally, it produces and distributes syrups, salads, pickles, jams and marmalades. The Company operates four production plants located in Rzeszow, Czestochowa, Plock and Stoczek Lukowski. The Company distributes its products through a sales network and hypermarkets in Poland, including Auchan, Tesco and exports it abroad. The Company operates through subsidiaries, such as MP Trade Sp z o o, Stoczek Sp z o o. As of April 20, 2012, the Company merged with its 100%-owned subsidiary, Stoczek Sp. z o.o.

name: MEGARON SA
businessSummary: Megaron SA is a Poland-based company engaged in construction materials industry. The Company manufactures and sells gypsum products. Its product portfolio includes gypsum plasters, finishing plasters, spatulas, reinforcement plasters and adhesives, among others. The Company distributes its products on the domestic market, as well as in Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Estonia, Latvia, the Russian Federation, Ukraine, the Czech Republic and Moldavia.

name: MFO SA
businessSummary: MFO SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the steel profiles manufacturing segment of industry. It produces steel profiles, anchors and reinforcements for PVC window joinery, cutting and profiling sheet, as well as foiling and laminating PVC profiles. It operates in the European Union, Russia and Ukraine. The Company divides its activities into two segments: Cold-bent sections, and Special sections. In the Cold-bent sections segment it manufactures and distributes window reinforcements and in the Special sections segment it offers special profiles based on individual documentation of the ordering party. Apart from window reinforcements it manufactures special profiles which can be applied in: light steel constructions, fences, elevated floors, racks, automotive industry, among others.

name: MEX POLSKA SA
businessSummary: Mex Polska SA is a Poland-based holding company engaged in gastronomy sector. As of January 9, 2012, the Company operated 10 restaurants under the brand name The Mexican, with Mexican national cuisine, located in Warsaw, Lodz, Poznan, Wroclaw, Cracow, Sopot and Zakopane; two restaurants under the brand name Browar De Brasil with Brazilian national cuisine and own breweries, located in Lodz an Warsaw; and four music clubs, Klub Desperados and Opera Club, both located in Warsaw, Klub Bedroom located in Lodz and Klub Bed, located in Wroclaw. The Company operated though subsidiaries and affiliates, such as Mex Master Sp z o o, Mag Sp z o o, Mex k Sp z o o, Ase Sp z o o, Villa Sp z o o, Aad Sp z o o, Mex P Sp z o o and Cafe II Sp z o o. The Company was 57.88%-owned by Milduks Limited.

name: M FOOD SA
businessSummary: M Food SA is Poland-based holding company and a producer of honey. The Company manages the production assets and logistics of apiculture products- mainly honey. The Company divides its activity in to three segments: PRODUCTION OF RAW MATERIAL, DOWNSTREAM and RETAIL SALES. PRODUCTION OF RAW MATERIAL segment, control of raw material supply based on the Company's raw material production infrastructure; DOWNSTREAM segment includes: acquisition and contracting of raw materials from international markets, organization and management of the logistics and storage of raw materials on the basis of land and sea infrastructure, storage and packaging, organization and contracting markets for wholesale international markets.
