RETAIL SALES segment includes: sales organization of final products in the retail networks, infrastructure and logistics management, retail sales certificates.

name: MEDINICE SA
businessSummary: Medinice SA is a Poland-based company engaged in medical diagnostic and testing equipment business sector. The Company specializes in creating, developing and commercializing safe and minimally invasive solutions in the field of medicine, in particular cardiology and cardio surgery. Its portfolio comprises of projects, such as CathAIO, Cryoapplicator, Med-IConsole, Minimax, Pacepress and others. All of the Company's projects have a global potential. The Company cooperates with research centers in Poland and Europe. It strives to commercialize inventions brought by both co-founders of the Company and acquired projects through the sale of licenses worldwide in the production of medical devices.

name: MEDICALGORITHMICS SA
businessSummary: Medicalgorithmics SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the advanced medical equipment and technology industry. The Company develops and manufactures system for the diagnosis of heart arrhythmia. Its product, named PocketECG, is used for remote monitoring of cardiac disorders, arrhythmia diagnosis and monitoring of heart, as well as is used for clinical drugs trials for cardiac safety. In addition, Medicalgorithmics SA provides services in the field of information technology and biotechnology, scientific research and development of natural sciences. Moreover, the Company works on the several projects, such as a device for tele-rehabilitation cardiology, software for optimizing repetitive task in hospitals, as well as devices and systems for remote description of the electrocardiography (ECG). It operates through MEDICALGORITHMICS US HOLDING CORPORATION and Medi-Lynx Cardiac Monitoring LLC and Medi-Lynx Cardiac Monitoring LLC.

name: MCI CAPITAL SA
businessSummary: MCI Capital Alternatywna Spolka Inwestycyjna SA, formally MCI Capital SA, is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the management of investment funds. The Company is active in two business segments, namely Investment and Asset management. The Company’s operations cover the investments and management of venture capital (VC) funds, as well as the investments and management of private equity (PE). The Company manages funds including MCI.PrivateVentures FIZ fund, Internet Ventures FIZ and MCI Digital and Climatech Fund V S.C.A. MCI Capital Alternatywna Spolka Inwestycyjna SA counts with subsidiaries including MCI Capital TFI SA, PEM Asset Management Sp z o o w likwidacji and MCI Digital and MCI Digital and Climatech GP S.a r.l.

name: MABION SA
businessSummary: Mabion SA is a Poland-based biopharmaceutical company. The Company provides a broad spectrum of services in the segment of small and medium-sized projects at various stages of development (from early-stage discovery to commercial manufacturing). The Company's competencies include the selection of protein expression technologies, their purification, GMP-standard manufacturing activities (obtaining Active Substances - Drug Substance and Finished Products - Drug Product), development of analytical tools (for structural, functional, physicochemical characterization), clinical development, clinical analytics and a full range of regulatory activities in the development and operational areas. The Company's goal is to establish itself as a recognizable player in the global contract manufacturing and contract drug development market and to complete its full transformation into an integrated biologics CDMO company.

name: GRUPA KAPITALOWA IMMOBILE SA
businessSummary: Grupa Kapitalowa Immobile SA is a Poland-based company that acquires and develops companies from various sectors. It owns companies operating in the heavy industry (PROMStahl offering docking solutions, Modulo Parking- automatic parkings and the Makrum brand providing crushing and grinding machines), hotel industry (Focus Hotels - Polish hotel network with dozen operating facilities and several under construction), development (CDI Konsultanci Budowlani - residential, office and service projects), industrial construction (Projprzem Budownictwo - construction of warehouse halls and industrial facilities), as well as automation and power engineering (Atrem).

name: PROTEKTOR SA
businessSummary: Protektor SA, formerly Lubelskie Zaklady Przemyslu Skorzanego Protektor SA, is a Poland-based producer of leather military, professional, as well as working and protective footwear. Its products range includes military, firemen, as well as safety and work footwear. Additionally, the Company’s portfolio includes footwear for hunters and motorcyclists. The Company operate four footwear production plants, based in Poland, the Czech Republic and Moldova. The Company has a distribution network throughout Poland. The Company sells its products in Europe, Asia, Africa and South America. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated six subsidiaries, including Abeba Spezialschuh-Ausstatter GmbH, Inform Brill GmbH and Praos pluas as, among others. As of May 15, 2012, the Company sold its subsidiary Prabos plus as.

name: LUBELSKI WEGIEL BOGDANKA SA
businessSummary: Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka SA is a Poland-based manufacturer of hard coal. It is engaged in the excavation of the hard coal used for the generation of electric and thermal energy as well as for cement production. The Company’s main customers are: power stations, cement plants, plants producing fertilizers and thermal power stations located in the East or Northern-East of Poland. The mine Bogdanka has been located in Central Coal District, which is situated in Lubelskie Coal Basin. The Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka SA's mine performs its mining operations within the mining area of a surface of 57 square kilometers. As of December 31, 2012, it operated one subsidiary, Leczynska Energetyka Sp. z o.o., and it held a 24.41% stake in Kolejowe Zaklady Maszyn KOLZAM SA. The main shareholder of the Company is Enea SA.

name: TEXT SA
businessSummary: Text SA, formerly known as Livechat Software SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the software industry. The Company is a producer and global provider of software as a service (SaaS) LiveChat, communication software for business. It enables fast and intuitive communication between company's employees and customers visiting corporate Website. The application also tracks customers’ activity on a Website. The Company produces and distributes software for business-to-consumer (B2C) and business-to-business (B2B) communication. Its product portfolio includes three types of LiveChat plans: Solo, dedicated to single user and offering such features as unlimited chats, ticketing system, enhanced security and basic reporting; Team, for numerous teams that additionally includes chat routing and groups creation; and Enterprise, for companies that, additionally to previous ones, provides advanced reporting, work scheduler and unlimited visits on a Website.

name: LUBAWA SA
businessSummary: Lubawa SA, formerly Zaklady Konfekcji Technicznej Lubawa SA, is a Poland-based company involved in the production of safety, quartermaster and also tourist equipment. The Company's product portfolio comprises bulletproof equipment, military tents and tippets, helicopter equipment, soldiers' equipment, tarpaulin and safety equipment, including fire brigades' equipment. The Company provides supplies of military logistic equipment for the Ministry of Defense. Lubawa SA also operates in the rubber coating industry through its Grudziadz-based production plant, Milagro. The Company comprises a capital group and operates subsidiaries, such as Litex Promo Sp. z o.o., Effect-System SA, Miranda Sp. z o.o., Miranda SA w likwidacji, Miranda Serwis Sp. z o.o., Litex Eco Sp. z o.o., Litex Service Sp. z o.o. Len SA, Eurobrands Sp. z o.o, Lubawa Armenia SA and Lubawa Ukraina.

name: LSI SOFTWARE SA
businessSummary: LSI Software SA is a Poland-based company specialized in the design and provision of software solutions for the retail and hospitality sectors. Its portfolio of products includes Bastion ERP, a corporate management system; POSitive Retail, aimed at retail stores management; and POSitive Hospitality, designed for the management of hotels, restaurants and SPAs, among others. The Company is also a supplier of customer-tailored software solutions. It deals with all levels of software implementation, from the design, through installation, to system configuration, training and post-sale services. The Company holds a partnership with Microsoft for system environment and database implementation and with Long Range Systems for development of software solutions. It also provides building management systems (BMS) under the GIP brand name. The Company operates a number of subsidiaries, such as Softech Sp z o o and Przedsiebiorstwo Projektowo Wdrozeniowe GiP Sp z o o.

name: LPP SA
businessSummary: LPP SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the apparel and accessories industry. The Company specializes in the design and distribution of clothing, such as sweatshirts, shirts, jumpers, coats, trousers and dresses, as well as underwear, and accessories, such as shoes, gloves, scarves and caps, among others. LPP SA operates through a network of numerous shops in Central and Eastern Europe, as well as in Egypt and Qatar. It also offers online shopping to its brands, particularly in Poland. The Company owns several brands such as RESERVED, Cropp, House, MOHITO and SiNSAY. The Company operates departments in Gdansk, Cracow, Shanghai and Dhaka. LPP SA operates several national and numerous foreign subsidiaries.

name: LOKUM DEWELOPER SA
businessSummary: Lokum Deweloper SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction and engineering industry. The Company offers wide range of commercial and residential buildings, including selling of flats, apartments, houses and parking lots, as well as renting offices and commercial spaces. In addition, Lokum Deweloper SA provides partial finishing flats services, such as building renovation. The Company's products portfolio encompasses Lokum Vita, Lokum da Vinci and Lokum de Trevi, among others. It is active in the domestic market, exactly in Wroclaw.

name: LENTEX SA
businessSummary: Lentex SA, formerly Zaklady Lentex SA, is a Poland-based floor covering and nonwovens manufacturer. The Company’s product portfolio includes residential and commercial polyvinyl chloride (PVC) floor coverings, nonwovens, such as flat, fluffy and spun lace fabrics applied in various industries, as well as sport floor coverings systems. Additionally, the Company provides quilting services. It distributes its products through retail networks of Castorama, Komfort, Leroy Merlin, PSB, and Praktiker. It also sells its products in Ukraine, the Russian Federation, Kazakhstan, Lithuania and Latvia, among others. The Company is a parent entity of a capital group, consisting Zaklady Tworzyw Sztucznych Garmat SA and Lentex Marketing Sp z o o and Baltic Wood SA.

name: LENA LIGHTING SA
businessSummary: Lena Lighting SA is a Poland-based manufacturer of lighting fittings. The Company’s offering comprises interior, machine, portable and exterior lighting, as well as floodlighting. The Company’s products portfolio includes also electro-technical articles, such as electronic transformers and extension leads. It undertakes lighting projects and provides expert consultancy. The Company also offers design software, Prometheus 3.0, which is used to design lighting in closed rooms. It distributes its products domestically, as well as to countries worldwide including Germany, France, Russia, Czech Republic, Sweden and Hungary. The Company operates such subsidiaries as Lena Lighting Hungary Kft, Lena Lighting GmbH and Luxmat Investment Sp z o o, among others.

name: DEVELIA SA
businessSummary: Develia SA, formerly known as LC Corp SA, is a Poland-based holding company engaged in the real estate development operations. It is involved in the acquisition, management, rental and sale of commercial and residential properties located in such Polish cities as Warsaw, Wroclaw, Krakow, Lodz, Gdansk and their surroundings. Its main development projects in the commercial properties area include Arkady Wroclawskie shopping and retail complex in Wroclaw, as well as an office complex, Wola Center in Warsaw. In the area of residential investment it develops apartments houses Przy Promenadzie, Rezydencja Kaliska and Powstancow 33 in Warsaw; Maestro and Vratislavia Residence in Wroclaw; Debowa Ostoja in Lodz; as well as Niepolomicka and Srebrena in Gdansk. The Company owns 99.95% stake in LC Corp Invest XV Sp z o o Investments SKA. and 100% stake in Sky Tower SA, in the the Netherlands.

name: LIBET SA
businessSummary: Libet SA is a Poland-based company engaged in construction materials industry. The Company manufactures and sells sett and other concrete surfacing materials, such as paving blocks, pavement blocks and sandstone. The Company has production facilities in 14 factories and has 24 production lines. Libet SA also has a distribution network of Authorized Retail Outlets and sells its products directly to road construction companies, warehouses and general construction concerns. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated two wholly owned subsidiaries, Libet 200 Sp. z o.o. and Libet Libiaz Sp. z o.o.

name: KRYNICA VITAMIN SA
businessSummary: Krynica Vitamin SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the beverages industry. The Company is a producer of non-alcoholic and low-alcoholic beverages. It specializes in producing beverages for its own brands and providing bottling services for brand-name products. The Company's offer includes functional and energy drinks, such as isotonic and hypotonic drinks, beverages that support the metabolism, and vitamin dietary supplements. Krynica Vitamin SA also provides functional waters, modern mixed-fruit drinks, drinks with fruit pulp, alcopops, ciders, malt beverages and a selection of carbonated beverages. In addition, the Company is engaged in the research and development services for its products. It operates through Dent Blanche s r o.

name: KORPORACJA KGL SA
businessSummary: Kgl SA is a Poland-based company which is primarily engaged in wholesale of chemical products industry. The Company's activities are divided into two business segments: Production and Distribution. The Production division is engaged in the production of plastic products, i.e. mainly plastic packaging produced by thermoforming and foil produced by extrusion. The Production division produces foil and packaging from three main types of plastics corresponding mainly to the specifics of the food industry. The Distribution division carries out the distribution of plastic granulates and coloring agents. The Distribution segment is also focused on the sale of three categories of plastics - technical, polyolefin and styrene, which are used in various industries.

name: KRUK SA
businessSummary: Kruk SA is a Poland-based company, which is engaged in the business support industry. The Company is a multi-operator, which offers loss prevention and debt collection services. The Company divides its business into two main operating segments: Debt Purchase, including acquisition of non-performing debt portfolios, and Debt Collection Outsourcing, offering fee-based collection of debt on client’s behalf, focused on consumer and corporate loans. The Company provides services to financial institutions and large corporate customers. It manages receivables of banks, credit intermediaries, leasing companies and digital platform providers, among others. The Company’s operating activities concentrate in a number of countries, such as Poland, Romania, Czech Republic, Slovakia and Spain. The Company's subsidiaries include Kruk Deutschland GmbH, Presco Investments Sarl and Espand Soluciones de Gestion y Recuperacion de Deuda SL, among others.

name: KOSZALINSKIE PRZEDSIEBIORSTWO PRZEMYSLU
businessSummary: Koszalinskie Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Drzewnego SA (KPPD SA) is a Poland-based company active in the wood processing sector. The Company acts as a producer and wholesale and retail trader. Its products portfolio includes softwood and hardwood timber, construction timber, covering and terrace boards, sleepers, wooden garden products, glued boards, briquette and heating wood. It also sells interior decoration articles as well as sanitations ceramics, glues, joint, paints, lacks, furniture, spare parts for sawmill machines, among others. It operates plants located in the Eastern part of Western Pomerania District, including nine softwood sawmills in Czaplinek, Drawsko Pomorskie, among others; two hardwood sawmills in Kolacz and Wierzchowo; two warehouses in Koszalin and Szczecinek, as well as a plant producing beech and oak glued boards in Bialogard. In August 2014 liquidated its branch Koszalinskie Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Drzewnego Spolka Akcyjna Sklad Fabryczny nr 1 w Szczecinku.

name: PRZEDSIEBIORSTWO PRODUKCYJNO HANDLOWE KO
businessSummary: Przedsiebiorstwo Produkcyjno Handlowe Kompap SA is a Poland-based company engaged in printing services and solutions. The Company’s range of activities includes the production and trade of printed forms, envelopes, paper for computer printers, leaflets, paper rolls, cash registered rolls, thermal, fax and self-adhesive rolls, brochures, catalogues, instruction sets to electronic equipment, labels and carton boxes, among others. It serves various sectors and industries such as insurance and financial, enterprises, public administration, chemical and pharmaceutical and electronics market. The Company's subsidiaries include OZGRAF Olsztynskie Zaklady Graficzne SA, Bialostockie Zaklady Graficzne SA, Komunikacja Masowa Sp z o o, and Imprimus Sp z o o.

name: KINO POLSKA TV SA
businessSummary: Kino Polska TV SA is a Poland-based media group. It distributes and produces content for television, VOD platforms, streaming services and cinemas. The Company’s main activities include: television broadcasting and distribution, as well as publishing and television production. The Company operates the television channels Kino Polska, Kino Polska Muzyka, Zoom TV, Stopklatka, Kino TV, FilmBox and other thematic channels. In addition, The Company produces and distributes stations of the FilmBox group in Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania and Hungary. The Company owns a publishing house, Wydawnictwo Telewizji Kino Polska, which is engaged in the production of digital video discs (DVD) devoted to Polish films. It also sells advertising time on selected channels.

name: KOMPUTRONIK SA
businessSummary: Komputronik SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the distribution of hardware and software solutions, as well as consumer electronics products. The Company's product portfolio is comprised of notebooks, personal computers, monitors, computer peripherals and components, chargers and others. It operates through retail stores and a network of authorized dealers, Komputronik Partner, as well as runs an online shop and stores on a franchise basis. In addition, the Company is involved in the provision of other information technology (IT) services, such as customer-tailored business analysis tools and management support systems, including enterprise resource planning (ERM) and customer relationship management (CRM) solutions. It also sells equipment under its own brand names, including Geo PC brand for computers. On January 21, 2013, the Company established new subsidiary, Komputronik GmbH, Germany.

name: MIRACULUM SA
businessSummary: Miraculum SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the manufacture, distribution, wholesale and retail trade of cosmetics and skin care products. The Company’s portfolio of brands includes Miraculum, Pani Walewska, Brutal, Gracja, Tanita, Paloma, Lider, Wars and Byc moze. The product range includes facial care cosmetics, featuring creams, toners, milks and masks; body care solutions, encompassing hand creams and body lotions; sun protection articles; perfumes; skin care solutions for teenagers; and supplementing products. It operates in the domestic and foreign markets, exporting its products to approximately 20 countries worldwide, including Russia, Ukraine, Azerbaijan, Lithuania, Belarus, the United States and Germany, among others.

name: RAWLPLUG SA
businessSummary: Rawlplug SA, (formerly Koelner SA), is a Poland-based manufacturer and wholesaler of fixings for construction and industry sectors. Its range of activities includes the production and distribution of fixing systems, cable suspension systems, insulation fixings for facades and roofs, self-drilling screws, powder actuated and gas-driven fastening systems, accessories for drywall systems, wood connectors, ropes and rope accessories, as well as hand and power tools, including screw drivers, pliers, hammers, drilling and cutting tools, and others. It product portfolio includes about 40,000 items offered under such brand names as Koelner, Modeco, Rrawlplug, Globus and Rawlfixing. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated a number of subsidiaries based in Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Bulgaria, Romania, Lithuania, Ukraine, South Africa, Germany and Slovakia, among others. The Company major shareholder is Amicus Poliniae Sp z o o.

name: ZESPOL ELEKTROCIEPLOWNI WROCLAWSKICH KOG
businessSummary: Zespol Elektrocieplowni Wroclawskich Kogeneracja SA (Kogeneracja SA) is a Poland-based power industry company operating in the production of heating and electricity, as well as wholesale and retail of heat and electric power. In addition, the Company uses and utilizes the combustion side-products and supply of biomass for energy production from renewable sources, production of construction compounds based on cement, aggregates and by-products of coal combustion . The Company operates through three production plants, such as Elektrocieplownia Wroclaw, Elektrocieplownia Czechnica and Elektrocieplownia Zawidawie. Kogeneracja SA is active through subsidiary EC Zielona Gora SA, which produces electricity, and produces and distributes heat.

name: KGHM POLSKA MIEDZ SA
businessSummary: KGHM Polska Miedz SA is a Poland-based company involved in the copper ore mining, copper production and the production of precious metals and other non-ferrous metals. The Company also produces salt and provides casting of light metals. It deals with geological and exploratory activities, as well as waste management. KGHM Polska Miedz SA has a multi-divisional organizational structure, which comprises its Head Office and several divisions: mines, smelters, the Concentrator Division, the Tailings division, the Mine-Smelter Emergency Rescue Division and the Data Center Division. Its products are sold domestically, as well as exported to Germany, the United Kingdom, France, China, and the Czech Republic, among others. Through a wholly owned subsidiary Bipromet SA the Company is also engaged in construction and engineering industry. The Company operates direct and indirect subsidiaries, as well as affiliated companies.

name: GRUPA KETY SA
businessSummary: Grupa Kety SA is a Poland-based company that is principally engaged in the aluminum industry. The Company’s activities are divided into following segments: Extruded Product, Aluminum Systems, Constructional Accessories, Constructional Service, Transport Systems and Flexible Packaging. The Company’s offer includes aluminum profiles, components, extrusions, multi-layer packaging made of aluminum foil and polypropylene, polyethylene and polyester films and paper, building fittings and system accessories, and car bodies for utility cars, among others. It also provides assembly of aluminum facades. On May 21, 2014, the Company established new wholly owned subsidiary, Grupa Kety Italia srl.

name: CLEAN&CARBON ENERGY SA
businessSummary: Clean&Carbon Energy SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the real estate operations. The Company’s main activities are buying and selling real property as well as renting and managing owned and leased properties. It rents properties in Szczecin, Gorzow Wielkopolski, Stargard Szczecinski and Cecenowo.

name: FABRITY HOLDING SA
businessSummary: Fabrity SA, formerly Fabrity Holding SA, is a Poland-based Internet marketing company, which focuses on offering new media and technology. The Company’s services include usability research and design, media planning, managed hosting, search engine marketing, electronic commerce (e-commerce) systems, performance marketing and loyalty programs, among others.

name: JWW INVEST SA
businessSummary: JWW Invest SA, located in Katowice, Poland, provides power equipment repair and maintenance services. It was founded in 2012.

name: JASTRZEBSKA SPOLKA WEGLOWA SA
businessSummary: Jastrzebska Spolka Weglowa SA is a Poland-based coking coal producer. The Company’s activities are divided into two sectors: Coal, including extraction and sales of black coal; and Coke, including production and sales of coke and coal derivatives. Additionally, the Company is engaged in natural gas mining and generation, transmission and distribution of electricity. The Company’s products are sold domestically as well as to Germany, Austria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania and Hungary, among others. The Company operates five mining plants: Borynia-Zofiowka, Budryk, Jas-Mos, Krupinski and Pniowek.

name: IZOSTAL SA
businessSummary: Izostal SA is a Poland-based company active in the steel industry. It is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of steel pipes, metallurgical products and steel fixtures. It offers external anticorrosive coatings for steel pipes used mainly for constructing transmission pipelines, such as single layer epoxy coatings, three layer epoxy-copolymer-polyethylene coatings and three layer epoxy-copolymer-polypropylene coatings. Apart from anticorrosive coatings, its product portfolio comprises a range of steel pipes, including seamless pipes, pipes welded with high frequency current, spiral-welded steel pipes and longitudinally welded steel pipes; long and flat metallurgical products, such as angles, bars, cold-formed profiles, cold- and hot-rolled steel sheets of various formats. As of December 31, 2011, its main shareholder was Stalprofil SA, with a 60.3% stake in the capital.

name: IZOLACJA JAROCIN SA
businessSummary: Izolacja Jarocin SA is a Poland-based producer and wholesaler of asphalt roofing materials. The Company’s range of products includes various types of asphalt roofing, including paper-based and thermally sealed; mastic asphalt; asphalt shingles with fiberglass filing; construction putty, including resin- and asphalt resin-based, as well as other adhesives and insulation mixtures. Additionally, it provides specialized equipment, tools and services for asphalt roofing installation. The Company operates a production facility in Jarocin, Poland. It offers thermally sealed tar papers under the Jarbit and Jarplast brands.

name: IZOBLOK SA
businessSummary: Izoblok SA, formerly Izo-Blok SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the chemicals industry. The Company specializes in processing enhanced plastics, especially enhanced polypropylene (EPP). Its activity is mainly related to automotive industry and logistics. The Company provides car parts used in the production of bumpers, headrests, child seats, dashboards, armrests, among others. It offers reusable packaging and reusable transport containers, such as containers for automobile mirrors, brake calipers or steering gears. Electrostatic dischargeable types are available for packaging sensitive electronic goods. The Company’s clients and partners are Audi, Ford, Skoda, Jaguar, Kia, Hyundai, Volkswagen, LG Display, Ikea, Hutchinson, among others. It operates through SSW PearlFoam GmbH.

name: RAEN SA
businessSummary: Raen SA, formerly known as Punkpirates SA, is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the renewable energy sector. The Company focuses on the provision of energy solutions in the field of photovoltaic technology. The Firm’s offer includes design, construction, service and maintenance of photovoltaic installations. In addition, Raen SA conducts energy consultations and energy audits. The Company provides its services to individual clients, as well as enterprises and local governments, enabling them to switch to sustainable energy sources.

name: IPOPEMA SECURITIES SA
businessSummary: Ipopema Securities SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the capital markets industry. The Company focuses on providing brokerage, equity research, and investment banking services. Their key product is a portfolio and fund management platform, which is a financial services solution. It aims to support institutional and retail clients in managing investments, executing transactions, and accessing capital markets.

name: BRAS SA
businessSummary: Bras SA, formerly Inventi SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the provision of renewable energy services. The Company’s activities are divided into three business areas: Project development, which focuses on the creation and implementation of renewable energy projects, collection of construction permissions, provision of environmental studies, as well as coordination of design works before project sale, among others; Energy management, which includes consulting services for individual customers, energy audits and modernization of energy installations, and Consulting, which offers services to companies active in the electric utilities sector, including analysis of energy market, computer systems and corporate structure, as well as financial and legal advisory, among others.

name: INTERSPORT POLSKA SA
businessSummary: Intersport Polska SA is a Poland-based company, which is principally engaged in the trade of sports goods. Its offering includes a range of sports equipment and clothes under such brand names as Adidas, Nike, Reebok, Puma, Asics, Giant, Ecco, Rossignol, Salomon, The North Face and Jack Wolfskin, as well as products under its own-brand names: McKinley and Pro Touch, among others. The Company operates 30 outlets located in malls in Poland, in such cities as Cracow, Warsaw, Katowice, Lodz, Poznan, Wroclaw, Gdansk and others. In addition, the Company provides seasonal maintenance of sport equipment, rental of ski models and tennis rackets, operates ski club for kids and teenagers and others.

name: INTROL SA
businessSummary: Introl SA is a Poland-based provider of industrial automation solutions. It is the superior company of the Introl Capital Group. The Company's services include the design, implementation and start-up of automation solutions for measuring and controlling equipment, electrical and power installations, industrial machinery and control units, as well as for environmental engineering projects. Its production unit offers components for measuring and controlling equipment, as well as temperature sensors. The distribution segment offers control and measuring equipment and software, as well as measuring system design and technical support. The Company with its subsidiaries and affiliated companies forms a capital group which covers three business sectors including services, distribution and production.

name: IMS SA
businessSummary: IMS SA, formerly Internet Media Services SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the advertising and marketing industry. The Company specializes is sensory marketing services and uses techniques which allow creating appropriate mood and influencing the customer. Its solutions include three service groups: audio marketing, preparation of music formats, production and broadcast of audio advertisements; digital signage, production and broadcast of advertising messages and visual and informative content on plasma screens; aromamarketing preparation of individual aroma-projects which include a brand's image and specificity of the point of sale (POS). In addition, It offers in-store advertising, including in-store TV, in-store radio, as well as POS TV. The Company is a parent of a number of entities, such as Mood Factory, Tech Cave Sp z oo, Videotronic Media Solutions Sp z o o and Entertainment Group Sp z o o.

name: CFI HOLDING SA
businessSummary: CFI Holding SA, previously Intakus SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction sector. The Company’s activities include construction of multi- and single-family facilities, construction of industrial buildings, modernization and renovation of general building facilities, development of construction projects and regulations, rental and sales of tower cranes and building containers, machinery and vehicles and wholesale of construction materials. The Company operates such subsidiaries as Towarzystwo Budownictwa Spolecznego Nasze Katy Sp z o o, IMA Maszyny budowlane Sp z o o, BL8 Sp z o o SKA and Central Fund of Immovables Sp z o o.

name: LESS SA
businessSummary: Less SA, formerly Groclin SA, is a Poland-based company. The Company is the management company of the LESS Capital Group. The Group is engaged in the provision of services to subsidiaries, including business and management consulting, financial reporting and bookkeeping. The Company makes strategic decisions regarding the directions of its activities, as well as activities of the companies of the Group. Operational and development activities are carried out in the subsidiaries CountMe Sp. z o.o. and LESS BIKE Sp. z o.o. LESS Group is a brand associated with selling and acquiring used items - clothes, toys, books - and placing them again on the subsequent market - both off-line and in an on-line shop.

name: INTER CARS SA
businessSummary: Inter Cars SA is a Poland-based car and truck parts importer and distributor. The Company’s offering includes spare parts for passenger and commercial cars and trucks, motorcycle parts, semitrailers, tuning products, car accessories, garage equipment, as well as gas installation services and production of semi-trailers. It operates through 149 branches in Poland, and 106 branches abroad, located in such countries as: the Czech Republic, Bulgaria, Slovakia, Ukraine, Lithuania, Hungary, Croatia, Latvia, Italy and Romania. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated 20 subsidiaries, including Inter Cars Ukraine LCC, Lauber Sp. z o.o., Q-Service Sp. z o.o., Inter Cars Ceska Republika, Feber Sp. z o.o. and Inter Cars Slovenska Republika, among others.

name: INTERBUD LUBLIN SA
businessSummary: INTERBUD LUBLIN SA is a Poland-based company active in construction and engineering. It is engaged in residential, industrial, commercial and environmental construction. It also offers modernization of public and commercial properties such as schools, hospital branches, sport halls and pitches, petrol stations, warehouses, office buildings, sewer systems, water treatment plants and others. Additionally, the Company provides preparation of land for construction, civil engineering, rental of construction equipment and real estate services. As of December 31, 2011, the Company held a 100% stake in Interbud-Willowa sp. z o.o. It started works on preparing bankruptcy with possibility of creditors' agreement motion.

name: INSTAL KRAKOW SA
businessSummary: Instal Krakow SA is a Poland-based company principally engaged in the engineering and construction industry. The Company’s other activities comprise the manufacture of fabricated metal and plastic products, refrigeration and ventilation systems, steam generators, heaters, as well as central heating boilers. It specializes in the implementation and installation of its products for industrial, municipal and environmental protection objects. Instal Krakow SA also operates in such areas as investment in the residential buildings construction and property leasing. The Company’s goods are sold domestically, as well as abroad. As of December 31, 2011, Instal Krakow SA was a parent entity of a capital group that included the Company's four subsidiaries, Frapol Sp. z o.o., Biprowumet Sp. z o.o, BTH Instalacje Sp. z o.o. and Wamstal Sp. z o.o.

name: INPRO SA
businessSummary: INPRO SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the construction of apartment buildings. The Company operates at the Polish Baltic coast in Gdansk, Gdynia and Sopot as well as abroad. INPRO SA’s offer comprises primarily of apartments and single-family houses. The Company also implements commercial projects such as hotels, apartment and office buildings, and renders construction and renovation services. The Company operates wholly owned subsidiaries, Rugby Prefabrykaty Sp. z o.o, which manufactures pre-cast concrete units and elements of door and window joinery, and is involved in the manufacture and erection of steel structures; Dom Zdrojowy Sp z o o, which runs a hotel in Jastarnia, Hotel Mikolajki Sp z o o, engaged in hotel industry; PB Domesta Sp z o o o, which specializes in building and selling flats and Przedsiebiorstwo Instalacyjne ISA Sp z o o.

name: INC SA
businessSummary: INC SA, formerly Investcon Group SA, is a Poland-based company that specializes in investments and advisory services related to raising funds for investment projects. It offers business and management consulting services, managing business activities, auxiliary financial services to businesses, financial mediation, training and education. The Company's service is directed to small and medium companies aiming at the NewConnect Market and at the Warsaw Stock Exchange. INC SA operates through subsidiaries and affiliates, such as Inwest Consulting SA, Inwest e-Finance Sp z o o, Investcon Fund Sp z o o, Dom Maklerski INC SA and e-Misja Sp z o o.

name: HARPER HYGIENICS SA
businessSummary: Harper Hygienics SA is a Poland-based producer of hygiene products and cosmetics. Its range of products includes cotton balls and pads, wet wipes, peeling wet wipes, baby wipes and accessories, cotton swabs and plaster strips. It offers its personal hygiene products under the brand names Ola and Cleanic, which includes such product lines as Cleanic, Cleanic Natural Beauty, Cleanic dzidzius, Cleanic Kindii, Cleanic Intimate, Cleanic Clean O’’Peel, and house cleaning wipes, such as multipurpose wipes and wipes for furniture, as well as for cars, under the name Presto Clean. As of December 31, 2011 the Company operated two wholly owned subsidiaries based in the Russian Federation, Harper Hygenics Rus OOO and Harper Production OOO. The Company's majority stakeholder was Central European Cotton Holdings Ltd. Ireland with a 74.59% stake in the capital.

name: STARHEDGE SA
businessSummary: Starhedge SA, formerly Global Energy SA, is a Poland-based company active in the renewable energy sector. The Company is engaged in energy production from different renewable sources through its brand Greenenergy, as well as crop production and dairy cattle farming for eco food, through its brand Graineco. The Company cooperates with Novenergia II Energy&Environmental (SCA) SICAR, as well as Fairplay Agriculutral Fund. It operates in Bulgaria. On March 26, 2014, the Company sold its remaining 50% stake in New Vision Management AD to IBG Consulting Co Ltd, China. It operates through several special purpose entities, such as KIS INVEST 1 OOD, KIS INVEST 2 OOD, KIS INVEST 3 OOD, KIS INVEST 4 OOD and KIS INVEST 5 OOD as well as KIS INVEST OOD.

name: HOLLYWOOD SA
businessSummary: Hollywood SA, located in Sierpc, Poland, provides team management and consulting services in such areas as laundry service and professional uniform leasing. It is also a holding company. It operates through Konsorcjum Pralnicze Sp z o o.

name: WASKO SA
businessSummary: Wasko SA is a Poland-based Information and Communication Technology (ICT) company. It is engaged in the development and manufacture of software, as well as the provision of services within the implementation, maintenance and operation of Information Technology (IT) systems, including IT audits, trainings, software installation and IT system integration. In addition, its operations include the design and installation of IT infrastructure, as well as the construction of data transmission networks, including radio lines and base stations for mobile telephony. It also provides hosting services as well as outsourcing. As of December 31, 2011, Wasko SA had one wholly owned subsidiary: ISA Sp. z o.o. As of June 18, 2012, the Company established a new subsidiary, D2S Sp. z o.o. As of August 21, 2012, the Company completed the acquisition of an 85% stake in COIG SA.

name: HELIO SA
businessSummary: Helio SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the confection, import and distribution of dried fruits, nuts, seeds and grains, as well as manufacturing of poppy seed products. The Company’s products are offered under three brands, including Helio, Sloneczne Owoce, and Helio Gold. The Company also sales its products in chain store brand names, such as, Auchan, Biedronka, Carrefour, EKO Holding, E.Leclerc, Intermarche, Makro Cash & Carru, Netto,, Piotr I Pawel, Real and Tesco stores. In addition the Company offers dried fruits and nuts in bulk. Its main customers include domestic chain stores, food wholesalers and retail stores.

name: PRZEDSIEBIORSTWO HYDRAULIKI SILOWEJ HYDR
businessSummary: Przedsiebiorstwo Hydrauliki Silowej Hydrotor SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the industrial machinery sector. Its main product groups consist of the hydraulic elements, such as the gear pumps, combine harvesters, bucket loaders, forklift trucks and vans; the hydraulic selector valves with manual and electronic controls, bucket loaders and building machines; the engine oil pumps and the pressure relief and non-return valves, used in forklift trucks, building and road construction machines, combine harvesters and steering block units. In addition, the Company produces the hydraulic power source units, piston pins, toothed and piston flow meters and tool holders. It exports its products to Germany, France, Slovakia, Iraq, Egypt, the Russian Federation, Denmark, the United Kingdom and Hungary, among others. In September 2013, it sold 57.05% stake of Defka's share capital.

name: GLOBE TRADE CENTRE SA
businessSummary: Globe Trade Centre SA (GTC) is a Poland-based holding company engaged in the real estate sector. The Company operates within two real estate market segments, including Office and Commercial Space Rental, and Residential Development for Sale. Through subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates, the Company operates commercial and residential real estate companies in Poland, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, the Russian Federation, Slovakia, Hungary and Ukraine. Its portfolio consists of commercial buildings, residential properties and undeveloped plots of land. The Company is engaged in real estate management, as well as real estate purchasing, sales and rental. Among the Company’s clients are such companies as Carrefour, Cora, Zara, Reserved, Peek & Cloopenburg, C&A, H&M, Cinema City and New Yorker, among others. The main shareholder of the Company is LSREF III GTC Investments BV (LSREF).

name: CAPITEA SA
businessSummary: Capitea SA, formerly known as GetBack SA w restrukturyzacji, is a Poland-based company engaged in the financial sector. The Company provides debt collection services. The Company's activities are divided into two segments: Proprietary Funds and Third-Party Funds. The Proprietary Funds division focuses on the recovery of liabilities for its own account using securitization funds and securitization firms owned by the GetBack Group, such as easyDebt NSFIZ, Universe 3 NSFIZ, GetPro NSFIZ, Open Finance Wierzytelnosci NSFIZ and Bakura Sp z o o. The Third-Party Funds division is responsible for the management of accounts receivable portfolios owned by securitization funds based on unit-linked funds, as well as provision of related advisory services, such as legal consulting and representation in court.

name: GETIN HOLDING SA
businessSummary: Getin Holding SA is a Poland-based financial holding. The Company invests in ventures on the markets of Central and Eastern Europe. It divides its services into four segments: Banking Services, Leasing Services, Financial Intermediation and Holding Services. The Company’s main activities are connected to the investment in and management of the Capital Group, while the remaining units of the group deal with retail banking, leasing, financial intermediation and insurance intermediation and other financial activities. Among the Company’s brands are Idea Bank Polska, Tax Care, Idea Expert, MW Trade, Idea Leasing, Carcade, Kuban Bank, Idea Bank Ukraine and Idea Bank Belarus. The Company is operational in Poland, Ukraine, Belarus and the Russian Federation. In October 18, 2013, it acquired 95.5% stake in Bialoruski Bank Malego Biznesu ZAO (Belarusian Bank for Small Business). In June 2014, it acquired a 96.066% stake in OAO Investisionnyi Doveritel'nyi Yevropeyskiy Aktsionernyi Bank.

name: GRUPA PRACUJ SA
businessSummary: Grupa Pracuj SA is a Poland-based company engaged in digital recruitment market. The Company provides support services to businesses in the recruitment, retention and development of employees and technological support for Human Resources (HR) processes in companies within the Software as a Service (SaaS) model. Grupa Pracuj's operations cover two main areas of activity: comprehensive online recruitment and modern technologies for Human Resources (HR). The Company owns the brands, such as Pracuj.pl, Robota.ua, Dryg.pl, Theprotocol.it and eRecruiter system. The Company has been present in Poland and Ukraine.

name: GRODNO SA
businessSummary: Grodno SA is a Poland-based company active in the electric lighting sector. It is a distributor of electrical and lighting fixtures. It sells product in the wholesale and retail trade. The Company operates through a main office and a network of 36 local branches based in Poland. The Company also offers lighting and electrical installations design, technical consultancy, lighting maintenance, transportation and disposal of used lamps.

name: 3R GAMES SA
businessSummary: 3R Games SA, formerly known as HubStyle SA, is a Poland-based company. Main acitity of the Company is publishing of computer games for high-end virtual reality devices and platforms Facebook Oculus Quest 2 PlayStation VR, HTC Vive, Steam VR.

name: GIELDA PAPIEROW WARTOSCIOWYCH W WARSZAWI
businessSummary: Gielda Papierow Wartosciowych w Warszawie SA (Warsaw Stock Exchange, GPW) is a Poland-based stock exchange. It is a parent entity of WSE Group that offers products and services within its trading markets of equity, derivate, fixed income and structured products. It also distributes market data. The Company has two business lines: Financial market, which includes trading in equities, derivatives, fixed-income and other instruments, listing, and information services; and Commodity market, which includes trading in electricity and property rights in certificates of origin, operation of a register of certificates of origin, clearing, trade and technical trade operator services. As of December 31, 2011, it operates two wholly owned subsidiaries, WSEInfoEngine SA, providing data transmission and information services; and Instytut Rynku Kapitalowego WSE Research SA, engaged in publishing; as well as 92.47%-owned BondSpot SA.

name: GENOMTEC SA
businessSummary: Genomtec SA is a Poland-based company engaged in biotechnology and medical research business sector and it is operating in the field of clinical diagnostics. The Company is focused on development of of Genomtec ID, a mobile platform for genetic diagnosis in the point of patient care. Its creation and commercialization allows the diagnostic process to be executed in point of care setting, such as: primary care clinics, pharmacies, doctor’s offices, hospital emergency departments (ERs) without the need for complicated and time-consuming laboratory workflow conducted by qualified personnel.

name: GAMES OPERATORS SA
businessSummary: Games Operators SA is a Poland- based company primarily engaged in software publishing. The Company outsourcing games creation to other companies, funding the full development process and marketing.

name: GAMING FACTORY SA
businessSummary: Gaming Factory SA is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in videogames development. The Company operates as an advisor for other companies that develop video games. The Firm provides the necessary finances for some projects and knowledge in the field of game development. The Firm cooperates with a team of specialists, which are needed for computer game development, such as programmers, graphic designers, and game planners. The Company focuses on developing programs for platforms such as personal computers (PC) and consoles such as Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox. The Company also engages in porting games to consoles and in board-game production. The Firm developed multiple titles such as Anthology of Fear, Bug Academy, City Eye, and Grave Keeper among others.

name: DR MIELE COSMED GROUP SA
businessSummary: Dr Miele Cosmed Group SA, formerly Global Cosmed SA is a Poland-based company active in the cosmetic sector. The Company is engaged in production and distribution of cosmetics and detergents. The Company’s brand portfolio comprises such products as Apart Natural and Malwa, personal wash and care products, Bobini Baby and Bobini, personal wash and care products for kids, Sofin Global, fabric softeners and washing liquids, Kret, cleaning detergents, and Robots, products for dishwashers. The Company sells its products domestically as well as abroad, in such countries as Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Germany, the Russian Federation, Albania, Kosovo and the United States. The Company is a part of the Dr. Miele Cosmed Group.

name: FAST FINANCE SA W RESTRUKTURYZACJI
businessSummary: Fast Finance SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the receivables market. The Company’s strategy is to purchase retail debts and then retrieve them on its own account. The Company’s clients comprise various financial institutions. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated one 50.12%-owned subsidiary, Columbus Factoring Solutions SA, engaged in financing and securing the cooperation with health care entities. It operates through FF Inkaso Sp z o o. Receivables held by FF Inkaso from the parent company Fast Finance S.A. in restructuring result from repayments made to the bondholders of Fast Finance S.A. from the funds the Company receives from debtors within the framework of its debt packages.

name: FABRYKI SPRZETU I NARZEDZI GORNICZYCH GR
businessSummary: Fabryki Sprzetu i Narzedzi Gorniczych Grupa Kapitalowa Fasing SA is a Poland-based company that specializes in the production of link chains. Its product portfolio includes round and flat link mining chains, combined cutter loader chains, chain assemblies, locks, lifting chains, hoist chains, trawl chains, and other general purpose chains. The Company provides services in the area of mechanics and automatics, including maintenance and repairs. Its main customers are companies active in the mining, power, building, transport, agriculture and fishing industry. The Company operates through Zavody gornowo oborudowanija i instrumenta Fasing OOO and FASING Sino-Pol (Beijing) Mining Equipment and Tools Co Ltd.

name: FABRYKI MEBLI FORTE SA
businessSummary: Fabryki Mebli Forte SA is a Poland-based company, which is engaged in the production of furniture. It specializes in home, office and kitchen furniture. Its home furniture offerings include furniture systems for the lounge, dining room, bedroom, living room, sitting room, study and children's room, as well as wall units. The Company's office furniture offerings include a range of system furniture, which consists of number of cabinets in different designs and dimensions. The offer also includes complex computer stands. In the area of kitchen furniture, its product line consists of ready-made cabinets that can be put together in different arrangements, as well as customized kitchen projects. The Company operates through subsidiaries, including MV Forte GmbH, Forte Mobel AG, Forte Mobila Srl and TM Handel Sp z o o, among others.

name: FERRO SA
businessSummary: Ferro SA is a Poland-based Company active in the sanitary and heating sector. Its offer includes sanitary and installation fittings under their own brand FERRO as well as elements of heating systems under own brand name Weberman. Furthermore, the Company represents Italian brands Caleffi, Cewal and Cimm on the Polish market. The Group operates in the Polish market and carries out international sales activities in among others Romanian, French, Ukrainian, Belorussian, Bulgarian and Russian markets. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated four subsidiaries, including Ferro International Sp. z o.o., Nvaservis spol sro, based in the Czech Republic, Novaservis Romania SRL, based in Romania and Ferro Marketign Sp. z o.o.

name: FEERUM SA
businessSummary: Feerum SA is a Poland-based company active in the construction sector. The Company produces grain elevators, which are designed for drying and storage of plant products such as grain, oily and legume plants, corn and other. It offers analysis of customer expectations through the technological solutions propositions, appliances productions, object erection, transmission to operation, after-sales service and delivery of components. The Company’s product portfolio includes cylofans, bucket elevators, chain conveyors, funnel silos, flat-bottomed silos, continuous cycle drivers and batch cycle drivers, among others. It operates in Poland, Ukraine, Belarus, Lithuania and Romania. The Company is controlled by Danmag Sp z o o.

name: GRENEVIA
businessSummary: Grenevia SA, formerly known as Famur SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the manufacturing of mining machinery, and green energy technologies. The Company is active in multiple sectors: Mining Equipment and Machinery, Clean Energy Generation, Energy Storage and Batteries, and Energy Distribution and Metering. Mining Equipment and Machinery is a sector in which the Company produces automated longwall systems enabling the exploitation of coal, equipment for underground mines and open pits, as well as bulk material handling equipment and machines for coal preparation plants. Clean Energy Generation is a sector in which the Company focuses on producing clean energy such as solar and wind energy. Energy Storage and Batteries is a sector focused on e-mobility, energy storage, and batteries. Energy Distribution and Metering sector focuses on the transmission and distribution of energy, energy metering, and smart grids. The Company operates through its multiple subsidiaries.

name: EUROCASH SA
businessSummary: Eurocash SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the industry of wholesale and retail distribution of food and distribution of fast moving consumer goods (FMCG). It operates through four segments: Wholesale, Retail, Projects and Others. The Wholesale segment is divided into Eurocash Distribution, including distribution and supporting franchise activities; Cash&Carry, which operates a national network of warehouses; Tobacco & Impulse, which distributes tobacco products, Alcohol Distribution, Eurocash Food Service and Other. The Retail segment operates the retails activities of Eurocahs group and the wholesale of Delikatesy Centrum franchisees. It also includes other retail operations under EKO, Mila and Inmedio brand names. The Project segment is dedicated to run the projects of the Eurocash Group. It cooperates with different partners including abc, Groszek, Delikatesy Centrum, Lewiatan, Euro Sklep or Gama.

name: ESOTIQ & HENDERSON SA
businessSummary: Esotiq & Henderson SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the fashion industry. The Company aims at designing, producing and selling clothes and cosmetics for female and male. Its product’s portfolio encompasses lingerie, swimsuits, pajamas and robes, as well as t-shirts, shorts, blouses, bags and dresses. In addition, Esotiq & Henderson SA provides cosmetics products, such as shower gel, lotions, peelings, creams, shampoos, conditioners, lips ticks as well as fragrances, among others. The Company operates in the domestic market, though franchising business model and internationally, through dealers in Slovakia, Lithuania, Estonia, the Russian Federation, Ukraine, Moldova, Kazakhstan and Latvia.

name: EUROTEL SA
businessSummary: Eurotel SA is a Poland-based company active in telecommunications sector. It acts as an authorized dealer of the products of Polish mobile telephony operators, T-Mobile (formerly ERA) and Play. It operates a network of points of sale, offering such products as mobile phones and accessories, wireless connection services, prepaid card services and customer-tailored packages. Eurotel SA operates also a network of approximately 400 electronic terminals for the prepaid recharges of mobiles phones for such network operators as Heyah, Tak Tak, Pop, SIMPLUS, Sami Swoi and Play. In addition, it is an authorized partner for an operator of the satellite television, Telewizja Nowej Generacji n. On December 20, 2013, the Company acquired a business under Apple Premium Reseller (APR) agreement with Apple Inc, comprised of four APR sales points.

name: EUROSNACK SA
businessSummary: Eurosnack SA is a Poland-based company active in the food processing sector. It is engaged in the production and sale of salty snacks, such as potato and gluten-free corn chips. It also offers traditional sponge cake cookies. The Company’s products are sold under Chrupcie, Lajkonik, Hip Chrup and Salaterki brand names, among others. Eurosnack SA cooperates with Tesco Polska Sp. z o.o., Carrefour Polska Sp. z o.o., E'Leclerc, Eurocash, Eko and Netto, among others. Eurosnack SA has two production units placed in Dobczyce and Chorzow, Poland.

name: EUROPEJSKIE CENTRUM ODSZKODOWAN SA
businessSummary: Europejskie Centrum Odszkodowan SA is a Poland-based company active in the financial sector. It provides services of recovering claims for payment due to indemnity or other payments resulting from damage. The Company conducts negotiations with insurance companies with the aim of recovering payment of indemnity or other benefits before legal action, as well as recovers all the claims connected with accidents, including claims due to loss of health, claims from losing income, reimbursement of medical costs and travel expenses, among others. In addition, through Eucocar SA, the Company offers replacement car after collision.

name: ERG SA
businessSummary: ERG SA is a Poland-based company active in the plastic processing industry. The Company is a manufacturer and wholesale trader of plastics products in three departments: Film Products, Injection Products, and Adhesive Tapes. The Company's product range includes laminating films, cold shrinkable films, deep drawing films, packaging films, thermo shrinkable films, garbage bags, battery cases, transporting containers, baskets, spools, cloaking tapes, self-adhesive tapes and polypropylene packaging tapes, among others. The Company operates through subsidiaries, including wholly own3ed Folpak Sp z o o, among others.

name: ENERGOINSTAL SA
businessSummary: Energoinstal SA is a Poland-based manufacturer of power boilers. Its offer includes power steam boilers, high-duty power water boilers, steam biofuel boilers, boilers and auxiliary devices for waste incinerating plants, boiler houses, supporting structures of boilers and industrial objects, oil and gas burners, gas and oil pressure reducing-metering stations, finned tubes, environmental protection installations and equipment, central heating systems, processing heat installation, water and sewage systems, ventilation and air-conditioning systems, thermal insulations, energetic pipelines and anticorrosion painting, as well as installations made of precious steels for the food industry. The Company also offers assembly and maintenance services. Energoinstal SA is a parent company of the Capital Group that comprises Energoinstal Sp z o o, Instal Bielsko Sp z o o, Instal Development Sp z o o, among others. On November 15, 2013, WAM Sp z o o acquired 61.80% stake in the Company.

name: ERBUD SA
businessSummary: Erbud SA is a Poland-based company active in the construction and engineering sector. It operates in three segments: large-volume building, road engineering, and energy sector construction. It is engaged in the development of public utilities, such as hospitals, swimming pools and schools; commercial buildings, including shopping and services centers; residential buildings, encompassing housing estates, multifamily buildings; hotels and industrial constructions and halls, such as steel and reinforced concrete frames. It is also involved in the modernization and renovation of existing objects, construction of infrastructure and specialist building, such as railroads and road tunnels. The Company operates on the domestic market and in Germany and Ireland. It is a parent of a capital group and operates such subsidiaries as Erbud International Sp z oo, GWI GmbH and Przedsiebiorstwo Budownictwa Drogowo Inzynieryjnego SA, among others.

name: ENTER AIR SA
businessSummary: Enter Air SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the provision of charter air services. The Company's activities are divided into two business segments: Airline services and Sales on board. The Airline services division offers charter flights, as well as certified flight trainings in the field of civil aviation. Its fleet includes over 15 Boeing aircrafts. The Sales on board segment is responsible for the provision of airline catering services and duty free products, such as alcohol, perfumes and tobacco. The Company delivers individual, regular, as well as ad-hoc flights. Its destinantion range comprises Portugal, Spain, Turkey, Greece, Italy, Bulgaria, Croatia, Egypt, and Tunisia, among others. The Company cooperstes with a number of travel agencies, including Rainbow Tours, TUI, Wezyr, and Itaka, among others.

name: CENTRUM MEDYCZNE ENEL MED SA
businessSummary: Centrum Medyczne Enel Med SA is a Poland-based company that provides medical services. The Company is the parent company of the ENEL-MED Capital Group. It offers medical services on the Polish healthcare market for both private patients and those using services within the National Health Fund. The Company provides medical services including: basic and specialist outpatient care, including rehabilitation and outpatient procedures, dental care, including implantology, prosthetics and orthodontics, diagnostic imaging tests, hospitalization, including procedures and surgeries in selected specializations in the form of elective surgeries, out-of-home medicine and interventional home visits as well as aesthetic medicine.

name: ENERGA SA
businessSummary: Energa SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the electric power sector. It produces and distributes the electric power and participates in the electric power market in Northern and Central Poland. It divides its business into seven segments: Electricity Distribution consists of electricity distribution conducted by subsidiaries; Renewable Energy invests in renewable energy sources and produces electricity through hydro, wind and bio-energy plans; Baseload Power Plant consists of manufacturing and investment activities in the area of conventional power plants, service and repair activities related to the generation of electricity; Combined Heat and Power (CHP) includes manufacturing activity of power plants and the heat distribution; Sales is engaged in lighting services, trading of electrical energy and customer service; Services provides accounting, human resources (HR) and payroll services, among others; Other includes hotel and training centers, and transportation services.

name: ENEA SA
businessSummary: Enea SA is a Poland-based company active in the energy sector. It is engaged in the production and distribution of electricity. The Company’s business is divided into three segments: Trading, Distribution, and Production. Enea SA provides energy from fossil fuels and renewable sources, including biomass co-combustion and hydroelectric stations. In addition, the Company is involved in the construction, extension, modernization and renovation of power grids and installations; designing, construction, production and sales of electric devices and equipment, and services related to the maintenance of street lights and low-voltage grids, among others. Enea SA is the parent company of the Enea SA Group comprises a number of subsidiaries. The Company’s major shareholder is the Polish State. It operates through Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka SA.

name: ENERGOAPARATURA SA
businessSummary: Energoaparatura SA is a Poland-based company engaged in specialty engineering, building and architectonic services. Energoaparatura SA undertakes projects in such fields as instrumentation and control, electric works, as well as building installations. The Company’s range of services includes the preparation of technical specification, delivery of instruments and equipment, programming of controllers and visualization of applications, on-site assembling, adjustment, measurement and start-up procedures, as well as personnel training and after-build services. Energoaparatura SA is also engaged in fiber optic works, including light pipe and gradient networks construction.

name: WIKANA SA
businessSummary: Wikana SA is a Poland-based holding company engaged in the real estate development sector. The Company was established as a result of a merger between Masters SA and WIKANA SA. As of December 31, 2011, it managed a capital group, which is comprised of Wikana Project Sp. z o.o. engaged in residential and commercial buildings development; Wikana Nieruchomosci Sp. z o.o. that manages several projects and special purpose companies engaged in the real estate development in Southern Poland; TBS Wikana Sp. z o.o. that manages real estate and Wikana Bioenergia Sp. z o.o., engaged in the renewable energy sector; and Multiserwis Sp. z o.o., engaged in the retail of shoes and leather goods. The Company’s real estate activity includes construction of multifamily houses in the Southern Poland, in such cities as Lublin, Rzeszow, Zamosc, Lancut and Krynica Zdroj, Krosno, Bilgoraj and Legnica. In May 2016, the Company was acquired by a unit of AgioFunds Towarzystwo Funduszy Inwestycyjnych SA.

name: ELEKTROTIM SA
businessSummary: Elektrotim SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the provision of electric installations and automatic systems for the construction industry. The Company produces metal construction elements, machines and devices, as well as conducts and manages building projects. Its products portfolio consists of electric installations and networks, electric switchgears, industrial automatics products, road traffic engineering products, mechanic installations, power automatics products, low-current systems and others. The Company also provides project management services, as well as information technology (IT) solutions in the security management area. It operates through a number of subsidiaries, such as Mawilux SA, Eltrako Sp z o o and Enamor System Sp z o o.

name: EKO EXPORT SA
businessSummary: EKO EXPORT SA is a Poland-based company engaged in processing and distribution of microspheres. The microspheres provided by the Company can be used in various areas, including building sector (elevation panels, special cements, mortars, plasters), power engineering and technology (drilling mud, propeller arms, spaceship coating and composites) and automotive industry (composites, tires, moulds). Microspheres are also used in production of various sport equipment (boats, surfboards, canoes), ceramics (refractory materials, insulating materials) and plastics (nylon, polyethylene). EKO EXPORT SA imports grey and white raw microspheres as well as dried microspheres mainly from Russia, Kazakhstan and Ukraine. The Company's subsidiaries include EKO Sphere KZ, a Kazakhstan-based company.

name: KORPORACJA GOSPODARCZA EFEKT SA
businessSummary: Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt SA is a Poland-based holding company primarily engaged in energy sector. The Company is active within two business sectors: commercial and services, as well as hospitality and tourism. In the commercial and services business segment, it offers non-residential rental and lease services, as well as wholesale and retail trade of solid and fluid fuels and building materials. In the hospitality and tourism field, the Company is engaged in managing hotels and restaurants, particularly with regard to urban and business tourism. It also organizes conferences, conventions and special events. As of December 31, 2011, the Company was operational through three wholly owned subsidiaries: Efekt-bis sp. z o.o., Efekt-Hotele SA and Lider Hotel sp. z o.o. As of June 25, 2012, the Company sold its entire stake in Efekt-bis Sp. z o.o.

name: ED INVEST SA
businessSummary: ED Invest SA is a Poland-based company active in the real estate construction and development sectors. The Company's principal activities comprise of investment preparation, execution, marketing, and sale of apartments and single-family houses, as well as multifamily houses and commercial spaces. The Company is active through two business segments: the Construction segment and the Development segment, which are connected with housing investments. The Company's projects portfolio encompasses several housing projects, such as Osiedle Wilga, Osiedle Jantar, Osiedle Jantar Bis, Osiedle Iskra VI, Osiedle Nasturcja, Przy Parku I, Przy Parku II, Ogrody Bielawy, Dywizjonu 303 and Osiedle Krasnowolska, among others. In addition, The Company offers property management services. ED Invest SA is active in the domestic market in Warsaw.

name: NEW TECH CAPITAL SA
businessSummary: New Tech Capital SA, formerly Invista SA, is a Poland-based business consulting company. The Company’s services portfolio includes financial risk management, financial and strategic advisory, audit services, currency and commodity market analysis, private equity management, as well as mergers and takeovers. The offer is mainly addressed to the small and medium companies. In addition, Invista SA offers trainings in the field of investment risk management and currency market analyses. As of December 31, 2011, the Company wholly owned a brokerage house, Invista Dom Maklerski SA.

name: ECHO INVESTMENT SA
businessSummary: Echo Investment SA is a Poland-based company active in the real estate sector. The Company realizes investments in three operating segments: residential areas, providing leasing out and sale of residential and commercial space; shopping centers, providing leasing out and sale of commercial and entertainment space; and office buildings and hotels, providing leasing out and sale of office and hotel space. The Company manages the investment processes of given projects, starting from the purchase of property, through obtaining administrative permits, financing, implementation, supervision to putting the facility into service. The Company provides its services in Poland, Ukraine, Romania and Hungary. The Company operated 75 subsidiaries providing construction and engineering services, as well as rental and management of real estate properties. The main shareholder of the Company is Bafia Sp z o o. It operates through Compass Offices Management Poland Ltd Sp z o o.

name: EC BEDZIN SA
businessSummary: Ecb SA, formerly known as EC Bedzin SA, is a Poland-based company, which is primarily engaged in the energy sector. The Company is multi-utility provider, specializing in the generation and distribution of heat (water steam and hot water) and electricity for the industrial, municipal and household use. The Company specializes in providing thermal energy for heating, domestic hot water and industrial processes with primary energy source obtained from hard coal. The Company is active in the Zaglebie Dabrowskie region, Poland. The Company provides additional services such as construction and maintenance of distribution infrastructure, including pipelines, power lines, and telecommunications lines.

name: GOBARTO SA
businessSummary: Gobarto SA, formerly Polski Koncern Miesny Duda SA, is a Poland-based company active in the meat processing and distribution industry. The Company focuses on the red meat production. Its main line of business is purchasing and slaughtering of pigs and cattle, as well as butchery services. Apart from sides of pork and quarters of beef, the range of products includes cuts of pork and beef, culinary meat, pluck and fats. Moreover, the Company's offer includes game meat and grains and oilseeds production. As a complement to its production and trading activities, the Company offers services with regard to the freezing and storage of foodstuffs that require specialist refrigeration facilities. It operates within a group comprising approximately 30 companies based in Poland, Ukraine and Germany. The main shareholder of the Company is Cedrob SA. It operates through Meat Pack Sp z o o. The main shareholder of the Company is Cedrob SA.

name: DOM DEVELOPMENT SA
businessSummary: Dom Development SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction and sale of residential real estate. The Company's main activities include housing projects for the mass market, exclusive residences and single-family houses. Dom Development SA cooperates with various banks and independent financial advisors to develop apartment purchase programs, based on mortgage loans. It has one wholly owned subsidiary Dom Development Morskie Oko Sp. z o.o., one affiliated company, Dom Development Grunty Sp. z o.o, active in purchase of real estate for development activities of the Group. The Company also has stake in a joint venture company Fort Mokotow Sp. z o.o. As of December 31, 2011, Dom Development SA was controlled by Dom Development BV, which held a 61.91% stake in the Company. As of December 31, 2011, the Company’s subsidiary, Dom Development Morskie Oko Sp. z o.o., was liquidated.

name: DINO POLSKA SA
businessSummary: Dino Polska SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the food retail. The Company focuses on operating a supermarkets chain under the Dino brand name. Its offer includes dairy and bakery products, chocolate and non-chocolate confectionary, fruits and vegetables, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, as well as pet food, among others. In addition, the Company provides meat stalls under the Agro-Rydzyna brand name, as well as sells non-food goods, such as cosmetics, household products, kitchen appliances and toys. It also offers mobile phone recharge, cash back service and vouchers. The Company's supermarkets are located in a number of Polish voivodeships, including wielkopolskie, dolnoslaskie, lodzkie, mazowieckie and pomorskie, among others.

name: DIAGNOSTYKA SA
businessSummary: Diagnostyka SA is a Poland-based company. It operates a network of medical labs. The Company specializes in providing laboratory services from collecting and transporting biological materials, through testing, to providing the results of medical analysis. It specializes in laboratory tests, specialized tests, Molecular biology tests, Autoimmune diagnostics, blood collection. The Company operates a network of 180 laboratories and 1,100 Sampling Labs throughout Poland. It offers a wide range of laboratory analyzes (over 3000 test types), both routine and specialist, available with and without a physician’s referral, such as hematology, diagnostics of infections, allergology, hormonal diagnostics and more.

name: DGA SA
businessSummary: DGA SA is a Polish consulting and investment company. Its business is divided into following segments: European Funds, including project managements, audit of investment projects, outsourcing of services, acquiring resources and public aid; Business consulting, offering enterprise strategy development, mergers and takeovers, management systems, business continuity management, fraud management, financial consulting and business ethics, among others; Public sector, including programs off revitalization and strategies of development, management systems, common assessment framework (CAF), anticorruption system and security of information; and IT products, offering business process management platform, management of an electronic system of document circulation and information technology (IT) consulting. On June 23, 2014, the Company sold all shares it held directly and indirectly in Audiobook.pl Sp z o o to Bezkartek.pl SA.

name: DELKO SA
businessSummary: Delko SA is a Poland-based company involved in household products distribution. The Company is principally engaged in the wholesale of fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), primarily cosmetics, personal hygiene and household cleaning products, as well as groceries and tobacco, across Poland. The Company’s partners include Unilever, Gillette, Bella, Lambi and Dove, among others. Moreover, the Company offers products under its own brands, such as Filip, Filip Fresh, Blue, Teak, Delikato, Oskar, Tanius, Granit, Domowy, Delko Professional and others. The Company operates through three segments: Wholesale, Retail through own grocery and chemist stores, and Retail through a franchising network. The distribution is conducted through regional sales representatives, the Company's own network of warehouses, as well as direct service for main retail clients.

name: DEKPOL SA
businessSummary: Dekpol SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction industry. The Company operates through three business segments. The General Construction segment develops industrial buildings, such as warehouses, commercials, retails and production halls, as well as provides external infrastructure services, including construction of roads, yards, parking lots and green areas among others. The Development segment is engaged in the construction, finishing and marketing of business units and residential properties mainly on the north of Poland. The Steelworks segment is active in the manufacture and installation of steel constructions and production of buckets and attachment designed for the construction equipment. Dekpol SA operates mainly in the domestic markets and internationally.

name: DECORA SA
businessSummary: Decora SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the building materials industry. The Company focuses on the production and distribution of technologically advanced flooring products and accessories. Their key product is floor underlay, which is a type of material used beneath flooring surfaces such as vinyl, laminate, or wood floors. It aims to provide improved sound insulation, moisture protection, and enhanced durability for floor installations. The Company manufactures floor underlays using three different technologies: Polyurethane Mineral (PUM), Extruded Polystyrene (XPS), and Polyethylene High Density Aquastop (PEHD Aquastop). The Company also produces vinyl flooring, skirting boards, and floor profiles, marketed under brands such as Arbiton, Ewifoam, Afirmax, and Vidella. The primary goal of these products is to support the installation and performance of flooring systems in residential and commercial buildings.

name: FIRMA OPONIARSKA DEBICA SA
businessSummary: Firma Oponiarska Debica SA is a Poland-based producer, wholesale and retail trader of passenger and commercial tires.
