The Digital segment, which consists of business-to-business (B2B) solutions and business-to-consumer (B2C) neo-economy, proposes digital solutions such as operating e-commerce malls specializing in fashion and providing information and logistics systems, and develops and deploys new digital-based services. The Platform segment operates platform businesses such as the production, procurement, and trading of clothing and accessories, as well as space creation support through the manufacture and sale of fixtures. The Common Department segment covers corporate-related operations, such as providing management and guidance to subsidiaries and covering staff expenses with revenue from management guidance fees.

name: LONSEAL CORP
businessSummary: LONSEAL CORPORATION is principally engaged in the processing and sale of synthetic resins. The Company operates in two business segments. The Synthetic Resin Processed Products segment provides architectural flooring materials, waterproofing materials, housing materials, wall covering materials, vehicle flooring materials, film bases, various waterproofing works. The Real Estate Leasing segment is involved in the leasing of shopping center facilities.

name: ROBOT PAYMENT INC
businessSummary: Robot Payment Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet payment agency services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Payment segment is engaged in the provision of Internet payment services mainly for electronic commerce (EC) of business-to-consumer (BtoC) businesses, and business-to-business (BtoB) businesses. The Financial Cloud segment is engaged in the provision of cloud services that streamline and automate billing, collection, application and reminder operations for BtoB and BtoC businesses.

name: LOGOS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Logos Holdings Inc is mainly engaged in the housing sales business. Through the subsidiaries, the Company mainly provides services related to custom-built homes, condominiums, and land sales, renovations and group homes, support for construction companies including housing design assistance and information technology (IT) consulting, Computer-Aided Design (CAD) operations including housing assistance and cost estimation. The Company also designs, constructs, and sells housing, buys and sells real estate, and provides brokerage and mediation for target customers using the products and brands of the subsidiaries. The Company operates custom-built housing business, digital transformation (DX) support business, and offshore development business. The DX support business supports digital efficiency in the housing industry. The offshore development business is engaged in the residential offshore CAD service business.

name: ROLAND CORP
businessSummary: Roland Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electronic musical instrument business. The Company is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of electronic musical instruments. The main products include electronic pianos, electronic drums, synthesizers, guitar related equipment, dance and disc jockey (DJ) related equipment, video related equipment, effectors, musical instrument amplifiers and others. The Company is also engaged in the development and sale of software products for music and media producers, the sale of headphone products, as well as the manufacture and sale of electronic organs.

name: ROHM CO LTD
businessSummary: Rohm Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily manufactures and sells electronic components. The Company operates through three business segments. The Large-Scale Integration (LSI) segment produces LSIs including analog, logic and memory. The Semiconductor Device segment produces transistors, diodes, power devices, light-emitting diodes and semiconductor lasers. The Module segment produces print heads and optical modules. The Company is also engaged in the resistor business.

name: ROHTO PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Rohto Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of eye care (eye drops, eyewash), skin care (external medications, lip balm, sunscreen, functional cosmetics), oral medication (gastrointestinal medicines, herbal medicines, supplements), and other products and services (in vitro diagnostic reagents) in the health and beauty care field. The Company operates through four regional segments. The Japan segment manufactures and sells eye care, skin care, oral medication, and other products (services). The Americas segment and the Europe segment mainly manufacture and sell skin care products (services). The Asia segment mainly manufactures and sells eye care and skin care products (services), as well as oral medication products (services).

name: RORZE CORP
businessSummary: RORZE CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of motor control equipment, semiconductor-related equipment and flat panel display (FPD) -related equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. The Semiconductor and FPD-related equipment segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of dust-free transport equipment in the semiconductor and LCD industries. The main products are EFEM, wafer transporter for atmosphere, wafer sorter, wafer stocker for N2 purge, wafer transporter for vacuum, wafer transport unit, large glass substrate transporter, glass cutting machine, stepping motor driver and controller. The Life Science segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of cell culture devices in the drug discovery industry and other fields. The main products are incubators (cell culture devices) and others.

name: RENGO CO LTD
businessSummary: Rengo Co Ltd is a paper box manufacturer. The Company operates in four segments. The Cardboard and Paper Processing-related segment manufactures and sells paperboards, corrugated boards and kraft pulps in domestic markets. The Soft-type Packaging-related segment manufactures and sells soft-type packaging products and cellophane in domestic markets. The Heavy Duty Packaging-related segment manufactures and sells heavy duty packaging products in domestic markets. The Overseas-related segment manufactures and sells paperboards, corrugated boards, corrugated boxes, soft-type and heavy duty packaging products in overseas markets. The other businesses include the manufacture of nonwoven cloth, the logistic business, insurance agency business, lease business and real estate business.

name: RENOVA INC
businessSummary: Renova Inc is a Japan-based company that develops, owns and operates renewable energy power plants. The Company operates through two business segments: the Renewable Energy Power Generation Business segment and the Development and Operation Business segment. The business objective is to develop and operate power generation projects using multiple sources of energy, including solar power, biomass power, onshore and offshore wind power, geothermal power and hydroelectric power. The Company also promotes the green transformation (GX) business, which involves storage batteries and new fuels including ammonia and hydrogen.

name: LOOK HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Look Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture, import and sale of apparels and related products. The Company has seven segments. The Apparel Related segment includes four regional segments: Japan, South Korea, Europe, and Other Overseas. The Apparel Related segment is engaged in the planning, production and sale of apparels, the purchase and import of products, the sale of products through directly managed stores, department stores, shopping centers and electronic commerce, as well as the planning, production and sale of leather products in Japan, South Korea, Europe, Hong Kong, China and the United States. The Production And Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) segment is engaged in the OEM production and processing of apparel related products, and trading business. The Logistics segment is engaged in the inspection, shipment and storage of apparel products. The Restaurant segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of gelato products.

name: RETTY INC
businessSummary: Retty Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of a real name gourmet platform Retty that accumulates restaurant recommendation information and restaurant information nationwide, and provides individually optimized restaurant information to users. Store information such as store data, real name recommendation data, browsing log data, follow-up and action data are stored in Retty. The Company is engaged in the provision of two services. The fun relationship management (FRM) service is a subscription business model in which a fixed monthly service fee income is earned from contracted restaurants. It provides online sales promotion services, advertising services and customer management systems. The advertising content services consist of advertising solutions that send Retty users to customers through tie-ups, ad technology and alliances, as well as content solutions that accumulate and provide content to cosmetics, apparel, travel, real estate and other industries.

name: REZIL INC
businessSummary: Rezil Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in distributed energy business that supplies electricity by installing power receiving and transforming equipment for condominiums, green energy business that supports corporate decarbonization and supplies electricity, and energy digital transformation (DX) business that supports business reform. The Company operates through three segments. The Distributed Energy Business segment focuses on the condominium bulk power reception service, which reduces electricity costs for condominium residents and common areas. The Green Energy Business segment is engaged in retail sales of electricity, mainly to small and medium-sized corporate customers. The Energy DX Business segment is a business that supports energy-related companies in promoting DX of back-office operations, and specifically provides integrated solutions from customer management to back-office operations, data linkage, and even the security of high-voltage equipment.

name: RHEON AUTOMATIC MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: RHEON AUTOMATIC MACHINERY CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of automatic food processing machines, and manufacture and sale of food products. It operates through two business segments. Food Processing Machinery Manufacturing and Sales business operates in Japan, North and South America, Europe and Asia, and is engaged in development, manufacture and sale of food molding machines and bread making lines. It also provides equipment and parts repair, options and technical guidance service. It provides ovens, mixers and packaging machines purchased from other companies. Food Manufacturing and Sales business operates in North and South America and Japan. It manufactures and sells high-processing frozen foods such as croissants, danish pastries, pies, cookies and frozen roll-in dough, and natural yeast bread. Food processing machines include universal automatic packaging machines, Martians, flex in clusters, EZ dividers and others.

name: LEOCLAN CO LTD
businessSummary: LEOCLAN Co.,Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical total solution business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Medical Total Solution segment is engaged in the contract sale of medical equipment and medical information system products based on consulting for medical institutions, prevention and examination facilities, nursing care and welfare facilities, as well as the related maintenance services business, the building interior work and medical equipment construction business. The Remote Image Diagnosis Service segment is engaged in the provision of remote diagnosis services through image data taken by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and computed tomography (CT) for medical institutions without a radiation diagnosis specialist. The Provide Lunch segment is engaged in the provision of ordinary and recuperation meal services for nursing and welfare facilities.

name: LASERTEC CORP
businessSummary: Lasertec Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of the inspection and measurement equipment. The Company is involved in the design, manufacture and sale of the semiconductor-related devices and other devices using optical application technology, as well as the provision of the related services. The Company’s main products include semiconductor related equipment such as photomasks and defect inspection or measurement equipment for various wafers, energy & environment related equipment for SiC wafer, transparent wafer defect inspection or review equipment, FPD-related equipment for FPD photomask defect inspection equipment, hybrid laser microscope laser microscope. The Company operates in North America and Europe, Japan and Asia.

name: RINNAI CORP
businessSummary: RINNAI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of heating appliances and components. The products and components are manufactured by the company and affiliated companies. In the domestic market, the Company sells directly to customers such as city gas companies, propane fuel sales companies, housing equipment manufacturers, house manufacturers, pipe building material sales companies. The Company manufactures and sells at overseas subsidiaries and affiliates. The Company operates in six businesses, including Japan, the United States, Australia, China, Korea, and Indonesia.

name: LINK-U INC
businessSummary: Link-U Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of a server platform business that provides one-stop data distribution based on original servers designed in-house, as well as artificial intelligence (AI) solutions that appropriately store, analyze, and process that data. The Internet service business includes recurring service, initial development and maintenance development service, and other services that occur on-site. The recurring service provides server maintenance operation including server procurement, system construction, and data center installation. The initial development and maintenance development service provides contracted development for acquiring recurring service projects. Other services mainly consist of spot development projects such as Website development.

name: SINOPS INC
businessSummary: sinops Inc., formerly Link Inc., operates software package group sinops series to optimize inventory of retail, wholesale and manufacturing industries. The Company operates sinops (strategic inventory optimum solution) business. The Company provides package sales, rental sales, implementation support service and support service. The package sales service provides sinops series in batch sales type. The rental sales service provides the sinops series in usage fee type. The implementation support service provides system construction and operation construction services to maximize the implementation effect of sinops. The support service supports daily operation of sinops. The Company owns two types of sales, including direct sales to end users and sales by sales partners.

name: RYOYU SYSTEMS CO LTD
businessSummary: Ryoyu Systems Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in provision of information services. The Company's main business can be divided into the design, development, operation and maintenance of information communication systems, the sale of information communication system related equipment. The Company is also engaged in the design, analysis and simulation of industrial products, as well as provision of information processing services using information communication systems.

name: RYOHIN KEIKAKU CO. LTD.
businessSummary: Ryohin Keikaku Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in sale of products under the brands of Mujirushi Ryohin and MUJI. The Company has four segments including Domestic segment, East Asia segment, Europe and Americas segment as well as Southeast Asia and Oceania segment. The Domestic segment is engaged in sale and supplement, the operation of camp sites and house sale business. The East Asia Business segment is engaged in product sales and restaurant business in East Asia. The Southeast Asia & Oceania Business segment is engaged in product sales and restaurant business in Southeast Asia and Oceania. The Europe and America Business segment is engaged in product sales and restaurant business in Europe and America. The Company is also involved in food and beverage sale under Cafe&Meal MUJI brand, the operation of camp sites, sale of houses and sale of IDEE brand products.

name: RYODEN CORP
businessSummary: Ryoden Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of factory automation (FA) system products, refrigeration building system products, information and communication technology (ICT) system products, and electronics products, and the provision of services incidental to each business, as well as insurance agency business. The Company operates through four segments. The FA System business segment provides servo systems, inverters, and numerical control (NC) devices. The Refrigeration Building System business segment provides packaged air conditioners, chilling units, refrigerators and elevators. The ICT System business segment provides video and image information systems, medical facilities, and plant factory systems. The Electronics business segment provides memories, microcomputers, power devices, materials, and fabricated materials.

name: RYOYO RYOSAN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Ryoyo Ryosan Holdings Inc is a Japan-based trading company mainly engaged in the purchasing and sales of devices and information and communication technology (ICT) products in the electronics field. The Company is engaged in the sales of devices, ICT products, and embedded products to domestic and foreign electronic equipment manufacturers and electronic equipment users. The Company is engaged in the operation of the device business, which sells semiconductors and electronic components, and the solution business, which sells information technology (IT) equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of design, development, technical support and other services, and development of solutions related to the above.

name: BANK OF THE RYUKYUS LTD
businessSummary: Bank of The Ryukyus, Limited is a Japan-based regional bank mainly engaged in the provision of financial services for individual and corporate customers. The Bank operates in two business segments. The Banking business includes deposit business, lending business, domestic exchange business, and foreign exchange business, among others. The Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing business. The Company is also engaged in the cash scrutiny organize business, research businesses related to industry, economy and finance and others.

name: REMIXPOINT CO LTD
businessSummary: Remixpoint, inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in energy-related business and automotive business. Energy-related business engages in the development and sales of energy management systems, energy saving support consulting, sales of energy saving equipment, as well as purchase and sale power. Automotive-related businesses engages in the development and sale of used car assessment system, buying and selling of used cars related consulting, as well as the buying and selling of used cars. The Company also engages in operating of virtual currency trading post related services.

name: LIBERAWARE CO LTD
businessSummary: Liberaware Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that mainly provides digital transformation (DX) solutions for infrastructure facilities and equipment using hardware technology centered on drones and software technology for processing, processing, and managing captured images and video. The Company operates its business through infrastructure DX business segment. The Drone business provides data that contributes to surveying, inspecting, and measuring infrastructure and plants using drones, and manufactures and sells drones. The Digital Twin business constructs and provides digital images, three dimensions (3D) data, and information that contributes to the detection of abnormalities, using image processing technology for data acquired by drones. The Solution Development business develops new solutions based on its technological capabilities and know-how.

name: LIVING PLATFORM LTD
businessSummary: Living Platform,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the life care business. The Life Care segment is engaged in the development of nursing care business, support services for people with disabilities, childcare business and other businesses. The nursing care business provides paid nursing homes with nursing care, residential paid nursing homes, housing for the elderly with services, cohabitation care for people with dementia, home care support, day care, short-term nursing home life care, home care and consulting services. The support business for persons with disabilities provides employment continuation support, consultation support, independence training and cohabitation support services. The daycare business operates licensed daycare centers and company-led daycare centers. Other businesses provide catering services, job advertisement services, real estate holding and leasing business and joint purchasing business.

name: LIVING TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Living Technologies Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of real estate platform. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of matching services and branding services. The matching services are mainly engaged in the provision of real estate sale services, rental management services, renovations services, custom housings services, recruitment services and other Internet matching services for end users and member companies. The branding services are mainly engaged in the provision of advertisings services through Livin Match which is a vertical media operated by the Company to offer real estate companies comparison, as well as the advertisings sale services of other Internet advertising medias.

name: RICKSOFT CO LTD
businessSummary: Ricksoft Co., Ltd. develops software that is mainly used for the provision of tool solution. The products used in the process management and assignment management. The Company performs comprehensively from proposal to license sale, consultant project participation, system integration (SI), training, operation support. The license and SI service business conducts license sale, consultant project participation, system integration (SI) and others. The cloud service business provides cloud environments. The software development business develops its own functions as add-on products to Jira and Confluence.

name: LITALICO INC
businessSummary: Litalico Inc is a Japan-based real estate company that provides employment and learning support services in the field of disability welfare. The Company operates through four business segments. The Employment Support Business segment provides comprehensive support to people with disabilities seeking employment, from employment to workplace setup. The Child Welfare Business segment provides child development support services, after-school day care services and nursery school visit support services. The Platform Business segment operates a matching media platform and provides recruitment services for facility users and staff and provides software as a service (SaaS) product for facilities. The Overseas Business segment operates a publicly funded group home for people with severe behavioral disorders in Nebraska and provides services related to housing and daytime activity support in other areas.

name: RHYTHM CO LTD
businessSummary: Rhythm Co Ltd, formerly Rhythm Watch Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company engaged in the clocks business, connection terminal business, precision business, and electronic business. The Company has four business segments. The Connection Terminal segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of tab terminals, taping terminals, terminal blocks and others used in automobiles, solar power generation and home appliances. The Clock segment is engaged in the provision of clocks such as wall clocks, table clocks, alarm clocks, digital clocks, equipment clocks, clock movements, universal serial bus fans and disaster prevention administrative radios. The Electronic segment is engaged in the provision of electronic manufacturing services (EMS) for electronic devices, information related devices, in-vehicle devices. The Precision segment is engaged in the provision of precision parts for industrial equipment, optical equipment, office and communication equipment. It also operates logistics business.

name: RICOH LEASING CO LTD
businessSummary: Ricoh Leasing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of leasing services and related business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Leasing and Finance segment is engaged in the provision of finance leases, operating leases, installment sales and credit for office and information-related equipment, medical equipment, industrial machine tools, measuring instruments, as well as corporate loans, industry-specific loans, housing loans, condominium loans. In addition, the Company provides corporate loans, industry-specific loans, housing loans, condominium loans, and other loans. The Services segment is engaged in the provision of invoicing and accounts receivable collection services, medical and nursing care reimbursement factoring services, factoring services for the Ricoh Group, and relocation management services. The Investment business includes solar power generation, housing leasing, and real estate related businesses.

name: RICOH CO LTD
businessSummary: Ricoh Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, production, sales, and service activities for digital services, digital products, graphic communications, industrial solutions, and others. The Company has five business segments. Digital Services segment sells imaging equipment such as office multifunction devices and printers and provides information technology (IT)-related solutions. Digital Products segment is involved in the development and production of imaging equipment such as office multifunction devices and printers, and edge devices that support digital communication. Graphic Communications segment includes the commercial printing business and the industrial printing business. Industrial Solutions segment consists of the thermal business and the industrial products business. Industrial Products segment provides precision equipment parts. The Other segment is engaged in the digital cameras, 360-degree cameras, environment and healthcare business.

name: RIKEN VITAMIN CO LTD
businessSummary: RIKEN VITAMIN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based food processing company. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Domestic Food segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of household food products, commercial food products and raw materials for food processing, including seaweed products, dressings, food extracts and seasonings, food improving agents, vitamin and health food. The Domestic Chemicals and Others segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical improving agents and animal feed additives. The Overseas segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of improving agents for food and chemical products, as well as processed marine products and frozen vegetables. The Company distributes its products in Japan, Southeast Asia, South Asia, the Middle East, Oceania, Europe, Africa, the North America, Latin America, China, Taiwan and South Korea, among others.

name: RIKEN KEIKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Riken Keiki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various industrial measuring instruments, as well as related business activities. It manufactures and sells gas detection and alarm equipment and provides after-sales maintenance services related to the equipment. Its products include portable gas detectors, fixed gas detectors, and other measuring instruments. Portable gas detectors include multi-gas detectors and single-component gas detectors. Fixed gas detectors include detectors, alarms, analyzers, and other components. It also offers analytical instruments, including atmospheric photoelectron yield spectroscopy instruments and portable multi-X-ray analyzers. Its industrial gas detectors are used in places where gas is likely to be generated and in industries that use gas, including semiconductor manufacturing, oil refining, steelmaking, power generation, city gas, waterworks and sewerage, food manufacturing, and others.

name: NPR-RIKEN CORP
businessSummary: NPR-Riken Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the management and administration of its subsidiaries and group companies, as well as other businesses incidental or related to such management and administration. The Company conducts its business through subsidiaries such as RIKEN and Nihon Piston Ring. The Riken Group is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive and industrial machinery parts, anechoic chambers, industrial furnaces and heating materials, construction-related parts, construction contracting, environmental maintenance, and factory repair and maintenance. Nippon Piston Ring Group is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive-related products, marine and other products, as well as logistics, services, and other business activities related to each business.

name: RECRUIT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Recruit Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in human resources (HR) technology business, matching & solutions business, and staffing business. The Company operates through three segments. The HR Technology segment provides job advertisements and recruitment solution services globally through online job matching platforms such as Indeed and Glassdoor. The Matching & Solutions segment operates mainly in Japan and consists of the human resources field and sales promotion field. The human resources field provides support services for individual users' job search activities and corporate clients' recruitment activities. The sales promotion field operates a vertical matching platform for each business field that connects individual users with corporate clients, and software as a service (SaaS) for corporate clients. The Staffing segment provides temporary staffing services such as clerical staffing, manufacturing work and light work staffing, and professional staffing.

name: COSMOS INITIA CO LTD
businessSummary: Cosmos Initia Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the residential business, solutions business, accommodation business, construction business, and related businesses. It operates through four business segments. The Residential segment sells new condominiums, detached houses and renovated condominiums, brokers condominiums, provides real estate management services, and develops condominiums for sale in Australia. The Solutions segment sells income-generating real estate, manages and operates real estate rentals, brokers income-generating real estate and commercial land, provides property consulting, and renovates and sells used income-generating real estate in the United States. The Accommodation segment sells and operates hotel facilities and plans and operates outdoor resorts. The Construction segment provides office relocation and interior construction, architecture and renovation work, and condominium gallery construction.

name: REALCOM INC
businessSummary: Abalance Corporation, formerly Realcom Inc., is mainly engaged in software license sales, system construction, and the distribution and sale of construction machinery,as well as green energy related business. The Company operates in three business segment. The Information Technology (IT) segment is involved in the introduction of core product Knowledge Market to its new customers, as well as the sale of licenses, the provision of system integration, and operation and maintenance businesses. The Construction Equipment Sale segment is involved in the trading of construction machinery in domestic market and to overseas markets. The Green Energy segment is involved in the trading of solar panels and related products, power plant construction and solar power generation.

name: LEADER ELECTRONICS CORP
businessSummary: LEADER ELECTRONICS CORPORATION is primarily engaged in the manufacture of electrical measuring instruments. The video-related equipment business includes video signal-related products for commercial and consumer video equipment, and others, such as video signal generators, waveform monitors, vector scopes and camera test systems. The radio wave-related equipment business includes high-frequency signal generators, television field-strength meters, and characteristic testers for electronic components, such as standard signal generators, television field-strength meters, automatic digital broadcasting related equipment. The others business provides basic measuring instruments, repair services, parts and others.

name: LETECH CORP
businessSummary: LeTech Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the real estate related business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Real Estate Solutions segment is engaged in the purchase real estate from property information of various sources, raises asset value by applying value up, as well as sales properties to high net worth individuals. The Real Estate Solutions segment includes detached housing, land effective utilization, residential development, commercial development, and renovation. The Real Estate Rental segment is engaged in the rental of real estate owned by the Company. The Company also engages in the real estate consulting business and the nursing care business including paid nursing home, housing for the elderly with the service, installation, operation and management of the group home, care prevention support service based on the care insurance law, and home care insurance business.

name: LAND CO LTD
businessSummary: LAND Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based real estate company. The Company operates through Real Estate business segment. The Company is mainly engaged in the trading and investment of real estate properties, including renewable energy related investment such as photovoltaic power plants, real estate related consulting business, as well as other real estate business aimed at acquiring fee through brokerage business. The Company mainly operates in domestic market.

name: LANDIX INC
businessSummary: Landix Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of one-stop solutions from real estate purchase to sale, sale brokerage, custom-made housing matching and after-sale follow-up after construction. The Company operates in two business segments. The SUMUZU segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of residential land, the brokerage of real estate, as well as the provision of introduction services for custom home construction. The Company is also engaged in the operation of own portal site SUMUZU. The Leasing segment is engaged in the purchase of profitable real estate. The Company is also engaged in the rental property management business and the insurance agency business.

name: LANCERS INC
businessSummary: LANCERS,INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the platform business. The Company is engaged in the operation of a freelance platform Lancers that matches freelances and companies online. The Company is engaged in the provision of services in online stuffing platform area and crowdsourcing area. The online stuffing platform is a service in which clients can request work from specific lancers either directly or through agents and directors. The main work includes work with a high unit price such as system development and operation, design and creative production, article creation and others. The Company develops and provides directly order to freelancers services and selected freelancers introduction services in the area. The crowdsourcing is a service that requests work from an unspecified number of lancers and orders work based on deliverables. The main work includes work with relatively low unit costs such as data entry, article creation, logo design and others.

name: ARCS CO LTD
businessSummary: ARCS COMPANY, LIMITED is principally involved in the supermarket business. In the retail business, the Company is engaged in the operation of supermarkets that mainly sell food products and home centers that sell home-related products, development printing enlargement (DPE) business, wholesale of pharmaceuticals, as well as manufacture and sale of bread. The other businesses include tourism business, building maintenance business, real estate leasing business, property insurance and life insurance agency business, wholesale business, food manufacturing business, industrial waste and general waste collection and transportation business, construction business, as well as discount business.

name: LAST ONE MILE CO LTD
businessSummary: Last One Mile Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the last mile business. The Company is engaged in the provision of services with high needs such as home delivery and Internet access at the timing of new life and centered on living infrastructure services such as electricity and natural gas. The Company is engaged in the operation of Marutto Change, a new life support platform for the mobile one-stop service. Marutto Change is a service in which the Lifeline Concierge uses a telephone or short message service (SMS) to act on behalf of or guide customers to lifeline and other new life procedures.

name: RASA CORP
businessSummary: Rasa Corporation is mainly engaged in resource and metallic materials related business. The Company operates in six business segments. The Resources and Metallic Materials-related segment imports, exports and sells mineral products, mainly including zircon sand, and other goods. The Industrial and Construction Equipment-related segment engages in sale and maintenance of delivery equipment, and sale, rental and maintenance of shield tunneling machines and other construction machines. The Environment Facilities-related segment imports and sells high-pressure pumps. The Plant and Equipment Construction-related segment engages in design, construction and maintenance work related to plant and related equipment construction in various fields. The Chemical-related Products segment involves in the production and sale of plastics and chemicals. The Real Estate Rental-related segment leases real estate properties.

name: RAKUMO INC
businessSummary: Rakumo Inc is engaged in information technology (IT) solution business. The Company’s main business includes Software as a Service (SaaS) service, which provides license services; solution service, which centered on installation support and business support related to license services; IT offshore development service that develops lab-type IT systems based in Vietnam. The SaaS service develops and sells the groupware product rakumo for companies, as well as selling agents of other company's licenses. rakumo is a general term for a group of services in corporate groupware for which the group handles planning and development. The solution service sells hardware of other companies related to the license service, in addition to solution services such as installation support and business support of own and other company’s SaaS services. IT offshore development services provides IT offshore development services based on its Vietnam subsidiary rakumo Company Limited.

name: RAKUTEN GROUP INC
businessSummary: Rakuten Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Internet services, FinTech, and mobile business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Internet Service segment is mainly engaged in the operation of electronic commerce (EC) sites, including Rakuten Ichiba, as well as online cashback sites, travel reservation sites, portal sites, digital content sites and messaging services. It is also involved in the sale of advertisements on these Websites, and the operation of sports facilities. The FinTech segment is engaged in the provision of credit card-related services, banking and securities services, cryptocurrency (virtual currency) intermediation, insurance services and electronic money services. The Mobile segment is engaged in the provision of communication services and messaging services, as well as operation of digital content Websites. The Company also operates marketing support business, Rakuten delivery business and real-time takeout business.

name: RAKSUL INC
businessSummary: Raksul Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of support platforms for companies and sole proprietors. The Company operates through four business segments. The Raksul segment operates Raksul, a sharing platform for printing and customer-attraction support. It develops and provides a system for collecting printing orders from customers nationwide via the Internet, placing those orders with printing companies and printing during non-operating hours of the printing presses. The Novasell business operates the television (TV) advertising platform Novasell. The Hacobell business operates Hacobell, a logistics platform. The Josys business is a one-stop corporate information technology (IT) platform for operations from hardware procurement to storage and kitting as well as software management.

name: RAKUS CO LTD
businessSummary: Rakus Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) services. It operates through two business segments. The Cloud Business segment plans, develops and operates various cloud services, including the expense settlement system Raku-Raku Seisan, the electronic invoice issuance system RakuRaku Meisai, the sales management system Rakuraku Hanbai, the attendance management system RakuRaku Kintai, the email sharing and management system Mail Dealer, and the email marketing service HaiHai Mail. The IT Human Resources Business segment provides full-time staffing services specializing in IT engineers. Staffing services include system development, infrastructure construction and operation, machine learning, and quality control.

name: LAXUS TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Laxus Technologies Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of Luxus, a subscription-based sharing service for branded bags to general consumers in Japan. The Company provides the opportunities for general consumers to use high-quality branded bags through smartphone apps and Internet sites. The Company operates through a subscription service with a flat-rate fee. The age range of Luxus users is from their 20s to 50s, with the majority being in their 30s and 40s. The Company also allows users to purchase any rental bag they like, and also starts business to business/consumer (BtoB/C) sales, which selects the most appropriate sales destination from domestic reuse select shops, auctions, overseas e-commerce sites depending on the market value of the bag.

name: RACCOON HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: RACCOON HOLDINGS, Inc. is primarily engaged in providing services facilitating business transactions between enterprises, mainly operating EC business. The Company operates in three segments. The EC segment is engaged in Super Delivery business, which operates wholesale site connecting retailers and manufacturers engaged in apparel and other goods business, as well as COREC business, which is a cloud-type ordering system that can collectively manage ordering in business-to-business transactions (BtoB) on the Internet. The Paid segment engages in invoice issuance and payment collection generated between company transactions. The Guarantee segment is engaged in the provision of accounts receivable and rent and court costs.

name: LAOX HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Laox Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic retail business, overseas business, lifestyle fashion business, and asset business. The Company operates through four segments. The Domestic Retail segment sells mainly food and cosmetics in domestic shops through real shops and online stores. The Overseas segment focuses on high-quality Japanese products and develops trade, global e-commerce (EC) and support for expansion into China through various channels and networks, whether direct-to-consumer (BtoC) or business-to-business (BtoB), real or online. The Lifestyle Fashion segment sells gift-related products through multiple sales channels. The Asset segment is engaged in the operation and management of commercial complexes, restaurants, and cultural events, and the sale and brokerage of real estate.

name: ROUND ONE CORP
businessSummary: Round One Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the comprehensive amusement business. The Company operates through Japan and United States two geographic segments. The Company is engaged in the operation of indoor leisure complex with bowling alleys, arcade games, karaoke, billiards, and Spo-Cha (a sports-themed facility with time-based admission). The Company also operates indoor complex leisure facilities in China, operates food and beverage businesses in the United States, and sells prizes.

name: LIGHTWORKS CORP
businessSummary: Lightworks Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human capital management (HCM) cloud service business. The Company is engaged in the provision of HCM platform provision service and online English conversation service utilizing HCM cloud. The HCM platform provision service operates CAREER SHIP, a human resources development platform, by providing HCM solutions for enterprises and education fields as cloud services. The online English conversation service utilizing HCM cloud provides online English conversation under the OLECO brand in the cloud as content that can effectively utilize the learning management platform provided for cram schools.

name: RAITO KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: RAITO KOGYO CO., LTD. is a company mainly engaged in the operation of construction business. The Construction segment is involved in the civil engineering construction business focusing on slope protection and soil improvement construction works; the provision of contracted construction works, as well as the sale of construction materials. The Others segment is involved in the sale of construction materials; the leasing of automobiles, construction machines and office machines; the management of welfare establishments; the operation of life and non-life insurance agencies, as well as the provision of nursing care services.

name: LION CORP
businessSummary: Lion Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of consumable goods and industrial products. The Company operates in three business segments. The General Consumable Goods segment purchases and manufactures consumable goods, as well as sells its products through agent stores. This segment also involves pet food trading and over-the-counter management business. The Industrial Goods segment trades industrial products and kitchen cleanser. The Overseas segment manufactures and sells general consumable goods and chemical materials in overseas markets. The Company is also engaged in the design, construction and maintenance of the Company's equipment and the transportation of its products, the real estate, agency and welfare businesses.

name: YODOGAWA STEEL WORKS LTD
businessSummary: Yodoko Ltd, formerly Yodogawa Steel Works Ltd, is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, processing and sale of iron and steel products. The Company operates through four segments. The Steel Sheets-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cold-rolled steel sheets, polished steel strips, hot-dip galvanized steel sheets, painted galvanized steel sheets, and other steel sheets, the manufacture and sale of building materials and exterior products, as well as the design and construction of construction works. The Roll segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel rolls and non-ferrous rolls. The Grating segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of gratings. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and trading of real estate. The Company is also engaged in transportation and warehousing, golf course management, machinery plant sales, solar power generation electricity sales, and software design and development.

name: YOSHIMURA FOOD HOLDINGS KK
businessSummary: Yoshimura Food Holdings KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of support service for sales marketing, product development, production control, purchasing logistics, quality control, and business management. The Company operates through two business segments. The Manufacturing Business segment develops and manufactures its own products, and domestic subsidiaries sell them mainly through wholesalers to supermarkets, convenience stores, and drug stores throughout Japan, and overseas subsidiaries mainly sell to hotels, restaurants, supermarkets in Singapore and Malaysia. The Sales Business segment is engaged in the sale products to industrial food service providers, consumer cooperatives, supermarkets, hotels, restaurants.

name: YOSSIX CO LTD
businessSummary: Yossix Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the food business includes direct management of pub chain stores and franchised store development as well as construction business centered on restaurant construction. The Company operates pub chains under various brands, including Nipachi, Yataiya, Yataizushi, Sento, Koreya, Yakiniku Genki, providing Sushi, iron-plate cooking, chicken black charcoal and others.

name: YOSHICON CO LTD
businessSummary: Yoshicon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Company has four business segments. The Residence segment is engaged in the planning and sale of condominiums and single family houses. The Real Estate Development segment is engaged in the planning, development, sale, brokerage and construction of real estate such as condominiums, houses, commercial and industrial facilities. The Rental and Management segment is engaged in the rental of condominiums, commercial and industrial facilities and parking lots, the management, design and construction of condominiums, as well as the power sales business. The Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of concrete products for construction, precast concrete (PC) components for houses, as well as the civil engineering and construction business. The Company is also engaged in the beverage manufacturing business, food business, clothing sales business, advertising and insurance agency business.

name: YOKOHAMA WRIGHT INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: YOKOHAMA WRIGHT Industries Co.,LTD is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pile removal business. The Pile Removal segment is mainly engaged in the development of extracting piles, which are underground structures of existing buildings, as well as the provision of construction business based on the know-how and ideas accumulated as a construction company specializing in pile removal work. The pile removal business is mainly engaged in the driving of piles into the ground to support the building so that it does not sink or tilt when building the infrastructure. The Company also provides existing pile removal work, demolition and civil engineering work, underground obstacle removal work and mega solar business.

name: YOKOHAMA RUBBER CO LTD
businessSummary: Yokohama Rubber Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tires for cars and other automotive products. The Company operates through two business segments. The tire business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of tires, tubes, aluminum wheels, and automotive accessories for passenger cars, trucks and buses, light trucks, agricultural machinery, construction vehicles, industrial vehicles, and forestry equipment. The multiple business (MB) segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of conveyor belts, various hoses, fenders, oil fences, marine hoses, and aviation parts. The Company is also engaged in the provision of sporting goods and information processing services.

name: YOKOGAWA ELECTRIC CORP
businessSummary: Yokogawa Electric Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of control equipment. The Company operates in three segments. The Control segment provides comprehensive solutions ranging from on-site sensors such as flow meters, differential pressure/pressure transmitters, and process analyzers to production control systems, programmable controllers, industrial recorders, and various software to improve productivity and services to minimize plant life cycle costs. The Measuring Instruments segment provides waveform measuring instruments, optical communication-related measuring instruments, signal generators, and power, temperature, and pressure measuring instruments. The New Business and Others segment provides services utilizing the Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI), manufacture and sales of biomass materials, and research, development, and contract manufacturing of bulk pharmaceuticals and other products.

name: YOKOWO CO LTD
businessSummary: Yokowo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of various electronic devices, including vehicle communication comfort & safety (VCCS) products, circuit testing connector (CTC) products, fine connector and medical device (FC&MD) products, and incubation center products. It operates through four business segments. VCCS segment develops and provides antenna systems that utilize antenna, microwave, and modularization technologies. CTC segment globally develops and provides semiconductor testing connectors for all front-end and back-end inspection processes. FC&MD segment's FC business manufactures and sells fine spring connectors. MD business provides original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) guidewires, medical catheters, and other products. Incubation Center segment works on developing products in new fields such as advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), and others.

name: YOTAI REFRACTORIES CO LTD
businessSummary: YOTAI REFRACTORIES CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of refractory products, as well as the furnace installation engineering business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Refractory Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various refractory bricks such as basic bricks, high alumina bricks, clay bricks and silica bricks, and unshaped refractory products for irons and steels, nonferrous metals, cements, glass, furnaces and environmental equipment related kilns uses. The Engineering segment is engaged in the design and construction of various industrial kilns and environmental facilities that use refractories, as well as the contacted maintenance business.

name: DEMAE-CAN CO LTD
businessSummary: DEMAE-CAN CO.,LTD, formerly YUME NO MACHI SOUZOU IINKAI CO., LTD., is a Japan-based company mainly involved in the operation of home delivery Websites and the mail order business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Demae-can segment is engaged in the operation and management of a delivery Website under the name Demae-can, the development of order information transmission system, the operation and management of advertisements, and the delivery agency business. The Demae-can is a virtual shopping mall specializing in home delivery services that mainly provides pizza, sushi, curry, Chinese food, fast food and other food delivery services, and stores offering home delivery services are members. The mail order segment is engaged in the mail order sale of shochu and other alcohol products, food and supplements for restaurants through call centers.

name: GREMZ INC
businessSummary: grems Inc is primarily engaged in providing consulting services, products and services related to energy, the sales of electric power, as well as development of renewable energy. The Company operates in three business segments. The Energy Cost Solution segment is engaged in the businesses related to the reduction of energy costs, such as consulting on reducing basic electricity charges for corporations, sales of commercial solar power generation systems and energy-saving products. The Smart House Project segment is engaged in the sale of residential solar power generation systems and storage batteries to general households, as well as the development of renewable energy. The Retail Electricity segment is engaged in the retail of electricity to corporate customers.

name: UNIPRES CORP
businessSummary: UNIPRES CORPORATION is a Japan-based company which is mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sale of press processing parts for automobiles. The Company operates in four business segments which are Japan segment, the Americas segment, Europe segment and Asia segment. The vehicle body press parts business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of vehicle body press parts. The transmission parts business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of transmission parts. The resin parts business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of resin parts. Other businesses include the design and construction of plants, as well as the provision of insurance agency and freight transportation services.

name: UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA CO LTD
businessSummary: UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA CO.,LTD is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the green business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Green business segment is engaged in rental green business and horticulture related products handled business throughout Kansai area, Kanto area and overseas area. The Wholesale business segment is engaged in sales of artificial flower, exterior stone and decorative plant. The Retail business segment is engaged in sales of plant, decorative plant and gardening materials in shops.

name: UNICHARM CORP
businessSummary: Unicharm Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of baby care-related products, feminine care-related products, healthcare-related products, clean & fresh-related products, pet care-related products. The Company operates in three business segments. The Personal Care segment is engaged in the provision of baby care-related products including paper diapers, feminine care-related products including sanitary items, as well as healthcare-related products, including incontinence articles for adults and powder puffs. The Pet Care segment is engaged in the provision of pet food products and pet toiletry products. The Others segment offers industrial materials-related products and others. Its brands include moony, Silcot, Wave, Sofy and Lifree.

name: UNITIKA LTD
businessSummary: UNITIKA LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company that mainly engages in macromolecule business, function materials business and other businesses. The Company operates in three segments. The Macromolecule segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic film, resin, nonwoven cloth and others. The Functional Materials segment is engaged in the provision of functional materials, such as glass fiber products, glass beads, activated carbon fiber, among others. The Fiber segment is engaged in the production and sale of various types of fiber, such as thread and cotton. In addition, the Company is also involved in the design of factory equipment, construction management and equipment maintenance business, among others.

name: UT GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: UT Group Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the indefinite employment and dispatch business for the manufacturing, design, development and construction industry. The Company operates in three business segments. Manufacturing segment is involved in the provision of temporary staffing, contracting and human resources services for the manufacturing industry. Its main customers include domestic semiconductors, electronics, automobiles, building materials and housing equipment companies. Solution segment is involved in the provision of employment dispatch, contracting for transfer in line with structural reforms for main manufacturing companies. Its main customers are major electronics manufacturers in Japan. Engineering segment is engaged in the provision of engineer dispatch, contracting and human resources services for electro-mechanical companies. Its main customers are manufacturers and general contractors.

name: UNITED SUPER MARKETS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: United Super Markets Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the operation of supermarkets. Supermarket business includes supermarket business in China such as daily living goods and clothing items, mainly foodstuffs, living related goods and clothing items, mainly foodstuffs, fresh food processing business, food processing business and vegetable processing and packaging business. The Company is also involved in the real estate business, product development business, quality control and quality inspection business, business consignment business and temporary staffing business, among others.

name: YUTAKA GIKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: YUTAKA GIKEN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive components. The Company operates through five geographical segments include Japan, North America, Asia, China, others. The Company’s main components include automotive components four wheels such as exhaust system components, drive system components and others, as well as automotive components two wheels, general-purpose components and other components. The Company’s main products include torque converters, exhaust systems, brake discs, stator cores, rotors and others. The Company operates mainly in Japan, United States, Mexico, Philippines, Indonesia, China, United Kingdom, among others.

name: YUKEN KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: YUKEN KOGYO CO., LTD. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic, system products and environment equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Japan segment, Asia segment and Europe segment are engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic equipment, including hydraulic products, system products and environment equipment. The hydraulic products division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of oil pumps and motors, pressure-control valves, flow-control valves, directional-control valves and various hydraulic control equipment. The system products division is engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of hydraulic systems for industrial machinery, standard hydraulic units and hydraulic cylinders. The environment equipment division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automatic cutting compression machines, automatic polyethylene terephthalate (PET) bottles volume reduction machines, as well as automatic multi-compactors.

name: YUKIGUNI MAITAKE CO LTD
businessSummary: Yukiguni Factory Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the production and sale of mushrooms and processed mushroom foods, including maitake mushrooms, eringi mushrooms, buna shimeji mushrooms, mushrooms, hon shimeji mushrooms, and hatake shimeji mushrooms. The Company operates its business through the Mushrooms business segment. The Mushrooms business segment is engaged in the production and sale of mushroom products such as maitake mushrooms, eringi mushrooms, and bunashimeji mushrooms. Other businesses include the outsourced production and sale of health food products, operation of a product store, and the sale of culture medium activator.

name: JAPAN POST BANK CO LTD
businessSummary: JAPAN POST BANK Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking business. It primarily engages in deposit business, lending business, securities investment business, exchange business, government bonds, investment trust and counter sales of insurance products, intermediary business as well as credit card business. The Bank's main businesses include fund management, financing, asset and liability management, as well as fee-based business.

name: YUASA FUNASHOKU CO LTD
businessSummary: YUASA FUNASHOKU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the commercial business, hotel business, and real estate business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Commercial segment is mainly engaged in the wholesale of rice, flour, starch, sugar, fats and oils, feed, processed food and liquors. The Hotel segment is mainly engaged in the operation of hotels and restaurants. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the real estate leasing business. The Company is also engaged in the logistics business and insurance agency business.

name: YUASA TRADING CO LTD
businessSummary: YUASA TRADING CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the sale of industrial machinery and equipment. The Industrial Equipment segment is engaged in the sale of tools, industrial equipment, control equipment and logistics equipment. The Industrial Machinery segment is engaged in the sale of industrial machinery and equipment. The Housing Equipment, Piping and Air Conditioning segment is involved in the sale of piping, air conditioning equipment and housing equipment, the design, supervision and contracting of construction works, and the trading of land and buildings. The Construction and Exterior segment is involved in the sale of construction materials, as well as materials for landscape, exterior and civil engineering use. The Construction Machinery segment is involved in the sale and leasing of construction machinery and materials. The Energy segment is involved in the sale of petroleum products. The Company is also engaged in the sale of living-related products and wood products.

name: UPR CORP
businessSummary: UPR Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in rental and sales of pallets and other distribution equipment. The Company operates two segments. The Distribution segment is engaged in rental and sales of wooden and plastic pallets, metal distribution equipment such as nesting racks and basket cars, assist suits, other distribution equipment and related products. The Connected segment is engaged in rental and sales of location information solutions, services for remote monitoring solutions, rental and sales of related equipment, management, rental, sales and operation of car sharing business.

name: YUSHIN PRECISION EQUIPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Yushin Co is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of plastic injection molding take-out robots and related equipment. The Company operates through four geographic segments including Japan, the U.S., Asia, and Europe. The Company mainly develops, manufactures, sells, and provides after-sales service for injection molding product take-out robots and peripheral equipment, including labor-saving systems. Products include take-out robots, palletizing robots, attachment heads, stocking systems, and automation equipment.

name: USER LOCAL INC
businessSummary: User Local, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the data cloud business. The Company is engaged in the provision of platform for collecting, analyzing, and utilizing digital information. It provides four kinds of services. User Insight is a Web analytics product that measures the user experience. Social Insight is a management and analysis product for companies that supports social media operations. It provides insights based on the results of analyzing domestic social network service (SNS) user accounts, corporate accounts, post data, photos, video data, and supports their use in social marketing. Media Insight is an article content analysis product specializing in the operation of websites such as news sites. Support Chatbot is a support operation support system utilizing artificial intelligence.

name: EUGLENA CO LTD
businessSummary: Euglena Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that sells food and cosmetics using microalgae including Euglena (Japanese name: Midorimushi) and develops and manufactures biofuels. The Company operates through three business segments. The Healthcare Business segment is mainly engaged in the planning and sales of healthcare products including food and cosmetics, the supply of original equipment manufacturers (OEM), as well as the development and production of raw materials. The Biofuel Business segment is mainly engaged in research and development, production and sales of biofuels, as well as the development of cultivation technology for microalgae, primarily Euglena. The Other Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sale of organic compound fertilizers, genetic analysis services, social business, as well as research and development in new fields.

name: USS CO LTD
businessSummary: USS Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the auto auctions business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Auto Auction segment is engaged in the operation of auto auctions with used car dealers as members, the management of motorcycle auctions with used motorcycle dealers as members, the provision of auto auction connection services by satellite TV line and Internet, the provision of used car information services, the land transportation agency of exhibited cars and successful cars of auto auction, as well as the provision of financial services for auto auction members. The Used Automobile Purchase and Sale segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of used cars and accident-affected vehicles. The other business is engaged in the recycling of used vehicles, the provision of agency services for used vehicles, the sale of solar power generation systems and rental cars, as well as production and sale of recycled plastics.

name: YAMAHA MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamaha Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the land mobility, marine, robotics, financial services and others. The Company operates in four business segments. The Land Mobility Business segment manufactures and sells motorcycles, intermediate parts, parts for overseas production, four-wheeled buggies, recreational off-highway vehicles, electrically assisted bicycles, electrically assisted bicycle drive units (e-Kits), electric wheelchairs, automobile engines, automobile components. The Marine Business segment manufactures and sells outboard motors, water vehicles, boats, fishing boats and Japanese-style boats. The Robotics Business segment manufactures and sells surface mounters, semiconductors manufacturing post-engineering equipment, industrial robots and industrial unmanned helicopters. The Financial Services Business segment provides sales financing and leasing for its products. The Company also provides golf cars, generators, general-purpose engines and snowplows.

name: YAMAHA CORP
businessSummary: Yamaha Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the musical instruments business, the audio equipment business and other businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Musical Instruments Business segment manufactures and sells musical instruments, operates music schools and other facilities, and produces and sells music and video software. The Audio Equipment Business segment provides various solutions for both consumer and commercial use. It consists of a wide range of products from home audio equipment, music production and distribution equipment, professional audio equipment, and network equipment. The Company also engages in components and equipment business, consisting of electronic devices, automotive interior components, and factory automation (FA) equipment, as well as the golf goods business and resort business.

name: ASTELLAS PHARMA INC
businessSummary: Astellas Pharma Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sales of pharmaceutical products. The Company mainly operates Pharmaceutical Products business segment. The main products include XTANDI, BETANIS, MIRABETRIC, BETMIGA and new products ZOSPATA, EVERENZO and ENHOLTUMAB VEDOTIN, among others.

name: YAMANASHI CHUO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Yamanashi Chuo Bank Ltd is mainly engaged in the financial service business including banking business and credit card business. The Banking segment is engaged in the deposit, loan, securities trading, investment securities, domestic and foreign exchange business, as well as the over-the-counter sales of corporate bond trustee services, government bonds and other public bonds, investment trust and insurance, and the consulting business through the head office and branches. Through consolidated subsidiaries, the Bank provides credit guarantee services to complement lending operations. The others business is engaged in the leasing business, credit card business, as well as the provision of general consulting, venture capital and other banking related businesses.

name: YAMATO CORP
businessSummary: YAMATO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in facility works. The Company is involved in the design, supervision and construction work of construction facilities such as industrial air conditioning and hygiene equipment, general air conditioning and hygiene equipment, cold and frozen storage equipment for food distribution facilities, living-related processing equipment for environmental facilities. Through its subsidiaries, the Company also provides repair and maintenance services, as well as operation and repair management of water supply and sewerage facilities, among others.

name: YAMATO KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: YAMATO KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of shape steel. The Company operates through four geographic segments. The Steel (Japan) segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of H-shape steel, channel steel, I-shape steel, steel sheet piles, elevator guide rails, shaped steel for shipbuilding and ship cans, among others. The Steel (South Korean) segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel bars. The Steel (Thailand) segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of H-shape steel, channel steel, I-shape steel and steel sheet piles. The Railway-related segment is engaged in process and sale of turnouts and crossings, extensible joints, new crossings, glued insulated rails, derailment prevention guards, tie plates and bolts. The Company is also involved in the transportation and real estate properties business, as well as the treatment of medical waste.

name: YAMATO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamato Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the home delivery, logistics and transportation businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Retail segment provides home delivery services to individual customers and small- and medium-sized corporate customers. The Corporate segment is engaged in transportation services for large corporate customers, planning and operation of distribution centers, customs clearance, and air freight forwarding agency services. The Others segment is engaged in information technology (IT) systems development, operation and management, automobile maintenance, fuel sales, non-life insurance agency, and freight trucking. The Company also develops information systems and provides fleet management services for carriers.

name: YAMADA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamada Holdings Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the business of selling home appliances and information appliances. The Company operates through two business segments. The Denki segment is engaged in the sale of home appliances such as televisions, refrigerators, and washing machines, as well as information appliances such as PCs and cell phones, and home renovation, furniture, interior design, and other products related to the home. The Housing Construction segment is engaged in the sale of detached houses and other housing units, and manufacture and sale of bathrooms, kitchens, and other housing equipment. It also operates environmental businesses, financial businesses, and businesses related to building materials.

name: YAMADA CORP
businessSummary: YAMADA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of refueling equipment and related products. The Company operates in five regional segments. The main products include automotive equipment such as hand pumps, bucket pumps, lubricators and other lubrication equipment and tire service equipment, exhaust gas emission systems, freon gas collection equipment and other environmental maintenance equipment for automobile maintenance shops and gas stations, as well as industrial equipment such as air pumps and double diaphragm pumps that transport chemicals, inks, adhesives and paint fluids. The Company is also engaged in the sale and repair of service parts. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the United States, Netherlands, China and Thailand.

name: AZBIL CORP
businessSummary: Azbil Corporation is engaged in the manufacture of automation equipment. It has three segments. The Building Automation (BA) segment offers network building automation systems, wide area management systems, actuators and control valves, as well as building and energy management, maintenance and consulting services. The Advanced Automation (AA) segment offers supervisory control systems, solution packages, controllers, combustion safety control equipment, etc. The Life Automation segment provides various gas meters, safety maintenance equipment, supply equipment, etc. The Company also conducts insurance agency business.

name: YAMAZAKI BAKING CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamazaki Baking Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food business, distribution business, and other businesses. The Company has three business segments. The Food Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of bread, Japanese and Western confectionery, prepared bread and rice dishes, confectionery and rice crackers. The Distribution Business segment is engaged in the convenience store business and the operation of food supermarkets. The Other Business segment is engaged in logistics business, contracting the design, supervision and construction of food manufacturing equipment, administrative contracting and outsourcing, non-life insurance agency business, and the manufacture and sale of cleaning agents for food manufacturing machinery and equipment.

name: YAMAU HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamau Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Yamau Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of concrete products. The Company has seven business segments. The Concrete Product Manufacturing and Sale segment provides civil engineering products and landscape products. The Floodgate and Weir Manufacturing, Construction and Maintenance segment provides steel structures such as floodgates, and construction and maintenance services.
