The Geological Survey, Consultant and Civil Engineering segment provides geological survey services. The Information Equipment Sale and Maintenance segment sells and maintains processing support equipment. The Concrete Structure Inspection, Investigation and Repair segment provides inspection, investigation and repair services for concrete structures. The Real Estate segment leases real estate. The Bridge and Elevated Road Telescopic Device Manufacturing, Sale and Installing segment provides telescopic devices for bridges and elevated roads.

name: YAMAICHI ELECTRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamaichi Electronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechanical components such as integrated circuit (IC) socket products used in semiconductor inspection processes and connector products for electronic and electrical equipment. The Company operates through three segments. The Test Solutions segment provides burn-in sockets, test sockets, and semiconductor test-related services. The Connector Solutions segment manufactures and sells high-speed transmission connectors, card connectors, interface connectors, board connectors, pressure-welded connectors, mounting IC sockets, various other connectors, and YFLEX (high-speed transmission cables and mounting boards). The Optical-related Business segment manufactures and sells red, green, and blue (RGB) filters, ultraviolet (UV)/infrared (IR) cut filters, dichroic filters/mirrors, fluorescent dichroic filters, short/long-pass filters, band-pass filters, and semiconductor laser light sources.

name: YAMAICHI UNIHEIM REAL ESTATE CO LTD
businessSummary: Yamaichi Real Estate Co Ltd, formerly Yamaichi Uniheim Real Estate Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the development, sale, leasing, management and brokerage of real estate. The Company operates through three business segments. The Real Estate Development and Leasing segment develops and leases residential and commercial real estate properties and operates a parking lot business. The Real Estate Development and Sales segment develops residential land, sells land, and contracts for construction of detached houses. The Condominium segment mainly plans and sells condominiums. The Company is also engaged in the lease, sale, and management of condominiums for seniors, home nursing care and in-home care support services, operation of Japanese restaurants, and management of hot spring facilities. The Company also provides non-life insurance agency services and electricity sales.

name: LY CORP
businessSummary: LY Corp, formerly Z Holdings Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Softbank business. The Company operates in three segments. The Media Business segment provides services such as LINE advertising and Yahoo advertising. It operates platforms such as LINE VOOM, LINE NEWS, Talk List, Talk Head View, Talk Head View Custom, LINE Official Accounts, LINE Promotion Stamps, Lived Blog, LINE Stamps, LINE GAME, LINE Divination, LINE LIVE and other platforms. The Commerce Business segment includes electronic commerce (EC) for goods sales, including shopping business, reuse business, ASKUL stand-alone business-to-business (BtoB) business, and service EC. It operates platforms such as Yahoo! Shopping, PayPay Mall, ZOZOTOWN, LOHACO, Charm, LINE Shopping, LINE FRIENDS, LINE GIFT, and MySmartStore. The Strategic Business segment conducts Fintech business and provides PayPay Consolidated, PayPay Bank, and other financial services. The Company also provides cloud-related services.

name: KATITAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Katitas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the used housing rehabilitation business. The Used Housing Rehabilitation segment purchases mainly used detached houses, renovates them, and then sells them. The used housing rehabilitation business includes purchasing, commercialization, and sales. Properties are purchased through purchase or auction. Commercialization business involves planning and carrying out plumbing replacement such as kitchens, toilets, sinks, and unit baths, wallpaper and floor replacement, layout changes, exterior wall painting, and exterior construction such as parking lot expansion. Sales are conducted through the Company itself and through intermediary sales.

name: YASUHARA CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: YASUHARA CHEMICAL CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of terpene chemical products, hot melt adhesives and laminates. The Company operates through three business segments. Terpene Chemicals segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of adhesive, adhesive resins and chemical products. Hot Melt Adhesive segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of hot melt adhesives for adhesives and adhesive resins. Laminate segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of laminated products for glossy paper.

name: YASUDA LOGISTICS CORP
businessSummary: Yasuda Logistics Corporation, formerly The Yasuda Warehouse Company, Limited, is a company principally involved in the logistics and real estate businesses. The Company operates in two business segments. The Logistics segment is engaged in the provision of warehousing, land transportation, as well as international freight and logistics management services. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate and the management of rental buildings. As of March 31, 2015, the Company had 12 subsidiaries.

name: YASKAWA ELECTRIC CORP
businessSummary: Yaskawa Electric Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation, maintenance, and engineering of electrical equipment. The Company operates through three business segments. The Motion Control segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides maintenance services for alternating current (AC) servo motors, control devices, and inverters. The Robotics segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides maintenance services for industrial robots. The System Engineering segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides maintenance services for environmental and social systems and industrial automation drives.

name: YEDIGITALCORPORATION
businessSummary: YE DIGITAL Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of information processing services such as building and operating information systems and developing and selling information processing software. The Company’s two business solutions centered on business system construction and services, and the Internet of things (IoT) solution business, which focuses on solutions that utilize artificial intelligence (AI) and big data analysis technology, as well as contracted development of embedded and control systems. The business solutions business builds core systems for companies (sales management, production management, purchasing management, accounting management and others), develops systems for mobile communication carriers (mobile phone subscriber management, accounting management), and provides solution system services for health insurers. The IoT solutions business builds smart logistics solutions, IoT and machine-to-machine (M2M) solutions.

name: YASHIMA & CO LTD
businessSummary: Yashima & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based trading company mainly engaged in the sale of body products and electrical products to railway operators and others, as well as the electronic components to general industries. The railway business provides electrical products for railway vehicles, car body products, vehicle-mounted products, connectors and electronic parts. The general business provides connectors and electronic parts. In addition, the Company provides repair and modification products for thermal power plants overseas, various processed harness products, power devices such as power supply units, and water generators containing micro bubbles.

name: YAKULT HONSHA CO LTD
businessSummary: YAKULT HONSHA CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of dairy products and pharmaceuticals. The Company operates in three business segments. The Beverages and Food Manufacturing and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of dairy products, beverages, noodles and healthy food, the purchase and sale of materials, as well as the transportation business. The Company operates business in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia and Oceania. The Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of anticancer drugs and other ethical drugs. The Others segment is engaged in the production and sale of cosmetics, as well as the operation of professional baseball clubs.

name: YAKUODO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: YAKUODO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the retail of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, food products, miscellaneous goods and other life related products. The Company operates through healthcare business, beauty care business, home care business and convenience care business. The healthcare business is mainly engaged in the sale of pharmaceuticals, hygiene products, medical supplies, health foods, nursing care products and preparations. The beauty care business is mainly engaged in the sale of cosmetics, as well as hair care, oral care and body care products. The home care business is mainly engaged in the sale of detergents, kitchen utensils, clothes, footwear and fashion accessories. The convenience care business is mainly engaged in the sale of stationery, toys, pet supplies, electric appliances, confectionery, beverages, food, books, liquors and tobacco.

name: YAGI & CO LTD
businessSummary: YAGI & CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the trading, import and export of textile products. The Company operates business through raw material field, textile field and textile secondary products field. The Company is also engaged in the textile processing business, real estate business and other businesses.

name: YA-MAN LTD
businessSummary: Ya-Man Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the beauty and health related business. It is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, purchase and sale of household beauty and health equipment and cosmetics, as well as the purchase and sale of variety sundries. The Company mainly has four business segments. The Mail Order segment sells products to consumers through mail order houses, as well as to catalog retailers and Internet retailers. The Store Sales segment is engaged in the sale to electronics retail stores, large department stores and variety shops. The Direct Sales segment sells products to consumers through infomercials, magazines, newspapers and Websites. The Overseas segment sells its products to overseas mail dealers, wholesalers and, individual consumers.

name: MORIYA TRANSPORTATION ENGINEERING AND MA
businessSummary: Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing, sales, installation, maintenance and repair business of elevators in Japan and overseas. The Elevator segment is mainly engaged in the business related to cargo and marine elevators in Japan, as well as purchasing agency business, marine elevator installation and maintenance business overseas. Products include luggage elevators and marine elevators. Services include maintenance and repair. The Company conclude maintenance contracts and inspection contracts for elevators with clients, and carry out outsourced maintenance, repairs, and periodic inspections and inspections required by the Building Standards Act and the Industrial Safety and Health Act.

name: MORIYA CORP
businessSummary: MORIYA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business, civil engineering business and other related business. The Company operates through three business segments. Construction segment and Civil Engineering segment is involved in the construction business, civil engineering business and conducts contract business related to other general construction work. Real Estate segment is engaged in business related to real estate such as purchase, sale, rental and mediation of real estate. The Company is also engaged in the management of golf courses.

name: MORINAGA & CO LTD
businessSummary: Morinaga & Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in food manufacturing, food wholesale, real estate and services etc. The Company operates in three segments. The Food Manufacturing segment is engaged in manufacturing of confectionaries, foods, frozen desserts, jelly drinks, etc. The Food Wholesale segment is engaged in wholesales of commercial food. The Real Estate and Services segment is engaged in real estate rental business and management of golf courses. Other business involves in the financial services and other activities.

name: DMG MORI CO LTD
businessSummary: DMG Mori Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions covering machine tools such as machining centers, turning centers, multi-tasking machines, 5-axis machines, additive manufacturing machines, and other products, software such as user interfaces, technology cycles and embedded software, measuring equipment, repair and restoration support, applications, and engineering. The Company operates in two business segments. The Machine Tools segment manufactures and sells machine tools. The Industrial Services segment provides services and solutions related to machine tools, manufactures and sells measuring equipment, and develops and sells software, image processing hardware.

name: MORY INDUSTRIES INC
businessSummary: MORY INDUSTRIES INC. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufactures and sells stainless tube, stainless bars, processed stainless products and steel tubes. The Indonesia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless tubes. The Company also sells automobile-related products and mail-order goods.

name: MOBILE FACTORY INC
businessSummary: Mobile Factory,Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in mobile service. The Company provides social application service and contents service. Social Application Service is focus on delivering services of game application through SNS platforms and application markets. Contents Service mainly provides sites, such as ringer melody and divination sites, which are operated by telecommunication carriers.

name: MONOTARO CO. LTD.
businessSummary: MonotaRO Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in mail-order sales primarily through e-commerce, an internet-based distribution channel, selling industrial supplies to customers mainly consisting of domestic and international businesses. Products procured from domestic and international wholesalers and manufacturers are listed in the Company's online catalog on its website and in paper catalogs distributed to individual customers, and are sold directly to end users both domestically and internationally. The Company conducts its business through the Factory Indirect Materials Sales segment. The products handled primarily consist of factory indirect materials, such as consumables and repair supplies used routinely within factories.

name: MONOGATARI CORP
businessSummary: Monogatari Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurant business through direct management and franchise. The Company mainly operates large suburban-type restaurants in Japan under the brand name of Yakiniku Kingu, Marugen Ramen, Marugen II, Aged Soy Sauce Ramen Kyabeton, Okonomiyaki Honpo, Sushi & Shabu Shabu Yuzuan, Fish & Shellfish Samai Genya, Shabu Kani Genji So Honten, Gyutan Loving Yakiniku Happii, Aged Yakiniku Niku Gen, Yakitate Karubi, Kajitsuya Coffee and Thick Chinese Soba Gyoza Marufuku. The Company also operates a franchise business that collects royalties, franchise fees, and outsourcing fees from franchisees on a percentage-of-sales basis.

name: MODALIS THERAPEUTICS CORP
businessSummary: Modalis Therapeutics Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the research and development of gene therapy drugs using the core platform CRISPR-GNDM technology. The Company develops gene therapy drugs that use CRISPR-GNDM technology, which is a unique platform technology, for genetic diseases caused by errors in the genetic code and epigenetics. The Company has two business models. Collaborative model pipeline opens CRISPR-GNDM technology to partners, and develops therapeutic drugs with partners' funds for the targets selected by the partners. In-house model pipeline selects targets using the Company's own CRISPR-GNDM technology and develops therapeutic agents. The Company's pipeline consists of a collaborative model pipeline of 5 items such as MDL-201 and an in-house model pipeline of 2 items such as MDL-101.

name: MENTAL HEALTH TECHNOLOGIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Mental Health Technologies Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the mental health solution business, medical career support business and digital marketing business. The Company operates through three segments. The Mental Health Solution segment develops the mental health care service ELPIS and provides services to customers. The Company packages the service provision service provided by industrial physicians and public health nurses and various cloud-type services ELPIS related to the physical and mental health management of workers, and provides them under the name of Industrial Physician Cloud. The Medical Career Support segment is a paid employment agency business based on the Employment Security Law, and mainly provides recruitment support services to introduce doctors to medical institutions. The Digital Marketing segment provides services for medical societies and web marketing support services.

name: MEDLEY INC
businessSummary: Medley, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of various Internet services in the medical healthcare field. The Company operates in three business segments. The Human Resources Platform segment is engaged in the operation and provision of a performance-based human resource recruitment system Job Medley for solving the shortage and uneven distribution of human resources in the medical healthcare field. The Medical Platform segment is engaged in the development and provision of an online medical care system CLINICS and a medical information provision system MEDLEY to improve the operational efficiency of medical institutions and improve medical access for patients. The New Development Services segment is engaged in the development of nursing care facilities search site Kaigonohonne.

name: MERCARI INC
businessSummary: Mercari Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the operation of consumer-to-consumer (CtoC) platforms. The Company operates through two segments. The Japan Region segment operates Marketplace, which operates the Mercari flea market app in Japan, as well as payment and finance and cryptocurrency-related businesses in Japan. The US segment operates the Mercari flea market app in the United States. The Company also engages in sports business and other businesses.

name: MENICON CO LTD
businessSummary: Menicon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the vision care business and others. The Vision Care Business segment manufactures and sells contact lenses and contact lens care products. Besides traditional hard and soft contact lenses, the Company manufactures and sells disposable contact lenses, including daily disposable, biweekly, and monthly replacement contact lenses. The Company also manufactures and sells contact lens care products, which are solutions for cleaning, disinfecting, and storing contact lenses. The Company also offers a flat-rate membership system called Menicon Eye Life Support Plan. By paying an initiation fee and a fixed monthly membership fee, the Company offers coverage for loss, damage, and prescription changes, allowing users to continue wearing contact lenses safely and optimally. Other businesses include the development and sale of veterinary medical products, materials for promoting rice straw decomposition and others.

name: METAWATER CO LTD
businessSummary: METAWATER Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the design, construction, repair, maintenance and operation management of mechanical and electrical equipment for water purification plants, sewage treatment plants, waste treatment facilities and recycling facilities. The Company operates its business in two business segments. The Plant Engineering segment involves in the design, procurement and sale of mechanical and electrical equipment used in water purification plants and sewage treatment plants. The Service Solution segment involves in the repair, maintenance and operation management of mechanical and electrical equipment used in water purification plants and sewage treatment plants, providing equipment inspection, repair, maintenance and other services.

name: MEDICAL DATA VISION CO LTD
businessSummary: Medical Data Vision Co.,Ltd. is a company engaged in the medical data network business. The Data Network Service provides management support systems for medical institutions and health insurance unions, as well as EVE, Medical Code and CADA-BOX for hospitals. The Data Utilization Service provides corporate services and personal services based on the medical and health information accumulated through the data network services, various analysis data to pharmaceutical companies, research institutes, patients and consumers. The segment provides various services, such as MDV analyzer, ADHOC research service, OTC, H&BC and insurance company services, as well as Media logs and others.

name: MEDPEER INC
businessSummary: MedPeer, Inc. provides social service MedPeer to doctors. The Company mainly operates two business segments. The Doctor Platform business operates the MedPeer site, which is a knowledge management tool that shares raw information from physicians at medical clinics, and a place where all the doctors nationwide gather together is established on the Internet. The Healthcare Solutions business utilizes expert networks such as doctors and administrative nutritionists to develop services targeting health promotion and prevention areas.

name: MEDIKIT CO LTD
businessSummary: MEDIKIT CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company involved in the development, manufacture and sale of medical equipment. Its major products consist of artificial diagnostic equipment, which includes indwelling needles that are used for artificial dialysis purposes; indwelling venous needles (anesthesia type), which are used for blood and fluid transfusion purposes, and angiography equipment, which includes introducers and angiographic catheters.

name: METALART CORP
businessSummary: Metalart Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision die-forged products, and its products are mainly automobiles and construction machinery parts. The Company manufactures, processes and sells hot forged products and precision stamped and forged products used in automobiles, construction machinery, agricultural machinery, ships and other general industrial machinery. The Company provides parts shapes from forging to machining, centering on engine parts, suspension parts, transmission gears and other industrial parts.

name: MEC CO LTD
businessSummary: MEC COMPANY LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the production and sale of chemicals for electronic printed circuit boards (PCBs), as well as the sale of machinery and materials for PCBs. The Company manufactures and sells PCB chemicals, including copper surface treatment, flux, anti-rust and metal-resist removing agents, and PCB machinery, including chemical treatment machinery, pre-treatment machinery and post-treatment machinery, as well as sells PCB materials, such as copper foils and dry films. The Company is also engaged in the provision of repair services for machinery.

name: MEGACHIPS CORP
businessSummary: MegaChips Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of system large-scale integrations (LSIs) based on the basic technologies of image, audio and telecommunication sectors, and electronic components and system machinery equipped with its system LSIs. The Company’s main products Include LSIs for entertainment devices such as game consoles, image processing LSIs for digital cameras, LSIs for liquid crystal display (LCD) panels, and video surveillance system equipment for security field, among others. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had four subsidiaries.

name: MEIWA CORP
businessSummary: Meiwa Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemical-related businesses. It operates through four business segments. The First Business segment engages in the resources and environment business, flame retardants business and functional building materials business, providing rare earths and rare metals, environmental-related products, metal-related products, flame retardants, insulation materials and others. The Second Business segment engages in the petroleum products business, providing lubricants, base oils and additives. The Third Business segment engages in the high-performance materials business, functional chemicals business, synthetic resins business, and inorganic chemicals business, providing film products, printing raw materials, papermaking chemical raw materials, adhesive raw materials and others. The Automotive and Battery Materials Business segment engages in the automotive and battery materials businesses, providing automotive parts and battery materials.

name: MEIHO ENTERPRISE CO LTD
businessSummary: MEIHO ENTERPRISE CO., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Real Estate Allotment Sale segment is engaged in the allotment sale of condominiums developed by the Company, the renovation and sale of pre-owned condominiums, the development of attached house and town house, as well as the allotment sale of properties as its joint venture business. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases condominiums and buildings. The Real Estate Brokerage segment is involved in the brokerage business of land for condominium use, as well as other brokerage businesses. The Others segment provides real estate leasing-related services, such as the acquisition of construction management fee and other various consulting reward.

name: MEIDENSHA CORP
businessSummary: MEIDENSHA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the social infrastructure business, industrial system business, maintenance service business and real estate business, etc. The Company operates in four segments. The Social Infrastructure segment provides products and services related to social infrastructures, such as power generation and transformation systems. The Industrial System segment provides products and services such as component products, power measurement system products and automatic guided vehicles mainly to the general manufacturing industry. The Maintenance Service segment is mainly engaged in the maintenance business. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in leasing business related with real estate. Other businesses include other manufacturing and sales business, employees' welfare services and the manufacturing and sales of chemical products.

name: MEITEC GROUP HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Meitec Group Holdings Inc, formerly Meitec Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the engineering solutions business and engineer introduction business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Engineering Solutions business segment is engaged in the provision of engineering solution services with a focus on engineer dispatch services. This segment includes high-end engineer dispatching business, middle-range engineer dispatching business, senior engineer dispatching business, registered staffing business whose main customers are the manufacturing industry, and general outsourcing business. The Engineer Introduction business segment is engaged in the employment placement business for engineers.

name: MEISEI INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: MEISEI INDUSTRIAL Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction work, mainly heat insulation work, and boiler business for manufacturing and installing boilers. The Company is engaged in insulation work, construction material work, freezing, refrigeration and low temperature work in the manufacturing and construction of materials in Japan and overseas. The Company is also involved in the manufacture, construction, sale and installation of boilers and industrial machinery in Japan and overseas.

name: MEIJI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Meiji Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the management of subsidiaries that manufactures and sells food and medicines. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Food segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of yogurt, milk, beverages, cheese, butter, margarine, cream, ice cream, frozen food, chocolate, gummi, gum, sports nutrition, powdered milk, liquid food, beauty food, general medicine, sugar, saccharified flour and others. The Pharmaceuticals segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of ethical pharmaceuticals, and animal drugs.

name: MURATA MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: Murata Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production of semi-finished products, which are intermediate products of various electronic components. The Company operates through three segments. The Components segment provides capacitors, inductors, and electromagnetic interference (EMI) rejection filters. The Devices and Modules segment provides high-frequency modules, surface wave filters, lithium-ion rechargeable batteries, and sensors. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of healthcare equipment, solution business. The Company also provides employee benefits, leases real estate, and develops and sells products and software.

name: MURAKAMI CORP
businessSummary: MURAKAMI CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive rearview mirrors and fine glass. The Company operates in three segments. Products include mirror-related products such as mirrors with hydrophilic functions, electrochromic mirrors, aspherical mirrors, small electrical units, actuators, blind spot display mirrors, door mirrors with built-in feet lighting, and automatic electric retractable mirrors; optical thin film products such as dichroic mirrors, dichroic filters, cold mirrors, laser mirrors and concave molded mirrors; as well as mechanical products such as small actuator units, navigation stands, active spoilers and controllers.

name: MUSASHINO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Musashino Bank Ltd mainly operates banking business, and financial services including leasing business and credit guarantee services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the provision of deposit and loan services, exchange business and investment of securities business. The Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of finance-related leasing services. The Credit Guarantee segment is engaged in the provision of finance-related credit guarantee services. The other businesses include money lending, credit guarantee services related to card operations, the development, sales and maintenance of computer systems, research and study of the prefecture's economy and industry, management and tax consultations, the operation of seminars, the investment in venture companies, the management consultations, administrative agency services, regional trading company operations, consulting services, investment management and investment advisory services.

name: MUSASHI SEIMITSU INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: Musashi Seimitsu Industry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive powertrain parts, suspension parts, steering parts, and transmission parts. The Company operates its business through five geographical segments: Japan, Americas, Asia, China and Europe. Its products are used in industries such as automobiles, machine tools, and industrial machines. Powertrain (PT) products includes planetary gear assemblies, differential gear assemblies, bevel gears, ring gears, camshafts, and balance shafts. The linkage and suspension (L&S) products include suspension arm assemblies, suspension ball joints, steering ball joints, and various joints for connection. Motorcycle products include motorcycle transmission gear assemblies, motorcycle camshafts, motorcycle kick starter components, other motorcycle drivetrain components, and general-purpose engine components.

name: MOVIN STRATEGIC CAREER CO LTD
businessSummary: Movin' Strategic Career Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that provides recruitment services to professional firms, focusing on the human resources consulting industry. The Company operates through the recruitment business segment. The Recruitment Business segment focuses on supporting management consultants in recruiting. The recruitment service introduces full-time candidates to companies seeking full-time positions. Career advisors obtain job details from companies seeking full-time positions and match candidates who meet the job requirements from a registered user database (or external job-hunting Websites). Career advisors also conduct interviews with registered users who wish to change jobs, provide career consultations on desired job types, confirm their intentions to change jobs, introduce job openings that match the registered user's career aspirations, send resumes and other information and provide support and advice from the job interview to joining the company.

name: MINKABU THE INFONOID INC
businessSummary: MINKABU THE INFONOID,Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in media business and solutions business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Media business segment includes revenue from information media for investors such as https://minkabu.jp/, https://kabutan.jp/ (Kabutan) and the like obtained from The Company and the services that The Company plays a part of the site management through business alliance, and part Record billing revenue from paid services offered at the site. In the solution business segment, the Company provides information-based FinTech solutions that processed content generated using artificial intelligence (AI) for investor information media managed by The Company and cloud input data collected on the site. It records revenue from application service provider (ASP) service to be provided to third parties, software development work accompanying them and maintenance and operation work.

name: MIROKU CORP
businessSummary: Miroku Corporation is primarily engaged in hunting rifle, machine tool and automobile-related businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Hunting Rifle segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of shotguns, sport rifles and shotgun-related products. The Machine Tool segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of deep hole processing machines, ultra-precision grinding machines and deep hole processing tools, among others. The Automobile-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive handles, automobile-related products and others. The Company also purchases and sells woodworking products.

name: MIROKU JYOHO SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: MIROKU JYOHO SERVICE CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the operation of software-related business. The Company provides development and sales of application software for business use, sales of general-purpose servers and personal computers, sales and maintenance of supply goods, management information services, training services, consulting services to small and medium-sized companies, mainly accounting firms (tax accountants and certified public accountants firms) and their advisors to support customer management. The Company’s main products and services include the sale of computer hardware, such as servers, personal computers and peripheral devices, the development and sale of business application software, the provision of comprehensive maintenance services for accounting firms, such as program update services, telecommunication support services and information services, the provision of business application software rental service and comprehensive maintenance service.

name: TOKIO MARINE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Tokio Marine Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the domestic non-life insurance business, domestic life insurance business, overseas insurance business, and financial and other businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Domestic Non-Life Insurance Business segment is engaged in no-life insurance underwriting business and asset management business in Japan. The Domestic Life Insurance Business segment is engaged in life insurance underwriting and asset management services in Japan. The Overseas Insurance Business segment is engaged in overseas insurance underwriting and asset management services. The Financial and Other Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of investment advisory services, investment trust outsourcing services, staffing services, as well as real estate management and nursing care business.

name: MIRAIT HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Mirait One Corp is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the nippon telegraph and telephone (NTT) business, multicareer business, environment and social innovation business, as well as information communications technology (ICT) solution business. The Company operates through seven segments, including MIRAIT, MIRAIT Technologies, Lantrovision, TTK, Solcom and Shikokutsuken, Seibu Construction. The seven segments are involved in the information communication engineering, electrical equipment works and air condition maintenance business. The Company is also engaged in the communication infrastructure business, global business, and mobile network business.

name: MIYAJI ENGINEERING GROUP INC
businessSummary: MIYAJI ENGINEERING GROUP, INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the bridge business. The Company operates in two business segments. Along with its subsidiaries, MIYAJI ENGINEERING segment is engaged in the design, production and site installation, the maintenance, repair and reinforcement of bridges, structural steel products and others; sales of fiber-reinforced plastics (FRP) structures; prestressed concrete bridges and other civil engineering works; as well as earthquake-proof and seismic isolation works for large and high-rise buildings, steel towers, chimneys, factory buildings and others. The MM BRIDGE segment is engaged in the production, installation, sales and repair of bridges, coastal structures, as well as the contract, design and supervise construction of civil engineering construction works.

name: MINO CERAMIC CO LTD
businessSummary: MINO CERAMIC CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial refractory products, the design and construction of plants and the sale of flooring and paving materials. The Company operates in four business segments. The Refractory segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of bricks, irregular refractory products and others, as well as the production of ceramic products. The Plant segment is engaged in the design and construction of industrial kilns and automated systems. The Construction and Paving Materials segment is engaged in the construction and sale of construction materials, as well as the manufacture and provision of paving materials and processed products. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases offices. The Company is also engaged in the sale of outsourced goods.

name: MINEBEA MITSUMI INC
businessSummary: Minebea Mitsumi Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machined components and electronic equipment. The Company operates through four segments. The Machined Components segment mainly provides ball bearings, rod end bearings, pivot assemblies for hard disk drives (HDD) and other mechanical parts, as well as aircraft screws. The Electronic Equipment segment includes liquid crystal display (LCD) backlights, measuring devices and other electronic devices, HDD spindle motors, stepping motors, direct current (DC) motors, fan motors, precision motors and special equipment. The Mitsumi segment mainly includes semiconductor devices, optical devices, mechanical components, high-frequency components, and power supply components. The Yushin segment's main products are automotive parts such as key sets, door latches, and door handles, as well as parts for industrial equipment.

name: MIZUNO CORP
businessSummary: Mizuno Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of sporting goods. It manufactures and sells sports shoes, sportswear, baseball and golf products through four segments, including Japan, Europe, Americas, and Asia & Oceania. The Japan segment is also engaged in the construction of sports facilities, the operation and contract operation of sports facilities, school business, as well as the manufacture and sale of sports equipment, lifestyle products, and working products in Japan. The Asia & Oceania segment is also engaged in the construction of sports facilities.

name: MITSUBOSHI BELTING LTD
businessSummary: Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of belts and construction materials. The Company operates in three business segments along with its subsidiaries. The Domestic Belts segment manufactures and sells belts for automobiles, general industry and transportation use in domestic market. The Overseas Belts segment manufactures and sells belts for automobiles, general industry, office automation (OA) equipment and other use in overseas markets. The Construction Materials segment manufactures and sells waterproof sheets for construction and civil engineering use and related products. The Company also involves in the provision of equipment and machinery, third-party products, engineering structural forms and related services.

name: MITSUBOSHI CO LTD
businessSummary: MITSUBOSHI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of rubber electric wires, plastic electric wires, extruded synthetic resin products and electrical heating wires. The Company operates through three business segments. The Electric Wire segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of natural rubber-sheathed flexible cables, synthetic rubber-sheathed flexible cables, polyethylene cables, welding cables, control cables, plastic-sheathed flexible cables and plastic cords. The Polymatech segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of extruded synthetic plastic products, injection synthetic products, vacuum synthetic products and high performance tubes. The Electrical Heating Wire segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electrical heating wires and ribbons.

name: MITSUBISHI MATERIALS CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Materials Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed copper products, electronic materials, and cemented carbide products, as well as the smelting and sale of copper, gold, silver, palladium, and other metals. The Company operates in four business segments. The High Functional Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed copper products, functional materials, electronic devices, chemical products, sealing components, and other products. The Machined Components Business segment manufactures and sells cemented carbide products and other products. The Metals Business segment is engaged in smelting and sales of copper, gold, silver, palladium, and other metals. It also engages in smelting and refining. The Environment & Energy segment is engaged in geothermal and hydroelectric power generation and environmental recycling. The Company also operates cement and related businesses and engineering-related businesses.

name: MITSUBISHI UFJ FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in financial business. It operates through eight business segments. Retail & Digital Business Group provides financial services to individual customers and corporations. Commercial Banking & Wealth Management Business Group provides financial services to corporations and wealth management clients. Japanese Corporate & Investment Banking Business Group provides financial services to large Japanese corporations. Global Commercial Banking Business Group provides financial services to individuals, mid-sized enterprises, and other enterprises. Asset Management & Investor Services Business Group provides asset management, asset administration, and pension services. Global Corporate & Investment Banking Business Group provides financial services to large non-Japanese corporations. Global Markets Business Group provides foreign exchange, funding, and other services. It also operates The Other segment.

name: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Electric Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the industry mobility, life and other businesses. The Company operates in six business segments. The Infrastructure segment is engaged in the social systems, power systems, defense and space and systems businesses, and provides electrical equipment for railway vehicles, wireless communication equipment and others. The Industry & Mobility segment is engaged in the factory automation (FA) system business and the automotive equipment business. The Life segment is engaged in the building system business and the air conditioning and home appliances business. The Business Platform segment is involved in the information systems and services business. The Semiconductor Device segment is involved in the electronic devices business. The Other segment provides materials procurement, logistics, real estate, advertising and publicity and finance.

name: MITSUBISHI LOGISTICS CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Logistics Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the logistic business. It has two business segments. The Logistic segment is engaged in the warehousing, land transportation, port transportation and international transportation handling businesses. The warehousing business involves depositing, storing, warehousing, unloading, and other operations. The land transportation business transports cargo and acts as a transportation agent. The port transportation business involves the loading and unloading of cargo, transportation, carrying in and out of sheds and other cargo handling areas, storage. The international transportation handling business involves development of international transportation systems, and handling of international transportation of goods. The Real Estate segment involves the rental and management of buildings, the management and operation of parking lots and shopping centers, the design and contracting of various construction works and real estate sales.

name: MITSUBISHI PAPER MILLS LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Paper Mills Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the functional products business and the paper materials business. The Company has two business segments. The Functional Products Business segment handles information and specialty paper products, functional materials, photographic materials, inkjet paper and others. The Paper Materials Business segment handles printing paper, pulp and others. The Company also engages in engineering services such as the maintenance, design, and manufacture of factory equipment.

name: MITSUBISHI HEAVY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of energy, plants and infrastructure systems, logistics, heating and cooling, drive systems. The Company operates through four segments. Energy Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of thermal power generation systems, nuclear power generation systems, wind power generation systems, aircraft engines. Plants & Infrastructure Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of steelmaking machinery, merchant ships, engineering, environmental equipment and mechanical systems. Logistics, Thermal & Drive Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of logistics equipment, heat and cooling products, engines, turbochargers and others. Aircraft, Defense & Space Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of civil aircraft, defense aircraft and others.

name: MITSUBISHI MOTORS CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Motors Corp is engaged in the development, production and sale of automobile and related parts, as well as the financial business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automobile segment is engaged in the manufacture of general and small-sized passenger vehicles and light vehicles, the sale of parts, new car inspection, maintenance and logistics of parts in domestic markets, and the manufacturing and sales in overseas market. Its major products include electric vehicles, sports utility vehicles (SUVs) and pickups, passenger cars and minivans, and light vehicles. The Financing segment is engaged in the automobile leasing business and sales finance business.

name: MITSUBISHI ESTATE CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in commercial real estate, Marunouchi, housing, overseas, investment management, and design supervision and real estate services. The Company operates through six business segments. The Commercial Real Estate Business segment develops, leases, operates, and manages various asset types, as well as parking lots and district heating and cooling. The Marunouchi Business segment develops, leases, operates, and manages office buildings in the Otemachi, Marunouchi, and Yurakucho areas, as well as district heating and cooling. The Housing Business segment constructs, sells, leases, manages, renovates, and brokers condominiums and detached houses, and others. The Overseas Business segment develops, leases, and manages real estate overseas. The Investment Management segment manages real estate investments. The Design Supervision and Real Estate Services segment engages in the design and supervision of architecture, and others.

name: MITSUBISHI CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in metal resources, natural gas, consumer industry and other businesses. It has ten business segments. Natural Gas segment engages in production and development of natural gas and crude oil. Comprehensive Materials segment engages in sales transactions of carbon, steel products. Chemical Solutions segment engages in sales, business development and investment in chemical-related fields. Metal Resources segment engages in investment and development of metal resources. Industrial Infrastructure segment conducts business in energy infrastructure and industrial plants. Automobile and Mobility segment provides value chain businesses. Food Industry segment conducts sales transactions in food related production. Consumer Industry segment provides products and services in the retail and apparel. Electric Power Solution segment provides power. Complex Urban Development segment conducts urban and real estate development.

name: MITSUBISHI CHEMICAL HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Chemical Group Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the functional products, healthcare and materials business. The Company operates through five segments. The Specialty Materials segment provides polymers and coatings additives, films and molding materials, and advanced solutions, including life solutions and information electronics. The Industrial Gases segment provides industrial gases. The Healthcare segment provides pharmaceuticals. The Methyl Methacrylate (MMA) segment provides MMA and Polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA). The Basic Materials segment provides petrochemical infrastructure, polyolefins, basic chemicals, and carbon. The Company also provides engineering, transportation and warehousing services.

name: MITSUBISHI GAS CHEMICAL CO INC
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Co Inc is a Japan-based chemical company. The Company operates in two business segments. The Green Energy & Chemicals segment manufactures and sells methanol, methanol and ammonia-based chemicals, life science products, general aromatic chemicals, special aromatic chemicals, foam plastics, and electricity. The Performance Chemicals segment manufactures and sells inorganic chemicals, plastic lens monomers, engineering plastics, electronic materials, and oxygen absorbers. The other businesses include real estate business.

name: MITSUBISHI KAKOKI KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the engineering business and the industry machinery business. The Company operates through two business segments. Main products of the Engineering segment are city gas and petroleum related plants, plants for chemical industries, hydrogen production equipment, sewage treatment equipment, industrial wastewater treatment equipment and other water treatment equipment, among others. The industry machinery segment’s main products are oil purifiers, others types of centrifugal separators, filtration equipment, dust removal equipment for seawater intake, as well as agitators.

name: MITSUBISHI PENCIL CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Pencil Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the writing instruments and writing instrument peripheral products business and other businesses. It operates through two segments. The Writing Instruments and Writing Instrument Peripheral Products segment manufactures and sells writing instruments and peripheral products such as cosmetics, which utilize the technology cultivated in the writing instrument business. Products include ballpoint pens, multi-function pens and customized pens, mechanical pencils, felt-tip pens and markers, pencils and colored pencils, seals and name pens, office and school supplies, and green nets. The Other Business segment is mainly involved in the manufacture and sale of adhesive tape and the sale of handicrafts.

name: PLANT CO LTD
businessSummary: PLANT Co., Ltd. is a company mainly involved in the operation of discount stores. The Company operates three types of stores under the names JOYFUL STORE, HOME CENTER and SUPER CENTER. The JOYFUL STORE is located in the urban areas, and primarily provides small-sized and small-sum groceries and other daily consumable goods. The HOME CENTER is found in the suburbs, and principally supplies Do-It-Yourself (DIY) items, garden supplies, food products excluding fresh food, as well as clothing. The SUPER CENTER is located in the rural areas, and mainly provides daily living-related products including fresh food and others.

name: ISETAN MITSUKOSHI HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the department store business, credit & finance business/customer organization management business, and real estate business. It operates through three segments. The Department Store Business segment sells clothing, personal items, miscellaneous goods, household goods, and food. The Credit & Finance Business/Customer Organization Management Business segment is involved in credit cards, money lending, non-life insurance agency, life insurance solicitation agency, and customer organization management businesses. The Real Estate Business segment is involved in real estate rental, tenant management, and building interior design. In addition, the Company is also involved in retail, manufacturing/import/export/wholesale, logistics, human resources services, information processing services, media, and travel businesses.

name: MITSUI MATSUSHIMA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui Matsushima Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in a variety of businesses, including consumer goods, industrial products, and finance. The Company operates through four segments. The Consumer Goods segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of extendable straws, the purchase and sale of food and beverage supplies, and others. The Industrial Products segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of mask blanks, and others. The Finance and Other Businesses segment is primarily engaged in real estate-backed loans for businesses, and others. The Energy Business segment consists of the Coal Production segment, and the Coal Sales segment. Due to the closure of existing mining areas in the Australian coal mining business, the Coal Production and Coal Sales segments of the Energy Business segment were discontinued at the end of the fiscal year ending March 2024.

name: MITSUI & CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui & Co Ltd is a Japan-based general trading company. The Company operates through seven segments. The Mineral & Metal Resources segment is engaged in resource development, manufacture, sales, and trading of steel and non-ferrous metal raw materials. The Energy Segment trades oil and gas, coal, and related products, and operates an electric power business. The Machinery & Infrastructure segment manufactures, sells, and trades machinery and equipment, as well as leases, finances, and operates infrastructure businesses. The Chemicals segment manufactures, sells, and trades chemicals and housing materials. The Iron & Steel Products segment manufactures, sells, and trades steel products. The Living Essentials segment manufactures, sells, and trades food and consumer goods, and conducts wellness-related businesses. The Next-Generation & Functional Businesses segment engages in the information and telecommunications business, logistics business, insurance business and media business.

name: MITSUI FUDOSAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the leasing, sales, management and other businesses. The Company operates in five business segments. The Leasing Business segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and commercial facilities. The Sales Business segment sells condominiums and detached houses to individual customers, and sells rental housing and office buildings to investors. The Management Business segment is engaged in non-asset businesses such as property management, brokerage and asset management. The Facility Sales Business segment is engaged in hotel and resort business, and sports and entertainment business. The Other segment is engaged in the design, construction supervision and construction contracting of new housing, renovation work for homes and renewal work for offices and commercial facilities, golf course business, retail of flowers, seeds and seedlings, gardening supplies, specified power transmission and distribution, and others.

name: MITSUI HIGH-TEC INC
businessSummary: Mitsui High-tec Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of molds and machine tools, electronic components, and electrical components. The Company conducts business through three segments. The Molds and Machine Tools segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of press dies and surface grinders, and other products. The Electronic Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of lead frames, and other products. The Electrical Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of motor core products, and other products.

name: SUMIKEN MITSUI ROAD CO LTD
businessSummary: SUMIKEN MITSUI ROAD CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the construction business, as well as the manufacture and sales of related materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the pavement construction, civil engineering work, building construction and others. The Manufacturing and Sales segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of construction materials. The Others segment is involved in the sales of electricity and real estate transaction-related business.

name: SUMITOMO MITSUI TRUST HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group Inc, formerly Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking, asset management, asset administration, and real estate-related businesses. The Company operates through seven business segments. The Personal Business segment provides services to individual customers. The Corporate Business segment provides services to corporate customers. The Investor Business segment provides services to investor customers. The Real Estate Business segment provides real estate business services. The Market Business segment provides marketing, market making, investment, and financial management services. The Operation Business segment provides asset management services. The Other Business segment includes income and expenditures for capital procurement and policy stock dividends, costs of the business management headquarters, and eliminations of internal transactions.

name: MITSUI E&S HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui E&S Co Ltd, formerly Mitsui E&S Holdings Co Ltd, is primarily engaged in ship, marine development, machinery, and engineering businesses. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Ship segment provides ships, naval vessels, high-speed passenger ships, offshore structures, underwater equipment, design engineering services, ship-related equipment and machinery, and steel structures. The Marine Development segment provides floating offshore oil and gas production, storage, and offloading facilities. The Machinery segment provides marine and land-use diesel engines, marine equipment, gas engines, steam turbines, blowers, compressors, gas turbines, among others. The Engineering segment provides power generation projects and general overseas civil engineering and construction work. The Company also engages in land-based diesel power plant business, information and communication equipment business, system development business, gas-related engineering, among others.

name: MITSUI SOKO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui Soko Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the warehouse business, port transportation business and global flow business. The Company operates in two business segments. Logistics segment provides logistics services. These services include warehouse storage & handling, port work & transportation, overseas logistics & multiple integrated transport, air freight transport, third-party logistics (3PL), supply chain management support, as well as land freight transport services, among others. Real Estate segment provides services centered on the building leasing business.

name: SUMITOMO MITSUI FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to financial services, centering on banking, leasing, securities, consumer finance, and system development and information processing. The Company consists of five business segments. The Wholesale Business segment provides services to large domestic corporations as well as small and medium-sized enterprises. The Retail business segment serves retail customers in Japan. The Global Business segment serves Japanese and non-Japanese clients overseas. The Market Business segment provides services for financial markets. The Headquarters Administration Business segment provides services that do not belong to any of the above business segments.

name: MS&AD INSURANCE GROUP HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the insurance business. The Company has six business segments. The domestic non-life insurance business includes three segments: Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance, Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance, Mitsui Direct General Insurance. The business is engaged in the sale of fire insurance, marine insurance, accident insurance, automobile insurance and other non-life insurance products in Japan. The domestic life insurance business includes two segments: Mitsui Sumitomo Aioi Life Insurance and Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life Insurance. The business is engaged in the sale of personal insurance, personal annuity insurance, group insurance and other life insurance products in Japan. The Overseas Business segment is engaged in the insurance business in the United States, Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Australia and other regions. The Company is also engaged in the financial services business and risk related business.

name: NIPPON COKE & ENGINEERING CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON COKE & ENGINEERING COMPANY, LIMITED is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of coke, general coal and powder and granular equipment, as well as the call center business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Coke segment manufactures and sells coke. The Fuel Sales segment is engaged in purchasing and sale of coal and petroleum coke, and call center business. The Comprehensive Engineering segment is engaged in manufacture, sale and maintenance of chemical equipment and other equipment, as well as collecting, transportation and processing of industrial waste. The others business includes cargo handling business, real estate sales and leasing business.

name: SUMITOMO MITSUI CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Mitsui Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the civil engineering and construction work. The Company operates in two business segments. Along with its subsidiaries, the Civil Engineering Work segment is engaged in the design and construction of civil engineering works in domestic markets and overseas markets, include construct prestressed concrete (PC) bridges and other construction projects ordered mainly by government agencies. The Building Work segment is engaged in the design and construction of building works in domestic markets and overseas markets, include high-rise residential buildings and other construction projects ordered mainly by private companies. The Company also operates solar power generation business and related businesses, as well as insurance agency business.

name: MITSUI MINING AND SMELTING CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui Kinzoku Co Ltd, formerly Mitsui Mining and Smelting Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in functional materials business, metal business, mobility business and others. The Company operates in four segments. The Functional Materials segment provides copper foils such as ultra-thin copper foils with carriers and electrolytic copper foils for plant wiring boards, functional powders such as metal powders for electronic materials and tantalum oxide, battery materials such as hydrogen storage alloys, sputtering targets such as indium tin oxide, and ceramic products. The Metals segment manufactures and sells zinc, lead, copper, gold, and silver, as well as engages in resource recycling. The Mobility segment manufactures and sells exhaust gas purification catalysts, automotive door locks, die-casting products, and powder metallurgy products. The Other segment manufactures and sells drawn copper products and pearlite products, as well as engages in industrial plant engineering.

name: MITSUI CHEMICALS INC
businessSummary: Mitsui Chemicals Inc is engaged in life and healthcare solutions, mobility solutions, information and communication technology (ICT) solutions, and basic and green materials business. The Company operates in four business segments. Life and Healthcare Solutions segment manufactures and sells vision materials, nonwoven fabrics, oral care materials, personal care materials and agricultural chemicals. The Mobility Solutions segment manufactures and sells elastomers, functional compounds and polypropylene compounds, and supports the development of new products for industrial products. The ICT Solutions segment manufactures and sells semiconductor and electronic component process materials, optical materials, lithium-ion battery materials, next-generation battery materials and others. The Basic and Green Materials segment manufactures and sells ethylene, propylene, polyethylene, polypropylene, catalysts, phenols, high-purity terephthalic acid, polyethylene terephthalate resin and others.

name: MODEC INC
businessSummary: Modec Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction of floating oil production facilities and the provision of various related services. Its primary business is the provision of engineering, procurement, construction, and installation (EPCI) services and charter services (leasing and operation services) for floating production, storage, and offloading facilities, such as floating production, storage, and offloading (FPSO), floating storage, and offloading (FSO), and tension-moored platforms (TLP), used in the midstream of offshore oil and gas production. Its primary clients are government-affiliated and private oil and gas development companies overseas. It also provides after-sales services, such as parts supply and engineering support, for FPSOs and other facilities it builds and delivers to oil and gas development companies, as well as management and operational support to affiliates and joint ventures.

name: MIDAC CO LTD
businessSummary: Midac Holdings Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the waste disposal business. The Company operates through three major business segments. The Waste Disposal segment is engaged in the provision of waste disposal services via its facilities. The Waste Collection and Transportation segment is mainly engaged in the collection and transportation of waste. The Brokerage Management segment provides operator introduction services to the processing company. The Waste Disposal segment consists of intermediate disposal of waste and final disposal of waste.

name: MITACHI CO LTD
businessSummary: MITACHI CO., LTD is a company mainly involved in the sale of semiconductors, liquid crystal products and electronic parts. The Domestic division is engaged in the purchase and sale of semiconductors, including universal integrated circuits (ICs), diodes, transistors, optical semiconductors and system large-scale integration (LSI); liquid crystal products, such as liquid crystal modules; electronic components, including resistors, condensers, switches and electronic printed boards; industrial equipment, such as chip mounters and printers, as well as other components, such as hard discs and electric motors. The Overseas division is engaged in the contracted manufacture and sale of electrical devices and electrical components, as well as the purchase and sale of electrical devices and electrical components. In addition, the Company is engaged in the contract processing of electronic products.

name: MIZUHO FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Mizuho Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking, trust banking, securities, and other financial services. The Company operates through five business segments: Retail & Business Corporations Company (RBC), Corporate & Investment Banking Company (CIBC), Global Corporate & Investment Banking Company (GCIBC), Global Markets Company (GMC), and Asset Management Company (AMC). The CIBC segment operates for clients of large corporate corporations, financial corporations and public corporations in Japan. The GCIBC segment operates for clients of overseas-affiliated Japanese companies and non-Japanese companies. The GMC segment is engaged in investment business in interest rates, equity, among others. The AMC segment is engaged in the development and provision of products that meet the asset management needs of clients from individuals to institutional investors.

name: MISUMI GROUP INC
businessSummary: MISUMI Group Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the factory automation (FA) business, the mold parts business, and the parts and consumables (MRO) business. The Company has three business segments. The FA segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of shafts, bushes, linear guides, locating parts, pulleys stages and other standard parts for automatic equipment, as well as the development and provision of automatic positioning modules and various research equipment. The Metal Molding Parts segment is engaged in the development and provision of spring guides, ejector pins, core pins, guides, retainers and other standard mold parts for automotive, electronic and electrical equipment fields, as well as the provision of precision mold parts. The Variation & One-stop by New Alliance (VONA) segment is engaged in the general distribution business, as well as the provision of air pressure parts, piping parts, screws, bolts and other manufacturing materials and MRO products.

name: MIXI INC
businessSummary: MIXI Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital entertainment business, sports business and lifestyle business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Digital Entertainment Business segment is engaged in the provision of games for smart devices, the implementation of related events, and the production and sale of goods. The Sports Business segment is engaged in the investment in sports team management and public sports related businesses. The Lifestyle Business segment is engaged in the management of services that are related to people's lives using the Internet. The main services include Kazoku Album Mitene, a photo and video sharing application for families, and minimo, a salon staff direct reservation application.

name: PARIS MIKI HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Paris Miki Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of eyeglasses and other products. The Company operates through two segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the retailing of eyeglasses, the manufacture and repair of eyeglass frames in Japan, as well as the general construction and interior finishing business, store design and construction, medical-related business support, investment business, and health-related business. The Overseas segment is engaged in the retailing of eyeglasses in various countries and regions overseas, and the operation of eye care facilities overseas.

name: MIURA CO LTD
businessSummary: MIURA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacturing of boilers. The Company has five business segments. The Domestic Equipment Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture, processing, coating, assembly and sale of miniature through-flow boilers, as well as the manufacture and sale of related equipment. The Domestic Maintenance segment is engaged in the maintenance business in domestic market. The Domestic Laundry segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial washing machines and dryer equipment in Domestic market. The Overseas Equipment Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of miniature through-flow boilers and related equipment. The Company is also engaged in the management, inspection, maintenance of properties, life insurance and life insurance agency business.

name: MANDOM CORP
businessSummary: MANDOM CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics. The Company operates through three geographic segments including Japan, Indonesia and Other Countries. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics, fragrance products and quasi-drugs. In addition, the Company exports cosmetics handled by subsidiaries. Main products of the Company are hair styling, hair coloring, hair care, skin care, body care, foot care, hand care, fragrance and other products. The Company is also engaged in insurance agency business and management business of the Company's headquarters building.

name: MANSEI CORP
businessSummary: MANSEI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of electrical equipment and industrial systems, electronic devices and information communication equipment, and related services. The Company operates through four business segments. Electrical Equipment and Industrial System segment provides rotating machines, industrial fans, switches, watt-hour meters, transformers, indicators, generator and substation systems, measurement control systems, and other industrial mechatronic systems and equipment. Electronic Device and Information Communication Equipment segment provides semiconductors, optical equipment, liquid crystal panels, personal computers, printers, video equipment, embedded microcomputer software, and electronic manufacturing services. Equipment segment provides air conditioners, refrigerators, chillers, electric water heaters, lighting equipment, elevators, and related construction, maintenance, installation services. Photovoltaic segment provides power.

name: MARUWA CO LTD
businessSummary: MARUWA Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of ceramic components, including electronic components, and lighting equipment. The Company operates through two segments. The Ceramic Components segment manufactures and sells electronic components, ceramic substrates, and products related to semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Lighting Equipment segment is involved in the production and sale of the lighting equipment that uses light emitting diode (LED) in addition to conventional lighting equipment. The Company is also involved in the business of supporting foundation activities.

name: MARUWA UNYU KIKAN CO LTD
businessSummary: AZ-Com Maruwa Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the logistics business that primarily includes third-party logistics (3PL) and transportation and delivery services. The Logistics Business segment is mainly engaged in center operation, general cargo transportation and warehousing business. Others provide services, including document storage rental business and real estate rental business. It conducts business activities in Japan.

name: MARUMAE CO LTD
businessSummary: Marumae Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precision cutting works. The Company is engaged in the manufacture of vacuum chambers and electrodes used in flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The products include semiconductor manufacturing equipment related parts, FPD manufacturing equipment related parts, and other equipment parts. The semiconductor manufacturing equipment parts are vacuum parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and inspection equipment. The FPD manufacturing equipment parts are vacuum devices for manufacturing equipment apparatus and inspection apparatus used in liquid crystal and organic electro luminescence (EL). The other parts consist surface processing equipment for smart phone housing, solar cell manufacturing equipment parts, motorcycle racing parts, industrial equipment parts for camera and microscope, as well as parts for medical equipment.

name: MARUBENI CORP
businessSummary: Marubeni Corp is engaged in the import, export and transaction of various products through domestic and overseas networks. The Company has sixteen segments.
