The Lifestyle segment includes apparel, footwear, daily necessities, sporting goods. The Information Solutions segment includes services utilizing digital technology in the ICT and logistics fields. The Food 1 segment includes dairy products, sugar, processed foods and beverages. The Food 2 segment includes feed grains, soybeans, wheat. The Agri segment includes agricultural materials sale business. The Forest Products segment includes papermaking raw materials and paperboard. The Chemicals segment includes petrochemicals and electronic materials. The segments also include the Metals, the New Energy Development Promotion Department, the Energy, the Electricity, the Infrastructure Projects, the Aviation and Ship, the Finance, Leasing and Real Estate, the Construction & Industrial Machinery, Next Generation Business Development.

name: MARUBUN CORP
businessSummary: MARUBUN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of semiconductors, electronic components, electronic equipment and other domestic and foreign electronics products. The Company operates through two business segments. The Device segment is engaged in the sale of semiconductors, including analog integrated circuits (ICs), standard logic ICs, memory ICs, microprocessors, special-purpose ICs, and custom ICs, as well as electronic components such as display panels, crystal units, connectors, printed circuit boards, and modules. The Systems segment is engaged in the sale of aerospace equipment, industrial equipment, laser equipment, information and communication equipment, and medical equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of maintenance and technical services for electronic equipment.

name: MARUFUJI SHEET PILING CO LTD
businessSummary: MARUFUJI SHEET PILING CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturer of construction materials. The Company is principally involved in the sale, leasing, process and transportation of steel sheet piles, H-section steel, earth retaining steel materials, lining boards, temporary system bridges, reinforced soil wall materials and processed iron frames for buildings, as well as the related construction works. The Company has three business divisions. The Sales division is engaged in the purchase and sale of materials. The Factory division specializes in the storage of leased materials, as well as the provision of repair, maintenance, manufacture and processing services. The Transportation division provides product transportation services.

name: MARUHA NICHIRO CORP
businessSummary: Maruha Nichiro Corporation is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the fishing, aquaculture, food manufacture, processing and sale business. The Company operates in five business segments. Fishery & Aquaculture segment is involved in fishery business, aquaculture business and the procurement of fishery resources. Trading segment is involved in the procurement and sale of marine products and livestock products. Overseas segment is involved in the sale of marine products and processed foods, as well as the producing and sale of surimi. Processing segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of frozen foods, canned foods, fish sausages, chikuwa, desserts, seasonings, freeze-dried products, and chemical products. Logistics segment stores and transports frozen products. The Company is also involved in the feed storage, shipping, real estate business, as well as the manufacture and sale of furs and pet foods.

name: MARUDAI FOOD CO LTD
businessSummary: Marudai Food Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the processed food business and meat business, as well as related services such as insurance agency services. The Company operates through two segments. The Processed Food segment manufactures and sells ham, sausages, and cooked processed foods. The Meat segment processes and sells meat products, including beef, pork and chicken. The Company is also engaged in insurance agency business.

name: MARUZEN SHOWA UNYU CO LTD
businessSummary: Maruzen Showa Unyu Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the lorry transportation business, port transportation business and on-site work. The Company operates through two business segments. The Logistics segment is involved in the lorry transportation business, freight transportation business (lorry, railroad, ocean shipping, coastal shipping, and air transportation), port transportation business (general port transportation, port cargo handling (onboard and coastal barge transportation), warehouse Business, customs clearance, packing, marine transportation and air transportation agency. The On-Site Work and Machinery Cargo Handling segment is engaged in the transportation, assembly, replenishing, storage and cargo handling of raw materials, products, heavy cargos and precision machinery in factories, as well as the leasing of machinery. The Company also provides services such as construction, security, real estate, insurance agency and car maintenance.

name: MARUZEN CO LTD
businessSummary: MARUZEN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial kitchen equipment. The Company operates through three business segments. The Commercial Kitchen Equipment Manufacturing and Sales segment manufactures, purchases and sells commercial kitchen equipment. The Bakery Equipment Manufacturing and Sales segment manufactures, sells and maintains bakery equipment such as bakery factories. The Building Leasing segment leases buildings such as business hotels and nursing care-type nursing homes.

name: MRK HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: MRK HOLDINGS INC., formerly MARUKO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based apparel company. The Company is principally engaged in the purchase and retail of women's underwear, such as shapewear and lingerie, as well as health food and body care cosmetics, among others. The Company is also engaged in the provision of customer services, such as body makeup, to customers through its directly-managed stores nationwide in Japan. The Company sells products through direct-sale stores and franchise stores.

name: MARUO CALCIUM CO LTD
businessSummary: Maruo Calcium Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of calcium carbonate and related business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various types of calcium carbonate used in synthetic resins, paints, reinforcing fillers for rubber, and chemicals and food additives. The main products are compounded calcium carbonate and heavy calcium carbonate. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of inorganic chemicals such as talc and silica.

name: MARUI GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Marui Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the retail and fintech business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Retailing segment is engaged in the purchase and sales of clothing, decorative items, household products, the leasing and operation of commercial facilities, the interior decoration of stores, advertising, the subcontracting of fashion product logistics, the maintenance and management of buildings. The Fintech segment specializes in credit card business, as well as the provision of consumer loans, rental guarantee, information system services, the leasing of real estate, investment trust sales, and small-amount short-term insurance business.

name: MULLION CO LTD
businessSummary: Mullion Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in providing real estate leasing related service business. The Company is engaged in real estate rental service business, real estate securitization service business and real estate sales business. The real estate rental service business is maintaining properties for residents, especially lease real estate in metropolitan areas and providing rental services. The real estate securitization service business is providing investor service with investment income that supplements public pensions through investment in real estate securitized products. The real estate sales business is engaged in the sales of properties as part of the exit strategy of the property owned by this company.

name: MAMEZO DIGITAL HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Mamezo Co Ltd, formerly Mamezo Digital Holdings Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company engaged in information services business. It operates in four service businesses. Cloud Consulting Services provides companies with consulting services for promoting in-house development using cutting-edge technologies, including cloud computing, enterprise resource planning (ERP) implementation and educational services. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Consulting Services provides companies promoting digital transformation with AI-based data utilization and system design, algorithm development and consulting, generative AI implementation support services. AI Robotics Engineering Services provides consulting and development services for AI software development, model-based development (MBSE) and process improvement to companies. Mobility Automation Services provides development support for AI software and hardware related to the automotive, aerospace, educational services and consulting for factory automation.

name: MABUCHI MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: MABUCHI MOTOR CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of small motors. Its automotive electrical equipment are used in car mirrors, door locks, dampers for air conditioning, power windows, power sheets, collimating equipment for headlights, lumbar supports and others. Its consumer goods and business machine are used in shavers, hair clippers, hair removal machines, toothbrushes, hair dryers, impact wrenches, circular saws, tools, inkjet printers, copiers, multifunction peripheral (MFP), laser printers and others.

name: MONEY FORWARD INC
businessSummary: Money Forward,Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the platform service business. The Company provides two services. The money forward cloud service is involved in the provision of a cloud enterprise resources planning (ERP) service platform. The platform provides management support for medium-sized and small enterprises to improve efficiency of management and back office operations based on data. The personal financial management (PFM) service is involved in the operation of Money Forward ME platform for solving problems and issues related to personal money through various services.

name: MANI INC
businessSummary: MANI Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of surgical related products, eyeless needle related products, and dental related products. It operates through three business segments. The Surgical Related Products segment provides surgical equipment, including skin sutures, ophthalmic knives, deep sutures, bone saws, vascular knives, ophthalmic trocars, and vitreous forceps. The Eyeless Needle Related Products segment provides surgical needle-attached sutures, eyeless suture needles (materials for surgical needle-attached sutures), and eyed suture needles (surgical suture needles). The Dental Related Products segment provides dental root canal treatment equipment, including reamers, files, nickel titanium (NiTi) files, cleansers, and broaches, dental rotary cutting equipment, including diamond burrs, carbide burrs, stainless steel burrs, and peeso reamers, and dental materials, including dental restorative materials.

name: MATERIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Material Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly operates three businesses: public relations (PR) consulting business, digital marketing business, and PR platform business. The PR Consulting Business segment provides support from strategy design to implementation of measures to deliver information on corporate brands, products, and services to consumers, consumers, and other stakeholders through the media and social networking service (SNS), and to increase awareness and transform perceptions, mainly through various PR methods and marketing communication measures, including advertising. The Digital Marketing Business segment provides support for the design and execution of marketing communication strategies in the digital domain, creative advertising production services, and sales of the Flipdesk web-based customer service tool. The PR Platform Business segment provides CLOUD PRESS ROOM, a platform for connecting with the media in real life and on the Web.

name: MATSUMOTO YUSHI-SEIYAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: MATSUMOTO YUSHI-SEIYAKU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based supplier of surfactants. The Company operates in two segments, including Japan and Indonesia. The surfactant business is primarily engaged in the production and sale of industrial surfactants for metals, can manufacturing and fiber uses. The others business is engaged in the production and sale of synthetic stabilizers and microspheres for fiber industry.

name: MATSUMOTOKIYOSHI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: MatsukiyoCocokara & Co, formerly Matsumotokiyoshi Holdings Co Ltd, is engaged in retail business, wholesale business and management support business. Retail business is engaged in operating chain stores of drugstores and insurance pharmacies, opening and operating insurance dispensing pharmacies, dispatching pharmacists and others. Wholesale business purchases and sells products handled by group companies and business partners that engage in retail business, develops franchise businesses, and supplies products to franchisees. The Management Support segment is involved in the management of group companies and contracting of indirect business, planning and development of private brand products, asset management and operation, the construction and maintenance of stores, as well as the operation of non-life and life insurance agency business.

name: MORESCO CORP
businessSummary: MORESCO Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals including special lubricating oil, synthetic lubricating oil, materials and hot melt adhesives. The Company operates in four geographical segments. Japan segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of the Company’s main products, as well as brake fluid and antifreeze for automobiles. China segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of special lubricants and hot melt adhesives through the Company’s subsidiaries in China. Southeast and South Asia segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of special lubricants and hot melt adhesives through the Company’s subsidiaries in Southeast and South Asia. North America segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of specialty and synthetic lubricants.

name: MATSUDA SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: MATSUDA SANGYO Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precious metals business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Precious Metal-related Business segment is engaged in the recovery and smelting of precious metals, the sale of precious metal ingots, chemical products and electronic materials, and the collection, transportation and processing of industrial waste. The Food-related Business segment is engaged in the sale of raw materials (fishery products, agricultural products, livestock products and others) for food processing and the provision of logistics services.

name: MAZDA MOTOR CORP
businessSummary: Mazda Motor Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and distribution of automobiles and automobile parts. The Company operates through four segments, including Japan, North America, Europe and Other Regions. The Company is engaged in the manufacture of passenger cars and the sale of passenger cars and trucks. The Company's main product lines include passenger cars, mini vehicles, special edition vehicles, commercial and special purpose vehicles, and welfare vehicles. The Company also handles used vehicles.

name: PANASONIC CORP
businessSummary: Panasonic Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture of electronic products. The Company operates in five segments. The Living segment develops, manufactures, and sells refrigerators, microwave ovens, rice cookers, washing machines, solar power generation systems, fuel cells, bicycles, and nursing care-related products. The Automotive segment develops, manufactures, and sells in-vehicle infotainment systems, head-up displays, in-vehicle switches, and automotive mirrors. The Connect segment develops, manufactures, and sells in-flight entertainment systems and communication services, electronic component mounting systems, welding machines, projectors, and professional-use camera systems. The Industry Segment develops, manufactures, and sells electronic components, motors, and electronic materials. The Energy segment develops, manufactures, and sells automotive cylindrical lithium-ion batteries, primary batteries, and small rechargeable batteries.

name: MATSUI SECURITIES CO LTD
businessSummary: MATSUI SECURITIES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based securities company engaged in financial product trading business. The Company conducts stock brokering and underwriting operations through Internet transactions. The Company mainly conducts stock brokering business for individual investors and provides online securities trading service Net Stock. The Company provides services such as consignment trading and underwriting of stocks, futures and options, offering and sale of market derivatives, as well as foreign exchange margin trading, among others.

name: MATSUI CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: MATSUI CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction work, real estate business and sales of building materials. The Company operates through two business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the construction and civil engineering businesses, including contracting for construction work, ordering part of construction work and receiving orders for construction work. The Real Estate segment is involved in the sale of the real estate land and buildings, the leases housing and rental offices business , the sale of building materials, as well as the private finance initiative (PFI) business.

name: MAKOTO CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Makoto Construction Co, Ltd. is mainly engaged in the detached house selling and real estate brokerage businesses. The Company operates in two business segments. The Detached House Selling segment is involved in the plan, design, construction and sale of built-for-sale houses and custom-built houses. The segment is also involved in the information collection about building sites, the planning of business interest scheme, the planning of land use, the planning and design of buildings, the purchase of land, the land development application business, the designing business, the purchase of materials, the outsourcing of construction works, the management of construction work, as well as maintenance and repair works. The Real Estate Brokerage segment is involved in the house selling brokerage business.

name: MAKUAKE INC
businessSummary: Makuake, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the crowdfunding business. The Company is engaged in the provision of Makuake service, Makuake Incubation Studio service and other services. The Makuake service is engaged in the operation of the crowdfunding platform Makuake, as well as the provision of matching services on the Internet for companies and individuals who want to realize and accelerate products or services using new ideas and technologies, and multiple individuals who support the projects. The Makuake Incubation Studio service is engaged in the provision of various incubation services in the products development area, such as new products planning, partners matching to realize planning, project strategy planning and marketing report creation. The other services is engaged in the provision of electronic commerce (EC) site management services, advertising distribution services, Makuake SHOP services and sales channel introduction services.

name: MAKINO MILLING MACHINE CO LTD
businessSummary: Makino Milling Machine Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing, sale and repair of machine tools. The Company operates through four business segments. The products include machining centers, numerically controlled (NC) electric discharge machines, NC milling machines, laser processing machines, computer-aided design (CAD)/computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) systems, as well as flexible manufacturing systems (FMS). The after-sales services include troubleshooting support, machine installation and test runs, explanations of operation methods and functions, as well as reinstallation and operation checks following factory equipment relocations and layout changes. The Company sells its products in Japan, the United States, other parts of North, Central and South America, China, other parts of Asia, Europe and other regions.

name: MAKITA CORP
businessSummary: Makita Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric tools, air tools, horticultural equipment, household equipment. The Company operates in four regional segments including Japan, Europe, North America and Asia. The Company provides lithium-ion series products, high-pressure air tool series products, dust collector series products, wireless interlocking series products and disaster preparedness series products.

name: MAEZAWA INDUSTRIES INC
businessSummary: Maezawa Industries, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of water sewage equipment and water treatment equipment, as well as the environmental business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Environmental segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of water treatment equipment for water sewage systems, industrial water treatment equipment, purification equipment for soil and groundwater pollution and organic waste recycling equipment. The Valve segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of valves, taps and gates for water sewage systems. The Maintenance segment is mainly engaged in the repair, installation and maintenance of equipment for water sewage, as well as the maintenance and operation of waste water treatment facilities for water purification factories.

name: MICROAD INC
businessSummary: MicroAd Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the data platform business. The Data Platform business segment is mainly comprised of three services: data solution services, overseas consulting services, and digital signage services. Its main products include UNIVERSE DATA PLATFORM, a data platform; UNIVERSE Ads, an advertising platform; MicroAd COMPASS, an advertising revenue maximization service for media companies; COMPASS-FIT, an advertising platform, and MONOLITHS, an advertising distribution service.

name: AEON HOKKAIDO CORP
businessSummary: Aeon Hokkaido Corporation is mainly engaged in the retail business. The Company operates a chain of general merchandise stores (GMSs) in Hokkaido. The Company provides clothing, residential and leisure products, food products and others. The Company operates GMS, small supermarkets and bicycle specialty stores in Hokkaido area.

name: MARVELOUS INC
businessSummary: Marvelous Inc., formerly Marvelous AQL Inc., is mainly engaged in the entertainment business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Online segment involves in the planning, development and operation of online games and game applications with a focus on social games for social networking service (SNS). The Consumer segment involves in the planning, development and sale of software for home-use game machines, and commercial equipment and products for amusement facility operation companies, as well as the contracted development of game software. The Music and Video segment involves in the production of music and video contents with a focus on animations, the commercialization of music, videos and characters, the operation of delivery business, as well as the operation of performance business via the production of stage performance works, with the popular works of cartoons, animations and games as originals.

name: MARS GROUP HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Mars Group Holdings Corporation, formerly Mars Engineering Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of entertainment machinery. The Company operates in three business segments. The Amusement-related segment is engaged in the development, manufacturing and sale of products for amusement facilities. The Automatic Identification system-related segment is engaged in the proposal and sale of automatic identification systems utilizing RFID (radio frequency identification device) and bar code. The Hotel-related segment is engaged in operating hotels.

name: MARKLINES CO LTD
businessSummary: MarkLines Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of online information services specializing in the automobile industry. The Company operates automotive industry portal which provides solutions through eight business segments includes information platform segment, consulting segment, recruitment segment, LMC Automotive Ltd. products (market forecast information) sales segment, promotional advertising segment, teardown investigation data sales segment, and vehicle parts procurement agency segment. The Company forms the supply chain of the automotive industry with related companies providing products and services include complete vehicle manufacturers, supporting parts manufacturers, materials manufacturers, equipment and machinery manufacturers, software vendors, trading companies, and transportation companies.

name: MERCURIA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Mercuria Holdings Co Ltd mainly manages the business of group companies and conducts incidental operations as a holding company. Through the wholly owned subsidiary, the Company operates fund operation business, which is involved in the management and operation of collective investment funds for both Japanese and overseas investors, and principal investment business, which is involved in the provision of principal investments towards the funds which are managed and operated by the Company. The Company operates Investment Management segment. The Company provides business investments and asset investments towards future growth investments, value investments, buyout investments, real estate investments and cash flow (CF) investments.

name: MERCURY REALTECH INNOVATOR INC
businessSummary: Mercury Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operating in the real estate marketing solutions business segment. Based on the business concept of real estate big data x technology, the Company operates two businesses, the platform business and the digital marketing business, as well as other services. The platform business develops and provides services tailored to the business models of both new and used condominiums based on the real estate big data it possesses. The digital marketing business supports customer acquisition in condominium sales through Web marketing. Other services include the contract development of a direct mail delivery service system that distributes advertisements by assuming household attributes based on the floor plan and sales price of the condominium from a real estate database.

name: POPPINS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Poppins Corp, formerly Poppins Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly operates home service business including nanny service and babysitter, nursery service and housekeeping service, educare business including management of childcare facilities, and other service businesses including education training and research business, recruitment and dispatch business, and day service for seniors. The Company operates through two business segments. The Home Care Service segment mainly provides childcare and elderly care services by visiting homes such as childcare service business, elderly care service business, and housework support service business. The Educare segment mainly operates kindergarten and elementary school facilities. The other service businesses provide services for domestic training, overseas training, and others.

name: POPER CO LTD
businessSummary: POPER Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of software as a service (SaaS) business management platform for educational providers, mainly for cram schools. The Company provides the SaaS business management platform Comiru, the online class and home study support service ComiruAir, and the labor management and communication service ComiruHR for instructors. The SaaS business management platform Comiru offers three plans, Comiru FREE, Comiru BASIC and Comiru PRO, to improve the efficiency of back office operations and strengthen communication with parents. The online class and home study support service ComiruAir supports online classes and home study for students. The labor management and communication service ComiruHR for instructors, efficiently adjusts shifts for instructors, aggregates salaries and labor, and communicates related to these.

name: POSTPRIME INC
businessSummary: PostPrime Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in financial and economic information platform business. It operates the social networking service PostPrime. PostPrime specializes in content centered on finance and economics. PostPrime is a platform that allows users to register as members free of charge, and once registered, they can choose from a variety of methods to transmit information, including text, images, audio, video and live streaming, and post for free, while also viewing and browsing the posts of other users. PostPrime offers prime registration, membership and other free and paid features. By meeting certain requirements and becoming a prime creator, users can set some of their posts as paid posts, enabling them to earn revenue by disseminating information. The Company also operates a YouTube channel.

name: POLETOWIN PITCREW HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Pole To Win Holdings Inc, formerly Poletowin Pitcrew Holdings, Inc., is a holding company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet-related debug and verification services. The Company operates through two segments. The Testing and Verification & Evaluation segment is engaged in the detection of software bugs through the provision of debug services for home-use software, social applications, mobile contents, contents for smart phones and tablet personal computers (PCs), PC software, as well as pachinko (Japanese pinball) and pachisuro instruments, verification services for information technology (IT) home electronics, as well as translation services for home-use games, mobile contents and PC software. The Internet Supporting segment is engaged in the detection of illegal and harmful information. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the publishing and media businesses.

name: PORT INC
businessSummary: PORT Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of Internet media business. The Company provides career-based media Career Park!, finance-based media Manet, medical-based media Online Clinic, Port Medical and Doctors’ Diet services. The main features of the Internet media business include membership model and cross sales of Internet solutions and products and services. Career-based Internet media Career Park! is a career information platform that helps career selection centering on job hunting and career change. Finance-based Internet media Magnet uses the media development know-how cultivated in Career park!, operates as a money-related life support type media. Medical-based Internet media Online Clinic provides knowledge of diseases supervised by medical specialist teams. Doctor's Diet provides online diet advice and exercise videos.

name: HONDA MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: Honda Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the motorcycle business, the automobile business, the financial service business and the life creation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Motorcycle segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), side-by-side vehicles and related parts. The Automobile segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of automobiles and related parts. The Financial Service segment is engaged in the sales financing and leasing of its products. The Power Products and Other Business segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of power products and related parts.

name: HORIBA LTD
businessSummary: Horiba Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of measuring instruments. The Company operates in five business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the provision of engine exhaust gas measuring devices, driveline test systems, engine test systems, brake test systems and other products. The Environmental and Process segment is engaged in the provision of flue gas analyzers, water quality measuring devices, air pollution monitoring analyzers and other products. The Medical segment is engaged in the provision of blood cell counting devices, immunoassay devices and other products. The Semiconductor segment is engaged in the provision of mass flow controllers, chemical solution concentration monitors and other products. The Scientific segment is engaged in the provision of water quality measuring device, particle size distribution measuring device and others.

name: HOKKAIDO ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Hokkaido Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in power generation and retail electricity businesses. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Hokkaido Electric Power Segment is engaged in corporate functions (group headquarters functions) and power generation and retail electricity business. The Hokkaido Electric Power Networks segment is engaged in electric power transmission and distribution. The Others segment includes electrical and telecommunications engineering, comprehensive real estate management, civil engineering and construction work, periodic inspection, maintenance, and repair work at power plants, and telecommunications business.

name: HOSIDEN CORP
businessSummary: Hosiden Corporation is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The Company has four business segments. The Mechanical Component segment provides connectors, jacks and switches. The Acoustic segment offers microphones, headphones, headsets, speakers and receivers. The Liquid Crystal Display Device segment provides passive liquid crystal display devices. The Composite Part and Others segment offers remote controllers and solenoids.

name: HOSHIZAKI CORP
businessSummary: Hoshizaki Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture, sale and maintenance services for food service equipment. The Company operates in three regional segments including Japan, the Americas, Europe and Asia. The Company is engaged in the research and development of food service equipment, as well as the provision of consistent research system from product planning to commercialization. The Company is also engaged in the development of new product and advanced technology, improvement and improvement of existing products, as well as the provision of series development activities and cost reduction activities. The Company provides a system to utilize information obtained from sales and maintenance service activities and market quality information for product development.

name: HOSHI IRYO-SANKI CO LTD
businessSummary: HOSHI IRYO-SANKI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical gas business and household medical business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Medical Gas-related segment is engaged in the sale of medical oxygen gas, anesthesia gas and other general medical gases. The Household Medical-related segment is engaged in the rental and sale of oxygen generator for home use, equipment for continuous positive pressure respiratory therapy, home respirators and others. The Medical Gas Equipment Work-related segment is engaged in the design and construction of medical gas piping works, and the maintenance and inspection of medical gas plumbing facilities. The Nursing Welfare-related segment is engaged in the rental and sale of nursing welfare-related products, housing renovation, the operation of home-visit nursing and home care support offices, and related businesses. The Facility Care-related segment is engaged in the operation of pay nursing home and others.

name: HOKURIKU ELECTRIC POWER CO
businessSummary: Hokuriku Electric Power Company is a Japan-based company engaged in supply of electricity mainly to Toyama Prefecture, Ishikawa Prefecture, Fukui Prefecture and part of Gifu Prefecture. The Company is mainly engaged in general electricity business, such as supply of electricity. The segment is also engaged in the maintenance of power equipment, power related facility operation and management business, equipment maintenance and construction work business, manufacture and sale of materials and equipment, management and service of real estate, commercial business as well as information and communication business. The materials and equipment business is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of power products and equipment, such as concrete products, electricity meters, switches and transformers. The real estate management business includes the energy solution business, rental and management business of real estate, as well as staffing business.

name: HOKURIKU ELECTRICAL CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: HOKURIKU ELECTRICAL CONSTRUCTION CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment construction business. The Company provides two kinds of services. The electric power facility construction work is engaged in the electrical construction related to power supply facilities such as power distribution facilities. The electrical and air-conditioning pipe work is engaged in the power equipment work, telecommunication work, pipe work, water supply work, fire-fighting work, and civil engineering work. The Company is also engaged in the rental of real estate.

name: NORTH PACIFIC BANK LTD
businessSummary: North Pacific Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking business and the leasing business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in deposit, lending, domestic exchange, foreign exchange, securities and credit card businesses. The Leasing segment is engaged in leasing business. The Company also involved in the credit guarantee business, banking agency business and securities business.

name: HOKUHOKU FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Hokuhoku Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of comprehensive financial services centered on the banking business. The Company operates in two business segments including Hokuriku Bank and Hokkaido Bank. The Company provides regional financial group with offices in the three major metropolitan areas of Hokkaido, Hokuriku, and Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka. The Company primarily offers comprehensive financial service functions that respond to a wide range of needs such as securities business, leasing, credit card, venture capital, software development, servicer business. The Hokuriku Bank segment and Hokkaido Bank segment offer banking business. The Company also provides securities business, leasing business and credit card business.

name: HOKUETSU METAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Hokuetsu Metal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, processing and sale of steel products. The Company mainly provides steel bars, wire rods, shaped steels, ultra-high yield (UHY) hoops, fab decks, meshes, lock bolts, turn buckles, UN bolts, deformed bolts, UND self-drilling bolts, spring chains, among others.

name: HOKUETSU CORP
businessSummary: Hokuetsu Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the pulp and paper business and packaging and paper processing business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Paper and Pulp Business segment manufactures and sells paper and pulp products. The Packaging and Paper Processing Business segment is engaged in manufacture and sale of paper containers and liquid containers, and the manufacture, processing, and sale of paper products. The Company is also engaged in the timber business, construction business, machine manufacturing, sales, and maintenance business, transportation and warehousing business, and used paper wholesale business.

name: HOGY MEDICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: HOGY MEDICAL CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company, principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical-related products. The Company primarily provides medical consumable products, medical equipment and medical nonwoven products, among others. The Company also provides medical consumable products, medical equipment, medical nonwoven fabric products to Indonesia through its sub-subsidiaries.

name: HOWA MACHINERY LTD
businessSummary: Howa Machinery,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools, pneumatic hydraulic equipment and electronic machines, firearms, building materials and specially equipped vehicles. The Company operates through six business segments. The Machine Tool-related segment is engaged in the production of machining centers, various special-purpose machines, and pneumatic hydraulic equipment. The Firearms segment is engaged in the production of rifles, mortars and hunting rifles. The Domestic Sales Subsidiary segment is engaged in the sale of steel and other products. The Building Materials segment is engaged in the production of aluminum sash doors, steel sash doors, and waterproof boards. The Specially Equipped Vehicle segment is engaged in the production of road cleaning vehicles, industrial cleaning machines, automatic floor cleaning machines. The Real Estate Rental segment is engaged in the leasing of land and buildings.

name: HOYA CORP
businessSummary: Hoya Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of healthcare-related products, medical-related products, electronics-related products, and imaging-related products, as well as related businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Life Care segment manufactures and sells healthcare-related products used in daily life in the health and medical fields, and medical-related products such as medical devices and medical supplies used in medical procedures. The Information and Communication segment manufactures and sells components essential for digital equipment, including electronics-related products that are indispensable for modern digital information and communication technology and imaging-related products that are necessary for capturing images and video as digital information based on optical technology. The Others segment is mainly engaged in the speech synthesis software business and the information system services business.

name: PEPTIDREAM INC
businessSummary: PeptiDream Inc. is a Japan-based bio-venture company started by the University of Tokyo and principally engaged in the discovery and development of non-standard peptide therapeutics. The Company operates the Peptide Discovery Platform System (PDPS), a drug development platform system and conducts research and development (R&D) on new drug candidates based on the joint R&D with pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas. The Company is involved in the business centered on drug development based on special peptides. The Company's businesses include drug discovery joint R&D, PDPS technology loan (PDPS technology license) and expansion of its own pipeline through strategic alliance (strategic alliance or in-house drug discovery).

name: BP CASTROL KK
businessSummary: BP Castrol KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of Castrol and bp brand automotive lubricants. The Company is engaged in product development, raw material procurement, marketing and sales activities. Its main products include gasoline engine oil, diesel engine oil, automotive gear oil, automatic transmission fluid (ATF) including continuously variable transmission (CVT) fluid, brake fluid and car care products. The automotive lubricants market is divided into the passenger car market, motorcycle market, and commercial vehicle market, and products are supplied through direct sales or agency sales. The consumer business in the passenger car market is centered on sales to car shops, home improvement centers, and tire shops, while the business-to-business (BtoB) business is centered on sales to domestic car dealers, imported car dealers, and auto repair shops.

name: PEPPER FOOD SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: Pepper Food Service Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Company operates through four business segments. The Ikinari! Steak Business segment is engaged in the operation of charcoal-grilled steak restaurant Ikinari! Steak, operated directly by the group, a franchise, or a consignment business. The Pepper Lunch Business segment has three businesses: franchise business, direct management business and consignment business. It operates stores such as Pepper Lunch, Pepper Lunch Diner, 92's and food court type Charcoal-grilled Hamburg Steak Kuni, Tokyo 634 Burg, Musashi Hamburg. The Restaurant Business segment operates custom-cut steak restaurants, tonkatsu stores, beef tongue restaurants and others as a direct management, franchise and consignment business of the group. The Product Sales Business segment sells ingredients such as tonkatsu sauce, frozen pepper rice, dressing, and lux ham, as well as chopsticks.

name: GMO PEPABO INC
businessSummary: GMO Pepabo, Inc. is principally engaged in the provision of low-priced Internet services to individuals. The Company operates in three business segments. The Hosting segment provides rental servers and domain acquisition services related to domain acquisition and utilization. The Electronic Commerce (EC) Support segment provides online shop opening and creation services that support the operation of e-commerce. The Hand-made segment is involved in the provision of handmade market services. The Company is also engaged in Internet advertising and media business.

name: BELL-PARK CO LTD
businessSummary: Bell-Park Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the information and communication devices sale and service business centering on the operation of carrier shops. Among them, SoftBank Shops, au Shops, Y!mobile Shops and UQ Spots operate as the primary sales agent for mobile communication services, Docomo shop operates as a secondary agency. In the carrier shops, the Company arranges new contract of information communication service, sell products such as information communication equipment, conducts installment contract, maintenance business, fee planning and communication fee relates business. The co-sales stores operated by the secondary agency are limited to the sale of new contracts of information communication services and products such as information communication devices.

name: VELTRA CORP
businessSummary: VELTRA Corporation is engaged in the operation of domestic and overseas experienced optional tour online reservation site VELTRA. The Company operates travel related business that manages the travel online service of the local experience tours. The Company mainly operates three departments. The overseas travel department provides services mainly for Japanese overseas trips. The inbound department provides services for visitors to Japan. The global department provides services all over the world for global travelers. VELTRA operated by the Company operates websites that correspond to four languages, including Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) and Korean, and the sites of the local experience tour corresponds to all over the world. The Company contracts directly with domestic and overseas operating companies and offers services in various lineups including sightseeing tours, cultural experiences, gourmet tours, shows, museums, cruises, restaurants and others.

name: VERTEX CORP
businessSummary: Vertex Corporation is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of subsidiaries which manufacture secondary concrete products and other related business. The Company’s subsidiary HOKUKON CO., LTD operates through four business segments: block business, pile business, construction business and other business. The Company’s subsidiary HANEDA ZENITH HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd operates business through four business segments: concrete products, ceramic business, construction business, as well as other business.

name: BELLSYSTEM24 HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Bellsystem24 Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the customer relationship management (CRM) business mainly including contact center operations. The Company has two business segments. The CRM segment is engaged in the traditional inbound and outbound call business, as well as the provision of customer support services, sales support services, technical support services and business process outsourcing (BPO) services for client companies through telephone, Web and social medias. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of content for general consumers on a monthly basis, and weather forecast content for businesses through mobile personal computers (PCs), as well as the general affairs and administrative business.

name: BASE INC
businessSummary: BASE, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of e-commerce platform, online payment services and financing services. The Company operates through two business segments. The BASE segment is engaged in the provision of e-commerce platform that provides online shop creation services and shopping mall apps that allow customers to purchase products from the shops established there. The PAY segment is engaged in the development of PAY.JP, which allows easy introduction of online payments to Web services and existing online shops, as well as PAY ID, which provides unique ID payment services.

name: BAYCURRENT CONSULTING INC
businessSummary: BayCurrent Inc, formerly BayCurrent Consulting Inc, is a Japan-based comprehensive consulting firm that provides support for a wide range of themes including strategy, digital, and operations. The Consulting business segment offers planning and execution support to resolve significant management issues faced by client companies, such as formulating company-wide and business strategies to support top management decision-making, and supporting the consideration of business operations using digital technology. The Company understands the unique corporate culture and values of its clients, and provides proposals that it considers feasible and optimal.

name: BASE CO LTD
businessSummary: BASE CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of software. The Company is engaged in the provision of system development services, enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions and other solutions. The system development services are engaged in the provision of total system development services including requirements definition, basic design, detailed design, program design, programming, various tests, migration, release, operation and maintenance services for the financial, distribution and manufacturing fields. The ERP solution services are engaged in the provision of services in the ERP, customer relationship management (CRM), company-specific middleware component software and other areas. The other solution services are engaged in the provision of Nippon Individual Savings Account (NISA) opening services, card number recognition services using optical character recognition (OCR) function, as well as business process outsourcing ( BPO) services.

name: HENNGE KK
businessSummary: Hennge KK is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of services to customers mainly in the form of software as a service (SaaS). The HENNGE One business develops HENNGE One, which reduces security risks without compromising the convenience of cloud services for companies that introduce cloud services to improve business efficiency. The Professional Services and Others business develops email delivery package software that delivers large volumes of email securely at high speed. The Customers Mail Cloud is a cloud-based email delivery service that delivers large volumes of email at high speed to mobile phones, personal computers (PCs), and smartphones.

name: HEALIOS KK
businessSummary: Healios KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business in the somatic stem cell regenerative medicine field and in the iPSC regenerative medicine field, which involves research, development and manufacture of regenerative medicine products (iPSC regenerative medicines) utilizing technologies related to induced pluripotent stem cells (iPS cells, iPSCs). The somatic stem cell regenerative medicine field develops and markets cell therapy drugs for acute stroke and acute respiratory distress syndrome using MultiStem, a somatic stem cell product for which the Company holds patent and patent licensing rights. The iPSC regenerative medicines include the creation of universal donor cells (UD), next-generation iPSCs that reduce the risk of immune rejection regardless of human leukocyte antigen (HLA) type using gene editing technology.

name: HEIWA REAL ESTATE CO LTD
businessSummary: HEIWA REAL ESTATE CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in leasing business and real estate solution business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Leasing segment specializes in the development, leasing, management and operation of stock exchanges, offices, commercial facilities and housing. The Real Estate Solution segment is engaged in the development, sales, operation and management of real estates for revenue, development and sales of residential houses as well as real estate agency business. The Others businesses include the maintenance and repair of building equipment, contract work for repair, insurance agency business, etc.

name: HEIWADO CO LTD
businessSummary: HEIWADO CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the retail sales and peripheral businesses. It has three segments. The Retail segment is engaged in sales of food products, clothing products, and daily goods. The Retail Peripheral segment involves rental of stores, management of commercial infrastructure and maintenance of buildings. The Others segment is engaged in management of suburban restaurants, family restaurants, amusements, bowling alleys, as well as development, sales and maintenance of real estate.

name: HEIWA PAPER CO LTD
businessSummary: HEIWA PAPER CO.,LTD. is engaged in the Japanese paper and Western paper wholesale business. The Japanese and Western paper wholesale business sells Japanese and Western paper. The warehousing and paper processing business is involved in the delivery, storage and packing of its products, as well as the paper processing business.

name: HEIAN CEREMONY SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: HEIAN CEREMONY SERVICE CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly provides wedding and funeral services. The Company operates in four business segments. The Wedding Ceremony segment provides wedding ceremonies, as well as services such as weddings and coming-of-age ceremonies rental costumes, photography and dressing. The Funeral segment provides funeral related services and ancillary services such as the sale of Buddhist altars and utensils at homes, temples and congregations. The segment also provides franchise agreements and partnership agreements with funeral companies. The Mutual Relief Society segment is engaged in ceremonial funeral festival mutual aid society business, as well as the recruitment of members and the management of members' information, the provision of wedding and funeral agency services for its members. The Nursing Care segment provides home care services, facility services and rental housing business for the elderly. The Company also provides logistics business.

name: PROPERTY DATA BANK INC
businessSummary: Property Data Bank, Inc. is engaged in development of software for real estate and facility management, as well as provision of integrated asset management cloud service under the name @property. The cloud service mainly engages in provision and maintenance of @property, and support of users. It receives monthly usage fee and maintenance service fee by customer-based billing according to the number of registered building data on a monthly basis from customers. The solution service engages in business efficiency improvement for customers, who already introducing @ property or planning to introduce it. It also engages in provision of solution services according to customer specific needs.

name: PRO-SHIP INC
businessSummary: Pro-Ship Incorporated is primarily engaged in the development and marketing of package systems, the entrusted development, and the operation management business of systems. The Company operates in two business segments. The Package Solution segment is involved in the operation of package solution business, ranging from the consultation to the implementation and maintenance of fixed assets systems and sales management systems. The Others segment is involved in entrusted development and operation management business.

name: PRESS KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: PRESS KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture of automotive parts and construction machinery. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automobile-related segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts, automotive assembly and automobile molds. The Construction Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction machinery parts. The Company is also engaged in manufacture and sale of building-related parts and multi-story parking equipment. The main products include chassis frame, completed vehicle assembly, side cover, transmission cover, under cover, front bumper, front pillar inner, mold & automation equipment axle, motorcycle garage, cabin for construction machinery, and among others.

name: PLAID INC
businessSummary: Plaid Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of customer experience (CX) platform KARTE to businesses operating websites and smartphone applications in a cloud format. The Company is engaged in the development of the CX platform KARTE. By incorporating KARTE into websites and smartphone applications operated by businesses, businesses collect and analyze data on the behavior of users who visit those websites and smartphone applications, organize and visualize data on a user-by-user basis, and personalize communication via websites, smartphone applications, emails and chats to each user or user segments. The Company is also engaged in the operation of a media called XD to provide information on the Internet.

name: PRINTNET INC
businessSummary: PRINTNET INC. mainly engages in the mail order business of printing materials and printing materials through the Internet. In its main business, the Company receives orders from customers on websites that include printing specifications and fees, receives printing data, conducts printing and processing businesses in domestic factories, as well as sends to customers. The Company provides pamphlets, free papers, leaflets, newspaper folding leaflets, company name envelopes, election posters, calendars and others on the company website.

name: PRIMA MEAT PACKERS LTD
businessSummary: Prima Meat Packers, Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the production and sale of meat products and processed products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Processed Food Business Division segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed foods, the supply of side dishes, the sale of hams and sausages and other related products, as well as the provision of cleaning services. The Meat Business Division segment is engaged in beef production and related business, as well as the processing and logistics of meat. The Company is also engaged in information processing business, human resources, insurance and real estate services business, the development, manufacture and sale of physics and chemistry equipment, as well as consulting services such as inspection and hygiene management.

name: PRISM BIOLAB CO LTD
businessSummary: PRISM BioLab Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the drug discovery business. The Company operates through Japan drug discovery business segment. The Company builds a new drug discovery platform and develops new drugs. The Company conducts research and development of pharmaceuticals using their owned drug discovery platform technology PepMetics technology. There are two business models. The in-house development business is engaged in the select of drug discovery targets and creates programs in-house. The joint development business creates programs using their owned technology to target drug discovery targets for pharmaceutical companies.

name: PLUS ALPHA CONSULTING CO LTD
businessSummary: Plus Alpha Consulting Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the visualization engine business, the customer rings business and the talent palette business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Visualization Engine segment is engaged in the development and operation of Visualization Engine, a customer experience feedback system. The Customer Rings segment is engaged in the development and operation of CustomerRings, an integrated marketing platform. The Talent Palette segment is engaged in the development and operation of Talent Palette, a talent management system.

name: BUNKA SHUTTER CO LTD
businessSummary: Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of shutters, and housing and building materials. The Company operates in four business segments. The Shutter-related Products segment offers lightweight shutters, heavy shutters, over-sliding doors, panel shutters and window shutters. The Construction Material-related Products segment offers exterior products, cross-cut weatherboardings, doors, partitions and other related products. The Service segment is engaged in maintenance and repair of existing shutters and building materials. The Reform segment is engaged in the renovation of housing.

name: BROAD ENTERPRISE CO LTD
businessSummary: Broad Enterprise Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet services mainly to apartment complexes built and managed by condominium owners, property management companies, and house builders. The Company provides a comprehensive range of Internet services under the brand name B-CUBIC, from installation of Internet systems for laying optical fiber lines in apartment complexes to maintenance and servicing of the Internet connection environment after the Internet system has been installed. Condominium owners, property management companies, and house builders have a need to increase the added value of their properties as a means of improving occupancy rates, and in order to meet this need, the Internet of Things (IoT) product BRO-CUBIC will be offered along with the IoT intercom system BRO-LOCK with face recognition.

name: BROADLEAF CO LTD
businessSummary: Broadleaf Co., Ltd. is engaged in provision of industry-specific business applications through the network, maintenance services and supplies, and various network services on the industrial platform, mainly to the automobile aftermarket industry and other markets. The system sales business develops and sells industry-specific business applications, work analysis and optimization softwares, as well as purchases and sells personal computer (PC) bodies and printers. The system support business provides maintenance services, as well as purchases and sells documents and office automation (OA) supplies. The network service business provides database service, server service, settlement agency service of automobile recycling parts, electronic parts ordering function of automobile parts, support tool of tablet type business, as well as analysis service of ecommerce and data.

name: BROADBAND SECURITY INC
businessSummary: BroadBand Security, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in security service business. The Company’s services include security audit consulting service, vulnerability diagnosis service and information leakage IT countermeasure service. Information Disclosure In the security equipment management service in IT countermeasure services, it sells security equipment to customers and purchase them from manufacturers. In addition, it receives license from overseas security software company in secure mail service and malware detection service. Vulnerability assessment service sometimes outsources a part of vulnerability diagnosis for smart phones.

name: BRAINPAD INC
businessSummary: BrainPad Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of data analysis services for companies. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Analytics segment is engaged in the provision of data analysis services and optimization operations for companies aiming to support clients’ activities. The Solutions segment is engaged in the selection and provision of software products necessary for policy execution based on data accumulation, analysis and analysis results, and system development and operation. The Marketing Platform segment develops its own proprietary software from the data analysis algorithm mainly in the digital marketing field and provides products centered on Software as a Service (SaaS) type services, and maintenance service.

name: BLUE ZONES HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Blue Zones Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that manages and operates subsidiaries that operate food supermarkets and trading businesses, as well as related businesses. The Company primarily operates supermarkets that mainly sell food. The Company is also engaged in a range of store-related businesses, wholesale and import of food and beverages assistance with food manufacturing, processing, packaging and other related businesses.

name: BRIDGE INTERNATIONAL CORP
businessSummary: Bridge International Group Corp, formerly Bridge International Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of various solution services that solve corporate sales challenges, with a focus on inside sales. The Company operates through three business segments. The Inside Sales Outsourcing Business segment conducts sales activities to prospective customers without meeting them face-to-face, using telephone, email, online conferencing tools, and also provides inside sales outsourcing services. The Process Technology Business segment provides consulting services, system solutions, operation support, and network solutions for corporate marketing and sales activities. The Training Business segment provides digital talent development training for companies.

name: BRIDGESTONE CORP
businessSummary: Bridgestone Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the tire business. The Company operates its business through five business segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the premium tire business, the solutions business, and the chemicals and diversified products business. The China, Asia, and Oceania segment is engaged in the premium tire business and the solutions business. The Americas segment is engaged in the premium tire business, solutions business, and diversified products business. The Europe, Russia, Middle East, India and Africa segment is engaged in premium tire business and solution business. The Others segment is engaged in other businesses.

name: BRANGISTA INC
businessSummary: Brangista.Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital magazine business. The Company provides two kinds of services. The digital magazine service is engaged in the provision of digital magazine advertisements business and the production of digital magazines. Its electronic magazines mainly include Tabiiro, GOODA, and SUPER CEO. Solutions and other services are engaged in the provision of various supporting sales promotion services. Electronic commerce (EC) support provides one-stop support for planning, production, development, operation for EC sites. Customer relationship management (CRM) services are engaged in the provision of planning and operation for sale activities.

name: BROTHER INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Brother Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of office equipment and supplies. The Company operates in six business segments. The Printing and Solutions segment manufactures and sells communication and printing equipment like printers, multifunction devices and electronic stationery, among others. The Personal and Home segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of household sewing machines. The Machinery segment manufactures and sells industrial sewing machines, garment printer, machine tools, reducers and gears, among others. The Network and Contents segment is involved in the manufacture, sale and service of commercial karaoke equipment, as well as the provision of contents delivery services. The Domino segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial printing equipment. The Others segment is involved in the real estate business.

name: BOOKOFF GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: BOOKOFF GROUP HOLDINGS LIMITED is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of subsidiaries which operate reuse store and book off online business, as well as other related business. The Company operates three kinds of business. The reuse store business is involved in the operation of head office and other chain and the reuse shop BOOKOFF which provides books and software. The BOOKOFF online business is involved in the operation of reuse shop BOOKOFF Online on the Internet. The Hugall business operates a reuse business that is not limited to store type business and purchases and sells products. The Company also involved in the operation of shops of the newly published bookstore Aoyama Book Center, Ryusui Shobo and yc-vox, the planning, designing and construction of its own stores’ interior and exterior works, processing of products to be sold at stores, as well as the operation of Internet review Website Booklog.

name: BUSHIROAD INC
businessSummary: Bushiroad Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the development and acquirement of intellectual property (IP). The Company operates in two business segments. The Entertainment business segment is composed of five departments including trading card game department, mobile online games department, music department that engages in plan, production and management of music content and live performances and events, merchandising (MD) department that plans and releases goods related to IP, as well as media department that engages in book publishing and Internet radio operating. The Sports business segment is composed of the box office department, MD department that plans and sells goods, as well as the content department that product and distributes video content.

name: V TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
businessSummary: V Technology Co., Ltd. is a manufacturing company. The Company is mainly engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of inspection systems, repair systems and measuring systems used for the manufacture of flat panel display (FPD), such as liquid crystal display (LCD) and plasma display panel (PDP). Through its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in the provision of product sales support service and maintenance service, as well as the sale of consumable parts. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had three subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: FRONTIER MANAGEMENT INC
businessSummary: Frontier Management Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of various management support services and financial support services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Consulting and Advisory Business segment is divided into management consulting business, mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisory business, turnaround support business and other businesses. Management consulting business provides services such as formulating management strategies and others. M&A advisory business provides advice and assistance on all aspects of M&A and organizational restructuring. Turnaround support business provides support to companies that require turnaround support. Other business provides research in connection with the turnaround support and M&A advisory. The Investment Business segment operates investment business involving the dispatch of management personnel with the aim of improving the long-term and sustainable corporate value of investees.

name: FRONTIER INTERNATIONAL INC
businessSummary: FRONTIER INTERNATIONAL INC., together with its subsidiaries, is principally engaged in the comprehensive promotion business, such as event & public relations (PR), as well as over-the-counter sales business. The event promotion business is involved in the planning, operation and production of field events. The campaign promotion business is involved in the management of the campaign secretariat and the premium & novelty planning production. The PR business is involved in the provision of PR, planning of public relations activities, as well as strategy formulation and advices. Space produce business is involved in the space development with event art and display, among others. Digital promotion business is involved in the planning and operation of digital campaign and the production of contents. The over-the-counter sales support business is involved in the provision of over-the-counter sales support and other services.

name: FURUYA METAL CO LTD
businessSummary: FURUYA METAL CO.,LTD is a Japan-based company engaged in manufacturing and sales of industrial precious metal products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Electronic segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of electronic components used in electronic products. The Thin Film segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of precious metal targets used for thin film. The Sensor Segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of temperature sensor used for semiconductor equipment. The Other business segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of precious metal compound, as well as collection and purification of precious metal.

name: FULLCAST HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Fullcast Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the human resource outsourcing business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Short-term Business Support segment is engaged in the provision of short-term, events-related human resource services and payroll management service, among others. The Sales Support segment includes agency sales and call center business. The Security and Others segment is engaged in the security guard business for public facilities and general corporations.

name: FURUKAWA ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Furukawa Electric Co Ltd is a Japa-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products that develop and apply technologies developed in the infrastructure, electrical & electronics, and functional products businesses. The Company operates four business segments. The Infrastructure segment provides optical fiber, optical fiber cables, metal communication cables, optical related components, and optical semiconductor devices. The Electrical and Electronics segment provides automotive components, batteries, windings, copper and copper alloys, plated products, processed products for electronic components, and specialty metal materials. The Functional Products segment provides cable conduit materials, foam products, tapes for semiconductor manufacturing, electronic components and heat-dissipating products. The Services, Development segment mainly provides hydroelectric power generation, new product research and development, and real estate leasing.

name: UACJ CORP
businessSummary: UACJ Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of non-ferrous metals including aluminum. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of rolled products, casting products, forging products and processed products made from metal alloys. The Company operates the Aluminum Products segment. The plate-related products include rolled plate products and foil products made from aluminum and its alloys. The extrusion and processing-related products include extrusion products and processed products made from aluminum. The Company also undertakes civil engineering works related to extrusion and processed products. The casting and forging-related products include cast products and forging products made from aluminum. The automotive-related products include automotive parts made from aluminum. The Company also engages in freight transportation and handling, as well as the wholesale of products.

name: FURUKAWA CO LTD
businessSummary: Furukawa Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the industrial machinery business, rock drill business and other businesses. The Company operates in seven segments. The Industrial Machinery segment manufactures, sells, and provides services for pumps, steel structures, bridges, crushers, pulverizers and others. The Rock Drill segment provides rock drills, including hydraulic breakers, crushers, blasthole drills, tunneling and mining machinery and others. The UNIC segment provides UNIC cranes, mini crawler cranes and others. The Metal segment provides copper, gold, silver, sulfuric acid, limestone and others. The Electronic segment provides high-purity metallic arsenic, crystal products, aluminum nitride ceramics and others. The Chemical segment manufactures and sells crystal products, polyferric sulfate solution, and others. The Real Estate segment rents, buys, sells, and brokers real estate. The Company is also engaged in metal powder, casting and transportation businesses.

name: UNIPOS INC
businessSummary: Unipos Inc, formerly Fringe81 Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and consultation of Internet advertising technology, as well as the provision of Website services mainly in human resources (HR) tech fields. The advertising business includes advertising agency service, media growth service and solution service. The advertising agency service is involved in the sale of Internet advertisements. The media growth service is involved in the provision of planning, development and operation of advertising goods for smartphone media including applications. The solution service is involved in the provision of advertising strategy’s decision-making support products for advertisers who receive Internet advertising. The Unipos business is involved in the provision of a service named Unipos for mutual evaluation and praise.

name: FREEBIT CO LTD
businessSummary: FreeBit Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet-related services for corporations and individuals.
