The Broadband segment mainly provides necessary services for Internet Service Provider (ISP) operation. The Mobile segment provides enterprise support services to enterprises for virtual mobile communications carriers (MVNO) business. The Advertisement Technology segment provides Internet marketing related services for corporations and next generation advertising platforms specialized for telephone. Cloud segment provides cloud services for corporations and cloud services for individuals. The Health Tech segment provides solution services for dispensing pharmacies and applications for smartphones for individuals. Others segment provides other services.

name: FREEE KK
businessSummary: freee KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and provision of software as a service (SaaS) services to improve the back-office productivity of small businesses. Freee accounting is an integrated cloud accounting software for sole proprietors and corporations. Freee human resource management is an integrated cloud human resource management software for corporate clients. Freee sales is integrated cloud sales management software for sole proprietors and corporations. Freee tax return is a cloud-based tax filing software that seamlessly integrates with freee accounting and is offered to accounting firms and small corporations. Freee sign is an electronic contract service offered to sole proprietors and corporations. In addition, the Company offers freee card and freee card Unlimited as financial services designed to improve the cash flow of small businesses.

name: FUYO GENERAL LEASE CO LTD
businessSummary: Fuyo General Lease Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of the leasing of machinery, equipment, and fixtures, real estate leasing, installment sales, and financial transactions such as loans. It has three segments. The Leasing and Installment Sales segment is engaged in the leasing of information-related equipment, office equipment, industrial machine tools, and other items (including property sales upon the expiration or cancellation of lease transactions), real estate leasing, and installment sales of commercial facilities, production facilities, and hospital facilities. The Finance segment is engaged in the lending of money, the management of securities held and the formation of anonymous partnerships to generate financial revenue for business purposes. The Other segment is engaged in environmental energy-related services, commissions, business process outsourcing (BPO), and mobility business services.

name: FUETREK CO LTD
businessSummary: FueTrek Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the licensing of software. The License segment is engaged in converting what has been developed and designed into intellectual property rights. The Video and Media segment is a video production business and an advertising agency business that perform planning, production of video such as television programs. The Others segment is the basic business field that performs entrusted development and automotive software development, the transcription business field that provides services that transcribe voice data provided by customers in characters, and the international business field that performs inbound and outbound business.

name: FUMAKILLA LIMITED
businessSummary: FUMAKILLA LIMITED is a Japan-based chemical manufacturing company. The Company operates in four business divisions. The Pesticide division manufactures and sells battery-operated mosquito destroyers and insect deterrents, mat-type and liquid mosquito destroyers, fly and mosquito insecticides, fumigants, as well as cockroach repellents in Japan, South Asia and other regions. The Gardening Equipment division manufactures and sells insecticides and disinfectants for gardening use, fertilizers, immunizer, herbicides and culture soil in Japan. The Disease Prevention Agents division manufactures and sells emulsions, oil solutions, powder and rat poisons in Japan. The Household Products division manufactures and sells dehumidifying agents, clothing repellents, pollen allergy products and sanitizers in Japan.

name: FUNAI ZAISAN CONSULTANTS CO
businessSummary: Aoyama Zaisan Networks Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in property consulting services for asset owners and corporations. The Company earns remuneration through providing consulting services for assets succession, operation, and management. There are four types of revenue. Property consulting revenues are from property and financial consulting services that provide support from consultation to execution of property succession, operation and management. Real estate transaction revenues are from sales of individual real estate properties and sales of the Real Estate Co-ownership System which meet customer asset management needs. Sublease income is earned by renting and operating rental properties owned by asset owners. Other revenues are from network dues, seminars, and property consulting related books publication.

name: H.U. GROUP HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: H.U. Group Holdings Inc, formerly Miraca Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company engaged in manufacture and sale of clinical test drugs, entrusted clinical examination and sterilization related business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Outsourced Clinical Testing segment accepts special tests from medical institutions. The Clinical Laboratory Medicine segment manufactures and sells clinical laboratory medicines and sells them to medical institutions and contract clinical laboratory companies. The Sterilization segment mainly entrusts the sterilization of medical equipment used for medical treatment in hospitals of large-scale hospitals and the related operations. The New Development & Others segment is involved in the homecare & welfare equipment business, self-medication & health insurance business, food & environment & cosmetics inspection business.

name: FUJIMI INC
businessSummary: FUJIMI INCORPORATED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of abrasives. The Company operates in four segments: Japan segment, North Americas segment, Asia segment and Europe segment. The Company has products like products for slicing single crystal silicon ingots, lapping, and polishing silicon wafers, abrasives used in the production of semiconductor devices, including chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) slurry (polish) and other materials, polishing products for magnetic disks of the hard disk drives, abrasives for specialty materials and abrasives for thermal spray materials, etc.

name: FUJIMAK CORP
businessSummary: FUJIMAK CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, maintenance and repair of kitchen equipment for business uses. The Company provides the heating equipment such as oven equipment and the bakery equipment; the cooling equipment such as refrigeration equipment; the washing and sterilizing equipment such as dish washer and conveyer dish washer; the service equipment such as ice cream machine, and other kitchen equipment for business uses. The Company is also engaged in the delivery, storage and management of its products.

name: FUJI ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Fuji Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in business activities such as product development, production, sales, and services in the fields of energy, industry, semiconductors and food distribution. The Company operates through four segments. The Energy Segment provides geothermal power generation, hydroelectric power generation, thermal power generation, fuel cells, substation equipment, power storage systems, energy management systems. The Industry Segment provides products and services such as inverters, measuring instruments, sensors, drive control and measurement control systems, nuclear power related equipment, radiation equipment and systems, drive systems and door systems for rolling stock, systems for ships and harbors. The Semiconductor segment provides power semiconductors for industrial and automotive applications. The Food Distribution segment provides beverage vending machines, food and goods vending machines, store equipment, and money machines.

name: FUJI MEDIA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Fuji Media Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the core broadcasting business, the media and content business, and the urban development and tourism business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Media and Content segment is engaged in the production of broadcast programs, movies, anime, games and events, the sale of video and music software, the publication of music, magazines and newspapers, as well as television broadcasting, radio broadcasting, mail order sales and advertising business. The Urban Development and Tourism segment engages in the rental and sale of residences, offices and logistics facilities, the operation of hotels and marine leisure facilities, as well as events and interior decoration and building management business. The Company also engages in movable property leasing and product sales, software development, and restaurants and shops business.

name: FUJITEC CO LTD
businessSummary: Fujitec Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation and maintenance of elevators, escalators, moving walks and other products. The Company manufactures elevators and escalators in its domestic production sites and overseas production sites, located in North America, East Asia and South Asia. The Company sells, installs and repairs its products in both domestic and overseas sales bases.

name: FUJIX LTD
businessSummary: FUJIX Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of sewing thread, embroidery thread and various handicraft threads. The Company operates through two geographical segments including Japan and Asia. The Company is involved in the manufacture and sale of textile products such as sewing thread, knitting thread, embroidery thread and other accessories, the sale of various kinds of textile and intermediate products such as raw and twisted yarns, the supply and sale of electricity by solar power generation, as well as the related business. The main products include RSS, Wooly Rock Glam, Quilter Soft, Silver Thread, Sparkle Glam, Fine Sewing Thread, Mochite, RSS50.

name: FUJITSU LTD
businessSummary: Fujitsu Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in a total solutions business in the field of information and communications technology (ICT), providing a variety of services, as well as comprehensive services ranging from the development, manufacture, and sales of products and electronic devices that support these services, to maintenance and operation. The company operates in four business segments. The Service Solutions segment provides consulting services, cloud services, and other services. The Hardware Solutions segment provides system products, mainly sales and maintenance services for hardware such as servers and storage systems that form the foundation of ICT, as well as communications infrastructure such as cell phone base stations and optical transmission systems. The Ubiquitous Solutions segment mainly develops, designs, manufactures, and sells personal computers. The Device Solutions segment mainly provides electronic components such as semiconductor packages and batteries.

name: FUJITA ENGINEERING CO LTD
businessSummary: FUJITA ENGINEERING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction of comprehensive facilities, including the creation and maintenance of area space for construction equipment, industrial equipment and environmental equipment. The company operates through four business segments. The Construction segment includes building equipment, industrial equipment and environmental equipment. The Equipment Sales and Information Systems segment sells equipment, installs and sells information and communication equipment and develops and sells software. The Equipment Maintenance segment includes repair, maintenance, installation of air conditioning equipment and installation of housing equipment. The Electronic Component Manufacturing segment is involved in the inspection, classification, assembly and equipment manufacturing of electronic components. The Company is also involved in the water supply facility management contract business.

name: FUJI OIL HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Fuji Oil Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of vegetable oils and fats, chocolate for commercial use, emulsified and fermented ingredients, and processed soybean ingredients. It operates its business through four segments. The Vegetable Oils and Fats business segment manufactures and sells edible processed oils and fats, edible oils, and oils and fats for chocolate made from palm oil, palm kernel oil, and other basic ingredients. The Commercial Chocolate business segment manufactures and sells chocolate, compounds, and cocoa products. The Emulsified and Fermented Ingredients segment manufactures and sells cream, margarine, and fillings. The Processed Soy Ingredients business segment manufactures and sells soy protein ingredients, soy protein foods, and water-soluble soy polysaccharides. In addition, the Company also develops business activities such as logistics and other services related to each business segment.

name: FUJI PHARMA CO LTD
businessSummary: Fuji Pharma Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hormone medicines for obstetrics and gynecology department, as well as injectable drugs for radiological department such as radiopaque dye for urinary tracts and blood vessels through its branches. In addition, the Company purchases its main pharmaceutical ingredients from its main parent company.

name: SUBARU CORP
businessSummary: Subaru Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture of Subaru automobiles. The Company operates through two business segments. The Automobile segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and repairing of mini cars, small cars, ordinary cars and their parts. The Aerospace segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and repairing of aircraft, space-related equipment and parts. The Company is also engaged in real estate leasing business.

name: FUJIFILM HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Fujifilm Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the healthcare, materials, business innovation, and imaging businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Healthcare segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services medical system equipment, contract manufacturing and development of biopharmaceuticals, drug discovery support materials such as cells, culture media, and reagents, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and supplements. The Materials segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services electronic materials, display materials, industrial materials, fine chemicals, graphic communication system materials, and inkjet materials. The Business Innovation segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services digital multifunction devices, solutions, and services. The Imaging segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services instant photo systems, color films, color paper, services, and equipment for photo printing, digital cameras, and optical devices.

name: FUJI SEAL INTERNATIONAL INC
businessSummary: FUJI SEAL INTERNATIONAL, INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, proposing, developing, manufacturing and sales of packaging systems centered on shrink sleeve labels, self-adhesive labels (pressure sensitive labels) and spouted pouches. The Company operates in five segments: Japan segment, the Americas segment, Europe segment, PAGO segment and Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) segment. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of packaging products, packaging machinery and related machinery as well as providing maintenance services. The Company’s products are used in food, beverages, dairy, home and personal care and pharmaceutical products, etc.

name: FUJICOPIAN CO LTD
businessSummary: FUJICOPIAN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of recording media for printing, as well as office consumables. The Company's products include thermal transfer media, such as thermal transfer ribbons and thermal carbon copies; impact ribbons, including encompassing cloth ribbons, film ribbons and link units; tapes, including correction tapes and glue tapes; functional films, including FIXFILM and others, as well as various carbon papers.

name: FUJI CORP (MIYAGI)
businessSummary: Fuji Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of car accessories. The Company focuses on tires and wheels, and sells them through three sales formats: retail sales, mail order sales, and dealer sales. Retail sales are in suburban locations, mostly located along major roads. Mail order sales are conducted through sales Websites on the Company's own Website and online shopping malls, and sales are conducted both in Japan and overseas. Dealer sales involve direct sales to fellow retailers of car accessories, car dealers, home improvement centers, gas stations, as well as through wholesalers. The Company handles national and private brand wheels, which are procured directly from both within Japan and overseas and sold through retail sales, mail order sales, and dealer sales. The Company handles top domestic tires such as Yokohama, Dunlop, and Bridgestone, as well as imports luxury tires such as Michelin and Pirelli.

name: FUJIKURA LTD
businessSummary: Fujikura Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business activities such as manufacturing, sales, and services of products across the Information Technology, Electronics, Automotive, Energy, and Real Estate business divisions. The company operates in five business segments. The Information Technology segment provides optical fiber, optical cables, telecommunication components, optical components, optical related equipment, network equipment, and construction work. The Electronics business segment provides printed circuit boards, electronic wires, hard disk components, and various connectors. The Automotive Business segment provides wiring harnesses, electrical components, and other products for automobiles. The Energy Business segment provides power cables, communication cables, aluminum wires, coated wires. The Real Estate business segment leases real estate.

name: JAPAN CRAFT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Craft Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Fujikyu Holdings Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail business and the management of group companies. The Company's main business is the general retail business centered on yarn, handicraft supplies, fabrics, Japanese and Western clothing, clothing products and household goods. Along with a handicraft specialty store chain consisting of Craft Heart Tokai, Craft World, Craft Park and Craft Loop, the Company carries out the store sales business that develops a household goods specialty store Suntreme. The Company also operates mail-order sales that sell to general customers through online shops and media such as catalogs and also engages in the real estate leasing business.

name: FUJI CORP (AICHI)
businessSummary: Fuji Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic component mounting robots and machine tools. The Company operates through two business segments. The Robot Solutions segment is engaged in the production of electronic component mounting robots and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Machine Tools segment is engaged in the production of machine tools. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture of control equipment, electronic equipment, and image processing development.

name: FUJII SANGYO CORP
businessSummary: Fujii Sangyo Corporation is primarily engaged in sale of electrical equipment and supplies, machine tools, information equipment, civil engineering and construction machinery and others. The Electrical Supplies segment sells electrical supplies and provides installation works. The Industrial System segment sells electrical equipment, machine tools, information equipment, and provides construction work and facility construction work. The Construction segment sells construction materials, provides integrated construction services and others. The Civil Engineering and Construction Machinery segment provides civil engineering machinery, and maintenance and rental services. The Renewable Energy Power Generation segment provides power generation business, management and operation business.

name: FUKUYAMA TRANSPORTING CO LTD
businessSummary: Fukuyama Transporting Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation business and charter business, as well as other businesses such as distribution and processing business, international business, and real estate rental. It operates through four segments. The Transportation segment and Charter segment are involved in freight transportation, port transportation, and businesses incidental to the transportation business such as product payment collection agency. The Distribution and Processing segment is involved in warehousing business, and distribution and processing business. The International segment is involved in international transportation, international freight forwarding, and customs clearance. In addition, it is also involved in real estate rental, goods sales, convenience store, non-life insurance agency, bowling, travel, security, labor dispatch, and electrical equipment installation businesses.

name: FUKUVI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: FUKUVI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of synthetic resins and inorganic compounds. The Company has two business segments. The Construction Materials segment manufactures and sells glass fiber reinforced cement (GRC), windproof and permeable sheets, plastering materials, bus panels, interior base sheets, heat insulating materials, long cushions, system double floors, floor tiles, among others. The Industrial Materials segment manufactures and sells window frames, doors, furniture products, housing components, vehicle parts, furniture and precision chemical products, among others.

name: FUKUDA DENSHI CO LTD
businessSummary: FUKUDA DENSHI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture, purchase and sale of medical electronic equipment. The Company operates in four business segments. The Biopsy Device segment mainly involves in the manufacture, trading and sales of electrocardiographs, ultrasound diagnostic imaging equipment, automated hemocytometers, etc. The Biological Information Monitoring segment involves in the manufacture, trading and sale of biological information monitors. The Therapy Apparatus segment involves in the manufacture, trading and sale of defibrillators, ventilators, pacemakers, catheters, home rental business, etc. The Consumable Supplies and Others segment provides the consumable goods of equipment for all segments as well as repair and maintenance services.

name: FUKUDA CORP
businessSummary: Fukuda Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in construction and real estate businesses, and also provides non-construction related services. It operates through two segments. The Construction business segment is engaged in the acceptance and execution of construction work, as well as the rental and manufacturing/sale of construction-related equipment and materials. The Real Estate business segment is engaged in the sale, rental and development of real estate. The Company also rents and sells products and provides services other than those related to construction work, and operates welfare facilities.

name: FUKUSHIMA GALILEI CO LTD
businessSummary: Galilei Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of refrigerator-freezers, the manufacture and sale of medical and scientific products, the manufacture and sale of frozen and refrigerated showcases, large food processing machinery, large and small refrigerated panel equipment sales, and service maintenance. Products include commercial refrigerators and freezers, showcases, ice machines, quick freeze and thaw equipment, pastry and bakery equipment, sanitation-related equipment, equipment for hospitals and aged care facilities, cooking and processing equipment, service equipment, and medical and physical chemistry equipment.

name: FUKUOKA FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Fukuoka Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking business. The banking business is engaged in the provision of banking services, such as deposit, loan, domestic and foreign exchange. The others business is engaged in the securities business, guarantee business, the business revitalization support business, the loan management and collection businesses, as well as leasing business.

name: FUKUI COMPUTER HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Fukui Computer Holdings, Inc. is engaged in the development and sale of computer-aided design (CAD) software. It has two business segments. The Architecture CAD segment is engaged in the development, sale and maintenance of architecture CAD software, as well as the provision of Web service and other software services. The Measurement Civil Engineering CAD segment is engaged in the development, sale and maintenance of measurement CAD software and civil engineering CAD software.

name: FIT EASY INC
businessSummary: Fit Easy Inc is a Japan-based company mainly operates FIT-EASY, an amusement fitness club that incorporates not only fitness training equipment but also amusement elements, as well as franchise chains (FCs). The Fitness Club Management segment is primarily involved in the development of stores and services that utilize the know-how of amusement fitness clubs, the operation and planning of stores that will become third places (a third place neither at home nor at work), and franchise expansion. Amusement fitness clubs aim to create spaces that can be enjoyed with all five senses, where customers can use amusement facilities such as FIT-GOLF (simulation golf) and FIT-SAUNA (private sauna), FIT-RACE (a full-scale racing simulator supervised by a professional driver), FIT-LOUNGE (a co-working space where customers can bring their own personal computers (PCs) to work or have online meetings), and self-beauty treatments according to their own hobbies and preferences.

name: FINATEXT HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Finatext Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of cloud-based core systems for financial business, and data analysis services. The Company operates through three business segments. The Financial Infrastructure segment is engaged in the provision of core systems required to operate financial services as a cloud-based software as a service (SaaS) type. The FinTech Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of support services for digital transformation and digital marketing for financial institutions. The Big Data Analysis segment is engaged in the promotion of data utilization, and the provision of data analysis services.

name: PHOTOSYNTH INC
businessSummary: Photosynth Inc mainly develops services that utilize Internet of Things (IoT) devices such as smart locks and cloud-type authentication platforms, and provides them through a subscription model. The Company mainly operates Akerun business. The Akerun business develops related services centered on personal authentication and security using edge terminals such as smart locks that connect to the cloud and the Internet for corporations and housing toward the realization of a keyless society. The Akerun business is provided as Hardware Enabled Software as a Service (HESaaS) based on a subscription model, has access authentication platforms and cloud security systems, and owns value as an authentication platform that utilizes the access authentication platform.

name: FICHA INC
businessSummary: Ficha Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the image recognition software development business. The Company is mainly engaged in the development of Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) that supports the driving operation of automobile drivers that detect pedestrians, vehicles, lanes, signs, mainly for in-vehicle cameras and drive recorders. The main customers are auto parts manufacturers and drive recorder manufacturers called companies that directly supply parts to automobile manufacturers (Tier 1). In addition, the Company is also engaged in the installation of software for Driver Monitoring System (DMS), which can detect face recognition and sight, dangerous driving, sleepy driving, in the vehicle through an automobile parts manufacturer.

name: FORUM ENGINEERING INC
businessSummary: Forum Engineering Inc. operates the engineer dispatch and introduction business. The clients cover eight major industries in the mechanical and electrical fields, including automobiles, transportation machineries, industrial machineries, precision equipment, electrical equipment, home appliances, electronic components, and information and communications. The Company dispatches technical staffs to client companies for design and development, experiment and evaluation, production technologies, and quality assurance. The engineer dispatch service has three features, including management of client companies by department, skill-based matching using artificial intelligence, and recruitment of human resources through a unique route. The Company also conducts engineer introduction and other businesses, and provides human resources services including engineer dispatch service, electromechanical engineer recruitment service, as well as human resource management services.

name: FEEDFORCE INC
businessSummary: Feedforce Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly provides support to companies in solving their problems and improving productivity in the fields of digital marketing and e-commerce by utilizing technologies such as performance-based advertising agency, data feeds, and identity (ID) integration. The Company operates through three segments. The Professional Services segment consists of two main services, Anagrams and DF PLUS, and provides marketing support and solutions using data feeds and listings. The Software as a Service (SaaS) segment consists of three main services, Social PLUS, dfplus.io, and EC Booster, and provides social login support tools, data feed marketing management tools, and automatic ad distribution tools. The Digital Transformation (DX) segment consists of five main services, App Unity, Rewire, FRACTA, TePs, and Shippinno, and provides services to support companies' DX through e-commerce business support services using Shopify and Shopify app development.

name: FEED ONE CO LTD
businessSummary: FEED ONE CO., LTD., formerly FEED ONE HOLDINGS CO., LTD., is engaged in the feed business and livestock and marine products business. The Company mainly operates in three segments. The Feed segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of feeds for livestock, aquatic feeds and other feeds. The Livestock and Marine Products segment is engaged in the production and sale of pigs, chicken eggs and chickens, the purchasing, processing and sale of livestock products, and the purchase and sale of marine products, among others. The Others segment is engaged in the farming of saltwater fish based on compound feeds, the production and sale of seeds and seedlings, and real estate leasing business, among others.

name: FIXSTARS CORP
businessSummary: Fixstars Corporation is an information technology (IT) company. The Company operates in two business segments. Software Services segment is engaged in the development of software, focusing on embedded system for manufacturing industry, as well as grid framework and risk measurement for financial industry. Hardware Infrastructure segment provides multi-core processors and computing boards that are optimal for customers' products and business. The Company's main products consist of image processing processor-based computing boards and peripheral devices, and general-purpose equipment which includes graphics processing unit (GPU) and multi-core-based servers. The Company provides total solutions for customers in health care, industrial equipment, mobile, and financial sectors.

name: FISCO LTD
businessSummary: FISCO Ltd. is engaged in the provision of information services. It mainly operates through nine business segments. The Information Service business provides corporate information for corporations and individuals, providing financial information and virtual currency information, real time distribution, Internet distribution, outsourcing, among others. The ICT IOT Device business includes agricultural ICT business and, research and development of robot business, among others. The FinTech System Development business includes system development, cloud services, and ASP services for nursing care establishments. The Internet Travel business includes e-market place management of travel related products. The Advertising Agency Services business includes advertising agency work, planning, editing, production and issuance of advertisement publications. It also engages Consulting business, Brand Retail Platform business, Virtual Currency / Block Chain business as well as Other business.

name: FELISSIMO CORP
businessSummary: FELISSIMO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in mail-order business centered on clothing, clothing accessories, and lifestyle-related products. In Japan, The Company is engaged in mail order sale of apparel, apparel goods including clothing, personal products, life-related items including houseware, daily necessities, health-related products, handicraft and leisure-related products, food, among others. In addition, the Company is also engaged in order reception, inquiry response, information processing, merchandise management, and order shipment business at the Company's orders and distribution centers.

name: FAN COMMUNICATIONS INC
businessSummary: FAN Communications Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in offering affiliate advertising services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Cost Per Action (CPA) Ad Network Business is engaged in the provision of advertising service targeted at personal computer (PC) users under the name A8.net and cellular phone users under the name Moba8.net, as well as smart phone user under the name adcrops. The Cost Per Click (CPC)/Targeting Ad Network Business is engaged in the provision of service for operation type advertisement under the name nend and for retargeting advertisement distribution under the name nex8. The Company is also involved in the media business.

name: FOSTER ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Foster Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the speaker business and mobile audio business. It conducts its operations through three segments. The Speaker segment manufactures and sells speaker products such as automotive speakers and speaker systems, and TV speakers. The Mobile Audio segment manufactures and sells mobile audio products including headsets, headphones, earphone drivers, and vibration actuators. Other segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of proximity warning speakers, vehicle emergency notification system speakers, and Fostex brand products.

name: FERROTEC HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Ferrotec Corp, formerly Ferrotec Holdings Corp, is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of products used in semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, thermo-modules, as well as silicon products, magnetic fluids, sensors and their application products. The Company operates through three segments. The Semiconductor and Other Equipment Related segment is engaged in the production of vacuum seals, metal fabricated products for various manufacturing equipment, quartz products, ceramics products, chemical vapor deposition (CVD)-silicon carbide (SIC) products, silicon parts, quartz crucibles, and equipment parts cleaning. The Electronic Devices segment produces thermo-modules, substrates for power semiconductors, magnetic fluids, and sensors. The Automotive segment manufactures thermo-modules, substrates for power semiconductors, and sensors. It also manufactures saw blades, machine tools, and silicon products for solar cells.

name: HELIOS TECHNO HOLDING CO LTD
businessSummary: Helios Techno Holding Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the lamp business, manufacturing equipment business and human resources service business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Lamp segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of projector lamps, halogen lamps for general lighting, as well as light emitting diode (LED) lamps. The Manufacturing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of alignment film printing equipment, special printing equipment, light source units for ultraviolet (UV) exposure equipment, as well as inspection and measurement equipment. The Human Resource Service segment is engaged in dispatching and contracting technical and general production workers.

name: TSUBURAYA FIELDS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Tsuburaya Fields Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business related to game machines. The Company mainly plans, develops, manufactures, and maintains gaming machines, and plans and develops software for gaming machines. The Company is also engaged in the management and operation of fitness clubs, the leasing, management, trading and asset management of real estate, the planning and production of computer graphics, movies and television programs, as well as the planning, production and sales of character products.

name: FALCO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: FALCO HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the clinical testing business and the dispensing pharmacy business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Clinical Testing segment is engaged in the contracted clinical specimen testing business for hospitals and clinics, as well as the development and sale of electronic medical charts and other medical information systems, and the wholesale of in-vitro diagnostic drugs. The Dispensing Pharmacy segment is engaged in the operation of dispensing pharmacies.

name: FABRICA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Fabrica Holdings Co Ltd, formerly known as Fabrica Communications Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of the Internet service business centered on the used car sales business support cloud service symphony and the short message service (SMS) distribution platform Media SMS. The Company operates in four business segments. The U-CAR Solution Group segment is engaged in the provision of the used car sales business support cloud service symphony, as well as the support of businesses related to automobile after-sales service. The SMS Solution Group segment provides the SMS transmission service Media SMS for corporations. The Internet Service Group segment is engaged in the operation of automobile web magazines and the provision of used car batch assessment services. The Auto Service Group segment provides one-stop services for tow trucks and automobile maintenance business at designated factories.

name: FANUC CORP
businessSummary: Fanuc Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of computer numerical control (CNC) systems used in production systems through automation and their application products based on CNC system technology, as a comprehensive supplier of factory automation (FA). The FA division is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of FA products, such as CNC systems and laser products. The Robot division is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of robot systems and other robotic products. The Robot Machine division is engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of small cutting machines, electric injection molding machines, wire electrical discharge machining tools, and other products.

name: FAST RETAILING CO LTD
businessSummary: Fast Retailing Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the clothing business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Japan UNIQLO segment is engaged in the sale of casual clothing in Japan market under the brand of UNIQLO. The Overseas UNIQLO segment is engaged in the sale of casual clothing in overseas markets under the brand of UNIQLO. The GU segment is engaged in the sale of casual clothing in Japan and overseas markets under the brand of GU. The Global Brand segment is engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of clothing in Japan and overseas markets, and operates Theory, PLST, COMPTOIR DES COTONNIERS and PRINCESSE TAM.TAM businesses. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business and other businesses.

name: FIRST JUKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: First Juken Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in developing and selling detached houses and contract work. The Detached Housing segment is engaged in the planning, development and sale, and contractor work of detached housing, and additionally insurance agency and other related business. The Others segment is engaged in condominium business, including development and sale of new condominiums, renovation and sale of existing condominiums, condominium rental and related business. The condominium business sells new condominium buildings and sells second-hand condominiums after renovation. The construction of new condominiums business engages in the purchase of land for sale, construction management, distribution and sale of various constructions.

name: PEERS CO LTD
businessSummary: Peers Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consulting business in the telecommunications industry. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of consulting services, human resource solution services and information technology (IT) solution services. The consulting services are mainly engaged in the proposal of original training programs about management issues and sales issues for career shops and home appliance mass retailers, as well as the educational support services. The human resource solution services are mainly engaged in the holding of sale promotion events at sale sites, as well as the provision of educational support and dispatch services for foreign workers. The IT solution services are mainly engaged in the provision of sale skills and know-how services through video contents and applications.

name: PIALA INC
businessSummary: PIALA INC. is mainly engaged in the Electronic Commerce (EC) support business. The Company promotes EC transformation. The EC support business provides clients with EC marketing and advertising marketing services specialized mainly in beauty, health and food fields such as cosmetics and health foods. The EC marketing mainly focuses on customer attracting, provides Key Performance Indicator (KPI) guarantee service using RESULT Series, operates through marketing support business related to advertising agency and customer support service, conducts RESULT Series solution including RESULT MASTER equipped with Data Management Platform (DMP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI). The advertising marketing provides fee-based services, conducts EC support service by proposing various media and methods from ordinary media to niche media such as local newspapers and area-limited magazines in accordance with client's direct marketing issues.

name: PIGEON CORP
businessSummary: Pigeon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of childcare and nursing products. It has six business segments. Domestic Baby and Mom segment manufactures and sells childcare and women’s products. Products are mainly weaning related products, skin care products, wet tissues, baby foods and outing products. China segment manufactures and sells products in China, South Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Russia. Lansinoh segment manufactures and sells products in United States, Germany, United Kingdom, Turkey, China. Singapore segment manufactures and sells products in ASEAN countries such as Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Malaysia, as well as India, Australia and Middle East. Healthcare and Nursing Care segment manufactures and sells products and provides nursing care services. Products are incontinence products, care facility products. Children Support segment operates childcare facilities and infant classrooms and provides baby-sitting services.

name: PCA CORP
businessSummary: PCA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the computer software business. The Company is mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing, sale and maintenance of computer software, the support of computer software installation and operation, as well as the provision of cloud service. The Company is mainly engaged in the production of PCA cloud software for core business cloud service, PCA hyper software for core business systems, PCA KAIKEI DX software for financial accounting, and PCA KYUYO DX software for salary calculating.

name: PBSYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: PBsystems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in system virtualization business. The Company is engaged in system cloud conversion for companies and local governments. The Company operates through two business fields. The secure cloud system business is engaged in cloudization of core systems and implementation of robust cybersecurity and resilience. The emotional systems segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of the emotional sharing VR theater MetaWalkers.

name: P.S. MITSUBISHI CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: PS Construction Co Ltd, formerly P.S. Mitsubishi Construction Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in civil engineering business, construction business and manufacturing business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the construction of prestressed concrete (PC) and civil engineering works, the manufacture and sale of PC products, the operation of pavement, repair and foundation works of civil engineering structures, and the management of civil engineering equipment. The Building Construction segment is engaged in operation of PC works and other general construction works, as well as the manufacture and sale of PC products. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of concrete products. The Others segment is engaged in the sale, leasing and brokerage of real estate, and the provision of non-life insurance brokerage services.

name: BEAUTY GARAGE INC
businessSummary: BEAUTY GARAGE Inc. is primarily engaged in selling beauty equipment, store design business and other solution business. The Company operates in three segments. The Merchandising segment sells beauty equipment and cosmetics through Internet site, mail catalog and show room. In addition to purchasing from manufacturers, it also develops its own original brand products, and purchases and sells used beauty equipment. The Store Design segment is engaged in store design and construction supervision. The Other Related Solutions segment is engaged in providing a range of resources services for beauty salon operation.

name: BIC CAMERA INC
businessSummary: BIC CAMERA INC. is a Japan-based company engaged in the sale of goods such as audio-visual products, home appliances and information communication equipment products. Audio-visual products include cameras, televisions, recorder & video cameras, as well as audio products, among others. Home appliances include refrigerators, washing machines, cooking appliances, seasonal appliances, and beauty appliances. Information communication equipment products include personal computers, personal computer peripherals, computer software, and mobile phones. The Company also sells watches, second-hand computers, sporting goods, toys, glasses, contact lenses, alcoholic beverages, food, drinks, pharmaceuticals, as well as daily necessities. The Company is also involved in the broadcasting business, the logistics business, the recycling & reuse business, the communication service agency business, as well as the planning and sale of security equipment products.

name: VISION INC
businessSummary: VISION INC. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the global WiFi business, and the information and communication services business. The Company operates in two segments. The Global WiFi segment is engaged in the rental of mobile WiFi routers in Japan and other countries. The Information and Communication Services segment is engaged in the fixed communication services business, the sale of mobile communication equipment and office automation (OA) equipment, as well as the creation of homepages. The Company is also engaged in the higher time sharing services business, the media business and the mail order business.

name: BUSINESS BRAIN SHOWA-OTA INC
businessSummary: Business Brain Showa-Ota Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consultation and development of business system. The Company operates through two business segments. Consulting and System Development segment is involved in the provision of consultation for accounting system and its peripheral system, system development and establishment, system development for financial institutions, among others. Management Service (BPO) segment is involved in the outsourcing of personnel, salary, labor, accounting and finance, system management, the dispatch of information technology (IT) engineers, medical office workers and others, as well as the provision of system support for insurance agencies of non-life insurance companies and system support for financial institutions.

name: VISASQ INC
businessSummary: visasQ Inc. operates the knowledge platform business. The Company provides service that matches customers with advisors with business knowledge and sets up hourly telephone calls and face-to-face interviews according to customer needs. The services provided by the knowledge platform business include visasQ interview, visasQ expert survey, visasQ outsourcing, visasQ project, visasQ web exhibition in the full support format visasQ, and visasQ lite in the self-matching format visasQ lite. The registrants include manufacturing, retailing, eating and drinking, living, medical and healthcare, business support, finance, education, media, construction and real estate, energy infrastructure, agriculture, forestry and fisheries, among others. It covers a wide range of industries and occupations, including management departments, information technology (IT) and systems, new businesses and research and development (R&D), overseas businesses, professionals, and production and procurement.

name: BEAGLEE INC
businessSummary: Beaglee Inc.is a Japan-based company engaged in the content platform business which provides content distribution service and an environment for creators. The main service provided by the content platform business is involved in the operation of a comic distribution Website Manga Okoku. The Company is also involved in some new related business with the assets and know-hows cultivated from the operation of Manga Okoku, such as the provision of the illustration distributed media ETOPICA, the manga-specialized crowd-funding service FUNDIY, as well as the native application business.

name: BML INC
businessSummary: BML, INC. is mainly engaged in the clinical testing as well as related business. The Testing segment engages in the commissioned work of clinical testing. The Medical Information Systems segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of system equipment for medical institutions, as well as provision of medical information service.

name: B&P CO LTD
businessSummary: B&P Co.,Ltd. is mainly engaged in the provision of advertisements for sales promotion using commercial inkjet printers, and living materials and products such as interiors. The Company also uses the large-format inkjet printers for business, and conducts inkjet output business that consistently performs printing, processing and delivery. The Company mainly operates its businesses through the production business of advertising materials for sales promotion, and the production business of living materials and products. The production business of advertising materials for sales promotion is ordered from advertising agencies, advertising production companies, printing companies, design companies and others. The production business of living materials and products provides exterior curtains of print seal machines handled by game machine manufacturers, and interior wallpapers and floor materials handled by interior makers and interior trading companies.

name: HIROSE ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Hirose Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of multi-pole connectors, coaxial connectors, and other electronic components. The Company operates through two business segments. The Multi-Pole Connector segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of round connectors, square connectors, and connectors for printed wiring boards. The Coaxial Connector segment is engaged in the provision of coaxial connectors and optical connectors. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic medical devices and micro switches.

name: HIROGIN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Hirogin Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of banking services and financial services. The Company is engaged in the collateral real estate evaluation business, financial product trading business, bond management and collection business, asset management business, credit card business and credit guarantee business. The Company is also engaged in the leasing and auto-leasing business, factoring business, investment business and other comprehensive financial business.

name: HIRAMATSU INC
businessSummary: Hiramatsu Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management of restaurants, cafes and hotels. The Company is engaged in development of restaurant business, wedding business, catering business, wine business and hotel business. The Company operates stores mainly in Tokyo, Kanagawa, Sapporo, Kanazawa, Nagoya, Osaka, Kyoto, Nara, Fukuoka, Okinawa and Paris. The overseas subsidiary is mainly engaged in the provision of food and beverages to the Company, as well as the operation and management of Restaurant Hiramatsu Paris in Paris.

name: HIRANO TECSEED CO LTD
businessSummary: HIRANO TECSEED Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of coating machines-related and chemical machines-related equipment, among others. The Coating Machines-related segment manufactures and sells coating and laminating-related machines such as magnetic tapes, composite films for wrapping, adhesive tapes, synthetic leathers, floor materials, wallpaper, decorative sheets, insulating plates, as well as drying and heat disposal machines, among others. The Chemical Machines-related segment manufactures and sells macromolecular chemical machines such as machines for plastic films, film formations, electrical printed circuit boards (PCBs) and ceramic sheet moldings, high-heat processing equipment, drying and heat disposal machines and others. The Others segment manufactures and sells dyeing machines and various machinery parts, as well as provides repair and remodeling services.

name: HIRAGA CO LTD
businessSummary: HIRAGA CO., LTD. is engaged in the sale promotion-related business. The Company is engaged in comprehensive printing business, sales promotion, planning and management of sales promotion management system, digital marketing of WEB and social networking service (SNS). The Company is also providing service including flyers printing, sticker printing, store sales promotion, sorting, packing, management, delivery, material printing, reservation systems, inventory management systems, campaign systems, digital flyers, novelty seal promotion, and LINE official account opening and operation support.

name: HUMAN TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Human Technologies Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software as a service (SaaS) business for an attendance management service. The Company is mainly engaged in the development and sale of the cloud attendance management system KING OF TIME. Its main functions include overtime management, schedule/shift management, administrator privileges, workflow (application/approval), among others.

name: HYAKUGO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Hyakugo Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly provides financial services such as leasing business mainly banking. The Company mainly operates through two business segments. The Banking segment provides deposit services, loan services, domestics exchange services and foreign exchange services. This segment is involved in the investment trust and insurance counter sales, financial product intermediation, merger and acquisition (M&A) and syndicated loans. This segment is also engaged in the examination and adjustment of cash, the storage and management of documents and accounting books, the survey and evaluation of real estate, the placement agency and personnel management business. The Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing business. The Company is also engaged in the trading of financial products, the credit card and credit guarantee business, the provision of regional industry survey- and consulting-related services, as well as the processing of information business.

name: HINO MOTORS LTD
businessSummary: Hino Motors Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of trucks and buses, and the provision of related services. The Company operates in two regional segments, including Japan and Asia. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various trucks, sightseeing buses, route buses, industrial diesel engines and other products, the manufacture of machined parts, forged parts, dies, electrical components and other products, the assembly of automobiles and unit parts, as well as the sale of automobiles. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including Asia, North America, Oceania and others.

name: HITO-COMMUNICATIONS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Hito Communications Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the outsourcing business, temporary staffing business, electronic commerce (EC) and television shopping (TC) support business, and wholesale business. It operates through four segments. The Outsourcing segment undertakes a series of operations from manufacturers and telecommunications carriers. The Temporary Staffing segment dispatches staff to manufacturers, telecommunications carriers, and supermarkets and general merchandise stores (GMS) according to the needs of the destination. The EC/TC Support segment provides sales support using e-commerce and television shopping. The Wholesale segment is engaged in the manufacture and wholesale of clothing. The Company also provides system development related services, limousine services for the wealthy, land operating services for foreign tourists visiting Japan, social welfare services such as home care and group home management, and online customer services.

name: MAXELL LTD
businessSummary: Maxell Ltd, formerly Maxell Holdings Ltd, is mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of energy, industrial materials and electric appliances and consumer products. The Company mainly operates through three business segments. The Energy segment manufactures and sells secondary batteries, such as coin type lithium secondary batteries, industrial lithium ion batteries and electrodes, and consumer lithium ion batteries, primary batteries such as lithium primary batteries and button batteries, and charger and battery packs. The Industrial Materials segment manufactures and sells optical components, functional materials, electroforming and precision parts, semiconductor-related embedded systems, mold and synthetic resin molded parts, adhesive tapes, radio-frequency identification (RFID) systems and Integrated Circuit (IC) cards, industrial rubber products and others. The Electric Appliance and Consumer segment manufactures and sells projectors, small electric equipments and others.

name: HITACHI ZOSEN CORP
businessSummary: Kanadevia Corp, formerly Hitachi Zosen Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture, installation, sale, repair, maintenance, and operation of environmental equipment and plants, machinery and equipment, and infrastructure facilities. The Company operates through four business segments. The Environmental Business segment engages in the manufacture of various plants, such as waste incineration power generation and recycling facilities. The Machinery and Infrastructure Business segment engages in the manufacture of automobile press machines, boilers, plastic machinery, food machinery, pharmaceutical machinery. The Decarbonization Business segment engages in the manufacture of marine engines, denitrification catalysts, various process equipment such as pressure vessels, nuclear power-related facilities, and wind power generation. The Other Business segment engages in the operation and management of facilities such as dormitories and company housing.

name: HITACHI LTD
businessSummary: Hitachi Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing and sales of products and provision of services. The Company has five business segments. Digital Systems & Services segment provides services such as system integration, consulting and cloud services, information technology (IT) products and software and automated teller machines (ATMs). Green Energy & Mobility segment provides power grids, renewable energy, nuclear power and rail systems. Connective Industries segment provides elevators and escalators, home appliances and air conditioning, measurement and analysis systems for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and medical analysis equipment, industrial and distribution solutions, water and environmental solutions, and industrial equipment. Automotive Systems segment offers powertrain, chassis, advanced driver assistance and systems for two-wheelers. The Others segment is engaged in the management, sale and rental of real estate.

name: HITACHI CONSTRUCTION MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction equipment, and the provision of related services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction Machinery Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic excavators, ultra-large hydraulic excavators, wheel loaders and the provision of other related toral life cycle. The Specialized Parts & Services Business segment is involved in the development, manufacture, sale and provision of after-sales service solutions for mining equipment and machinery.

name: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY CO
businessSummary: East Japan Railway Co is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation, distribution and services, and real estate and hotel businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Transportation segment is involved in passenger transportation, primarily railway services, as well as travel, cleaning and maintenance, station operations, facility maintenance, railway vehicle manufacturing, and railway vehicle maintenance. The Distribution and Services segment is involved in lifestyle services such as retail and food service, wholesale, truck transportation, and advertising agency business. The Real Estate and Hotel segment is involved in lifestyle services such as shopping center operation, office building rental, hotel business, and real estate development and sales for these businesses. The Company also engages in credit card and information processing businesses.

name: HIKARI TSUSHIN INC
businessSummary: Hikari Tsushin Inc is a holding company mainly engaged in the corporate service business, personal service business, and agency sales business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Corporate Service segment is engaged in the sale of products planned and developed in-house, such as communication line services, electric power, and various systems, to small and medium-sized enterprises. The Personal Service segment mainly sells products planned and developed in-house, such as communication line services and home water distribution, to individuals. The Agency Sales segment is engaged in the sale of various products such as telecommunications carriers, insurance companies, and manufacturers.

name: PUNCH INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: PUNCH INDUSTRY CO., LTD. is principally engaged in the manufacture and distribution of molds. The Company's main products are comprised of plastic molds, which are used for the manufacture of plastic products, such as the outer frame of digital cameras and mobile phones, as well as pressed molds, which are manufactured by pressing machinery. The main products manufactured by the Company include sprue bushings, gate bushings, ejector pins and other plastic molds, as well as guide bushes for die sets, punches, stripper guides and other pressed molds.

name: PARAMOUNT BED HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: PARAMOUNT BED HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of beds for medical and welfare use. Through its subsidiaries and associated companies, the Company is involved in the manufacture and sale of beds for medical and welfare use, mattresses, furniture for hospital room use, and medical equipment and fixtures, the inspection, repair, sterilization, maintenance and leasing of beds and mattresses, the rental and wholesale of welfare equipment, as well as the operation of insurance agency business, among others.

name: PASONA GROUP INC
businessSummary: Pasona Group Inc. is primarily engaged in temporary staffing services. The Company mainly operates through three business segments. The human & resources (HR) solution business includes experts service (staffing), insourcing (outsourcing / contracting), HR consulting, education and training, other global sourcing (overseas talent service), career solutions (staffing, reemployment support), as well as outsourcing service. The life solutions business is engaged in nurseries, nursing care services, housekeeping substitution projects, among others. The public solutions business is engaged in social welfare-related projects, including regional creation projects and projects related to job creation for persons with disabilities.

name: PASSLOGY CO LTD
businessSummary: Passlogy Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in development and sale of authentication security software which based on identity authentication technology. The Company is mainly engaged in own product development business. PassLogic is an authentication security software for enterprises and organizations that has been commercialized as an authentication system using the pass logic method of the its own authentication technology. It provides PassLogic products to customers mainly through distributors and service providers.

name: POWDERTECH CO LTD
businessSummary: Powdertech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells powder products, such as ferrite powder and iron powder products, as well as oxygen scavengers. The Company operates in two business segments. The Carrier segment manufactures and sells electrophotography carrier for copy machine and printer industry. The Iron Powder segment manufactures and sells various iron powder for powder metallurgy use, as well as oxygen scavenger and oxygen sensing agents for food industry. The Company also engages in logistics services related to their business and purchases raw materials through non-consolidated subsidiaries and other affiliated companies.

name: PILOT CORP
businessSummary: Pilot Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, purchasing and sale of stationery items such as writing instruments and toys. The Company operates through four geographical segments: Japan, Americas, Europe, Asia (including Africa and Oceania). The Company’s main business is the manufacture and sale of writing instruments. Its main products include writing instruments such as fountain pens, ballpoint pens, mechanical pencils, multifunction pens, color pens, felt-tip pens, markers, drawing materials and drawing pens; stationery items such as business bags, correction items, office stationery, whiteboards, and notebooks. In addition to stationery supplies, the Japan segment is also involved in the manufacture, purchasing and sale of toys, precious metal accessories such as rings, and ceramic parts.

name: PARK24 CO LTD
businessSummary: Park24 Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation and management of parking lots, and the rental and purchase of automobiles. The Company operates through three segments. The Domestic Parking Lot Business segment provides hourly and monthly parking lot services, and operates reservation-type parking lots and manages facilities attached to parking lots. The Overseas Parking Lot Business segment provides hourly and monthly parking lot services through sublease contracts and management contracts in the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Taiwan. The Mobility Business segment provides a mobility service called Times Car (a fusion of car sharing and rental car service) that allows users to rent a car for the time and period they want at manned stores and unmanned stations nationwide, and also provides road service to respond to car accidents and breakdowns.

name: PARKER CORP
businessSummary: PARKER CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles, steel, machinery and equipment, parts, materials and chemicals. The Company operates through five business segments. The Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of food machinery, shoemaking machinery, automotive equipment and other equipment. The Chemical Product segment provides sealing materials, undercoats, body weight reductions, hollow foam members as rigidity auxiliary materials, and glass sealing materials for automotive production lines. The Chemicals segment provides industrial cleaning agents and steel equipment. The Industrial Materials segment provides soundproofing materials for automobiles and home appliances. The Chemical Industry segment provides liquid crystal-related chemicals, car wash chemicals, other industrial chemicals and industrial hot air blowers. The other business is involved in petroleum-related products and real estate leasing business.

name: BANDAI NAMCO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Bandai Namco Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital business, toys and hobby business, intellectual property (IP) producing business, and amusement business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Digital Business segment plans, develops, and distributes network content, and plans, develops, and sells home video games and other products. The Toys and Hobby Business segment plans, develops, manufactures, and sells toys, capsule toys, cards, confectionery and food products, apparel, household goods, plastic models, premiums, stationery. The IP Production Business segment plans, produces, and operates animation and other visual and music content, manages and operates copyrights and copyrighted works, discovers and develops artists, and operates live entertainment businesses. The Amusement Business segment plans, develops, and provides after-sales service for amusement machines, and plans and operates amusement facilities.

name: BALMUDA INC
businessSummary: Balmuda Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, design, development and sale of home appliances in Japan and overseas. The main products include air conditioner-related products such as electric fans, humidifiers and air purifiers, kitchen-related products such as steam toasters, electric kettles, rice cookers and microwave ovens, as well as other products such as solar light emitting diode (LED) desk lights, portable LED lanterns, wireless speakers and hover cleaners. The Company is also engaged in the production of content such as photos and videos related to product promotion.

name: VALTES HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Valtes Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Valtes Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly provides software testing services, web/mobile application development services, and offshore services. The Company operates through three segments. The Software Testing Services segment provides manufacturers and software vendor clients with effective testing services from a third-party neutral standpoint by accurately following up on a wide range of activities, including test planning, test design, test case creation, test execution, and test summary reports. The Web/Mobile Application Development Services segment provides web/mobile app development and web security diagnosis (vulnerability diagnosis) for web apps and mobile apps. In the Offshore Services segment, the Company's group company, VALTES Advanced Technology, Inc. provides testing services and contracted system development to support client companies in improving the quality of their products by sharing its know-how with group companies.

name: VALUENEX JAPAN INC
businessSummary: VALUENEX Japan Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in algorithm business. The Company includes ASP service, which provides analysis tool for big data based on algorithm, as well as consulting service and sale of report. The ASP type license service consists of TechRadar Scope, TechRadar Vision and DocRadar. The consulting service includes research consulting and coaching. The research consulting is performed by using TechRadar and DocRadar technology on research and analysis according to customer's request. The coaching is engaged in nurturing human resources for information analysis for customer.

name: VALUECOMMERCE CO LTD
businessSummary: ValueCommerce Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the development of businesses that provide effective marketing solutions from attracting customers to retaining customers in order to maximize the performance of commerce businesses. The Company operates in two business segments. The Marketing Solution segment provides solutions centered on attracting customers to electronic commerce (EC) sites of commerce businesses. The main service is performance-based advertising affiliate. The EC Solution segment provides solutions centered on sales promotion on the EC site of commerce companies. The main services are the CRM tool Stores R8 for online mall stores and the pay-per-click advertisement Store Match.

name: HAMMOCK INC
businessSummary: Hammock Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions that solve customers' issues, needs, and problems using information technology (IT). The Company provides three solutions. Network solution develops and sells the AssetView series, which is software that comprehensively manages IT assets such as corporate personal computers (PCs) and PC networks from the perspective of security measures and provides solution services to comprehensively solve various issues surrounding IT asset management and operational support services. Sales digital transformation (DX) solution provides development, sales, and operational support services for Hot Profile and Hot Approach. Artificial intelligence (AI) data entry solution provides solutions for streamlining data entry operations based on AI optical character reader (AI OCR) technology, and its main products are AnyForm OCR and WOZE.

name: HANDS CO LTD
businessSummary: Hands Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business of construction. The Company operates through three segments. The Construction segment mainly carries in and out materials at construction sites. The Engineering segment mainly carries out various construction work such as solar panel installation, steel frame construction, and platform door installation. The Repair segment mainly repairs interior scratches on detached houses and apartment houses.

name: H2O RETAILING CORP
businessSummary: H2O Retailing Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the department store business, food business, commercial facility business and other businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Department Store Business segment is engaged in the operation of department stores, mainly selling clothing, personal items, household goods, and food products. The Food Business segment is engaged in the operation of food supermarkets, as well as food manufacturing, food purchasing agency business, and individual home delivery business. The Commercial Facility Business segment is engaged in the rental management of commercial real estate, the operation of commercial facilities, the management of hotels, the maintenance and management of building facilities, and other businesses. The Other Businesses segment is involved in interior construction work, friendship associations, temporary staffing, restaurants, information processing services and other businesses.

name: HANKYU HANSHIN HOLDINGS INC.
businessSummary: Hankyu Hanshin Holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in transportation, real estate and other businesses. It operates in six business segments. The City Transportation segment is involved in the railway, automobile, distribution, advertisement and city transportation businesses. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the real estate leasing and sales businesses. The Entertainment and Communication segment is engaged in the sports, stage, communication media and leisure businesses. The Travel segment is involved in the provision of traveling. The International Transportation segment involves in the international transportation business. The Hotel segment is engaged in the hotel business. The Company is also involved in the businesses including construction and environment business, group cards business, group financial business, human resource and accounting agency business, among others.

name: HALMEK HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Halmek Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the platform business for seniors, publishing the magazine Halmek, developing and selling products, and providing services such as travel and courses. The Company operates through two segments. The Halmek business segment is engaged in the publication of Halmek, a magazine for senior women, mail order business Halmek, advertising business, cultural business such as events, external sales of newspapers, and store operation business. The Nationwide Mail Order business segment is engaged in the mail order business Cotose for senior women and the advertising business.

name: REVOLUTION CO LTD
