businessSummary: REVOLUTION CO.,LTD., formerly HARAKOSAN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Real Estate Sale segment is engaged in the sale and sale agency of condominiums, the planning, design and sale of detached houses, as well as the sale and brokerage of real estate. The Real Estate Leasing and Management segment is engaged in the real estate leasing business, the real estate management business and the real estate brokerage business.

name: HAMAMATSU PHOTONICS KK
businessSummary: Hamamatsu Photonics KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of photomultiplier tubes, imaging equipment and light sources, optical semiconductor elements, image processing and measuring devices, and other optical-related products. The Company operates through three business segments. The Electronic Tube segment manufactures and sells photomultiplier tubes, imaging equipment and light sources. The Optical Semiconductor segment manufactures and sells optical semiconductor elements. The Imaging Measurement Equipment segment manufactures and sells image processing and measuring devices. The Company also engages in semiconductor laser-related businesses and hotel businesses.

name: HACHIJUNI BANK LTD
businessSummary: Hachijuni Bank Ltd is a Japan-based regional bank which operates in two business segments. The Banking segment provides deposit, loan, domestic exchange, foreign exchange and trust services. This segment is also engaged in the credit guarantee, debt management and collection, as well as fund transaction. The Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of leasing services. The Company is also engaged in securities trading, investment, investment management, regional trading, and electric power (power generation) businesses.

name: HASEKO CORP
businessSummary: Haseko Corp is mainly engaged in housing related business. The Company mainly operates in four business segments. The Construction-related segment is engaged in the planning, design and construction of condominiums, the contract construction, as well as the sale and rental of construction materials and equipment. The Real Estate-related segment is engaged in the management of condominium sales business, the sale and rental of condominiums, and the sale of detached houses. The Service-related segment is engaged in the repair of condominiums, interior renovation, rental and rental management of condominiums, management of company housing, sale of condominiums, real estate distribution brokerage, printing business, building management of condominiums, operation of paid nursing homes, and nursing care insurance business. Its Oversea-related segment is engaged in the development and sale of real estate and the operation of commercial facilities in the United States.

name: T.HASEGAWA CO LTD
businessSummary: T.Hasegawa Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of fragrances and related businesses. The Company operates through three segments, including Japan, Asia, and the United States, and operates in the Fragrance division and the Food division. The Fragrance division includes fragrances used in cosmetics such as perfumes and creams, toiletries such as shampoos and soaps, and household products such as detergents. The Food division includes essences, food oil-based flavors, food powder flavors, seasonings, fruit processed products, and natural colors used in beverages, sweets, frozen desserts, desserts, and instant noodle soups.

name: HAZAMA ANDO CORP
businessSummary: Hazama Ando Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction (civil engineering and architecture), and it also conducts business activities related to each business. The Company has three business segments. The Civil Engineering Business segment is involved in all civil engineering works both domestically and overseas. The Architecture Business segment is involved in all architectural works both domestically and overseas. The Group Business segment is involved in the sale and leasing of construction materials and the construction of civil engineering and architectural works through consolidated subsidiaries. The Company also includes survey and research contract work.

name: HAKUHODO DY HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Hakuhodo DY Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the marketing services. The Company is engaged in the provision of specialized marketing services, including the development of client companies' marketing strategies and various marketing-related plans, handling of advertising media such as newspapers, magazines, radio, television, the Internet, and outdoor advertising, advertising production, consulting, research, sales promotion, public relations, and event organization in domestic and overseas markets.

name: HAKUTO CO LTD
businessSummary: Hakuto Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the sale, import and export of electronic and electric equipment and electronic components, as well as the manufacture and sale of industrial chemicals. It operates through four business segments. The Electronic Components Business segment sells semiconductor devices and general electronic components. The Electronic and Electric Equipment Business segment sells and provides services for printed circuit board (PCB)-related equipment and semiconductor manufacturing-related equipment. The Industrial Chemicals Business segment manufactures and sells petroleum and petrochemical-related products, pulp and paper-related products, and cosmetic bases. The Other Business segment is involved in solar power generation, contract work, service businesses, water treatment businesses, and insurance agency operations.

name: HOWTELEVISION INC
businessSummary: Howtelevision, Inc. mainly operates carrier platform business through the operation and management of the recruiting platform gaishishukatsu.com, Liiga and Elite Youth Recruiting DSP. The gaishishukatsu.com is a new graduate student recruitment platform, posting the recruiting information of companies. Liiga aims to support the skill development and career development of young working people who are registered members through columns, case studies and industry research. The DSP service collects fees by advertising distribution companies through the management of Elite Youth Recruiting DSP, an advertising distribution platform specialized for Elite Youth.

name: HOUSE FOODS GROUP INC
businessSummary: House Foods Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of food products, and restaurant management business. The Company operates through five segments. The Spice/Seasoning/Processed Food segment manufactures and sells household products such as roux curry, roux stew, retort curry, spice products, and starch noodles in Japan. The Health Food segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, and mail-order sales of health foods and functional beverages such as Ukon No Chikara, and C1000 in Japan. The International Food segment manufactures and sells soybean-related products such as tofu, curry products, and functional foods, mainly in the United States, China, and Southeast Asia. The Restaurant segment plans and operates restaurants around the world, including Curry House CoCo Ichibanya, which offers Japanese-style curry. The Other Food Related Business segment manufactures and sells prepared dishes, imports and sells ingredients, and analyzes food.

name: HIMACS LTD
businessSummary: HIMACS, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of value solution services. The Company mainly provides value-added solutions for computer and software systems. The Company provides two types of services. The system solution service is engaged in the provision of consulting services, the design, development, testing and implementation of operation systems. The system maintenance service is engaged in the provision of maintenance services for systems after operation.

name: HIDAY HIDAKA CORP
businessSummary: HIDAY HIDAKA Corp. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurant chains. The Company offers ramen, dumplings and Chinese food through restaurants under the names Chuka Soba Hidakaya and Chuka Shokudo Hidakaya. The Company is also engaged in the purchase of cooking ingredients, the production of noodles, dumplings and seasonings, the administration management related to restaurant orders, as well as the logistics business. It also operates Chinese restaurants Chuka Ichiban, as well as Yakitori Hidaka, which offer Japanese char-broiled chicken.

name: HARMONIC DRIVE SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: Harmonic Drive Systems Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the speed reducers business. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision speed reducers, precision actuators and control devices. The Company is mainly engaged in the production of speed reducers, rotary actuators and linear actuators. The Company distributes its products within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the Americas and Europe.

name: HEARTSEED INC
businessSummary: Heartseed Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in research and development of regenerative medicine products. The Company has established cardiac regenerative medicine, a therapy in which microtissue (cardiomyocytes) derived from iPS cells are transplanted into the heart, and conducts business activities for patients with severe heart failure. Target diseases include dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), old myocardial infarction (OMI), and dilated-phase hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (D-HCM). Except the pipeline's leading cardiac treatment HS-001 (administration of regenerated myocardium derived from allogeneic iPS cells to the myocardium), the Company also conducts research into the creation of myocardium using autologous iPS cells that do not pose immune rejection reactions and iPS cells with HLA knockout.

name: HARD OFF CORPORATION CO LTD
businessSummary: Hard Off Corporation Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of reused goods. It operates through two segments. The Reuse segment operates the reuse shops Hard Off, Off House, Mode Off, Garage Off, Hobby Off, Liquor Off, and Book Off (Franchisee). Hard Off buys and sells computers, audio and visual equipment, musical instruments, and watches. Off House buys and sells brand-name products, furniture, and interior goods. Mode Off buys and sells women's and men's clothing, and bags. Garage Off buys and sells audio equipment, tires, dress-up products, and other automotive accessories. Hobby Off buys and sells trading cards and games. Liquor Off buys and sells alcoholic beverages, and glasses. Book Off buys and sells books, and compact discs (CDs). The Franchise (FC) segment operates the franchise chain business of the reuse shops Hard Off, Off House, Mode Off, Garage Off, Hobby Off, and Liquor Off. The Company is also engaged in systems development business.

name: NORITAKE CO LTD
businessSummary: Noritake Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of products in the industrial products, ceramics materials, engineering and tabletop divisions. The Company operates in four business segments. The Industrial Products segment, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells grinding wheels, diamond tools, cutting and offset grinding wheels and others. The Ceramic Materials segment, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells electronic pastes, transfer paper, painting materials, thick-film circuit boards, gypsum, ceramic cores, porous ceramic components and others. The Engineering segment manufactures and sells firing furnaces, drying furnaces, mixing equipment, filtration equipment, carbide circular saw cutting machines, road cutters and others. The Tabletop segment manufactures and sells ceramic tableware, other tableware-related products, decorations and art objects.

name: NOMURA REAL ESTATE HLDGS INC.
businessSummary: Nomura Real Estate Holdings Inc is a real estate holding company. The Company operates in five business segments. The Housing segment is engaged in the development and allotment of condominiums, detached houses and residential properties, the development of housing for seniors, as well as the contracting of reform work business. The Urban Development segment is engaged in the development, leasing and sale of office buildings, logistics facilities and commercial facilities. The Asset Management segment provides asset management services for private placement funds, REITs and real estate securitized products. The Brokerage and CRE segment is engaged in the brokerage and consulting of real estate. The Operation Management segment is engaged in the management of office building and condominiums. The Company is also engaged in trading and leasing of land and buildings.

name: NOMURA RESEARCH INSTITUTE LTD
businessSummary: Nomura Research Institute Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of consulting services, development and product sales, operational services, and product sales services. The Company operates four business segments. The Consulting segment provides policy recommendations, strategic consulting, operational consulting, and systems consulting. The Financial IT Solutions segment provides system consulting, system development and operation services, IT solutions such as joint-use systems, and business process outsourcing (BPO) services, mainly for financial industry clients. The Industrial IT Solutions segment provides IT solutions such as system consulting, system development and operation services to the distribution, manufacturing, service, and public sectors. The IT Platform Services segment provides data center operations and management, IT infrastructure and network construction, and other services.

name: NOMURA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nomura Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the securities, investment, and other financial services business across the world. The Company has three business segments. The Sales segment provides investment consultation services to individual clients in Japan. The Investment Management segment provides investment management services and investment solutions, including the establishment and management of investment trusts, discretionary investment services for domestic and foreign investors, fund management and administration for investment corporations and institutional investors, and silent partnership management. The Wholesale segment is engaged in the sale and trading of bonds, equity securities, derivatives, and foreign exchange, as well as investment banking services such as the bonds and securities underwriting business, merger and acquisition (M&A) business and financial advisory services. The Company operates in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia and Oceania.

name: NOMURA CO LTD
businessSummary: NOMURA Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the survey, consulting, planning, design and production of display environment for attracting customers, as well as the operation of various facilities and events. The Company operates through two business segments. The Display segment is engaged in the interior production, exhibition production, environmental production, sales promotion, as well as the planning, design, management and other construction work for specialty stores, department stores, complex commercial facilities, public relations, sales promotion facilities, museums, leisure facilities and others. The Restaurants and Sales segment is engaged in the operation and management of restaurants and souvenir shops.

name: NOVAC CO LTD
businessSummary: Novac Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in civil engineering and construction work. The Company operates through two business segments. The Civil Engineering Business segment is engaged in social infrastructure construction work (road construction, river construction, water supply and sewage construction, and land development work) mainly for public agencies such as local governments and highway companies. The Building Construction Business segment mainly carries out apartment building construction work ordered by private companies, and construction projects ordered by government agencies, such as schools, welfare facilities, government buildings, offices, and highway service areas. The Company also operates real estate rental business, renovation work and other businesses.

name: NODA CORP
businessSummary: NODA CORPORATION is primarily engaged in manufacturing and selling housing materials and plywood. The Company operates in two segments. The Housing Materials segment manufactures and sells interior materials, housing equipment and fiberboards, and provides house-related works. The Plywood segment imports, manufactures and sells plywood.

name: NOJIMA CORP
businessSummary: Nojima Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the sale of digital home appliances, related installation work, repairs and technical guidance. The Company operates its business through six segments. Digital Home Appliance Specialty Store Operation segment engages in the sale of digital audio-visual (AV) equipment, along with related services. The Segment also engages in the sale of information technology (IT) and information-related devices. Overseas segment engages in the sale of digital AV equipment, IT and information-related devices, household electrical appliances and home furniture. Carrier Shop Operation segment provides sales and related services for communication devices. Internet segment offers broadband connection services, along with communication, security and other related services. Product segment involves in the planning, design, development, manufacturing and sales of computers and provides related services. Financial segment offers financial product trading services.

name: NOHMI BOSAI LTD
businessSummary: NOHMI BOSAI LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing, sales and installation of fire alarm systems and firefighting equipment as well as the maintenance of these devices. The Company operates in three segments. The Fire Alarm Devices segment is engaged in manufacturing, sales and installation of automatic fire alarm equipment, environmental monitoring systems, fire doors, and smoke extinguishing facilities, etc. The Firefighting Equipment segment is engaged in manufacturing, sales and installation of various sprinkler equipment, foam fire extinguishing equipment, plant disaster prevention equipment, tunnel disaster prevention equipment etc. The Maintenance and Inspection segment is engaged in the maintenance, inspection and repair of various disaster prevention equipment. Other business includes construction and maintenance of parking lane traffic control systems as well as manufacture and sales of crime prevention equipment operated by its affiliate companies.

name: NOTE INC
businessSummary: note Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of media platform. The Company mainly operates the media platform note where creators can freely post and sell content such as texts, manga, photos, audio, and videos, and users can enjoy and support and subscribe to the content. In addition, while utilizing the platform of note, The Company also operates note pro, a software as a media service (SaaS) that expands the function that allows companies to transmit information as their own original site. The corporate service business regularly holds corporate-sponsored contests on note and manages events. Income from secondary use such as external distribution of note content was recorded in other businesses.

name: NEXTONE INC
businessSummary: NexTone Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the copyright management business and casting business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Copyright Management business is engaged in receiving consignment form copyright holders to license the use of musical works and collect and distribute royalties. In music copyrights, there are mainly performance rights, recording rights, publishing rights, lending rights, broadcasting and cable broadcasting, interactive distribution, and commercial karaoke for business use. The Casting business is engaged in the provision of casting consulting, non-movie digital content (ODS) support, and event coordination. The Company is also engaged in the development and provision of rights processing systems such as copyrights and master rights, and content distribution system, and the development and operation of various in-house systems.

name: NEXTAGE CO LTD
businessSummary: NEXTAGE Co., Ltd. is principally engaged in the dealing of used cars. The main businesses of the Company consist of used car store operation, maintenance, insurance agency and automobile dealing, as well as other services, such as used car export and car coating services. The used car store operation business is comprised of domestic general automobiles, light automobiles and imported automobiles. The maintenance business provides vehicle inspection and maintenance services. The insurance agency business offers automobile insurance as an insurance agency. The automobile dealing business mainly purchases vehicles that are no longer needed by its customers. The Company exports used cars mainly to developing countries and emerging countries in east Africa and Oceania. Through its subsidiary, it provides car coating services, which makes car bodies hydrophilic and durable to dirt, acid and ultraviolet degradation. It also involves in new car dealer operation business.

name: NET ONE SYSTEMS CO LTD
businessSummary: Net One Systems Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the system construction of information and communications technology (ICT) and related services. The Company operates in four segments. The ENT segment offers products and services to general private companies. The SP segment offers products and services to telecommunication companies. The PUB segment offers products and services to central ministries, municipalities and companies providing social infrastructure. The Partner segment offers specialized products and services in collaboration with partner companies. Other businesses include server services and others. The Company has two product groups, the equipment product group which is engaged in purchasing and sales of networks and platforms for ICT systems as well as service product group which provides support and services on equipment and systems.

name: NEXON CO LTD
businessSummary: Nexon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, production and distribution of online games for personal computers (PCs) and mobile games. The Company operates through five business segments: Japan, Korea, China, North America and Others. The PC online business is mainly engaged in the production, development and distribution of PC online games. Game titles include MapleStory, Arad Senki (Dungeon&Fighter) and EA SPORTS FC ONLINE. The consulting business provides consulting services related to the construction and management of billing systems, business strategy, game operation and marketing in China. In Korea, the Company also provides customer support and internet cafe operation services for PC online games and mobile games, and provides advertising platforms and operation management services. The Merchandising business produces and sells products using game characters. The mobile business develops and distributes mobile games played on the smartphones and tablets.

name: LIFULL CO LTD
businessSummary: LIFULL Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of real estate related information services. The Company has two business segments. The HOME’S Related segment is engaged in the operation of the real estate information Website LIFULL HOME'S, the advertising agency business, the system development and Web production business, the provision of customer relationship management (CRM) services for real estate companies, and data management platform (DMP) service for developers, as well as the Internet marketing business. The Overseas segment is engaged in the operation of the aggregation site Trovit and overseas real estate information sites. The Company is also engaged in the operation of a series of Websites for nursing facilities searching, insurance shops searching and reservation, moving estimate and reservation, rental storage space information searching, as well as the insurance agency business and other businesses.

name: UNITED INC
businessSummary: United Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in investment, education, talent matching, and ad tech/content businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Investment Business segment invests in startup companies and manages funds. The Education Business segment operates online education, smartphone app development, and private tutoring schools. The Talent Matching Business segment provides recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) services such as scouting and recruitment support, as well as recruitment placement and designer-specific matching. The Ad Tech/Content Business segment plans, develops, and operates advertising distribution platforms for advertisers and advertising agencies and advertising management platforms for media outlets, plans, produces, and operates digital content, and engages in fan business and sports marketing.

name: NULAB INC
businessSummary: Nulab Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cloud services business. The Cloud Services Business segment is primarily engaged in service development and marketing. Its main products include Backlog, a tool to manage, Cacoo, a visual collaboration tool, Typetalk, a business chat tool, and Nulab Pass, a tool to facilitate ID management and improve information security and governance in organizations. The Company operates within Japan market and overseas market.

name: NINTENDO CO LTD
businessSummary: Nintendo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of entertainment products in the field of home entertainment. The Company develops, manufactures, and sells hardware and software for portable and home console games. Its main products are game consoles, which are computer-based entertainment devices, and character goods and playing cards. Game consoles are hardware and software for handheld and home console games, which are developed by the Company and its affiliates, manufactured by the Company, and sold mainly by its affiliates in Japan and overseas. The Company also develops businesses utilizing its intellectual property (IP), such as video content and mobile applications.

name: NIRECO CORP
businessSummary: NIRECO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of facility equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Process segment offers process control equipment, automatic identification printing equipment, edge position control equipment for metal, level gauges for vortex molten steel and wide board gauges, among others. The Web segment provides edge position control equipment for printing and films, tension control equipment, registration control equipment and starch equipment. The Inspection Equipment segment offers plain inspection equipment, image processing and analyzing equipment, near-infrared analyzing system and fruit sorting equipment, among others. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had three subsidiaries.

name: NIFCO INC
businessSummary: Nifco Inc is a Japan-based manufacturing company primarily engaged in synthetic resin business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Molded Synthetic Resin segment manufactures and sells industrial plastics, fasteners, plastic precision molding components and molds. The Bed and Furniture segment is engaged in the production and sale of beds, the import and sale of furniture, and reclining chair business.

name: NITORI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nitori Holdings Co Ltd is engaged in the sale of furniture and interior goods. The Company operates through two business segments. The Nitori Business segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of furniture and interior goods, as well as real estate rental, advertising services and logistics services. The Shimachu Business segment is engaged in the sale of furniture, interior goods and home improvement products.

name: JAPAN LIFELINE CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Lifeline Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the import, manufacture and sale of cardiac circulators and other medical devices. The Company is mainly engaged in the production of rhythm devices, electrophysiological (EP) and ablations, surgical products and intervention products. The rhythm devices include cardiac pacemakers, implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD), cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillator (CRT-D) and other rhythm devices. The EP and ablations include EP catheters for cardiac arrhythmia examination, ablation catheters for arrhythmia treatment and other EP and ablations. The surgical products include prosthetic heart valves and annuloplasty rings for heart disease surgical treatment, vascular grafts, open stent grafts and stent grafts for aortic disease treatment, as well as other surgical products. The intervention products include balloon catheters, guide wires, penetration catheters and other intervention products.

name: MITSUBISHI LOGISNEXT CO LTD
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Logisnext Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance services of forklift trucks and other logistics equipment and maintenance parts. The Company primarily operates through two business segments. The Domestic segment is engaged in the domestically manufacture and sale of logistics equipment and maintenance parts, mainly forklift trucks, as well as the sale of related products and maintenance parts. The Overseas segment is mainly operated in the Americas, Europe, China and Asia. The Company is mainly engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of logistics system products such as battery forklifts, engine forklifts, container carriers, transfer cranes, transport robots, automated warehouses, and warehouse management systems (WMS). The Company is also engaged in the business of non-life insurance agency.

name: NIPPON YUSEN KK
businessSummary: Nippon Yusen KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation business. The Company operates through six business segments. The Liner Shipping segment is engaged in international marine cargo transportation by liner ships, container terminal business, port transportation business, and tugboat business for the purpose of revenue. The Air Freight segment is engaged in air freight business. The Logistic segment is engaged in the warehouse and freight businesses, and the provision of marine, land and air transportation integrated logistics network services. Irregular Specialized Liner segment is engaged in international marine cargo transportation by trampers and tankers, ship chartering, and others. Real Estate segment leases, manages and sells real estate. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of equipment and machinery and petroleum products, the provision of information processing services, passenger vessel business, petroleum product wholesale business and others.

name: JAPAN POST HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Post Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in postal and logistics services, post office counter services, international logistics, banking, and life insurance. The Company has five business segments. The Postal and Logistics segment is engaged in the postal business, the logistics business and others. The Post Office Counter segment includes counter services related to postal and logistics services, bank counter services, insurance counter services, merchandise sales, real estate business, and affiliated financial services. The International Logistics segment is engaged in the express, forwarding and logistics business in the global markets centered on Australia. The Banking segment is engaged in the banking business such as fund management, financing and other business. The Life Insurance segment is mainly engaged in the life insurance business. The Company is also engaged in the group shared business, hospital business, accommodation business, and investment.

name: MEDICAL NET INC
businessSummary: Medical Net, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in media platform business, medical institution management support business and medical business-to-business (BtoB) business. The Company operates through three business segments. Media Platform segment operates a dedicated portal that provides specific information about the body, health, beauty and parenting. Medical Institution Management Support segment provides search engine marketing (SEM) services that includes search engine optimization (SEO) services and listing advertising (search-linked advertising) operation agency services, corporate Website creation and maintenance services, as well as agency sales services. It also operates dental clinics and sells equipment, instruments and medicines to dental clinics. Medical BtoB segment operates a BtoB portal site that includes dental workers.

name: NIPPON MANUFACTURING SERVICE
businessSummary: nms Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human solution (HS) business, the electronics manufacturing services (EMS) business and the power supply (PS) business. The Company operates in three business segments. The HS segment is engaged in the provision of production dispatch services, contract manufacturing services and repair customer services. The EMS segment is engaged in the provision of mounting and assembly services for electronic device boards in Japan and overseas. The PS segment is engaged in the design, development, manufacturing and sale of products in the power supply field.

name: MCDONALD'S HOLDINGS COMPANY JAPAN LTD
businessSummary: McDonald's Holdings Company Japan Ltd is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation of hamburger restaurants business through its subsidiaries and affiliated companies. The Company's main business is formulating and executing consolidated management strategies for group companies and real estate rental. Through its affiliates, the Company operates hamburger restaurant business through franchisees as well as directly managed stores. The Company pays royalties on licenses. In Japan, the Company grants sub-licenses of know-how and trademarks to franchisees who operate franchise stores, and receives royalties from the franchisees.

name: MICRONICS JAPAN CO LTD
businessSummary: MICRONICS JAPAN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of semiconductor measuring instruments, as well as semiconductor and liquid crystal display (LCD) testing equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. The Probe Card segment develops, manufactures and sells semiconductor measuring instruments, and provides related maintenance service. The Testing Equipment (TE) segment develops, manufactures and sells LCD testing equipment and semiconductor testing equipment, and provides related maintenance service.

name: NIPPON PAINT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Paint Holdings Co Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of coating materials and fine chemicals products. The Company is involved in the manufacture and sale of paint for automobile-, general- and industrial-uses, as well as fine chemicals. The Company operates in four business segments. The Japan segment conducts paint for automobile-, general- and industrial-uses, as well as fine chemicals business. The Asia segment conducts paint for automobile-, general- and industrial-uses, as well as fine chemicals business in China Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Korea, Southeast Asian countries, India. The Oceania segment conducts paint business, such as paint for general-, industrial-uses, and paints peripheral businesses. The Americas segment conducts paint for automobile business and contruction coating materials business.

name: JAPAN PROCESS DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Process Development Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the system development and information service business. The Company has six business segments. The Control System segment is engaged in the development of energy systems, traffic systems and information processing systems. The Automotive System segment is engaged in the development of vehicle control systems and advanced driving assistance systems (ADAS). The Specific Information System segment is engaged in the development of satellite image processing systems and disaster prevention systems. The Embedded System segment is engaged in the development of systems embedded in storage devices and medical equipment. The Industrial and Public System segment is engaged in the development of systems for member and content management, integrated circuit (IC) cards and satellites. The Information Technology (IT) Service segment is engaged in the provision of services such as systems construction, maintenance and operation.

name: FENWAL CONTROLS OF JAPAN LTD
businessSummary: Fenwal Controls of Japan, Ltd. is mainly engaged in development of products based on heat control technology. The Company operates in four business segments. Fire Prevention and Extinction segment develops, manufactures and sells fire detection equipment, firefighting equipment, fire alarm systems, explosion control system, high sensitivity smoke detection (SAS) system and overheat alarm system, as well as engages in provision of services of the systems. Temperature Control segment develops, manufactures, sells, designs and services temperature controller, hot plate and equipment for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, thermocouple for high temperature furnace and other temperature control equipment and services this system. Medical segment develops, designs, manufactures and services artificial kidney dialysis equipment and medical equipment. Printed Circuit Board segment engages in artwork design, noise countermeasure and printed circuit board mounting assembly.

name: NIHON FALCOM CORP
businessSummary: NIHON FALCOM CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the planning, development, production and sale of game software. The Company operates in two business divisions. The Product division is engaged in the planning, development, production and sale of role-playing game software, the production and sale of Japanese version of overseas game software, and the planning, production and sale of music compact discs (CDs). The License division is engaged in licensing permission for the development and sale of family game software in Japan, the localization and local marketing of the Company's software to overseas markets, the provision of services through mobile phones using its game software and game music, the download and sale of its game software online and the production and sale of books.

name: PILLAR CORP
businessSummary: PILLAR Corp, formerly Nippon Pillar Packing Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of fluid control related equipment products, mainly PILAFLON products (fluororesin products), mechanical seal products, and gland packing and gasket products. The products are used in industrial fields such as semiconductors and liquid crystal, as well as electricity, petroleum, automobiles, chemicals, ships, civil engineering and construction, food, and pharmaceuticals. The Company operates through two business segments. The Electronic Equipment Related Business segment mainly produces and sells resin-related products such as PILAFLON products. The Industrial Equipment Related Business segment produces and sells mechanical seal products, gland packing and gasket products. The Company also operates office building rental businesses, insurance agency businesses, and electricity sales businesses.

name: JAPAN BUSINESS SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: Japan Business Systems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing cloud services, consulting and information technology (IT) services. The Company operates through three business segments. The Cloud Integration segment mainly supports the introduction of Microsoft's cloud products Azure (Microsoft Azure) / M365 (Microsoft365) / D365 (Dynamics365) and peripheral cloud services. The Cloud Service segment undertakes maintenance, operation, and improvement in cloud utilization, including Azure / M365 / D365, and provides consistent support. The License & Products segment mainly provides cloud solutions such as Microsoft's Azure, M365, and D365, which are the basis of customer system development, and licenses and related equipment as resale. In addition, the Company also rents real estate.

name: NIPPON PALLET POOL CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON PALLET POOL CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of pallet rental services. The Company is engaged in the rental of cargo handling and transportation equipment such as wooden pallets, plastic pallets, supporters, nesters, roll boxes, containers, racks, carts and others, as well as the operation of the pallet pool. The pallet pool operation business is engaged in the provision of pallet rental and recycling services for customers in pallets storage and management bases through the same standard pallets sharing and circulating system, as well as the provision of repair, maintenance and management services for pallets. The general palletization promotion business is engaged in the provision of unloading and transshipping services for cargo loaded on pallets, as well as transportation and storage services using forklifts and other loading equipment.

name: NIHON PARKERIZING CO LTD
businessSummary: Nihon Parkerizing Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based manufacturer of chemical agents and equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Chemical Agents segment manufactures and sells metal surface treatment chemicals, anti-rust oil, rolling mill lubricant, coating materials, electroless nickel plating and industrial detergents. The Equipment segment manufactures and sells metal surface treatment equipment and coating equipment. The Processing segment is engaged in the provision of anti-rust processing service and heat treatment processing service. The Company is also involved in the maintenance work of buildings, the manufacture and sale of metal specimen plates, the management and leasing of real estates.

name: NH FOODS LTD
businessSummary: NH Foods Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Processing Business Headquarter segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of ham, sausages and processed foods, as well as the manufacture and sale of marine products and dairy products in Japan. The Meat Business Headquarter segment is mainly engaged in the production and sale of meat, the breeding and raising of pigs and broilers, and the sale of meat products in Japan. The Overseas Business Headquarters segment is mainly engaged in the production, manufacture and sale of ham, sausages, processed foods and meat. The ballpark business is engaged in the operation of professional baseball teams and stadiums.

name: NHK SPRING CO LTD
businessSummary: NHK Spring Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of automotive-related parts, such as suspension springs, seats and seat components, and precision components. It also manufactures and sells information equipment-related products, and engages in logistics activities. The Company operates in five segments. The Suspension Springs segment manufactures and sells coil springs, leaf springs, stabilizers, accumulators, torsion bars, stabilizer links and stabilizer linkers. The Seating segment manufactures and sells automotive seats, seat structural parts. The Precision Components segment manufactures and sells mechanical parts for hard disk drives (HDDs), wire springs, thin leaf springs, motor cores, fasteners, and precision-machined products. The DDS segment manufactures and sells HDD suspensions and semiconductor inspection probe units. The Industrial Equipment and Others segment manufactures, sells, and transports semiconductor process parts, ceramic products and others.

name: NITERRA CO LTD
businessSummary: Niterra Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive products, ceramic products, and products related to new businesses. The Company has three business segments. The Automobile-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of parts that are mainly assembled into automobiles, such as spark plugs and exhaust gas sensors. The Ceramics segment manufactures and sells cutting tools, industrial equipment components, semiconductor manufacturing equipment components, semiconductor packages, and oxygen concentrators for medical use. The New Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to new businesses such as the environmental energy field. It also sells materials and provides welfare services.

name: NIPPON TELEGRAPH AND TELEPHONE CORP
businessSummary: NTT Inc, formerly Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, is engaged in the comprehensive information and communications technology (ICT) business, the regional communications business, and the global solutions business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Comprehensive ICT Business segment is engaged in the mobile phone business, inter-prefectural communications services in the domestic telecommunications business, international communications business, solutions business, system development business, and related businesses. The Regional Communications Business segment is engaged in the provision of intra-prefectural communications services in the domestic telecommunications business and related businesses. The Global Solutions Business segment is engaged in the system integration, network systems, cloud, global data centers, and related businesses. The Other (Real Estate, Energy) segment includes real estate business, energy business and others.

name: JAPAN ELECTRONIC MATERIALS CORP
businessSummary: Japan Electronic Materials Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor testing components and electron tube components. It operates through two business segments. The Semiconductor Testing Components Related Business segment provides cantilever-type probe cards such as C-type probe cards, including CE series, and advanced probe cards such as V-type probe cards, including the VT series of vertical contact probe cards, the VS series of vertical spring contact probe cards, and the VE series of vertical + cantilever hybrid probe cards, and M-type probe cards, including the MC series, ML series, and MT series. The Electron Tube Components Related Business segment mainly provides cathodes and filaments.

name: JEOL LTD
businessSummary: JEOL Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, maintenance, development and research of scientific instruments, semiconductor related equipment, industrial and medical equipment, and related products and parts. It operates through three business segments. Science and Measurement Equipment segment manufactures and sells three types of equipment. Electron optical devices include electron microscopes, peripheral devices and others. Analytical instruments include nuclear magnetic resonance equipment, electron spin resonance equipment and others. Measurement and inspection equipment include scanning electron microscopes, analytical scanning electron microscopes, peripheral equipment and others. Industrial Equipment segment manufactures and sells electron beam lithography equipment, linear electron guns and power supplies and others. Medical Equipment segment manufactures and sells clinical test information processing systems, and automatic amino acid analyzers.

name: NIDEC CORP
businessSummary: Nidec Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision small motors, in-vehicle products, home appliances, commercial and industrial products, equipment, electronic and optical components. The Company operates through 10 segments. The SPMS segment manufactures and sells motors for hard disk drives (HDDs) and other small motors. The AMEC segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The MOEN segment, ACIM segment and Nidec Techno Motor segment manufacture and sell home appliances, commercial and industrial products. The Nidec Instruments segment manufactures and sells equipment, in-vehicle products, electronic components and other small motors. The Nidec Mobility segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The Machinery Business Headquarters segment and the Nidec Advanced Technology segment manufacture and sell equipment. The Other segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products, equipment, electronic components, other small motors.

name: NIHON DENKEI CO LTD
businessSummary: NIHON DENKEI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale, repair and calibration of electronic measuring instruments. The Company operates in three regional segments including Japan, China and Others. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale and manufacture of electronic measuring instruments, various system equipment, electronic components, as well as leasing and rental business. The business items include electronic measuring instruments, measuring instruments for communication, computers and peripherals, automatic and labor-saving equipment, measuring instruments for physics and chemistry, industrial application equipment, measuring instruments for production processes, environmental testing instruments, optical measuring instruments, and educational experiments, electronic parts, mechanical parts, measuring instrument leasing and rental services, curio dealers, building construction, jumping and construction business.

name: NIPPON ELECTRIC GLASS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Electric Glass Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of glass and other specialty glass products and glass manufacturing machinery, primarily in the electronics and information fields. In the electronics and information field, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of special glass products for displays and electronic devices. In the functional materials field, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of composite materials, medical, heat-resistant, architectural and other special glass products, as well as glass manufacturing machinery.

name: NEC CORP
businessSummary: NEC Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the information technology (IT) services and social infrastructure businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The IT Services segment provides system integration (system construction and consulting), support (maintenance), outsourcing and cloud services, and system equipment and software services. The Social Infrastructure segment provides network infrastructure (core networks, cell phone base stations, optical transmission systems, and marine systems), software and services for telecommunications carriers, and system equipment, system integration (system construction and consulting) and support (maintenance) in the aerospace and defense domain.

name: NIPPON TELEVISION HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nippon Television Holdings, Inc. is a certified broadcast holding company. The Company operates in three business segments. The Content Business segment is engaged in the sale of television advertising frames, the licensing of program contents, the production and publication of movies, the organizing of events, mail order business and the publishing and sale of publications, program broadcasting operations, homepage design and Website operation, as well as advertising and marketing business, among others. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases offices and commercial tenants and lands, and provides building management services. The Company is also engaged in ecology related business, the operation of stores and other businesses.

name: SOFTBANK CORP PREFERRED
businessSummary: SoftBank Corp is a Japan-based company mainly provides wholesale software, broadband, electronic commerce (EC), and other information services. The Company operates through five segments. The Consumer segment provides electric power services. The segment also purchases mobile handsets from handset manufacturers and sells them to agents operating SoftBank stores and other retail outlets or to individual customers. The Enterprise segment provides a variety of corporate services, including mobile services and fixed-line communication services. The Distribution segment provides cloud services mainly for corporate customers and commercial products such as software and mobile accessories for individual customers. The Media & Ecommerce segment provides online and offline services. The Media segment provides advertising-related services, online shopping services, and reuse services. The Finance segment provides cashless payment services, financial services, and payment agency services.

name: NIPPON PARKING DEVELOPMENT C
businessSummary: Nippon Parking Development Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the parking lot business, the ski resort business and the theme park business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Parking Lots segment is engaged in the operation and management of parking lots, such as direct management, leasing, management, and monthly rental car businesses. The Ski Resorts segment is engaged in the operation and acquisition of ski resorts. The Theme Parks segment is engaged in the operation and acquisition of theme parks. The Company is also engaged in the car sharing business, education business, healthcare business, and renewable energy business, real estate business and other businesses.

name: JAPAN TOBACCO INC
businessSummary: Japan Tobacco Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the tobacco business, the pharmaceutical business and the processed food business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Tobacco segment manufactures and sells manufactured cigarettes in Japan and overseas. The Pharmaceuticals segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of prescription pharmaceuticals. The Processed Foods segment manufactures and sells frozen and room-temperature processed foods and seasonings. In addition, the Company also engages in real estate leasing and other businesses. The Company's tobacco brand portfolio includes the Winston, Camel, Mevius and LD brands.

name: NIPPON SODA CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Soda Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical products. The Chemical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial chemicals, synthetic chemicals, dye products, functional materials, eco-care products, pharmaceuticals and medical intermediates, among others. The Agricultural Chemical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of fungicides, insecticides, miticides, herbicides and industrial fungicides. The Business Firms segment offers chemicals, synthetic resins, industrial machineries and devices, among others. The Transportation and Warehouse segment is engaged in the provision of warehouse and transportation services. The Construction segment is involved in the plant construction and civil engineering businesses. The Others segment is involved in the casting, processing and sale of alloy, the treatment of industrial wastes, the leasing of lands and equipment, the manufacture and sale of molded synthetic resin, among others.

name: ZEON CORP
businessSummary: Zeon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the elastomer materials business and the high-performance materials business. The Company operates through two segments. The Elastomer Materials segment produces and sells synthetic rubber, synthetic latex, and chemical products. The High-Performance Materials segment produces and sells high-performance resins, high-performance components, electronic materials, battery materials, toner, chemicals, and medical equipment. The Company also sells reaction injection molding (RIM) compounds, coatings, and other products.

name: JAPAN OIL TRANSPORTATION CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Oil Transportation Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation of petroleum products, high-pressure gas and petrochemical products, and the leasing and rental of shipping containers. The Company operates through four business segments. The Petroleum Transportation segment is engaged in the railway tankers and lorries transportation for petroleum products such as gasoline and kerosene. The Chemical Products and Container Transportation segment is engaged in the railway tankers and lorries transportation for petrochemical products, and the leasing and rental of various containers. The High-Pressure Gas Transportation segment is engaged in the railway tankers and lorries transportation for high-pressure gas, as well as multimodal transportation. The Other segment is engaged in the solar power generation business.

name: NIPPN CORP.
businessSummary: Nippn Corp, formerly Nippon Flour Mills Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the flour milling business and the food business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Flour Milling segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wheat flour, bran, buckwheat flour and premix products. The Food segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of household wheat flour, premix, pasta, frozen food, prepared food and rice flour products. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate, the manufacture and sale of pet food products, the design, manufacture and installation of equipment for food industry, the freight transportation business, the development of information processing systems, the sale of health food products, as well as the operation of donut shops.

name: NIPPON PAPER INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Paper Industries Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the paper and paperboard business, lifestyle-related business, energy business, and wood, building materials, civil engineering, and construction-related business. It has four business segments. The Paper and Paperboard Business segment manufactures and sells paper, paperboard, pulp, and papermaking raw materials. The Lifestyle-related Business segment manufactures and sells household paper, processed paper products, and chemical products. The Energy Business segment manufactures and sells electricity. The Wood, Building materials, Civil Engineering, and Construction-related Business segment purchases and sells wood, manufactures and sells building materials, and engages in civil engineering and construction. Other businesses include logistics and leisure businesses.

name: JAPAN STEEL WORKS LTD
businessSummary: Japan Steel Works Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in industrial machinery business. The Industrial Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, and provision of maintenance services for resin manufacturing and processing machinery, electronic component and display manufacturing equipment, and semiconductor-related equipment. The profile and engineering segment manufactures and sells general cast and forged steel products such as power generation components and nuclear power related components, cast and forged steel components such as functional materials, clad steel sheets, etc. The segment also engages in various non-destructive testing and welding processes, and monitoring, maintenance, inspection, and repair of various equipment and devices. The other segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacturing and sales of new products, and business support and management service business.

name: NSK LTD
businessSummary: NSK Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of bearings, automobile-related products and precision machinery products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Industrial Machinery Business segment manufactures and sells bearings, precision equipment-related products, condition monitoring systems, and other products for general industry. The Automotive Business segment manufactures and sells bearings, automatic transmission parts, and other products for automobile and automobile parts manufacturers. Major products include ball bearings, hub unit bearings, tapered roller bearings, ball screws, linear guides, condition monitoring systems, and components for automatic transmissions. The Company also manufactures and sells steel balls and machinery and equipment.

name: NIPPON SEIKI CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON SEIKI CO., LTD. is a manufacturing company that operates in four business segments. The Automobile and General Instrument segment offers measuring gauges for four-wheel and two-wheel vehicles, head-up displays, general measuring gauges and various sensors. The Consumer Equipment segment offers operating panels for office automation (OA) and information equipment, controllers for air-conditioning and household equipment, assemblies for factory automation (FA) and amusement units, as well as high-density mounting boards. The Automobile Sales segment is engaged in the sale of new and secondhand automobiles, and the provision of car inspection and maintenance services. The Others segment is engaged in the transportation of cargoes, the development and sale of software, the entrusted accounting business, and the processing and sale of resin materials, the providing of displaying elements and modules for liquid crystal and organic electroluminescence (EL), among others.

name: NIPPON FINE CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Fine Chemical Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of industrial, pharmaceutical and cosmetic chemicals as well as household products. The Company operates in two segments. The Industrial Products segment is engaged in the manufacturing, sales and purchasing of cosmetic raw materials, pharmaceutical intermediates, resin additives, leather oils, vegetable fats and oils, synthetic resin products etc. The Household Products segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of industrial detergents, medicated soap solution, eradication and disinfectant, and insect repellent etc. Other businesses include real estate operation and consignment business of pharmacology and safety test.

name: NIPPON SUISAN KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Nissui Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in marine products business, food business, fine business and logistics business, as well as research and services related to each business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Marine Products Business segment is engaged in the fishing business, aquaculture business, as well as processing and trading business. The Food Business segment is engaged in the processing business and the chilled business. The Fine Business segment is engaged in the production and sale of pharmaceutical raw materials, functional raw materials, and functional foods. The Logistics Business segment is engaged in refrigerated warehouse business, delivery business and customs clearance business. The Company is also engaged in the construction, repair, operation and engineering of ships.

name: NJS CO LTD
businessSummary: NJS Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the water and sewerage business, and the environment business. The Company has two regional segments. The Company is mainly engaged in the construction consulting business, the development and provision of consulting services and software through the life cycle of water and sewage infrastructures, the provision of research, design, construction management and operation consulting services, the provision of disaster prevention and mitigation measures, environmental planning and environmental assessments, the provision of support services for water and sewage operation business, the provision of residents services, financial accounting and facility management services, and public-private partnership services, management improvement support services, the water and sewage consulting business in overseas, as well as the leasing, sale and management of real estate. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets.

name: NIPPON SHINYAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Shinyaku Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals and functional foods. The Company has two business segments. The Pharmaceutical Business segment conducts research and development in three focus areas: hematology, intractable and rare diseases (pulmonary arterial hypertension, muscular dystrophy, etc.), and urological and gynecological diseases. The Functional Food Business segment conducts research and development mainly in three categories: health food ingredients, quality-stabilizing preservatives, and protein preparations. Other businesses include business support, non-life insurance agency and life insurance solicitation, real estate rental, and educational support services.

name: NIPPON SHOKUBAI CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Shokubai Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals. It has two business segments. The Materials Business segment includes acrylic acid, acrylic esters, ethylene oxide, ethylene glycol, ethanolamine, special esters, superabsorbent polymers, maleic anhydride, and process catalysts. The Solutions Business segment includes polymers for concrete admixtures, glycol ethers, secondary compounds, alcohol ethoxylates, water-soluble polymers such as detergent raw materials, pharmaceutical intermediates, electronic information materials, iodine compounds, resins for adhesives and paints, ethyleneimine derivatives, adhesive products, automotive catalysts, denitrification catalysts, dioxin decomposition catalysts, exhaust gas treatment equipment, wet oxidation catalysts, and battery materials.

name: SUNNEXTA GROUP INC
businessSummary: Sunnexta Group Inc, formerly Japan Corporate Housing Service Inc is mainly engaged in the provision of solutions that solve issues related to human resources and general affairs. The Company operates in three business segments. The Corporate Housing Management Agency segment is engaged in the outsourcing business of company housing, dormitories and parking lots for client companies. It provides client company management services such as introduction of rented company housing properties, contract and occupancy procedures, payment of rent, and checking of restoration costs when leaving. The Facility Management segment provides total management services from repairs based on facility management centered on condominiums. The Others segment provides cost reduction and operational efficiency services for the management departments of client companies, and secure support services for systems, equipment, and equipment related to crime prevention, disaster prevention, security and safety.

name: JAPAN SYSTEM TECHNIQUES CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan System Techniques Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the software business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Software segment is engaged in the development of software that is tailor-made to meet the individual needs of customers. The GAKUEN segment is engaged in the development and sale of school business reform packages and related services. The System Sale segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of information technology (IT) equipment, hardware and software, as well as the building of information and communication infrastructure. The Medical Big Data segment provides services for automatic inspection, analysis, and notification of medical expenses for receipts.

name: NIPPON SYSTEMWARE CO LTD
businessSummary: NSW Inc, formerly Nippon Systemware Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing information technology (IT) solutions, service solutions and product solutions. The Company operates through three segments. The IT Solution segment consists of the business solutions business, the financial and public solutions business, and the system equipment sales business. The Service Solution segment consists of the digital solution business and the cloud/infrastructure service business. The Product Solution segment consists of the embedded development business and device development business.

name: NIPPON SANSO HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Nippon Sanso Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of gas and related equipment. The Company operates in five segments which are Japan Gas segment, the United States Gas segment, the Europe Gas segment, the Asia and Oceania Gas segment, and the Thermos segment. The Company provides gas products, including oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, helium, hydrogen, acetylene, medical gas, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas and special gas; equipment and materials, including electronic related equipment, fusing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, welding materials, medical equipment, air separation equipment; the assembling, processing, inspection and maintenance of electronic components; and stainless steel thermos bottles.

name: AOZORA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Aozora Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking business. The Company also engages in business related to financial services such as financial products trading business and others, as well as debt management and collection business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Institutional Banking Group segment includes loans, deposits, sales of financial products, private equity investment, and other businesses. The Structured Finance Group segment includes acquisition finance, environmental project finance, rehabilitation finance, and real estate finance. The International Business Group segment includes overseas investment and financing. The Market Group segment includes the sale and trade of derivatives and foreign exchange products, and other businesses. The Customer Relation Group segment includes the sale of loans, deposits, and financial products to corporate clients, and the sale of deposits, mutual funds, and insurance to retail clients.

name: NIKKON HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nikkon Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation, warehousing, packaging, and testing businesses. It has four segments. The Transportation Business segment transports completed four-wheeled and two-wheeled automobiles and auto parts, housing equipment, agricultural machinery. The Warehousing Business segment stores completed four-wheeled and two-wheeled automobiles and auto parts, housing equipment, agricultural machinery. The Packaging Business segment provides distribution processing, delivery agency services for auto parts, and export packaging. The Testing Business segment tests completed four-wheeled and two-wheeled automobiles and auto parts, agricultural machinery. Other businesses include customs clearance, vehicle repair and maintenance, petroleum product sales, non-life insurance agency services, real estate sales, rental and intermediary management, waste disposal and collection, power generation and sales, and others.

name: NCS&A CO LTD
businessSummary: NCS&A CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of integrated information services, including the design, development, operation support and maintenance of systems. The systems development business is engaged in the design of systems, the development of software, and the sale of customized packaged software products. The services business is engaged in the provision of maintenance services for computer equipment and other hardware, and system support services for enterprise computer systems, as well as the operation of inbound and outbound call centers for distribution and mail order fields. The system equipment sales business is engaged in the sale of computer equipment and peripherals, and packaged software products.

name: NIHON KOHDEN CORP
businessSummary: NIHON KOHDEN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of medical electronic equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance and repair services. The Company mainly operates medical electronics related business. The Company offers electroencephalograph, electromyographic, evoked potential testing equipment, electrocardiographs, cardiac catheterization equipment, diagnostic information systems and related consumables (paper, electrodes, catheters and others), biological information monitors, clinical information systems, artificial respiration, artificial ear, hemocytometer, ultrasonic diagnostic equipment, research equipment and transformers, among others. The Company is also engaged in the sales promotion for its products, as well as the general affair-related and manpower dispatching businesses.

name: JAPAN AVIATION ELECTRONICS INDUSTRY LTD
businessSummary: Japan Aviation Electronics Industry, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of connectors, interface solution equipment and others, as well as the purchase and sale of the other related equipment and parts. The Company operates through three business segments. The Connector segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of various connectors for use in mobile devices, automobiles, industrial machinery and infrastructure, among others. The Interface Solutions segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of automotive products, industrial machinery and infrastructure products. The Aircraft segment is involved in the production of flight control equipment, inertial navigation equipment, defense and space electronic equipment, drive equipment and sensor packages, as well as the manufacture and sale of aircraft and infrastructure and automotive products. The Company is also involved in the sale of other goods and the service business.

name: JAPAN AIRLINES CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Airlines Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that operates businesses including air transportation, cargo, finance and travel. The Company operates through three business segments. The Full-Service Carrier Business segment operates air transportation services connecting the world with Japan, cities with regions, as well as cargo and mail services that combine the cargo space of its own passenger aircraft and dedicated freighter aircraft. The Low-Cost Carrier (LCC) Business segment operates air transportation services connecting North America, Asia, Japan, China and other regions. The Mileage/Finance & Commerce Business segment operates mileage programs, provides credit card services and engages in wholesale business. The Company also operates a travel business. The travel business plans and sells travel using air transportation and develops and operates systems.

name: JCR PHARMACEUTICALS CO LTD
businessSummary: JCR Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical business, as well as the medical and research equipment business. The Company operates in two segments. The Pharmaceutical segment engages in the research, production, purchase and sale of medical drugs and pharmaceutical raw materials. The Medical and Research Equipment segment engages in the purchase and sale of the medical and research equipment.

name: NIPPON LIGHT METAL HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Light Metal Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of alumina and chemical products, ingots, plates, extruded products, processed products, foil, and powder products. The Company operates through four business segments. The Alumina and Chemical Products and Ingots segment manufactures and sells alumina, aluminum hydroxide, various chemical products, and aluminum ingots and alloys. The Plate and Extruded Products segment manufactures and sells aluminum plates and aluminum extruded products. The Processed Products and Related Businesses segment manufactures and sells transportation-related products, freezers and refrigerator panels, and other aluminum processed products, as well as provides services such as transportation, information processing, and insurance agency services. The Foil and Powder Products segment manufactures and sells foil and powder products.

name: HI-LEX CORP
businessSummary: Hi-Lex Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of control cables and accessories for the remote operation of motorcycles and automobiles, industrial equipment, residential equipment and ships. The Company has six geographical segments: Japan, North America (United States and Mexico), China, Asia (mainly South Korea, Indonesia and India), South America and Europe (United Kingdom, Hungary, Russia, Germany) based on the production and sales systems. The Japan segment is also engaged in the production and sale of medical equipment, besides control systems. The Europe segment is also engaged in the design, sale, purchasing and testing of western manufacturers for global models besides control systems.

name: JAPAN AIRPORT TERMINAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Airport Terminal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the facilities management and operation business, product sales business, and food and beverage business. The Company operates three segments. The Facilities Management and Operation segment is engaged in the leasing, maintenance, operation, and other services for airline passengers at Haneda Airport's passenger terminal facilities. The Product Sales segment is engaged in the sale of goods to airline passengers, wholesale of goods to airport terminal building companies, and other related businesses. The Food and Beverage segment is engaged in the provision of food and beverage services to users of Haneda Airport and Narita Airport, the manufacture and sale of in-flight meals, and other related businesses.

name: NIPPON KINZOKU CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON KINZOKU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cold-rolled stainless steel strips, specially polished steel strips and processed products, as well as the development of related business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Polished Steel Strip segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of cold-rolled stainless steel strips and polished specialty steel strips. The Processed Product segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of mold steel and stainless precision steel.

name: NIPPON GAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Gas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the gas business and related businesses, such as the production, supply, and sale of city gas, the sale of liquefied petroleum gas and gas equipment, and the construction of gas piping.
