It operates in four segments. The City Gas segment is engaged in the production, supply, and sale of city gas. The Liquefied Petroleum Gas segment sells liquefied petroleum gas and equipment for liquefied petroleum gas. The Order Construction and Gas Equipment segment is engaged in the construction of pipelines for the supply of city gas and liquefied petroleum gas, the sale of equipment and housing-related facilities. The Electricity segment is engaged in the sale of electricity. The Company is also engaged in the maintenance and construction of information and communications infrastructure, the operation of sports clubs, the management and operation of designated management facilities, and the sale of plants and agricultural products.

name: NGK INSULATORS LTD
businessSummary: NGK Insulators Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the environmental, digital society, and energy & industry businesses. The company operates three business segments. The Environment Business segment provides automotive exhaust gas purification components and sensors. The Digital Society Business segment provides products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, products for the electronics industry, beryllium copper products, and molds. The Energy & Industry Business segment provides sodium and sulfur batteries, insulators and overhead line fittings, equipment for power transmission, substation, and distribution, insulator cleaning equipment and disaster prevention equipment, corrosion-resistant equipment for the chemical industry, liquid and gas membrane separation equipment, combustion equipment and refractory materials, and radioactive waste treatment equipment. The Company also operates an insurance agency business and a golf course management business.

name: JAPAN PROPERTY MANAGEMENT CENTER CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Property Management Center Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of property management business nationwide, centered on lump-sum lease business. The Company rents real estate properties (rental housing such as rental condominiums and rental apartments) from real estate owners and subleases them to general residents. The Company is engaged in the rental management on behalf of landlords. Construction work, remodeling work, real estate property management and brokerage, and management of elderly housing are operated by partner companies (real estate management companies, construction companies, remodeling companies, and long-term care companies) nationwide. The Company is also engaged in the delinquency guarantee business, insurance business, broadband business (JPMC Hikari), sales business of building materials, and contract for renewal, remodeling and renovation work in the metropolitan area.

name: NIPPON KAYAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON KAYAKU CO., LTD. is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of functional chemical products. The Company has three business segments. The Functional Chemical segment manufactures and sells functional materials, such as epoxy resin, ultraviolet curable resin and high-performance chemicals; pigment materials, including functional dyes, pigment for inkjet printers and others; catalysts, such as catalysts for acrylic and methacrylic acid manufacturing, as well as coloring materials, such as dyes and special coloring materials for nonfibrous products, among others. The Pharmaceutical segment supplies pharmaceutical products, medical intermediates and diagnostic medicines, among others. The Safety Systems segment provides inflators for airbags and micro gas generators for seatbelt pretensioners. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of agricultural chemicals.

name: NKK SWITCHES CO LTD
businessSummary: NKK SWITCHES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various industrial switches. The Company operates in three regional segments. The Japan segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of various industrial switches, and the processing of switches manufactured by external customers in Japan. The America segment is involved in the sale of switch products in North America. The Asia segment is involved in the assembly processing of switch products in China, and the sale of products in Hong Kong, China, and rest of Asia.

name: NIPPON CARBON CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Carbon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of carbon and silicon carbide products. The Company operates through three segments. The Carbon Products segment produces artificial graphite electrodes, impermeable graphite products, isotropic high-purity graphite products, mechanical graphite products, general-purpose carbon fibers and graphite fibers, resin-containing graphite fiber packing, flexible graphite sealing materials, and lithium-ion battery anode materials. The Silicon Carbide Products segment produces silicon carbide continuous fibers. The Other segment manufactures industrial machinery, repairs machinery, and rents parking lots.

name: ORACLE CORP JAPAN
businessSummary: Oracle Corp Japan is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of software including database, middleware and application, hardware including servers, storage and network equipment, the provision of cloud services and the support for product introduction and use. The Company operates in three business segments. The Cloud & License segment is engaged in the sale of database management software, middleware, application software used in corporate activities, and the provision of services for these software and hardware through the Internet, as well as the provision of software license renewal rights and technical support. The Hardware Systems segment is engaged in the sale of servers, storage, engineered systems, network equipment, as well as the provision of technical support, repair service and maintenance for hardware products. The Service segment provides consulting services, advanced customer support services.

name: NIHON M&A CENTER HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nihon M&A Center Holdings Inc, formerly Nihon M&A Center Inc, is a Japan-based company principally involved in the merger and acquisition (M&A) brokerage business. The Company mainly works on projects of small and medium-sized enterprises in Japan. The Company mainly operates M&A brokerage business. The flow of the M&A brokerage business includes marketing, contracting of the transferring company, evaluation of the transferring companies, proposal to the buyer companies, various negotiations and adjustment of contracts. Other businesses include the operation of membership organizations (membership fee income) of regional M&A centers operated by accounting offices in each region.

name: NIPPON EXPRESS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nippon Express Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in logistics business, security transportation business, heavy goods construction business and logistics support business. The Company operates through four segments. The Logistics segment is mainly engaged in railway transportation business, truck transportation business, warehousing business, air transportation business, marine transportation business, and harbor transportation business. The Security Transportation segment is engaged in security services and related businesses. The Heavy Goods Construction segment is engaged in the transportation, erection, installation and incidental business of heavy goods. The Logistics Support segment is engaged in the sales of logistics equipment, packaging materials, vehicles, petroleum, liquefied petroleum gas and other products, the maintenance of vehicles, as well as real estate business, logistics finance business and worker dispatch business.

name: WAVELOCK HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: WAVELOCK HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of composite materials made from plastic, fiber and paper. The Company operates through four business segments. Interior segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of wallpaper products, as well as the sale of related products. Weaving segment is involved in the manufacture of net products made of synthetic fibers, as well ae the sale of insect-proof nets for general houses, insect-proof nets for rehabilitation, agricultural material nets, civil engineering materials and construction temporary materials. Advanced Technology segment is involved in the sale of metal decorative films, glitter tapes, special printing, functional films and sheets and opening tapes. Industrial Materials and Packaging Materials segment is involved in the sale of films and plastic sheets including construction temporary materials, agricultural materials, food packaging materials.

name: NIPPON INSURE CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Insure Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of services related to the guarantee business. The guarantee business includes rent obligation guarantee service, nursing care expense obligation guarantee service, and hospitalization expense obligation guarantee service. The rent obligation guarantee service provides guarantees for rent obligations in rental housing and other properties. The nursing care expense obligation guarantee service is a guarantee product that assumes the risk of nonpayment of nursing care facility fees by concluding a guarantee consignment contract between a nursing care facility user and the company, and acting as a joint guarantor for the facility user. The hospitalization expense obligation guarantee service is a guarantee product that assumes the risk of nonpayment of hospitalization expenses by concluding a guarantee consignment contract with hospitalized patients and becoming a joint guarantor.

name: NIPPON SHEET GLASS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Sheet Glass Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the architectural glass business, automotive glass business, and functional glass business. It operates through four segments. The Architectural Glass segment manufactures and sells flat glass products and processed glass products for interior and exterior use for the building materials market, as well as glass for solar panels. The Automotive Glass segment manufactures and sells various glass products for the new car assembly and repair markets. The Functional Glass segment consists of several businesses, such as the manufacture and sale of thin glass used for display cover glass, lenses and light guides for printers, and the manufacture and sale of glass fiber products such as engine timing belt components. The Other segment operates other small businesses.

name: NIPPON ANTENNA CO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPON ANTENNA CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of transmission and reception products as well as telecommunications engineering business. The Company operates in two segments. The Transmission and Reception Products Manufacturing segment is engaged in the development, manufacturing and sales of antennas and receivers for terrestrial digital broadcasting. The Engineering segment is engaged in the telecommunications engineering such as cable television (CATV) engineering, etc.

name: JAPAN ASIA INVESTMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Asia Investment Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the investment business in Japan and other areas of Asia. The Company is engaged in the investment through its funds such as investment partnerships and others, which are established by institutional investors and other investors and by the Group's own investment. The Company operates through three investment businesses. The management and operation business is involved in the conduction, management and operation of funds, as well as the provision of services of undertakes accounting and in-kind management. The investment business is involved in the investment in private equity and projects such as renewable energy, healthcare and smart agriculture. The other business in involved in the provision of peripheral services such as provides various types of information and services for supporting investee companies and investing in projects.

name: NIPPO LTD
businessSummary: NIPPO LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial materials and plastic molded articles. The Company has four business segments. The Mobility segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of resin molded products such as powertrain mechanical components and electronic control components for automobiles. The Electronics segment is engaged in the sale of electric materials, parts, jigs and equipment for manufacturers of electronic components and clean energy. The Precision Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of resin molded products for office automation equipment, digital imaging equipment and medical equipment. The Household Equipment segment is engaged in the sale of resin molded articles, control units for blinds and nursing beds, high functional materials and equipment. The Company is also engaged in the radio frequency identifier (RFID) business.

name: NITTOC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: NITTOC CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the construction industry. The Company, along with its subsidiaries, is engaged in the civil engineering works, the purchase and distribution of materials, as well as the non-life insurance agency business. The Company is also engaged in the sales of goods materials and the provision of insurance agency service.

name: NITTO BOSEKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Nitto Boseki Co Ltd is principally engaged in the electronic materials business, medical business, composite materials business, materials and chemicals business, insulation materials business, and other businesses. The Company operates in six business segments. The Electronic Materials segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass fiber products for electronic materials. The Medical segment develops, manufactures, and sells in-vitro diagnostic reagents. The Composites segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass fiber products for plastic reinforcement materials. The Materials and Chemicals segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass fiber products for industrial materials, chemical products, interlining products, functional materials, and dishcloths. The Insulation Materials segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass wool products for insulation, heat retention, and sound absorption. The Other segment designs industrial machinery and equipment.

name: NITTO DENKO CORP
businessSummary: Nitto Denko Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the industrial tape business, the optronics business and the life science business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Industrial Tapes segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of basic functional materials such as bonding materials and protective materials, as well as automotive materials. The Optronics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of information functional materials, printed circuits and process materials. The Human Life Science segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of nucleic acid contract manufacturing, nucleic acid synthesis materials, nucleic acid drug discovery, medical-related materials and other life sciences, membranes such as polymer separation membranes, and personal care materials such as functional films for hygiene materials. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of new businesses and other products.

name: NITTO FUJI FLOUR MILLING CO LTD
businessSummary: NITTO FUJI FLOUR MILLING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the flour manufacture and food business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Flour and Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of flour, mix flour, food products, as well as the design and construction of flour manufacture and noodle making factories, as well as the wheat and wheat silo machines. The Restaurant segment operates Kentucky Fried Chicken (KFC) restaurants as franchisee, and also operates other kinds of restaurants. The Transportation segment is involved in the transportation of wheat and other products.

name: NITTO KOGYO CORP
businessSummary: NITTO KOGYO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of switchboard-related products, as well as the purchase and sale of information and communication equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Switchboard-related segment manufactures and sells switchboards, cabinets, breakers, switches and parts, among others. The Information and Communication related Distribution segment purchases and sells information communication equipment and other materials. The Works and Services segment is engaged in the construction of electrical equipment and network systems, and the provision of maintenance service.

name: NITTO KOHKI CO LTD
businessSummary: NITTO KOHKI CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of quick-connecting fuild couplings, machine tools and others. The Company operates in four business segments. The Quick-connecting Fluid Couplings segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of quick-connecting fluid couplings. The Machine Tools segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools. The Linear Motor Driven Pumps segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of linear motor driven pumps. The Construction Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction machinery.

name: NITTETSU MINING CO LTD
businessSummary: Nittetsu Mining Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in resource business, machinery & environment business, real estate business and renewable energy business. The Company operates in five business segments. Ore segment mainly sells limestone, crushed stones, processed products and other related products produced from limestone mines owned by the Company. Metal segment is involved in the smelting and sale of copper bullion and the sale of copper concentrate. Machinery & Environment segment is involved in the sale of water treatment agents and the manufacture and sale of environmentally-friendly products such as dust collectors. Real Estate segment is involved in the rental of office buildings, condominiums, stores, factories and warehouses, as well as the sale of real estate. Renewable Energy segment develops environment-friendly energy through the geothermal sector, solar power generation and hydroelectric power generation.

name: NITCHITSU CO LTD
businessSummary: NITCHITSU CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the machinery-related business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Machinery-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of marine equipment and industrial equipment, the installation and sale of mechanized equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of air preheaters and elements of air preheater. The Resource-related segment is engaged in the mining, processing and sale of crystalline limestone, the manufacture and sale of purified silica powders, the purchase and sale of siliceous sandstone, crushed stone, sand and gravel. The Real Estate-related segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings. The Materials-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of heat-resistant paints, and purchase, processing and sale of Linatex which is a high-purity natural rubber.

name: NISSO PRONITY CO LTD
businessSummary: Nisso Group Co Ltd, formerly Nisso Pronity Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in metal processing, rubber processing, construction, and tile business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Metal Processing segment is engaged in planning, design, processing, manufacturing, and sales of various metal products in the construction, energy, and machinery and equipment fields. The Rubber Products segment is engaged in the planning, design, processing, manufacturing, and sales of various rubber products in the housing, machinery, and public infrastructure fields. The Construction segment is the construction business associated with the above businesses. Tile segment is engaged in planning, designing, processing, manufacturing, and sales of exterior and interior tiles for houses and buildings. It also provides manufacturing web services, contracted system development, and wood processing.

name: NIHON SUIDO CONSULTANTS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nihon Suido Consultants Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the water supply and sewerage related construction consulting business. In the development of social infrastructure such as lifelines such as water supply and sewerage, and disaster prevention related to rivers and erosion control, the Company mainly receives orders from public agencies and other public institutions and provides technical consulting related to surveys and designs. The Company is also engaged in the construction consulting business for river, environment, architecture, and the mechanical and electrical. Overseas, the Company also operates in Southeast Asia, India, and Africa.

name: NISSHINBO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the wireless and communications, microdevices, brakes and other businesses. The Company has seven business segments. The Wireless and Communication segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of wireless communication equipment. The Microdevice segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The Brake segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of friction materials for automobile brakes. The Precision Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechatronics products and plastic molded products. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of rigid urethane foams, carbon products and others. The Textile segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cotton yarns, spandex products and clothing. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of real estate. The Company also sells food and industrial materials and provides telemedicine services.

name: NISSHIN GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: NISSHIN GROUP HOLDINGS Company, Limited, formerly NISSHIN FUDOSAN Co., Ltd., is mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the planning and sale of condominiums, as well as the leasing of real estate properties. The Construction segment is engaged in the planning and construction of condominiums, as well as civil engineering works. The Real Estate Management segment is involved in the management of common areas of condominiums, buildings and leasing properties, the renovation and large-scale repair business, as well as the sale of leasing condominiums. The Golf Course segment operates golf courses.

name: NISSHIN SEIFUN GROUP INC
businessSummary: Nisshin Seifun Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the flour milling business, food business, and prepared meals and prepared foods business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Flour Milling segment manufactures and sells flour, bran, and flour-related products. The segment also sells frozen foods and their ingredients, operates restaurants using flour-related commercial products, and sells packaging materials. The Foods segment manufactures and sells premixes, wheat flour for home use, pasta, pasta sauce, frozen foods, food ingredients for baking and other uses, biochemical products, drug discovery research support business, and health foods. The Mid-market Foods and Prepared Foods segment manufactures and sells prepared foods such as boxed lunches, prepared foods, and cooked noodles, and operates directly managed department stores. The Company also operates businesses related to engineering, mesh cloth, and cargo handling and storage businesses.

name: NISSIN FOODS HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Nissin Foods Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of instant foods, such as instant noodles. The Company is also involved in other food business, logistics business and other related businesses. The Company also conducts business overseas through the manufacture and sale of instant noodles and other products. The Company operates the instant noodles business, refrigerated and beverages business, and confectionery business through six segments, including Nisshin Foods segment, Myojo Foods segment, Refrigerated and Beverages Segment, Confectionery Segment, Americas Segment, and China Segment. Nisshin Foods segment, Myojo Foods segment, Americas segment and China segment manufacture and sell instant bag noodles and cup noodles. Refrigerated and Beverages Segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of chilled products, frozen products and beverages. The Confectionery Segment manufactures and sells confectionery products.

name: NS TOOL CO LTD
businessSummary: NS Tool Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production and sale of end mills, which are cutting tools that are attached to machining centers (machine tools) to process metals. The Company operates in two business segments. End Mill segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cutting tools centering on carbide small-diameter end mills. Others segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic moldings focusing on tool cases. The product sizes include end mill (6mm or less), end mill (over 6mm), and end mill (others).

name: NISSIN CORP
businessSummary: Nissin Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of domestic and international logistics businesses, as well as travel and real estate businesses. The Company has three business segments. The Logistics Business segment is involved in air cargo and sea cargo businesses, primarily focused on international logistics. The Travel Business segment is involved in the travel business, primarily focused on business travel. The Real Estate Business segment has a consolidated subsidiary that specializes in real estate sales and brokerage, as well as the leasing of land, buildings and others, through the Company and its consolidated subsidiaries, whose main business is logistics.

name: NIPRO CORP
businessSummary: Nipro Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical, pharmaceutical, and pharma packaging businesses. It has three segments. The Medical segment consists of the domestic business division and the international business division. The domestic business division sells medical devices related to injections and infusions, artificial organs, high-performance medicines, and dialysis. The international business division, centered on the head office, has medical device manufacturing and sales bases overseas for regional expansion, selling medical devices related to injections and infusions, artificial organs, and diabetes. The Pharmaceutical segment sells pharmaceuticals related to kit preparation containers on a contract basis from pharmaceutical companies. The Pharma Packaging segment sells medical glass products such as glass tubes and ampoules, thermos flasks, and kit preparation containers in Japan.

name: NISSAN MOTOR CO LTD
businessSummary: Nissan Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles and parts, as well as the provision of sales financial services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric vehicles, compact cars, light cars, minivans, commercial vehicles, trucks, micro buses and other automobiles, as well as related parts. The Sales Finance segment is engaged in the sales finance business and the leasing business to support sales activities of automobile business.

name: NISSAN CHEMICAL CORP
businessSummary: Nissan Chemical Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the agricultural chemicals business, functional materials business and wholesale business. The Company operates through six business segments. The Agrochemicals Business segment provides herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, plant growth regulators, and other agrochemicals, as well as bulk veterinary pharmaceuticals. The Functional Materials Business segment provides display materials, semiconductor materials, and inorganic colloids. The Wholesale Business segment is engaged in the wholesale of chemical products. The Chemicals Business segment provides basic chemicals such as sulfuric acid, nitric acid, and ammonia, and fine chemicals such as specialty epoxies for encapsulants. The Pharmaceuticals Business segment provides bulk pharmaceuticals for hypercholesterolemia treatments and fine chemicals. The Others segment provides fertilizers, landscape gardening, transportation, plant engineering, and other services.

name: NIKKO CO LTD
businessSummary: NIKKO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of asphalt plants, concrete plants, as well as environment and transport machinery. The Company operates in three business segments. Asphalt Plant-Related Business segment produces asphalt plants, recycling plants, as well as compound silos, among others. Concrete Plant-Related Business segment produces concrete plants, concrete pumps, as well as factory equipment for concrete product production, among others. Environment and Transportation Related Businesses segment produces environment and recycling plants, conveyor systems. The Company is also involved in the manufacture of pipe frame scaffolds, steel road boards, pipe supports, small concrete mixers, mortar mixers, sluice gates, crushers, among others, as well as the sale of real estate leasing and home renovation.

name: NIKKISO CO LTD
businessSummary: NIKKISO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial pumps, precision equipment and blood related products, among others. The Company operates in two business segments. Industrial Business segment conducts industrial business including the manufacture, sale and maintenance of industrial special pumps, as well as liquefied gas & industrial gas related equipment and devices. The Segment is also involved in precision equipment business, aerospace business and deep ultraviolet light emitting diode (LED) business. Medical Business segment’s products are dialysis-related products including hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, such as artificial dialysis machines, dialyzers, blood circuits, and powder-type dialysis agents. The Segment also manufactures, sells and maintains products and medicines related to CRRT (acute blood purification therapy), artificial pancreas devices that manage blood glucose, and energy devices for microwave surgery.

name: JGC HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: JGC Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general engineering and functional materials manufacturing businesses. The Company operates in two business segments. The Integrated Engineering segment is engaged in the planning, design, procurement, construction and testing of equipment, appliances and facilities for petroleum, petroleum refining, petrochemicals, gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG) and others, as well as the water and power generation business. The Functional Material Manufacture segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of products in the catalyst field, nanoparticle technology field, clean and safety field, electronic materials, high-performance ceramics field and the next generation energy field. The Company is also involved in consulting, office support, desalination, and crude oil and gas production and sales.

name: NIKKATO CORP
businessSummary: NIKKATO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the ceramics and engineering business. The Company has two business segments. The Ceramics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of functional ceramics such as thermal heating elements, oxygen sensors and ceramics filters, abrasion resistant ceramics such as ball mills and crushing balls, heat resistant ceramics such as thermocouple protection tubes, insulation tubes, core tubes, transportation rollers and heat treatment equipment, as well as physical and chemical ceramics such as evaporating dishes, crucibles and ceramics for experimental purposes. The products are mainly used for electronic parts, food, medicines, paints and others. The Engineering segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of heating equipment such as electric furnaces, vacuum furnaces and thermal treatment equipment, as well as measuring equipment such as temperature sensors, stress measurement equipment and measurement controllers.

name: NICCA CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: NICCA CHEMICAL CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of surfactants. The Company operates in two business segments. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals for textile processing, chemicals for information recording paper, resin raw materials, commercial cleaning chemicals, chemicals for medical and nursing care facilities, and other functional chemicals. The Cosmetics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hair care agent, hair color agent, perm agent, scalp care agent and styling agent. The other business is engaged in the contracted construction of facility works.

name: NICHIWA SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: NICHIWA SANGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of mixed feed products with grains as the main ingredients, and other livestock products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Feed segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mixed feed products for broilers, pigs, beef cattle, dairy cows, fishes, ducks, ostriches and rabbits, as well as the purchase and sale of livestock products. The Livestock Products segment is engaged in the production and sale of livestock products, the production of piglets, as well as the rearing and sale of pigs.

name: NICHIREI CORP
businessSummary: Nichirei Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in processed food business, fishery business, livestock business, low-temperature logistics business, real estate business and other businesses. The Company operates in five business segments. Processed Food segment is engaged in the manufacture, process and sale of frozen foods, processed agriculture products, retort foods and others. Marin Products segment is engaged in the process and trading of seafood products. Animal Husbandry segment is engaged in process and sale of poultry, breeds, as well as the sale of chicken for meat. Low-temperature Logistics segment is engaged in the third-party logistics business, the provision of storage, inventory control and others. Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and parking lots. The Company is also involved in the bioscience business, the personnel salary related business services, as well as the business related to greening management and cleaning services.

name: NICHIRIN CO LTD
businessSummary: NICHIRIN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sale of hoses for automobiles. The Company is engaged in manufacturing and sales of automotive hoses, automotive hose parts and nonferrous metal materials (molybdenum, vanadium), as well as manufacturing and sales of piping parts such as rubber and resin hose through its subsidiaries.

name: SOJITZ CORP
businessSummary: Sojitz Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the buying, selling, and trading of goods, the manufacture and sale of products, the provision of services, the planning and coordination of projects, and financial activities. The Company operates in seven business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the wholesale of automobiles. The Aviation Industry and Transportation Projects Segment is engaged in aviation, transportation, and social infrastructure projects. The Infrastructure & Healthcare segment is engaged in the environmental infrastructure business. The Metals, Mineral Resources & Recycling Segment conducts mineral resources and resource recycling businesses. The Chemicals Segment provides various chemical raw materials and products. The Living Essentials & Agribusiness segment provides various food raw materials. The Retail & Consumer Services segment provides food and consumer goods distribution and convenience store operations.

name: NICHIBAN CO LTD
businessSummary: NICHIBAN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical products, adhesive tapes and adhesives, as well as related equipment. The Company has two business segments. The Medical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals based on cloth, paper, cellophane and plastic, medical equipment, cosmetics, medical auxiliary tapes, taping tapes and other tapes for medical use. The Tapes segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of adhesive tapes, adhesive sheets and related equipment for home and office use, and industrial use.

name: NICHIAS CORP
businessSummary: Nichias Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of heat insulating and sealing materials for plants and housing, fluororesin products, filter products and others. The Company operates in five segments. The Construction and Sales for Plants segment is engaged in the construction and maintenance of hot insulation works, fire-retardant works, soundproofing works and disaster prevention works. The Industrial Products segment is engaged in the provision of gasket packing, fluorine resin products, heat insulating materials and filters. The Advanced Product segment offers pipes and machinery for handling heat, liquid chemicals and gas. The Automobile Parts segment offers cylinder head gaskets and other parts. The Construction Material segment offers noncombustible matters and adiabatic materials.

name: NICHIA STEEL WORKS LTD
businessSummary: NICHIA STEEL WORKS, LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of ordinary wire products, special wire products and rivet wire products. It operates through four business segments. Special Wire Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hard steel wires, plated steel wires, steel flat wires, steel stranded wires, and wire ropes for motor vehicle industry, electric power and communications industries, and public works. Ordinary Wire Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of rock fall prevention nets, gabion, plated iron wires, and processed products using plated iron wires. Tack and Screw Product segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of torsia-type high-strength bolts, hexagonal high-strength bolts, and galvanized nithia (GN) bolts for civil engineering and construction industries. Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in real estate leasing of buildings and land. It also sells plating processing and by-products.

name: NISHIMATSUYA CHAIN CO LTD
businessSummary: Nishimatsuya Chain Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail of baby and children's lifestyle products. The children's clothing includes baby outerwear, underwear, and pajamas, boys' outerwear, underwear, and pajamas, and girls' outerwear, underwear, and pajamas. The Company also offers childcare and clothing accessories, baby formula and weaning supplies, hygiene and general merchandise, bedding, strollers and car seats, indoor items such as mats, chairs, racks, and walkers, hats, shoes, rain gear, and other clothing accessories, toys, and gift sets. The baby and maternity clothing includes newborn clothing, maternity products, and Japanese clothing. The Company also offers vending machine products. The Company’s products are sold primarily directly to customers through stores and online sales, primarily for cash or other payment. It also sells Nishimatsuya Chain Gift Cards for gifting.

name: WEST JAPAN RAILWAY CO
businessSummary: West Japan Railway Co is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of passenger railway transportation services. The Company has four business segments. The Mobility segment is involved in the railway business, passenger automobile transportation business, and ship business. The Company operates in the Hokuriku, Kinki, Chugoku, and northern Kyushu areas, and is engaged in intercity transportation using Shinkansen and conventional express trains. It also operates construction and cleaning and maintenance businesses. The Distribution segment operates department stores, as well as retail and food services at major stations. The Real Estate segment sells and rents real estate using its real estate holdings, as well as operates shopping centers and hotels. The Travel and Regional Solutions segment is involved in travel and regional solutions. It also operates advertising, civil engineering and construction consulting, spatial information consulting, and information services.

name: NISHI-NIPPON FINANCIAL HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Nishi-Nippon Financial Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of financial services centering on banking business. The Banking segment mainly provides diverse financial products and services to local customers through deposit business, lending business, securities investment business, domestic exchange business, foreign exchange business, over-the-counter sales business of investment trusts and insurance products.

name: NISHI-NIPPON RAILROAD CO LTD
businessSummary: Nishi-Nippon Railroad Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based transportation company. The Company operates in five business segments. The Transportation segment operates railroad, bus, taxi and other transportation-related business. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and allotment sale of real estate properties, as well as other real estate-related businesses. The Distribution segment is involved in the storage business. The Logistics segment is involved in the international and domestic logistics business. The Leisure and Service segment is involved in the hotel, leisure, travel, restaurant, advertising agency and other business. The Company is also engaged in the integrated circuit (IC) card, automobile maintenance-related, construction and metal recycle business.

name: NISHIKAWA KEISOKU CO LTD
businessSummary: NISHIKAWA KEISOKU CO., Ltd. is a company mainly engaged in the sale of engineering equipment. The Company operates in four businesses. The control and information equipment system business provides computers and computer systems for process automation (PA) and factory automation (FA) controlling, detection devices including thermometers and flow meters, as well as control equipment including controllers and sequencers. It also provides engineering services, software production, instrumentation works, and maintenance services. The measuring equipment business provides various electrometric tools, oscilloscopes, communication measurement instruments and measuring systems. The analytical instrument segment provides organic chemistry analyzers and inorganic analyzers, and produces software for data analysis. The industrial machinery and others business provides environmental testing devices, hydraulic equipment, pneumatic equipment, industrial robots and thermostat baths.

name: NIKON CORP
businessSummary: Nikon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the imaging, video, precision machinery, healthcare, components, and digital manufacturing businesses. The Company operates in six business segments. The Imaging Business segment provides products and services such as interchangeable lens digital cameras, digital cameras with integrated lens and interchangeable lenses. The Precision Equipment Business segment provides products and services for flat panel display (FPD) lithography equipment and semiconductor lithography equipment. The Healthcare Business segment provides products and services of biological microscopes and ultra-wide-angle scanning laser ophthalmoscopes. The Components Business segment provides products and services such as optical components, optical parts, encoders and materials processing. The Digital Manufacturing Business segment provides products and services of industrial microscopes and measuring instruments. The Others segment engages in other businesses.

name: BSN MEDIA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: BSN Media Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the broadcasting business and general broadcasting business. The Company is engaged in the planning, production, and sales of broadcast programs. The Company is engaged in the planning, production, sales, and entertainment of various events including art, music, sports, movies, theater, performing arts, and science. The Company is also engaged in the planning, publishing, and sales of publications.

name: NANTO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Nanto Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking, leasing and credit guarantee and other financial business. The Company operates through two business segments. Banking segment is engaged in the deposits, loans, domestic exchange and foreign exchange. Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of leasing properties ranging from office equipment to large industrial equipment and automobiles for customers. The Company is also engaged in the provision of credit guarantee business, real estate leasing and management business, software development business, credit card business, employment service and securities business.

name: NANSO TRANSPORT CO LTD
businessSummary: NANSO Transport Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the freight car transport business, warehousing business, ancillary business, real estate business, construction business and other businesses. The Company operates through five business segments. The Lorry Transportation segment provides charter and freight trucks using freight trucks. The Warehousing segment is engaged in cargo storage operations using in-house and leased warehouses. The Ancillary segment is engaged in outsourcing work and general worker dispatching business in customer factories. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the provision of stores, offices and parking lots that meet customer needs, as well as the leasing business. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction and repair of buildings and other buildings of customers and the group company. The Company is also engaged in passenger car transport business and insurance agency business.

name: NANSIN CO LTD
businessSummary: NANSIN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of casters and dollies. The Company operates in three business segments. The Malaysia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of casters in Malaysia. The China segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of casters and dollies in China. The Britain segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate in Britain.

name: NANKAI PLYWOOD CO LTD
businessSummary: NANKAI PLYWOOD CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wooden building interior materials, as well as the sale of electric wires and electrical equipment. The Company operates through two business segments. The Wood Related segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of ceiling materials, storage materials, plywood and others, as well as the handling, packaging and transportation of raw materials and products. The Electric Wire Related segment is involved in the sale of electric wires and electrical equipment. The Company is also involved in the production and process of industrial and household synthetic resin products, as well as the real estate rental business.

name: NANKAI ELECTRIC RAILWAY CO LTD
businessSummary: Nankai Electric Railway Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the transportation business. The Company has six business segments. Nankai Electric Railway Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the transportation business. The Company has six business segments. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of real estate. The Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of shopping centers, station business and others. The Leisure Service segment is engaged in the amusement park business, the tour business, the hotel business, the boat race facility leasing business, the building management and maintenance business, funeral business and others. The Construction segment is engaged in building construction works. The Others segment is involved in the accounting and information processing businesses, among others.

name: NARUMIYA INTERNATIONAL CO LTD
businessSummary: NARUMIYA INTERNATIONAL Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in planning and sale of baby and children's clothing as a specialty store retailer of private label apparel. The Company mainly sells through department stores, shopping centers, outlet malls in real stores, as well as ecommerce such as own online sites and other companies' online sites. The Company's brands contain mezzo piano, BLUE CROSS, petit main, Lovetoxic and Pupil House.

name: NARASAKI SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: NARASAKI SANGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of electric appliances, materials and fuel. The Company has five business segments. The Electric Appliances Related segment is engaged in the sale of motors, control equipment, heavy electrical equipment, refrigeration equipment, precision processing equipment and others. The Machinery-related segment is engaged in the sale of food manufacturing equipment, laborsaving logistics equipment, grain storage equipment and others. The Material and Fuel-related segment is engaged in the sale of cements, concretes, concrete piles, autoclaved lightweight concrete (ALC) plates, petroleum, gas, asphalts and others. The Marine Transportation-related segment is engaged in the provision of marine transportation, customs, harbor operation, trucking, warehousing and other services. The Construction machinery-related segment is engaged in the sale of concrete pump trucks, rotary snow plows and road cutting pavement equipment.

name: NABTESCO CORP
businessSummary: Nabtesco Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the component solution business, transport solution business and accessibility solution business. The Company operates through three segments. The Component Solutions segment is engaged in the design, manufacture, sale, maintenance and repair of industrial robot parts and construction equipment. The Transport Solution segment is engaged in the design, manufacture, sale, maintenance and repair of railway vehicles brake and automatic door devices, aircraft parts, marine control devices and related parts. The Accessibility Solution segment is engaged in the design, manufacture, sale, installation, maintenance and repair of automatic door devices for buildings and general industries, platform safety equipment and related parts. The Company is also engaged in the design, manufacture, sale, maintenance and repair of packaging machines, machine tools, forging machines, and other general industrial machines.

name: NANO MRNA CO LTD
businessSummary: Nano Mrna Co Ltd, formerly NanoCarrier Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacturing and sales of pharmaceuticals. The Company develops businesses using the research and development of messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) medicine. The products under development are specialized in mRNA medicines. mRNA medicine is a medicine that prevents or treats diseases by administering artificially produced mRNA to the body and allowing the body to discover the protein encoded by the mRNA. Its pipeline includes RUNX1, the mRNA drug pipeline, non-mRNA drug pipeline, Comrex otological liquid 1.5%, NC-6100, TUG1, and others.

name: NATOCO CO LTD
businessSummary: NATOCO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of paints, fine chemical products and thinners. The Company operates through three business segments. The Paint segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of synthetic resin paints and paint-related products. The Fine Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of highly functional resins and various functional fine particles. The Thinner segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pure and recycled thinners, as well as the collection, transportation and disposal of industrial waste.

name: NADEX CO LTD
businessSummary: NADEX CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of electronics components, sales of industrial machinery, factory automation (FA) system business and welding solution business of resistance welding equipment. The Company operates in four segments: Japan segment, the Americas segment, China segment and Thai segment. The Company’s welding equipment & materials business includes resistance welding, arc welding, laser and industrial robots, etc. The factory automation business includes automatic and labor-saving car parts manufacturing facilities, electronic devices, manufacturing facilities, inspection and meters. The electronic control equipment business includes electronics, control components and equipment, power supply modules. The information technology (IT) solutions include manufacturing execution system (MES) solutions, equipment management solutions, energy management solutions and image inspection solutions, etc.

name: NASU DENKI TEKKO CO LTD
businessSummary: Nasu Denki Tekko Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to the electric power and telecommunications infrastructure business and the transportation infrastructure business. The Company operates two business segments. The Electric Power and Telecommunications Infrastructure Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel towers and steel structures, steel pipe columns, overhead line materials, and information and telecommunications materials, as well as telecommunications tower facility construction. The Transportation Infrastructure Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of transportation system materials, road equipment construction, underground line equipment construction, and hot-dip galvanizing wage processing.

name: NAGOYA RAILROAD CO LTD
businessSummary: Nagoya Railroad Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the provision of transportation services. The Company operates through five business segments. The Traffic segment provides rail, bus, taxi passenger transportation services. The Transportation segment is engaged in trucking and marine transportation services. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sales of real estate. The Leisure Service segment is engaged in the hotel, tourism, sightseeing facilities and advertising agency businesses. The Distribution segment is engaged in the department store and other retail businesses. The others business is engaged in the maintenance and construction of facilities, the airline business, the information processing business, the construction business, as well as the provision of information management and insurance services.

name: BANK OF NAGOYA LTD
businessSummary: Bank of Nagoya Ltd is a regional bank that conducts business related to financial services, such as banking, comprehensive finance leasing, outsourcing, and credit card business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Banking segment provides deposit, loan, domestic and foreign exchange, securities investment, commodity securities transactions, as well as bond registration services. The Leasing segment is engaged in the general finance leasing business. The Card segment is engaged in the credit card business and guarantee business. The other business activities include cash consolidation and scrutiny services, support for business succession, advice on initial public offerings and capital policies, and information and communication technology (ICT).

name: NAGANO KEIKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Nagano Keiki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of pressure gauges, pressure sensors, measurement and control equipment, die-casting, as well as related businesses and the manufacture and sale of application products. The Company has four business segments. The Pressure Gauge Business segment manufactures and sells pressure gauges, pressure switches, and thermometers. The Pressure Sensor Business segment manufactures and sells pressure sensors. The Measurement and Control Equipment Business segment manufactures and sells pneumatic equipment, air leak testers, pressure testers, pressure generators, and other application-developed products. The Die-Casting Business segment manufactures and sells die-cast products. The Company also operates real estate rental and automotive electrical equipment businesses.

name: NAGASE & CO LTD
businessSummary: Nagase & Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the import, export, manufacture and sale of a wide range of products. The Company operates through five business segments. Functional Materials segment offers raw materials for paints, inks, adhesives, and other products. Processed Materials segment offers dyes, pigments, functional pigments, resins, automotive repair and conductive paints and others. Electronics and Energy segment offers modified epoxy resins, fluorine products, and materials and equipment for semiconductor, display, as well as energy management system proposals, battery evaluation and healthcare services. Mobility segment offers general synthetic resins, and other materials and parts for automobile. Life-related segment offers raw materials for pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals, food additive, cosmetic additives, and radiation measurement service. The Company also offers logistics services, information processing and other professional services.

name: NAGAILEBEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Nagaileben Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture, and sale of various medical wear, as well as shoes and other products. It sells medical wear used by medical professionals and caregivers, which are products that it plans and develops itself, supplied by its manufacturing subsidiary. For some medical wear, it purchases and sells products produced overseas and domestically from its manufacturing subsidiary and general business partners. It also purchases and sells shoes from general business partners.

name: NAKAYAMAFUKU CO LTD
businessSummary: NAKAYAMAFUKU CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the wholesale business about household goods such as kitchen goods and dining goods, as well as the manufacture and sale business about horticulture and interior goods. The Company operates through five geographic segments including Hokkaido & Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kinki and Chugoku & Kyushu. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale of kitchen goods, dining goods, sanitary goods, storage goods and season goods to retailers in Japan (home centers, supermarkets, mail order dealers, co-ops, specialty retailers). In addition, the Company is also engaged in the Internet mail order business, import and sale business of interior related products, as well as the manufacture and sale business of horticulture and interior goods.

name: NAKAYAMA STEEL WORKS LTD
businessSummary: Nakayama Steel Works Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of iron and steel. It operates through three segments. The Steel segment manufactures and sells primary iron and steel products and secondary processed products. Its main products include steel plates such as hot-rolled steel strips, thick plates and intermediate plates, steel bars such as wire rods, bar-in coils and rebar, steel slabs and by-products. The Engineering segment accepts orders and sells steel fish farms and aquaculture farms, rolls, valves, and other products, as well as processes and assembles machinery. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the rental and sale of owned real estate, real estate buying and selling and brokerage, and other service businesses.

name: NAKANO REFRIGERATORS CO LTD
businessSummary: NAKANO REFRIGERATORS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of frozen and refrigerated showcases for food stores. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of showcases for stores, the construction and maintenance of showcases for food stores, as well as the sale, construction and maintenance of showcases for food stores.

name: NAKANO CORP
businessSummary: NAKANO CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the construction and real estate business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction business in Japan and Southeast Asia. The Real Estate segment is involved in the real estate leasing business in Japan and Southeast Asia. The Others segment is engaged in the insurance agency business, solar power business and private finance initiative (PFI) business.

name: NAKANISHI MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: NAKANISHI MFG.CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in manufacture and sale business of the commercial kitchen equipment and the real estate leasing business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Commercial Kitchen Equipment Manufacture and Sale segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial kitchen equipment for group canteens such as school canteens of school, hospital and company. The main products of this segment include dishwasher, rice cooker and tableware disinfection storage machines. The Company is also engaged in shipping of products from the Nara plant to the users. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in operation of office rental and parking lot rental for business persons.

name: NAKANISHI INC
businessSummary: NAKANISHI INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of dental instruments, as well as general industrial cutting and grinding machinery. The Company operates in three business segments. The Dental Product-related segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of handpieces for dental treatment, mechanical micro motors and handpieces as well as handpieces for surgeries, among others. The Industrial Product-related segment manufactures and sells grinders for manual works and spindles for machinery attachment. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of inspection and repair services for its dental and medical equipment and general industrial cutting and grinding equipment.

name: NAKAKITA SEISAKUSHO CO LTD
businessSummary: NAKAKITA SEISAKUSHO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automatic control valves, butterfly valves and remote controllers for ships and power plants. The Company offers three types of products: automatic control valves, which include auto actuated valves, servo actuated control valves, remote control valves, cylinder valves, safety valves, air purge-type automatic regulatory equipment, actuators, valves for nuclear plants, superheated steam pressure reducers and attemperators, other special automatic control valves and controlling equipment; butterfly valves, which include manual butterfly valves, remote control butterfly valves, and butterfly valves for low-temperature use, and remote controllers, which include cargo handling and ballast remote controllers and remote water level indication and warning equipment for ships.

name: NAIGAI TRANS LINE LTD
businessSummary: NAIGAI TRANS LINE LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the international freight transportation business. The Company provides four types of services. The Less than Container Load (LCL) Export services include the nonstop consolidated marine transportation services connecting ports in Japan, as well as the consolidated marine transportation services through hub ports for the countries without nonstop ships. The Full Container Load (FCL) Export services include the freight transportation services in unit of containers. The LCL Import services include the cargo transportation services from abroad. The FCL Import services provide freight transportation services in unit of containers.

name: NAIGAI TEC CORP
businessSummary: Naigai Tec Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sales business and contract manufacturing business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Sale business purchases various components and equipment such as pneumatic equipment, vacuum equipment and temperature control equipment which are used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, and electronic equipment from domestic manufacturers, and sells to domestic users. The Contract Manufacturing business is engaged in the contract manufacture of equipment assembly, contract processing, process management, information equipment assembly, and maintenance services, and main business partners are semiconductor manufacturers, semiconductor manufacturing equipment manufacturers, FPD manufacturing equipment manufacturers, and electronic equipment manufacturers.

name: NAIGAI CO LTD
businessSummary: NAIGAI CO.,LTD. is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, import and export of textile products such as socks. The Company operates in two business segments. The Wholesale segment is engaged in the plan, manufacture and sale of textile products such as socks. The Company outsources socks production to subcontractors and purchased products, and also imported products from trading companies including overseas subsidiaries. In addition, it exports products to overseas. The Mail Order segment is engaged in the development of mail-order sales of textiles and leather products through television, catalogs, and the Internet. The Company’s brands include NAIGAI COMFORT, NAIGAI PERFORMANCE, NAIGAI STYLE, NAIGAI TRADITIONAL and other.

name: PAN PACIFIC INTL HLDGS CORP.
businessSummary: Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation, formerly Don Quijote Holdings Co.,Ltd., is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail business and tenant leasing business. The Company has two business segments. The Retail segment is engaged in the retail sale of household appliances, daily commodities, food, watch and fashion supplies, sports and leisure goods and do it yourself (DIY) products, as well as the operation of big convenience and discount store under the name Don Quijote, family discount store under the name MEGA Don Quijote, comprehensive supermarket under the name Nagasakiya and the home center under the name Doit. The Tenant Leasing segment is engaged in the attract and manage tenant of commercial facilities. The Company is also involved in the real estate related business, the marketing business and the financial services business.

name: DRAFT INC
businessSummary: DRAFT Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, design and construction of spaces such as offices, commercial facilities, urban development, environmental design and others. The Company’s business area includes environmental design for designing common areas of buildings, urban development for designing the entire block and renewal design for aging buildings. The construction business is involved in the project management and construction management as primary contractors, as well as the outsource carpentry work, electrical work, interior finishing work and others to an external partner company. The characteristics of the business is to operate the business in multiple areas using design as a starting point.

name: DOUTOR NICHIRES HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: DOUTOR NICHIRES Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the roasting, processing and sale of coffee, as well as the operation of restaurants. The Company operates in two business segments. The Japan Restaurant System Group segment is engaged in the operation of restaurant chains, the production and sale of bakery products and others. The Doutor Cafe Group segment operates coffee chains with directly managed stores and franchise systems, conducts the purchasing, roasting processing and sale of coffee beans and other businesses.

name: DOWA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: DOWA Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the recycling and metal processing business. The Company operates five business segments. The Environment and Recycling segment is engaged in waste disposal, soil remediation, resource recycling, and logistics. The Smelting segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of gold, silver, copper, lead, zinc, zinc alloys, indium, platinum. The Electronic Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity metal materials, compound semiconductor wafers, conductive materials, battery materials, magnetic materials, and reduced iron powder. The Metal Processing segment manufactures and sells copper, brass, and copper alloy products. The Heat Treatment segment is engaged in heat treatment and surface treatment of metal materials for automotive parts, and manufacture, sales, maintenance of heat treatment processing equipment. The Company also operates real estate leasing, construction, management, and technical support services.

name: DOSHISHA CO LTD
businessSummary: Doshisha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wholesale of lifestyle-related products. It operates through two business segments. The Development Type Business Model segment sells uniform products such as audio and video (A&V) related products, home appliances and household goods, storage related products, clothing, food and alcoholic beverages. The Wholesale Type Business Model segment sells watches, bags, and assorted gifts. It also engages in real estate, licensing, logistics, nursing care and welfare services, trading, and professional services.

name: TREND MICRO INC
businessSummary: Trend Micro Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, sales and provision of computer security products and related services. The Company operates through four geographic segments: Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Solutions include cyber risk management, cloud-native application protection, protection of hybrid cloud environments and others. Platforms include enterprise cybersecurity platforms, cloud security, endpoint security, network security and others. Services include incident response services and others.

name: TRIPLA CO LTD
businessSummary: Tripla Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the hospitality solution business. The Company provides information technology (IT) services for accommodation facilities including tripla Book, tripla Bot, tripla Connect, and tripla Pay. tripla Book is a cloud-based official Website reservation system for accommodation facilities. tripla Bot is a service that displays a chatbot on the official Website of accommodation facilities, and automatically answers questions from users (guests) using artificial intelligence (AI) developed in-house. tripla Connect is a customer relationship management (CRM) and marketing automation (MA) tool specialized for accommodation facilities. tripla Pay is a service that provides a local payment system specifically for accommodation facilities.

name: TRINITY INDUSTRIAL CORP
businessSummary: TRINITY INDUSTRIAL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of equipment and automobile components. The Company has two business segments. The Equipment segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of coating plant equipment such as pre-treatment systems, electrolytic coating systems, painting booths, drying ovens, air ventilation devices, exhaust-gas treatment equipment and conveyers, coating equipment such as electrostatic equipment, automatic coating systems, coating supply systems, automatic paint recoloring equipment and others, as well as industrial machines such as heat treating furnaces, autoclaves, electrostatic oiling machines, coating dryers, washers, leak testers, ultra filter (UF) and reverse osmosis (RO) equipment. The Automobile Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive interior and exterior products such as steering handles, door switch bases, center clusters and side mudguards.

name: TRANSCOSMOS INC
businessSummary: transcosmos Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of one-stop, high-value-added services both domestically and overseas. The Company has three business segments. The Individual Services Business segment is responsible for the outsourcing business developed by the Company itself. The Domestic Affiliated Companies Business segment is responsible for the outsourcing business developed by domestic group companies. The Overseas Affiliated Companies Business segment is responsible for the outsourcing business developed by overseas group companies.

name: TRANSACTION CO LTD
businessSummary: TRANSACTION CO., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the planning, design, manufacture, quality management and sales of general sundry goods and healthcare sundry goods. The Company is engaged in the business management. It sells goods through its subsidiaries by direct sales, wholesale, store sale and Web sale.

name: OPEN UP GROUP INC
businessSummary: Open Up Group Inc, former BeNext-Yumeshin Group Co, is a Japan-based company engaged in human resource services, mainly dispatching engineers and business contracting. The Company operates in four business segments. The Mechanical and Electrical, Information Technology (IT) Domain segment consists of mechanical, electrical and electronic engineers such as development, design and manufacturing technology at domestic manufacturers, and construction and development of networks, servers, software at IT companies. Dispatch and contract work by IT engineers for operation system. The Construction Domain segment mainly dispatches construction management engineers and computer-aided design (CAD) engineers to companies in the domestic construction industry. The Manufacturing Domain segment mainly dispatches and outsources work in the manufacturing process for domestic manufacturers. The Overseas Domain segment is engaged in dispatch, recruitment, and personnel consulting.

name: TRIAL HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Trial Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the distribution and retail business and retail artificial intelligence (AI) business through its subsidiaries. The Company operates through two business segments. The Distribution and Retail segment mainly operates discount stores under the Trial brand that mainly provide daily necessities, home appliances, apparel goods, hobby goods, among others. Store formats include mega center, supercenter (SuC), smart and small store. The Retail Artificial Intelligence (AI) segment mainly provides products and solutions to retailers and food and consumer goods manufacturers that help improve customers' shopping experiences, physical store operations, and the efficiency of advertising and sales promotion activities. The Company also engages in resort-related businesses such as inn facilities and golf course management, as well as construction and real estate management business.

name: TOYOTA TSUSHO CORP
businessSummary: Toyota Tsusho Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the trading of various products, the manufacture, processing, sale and investment of the related products, as well as the provision of services. The Company operates in seven business segments. The Metals segment processes, manufactures, treats, and sells steel products and nonferrous metal ingots, among others. The Global Components & Logistics segment manufactures and assembles mobility parts and develops, designs, and sells mobility accessories. The Mobility segment sells and services vehicles and vehicle parts. The Machinery, Energy and Plant Projects segment provides manufacturing and distribution equipment, parts and tools, and construction equipment. The Chemicals & Electronics segment provides automotive components, semiconductors and electronic components. The Foods & Lifestyle Segment provides processed foods, and food ingredients. The Africa segment operates mobility, healthcare, consumer, and infrastructure businesses.

name: TOYOTA INDUSTRIES CORP
businessSummary: TOYOTA INDUSTRIES CORPORATION is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles, industrial vehicles and textile machinery. The Company operates in three business segments. The Automobile segment manufactures and sells automobiles, engines, compressors for automotive air-conditioners, and electronic equipment, among others. The Industrial Vehicle segment provides forklift trucks, warehouse equipment, automatic warehouse, vehicles for high-place work, logistics solution and sales finance business. The Textile Machinery segment offers weaving machines and spinning machines, as well as yarn quality measurement equipment and cotton grading equipment.

name: TOYODA GOSEI CO LTD
businessSummary: TOYODA GOSEI CO., LTD. is a company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile parts and optoelectronic products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automobile Parts segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of body sealing products, such as door weather strip and glass run; functionality parts, including functionality system components and fuel tank modules; interior and exterior parts, such as instrument panels and console boxes; safety system products, such as handles and air bag modules, as well as metal molds and machinery, among others. The Optoelectronic Product segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of high luminosity light-emitting diode lamp chip for liquid crystal backlights/ illumination light source.

name: TOYOTA MOTOR CORP
businessSummary: Toyota Motor Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automotive business, as well as financial services and other businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Automotive segment designs, manufactures, and sells automobiles, including sedans, minivans, compact cars, sport utility vehicles (SUVs), and trucks, as well as related parts and accessories. The Financial Services segment provides financing and vehicle leasing services to complement the sales of automobiles and other products manufactured by the Company and its affiliates. The Other segment engages in information and communications services. It also oversees manufacturing and sales companies, conducts public relations and research activities, oversees financial companies, and develops various mobility products, primarily software.

name: TOYOKUMO INC
businessSummary: Toyokumo Inc is mainly engaged in the development and sale of cloud services for corporations. The Company provides two types of services, including the development and sales of safety confirmation service, which is a cloud service designed to easily share information in an emergency, and kintone linkage service, a cloud service in cooperation with kintone, a business application construction service.
