The safety confirmation service is a cloud service that confirms the safety of employees and others in the event of a disaster using mobile phones, smartphones, and personal computers. The kintone linkage services include services such as print creator, form bridge, kBackup, kViewer, kMailer, time stamp for kintone and data collect, among others.

name: FIRST BANK OF TOYAMA LTD
businessSummary: First Bank of Toyama Ltd is mainly engaged in banking business and financial services related business such as leasing business. The Bank mainly operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in deposit business, lending business, domestic exchange business, foreign exchange business, and commodity securities trading business. The Company also conducts banking business, including bank administrative services. The Leasing segment is engaged in leasing business. The Bank is also engaged in credit business, credit guarantee business and money lending business.

name: TOMITA CO LTD
businessSummary: TOMITA CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of machine tools. The Company operates through four geography segments, including Japan, North America, Europe, Asia. The main machine products are general-purpose lathes, drilling machines, boring machines, broaching machines, and electrical machines. Tool equipment products are mainly pneumatic equipment, hydraulic equipment, cutting tools, electrical equipment, measuring equipment, machine equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of information consulting, mail order services and insurance sale services.

name: TOPCON CORP
businessSummary: Topcon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and service of products supported by advanced technology. It operates in three segments. The Positioning business segment manufactures and sells total stations, three-dimensional (3D) laser scanners, information and communication technology (ICT) automated construction systems, information technology (IT) agricultural systems, global navigation satellite system (GNSS) receivers for surveying, laser equipment, and software (construction management, surveying and civil engineering). The Eye Care business segment manufactures and sells 3D fundus imaging devices, fundus cameras, auto refractors/auto kerato refractors, slit lamps, tonometers, lens meters, ophthalmic laser photocoagulation devices, software (ophthalmic image filing/data management), and eye examination systems. The Other segment is engaged in precision measurement business and optical device business.

name: TOPY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Topy Industries Ltd is an automobile and industrial machinery parts manufacturing company. It operates in two business segments. The Steel segment produces steel using electric furnaces and rolls bar steel. H-beams, general shaped steel, and deformed steel bars are sold domestically and internationally, while deformed steel is supplied to the automotive and industrial machinery parts division. The Automotive and Industrial Machinery Parts segment provides automotive steel wheels, aluminum wheels, steel wheels for construction machinery, automotive press products, industrial fasteners, and industrial machinery parts. Industrial fasteners include automobiles, home appliances, and industrial machinery. The Industrial Machinery Parts segment provides undercarriage parts for bulldozers and power shovels, tip fittings for blades and buckets, and cutting edges. Other businesses include the wholesale sale of electricity, the manufacture and sale of synthetic mica and others.

name: TOBILA SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: Tobila Systems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the junk information filter business and other businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Junk Information Filter segment develops Tobilaphone to prevent malicious nuisance calls and fraudulent phone calls, and utilizes the Tobiraphone phone number database and nuisance phone number analysis algorithm to provide applications and services for mobile terminals such as smartphones and feature phones and fixed lines, selling TobiraphoneBiz for optical lines for corporate customers, developing products and services for unwanted information filters. It provides three kinds of services, including mobile filter service, fixed phone filter service, and business phone filter service. The Other Business segment is engaged in the sale of Website production management support system HP4U and commissioned development of systems.

name: TOBISHIMA CORP
businessSummary: Tobishima Holdings Inc manages the business of group companies and performs related business. Through subsidiaries, the Company is engaged in construction and development business. The construction business is mainly engaged in general construction business with civil engineering and architectural business, and through subsidiaries, it is engaged in construction work orders, earthquake reinforcement design, manufacturing and sales of materials, civil engineering work and diving work. The development business is engaged in real estate development, sales and rental, and through subsidiaries, it is also engaged in insurance agency business, boat sales, insurance and repair, real estate sales, rental and brokerage, real estate sales agency, information technology (IT) system development and maintenance, and through affiliated companies, it is engaged in digital transformation (DX) total support business.

name: TOPPAN PRINTING CO LTD
businessSummary: TOPPAN Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the information and communication, lifestyle and industry, and electronics business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Information and Communication segment provides gift card application service provider (ASP) services, radio frequency identification (RFID) solutions, payment-related services, digital content production, back-office operation and customer contact services, securities, integrated circuit (IC) cards and others. The communication media business provides sales promotion (SP) tools and manages events. The Lifestyle and Industry segment provides flexible packaging materials, various containers, ink and others. The Electronics Business Segment is involved in provision of color filters for displays, anti-reflective films, small and medium-sized thin-film transistor (TFT) liquid crystal display panels, and light control films, as well as photomasks and flip-chip ball grid array (FC-BGA) substrates.

name: TODA CORP
businessSummary: Toda Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engages in construction, civil engineering, domestic investment and development, domestic group companies, overseas group companies, and environment and energy. It has six business segments. The Construction Business segment engages in construction work both domestically and overseas. The Civil Engineering Business segment engages in civil engineering work both domestically and overseas. The Domestic Investment and Development Business segment engages in independent real estate development, sales, and leasing. The Domestic Group Companies Business segment includes construction, civil engineering, real estate management, hotel services and others. The Overseas Group Companies Business segment includes construction work and related businesses overseas conducted by overseas consolidated subsidiaries, independent real estate development, sales, and leasing, hotel services. The Environment and Energy segment engages in power generation and sales.

name: LIXIL CORP
businessSummary: LIXIL Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in water technology business, housing technology business, building technology business, housing and service business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Water Technology segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sanitary equipment, faucet fittings, bathrooms, system kitchens. The Housing Technology segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sashes, doors, shutters, interior building materials. The Building Technology segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of curtain walls. The Housing and Service segment is engaged in the provision of housing solutions, the sale and management of real estates, as well as the provision of mortgages.

name: TOKUYAMA CORP
businessSummary: Tokuyama Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in chemical products, cement, advanced electronic materials, life science, and environmental business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Chemicals segment provides products such as caustic soda, soda ash, calcium chloride, sodium bicarbonate, sodium silicate, hydrogen, and vinyl chloride monomer. The Cement Segment provides products such as cement, ready-mixed concrete, cementitious solidifiers, and recycled resources. The Advanced Electronic Materials & Components segment provides products such as polycrystalline silicon, dry silica, silicon tetrachloride, and aluminum nitride. The Life Science segment provides products such as medical diagnostic systems, dental equipment, bulk pharmaceuticals and intermediates, plastic lens-related materials, and microporous films. The Environmental Business segment provides products such as ion-exchange membranes, plastic sashes, and recycled gypsum board.

name: TOKUDEN CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKUDEN CO., LTD. is a company engaged in the welding and welding-related businesses. The Company operates in two segments. The Works segment is involved in the welding of manufacturing machinery for the steel making, petrochemical, cement, home electrical appliance, automobile and food industries, as well as facility maintenance-related welding for the steel and non-ferrous metal industries. The Welding Materials segment purchases, manufactures and sells special welding materials, including flux wires, coated electrodes, various wire rods and pulverized materials. The Company is also involved in the sale of aluminum die-casting machine parts, including plunger sleeves, sprue bushes, plunger chips and ladles for automotive industry, the manufacture and sale of deodorization equipment, forced-air cooling apparatus.

name: TOGAMI ELECTRIC MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: Togami Electric Mfg. Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric machinery and other general machinery and equipment, as well as the provision of the undertakes construction work and incidental business activities. The Company is engaged in the provision of total support business from design and proposal of solar power generation system to construction and inspection including high voltage control equipment, exploration and measurement equipment, switchboards and environmental equipment business. The Company is involved in the manufacture and sale of electronic controllers, high-voltage switches for distribution, switchboards and system equipment, as well as the development of the software for electronic controllers, switchboards and system equipment. The Company is also involved in the provision of the dispatch information processing engineers and the training for computer personnel.

name: TOWA PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Towa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The main products are generic drugs, which are launched after the efficacy and safety of new drugs have been confirmed for a certain period of time. It is a drug with the same effect, usage and dosage. The Company is involved in the sale and outsourced manufacture of products and generic drugs. The Company is involved in the research and outsourced manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredient and soft capsules. The Company is also involved in the planning, development, contract manufacturing of health foods, general foods, miscellaneous goods and others.

name: TORAY INDUSTRIES INC
businessSummary: Toray Industries Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the textile business, functional chemicals business, carbon fiber composite materials and other businesses. It has five business segments. Textile segment provides nylon, polyester, cotton, spun yarns, woven and knitted fabrics, nonwoven fabrics, artificial leather and apparel products. Functional Chemicals segment provides nylon, acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS), polybutylene terephthalate (PBT), polyphenylene sulfide (PPS) and other resins products, polyester, electronic information materials and others. Carbon Fiber Composite Materials segment provides carbon fibers, carbon fiber composite materials and carbon fiber molded products. Environment and Engineering segment provides water treatment equipment, information-related equipment, and construction materials. Life Sciences segment manufactures, processes and sells the pharmaceuticals and medical equipment. It also provides analysis, investigation and research services.

name: TRUE DATA INC
businessSummary: True Data Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of data marketing-related services. The Company is a provider of data marketing-related services, including the provision of analysis and disclosure support tools that utilize point-of-sale (POS) data with customer identification (ID) from retailers nationwide, including supermarkets and drugstores. Services are divided into solutions for manufacturers, solutions for retailers, and solutions for all industries. The company provides services such as Eagle Eye and Dolphin Eye for manufacturers' solutions, and Shopping Scan for retail solutions. Solutions for all industries are services that provide data, analysis reports, and artificial intelligence (AI) related to consumer purchasing.

name: TOYOBO CO LTD
businessSummary: Toyobo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the film and functional resin business, industrial material business, and textile and commerce business. It has five business segments. Film and Functional Resin segment manufactures, processes and sells packaging films, industrial films, industrial adhesives, engineering plastics and optical functional materials. Industrial Materials segment manufactures, processes and sells automotive fiber materials, super fibers, non-woven fabrics. Textile and Trading segment manufactures and sells functional clothing, apparel products, clothing textiles, and clothing fibers. Healthcare segment manufactures, processes and sells bio products, pharmaceuticals, medical membranes, medical devices, aqua membranes, and functional filters. It is also engaged in the assembly and sale of seawater desalination modules. The Real Estate segment sells, rents and manages movables. It also designs and constructs buildings and machinery and sells equipment.

name: TOYO DRILUBE CO LTD
businessSummary: Toyo Drilube Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in drilube business. The Company is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and coating processing of drilube products, as well as in the provision of technical guidance services for drilube products coating process. The Company is engaged in the research and development of compounding technology and dispersion technology to uniformly disperse main components such as molybdenum disulfide, fluororesin, graphite, and resinous binders such as polyamide-imide, epoxy in solvent, as well as the development, manufacture and sale of dry lube products, and the provision of the manufactured dry lube products.

name: TOYO SEIKAN GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Toyo Seikan Group Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based container manufacturer. The Company operates in five segments. The Packaging Container segment manufactures and sells containers made primarily from metal, plastic, paper, and glass. The Engineering, Filling, and Logistics segment manufactures and sells packaging container-related machinery and equipment, contracts the manufacture and sale of beverage filling products, aerosol products, and general filling products, as well as truck transportation and warehousing. The Steel Plate-Related segment manufactures and sells steel plates and processed steel plate products. The Functional Materials-Related segment manufactures and sells functional materials such as aluminum substrates for magnetic disks, optical functional films, glazes, pigments, gel coats, and trace element fertilizers. The Real Estate-Related segment rents out office buildings and commercial facilities. The Company also manufactures and sells automotive press dies and others.

name: TOYO SUISAN KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Toyo Suisan Kaisha Ltd is a Japan-based food manufacturing company. The Company operates through six business segments. The Seafood segment is engaged in the purchase, processing and sale of seafoods in domestic and overseas markets. The Overseas Instant Noodles segment provides cup and bag noodles mainly in the United States and Mexico. The Domestic Instant Noodles segment provides cup and bag noodles in Japan. The Low Temperature Food segment manufactures and sells steamed and roasted buckwheat noodles, raw ramen, boiled noodles, frozen noodles and commercial cocking products. The Processed Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed foods such as aseptic packaged rice, retort rice, soup, dashi-no-moto, bonito flakes, and paste products in Japan. The Frozen and Cold Storage segment is engaged in the provision of storage and freezing services. The Company also involves in the bag lunch, prepared food businesses.

name: TOYO CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: TOYO CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. is a construction company. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Civil Engineering segment is engaged in civil engineering in Japan. The Domestic Construction segment operates in construction business in Japan. The Overseas Construction segment is engaged in civil engineering and construction works overseas. The Real Estate segment operates in leasing and sale of real estate business. The others business is engaged in the non-life insurance business, the leasing and sale of general goods and ships, as well as the manufacture and sale of hygienic facilities and interior and exterior toilet facilities.

name: TOYO ENGINEERING CORP
businessSummary: TOYO ENGINEERING CORPORATION is a Japan-based company involved in the total engineering business. The Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) segment is involved in the development, design, machinery procurement, construction, test operation and technical guidance of general chemistry plants, petroleum chemistry plants, petroleum refining plants and energy-related plants, as well as plants in electric power, nuclear power, water, transportation, advanced production systems, logistics, medicine, resource development, bio, environment and various other industries.

name: ARTIENCE CO LTD
businessSummary: artience Co Ltd, formerly Toyo Ink SC Holdings Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture of chemical products. The Company operates through four business segments. The Color Materials and Functional Materials-Related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of organic pigments, processed pigments, colorants for plastics, color filter materials, inkjet materials and lithium ion battery materials. The Polymer and Coating-Related segment manufactures and sells paints for cans, resins, adhesives, adhesives, coating materials, natural materials and medical products. The Package-Related segment manufactures and sells gravure ink, flexo ink and gravure cylinder plate making. The Printing and Information-Related segment manufactures and sells offset ink, metal ink, printing machinery, printing equipment, prepress systems, printing materials, inkjet materials, and others. The Company also sells raw materials.

name: TOUMEI CO LTD
businessSummary: TOUMEI.CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly provides office-related services. The Company mainly operates in three segments. The Office Hikaru 119 segment is engaged in the sale of the Company’s brand Office Hikaru 119 which provides the one-stop office-related services including optical collaboration service to small medium enterprise (SME) and individual employers, besides it is also doing business as an agent of the NTT Group to handle optical line services. The Office Solution segment is engaged in the sale of information communication equipment such as business phones, unified threat management (UTM) equipment, network compatible multifunction machines, light emitting diode (LED) lighting equipment, electric lights and the providing of Rentakun services. The Financial Planning segment is engaged in the visiting shop insurance brokerage. Other business includes real estate leasing business.

name: TOHOKU STEEL CO LTD
businessSummary: Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of specialty steel products, as well as the real estate leasing business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Specialty Steels segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various specialty steel products such as heat-resistant steels for automotive, and magnetic materials, the processing and heat treatment of equipment parts and tools, as well as the rental, cleaning and security of factory land. The Real Estate Rental segment is engaged in the rental and maintenance of commercial facilities such as shopping centers, and rental houses, as well as the leasing of former factory land.

name: TOHOKU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Tohoku Electric Power Co Inc is mainly engaged in the power supply business. It operates in two segments. The Power Generation and Sales segment supplies electricity from thermal, nuclear, and renewable energy sources, provides services using renewable energy, retails electricity and provides solution services, and provides corporate and indirect functions. The Power Transmission and Distribution segment provides power network services.

name: TOHOKUSHINSHA FILM CORP
businessSummary: TOHOKUSHINSHA FILM CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the production of contents. The Company operates in five business segments. The Advertisement Production segment is involved in the production of commercial messages (CMs) and sales promotion. The Content Production segment is engaged in conducts digital production work, movie and program production, Japanese version production, management of video school, as well as coordinated overseas production of CM production. The Media segment is engaged in the operation of communications satellite (CS) and broadcast satellite (BS) channels, program procurement, organization, and outsourcing of broadcasting related work. The Property segment is engaged in the co-planning and production of video contents, copyright business, as well as distribution of theaters and television. The Product Sales segment is engaged in the operation of supermarkets and sales of video media.

name: TOHO TITANIUM CO LTD
businessSummary: TOHO TITANIUM COMPANY, LIMITED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the metallic titanium business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Metallic Titanium segment is engaged in manufacture of sponge titanium, titanium ingot and high purity titanium. The Functional Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture of propylene polymerization catalysts, ultrafine nickel, high-purity titanium oxide, and other products.

name: TOHO SYSTEM SCIENCE CO LTD
businessSummary: TOHO SYSTEM SCIENCE CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software development and computer operation management. The Company operates through two business segments. The Software Development segment is engaged in the development of software for financial users such as insurance corporations, securities corporations and banks, as well as for communication industry. The Information System Service segment is involved in the operation and management of users' computers.

name: TOHO GAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Toho Gas Co Ltd is a company primarily engaged in the gas business, construction and equipment and other businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Gas segment is engaged in the manufacture, supply and sale of gas, the reading of gas meters and the provision of gas charge recovery services. The Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), Electricity and Other Energy segment is engaged in the electricity business, the sale of liquefied natural gas (LNG), the supply of heat, the sale of LPG and LPG equipment, the provision of LPG piping works, as well as the sale of coke and petroleum products. The Construction and Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of piping works for gas supply and the sale of gas equipment. The other businesses include LNG entrusted processing, the leasing and operation of real estate, the design and construction and the provision of utility service for plants and facilities, the sale of household equipment and others.

name: TOHO ZINC CO LTD
businessSummary: Toho Zinc Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of non-ferrous metal products, the exploration, development and production of non-ferrous metal resources, the manufacture and sale of electronic parts, environment and recycle business, the logistics and other business. The Company operates in four businesses. The Smelting & Refining segment manufactures and sells zinc and lead products, electrolytic silver, and sulfuric acid. The Environment & Recycling segment manufactures and sells zinc oxide and waste treatment and reclamation. The Mineral Resources segment explores, develops, produces, and sells non-ferrous metal resources. The Electronic Components & Functional Materials segment manufactures and sells electronic components, electrolytic iron, plating, and equipment components. The Company also operates businesses related to soundproofing materials, civil engineering, construction, plant engineering, transportation, and environmental analysis.

name: TOHO CO LTD (TOKYO)
businessSummary: TOHO Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the movie, theater and real estate businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Movie segment is engaged in the distribution to movie theaters, domestic distribution of theatrical films, management of movie theaters, use of anime contents, sales of packages and art production for video works. The Theater segment is engaged in the production and performance of theater performances, the sale of theater tickets, and the management of entertainment production. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing, maintenance and management of real estate, the management, cleaning and repair of roads. The Company is also engaged in the sports facility management business, products sale business and the accounting consulting and guidance business.

name: TOBU RAILWAY CO LTD
businessSummary: Tobu Railway Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation, leisure, distribution, and real estate businesses and others. The Company operates through five business segments. The Transportation Business segment is involved in railway, bus and taxi, and freight transportation businesses. The Leisure Business segment is involved in amusement parks and tourism, sports, travel, hotels, and Skytree businesses. The Real Estate Business segment is involved in real estate rental, real estate sales, and Skytree Town businesses. The Distribution Business segment is involved in department stores, supermarkets, convenience stores and others. The Other Business segment is involved in construction, electrical work, and other businesses.

name: TOUBUJYUHAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Toubujyuhan Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in real estate related business. The Company provide used real estate for reformed detached houses. It has four business segments. The Real Estate Trading segment involves in the sale of properties owned by the Company, and the brokerage sale of properties owned by others. The Real Estate Rental segment involves in the brokerage sale and rental management business of properties owned by other companies, as well as the sale of properties owned by the Company. The Real Estate-related segment involves in the contracting of remodeling of properties, agency sale of insurance such as fire insurance, as well as real estate-related goods sale through Internet. The Others segment involves in the sale of welfare related goods, the provision of equipment rental, silver renovation construction contracting and others.

name: TOTO LTD
businessSummary: TOTO Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of restroom, bath, kitchen and washroom products. The Company operates through six business segments. The Japan Housing Equipment Business segment, the Mainland China Business segment, the Asia and Oceania Business segment, the Americas Business segment and the Europe Business segment are engaged in the manufacture and sale of sanitary ware, heated toilet seats, unit bathrooms, system kitchens and washstands, faucets, electric water heaters, handrails, bathroom ventilation heaters and dryers, faucets, seats for seated toilets, plastic and rubber molded parts, plastic bathtubs and marbright counters, and others. The Company provides after-sales services such as repair work for these products. The Company also installs, sells, designs and contracts housing equipment. The New Area Business segment is engaged in the provision of ceramic products. The Company is also engaged in the office buildings rental business.

name: TOTETSU KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: TOTETSU KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the plan, design, construction, supervision and other businesses related to general civil engineering work. The Construction segment is engaged in the plan, design, construction, supervision and other businesses related to general construction work. The Company is also engaged in the leasing business of commercial buildings, the environmental business, including the power generation business, the greening business, and the crushed stone recycling business, as well as the production, inspection and maintenance business of track maintenance machines, the manufacture and sale of railway-related products, and the railway-related consulting business.

name: TOSOH CORP
businessSummary: Tosoh Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of basic raw materials and functional products such as petrochemicals and chemical products. The Company operates in four segments. The Petrochemicals segment manufactures and sells olefin products such as ethylene and propylene, low-density polyethylene, high-density polyethylene, processed resin products, and functional polymers. The Chlor-Alkali segment manufactures and sells caustic soda, vinyl chloride monomer, vinyl chloride resin, inorganic and organic chemicals, cement, and urethane materials. The Functional Products segment manufactures and sells inorganic and organic fine products, measuring and diagnostic products, electronic materials, and functional materials. The Engineering segment manufactures and sells water treatment facilities and engages in construction and repair businesses. The Company also engages in transportation and warehousing, inspection and analysis, and information processing.

name: TOSEI CORP
businessSummary: TOSEI CORPORATION is a real estate company. The Real Estate Revitalization segment sells real estate properties revitalized through implementation. The Real Estate Development segment engages in sale of condominiums and detached houses to individual customers, and rental condominiums and office buildings to investors. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases offices and condominiums. The Real Estate Fund Consulting segment engages in asset management business of real estate funds. The Real Estate Management segment provides comprehensive property management services.

name: SHIBAURA MACHINE CO LTD
businessSummary: Shibaura Machine Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of molding machines and machine tools. It operates through two business segments. Molding Machine segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation, and maintenance of injection molding machines, extrusion molding machines and die casting machines. Products include all-electric injection molding machine EC-SXIII, EC-SX and EC-S series, hybrid type Injection molding machine ED and IS series, special specification injection molding machine, fine foam molding and control system. Machine Tool segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation and maintenance of machine tools. Products include high-speed shape machines MPJ-M and MPJ series, horizontal boring machines BTD-100R12 and BTD-110H.R13/R16, grinding machines KWA-D and KT-C series. It is also engaged in manufacture and sale of industrial robots, servo motors, computer numerical control (CNC) devices, sewerage-related measuring equipment.

name: TOKYO RADIATOR MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO RADIATOR MFG. CO., LTD. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of heat exchangers, fuel tanks and press steel plates. The Company's products include parts for heat exchangers, such as radiators, exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) coolers, oil coolers and fuel coolers, among others; as well as automobile body components, such as oil pans, vacuum tanks, fuel tanks and selective catalytic reduction (SCR) tanks, among others. It mainly operates through three business segments: Japan, China and Asia.

name: TYK CORP
businessSummary: TYK CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of refractories. The Company operates through four geographic segments including Japan, North America, Europe and Asia. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of refractory bricks for steel, amorphous refractories, graphite crucibles for non-ferrous metals, and new ceramics. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the sale of environment-related products, the manufacture and repair of ceramics and machinery, construction and repair business, transport business, as well as the operation of sports facilities.

name: TBS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: TBS Holdings Inc, formerly Tokyo Broadcasting System Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in broadcasting business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Media and Content segment is involved in the broadcasting-related business which conducts broadcasting, program production, video technology, audio technology, cable television broadcasting (CATV) investment, video investment and others; the planning production business which conducts video and audio software production, sales and distribution business, various events, program sales, video software production and sales, animation and music software planning and production. The Lifestyle segment is involved in the mail-order sales, general merchandise retailing, cosmetics manufacturing and sales business. The Real Estate and Others segment is involved in real estate leasing, maintenance and service business, studio management, heating and cooling management, insurance agency and other business.

name: YAMADA CONSULTING GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: YAMADA Consulting Group Co.,Ltd. is mainly engaged in the management consulting business, real estate consulting business and other businesses. The Company operates in four business segments. The Management Consulting segment conducts management consulting business, merger and acquisition capital consulting business, overseas business consulting business and others. The Real Estate Consulting segment provides real estate consulting, real estate sales brokerage and other businesses. The Educational Training and Financial Planner (FP)-related segment includes sales of FP-qualified courses, corporate training, and others. The Investment and Fund segment conducts the formation, operation, and investment of investment business associations.

name: NISSAN TOKYO SALES HOLDINGS
businessSummary: NISSAN TOKYO SALES HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automobile related business and the information system related business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automobile Related segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of automobiles and automobile components, as well as the maintenance and inspection of automobiles. The Information System Related segment is engaged in the sale of computer hardware and software, the provision of kitting, installation support, network construction and maintenance services for equipment, as well as the provision of help desks and data centers services. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: TOKYO ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY HOLDINGS IN
businessSummary: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to electric power. The Company operates through five segments. The Holdings segment provides management support, common services to each core operating company, and nuclear power generation and other businesses. The Fuel & Power segment sells electricity generated by thermal power plants, procures fuel, develops thermal power sources, and invests in fuel businesses. The Power Grid segment supplies electric power through transmission, substation, and distribution, and constructs and maintains transmission, distribution, and communication facilities. The Energy Partner segment proposes total solutions in line with customer requirements, provides services, and conducts power supply procurement business. The Renewable Power segment sells electricity generated from renewable energy sources, maintains and manages facilities, and develops and invests in new renewable energy power sources.

name: TOKYO ENERGY & SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: TOKYO ENERGY & SYSTEMS INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in design and construction of electric power facilities and general electric facilities. The facility construction business is engaged in the construction and maintenance of thermal power generation facilities, nuclear power generation facilities, hydroelectric power generation facilities and solar power generation facilities, as well as the design and construction of substation facilities, general electric facilities, information communication facilities, and air conditioning equipment. The Company also involves in leasing and management of real estate, leasing and rental of tools, fixtures and vehicles, as well as provision of insurance agency business.

name: TOKYO TEKKO CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO TEKKO CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the steel business. The Company has two businesses. The iron and steel business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of small steel bars, mechanical joints of reinforcing bars and processed steel bars. The other business is engaged in the provision of freight transportation and equipment maintenance services, among others.

name: TOKYO METRO CO. LTD.
businessSummary: Tokyo Metro Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to railroads. The Company operates through three business segments. The Transportation Business segment owns a subway network consisting of nine lines, mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area, and operates and manages trains as well as maintains and manages railroad facilities. The Real Estate Business segment is based on business development that can generate synergy effects with the railroad business, and leases real estate, mainly office buildings and hotels, such as Shibuya Mark City, along the Company's railway lines. The Distribution and Advertising Business segment operates commercial facilities such as Echika at stations along the Company's lines, and is involved in the advertising business, which mainly handles advertising inside stations and trains, and the information and telecommunications business, which leases optical fiber and other services.

name: TOKYO TATEMONO CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Tatemono Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Company operates three business segments. The Building Business segment develops, sells, leases, operates, and manages office buildings, commercial facilities, and logistics facilities. The Residential Business segment develops, sells, leases, and sells condominiums. The Asset Services segment is engaged in real estate sales, brokerage, consulting, and the development and operation of parking facilities. The Company also operates quality life business, asset management business, overseas business, and real estate appraisal business.

name: TOKYO SOIR CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO SOIR CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of women's formal wear and the sale of accessory accessories. The Company is a comprehensive women's formal wear maker that plans products for wear and accessories and wholesales it to department stores and chain stores nationwide. The Company provides black formal, color formal and accessory products.

name: TOKYO SEIMITSU CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Seimitsu Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and precision measuring equipment. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processing and inspection equipment for the manufacture of semiconductor, such as wafer probing machines and wafer dicing machines, as well as the provision of after-sales services and the development of related software. The Measuring Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision measuring equipment for three-dimensional (3D) vision systems, as well as surface roundness and profile shape measuring instruments including 3D coordinate measuring machine, true degree and column shape measuring machine, surface roughness measuring machine, wheel shape measuring machine and others.

name: TOKYO STEEL MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO STEEL MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of steel products. The Company has two kinds of products. The long steel products include H beams, tuned-H beams, sheet piles, I beams, checkered H-beams, channels and reinforcing bars, etc. The flat steel products include heavy plates, hot rolled coils, pickled and oiled coils, hot-dip galvanized coils, checkered coils and steel sheets, etc.

name: TOKYO SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Sangyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the electric power business, the chemical and environment business, the electronic precision equipment business and the life related business. The Company operates through four business segments. Electric Power segment is engaged in the provision of power generating equipment, power distribution equipment and other electric power related equipment. Chemical and Environment segment is engaged in the provision of plants and equipment for chemical, petroleum refining, pharmaceutical, textile, rubber, nonferrous metals and other industries. Electronic Precision Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of precision equipment, measuring devices, air conditioning and other related equipment. Life Related segment is engaged in the provision of water-saving automatic flusher, plastic bags and garbage collection bags. The Company is also engaged in the management and operation of buildings, and the real estate leasing business.

name: TOKYU CORP
businessSummary: Tokyu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation business, real estate business, leisure service business, as well as hotel and resort business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in the operation of railways and airports, the provision of bus transportation services, as well as the railway related business. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sale, management, leasing and brokerage of real estate, as well as the construction business. The Leisure Service segment in engaged in the operation of department stores, chain stores and shopping centers, as well as the credit cards business, cable television business, advertising agency business and video business. The Hotel and Resort segment is engaged in the operation of hotels and golf courses.

name: TOKYO KISEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Kisen Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of services such as tugboat business, passenger ship business, stand and cafeteria business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Tugboat segment is involved in tugboat business, charter business, disaster prevention-related business and others. The Passenger Ship segment is engaged in tourism, car ferry and transportation ship businesses. The Stand and Cafeteria segment is engaged in the sale of goods associated with the car ferry business and restaurant cafeteria business.

name: TOKYO KIKAI SEISAKUSHO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO KIKAI SEISAKUSHO, LTD. is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of printing machinery and press control systems. The Company operates the Printing Machinery-related segment. The segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of printing machinery related products, as well as the provision of related maintenance service.

name: TOKYO GAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Gas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the gas, electricity, energy-related businesses and real estate businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Energy Solutions segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of city gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales, trading, electricity, engineering solutions (engineering, energy services) and others. The Network segment is engaged in the transportation and supply of city gas. The Overseas segment is engaged in the overseas resource development and investment, energy supply and others. The Urban Business segment is engaged in the real estate development and rental and others.

name: TOKYO OHKA KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO OHKA KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of materials and equipment. The Company operates in two segments. The Materials segment is mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of electronics functional materials and high purity chemicals. The Equipment segment is mainly engaged in manufacturing, sales and maintenance of processing equipment for semiconductors and displays. The Company operates in Japan, Taiwan, South Korea, the United States, etc.

name: TOKYO ELECTRON DEVICE LTD
businessSummary: TOKYO ELECTRON DEVICE LIMITED is a company mainly engaged in the sale of domestic and foreign electronic products such as semiconductor products, electronic components, contract products, network devices, storage devices and software, as well as proprietary products to major electronics manufacturers. The Company operates in two segments. The Semiconductors and Electronic Devices segment sells semiconductor products and other electronic parts. The Computer Systems segment sells network and storage equipment.

name: TOKYO ELECTRON LTD
businessSummary: Tokyo Electron Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial electronics products, primarily semiconductor production equipment and flat panel display (FPD) production equipment. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment provides wafer-compatible batch-type thermal processing equipment, wafer-compatible semi-batch-type deposition equipment, wafer-compatible single wafer deposition equipment, wafer-compatible coater/developers, wafer-compatible plasma etch systems, and semiconductor test systems. The Company also provides logistics, facility management, and insurance services.

name: TOKYU FUDOSAN HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Tokyu Fudosan Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the real estate business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Urban Development segment develops, leases, operates and sells office buildings and commercial facilities, and develops, leases and sells condominiums and rental housing. The Strategic Investment segment develops, leases, operates and sells renewable energy power generation facilities and logistics facilities. It also manages real estate private placement funds, and asset management and investment. The Management and Operation segment is involved in the management of condominiums and buildings, renovation work, sales of member-only resort hotels, management of hotels, golf courses and ski resorts, corporate welfare contracting, environmental greening and landscaping. Real Estate Distribution segment is involved in real estate brokerage, sales agency, management and operation of rental housing and student apartments and subleasing business.

name: TOKYU CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokyu Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Construction (building) segment is engaged in the construction of offices, commercial facilities, educational facilities, cultural and social facilities, sports facilities, government office buildings, research institutes, training facilities, housing, medical and welfare facilities, logistics facilities. The Construction (civil engineering) segment is engaged in the construction of railways, dams, environmental sanitation facilities and roads. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sales and leasing of real estate properties. It also engages in sales of vegetables, and rehabilitation work through its subsidiaries. It is also engaged in the development of artificial intelligence/Internet of Things (AI/IoT) platform that protects and manages photovoltaic power generation panels.

name: CENTRAL JAPAN RAILWAY CO
businessSummary: Central Japan Railway Co is a Japan-based company mainly involved in the provision of railway services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in the operation of Tokaido Shinkansen railways and the conventional railways in the Tokai area, as well as the provision of bus services. The Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of department stores in JR central towers, as well as the merchandising business in train compartments and stations. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of station buildings and other real estate. The Company also operates a hotel business, travel agency business, advertising business, railroad car manufacturing business, and construction business.

name: TOKAI SOFT CO LTD
businessSummary: TOKAI SOFT CO.,LTD. is an independent software development company. The Company mainly provides services related to software contract development and software development. The Company operates Software Development segment and is classified into three businesses, including embedded related business, manufacturing, distribution and business system related business, and finance and public related business. The embedded related business conducts the vehicle releted development business, as well as the consumer and industrial equipment related development business. The manufacturing, distribution and business system related business conducts the manufacturing and distribution system related development and business system related development business. The finance and public related business is engaged in the software development for major financial institutions and software development of various ministries and agencies, local governments, universities, public corporations.

name: SUMITOMO RIKO CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Riko Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive and general industrial products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automotive Products segment manufactures and sells anti-vibration rubber, hoses, interior parts, soundproofing products, fuel cell (FC) components, and rubber sealing materials. The General Industrial Products segment manufactures and sells precision resin blades and rolls, anti-vibration rubber for railway vehicles, housing, and bridges, high-pressure hoses, and conveyor hoses.

name: TOKAI CARBON CO LTD
businessSummary: Tokai Carbon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of carbon products. The Company operates five business segments. The Graphite Electrode Business segment provides graphite electrodes for electric steelmaking furnaces. The Carbon Black Business segment provides carbon black for rubber products, black pigments, and conductive materials. The Fine Carbon Business segment provides specialty carbon products, solid silicon carbide, and silicon carbide coatings. The Smelting & Lining Business segment provides cathodes for aluminum electrolysis, blast furnace blocks, and carbon electrodes. The Industrial Furnace and Related Products Business segment provides industrial electric furnaces and silicon carbide heating elements.

name: TOEI ANIMATION CO LTD
businessSummary: TOEI ANIMATION CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the film production and sale business, the licensing business and the product sale business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Film Production and Sale segment is mainly engaged in the planning and production of animations for theater and television, the sale of production broadcasting right and video creating right, as well as the provision of film distribution services for personal computer and mobile terminals. The Licensing segment is mainly engaged in the commercialization license of characters appearing in the productions. The Product Sale segment is mainly engaged in the development and sale of character products. The Company is also engaged in the planning and operation of costume show musical events and other events.

name: TOEI CO LTD
businessSummary: TOEI COMPANY, LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly involved in the image related business. It has five business segments. The Image-related segment is engaged in the production, distribution, import and export of theater movies, the production and sale of digital versatile disk (DVD), the production and distribution of television (TV) films, the development of movie films, as well as the advertising agency business, among others. The Distribution-related segment operates direct managed theaters and cinema complexes. The Event-related segment plans and operates the characters in its films and culture events. The Tourism and Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate and the operation of hotels. The Construction and Interior Decoration segment is involved in the construction and interior decoration businesses.

name: TVE CO LTD
businessSummary: TVE Co Ltd, formerly Toa Valve Engineering Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of various industrial valves, as well as the decontamination and decommissioning business. The Company has three business segments. The Valve segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, dismantlement, inspection, repair and maintenance of high temperature and high pressure valves for power plants such as nuclear power plants and thermal power plants, and various industrial valves and parts for ships, petrochemical plants and others, as well as the manufacture of cast steel parts for valve products. The Steelmaking segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cast steel products for construction equipment and other industries. The Decontamination segment is engaged in the radioactive removal business in Fukushima Prefecture.

name: TOA ROAD CORP
businessSummary: Toa Road Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business, manufacture and sale of related construction materials and environmental businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Construction Business segment is engaged in paving, civil engineering and other construction work, as well as building demolition work. The Manufacturing, Sales, and Environmental Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of asphalt mixtures, asphalt emulsions, and other construction materials, as well as the intermediate treatment of construction waste, and the investigation and purification of contaminated soil.

name: DKK-TOA CORP
businessSummary: DKK-TOA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company principally engaged in measurement instrument business and real estate leasing business. The Company operates its business through two business segments. Measurement Instrument Business segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of environmental and process analysis instruments, scientific analysis instruments, industrial gas detection alarms, as well as electrodes and standard solutions. The segment also provides maintenance services. Real Estate Leasing Business segment owns one rental building adjacent to the Company in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo and conducts real estate leasing business.

name: TOAGOSEI CO LTD
businessSummary: Toagosei Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemicals business and polymer and oligomer businesses. The Company operates through five business segments. The Core Chemicals segment manufactures and sells electrolytic products such as caustic soda, caustic potash, and sodium hypochlorite, industrial gases and acrylic monomers such as acrylic acid and acrylic acid esters. The Polymer and Oligomer segment manufactures and sells acrylic oligomers such as acrylic polymers, polymer flocculants, and light-curing resins. The Adhesive Materials segment manufactures and sells instant adhesives and functional adhesives. The High-Performance Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity inorganic chemicals and inorganic functional materials. The Resin Processed Products segment manufactures and sells environmental infrastructure system products, building materials and civil engineering products. It also conducts new product research and development, transportation.

name: TOWA CORP
businessSummary: TOWA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision molds for semiconductor manufacturing, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and fine plastic-molded parts. The Company operates in two business segments. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment manufactures and sells semiconductor manufacturing precision molds, molding equipment and singulation equipment, among others. The Fine Plastic Moldings segment manufactures and sells medical equipment.

name: TOMEN DEVICES CORP
businessSummary: Tomen Devices Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the trading of semiconductors and electronic components. It conducts business through two segments which are Japan and Overseas. The Company's main products include semiconductor memory such as DRAM, NAND FLASH, multi-chip packages (MCPs), and solid-state drives (SSDs), and system-on-chip (SoC), display driver integrated circuit (DDI), complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) image sensor (CIS), power management integrated circuit (PMIC), system-in-package (SiP), foundry, and other large-scale integrated circuits (LSI), and displays such as liquid crystal panels (LCDs) and organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), and light-emitting diodes (LEDs), multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), batteries, and equipment.

name: TOSO CO LTD
businessSummary: TOSO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of interior decoration products. The Interior Decoration-related segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of interior products including curtain rails, interior blinds, roll screens, roman shades and accordion-type partitions. The others business is engaged in the sale of nursing care products and plastic chains, the inventory management, packing, packaging and forwarding of interior products, as well as the non-life insurance agency business.

name: TOCALO CO LTD
businessSummary: TOCALO Co., Ltd. mainly develops and provides thermal decomposition (TD) processing, ZAC coating processing, plasma transferred arc (PTA) processing, physical vapor deposition (PVD) processing business, with a focus on thermal spray coatings. The Company operates in two business segments. The Thermal Spray Coatings segment provides spray processing for semiconductor and parts of flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, gas turbines for power generation and batteries for electric power storage, various bearings and other parts for industrial machinery, steel rolls and papermaking rolls, as well as chemical plant parts and other equipment parts. The Domestic Subsidiary segment is engaged in PVD processing for cutting tools, blades, automobile molds and others.

name: TOAMI CORP
businessSummary: TOAMI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of civil engineering and building materials. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various wire meshes such as welded wire meshes, rebar grids, welded wire meshes for reinforcing openings, stainless steel welded wire meshes, one-way meshes and solid foundation rebar units, reinforced processed products such as TOAMI hoops, spiral hoops, power rings, polygonal hoop bars for circles and spiral bars for seismic reinforcement, wire meshes for glass, mesh fences, as well as special welded wire mesh products such as C panels and blank panels. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of reinforcing steels, gabions, square gabions and other products.

name: DENYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Denyo Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial electric machinery and apparatuses. The Company operates in four region segments. In Japan, the Company manufactures and sells engine electric generators, engine welders, engine compressors and generating equipment for emergency, as well as parts for repair use. In the United States, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of engine electric generators and engine compressors. In Asia, the Company is engaged in the sale and lease of engine electric generators and engine welders. In Europe, the Company sells engine electric generators and engine welders.

name: DENTSU GROUP INC
businessSummary: Dentsu Group Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of communication-related services with a focus on advertising. The Company operates in four business segments, including Japan, Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and Asia Pacific (APAC). The Company's advertising business involves the handling of advertising work for newspapers, magazines, radio, television, the Internet, sales promotion, movies, outdoor, transportation and other areas, as well as the planning, production and marketing of advertising expressions, public relations (PR) and content services. The Company's information services business involves the sale of information services and information-related products. Other businesses include the provision of specialized functions in the corporate field, office rental and building services. Through its affiliated companies, the Company is engaged in advertising and advertising-related services, information services and other services.

name: DENSO CORP
businessSummary: Denso Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of automotive parts in the areas of thermal systems, powertrain systems, mobility electronics, electrification systems, advanced devices, and non-automotive business. The Company operates through four segments, including Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. Thermal system products include passenger thermals and commercial thermals. Powertrain system products include injection equipment, and engine equipment. Mobility electronics products include electronics products, and safety system products. Electrification system products include electrification components, power mobility electronics, and motors. Advanced device products include mechatronics systems, and sensing systems. Non-automotive business includes AUTO-ID-related products, and factory automation (FA)-related products. The Company also operates business activities through local subsidiaries in South America and other regions.

name: ELECTRIC POWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Electric Power Development Co Ltd is mainly engaged in electricity generation business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Electricity segment engages in power generation business including hydroelectric power generation, thermal power generation and wind power generation, as well as provision of electricity. The Electricity-Related segment engages in design, installation, maintenance and repair of electrical power equipment, the port operation of fuel and coal ash, the coal mine development, the import of coal, the procurement and manufacture of biomass fuel, the operation of public health facilities, as well as the provision of computer services. The Overseas Operation segment is in the operation of electrical power generation investment business and other related businesses, engineering and consulting businesses in overseas. The Others segment engages in new electricity business, environment-related business and others.

name: DMW CORP
businessSummary: DMW CORPORATION is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, installation and sale of wind and water equipment. The Company’s main business is the manufacture and sale of wind and water equipment, energy recovery equipment for seawater desalination, wastewater treatment equipment, waste treatment equipment, switchboards, electrical instrumentation control equipment and telecommunication control equipment, as well as other related works. The Company’s main products include pumps including industrial pumps, large pumps, centrifugal pumps and submersible pumps, blowers including fans and blowers, as well as valves, among others.

name: DENKYOSHA CO LTD
businessSummary: Denkyo Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wholesale of electrical goods and household goods. The Company operates through two business segments. The Electric Goods Wholesale Business segment is engaged in the sale of electrical products purchased from makers to retailers including the electronics retail stores, home centers and general merchandise stores. The segment is also engaged in the planning and manufacture of home appliances overseas, as well as the sale of products to domestic wholesalers and retailers. The Household Goods Wholesale Business segment is involved in the sale of household products to retailers including the electronics retail stores, home centers and general merchandise stores. The Company is also engaged in the electronic components sales business, home appliances repair and logistics delivery business, electrical-related systemization business and real estate management business.

name: DKK CO LTD
businessSummary: DKK Co Ltd, formerly Denki Kogyo Co Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the electric communication- and high frequency-related business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Electric Communication segment is engaged in the manufacture, construction and sale of various antennas, reflector plates, steel towers and steel structures, plating processing of various telecommunications equipment and steel frames, as well as construction of electric communication facilities. The High Frequency-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of high frequency induction heating equipment, various high-frequency power supplies for plasma, as well as processing of High-frequency heat treatment. The Company is also involved in the equipment lending business and solar power distribution business.

name: DENKA CO LTD
businessSummary: Denka Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic and advanced products, life innovation, elastomers and infrastructure solutions, and polymer solutions. The Company operates through four business segments. The Electronics & Advanced Products segment provides electronic packaging materials, fine ceramics, fused silica, acetylene black, electronic circuit boards, and industrial tapes. The Life Innovation segment provides vaccines, diagnostics, and oncology virus products. The Elastomers and Infrastructure Solutions segment provides chloroprene rubber, cement, specialty admixtures, fertilizers, carbide, refractories, and environmental materials. The Polymer Solutions segment offers tylene monomers, polystyrene resins, clearenes, heat-resistant and transparent resins, poval, yarn for synthetic wigs, and food packaging materials. The Company also operates plant engineering and trading businesses.

name: DELTA-FLY PHARMA INC
businessSummary: Delta-Fly Pharma, Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The Company's development pipeline includes anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-10917 whose target disease is refractory or recurrent acute myelogenous leukemia, anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-14323 whose target disease is lung cancer, anti-cancer drug candidate compound DFP-11207 whose target disease is solid cancer, anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-14927 whose target disease is solid cancer or blood cancer, anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-10825 whose target disease is peritoneal dissemination metastatic cancer.

name: DIGITAL GARAGE INC
businessSummary: Digital Garage, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the marketing technology business, the financial technology business, the incubation technology business and the long term incubation business. The Company has four business segments. The Marketing Technology segment is engaged in the comprehensive promotion business, the data management business, as well as the advertising products development and marketing business. The Financial Technology segment is engaged in the provision of electronic payment solutions such as credit card payments and convenience store payments, as well as the design, development and operation of Internet systems and electronic commerce (EC) systems. The Incubation Technology segment is engaged in the strategy support type venture incubation business. The Long Term Incubation segment is engaged in the development and management of medias, the development and support of data security related systems, and the financial business utilizing blockchain.

name: D I SYSTEM CO LTD
businessSummary: D I System Co Ltd is a Japan-based independent information service company engaged in conduction of system integration business and education service security solution business. The Company operates in two business segments. The system integration business is engaged in design and development of business applications, design and construction of infrastructure systems, and operation and maintenance of business application infrastructure systems. The educational service security solution business provides educational services such as computer languages, databases, servers, and networks. The Company also develops, sells, introduces, and maintains security products.

name: DEXERIALS CORP
businessSummary: Dexerials Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of optical materials, electronic materials and bonding materials. The Company operates in two business segments. The Optical Material Products segment is divided into three categories: optical films, optical resin materials and optical solutions. Main products are ultraviolet curable resins for optical discs, optical elastic resins and antireflection films. The Electronic Material Products segment is divided into four categories: bonding materials, anisotropic conductive films, surface mount fuses and microdevices.

name: DVX INC
businessSummary: DVx Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of medical equipment for circulatory system diseases. The Company operates in two business segments. The Arrhythmia segment mainly sells cardiac pacemakers, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), electrode catheters and ablation catheters. The Ischemia segment is engaged in the import and sale of automated contrast medium injectors under the name ACIST, excimer laser angioplasty systems, as well as sale of coronary artery stent products as agency business. The others business is engaged in the sale of neurosurgical products, general surgery related products, gastrointestinal related products, radiation protection supplies, among others.

name: AVANT GROUP CORP
businessSummary: Avant Group Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, sales and maintenance of software and systems to promote management reform, and the provision of software-based consulting and business process outsourcing (BPO) services. The Company operates through three segments. The Group Governance segment is engaged in the sale of licenses for DivaSystem, an in-house developed package software for consolidated management and consolidated accounting, and the provision of consulting services for its introduction. The Digital Transformation Promotion segment provides system integration services for the utilization of information called business intelligence (BI). The Outsourcing segment provides outsourcing services for operations such as consolidated accounting and consolidated tax payment.

name: DCM HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: DCM Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company that is mainly engaged in the home center business. The Company is engaged in the management of all Company-wide businesses. It consists of two business segments. The Home Improvement segment is engaged in the home improvement center business. The X-Price segment is engaged in the e-commerce (EC) business. The shared point service business is engaged in the operation of the point service.

name: DAYTONA CORP
businessSummary: DAYTONA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and sales of motorcycle parts and accessories. The Company operates in three business segments. The Domestic Wholesale segment is engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and wholesale of motorcycle parts and accessories in Japan and overseas markets. The Asia Wholesale segment is engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and wholesale of motorcycle parts and accessories, mainly in Southeast Asia areas. The Retail segment is engaged in purchase of motorcycle after parts and supplies, as well as sales to end user. The other business is engaged in the solar power generation business.

name: DIP CORP
businessSummary: dip Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in human resources service business and digital transformation (DX) business. The Company operates through two segments. The Human Resource Service segment conducts internet job advertising and nurse recruitment, and operates recruitment information sites such as Baitoru, Baitoru NEXT, and Hatarakonet. The DX segment develops and provides services that utilize artificial intelligence (AI) and robotic process automation (RPA). Services include recruitment page cobots, interview cobots, HR cobots, human resources (HR) cobots, and regular cobots.

name: DENA CO LTD
businessSummary: DeNA Co Ltd mainly provides Internet services for mobile and personal computers (PC). The Company operates in five business segments. The Game segment provides mobile game-related services such as Mobage, which distributes game applications in Japan and overseas. The Live Streaming segment provides live streaming services such as Pococha and IRIAM in Japan and overseas. The Sports segment provides sports related services such as Yokohama DeNA BayStars and Yokohama Stadium, and Kawasaki Brave Thunders and Sports Club Sagamihara in Japan. The Healthcare and Medical segment provides health big data related services and healthcare and medical related services such as Join, which is a medical digital transformation (DX) related service, in Japan and overseas. The New Business and Other segment provides new businesses and other services in Japan, such as e-commerce (EC) business and other new businesses.

name: DISCO CORP
businessSummary: Disco Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor manufacturing devices and precision processing tools, as well as the maintenance and related services business. The Company is engaged in the provision of dicing saws, laser saws, grinders, polishers, surface planers and other precision processing equipment, as well as dicing blades, grinding wheels, dry polishing wheels, grindstones for grinding and cutting and other precision processing tools.

name: SCALA INC
businessSummary: Scala Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software as a service (SaaS) and application service provider (ASP) business, the sales force automation (SFA) business and others. The Company has four business segments. The SaaS/ASP segment is engaged in the provision of SaaS and ASP type services that support communication between companies and people such as i-search and i-ask. The SFA segment is engaged in the license sale of sales support systems, the provision of cloud services, customized development services, sales consulting and skill training services. The Field Marketing segment is engaged in the provision of field activities and market research services. The Customer Support segment is engaged in the provision of customer support consulting services for call centers. The Company is also engaged in the operation of electronic commerce (EC) sites, the planning, editing and publishing of business books, the provision of recruitment and employment services and others.

name: DTS CORP
businessSummary: DTS Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operations & solutions, technology & solutions, and platform & services businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Operations & Solutions segment includes consulting for system implementation, system design, development, operation, and maintenance (including the design and construction of infrastructure and networks), and the creation of industry-specific solutions. The Technology & Solutions segment includes consulting for system implementation, system design, development, operation, and maintenance (including design, construction, and integration of infrastructure and networks), and installation, operation, and maintenance of solutions (in-house and other companies). The Platform & Services segment includes the introduction of cutting-edge information technology (IT) equipment, the construction of IT platforms, the operation design and maintenance of total information systems including cloud services.

name: DATA APPLICATIONS CO LTD
businessSummary: Data Applications Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software related business.
