The Company is engaged in the development, sale and maintenance of basic software products, supporting the business processes of companies centered on data exchange middleware, and the provision of introduction and operation service of software products. The Company operates through Software-related segment. Products include an enterprise data linkage platform ACMS Apex, an integrated electronic data interchange (EDI) server ACMS B2B, EDI clients ACMS Lite Neo and ACMS/WS, and a Web-EDI system platform ACMS Web Framer, file exchange ACMS Web/deTrade II and others.

name: PERSOL HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: PERSOL HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of general human resource services. The Company has six segments. The Dispatching and Business Process Outsourcing(BPO) segment is engaged in the provision of dispatching services, as well as consulting and other BPO services. The Recruiting segment is engaged in the recruitment advertisement and recommendation business. The PROGRAMMED segment is engaged in the facilities maintenance business and the staffing business. The PERSOLKELLY segment is engaged in the provision of staffing, recruitment, outsourcing and other services in Asia-Pacific under the PERSOLKELLY brand. The Information Technology Outsourcing (ITO) segment is engaged in the planning and development of communication networks and systems, as well as the information and communication technology (ICT) outsourcing business. The Engineering segment is engaged in the provision of human resource services in mechanical design and other technical fields.

name: TENSHO ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Tensho Electric Industries Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts, logistics industry materials, mechanical parts and molds, as well as the real estate-related businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Japan Molding segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts, logistics industry materials, mechanical parts and molds. The China Molding segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of logistics industry materials, mechanical parts and dies. The American Molding segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechanical parts and dies. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the leasing of buildings.

name: TENTIAL INC
businessSummary: Tential Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of the TENTIAL conditioning brand. The conditioning brand business develops and sells products that can be easily incorporated into daily life to support good health, including the BAKUNE line of nightwear designed to improve the quality of sleep when worn. The Company's main products are the BAKUNE RECOVERY WEAR series of nightwear using a special fiber with far-infrared radiation effect, the MIGARU series of comfort tech wear, INSOLE series, Recovery Sandals series, and Comforter series. The products are sold through the Company's e-commerce site tential.jp, Amazon, Rakuten Ichiba, Yahoo! Shopping and other e-commerce malls, TENTIAL stores, clothing stores, general merchandise stores and electronics retailers.

name: TERUMO CORP
businessSummary: Terumo Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical devices and pharmaceuticals. The Company operates in three segments. The Cardiovascular Company segment provides guidewires for angiography, catheters for angiography, introducer sheaths, coils, stents and bag embolization devices for treatment of cerebral aneurysms, artificial lungs and artificial heart-lung machines. The Medical Care Solutions Company segment provides hospital care solutions, life care solutions, and pharmaceutical solutions. The Blood and Cell Technology Company segment provides blood bags, component blood collection systems, automated blood product systems, pathogen reduction systems, and centrifugal blood component separators.

name: TERA PROBE INC
businessSummary: Tera Probe, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in wafer testing, and final test consignment. The Company operates in two business segments. The Memory segment is mainly engaged in the contract wafer testing business of dynamic random access memory (DRAM) produced by semiconductor manufacturers and fabrication factories. The System Large-scale Integration (LSI) segment is principally involved in the contract wafer testing business of semiconductor products such as System on Chips (SoCs), image sensors and analogs produced by domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers and fabrication factories. This segment also operates contract final testing business.

name: TERASAKI ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: TERASAKI ELECTRIC CO., LTD. is a company engaged in the manufacture and sale of marine and industrial systems, as well as electrical equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. The System segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of power distribution systems, monitoring and controlling systems, group starter panels, cogeneration systems and medical equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance and after services and engineering services for its products. The Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of low voltage breakers, such as air circuit breakers, electrical circuit breakers and leakage circuit breakers.

name: TENO.HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: teno.Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of childcare services. The Company is engaged in the operation of public childcare schools and consignment childcare schools. The Company operates in two business segments. The Public Child Care segment is engaged in the operation of licensed nursery schools, certified nursery schools and others. The Entrusted Childcare segment is engaged in outsourcing childcare projects in places such as workplaces and hospitals. The Company is involved in the dispatch of nursery teachers to other kindergartens and nursery schools, the provision of babysitting services and house services, the operation of tenoSCHOOL, the operation of unlicensed daycare centers, small-scale licensed daycare centers and long-term care facilities. The Company also operates a long-term care business and housing for the elderly.

name: TENOX CORP
businessSummary: TENOX CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the construction works, as well as the sale of construction materials. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction business and the leasing of construction machinery. The Civil Engineering and Construction Consulting and Others segment is engaged in the provision of consultation services for civil engineering and construction, as well as brokerage services for construction properties. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had four consolidated subsidiaries.

name: TEKKEN CORP
businessSummary: TEKKEN CORPORATION is a company primarily engaged in the civil engineering business and construction business. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the civil engineering works. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction works. The Real Estate segment is engaged in businesses related to house and land development. The Ancillary segment engages in the sales of equipment and materials related to civil engineering work. The Others segment is engaged in the the operation of sports facilities, as well as private finance initiative businesses.

name: TEKSCEND PHOTOMASK CORP
businessSummary: Tekscend Photomask Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of photomasks for semiconductors. The Company operates its business through the photomask business segment. The Company’s products are made to order based on specifications provided by customers and include binary masks, phase shift masks and extreme ultraviolet (EUV) photomasks. The Company is also involved in the development and manufacturing of molds for nanoimprint and silicon stencil masks.

name: TECNOS DATA SCIENCE ENGINEERING INC
businessSummary: TDSE Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in big data and artificial intelligence (AI) solution business. The business is divided into two categories, including consulting business centered on AI know-how and product business based on AI products. The consulting business centered on AI know-how provides integrated solutions centered on AI for companies aiming for data management, providing services including digital transformation and artificial intelligence (DX/AI) assessment, DX/AI consulting, analysis design/analysis, system construction/implementation, maintenance/tuning, and education. The product business based on AI products promotes the sale of its own AI products TDSE series and other companies' AI products, as well as services that provide business-specific AI modules to client companies.

name: TECHNOPRO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: TechnoPro Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in dispatch and contract engineers in the fields of machinery, electrical/electronics, embedded control, software development and maintenance, biochemistry and construction management. It operates through four business segments. Research and Development (R&D) Outsourcing segment provides engineer dispatch and contract work in the technical fields of machinery, electric & electronics, embedded control, information technology networks, business applications, system maintenance and operation. Construction Management Outsourcing segment dispatches engineers for construction management in the areas of construction, civil engineering. It also provides contract work for creating architectural drawings. Overseas segment provides technology outsourcing and recruitment services in China, Singapore, India and the United Kingdom. Domestic and Other segment provides recruitment services and technical education and training services.

name: TECHNO MEDICA CO LTD
businessSummary: Techno Medica Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in development, manufacture, sale and export of analysis device for clinical examination equipment and other medical equipment, as well as devices repair services. The blood collection tube preparation apparatus business provides blood collection peripheral equipment, such as blood and urine collection automation reception equipment, among others, as well as blood tube preparation systems. The laboratory test apparatus business provides blood gas analysis apparatus, electrolyte analyzers, erythrocyte sedimetation rate measuring machines, among others. The consumable goods business provides blood collecting tubes, labels, sensor cards, calibration packs, among others, as well as maintenance services.

name: TECHNO QUARTZ INC
businessSummary: Techno Quartz Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of quartz products for semiconductors. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of chromatograph equipment and consumables. Quartz glass products include quartz rings, large-diameter chambers, reactors, and cells for spectrophotometers. Processed products of crystalline silicon materials include gas shower plates and large plates.

name: TECHNO RYOWA LTD
businessSummary: TECHNO RYOWA LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the design and construction of equipment construction centered on air conditioning and sanitary equipment technology, the sale, repair and renovation of cooling (air conditioning) equipment, as well as the research of related to each business activities. The Equipment Construction segment is mainly engaged in the design and construction of equipment work centered on air conditioning and sanitary equipment technology, the design and construction of electrical equipment work, as well as the sale of cooling and heating equipment associated with related works.

name: TIEMCO LTD
businessSummary: TIEMCO LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the planning, development, import, export and sale of fishing and outdoor products. The Company operates in three business segments. The Fishing Product segment provides lure fishing products, fly-fishing products and other fishing products. The Outdoor Product segment provides outdoor apparels under the brand Foxfire and other outdoor activity-related items. The Others segment is involved in the property and casualty insurance agency business and the real estate leasing business.

name: TEIJIN LTD
businessSummary: Teijin Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the materials, textiles and products, healthcare, information technology (IT) and other business. It has four business segments. The Material segment includes the high performance materials business, which manufactures and sells aramid fibers, resins and others, and the composite molding materials business, which manufactures and sells composite molding materials. The Textiles and Products segment manufactures and sells textile products and manufactures and sells polyester fibers and textiles. The Healthcare segment manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and medical devices, provides home medical services, and manufactures and sells other healthcare-related products. IT segment operates, develops, and maintains information systems, and provides electronic comic distribution services. It also manufactures and sells battery components, and develops, manufactures and sells regenerative medicine products and implantable medical devices.

name: TEIKOKU ELECTRIC MFG. CO LTD
businessSummary: TEIKOKU ELECTRIC MFG. CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturer of pumps and electronic parts. The Company operates in two business segments. The Pumps segment manufactures and sells motor pumps for chemicals including chemical machine motor pumps, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) machine motor pumps, cooling machine and air-conditioner motor pumps, as well as motor pumps for machines other than chemicals including semiconductor motor pumps and electricity-related machine motor pumps. The Electronic Parts segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile electronic components including control units and automobile electronics, as well as industrial machine circuit boards including sequencer circuit boards. The other business includes the provision of special equipment, health products and staffing services.

name: TEIKOKU SEN-I CO LTD
businessSummary: Teikoku Sen-I Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the disaster prevention, textile, and real estate leasing businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Disaster Prevention segment manufactures, purchases, and sells fire hoses, chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosive (CBRNE) disaster prevention equipment, rescue vehicles, special disaster prevention vehicles, and airport chemical fire trucks. The Textile segment manufactures, processes, and sells textile materials for government agencies and high-performance textile materials such as Nomex for industrial use for private demand. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases land for shopping centers, and others. The Other segment provides insurance agency services.

name: TAKE AND GIVE NEEDS CO LTD
businessSummary: Take And Give Needs Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the domestic wedding business. The Company operates through the Domestic Wedding Business segment. The Domestic Wedding Business segment is involved in the planning and operation of domestic house weddings and restaurant weddings, as well as various product planning. The Company is also involved in the finance and credit business, travel business and childcare business.

name: TAYCA CORP
businessSummary: TAYCA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical products and electro ceramics. The Company operates in two business segments. The Titanium Oxide segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of titanium oxide, particle titanium oxide, particle zinc oxide, surface-treatment products and photocatalytic titanium oxide, among others. The Others segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of surface-acting agents, sulphonic acid and others, as well as the transportation and storage of industrial chemical products.

name: THK CO LTD
businessSummary: THK Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of linear motion (LM) guides and ball screws, as well as transportation equipment components such as link balls and suspension ball joints. The Company operates in five segments including Japan, Americas, Europe, China, and Others. The industrial equipment business primarily manufactures and sells mechanical components, mainly linear motion systems, and industrial machinery. The transportation equipment business primarily develops, designs, manufactures, and sells steering parts, suspension parts, and brake parts for transportation equipment such as automobiles and motorcycles. Linear motion systems are mechanical components used in linear motion of machinery. It directly sells to manufacturers and distributors of industrial machinery, including machine tools, industrial robots, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, while other companies sell to other manufacturers and distributors.

name: TS TECH CO LTD
businessSummary: TS TECH CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of two-wheel vehicle seats and interior components. The Company operates in four segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of two-wheel vehicle seats and resin parts, four-wheel vehicle seats and interior components. The Americas segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of two-wheel vehicle seats and resin parts, four-wheel vehicle seats and interior components. The China segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of four-wheel vehicle seats and interior components. The Asia and Europe segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of two-wheel vehicle seats and resin parts, four-wheel seats and interior components.

name: T&D HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: T&D Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the life insurance business. The Company operates four business segments. The Taiyo Life Insurance segment provides life insurance services to the household market. The Daido Life Insurance segment provides life insurance business to the small and medium-sized business market. The T&D Financial Life Insurance segment operates with the boarding agency market as its respective sales market and has different sales products under its own sales policy. The T&D United Capital segment is engaged in strategic business investments in the life insurance business and new growth business areas.

name: TDK CORP
businessSummary: TDK Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of passive components, sensor application products, magnetic application products and energy application products. The Company operates through four business segments. The Passive Components segment is engaged in the provision of ceramic capacitors, aluminum electrolytic capacitors, film capacitors, inductive devices, high frequency components, piezoelectric material components and circuit protection components. The Sensor Application Products segment is engaged in the provision of temperature and pressure sensors, magnetic sensors and micro electromechanical system (MEMS) sensors. The Magnetic Application Products segment is engaged in the provision of hard disk drive (HDD) heads, HDD suspensions and magnets. The Energy Application Products segment is engaged in the provision of energy devices and power supplies. The Company is also involved in the provision of mechatronics and micro actuators products.

name: TSI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: TSI Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the apparel related business and other business. The Apparel Related segment is mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of fashion and apparel products such as women's clothing, men's clothing and fashion accessories, as well as the license brand business, and the production and logistics business. The Company is also engaged in the other businesses such as the sales agency and staffing business, the synthetic resin products manufacturing and sale business, the store design supervision business, the food and beverage business, as well as the import and sale of cosmetics and soaps. The brands include apparel brands such as ADORE, and wander, Apuweiser-riche, Arpege Story, AVIREX, BAIT, BOSCH, BEAVER and others, food and beverage brands such as Urth Caffe, Patisserie Slier and others, as well as licensed brands such as PRIVATE LABEL, VIVAYOU, Pinky Girls, VertDense, MATERIA, NOVESPAZIO, BRIGITTE and others.

name: TOA CORP (HYOGO)
businessSummary: TOA Corp is a Japan-based company operates manufacturing, sales, and related businesses mainly in the audio and video fields. The Company sells audio and video equipment and others through five segments: Japan, Asia Pacific, Europe and Middle East and Africa, America, China and East Asia. Additionally, the Japan segment produces audio equipment, video equipment. The Company’s products include emergency broadcast equipment, commercial broadcast equipment, wireless systems, intercom systems, sound systems, and loudspeaker equipment and others.

name: TRE HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: TRE Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the waste treatment and recycling business, renewable energy business, environmental engineering business and resource recycling business. The waste treatment and recycling business includes collection and transportation, intermediate treatment, recycling and final disposal site. The renewable energy business operates a woody biomass power plant that mainly uses forest resources as fuel. The environmental engineering business develops, manufactures and sells environmental equipment, plants and specially equipped vehicles. The environmental consulting business includes measurement certification business, environmental measures business, hazardous waste investigation and analysis business. The resource recycling business includes metal recycling business, automobile recycling business, industrial waste treatment business, home appliance recycling business and other businesses.

name: TSURUMI MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: Tsurumi Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pumps. It operates through four regional segments including Japan, North America, Asia, and Europe. It manufactures, purchases, sells (including imports and exports), and leases various pumps, mainly submersible pumps, environmental equipment, and related equipment, as well as provides repair and after-sales services. It also engages in machinery and equipment installation, civil engineering, electrical work, piping, waterworks, cleaning facilities, steel structure construction, secondhand goods sales, fixed asset leasing, and the casting, manufacture, purchasing and sale of various pump parts. It is also engaged in real estate rental and machinery, office equipment and vehicle leasing business.

name: TSURUHA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Tsuruha Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of product sale business centered on pharmaceuticals and cosmetics. The Company is engaged in the management of drug stores that sell pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, miscellaneous goods, the sale of pharmaceuticals, the sale of pharmaceuticals based on pharmacy and store sales business in Kanto area, Hokkaido area, Kanto Koshinetsu, Tohoku area, Chugoku, Kyushu area, Shizuoka prefecture, Aichi prefecture, Hiroshima prefecture, the management of drug store management subsidiary, product procurement and logistics planning, business negotiations, procurement operation business, the planning, development and sale promotion of private brand products, the mail order business for the products handled by telephone and Internet, the insurance agency business and management guidance management, real estate leasing business, as well as the rental of vending machines and sale of beverages.

name: TSUBAKIMOTO CHAIN CO
businessSummary: Tsubakimoto Chain Co is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of drive chains, conveyor chains, reducers, linear actuators, engine timing chain systems, and conveying, sorting, and storage systems. The Company operates four segments. The Chain segment includes drive chains, small conveyor chains, large conveyor chains, plastic modular chains, top chains and others. The Motion Control segment includes reducers, linear actuators, shaft couplings, fasteners, clutches, electrical control devices, mechanical overload protection devices, and others. The Mobility segment includes engine timing chain systems (cam drives, accessory drives), transfer case chains and others. The Material Handling segment provides systems for the logistics industry, life sciences, newspaper printing plants, automotive, and other transport, sorting, and others. The Company also engages in building maintenance, insurance agency services, and new business ventures.

name: TSUBAKIMOTO KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: TSUBAKIMOTO KOGYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of automated and labor-saving products such as machine parts and transport equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The East Japan Headquarters segment and West Japan Headquarters segment provide various drive components such as transmissions and reduction gears, various transport components such as conveyor chains, control devices, various sensors, electronic devices, other transmission devices, clean energy-related equipment, pharmaceutical-related equipment, chemical machinery, water treatment equipment, food machinery, other environmental equipment, machine tools, industrial robots, various conveyors, various automation equipment and automatic sorting equipment. The Development Strategy Division segment provides various nonwoven fabrics, processed products, various synthetic resin molding machines and molded products, and functional materials overseas.

name: TSUBAKI NAKASHIMA CO LTD
businessSummary: TSUBAKI NAKASHIMA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision balls, ball screws and air blowers. The Company operates through three segments. The Precision Component segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of ball bearings, ceramic balls, cemented carbide balls, glass balls, plastic balls, carbon steel balls and other precision ball products, as well as rollers, retainers and sheet metal parts. The Linear segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision ball screws, ball screws for high-load, precision miniature ball screws, caged precision ball screws, hollow shaft ball screws, precision rolled ball screws, general industrial ball screws and other ball screw products, as well as air blowers. The Others segment is engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: TSUZUKI DENKI CO LTD
businessSummary: TSUZUKI DENKI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of information network solution services and electronic devices. It operates through two business segments. Information Network Solution Service segment has three kinds of services. Network integration business provides global communications, Internet Protocol (IP) telephony solutions, call center solutions and other network solutions. System integration services provide various business solutions in the fields of manufacture, real estate, medical care and others. Service business provides network monitoring services, network diagnostics, network operations services, life cycle management (LCM) services, cloud services, support desks, security services and information technology (IT) infrastructure control services. Electronic Devices segment is engaged in the provision, design and development of semiconductors, electronic components, embedded server equipment and office supplies, as well as devices solution.

name: TSUTSUMI JEWELRY CO LTD
businessSummary: TSUTSUMI JEWELRY CO., LTD. is a Japan-based jewelry company. The Company is engaged in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of jewelry, such as rings, necklaces, bracelets and other accessories. The Company sells its products through its direct jewelry specialty stores.

name: TSUKURUBA INC
businessSummary: Tsukuruba Inc is a Japan-based company develops by combining Information and communication technology and design. The Company operates in two business segments. Cowcamo segment is involved in the provision of services, such as property information distribution services through online media, broker services by the Company’s own agents, as well as support services for sellers and business utilizing customer needs and property data. The segment provides its services through the renovation and second-hand housing distribution platform cowcamo. Shared Workplace segment develops business centered on the sharing service of workspaces that provides working place combining services with renovated office spaces as a subscription type service. The Segment provides Co-working space co-ba, whose main customers are people and organizations such as startups, individual business owners and creators, as well as HEYSHA, which can rent office space flexibly according to the growth and change of Company.

name: TSUKUBASEIKO CO LTD
businessSummary: TSUKUBASEIKO Co,.Ltd. is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of electrostatic chucks. The electrostatic chucks generate high adsorption power at low voltage and realize cordless and thin Carrier type electrostatic chucks. The Company's products include supporters, stages and others. The supporters is a system of electrostatic chuck which can maintain adsorption power for a long time even if it is separated from a power supply unit, and generate adsorption by using power supply units when adsorbing the materials. The stages is a system of electrostatic chuck to which a power supply unit belongs, supplies power when adsorbing the materials and stops power supply when releasing the material to be attracted. The other products include small electrostatic chucks, including other applied products of electrostatic chucks, embedded in handling materials for semiconductor wafers.

name: TWINBIRD CORP
businessSummary: Twinbird Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of home appliances, and new cooling technology free piston stirling coolers (FPSC) and its applied products. The Company is engaged in the planning, manufacture and sales of home electric appliances, quality management and production management. Products are light emitting diode (LED) desk stand, rice cooker, microwave oven, home bakery, toaster, coffee maker, stick type cleaner, handy cleaner, horizontal cleaner, hand steamer, air purifier, refrigerators, shoe dryers, humidifiers, circulators, electric fans, washing machines, refrigerators, electronic refrigerators, bathroom liquid crystal display televisions, radios, waterproof compact discs (CDs) players, massagers, head care, face steamers, and beauty and health equipment, FPSC refrigerator-freezers.

name: CHIYODA CORP
businessSummary: Chiyoda Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the integrated engineering business. The Engineering segment is engaged in the planning of various industrial and consumer facilities, as well as pollution control, environment improvement and disaster prevention facilities. This segment is also engaged in the design, procurement and installation of related devices and equipment, civil engineering and construction works, electrical works, instrument and pipe works, trial operation, as well as other related businesses. The other segment is engaged in the provision of travel services, air transportation services, consultation services on finance, accounting and tax, employee detachment and investigation, as well as the provision of education training and reemployment services.

name: CHIYODA INTEGRE CO LTD
businessSummary: CHIYODA INTEGRE CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production and sale of mechanical parts and functional parts. The Company operates through three regional segments including Japan, Southeast Asia and China. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture of mechanical and functional parts for office automation (OA) equipment, audio and video (AV) equipment, communication equipment, automobiles and other products, and the sale of products mainly to electric manufacturers, as well as the sale of raw materials to subsidiaries, and the provision of royalties. The Company is also engaged in the reception of orders mainly from manufacturers of handicrafts and accessories, and the process and sale of felt products through a subsidiary.

name: CHIYODA CO LTD
businessSummary: Chiyoda Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the retail and wholesale of footwear. The Company operates in two business segments. The Shoes segment is engaged in retail and wholesale of shoes. The Clothing segment is engaged in the retail of clothing. Stores include TOKYO SHOES RETAILING CENTER, SHOE PLAZA, CHIYODA HAKI-GOKOCHI, Chiyoda, cloverleaf, SPC. The brands include HYDRO-TECH, CEDAR CREST, Bio Fitter, Cristiano Rossani, fuwaraku, cloverleaf, ChiffonFit, KIREI WALK, FILA, be GAIA, Regent Street, Shutte, ELLE SPORT, McGREGOR, TEXACO, OCEAN PACIFIC, Yukiko Kimijima, Zipper, SAVOY, GERRY COSBY, SURPLUS, reyn spooner and AMERICANINO EDWIN.

name: CHOFU SEISAKUSHO CO LTD
businessSummary: CHOFU SEISAKUSHO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture of hot water supply equipment, air conditioning equipment, system devices and solar equipment. Its main products include hot water supply equipment, such as oil-fired water heaters, gas-fired water heaters, electric water heaters, eco water heaters and cogeneration systems; air conditioning equipment, such as air conditioning, hot water systems and oil heating equipment for household uses; system devices, such as system bathrooms, system kitchens and bathroom vanities, as well as solar equipment, including solar power generation devices, solar underfloor ventilation fans and solar water heaters, among others. The Company operates the manufacture and sales of housing related equipment.

name: CHUBU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in a variety of businesses in its core area of energy business supplying electricity and gas, as well as overseas energy business, construction and manufacturing related to energy business, and real estate business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Mirise segment is engaged in the sale of electricity and gas and provides various services. The Power Grid segment provides power network services. The JERA segment is engaged in upstream and procurement of fuel, power generation, and sales of electricity and gas. The Company also operates businesses in renewable energy, business creation, global business, nuclear power, and administrative overhead.

name: CHUBUSHIRYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Chubushiryo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the feed business. The Feed segment manufactures and sells livestock feed for chickens, pigs, and cattle, as well as aquatic feed for fish. In addition, the Company is also involved in the sale of livestock and marine products to consumers, the sale of livestock equipment, the manufacture and sale of compound fertilizers, the leasing of real estate for utilizing former factory sites, insurance agency business, and egg business.

name: CHUGOKU MARINE PAINTS LTD
businessSummary: CHUGOKU MARINE PAINTS, LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of paint, as well as the provision of contract painting services. The Company has five geographical segments, including Japan segment, China segment, Korea segment, Southeast Asia segment and Europe and America segment. Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of paint, as well as the management of real estate business. The other four reporting segments are engaged in the manufacture and sale of paint.

name: CHUGOKU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Chugoku Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electric power business, comprehensive energy supply business and information and communication business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Electric Power Business segment supplies electricity based on the Chugoku region as the basis for business development. The Comprehensive Energy Supply Business segment is engaged in the sale of liquefied natural gas (LNG) and provision of energy utilization services such as electricity and heat sales. The Information and Communications Business segment provides telecommunications services and information processing services that utilize information and communication technology (ICT). The Company also provides environmental harmony creation, business and life support, and electric power business support.

name: CHUGOKUKOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: CHUGOKUKOGYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of high-pressure gas containers, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas storage tanks and equipment, steel structure equipment products and facility equipment products. The Company operates through four business segments. The High-Pressure Equipment segment manufactures and sells high-pressure gas containers, LP gas equipment, LP gas storage tanks and other high-pressure gas storage tanks, as well as designs and constructs high-pressure gas-related equipment. The Steel Structure Equipment segment manufactures and sells inner covers and other various steel structure products for steel manufacturers. The Facility Equipment segment manufactures and sells feed tanks and containers, wastewater treatment equipment, livestock machinery, chemical tanks, deodorizers and various other reinforced plastic (FRP) products. The Transportation segment includes general area freight forwarding, moving and warehousing.

name: CHUGAI PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Chugai Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture, sale, import and export of pharmaceutical products. The pharmaceutical products and medical devices for patients include ACTEMRA, Avastin, ALAGLIO, Aresensa, Kadosaira, Gazaiba, Seruseputo, Zeruborafu, Zeroda, Taruseba, Tecentoriku, Pajeta and other products. The products are mainly applied to the treatment of cancer, kidney diseases, kidney transplantation, bone and joint diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis, osteoporosis, knee osteoarthritis and locomotive syndrome, influenza, hemophilia and other diseases. The Company is also engaged in the provision of management services, transportation and storage services, as well as drug information literature research services. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including Switzerland, United Kingdom, Germany, France, China, Singapore, Korea and the United States.

name: CENTRAL AUTOMOTIVE PRODUCTS LTD
businessSummary: Central Automotive Products Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wholesale, import and export of automobile parts, supplies and accessories, as well as the manufacture and sale of automobile supplies. It operates through two segments. The Auto Parts and Supplies Sales segment is engaged in the development, sale, import and export of automobile parts, supplies, new products and related services, the sale of new and used cars, and the manufacture and sale of chemical supplies. The Automobile Disposal segment is engaged in the disposal of vehicles certified as total losses by non-life insurance companies.

name: CHUOKEIZAI SHA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Chuokeizai-Sha Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in publishing business that publishes and sells specialized books and magazines related to corporate management and other fields, as well as publishing related business about advertising contract agent. The publishing business is engaged in the planning, editing, production and sale of books, magazines, and mooks, as well as the planning and production of corporate PR magazines and newsletters. The publishing related business is engaged in advertising agency contract business for media mainly in the fields of tax and accounting, as well as the planning and production of corporate product catalogs and sales promotion brochures. The Company is also engaged in the storage, loading & unloading, inventory management of publications, as well as the management and leasing of real estate.

name: KUBELL CO LTD
businessSummary: kubell Co Ltd, formerly Chatwork Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of business communication tools developed in-house and sales agent of security software. The Company operates in two segments. The Chatwork segment is mainly engaged in the development and provision of business chat tool Chatwork. It is also engaged in the provision of advertising service and various services using Chatwork as a service platform. The sgement also develops and provides cloud storage services, such as Secure SAMBA. The Security segment purchases and sells security software. The Security Segment is engaged in the purchases and sales of security software. The Company’s sales site uses web advertisement and affiliate programs to attract customers and sell software.

name: CHIBA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Chiba Bank Ltd is a Japan-based bank mainly engaged in the banking business and the financial services business. The Bank is engaged in the banking business, stores maintenance and management business, accounting business, employment placement business, receivables management and collection business, securities business, credit guarantee business, collection business, credit card business, leasing business, software development and information processing business, venture capital business, investment management and advisory business, research and consulting business, fintech research business, as well as the planning and development of financial services.

name: CHANGE INC
businessSummary: Change Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the NEW- information technology (IT) transformation business and public tech business. The Company operates through two business segments. The NEW-IT Transformation Business segment is divided into the areas of resolving labor shortages and cybersecurity and provides solutions that bring about change to the business operations and business models of Japanese companies through new technologies and digital human resource development, improving productivity and added value, as well as internet security services. The Public Tech Business segment is divided into the regional revitalization and public digital transformation (DX) areas and provides platform business for hometown tax donations and solutions for government agencies.

name: TEAMSPIRIT INC
businessSummary: TeamSpirit Inc. mainly provides professional services for enterprises. The Company provides two types of service: license and professional service. The license service is provided by TeamSpirit and TeamSpirit Leaders products. TeamSpirit is mainly SaaS which integrates attendance management, work management, man-hour management, expense adjustment, electronic approval, calendar, SNS, among others. TeamSpirit Leaders is one of the family products of TeamSpirit, and it is the project of project cost management that is used in combination with TeamSpirit as the main business. Professional service is a premier support product, and it mainly consists of paid support work carried out by a consultant in charge for the customer's production operation and steady operation.

name: W TOKYO INC
businessSummary: W TOKYO Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the utilizing of the TOKYO GIRLS COLLECTION brand. The Company is engaged in the TGC production business that receives income from sponsorship money, ticket sales, and brand exhibition fees of TOKYO GIRLS COLLECTION. The Company operates content production and branding business that earn advertising casting income and creative production income by branding products. The Company is also engaged in digital advertising business, develops affiliate service provider (ASP) Affiliate Walker and official media girlswalker.

name: WDB COCO CO LTD
businessSummary: WDB coco CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the contract development of pharmaceutical companies. The Company is engaged in the provision of safety information management service as an agent and support for drug development, document support service, development support service and clinical development support service. The safety information management service provides support services such as input, evaluation drafting and report drafting. The document support service provides support services from QC (quality assurance) and translation of documents and materials necessary for marketing approval to PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency) to the creation of approval application called CTD (Common Technical Document). The development support service provides services such as survey form management, filing of survey-related documents and call center operations. The clinical development support service provides support services for clinical trial related work.

name: WA INC
businessSummary: WA, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the plan and sale of women's shoes. The plan and sale of women's shoes business is involved in the product planning and development business, the product inspection business and the product sale business. The product sale business is involved in the retail sale at physical stores and EC sites, as well as wholesale and sale at other fashion brands. The Company is engaged in the sale of products under the brands of ORiental Traffic, WA ORiental Traffic, NICAL and OR KIDS.

name: W-SCOPE CORP
businessSummary: W-Scope Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of separators for lithium-ion secondary batteries. Microporous membranes made of polyolefin are generally used for the separators of main products, and their role is to separate the positive and negative electrode materials while ensuring lithiumion conductivity between the positive and negative electrodes. In addition, when the battery becomes abnormally hot and reaches a high temperature, the safety mechanism (shutdown property) in which the polyolefin melts and closes the pores plays an important role in stopping the movement of lithium ions and safely stopping the battery's function, responsible for battery safety.

name: WDB HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: WDB HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a company mainly engaged in the manpower dispatching business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Human Resource Service segment is engaged in the work of client customers mainly through temporary staffing and contracting contracts. The CRO (Contract Research Organization) business segment acts on and supports experimental work in basic research of pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, cosmetics and development work after clinical trial. The other business is engaged in the contracted manufacture of organic chemicals, as well as the product development and sale, and the research of the aquaculture and breeding of clams, fishes and algae, among others.

name: DAIWA INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: DAIWA INDUSTRIES LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of freezers, refrigerators, showcases and ice machines, purchase and sales of cooling and heating equipment for commercial uses, and provision of inspection, repair and leasing services of its equipment. The Company is also engaged in design and construction of stores and kitchens, leasing of freezers, refrigerators and others.

name: DAIWABO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiwabo Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture, processing and sale of textile products, sale of information equipment, manufacture and sale of machine tools. It has four business segments. Information Technology Infrastructure Distribution business sells computer and peripheral equipment, provides one-stop services of logistics and technical services, provides solution business of system development, network construction. Textiles business is engaged in manufacture, processing and sale of synthetic cotton, non-woven products, industrial materials products, textiles, knits, secondary products. Industrial Machinery business manufactures and sells machine tools, automatic machines. It is also engaged in hotel business, real estate leasing and management, provision of general affairs, personnel and financial services, development and operation of information processing systems, civil engineering and construction, insurance agency and finance business.

name: DAIWA HOUSE INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiwa House Industry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly is engaged in comprehensive business operations in the lifestyle infrastructure industry. The Company operates through six core business segments. The Detached Houses segment is engaged in custom-building and sales of detached houses. The Rental Houses segment is engaged in development, construction, management, operation, and brokerage of rental housing. The Condominium segment develops, sells, and manages condominiums. The Commercial Facilities segment develops, constructs, manages, and operates commercial facilities. The Business Facilities segment develops, constructs, manages, and operates logistics and manufacturing facilities, medical and nursing care facilities, and other facilities. The Environmental Energy segment includes the development and construction of renewable energy power plants, renewable energy power generation, and electricity retailing. The Company also develops other businesses.

name: GLOBERIDE INC
businessSummary: Globeride Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of fishing equipment, golf equipment, and racket sports equipment. The Company operates through four regional segments: Japan, Americas, Europe, Asia and Oceania. The Japan segment manufactures and sells equipment, repairs, provides employee welfare services, and handles warehouse cargo. The Americas segment sells equipment. The Europe segment and Asia and Oceania segments manufacture and sell equipment.

name: DAIWA SECURITIES GROUP INC
businessSummary: Daiwa Securities Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the securities related business and other investment and financial business. The Company operates through four business segments. Retail segment is engaged in the provision of financial products and services for individuals and unlisted corporates. Wholesale segment is engaged in the global markets business, including the sale and trading of stocks, bonds and others, as well as the global investment banking business, including securities underwriting, merger and acquisition (M&A) advisory and others. Asset Management segment is engaged in the establishment and management of investment trusts, and the provision of investment advisory and management services for pension assets. Investment segment is engaged in the provision of investment recovery in existing projects, and the creation of new investment funds. The Company is also engaged in the management, banking, information and real estate leasing business.

name: DAIWA CYCLE CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiwa Cycle Co Ltd is a Japan-based company sells bicycles and bicycle parts and accessories, and provides bicycle maintenance and repair services, primarily at its stores. The Company operates its business through the Bicycle-Related Sales segment. The Company sells bicycles, including general-purpose, infant/child, sports, and electrically power assisted bicycles, as well as parts and accessories, including baskets, batteries, tires, helmets, and other items. The Company also provides various maintenance, repair, and other ancillary services, as well as long-term warranty services. In addition to directly managed stores, the Company sells directly to customers through franchise stores and e-commerce.

name: RESONA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Resona Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of financial services such as banking and trust services, credit card services and venture capital services. The Company operates in four segments. The Retail Division segment is mainly engaged in consulting services related to personal loans, asset management, and succession of assets, etc., for individual customers. The Corporate Division segment is mainly engaged in business for corporate clients, focusing on support for business growth, including corporate lending, asset management using trusts, real estate operations, corporate pensions, and business succession. The Market Division Segment is mainly engaged in financing and investment of funds, foreign exchange, bonds, and derivatives through financial markets. The Kansai Mirai Financial Group segment is engaged in banking business in the Kansai region, including deposit and lending business.

name: DIRECT MARKETING MIX INC
businessSummary: Direct Marketing MIX Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the marketing business and on-site business. The Company has two business segments. The Marketing segment is engaged in the direct marketing business, consulting business and business process outsourcing business. The direct marketing business is engaged in the sale of products and services to end users on behalf of client companies through channels such as telephone contact, direct visit and Web contact by communicators. The consulting business is engaged in the provision of strategies and plans formulation services, system construction and actual operation services, as well as consulting services such as contact center operation and product development, training and market research. The business process outsourcing business is engaged in the labor saving and simplification support business. The On-Site segment is engaged in the temporary staffing business, including dispatch of communicators for marketing business.

name: MITSUBISHI HC CAPITAL INC
businessSummary: Mitsubishi HC Capital Inc, formerly Mitsubishi UFJ Lease & Finance Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the financial business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Customer Finance segment is engaged in the finance lease and installment sale of machinery, equipment and fixtures, as well as the provision of monetary loan services and other related financial services. The Asset Finance segment is engaged in the operating lease of machinery and transportation equipment, the investment and loan businesses related to real estate, the management of securities, the finance business related to aircrafts and ships, as well as the leasing of office buildings.

name: DIAMOND ELECTRIC HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Diamond Electric Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic control devices such as ignition coils and electrical components for automobiles. The Company operates through three business segments. The Automotive Equipment segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and supply of maintenance services for automotive ignition coils and electrical components. The Energy Solutions segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and supply of maintenance services for power conditioners for solar power generation and hybrid systems for energy storage. The Electronic Devices segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and supply of maintenance services for ignition devices for home heating and cooling systems and hot water supply systems, electronic control devices, and other products.

name: DAIHO CORP
businessSummary: Daiho Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business, focusing on civil engineering and architectural works. The Company operates in three business segments. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in all civil engineering works. The Construction segment is engaged in all architectural works. The Others segment is engaged in real estate sales and rentals, as well as the sale and rental of construction materials.

name: DIVE INC
businessSummary: Dive Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the tourism human resources (HR) business, regional revitalization business, and information system business. The Company operates through three segments. The Tourism HR Business segment provides HR services specializing in resort jobs, and provides temporary staffing and placement services to resort hotels and inns, restaurants, theme parks, leisure facilities, ski resorts, and other tourist facilities throughout Japan. The Regional Revitalization Business segment operates lodging facilities such as glamping facilities in five locations throughout Japan. The Information System Business segment provides general support services for clients' information systems.

name: DAIFUKU CO LTD
businessSummary: Daifuku Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of material handling systems and equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of car wash machines, industrial personal computers and interface boards. The Company operates in five business segments. The Daifuku segment manufactures and sells material handling systems and equipment, and car wash machines, and provides after-sales services. The Content segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides after-sales services for personal computer (PC) peripherals and industrial computer network equipment. The DNA segment manufactures and sells material handling systems and equipment, mainly in North America. The CFI segment manufactures and sells clean room transport systems, mainly to semiconductor manufacturers in South Korea, and provides after-sales services for clean room transport systems, mainly to semiconductor manufacturers in China. The other businesses include after-sales services.

name: KDDI CORP
businessSummary: KDDI CORPORATION is a telecommunications company. The Company operates in four segments. The Personal segment is engaged in the provision of communication services for personal and home, including au mobile phone, and fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) and cable television (CATV) services, among others. The Life Design segment provides commerce services, financial services, payment services, and content services such as video, music and information distribution. The Business segment offers various communication services, the sale of mobile handset, data center services and various Information and Communication Technology (ICT) solutions/cloud-based services to enterprise customers. The Global segment offers various communication services, data center services and various ICT solutions/Cloud-based services to to overseas customers. The Company also provides communication equipment maintenance service, as well as the research and development services of information communication.

name: SUMITOMO DAINIPPON PHARMA CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Pharma Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company operates through three geographical segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of prescription drugs, purchase and sale of medical devices, undertakes development and manufacture in the field of regenerative medicine and cellular medicine, and the manufacture of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and regenerative medicine products that have been developed through joint development in the field of regenerative medicine. This segment also provides storage and delivery service of pharmaceuticals. The North America segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of prescription drugs. The Asia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of prescription drugs (small packaging), and the import, purchase and sale of prescription drugs in Southeast Asia and Taiwan, as well as the provision and collection of information on products.

name: SCREEN HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Screen Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Company operates through four business segments. The Semiconductor Production Equipment (SPE) segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Graphics and Arts Equipment (GA) segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of printing related equipment. The Display Manufacturing Equipment and Film Forming Equipment (FT) segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of display manufacturing equipment and film forming equipment. The Printed Circuit Board-related Equipment (PE) segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of printed circuit board related equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of life science equipment, plan and production of documents, and development and sale of software.

name: DAI NIPPON PRINTING CO LTD
businessSummary: Dai Nippon Printing Co Ltd is a Japan-based engaged in business activities related to smart communications, life & healthcare, and electronics, mainly in the printing and soft drink businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Smart Communications segment is engaged in the provision of books, magazines, textbooks, e-books, digital marketing support for sales promotion and customer analysis, catalogs, flyers, pamphlets, calendars, thermal transfer products, and library operations. The Life & Healthcare segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of lithium-ion battery materials, solar battery materials, materials for transporting electronic components, multifunctional heat insulation boxes, fruit juice, functional beverages, interior and exterior materials, and pharmaceuticals. The Electronics segment manufactures and sells optical films for displays, large-size photomasks for liquid crystal displays, photomasks for semiconductor products, and other products.

name: DIC CORP
businessSummary: DIC Corp is a Japan-based Company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of printing inks, organic pigments, and synthetic resins. The Company operates three business segments. The Packaging & Graphics segment manufactures and sells gravure inks, offset inks, newspaper inks, jet inks, and polystyrene. The Color & Display segment manufactures and sells organic pigments, liquid crystal materials, and health care food products. The Functional Products segment manufactures and sells acrylic resins, urethane resins, epoxy resins, PPS compounds, and industrial tapes.

name: DAINICHISEIKA COLOR & CHEMICALS MFG CO L
businessSummary: DAINICHISEIKA COLOR & CHEMICALS MFG. CO., LTD. is a Japan-based comprehensive manufacturer of high-tech and color science. The Company operates in five business segments. The Chemical Product segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of paints and printing inks, inorganic and organic pigments and processed pigments for information display and recording, as well as colorants for fibers. The Chemical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of colorants for plastics such as master batches and resin compounds, as well as UV electron beam curable coating agent. The Macromolecule segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of urethane resin and nature polymeric products. The Printing Integrated System segment provides manufacturing and sales of printing ink and products and services incidental to the business. The Others segment is real estate leasing and financial business.

name: DAINICHI CO LTD
businessSummary: Dainichi Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of oil heating equipment, environmental equipment and coffee makers. The Company's products include kerosene heaters, such as oil fan heaters for household use and fuel stoves for business use; environmental equipment, such as humidifiers; coffee makers, coffee beans roasting equipment, smoke making machines, photosynthesis promotion machines and horticulture heaters, among others.

name: DAIDO STEEL CO LTD
businessSummary: Daido Steel Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly provides special steel products, functional and magnetic materials, automotive and industrial machinery parts, engineering, and distribution and services. It operates through five segments. The Special Steel Products segment manufactures and sells special steel products. The Functional and Magnetic Materials segment manufactures and sells stainless steel products, rare earth magnets, high-alloy products, materials for electrical and others. The Automotive and Industrial Machinery Parts segment manufactures and sells die-forged products, steel machinery products for trucks, band saw materials and others. The Engineering segment manufactures and sells steel equipment and environmental equipment. The Distribution and Services segment engages in real estate, insurance, the group's employee welfare business, golf course management, analysis of steel and ceramics, development and maintenance of information systems, and building rental.

name: DAIDO SIGNAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Daido Signal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of railway signaling equipment and industrial equipment, and the provision of maintenance and repair service to these equipment, as well as installation work of railway signaling equipment, the manufacture and sale of metal surface treatment and mold, and leasing of real estate. The Company operates through three business segments. The Railway Signal-related Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and installation of railway signal security equipment. The Industrial Equipment-related Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of information and communication equipment, traffic signal equipment, railroad vehicle supplies, gas detectors, plastic molded products, metal surface treatments, and molds. The Real Estate-related Business segment mainly rents real estate.

name: DAITO TRUST CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Daito Trust Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in real estate-related business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in the planning, design and construction of contracted works. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the brokerage, management and leasing of real estates, the provision of real estate information and guarantor contract business. The Financial segment is involved in the construction loan business, trust business, consulting business related to asset succession and asset management, and fire reinsurance business. It is also engaged in the sale of fuel (LP gas), operation of day service centers and childcare facilities, provision of home-visit nursing care services, sale and supply of electricity, operation of overseas hotel businesses, and the ship and print of documents.

name: DAICEL CORP
businessSummary: Daicel Corporation is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cellulose products, organic synthetic products, synthetic resin products, pyrotechnic products and others. The Company operates in five business segments. The Cellulose segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cellulose acetate, acetate tow for cigarette filters, carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) and hydroxyethyl cellulose (HEC). The Organic Synthesis segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of acetic acid derivatives, epoxy compounds, semiconductor resist materials and others. The Synthetic Resins segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of polyester resins, wrapping plastics and others. The Pyrotechnic segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of propellant powder and emergency evacuation systems for aircraft passengers, among others. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of production innovation services and other businesses.

name: DAISEKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiseki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the environment-related business. The Company is engaged in the collection, transportation and intermediate treatment of industrial wastes, the investigation and treatment of contaminated soil, the collection, transportation and recycling of used batteries, the refining of lead, the sale of non-ferrous metal raw materials, tank washing and related services, the collection of volatile organic compounds (VOC) gases, the sludge reduction works, the sale of crude oil washing (COW) machines, as well as the manufacture and sale of petrochemical products.

name: DAISUE CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: DAISUE CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. is primarily engaged in construction business. In addition to construction business, the Company is also involved in real estate, insurance agency, worker dispatching and security business.

name: DAISHI HOKUETSU FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Daishi Hokuetsu Financial Group, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of subsidiaries which operate as a bank obeying banking laws, as well as other related business. The Company is engaged in business related to financial services and centering on banking business, such as leasing business and securities business. The banking business is the Company’s main business. The headquarters of the Daishi Bank and other domestic branches focus on deposit business and lending business and conduct securities investment business, domestic exchange business, foreign exchange business, as well as windows sales business of public bond, investment trust and insurance. The Company is also involved in computer related business, credit guarantee business, credit card, venture capital and consulting business.

name: DAIKO TSUSAN CO LTD
businessSummary: DAIKO TSUSAN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the purchase and sale of various products for cable television (CATV) and information communication network. The Company is involved in the manufacture of various goods purchased from domestic and foreign manufacturers, such as wire and cable manufacturers, telecommunications machine equipment manufacturers and metal product manufacturers, for communication construction contractors, telecommunications carriers, electric power companies and government agencies. The products purchased by the Company are classified mainly as cables, materials, and equipment, and are used for indoor communication work, outdoor communication work, electric power construction at the sales destination. Cable products include local area network (LAN) & wide area network (WAN) cable, coaxial cable, optical cable. Material products include connecting materials, overhead wire hardware, and in-house lead-in & wiring materials.

name: DAIKEN CORP
businessSummary: DAIKEN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of eco-friendly materials, wooden interior building materials and housing equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of eco-friendly materials including insulation boards, die lawn, die light, medium-density fiberboard, tatami mats, eco-boards. The Building Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of wooden interior building materials and housing equipment. The Engineering segment is engaged in interior construction of buildings, condominiums and stores, renovation and repair of houses, as well as apartment renovation business. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of products such as plywood.

name: DAIKIN INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Daikin Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of air conditioners, refrigerators and chemical products. The Company operates in two business segments. Air Conditioner & Refrigerator segment manufactures, constructs and sells residential, commercial, marine air conditioners and refrigerator products. Chemical segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of chemical products, such as fluorocarbon gas, fluororesin and chemical machinery. The Company also conducts oil machinery business, special machinery business and electronic system business.

name: DAIKYONISHIKAWA CORP
businessSummary: DaikyoNishikawa Corp is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive resin parts. The Company operates in four geographical segments: Japan, China & Korea, ASEAN, Central America & North America. The Company purchases raw materials and manufacturers automobile equipment such as instrument panels and bumpers, and housing equipment such as bus unit members. The Japan segment has two divisions. The automobile parts manufacture division is involved in the provision of automobile resin parts, the development of production equipment and jigs, and the design and manufacture of molding dies and precision jigs. The others division is involved in the provision of housing equipment, the life insurance and non-life insurance agency business. Other segments are also involved in the design and technical services for automobile parts and staffing business, in addition to the provision of resin parts for automobiles.

name: METAPLANET INC
businessSummary: Metaplanet Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Bitcoin treasury business, hotel business, and other businesses. The Company operates in two segments. The Bitcoin Treasury Business segment focuses on maximizing Bitcoin yields (profitability) and creating long-term shareholder value. The Hotel Business segment operates hotels, providing a space for Bitcoin enthusiasts, business professionals, and educators to learn from each other. In addition, the Company utilizes its exclusive license for Bitcoin Magazine Japan to promote the spread and education of Bitcoin. It is also engaged in the acquisition, holding and disposal of real estate and real estate trust beneficiary rights, as well as business using advanced technologies such as Web3, blockchain and non-fungible tokens (NFTs).

name: DAIEI KANKYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiei Kankyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in environment-related businesses centered on waste treatment and resource recycling. The environment-related segment is engaged in the provision of one-stop services for waste collection, transportation, intermediate treatment, recycling, and final disposal, as well as total solutions for contaminated soil, from investigation to remediation. The environment-related business is divided into seven categories: waste treatment and resource recycling, soil remediation, energy creation, forest conservation, facility construction and operation management, consulting, and others. The Company also operates a valuable resources recycling business consisting of aluminum pellets and recycled plastic pallets.

name: DAI-ICHI LIFE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Dai-ichi Life Holdings Inc is a Japan-based insurance holding company that mainly operates in the insurance business and owns domestic and overseas life insurance companies as subsidiaries, and manages the subsidiaries. The Company operates through three segments. The Domestic Insurance segment is engaged in the individual insurance, individual annuity insurance, group insurance, group annuity insurance and other life insurance business, the non-life insurance business, as well as the life insurance related business, such as the acquisition of securities, real estate and monetary claims. The Overseas Insurance segment is engaged in the insurance business overseas. The Other segment is mainly engaged in the management of group companies and asset management related businesses.

name: DAIICHI JITSUGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiichi Jitsugyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale and rental of various machinery, tools and parts. It operates through seven business segments. Plant & Energy Business segment sells energy development and production, gas and oil refining, chemicals, engineering, construction, and paper and pulp related products. Energy Solutions Business segment sells lithium-ion battery manufacturing related products. Industrial Machinery Business segment sells plastics, rubber, steel, and food related products. Electronics Business segment sells electronics, information and communications, electrical equipment, precision machinery, optics, audio, and musical instruments related products. Automotive Business segment sells automobile-related products. Healthcare Business segment sells pharmaceutical and pharmaceutical-related products. Aviation & Infrastructure Business segment sells aviation and disaster prevention related products. It also rents various machinery and tools.

name: DAIICHI SANKYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Daiichi Sankyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The Company is involved in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals, as well as the provision of intermediates and basic materials for pharmaceutical producing in Japan, the United States, Europe and other markets. The Company is also engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of over-the-counter drugs and vaccines, the provision of administrative services such as human resources and accounting services, real estate leasing and insurance agency business.

name: DKS CO LTD
businessSummary: DKS Co. Ltd. is engaged in the manufacture and sale of surfactants, functional materials and electronic device materials. The Company operates in five business segments. The Surfactant segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of nonionic surfactants, anionic surfactants, cationic surfactants and amphoteric surfactants. The Amenity Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sucrose fatty acid esters, cellulose-based polymer materials, vinyl-based polymer materials and health supplements. The Urethane Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of polyether polyols, urethane prepolymers and urethane systems. The Functional Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of materials for photocurable resins, aqueous urethane resins, flame retardants, amide-based lubricants. The Electronic Device Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of conductive pastes for electronic components and pellets for injection molding.

name: DAIICHI KENSETSU CORP
businessSummary: DAIICHI KENSETSU CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and real estate business. The Company operates in two business segments.
