The Construction segment is engaged in the construction and civil engineering works, including railway-related civil engineering and construction works, social infrastructure maintenance works, concrete repair works, renewal works, track maintenance and repair works, as well as the construction of public facilities, educational and cultural facilities, medical and welfare facilities, commercial facilities, offices, warehouses, factories, apartment buildings and others. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and brokerage of real estate.

name: DAI-ICHI CUTTER KOGYO KK
businessSummary: Dai-Ichi Cutter Kogyo KK is a Japan-based construction company mainly engaged in cutting and drilling works. The Company has three business segments. The Cutting and Drilling Construction segment is engaged in cutting work necessary for dismantling, cutting and drilling necessary for dismantling and removing concrete structures. The Building Maintenance segment is engaged in maintenance and inspection of water supply and drainage facilities, cleaning of water tanks, and cleaning of miscellaneous drainage pipes in housing complexes and office buildings. The Reuse and Recycling segment is engaged in the reuse and recycling services, including the purchase and collection of information technology (IT)-related equipment and used office automation (OA) equipment, data erasure services, sales to corporations and individuals, and office installation services for telecommunications equipment.

name: TAMA HOME CO LTD
businessSummary: Tama Home Co., Ltd. Is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in residential business, real estate business, financial business and energy business. The Company operates in four business segment. The Residential business segment is engaged in the contract construction and renovation of detached house and apartment house. The Real Estate business segment is engaged in development of detached house, development and sales of condominiums, sublease of rental building, as well as real estate brokerage. The Financial business segment is engaged in insurance agency business of fire insurance and life insurance and bridge loan for home purchaser. The Energy business segment is engaged in the operation and management of mega solar power generation facilities.

name: TANABE ENGINEERING CORP
businessSummary: TANABE ENGINEERING CORPORATION is a company mainly engaged in the provision of facility construction works. The Company operates in two business segments. The Facility Construction segment is engaged in the construction of industrial plant facilities, such as plant facilities, environmental equipment, various laborsaving device systems and automatic equipment; plant maintenance facilities, electricity instrumentation, power transmission and piping works. The Surface Treatment segment is engaged in the surface treatment activities in Thailand. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of industrial furnaces for metal casting, as well as the import and sale of industrial equipment.

name: TANAKEN
businessSummary: Tanaken Inc, formerly Tanaken, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in demolition work of the building structure and supervision of various constructions incidental thereto. The Company provides overall business, including current situation survey, proposal of construction method, design, construction plan, neighbor correspondence and others. The Company also provides supervise construction work related to building construction demolition work, mountain work, basic demolition work and pile removal work. It proposes and provides various dismantling works in cost, construction term and safety concerning removal of harmful pollutants such as polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB), groundwater purification and soil improvement. The Company carries out work supervision, safety control, neighbor communication, guides and supervises cooperative companies, and carries out demolition work.

name: TANABE CONSULTING GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Tanabe Consulting Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management consulting business. The management consulting areas include strategy consulting, digital transformation (DX) consulting and brand & design consulting. The services in the strategic consulting area include domain consulting, function consulting, human resources (HR) Consulting, mergers & acquisitions (M&A) alliance consulting, regional consulting, strategic domain & function study group and first call company (FCC) seminar. The services in the DX consulting area include digital marketing, management DX, branding DX, marketing DX and FCC academy cloud. The services in the brand & design consulting area include marketing strategy planning, branding, customer experience (CX) design, creative, and Web promotion. The sales promotion products include sales promotion tools, blue diaries and calendars.

name: TAZMO CO LTD
businessSummary: TAZMO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sale of liquid crystal manufacturing equipment, semiconductor-related equipment, precision molding dies and plastic moldings. The Company operates in two business segments. The Processing Equipment segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of electronic device manufacturing process equipment, such as liquid crystal display (LCD) processing machine, semiconductor processing machine and peripheral equipment. The Molding Dies and Plastic Moldings segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of precision molding dies and plastic moldings, including embossed carrier tapes and connectors for electronic equipment.

name: TACHIBANA ELETECH CO LTD
businessSummary: TACHIBANA ELETECH CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of the factory automation (FA) equipment, industrial machinery, industrial devices, semiconductor and electronic devices and equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance and service for related business. The Company operates through three business segments. FA System segment offers programmable controllers, inverters, and electrical discharge machines. Semiconductor Device segment provides semiconductors and electric devices. Information Communication segment provides radiofrequency identification (RFID) system, surveillance cameras and thin clients. Facility segment provides air-conditioning equipment, solar power generation systems, all-electric appliances, room air conditioners, elevators, among others. The Company is also involved in the support for customers with contract manufacturing of electronic equipment (EMS) and contract manufacturing of metal processing (MMS).

name: TACHI-S CO LTD
businessSummary: TACHI-S CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of automotive seats and related parts. The Company operates through six business segments. It is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of seats for vehicles, including passenger cars, trucks and buses. It is also engages in the manufacturing and sales of other parts, such as steering components and vehicle body mechanism components. It is also engaged in the rental of commerce facilities.

name: TASUKI HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Tasuki Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the life platform business, software as a service (SaaS) business, digital transformation (DX) consulting business, liquidation business, condominium sales business, and asset holding business. The life platform businesses include the business that develops and sells Internet of Things (IoT) residences for newly built investment, the refining business that acquires used properties, increases their value, and then sells them, as well as the asset management business. The SaaS business develops TASUKI TECH as a SaaS-type multi-platform for real estate developers. The finance consulting business provides real estate financing services. The Company conducts construction contract business, brokerage business, and real estate consulting business.

name: TAKEDA PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Takeda Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture, sale and licensing of pharmaceuticals. The Company focuses on the main business areas of gastrointestinal diseases, rare diseases, plasma derivatives (immune diseases), oncology (cancer), and neuroscience (neuropsychiatric diseases). The Company focuses on three research and development areas: innovative biopharmaceuticals with the focus on gastrointestinal and inflammatory diseases, neuroscience, and oncology, plus plasma derivatives and vaccines. Most of the pharmaceuticals treat rare diseases in the focus disease areas and the plasma derivatives area. The Company operates in Japan, the United States, Europe, and China.

name: TAKEDA MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKEDA MACHINERY CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of shaped steel processing machines and circular saw machines for the processing of steel frames, steel materials, sheet metals and others. The Machine Tools Related segment is engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of shaped steel processing machines such as small shaped steel processing machines, flat plate drilling machines, H-shaped steel drilling machines and steel plate processing machines, as well as circular saw machines such as shaped steel cutting machines, unprocessed steel cutting machines and pipe cutting machines. The Company is also engaged in the provide after-sales services, as well as the purchase and sale of stamping dies.

name: TAKEUCHI MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: Takeuchi Mfg Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of construction machinery. The Company operates its business through five geographical segments: Japan, the United Sates, the United Kingdom, France and China. The Company’s main products are deep foundation excavators, disassembled electric mini backhoes, mini excavators and hydraulic excavators, as well as crawler loaders. It also provides standard machines, ultra-small turning machines, crawler loaders to the international market.

name: TAKUMA CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKUMA CO., LTD. is a company that is active in four business segments. The Domestic Environment and Energy segment is engaged in the design, construction, sale, operation and maintenance of general waste treatment plants, industrial waste treatment plants, resource recovery plants, sewage disposal plants, sludge incineration plants, biomass electric generation plants and generation gas turbine systems. The Overseas Environment and Energy segment provides waste power generation plants and biomass power generation plants. The Civilian Heat Energy segment offers miniature through-flow boilers and vacuum hot-water supply heaters. The Facilities and Systems segment is involved in the sale and maintenance of building facilities, semiconductor industry-use facilities and clean systems.

name: TAKIGAMI STEEL CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: Takigami Steel Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of steel structure products. The Company operates in five business segments. The Steel Structure Products Manufacturing segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and construction of steel bridges, iron frames and other steel structure products and the development and sale of precast concrete products for bridges, and sale of asphalt additives. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing and management of real estate properties. The Materials Sale segment is engaged in processing and sale of steel sheets and various steel materials. The Transportation segment is engaged in transportation of goods and other related business. The machine tool manufacturing segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of machine tools, automotive machine tools, and jigs and tools. The Company also operates a solar power generation business.

name: MIRARTH HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Mirarth Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, sale and liquidation business of the newly built condominium Leben series, as well as the energy business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Real Estate Sales Business segment mainly engages in the sale of newly built condominiums, income real estate and detached houses, as well as the renewal condominium business. The Real Estate Rental Business segment is engaged in the rental business of offices and residential condominiums. The Real Estate Management Business segment is engaged in the comprehensive management business of condominiums. The Energy Business segment conducts power generation business using renewable energy nationwide. The Company also engages in nursing care business, construction business, commissioned sales agency business, investment management business and hotel business.

name: TAKARA BIO INC
businessSummary: TAKARA BIO INC. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in bio-industry support business and gene medicine business. The Company operates in three business segments. Bioindustry Support segment provides reagents for research (genetic engineering reagents, cell engineering reagents, protein engineering reagents), scientific instruments, contract services and license fees for gene related patents to research institutes, such as universities and companies where biotechnology research and development are conducted. Gene Medicine segment provides gene therapy-related development and sale licensing fees and trial products as an application field of genetic engineering technology and cell engineering technology which is core technology cultivated in development of research reagents. Medical Food and Biotechnology segment provides health food and health food research and development services, license fees for health food related patents, as well as license fees for mushrooms.

name: TAKARA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: TAKARA HOLDINGS INC. is Japan-based brewing holding company. The Company operates in three business segments. The TAKARA SHUZO CO., LTD segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of alcohol beverages, food seasonings and other businesses. The TAKARA SHUZO INTERNATIONAL CO., LTD segment exportr liquors from Japan, manufactures and sells liquors overseas, and conducts Japanese food wholesale business. The TAKARA BIO INC segment involves in the manufacture and sale of research reagents, physical and chemical equipment, mushrooms, the provision of contract research services on gene therapy and cell therapy.

name: TAKAMATSU MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKAMATSU MACHINERY CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools and other industrial machines. The Company operates in three business segments. The Machine Tools segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and the provision of maintenance services of computer numerically controlled (CNC) lathes, as well as the manufacture and sale of parts and collet chucks. The Information Technology (IT)-related Manufacturing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture of IT-related manufacturing equipment. The Automobile Parts Processing segment is engaged in the processing of automobile parts.

name: TAKAHASHI CURTAIN WALL CORP
businessSummary: TAKAHASHI CURTAIN WALL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction of building exterior walls. The Company operates in two business segments. The Precast Concrete (PC) Curtain Wall segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and construction of building exterior walls, mainly precast concrete curtain walls. The Aqua segment is engaged in the design and construction of bathing facilities and sports facilities. The other businesses include real estate leasing business and recreation facility management of the Company.

name: TAKANO CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKANO CO.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of living related equipment, inspection and measurement equipment, industrial equipment and exterior products, as well as the sale of machine and tools. The Company operates through five business segments. The Living Related Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of office chairs, as well as chairs for medical and healthcare facilities. The Inspection and Measurement Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of atomic force microscope (AFM) equipment and film inspection equipment. The Industrial Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of solenoid actuators and unit components. The Exterior Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of flip-up gates, carports, terraces and awnings. The Machine and Tool segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of machine and tools.

name: TAKACHIHO KOHEKI CO LTD
businessSummary: TAKACHIHO KOHEKI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the search and development of technology products, the import and export business of products, as well as the installation, maintenance and system design of products. The Company operates through two business segments. The System segment is engaged in the provision of consulting service, system design service, system operation service, as well as installation and maintenance service of system equipment mainly for security products. This segment’s products include security products, such as advanced fire protection systems, other solution products including network equipment, and customer service products. The Device segment is mainly engaged in the sale and consultation of products, such as semiconductors and mechanical parts. This segment’s products include electronic products, such as semiconductors, electronic components and industrial products, such as slide rails, gas springs and keys.

name: TAKASHIMAYA CO LTD
businessSummary: Takashimaya Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged mainly in the department store business, as well as real estate, finance, and construction. The Company operates in four business segments. The Department Store Business segment sells apparel, personal effects, general merchandise, household goods, and food products. The Commercial Development Business segment engages in commercial development that generates synergies with the department stores, and in the management and operation of assets and facilities. The Financial Services segment engages in the brokerage of financial products such as savings and investment and group insurance, as well as the issuance of credit cards and financial services for group companies. The Construction and Decorating segment is engaged in interior design and construction. The Company also operates a mail-order business, wholesale business, and advertising business.

name: TAKASAGO THERMAL ENGINEERING CO LTD
businessSummary: Takasago Thermal Engineering Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in equipment construction business as well as manufacturing and sales of equipment. The Company has two segments. The Equipment Construction segment involves in the maintenance and general management of equipment, the design and construction of air conditioners, water supply and drainage facilities, technical assistance to overseas subsidiaries as well as the manufacturing, sales and installation of cleanroom related equipment and interior materials. The Equipment Manufacturing and Sales segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing and sales of air conditioners. Other business involves in the sales and leasing of real estates and insurance agency business.

name: TAOKA CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: TAOKA CHEMICAL COMPANY, LIMITED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemical business. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical intermediates, agricultural chemicals intermediates, electronic components materials, resin raw materials, dyes and other fine chemicals, adhesives, rubber additives and other functional chemical materials, processed resins, varnishes and other functional resins, as well as plasticizers, methyl esters and other chemical products. The Company is also engaged in the chemical analysis contract business.

name: TAUNS LABORATORIES INC
businessSummary: Tauns Laboratories Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the business of developing, manufacturing and marketing in vitro diagnostic products and research reagents. The Company operates its business in the in vitro diagnostic products business segment. The Company’s main product is antigen test kit that uses immunochromatography to enable rapid diagnosis at the patient's side without the need for special equipment. The products include ImunoAce Flu, ImunoAce SARSCoV-2 II, ImunoAce SARSCoV-2 Saliva, ImunoAce SARSCoV-2/Flu, ImunoAce Adeno, ImunoAce Strep A Neo, ImunoAce hMPV, ImunoAce Mycopiasma, ImunoAce RSV Neo and ImunoAce Noro.

name: TAIYO YUDEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Taiyo Yuden Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The Company’s main products include multilayer ceramic capacitors, inductors, high frequency devices, and conductive polymer hybrid aluminum electrolytic capacitors and others. The Company sells and supplies finished products to domestic and overseas set manufacturers and sales affiliates. The Company also supplies raw materials and semi-finished products to domestic and overseas manufacturing affiliates. The Company also provides services to employees, temporary staffing, and consulting on environmental measurements.

name: TAIYO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: TAIYO HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals for electronic components. The Company's products include flat panel display (FPD) materials, as well as printed-wiring board (PWB) materials, such as solder resist (SR), etching resist, marking ink and plugging ink, which are used for rigid substrates, package (PKG) substrates, flexible substrates and build-up substrates. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in the provision of technical services related to PWB, as well as the provision of delivery and warehousing services. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of dyes, pigments, chemicals and inks. The Company also involves in the natural energy power generation business.

name: TIMEE INC
businessSummary: Timee Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the plan, development and operation of applications. The product is Timee, which is a part-time job application connects people who want to work in their spare time with stores and companies that want immediate manpower.

name: TAIHEIYO CEMENT CORP
businessSummary: Taiheiyo Cement Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Cement segment provides concrete. The Resources segment provides aggregates and limestone products. The Environmental Business segment provides waste recycling and desulfurization materials. The Building Materials & Construction segment provides secondary concrete products and lightweight foamed concrete (ALC). The Company also operates businesses related to real estate, engineering, information processing, finance, transportation and warehousing, chemical products, sports, and electric power supply.

name: PACIFIC INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: PACIFIC INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of press and resin products, and valve products. The Company operates through two business segments. The Press and Resin Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wheel caps, engine covers, hood trunk hinges, oil pans and other press and resin products for automobile, as well as press molds, resin molds and other mold products. The Valve Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tire valves, valve core products, air conditioning valves and other valve products, microcomputer control equipment and other electronic machine products, compressor related products, as well as tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) products. The Other segment is mainly engaged in the processing of information by computer, the development and sale of software, and the provision of insurance agency service.

name: PACIFIC METALS CO LTD
businessSummary: Pacific Metals Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of ferronickel, and the electric power generation business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Nickel segment is engaged in the purchase and refine of nickel ore, the main raw material for ferronickel products, as well as the manufacture and sale of ferronickel products and high-carbon ferronickel products. The Electric Power Generation segment is engaged in the generation of electric power. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of gas products used in the manufacturing processes, the purchase and sale of forged steel products and various industrial equipment, the waste recycling business, and the real estate business.

name: TAIHEI MACHINERY WORKS LTD
businessSummary: Taihei Machinery Works, Limited is a Japan-based manufacturing company. The Company operates in three business segments. The Plywood Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of plywood machinery including Veneer lace, dryer, hot press and others. The Woodworking Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of woodworking machinery including gang ripper, chipper, finger jointer and others. The Housing Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of housing construction materials for two-by-four housing. The main products also include knife polishing machine, reeling device, log hole conveyor, log charger, veneer lace, finger joint system, moulder, mighty chipper and veneer chipper.

name: TAISEI CORP
businessSummary: Taisei Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the civil engineering business, the construction business and the development business, as well as other business further associated with each business. The Company operates in three business segments. Civil Engineering segment operates business related to the construction of civil engineering works. Construction segment operates business related to general construction of buildings. Development segment operates business related to real estate in general, including sale, leasing, management and placement of real estate. The Company also operates businesses related to the construction industry, such as contract research, technology provision, and environmental measurement, as well as logistics, leisure-related, and other service businesses.

name: TAISEI ONCHO CO LTD
businessSummary: Taisei Oncho Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment construction business. It operates through four regional segments including Japan, the United States, China, and Australia. The equipment construction business designs and constructs heating and cooling, water supply and drainage sanitation, electricity, constant temperature and humidity, dehumidification, heat exchange, and refrigeration and freezing. The construction business designs and constructs buildings and ancillary facilities. The real estate business rents out land and buildings for commercial and residential use. The other businesses include the sale of heating and cooling equipment, solar power generation, and others.

name: TAISHO PHARMACEUTICAL HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of over-the-counter drugs, quasi-drugs, foods, medical supplies, hygiene products, and ethical drugs. The Company operates in two business segments. The Self-Medication segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of over-the-counter drugs, quasi-drugs, foods, medical supplies, hygiene products. The Pharmaceutical segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of ethical drugs. The other business is engaged in the leasing and management of real estate, as well as hotel management business.

name: TAIKISHA LTD
businessSummary: Taikisha Ltd is principally engaged in the environmental systems business and painting systems business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Environmental Systems segment offers general air-conditioning facilities for offices, schools, hotels, stores, research institutes, theaters, halls, hospitals and residential homes, as well as the industrial air-conditioning facilities for clean rooms in factories that manufacture semiconductors, electronic components, precision machinery, pharmaceuticals, foodstuffs and others. The Painting Systems segment provides the painting facilities for factories that manufacture vehicle bodies, bumpers, railway vehicles, construction vehicles and airplanes.

name: TIGERS POLYMER CORP
businessSummary: TIGERS POLYMER CORPORATION is a Japan-based manufacturer of hoses and rubber products. The Company operates in four segments. The Japan segment manufactures and sells hoses, sheets, molded products and others. The Americas segment, Southeast Asia segment and China segment produce and sell hoses and molded products. The hoses division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of household hoses, which are used for vacuum cleaners, washing machines and air conditioners, as well as industrial hoses, which are used for general industrial, civil engineering and housing purposes. The rubber sheets division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sheets, which are used in packing and shock-absorbing materials, as well as the manufacture and sale of door mats. The molded products division is involved in the manufacture and sale of automobile parts, such as rubber molded items and resin molded products.

name: DAIO PAPER CORP
businessSummary: Daio Paper Corporation is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of paper products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Paper and Paper Board segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of papers, paper boards, newsprint paper, printing paper and related materials. The Home and Personal Care segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sanitary paper products, disposable diapers, feminine care products, wet wipes.

name: ZOJIRUSHI CORP
businessSummary: Zojirushi Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cooking appliances, living products, household appliances and other products. The Company operates through manufacturing department, sales department, logistics department, as well as repair and recycling department. The cooking appliances include rice cookers, electric pots, electronic jars, hot plates, coffee makers, oven toasters, home bakeries and rice mills. The living products include glass thermos, stainless steel bottles, stainless steel lunch jars and stainless steel food jars. The household appliances include air purifiers, humidifiers, bedding dryers and tableware dryers. The other products include heat insulation containers, stainless steel vacuum panels and brown rice cold storages.

name: SORACOM INC
businessSummary: Soracom Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Internet of Things (IoT) platform business. The IoT Platform Business segment mainly provides SORACOM, an IoT platform that solves common issues faced by client companies when introducing and operating IoT. It provides IoT devices, IoT subscriber identity modules (SIM), communication lines required for IoT, data storage and visualization applications required for IoT services, and network services as platform services. The Company also provides consulting services and undertakes contract work such as technology development support.

name: SOLIZE CORP
businessSummary: Solize Holdings Corp, formerly Solize Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the engineering partnering of global product development through the use of 3D technology and other digital technologies. In addition to the production of prototypes, the Company also provides services such as research and development, design (styling), control, design, and analysis, which are the pre-production processes of prototypes, and production preparation, and the post-production process, such as production preparation and the production of final parts using 3D printers. The Company operates through two business segments. The Design segment is engaged in the support of product development and corporate business model transformation. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the provision of evaluation and verification models for product development, as well as sales and operational support for 3D printers.

name: SOMAR CORPORATION
businessSummary: SOMAR CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the high functional materials business, environmental materials business and food materials business. The Company has three business segments. The High Functional Material segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of films and other coating products, electrical insulation resins and other high functional resin products, circuit board materials and other electronic materials, as well as heat curable resins and other functional resin products. The Environmental Material segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial fungicides and other fine chemicals, as well as paper coating binders and other paper manufacturing chemicals. The Food Material segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of thickener, stabilizer, dehydrated vegetables and food ingredients. The Company is also engaged in the golf courses operation business, real estate rental management business, and insurance agency business.

name: SBI HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: SBI Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the financial business. The Company operates five business segments. The Financial Services segment engages in various finance related businesses, centered on securities related, banking, and insurance businesses in Japan and overseas. The Asset Management segment is engaged in investment management, including the establishment, offering, and management of investment trusts, investment advisory services, and provision of financial products information. The Investment segment includes investment in domestic and overseas information technology (IT), fintech, blockchain, financial, and biotechnology related venture companies. The Crypto-asset segment provides crypto-asset exchange and trading services. The Non-financial segment is engaged in various businesses such as bio-healthcare & medical informatics business, Web3 related business, renewable energy business, and businesses developing in new overseas markets such as Africa.

name: SOFTWARE SERVICE INC
businessSummary: Software Service, Inc. is primarily engaged in providing medical information systems. The Company operates in three segments. The Medical Information Systems segment develops, sells and provides guidance of medical information systems, such as electronic charts and ordering systems. The Maintenance Service segment provides maintenance service for users of its medical information systems using online network. The Hardware Sales segment sells required hardware such as servers together with the introduction of the medical information systems.

name: SONOCOM CO LTD
businessSummary: SONOCOM CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of screen masks and photo masks for electronic industry. The Company operates through two business segments. The Screen Mask segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of screen masks for electronic components producing and printed circuit board surfaces mounting. The Photo Mask segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of photo masks for display element production. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of printing machine, squeegees and other screen printing equipment.

name: M3 INC
businessSummary: M3 Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of services centering on the platform of healthcare. The Company has five business segments. Medical Platforms segment conducts marketing-related businesses in Japan utilizing the Internet and real operations centered on medical employee specialized site m3.com. Evidence Solution segment is involved in the contract research organization (CRO) business that supports clinical development work and research, and site management organization (SMO) business that manages the clinical trial operations. Career Solutions segment is engaged in human resource services for healthcare professionals. Site Solution segment provides operational support for medical institutions and home-visit nursing services. Overseas segment provides services of medical related marketing support, research and careers, utilizing the medical employee specialized sites in the United States, the United Kingdom, China, Korea, India, France, Germany and Spain.

name: SONY GROUP CORP
businessSummary: Sony Group Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the games & network services (G&NS), music, movies, entertainment technology & services (ET&S), imaging & sensing solutions (I&SS) and other businesses. It has seven business segments. G&NS segment is involved in network service business, the manufacture and sale of home video game consoles and software. The Music segment mainly includes music production, music publishing and video media platform businesses. The Movies segment mainly includes film production, television program production and media network businesses. The ET&S field mainly includes the television business, audio, video business, still image, video camera business, smartphone business and Internet-related service business. The I&SS segment mainly includes the image sensor business. The Financial segment is involved in the insurance business and banking business. The Other segment consists of activities such as disc manufacturing business and recording media business.

name: SODICK CO LTD
businessSummary: Sodick Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment business. The Company has three business segments. The Machine Tool segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of electric discharge equipment, machining centers and metal three-dimensional (3D) printers. The Industrial Machine segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of horizontal injection molding equipment, vertical injection molding equipment and special-purpose molding equipment. The Food Machine segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of noodle making equipment and rice cooking devices. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of mold and plastic molding products, the development, manufacture and sale of linear motor products and ceramics products, the development of hardware and software for numerical control (NC) devices, as well as the leasing of electric discharge equipment.

name: SOCIONEXT INC
businessSummary: Socionext Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of System-on-a-Chip (SoC) to be developed under the Solution SoC business model. The Company's business is focused on custom SoCs that are designed specific to particular customers. The Company partners with customers who require unique advanced SoCs for new service and product differentiation, and provides intellectual property (IP), electronic design automation (EDA) tools, and technologies ranging from software to process, assembly, and test. The Company's solution SoC business model allows it to work with customers to create these upstream designs, thus making its products available to customers who do not possess upstream design capabilities.

name: SOHGO SECURITY SERVICES CO LTD
businessSummary: ALSOK Co Ltd, formerly Sohgo Security Services Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the security business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Security Business segment is engaged in mechanical security business, HOME ALSOK business, stationed security business and security transport business. The FM Business segment is engaged in facility construction, including piping and electrical work, facility management, environmental hygiene management, cleaning management, inspection and construction of firefighting equipment, and sales of various disaster prevention equipment. The Nursing Care Business segment provides home nursing care support, visiting nursing care, day care and facility nursing care. The Overseas Business segment provides stationed security services and mechanical security services, as well as facility management. The Company also engages in businesses related to supporting foreign nationals with specific skills.

name: SOIKEN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Soiken Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based holding company. The Company operates in six business segments. The Biological Evaluation System segment is engaged in evaluation test of food and research support of medicine. The Healthcare Support segment is engaged in the provision of service about certain health guidance and healthcare insurance. The Cosmetics segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of cosmetics. The Dietary Supplements segment is engaged in sales of unique dietary supplements. The Marketing segment is engaged in the marketing research of health supplement and sales of energy drink. The Functional Material Development segment is engaged in development and sales of functional materials, such as lactoferrin.

name: SOKEN CHEMICAL & ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Soken Chemical & Engineering Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals, the sale of devices and systems, as well as the provision of engineering services for manufacturing systems. The Company operates in two business divisions. The Chemicals division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of adhesives, fine particles, special performance materials and processed products. The Device System division is involved in the sale of devices and systems, the engineering of manufacturing systems, the provision of maintenance services for plants, and the import and sale of heating medium oil. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had nine consolidated subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: ZENHOREN CO LTD
businessSummary: Zenhoren Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the rent debt guarantee business. The rent debt guarantee is a service that guarantees rent payment to lessors. The Company makes the subrogation payment on behalf of the lessee and collect the subrogated rent from the lessee at a later date for the lessee who fails to pay the rent. The Company provides rent obligation guarantee service that guarantees the payment of rent to the lessor, a joint guarantor is not required, and the lessee can smoothly conclude a lease contract. The Company provides the rent obligation guarantee service through property management companies and real estate brokerage firms that sign guarantee business agreement contracts.

name: ANA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: ANA Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in the aviation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Aviation segment conducts regular and irregular air transportation of passengers and cargo domestic and international flights. The Aviation-related segment provides services associated with air transportation such as airport handling and maintenance, and various services at the airport to customers and provide reservation information services by telephone. The Travel segment is engaged in the development and sale of packaged travel products, mainly made from airline tickets and accommodation. The Trading Companies segment mainly engaged in the import and export of aviation-related materials and mail orders. The Company is also engaged in the building management and temporary staffing business.

name: ZENSHO HOLDINGS CO. LTD.
businessSummary: Zensho Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the food industry. The Company has six segments. The Global Sukiya segment operates the beef bowl chain Sukiya domestically and overseas. The Global Hama Sushi segment operates the sushi chain Hama Sushi domestically and overseas. The Global Fast Food segment operates various fast food businesses, including takeout sushi, domestically and overseas. The Restaurant segment operates the restaurant business domestically and overseas. The Retail segment operates supermarkets, etc. The Headquarters and Support segment provides support services for each business type. Other businesses are mainly external sales manufacturing and wholesale, nursing care, and livestock and fisheries businesses.

name: ZENKOKU HOSHO CO LTD
businessSummary: ZENKOKU HOSHO Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the operation of credit guarantee business. The Company’s guarantee products comprise three categories. The housing loan guarantees are its core products, which can meet the diverse needs of customers, such as housing acquisition funds and refinancing funds, and renovation funds and others. It acquires guarantee fees from guarantee requesters through the classification by collateral valuation and other requirements such as annual income and years of service. Education loan guarantee products guarantee the borrowings of education funds, which deal with term loans, overdraft and other formats. About the use of funds, it deals with tuition fees, exam costs and others. The apartment loan guarantee products guarantee the borrowings of construction costs of rental housing.

name: TV ASAHI HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: TV Asahi Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operations associated with program production. The Company operates its business through four business segments. The Television Broadcasting Business segment is engaged in operations related to the production and broadcasting of television (TV) programs. The Internet Business segment is involved in the production and rights licensing of video distribution with advertising and video distribution content via the Internet. The Shopping Business segment is involved in TV shopping programs and mail-order sales through electronic commerce (EC) sites. The Other Business segment includes music publishing, event business, equipment sales and leasing, and film investment.

name: ZERIA PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Zeria Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of ethical drug business, consumer healthcare business and other business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Ethical Drug segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of ethical drugs. The Consumer Healthcare segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of over-the-counter (OTC) drugs, health foods, quasi drugs and cosmetics related to self-medication. The others include insurance agency business and real estate business, as well as various maintenance business such as purchasing and sale of promotional materials.

name: XEBIO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Xebio Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general retail business, primarily sporting goods and equipment and apparel. The sports business division operates large sporting goods specialty stores and golf specialty stores. It also offers casual apparel. The fashion apparel division includes the Next business, which has a tie-up with a British manufacturer and retailer and exclusively sells products designed by the Company in Japan, and the X'style and Rookie USA businesses, which develop their own fashion lineup. Other businesses include sports eyeglass and sunglass specialty stores, sports drug specialty stores, and fancy stationery and sundry specialty stores. The Company also operates sports marketing business, credit card business, website management business, marketing agency business, e-commerce (EC) business, overseas contact center business, and research and development (R&D) business.

name: ZENITAKA CORP
businessSummary: Zenitaka Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and real estate businesses. The Company operates in two segments. The Construction segment is engaged in the comprehensive construction business, including civil engineering, architectural and other construction related businesses, as well as the leasing of construction equipment and materials. The properties include government buildings, cultural and research facilities, educational facilities, communication facilities and data centers, office buildings, medical facilities, production facilities, commercial facilities, housing, energy facilities, road facilities, railway facilities, water supply and sewerage facilities. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sale, leasing, brokerage, and management of real estate properties.

name: ZETT CORP
businessSummary: ZETT CORPORATION is principally engaged in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of sports products, as well as the provision of related services. Along with its subsidiaries, the Company operates Sport Business segment, which has four business divisions. The Wholesale division is engaged in the wholesale of sports equipment. It purchases products from approximately 300 companies and sells the products to retailers and mass merchandisers nationwide, the segment also sells baseball products in China. The Manufacturing division designs and develops baseball products and sports wears, it also designs, manufactures and sells health supplies. The Retail division sells products through directly-managed stores to general customers. The Others division provides logistic services to the Wholesale and Manufacturing divisions, and operates sports facilities.

name: SAINT-CARE HOLDING CORP
businessSummary: SAINT-CARE HOLDING CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in nursing-care services. The Nursing-care Service segment provides visiting care service, home-visit bathing service, in-home long-term care management, home visit nursing, sales and rental of social welfare equipment, daily-life group care for the elderly with dementia, day care, short-stay daily-life care service, small-scale and multifunction type in-home care, regular visiting & as-needed handling type visiting care and home visit nursing, small-scale and multifunction type in-home care with home visit nursing, daily-life care service in specified facilities and home renovation service. The Company is also engaged in employment transition support business for disabled people, outsourcing business such as production of printed matters, the sale of nursing care insurance application service provider (ASP) systems, shared service business, personnel dispatch business and the sale of care robots.

name: TOKYO CENTURY CORP
businessSummary: Tokyo Century Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to leasing and financing. The Domestic Leasing Business segment provides leasing and financing and related services for information and telecommunications equipment, office equipment, transportation equipment, and commercial and service equipment. The Auto Mobility Business segment provides auto leasing, car rental, car sharing, and other services for corporate and individual customers. The Specialty Business segment provides domestic and overseas lease financing and related services for products such as ships, aircraft, and real estate. The International Business segment provides lease financing and related ancillary services in East Asia, ASEAN countries, North America, and Latin America, as well as automobile business. The Environmental Infrastructure Business segment engages in power generation business, lease financing, and related ancillary services in Japan and overseas related to renewable energy.

name: SENSHU ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Senshu Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the sale of wires and cables, electrical materials, information related equipment and others. The Company is engaged in the provision of equipment wires, communication wires, fire protection wires, heat-resistant wires, network cables, thermocouples and compensating wires, instrumentation cables, magnet wires, power cables, control cables, insulated wires, signal cables, various eco cables, lightning rod wires, bare copper wires, robot wires, automobile wires, optical fiber cables and peripheral devices. The Company is also involved in the orders and sales of related control devices.

name: SENKO GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Senko Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the logistics business, the trading business and other business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Logistics segment is mainly engaged in the automobile transportation business, the rail transportation business, the maritime transportation business, the international transportation business and the warehousing business, as well as the packing and moving of raw materials and products on the shipper's premises, the operation of distribution centers. The Trading segment is mainly engaged in the oil sales business, the trading sales business and the trading business. The Other segment is mainly engaged in life support business, the food service business and the information processing contract business. The Company also operates worker dispatching business, paid employment agency business and training business.

name: SERENDIP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: SERENDIP HOLDINGS Co Ltd operates Professional Solutions business, Investment business, and Manufacturing business. The Professional Solution business includes manager dispatch business, such as professional manager dispatch and management consulting (business succession and business revitalization), engineer dispatch business, such as the design, development and information technology engineer dispatch, and software development. The Investment businesses include investment, mergers and acquisition-related businesses, including funds, joint investment, and financial advisory. The Manufacturing business includes automotive suppliers including automobile interior and exterior parts (luggage room interior parts, exterior parts such as fender liners and rear wheel house liners) and automobile precision parts (automatic functional parts), as well as factory automation equipment including connector automatic assembly machines, and battery-related automatic assembly machines and others.

name: CEL CORP
businessSummary: CEL Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the rental housing business, which provides consulting and solutions for apartment management; the rental development business, which develops and sells real estate; and the rental management business, which provides property management services. The Company operates business through three segments. The Apartment Construction Subcontracting segment is engaged in the plan, design, construction, and contracting of apartments for single persons, specializing in the Tokyo area. The Stock segment is mainly engaged in the leasing and management of apartment buildings on a lump-sum lease basis, apartment management services such as rent collection, and repair work. The China Leasing segment operates a serviced factory business in Ningbo City, which takes advantage of the advantages of large factory buildings to provide size categories and functions that meet the needs of clients, and a serviced office business in three locations in Shanghai.

name: CELLSOURCE CO LTD
businessSummary: CellSource Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in regenerative medicine related business and consumer business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Regenerative Medicine Related business segment is engaged in the provision of contracted services for processing tissues and cells derived from fat and blood to medical institutions, and support services for regenerative medicine laws and regulations related to safety assurance such as regenerative medicine, as well as sales of medical equipment. The Consumer business segment is engaged in the sales of cosmetics and facial products to general consumers.

name: CELLSEED INC
businessSummary: CellSeed Inc. is mainly engaged in the regenerative medical business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Regenerative Medical Support segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of temperature-responsive cell incubators. The Cell Sheet Regeneration Medical segment is involved in the research and development of cell sheet regenerative medical products.

name: SERIA CO LTD
businessSummary: Seria Co Ltd. is a Japan-based discount retailer of general merchandise that sells products at a single price of 100 yen. The Company is involved in the retail of consumer products through stores, as well as the wholesale of products to franchisees, big clients and overseas agents. The Company offers daily miscellaneous goods such as make-up goods, kitchen supplies, eating utensils, washing and bathing goods, sanitary products, cleaning substances, cosmetics, accessories, sewing goods, stationery, toys, character goods, gardening goods, health products, hygiene products, clothes, cleaning products, storage goods, tools, umbrellas, electrical appliances, pet goods, interior goods, outdoor products and seasonal products, among others. It also provides sweet stuff including instant foods, seasonings, canned food, noodles, rice, confectionery, drinks, bakery products, sweets and others.

name: SERAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: SERAKU Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions of information technology (IT) infrastructure, web marketing communication and smart solution through the Internet. The Company includes 3 business segments. The IT Infrastructure segment supports network, server, building security, maintenance and contract development business by the company-owned qualified IT infrastructure engineers. The Web Marketing Communication segment is engaged in the construction and operation of website, as well as planning and operation of marketing for companies and organizations. The Smart Solutions segment is mainly engaged in development of web systems, smart phone applications and embedded systems.

name: SEPTENI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Septeni Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the Internet advertising business. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Internet Marketing segment is involved in the provision of Internet advertising support, the operation of marketing platforms such as cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) services and affiliate networks, and the other businesses that support Internet marketing for companies. The Media Content segment provides manga contents, recruitment platform, social contribution platform, medical platform, childcare platform.

name: SEVEN & I HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Seven & i Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the distribution business, primarily in domestic convenience store operations, overseas convenience store operations, superstore operations, and finance-related operations. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Convenience Stores segment is engaged in convenience store operations through direct management and franchise system. The Overseas Convenience Stores segment is engaged in convenience store operations through both directly managed and franchised stores. The Superstore segment is engaged in the retail business that provides a comprehensive range of daily necessities such as food and daily necessities. The Finance-related segment is engaged in banking, credit card, leasing, and other businesses. The Company also operates businesses related to department stores, specialty stores, and real estate.

name: SECOM CO LTD
businessSummary: Secom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of security services. The Company operates in six business segments. The Security Services segment provides comprehensive security services, focusing on centralized systems for offices and homes. The Fire Protection Services segment provides various types of fire protection systems. The Medical Services segment provides various medical services, including home medical services, operation of senior residences, and sales of electronic medical records. The Insurance Business segment develops and sells insurance products. The Geospatial Information Services segment provides geospatial information services, geospatial information services, and other services. The Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Information and Communication Technology (ICT) segment provides information security services, large-scale disaster response services, data center operations, and BPO services.

name: JAPAN PETROLEUM EXPLORATION CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Petroleum Exploration Co., Ltd. is a company principally involved in crude oil and natural gas related business. The Company operates in four geological segments. The Japan segment involves in the exploration, development, production, purchase, sale, transportation of crude oil and natural gas, the production, purchase, sale, transportation of petroleum products, as well as contracting work of mining wells. The North America segment involves in exploration, development, production, purchase and sale of crude oil, natural gas, as well as bitumen which is super heavy oil collected from the oil sand layer in North America. The Europe segment involves in the exploration of crude oil and natural gas in Europe. The Middle East segment involves in the exploration, development and production of crude oil and natural gas in Middle East.

name: SEKISUI HOUSE LTD
businessSummary: Sekisui House Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the detached house business, rental and commercial building business, civil engineering business and other related business. It has seven business segments. The Detached House segment designs, contracts and sells detached houses. Rental and Commercial Building segment designs, contracts and sells rental housing and commercial buildings. Architecture and Civil Engineering segment designs and contracts for construction and civil engineering work for commercial buildings. Rental Housing Management segment leases and manages rental housing. Remodeling segment remodels detached houses and rental housing. Development segment includes the brokerage and real estate business, condominium business and urban redevelopment business. International Business segment sells detached houses overseas, develops and sells residential land, and develops condominiums and rental apartments. It is also engaged in non-life insurance agency business.

name: SEKISUI JUSHI CORP
businessSummary: Sekisui Jushi Corporation is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the transportation and landscape related products, sports facilities related products, living and construction products, integrated logistics materials related products business. The Company operates in two segments. The Public segment manufactures, processes and sells soundproof wall materials, traffic safety products, signs, thermal insulation pavement, protective fence, high field, shelter, artificial turf and others. The Private segment manufactures, process and sells mesh fences, artificial timber, meta color building materials, aluminum resin laminated composite boards, packaging bands, stretch films and others.

name: SEKISUI CHEMICAL CO. LTD.
businessSummary: Sekisui Chemical Co Ltd is mainly engaged in housing business, environment and life line business, high-performance plastics business and medical business. The Company operates in four segments. The Housing segment is engaged in the manufacture, construction and sale of steel-frame and wood-frame modular housing, the sale of land for sale, renovation, real estate brokerage, rental management, interior and exterior sales and construction. The Environment & Life Line segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and construction of polyvinyl chloride pipes and fittings, polyethylene pipes and fittings, plastic valves and others. The High-Performance Plastics segment manufactures and sells liquid crystal particles and photosensitive materials. The Medical segment manufactures and sells clinical diagnostic reagents, automatic analyzers and blood collection tubes. The other businesses include the provision of services for film-type lithium-ion batteries and products.

name: SEGA SAMMY HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Sega Sammy Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the gaming machine business, entertainment content business and resort business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Gaming Machine segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of pachislo machines and pachinko machines. The Entertainment Content segment is engaged in the development and sale of packaged games and amusement equipment centering on digital games, the development and operation of amusement facilities, the planning, production, sale of animation movies, as well as the development, manufacture and sale of toys. The Resort segment is engaged in the development and operation of hotels and golf courses in integrated resort business and other facilities business.

name: SEIBU HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Seibu Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company operates in the real estate, hotel and leisure, and urban transportation and railway line businesses. It has three business segments. The Real Estate Business segment consists of development and leasing, investment management, management and others. The development and leasing business is engaged in real estate development, primarily in the Takanawa and Shinagawa areas, and the management and value-add of acquired properties in the real estate turnover business. The Hotel and Leisure Business segment consists of domestic hotel operations, overseas hotel operations, sports, and others. The Urban Transportation and Railway Line Business segment consists of railway operations, bus operations, railway line lifestyle services, sports, and others. Other businesses include rail passenger transportation, bus and taxi operations, leisure facility operations, and sports businesses.

name: SEIBU ELECTRIC & MACHINERY CO LTD
businessSummary: Seibu Electric & Machinery Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of transport machinery, industrial machinery and precision machinery, sale aftermarket service activities, as well as the sale of machinery parts and multi-story parking equipment and operation of parking lots. The Company operates in three business segments. The Transport Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of logistics systems and transport equipment. The Industrial Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of valve actuators and gate drive devices. The Precision Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of ultra-precision and high-precision wire electric discharge machines and ultra-precision and high-precision numerical control (NC) lathes. The Company is also engaged in the sale of mechanical equipment parts and multi-story parking equipment, as well as parking lot management and other businesses.

name: SEIBU GIKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Seibu Giken Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, and provision of installation and other services for desiccant dehumidifiers and volatile organic compounds (VOC) concentrators. Desiccant dehumidifiers dehumidify air by adsorbing moisture inside a honeycomb using adsorbent materials such as silica gel or zeolite. Since air does not need to be cooled, it is characterized by its ability to dehumidify even at low temperatures or in low dew-point environments where there is little moisture in the air. VOC concentrators selectively adsorb volatile organic compounds, collectively known as benzene and toluene, which cause air pollution generated from paint, into the VOC concentrator rotor to make it possible to detoxify exhaust gas emissions by selectively adsorbing VOC concentrating rotors. Product-related services is engaged in the provision of installation, maintenance, and rotor replacement services.

name: SEYFERT LTD
businessSummary: Seyfert Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing comprehensive support for the various management issues of beauty salon management companies. The salon support business segment provides advertising recruitment services, referral / dispatch services, and education (other) services. The advertising recruiting service provides mid-career and new graduate recruitment support services through paper media, web media, and events. The referral / dispatch service provides a referral / dispatch service specialized for cosmetologists who can meet the diverse needs of both cosmetologists and cosmetologists. The education (other) service provides educational services specialized for beauticians.

name: SEIKO EPSON CORP
businessSummary: Seiko Epson Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the printing solutions business, visual communication business, as well as wearable and industrial products business. The Company has three business segments. The Printing Solutions Business segment includes office and home inkjet printers, serial impact dot matrix printers, page printers, color image scanners, dry office paper machines, and commercial and industrial inkjet printers, inkjet print heads and other products. The Visual Communications Business segment provides products such as liquid crystal projectors and smart glasses. The Manufacturing and Wearables Business segment provides products such as industrial robots, small injection molding machines, watches, watch movements, quartz devices, semiconductors, metal powders, and surface treatment processing.

name: SEIKO HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Seiko Group Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of watch business, electronic device business and system solution business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Watch segment is engaged in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of watches and watch movements, as well as watch repair and after-sales service. The Electronic Device segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of crystal oscillators, batteries and materials, printers, and precision parts. The System Solution segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to wireless communication equipment, information network systems, and data services. The Company also operates the time creation and wako business, including the sale of equipment clocks and sports timing equipment, the development manufacture, sale, repair and after-sales service of clocks, the retail of luxury jewelry, apparel and miscellaneous goods, and real estate leasing business.

name: SEIKITOKYU KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Seikitokyu Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the construction business, mainly paving and civil engineering, as well as the manufacture and sale of paving materials. It operates through two business segments. The Construction segment is involved in paving, civil engineering, and other general construction work. The Paving Materials Manufacturing and Sales segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of paving materials such as asphalt mixtures. It is also involved in the electricity sales business, construction machinery sale business, and automobile leasing business.

name: SEIKAGAKU CORP
businessSummary: SEIKAGAKU CORPORATION is principally engaged in the research, development, purchase, manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products and limulus amebocyte lysate (LAL). The Company operates in two business segments. The Pharmaceutical business segment provides hyaluronan-based medicines for joint function improvement, ophthalmic operation boosters and submucosal injection materials for endoscopes, as well as drug substances for various pharmaceuticals. The LAL business segment provides reagents for measuring endotoxin.

name: ZUKEN INC
businessSummary: ZUKEN INC. is a Japan-based company engaged in the research and development of software solutions which support the optimization of product design and engineering operations for manufacturing industries, as well as the provision of the software solutions. The Company operates through four geographic segments including Japan, Europe, the United States and Asia. The Company is mainly engaged in the research and development, sale and consulting of software and middleware products, technical support services business including staffing, support services business and the sale of network related products.

name: SLOGAN INC
businessSummary: Slogan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human resources creation business in new industrial areas. The Company develops business in the carrier service field and software as a service (SaaS) field. In the career service field, The Company operates a carefully selected job-hunting platform Goodfind for new graduate students, operates a consulting job hunting platform Fact Logic for new graduate students and provides job-hunting services that specialize in foreign-affiliated and Japanese consulting firms, operates a long-term intern referral platform for students, Intern Street, which specializing in recruiting start-ups and venture companies. In the media and SaaS field, The Company operates FastGrow, a business media for young innovation human resources that provides services that support recruitment public relations, branding, and service recognition of companies in new industrial fields, operates a SaaS-type human resources service TeamUp.

name: SURUGA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Suruga Bank Ltd. is a Japan-based bank engaged in the banking business, as well as the provision of other financial services such as leasing business, loan business and guarantee servive. The Bank operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the provision of deposit services, loan services, and domestic and foreign exchange transactions services, as well as the counter sale of securities, investment trust and insurance. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of loans, leasing services, manpower dispatching services, credit guarantee services, system development services and credit cards services, among others.

name: SUMITOMO FORESTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Forestry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the forestry business, the procurement, manufacturing, processing, and sales of timber and building materials, contracting and renovating construction work for detached houses. The Company operates in four segments. The Timber and Building Material segment provides lumber products and building materials. The Housing segment conducts contracting construction work, after-sales maintenance and renovation, selling condominiums, leasing, managing, buying and selling, and brokering real estate, contracting exterior and landscaping work. The Construction and Real Estate segment is engaged in the sale of condominiums overseas, contracting for the construction of detached houses, the operation of panels and trusses, the development of apartment buildings and commercial complexes. The Resources and Environment segment is engaged in the renewable energy business and forestry resource business.

name: SUMITOMO BAKELITE CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Bakelite Company Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor-related materials, high-functional plastic and quality of life related products. The Company operates in three segments. The Semiconductor-related Materials segment provides epoxy molding materials for semiconductor encapsulation, liquid resins for semiconductor uses and semiconductor substrate material. The High-Functional Plastic segment provides phenolic molding materials, industrial phenolic resins, molding products and synthetic resin-based adhesives, among others. The Quality of Life Product-related segment offers medical equipment, thermoplastic resins, vinyl resin sheets and melamine resin decorated sheets, among others. Other businesses include contract works of research and test and the leasing of land, etc.

name: SUMITOMO REALTY & DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Realty & Development Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to real estate. The Company operates its business through five business segments. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases and manages office buildings and condominiums, and operates and manages hotels, event halls, and commercial facilities. The Real Estate Sales segment sells condominiums and detached houses. The Construction Completion segment is engaged in contracting for construction and renovation of detached houses and condominiums. The Real Estate for Sales segment engages in real estate brokerage and sales agency services. The Others segment is engaged in the fitness club business, restaurant business.

name: SUMITOMO DENSETSU CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Densetsu Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment work business. The Company provides electric power supply work, general electric work, information communication work, plant and air conditioning work and other equipment work, as well as related engineering services. The electric power supply work is mainly engaged in the design, construction and supervision of transmission and distribution equipment. The general electric work is engaged in the design, construction and supervision of electrical installation work and environment related work. The information communication work is engaged in the design, construction and supervision of telecommunication equipment work. The plant and air conditioning work is engaged in the design, construction and supervision of plants and air conditioning sanitary tubes. The Company is also engaged in the insurance agency business, the manufacture and repair of equipment, and the manufacture and sale of water heaters.

name: SUMITOMO ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Electric Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and servicing of business products related to environmental energy. The Company operates its business through five business segments. The Environment and Energy-related Business segment provides electrical conductive products, wires, cables, and equipment for power transmission and distribution. The Information and Communication Related Business segment provides optical fiber cables, communication cables and equipment, optical fusion splicers. The Automotive Business segment provides network and system products such as wire harnesses, anti-vibration rubber and automotive hoses.
