The Electronics-related Business segment provides electronic wires, electron irradiation products, and flexible printed circuits. The Industrial Materials & Others segment provides steel wires for precision springs, steel cords, carbide tools, sintered parts, and semiconductor heatspreader substrates.

name: OSAKA TITANIUM TECHNOLOGIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Osaka Titanium Technologies Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the titanium business and the high-performance materials business. The Company operates through two segments. The Titanium segment manufactures and sells sponge titanium, titanium ingots, titanium tetrachloride, and titanium tetrachloride aqueous solution. The Advanced Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity titanium, silicon monoxide (SiO), spherical titanium powder (TILOP), and powdered titanium.

name: SUMITOMO WAREHOUSE CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Warehouse Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the integrated logistics business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Logistics segment is engaged in the warehousing, harbor transportation, international transportation and land transportation, as well as the development of software related to its logistics business. The Marine Transportation segment is engaged in the freight transportation using ships, and the operation of marine transportation agents. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the trading, leasing and management of business offices and lands.

name: SUMITOMO HEAVY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Heavy Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of general heavy machinery. It has four business segments. Mechatronics segment provides transmissions, motors, inverters, laser processing systems and precision positioning devices, and operates in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, China and Japan. Industrial Machinery segment provides plastic processing machinery, cryogenic freezers, accelerators, medical machinery and equipment, forging presses and others in Japan, North America and Europe. Logistics & Construction segment provides hydraulic excavators and road machinery, construction cranes, transport and loading machinery, logistics systems, parking systems and forklifts in Japan, China, Indonesia and North America. Energy & Lifeline segment provides boilers and air pollution control equipment, water treatment equipment, industrial turbines and pumps, reaction vessels, food machinery and ships. It also has real estate, software and other business.

name: SUMITOMO CORP
businessSummary: Sumitomo Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in diversified business activities in response to the diverse needs of its customers. The Company operates in nine segments. The Steel segment handles steel pipes and products. The Automotive segment trades vehicles, tires, and related items. The Transportation & Construction Systems segment deals with ships, aircraft, and construction machinery. The Infrastructure & Urban Development segment covers real estate, construction materials, logistics, insurance, and infrastructure. The Media & Digital segment provides digital solutions and telecom infrastructure. The Lifestyle segment includes retail, food, and healthcare business. The Mineral Resources segment engages in development, production, and trading of metals and derivatives. The Chemicals, Electronics & Agriculture segment handles plastics, chemicals, and agrochemicals. The Energy Transformation segment engages in infrastructure business.

name: SUMITOMO RUBBER INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Ltd. is a Japan-based tire manufacturer. The Company operates in three business segments. The Tire segment manufactures and sells tires and tubes for automobiles, construction vehicles, industrial vehicles, race rallies and motorcycles. The Sports segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sports items, including golf clubs, golf balls and other golf-related supplies, and tennis-related supplies, as well as the operation of golf tournaments, golf and tennis schools and fitness center. The Industrial Products and Others segment offers vibration suppression dampers, printing blankets, medical precision rubber, slope for wheelchair, and fenders, among others.

name: SUMITOMO METAL MINING CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in resource development, manufacturing and sales of non-ferrous metal products, and manufacturing and sales of battery materials and functional materials. The Company operates through three business segments. The Mineral Resources segment is engaged in the exploration, development, production and sales of non-ferrous metal resources and products in Japan and overseas. The Smelting & Refining segment smelts and sells copper, nickel, ferronickel, zinc and other metals, and smelts and sells gold, silver, platinum, palladium and other precious metals. The Materials segment manufactures, processes, and sells battery materials, powder materials, crystal materials, and tape materials, as well as lightweight foamed concrete, automotive exhaust gas treatment catalysts, chemical catalysts, and petroleum refining desulfurization catalysts. The Company also operates businesses related to real estate and engineering.

name: SUMITOMO CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Chemical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that operates the chemical business. The Company has five segments. Essential & Green Materials segment manufactures and sells synthetic resins, raw materials for synthetic fibers, industrial chemicals, methacrylate, processed synthetic resin products, aluminum and alumina and synthetic rubber. Advanced Medical Solutions segment handles process development and contract manufacturing for pharmaceuticals and others. Information and Communication Technology (ICT) & Mobility Solutions segment handles optical products, semiconductor process materials, compound semiconductor materials, touch sensor panels, chemical products, engineering plastics and battery materials. Agro & Life Solutions segment handles agricultural chemicals, fertilizers, agricultural materials, pest control insecticides and materials for tropical disease control. Sumitomo Pharma segment handles small molecule pharmaceuticals. The Company also provides other businesses.

name: SUMITOMO OSAKA CEMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Sumitomo Osaka Cement Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cement business. The Company has seven business segments. The Cement segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement and ready-mixed concrete products, the sale of electric power, the processing of recycled raw fuel. The Mineral Products segment is engaged in the provision of limestone, dolomite and aggregate products. The Construction Material segment is engaged in the provision of concrete structure repair materials and admixtures. The Optoelectronics segment is engaged in the provision of optical communication components and optical measurement equipment. The New Materials segment is engaged in the provision of ceramic products, nanoparticle materials and functional paints. The Battery Materials segment is engaged in the provision of secondary battery cathode materials. The Other segment is engaged in the real estate leasing business, engineering business and software development business.

name: SUMISEKI HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Sumiseki Holdings,Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in coal business. The Company has three business segments. The Coals segment purchases and sells coals. The New Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of artificial diamonds for industrial use. The Quarry segment is engaged in the mining, processing and sale of crushed stone.

name: SCSK CORP.
businessSummary: SCSK Corp is a Japan-based company mainly provides information technology (IT) consulting, system development, verification services, IT infrastructure construction, IT management, IT hardware and software sales, and business process outsourcing (BPO) services. The Industrial IT segment provides various IT solutions to customers through the development, maintenance, and operation of mission-critical systems and other systems. The Financial IT Segment is mainly engaged in system development, maintenance, and operation for financial institutions such as banks and trust companies. The IT Solutions segment provides IT solutions such as application management outsourcing (AMO) services. The IT Platform segment develops and sells packaged software. The IT Management segment develops data centers netXDC. The Others segment develops software and manages system operations, sells system equipment, and provides consulting services and remote development.

name: SMAREGI INC
businessSummary: Smaregi Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cloud service business. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of cloud systems for companies to manage and analyze information necessary for business management, including Sumaregi, a cloud-based point-of-sale (POS) register used by restaurants and retail stores to manage and analyze sales information. The Company is also engaged in the sale of peripheral devices for cash registers, such as tablets and receipt printers, used by users of cloud services.

name: SPACE MARKET INC
businessSummary: Spacemarket Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of the platform SPACEMARKET where any space can be rented and borrowed, the provision of the public facility reservation management system Spacepad, as well as the operation of spaces on behalf of the owner. SPACEMARKET is a platform where any space can be rented and borrowed, and provides a service that allows anyone to rent and borrow space easily and conveniently over the Internet or smartphone. The Company also supports the operation of shared spaces, and upon request from owners, selects, orders, and installs furniture and equipment suitable for the shared space, and prepares the interior, takes promotional photos, writes listing text, sets prices, creates rules for use, and lists the space on SPACEMARKET. It also handles reservations and rentals, cleaning, replenishing equipment, responding to inquiries, and brushing up the listing content on behalf of the owner.

name: SPORTSFIELD CO LTD
businessSummary: Sportsfield Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in sports personnel recruitment support business. The Company is engaged in sale support business, human resource introduction business and recruitment outsourcing business with its subsidiaries. Sports personnel recruitment support business can be divided into new graduate business (for new graduates) and mid-career business (for graduates). The new graduate business is for active athlete students, and mid-career business is for adults with experience in sports and competitions and retired professional and amateur athletes. The business is classified into event business for new graduates, human resource introduction business for new graduates, and human resource introduction business for existing graduates. Through these businesses, the Company is involved in the match of sports people with companies that want to hire sports people.

name: SUBARU ENTERPRISE CO LTD
businessSummary: Subaru Enterprise Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the provision of road maintenance services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Road segment is engaged in the maintenance, cleaning and repair works of roads, the entrusted operation of expressway facilities and solar power generation business. The Leisure segment is engaged in the customer service business such as the distribution of movie films, the sale of food and beverage and other businesses. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the leasing of real estate properties.

name: STRIKE CO LTD
businessSummary: Strike Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) brokerage business. The Company conducts M&A brokerage business, including mergers, acquisitions, and capital alliances between companies as a certified public accountant and tax accountant company. The Company also performs incidental business including advisory business, support for M&A execution, due diligence business, company evaluation business, consulting service for improving corporate value, as well as financial consulting service, among others.

name: STREAM CO LTD
businessSummary: Stream Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the Internet retail business. It operates in three business segments. The Internet Retail segment is engaged in the sale of products through its Websites (e-commerce (EC) CURRENT, eBEST and TOKKA COM) and mobile sites. The products offered by the Company include personal computers (PCs); computer peripheral equipment, such as monitors, printers and digital cameras; home electrical appliances, such as televisions, refrigerators, washing machines and vacuum cleaners; software, such as business and game software, as well as new products such as watches, miscellaneous goods and others. This segment also provides warranty extension and repair agency services. The Beauty & Healthcare business conducts sales business for daily necessities including cosmetics and health foods. The Others segment is involved in the sales support business and online game business.

name: STELLA CHEMIFA CORP
businessSummary: STELLA CHEMIFA CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the manufacture, import and sale of high-purity chemicals. The Company has six business segments. The High-purity Chemical segment manufactures and sells high-purity chemicals with a focus on fluoride used for etching agents, detergents, electrolytes for lithium-ion secondary batteries and others. The Transportation segment is engaged in the logistics business focusing on chemicals, the warehousing and customs clearance businesses. The Medical segment is involved in the development and research of cancer treatment drugs. The Cosmetics segment sells cosmetics such as basic skin care. The Energy Management segment is engaged in the development and sale of network-related equipment and software. The Others segment is engaged in the maintenance of automobiles, the provision of insurance agency services, as well as the manufacture and sale of photoluminescent products. As of March 31, 2014, it had 11 subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: STEMRIM INC
businessSummary: StemRIM Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the regenerative medicine business. The Company is engaged in the development and research of medicines based on new action mechanism to promote functional regeneration and healing of biological tissue damaged and lost function due to injury or illness. The Company’s main product is stem cell regeneration-inducing medicine. The stem cell regeneration-inducing medicine is a medicine which can obtain the same therapeutic effect as regenerative medicine only by administering the medicine without using living cells and tissues.

name: STANLEY ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Stanley Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive equipment products, component products and electronic applied products. The Company operates through three segments. The Automotive Equipment segment mainly manufactures automotive lighting products, which are sold to automobile manufacturers. The Components segment mainly manufactures electronic device products that are sold to manufacturers related to electrical machinery and automobiles. The Electronic Applied Products segment mainly manufactures electronic applied products such as units and modules that meet the specifications of customers, such as liquid crystal backlights, and operation panels that are sold mainly to electrical equipment, automobiles, and automobile-related manufacturers. In addition, the Company is also engaged in business activities such as promotion of employment of people with physical disabilities and financial and management services for groups.

name: STAR MICA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Star Mica Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in renovation apartment business, investment business and advisory business. The renovation apartment business is engaged in purchase of family type apartments mainly from the metropolitan area and lease to tenants as portfolio. After the tenants leave, the Company will renovate to increase asset value, and then sold as residences to end users through house agents. The investment business conducts investments activities including leasing and sale of real estate mainly in the metropolitan area and investment development business centering on securities. The advisory business is engaged in real estate brokerage, rental brokerage, rental management, building management, operation of monthly apartments, etc. and fee operation of renovation apartment business and investment business.

name: ZOZO INC
businessSummary: ZOZO Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged mainly in the operation of the fashion e-commerce site ZOZOTOWN and the fashion media site WEAR. The ZOZOTOWN business consists of purchase and manufacturing sales, consignment sales, and USED sales. USED sales is a secondary distribution business that buys used fashion merchandise, mainly from individual users and sells it while maintaining its own inventory. LINE Yahoo Commerce business sells products through online shopping malls and online auction services. The business-to-business (BtoB) business provides services to support various fulfillment-related operations, including e-commerce site system development, design production, logistics contracting, and marketing support. The advertising business provides advertising space by utilizing the user reach base of ZOZOTOWN and WEAR. The Company also operates businesses related to shipping and settlement fee revenues.

name: STARTS CORP INC
businessSummary: STARTS CORPORATION INC. is a real estate company. The Company operates in nine business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in construction of rental houses, detached houses and others. The Rental Brokerage segment and Trading Brokerage segment is engaged in brokerage of real estate leasing and transaction. The Real Estate Management segment manages and leases real estate. The Real Estate Business for Sale segment sells houses and other properties. The Publishing segment is engaged in publishing of magazines and books centered on the women's Website. The Spacious segment is engaged in the elderly support and childcare business, travel business, hotel and inn business, and restaurant management. The Consulting segment provides estate store management guidance, securities business, investment corporation management business, trust business, insurance business and consulting business. The Products Sale segment plans, manufactures and sells residential security system.

name: STAR MICRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: STAR MICRONICS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company centered on manufacturing and assembly of small sized precision components and equipment. The Company operates in three segments. The Special Products segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of small printers. The Machine Tools segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of machine tools like computerized numerical control (CNC) automatic lathes. The Precision Products segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of wristwatch components and various components used in automobiles, air conditioners, hard disk drives (HDD) and medical. The Company operates in Japan, the United States, China, Germany, etc.

name: SUZUKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Suzuken Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Pharmaceutical Wholesale segment sells pharmaceuticals, diagnostic drugs, and medical equipment and materials, among others. The Pharmaceutical Manufacturing segment manufactures pharmaceuticals and diagnostic drugs and others. The Insurance Pharmacy segment is engaged in dispensing operations based on prescriptions from medical institutions. The Medical-related Service and Others segment is engaged in the provision of manufacturer support services, such as the transportation of medicines and comprehensive support for the distribution of drugs for rare diseases; the nursing services; the manufacture of physiological examination equipment, such as electrocardiographic monitors and blood pressure monitors; as well as other services, such as the sale of medical books.

name: SUZUKI MOTOR CORP
businessSummary: Suzuki Motor Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of motorcycles, automobiles, outboard motors and electric wheelchairs, as well as development of logistics and other services related to each business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Four-wheel Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of mini vehicles, compact vehicles, and standard-sized vehicles. The Two-wheeled Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of motorcycles and buggy cars. The Marine Business segment manufactures and sells outboard motors. The Others Business segment is engaged in the electric wheelchair, solar power generation, and real estate businesses.

name: SCHOO INC
businessSummary: Schoo Inc is a Japan-based company that develops businesses mainly originating from learning and education. For learners, the Company offers Schoo for Business, a training service for corporations, and Schoo for Personal, a learning service for individuals, while for teachers at institutions of higher education and adult education providers, it offers Schoo Swing, a learning management platform service. Schoo for Business is an online training service for developing autonomous human resources. Schoo for Personal is an online learning service. Schoo Swing is a cloud-based learning management platform service.

name: SUGI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Sugi Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the drug store and pharmacy business. Through its subsidiaries, it sells pharmaceuticals, health foods, cosmetics, and daily necessities, operates drug stores with pharmacies that provide prescription dispensing and home medical care in cooperation with local medical professionals, provides various services to consistently support customers' health maintenance and prevention, manages subsidiaries specializing in medical and healthcare-related businesses such as visiting nursing services and medical institution start-up support services, engages in trading and domestic wholesale businesses that export Japanese products, mainly drug store materials such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities and food, and manages subsidiaries specializing in prescription dispensing.

name: SKY PERFECT JSAT HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: SKY Perfect JSAT Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company engaged in broadcasting business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Media segment is engaged in the broadcasting of fee-charging channels broadcasting service through optical fiber networks. This segment is also involved in the widespread broadcasting of fee-charging channels for client management and advertising, the digitalization and encipherment of broadcast signals, as well as the image and information transmission business through communication satellites and optical fibers. The Universe and Satellite segment provides communication services for public agencies, public institutions, corporate communication, international data communication and mobile communication. The company also operates a public relations business and an Internet portal.

name: SKYLARK HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Skylark Holdings Co Ltd, former Skylark Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the restaurant business and also engaged in the development of businesses such as food sales and support for group companies. In the restaurant business, in addition to developing family restaurants and buffets in Japan and selling food products, The Company also develops restaurants overseas. The restaurant brands include Gusto, Bamiyan, Syabuyo, Jonathan's, Yumean, Steak Gusto, Karayoshi, Aiya, Musashi No Mori Coffee, Grazie Gardens, Totoyamichi, chawan, Tonkaratei, La Ohana and others. Other businesses include food sales, food delivery, store cleaning and maintenance, store product delivery, and linen supply support businesses for group companies.

name: ACSL LTD
businessSummary: ACSL Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of industrial flight robot, the order development, production and sale of unmanned systems utilizing drones. With the latest autonomous control technology as the core, The Company promotes the development of application-specific drones through on-site inspections, dialogues, and demonstrations of customers in order to provide drones that substitute and evolve the operations of customers. Proof-of-concept (PoC) services are provided to core clients, mainly large companies, on the premise of providing a one-stop system construction from the examination stage to the actual introduction of drones.

name: KACHIKAIHATSU CO LTD
businessSummary: Polaris Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Kachikaihatsu Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the hotel business and the real estate business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Hotel segment is involved in the hotel management, consultancy, operation and franchise business. The Real Estate segment operates in five kinds of businesses. The real estate leasing business is involved in the leasing and operation of office buildings and condominiums. The real estate trading business is involved in the purchase and sale of office buildings and condominiums. The real estate development business is involved in the provision of information collection, survey, analysis, planning and construction services. The real estate investment business is involved in the investment of silent partnership in special purpose company (SPC) that holds trust beneficiary rights. The real estate management business is involved in the trust of the operation management business.

name: INFORMATION STRATEGY AND TECHNOLOGY CO L
businessSummary: Information Strategy and Technology Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital transformation (DX)-related business. The DX-Related Business segment consists of Tier 0 system development, which realizes DX for customers, and the WhiteBox service, which realizes DX for the system development industry. Tier 0 system development is an agile development method in which customers and engineers collaborate on development through repeated proposals and consultations, and can be changed in response to changes in business conditions. WhiteBox is a service that can be used by system development companies or freelancers who apply to use the service and are accepted as members.

name: JOYFUL HONDA CO LTD
businessSummary: Joyful Honda Co Ltd is engaged in the sales of housing products including materials and professional supplies, interior and living products, and garden and farm products, the design and construction of renovation work and the sales of related products, and the sales of living products including daily necessities, pets and leisure products. The Company operates home center business and housing renovation business. The stores include large-scale retail stores and specialty retail stores. The products include material and professional supplies such as lumber, construction materials, paints, tools, hardware, work supplies and electrical parts, daily necessities such as everyday consumables, sanitary products, medicines, health care products, beverages and alcoholic beverages, garden and farm products such as flower seedlings, vegetable seedlings, plants, culture soil, fertilizer, bricks and paving stones, interior and living products such as floors, walls, windows, furniture and others.

name: JAFCO GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: JAFCO Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company specializes in venture investments and buyout investments through fund management. The Company solicits investments from institutional investors and business companies once every three years. The Company also invests its own capital in all funds and is committed to improving fund performance. The fund's management period is 10 years, with a two-year extension period. The Company also increases its involvement in management after investment, working with entrepreneurs to grow the business and improve corporate value. The Company then aims for an exit through an initial public offering (IPO) or mergers and acquisitions (M&A). The main sources of revenue are capital gains from fund investments, fund management fees, and success fees. The Company operates in Japan, the United States, Asia, and other regions.

name: JAPAN MATERIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Material Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electronics-related business, graphics solution business and solar power generation business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Electronics-related segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture of special gas supply equipment, design and construction of supply piping, sale management of special gas, as well as the provision of technical services. The Graphics Solution segment is mainly engaged in the sale of graphic boards and digital signage related products. The Solar Power Generation segment is engaged in the sale of electricity to electric power companies by solar power generation.

name: JAPAN DISPLAY INC
businessSummary: Japan Display Inc. is engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of small and medium-size displays and related products. Its display is the electronic component that displays images such as characters, photographs, moving images as an output device of electronic device. The Company's small and medium-sized displays are mainly mounted on smart phones, tablet terminals, car-mounted equipment, medical equipment, wearable devices, digital cameras, among others. The Company operates through the Small and Medium Size Display business.

name: JK HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: JK Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plywood, the processing and sale of wood, and the wholesale and retail of plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment. The Company has three business segments. The General Building Material Wholesale segment is mainly engaged in the wholesale of plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment. The Plywood Manufacturing and Wood Processing segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of structural plywood, long plywood, laminated wood and assembled processed products, and the processing and sale of wood. The General Building Material Retail segment is mainly engaged in the retail of plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment. The Company is also engaged in the franchise, real estate leasing, warehouse, transportation, construction and travel business, and the insurance agency business.

name: JAPAN ELEVATOR SERVICE HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: JAPAN ELEVATOR SERVICE HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of the maintenance and inspection service for elevators and escalators, as well as the renewal service for elevators. The Company operates three kind of businesses. The maintenance and inspection business is involved in the provision of maintenance, inspection, replace and repair services for the engine performance and the operation safety of elevators and escalators. The renewal business is involved in the provision of a full range of main components’ replacing service, the removal service of products already in the field, as well as the new setting service for elevators which are installed 20 years ago. The others business is involved in the sale of parts for elevator’s maintenance.

name: JAPAN EYEWEAR HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Japan Eyewear Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of eyeglasses through its subsidiaries. The Company operates in two business segments. The Kaneko Optical Business segment encompasses the businesses of each brand category under the Kaneko Optical brand and provides fashionable eyeglasses based on trends. The Four Nines business segment encompasses business by brand category under the Four Nines brand, designs and sells luxury brand eyeglasses, and has an sales network of directly managed stores and dealers.

name: JAPANIACE CO LTD
businessSummary: Japaniace Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of advanced engineering business that provides on-site development support and contract development. The Company participates in projects in four fields, such as software, infrastructure, mechatronics, and electronics. The Company is engaged in the provision of technology for projects in new areas such as artificial intelligence (AI), cloud, and next generation communications. Contracts with client companies are mainly dispatch contracts, but also partial contract contracts and quasi-delegation contracts. Business areas include software, infrastructure, mechatronics, electronics, and AI.

name: JUSTSYSTEMS CORP
businessSummary: Justsystems Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, and provision of software and related services. The Company is primarily engaged in the development and domestic sales of software. It provides software such as the Japanese input system ATOK and word processing software Ichitaro to individuals, and solutions such as document creation, data management, and business support to corporations. The Company also develops and provides software in the United States and Canada.

name: AEON CO LTD
businessSummary: Aeon Co Ltd is a pure holding company that develops comprehensive finance, developers and services focusing on retail businesses. The Company operates in eight segments. The General Merchandise Stores (GMS) segment mainly operates general supermarkets. The Supermarket (SM) segment operates supermarkets, convenience stores and small supermarkets. The Discount Store (DS) segment operates discount store business. The Health & Wellness segment operates drug stores, dispensing pharmacies. The Integrated Financial segment operates credit card business, fee business, banking business and insurance business. The Developer segment develops and leases shopping centers. The Service and Specialty Store segment operates specialty stores that sell general facility management services, amusement, food service, family casual fashion and shoes. The International segment operates retail businesses in the ASEAN region and China. The others include mobile marketing business and digital business.

name: JIMOTY INC
businessSummary: Jimoty, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the classified site operation business. The Company is engaged in the operation of a platform Jimoty that provides local information. The platform categorizes regional information from all over Japan by purpose, such as buying and selling goods, asking for help, recruiting members, renting and selling real estate, buying and selling used cars, recruiting full-time and part-time employees, various business advertising, events and others. The platform provides matching opportunities between users, and develops a customer support system through checking all submitted contents, drawing users' attention to offending users, taking measures to suspend use and others. The platform is also provides network advertising services such as automatic distribution, and marketing support services.

name: GLTECHNO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: GLtechno Holdings Inc is engaged in the management of its subsidiaries and group companies. Through its subsidiary, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of analytical equipment related products, semiconductor related products, and contactless integrated circuit (IC) card related products, and the purchase and sale of similar products, related research and development, and the provision of technical services. The subsidiary is engaged in the analytical equipment business, which develops, manufactures gas chromatograph and liquid chromatograph equipment, the semiconductor business, which manufactures quartz jigs and materials for semiconductors, optical polishing, and quartz cells for spectrophotometers, and the automatic recognition business, which develops, manufactures, and sells peripheral devices using contactless IC cards. Through its another subsidiary, the Company is also engaged in the manufacture and purchase of quartz products for semiconductors.

name: GENDA INC.
businessSummary: Genda Inc is a Japan-based company that provides business management such as management guidance as a pure holding company. The Company operates through the Amusement segment. The Amusement segment is engaged in the development and operation of amusement facilities, development and operation of online crane game applications, rental of amusement machines, sales promotions, sales of prizes and amusement machines, and character licenses.

name: GENOVA INC
businessSummary: Genova Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical platform business and the smart clinic business. The Company operates in two business segments. In the medical platform business, the Company operates Medical DOC and provides medical information to people who seek correct preventive information and health knowledge. In addition, Medical DOC provides a database of information on medical institutions nationwide and provides a function that allows easy searches by region or medical department. NOMOCa-Stand, which is the main service of the smart clinic business, is a smart simple automatic payment machine and revisit reception machine for medical institutions (bedless clinics). It also provides CLINIC BOT, a customer relationship management system (CRM) service using LINE. In addition, the Company also provides Website creation for medical institutions and the operation and maintenance of created Websites.

name: GRCS INC
businessSummary: GRCS Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the protection of companies from the complex external environment by improving the efficiency of information management, mainly through the use of technology. The Company focuses on the perspectives of governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) and security, and develops businesses to solve corporate issues arising from changes in the external environment. At present, the Company mainly operates in the security domain. By introducing dedicated tools for risk management, regulatory/policy management, internal audit, incident management, and other operations, the Company is able to help improve the efficiency of information management and achieve cross-company understanding and management. The company has a single segment, GRC Solutions, which is divided into Solutions and Product divisions based on the content of services.

name: G-NEXT INC
businessSummary: G-NEXT Inc provides Discoveriez, a platform for digital transformation (DX) of customer service, mainly in the cloud format for companies of various sizes and industries. The Company operates Customer DX platform business segment. Discoveriez is a software unifying the contents of calls, emails and chats from customers received at the call center, sharing information with stakeholders such as internal departments and outside the Company, approving and recording response processing by workflow, risk management, quality control and new product development information, aggregation and analysis in a cloud format. The Company provides two services, including the cloud business, which provides a versatile platform Discoveriez that sublimates the know-how cultivated through conventional on-premises customer service counters into a cloud type, and the on-premise business, which is an on-premise customer service counter service.

name: GMO FINANCIAL GATE INC
businessSummary: GMO Financial Gate Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of face-to-face payment services in the cashless payment market. Sales are divided into four categories including initial, stock, fee, and spread, depending on the content of the service. It provides two kinds of services. The payment processing service provides connection services to the payment information processing centers of payment service providers. It provides credit center terminal (CCT) and operates payment information processing center CCT Center. It also operates a 24/7 help desk. It has four business models. It is a payment service that can handle contact-type credit card payments, debit card payments, contactless electronic money payments, and code-type payments that can be displayed and read on a smartphone. The payment agency service has two business models, including comprehensive merchant contract and merchant agency contract.

name: JMDC INC
businessSummary: JMDC Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the health big data business, telemedicine business and dispensing pharmacy support business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Health Big Data segment is engaged in the provision of receipt data analysis and health promotion solutions, and personal health information platforms, the build, management and analysis of medical databases such as receipt data and medical examination data, the build and sale of drug databases, and the development and provision of systems using drug databases for medical institutions. The Telemedicine segment is engaged in the provision of remote image diagnosis matching services, and infrastructure systems for remote image diagnosis. The Dispensing Pharmacy Support segment is engaged in the development and provision of business systems and electronic medication record for dispensing pharmacies, as well as the operation of dispensing pharmacies.

name: JAIC CO LTD
businessSummary: JAIC Co.,Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in education-integrated recruitment services. The college business is engaged in the provision of education-integrated human resource introduction services and educational opportunities for SMEs with less than 300 employees. The Company is also engaged in the provision of a wide range of detailed education and training services including Job College service, Women's College service, Second College service, New College service, Leader College service, Seven Habits training service, Harada Method training service, Discovery training service, and new employee training Basics of Work services.

name: J LEASE CO LTD
businessSummary: J-Lease Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the guarantee-related business, with a focus on rent guarantees for rental housing, offices and tenants, as well as the real estate related business and information technology (IT) related business. It operates through three business segments. The Guarantee Related Business segment provides rent guarantees for residential properties, commercial properties, parking lots and rental boxes, medical expenses guarantee services for medical institutions' unpaid medical receivables and child support guarantee services for single-parent households. The Real Estate Related Business segment provides rental brokerage services for foreign nationals looking for housing in Japan, rental management services for real estate owners and real estate rental services. The IT Related Business segment sells environmental inspection systems, develops software on a contract basis, and sells systems.

name: ZIGEXN CO LTD
businessSummary: ZIGExN Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in life media platform business which integrates the information on multiple media. The Company operates in two business segments. Its Life Media Platform segment is engaged in the development, operation and maintenance of media that integrate information from multiple Internet and paper media, specialized media that matches users and customers for specific industries and regions, as well as application Service provider (ASP) services. The Life Media Platform segment includes three fields: human resources field, real estate field and living field. The Others segment is engaged in the plan, development, operation and maintenance of new development services centered on the user billing model, leveraging the knowledge of the existing life media platform business.

name: ENEOS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: ENEOS Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the energy business, oil and gas development business, and metal business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Energy segment is engaged in refining and sale of petroleum, the provision of lubricants, basic chemicals, functional chemicals, gas, coals, electricity, new energy and other products. The Oil and Natural Gas Development segment is engaged in the exploration, development and production of petroleum and natural gas. The Metal segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of copper foil, precision rolled products, precision processed products, thin film materials, development and mining of non-ferrous metal resources, non-ferrous metal products, as well as the industrial waste treatment, titanium and electric wires. The Company is also engaged in group common businesses such as asphalt paving, civil engineering work, construction work, land transportation, real estate rental and fund raising.

name: J.FRONT RETAILING CO LTD
businessSummary: J.Front Retailing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the department store business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Department Store segment is engaged in the sale of apparel, general merchandise, household goods, foodstuffs, and others. The Shopping Center (SC) segment develops, manages, administers, and operates shopping centers. The Developer segment develops, manages, and operates real estate, and conducts interior decoration work and others. The Payment and Finance segment is engaged in the issuance and operation of credit cards. The Company is also engaged in wholesale trade, parking lot business, and leasing business.

name: JEDAT INC
businessSummary: Jedat Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electronic design automation (EDA) software development and sales consultation business. The Company is engaged in the development, sale, support and consultation for computer aided design (CAD) software. In addition to the sale and support of EDA products, the Company is also engaged in the solutions business, such as software development, semiconductor design, and EDA environment construction support. The Company provides EDA products, maintenance services and solutions to customers. The main customers are semiconductor manufacturers, LCD panel manufacturers, electronic device manufacturers, mask manufacturers, and design contract companies. Sales to domestic customers are mainly direct sales. Sales to overseas customers such as the United States, Taiwan, Mainland China, and South Korea are conducted through local agents.

name: GEOMATEC CO LTD
businessSummary: GEOMATEC CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of vacuum film related products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of substrates for flat panel displays (FPDs), as well as vacuum film substrates of indium tin oxide (ITO) and metal, mainly for liquid crystal displays (LCDs) of smart phones, tablet terminals, mobile phones, touch panels, car navigation systems, digital cameras and others. The Company is also engaged in the provision of various products for measuring equipment, medical equipment, lighting equipment and other optical equipment parts, solar cell parts, transparent heaters, beam expander lenses, thermocouples and others. The main products include optical thin films, transparent conductive films, ITO films, thin metal film heaters, thin film flow sensors, drip-proof and anti-fouling films, shielding and transmission prevention films, decorative films, decorative coatings and others.

name: JAC RECRUITMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: JAC Recruitment Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the recruiting business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Domestic Recruitment segment mainly introduces candidates for indefinite employees to the recruiting company, and charges to the recruiting company as a success fee when the candidate joins the Company. The Domestic Recruitment Advertisement segment is engaged in the publishing of job offerings from recruiting companies on the recruitment advertisement Website under the name CareerCross. The Overseas segment expands the functions of the Japan Desk, which introduces job seekers working in Asian countries to domestic residents, strengthens the list of applicants who wish to change jobs overseas, and proceeds with the establishment of account management for multinational companies.

name: LIKE INC
businessSummary: LIKE,Inc. is engaged in the general personnel service business, child care support service business, multimedia service business, and the provision of nursing care-related services. The Company operates in three business segments. The General Personnel Service segment is engaged in the provision of temporary staff dispatching services, outsourcing services, employment placement services, career and education support services. The Child Care Support Service business segment is engaged in the provision of contracted childcare services for contracted company, hospital, university childcare services operated by subsidiaries, as well as the public childcare services for licensed nursery schools and schoolchild clubs. The Nursing Care-Related business segment is engaged in the provision of nursing care and nursing services to residents at nursing care facilities operated by subsidiaries. The multimedia service sells mobile phone terminals and conducts subscription agent store business.

name: JFE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: JFE Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning of business strategy, the management of business and risk, as well as the presentation of group investor information. The Company mainly operates its business through three segments. The Steel segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products, processed steel products and raw materials, as well as the delivery, facility maintenance and construction businesses. The Engineering segment is engaged in engineering, recycling, and electric power retailing businesses related to energy, urban environment, steel structures, and industrial machinery. The Trading segment purchases, processes, and sells steel products, raw materials for steelmaking, non-ferrous metal products, and food products.

name: JSP CORP
businessSummary: JSP Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic products with enhanced functionality and economic efficiency, mainly using foaming technology. The Company operates business through two business segments. The Extrusion segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of polystyrene, polyethylene, polypropylene sheets, boards and others, using extrusion foam technology as its core. The Beads segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of foamed polypropylene, foamed polyethylene, and foamed polystyrene products based on bead foaming technology. The Company also operates businesses related to the sale of general packaging materials.

name: GMO PAYMENT GATEWAY INC
businessSummary: GMO Payment Gateway, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of payment agency services, finance related services and payment activation services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Payment Agency segment is engaged in the provision of online and continuous payment agency services and face-to-face payment agency services. The Finance Related segment is engaged in the provision of payment, remittance services and other money services, the provision of transaction lending to finance growth funds, as well as the provision of early payment services to improve the cash flow of member stores. The Payment Activation segment is engaged in the provision of mobile payment, authentication, notification and other services, as well as the provision of customer collection support services to improve sales of member stores.

name: GMB CORP
businessSummary: GMB CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of automobile parts. The Company operates in six business segments based on the regions. Each segment engages in manufacture and sale of automotive parts. The Company's main products include drive, transmission and control equipment parts, engine parts, and bearings. Drive, transmission and control parts include universal joints, steering joints, constant velocity joints and others. Engine parts include water pumps, water pump bearings and fan clutches. Bearings include tensioner and idler bearings, auto tensioner and idler bearings, ball bearings and others.

name: GS YUASA CORP
businessSummary: GS Yuasa Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of batteries, power supply devices, lighting equipment, and other battery and electrical equipment. The Company operates through four segments. The Automotive Batteries (Japan) segment manufactures and sells lead-acid batteries for automobiles and motorcycles, and automotive-related equipment. The Automotive Batteries (Overseas) segment manufactures and sells lead-acid batteries for automobiles and motorcycles overseas. The Industrial Batteries and Power Supplies segment manufactures and sells lead-acid batteries, small lead-acid batteries, alkaline storage batteries, rectifiers, and general-purpose power supplies. The Automotive Lithium-ion Batteries segment manufactures and sells automotive lithium-ion batteries. The Company also provides battery-related equipment, battery manufacturing facilities, environmental equipment, and mobile communication batteries.

name: NS UNITED KAIUN KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: NS United Kaiun Kaisha Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the shipping industry and related maritime businesses. The Company mainly operates through two segments. The Overseas Shipping segment transports iron ore, coal, steel products, non-ferrous ores, and other bulk commodities using bulk carriers. The Segment also transports liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and other liquids using tankers and engages in vessel chartering and related businesses. The Domestic Shipping segment transports steel products, limestone, cement, and other goods using bulk carriers within domestic waters. The Segment also transports LPG, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and other liquids using tankers and engages in vessel chartering and other businesses. The Company also provides information services and other related businesses.

name: SHINWA CO LTD
businessSummary: Shinwa Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of production equipment and materials in the manufacturing industry. The Company operates in four regional segments. The Company is engaged in the sale of metal joints, industrial equipment, factory automation (FA) system related products, the provision of cover welding and spraying services, soldering services and maintenance works, the manufacture and sale of FA systems, as well as the logistics business, the real estate management business, the insurance agency business, and the manufacture and sale of resin products. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the United States, Southeast Asia and China.

name: SHINMAYWA INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: ShinMaywa Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of special-purpose vehicles. The Company operates five business segments. The Special-purpose Vehicles segment manufactures and sells special-purpose vehicles such as dump trucks, tailgate lifters, and garbage trucks, as well as forestry machinery. The Parking Systems segment manufactures, sells, maintains, and repairs mechanical parking facilities and aircraft passenger boarding bridges. The Industrial and Environmental Systems segment manufactures and sells automatic wire processors, vacuum products, and waste disposal facilities and equipment. The Fluids segment manufactures and sells pumps and water treatment-related products. The Aircraft segment manufactures and sells flying boats and aircraft parts for overseas aircraft manufacturers. The Company also engages in construction, real estate, and software businesses.

name: SHIN MAINT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Shin Maint Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of maintenance services for various facilities and equipment in stores. Main customers are major restaurant chains and retail chains. The one-stop maintenance services provide an emergency maintenance service that responds to sudden troubles in various facilities and equipment, and a preventive maintenance service that regularly checks, maintains, and cleans various facilities and equipment. The maintenance outsourcing service provides support to improve the maintenance capability of the kitchen equipment manufacturer by providing a maintenance system. The emergency maintenance service accepts repair requests 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The preventive maintenance services provide tailored maintenance based on store conditions.

name: SYMBIO PHARMACEUTICALS LTD
businessSummary: SymBio Pharmaceuticals Limited is a Japan-based pharmaceutical company. Along with medicine specialists, contract research organizations (CROs) and other pharmaceutical companies, the Company is engaged in the design and operation of clinical tests, the manufacture and sale of new drugs specializing in three therapeutic areas: cancer, blood diseases and autoimmune diseases. The Company develops new medicines using chemical compounds proofed by preclinical tests and clinical tests. The Company manufactures and sells medicines through domestic and foreign pharmaceutical companies. The Company's pipelines include anticancer drugs, such as SyB L-0501, SyB L-1101 and SyB C-1101.

name: SHINNIHONSEIYAKU CO LTD
businessSummary: Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd develops and sells cosmetics, health foods and pharmaceutical products. The Company mainly operates its business through each sales channel with mail order sales. The Company sells cosmetics such as skin care, base makeup and hair care, health foods and medicines by mail order, and sells and wholesales cosmetics and health foods at directly managed stores that open stores in department stores and shopping centers, and through overseas agencies. The Company's products include cosmetics, healthcare and pharmaceuticals.

name: NIPPON STEEL CORP
businessSummary: Nippon Steel Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel manufacturing business, engineering business, chemical & material business and system solution business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Steel Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products. The Engineering segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial machinery and equipment, steel structures, contracting of construction work, waste treatment and reclamation, and supply of electricity, gas, heat. The Chemical and Materials segment manufactures and sells coal chemical products, petrochemical products, electronic materials, semiconductor and electronic component materials and components, carbon fiber and composite materials, and fabricated metal products. The System Solution segment provides engineering and consulting services related to computer systems, outsourcing services using information technology, and various other services.

name: SHINNIHON CORP
businessSummary: SHINNIHON CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in construction business and development business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Construction business is engaged in the contract, planning, design, and construction of civil engineering work. The Company is also engaged in the seismic reinforcement work and large-scale repair work of apartments. The Development business is engaged in the land purchase, buildings construction, land and buildings sale. The Company is also engaged in the provision of condominium and building management services, and the owning and renting of Shin Nihon Building, multiple dwelling houses, and office buildings.

name: IDEA CONSULTANTS INC
businessSummary: IDEA Consultants, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the environmental consultation business. The Company has four business segments. The Environmental Consultant segment is engaged in the environment-related planning, design, survey, analysis, predictive assessment and weather forecast. The Construction Consultant segment is engaged in the construction-related planning, design, survey, analysis and execution management. The Information System segment is involved in the development, construction, maintenance and operation of information systems. The Real Estate segment leases real estate properties.

name: NS SOLUTIONS CORP
businessSummary: NS Solutions Corporation is mainly engaged in the provision of information services. The Company operates in two business divisions based on the services offered to customers, including business solution business and service solution business. The business solution business provides solutions in total system lifecycle to meet customer needs based on knowledge and experience of business types and business operations. The service solution business provides information technology (IT) infrastructure solutions and outsourcing services, which combine platform construction technology and operation know-how to meet mission critical requirements.

name: SINTOKOGIO LTD
businessSummary: Sintokogio,Ltd. is a company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of casting, surface treatment, environment, carrier, special machine business, and other equipment and components. The Company operates in five business segments. The Casting segment offers molding machines, casting sand processing devices, granular processing equipment and components. The Surface Treatment segment offers shot blasting machines, components of surface treatment equipment, as well as shot materials and abrasive materials. The Environment segment offers dust collectors, deodorization equipment, water processing equipment and other components. The Carrier segment offers lifting devices, conveyors and conveying system. The Special Equipment segment offers inspection and measurement devices, servo-cylinders, handling robot and ceramics products. The others engages in design of machinery, information-related business and welfare businesses.

name: SYNSPECTIVE INC
businessSummary: Synspective Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the satellite data business using satellite constellations and data analysis technology. It develops, manufactures and operates synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites. It operates satellite constellations through the development and manufacture of small SAR satellites and related systems, sells the acquired data, and develops and sells solutions. It has two services. Data sale service sells data acquired from small SAR satellite StriX series. Customers are governments. The demand is for public security, disaster prevention/mitigation, infrastructure/land development and others. Solution provision services include ground movement monitoring, flood damage analysis and other solutions. Customers are governments, and companies involved in non-life insurance, infrastructure development and others, and the Company responds to demand for damage assessments, safety management of equipment and construction, environmental surveys and others.

name: NEW COSMOS ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: NEW COSMOS ELECTRIC CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacturing and sales of gas sensors, the development, manufacturing and sales of gas alarms and detectors, as well as the maintenance of its products.

name: SHINKO SHOJI CO LTD
businessSummary: Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. is principally engaged in the sale, import and export of electronic components and assembly products. The Company operates in three business segments. The Electronic Components segment offers integrated circuits, semiconductor devices, circuit components, liquid crystal displays (LCDs), and other electronic components. The main products include microcomputers, system large-scale integrated circuits, memories, semiconductors, capacitors, ferrite cores, color LCDs and general electronic components. The Assembly segment offers assembly products. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of electronic equipment and contract development of microcomputer software. The main products include workstation server and computer peripherals.

name: SHIN-ETSU POLYMER CO LTD
businessSummary: Shin-Etsu Polymer Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the electronic devices business, precision molded products business, and housing and lifestyle materials business. The Company operates through three segments. The Electronic Devices segment manufactures and sells input/output components and peripheral parts for automobiles and electronic equipment. The Precision Molded Products segment manufactures and sells precision molded products such as semiconductor wafer and electronic component handling materials, and parts for office automation (OA) equipment and medical devices. The Housing and Lifestyle Materials segment manufactures and sells resin-processed products like food packaging materials and housing-related materials, as well as functional materials used in automotive and machine tool parts and electronic components. The Company also engages in construction-related businesses.

name: SHIN-ETSU CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Shin-Etsu Chemical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemical business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Life Environment Materials segment is engaged in the provision of polyvinyl chloride resin, caustic soda, methanol, chloromethane, and poval. The Electronic Materials segment is engaged in the provision of semiconductor silicon, rare earth magnets (for electronics industry and general use), semiconductor encapsulants, packaging materials for light-emitting diodes (LEDs), photoresists, mask blanks, and synthetic quartz products. The Performance Materials segment is engaged in the provision of silicones, cellulose derivatives, metallic silicon, synthetic sex pheromones, polyvinyl chloride-vinyl acetate copolymer resins, liquid fluoroelastomers, and pellicles. The Processing, Trading, and Technical Services segment is engaged in provision of resin processing products, technology and plant exports, product imports and exports, and engineering.

name: SHOWA PAXXS CORP
businessSummary: SHOWA PAXXS CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of packaging-related products. The Company has five business segments. The Heavy-duty Packaging Bag segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of bags for petroleum chemical products, cement and ceramic products, chemical agents, agricultural products, fertilizers and food products, among others. The Film Product segment manufactures and sells film products for thermal contraction packaging, pallet packaging, agriculture use and secondary processing use. The Container segment provides flexible containers, bulk containers and others. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of buildings and warehouses. The Other segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of packaging materials, machinery and other related products, as well as the management of buildings and the non-life insurance agency business.

name: RESONAC HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Resonac Holdings Corp is a Japan-based comprehensive chemical company. The Company has four business segments. The Semiconductor and Electronic Materials segment provides semiconductor front-end process materials, including high-purity gases and functional chemicals, semiconductor back-end process materials, including epoxy encapsulants and die bonding materials, and device solutions, including hard disks and others. The Mobility segment provides automotive parts, including plastic molded products and friction materials, and lithium-ion battery materials, including aluminum laminate films, conductive additives for positive and negative electrodes. The Innovation Materials segment provides functional chemicals, functional resins, coating materials, ceramics, and aluminum functional components. The Chemical segment provides petrochemicals, chemicals, basic chemicals, graphite electrodes and others, including olefins, organic chemical, industrial gases, liquefied ammonia and others.

name: SHOWA SYSTEM ENGINEERING CORP
businessSummary: SHOWA SYSTEM ENGINEERING CORPORATION is a company mainly engaged in the development of software. The Company has two business segments. The Software Development segment is involved in the provision of system integration and consulting services related to corporate computer systems, the design, development and maintenance of software, as well as other software-related services. The Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) segment is involved in the provision of input data creation services, as well as batch processing data services with the Company-owned various input data creation devices to government offices and private companies.

name: MITSUI OSK LINES LTD
businessSummary: Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the shipping business. The Company operates in six business segments. The Dry bulk Carrier segment is engaged in the operation of dry bulk carriers. The Energy Transportation segment owns and operates coal carriers that transport coal for thermal power generation, oil tankers, offshore businesses, and tramp ships, including liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers, and is engaged in marine cargo transportation. The Product Transportation segment owns and operates pure car carriers and transports marine cargo. The Well-Being Life segment is engaged in real estate business, including land and building rental and building management, passenger and cargo transportation, and cruise business. The Associated segment is engaged in tugboat business and trading company business. The Other segment is engaged in ship management of ships other than transport ships and LNG ships, financial business such as group fund raising and others.

name: SHOEI YAKUHIN CO LTD
businessSummary: SHOEI YAKUHIN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in chemicals business. The Company mainly operates in three segments. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the sale of chemicals, including oleochemical, such as fatty acids, fatty amines, fatty alcohols and glycerin, as well as surfactants, among others. The Daily Necessities segment is engaged in the plan, development and sale of detergents, cosmetics and various ideas miscellaneous goods. The Civil Engineering and Construction Materials segment is engaged in the sale of ground improvement chemicals, repair materials, and environmental improvement chemicals.

name: SHOEI CO LTD
businessSummary: SHOEI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of motorcycle helmets. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of helmets for motorcycles, government and other official use, as well as the sales of helmet parts and other products. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in the agency administration business and marketing business, as well as the sales of helmets and related components in the Europe and North American areas.

name: HULIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Hulic Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate business and insurance business. It operates through two business segments. Real Estate segment has three kinds of business. The real estate leasing business manages approximately 250 rental properties (excluding real estate for sale) that are owned and managed mainly near stations in the 23 wards of Tokyo. Real estate development business is performed according to the characteristics of the property location. Asset management business is entrusted with asset management business. It also provides real estate rental, building management and cleaning business. The Insurance segment is engaged in non-life insurance agency business such as fire insurance and automobile insurance, life insurance such as fixed-term insurance and endowment insurance, and solicitation business. It is also engaged in the design, repair and construction work on owned buildings, hotel and inn management and agricultural production in Vietnam.

name: SYUPPIN CO LTD
businessSummary: Syuppin Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the purchase and sale of used and new goods through Internet or retail stores. The Company operates in four business segments. The Camera segment provides used and new cameras such as digital cameras, film cameras, interchangeable lenses, peripheral equipment and others. The Watch segment provides used and new watches. The Writing Instrument segment provides used fountain pens, new fountain pens, stationery, leather accessories and others. The Bicycle segment provides used and new goods of bicycle bodies, frames, parts, accessories and others.

name: CHARLE CO LTD
businessSummary: CHARLE CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the wholesale of women's underwear. The women's underwear anchored clothing and cosmetics wholesale business sells clothes, focusing on women's underwear, as well as cosmetics and others, produced in Japan and overseas subcontract factories. The Company operates door-to-door sale and mail order sale business through its business members, via home party-style fitting sessions for membership and general consumers.

name: SHARP CORP
businessSummary: Sharp Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of telecommunications equipment, electrical equipment and components. It operates through five business segments. The Smart Life & Energy segment provides refrigerators, superheated steam ovens, microwave ovens, small cooking appliances, air conditioners, washing machines, vacuum cleaners, air purifiers, fans, dehumidifiers, humidifiers, electric heating equipment, plasma cluster ion generators, and hairdressing equipment. The Smart Office segment provides digital multifunction devices, information displays, and business projectors. The Universal Network segment provides televisions, Blu-ray Disc recorders, audio equipment, cell phones, tablet terminals, routers. The Display Devices segment provides display modules, in-vehicle cameras. The Electronic Devices segment provides camera modules, sensor modules, opto sensors, opto-devices, wafer foundries, semiconductor lasers.

name: SHIMIZU CORP
businessSummary: Shimizu Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the construction business. The Company operates in two business segments, construction business and investment development business. The Company is involved in leasing of land and buildings, sales and leasing of construction materials and equipment, construction work, construction, maintenance and operation of public facilities, engineering, and life cycle valuation (LCV).

name: SHIMAMURA CO LTD
businessSummary: SHIMAMURA CO., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the operation of chain stores which principally retails apparel goods. The Company operates nationwide chain stores under the name Fashion Center SHIMAMURA, which sell fashion and utility apparel products, as well as related items for female customers aging from 20 to 50. It also operates other stores such as Avail, which sell men's and women's clothing and shoes aging from 10 to 30; Birthday, which sell baby products and children products; Chambre, which sell goods, interior, clothing, fashion goods for female customers, as well as Divalo, which offer shoes for female customers.

name: SHIMANO INC
businessSummary: Shimano Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of bicycle components and fishing tackle. The Company conducts business through three segments. The Bicycle Components segment manufactures and sells drivetrain components such as derailleurs, braking components such as brakes, other bicycle parts, and related accessories. The Fishing Tackle segment manufactures and sells reels, rods, and fishing gear. The Other segment manufactures and sells rowing-related equipment and other products.

name: SHIMADZU CORP
businessSummary: Shimadzu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of scientific and precision equipment. The Company has four segments. Testing and Measuring Instruments segment is engaged in the provision of chromatographic analysis systems, mass spectrometry systems, light analysis systems, thermal analysis systems, bio-related analysis systems, water quality measurement systems and others. Medical Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of X-ray television (TV) systems, angiography systems, X-ray imaging systems and others. Aircraft Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of flight control systems, air management systems, cockpit display systems and others. Industrial Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of turbomolecular pumps and others. The Company is also engaged in the leasing and management of real estate business.

name: SHIMA SEIKI MFG. LTD
businessSummary: SHIMA SEIKI MFG., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of flat knitting equipment, design systems, gloves and socks knitting equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Flat Knitting Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of computer flat knitting equipment and semi jacquard flat knitting equipment. The Design Systems Related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of computer design systems, as well as apparel computer-aided design (CAD) and computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) systems. The Gloves and Socks Knitting Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of seamless gloves and socks knitting equipment. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture, sale and trading of textile materials, the planning, manufacture and sale of textile products, the operation of hotels, the manufacture and sale of knitting equipment and design system parts, as well as the repair and maintenance business.

name: SHIBUYA CORP
businessSummary: Shibuya Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to packaging plant business, mechatronics system business and agricultural equipment business. It has three business segments.
