Packaging Plant segment's products are bottling systems, including filling systems, capping systems; box making/packaging systems and pharmaceutical equipment systems, including pharmaceutical manufacturing systems and isolators; regenerative medical systems, including cell culture isolators. Mechatronics System segment’s products are cutting processing systems, including laser beam machines, water jet cutting machines; semiconductor manufacturing system, including solder ball mounter, light emitting diode (LED) inspection device; medical equipment, including laser surgery and treatment equipment; hydraulic press machines. Agricultural Equipment segment's products are agricultural sorting and sorting systems. It also provides staffing and travel agency services.

name: SHIBAURA MECHATRONICS CORP
businessSummary: SHIBAURA MECHATRONICS CORPORATION is a Japan-based manufacturer primarily engaged in fine mechatronics business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Fine Mechatronics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, maintenance equipment for railroad tracks and vacuum pumps. The Mechatronics System segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of FPD manufacturing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, vacuum application equipment, secondary battery manufacturing equipment, precision parts manufacturing equipment and automatic equipment, among others. The Distribution Equipment System segment is engaged in the provision of vending machines, automatic ticket machines and others. The Real Estate Leasing segment is involved in the leasing and management of real estate properties.

name: SHINOBU FOODS PRODUCTS CO LTD
businessSummary: SHINOBU FOODS PRODUCTS CO., LTD. is engaged in the production and sale of prepared food products, such as sushi, rice balls, lunch boxes, prepared bread and other perishable food products. Through its subsidiary, the Company also engaged in leasing of real estate.

name: SHINAGAWA REFRACTORIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Shinagawa Refra Co Ltd, formerly Shinagawa Refractories Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily manufactures and sells refractories, insulation materials, and fine ceramics, and performs furnace construction work. The Company operates through four segments. The Refractories segment manufactures and sells shaped refractories, unshaped refractories, molded powder, quicklime, chemical products, and others. The Insulation Materials segment manufactures and sells refractory insulating bricks and ceramic fibers. The Advanced Materials segment manufactures and sells fine ceramics, inorganic coatings, and inorganic adhesives. The Engineering segment performs construction work for blast furnaces, converters, incinerators, and other facilities, as well as the design and construction of industrial furnaces. The Company also operates a real estate leasing business.

name: CITIZEN WATCH CO LTD
businessSummary: Citizen Watch Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in watch business, machine tools business, device business, electronic machinery business and others. The Company consists of four business segments. The Watches and Clocks Business segment produces and sells watches and movements. The Machine Tool Business segment produces and sells computer numeric control (NC) automatic lathes and other equipment. The Devices Business segment provides light-emitting diodes (LEDs), automotive parts, quartz devices, and small motors. The Electronic Equipment and Others Business segment provides printers, health care equipment, and other items.

name: 77 BANK LTD
businessSummary: 77 Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of banking services, leasing services, and financial services such as credit card services. The Company operates through the Banking Business segment. Banking business includes deposit business, lending business, commodity securities trading business, securities investment business, domestic foreign exchange business, foreign exchange business, corporate bond trust business, agency business, debt guarantee (payment acceptance), government bonds, investment trust, over-the-counter sales of insurance products. The leasing business is engaged in financial-related leasing activities. It is also engaged in credit guarantee business, credit card business, financial product transaction business, research and consulting business, outsourcing of calculation business using electronic computing equipment, fund management business, and investment business.

name: SHISEIDO CO LTD
businessSummary: Shiseido Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics, toiletries, personal care products, barber and beauty products. The Company operates through six business segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the sale of cosmetics, fragrance, toiletries, personal care products, beauty food and over-the-counter drugs in Japan. China segment and Asia Pacific segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics, toiletries and personal care products respectively in China and Asia-Oceania other region. Americas segment and Europe segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics and toiletries respectively in the Americas, as well as Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Travel Retail segment is engaged in the sale of cosmetics and toiletries in duty free shops around the world. The Company also conducts manufacturing businesses and food and beverage businesses.

name: SHIZUOKA FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Shizuoka Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking business, leasing business, and non-banking financial services, such as financial product transaction business. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Banking Business segment is engaged in banking business, including deposit, lending, securities investment, and foreign exchange services. The Leasing Business segment is engaged in leasing operations, mainly finance lease transactions. The Company also engages in domestic financial instruments trading, management consulting, and initial public offering support services.

name: SYSMEX CORP
businessSummary: Sysmex Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the health care business. The Company conducts product development, manufacturing, sales, and service in domestic markets, and some products are developed, manufactured, and sold by subsidiaries. Overseas, the Company conducts the manufacturing and sales of products in the Americas, EMEA, China, and Asia Pacific through other companies. Along with its subsidiaries, the Company is involved in the development, manufacture, sale and service of clinical laboratory equipment, laboratory test drugs and products related to laboratory test.

name: SYSTEM RESEARCH CO LTD
businessSummary: SYSTEM RESEARCH CO., LTD. involves in system integration and software development. The Company operates software related business. Its SI Services segment involves in planning, design, development of information systems. The software development business, centering on major companies, engages in system development and maintenance. Software project business creates, sells, and maintains programs for unspecified users. Product sales business conducts purchase and sale of products such as information equipment, software and others. Others include website management, cloud service.

name: SYSTENA CORP
businessSummary: Systena Corporation is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the business related to information technology (IT). The Company operates in eight segments. Solution Design segment engages in the provision of automatic operation, in-vehicle system, carrier service and others. Framework Design segment develops financial, industrial, public, and other key systems and develops basic systems. IT Service segment is engaged in the operation and maintenance of systems and networks, the provision of services of user support and data inputting, among others. Solution segment sells IT-related products and operates system integration business. Cloud segment sells and installs cloud software. Consumer Service segment plans, develops and sells game content for smartphones and tablets. Overseas segment is engaged in the solution business in overseas markets. Investment Development segment conducts new business.

name: SYSTEMSOFT CORP
businessSummary: SystemSoft Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the system solution and marketing business. The system solution business engages in the development of systems and the provision of solution services, the operation of real estate information sates business. The marketing business is primarily involved in the Web marketing business including Web marketing and consulting operations.

name: SYSTEM SUPPORT INC
businessSummary: System Support Holdings Inc, formerly System Support Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in cloud integration, system integration and outsourcing business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Cloud Integration segment provides technical support for the migration and use of cloud services (ServiceNow, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud) and resales of licenses. The System Integration segment provides technical support for the introduction and use of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) packages, infrastructure construction such as databases, and consulting, design, development, operation and maintenance of information technology (IT) systems. The Outsourcing segment provides database services such as private clouds, data analysis and input. The Product segment develops and sells software. The Overseas segment provides system integration overseas, outsourcing of payroll and accounting work, recruitment services, and media management.

name: SHIKOKU ELECTRIC POWER CO
businessSummary: Shikoku Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electricity, information and communications, energy, and construction and engineering businesses. It has four segments. The Electricity Business segment is involved in power generation and sales, power transmission and distribution, and is engaged in power supply, wind power generation, nuclear power generation, thermal power generation, hydroelectric power generation, and solar power generation. The Information and Communications Business segment is involved in information system development, platform business, communications business, program production and broadcasting. The Energy Business segment provides comprehensive energy solution services, the design and construction of heat supply systems for buildings and factories. It also operates and manages biomass power plants and provides liquefied natural gas (LNG). The Construction and Engineering Business segment provides comprehensive engineering services.

name: SHIGEMATSU WORKS CO LTD
businessSummary: SHIGEMATSU WORKS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of occupational safety and health protection equipment. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various occupational safety and health protection equipment such as respiratory protective equipment with electric fans, dust masks, gas masks, air supply masks, self-contained respirators, evacuation and rescue products, protective clothing, protective gloves, soundproof protective equipment, protective glasses, N95 masks and other products. The Company is also engaged in the agency sale of self-contained respirators, as well as the maintenance, inspection and repair of various protective equipment.

name: SHIGA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Shiga Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of financial services centered on the banking business. The Bank is engaged in the provision of deposits, loans, domestic exchange, foreign exchange and securities investment services. The Bank is also involved in the finance leasing business, installment sales business, venture capital investment business, credit card business, cashing business, the operation of automated teller facilities outside its offices, as well as the provision of document storage and management services, real estate assessment services, data processing services, mortgage guarantee services and business operation-related consulting services.

name: SHIONOGI & CO LTD
businessSummary: Shionogi & Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company is mainly engaged in the research and development, purchasing, manufacturing, sales, and related activities of ethical pharmaceuticals. The Company is engaged in research and development, purchasing, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceuticals for the treatment of gram-negative bacterial infections, influenza virus infections, new coronavirus infections, invasive aspergillus infections, complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis, Alzheimer's disease, chronic pain, cancer of the esophagus, bladder, head and neck, solid tumors, and other diseases. The Company provides products and services in Japan, Europe, North America, and other regions.

name: C CHANNEL CORP
businessSummary: C Channel Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the media business, electronic commerce (e-commerce) business and overseas business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Media segment is engaged in the provision of native video advertising services that plans, produces and distributes video advertising content for corporates, as well as the advertising and ad network services, event holding services, sample product sales services and influencer marketing services through the video media application C CHANNEL and mama+ in Japan. The E-commerce segment is engaged in the sale of apparel products, beauty equipment and cosmetic products in Japan through applications and social networking services (SNS). The brands include KOBE LETTUCE, Isn't She?, N WITH., and BELL PALETTE. The Overseas segment is engaged in the overseas expansion of the C CHANNEL business mainly in the Asian regions such as China, Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia and Vietnam.

name: C S LUMBER CO INC
businessSummary: C.S. LUMBER CO., INC is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pre-cut business and other businesses. The Company mainly operates in three business segments. The Pre-cut segment is engaged in the pre-cut processing of lumbers, design of two-by-four method, as well as the manufacture and distribution of panels. The Construction Contracting segment is engaged in the construction contracting of wooden detached houses and wooden general buildings. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing and management of real estates. The other business is engaged in the development and sale of detached houses.

name: COMPUTER ENGINEERING & CONSULTING LTD
businessSummary: COMPUTER ENGINEERING & CONSULTING LTD. is engaged in the industry automation business, system integration business and platform integration business. The industrial automation business mainly provides products and services that support innovation in field of manufacturing from the aspect of ICT to customers in assembly manufacturing industry. The system integration business mainly provides system integration services specialized in business types and tasks for customers in the manufacturing, finance, public, government, and local governments. The platform integration business provides the ICT infrastructure best suited to businesses promoted by customers and the business platform services necessary for business execution, with the company's own data center connected by the Network as the core.

name: COMPUTER INSTITUTE OF JAPAN LTD
businessSummary: Computer Institute of Japan, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of system development and related services. The system development services are engaged in the design, manufacture, operation and maintenance of systems. The consultation and research services provide system consultation and research services. The system and package integration services are involved in the integration services of system or its own software products. The other services are engaged in the provision of other services and the sale of computer products.

name: CRG HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: CRG HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in temporary staffing introduction related business. The Company operates three kinds of business. The temporary staffing introduction business includes worker dispatch business and paid employment introduction business. The outsourcing manufacturing business is engaged in the outsourcing manufacturing of pet related products, such as pet foods and pet hygiene goods from business partner manufacturers and their accompanying business. The other business provides services to improve productivity in client business activities. The services include business process outsourcing (BPO), salary calculation agency, recruitment agency, robotic process automation (RPA), system solution, as well as information technology (IT) related services.

name: THECOO INC
businessSummary: Thecoo Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the fan community platform management business, the influencer marketing business and the online advertising business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Fanicon segment is engaged in the distribution, operation and management of fan community application platform Fanicon for general users. The Corporate Sales segment is engaged in the influencer sales business, the online advertising business, and the online marketing consulting business.

name: SANWA HOLDINGS CORP.
businessSummary: Sanwa Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of building and commercial facility construction materials, as well as the provision of maintenance and renovation services. The Company operates in three geological segments, including Japan segment, North America segment and Europe segment. Its products include shutters and related products, doors for buildings, partitions, stainless products, front desk products, windows, doors for housing, exterior products, garage doors for houses, and vehicle doors, etc.

name: SANRIN CO LTD
businessSummary: SANRIN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the energy related business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Energy Related segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of petroleum, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas, general high-pressure gas, charcoal, solar power generation systems and housing equipment, as well as the insurance agency business. The Ice Making segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of ice. The Fruit and Vegetable segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of vegetables and fruits. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the building lots and buildings transaction business. The Company is also engaged in the transportation business, the construction business, as well as the management and rental of LP gas related equipment.

name: SANRIO CO LTD
businessSummary: Sanrio Co Ltd is mainly engaged in character licensing, gift product planning and sales, and theme park business. The character licensing business involves licensing and managing merchandising rights. The gift product planning and sales business involves planning and selling gift products, greeting cards, and publications, as well as producing and selling video software. The theme park business involves operating theme parks and planning and performing musicals and other events. The other business involves selling and leasing robots, renting automobiles, and providing non-life insurance agency services. The Company operates in five business segments. The Japan segment includes gift products, merchandising rights, theme parks, robots, and non-life insurance agency services. The Europe segment includes gift products, merchandising rights, and loans. The North American, South American, and Asian segments include gift products and merchandising rights.

name: SUN LIFE HOLDING CO LTD
businessSummary: SUN LIFE HOLDING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of group companies which conduct ceremony, nursing care and other related business. The Company provides hotel & bridal service, funeral & Buddhist sermon service, nursing care service and other related services, for regional customers and mutual aid association members in the members' system (mutual benefit association). The Company’s subsidiary SUN LIFE CORPORATION operates in four business segments: hotel business, ceremonial business, other business and company-wide (common).

name: SANYU CO LTD
businessSummary: SANYU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of brass bar steel and cold headed steel wires. Company has two business segments. The Brass Bar Steel segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of brass bar steel, as well as the precision machining of these products. The Cold Headed Steel Wires segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cold headed steel wires. This segment also leases land, buildings and equipment, among others.

name: SUN FRONTIER FUDOUSAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Sun Frontier Fudousan Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based real estate company. The Company operates in four business segments. The Real Estate Revitalization segment is engaged in the re-planning business, including the remodeling of commercial properties; the building leasing business, as well as the real estate securitization business and the asset management business. The Brokerage segment offers sales brokerage services for commercial buildings and condominiums, and leasing brokerage services for offices and stores. The Property Management segment is involved in the operation of general properties management businesses, and the provision of cleaning, security and maintenance services. The Others segment is engaged in the construction planning business, such as the renovation planning, repair and renovation of commercial real estate, offices and condominiums, as well as the delinquent rent guarantee business. On September 9, 2014, it sold a building in Tokyo.

name: SUNDRUG CO LTD
businessSummary: SUNDRUG CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company operating in two business segments. The Drug Store segment is primarily engaged in the sale of pharmaceutical products, cosmetic products and sundry goods, among others. The Discount Store segment is primarily engaged in the sale of foodstuffs, household sundry goods, among others.

name: SUNTORY BEVERAGE & FOOD LTD
businessSummary: Suntory Beverage & Food Limited is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of beverages and food. The Company operates in five geographic segments. Japan segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of mineral water, coffee beverages, tea beverages, carbonated beverages, sports beverages, as well as foods for specified health use in Japan. Europe segment manufactures and sells carbonated beverages Orangina and Schweppes, fruit juice beverages Oasis and Ribena, energy and sports drinks Lucozade in France, the UK, Spain and Africa. Asia segment manufactures and sells health food products, such as the BRAND'S Essence of Chicken series in Taiwan and Southeast Asia, including Thailand. Oceania segment manufactures and sells soft drinks mainly in New Zealand and Australia. Americas segment manufactures and sells soft drinks mainly in North Carolina, the United States.

name: SUN CORP
businessSummary: Sun Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and sales of global data intelligence, entertainment-related, new information technology (IT) related, and wellness businesses. It operates through four segments. The Global Data Intelligence segment develops, manufactures, and sells mobile data transfer devices and related services for sale to criminal investigation agencies and similar entities (Digital Intelligence Business). The Entertainment-Related segment develops, manufactures, and sells pachinko machine components, such as control boards, primarily sold to pachinko machine manufacturers. The New IT-Related segment primarily develops, manufactures, and sells machine-to-machine (M2M) communication devices and Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, and develops and sells business support systems for B2B applications. The Wellness segment develops and sells products and services primarily aimed at improving sleep quality within the digital health field.

name: SANTEN PHARMACEUTICAL CO. LTD.
businessSummary: Santen Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceuticals. The Company engages in global research and development, manufacture, sale, and marketing of pharmaceuticals in the ophthalmology field. The Company engages in prescription pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and other businesses. The Company operates in Japan, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), China, and other regions.

name: SANTEC CORP
businessSummary: Santec Holdings Corp, formerly Santec Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of optical component-related and optical measuring instrument-related products. The Company operates through two business segments. Optical Components Related segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of optical components for optical transmission equipment. Products include optical monitors, optical attenuators, optical filters, and spatial light modulators (SLM). Optical Measuring Instrument Related segment is engaged in development, manufacture and sale of optical transmission equipment, measuring instruments for evaluation and inspection of optical parts, optical coherence tomography, and optical intraocular dimension measuring equipment. Products include wavelength tunable light sources, wavelength tunable filters, high-speed scanning lasers, optical coherence tomography (OCT) and others. It is also engaged in the system solution business.

name: SANSEI TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Sansei Technologies, Inc., formerly SANSEI YUSOKI CO., LTD., is primarily engaged in the manufacture and installation of stage machinery, gaming machines, elevating machines and others. The Manufacture segment manufactures and installs stage machinery and elevating machinery for theaters and culture halls, art equipment such as electric decoration devices in television stations, events and concert venues, gaming machines such as roller coasters and towers, and elevating machinery such as elevators, escalators and packing devices. It also purchases products and conducts maintenance work. In addition, the Company is also involved in operation and provision of leisure facilities in amusement parks, and management of parks owned by the Company.

name: SANSHIN ELECTRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: SANSHIN ELECTRONICS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sales of electronic devices and the providing of information technology (IT) solutions. The Company mainly operates in two segments. The Device segment is engaged in the sales of semiconductors and electronic components to electronics manufacturers, besides, it also provides technical support such as software development and module development. The Solution segment is engaged in information and telecommunications network business which provides infrastructure design, construction, operation and maintenance services to private enterprises, government agencies and municipalities.

name: SANSHA ELECTRIC MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: Sansha Electric Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductors and power equipment. The Company operates through two business segments. The Semiconductor segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of module products and discrete products for diode thyristor triac. The Power Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of direct current power equipment, metal surface treatment power equipment, alternating current uninterrupted power equipment, motor control power equipment, electric furnace power equipment, dimming devices, light source machine power equipment, arc welding equipment, dental equipment and alternating current power equipment. The Company is also engaged in the installation, test, repair, maintenance and construction of equipment.

name: SANSAN INC
businessSummary: Sansan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sales of digital transformation (DX) services that change the way people work. The Company operates through two business segments. The Sansan/Bill One Business segment is engaged in the provision of the sales DX service Sansan and the accounting DX service Bill One. The Eight Business segment is engaged in the provision of the business card app Eight and the event transcription service logmi series.

name: SANKO SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: SANKO SANGYO CO., LTD. is primarily engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of special printed products, such as adhesive labels, stickers and panels. The Company operates in three geographical business segments, including Japan, China and ASEAN. The Company provides special printed products in the fields of electrical equipment, such as mobile phones, digital cameras, video cameras, recorders and personal computers among others. The Company is also engaged in the provision of special printed products to equipment for transportation use and printing.

name: SANKO METAL INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Sanko Metal Industrial Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the construction works of roofs, as well as the sale of related construction materials. The Company operates in two business segments. The Roof segment is engaged in the construction of long roofs, water-proof roofs, solar roofs and painted roofs, as well as the sale of long molded products and solar molded products. The Construction Material segment is engaged in the sale of residential molded products. The Company also engages in the wholesale of electricity generated by solar power to electric power company.

name: SANKO TECHNO CO LTD
businessSummary: SANKO TECHNO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in fastening business and functional materials business. The Company operates in two business segments. Fastening segment is mainly involved in the manufacture and sale of post-installed anchor, drills and fasteners. The segment also conducts construction management related to construction of earthquake-resistant reinforcement business, maintenance and conservation business, as well as solar related business. Functional Materials segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of sheets made of fiber-reinforced plastics (FRP), electric hydraulic tools, measuring instruments, as well as electronic printed circuit boards for display boards and observation machines of vehicles, among others.

name: SANKO CO LTD
businessSummary: SANKO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precision components manufacturing and units processing business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of press products, hinge products, mechatronics products such as liquid crystal monitor constant-speed opening and closing mechanisms, and car navigation monitor opening and closing mechanisms, as well as plastic products such as insulators, resin frames and resin gears for automotive-related products, housing equipment-related products, office equipment-related products and digital appliance-related products. The Company is also engage in the insurance agency business.

name: SANGETSU CORP
businessSummary: Sangetsu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in in the interior and exterior businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Domestic Interior segment is engaged in the planning, manufacture, and sales of interior materials such as wall coverings, flooring materials, and fabrics (curtains and chair fabrics), as well as the space creation business, which is involved in the entire space creation process from design to construction. The Domestic Exterior segment is engaged in the sale and construction of exterior products such as gates, fences, and terraces for both the residential and non-residential markets. The Overseas segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of interior materials overseas.

name: SANKYO SEIKO CO LTD
businessSummary: SANKYO SEIKO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the fashion related business, the textile related business and the real estate leasing business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Fashion Related segment is mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of fashion products, the import and sale of overseas brand products, as well as the licensing business. The Textile Related segment is mainly engaged in the processing, planning, manufacture and sale of textile and clothing products. The Real Estate Leasing segment is mainly engaged in the leasing of real estate owned by the Company and group companies, including office, hotels and buildings. The Company is also engaged in the building maintenance business and interior decorating business.

name: SANKYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Sankyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pachinko machine related business, pachislot machine related business, and replenishment equipment related business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Pachinko Machine-related Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pachinko machines and gauge boards for pachinko machines, the sale of related parts, and acquisition of royalties income related to pachinko machines. The Pachislot Machine-related Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pachislot machines, the sale of related parts, and acquisition of royalties income related to pachislot machines. The Supply Equipment-related Business segment is engaged in the sale of pachinko/pachislot supply equipment, card system equipment, hall equipment peripheral equipment. It also provides mobile content services, real estate rental, sales of general molded parts.

name: SUN A. KAKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Sun A. Kaken Company, Limited is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of light packing products, industrial materials and functional materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Light Packing Materials segment manufactures and sells easy-to-unseal films, food packages, medical packaging materials, flexible drink containers and air buffering materials, among others. The Industrial Materials segment provides release coated papers, materials for adhesive tape, polyethylene laminated paper and resin cloths. The Functional Materials segment provides various surface protection films, as well as processed products of adhesive films. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had one subsidiary and two associated companies.

name: SAN-A CO LTD
businessSummary: SAN-A CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the retail business which provides clothing products, food products and living related products, as well as eating out business. The Company operates in two segments. The Retail segment is engaged in sales of food products, clothing products, housing related products and eating out business. The Convenience Store (CVS) segment is engaged in operation of franchise systems and direct stores of convenience stores under the name Lawson in Okinawa Prefecture. The other business is engaged in general freight trucking business, inspection / value-added / sorting work, and insurance agency business.

name: SAN-IN GODO BANK LTD
businessSummary: San-in Godo Bank Ltd operates business related to financial services such as leasing, and credit guarantee, with a focus on banking. The Bank operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the deposit, loan, securities investment, domestic exchange, foreign exchange, bond and bond registration businesses through the head office and branches. The Leasing segment is involved in the leasing business. The others business is engaged in the banking, leasing and credit guarantee business.

name: SAWAI GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Sawai Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical and over-the-counter drugs. The Company operates in two segments. The Japan segment is engaged in medical and healthcare-related businesses such as manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals and medical devices, as well as various related businesses. The America segment is engaged in the sale of manufactured pharmaceutical products to wholesale stores in America. The company is also engaged in the research and development of pharmaceutical products.

name: SAMTY HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Samty Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in real estate development business, real estate solutions business, overseas business, real estate rental business, hotel rental and operation business, and real estate management business. The real estate development business plans, develops, and sells its own brand 'S-RESIDENCE' series. The real estate solutions business acquires, rehabilitates, and sells profitable real estate. The overseas business is engaged in overseas investment and housing development business. The real estate rental business is engaged in the rental of condominiums, office buildings, and commercial facilities. The hotel rental and operation business is engaged in the rental and management of hotels. The real estate management business manages condominiums, office buildings, and commercial facilities.

name: SUMCO CORP
businessSummary: Sumco Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of high-purity silicon. The Company operates the high-purity silicon business, which is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of silicon wafers to semiconductor manufacturers. Semiconductor silicon wafers are used as substrate materials by semiconductor manufacturers when manufacturing various semiconductors such as memory and logic. The Company manufactures polished wafers of various diameters and epitaxial wafers with further special processing on their surfaces. The Company operates in Japan, the United States, Taiwan, Singapore, South Korea and the United Kingdom and other regions.

name: SANOYAS HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Sanoyas Holdings Corporation is a holding company mainly engaged in the shipbuilding business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Shipbuilding segment is mainly engaged in the building bulk carriers for domestic and overseas ship owners, and repair of ships for private and government vessels. The Land segment is involved in the manufacture and rental of elevators for construction work; the manufacture and maintenance of mechanical parking devices; the manufacture of mechanical parts and other products; the engineering work of air conditioning, drainage and environmental work; software development; sales of ship equipment; security business; management of real estate; as well as insurance agent business. The Leisure segment is engaged in manufacture of amusement park machine, management of amusement parks, operation and maintenance of amusement facilities, operation of Ferris wheel and accompanying facilities, and management of leisure facilities.

name: SATO FOODS INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: SATO FOODS INDUSTRIES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food processing business. The Food Processing segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tea extracts, natural seasonings, plant extracts and powdered sakes.

name: SATO SHOJI CORP
businessSummary: SATO SHO-JI CORPORATION is a company primarily engaged in the metal business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Steel and Iron segment sells common steel, such as surface-treated steel plates, cold-rolled steel, pickling steel, hot-rolled steel and steel bars, special steel, such as structural carbon steel, structural alloyed steel, and tool steel, as well as architectural materials and equipment, among others. The Non-Ferrous Metal segment sells aluminum, zinc, metal silicon and copper alloy, among others. The Electronic Materials segment sells electrical materials such as laminated sheets for printed circuit boards (PCBs) and others. The Life Operation segment sells tableware, such as Western-style tableware and others. The Machinery and Tools segment sells machine tools, factory line kits, cutting tools, grinding wheels and working tools, among others.

name: SATO HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Sato Corp, formerly Sato Holdings Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of automatic identification technology products like mechatronics products and supply products. The Company operates in three segments. The Automatic Identification Solution Japan segment is mainly engaged in the planning of the group management strategies, managements, asset lending, the manufacture and sales of mechatronics products and supply products as well as the manufacture and sale of industrial rubber products, synthetic resins, and radio frequency identification device (RFID) tags and labels. The Automatic Identification Solution Overseas segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of mechatronics products and supply products, as well as the manufacturing and sales of RFID tags and labels overseas. It is also engaged in the construction and civil engineering works.

name: SAPPORO HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Sapporo Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the alcoholic beverages, food and beverage, and real estate businesses. The Company is organized into three business segments. The Alcoholic Beverages Business segment manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages and operates various types of restaurants. The Food and Beverage Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of food products and drinking water. The Real Estate Business segment leases real estate. The Company also provides insurance agency services and indirect business services to affiliated companies.

name: SATA CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Sata Construction Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business. The Company is primarily engaged in the construction of civil engineering works and building construction works. In its construction business, the Company involves in the order entry and construction of works, as well as the sale of asphalt mixtures. Through one of its subsidiaries, the Company also involves in the provision of rental services of construction materials and equipment.

name: SAKURA KCS CORP
businessSummary: SAKURA KCS Corporation is mainly engaged in the provision of information services and the sale of system equipment. The Company operates in three business segments, including Financial-related segment, Public-related segment and Industrial-related segment, which focus on financial institutions, local public authorities and general corporations, respectively. The Company involves in the customized development of application software, the development and sale of packaged software, the operation of system consulting business, the contracted calculation processing, the provision of application service provider (ASP) services, computer center management and operation services, business support services for financial institutions, data inputting services, housing services and hosting services, and computer maintenance services. The Company also involves in the maintenance of computers, the sale of various supplies, and the sale of various computers and other devices.

name: SUCCEED CO LTD
businessSummary: Succeed Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of educational services and human resources services. It has three business segments. The Education Human Resources Support segment introduces and dispatches human resources related to education such as home teachers, information and communication technology (ICT) support staff, school teachers, club activity instructors, Japanese language teachers to general households, private cram schools, school corporations and local governments. The Welfare Human Resources Support segment introduces and dispatches welfare-related human resources such as nursery teachers, nutritionists, after-school care instructors, social workers, and care staff to nursery schools, kindergartens, after-school care facilities, and care facilities. The Individualized Instruction Classroom Business develops a cram school Individual Guidance Academy Succeed that provides individualized learning guidance and a schoolchildren's club Pentas Kids.

name: SOTETSU HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Sotetsu Holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in transportation business, distribution business and others. The Company mainly operates five business segments. Transportation segment provides railway, car business and others. Distribution segment involves in the operation of supermarkets and distribution business. Real Estate segment engages in the sale and leasing of properties. Hotel segment is engaged in the development and operation of hotels. The Others segment engages in the building maintenance business, the supply of heat and other businesses.

name: SAKATA SEED CORP
businessSummary: SAKATA SEED CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production or purchase, sale of the horticultural products. The Company operates through three business segments. The Domestic Wholesale segment and The Overseas Wholesale segment is involved in the production or purchase of vegetable seeds, flower seeds, bulbs, seedlings and agricultural and horticultural materials, as well as the wholesale of its products within domestic market and to overseas markets. The Retail segment is involved in the production or purchase of its products for general horticultural enthusiasts, as well as the sale of its products to home centers. The Company is also involved in the landscaping work for public offices and the private sector, temporary staffing, as well as the production, process and sale of agricultural products.

name: SAKAI HEAVY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: SAKAI HEAVY INDUSTRIES, LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of road paving equipment, as well as road maintenance and repair equipment. The Company is mainly engaged in the design, manufacture, sale and repair of construction equipment, industrial machinery and related parts, the purchase and sale of used construction equipment, as well as the design, construction, supervision and contracting of road pavement and repair work. The Company is engaged in the production of vibratory single drum rollers, vibratory tandem rollers, static pneumatic tired rollers, vibratory combined rollers, vibratory three wheel rollers, rammers, plate compactors, walk behind rollers and other road paving equipment, as well as road planers, asphalt pavers, road cleaners, water sprinklers and other road maintenance and repair equipment. The Company distributes its products within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the American, Indonesia, and China.

name: CYND CO LTD
businessSummary: CYND Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and provision of a cloud-based reservation management system for hairdressing and beauty stores. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of BeautyMerit, which is a cloud-based reservation management system that supports the connection between stores and customers. The system provides services that support the construction of optimal customer experience (CX) and digital transformation (DX) such as attracting customers, reservations, treatments, accounting and after-sales follow-up services.

name: CYBOZU INC
businessSummary: Cybozu, Inc. is a Japan-based information technology (IT) company. The Company's main businesses consist of the development and licensing of group software, the provision of software as a service (SaaS) cloud group software and net services, as well as high value-added system integration (SI) services. The Company operates the development and sales of software products centered on group software.

name: CYFUSE BIOMEDICAL KK
businessSummary: Cyfuse Biomedical KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of cell products. The Company is engaged in the development of pipelines for obtaining approval for regenerative medicine products and contract research cell products in the field of regenerative medicine. The Company is engaged in the development of cell products as tools for drug discovery support for pharmaceutical companies in the drug discovery support field. The Company is engaged in the development and sell of three-dimensional cell stacking system equipment equipped with basic technology, apply technology for cell product development, and develop new technology in the device field.

name: CYBER SECURITY CLOUD INC
businessSummary: Cyber Security Cloud , Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Web security business. The Company is engaged in the development and subscription of Web security services utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) technology. It is also engaged in the research of cyber attacks, and research and development of AI technology. Products include the cloud-based Web application firewall (WAF) Cyneural, AWS WAF's rule automatic operation service WafCharm, and AWS WAF's Managed Rules. Cyneural is a cloud-based security service that detects, blocks, and visualizes cyber attacks on Web applications. WafCharm is a service that attacks patterns and automatically operates AWS WAF rules. AWS WAF Managed Rules is a selected AWS WAF security rules set that are created independently by a security specialist.

name: CYBERBUZZ INC
businessSummary: CyberBuzz, Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the advertising and marketing business through social media such as blogs, Twitter, Facebook and Instagram. The NINARY service and Ripre service is involved in the advertising and marketing business by influencers who have a certain number of readers and followers in social media. The Pochicome service operates a monitor Website that anyone can use if they use social media. The to buy service operates an online media where influencers introduce their personal items and services as original articles. The SNS Account Management service supports the operation of social media accounts that are officially operated by client companies. In addition to sales of services operated by the Company, the Internet advertising agency sales service also sells advertising products centered on social media-related advertisements such as YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and LINE.

name: CYBERDYNE INC
businessSummary: Cyberdyne Inc is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and maintenance management related to Cybernics technology. The Company mainly uses human and the Internet of Things (IoH/IoT), robots, and artificial intelligence (AI) Cybernics technology to develop Cybernic systems. It develops the Cybernics treatment service business and the training service business that utilize Cybernics technology. The Company develops in various fields centered on HAL. HAL is a robot treatment device for the purpose of improving and regenerating the physical function of patients, a welfare device and life support device for the purpose of supporting independence, and a work support equipment. It can be used for various purposes by being worn and used by people. The Company is also involved in the productization of AI-equipped transport robots; cleaning robots; Cyin, which is used for communication with people with disabilities, and electrocardiography devices.

name: CYBERSOLUTIONS INC
businessSummary: CyberSolutions Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the development and sales of cloud-based email and email security services for corporate clients. The Company operates the digital communication and cybersecurity business segment. The security solutions business plans and sells products and services related to security and risk management, including email sanitization, threat protection and information leakage prevention. The email security products and services include Cloud Mail SECURITYSUITE, MailGates, CyberMail-ST, Cybermail-CDR and Enterprise Audit, a messaging archive solution. The communication solutions business plans and sells products and services related to business communication including email, business chat and groupware. The Company’s products and services include CyberMail, CYBERMAIL, CYBERCHAT, EMERGENCYMAIL, SecureDrive (cloud storage service), SecureBoard (cloud groupware service) and SecureCommunicationONE (integrated collaboration service).

name: CYBERAGENT INC
businessSummary: CyberAgent Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the media business, Internet advertising business, game business, investment development business and others. The Company operates in five business segments. The Media segment is engaged in the operation of ABEMA, a new television (TV) of the future, WINTICKET, an Internet voting service that allows users to watch live footage of bicycle and auto races and place bets online, the blog service Ameba, and tapple, a love-matching application that connects people through hobbies. The Internet Advertising segment is engaged in the advertising business, artificial intelligence (AI) business and others. The Game segment is engaged in the games business for smartphones. The Investment Development segment is engaged in the venture capital business. The Other segment is engaged in the crowdfunding management business.

name: SCIENCE ARTS INC
businessSummary: Science Arts Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of Buddycom, a live communication platform that connects deskless workers. The Company operates through two segments. The Buddycom segment is engaged in the development and sale of Buddycom, a live communication platform that connects deskless workers, and sale of accessories such as earphone microphones and headsets. The ALTIBASE segment is engaged in the sale of licenses and supply of support for ALTIBASE, a hybrid database.

name: PENTA-OCEAN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
businessSummary: Penta-Ocean Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and development business, equipment leasing business and shipbuilding business, as well as the sale of construction materials. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Civil Engineering segment conducts civil engineering works in the domestic markets. The Domestic Construction segment conducts construction works in the domestic markets. The Overseas Construction segment is involved in the provision of construction works in overseas markets. The Others segment engages in the independent development, sales and rental of real estate.

name: GODO STEEL LTD
businessSummary: Godo Steel Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business and agricultural materials business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Steel Business segment manufactures and sells wire rods, various large and medium-sized steel sections, rails, structural steel bars, reinforcing steel bars, processed steel bar products, processed wire rod products, threaded reinforcing bars, and sells machinery and steelmaking raw materials. The Agricultural Materials Business segment manufactures and sells organic fertilizers and chemical fertilizers. The Company is also engaged in crushed stone and crushed sand business.

name: GOLDCREST CO LTD
businessSummary: GOLDCREST Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in residential property sales business mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area. The Company operates in three business segments. The Property Sales segment is engaged in sales business of new condominiums, including the planning, development and sales of new condominiums such as Crest City, Crest Form series. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in rental and leasing business, including office buildings, apartments and others. The Others includes property management business such as integrated management services for condominiums, and the other ancillary businesses such as real estate agency and brokerage, loan and advertising services. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had seven subsidiaries.

name: GOLDWIN INC
businessSummary: GOLDWIN INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of sports goods based on fiber products. The Company is involved in the provision of climbing wears, marine wears, outdoor gears and other outdoor related products, training wears, tennis wears, fitness wears, swim wears, rugby wears, golf wears and other athletic related products, ski wears, snowboard wears and other winter related products, as well as functional underwear, dust proof wears and other products. The Company is also involved in the golf courses operation business, the travel agency business, the insurance agency business and the real estate related business.

name: CONCORDIA FINANCIAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Yokohama Financial Group Inc, formerly Concordia Financial Group Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking business. The Company operates through the Banking segment. The Company is engaged in banking, securities, leasing, information services and research, venture capital, credit guarantee, credit card, securities investment trust management, investment consulting, investment banking, parts delivery, office agency, business administration, and other related businesses. The Company mainly operates in Yokohama and East Japan.

name: COLOPL INC
businessSummary: COLOPL, Inc. is mainly engaged in the mobile service business. The domestic mobile game service distributes mobile game applications for the domestic market. The current mainstream is local applications for smartphones such as White Cat Project, Quiz RPG Wizard and Black Cat Wiz and White Cat Tennis. The Overseas mobile game service distributes mobile game applications to overseas. Distribution area is mainly in English-speaking countries and East Asia. There are two types of distribution methods: the Company's direct distribution method, and the partner distribution method with overseas local distribution partners. The Virtual reality (VR) services provide services for VR devices. For other services, the Company provides location information analysis consulting services for business companies such as local governments and railway companies nationwide. In addition, the Company provides a smartphone-specific research service Smart Answer.

name: COLUMBIA WORKS INC
businessSummary: Columbia Works Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of real estate development services and related business activities such as real estate leasing and management services, hotel management services, and asset management services. The Real Estate Development Business segment mainly includes residences (rental condominiums), offices, and hotels, and develops residences under the Blance and LUMIEC brand names and offices under the BIASTA brand name. Real estate leasing and management services mainly involve leasing and managing commercial facilities, offices, and residences. Hotel management services provide hotel management services through the creation of art hotels and other spaces. Asset management services provide asset formation, asset management, and asset preservation services on behalf of investors.

name: KOMORI CORP
businessSummary: KOMORI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of printing equipment, as well as the provision of related materials, finance services and real estate management services. The Company operates in three regional segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of securities printing equipment and other printing equipment in Japan, Latin America and Asia, as well as the purchase and sale of small printing equipment, the provision of inks, paper, folding machines, electrical equipment and other equipment parts and printing materials. The North America segment is mainly engaged in the sale of printing equipment in the United States. The Europe segment is mainly engaged in the sale of printing equipment in Western Europe, Eastern Europe and the Middle East, as well as the manufacture and sale of paper printing equipment . The Company also operates in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia and India.

name: KOMERI CO LTD
businessSummary: KOMERI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the home center business. The Company is engaged in the sale of hardware, tools and construction materials, as well as the green products such as horticulture, plants and agricultural materials. The Company is engaged in the store operation of Power and Home Center, which sell life related products, and the operation of Hard & Green, which is engaged in the sale of hardware and horticulture products. The Company is also engaged in the product storage and delivery business, information processing and software development business, credit card and related business, insurance agency business, renovation work, cleaning, repair and maintenance work. It is also engaged in the delivery of fuel to group companies, the sale of liquefied petroleum gas, gasoline, kerosene and related equipment, the sale of books, and real estate leasing business.

name: COMSYS HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Comsys Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the telecommunications carrier, information technology (IT) solutions, and social systems-related business. The Company has eight business segments. The Nippon COMSYS Group segment is engaged in the construction of telecommunications facilities focusing on Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation (NTT) group. The SANWA COMSYS Engineering Group segment is engaged in the construction of telecommunications facilities focusing on new common carriers (NCCs). The TOSYS Group segment, TSUKEN Group segment, NDS Group segment, SYSKEN Group segment and Hokuriku Denwa Kouji Group segment are engaged in the telecommunications facility construction business in the Shinetsu, the Hokkaido, the Tokai and Hokuriku, the Kyushu and the Hokuriku areas. The COMSYS JOHO SYSTEM Group segment is engaged in the information processing business. The Company is also engaged in the staffing business and the shared service business.

name: KOMATSU LTD
businessSummary: Komatsu Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the research, development, sale, sales finance of products such as construction machinery. The Company operates in three business segments. Construction Machinery & Vehicle segment provides drilling machinery, loading machinery, land preparation and roadbed machinery, transport machinery, forestry machinery, underground construction machinery, underground mining machinery, environmental recycling machinery, industrial vehicles, cast products and logistics services. Retail Finance segment is engaged in the sales finance business related to construction and mining equipment. Industrial Machinery & Others segment engages in the provision of forging machinery, sheet metal machinery, machine tools, defense-related equipment, temperature control equipment, and optical machinery.

name: COMMERCE ONE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Commerce One Holdings Inc. mainly operates e-commerce (EC) platform business that provides services supporting the operation of EC sites in the form of Software as a Service (SaaS) for small and medium-sized e-commerce sites operating in Japan. The Company operates the EC Platform business segment. The segment provides EC site interface construction and operation application service for EC business operators, systems for centrally managing the backyard of e-commerce site operators operating multiple stores, as well as management support tools based on EC site authentication service and data analysis.

name: COPRO-HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Copro-Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company that manages the group’s business and handles incidental and operates engineer staffing business through its subsidiaries. The construction engineer staffing and placement service specializes in staffing and placement services for construction and plant engineers. Dispatched industries and duties site supervision and computer-aided design (CAD) operators in architecture, civil engineering, facilities and plants. The mechanical and electrical/semiconductor engineer staffing and contracting service provides staffing and contracting services for mechanical and electrical/semiconductor engineers. Industries and tasks include the development and design departments of major manufacturing companies (transportation equipment, industrial machinery, home appliances and agricultural machinery). The IT engineering staffing service operates Bscareer IT and provides systems development and other services to client companies.

name: KONISHI CO LTD
businessSummary: Konishi Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of synthetic adhesives and sealants used mainly in the civil engineering construction field. The Company operates through three segments. The Bond segment manufactures and sells industrial adhesives, general household adhesives, construction adhesives, construction and civil engineering adhesives, repair materials, sealants, wall covering adhesives, wax and adhesive tapes. The Chemical Products segment sells industrial chemicals, synthetic resins, resin moldings, electronic component materials and thin film materials. The Construction Business segment carries out repair, renovation and reinforcement work in the infrastructure and stock markets. The Company is also engaged in the real estate rental business.

name: KONICA MINOLTA INC
businessSummary: Konica Minolta Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital workplace, professional print, healthcare, and industry businesses. The Company operates four business segments. The Digital Workplace segment develops, manufactures, and sells multi-functional peripherals and related consumables, and provides information technology services and solutions. The Professional Print segment develops, manufactures, and sells digital printing systems and related consumables for the commercial and industrial printing markets. The Healthcare segment develops, manufactures, and sells diagnostic imaging systems for medical use, digitizes and networks medical sites, provides diagnostic services and solutions, and offers genetic testing and drug discovery support services. The Industry segment develops, manufactures, and sells measuring instruments, industrial and professional lenses, industrial inkjet heads, functional films used in displays, network cameras, and video-related equipment.

name: KONAMI HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Konami Group Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment and sports businesses. The Company operates in four business segments. The Digital Entertainment segment is engaged in the production, manufacture and sale of mobile games, card games, home games and other digital contents. The Amusement segment is engaged in the production, manufacturing and sales of amusement machines. The Gaming and Systems segment is engaged in the production, manufacturing and sales of gaming machines and casino management systems, as well as the provision of related services. The Sports segment is engaged in the operation of fitness, swimming, gymnastics, dance, soccer, tennis, golf schools and other schools, as well as the sales of sports related products.

name: KOTOBUKI SPIRITS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kotobuki Spirits Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of confectionery. It operates through six business segments. The Sucrey segment offers shop brands such as The MAPLE MANIA, Tokyo Milk Cheese Factory, and Francais. The KCC segment offers shop brands such as LeTAO and Now on Cheese. The Kotobuki Seika/Tajima Kotobuki segment offers shop brands such as Okashi no Kotobukijo and KanoZA. The Sales Subsidiary segment offers shop brands such as KONDITOREI KOBE. The Kujukushima Group segment offers shop brands such as Akaifusen and Ivorish. The Other segment engages in non-life insurance agency business, health food sales, and confectionery sales.

name: KOZOSUSHI CO LTD
businessSummary: KOZO Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Kozosushi Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail business, food and beverage business and distribution business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Retail Business segment is divided into retail business and franchise (FC) business. The retail business sells takeaway sushi. The FC business enters into contracts with franchisees based on a franchise system, provides name recognition and credibility through the use of trademarks, and provides guidance on store construction, product manufacturing, product sales and receives royalty income. The Food and Beverage Business segment operates eat-in style restaurants and FC business. The Distribution Business segment is divided into delivery business and food wholesale business. The delivery business sells home delivery of in-house cooked products. The food wholesale business is engaged in wholesale of commercial food ingredients.

name: COSMOS PHARMACEUTICAL CORP
businessSummary: Cosmos Pharmaceutical Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail of pharmaceuticals and cosmetics. The Company’s products include pharmaceuticals such as over-the-counter medicines, energy drinks, oral care products, nursing care products, vitamins, health foods, diet foods, and prescriptions, cosmetics such as cosmetics, men's cosmetics, hair care products, and bath additives, miscellaneous goods such as baby products, detergents, insect repellents, air fresheners, bath and toilet supplies, cooking supplies, gardening supplies, car supplies, and clothing, general foods such as processed foods, daily necessities, seasonings, sweets, beverages, alcohol, and tobacco.

name: KOJIMA CO LTD
businessSummary: Kojima Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sales of home appliances and other products. The Company operates the Product Sales business segment of audio-visual products, home appliances, information and communication equipment products, and others. The Company also repairs and installs home appliances and electrical products. The audio-visual products include cameras, televisions, recorders and video cameras, audio products and others. The home appliances include refrigerators, washing machines, cooking appliances, seasonal appliances, hairdressing appliances and others. The information and communication equipment products include personal computers, computer peripherals, computer software products, mobile phones and others. Other products and services include games, watches, sporting goods, toys, pharmaceuticals and daily necessities, construction work including housing equipment and others.

name: KOSHIDAKA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Koshidaka Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the karaoke business, real estate management business and warm bath business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Karaoke segment is engaged in the management and operation of directly operated karaoke box stores under the Karaoke Manekineko and One Karaoke brands in Japan. Overseas, the Company operates directly managed karaoke box stores under the Manekineko brand in South Korea, and manufactures and sells karaoke peripheral equipment such as speakers mainly for the Group. The Warm Bath segment is engaged in the operation of directly managed hot bath facilities in Japan under the brands Maneki no Yu and Rumpu no Yu. The Real Estate Management segment is engaged in the ownership and operation management of real estate rental buildings in Gunma, Kanagawa, and Aichi prefectures.

name: COCONALA INC
businessSummary: Coconala Inc is a Japan-based company which operates a marketplace named Coconala for skills to buy and sell services based on individual knowledge, skills and experience. In Coconala, sellers list services that make use of their knowledge, skills, and experience. The Company can provides various services including design, illustration, Website production, video and music production, writing, support and agency for business marketing, as well as beauty, fashion, and career consultation. Other services include the operation and development of the lawyer consultation site Coconala Legal Counseling and the face-to-face service market Coconala Meets. The Coconala Legal Counseling is a matching site for in-house registered lawyers and users. The Coconala Meets is a marketplace where it is possible to provide skill services in real face-to-face after matching buyers and sellers on the Internet and adjusting the location and time.

name: KOKUYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Kokuyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of furniture and business supply distribution businesses in the work style field, and stationery and interior retail businesses in the lifestyle field. It operates through four business segments. The Furniture Business segment is engaged in space design and consultation, as well as the manufacture, purchase, sale, and installation of office furniture. The Business Supply Distribution business segment is engaged in the purchase, logistics, and sale of office supplies. The Stationery Business segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of stationery. The Interior Retail Business segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of interior and lifestyle goods. It also operates antenna shops.

name: INPEX CORP
businessSummary: Inpex Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in oil and natural gas (O&G) operations, primarily in the exploration, development, production, and marketing of oil and natural gas globally, as well as investments and loans to companies engaged in these activities. The Company operates through two segments. The Domestic O&G segment is involved in the Minaminagaoka gas field and the Naoetsu liquefied natural gas (LNG) terminal. The Overseas O&G segment is involved in the Ichthys Project, including Ichthys in Australia and surrounding exploration, as well as other projects in Australia (excluding Ichthys), Southeast Asia, Europe, Abu Dhabi. The Company also conducts the Net Zero5 field, transportation and marketing business, and civil engineering business.

name: KSK CO LTD
businessSummary: KSK CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the support of semiconductor design, embedded software development, software development, and network construction. The Company operates in three business segments. The System Core segment is engaged in the development and design of large-scale integration (LSI), the design of hardware systems, and the development of embedded software. The IT Solutions segment is engaged in the development of packaged software, the contract development of application software, the development of computer-aided design (CAD) systems and Website systems, data entry service, operator dispatch, as well as nursing-care and welfare service. The Network Service segment is engaged in the building, site adjustment, the operation and maintenance of communications and computer related systems, the operation and management of CAD systems, and support center business.

name: KOKUSAI ELECTRIC CORP
businessSummary: Kokusai Electric Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of business activities primarily in the manufacturing, sales, and maintenance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. The main products include batch film deposition equipment, treatment equipment for film quality improvement, units for measuring instruments and cleaning equipment and others. The Company is also engaged in the provision of after services for semiconductor manufacturing equipment such as sales of consumable parts and other components, new and used equipment, as well as relocation and modification of equipment.

name: COCA-COLA BOTTLERS JAPAN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the beverage business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Beverages segment is engaged in the purchasing, manufacture, sale, bottling, packaging, distribution and marketing of carbonated drinks such as coca and cola, coffee and tea beverages, and mineral water in Japan, as well as vending machine related business, real estate business, insurance agency, the procurement of raw materials and materials, the development and maintenance of information systems. The Healthcare and Skincare segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of green juice made from kale, health foods and cosmetics and related products, as well as investment business.

name: KORYOJYUHAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Koryojyuhan Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the real estate trading, rental, brokerage, management and other real estate related business in Ibaraki Prefecture and Tokyo Metropolis. The Company operates two business segments. Real Estate Distribution segment is involved in the sale of the Group’s real estate, trading and brokerage of real estate owned by others, as well as leasing brokerage of real estate owned by other companies. Real Estate Management conducts real estate rental business, real estate management business, as well as solar power generation power sale business. The Company is also engaged in business such as construction business, property insurance agency business, as well as coin parking lot management and operation business, among others.

name: JTEKT CORP
businessSummary: JTEKT Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to the automotive, industrial machinery and bearings, and machine tools businesses. It operates its business through three segments. The Automotive segment manufactures and sells products for the automotive industry, including steering and driveline components such as electric power steering, hydraulic power steering, and electronically controlled 4WD couplings. The Industrial Machinery & Bearings segment manufactures and sells bearings for industrial machinery such as roller bearings, ball bearings, and bearing units. The Machine Tools segment manufactures and sells machine tools such as grinding machines, machining centers, cutting machines, control devices, and industrial heat treatment furnaces.

name: KOBE BUSSAN CO LTD
