businessSummary: KOBE BUSSAN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of food ingredients for business use, as well as the franchise (FC) business, the restaurant business and the renewable energy business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Gyomu Super segment is engaged in the planning, development and procurement of products as the FC headquarters of Gyomu Super, as well as the production of food ingredients for business use. The Kobe Cook segment is engaged in the operation of directly managed stores and FC stores. The Cook Innoventure segment is engaged in the brand-powered business in sushi, izakaya, yakiniku, fast food and restaurant business categories, as well as the development of new stores and FC stores. The Eco-renewable Energy segment is engaged in the power generation business that uses renewable energy. The Company is also engaged in the facilities rental business, tourism business and galleon business.

name: KOBE STEEL LTD
businessSummary: Kobe Steel Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business. The Company has seven business segments. The Steel and Aluminum segment includes steel strips, steel sheets, aluminum rolled products, steel billets, and pig iron for castings. The Profile segment includes steel castings and forgings, aluminum alloys, and magnesium alloy castings and forgings. The Welding segment includes welding materials, welding robots, welding power sources, and various welding robot systems. The Machinery segment is engaged in energy and chemical-related equipment, nuclear power-related equipment, and tire and rubber machinery. The Engineering Segment is engaged in various types of plants and civil engineering works. The Construction Machinery segment is engaged in hydraulic excavators, mini excavators, wheel loaders, and crawler cranes. The Electric Power Segment is engaged in electric power supply. The Company also engages in high-pressure gas container manufacturing, superconducting.

name: KOZO KEIKAKU ENGINEERING HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Kozo Keikaku Engineering Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of engineering consulting and product services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Engineering Consulting segment provides structural design and structural analysis consulting, environmental assessment and disaster prevention consulting, system development in the housing and construction field, decision support consulting, and information and communications technology consulting. The Product Services segment provides manufacturing-related services, architecture and civil engineering-related services, information and communications-related services, and other cross-industry services.

name: KOHSOKU CORP
businessSummary: KOHSOKU CORPORATION is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of food packaging materials and industrial packing materials. Through its subsidiaries, the Company provides seals, labels, flyers, paper containers, tea packs, packing paper, candy boxes, containers, pallets, cage cars, iron fish boxes, plastic bags, cardboards, buffer materials, paper bags, office supplies and store equipment, among others.

name: KODENSHA CO LTD
businessSummary: Kodensha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the electrical facility construction business and product sales business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Electrical Facility Construction segment is engaged in the design, construction and contract of house wiring works, power transmission line construction, power generation and transformation construction, communication and air conditioning works. The Product Sales segment is engaged in the sale of general electrical equipment, industrial electrical and electronic equipment, heating and cooling equipment, and sale of electronic devices for control and measurement, substation equipment, machine tools, information and communication devices, refrigeration and air conditioning devices, elevators, and monitoring and control devices.

name: MIZUHO LEASING CO LTD
businessSummary: Mizuho Leasing Company, Limited, formerly IBJ Leasing Company, Limited, is mainly engaged in lease, installment sales and various financial transactions for industrial machinery, transportation equipment, information-related equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Leasing and Installment segment is engaged in the installment sales business of leasing operations (including expiration of lease transactions and property sales due to halfway cancellation) and production facilities, construction earthmoving machines, commercial facilities etc. for industrial machine tools, transportation equipment, information related equipment. The Finance segment is involved in corporate finance, ship financing, factoring business and investment business of securities owned to earn profits for business purpose. The Others segment is engaged in used property buying and selling, solar power selling business.

name: KOKYO INC
businessSummary: Kokyo Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the laser business. The laser-related product sales business is engaged in sale of laser-related products to companies, universities, and research institutes, with overseas and domestic manufacturers, the development and sale of laser-related products in-house, and mainly outsources manufacturing and assembly to subcontractors to sell original laser products. The other laser-related business operates the information sites Optipedia and Optinews regarding light and lasers, as well as disseminate information.

name: SAN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: San Holdings Inc(Tokyo) is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the provision of funeral services. The Company operates in four business segments. The Public Utility Group segment is operated in the Kansai area and the Tokyo metropolitan area, provides customers with funeral services. The Funeru Group segment provides funeral services, including associated products and services in Tottori. The Tarui Group segment provides customers with funeral services, including associated products and services in Hyogo Prefecture. The Holding Company Group segment leases real estate such as funeral halls and leases offices and parking lots.

name: KOITO MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: KOITO MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive lighting equipment, aircraft parts, railway vehicles parts, electrical equipment and measuring equipment. The Company mainly operates in six segments, including Japan, China, Asia, North America, Europe and Others. The Company’s major products include light-emitting diode (LED) head lamps, discharge head lamps, headlights, sign lamps, high mount stop lamps, halogen bulbs, miniature bulbs and other lamp fittings, control equipment for rail vehicles, roads traffic signals, traffic control systems, roads and tunnels illumination lamps, facilities illumination lamps, accommodation equipment, aircraft parts, electronic parts, head lamps cleaners, sheets for aircraft and rail vehicles, as well as environment control equipment. The Company is also engaged in the development and manufacture of forward monitoring operation support systems for advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) through subsidiary.

name: CORE CONCEPT TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: Core Concept Technologies Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) services. The main business of the Company is to support the digital transformation of the manufacturing and construction industries by combining consulting capabilities and artificial intelligence (AI) technology. The company is also engaged in the supply of support for other industries, such as wholesale, retail, and information and communications, as well as digitization (adding new value through digital technology) support, customized Salesforce implementation support, and IT engineer procurement support.

name: KOYOU RENTIA CO LTD
businessSummary: KOYOU RENTIA Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the rental business, space design business and product sales business. The Company has three business segments. The Rental Related segment is engaged in the rental of furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E) and office automation (OA) equipment for construction site offices, events and corporations, as well as the provision of solar power generation systems rental services, information and communication technology ( ICT) environmental maintenance work and interior work, office relocation services and real estate brokerage services, and the storage, maintenance, delivery and sale of rental products. The Space Design segment is engaged in the rental of furniture for condominium galleries, the design and construction of condominium galleries, the interior modification work and condominium renovation work. The Product Sales segment is engaged in the sale of office furniture and equipment to government agencies.

name: CHORDIA THERAPEUTICS INC
businessSummary: Chordia Therapeutics Inc is a Japan-based drug discovery venture company mainly engaged in the research and development of novel anticancer drugs for commercialization. The Company's main business is the research and development of small molecule breakthrough drugs (first-in-class) with novel actions in the field of oncology, where there is a high unmet medical need. The Company concentrates on management and research operations (exploratory, preclinical, and clinical research), particularly in the discovery, evaluation, optimization, and clinical testing of candidate compounds, and outsources basic research, active pharmaceutical ingredient and drug product manufacturing, distribution, and sales to its various external partners to advance its business.

name: COSEL CO LTD
businessSummary: Cosel Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of direct current stabilized power supplies. The Company conducts business through five segments. The Japan Production and Sales segment manufactures and sells unit power supplies, onboard power supplies, and noise filters, and manufactures component transformers used in power supplies. The North America Sales segment sells unit power supplies, onboard power supplies, and noise filters. The Europe Production and Sales segment sells unit power supplies, onboard power supplies, noise filters, and other products. The Asia Sales segment handles sales of unit power supplies, onboard power supplies, and noise filters. The China Production segment manufactures unit power supplies and exports these products manufactured in China to each sales business company.

name: KOSE CORP
businessSummary: Kose Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics. The Company operates through two business segments. The Cosmetics Business segment's main products include products from brands such as Kose, SEKKISEI, ESPRIQUE, LECHERI, ONE BY KOSE, Cosme Decorte, Predia, INFINITY, JILLSTUART, ADDICTION, and tarte. The Cosmetary Business segment's main products include products from brands such as Visee, FASIO, MAKE KEEP, NAILHOLIC, softymo, SUNCUT, CLEAR TURN, and STEPHEN KNOLL NEW YORK. The Company also engages in the amenity products business and real estate rental business.

name: KOEI TECMO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Koei Tecmo Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment, amusement, and real estate businesses. The Company operates three business segments. The Entertainment Business segment mainly engaged in the development and sale of entertainment content. The Amusement Business segment engaged in the development of commercial amusement machines and the operation of game centers. The Real Estate Business segment mainly engaged in the operation and management of rental real estate. The Company also involves venture capital and securities management.

name: KOA SHOJI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: KOA SHOJI HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is engaged in purchasing and sales of drug substance, manufacturing, purchasing and sales of pharmaceuticals, including medical prescription drugs and general pharmaceutical products, as well as contract manufacturing of formulation of pharmaceuticals. The Company operates through two business segments. The pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales business is engaged in development, manufacturing, contract manufacturing and sales of generic injection, oral preparation and external preparation. The drug substance sales business is engaged in import and export of generic drug raw materials, as well as introducing and supply of pharmaceutical raw materials and preparations.

name: GENKI SUSHI CO LTD
businessSummary: Genki Global Dining Concepts Corp, formerly Genki Sushi Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in restaurant-related businesses. The Company operates through two segments. The domestic business operates sushi restaurants. The overseas business operates overseas franchises and sushi restaurants. The Company also purchases ingredients.

name: GAMECARD JOYCO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Gamecard Holdings Inc, formerly Gamecard Joyco Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business of pachinko prepaid card systems. There are two main types of prepaid card systems. The first is the third-party-issued type, where a third-party card issuing company handles the settlement between the seller and the buyer, and the second is the self-issued type, which is used only by the issuer and its affiliates. The Company handles some self-issued systems, while third-party-issued systems are its main business. Its business's items can be broadly divided into four categories, including equipment, cards, system usage fees, as well as construction and maintenance.

name: CTI ENGINEERING CO LTD
businessSummary: CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of construction consulting services for public works such as rivers, dams, roads, the environment, and information. The Company operates in two business segments. The Domestic Construction Consulting segment is conducts comprehensive consulting business such as planning, survey, planning, design, orderer support, construction management, operation and maintenance of public works in Japan, and associated system development, maintenance management, general office work consignment and others. The Overseas Construction Consulting segment provides comprehensive consulting services for all construction projects such as excavation of projects overseas, the formulation, planning, investigation, design, construction management, operation and maintenance of master plans, and building-related businesses including structural design and equipment design.

name: KEL CORP
businessSummary: KEL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of connectors, racks, sockets and others. The connector business is involved in the manufacture and sale of connectors for electrical connection and disconnection between mounted printed circuit boards, devices, and between devices in electronic and electrical devices such as industrial devices and imaging devices. The socket business is involved in the manufacture and sale of integrated circuits (IC) sockets for IC into printed circuit boards. The rack business is involved in the manufacture and sale of racks that systematize storage of control boards and peripheral devices. The harness business is involved in the manufacture and sale of harnesses that connect connectors and cables.

name: KEIWA INC
businessSummary: KEIWA Incorporated is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of functional films and solutions that meet customer needs by adding Ultra Precision to the core technologies of sheeting, laminating and coating. The Company operates through two business segments. The Optical Sheets segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and process of light diffusion films for flat panel displays. The Functional Products segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and process of various products such as industrial packaging materials, industrial process paper, clean energy materials, building materials and agricultural materials.

name: KEIYO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Keiyo Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of financial services centering on banking business. The Company is engaged in the provision of financial products and services to customers in the region by focusing on deposit and lending operations, as well as domestic and foreign exchange operations, agency services such as Bank of Japan agency, securities investment operations, over-the-counter sales of government bonds and other public bonds, investment trusts, and insurance products, and trust agency services. Other services include fund management, mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and consulting, credit card services, credit guarantee services, and collateral valuation services.

name: CAVE INTERACTIVE CO LTD
businessSummary: Cave Interactive Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and operation of mobile online games, the provision of support and management services for Internet video distributors, and the multi-channel network business. The Interactive segment is engaged in the development and operation of games for mobiles and computers such as Do Don Pachi Dai Fukkatsu, Death Smiles, Mushihimesama, Akai Katana and others, as well as the provision of live distribution services.

name: KEIKYU CORP
businessSummary: Keikyu Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in transportation business. The Company has five business segments. Transportation segment is engaged in the management and operation of railway stations, bus business, as well as the taxi business. Real Estate segment leases and sells real estate. Leisure and Service segment is engaged in the operation of hotels, restaurants, leisure facilities, golf courses and others. Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of department stores and shopping centers, as well as the sale of goods. The Other segment is engaged in the construction and civil engineering work, transportation equipment repair, electrical work, building management, and driving school operations.

name: KEIHIN CO LTD
businessSummary: THE KEIHIN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of logistics business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Domestic Logistics segment is engaged in the warehousing storage business, warehouse cargo handling business, distribution and processing business, land transportation business, home delivery business and marine container transportation business, as well as the development of logistics system software, and the information processing business. The International Logistics segment is engaged in the international and air transportation business, customs clearance business, marine port operation business, and the ship agency business.

name: KEIHANSHIN BUILDING CO LTD
businessSummary: Keihanshin Building Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the rental of land and buildings, as well as the building management, construction contracting business. The Land and Building Leasing segment is involved in the rental of office buildings, data center buildings, Windsville, commercial buildings and other commercial buildings, as well as the maintenance and cleaning of buildings and machinery. The Company is also involved in the construction, equipment contracting and real estate brokerage business.

name: KEISEI ELECTRIC RAILWAY CO LTD
businessSummary: Keisei Electric Railway Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company that operates transportation, logistics, real estate, leisure service, construction and the other business segment. The Company operates in six segments. The Transportation segment operates railways, buses and taxes. The Distribution segment is involved in the store business, department store business, horticultural plant wholesale business, shopping centers business. The Real Estate segment sells, leases and manages properties. The Leisure Service segment operates theme parks, hotels, restaurants. The Construction segment is engaged in construction business. The Others segment is involved in the manufacture of automobile bodies, the maintenance of railway vehicles, as well as the operation of driving schools.

name: KEIO CORP
businessSummary: Keio Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation and distribution businesses. The Company operates in five segments. The Transportation segment mainly operates the passenger transportation, such as railway, bus and taxi, as well as the transportation and moving of cargo. The Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of department stores, stores business, the sales of books, shopping centers business, credit card business, the sales of household goods related products, the manufacture and sales of bread and desserts. The Real Estate segment rents and sells real estate. The Leisure Services segment offers services such as hotel, travel and advertising agency, sports and catering services, among others. The Others segment engages in building comprehensive management business, vehicle maintenance business, construction and civil engineering, information systems business, accounting agency and financial business, personnel agency services and other businesses.

name: KU HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: KU HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale and maintenance of automobiles. The Company operates through two business segments. The Domestic Car Sales segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of domestic and imported used cars. The Imported Car Dealer segment is engaged in the car’s sale and maintenance of Mercedes-Benz, BMW, MINI, Chrysler, GM, Volkswagen and Harley Davidson. The Company is also engaged in the provision of non-life insurance agency services.

name: KVK CORP
businessSummary: KVK CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, process, purchase and sale of water taps, water supply and drainage fittings and piping members. The Company operates through Japan, China, and Philippines three geography segments. Main products include bathroom faucets, kitchen faucets, wash faucets, water discharge pipes, resin caps, shower heads and hoses.

name: K'S HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: K'S Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the operation of electronics retail stores, providing home appliances, computers, computer peripheral equipment and mobile phones. The Company mainly provides electronic products, petroleum equipment, gas equipment, cooling and heating machines, watches, cameras, measuring equipment, medical equipment, communication equipment, education equipment, office equipment, computers and mobile phones, and others. The Company is also involved in the general freight vehicle transportation business and electrical construction business.

name: KG INTELLIGENCE CO LTD
businessSummary: KG Intelligence CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company in the provision of information service. The Company is mainly engaged in publishing of information magazines. Through its subsidiary, it is also engaged in operation of Internet information sites, design and development of software, as well as configuration, management and maintenance of networks.

name: KFC LTD
businessSummary: KFC, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale, design and install of the construction materials, as well as the import, design and install of impermeable sheets and waterproof sheets, among others. The Company has three segments. The Fastener segment is mainly engaged in the sale of construction materials which related to after construction anchor. The Civil Engineering Materials segment is mainly engaged in the sale of tunnel excavation materials. The Construction segment is mainly engaged in the tunnel interior and renovation works.

name: KH NEOCHEM CO LTD
businessSummary: KH Neochem Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of petrochemicals. The Company's business is divided into three business units. The basic chemical business’s main products include butyl alcohols, octyl alcohols and butyl acetates. The business is involved in the provision for the manufacture of paints, inks, commodity resins, plasticizers, detergents and others. The performance material business’s main products include isononanoic acids and octylic acids, among others. The business is involved in the provision of raw materials for surfactants, water-based paints, cosmetics, pesticides, as well as pharmaceutical products. The electronic material business’s main products include propylene glycol methyl ether-pure (PM-P) and propylene glycol methyl ether acetate-pure (PMA-P). The business is involved in the provision for semiconductors, display materials and optical materials, among others.

name: GUNMA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Gunma Bank Ltd is a Japan-based regional bank that operates in two business segments. The Banking Business segment is engaged in deposit and lending operations as well as securities investment, domestic and foreign exchange, over-the-counter sales of public bonds, investment trusts, and insurance products, and trust services, to provide financial products and services to local customers. The segment is also engaged in lending and other banking services. The Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of financial services, including leasing services, mainly to customers in the local community. The Company is also engaged in transportation of goods, maintenance of automated teller machines, securities, guarantees, management consulting, and fund formation and management.

name: GUNZE LTD
businessSummary: GUNZE LIMITED is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture, process and sale of functional materials and machineries, the sale of innerwear, leg wear, textile materials, textiles, real estate business and other related business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Functional Solution segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic-processed functional materials, medical materials and machinery. The Apparel segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of clothing and textile materials. The Life Create segment is engaged in the operation of commercial facilities, operates sports clubs, the sale of green trees, and generates solar power business.

name: GLORY LTD
businessSummary: Glory Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of currency processing equipment, and the provision of electronic payment services and face recognition solutions. The Company has four business segments. Financial Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to domestic financial institutions, original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and others. Distribution and Transportation Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to domestic supermarkets, department stores, security transport companies, railway companies, tobacco manufacturers, hospitals, local governments and companies. Amusement Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to domestic amusement halls. Overseas Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to overseas financial institutions, security transport companies, retail stores, casinos and OEMs. It also provides unmanned payment system solutions.

name: GROWTH X PARTNERS INC
businessSummary: Growth xPartners Inc, formerly Growth X Partners Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the enterprise digital transformation (DX) business. The enterprise DX business includes the DX promotion support business, the DX support product and service business, and the digital service co-creation business. The DX promotion support business provides comprehensive support, including consulting and application development and cloud utilization, to help customers realize business transformation. The DX support product and service business sells products and services to support customers in promoting DX and earns scalable revenues through license revenues. The digital service co-creation business co-creates digital services to expand customers' businesses and increase revenues. The customers are enterprise companies that are leading companies in various industries, such as healthcare, retail and distribution, mobility, communications, construction, manufacturing, and finance.

name: WELCIA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Welcia Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail business focusing on pharmaceuticals, preparations, cosmetics. The Company is engaged in the provision of the retail business based on a drug store. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale of pharmaceuticals, hygiene care products, baby products, health foods, preparations, cosmetics, household miscellaneous goods and foods.

name: GREEN MONSTER INC
businessSummary: Green Monster Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of investment learning support business. The Company is engaged in the development and operation of smartphone applications that allow hands-on learning about foreign exchange (FX), stock investment, and asset formation through game-like demo trading and simulations rather than classroom lectures. The main products include FX Navi, an FX demo trading application, Toushika, a money plan simulation application, and Kabu Tasu, a stock investment demo trading application. The Company is also engaged in the provision of financial planning services for corporations and individuals through subsidiary, including financial education, life planning proposals, home purchasing, and advice on inheritance planning.

name: BRIGHTPATH BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD
businessSummary: BrightPath Biotherapeutics Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of pharmaceutical products. The Company is a biopharmaceutical venture company focused on developing cancer immunotherapeutic. The Companies business model covers drug discovery research and early clinical development of cancer immunotherapy; conducting of early-phase clinical trials; and development, manufacturing, and launching of the drugs as commercial products in Japan and abroad. The Company also generates the revenues from license fees from the pharmaceutical companies.

name: GREENS CO LTD
businessSummary: GREENS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of hotel and restaurant, as well as the other related businesses. The Company operates through two businesses. Choice hotels business is involved in the operation of the brand hotel named Comfort which is a hotel specializing in accommodation to cities designated by government ordinances nationwide. Greens hotels business is involved in the development of the hotels tailored to local characteristics, from hotels with banquet halls and restaurants to accommodation-specific hotels. The Compnay is also involved in the rental business and real estate management business.

name: GREE INC
businessSummary: Gree Holdings Inc, formerly Gree Inc is a Japan-based company that manages the business operations of group companies. The Company operates five segments. The Game and Animation Business segment operates and develops various smartphone games on GREE, as well as WFS, Pokelabo, and GREE Entertainment. The Company also creates, develops, and produces IP. The Metaverse business segment develops and operates the smartphone metaverse REALITY and operates a VTuber office that manages and produces talents. The DX business segment provides DX support to client companies mainly in marketing fields. The Commerce Business segment develops the media business centered on the aumo excursion information media, as well as the software as a service (SaaS) business and the digital gift business. The Investment business segment invests mainly in the Internet and IT in Japan and overseas through fund investments and startup investments. The Others segment includes new development and other businesses.

name: GRANDES INC
businessSummary: GRANDES, Inc. is a real estate company mainly engaged in the construction and sales of residential properties. The Company operates through two business segments. The Real Estate Sales segment is engaged in the planning, development and sales of residential buildings and speculative houses. The Real Estate Rental Management segment is engaged in the management, maintenance and inspection of rental condominiums and tenant buildings.

name: GRANDY HOUSE CORP
businessSummary: Grandy House Corporation is a Japan-based real estate company. The Company operates in three segments. The Real Estate Sales segment is engaged in the purchase of land for sales, the authorization of development licenses, the management of residential land developing works, the design, construction and sale of housings, as well as the provision of maintenance services. The Construction Material Sales segment is engaged in the sale of construction materials and members with a focus on precut materials. The Real Estate Leasing segment is involved in the leasing of buildings and condominiums, as well as the parking business.

name: GRANTOMATO CO LTD
businessSummary: Grantomato Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the agri solution business. For store sales, the Company carries out a multi-store retail business of Grantomato stores that sell agricultural materials, agricultural equipment, agricultural materials such as pesticides, fertilizers and direct products, and FOODMART stores that sell groceries. There are two types of FOODMART stores: business supermarkets and FOODMART Grantomato. At FOODMART Grantomato, based on the purchasing network the Company builds a food mart system that is operated by focusing on pursuing originality, such as promoting sales of private brand products developed. For agricultural distribution, the Company cultivates rice, mandarin oranges, seed garlic, potatoes, tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplant seedlings, and flower seedlings through direct transactions with agricultural producers. For Fukushima Distribution Center (FDC) and Internet sales, the Company operates e-commerce business to provide products.

name: GRAPHICO INC
businessSummary: Graphico Inc is mainly engaged in the planning and sales of health foods, cosmetics, sundries, and pharmaceuticals. The product categories are categorized into healthcare centered on health foods, beauty care centered on cosmetics, household products, ethical drugs and over-the-counter drugs, and others. The main sales channels are drug stores, general merchandise stores (GMS), home centers, and variety stores, and the Company also conducts mail-orders. Overseas, the Company sells through distributors in each country. The Company a fabless company that outsources manufacturing and logistics, focusing on product planning, development, marketing, promotion, and sales.

name: GOODPATCH INC
businessSummary: Goodpatch Inc conducts business activities with the aim of making people's lives more convenient and easier through design. The Company operates in two business segments. The Design Partner provides experience design (UI / UX) design support, and UX designers and UI designers design projects for client companies (clients) who mainly want to advance the design development of digital products such as websites and smartphone applications. It carries out the design process while leading the way and support the realization of the UI / UX design that client companies really need. The Design Platform segment is engaged in the support of UI / UX design support provided by the design partner business from various aspects. It supports the process from the effective use of design to the release as a product from the viewpoint of software, in-house design personnel, and design business environment, and functions as a platform that supports the design partner business.

name: GOODSPEED CO LTD
businessSummary: Good Speed Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally involved in the sale of used cars and motorcycles, automobile sales, and related businesses. The Company provides used car sales, car purchasing, maintenance and body repair, insurance agency, rental car, and gas station services. The used car sales business operates MEGA specialty stores for used cars, domestic car specialty stores, and imported car specialty stores. The car acquisition business acquires cars through batch acquisition assessment sites operated by multiple companies. The maintenance and sheet metal business provides services such as the maintenance of sold cars and car inspections. Insurance agency business provides agency service of general insurance companies. The car rental business provides vehicle rental services.

name: GOODDAYS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: gooddays holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in information technology (IT) and real estate related business. The Company mainly operates in two segments. The IT segment provides IT solutions including system development and the segment includes three business categories: system engineer (SE) service business, contract business and sales business. The Living Tech segment involves in the renovation business of real estate and real estate agency business through the running of real estate mediation site. The Living Tech segment includes three business categories: real estate brokerage business, operation business and media business.

name: GOOD COM ASSET CO LTD
businessSummary: Good Com Asset Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, sales, and management of new investment condominiums under its own brand, the GENOVIA series. The Company operates through four business segments. The Wholesale segment sells new condominiums under its own brand to domestic and overseas corporations. The Retail Sales segment sells new condominiums under its own brand to domestic and overseas individual investors. The Real Estate Management segment manages rental properties and buildings for sold condominiums, as well as collecting rents and guaranteeing rent obligations before handing them over to customers. The Other segment provides investor relations (IR) and capital policy consulting for new listings and post-listings, sells real estate fractionalized products, Good Com Fund, and operates real estate fund business.

name: CROPS CORP
businessSummary: Crops Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in mobile communication business, store sublease business, stationery packaging and materials wholesale business. It operates through five business segments. Mobile Communications segment is engaged in the operation of au shop in Aichi, Mie, Gifu, Shizuoka, Tokyo, and Kanagawa, and the operation of UQ Mobile in Aichi and Mie. Store Sub-Lease segment is engaged in the provision of store opening and closing support services and store management service centered on restaurants. Stationery Packaging Materials Wholesale segment is engaged in the planning and wholesale of stationery and packaging materials for 100 yen shops, mail order stores, wholesale stores and others. Building Maintenance segment is engaged in the provision of cleaning, facility management and security services for commercial facilities and office buildings. Temporary Staffing segment is engaged in the general worker and specific worker dispatch, and business contracts.

name: KROSAKI HARIMA CORP
businessSummary: KROSAKI HARIMA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture of refractory materials. The Company operates through four business segments. Refractory segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of refractories used in various industrial kilns. Furnace segment is involved in the design, construction and repair of various kilns. Ceramics segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of various industrial fine ceramics, as well as sale of landscape materials. Real Estate segment is involved in the building and leasing of stores and warehouses on company land. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of lime for steelworks.

name: CREDIT SAISON CO LTD
businessSummary: Credit Saison Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the payment, leasing, finance, and real estate-related businesses. The Company operates through six business segments. The Payment Business segment is engaged in the credit card business, servicer (debt collection) business, and various peripheral businesses. The Leasing Business segment is engaged in the leasing business, mainly leasing office equipment. The Finance Business segment is engaged in the credit guarantee business and finance-related business. The Real Estate-related Business segment is engaged in the real estate business, real estate rental business, and servicer (debt collection) business. The Global Business segment is engaged in the lending business and investment business. The Entertainment Business segment is engaged in the amusement business, mainly operating amusement facilities.

name: CRESCO LTD
businessSummary: Cresco Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of information services for software and embedded software development. The Company is also engaged in the sale of related products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Software Development segment is engaged in the provision of application development, infrastructure system development and solution services. The Embedded Software Development segment is engaged in the development of embedded software in communication systems, car electronics and digital appliances field. The Company is also involved in the products sales business.

name: KURIYAMA HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: KURIYAMA HOLDINGS CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in sale and installation business of rubber and synthetic resin products. It operates through five business segments. Industrial Materials segment sells and installs rubber and resin products for construction and agricultural machineries, ships flooring and power plants. It is also engaged in design, development and manufacture of urea selective catalytic reduction (SCR) sensors. Sports and Construction Materials segment sells and installs construction materials such as rubber, plastic, braille tiles and metals. Other segment is engaged in the sale of sports apparel of brand MONTURA and dust control related products, the technical research and products development, and real estate management business. North America segment sells industrial hoses made of rubber, resin and metal. European segment manufactures and sells rubber lay flat hoses, industrial and firefighting hoses and nozzles in Europe and South America.

name: CLEANUP CORP
businessSummary: Cleanup Corporation is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machinery for housing, stores and offices use. The housing, store and office use equipment-related division is involved in the manufacture and sale of kitchen equipment, bathtubs and washbasins, as well as the supply of stainless raw materials and stainless steel materials. The others division is engaged in the ablation, coloring, processing and sale of stainless raw materials, the provision of transportation, cargo handling, physical distribution services, as well as nursing, manpower dispatching services.

name: CLIP CORP
businessSummary: CLIP Corporation is a company mainly engaged in the operation of education business, sports business and food business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Education segment is engaged in the operation of cram schools. The Sports segment is engaged in the operation of soccer schools. The Food segment is engaged in the home delivery of boxed lunches. The others businesses include the operation business of basket schools, the agriculture business, the sale of used golf club business and yakiniku restaurant business.

name: KURITA WATER INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Kurita Water Industries Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of water treatment-related products, technology and maintenance services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Water Treatment Chemical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of water treatment related chemicals and related equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance services. The Water Treatment Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of equipment and facilities related to water treatment, the provision of ultra-pure water, the provision of chemical cleaning and precision cleaning services, the purification of soil and groundwater, as well as the provision of maintenance services such as operation and maintenance of water treatment facilities.

name: CREEMA LTD
businessSummary: Creema Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of creator empowerment business. The Company is involved in the operation of customer to customer (CtoC) handmade marketplace Creema. The Company Provides four services. The marketplace service is involved in the online purchase and sale of original handmade works directly. The platform service provides a platform service that provides marketing support for store creators, companies and local public organizations. The event store service provides a handmade marketplace and develops craft events and editorial shops that directly connect creators and users in the real world. The crowdfunding service provides a purchase-type crowdfunding service Creema SPRINGS that specializes in supporting the creative activities of creators of the genre.

name: KURARAY CO LTD
businessSummary: Kuraray Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals. The Company operates through five business segments. The Vinyl Acetate segment provides functional resins and films such as poval, polyvinyl butyral (PVB), and EVAL. The Isoprene segment provides thermoplastic elastomer SEPTON, CLARITY, isoprene-related products, and GENESTA. The Functional Materials segment provides methacrylic resins, medical-related products, and carbon materials. The Textile segment provides synthetic fibers, artificial leather CLARINO, and non-woven fabrics. The Trading segment processes and sells synthetic fibers and artificial leather, and plans and sells other products. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sales of liquid crystal polymer film, rubber and resin processed products, design and construction of various plants, contracted production ancillary and logistics services, etc., warehousing and distribution and processing services, insurance, travel.

name: MEDIPAL HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Medipal Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the wholesale of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, and veterinary medicines. The Company operates in three segments. The Prescription Pharmaceuticals Wholesale Business segment engages in wholesale business targeting customers such as hospitals, clinics, and dispensing pharmacies. The Cosmetics, Daily Necessities, and General Pharmaceuticals Wholesale Business segment engages in wholesale business targeting customers such as drugstores, home improvement centers, convenience stores, and supermarkets. The Veterinary Medicines and Food Processing Raw Materials Wholesale Business segment engages in wholesale business targeting customers such as veterinary hospitals, livestock and fisheries producers, and processed food manufacturers. The Company also engages in preventive medicine, research and development of cutting-edge medical technology, non-life insurance agency services, and others.

name: BROADMEDIA CORP
businessSummary: Broadmedia Corporation is a multimedia distribution company. The Company operates in five business segments. The Content segment involves in the provision of cloud game services, distribution of video for multi-devices, content distribution for mobile, and operation of wide area correspondence high school. The Broadcasting segment involves in the production of fishing special programs, and the supply of programs for broadcast satellite (BS) broadcasting and communication satellite (CS) broadcasting and cable television station. The Studio segment involves in the subtitle production, program sales and movie distribution businesses. The Technology segment provides contents delivery network (CDN) services, digital cinema services and Internet service to hotel rooms. The Network Sales segment involves in the sale of Internet service provider (ISP) services and broadband lines, and the provision of cell phone services.

name: KURABO INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Kurabo Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in textile business, chemical products business, environmental mechatronics business, food and service business, and real estate business. It operates through five segments. The Textile segment manufactures and sells yarn, textiles, and textile products. The Chemical Products segment manufactures, processes, and sells soft urethane, functional resin products, residential building materials, nonwoven fabrics, and functional materials. The Environmental Mechatronics segment manufactures, sells, and maintains information system equipment, inspection and measurement systems, designs, manufactures, constructs, and sells various environment- and energy-related plants, operates biomass power generation, and manufactures and sells bio-related products. The Food and Service segment manufactures and sells freeze-dried foods and operates hotels and driving schools. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate.

name: KUMIAI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: KUMIAI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of agricultural chemicals and other chemical products. The Company operates in two business segments. Agricultural Chemicals & Agriculture-Related segment produces pesticides, such as insecticides, fungicides and herbicides, and sells them in Japan through the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations (JA ZEN-NOH). The Segment is also involved in the import and export of agricultural chemicals, the sale of greening materials, as well as the comprehensive maintenance of golf courses. Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells chlorotoluene and chloroxylene chemicals, fine chemicals, industrial chemicals, as well as polystyrene foam, among others. The Company is also involved in the rental business, power generation and selling business, construction business, printing business, logistics business, as well as information service business.

name: KUMAGAI GUMI CO LTD
businessSummary: Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the construction business and related business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Civil Works segment is engaged in the investigation, survey, planning, design, supervisor of construction works, and the provision of general engineering. The Construction segment is engaged in the investigation, survey, planning, design, supervisor of construction of apartment houses, offices and government buildings, factories, power stations. The Subsidiaries segment conducts construction business, the manufacture and sale of equipment for construction, and provision of construction technology products.

name: KUBOTA CORP
businessSummary: Kubota Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of agricultural machines, engines and construction machines. The Company operates in three business segments. Machinery segment manufactures and sells agricultural machines and agricultural products, such as tractors, tillers, combine harvesters, rice planters, lawn mowers. The Segment also provides construction machinery and engines for agricultural machinery, construction machinery, industrial machinery and generators. Water & Environment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pipe systems such as ductile iron pipes and synthetic pipes, industrial equipment such as reaction pipes, spiral steel pipes, air conditioning equipment, and various environmental plants, pumps, and other products related to the environment. Others segment mainly provides logistics and financial services, roofing materials and exterior wall materials.

name: KUSURINOMADOGUCHI INC
businessSummary: Kusurinomadoguchi Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and marketing of solutions primarily for pharmacies and healthcare. The media business operates EPARK Kusuri no Madoguchi, a search site and application for pharmacies such as dispensing pharmacies and drugstores, and EPARK Oyaku Techo, an electronic medication registry application. The Minnano Oyakubako business operates the Minnano Kyodo Shupply Service, which negotiates purchase prices of pharmaceuticals with pharmaceutical wholesalers on behalf of pharmacies and medical institutions, the e-Order System, which functions as an inventory management system and automatic ordering system for pharmaceuticals at pharmacies and medical institutions, and the Minnano Oyakubako application, which is a pharmaceuticals trading application. The core system business sells office processing systems and information systems required by medical institutions, pharmacies, and nursing care facilities.

name: KUDAN INC
businessSummary: Kudan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the artificial perception (AP) project. The AP is a technology advocated and developed by the company group. It is a series of software that mathematically processes the data acquired by the camera and three-dimensional (3D) sensor by a computer program, outputs the stereoscopic effect and kinesthetic sense in real time and performs storage and collation. The Company develops AP technology by reconstructing the existing technology called computer vision (a set of basic technologies for sensors and image processing centered on two-dimensional processing) and using it as a foundation.

name: KUNIMINE INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: KUNIMINE INDUSTRIES CO., LTD is a Japan-based company engaged in the raw mineral business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Bentonite segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of litter for civil engineering and construction, castings and pets, the purchase, sale and transportation of mud conditioning formulation and others. The Agriculture segment is engaged in the processing of agricultural chemicals, the manufacture, processing, sale and transportation of raw materials for agricultural base and processing products, agricultural materials, soil conditioners, and purified bentonite for pesticide applications. The Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells refined bentonite, environmental preservatives, and other products.

name: KUSURI NO AOKI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the neighborhood-type retail business of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, foods, and dispensing pharmacies. The Company operates drugstore business with an assortment of products that include daily necessities, with pharmaceuticals and cosmetics as core products. The Company provides five types of products. Health products include pharmaceuticals, health foods, and medical supplies. Beauty products include counseling cosmetics, face care products such as face wash, body care products, hair care products, and oral care products. Life products include baby-related products, nursing care products, sanitary products, detergents, household products, pet food, clothing products, and home appliances. Food products include processed foods, daily foods, fresh foods, seasonings, confectionery, beverages, liquor, and other foods. Pharmaceutical products include pharmaceuticals prescribed at pharmacies.

name: QOL HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Qol Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmacy business, business process outsourcing (BPO) business, and pharmaceutical business. It operates through three business segments. The Pharmacy Business segment manages insurance pharmacies and operates QOL Pharmacy. The BPO Business segment operates contract sales organization (CSO) business, contract research organization (CRO) business, temporary staffing business, and publishing-related businesses. The Pharmaceutical Business segment manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals.

name: QUICK CO LTD
businessSummary: Quick Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human resources service business and recruiting business. The Company operates through five business segments. Human Resources Service segment provides human resources introduction business, personnel dispatch, dispatch business contract, and operates nursery centers. Recruiting segment is engaged in the job advertising agency business and the provision of recruitment support tools, education and training service. Information Publishing segment publishes regional information magazines. IT and Internet-related segment plans and operates portal site for information on human resources and labor issues, other activities under the Japan's Human Resources Department brand, web promotion support, web and mobile applications and Artificial Intelligence solutions, and Information Technology (IT) engineer training and development. Overseas segment provides human resources introduction, dispatch and related service overseas.

name: GIFTEE INC
businessSummary: Giftee Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in e-gift platform business. It generates, distributes, and sells e-gifts that can be sent and used online via smartphones and other devices. The Company mainly offers four services. The giftee service allows individuals to send gifts via email or social networking services (SNS). The giftee for Business service provides e-gifts and distribution tools to corporations and other organizations. The eGift System service provides a software-as-a-service (SaaS) system that enables corporations to generate, distribute, sell, settle, and manage performance of e-gifts. The local currency service provides a solution that enables the circulation of currency and gift certificates that can only be used in specific regions, which were previously issued on paper or cards, via smartphones. The Company also provides the YouGotaGift.com Ltd. service, the Sow Experience service, and other services.

name: GIFT INC
businessSummary: GIFT Holdings Inc, formerly GIFT Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in food business. The Company operates directly managed stores mainly based on Yokohama family ramen, provides food materials and operation skills to producer stores. The directly managed store division consists of the domestic directly operated store business division and overseas directly managed business division. The produce business division concludes a basic transaction contract with the store owner who is going to start a new ramen shop and continuously purchases noodles, sauce, soup and ingredients from the store owner's produced store.

name: NEXT GENERATION TECHNOLOGY G
businessSummary: Next Generation Technology Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing support for the successive acquisition of manufacturing and manufacturing-related companies and the management of the acquiring companies. As a serial acquirer, the Company grows by conducting a series of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) of manufacturing companies at appropriate valuations. In acquiring companies, the Company receives referrals of potential acquirers primarily from corporate M&A advisors and financial institutions, for which it pays a fee. The Company provides various types of management support to the acquired companies, including the dispatch of executives, for which it receives a management support fee from each company.

name: GEECHS INC
businessSummary: geechs inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in information technology (IT) staffing business and games business. The Company operates through six segments. The IT Staffing segment is engaged in introducing IT freelances to companies in need. The IT Talents Development segment is engaged in school business for training IT engineers who are active in global. The Game segment collaborates and partner with game distributors to entrust the planning, development and operation of native application games for smartphones based on Unity. The Video segment entrust video and video production related to promotion on the Internet. The Internet segment operates Gridge, a specialized golf information site which can also deliver advertisements of golf equipment manufacturers and apparel companies. The Global Recruiting segment introducing foreign students studying in Japan and Japanese students studying abroad with companies in need of global talents.

name: KINDEN CORP
businessSummary: Kinden Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment construction business. Electrical work includes distribution work, general electrical work for buildings and factories, power transmission line work, and substation work. Information and communication work includes telecommunications work and instrumentation work. Environment-related work includes air conditioning pipe work. The Company is also engaged in water supply and drainage sanitary work, interior equipment work, civil engineering work, and other related businesses. It is also engaged in leasing and sales of vehicles, various non-life insurance agencies, maintenance and leasing of real estate, sales and engineering of information communication system equipment, wind power generation business, transportation of concrete utility poles, construction and maintenance management of firefighting equipment construction.

name: KING CO LTD
businessSummary: KING Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly involved in fiber products business. The Company has two business divisions. The Apparel division is involved in the wholesale of ladies apparels, fashion goods, apparel accessories, promotion materials, the planning, sale, logistics and clerical work agency businesses, as well as the sale of apparel store promotion items. The Textile segment is involved in the wholesale of textile products, through its subsidiary.

name: KINTETSU GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kintetsu Group Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in the provision of railway, bus and taxi services, the railway facilities maintenance business and other transportation related business, as well as the operation of tourist facilities. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sale, leasing and management of real estate. The Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of department stores, retail stores and station stores, as well as the food business. The Hotel and Leisure segment is engaged in the operation of hotels, movie theaters and aquariums, as well as the travel business. The Others segment is engaged in the general broadcasting business, the telecommunications business, the information processing business and the insurance agency business.

name: KIRIN HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kirin Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the integrated beverage business and the pharmaceutical business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Beer and Spirits segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of beer, low-malt beer, new genre products, wines and other liquor products in Japan. The Domestic Beverages segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of soft drinks in Japan. The Oceania Alcoholic Beverages segment manufactures and sells beer, Western-style liquors in Oceania and other regions. The Pharmaceuticals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. The Company is also engaged in the domestic wine business, North American beverage business, and the biochemical business.

name: KIYO LEARNING CO LTD
businessSummary: KIYO Learning Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the e-learning and education business. The Company provides cloud services that use information technology (IT) to streamline learning to individuals and companies. The Company is involved in the STUDYing business, which is an online qualification course for individuals, as well as the AirCourse business, which is an employee education cloud service for corporations. STUDYing is a concept-based online qualification course which provides about 26 courses for business person on smartphones, tablets, personal computers (PCs) and others. AirCourse is involved in the provision of employee education, the creating and delivering training courses, as well as the provision of centralized management of in-house education.

name: KYOKUTO BOEKI KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Kyokuto Boeki Kaisha, Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the trading business. The Basic Industry Related division provides machinery and equipment for steel, nonferrous metals, automobile, chemicals, shipbuilding and plant engineering industries, electrical machinery, oil drilling related equipment and resources development equipment. The Electronics and Control System Related division offers electronic components and equipment, software, instrumentation and control systems, image processors, ground support electronic equipment and navigation equipment, as well as automatic control devices for thermal power stations. The Industrial Materials division provides combined material manufacturing machinery, as well as machines for textile processing, meat processing, resin finishing, coating, measurement and analysis, among others. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had 11 subsidiaries and eight associated companies.

name: KYOKUTO SECURITIES CO LTD
businessSummary: KYOKUTO SECURITIES CO., LTD. is a financial company. The Company's main business consists of securities dealing and securities brokerage. It operates in four business segments along with its related companies. Financial Product Trade segment is engaged in the domestic financial instruments dealing. Real Estate segment is engaged in the operation of real estate business specializing in the rental of stores. The Investment segment is engaged in the investment business. Investment segment is engaged in the operation of investment business. Investigation and Research segment is engaged in the investigation and research of domestic and overseas economic and financial securities markets.

name: KYOKUTO KAIHATSU KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: KYOKUTO KAIHATSU KOGYO CO., LTD. is company engaged in the special-equipment vehicles business, environmental business and other businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Special-equipment Vehicles segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of dump trucks, tankers, tailgate lifters and garbage collectors, trailers, vans and wing body trucks, as well as the sale of pre-owned special-equipment vehicles. The Environmental segment is involved in the manufacture, sale, operation and administration of recycle facilities. The Real Estate Leasing and Others segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate, the operation of mega solar power plants and other businesses.

name: KYOWA KIRIN CO LTD
businessSummary: Kyowa Kirin Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical drugs. The Company operates in Pharmaceuticals business segment. The Company engages in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and import & export of prescription pharmaceuticals. The Company has drug discovery technologies in antibody therapeutics and hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy. Its development pipeline includes AMG531 for aplastic anemia untreated with immunosuppressive therapy, KHK4083/AMG 451 for moderate to severe atopic dermatitis, KHK4083/AMG 451 for moderate to severe asthma, and KK2845 for acute myeloid leukemia and others. In addition, through its subsidiaries, the Company develops, manufactures, markets, and contracts out biosimilar pharmaceuticals, and engages in wholesale and retail sales and insurance agency business. The Company operates in Japan and overseas.

name: KYOWAKOGYOSYO CO LTD
businessSummary: KYOWAKOGYOSYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of bolts for construction machinery. The Company manufactures hexagon bolts, hexagon socket head bolts and special bolts, and sells products to the industries of construction machinery, automobile related and industrial machinery. It has four departments. The construction machinery division manufactures hexagon bolts, shoe bolts and nuts, hexagon socket head bolts, flathead bolts, special bolts, and swing machinery shafts. The automobile-related department manufactures forged products, including transmission input shafts, continuously variable transmission shafts, hollow parts, pinion shafts. The industrial machinery division manufactures JIS standard (JIS B 1180) hexagon bolts and JIS standard (JIS B 1176) hexagon socket head bolts. The other division manufactures special bolts for internal combustion engines of ships and generators, and for large scale buildings such as gymnasiums and stadiums.

name: EXEO GROUP INC
businessSummary: EXEO Group Inc, formerly Kyowa Exeo Corp, is mainly engaged in the engineering solution business and the system solution business. It consists of four business segments: Kyowa Exeo Group, C Cube Group, Seibu Denki Group and Nippon Dentsu Group. The segments are mainly engaged in the construction of equipment and urban infrastructure for communication carriers, network integration, and system integration, centering on their respective construction areas. The engineering solution business includes communication carriers that build and maintain communication infrastructure equipment, and urban infrastructure that builds and maintains various communication infrastructure equipment for local governments, government agencies, railway companies, private companies and others. The system solution business builds systems and provides system integration for various companies such as telecommunications carriers, finance and manufacturing. The Company also operates pipe work business.

name: KYORITSU MAINTENANCE CO LTD
businessSummary: Kyoritsu Maintenance Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the dormitory management business, hotel business and others. The Company operates in five segments. The Dormitory segment is engaged in the operation of student and company dormitories. The Hotel segment is engaged in the operation of business and resort hotels. The General Building Management segment is engaged in the provision of management services for office buildings and residential buildings. The Foods segment is engaged in the restaurant business, the food catering business and the hotel restaurant business. The Development segment is engaged in the provision of construction, planning, design and brokerage services for real estate, as well as the condominium business and other development related businesses. The Company is also engaged in the management of homes for the elders, the provision of supporting services for single people, the insurance agency business and other related businesses.

name: KYORITSU ELECTRIC CORPORATION
businessSummary: Kyoritsu Electric Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the intelligent factory automation (FA) system business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Intelligent FA System segment is engaged in the development, design, manufacture and sale of intelligent FA systems, equipment and other products for manufacturing research and development and production sites. The Information Technology (IT) Control and Scientific Measurement segment is engaged in the sale of FA equipment, IT equipment, control equipment, scientific analyzers, measuring instruments industrial equipment and others. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate properties, and other business.

name: KYOTO FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Kyoto Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management of banks and companies that can be designated as subsidiaries under the Banking Act, as well as related businesses. It is primarily engaged in banking, leasing, credit card, and financial instruments trading businesses, and other financial services. The banking business includes deposits, lending, trading of commodity securities, securities investment, domestic foreign exchange, foreign exchange, and trust services. It also operates an e-commerce mall, provides consulting services, economic surveys and research, financial instruments trading, investment services, business rehabilitation and debt management, credit guarantee services, and investment management services through its subsidiaries.

name: KYOCERA CORP
businessSummary: Kyocera Corp is mainly engaged in the provision of products in the semiconductor, information and telecommunications, industrial machinery, automotive, and environment and energy-related markets. It operates through three segments. The Core Components segment provides various fine ceramic components such as components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, automotive camera modules, and ceramic/organic packages that protect electronic components and integrated circuits. The Electronic Components segment provides various electronic components and devices such as capacitors, crystal components, connectors, and power semiconductors. The Solutions segment provides cutting tools, pneumatic and electric tools, office printers and Multifunction Peripherals, document management systems, commercial and industrial printers, and telecommunication terminals and telecommunication solution services for corporate customers. The Company also offers smart energy-related products and services.

name: KIYO BANK LTD
businessSummary: Kiyo Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to financial services, centering on the banking business. The Banking business is engaged in deposit, lending, domestic and foreign exchange, and other services. The Company is also engaged in office work agency services, job placement services, credit guarantee services, leasing services, venture capital services, investment services, credit card services, program creation and sales, and contracted computing services.

name: KYOEI SECURITY SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: Kyoei Security Service Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly providing security service. The Company’s Security Service segment includes service on facility and patrol security field as well as service on crowd control and traffic guard field. The facility and patrol security field includes services such as facility security service, reception/concierge service, parking lot security service and airport fire service. The crowd control and traffic guard field includes services like traffic guarding security service, event security service and highway security service. Other businesses include bodyguard service, parking lot management service, apartment management service, building and facility management service, among others.

name: KYOEI STEEL LTD
businessSummary: Kyoei Steel Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic steel business, overseas steel business and environmental recycling business. The Company has three business segments. The Domestic Steel segment manufactures and sells steel products mainly for domestic civil engineering and construction steel products. The products include deformed steel bars, flat steel and I-shaped steel. The Segment also trades and transports steel products. The Overseas Steel segment manufactures and sells steel products mainly for overseas civil engineering, construction and ore-crushing steel products. The products include deformed steel bars, threaded bars and wire rods. The Environmental Recycling segment operates intermediate and final treatment of medical and industrial waste and engages in the reclaimed stone business. The Company is also engaged in port business, foundry business, civil engineering material sales business and insurance agency business.

name: KYORIN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Kyorin Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, formerly Kyorin Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceuticals business. The Pharmaceuticals segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase, sales and testing of pharmaceutical products, the purchase of raw materials for pharmaceuticals, the evaluation of technologies, the inspection, analysis and negotiation of license affiliations, the operations related to clinical trials and information gathering such as searching for drug discovery seeds, as well as the drug candidate compound discovery research and compound evaluation business. The Company also conducts the diagnostic businesses and verifies and creates research targets that are directly linked to drug discovery.

name: KYUSHU RAILWAY CO
businessSummary: Kyushu Railway Company is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in transportation, construction, station buildings and real estate, distribution and food business, as well as other business around Kyushu in Japan. The Company operates in four business segments. The Transportation segment operates railway business, bus business, marine business and car rental business. The Construction segment operates construction business, vehicle mechanical equipment engineering business, and electrical construction business. The Real Estate and Hotel segment engages in leasing and sale of real estate, parking lot operation, senior business, hotel business and operation of complex tourism facilities. The Distribution and Food segment engages in retail industry, catering industry and agriculture industry.

name: KYUSHU LEASING SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: KYUSHU LEASING SERVICE CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the leasing and installment business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Leasing and Installment segment is engaged in the leasing and installment sale of machinery and equipment. The Financing segment is engaged in the leasing of cash and the purchase of debts. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of real estate, as well as the investment in anonymous associations. The Fee Business segment is engaged in the soliciting of life insurance, the agency for automobile leasing, the provision of real estate-related services, as well as the nonlife insurance agency business. The Others segment is engaged in the electric power sales business, as well as the goods sales business.

name: KYUSHU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly involved in the electric power business. It has four business segments. The Domestic Electric Power segment mainly consists of domestic power generation and retail business, as well as power transmission and distribution business in the Kyushu region.
