Other Energy Services segment includes power supply such as construction and maintenance of electric facilities, gas and liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales businesses, renewable energy businesses, and overseas businesses. The Information Technology Communication (ICT) Service segment mainly includes data communication business, optical broadband business, telecommunications construction and maintenance business, information system development business, and data center business. Others segment mainly includes real estate business and paid nursing home business.

name: CUBE SYSTEM INC
businessSummary: CUBE SYSTEM INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of system solutions and services. It has three kinds of services. The system integration services are engaged in the provision of system user interface design, environment design, basic design, programming design and system testing services for customer's information system construction. The system outsourcing services are engaged in the services’ provision for system operation and evaluation, mechanism reform and system replacement. The professional services are engaged in the provision of systematization consulting service, database efficiency service, system monitoring service and other technical services by development tools and technology levels.

name: INSTITUTE FOR Q-SHU PIONEERS OF SPACE IN
businessSummary: Institute for Q-shu Pioneers of Space Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of earth observation satellite data business and related businesses. The Company is engaged in the acquisition of earth observation data by optical satellites. Optical satellites use optical cameras and sensors to observe sunlight reflected from the earth. The Company is engaged in the development and manufacture of small synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites and provision of earth observation data and images acquired by small SAR satellites for earth observation in real time. Real time observation of the earth includes shooting at night or in bad weather and launching satellites to keep them flying overhead at all times. Observation data by small SAR satellites are sold to public organizations and corporations such as government agencies.

name: KEWPIE CORP
businessSummary: Kewpie Corp is engaged in manufacture and sale of food products. The Company operates in six business segments. The Retail Market segment manufactures and sells mayonnaise, dressings, pasta sauces, delicatessen foods, packaged salads, baby foods, nursing care foods and others in the retail market. The Food Service segment manufactures and sells mayonnaise, dressings, vinegar, liquid eggs, frozen eggs, dried eggs, egg processed food and others in food service market. The Overseas segment manufactures and sells mayonnaise, dressings in China, Southeast Asia, North America markets. The Fruit Solutions segment manufactures and sells jams for household use and processed fruit products for industry use. The Fine Chemicals segment manufactures and sells hyaluronic acid and egg yolk lecithin as an ingredient for pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and foods. The Common segment sells food and food manufacturing machines.

name: QLS HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: QLS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd is mainly engaged in childcare business, nursing care business and temporary staffing business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Childcare segment is engaged in the operation of childcare facilities, such as daycare centers. The Nursing Care segment is engaged in the operation of nursing care facility that provides home care support and home care. The Temporary Staffing segment is engaged in the provision of professional staffing service. The other business is engaged in the sale of communication equipment, such as mobile phones under contract.

name: CANON ELECTRONICS INC
businessSummary: CANON ELECTRONICS INC. is a japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of components and electronic information equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. Component segment’s main products are shutter units, aperture units and laser scanner units. Electronic Information Equipment segment’s main products are document scanners, handy terminals and laser printers. The Company also provides customer information management services, business card management services, system development, maintenance and operation services, as well as medical equipment such as blood pressure monitors, sterilizers and medicine packaging machines.

name: CANON INC
businessSummary: Canon Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business activities ranging from development and production to sales and service in the fields of printing, medical, imaging, and industrial. The Company consists of four business segments. The Printing Business Unit segment provides digital continuous ledger printers and digital cut sheet printers. The Medical Business Unit segment provides diagnostic ultrasound systems and X-ray systems. The Imaging Business Unit segment is engaged in the provision of interchangeable lens digital cameras, interchangeable lenses, and compact digital cameras. The Industrial Business Unit segment is engaged in the provision of semiconductor lithography equipment. The Company also provides handy terminals and document scanners.

name: KIMOTO CO LTD
businessSummary: KIMOTO CO., LTD. is a manufacturer of films. The Company has four segments, including Japan, North America, East Asia and Europe. Through its segments, it is involved in the development of processing technologies for surface treatment on films, the manufacture and sale of various industrial materials, the sale of geographic information system (GIS)-related software, the provision of outsourced data processing services, as well as the contracting business of aerial photograph processing and duplication of drawings.

name: KIMURA CHEMICAL PLANTS CO LTD
businessSummary: KIMURA CHEMICAL PLANTS Co., Ltd. is engaged in the engineering, chemical machinery, and energy and environment businesses. The Engineering segment designs, manufactures, processes and sells various evaporation devices, crystallization devices, cleansing devices, stirring equipment, pressure containers, as well as stainless, steel and resin piping works. The Chemical Machinery is engaged in the design of various plants, the management and contract construction works of machinery manufacturing, existing facility removal, installation, piping, painting, thermal insulation, test operation adjustment and maintenance. The Energy and Environment segment is involved in the design, manufacture, process and sale of atomic fuel transportation casks and storage containers, nuclear fuel concentration equipment and irradiation-related facilities, among others.

name: KIPS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kips Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in venture finance business and event media business. The Company operates in two business segments. In the Venture Finance business segment, the advisor business advises on capital policies of venture companies; the investment business provides investment and advice to venture capital firms. In the Event Media business segment, the event business is responsible for managing events related to support for venture companies in local governments and business companies; in the media business, the company produces articles and publishes advertisements for the monthly information magazine THE INDEPENDENTS published by the company.

name: KISSEI PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: KISSEI PHARMACEUTICAL CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. The Company is engaged in the collection and analysis of medicine development information, and the manufacture and sale of medicines. It is also engaged in the purchase and sale of related materials, system development and information process work, construction contract work such as new construction, expansion and renovation of factories, laboratories and offices, the management of facility and equipment work, information collection and development support work, noodle manufacture and sale, and insurance agency business.

name: KIDS SMILE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Kids Smile Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in early childhood education business. The Company is mainly engaged in the management of subsidiaries, the operation of an accredited daycare center and preschool integrated daycare centers (non-authorized daycare facilities), as well as childcare and early childhood education business for raising children. The Company is mainly engaged in the management of nursery schools and development of early childhood education programs in Tokyo, Kanagawa and Aichi prefectures. The Company provides childcare and education services through the operation of Kids Garden and Kids Smile, which are licensed nurseries, and the KIDS GARDEN PREP SCHOOL, an unlicensed preschool integrated nursery.

name: KIKKOMAN CORP
businessSummary: Kikkoman Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of soy sauces, seasonings, beverages, wines and other food products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Food Manufacturing and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of soy sauces and seasonings, processed tomato products under the brand name Del Monte, cans, vegetable and fruit juices, soy milk drinks, wines, sweet cooking rice wines, commercial food materials and others. The Domestic Other Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of drugs and chemical products, as well as the real estate, logistic and indirect business. The Overseas Food Manufacturing and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of soy sauces, processed tomato products under the brand name Del Monte, cans and health food products in oversea markets. The Overseas Food Wholesale segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of oriental food products.

name: KITANOTATSUJIN CORP
businessSummary: Kitanotatsujin Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the e-commerce business. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale of health foods and beauty-related products through Internet, and the operation of related businesses, such as the order receipt and shipment business, the production of mail order Websites, the plan and production of sales promotion tools, as well as the development of systems. The Company provides its products through mail order Websites http://www.kaitekikobo.jp/ and http://www.kaitekikobo.jp/sp/ operated by the Company.

name: KITANO CONSTRUCTION CORP
businessSummary: KITANO CONSTRUCTION CORP. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the plan, design, construction management and consulting for construction work. The Company operates through four business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the construction work and civil engineering work, incidental development business and solar power generation business, as well as the general management and security of buildings. The Golf Course segment is involved in the operation of Kawanakajima Country Club. The Hotel segment is involved in the hotel management of Solomon Kitano Mendana Hotel and Hotel Duparc Hanoi, as well as the hotel in Nagano City. The Advertising Agency segment is involved in the operation of advertising agencies.

name: KITAKEI CO LTD
businessSummary: KITAKEI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of new construction materials, housing materials, housing equipment and related construction services mainly to timber stores, construction materials stores, construction companies, and housing companies. Interior building materials mainly include flooring, wall materials, ceiling materials, indoor doors, construction materials, stairs, handrails, counters, wall storage. Equipment includes kitchen, bath, vanity, toilet, water heater, ventilator, air conditioner, fireplace, floor heating, lighting equipment, door phones. Chemical products and hardware-related products include heat insulating materials, humidity control materials, waterproofing materials, soundproofing and sound insulating materials, gypsum boards, nails, screws, construction hardware, adhesives and paints. Exterior building materials include exterior wall materials, roofing materials, gutters, eaves, fences, gates, carports, tiles.

name: KIKUKAWA ENTERPRISE INC
businessSummary: KIKUKAWA ENTERPRISE, INC. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of woodworking machineries and machine tools. The woodworking machineries include machines which can process logs into square timbers, plates and small split materials, and machines which can secondary process timbers, plates, small split materials, plywood and fiberboards into products. The machine tools refer to machines processing irons, non-ferrous metals and other new materials.

name: KIOXIA HOLDINGS CORPORATION
businessSummary: Kioxia Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, research and development, and other services of memory and related products. The business is classified into solid state drive (SSD) & storage, smart devices, and other by application based on the use of the products. SSD & storage includes SSD products and memory products mainly for personal computers (PCs), data centers, and enterprises. Smart devices include embedded memory products with control functions used in consumer devices such as smartphones, tablets, and televisions, as well as in-vehicle and industrial applications. Others include retail products such as SD memory cards and universal serial bus (USB) memory.

name: KEYENCE CORP
businessSummary: Keyence Corp is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of electronic applied equipment. The Company mainly manufactures and sells automatic controlling equipment, measuring instrument, information equipment and other electronic application equipment, as well as related systems. The Company also develops software for its products. Its products include sensors, meters, projectors, image processing devices, programmable logic controllers and touch panels, among others. In addition, the Company is also engaged in advertising and marketing businesses through its subsidiaries.

name: GUNGHO ONLINE ENTERTAINMENT INC
businessSummary: GungHo Online Entertainment Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of online games via the Internet. The Company is mainly engaged in the planning, development, operation and distribution of smartphone games. The main products in smartphone games are Puzzle & Dragons, Ragnarok M: Eternal Love, Puzzle Radar, Summons Board, Kerihime Sweets, Yokai Watch World, TEPPEN. The Company is also engaged in the planning, development, operation, distribution and sale of consumer game software for home-use game consoles and portable game consoles, the production of game software, as well as the sale of products to customers through wholesale trading companies, retail stores and content distributors.

name: WITH US CORP
businessSummary: With us Corporation is mainly engaged in the provision of educational services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Tutoring School segment is engaged in the operation of tutoring schools with a focus on group and individual tutoring for elementary, middle and high school students. The High School Career Support segment involves in the operation of wide communication system high schools, examination guidance for obtaining various qualifications, the provision of examination guidance services for passing the high school level certification exams, as well as management of Japanese language schools. The others business is involved in the provision of information and communication technology (ICT) education and capacity development business, language services, as well as development of internal training portal sites.

name: GALA INC
businessSummary: GALA INCORPORATED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and operation of applications for smartphones and tablet personal computers (PCs), and online games. The Company has two regional segments. The smartphone applications operation and development business is engaged in the sale agency of licenses for smartphone applications, tablet PC applications and online games, as well as the planning, development and operation of applications for smartphones and tablet PCs for general consumers. The online game publishing business is engaged in the development of massively multiplayer online role playing games (MMORPGs) for general consumers, the creation and operation of portal sites for online games, as well as the provision of developed online game licenses to publishers in various countries. The Company operates in the domestic market and Korea market.

name: GARDEN CO LTD
businessSummary: Garden Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the restaurant business. The Restaurant Business segment is involved in the operation of restaurants, including ramen, restaurant, steak, and sushi restaurants, as well as franchise and real estate businesses related to its brands. Brands include Ichikakuya, Darumanome, Ichiryu, Terracho, Yamashita Honki Udon, Jonetsu no Sutameshidon, and Kaitenzushi Premium Kaiou. It conducts business activities in Japan and overseas.

name: JAPAN POST INSURANCE CO LTD
businessSummary: JAPAN POST INSURANCE Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the insurance business. The life insurance business performs insurance underwriting and asset management. The Company operates other financial businesses related to other insurance companies. The Company also performs simplified life insurance management services commissioned by the management organization.

name: KANTO DENKA KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: KANTO DENKA KOGYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the fine chemicals business and basic chemicals business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Basic Chemical segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of basic chemicals such as inorganic and organic chemicals. The Fine Chemical segment is involved in the fine chemicals such as fluorine gas and battery materials. The Iron segment is involved in the sale of basic chemicals and fine chemical, as well as the maintenance of containers. The Equipment segment is involved in the equipment related work. The Company’s main products include silicon tetrafluoride (CF4), sulfur hexafluoride (SF6), lithium hexafluorophosphate (LiPF6), magnetite, liquid caustic soda, aluminum chloride and vinylidene chloride, among others.

name: KANDENKO CO LTD
businessSummary: Kandenko Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the facilities construction business, the electric equipment sales business, the real estate business, the leasing business and the power generation business. The Equipment Engineering segment is engaged in the business related to electricity, pipe work and other equipment. This segment is also engaged in construction security business, as well as design and calculation business. The Company is engaged in the real estate business and the power generation business, the electrical equipment sales business and the leasing business. The Company is also involved in lease business of land, buildings and vehicles. The Company is also involved in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of software for cable television operators.

name: KANSAI PAINT CO LTD
businessSummary: Kansai Paint Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of paints and related services. The Company is composed of five regional segments based on its production and sales system, with five reportable segments: Japan, India, Asia, Africa, and Europe. In Japan, the Company manufactures and sells products, and its affiliated companies manufacture some of the products, which the Company purchases and sells. In principle, the Company sells its products and purchases goods through designated authorized dealers and sales companies. The Company also purchases color matching products from some authorized dealers and sales companies. Overseas, its affiliated companies manufacture products and sell them mainly in the countries where they are located. Some of its affiliated companies are involved in paint-related businesses and provide group services.

name: KANSAI ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Kansai Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the comprehensive energy and power provision business, the information and communication business, and the real estate business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Energy segment is engaged in the provision of solutions such as electricity, gas, and utility services. The Power Transmission and Distribution segment is engaged in the safe and stable supply of electricity. The Information Technology & Telecommunications segment is engaged in the provision of comprehensive information and telecommunications services. The Living & Business Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of real estate-related services and lifestyle and business-related services.

name: CAWACHI LTD
businessSummary: Cawachi Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail business that operates drugstores selling pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, food, and alcoholic beverages, as well as drugstores with attached pharmacies whose main business is prescription dispensing. The Company’s products include pharmaceuticals such as cold medicines, gastrointestinal medicines, various vitamins, eye drops, external medicines, health foods, nursing care products, dispensing, cosmetics such as basic skincare, makeup, and men's cosmetics, hair care products, oral care products, detergents, paper products, pet supplies, and childcare products, general foods such as processed foods, daily necessities, confectionery, beverages, and alcohol.

name: KAWADA TECHNOLOGIES INC
businessSummary: KAWADA TECHNOLOGIES, INC. is a company engaged in the construction-related business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Steel Structure segment designs, manufactures and builds steel bridges and constructional steel frames. The Civil Engineering and Construction segment is involved in the design, manufacture and building of pre-stressed concrete (PC) bridges and pre-beam bridges, as well as the maintenance of bridges. The Construction segment is engaged in the design and subcontract of construction works. The Others segment is involved in the development, manufacture and sale of next-generation industrial robots, development and sale of software, the sale of system equipment, the architectural analysis, design and drawing of bridges, the sale of bridge accessories, the aircraft business, as well as the subcontract, planning, design, supervision and consulting of construction works.

name: KAWASAKI HEAVY INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd is general engineering manufacturer. The Company operates in six business segments. The Aerospace Systems segment manufactures and sells aircraft, aircraft engines, and space-related equipment. The Rolling Stock segment manufactures and sells rolling stock, snow removal equipment, and other products. The Energy Solution & Marine segment manufactures and sells energy-related equipment and systems, hydrogen-related equipment, marine propulsion-related equipment and systems, plant-related equipment and systems, ships, and crushers. The Precision Machinery & Robotics segment manufactures and sells hydraulic equipment, industrial robots, and other products. The Powersports & Engines Segment manufactures and sells motorcycles, off-road vehicles (SxS, ATV), personal watercraft (PWC) jet ski, general-purpose gasoline engines, and other products. The Others segment is engaged in commerce, sales and order brokerage, and management of welfare facilities.

name: KAWASAKI KISEN KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the marine transportation business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Dry Bulk segment is engaged in the dry bulk transportation business. The Energy Resource segment is engaged in liquefied natural gas carrier business, electric power business, oil tanker business, and offshore business. The Product Logistics segment is engaged in the car carrier business, the logistics business, the near sea and inland shipping business, and the container ship business. The Company is also engaged in the ship management business, the travel agency business, as well as the real estate leasing and management business.

name: KAWAGISHI BRIDGE WORKS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kawagishi Bridge Works Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture and construction of steel frames and other steel structures. The Company’s contracted steel works mainly include site construction, design, and cost estimation for construction work in East Japan. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture, sale and installation of precast concrete products for construction.

name: KAWAI MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: KAWAI MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS MANUFACTURING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of musical instruments, material processing and information-related business. It has two business segments. Musical Instrument Education segment is engaged in the sale of pianos, electronic musical instruments, musical instrument toys and wind, strings and percussion instruments, the operation of music and physical education classes, the provision of musical instrument tuning and repair service, and the publication and sale of music scores and books. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of software used in music education. Material Processing segment is engaged in metal materials processing for electronic and electrical parts, automotive parts, as well as the manufacture and sale of pig iron castings and materials of soundproof rooms and acoustic components. It is also engaged in information-related business, finance-related business, insurance agency business.

name: CALBEE INC
businessSummary: Calbee Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of potato-based, wheat-based, and corn-based snacks and cereal foods. The Food Manufacturing and Sales Business segment manufactures and sells snacks and cereal foods, procures raw materials, manufactures primary processed products, and procures and sells potatoes and sweet potatoes. The Company is also engaged in the logistics business. It conducts business activities in Japan and overseas.

name: KYB CORP
businessSummary: KYB Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic shock absorbers and hydraulic equipment, as well as the provision of services related to each business. The Company operates through three segments. The Automotive Components (AC) segment produces hydraulic equipment for automobiles, mainly hydraulic shock absorbers for automobiles and motorcycles, and power steering products. The Hydraulic Components (HC) segment produces industrial hydraulic equipment mainly for construction machinery, stage mechanisms, naval equipment, and vibration damping devices. The Aviation Equipment segment produces takeoff and landing gear, steering gear, and control equipment for aircraft. The Company also manufactures and sells concrete mixers, powder and granule transport vehicles, and special function vehicles.

name: KAMEI CORP
businessSummary: KAMEI CORPORATION is engaged in the energy business. Energy segment distributes gasoline, kerosene, light oil, heavy oil and liquefied petroleum gas. Food segment distributes beer and wine products, and operates supermarkets. Housing segment distributes housing appliances and equipment, and operates renovation business. Automobile segment distributes domestic and imported cars, and operates car leasing. Overseas and Trading business segment exports tires, bearings and tanker planes, and imports and sells seafood, apparel products, beer and wine. Pet segment sells pet food, pet supplies and gardening supplies. Pharmacy segment operates dispensaries, and distributes drugs. The Others segment provides information equipment and office supplies, property leasing, insurance agency service.

name: KAMIGUMI CO LTD
businessSummary: Kamigumi Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the logistics service business. The Company operates in two business divisions. The Domestic Logistics segment is engaged in the harbor transportation business, the warehouse business, the freight automobile transportation and other domestic transportation-related business. The Overseas Logistic segment is engaged in the international transportation business. The Company is also involved in the heavy construction machinery work business, the real estate leasing business, the sale and leasing of goods, the finance business, as well as the development, sale and maintenance of software, among others.

name: CAPCOM CO LTD
businessSummary: CAPCOM CO., LTD. mainly engages in digital contents business, amusement facility business and others. The Company operates in three segments. The Digital Contents segment develops and sells household games and online games, and contents for cell phones. The Amusement Facility segment operates stores that set up a game machine. The Amusement Equipment segment develops, manufactures and sells game machine which were sold for store operators. The Company also involves the character-related license busines.

name: COVER CORP
businessSummary: Cover Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the character intellectual property (IP) development of virtual entertainers VTuber who are active using motion capture technology and anime look avatars, and the management of hololive production. The Company operates through the VTuber business segment, which is divided into four business areas. The distribution/content business provides video content through the video distribution platform, and also provides music content through the music streaming service. The live/event business provides offline or online events such as live concerts, fan meetings, and domestic and overseas exhibitions. The merchandising business sells character goods and digital contents based on VTuber IP. The licensing/tie-up business provides the right to use proprietary IP to manufacturers of external products or contents, and provides promotion and media appearances of other companies by VTuber through tie-up advertisements.

name: KANEMITSU CORP
businessSummary: KANEMITSU CORPORATION is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of steel sheet pulleys for automobiles, agricultural machinery and general machinery. Steel sheet pulleys, the main product of the Company, are divided into four categories, consisting of single pulleys, double pulleys, poly-V pulleys and flat pulleys, according to the forms and cross-sectional surfaces of the belts used in the engines of automobiles. These are installed in water pumps, crankshafts, alternators, power steering, air compressors and tension regulators of the engines of automobiles. The pulleys are also used in agricultural and general machinery. Using the plastic forming technology from the development of pulleys, the Company also develops and manufactures other automobile parts for airbags and transmissions, as well as gear products, among others.

name: KANEMATSU CORP
businessSummary: Kanematsu Corp is a Japan-based trading company. The Company operates in five segments. The Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Solutions segment provides infrastructure design, construction, and operation services, system consulting and others. The Electronics and Devices segment provides electronic parts and materials, semiconductors and liquid crystal manufacturing equipment and others. The Food segment provides frozen, dried, and canned fruits, frozen vegetables, coffee, sesame seeds, chia seeds, nuts, peanuts and others. The Steel, Materials, and Plants segment provides various steel plates, steel bars and wire rods, steel pipes, stainless steel products, general steel materials and others. The Vehicle and Aerospace segment provides automotive parts and mechanical parts, aircraft and aircraft parts, helicopters and helicopter parts and others. The Company also provides medium-density fiberboards, non-ferrous metals, insurance agents and brokerage and others.

name: KANEKA CORP
businessSummary: Kaneka Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in four business segments. The Material Solutions Unit segment includes general purpose vinyl chloride resin, caustic soda, polyvinyl chloride special resin, modifier, epoxy masterbatches, biodegradable polymer and modified silicone polymer. Quality of Life Solutions Unit segment includes styrene-based foam resin and molded product, styrene-based foam extrusion board, polyolefin foam, solar circuit construction method, polyimide film, optical material, graphite sheet, solar cells, storage batteries for housing, and acrylic synthetic fiber. The Health Care Solutions Unit segment includes medical devices, low molecular weight pharmaceutical raw materials, Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) and biopharmaceuticals. The Nutrition Solutions Unit segment includes functional food ingredients, lactic acid bacteria, margarine, shortening, baker's yeast, spices, antifreeze ingredients, dairy products, functional fertilizers and feeds.

name: CANARE ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Canare Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cables, harnesses, connectors, equipment (passive and electronic) and supplementary equipment for broadcasting and communication applications. The Company operates through six geogrephical segments, including Japan, the United States, South Korea, China, Taiwan and Singapore. The Company’s main products include broadcasting cables and connectors such as optical transmission systems, cables, connectors, patch panels and others, AV & console solutions such as lecture desks, AV wagons, terminal boards, AV outlets and others, Digital network products such as network storage and AV-over-IP system, optical devices such as beam profilers and laser-related products.

name: KANAMOTO CO LTD
businessSummary: Kanamoto Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the construction related business. The Construction-related segment is engaged in rental and sale of construction related machinery and equipment, such as foundation machines, construction cranes, temporary houses, security supplies and others.

name: KANAMIC NETWORK CO LTD
businessSummary: Kanamic Network Co Ltd is a Japan-based Company engaged in the building of information sharing platforms and healthcare platforms in the medical, nursing, and health fields. The Company provides four kinds of services. The Kanamic Cloud Service provides cloud services, including information sharing platforms, nursing care management systems, and childcare support systems, to medical and nursing care workers include municipal government employees, doctors, nurses, care managers, and nursing care service providers. The Platform Service provide content services, such as Internet advertisement distribution that provide useful information to medical and nursing care workers. The Healthy Life Extension Service operates and franchises fitness gyms. The Other Services include customized development for major customers, project contracting for the government, consultation services for regional development projects, and other businesses related to Kanamik Cloud Services.

name: KADOKAWA CORP
businessSummary: Kadokawa Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the publishing and intellectual property (IP) creation business, and others. The Company operates through five business segments. The Publishing and IP Creation Business segment publishes and sells books, e-books, e-magazines, and magazines, sells online advertisements, and plans and sells other IP creation-related products. The Animation and Live-Action Video Business segment plans, produces, and distributes anime and live-action video, licenses video distribution rights, and sells video package software. The Game Business segment plans, develops, and sells game software and network games. The Web Services Business segment operates video community services, plans and manages various events, and distributes mobile content. The Education and EdTech Business segment plans and manages online education and vocational schools. The Company also plans and sells character goods, and others.

name: KATO WORKS CO LTD
businessSummary: KATO WORKS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction cranes, hydraulic excavators, and other products. The Company operates through Japan, China, and other region three geography segments. Products are cargo handling equipment, including all hydraulic truck cranes, rough terrain cranes, all terrain cranes, on-board truck cranes, crawler cranes; construction equipment, including hydraulic excavators, earth drills for foundation work, mini excavators, crawler carriers; industrial machinery, including vacuum suction road sweepers, universal suction trucks, snow sweepers; and forestry machines, including forwarders and tower yarders.

name: KATO SANGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: KATO SANGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food wholesale business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Room-Temperature Distribution segment is engaged in the wholesale of processed foods and confectionery. It also manufactures and processes some of the products for sale. The Liquor Distribution segment is engaged in the wholesale of liquor. The Low-Temperature Distribution segment is engaged in the wholesale of low-temperature foods. The Overseas segment is engaged in the wholesale of processed foods. The Company is also engaged in the provision of logistics business, insurance agency business, restaurant franchise business, and the management and operation of some overseas affiliates.

name: KATSURAGAWA ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: KATSURAGAWA ELECTRIC CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of large format digital equipment, large format copying machines and micro motors, among others, as well as the research and services related to its businesses. The Image Information Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of large format digital equipment, such as LED full-color printers, as well as micro motors.

name: KASUMIGASEKI CAPITAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Kasumigaseki Capital Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate consulting business, which mainly involves consulting and management related to real estate investment, as well as the development of profitable real estate. The Company operates through four businesses. The logistics business develops rental type refrigerated warehouses. The hotel business develops apartment hotels, which are medium-to long-term stay hotels for group stays of 4 to 8 people, with a focus on rooms for large groups, where there is a supply-demand gap. The healthcare-related facility business is currently focusing on the development of hospice housing among healthcare-related facilities. The Company's overseas business focuses on the United Arab Emirates (Dubai) and enters the real estate market.

name: KAJIMA CORP
businessSummary: Kajima Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the civil engineering business, the construction business and the real estate development business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Civil engineering segment is engaged in the civil engineering business. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction business. The Development segment is engaged in the general real estate development business, the design, structural design and other design business, as well as the general engineering business. The Domestic Affiliates segment is engaged in the sale of construction materials and equipment, the contract of specialized work, as well as the general leasing business and the building leasing business in Japan. The Overseas Affiliates segment is engaged in the construction business and the real estate development business in overseas regions such as North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania.

name: CASIO COMPUTER CO LTD
businessSummary: Casio Computer Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business of developing and producing consumer and system products through to sales and service. The Company operates through four business segments. The Watches and clocks segment is engaged in the provision of watches and clocks. The Consumer segment is engaged in the provision of electronic dictionaries, calculators, electronic stationery, electronic musical instruments. The Systems segment is engaged in the provision of handheld terminals, electronic cash registers, management support systems. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of molded parts and molds.

name: CASY CO LTD
businessSummary: CaSy Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the housekeeping service business. The Company operates a matching platform that provides cleaning services, cooking services, and other lifestyle services (house cleaning services and storage services) in the service areas of nine prefectures (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba, Osaka, Hyogo, Kyoto, Aichi, and Miyagi). The cleaning services provides services such as house and room cleaning and tidying. The cooking services include food preparation, kitchen cleanup, and food shopping. The other lifestyle services include house cleaning services (cleaning services by specialized companies for air conditioners, ventilation fans) and tidying and storage services (advice on tidying and storage, including consulting on decluttering). The Company also sells online gift certificates for housekeeping services.

name: KASAI KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Kasai Kogyo CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive interior parts. The Company operates through Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia four geography segments. The Company is engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of automotive interior parts, the manufacture, sales, and technical development of automotive resin interior parts, and the manufacture of automotive ceiling materials. The Company is also engaged in the provision of insurance agency services and business contracts.

name: KAGOME CO LTD
businessSummary: Kagome Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of foods at home and abroad. The Company operates through four business segments. The Processed Foods segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of beverages and seasonings. The main products are the Vegetable Life 100 series, tomato juice, tomato ketchup, tomato seasonings, sauces, and products for mail order and gifts. The International Business segment is engaged in the tomato seed development and agricultural production, as well as product development, processing, and sales. The Agriculture segment is engaged in the production and sale of fresh vegetables. Products include fresh tomatoes, baby leaves, and others. The Other segment is engaged in the real estate business and outsourcing business.

name: KAKEN PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Kaken Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical and real estate businesses. The Company has two business segments. The Pharmaceutical Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and agricultural chemicals. The Real Estate Business segment is primarily engaged in the rental of real estate related to Bunkyo Green Court.

name: KAKUYASU GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: HitoMile Co Ltd, formerly Kakuyasu Group Co Ltd, is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in formulating management strategies and providing support to each group company for the sustainable growth of the Company's group. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Time Delivery business segment provides free delivery service 365 days a year and free of charge on a one-hour time frame to individual restaurants, general consumers, and corporate customers from locations such as small shipping warehouses and Nandemo Sakeya Kakuyasu stores. The Route Delivery business segment makes daily deliveries from distribution centers to customers such as restaurant chains, hotels and restaurants. The In-Store Sales business segment provides in-store sales to customers who visit the various Nandemo Sakeya Kakuyasu stores. The Company also engages in e-commerce (EC) business, wholesale business to other alcoholic beverage distributors, and logistics.

name: KAGA ELECTRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: Kaga Electronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that mainly manufactures and sells electronic components. The Company operates through four business segments. The Electronic Components Business segment develops, manufactures and sells semiconductors, general electronic components, electronics manufacturing service (EMS) and others. The Information Equipment Business segment sells finished products including personal computers, personal computer (PC) peripherals, home appliances, photo and video related products, as well as original brand products. The Software Business segment produces computer graphic (CG) videos and plans and develops amusement-related products. The Other Business segment repairs and supports electronics equipment, manufactures and sells amusement equipment and sells sporting goods.

name: KAKAKU.COM INC
businessSummary: Kakaku.com Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of purchasing support Website Kakaku.com. The Company operates through two business segments. Internet Media segment is engaged in the operation of Websites that provide price comparison service, restaurant search and reservation service, real estate information, travel information, movie information, automobile information, bus information and inheritance procedure service. The segment also develops dynamic package system, movie contents and Website production. The Finance segment is involved in the insurance agency business.

name: KAO CORP
businessSummary: Kao Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of consumer products and chemical products. The Company operates in five business segments. The Hygiene & Living Care segment provides fabric care products, home care products, and sanitary products. The Health & Beauty Care segment provides skin care products, hair care products, and personal health products. The Life Care segment is mainly involved in the provision of commercial hygiene products, health drinks and other life care products. The Cosmetic segment produces counseling cosmetics and self-cosmetics. The above four business segments are included in the consumer products business. Chemical segment provides oil and fat products, such as oleochemical alcohols, oleochemical amines, fatty acids, and edible oils and fats for commercial use, functional material products, such as surfactants, additives for plastics, and high-performance water reducers for concrete, as well as specialty chemicals products.

name: CAULIS INC
businessSummary: Caulis Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the money laundering and cyber security business. The Money Laundering and Cyber Security Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of Fraud Alert, a cloud-based unauthorized access detection service for corporate clients. Fraud Alert consists of three services: Fraud Alert login detection service, Fraud Alert deposit and withdrawal detection service, and Fraud Alert new account opening detection service.

name: KAIRIKIYA CO LTD
businessSummary: Kairikiya Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food and beverage business. The Company is engaged in the operation of directly managed stores, independent stores and franchise chains (FC). Their main product is Seabura Shoyu Ramen, which is a soup based on soy sauce and chicken stock with pork back fat added to it. The Company operates a takeout specialty store whose main product is fried chicken and a ramen shop whose main product is tanmen.

name: CHIOME BIOSCIENCE INC
businessSummary: Chiome Bioscience Inc. is a company mainly engaged in the research and development of antibody drugs, and the provision of development support services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Drug Discovery segment is engaged in the research and development of specific antibodies based on new antigens and mechanisms and licensing to pharmaceutical companies. The Drug Discovery Support segment is engaged in development of lead antibodies for therapeutic drugs in collaborating with pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas.

name: CARLIT HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Carlit Co Ltd, formerly Carlit Holdings Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemicals, bottling, industrial materials, and engineering services business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Chemicals segment consists of six business fields: chemicals, chemical products, electronic materials, contract evaluation, ceramic materials, and silicon wafers. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial explosives, hazard assessment tests, sodium chlorate, pesticides, organic conductive materials, abrasives, and silicon wafers for semiconductors. The Bottling segment handles the bottling processing and sales of soft drinks. The Metal Processing segment manufactures and sells silicon wafers for semiconductors, various heat-resistant refractories, and springs. The Engineering Services segment sells and paints industrial paints, and designs and supervises water and sewage and wastewater treatment facilities.

name: CAR MATE MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: CAR MATE MFG. CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the car-related business and outdoor, leisure and sports-related businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Car related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of car accessories, child seats, transportation racks and tire chains, small chemicals for vehicles, and electronic and electrical equipment. The Outdoor, leisure and sports related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of snowboard sporting goods and sale of bicycle related products. Main brands include Inno, ailebebe, d’Action360, giga, dr.deo, drivemate, and flux.

name: CURVES HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Curves Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of Curves, a fitness facility for women. The Curves segment is mainly engaged in the fitness club business. The domestic curve business is engaged in the introduction of system necessary for management guidance and business operation for franchisees (FC), the provision and sale of technology, equipment, product and printed matter, as well as the performance of support operations such as opening stores for franchisees and sale operations for members. The Company is also engaged in the development of directly managed stores. The overseas curves business is engaged in the management of royalties and sale of equipment used at stores to master franchisees around the world, including Japan, as well as the provision of operation support services to franchise member stores.

name: ORO CO LTD
businessSummary: Oro Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions that strengthen companies both inside and out. The Company operates through two business segments. The Cloud Solutions Business segment develops and sells business systems provided by cloud services. It primarily develops and sells enterprise resource planning (ERP) packages ZAC and Reforma PSA. The Marketing Solutions Business segment provides various solutions that transform customer experiences with a digital focus, including digital strategy formulation and digital advertising management services.

name: ORGANO CORP
businessSummary: ORGANO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the water treatment engineering business and functional products business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Water Treatment Engineering segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, maintenance and management of filtration equipment, pure water system equipment and other water treatment related equipment. The Functional Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of standard water treatment equipment, water treatment chemicals and food additives. The Company is also engaged in the chemical plant construction business.

name: OLYMPUS CORP
businessSummary: Olympus Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of endoscopes, therapeutic equipment, scientific and other products. The Company operates through three business segments. The Endoscope segment provides gastrointestinal endoscopes, surgical endoscopes, and medical services. The Therapeutic Equipment segment provides gastrointestinal treatment instruments, urology products, respiratory products, energy devices, otolaryngology products and gynecology products. The Others segment provides biomaterials and orthopedic instruments. The Company is also engaged in the business activities, including holding companies and financial investments related to each business.

name: ORIX CORP
businessSummary: ORIX Corp is a Japan-based diversified financial services company. It has ten business segments. Corporate Sales and Maintenance Lease segment is engaged in finance and commission business, and leasing and rental of automobiles and others. Real Estate segment is engaged in development, lease, management, facility operation of real estate. Business Investment and Concession segment is engaged in corporate investment and concession. Environmental Energy segment is engaged in renewable energy, solar panel sales and others. Insurance segment is engaged in life insurance business. Banking and Credit segment is engaged in banking and consumer loan business. Transportation Equipment segment is engaged in aircraft investment and management, and ship-related investment and loan. ORIX USA segment is engaged in finance, investment and asset management. ORIX Europe segment is engaged in asset management of global stocks and bonds. Asia and Australia segment is engaged in financing and investment.

name: ORIGINAL ENGINEERING CONSULTANTS CO LTD
businessSummary: ORIGINAL ENGINEERING CONSULTANTS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based engineering consultancy company specialized in the fields of water supply, sewerage works, sanitation and solid waste treatment. The Construction Consultant business is engaged in the research, planning, designing and construction supervision of water and sewage facilities, as well as the design and seismic diagnosis of buildings and structures. The Information Processing business is engaged in the information management for urban facilities, the development of software, the outsourcing design of facilities, and the provision of support services for system management.

name: ORICON INC
businessSummary: Oricon Inc. is a holding company. The Communication segment designs and operates Websites, operates Website advertising business, and provides entertainment system news distribution services. The Mobile segment provides contents delivery services, music delivery services and others. The Magazine segment edits and publishes magazines, including entertainment, audition information and entertainment business magazines, and sells advertisings. The Data Service segment provides marketing data and ranking information about music software, video software and books, as well as music databases. The Others segment is involved in the social game business, as well as the operation of Oricon Monitor Research (OMR). As of March 31, 2014, the Company had eight consolidated subsidiaries.

name: ORIENT CORP
businessSummary: Orient Corporation is a Japan-based consumer credit company. The Company operates in consumer credit business through four business segments. The Personal Installment segment is engaged in the provision of installment services for personal consumption such as school expense and housing improvement loans through reimbursement and credit guarantee methods. The Card and Financing segment operates in company own card business, affiliated credit card business, cashing service business, loan card business and other businesses. The Bank Guarantee segment is engaged in the provision of joint and several guarantee services for consumer’s financing activities. In addition, the Company is also involved in the credit management and collection business, as well as consumer credit peripheral business. The Settlement and Guarantee segment performs rent settlement guarantee, accounts receivable settlement guarantee, retail lease guarantee and collection agency.

name: ORIENTAL LAND CO LTD
businessSummary: Oriental Land Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the operation of theme parks and hotels. The Company operates in two business segments. Theme Park segment is engaged in the management and operation of the theme parks. Hotel segment is engaged in the operation of hotels, such as Disney Ambassador Hotel, Tokyo DisneySea Hotel MiraCosta and Tokyo Disneyland Hotel. The Company also operates the IKSPIARI business, the monorail business, and the Group's employee cafeteria operation business.

name: OMRON CORP
businessSummary: Omron Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of electrical machinery and equipment, electronic application machinery and equipment, precision machinery and equipment, and medical machinery and equipment. It operates through five business segments. Industrial Automation Business (IAB) segment provides programmable controllers, motion control equipment, sensor equipment, industrial cameras and code readers, inspection equipment and others. Healthcare Business (HCB) segment provides electronic blood pressure monitors, nebulizers, low-frequency therapy devices, electrocardiographs and others. Social Systems Solutions & Services Business (SSB) segment engages in energy business, station service systems, traffic management systems and others. Device & Module Solutions Business (DMB) segment provides relays, switches, connectors and others. Data Solutions Business (DSB) segment engages in data healthcare business, corporate health business, and other businesses.

name: OPTORUN CO LTD
businessSummary: OPTORUN Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of optical thin film equipment. Optical thin film refers to the coating of various optical components such as smart phones and lenses, and has different functions depending on the material of the coating. The company sells equipment, responds to various customer needs, provides advice on film formation processes, and provides film deposition solutions that utilize optical thin film deposition technology know-how. Its main products include optical thin film forming equipment, general purpose optical thin film forming equipment, antifouling film forming equipment, reactive plasma film forming equipment, sputtering film forming equipment for optical film, as well as Wafer level optical sputter deposition system.

name: DIGITAL HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Digital Holdings Inc, formerly OPT Holding Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the Internet advertising business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Marketing segment provides Internet advertising for large companies, digital marketing, related services, and digital marketing solutions for local small and medium enterprises. The Synergy Investment segment is involved in the investment in Internet-related venture companies, the information collecting in the United States, the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and AI platforms, the provision of digital shift support education services for companies, and the general trade operated in China.

name: OPTIMUS GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: OPTIMUS GROUP COMPANY LIMITED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of used car businesses. The Company operates through trading, logistics, services and inspection businesses. The Trading segment is engaged in the purchase and sales of used cars. The Logistics segment is engaged in the provision of logistics services. The Services segment is engaged in the provision of services to the dealers in New Zealand and general customers. The Inspection segment is engaged in the inspection business related to the export of used cars.

name: OPTIM CORP
businessSummary: OPTiM CORPORATION provides management service and information technology support service. The Company provides cloud device management service, remote manage service, support service, as well as content management service and security management service. Its products include Optimal Biz, Optimal Biz for Mobile, Optimal Remote, Optimal Setup, Optimal Diagnosis & Repair, Optimal Guard, among others.

name: OBARA GROUP INC
businessSummary: Obara Group Incorporated is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of welders and polishers. The Company operates in two segments. The Welders segment is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of welding guns, electrodes and related devices to the automotive industry. The Polishers segment is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of polishing machines to the electronics industry. The Company mainly operates in Japan, Asia-Pacific and the Americas areas.

name: ONO PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Ono Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of prescription and over-the-counter drugs. The Company has been particularly focused on research and development of prescription drugs, positioning them as its core business. The Company’s products include injectables, oral medications, and patches.

name: ODAWARA AUTO-MACHINE MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: ODAWARA AUTO-MACHINE MFG.CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of bus fare collection equipment and the provision of maintenance services for its products. The Company's products and goods include bus fare collection equipment-related products, such as fare collection equipment with immediate calculating function and general function, and safes and software for fare collection equipment, card equipment-related products, such as magnetic card systems, noncontact integrated circuit(IC) card systems and software for card equipment, as well as other equipment for bus, such as numbered ticket issuing equipment, checkout devices, data management servers, liquid crystal display (LCD) fare displays and related software, among others. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of light-emitting diode (LED) fare displays, routing display systems, roll paper for numbered ticket issuing equipment.

name: ODAKYU ELECTRIC RAILWAY CO LTD
businessSummary: Odakyu Electric Railway Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in transportation, distribution, and real estate businesses. The Company operates three business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in railroad, bus, cab, route, and cableway operations. The Distribution segment is engaged in department store and store operations. The Real Estate segment is engaged in real estate sales, real estate leasing, and other businesses. The Company is also engaged in the hotel, restaurant, travel, golf course, railroad maintenance, building management and maintenance, advertising agency, accounting agency, insurance agency, planning, design, and operations, and temporary staffing services.

name: OKUMURA CORP
businessSummary: OKUMURA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general construction and related businesses such as civil engineering and construction. The Company operates through three business segments. The Civil Engineering segment and Construction segment are engaged in civil engineering, construction and other general construction work. The Real Estate segment is involved in the sale and leasing of real estate. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of construction materials and equipment, as well as the Private Finance Initiative (PFI) business.

name: OKINAWA ELECTRIC POWER CO INC
businessSummary: Okinawa Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electric power business, and construction and other businesses to supplement and support the electric power business or to make effective use of management resources. The Company operates through two business segments. The electric utility segment is engaged in the provision of service to customers in Okinawa Prefecture, combining power generated by the Company with power received from other sources. The electric utility segment is engaged in the provision of power generation, general transmission and distribution, and retail electricity services. The construction business segment is engaged in the provision of civil, building, electrical, plumbing, and telecommunications construction, as well as installation and maintenance of electric power facilities. The Company is also engaged in contract operation of electromechanical equipment and real estate business.

name: OKINAWA CELLULAR TELEPHONE CO
businessSummary: OKINAWA CELLULAR TELEPHONE COMPANY is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the telecommunications business. The Company is engaged in the provision of mobile services, domestic and international communication services, and Internet services. The Company also provides dedicated services, au mobile phone services, au mobile phone terminal sales, renting and maintenance of communication equipment, and outsourcing lines. The Company is also engaged in the production and sales of agricultural business, and tourism business.

name: OKI ELECTRIC INDUSTRY CO LTD
businessSummary: Oki Electric Industry Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of information systems. The Company operates in four business segments. The Information Communication segment is engaged in the provision of transportation infrastructure systems, disaster prevention related systems, defense related systems, communication equipment for communication carriers and other products. The Mechatronics segment is engaged in the provision of automatic teller machine (ATM), cash processing equipment, check-in equipment and other products. The Printer segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of color light emitting diode (LED) printers, monochrome LED printers, dot impact printers and other products. The Electronic Manufacturing Service (EMS) segment is engaged in the provision of design and production services and printed wiring boards. The Company is also engaged in the transportation and management of products and the provision of related services.

name: OKAYAMA PAPER INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Okayama Paper Industries CO., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of paper boards and decorative paper boards. The Company operates through two business segments. The Paper Boards segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of inner base paper used for manufacturing of cardboards, and base paper cores used for papers, clothes, cellophanes, tapes threads and others. The Decorative Paper Boards segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of packaging and gift boxes for fruits and vegetables, food, electrical appliances and others. The Company is also engaged in the sale of products.

name: OKAYA ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES CO LTD
businessSummary: OKAYA ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic products. Along with its subsidiaries, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of noise-related products, such as noise suppression, capacitors, noise filters and others; surge products, including surge absorbers and others; display-related products, such as light-emitting diodes (LEDs), liquid crystal display (LCDs), field sequential products and others; as well as sensor-related products. The Company mainly operates its business in domestic and overseas markets.

name: OKAMOTO MACHINE TOOL WORKS
businessSummary: Okamoto Machine Tool Works Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the machine tool business and the semiconductor-related equipment business. It operates through two business segments. The Machine Tool Business segment manufactures and sells grinding machines including surface grinders, form grinders, cylindrical grinders, internal grinders, gear grinders, dedicated and special grinders, and grinding processing peripheral equipment, precision gears, and castings. The Semiconductor-related Equipment Business segment mainly manufactures and sells back grinders, polishing machines, lapping machines, slicing machines, and ingot grinders.

name: OKAMOTO INDUSTRIES INC
businessSummary: OKAMOTO INDUSTRIES,INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial products and household goods. The Company operates through two business segments. The Industrial Products segment sells products mainly made of plastic resins to processing companies. The Daily Necessities segment mainly sells daily necessities and consumable goods to consumers. The Company is also involved in the group's logistics business and solar power generation business. The Company’s major products include plastic films, construction and industrial materials, medical and daily necessities, shoes, clothing and sports equipment and others.

name: OKAMURA CORP
businessSummary: Okamura Corp is a company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sale of office environmental equipment, commercial environmental equipment and logistics system equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Office Environmental segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of office furniture, communal facility furniture, security products and health care products. The Commercial Environmental segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of store shelves, freezer showcases, refrigerated showcases and store counters. The Logistics System segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of logistics equipment, such as storage racks for factories and warehouses, logistics automatic equipment and facilities. The Company also manufactures and sells fluid transmissions for industrial vehicles and construction machinery.

name: OKAMURA FOODS CO LTD
businessSummary: Okamura Foods Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the salmon aquaculture business, processing business (domestic and overseas processing), and overseas wholesale business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Aquaculture Business segment is engaged in the farming and sale of adult salmon in Aomori and Denmark. The Domestic Processing Business segment is engaged in the processing and sales of fish egg products such as sardines and salmon roe at domestic factories. The Overseas Processing Business segment is engaged in processing and sales of seafood such as salmon and mackerel at overseas factories. The Overseas Wholesale Business segment is engaged in the overseas wholesale of Japanese food products, including seafood.

name: OKABE CO LTD
businessSummary: OKABE CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction equipment and materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Construction-related Product segment manufactures and sells temporary and formwork construction products, civil engineering products and structural products, and purchases and sells construction materials. The Automobile-related Product segment is engaged in the planning and sale of automobile related products. The Others segment manufactures and sells marine materials and supplies, and manufactures and sells fishing products in the United States.

name: OHMORIYA CO LTD
businessSummary: OHMORIYA Co., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food production and sale business covering all food products mainly including seaweed, as well as the real estate leasing business. The Food Production and Sale segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial laver products such as home laver, advanced products and sprinkles, both in Japan and overseas. Main products include seasoned laver, grilled laver, sprinkle, ochazuke, soup, among others.

name: OHMOTO GUMI CO LTD
businessSummary: OHMOTO GUMI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in civil engineering and construction works. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the provision of construction work. The Civil Engineering segment is involved in the provision of civil engineering works. The others business includes the environmental improvement business, as well as the insurance agency business.

name: OBAYASHI CORP
businessSummary: Obayashi Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and real estate businesses. It has five business segments. The Domestic Construction segment is engaged in the acceptance and construction of construction work, interior construction, sales and rental of construction materials and equipment, and comprehensive building management. The Overseas Construction segment is engaged in the construction work in North America and Southeast Asia. The Domestic Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the acceptance and construction of civil engineering work. The Overseas Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the civil engineering work in North America and Southeast Asia. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the buying and selling and leasing of real estate, and development business. It is also engaged in the private finance initiative (PFI) business, renewable energy business, information and communication technology (ICT) related business and financial business.

name: OTSUKA HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Otsuka Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in medical, nutraceutical, consumer and other business activities in Japan and overseas. The Company operates in four business segments. The Medical Business segment produces and sells therapeutic drugs and infusions. The Nutraceutical segment produces and sells functional beverages, quasi-drugs and nutritional supplements. The Consumer Products segment produces and sells mineral water, beverages and food products. The Others segment manufactures paper containers, manufactures synthetic resin molded products, stores products, provides storage space, and produces and sells chemicals and liquid crystal evaluation equipment, spectroscopic analysis equipment, and other products.

name: OTSUKA CORP
businessSummary: OTSUKA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of system equipment, the installation support and maintenance services. The Company operates through two business segments. System Integration segment conducts consulting, hardware and software sales, contract software development, equipment installation and network construction. Service & Support segment provides office supply, maintenance services, as well as business support services. The Company is also involved in the car maintenance business and insurance business.

name: OSAKI ELECTRIC CO LTD
businessSummary: Osaki Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of measurement and control equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Measurement and Control Equipment segment manufactures and sells electric energy meter, current limiter, instrument transformer, distribution board, supervisory control device, time switch, optical communication related equipment and meter reading system. The Flat Panel Display (FPD)-related Equipment segment is engaged in the design, manufacture, and sale of FPD-related equipment. The Real Estate segment is involved in the real estate leasing business.

name: OSAKA STEEL CO LTD
businessSummary: Osaka Steel Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business. The Company group is comprehensively engaged in the production and sale of ordinary steel products, as well as their transportation. It is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products such as steel sections, bars, and flat steel, as well as steel billets and processed steel products, as well as the transportation and on-site work of steel products.

name: JAPAN EXCHANGE GROUP INC
businessSummary: Japan Exchange Group Inc is a Japan-based financial instruments exchange holding company that lists securities and derivatives, provides trading venues, clearing and settlement services, and index and information services. The Company operates through the Financial Instruments Exchange Business segment. The spot market is centered on the stock market. The derivatives market offers trading of index futures, index options, government bond futures, government bond futures options, securities options, and commodity futures. Trading systems include arrowhead for the spot market and J-GATE for the derivatives market. Information services provide real-time information on securities trading and derivatives transactions, such as contract prices, as they occur and change, as well as index information calculated based on stock price information and various statistical information, to market participants such as trading participants and information vendors.

name: OSAKA GAS CO LTD
businessSummary: Osaka Gas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic energy and gas, domestic energy and electric power, overseas energy and life and business solutions businesses. The Company consists of three business segments. The Domestic Energy Business segment is engaged in the production, supply, and sales of city gas, sales of gas appliances, gas piping installation, liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales, LNG transportation, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) sales, industrial gas sales, and power generation and electricity sales. The Overseas Energy Business segment is engaged in development, investment, and energy supply related to natural gas, etc. The Life & Business Solutions segment develops and leases real estate, provides information processing services, and sells fine materials and carbon materials products.

name: OKURA INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Okura Industrial Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the processing, manufacture and sale of polyethylene, polypropylene and optical functional film products, processed plywood, particle boards and processed boards, among others. The Company operates through three business segments. The Synthetic Resin segment is engaged in the processing and sale of synthetic resin products such as polyethylene films and polypropylene films.
