The New Materials segment provides optical films, urethane films, seamless belts, adhesives composite materials. The Building Materials segment provides decorative panels, particleboards and other housing materials. The Company is also engaged in the hotel business, wood processing business, residential land creation and building construction business, information processing system development business, property insurance agency business, cable TV broadcasting business and real estate rental business.

name: OJI HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Oji Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to the paper manufacturing industry. The Company operates in four business segments. The Lifestyle and Industrial Materials segment is engaged in the containerboard and corrugated packaging business, white paperboard and folding carton business, packaging paper and bag-making business, household paper business, and disposable diapers business. The Functional Materials segment is engaged in the specialty paper, thermal paper, adhesive, and film businesses. The Resources and Environmental Business segment is engaged in the pulp business, energy business, and afforestation and wood processing business. The Printed Information Media segment is engaged in the newsprint business and the printing, publishing, and information paper business. The Company also conducts trading, logistics, engineering, real estate, and liquid paper container businesses.

name: OILES CORP
businessSummary: OILES CORPORATION is primarily engaged in the bearing equipment business. It has four business segments. The Bearing Equipment segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of oilless bearings and others. The Structural Equipment segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of support, seismic isolation and vibration suppression equipment, among others. The Construction Equipment segment is involved in the development, manufacture, sale, construction and maintenance of window operators, environmental equipment, and household equipment, among others. The Others segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of conduction equipment and others.

name: OPEN DOOR INC
businessSummary: Open Door Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of travel related services. The Company is engaged in the operation of travel products comparison Website TRAVELKO which provides online search, comparison, reservation, inquiry services of package tours, hotels, airline tickets and other travel products for users. The Company is also engaged in the operation of the hotel reservation Website Hoterea for individual customers and the airline tickets reservation Website Traverea, as well as the sale of travel products for corporate customers.

name: OPEN HOUSE CO LTD
businessSummary: Open House Group Co Ltd, formerly Open House Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the real estate related business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Detached House-Related Business segment engages in brokerage (Open House), detached house sales (Open House Development), detached house subdivision (Hawk One), and construction contracting (Open House Architect). The Condominium Business segment develops and sells new condominiums. The Income-Producing Real Estate Business segment acquires, manages, and sells income-producing real estate in Japan. The Others segment is engaged in the U.S. real estate business, including sales, consulting, property management, and financial services related to U.S. real estate. The Pleasant Corporation segment plans, develops and sells mainly studio and family condominiums.

name: OBIC BUSINESS CONSULTANTS CO LTD
businessSummary: Obic Business Consultants Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in software business. The Company is mainly engaged in the development of business solution technology and information technology (IT) solution technology, as well as the sale of products to customers through sales partners and information technology, and the provision of services such as maintenance and introduction guidance. The Company is also engaged in the development and sale of business software such as master bills, the development of computer system integration business and system support business, as well as the sale of some software products, office automation (OA) related equipment and consumables.

name: OBIC CO. LTD.
businessSummary: OBIC Co., Ltd. is an information technology (IT) company. The Company operates in three business segments. The System Integration segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of total information systems for customers. The System Support segment is engaged in the provision of hardware maintenance and system operational support services. The Office Automation (OA) segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of general OA equipment and computer products. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of packaged software for financial accounting and other purposes through its associated companies.

name: OVAL CORP
businessSummary: OVAL Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly operates in sensors manufacturing business. The sensors division manufactures and sells industrial measuring equipment and related equipment. The systems division manufactures and sells instrumentation and control and management equipment. The service devision is responsible for the maintenance of industrial measuring instruments and equipment, and the calibration of flow meters. Products include flow meters, electronic meters, peripheral and related equipment and system equipment.

name: OHASHI TECHNICA INC
businessSummary: OHASHI TECHNICA INC. is a Japan-based company engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of automotive parts such as engine related parts, automobile assembly parts and brake related parts, as well as the logistics business. The Company operates through six geographic segments including Japan, Americas, China, ASEAN, Europe and Taiwan. Japan segment and China segment are engaged in auto parts business and other related parts business. The Americas, ASEAN, Europe and Taiwan segments are mainly engaged in automotive parts. Automotive components include engine and mission components, differential components, brake components, body and chasse components and interior & exterior components.

name: ONEX CORP
businessSummary: ONEX CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the metal heat treatment business and transportation business. The Company has two business segments. The Metal Heat Treatment segment is involved in the metal heat treatment business such as carburizing heat treatment, nitriding heat treatment, quenching, tempering and annealing, as well as the metal straightening business to straighten bended and curved products generated from the metal heat treatment processes. The Transportation segment is engaged in the transportation and handling of industrial products and equipment, as well as the transportation of general cargos and heat treatment products.

name: ONAMBA CO LTD
businessSummary: Onamba Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric wires and cables, wire harnesses, solar power generation-related products and harness processing machines and parts. The Company operates in three regional segments including Japan segment, Europe and the United States segment, and Asia (excluding Japan) segment. The Company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of components used for consumer electronic equipment, information office equipment and industrial electronic equipment, as well as general-purpose electric wires and communication cables. The main products include solar power generation wiring units, special cables, vinyl wires, eco wires, harness products and wires for various devices.

name: ODK SOLUTIONS CO LTD
businessSummary: ODK Solutions Company, Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of information processing outsourcing services to school corporations, securities companies and general business corporations, as well as the provision of system integration for securities finance companies and others. The Company provides comprehensive information services, such as the operation, development and maintenance of information systems. The Company's main services include information processing outsourcing services, contract calculation services, software development, network construction services and office automation (OA) equipment sales.

name: OTEC CORP
businessSummary: OTEC CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the sale of pipe equipment and materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Pipe Equipment and Material Sales segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of steel pipes, joints, valves, sanitary ware and housing equipment. The Construction segment is engaged in the instrumentation works, electric works and maintenance works for both new and existing buildings. The Environment-related Equipment Sales segment is engaged in the sale of environment-related equipment. As of March 31, 2015, the Company had six subsidiaries, one associated company and one affiliated company.

name: OKUMA CORP
businessSummary: Okuma Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools. The Company operates through Japan, America, Europe and Asia-Pacific segment. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools, provision of after-sales service, and sales of parts machining and maintenance parts, as well as the manufacture of sheet metal parts for machine tools. The main products include numerical control (NC) lathes, machining centers, multi-tasking machines, NC grinders and other NC machine tools, NC equipment, factory automation (FA) products, servo motors and other general machines.

name: AUCNET INC
businessSummary: AUCNET INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automobile business and digital products business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Automobile segment is engaged in the provision of used car television (TV) auctions, shared inventory markets, live broadcast auctions, bid agency services, and vehicle inspection services. The Digital Products segment is engaged in the provision of auction and distribution related services for used smartphones and used personal computers (PCs) and other used digital devices. The Other Information Distribution segment is engaged in the provision of auction and distribution related services for branded products, used motorcycles, cut flowers and pots. It is also engaged in the development and provision of systems, the provision of communication, operation and maintenance services, the business related with used medical equipment, and overseas business.

name: OSG CORP
businessSummary: OSG Corp is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision machine tools, such as cutting tools, rolling tools, measuring tools, machine tools, and machine parts. The Company's cutting tools include thread cutting tools such as taps and dies, milling cutters such as end mills and indexable tools, and drills and other cutting tools such as drills and diamond tools. Its rolling tools include thread rolling dies and trimming dies. Its measuring tools include thread gauges. Other products include machine tools such as rolling machines, tooling tools, raw materials, and line head (LH) sticks. The Company primarily produces and sells precision machine tools. The Company conducts the domestic sales of precision machine tools, and overseas sales in the Americas, Europe and Africa, and Asia, as well as other local subsidiaries. The Company operates in four segments including Japan, the Americas, Europe and Africa, and Asia. It mainly produces and sells precision machinery tools.

name: O-WELL CORP
businessSummary: O-WELL CORPORATION is engaged in the sales of products related to Paint Related business segment and Electrical and Electronic Parts business segment. The Company supplies various products and services related to paints and electric and electronic parts to various industries. The Paint Related business segment includes paints and surface treatment agents such as general purpose paints and industrial paints; chemical products and goods such as soundproofing materials, plastic sheets, heat-resistant ceramic products, adhesives, synthetic resin products, coating materials, measuring instruments; painting equipment and measuring instruments; completion works such as painting line related works and interior and exterior renovation related works. The Electrical and Electronic Parts business segment includes hall intergrated circuits (IC) and light-emitting diode (LED) lighting products.

name: ENVIPRO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: ENVIPRO HOLDINGS Inc. is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the recycling of resources. The Company mainly collects metal scrap and industrial wastes discharged from corporations or dismantled properties, and transports them to intermediate treatment plants owned by its subsidiaries. In the intermediate treatment plants, the recycled wastes are treated through various processes, including shearing and cutting, dismantling, crushing and sorting, and solid fuel production to produce various products. The Company's products include iron scrap, non-ferrous (copper, aluminum, and stainless steel) scraps, and plastics. The Company also collects recycled resources from other recyclers. The Company's products are distributed to both domestic and overseas markets. It also conducts disabled welfare services, operation of photovoltaic power stations, recycling of rubbers, manufacturing and sales of rubber products.

name: ENBIO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: EnBio Holdings, Inc is a holding company principally engaged in the environmental business. The Company, together with its subsidiaries, operates through three business segments. Soil Contamination Countermeasures segment is engaged in the investigation of soil contamination, design and construction of purification work, and risk consulting to its customers. Soil Contamination Related Equipment And Materials Sales segment is engaged in the import and sale of equipment, materials and purification agents used in onsite investigation and remediation. Brown Field Utilization segment is engaged in the purchase of polluted land and resale of it after purification. As of March 31, 2013, the Company had three subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: ENDO MANUFACTURING CO LTD
businessSummary: ENDO MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of operating golf club heads, stainless products and forging parts. The Company operates in three segments. The Golf segment is engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and sale of golf club heads, as well as the assembly of golf clubs. The Stainless segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless metal sleeves for office automation (OA) equipment and others. The Automobile Forging Part segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of forging components for automobiles and others.

name: ENDO LIGHTING CORP
businessSummary: ENDO Lighting Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the lighting equipment-related business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Lighting Equipment-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various lighting equipment. The Environment-related segment is involved in the sale of energy saving products, as well as the rental of lighting equipment and energy saving products. The Interior Furniture segment is engaged in the sales of interior furniture and supplies.

name: ELEMENTS INC
businessSummary: ELEMENTS Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development of image recognition engines and data analysis platforms. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of personal authentication solutions such as LIQUID eKYC, an online identity verification service and personal optimization solutions in food, clothing, and housing utilizing biometrics, image analysis, and machine learning technologies. Personal authentication solutions include the biometric authentication business, which develops authentication services using biometric information. Personal optimization solutions include the behavioral analysis business, which develops personal optimization services for offices and residences, and the body shape analysis business, which develops personal optimization services for women's shoes and personal optimization services for clothing, as well as the purchase analysis business, which develops personal optimization services for food retail.

name: ELECOM CO LTD
businessSummary: ELECOM CO., LTD. is primarily engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of personal computer and digital equipment-related products. Its core products brands include ELECOM, JDS, ELECOM, Logitec, HAGIWARE Solutions, and others.

name: AMG HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: AMG Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in apartment sales business, custom-made building business, real estate management business and real estate leasing business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Apartment Sales segment is engaged in the sale of newly built apartment series More Grace for families in the Tokai area. The Custom-made Building segment provides unique custom houses and store construction based on the concept of houses to build with architects. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of apartments in Nagoya City, Aichi Prefecture and Gifu City, Gifu Prefecture. This segment is centered on Nagoya City and Gifu City. The Real Estate Management segment is engaged in the management of new apartments series More Grace and other real estate.

name: MCJ CO LTD
businessSummary: MCJ Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the computer related business and the general entertainment business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Computer Related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of computer products, the wholesale and sale of computer parts, as well as the development and sale of monitors. The General Entertainment segment is engaged in the operation of composite cafes under the aprecio brand and 24-hour fitness clubs under the MIRA fitness brand, as well as the operation of hotels.

name: M&A RESEARCH INSTITUTE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: M&A Research Institute Holdings Inc, formerly M&A Research Institute Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of merger and acquisition (M&A) brokerage services and web marketing support services. The Company operates through two business segments. The M&A Intermediary segment is mainly engaged in the provision of M&A intermediary services using artificial intelligence (AI) matching algorithms. The Others segment is mainly engaged in the provision of web marketing support services, leveraging its expertise in attracting web customers through M&A intermediary services.

name: M&A CAPITAL PARTNERS CO LTD
businessSummary: M&A Capital Partners Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of brokerage business of mergers and acquisitions (M&A), as well as the provision of related services. The Company is mainly targeting middle and small-sized enterprises, providing M&A agency service, using the business model that makes free debut money and promoting business expansion. The Company operates M&A related service business, including brokerage business, brokerage and advisory services, as well as database provision and media management business. In addition, the Company also operates administrative and general management consulting services.

name: M-UP HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: M-up Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in provision of content and distributing systems in entertainment business covering content holders to the users. The Company operates in three business segments. The Content segment is involved in the distribution business for mobile terminals. The E-commerce (EC) segment is involved in the sale of mail-order by mobile and personal computer (PC). The Electronic Ticket segment is involved in the electronic tickets and ticket trading, as well as the related services.

name: MRT INC
businessSummary: MRT Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of medical information platform based on Internet. The Medical Information Platform Business segment consists of medical human resources services and others. The medical human resources services include part-time and full-time physician introductions for physicians, mainly through physician referral websites, and part-time job introductions, career change introductions, and temporary placement services for nurses, pharmacists, clinical technologists, clinical engineering technologists, and radiology technologists, who are referred to as co-medicals. Others include provision of groupware to support medical office operations, provision of online medical treatment and health consultation services, provision of marketing and product development by physicians, publishing services, pharmaceutical promotion support for physicians, operation of registration and reception centers, and well-being services.

name: EBRAINS INC
businessSummary: EBRAINS,INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of backplanes, bus racks, and system chassis for industrial and industrial computers. The products are mainly used in application fields including communication equipment, electronic application equipment, electrical measuring instruments, traffic related equipment, and defense and others. The main applicable equipment includes Base station communication device, broadband related device, broadcast image device, power related, plant, medical device, super computer (HPC), semiconductor / integrated circuit (IC) measuring instrument, factory automation (FA) equipment, robot, intelligent road Transportation system related equipment (ITS), train onboard equipment, vehicle, ship, aircraft onboard equipment, air traffic control equipment, military vehicle, ship, aircraft onboard equipment, surveillance camera system, assembly machine, equipment, and among others.

name: FP PARTNER INC
businessSummary: FP Partner Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the insurance agency business, which provides financial planning services mainly to individual and corporate clients. The Insurance Agency Business segment sells products of a total of 32 life and non-life insurance companies to individual and corporate clients, and provides face-to-face and online consultation, product explanation, contracting procedures, and follow-up services. It conducts business activities in Japan.

name: FP CORP
businessSummary: FP CORPORATION is a company engaged in the manufacture and sale of food containers. The easy food containers business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic food containers, the sale of packaging materials and packaging machines, the sale of raw materials, the export and import of products, the operation of packaging material franchise chains, as well as the provision of catalog mail order services for food containers and packaging materials, and storage, picking and delivery services for its products, among others. The trading business is engaged in the sale of machinery. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of recycled plastic bottle reprocessing products, the manufacture of cardboards and the leasing business.

name: FINANCIAL PRODUCTS GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: Financial Partners Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in fund and financial services business and aviation services business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Funds and Financial Services Business segment is engaged in leasing fund business, real estate fund business, insurance business, mergers and acquisitions (M&A) business, private equity business, trust business, securities business, real estate leasing business and others. The Aviation Services Business segment operates as an air transport operator and an aerial user operator, primarily engaged in passenger transportation and other businesses. The Company also operates private jet business through subsidiaries.

name: FB CARE SERVICE CO LTD
businessSummary: FB Care Service Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the nursing care business. The Company operates through two segments. The Welfare Equipment segment provides welfare equipment rental and sales based on the Long-term Care Insurance Law, and home care support. The Long-term Care segment includes pay nursing homes with nursing care, residential pay nursing homes, group homes, small-scale multifunctional home care, nursing small-scale multifunctional home care, day services, home-visit care, home-visit nursing care, and long-term care non-insurance services. The Company provides welfare equipment, home care support, and dominant care services in the Shinetsu and Kita-Kantou areas.

name: FJ NEXT CO LTD
businessSummary: FJ Next Holdings Co Ltd, formerly FJ Next Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in the real estate sales business in the metropolitan areas. The Company has four business segments. The Real Estate Development segment mainly develops, sells, brokers and of one-room mansions and family condominiums in the Tokyo metropolitan area, and also engages in the real estate business in the Izu area. This segment also provides financial services. The Real Estate Management segment mainly undertakes rental management from condominium division owners and building management contracts from management associations. The Construction segment mainly designs, constructs, inspects, and renovates buildings such as condominiums. The Hotel segment operates hot spring hotels in Shizuoka Prefecture.

name: F.C.C. CO LTD
businessSummary: F.C.C. Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of two-wheeled vehicle clutches and four-wheeled vehicle clutches. The Company operates through two business segments. The Four-wheeler Clutch segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of clutch products for automatic vehicles and manual vehicles. The Two-wheeler Clutch segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of clutch products for motorcycles, scooters, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs) and general-purpose machine clutches, as well as other parts and components for two-wheeler and four-wheeler products.

name: FFRI SECURITY INC
businessSummary: FFRI Security Inc, formerly FFRI Inc, is a Japan-based company engaged in the cyber security business. The Company is engaged in the provision of security products such as FFRI yarai, a targeted attack countermeasure product, and FFRI yarai analyzer, a malware automatic analysis tool. The Company sells products by subscription license or perpetual license, and provides product update and maintenance services, as well as the copyright business. The security service business is engaged in the outsourced development of cyber security products, the investigation of computer system security robustness and impact when subjected to cyber attacks, as well as the provision of security investigation, analysis and research services. The main services include security measures support services for Internet of Things (IoT) devices and systems, as well as Prime Analysis, a service that provides consulting and security information, and FFRI Expert Seminar, a paid training for security engineers.

name: JCU CORP
businessSummary: JCU CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of surface treatment agents and equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Agents segment provides decorative or rustproof coating agents for automotive components, water faucets and construction materials, as well as coating agents for printed circuit boards (PCBs), electronic parts and semiconductors. The Equipment segment provides automated surface treatment equipment and filtration machinery for automobile, printed circuit boards industries. The New Business segment is engaged in the sale of etching and cleaning equipment of PCBs using plasma technology, the sale of solar power generators and others.

name: EBARA CORP
businessSummary: Ebara Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in manufacturing, sales, construction, maintenance, and services across the building and industrial, energy, infrastructure, environmental, and precision and electronic industries. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Building & Industrial segment provides standard pumps, chillers, and blowers. The Energy Segment provides custom pumps, compressors and turbines. The Infrastructure segment provides custom pumps and tunnel blowers. The Environment segment provides municipal waste incineration plants, industrial waste incineration plants, and water treatment plants. The Precision and Electronics segment provides vacuum pumps, chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) equipment, plating equipment, and waste gas treatment equipment. The Company also provides business support services.

name: EBARA FOODS INDUSTRY INC
businessSummary: EBARA Foods Industry, Inc. is a food manufacturing company. The Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sauce for various meat, such as barbecued meat sauce and chicken sauce; sauce for stew, such as Korean pickled cabbage hot pot sauce, and sauce for vegetables, such as pickle sauce, as well as the manufacture and sale of other food, including curry flakes, konjac and seaweed salads. The segment also involves in the manufacture and sale of soup, such chicken-bone soup and noodle soup. The others business is engaged in the advertising business, temporary staffing business, the operation of warehousing and cargo transportation businesses.

name: NTN CORP
businessSummary: NTN Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of axle bearings, constant-velocity joints and precision equipment for automobile, industrial machinery and repair commercial markets. The Company operates through four geographic segments, including Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia and others. The Company is engaged in the production of bearings, ball screws and other mechanical components, as well as gears, motors, sensors and other peripheral components.

name: NC HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: NC Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the manufacture of conveyors and multi-story parking equipment, as well as the staffing business and software development business. The Company has four business segments. The Conveyor Related segment is involved in the manufacture, installation and sale of belt conveyors and auxiliary equipment. The Multi-Story Parking Equipment Related segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of multi-story parking equipment. It is also involved in the construction, maintenance and inspection of related works. The Temporary Staffing Related segment provides general worker dispatching and paid employment placement services. The Solar Power Generation System segment is involved in the sale of solar power generation plants, as well as the sale and installation of solar power generation system equipment.

name: SOMPO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Sompo Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the non-life insurance business, life insurance business, and other businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Domestic Non-Life Insurance Business segment is mainly engaged in non-life insurance underwriting, asset management, and related businesses in Japan. The Overseas Insurance Business segment is mainly engaged in insurance underwriting and asset management businesses in the United States, the United Kingdom, Turkey, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, China, Brazil, India, and other regions. The Domestic Life Insurance Business segment is mainly engaged in life insurance underwriting and asset management businesses in Japan. The Nursing Care and Healthcare Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of nursing care service and nursing care-related services. The Company is also engaged in asset management business, risk management business, defined contribution pension business and others.

name: NOK CORP
businessSummary: NOK Corp is a company principally involved in the manufacture and sale of sealing materials and flexible circuit boards. The Company operates in four business segments. The Seal segment manufactures and sells seal products mainly for the automobile industry, construction machinery industry, and general industrial machinery industry. The Electronic Component segment manufactures and sells electronic parts and others for the electronic equipment industry. The Roll segment manufactures and sells products for the office machine industry. The Others segment manufactures and sells special lubricants.

name: ANYCOLOR INC
businessSummary: Anycolor Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the video content-related business. The Company is mainly engaged in the operation of the virtual youtuber (VTuber) group Nijisanji, which is centered on the live streaming domain of video distribution on YouTube, as well as the commerce domain (sales of VTuber goods and other content and events), which expands the range of VTuber activities by providing contact points other than video distribution. The Company also develops business in the promotion domain, where uses the intellectual property (IP) it owns related to its VTubers to promote the products and services of its corporate clients. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the operation of overseas VTuber business as a new business domain.

name: RENESAS ELECTRONICS CORP
businessSummary: Renesas Electronics Corp is a Japan-based semiconductor manufacturer mainly engaged in the research, design, development, manufacture, sale and servicing of semiconductor products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in vehicle control business which provides semiconductors for controlling the engine and body of automobiles, and vehicle information business which provides semiconductors for in-vehicle information devices such as car navigation systems. The segment mainly provides microcontrollers, system-on-chip (SoC), analog semiconductors and power semiconductors. The Industry, Infrastructure and Internet of Things (IoT) segment is engaged in the industry business that supports the smart society, the infrastructure business and IoT business. The segment mainly provides microcontrollers, SoCs and analog semiconductors. The Company is also engaged in the development and contracted production of semiconductors.

name: SQUARE ENIX HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Square Enix Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in digital entertainment, amusement, publishing, and rights/property businesses through its subsidiaries. The Company operates through four segments. The Digital Entertainment segment provides interactive digital content for home video game consoles ,including handheld consoles, and personal computers, smartphones, and other platforms. The Amusement segment is engaged in the operation of amusement facilities, as well as the sale and rental of amusement equipment for such facilities. The Publishing segment is involved in the publication and licensing of comic magazines, comic books, game-related books, and other materials. The Rights and Properties segment is engaged in the planning, production, sales, and licensing of derivative works.

name: NIPPON INFORMATION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
businessSummary: Nippon Information Development Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the embedded solution business, information and communication technology (ICT) innovation business, financial system business, network solution business and other businesses. The Company operates in five business segments. The Embedded Solutions segment is engaged in the development and design of embedded software to customers. The ICT Innovation Business is engaged in the design and development of communication systems for customers. The Financial Systems segment provides financial business software to customers in the fields of life and non-life insurance, credit and securities, information and services. The Network Solution segment provides services such as system construction, infrastructure construction, security services, system maintenance and operation. The Others segment is involved in three businesses including data solutions business, product business and staffing business.

name: ENIGMO INC
businessSummary: Enigmo Inc. is mainly engaged in operation of social shopping Website BUYMA. The Company operates though two business segments. The Social Commerce segment is in the operation of the social shopping Website BUYMA, users can use it to introduce, exhibit and sell of topics items. The Media segment is engaged in operation of media 4meee! for women use and media 4yuuu!for housewives and mothers use. Its media acts as advertising medium, expanding users by transmitting latest trends and earning sales mainly though advertising business.

name: EDULAB INC
businessSummary: EduLab Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of testing development, implementation, analysis, educational services for English and other tests. The Company operates through five segments. The Testing and Other Licensing segment provides testing services and learning services centered on languages to educational institutions, private companies, and individuals. The Educational Platform segment provides and operates learning services such as Stagia Eiken, Stagia Kanken, and Stagia Math Test, as well as media services. The Test Center segment establishes test centers nationwide and provides test centers for various qualifications, certification exams, and university entrance exams. The Artificial Intelligence (AI) segment provides services and products using AI technology researched and developed in-house. The Test Operation and Outsourcing segment provides services related to test question creation, system construction, management, operation, and scoring.

name: EDION CORP
businessSummary: EDION Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of home electric appliances, and the operation of home electronics mass retailers from Hokkaido to Okinawa. The Company is engaged in the sale of home appliances through directly managed stores, mobile phone specialty stores, mail-order stores and franchise stores. The other business is involved in the operation of software specialty stores, the operation and development of information systems, the sale and construction of solar power generation systems, home remodeling, the purchase and sale of used information and communication equipment, and processing and sale of useful metals, the sale of office supplies, daily necessities, the sale of alcoholic beverages, the management of a professional soccer team, as well as the operation of programming classes.

name: EDGE TECHNOLOGY INC
businessSummary: EDGE Technology Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm business. The AI algorithm business provides AI solution services, AI education services, and develops and sells AI products. AI solution services incorporate AI algorithms into existing businesses and systems, and implement and operate them. AI education services include services such as education courses for individuals specializing in AI technology, corporate training, and paid employment agencies specializing in the AI field. AI product service is a service that sells products that implement AI.

name: S-POOL INC
businessSummary: S-Pool Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of outsourcing and temporary staffing services. It operates through two business segments. The Business Solutions segment provides services that support the utilization of potential labor resources, such as seniors and people with disabilities, and outsourcing services that undertake part of corporate's business. It provides services that primarily support the recruitment, training and retention of people with intellectual disabilities, and services that help freelance talent solve management and operational issues for companies, and other services. The Human Resources Solutions segment provides human resources-related services such as temporary staffing and recruitment services, office support services such as call centers, in-store sales support services for smartphones and home appliances, and human resources services related to customer service in the hotel industry.

name: S&B FOODS INC
businessSummary: S&B FOODS INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, processing and distribution of foodstuffs, with a focus on manufacturing and processing food products that use spices as raw materials. The Company operates in two business segments. The Foodstuff segment is involved in the production and sale of various spices and condiments, instant curry, tube products, retort curry and others, as well as the procurement of related raw materials. The Cooked Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cooked food.

name: ESTIC CORPORATION
businessSummary: ESTIC CORPORATION is engaged in manufacture, sale, repair and inspection of nut runners, hand nut runners, servo press and screw tightening equipment. The nut runner consists of alternating current (AC) turbo motors, sensors and controllers. It uses AC servomotor as the driving source, analyzes information from sensor though computer and controls the motor to tighten screws of bolts and nuts. The hand nut runner is a hand tool for tighten. The servo press is a press machine, consisting of AC servo motor, sensor and controller. The machine is applied in nut runner technology, uses AC servomotor as the driving source, presses object by changing the rotational force of the motor to linear motion through ball screw. The repair and inspection business provides repair of nut runners, hand nut runners, servo press, as well as inspection of accuracy for screw tightening.

name: STG CO LTD
businessSummary: STG Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the casting, processing and sale of metal parts. The Company is mainly engaged in the design of metal molds, as well as the casting, processing, finishing and chemical conversion of magnesium alloy parts and other metal parts. The Company is mainly engaged in the production of magnesium alloy parts and other metal parts for projectors, single-lens reflex cameras, automobiles, copiers and medical devices.

name: SG HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: SG Holdings Co Ltd provides delivery business, logistics business and real estate business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Delivery segment provides hikyaku express courier, hikyaku large size courier service, mail service, specified letter service, art transport, delivery agent and food delivery. The Logistics segment provides distribution processing, logistics system construction, inventory storage and delivery management, international courier service and international air and sea transportation. The Real Estate segment provides real estate leasing and management, real estate development, asset management. The Company is also engaged in the transportation non-life insurance agency business, the sale of truck fuel, maintenance and sale of transportation vehicles, development and operation of logistics systems, provision of cash-on-delivery services for courier services, and the provision of human resources centered on work outsourcing in logistics facilities.

name: LIB WORK CO LTD
businessSummary: Lib Work Co., Ltd., formerly SK home Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the detached residential business. The Company is engaged in the planning, design, sale, construction and supervision of custom homes such as residential houses, condominiums and others. The Company is also engaged in the real estate sale business, and the renovation and remodeling businesses in association with the detached residential business.

name: SMS CO LTD
businessSummary: SMS CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the information operation businesses in nursing care, healthcare, career, senior life and overseas fields to business operators and end user, among others. The nursing care field is engaged in management support and meal home delivery search services to nursing care providers. The healthcare field is engaged in the communication sale business. The career field is engaged in the provision of nursing care services, recruiting information services and other medical related businesses. The overseas field is engaged in the provision of medical information services for medical staff and business operators.

name: SEC CARBON LTD
businessSummary: SEC CARBON, LIMITED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of carbon and steel products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of carbon products such as artificial graphite electrodes, cathode blocks for smelting aluminum, special carbon products, powdered products and other carbon products, as well as steel products by electric furnace steelmaking. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of carbon products, and the contract works on the factory premises.

name: SRE HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: SRE Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the AI x Real solution business that provides real estate distribution services utilizing agent system and artificial intelligence (AI) technology. The Company is engaged in the real estate business, information technology (IT) platform business and AI solution business. The real estate business is engaged in the acquisition and operation of profitable real estates, the development of assets such as smart homes that combine Internet of Things (IoT) and AI technology, as well as the provision of consulting and other real estate distribution services. The IT platform business is engaged in the provision of a real estate trading platform Ouchi Direct that based on IT and AI technology, and the IT platforms for various industries. The AI solution business is engaged in the provision of consulting services for various industries such as financial tech (Fintech) and real estate tech (RET) fields.

name: EKITAN & CO LTD
businessSummary: Ekitan & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company providing information contents services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Consumer business develops a transit guide service Station Search Transit Information for individuals through mobile phones including smart phones. The Business for Corporate Users provides transit guidance services provided by the Company as application service provider (ASP) service for corporations such as mobile carriers, railroad companies and map companies.

name: EZAKI GLICO CO LTD
businessSummary: Ezaki Glico Co., Ltd.is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of food products. The Company operates in five business segments. Confectionery & Food segment provides chocolate, gum, biscuits, snacks, curry roux, and retort products. Frozen Confectionery segment provides ice creams and other products. Dairy Products segment provides milk beverages and Western confectionery. Food Ingredients segment provides starch and pigments. Overseas segment provides confectionery and frozen desserts in other countries. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of health-related foods, the sale of confectionery in office, as well as the maintenance and development of information systems.

name: EXEDY CORP
businessSummary: Exedy Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of manual and automatic transmission-related automobile components. The Company has two business segments. The Manual Transmission (MT) Related segment provides clutch discs, clutch covers and two-mass flywheels, among others. The Automatic Transmission (AT) Related segment provides torque converters and automatic transmissions parts. The others business provides motorcycle clutches, power shift transmissions and related parts, brakes, retarders and mechanical equipment, among others. This segment also provides transportation services.

name: EIWA CORP
businessSummary: Eiwa Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial measurement and control equipment, environment monitoring and analytical equipment, measuring and testing equipment, and industrial machinery. Industrial instruments include level measurement equipment, pressure measurement equipment, temperature measurement equipment and distance measurement equipment. Environment monitoring and analytical equipment includes gas analysis and measurement equipment, meteorological and sea condition measurement equipment, water quality, concentration and viscosity measurement equipment. Inspection and measurement equipment includes pressure measurement equipment, material measurement equipment, and non-destructive inspection equipment. Industrial equipment includes security equipment, environment improvement equipment, air conditioning equipment and others.

name: EVIXAR INC
businessSummary: Evixar Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development of software based on sound signal processing (acoustic communication / sound synchronization and authentication technology) and provision of unique acoustic communication solutions based on these results. The Company develops Audio Fingerprint technology and Audio Watermark technology, and provides acoustic communication solutions centered on these core technologies. The Audio Communication Solution segment provides solutions mainly in the areas of entertainment, TV viewing measurement and IoT / M2M.

name: AIR-U LTD
businessSummary: AIR-U Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of seamlessly connected services based on telecommunications business. The network and carrier resale business is engaged in postpaid communication service mainly for domestic users, including foreign residents, and medium to long-term users. The cloud service operation business uses the cloud SIM system for domestic postpaid communication mainly for travelers from Japan to overseas, travelers from overseas to overseas, and medium to long-term users. The brand resale business is a prepaid communication service mainly for inbound tourists from overseas and short-term domestic users. The Company is mainly engaged in outsourcing of sales operations such as development of new sales channels and sales of smartphones and tablets.

name: AVIC CO LTD
businessSummary: AViC Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital marketing business. The Digital Marketing Business segment provides high-quality digital marketing services mainly to clients with medium to small advertising budgets. The Company provides internet advertising services such as purchasing advertising space from media management companies, measuring advertising effectiveness, and acting as an advertising operation agent for clients. The Company also provides search engine optimization (SEO) consulting services that measure the effectiveness of SEO measures, such as optimizing the internal structure of target websites and creating content to be posted on them, and then provides comprehensive solutions and appropriate information dissemination for clients.

name: HPC SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: HPC SYSTEMS Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of high-performance computer solutions for science and engineering fields. The Company operates in two business segments. High Performance Computer (HPC) segment is mainly involved in the development, manufacture and sale of high-performance computers for scientific and technological computations conducted by research and development institutions of universities and government agencies. Main products are cluster computers and personal cluster systems. Configure to Order (CTO) segment is involved in the development, manufacture and sale of embedded computers for industrial machinery. The Company also provides consulting services specializing in scientific and engineering calculations.

name: ATLED CORP
businessSummary: ATLED CORP. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of workflow products. The workflow products are the digitization of the business flow from deliberation, application, approval for various businesses. The main products are package softwares X-point and Agileworks, and cloud services providers X-point Cloud and ATLED WorkPlatform. X-point and X-point Cloud are targeted at small to medium-sized enterprises, Agileworks is targeted at medium to large enterprises, and ATLED WorkPlatform is targeted at software vendors and system development companies.

name: ATEAM INC
businessSummary: Ateam Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Ateam Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment business, the lifestyle support business and the electronic commerce (EC) business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Entertainment segment is engaged in the planning, development and operation of games and tool applications for smartphones, tablet terminals and other smart devices. The Lifestyle Support segment is engaged in the planning, development and operation of comparison sites and information sites that provide information closely related to life events and daily life. The EC segment is engaged the planning, development and operation of multiple E-Commerce sites that handle a variety of products, including lujo, RESP, and OBREMO.

name: EIDAI CO LTD
businessSummary: Eidai Co., Ltd. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wooden building materials and wooden boards. The Company operates in two business segments. The Housing Materials segment manufactures and sells building materials, including floorings, stairs sets, interior doors, construction materials and system kitchens. The Wooden Board segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of raw material particle boards and cosmetic particle boards. The others business engages in utilization business of owned real estate, asbestos treatment work, measurement and analysis of work environment, sales of processed chemicals and other environmental businesses, as well as solar power generation business.

name: EIDAI KAKO CO LTD
businessSummary: EIDAI KAKO CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various synthetic resin molded products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automobile Supplies-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive floor mats. The Industrial Material-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of air conducts, components and materials for household refrigerators, business desks, plastic bamboo panels, residential interior materials, bath lids, magazine sticks and terminal covers, as well as the sale of industrial materials including stands for drying machines and office chairs.

name: AJIS CO LTD
businessSummary: AJIS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in physical inventory service business and retail support service business. The Company operates its business through three business segments. Domestic Inventory Service Business segment conducts the physical inventory service business in Japan. Retail Support Service Business segment conducts retail support service business including centralized replenishment service, staffing, customer service, check service, as well as advertising planning and production. Overseas Inventory Service Business segment conducts the physical inventory service business overseas.

name: EIKEN CHEMICAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Eiken Chemical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sales of test drugs. Through its subsidiaries, the Company conducts contract the manufacturing of diagnostic reagents and purchases, manufactures and sells diagnostic reagents. The products and services include microbial testing reagents, urine testing reagents, immuno-serological test reagents, biochemical testing reagents and instrument food environment-related media. The Company sells its products in Japan and overseas markets.

name: AIR WATER INC
businessSummary: Air Water Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of industrial gas, chemical, medical, energy related products. It has eight business segments. Industrial Gas-related segment manufactures and sells industrial gas and installs high-pressure gas equipment. Chemical-related segment manufactures basic and fine chemical products. Medical-related segment provides medical gas products and hospital equipment construction. Energy-related segment offers liquefied petroleum gas and kerosene. Agriculture and Food-related segment manufactures and sells fruit, vegetables, frozen food, processed meat products and soft drinks. Logistics-related segment provides logistics service on high pressure gas and general cargo. Seawater-related segment manufactures and sells salts and salt-making by-products, as well as fused magnesia and magnesium oxide. The Other segment consist of aerosol business. It also develops green chemicals and biofuels and provides rehabilitation system.

name: A-ONE SEIMITSU INC
businessSummary: A-ONE SEIMITSU INC. is engaged in manufacturing and sales of collet chuck products, special cutting tools, as well as design, manufacturing and sales of cams for automatic lathe. The Company operates through three business segments. The Collet Chuck segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of collet chucks for automatic lathes, general industry machines and special machines. The Cutting Tools segment is engaged in regrinding of cutting tools, as well as manufacturing and sales of special cutting tools. The Automatic Lathe Cam segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of cams for small automatic lathe and special purpose machine.

name: A.D.WORKS GROUP CO LTD
businessSummary: A.D.Works Group Co.,Ltd. is mainly engaged in the management of the business of group companies and other related operations as a holding company. Through a wholly owned subsidiary and its affiliated companies, the Company operates two businesses, including profitable real estate sales business and stock-type fee business. The profitable real estate sales business seeks out and raises properties with high profitability, and operates the business through the process of property selection, purchase, value increasing and sales, centering on residential real estate with less than 500 million yen per building. The stock-type fee business supports all aspects of the management of real estate properties, and provides property management, real estate effective utilization consulting and real estate appraisal due diligence.

name: EISAI CO LTD
businessSummary: Eisai Co Ltd is a Japan-based pharmaceutical company mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture, sale, import and export of pharmaceuticals. The Company operates in two business segments. The Pharmaceutical segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals for medical use, generic drugs, general medicines, among others. The segment operates in five regions including Japan, Americas (North America), China, EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa, Russia, Oceania), Asia and Latin America (Korea, Taiwan, India, ASEAN, Latin America). The Others segment is involved in license revenues and pharmaceutical raw materials business. The Company is also engaged in the provision of brands such as the anticancer drugs Lembima and Halaven on the nerve and oncology areas.

name: FUJI OIL COMPANY LTD.
businessSummary: Fuji Oil Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in refining, storage, procurement, sales and purchase of petroleum, as well as transportation and receiving/shipping of crude oil and petroleum products. The Company refines, stores, procures, and sells petroleum. Through subsidiaries, the Company procures and sells crude oil and petroleum products, charters crude oil tankers, transports crude oil and petroleum products, manufactures and sells asphalt mixture for road paving, disposes of industrial waste, receives and ships crude oil and petroleum products, collects and transports industrial waste, generates solar power, constructs and maintains various plants, and manages assets for oil exploration projects, engineering of petroleum development and refining.

name: AHC GROUP INC
businessSummary: AHC GROUP INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the welfare, nursing care and restaurant business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Welfare segment is engaged in the operation of after school day service offices, child development support offices, employment support offices, consultation support offices and cohabitation support offices, the provision of advice and guidance related to welfare, the management business, and the licensing of welfare brands, including apuri, TODAY, A plus and Beetle. The Nursing Care segment is engaged in the operation of day service offices, the provision of advice and guidance related to nursing care, the management business, and the licensing of welfare brands, including Greenday, Aidearu and Tricolore. The Restaurant segment is engaged in the operation of izakaya and bistros, the provision of advice and guidance, the processing and sale of food products, and the licensing of brands, including Sanzo, TERIYAKI and others.

name: A&D HOLON HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: A&D Holon Holdings Co Ltd, formerly A&D Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of measuring instrument, medical and healthcare equipment. The Company operates through two segments. The Measuring Instrument segment provides measuring, control and simulation systems, electron guns for semiconductor exposure apparatus, analog to digital (AD) and digital to analog (DA) converters, testing machines, environmental measuring instrument, electronic balances, platform scales, indicators, counting scales and load cells. The Medical and Healthcare Equipment segment offers digital hemopiezometers for home use, blood pressure monitors, full automatic hemopiezometers, precision weighing scales and ultrasonic inhalators.

name: AI INSIDE INC
businessSummary: AI inside Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in artificial intelligence (AI) business. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of DX Suite which is an AI-OCR service with a user interface. DX Suite includes applications called Intelligent OCR, Elastic Sorter and Multi Form. Intelligent OCR is a service that reads standard forms and converts them into digital data based on handwritten character recognition technology. Elastic Sorter is an option of Intelligent OCR that selects and sorts the same type of forms when multiple types of forms are scanned in random order. Multi Form is an option of Intelligent OCR that reads non-standard forms other than standard forms and converts them into digital data including structured data. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the development of AI inside Cube which is an edge computing hardware that performs AI processing without requiring access to the cloud.

name: AI CROSS INC
businessSummary: AI CROSS Inc. is a Japan-based technology company. The Company provides messaging service, business chat service and artificial intelligence (AI) analytics service. The messaging service is a distribution platform service for delivering short message service (SMS) to mobile terminals owned by end users to domestic and foreign operators mainly engaged in business-to-consumer (B2C) business. The business chat service is a service that is intended to be used for business communication and business communication in companies. The AI Analytics service conducts research to enhance Engagement using AI technology. The other business is engaged in the development of system.

name: WITZ CORP
businessSummary: WITZ Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in provision of software. The Company operates in three business segments. The Embedded Systems segment is engaged in the provision of software development services for control devices, such as automobiles and industrial machinery. The Systems Engineering business segment is engaged in the provision of model-based technology for automobiles and virtual simulation technologies, such as automatic operation. The Functional Safety Development segment is engaged in the provision of consulting services to support functional safety measures of control devices using computers.

name: VRAIN SOLUTION INC
businessSummary: VRAIN Solution Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the provision of artificial intelligence (AI) systems and digital transformation (DX) consulting businesses that utilize technologies such as AI and Internet of things (IoT) technologies for the manufacturing industry. The Company operates through two businesses. The AI system business plans, researches, and develops AI systems as a solution to improve productivity. The Company also provides them in combination with peripheral hardware such as imaging equipment, depending on the manufacturing environment of the production line and problems for customers. Its main products include the AI visual inspection system Phoenix Vision/Eye. The DX consulting business provides services that support DX promotion for customers.

name: WOLVES HAND CO LTD
businessSummary: WOLVES HAND Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the veterinary hospital business. The main businesses are the operation of veterinary hospitals and pet salons, provision of software for veterinary hospitals, distribution of veterinary medical education seminars, and the manufacture and sale of medical equipment and instruments. The veterinary hospital operation business provides veterinary medical care at veterinary hospitals. The pet salon operation business provides grooming services and operates pet hotels. The veterinary hospital software provision business develops and sells the customer management system Wantaro for veterinary hospitals. The veterinary medical education seminar distribution business operates the information site VMN for veterinarians and creates seminar content. The medical equipment manufacturing and sales business researches, develops, manufactures, sells, leases, and imports and exports medical equipment and medical instruments.

name: UBE INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: UBE Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business related to chemicals, and molding machinery manufacturing. The Company operates through four business segments. The Performance Products segment manufactures and sells polyimide, separation membranes, ceramics, separators, and other products. The Resins & Performance Polymer Products segment manufactures and sells composites, nylon polymers, caprolactam, ammonium sulfate, industrial chemicals, fine chemicals, high-performance coatings, elastomers, and other products. The Machinery segment manufactures and sells die casting machines, extrusion presses, injection molding machines, industrial machinery, bridges and steel structures, and steel products. The Others segment manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals (active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates), supplies electric power, and buys, sells, leases, and manages real estate.

name: USHIO INC
businessSummary: USHIO INC. is a company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of light source products, equipment and industrial equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. The Light Source segment manufactures and sells halogen lamps, xenon lamps, high-pressure ultraviolet (UV) lamps and excimer lamps. The Equipment segment manufactures and sells projectors for movie theaters and related equipment, ultraviolet curable equipment, various lighting equipment, excimer-related equipment. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of injection molding machines, food packaging machines and audio equipment, the holding and management of subsidiaries, as well as the agency of insurance.

name: WANTEDLY INC
businessSummary: Wantedly, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operation of business social networking service(SNS) platform named Wantedly. The number of users per month at the end of May 2017 is 1,514,842. The Company operates through one segment: Business SNS. The segment provides company visit matching service Wantedly Visit, business card management application Wantedly People, business use specialized chat tool Wantedly Chat, media platform Wantedly and others. The company has one subsidiary.

name: PREMIUM WATER HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Premium Water Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of natural mineral water and home office delivery business which manufactures natural mineral water. The main product is 12L natural mineral water, which includes in-house production and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) production in Fujiyoshida City, Yamanashi Prefecture; Asago City, Hyogo Prefecture; Asago City, Hyogo Prefecture; Omachi City, Nagano Prefecture; Hamada City, Shimane Prefecture and Minamiaso Village, Aso County, Kumamoto Prefecture. The Company provides mineral water delivery services centered on the brand PREMIUM WATER mainly through the three sales methods of direct sales, distributors, original brand name (OEM) and through demonstration sales, WEB and telemarketing. The Company lends water servers to customers of direct sales, distributors and special agents, and wholesales water servers to customers of agents. The Company also conducts as a sales representative.

name: WELBE INC
businessSummary: Welbe, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in provision of disability welfare services. The employment transition support business provides employment training, including preparation and correction of application forms, mock interview and practical training in workplace. The business also provides specific consultation support and independence training for people with disabilities. The rehabilitation business provides instruction for growth and development for pre-school children with developmental disorders and lesson support for primary school students, junior high school students, and high school students after school classes and during long vacation.

name: C.UYEMURA & CO LTD
businessSummary: C.Uyemura & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of surface finishing materials and machinery. The Company operates in four business segments. The Surface Finishing Material segment provides plating solutions for aluminum magnetic discs, plating solutions for printed-circuit boards, industrial use chemical products and non-ferrous metals, among others. The Surface Finishing Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of plating machinery for aluminum magnetic discs and printed-circuit boards. The Plating Processing segment is engaged in the process of plating work for plastics and printed circuit boards. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and condominiums.

name: VERITAS IN SILICO INC
businessSummary: Veritas In Silico Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical discovery platform business. The main business is small molecule drug discovery targeting messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) using the ibVIS platform, which integrates digital technology including in silico ribonucleic acid (RNA) structural analysis technology and drug discovery technology, through joint drug discovery research with pharmaceutical companies to create mRNA-targeted small molecule drugs.

name: WEDS CO LTD
businessSummary: WEDS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wholesale of automotive-related parts. The Company operates in four business segments. The Automobile-related Wholesale segment is engaged in the wholesale of automotive aftermarket parts including automotive wheels and car accessory parts and others to general markets. This segment also manufactures and sells three-piece aluminum wheels, through its subsidiaries. The Automobile-related Retail segment sells automotive aftermarket parts, such as automotive wheels, car accessory parts and others, to general consumers. The Welfare segment is engaged in the welfare business for the elders. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of mobile phones and the leasing of real estate. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had three subsidiaries, one associated company and one affiliated company.

name: UEX LTD
businessSummary: UEX,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of stainless steel and other metal materials, the manufacture and sale of stainless steel and other metal processed products, and the manufacture and sale of mechanical equipment. The Company operates through three business segments. The Stainless Steel and Other Metal Materials Sales business is engaged in the cutting and sale of metal materials such as stainless steel plates, steel pipes, steel strips, and stainless steel pipes for semiconductor devices, the processing and sales of fake products, forged products, machined parts. The Stainless Steel and Other Metal Materials Manufacture and Sales business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless steel weather covers and stainless steel pipe products. The Machinery Manufacturing and Sales and Engineering business is engaged in the design and manufacture of general industrial equipment mainly for food and chemicals, and the provision of engineering services.

name: WEST HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: West Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, construction, sales, operation and maintenance (O&M) of public and industrial photovoltaic power generation systems, the west esco business of energy-saving services, and the sales of electricity to companies and local governments. The Company operates through four business segments. The Electric Power segment is engaged in the new electric power (PPS) business, power generation and sales business using solar power generation systems. The Renewable Energy segment is engaged in the construction and sales business of public and industrial photovoltaic power generation systems and the construction, sales and wholesale business of environment-friendly remodeling. The Energy-Saving Business segment provides total energy-saving services. The Maintenance Business segment is engaged in the comprehensive management and maintenance business for photovoltaic power generation systems and related equipment.

name: WESCO HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Wesco Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in general construction consulting business. The Company operates through five business segments. The General Construction Consulting segment involves in the provision of construction consulting, construction design, compensation consultant, environmental assessment, general survey, aerial survey and geological survey services. The Copy Bookbinding segment involves in the positive image printing, copy drawing, printing and bookbinding. The Real Estate segment involves in the subdivision and rental of real estate, as well as housing sales. The Sporting Facilities Operation segment involves in the operation of sporting facilities and related facilities. The Designated Management segment involves in the management of Suma Aqualife Park.

name: UEKI CORP
businessSummary: UEKI CORPORATION is mainly engaged in construction business and real estate business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Construction segment is engaged in order and construction for construction work, leasing of construction materials and other construction contracts. The Real Estate segment is engaged in sale, leasing and development of real estate, as well as development of residential land. The Construction Material Manufacture and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction materials. Other businesses include development and sales of software, operation of paid nursing homes, operation of golf courses, and leasing of industrial waste treatment facilities.

name: WIN-PARTNERS CO LTD
businessSummary: WIN-Partners Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the medical equipment supply business through its subsidiaries. The Company is mainly in the provision of medical device, such as catheters used in ischemic heart disease, pacemakers used in cardiac rhythm management area, artificial blood vessels used for cardiovascular surgery area, embolization coil used in peripheral vascular disease and brain surgery, as well as the provision of large -scale medical equipment, such as computed tomography equipment (CT) used in the radiology department and the operating room.

name: WINGARC1ST INC
businessSummary: WingArc1st Inc is engaged in the development and sale of corporate software and services. The Company is engaged in data empowerment business, including form and document management solutions and data empowerment solutions. In the form and document management solution, the Company provides software used in Japan as a business foundation for forms and solutions based on them. It is used for creating, outputting, and managing forms in various places in society, from business forms such as invoices, delivery notes, shipping slips, and e-tickets to various certificates issued by public institutions. Main products include SVF, SVF Cloud and SPA. The data empowerment solution mainly sells software, provides cloud services, and provides maintenance support to end users. The main software and services include Dr.Sum and MotionBoard. The Company is also engaged in the provision of professional services.

name: WILLPLUS HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Willplus Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the distribution of new cars and used cars, as well as the vehicle maintenance and general insurance agent business. The Imported Vehicle Sales-related segment is engaged in the sale of new cars purchased from each importer, the sale of high-year-low-running used cars of each brand, the sale of other brands used cars in auto auction, the provision of vehicle maintenance services such as maintenance, repair and inspection services, as well as the sale of compulsory automobile liability insurances and optional insurances, and the sale of new cars from importers.

name: WILLTEC CO LTD
businessSummary: WILLTEC Co.,Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing support business, construction support business and EMS business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Manufacturing Support segment is mainly engaged in the manufacturing contracting and dispatching business, the mechanical and electrical engineer dispatching business, and the repair service business. The Construction Support segment conducts construction engineer dispatching business. The EMS segment includes contract manufacturing and electronic parts wholesale.
