The other businesses include support for the disabled, livestock industry business and overseas businesses.

name: WILL GROUP INC
businessSummary: WILL GROUP, INC. is engaged in the human resource business focusing on temporary staffing, business contracting and recruitment business. Its Sales Outsourcing segment involves in the hybrid dispatch, general dispatch, and business contracting business, providing staff engaged in products sales, staff management, collection and report of sales information. Its Call Center Outsourcing segment involves in hybrid dispatch and general dispatch business, providing staff engaged in information providing and delivery, after services and claim handling to communication company. Its Factory Outsourcing segment involves in staff dispatch to companies in food, electrical equipment industries, among others. The Nursing Care Support segment provides nursing staff to companies operating nursing care facilities to provide stable operation of nursing care facilities. The Overseas HR segment develops human resources service business. Others segment involves in the general staff dispatch, among others.

name: INFRONEER HOLDINGS INC PREFERRED
businessSummary: Infroneer Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of comprehensive infrastructure services. The construction business develops construction work centered on apartment buildings and office buildings. The civil engineering business develops construction work centered on bridges and tunnels. The pavement business develops construction work such as pavement work. The manufacturing business revolves around the manufacturing and sales of construction equipment. The infrastructure management business operates renewable energy business and the concession business. The manufacturing and sales business manufactures and sells asphalt mixture and emulsion and other construction materials. The Company is also involved in the construction machinery-related business, industrial and iron structure machinery related business, nursing care products related business. The other businesses include real estate business, among others.

name: INFOMART CORP
businessSummary: Infomart Corporation is a Japan-based company principally involved in the business to business (BtoB) electronic commerce (e-commerce) business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Order Receiving segment provides ordering and ordering of B to B platform for streamlining daily ordering and receiving work. The Standards segment provides BtoB Platform Specifications to promote the creation of a framework for food safety and security. The E-Commerce Service (ES) segment provides BtoB Platform Invoice to realize paperless by electronic conversion of intercompany invoices and BtoB Platform negotiations to improve efficiency of business negotiation as a purchasing sales tool. The Company is also engaged in the provision of menu (recipe) development services and research & promotion services for the domestic food industry.

name: INTEGROUP INC
businessSummary: Integroup Inc is a Japan-based company that provides mergers and acquisitions (M&A) brokerage services mainly to small and medium-sized companies. The Company operates in the M&A Brokerage business segment. The M&A Brokerage service provides one-stop support to business owners who wish to sell their companies, from initial consultation, assessment of the expected sale price, proposal of potential buyers and transfer schemes, preparation of necessary materials, selection of potential buyers, proposal to potential buyers, meeting with potential buyers, negotiation of terms and conditions, arrangement of basic agreement and final contract. The service is remunerated only when an M&A transaction is concluded.

name: INTEGRAL CORP
businessSummary: Integral Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the private equity (PE) investment fund business. It forms and manages funds with the aim of investing primarily in unlisted companies. As a general partner (GP), it manages PE investment funds, earning management fees and providing management support to investee companies. It aims to expand profit opportunities by making principal investments in addition to investments through PE investment funds under certain rules. In addition to PE investments, it also invests in other asset classes such as real estate, growth and infrastructure as part of its medium- to long-term growth strategy.

name: INTIMATE MERGER INC
businessSummary: Intimate Merger, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the data management platform business. The Company uses its own data management platform IM-DMP to support both online and offline marketing of client companies by utilizing data. IM-DMP is constructed from information obtained from a Web browser used on a personal computer, a smarphone, a tablet, or the like as an attribute database of Internet users. The features of IM-DMP include an Internet user attribute database and a database for converting instant messenger identification (IM-ID) into different IDs.

name: INTERNET INITIATIVE JAPAN INC
businessSummary: Internet Initiative Japan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of Internet business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Network Services and System Integration (SI) segment is mainly engaged in the provision of a combination of network services and system integration services, which mainly consist of Internet connection services, wide area network (WAN) services and outsourcing services, as well as the provision of comprehensive solutions. The Automated Teller Machine (ATM) Operation segment is engaged in the operation of bank ATMs and network systems.

name: INTAGE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: INTAGE HOLDINGS Inc., formerly INTAGE Inc., is a provider of marketing research and consulting services. The Market Research and Consulting segment is engaged in marketing research operations, including customer panel research, retail shop panel research and other research activities; customized research services, including Internet research, mail survey, visiting interview survey and qualitative research, as well as the provision of related consulting services. The System Solution segment is engaged in the development and sale of software, the operation of systems and data centers, and the provision of various related consulting services. The Drug Development Support segment is engaged in the contract research organization (CRO) business. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had 24 subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: GMO INTERNET INC
businessSummary: GMO Internet Group Inc, formerly GMO Internet Inc, is engaged in Internet infrastructure business, Internet advertising and media business, Internet finance business, crypto asset business and incubation business. The Company operates through five segments. The Internet Infrastructure segment is engaged in domain business, cloud hosting business, electronic commerce (EC) support business, security business, and access business. The Internet Advertising and Media segment is engaged in Internet advertising business, Internet media business, and Internet research business. The Internet Finance segment provides financial instruments trading services such as online securities trading services and foreign exchange margin trading services. The Crypto Asset segment is engaged in the business related to crypto asset exchange and mining. The Incubation segment invests in unlisted companies, mainly Internet-related companies. The Company is also engaged in the mobile entertainment business.

name: ABC-MART INC
businessSummary: ABC-MART,INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale, planning and development of shoes. The Company operates in two regional segments, including Domestic and Overseas. The Company is engaged in the sale of shoes, shoes related accessories and apparel products under the brands HAWKINS,VANS, saucony, DANNER, NUOVO Collection and White's Boots through shoes retail stores ABC-MART in domestic and overseas. The Company is also engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of products, as well as the operation of retail stores DANNER in the United States.

name: INTER ACTION CORP
businessSummary: INTER ACTION Corporation develops, manufactures, purchases and sells light source device, solar power-related products, and image inspection devices. The Company has three business segments. The Light Source Equipment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of light source device for testing in the production process of imaging semiconductors (charge coupled device (CCD) and complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS)), and display devices. The Solar Power-related Product segment develops, purchases and sells solar simulators, cell testers, solar power modules. The Imaging Inspection segment develops, manufactures and sells Internet protocol (IP) modules, discrete fourier transformation (DFT) test systems, camera module test equipment and related components. As of May 31, 2014, the Company had five subsidiaries.

name: INSOURCE CO LTD
businessSummary: Insource Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing rank-based training, skills-based training and related social people education services. Its educational services business segment includes lecturer dispatched training business, public lectures business, and other business. Lecturer dispatched training business provides training services by dispatching lecturers. Public lectures business provides online training service to customers. Other business engages in providing personnel support system Leaf, operation career transition support business Bizstage and providing human resources education-related services.

name: INCLUSIVE INC
businessSummary: Inclusive Holdings Inc, formerly Inclusive Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the media & content, planning & production, and food-related businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Media & Content Business segment attracts users online through a wide range of information dissemination formats, including media, manga, and newsletters, and earns revenue from corporate clients through advertising or charges for selling content and services to individual users. The Planning & Production Business segment primarily serves corporate clients and provides planning related to corporate and group branding, promotion-related services, spatial design, construction services, and system development support. The Food-Related Business segment provides various food-related services based on the Shimogamo Saryo brand. The Company also engages in space-related businesses.

name: IWABUCHI CORP
businessSummary: IWABUCHI CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of hardware and concrete poles for various electrical wiring applications. The Company is involved in the manufacture, purchasing and sale of traffic signal and road sign poles, as well as brackets for safety net in schools, the cable poles for cable television (CATV) cable laying use and disaster prevention administrative wireless facility use, the poles for telecommunication lines, the poles and concrete poles for power distribution line use tailored to various electric power companies, and poles for distribution lines within factories, and railway poles, among others.

name: IWATANI CORP
businessSummary: IWATANI CORPORATION is a gas company. The Total Energy Division provides household, commercial and industrial liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), LPG supplying equipment, liquefied natural gas(LNG), gas products, and household kitchen appliances. The Industrial Gas and Machinery Division provides gas, helium, gas supplying equipment, welding equipment, industrial machinery and robots, pumps and compressors, as well as semiconductor and electronic parts manufacturing equipment, pharmaceutical and food machinery and environmental equipment. The Materials Division provides steel, nonferrous metals, functional films, display materials, electronic material, ceramic raw materials and biomass fuel. The Natural Industry Division provides frozen foods, health food, livestock systems, agricultural materials and equipment. The Others segment involves in finance, insurance, transportation and information processing businesses.

name: IYOGIN HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Iyogin Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in financial services such as leasing, with a focus on banking operations. The banking business is engaged in deposit business, lending business, securities investment business, and exchange business, as well as banking business agency business, credit guarantee business, credit card business, and investment fund management business. The leasing business is engaged in the provision of leasing business. In addition, the Company is also engaged in information processing consignment business and software development business.

name: IMAGE MAGIC INC
businessSummary: Image Magic Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in developing its business as a digital transformation (DX) company for manufacturing that utilizes the system. The On-demand Print Solution (ODPS) segment provides on-demand print services for products such as apparel and miscellaneous goods using the Internet, and provides on-demand print mechanisms to businesses such as apparel makers and printing companies. The on-demand print service is a service that prints and delivers the data submitted by the customer through the Internet site in a short delivery time from the order received, and is promoted by two channels, in-house sales and orders from partner companies. ODPS provides a production management system that has been improved with DX know-how as a cloud service, and sells hardware (printers, folding machines, packing and shipping machines) related to the production and shipping processes cultivated through the on-demand print service.

name: IMAMURA SECURITIES CO LTD
businessSummary: Imamura Securities Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the investment and financial services business with financial instruments trading business as its core business and provides a wide range of services to its customers in both financing and asset management. The principal business is trading of securities, market derivatives transactions or foreign market derivatives transactions, intermediary, agency or agent for trading of securities, intermediary, agency or agent for brokerage of trading of securities in the exchange-traded financial instruments market, underwriting of securities, offering of securities or private placement of securities, the underwriting of securities, the offering or secondary offering of securities and the handling of the offering or secondary offering of securities, or the handling of private placements of securities. The Company is also engaged in businesses incidental to the financial instruments business, gold bullion trading, insurance sale.

name: IMASEN ELECTRIC INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Imasen Electric Industrial Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechanical products and electric products for automobiles, wire harnesses and assistive products. The Company operates through three business segments. The Auto Part Related segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of seat adjusters, window regulators and other automobile mechanical products, as well as lamps, electronic units, horns and other automobile electric products. The Wire Harness segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wire harnesses for aircrafts and equipment. The Assistive Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric wheelchairs, artificial hands, artificial legs and non-powered walking support equipment. The Company is also engaged in the provision of welfare services for employees.

name: IMAGINEER CO LTD
businessSummary: Imagineer Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of content and renewable energy business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Content segment is involved in the provision of mobile content and mobile commerce, the manufacture of character goods, the development and provision of software for home video game consoles, as well as the license business. The mobile content is involved in the development for platforms centering on stamps and applications. The mobile commerce is engaged in the plan, manufacture and sale of original goods limited to Websites. The Renewable Energy segment is involved in the renewable energy business centered on small hydropower generation. The Company is also involved in the publishing business centering on Yakyu Taro.

name: IBIDEN CO LTD
businessSummary: IBIDEN CO., LTD. is primarily engaged in the manufacture of electronic and ceramic products. It operates in two business segments. The Electronics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of printed circuit boards (PCBs) and package substrates, as well as the design of PCB patterns. The Ceramics segment offers environment related ceramic products, special carbon products, fine ceramic products and ceramic fibers. The others business engages in provision of housing equipment and melamine decorative laminated sheets, design and construction of slopes, garden landscape and various facilities, synthetic plastic processing, agricultural seafood processing, information service business, automobile transportation, oil marketing, business support, investment, financing, and land ownership and management business.

name: TECHNO SMART CORP
businessSummary: Techno Smart Corp. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture of machinery and equipment. The Company is engaged in the design, production and sale of various dryers, heat treatment machines, chemical processing machines, and other industrial machines, mainly coating and drying equipment for imparting various functions to substrates such as films, metal foils, and paper. Products include closed edge die (CED) coaters, die coaters, gravure coaters, micro bar coaters for cleaning, two-roll reverse coaters, double-sided simultaneous coaters, floating dryers, unwinder and winder equipment, butt-splicing devices, film feed devices and film laminate devices, among others.

name: INUI GLOBAL LOGISTICS CO LTD
businessSummary: Inui Global Logistics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the overseas shipping business, warehousing and transportation business, and real estate business. It operates through three segments. The Overseas Shipping segment transports cargo by ship (operated by the Company) and provides time charter services to charterers (competitors). The Warehousing and Transportation segment is engaged in the warehousing business, including general warehousing and storage of duty-unpaid import and export cargo with permission from a bonded warehouse, the document storage business, which stores document boxes and fixtures in warehouses certified by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, and the freight transportation business, including the transportation of cargo deposited in warehouses and moving services. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the facility leasing business, renting out owned houses and offices.

name: INABATA & CO LTD
businessSummary: Inabata & Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the sale and manufacture of products in the fields of information and electronics, chemicals, consumer goods, synthetic resins, and other fields. The Company's main businesses are the buying and selling of goods, manufacturing and selling of products, and provision of services. It also develops domestic and overseas strategies. It operates in four segments. The Information and Electronics segment sells semiconductors and liquid crystal materials, machinery and equipment, dyes and pigments for copiers and printers, and materials. The Chemicals segment sells raw materials for automotive parts, resins and rubber, paints, inks and adhesives, papermaking chemicals, dyes and dyeing and weaving materials, wood and laminated lumber. The Consumer Goods segment sells pharmaceutical and agrochemical ingredients, fine chemicals, insecticides and toiletry ingredients. The Synthetic Resins segment sells general-purpose resins, engineering plastics and others.

name: ITOKURO INC
businessSummary: ItoKuro Inc. is a Japan-based company, mainly engaged in media services and consulting services. The Company operates Internet media business segment. It's media services is engaged in operating specialized domain-specific portal site in education industry. It's consulting services is engaged in supporting the marketing activities of client companies in education industry. The main features of the media service are a locomi stock model, a large volume of customers, and a performance-based billing system.

name: ITOHAM YONEKYU HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: ITOHAM YONEKYU HOLDINGS INC. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed meat products and meat products.. The Company operates in two business segments. The Processed Meat segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of ham, sausages and other processed meat products. The Meat segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of meat and processed foods. The other business includes administrative agency service business and logistics service business.

name: ITOCHU ENEX CO LTD
businessSummary: Itochu Enex Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in home-life business, car-life business, industrial business, and power and utility business. The Company operates through four segments. The Home Life Business segment is engaged in the sale and provision of services of liquefied petroleum (LP) gas, kerosene, electric power, life-related equipment and smart energy equipment. The Car Life Business segment is engaged in the sale and provision of services of gasoline, kerosene, light oil, electric power, and automobiles. The Industrial Business segment is engaged in the sale and provision of services of gasoline, kerosene, light oil, heavy oil, LP gas, and gas-to-liquid (GTL) fuel, the import and export of petroleum products, and the lease of terminal tanks. The Power & Utility Business segment is engaged in electric power generation, steam, district heating service, comprehensive energy service, electric heat supply service, asset management, and rental car business.

name: ITOCHU CORP
businessSummary: Itochu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the trading business. Food segment produces, distributes and sells food products. Energy & Chemicals segment trades and operates in the fields of energy, chemicals and electricity. Living & Lifestyle segment operates in the fields of living materials and logistics, as well as real estate. Machinery segment engages in the infrastructure-related business, power generation and other businesses. Metals segment engages in metal mineral resource development, steel product processing, trade of iron, ore and coal, non-ferrous metals and light metals and steel products. Information & Financial segment engages in information technology (IT) solutions, mobile distribution and services in the information and communications field, as well as financial services and insurance businesses. Textile segment engages in global business in goods from textile raw materials, yarns and fabrics to clothing. Eighth segment collaborates with other segments.

name: ITO EN LTD
businessSummary: Ito En Ltd is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tea and drinks. The Company operates in three business segments. The Leaf and Drink related segment purchases and manufactures tea leaf products, and sells them throughout Japan, mainly green tea, barley tea, and oolong tea. This segment also plans and develops beverage products, outsources production to manufacturers outside the group, and then purchases the finished products and sells them nationwide. The Food and Drink related segment operates and franchises restaurants of specialty coffee in Japan. The Others segment is involved in the manufacture and sell of supplements in United States.

name: IDEMITSU KOSAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd is Japan-based company primarily engaged in fossil fuel-related businesses. The Company operates five business segments. The Fuel Oil segment is engaged in the production, sales, import & export, and trading of refined petroleum products. The Basic Chemicals Segment is engaged in the production and sale of olefins and aromatics products. The High Functional Materials segment is engaged in lubricants, functional chemicals, electronic materials, functional pavement materials, and agribio products. The Power & Renewable Energy segment is engaged in power generation (includes thermal, solar, wind), power sales, and solar cell operations. The Resources segment is engaged in exploration, development, production, and sales of energy resources such as crude oil, natural gas, and coal. The Company also conducts insurance and intra-group service businesses.

name: ICHIKEN CO LTD
businessSummary: ICHIKEN Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in construction business, such as construction, civil engineering and interior finish construction, as well as real estate business. The Company opreates its business through two business segments. Construction segment is involved in the operation of the business related to general construction, civil engineering and other construction work. Real Estate segment is involved in the sale and leasing of real estate, as well as other business related to real estate.

name: IDEC CORP
businessSummary: IDEC CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of control equipment related products. The Company operates in four geographic segments, including Japan, America, EMEA and Asia Pacific. The main business is manufacturing and sale of human machine interface (HMI) solutions, in-board equipment solutions, automation solutions, safety and explosion-proof solutions, systems, and others. HMI solutions include switches, joysticks and indicator lights. In-board equipment solutions include switching power supplies, terminal blocks, control relays sockets, circuit protectors and others. Automation solutions include programmable controllers, programmable displays, photoelectric switches and automatic recognition devices. Safety and explosion-proof solutions include safety-related equipment and explosion-proof equipment. The Company is also engaged in manufacture and sale of systems, collaborative safety robot system business and environment energy business.

name: IZUMI CO LTD
businessSummary: IZUMI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general retail business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Retail segment is engaged in the sale of clothing, housing-related goods and food products through its shopping centers, general merchandise stores (GMSs) and supermarkets. The Retail-related segment is engaged in the credit and finance business, the management of shop facilities, as well as the operation of restaurants. The Company is also engaged in the wholesale business and the real estate leasing business.

name: ISUZU MOTORS LTD
businessSummary: Isuzu Motors Ltd is a Japan-based automobile manufacturer. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles, parts, and industrial engines, and provides logistics and other services related to these products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial vehicles and light commercial vehicles (LCVs), such as large-sized trucks, buses, small-sized trucks and pick-up trucks, as well as automobile components and industrial engines.

name: ISHIHARA SANGYO KAISHA LTD
businessSummary: Ishihara Sangyo Kaisha Ltd is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical industrial products in the organic chemical field, centered on agrochemicals, and the inorganic chemical field, centered on functional materials and titanium oxide, as well as other businesses. The Company operates three segments. The Organic Chemical segment includes agrochemicals such as herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides, veterinary medicines, pharmaceuticals, and organic intermediates. The Inorganic Chemical segment includes functional materials, titanium oxide, and other chemical products. The Others segment is engaged in trading and construction businesses. The trading business sells organic and inorganic chemical products and procures raw materials, as well as purchases and sells general chemical industrial products. The construction business constructs and repairs production facilities, and outsources the construction and repair of plants.

name: ISHIZUKA GLASS CO LTD
businessSummary: ISHIZUKA GLASS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of glass container-related products, houseware-related products, paper container-related products, plastic containers-related products, industrial equipment related products and others. The Glass Bottles-related segment manufactures and sells glass containers. Houseware-related segment manufactures and sells glass and ceramics dishes. The Paper Containers-related segment manufactures and sells paper containers and related filling machines. The Plastic Containers-related segment manufactures and sells preform for PET bottle. The Industrial Equipment-related business manufactures and sells heating and cooking utensils, such as top plate. The Others segment manufactures and sells ceramics products and metal caps.

name: IHI CORP
businessSummary: IHI Corp is engaged in the resources, energy and environment, social infrastructure, industrial systems and general machinery, and aerospace and defense. The Company operates in four business segments. Resource & Energy & Environment segment provides land-use prime mover plants, marine engines and other prime movers, carbon solutions, and nuclear power equipment. Social Infrastructure segment provides bridges and sluices, transportation systems, shield systems, concrete construction materials, and urban development. Industrial System & General-Purpose Machinery segment provides vehicle turbochargers, parking, rotating machinery, heat and surface treatment, material handling equipment, and logistics and industrial systems machinery. Aerospace & Space & Defense segment provides aero engines, rocket systems and space applications, and defense equipment systems. The Company also provides services for equipment and devices for communications, electronics, electrical measurement.

name: ISAMU PAINT CO LTD
businessSummary: Isamu Paint Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of paints and related products. The Paint segment is divided into automobile repair, industrial, and architectural applications. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various paints, thinners, aerosol products, the process of semi-finished products, the filling and subdivision work of products, and purchase and sale of related products. The Company is also engaged in the management of real estate rentals and parking lots.

name: SENSHU IKEDA HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Senshu Ikeda Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in banking business, as well as securities business, leasing business, credit guarantee business and credit card business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Banking segment includes deposit business, lending business, commodity securities trading business, securities investment business, domestic foreign exchange business, foreign exchange business, trusteeship of corporate bond enrollment and registration business and incidental business. The Leasing segment is involved in the provision of leasing services for industrial machines, machine tools, electronic calculators and office equipment. The Company is also involved in the provision of cash settlement, printing and outsourcing service, temporary staff service, as well as assessment and survey of collateral real estate, development and operation of station automatic teller machines (ATM).

name: IIDA GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Iida Group Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the detached houses sale business, the condominiums sale business, the contract construction business and related business. The Company has six business segments. The Hajime Construction Group segment and the Arnest One segment are engaged in the detached houses sale business, the condominiums sale business and the contract construction business. The Iida Industry Group segment is engaged in the detached houses sale business, the condominiums sale business, the contract construction business, the real estate leasing business and the spa hot springs business. The Toei Housing Group segment and the Tact Home Group segment are engaged in the detached houses sale business, the contract construction business and the real estate leasing business. The ID Home segment is engaged in the detached houses sale business and the contract construction business. The Company is also engaged in the sale and processing of wood products.

name: AKATSUKI EAZIMA CO LTD
businessSummary: AKATSUKI EAZIMA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the design, construction and maintenance management of facilities such as air conditionings, plumbing and sanitations. The Company has three business segments. The Facility segment is engaged in the general facilities work such as building facilities work, renewal work, civil engineering work, plant work and building care work, as well as the maintenance and management of equipment. The Solar Power Generation segment is engaged in the solar power generation business, and the sale of power. The Other segment is engaged in the sale and leasing of real estate, and other business.

name: ESOL CO LTD
businessSummary: eSOL Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in operation system (OS) development for embedded devices and contract development of embedded software. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Embedded Software segment is mainly involved in the development and sale of real-time operating system (RTOS) and development support tools, as well as the provision of engineering services. The Sensing Solution segment is involved in the development and sale of automotive printers, cold handy terminals, environmentally handicapped handy terminals, sales support software, as well as the proposal of the sensor network system to the markets where information and communication technology (ICT) is behind, such as agriculture and fishery business.

name: E J HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: E J Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of a general construction consulting business. The Company is engaged in the provision of a comprehensive construction consulting business that can provide an integrated service from planning to construction supervision for public works projects of government offices. The general construction consulting business includes construction consulting services such as planning, design, diagnosis, management, client support, and compensation consulting, as well as survey services such as surveying and geological surveys.

name: EGUARANTEE INC
businessSummary: eGuarantee, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the credit guarantee business. The Company is involved in the analysis and screening of information based on the corporate credit information database, as well as the promotion of liquidation for transference of credit risks. The Company provides guarantee services for industrial corporations, including the entrusted business for risks with bad debts, such as trading and contract agreements, as well as guarantee services for financial corporations, including the entrusted businesses for risks with financial obligations, advanced payment debts and repayment claims. The Company operates its business through community banks, major city banks, trust banks, security companies, commercial firms, major financial institutions, leasing companies, nonbanks, and insurance agents in Tokyo, Osaka, Kyushu and Nagoya Prefectures.

name: E-GUARDIAN INC
businessSummary: E-Guardian Inc. is a company mainly engaged in the bulletin board post monitoring business. The social support business focuses on the development of new services such as monitoring, customer support, operation and analysis, and deep sales to existing customers. The game support business conducts multi-lingual customer support orders from Chinese and Korean overseas game companies entering the Japanese market. Ad space business conducts the expansion of provision services such as ad space management, drafting management, ad writing, etc. Other businesses include hiring and training of human resources.

name: EMNET JAPAN CO LTD
businessSummary: eMnet Japan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the internet advertising business. The Company is involved in the provision of services such as search advertising, operational display advertising, social media advertising, video advertising, affiliate advertising, ad network advertising, digital signal processor (DSP), data management platform (DMP), smartphone advertising, native advertising, application advertising and net advertising. The Company also provides one-stop advertising including planning, operation, analysis and improvement, and provides comprehensive services as a consultant on internet advertising. The Company also gains know-how from the experience of advertisement operation on the client's electronic commerce (EC) sites and receives the creative production order at its own company.

name: ANRITSU CORP
businessSummary: ANRITSU CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of measurement equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. The Measurement Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of measurement equipment for digital communications and Internet protocol (IP) networks, optical communications and mobile communications, general-purpose measurement equipment for radio frequency (RF), microwave bands and millimeter wavebands, as well as service assurance. The Products, Quality and Assurance (PQA) segment is engaged in the provision of automated weight sorters, automated electronic measurement equipment, foreign substance detectors, as well as integrated quality management and control systems. The Company is also engaged in the provision of information communication, related devices, logistics and welfare services, the leasing of real estate, the manufacture of components, as well as the human resources (HR) and accounting related clerical business.

name: AMVIS HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Amvis Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical center business. The Company's core business is to provide consulting services to Ambis regarding the operation and management of paid nursing homes, and leasing land and buildings for use as paid nursing homes. The medical center business is primarily operated by Ambis, and meets the needs of customers, such as highly medically dependent individuals and their families, who are anxious and worried about where to go after being discharged from the hospital, by organically combining home visit services such as visiting nursing, visiting care, and home care support with facility-based services such as paid nursing homes.

name: AND FACTORY INC
businessSummary: and factory, inc mainly engages in Smartphone APP business and Internet of Things (IoT) business. The Company operates three segments. The Smartphone APP segment develops and operates a bulletin board application called strongest series that seeks the strategy of popular smartphone game applications managed by other companies and recruits partners of multiplayer, as well as provides saevices through distribution platform such as App Store. The IoT segment develops IoT platform applications that enable operation of multiple IoT devices, develops accommodation area related technology, and provides IoT service. The Other segment operates the advertising agency business related to advertisement distribution service using the smartphone application or media managed by the company as a publication medium.

name: AWA BANK LTD
businessSummary: Awa Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking services, leasing services and other financial services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the provision of deposits, lending, securities investment, domestic exchange, and foreign exchange services, and the provision of financial products and services through the sales of public bonds, investment trusts and insurance, financial products brokerage, and trust products. The Company is also engaged in the provision of banking services, credit guarantee services, credit card services, and management consulting services as supplements to the banking business. The Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing business.

name: ALPHA PURCHASE CO LTD
businessSummary: AlphaPurchase Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the provision of various required solutions to achieve indirect cost reduction. The Company operates two segments. Maintenance Repair and Operations (MRO) segment is mainly engaged in the sale of MRO products such as equipment and machinery repair supplies, stationery, office supplies on closed information technology platforms. Facility Management (FM) segment is mainly engaged in the provision of construction and other materials for new construction, renovation, and maintenance of commercial facilities, as well as maintenance and management of facilities and equipment. The Company also conducts business related to the collection, processing and provision of various types of information, as well as computer-based provision of information.

name: ALPS ALPINE CO LTD
businessSummary: Alps Alpine Co Ltd isa Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to the components, sensors and communications, and modules and systems businesses. The company operates through three business segments. The Components Business segment manufactures and sells electronic components such as switches, actuators, and haptics. The Sensors and Communications Business segment manufactures and sells electronic components for sensors and communication devices. The Modules and Systems Business segment manufactures and sells automotive modules, infotainment, display, and sound products. The Company also operates businesses related to system development, office services, finance and leasing, and logistics.

name: ALTECH CORP
businessSummary: Altech Corporation is a Japan-based company that principally engaged in the provision of outsourcing services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Outsourcing Service segment is engaged in the dispatching of technicians for mechanical, electrical and information processing and designing; the undertaken of technology projects, as well as staffing and contracted operation of office support and computer-aided design (CAD) business. The Global segment is engaged in the installation and maintenance of industrial machinery and equipment for overseas Japanese factories, as well as the provision of human resource services. The Company has four subsidiaries.

name: ALFRESA HOLDINGS CORP
businessSummary: Alfresa Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the wholesale of drugs. The Company operates in four business segments. The Pharmaceutical Wholesale segment is engaged in the wholesale of medical products, test reagents, as well as medical equipment and materials. The Self Medication Wholesale segment is engaged in the wholesale of general drugs. The Pharmaceutical Manufacture segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals, test reagents, medical equipment and implements, as well as pharmaceutical powders. The Medical-Related segment is mainly engaged in operation of pharmacies. The others business is engaged in the information system business, the transportation business, the warehousing business, the insurance agency business, the real estate management business, the sale of miscellaneous goods, as well as the manpower dispatching business, among others.

name: ALCONIX CORP
businessSummary: ALCONIX CORPORATION is a distributor of various nonferrous metal products. The Company operates in four business segments. Electronic and Functional Material segment offers compound semiconductor, electronic material, titanium product, nickel product and rare metal. Aluminum Copper segment provides aluminum product, copper and copper alloy, aluminum secondary alloy ingot and non-ferrous scrap, metallic silicon, zinc alloy ingot, magnesium ingot, various piping machinery and material, aluminum die casting product and others, as well as metal fitting work, renewal of building and condominium, and remodeling work. Equipment Material segment provides copper, nickel plating material and related chemical, nondestructive inspection equipment and others, as well as thermal spraying work. Metal Processing segment provides precision mechanical parts for communication equipment, surface mounting machine for semiconductor, and precision press mold and press parts for automobile.

name: ULVAC INC
businessSummary: Ulvac Inc is a Japan-based company that operates a vacuum-related business, providing products as capital goods to industrial fields that utilize vacuum technology. The Company operates through two business segments. The Vacuum Equipment Business segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of sputtering equipment for liquid-crystal displays, organic electroluminescence (EL) manufacturing equipment, take-up type vacuum vapor deposition equipment, sputtering equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, vacuum pumps and measuring equipment. The Vacuum Application Business segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance for vacuum-applied products including sputtering target materials and analytical equipment.

name: ALTECH CO LTD
businessSummary: ALTECH CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the purchase and sale of industrial machine and equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of plastic bottle preforms and plastic caps. The company operates through two business segments. The Business Firm segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of industrial machinery, equipment, as well as the provision of related services. Main product of this segment is plastic bottle related inspection equipment, plastic bottle molding dies, security related devices and synthetic resin materials, among others. The Preform segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic bottle preforms and plastic caps, as well as the provision of related services.

name: ARGO GRAPHICS INC
businessSummary: ARGO GRAPHICS Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the product lifecycle management (PLM) business and electronic design automation (EDA) business. The PLM segment consists of PLM solution business, system building support business and hardware maintenance and other business. The PLM solution business is engaged in the provision of PLM solutions, which target at the productivity improvement in manufacturing processes. The system building support business provides system building support services for the servers and personal computer (PC) clusters of manufacturers. The hardware maintenance (HM) and other business maintains the machines provided by the PLM solution and the system building support businesses. The EDA segment sells computer aided design (CAD) systems for electronic components and micro fabrication, including large scale integrated circuits, liquid crystal displays and other flat panel displays (FPD), magnetic head and micro machine.

name: ALUE CO LTD
businessSummary: Alue Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the human resource development business. The Company provides corporate service and individual service. In the corporate service, the Company conducts business skill training, mind training and language research, promotes the growth of corporates and individuals, provides classroom-based research, overseas dispatch training, overseas classroom training and corporate ALUGO for government agencies, private enterprises, school corporations and local governments. In the individual service, the Company provides ALUGO of English conversation service provided for corporate customers for individuals to improve homework and counseling learning support, builds an accompanying system, provides services in the form of ALUGO.

name: ARISAWA MFG CO LTD
businessSummary: Arisawa Mfg Co Ltd is a Japan-based mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of electronic materials, display materials, electric insulation materials, and industrial structural materials. The Company operates through four segments. Electronic Materials segment produces materials for flexible and rigid printed wiring boards. Industrial Structural Materials segment produces filament winding (FW) moldings, aircraft honeycomb panels and prepregs, pultrusion moldings, fiber reinforced plastic (FRP) ski seats, and others. Electrical Insulation Materials segment produces glass cloth, glass tapes, and prepregs for electric insulation. Display Materials segment produces three-dimensional (3D) display filters, special optical components and others.

name: ARIAKE JAPAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Ariake Japan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of natural seasonings. Together with its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in the production and sale of natural soups in domestic market; lease part of head office building and operation of convenience store; the manufacture and sale of natural seasonings in China, Taiwan, Southeast of Asia and European markets; as well as the production of agricultural products.

name: ARATA CORP
businessSummary: Arata Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the wholesale of cosmetics, daily used products, household products and pet products. The Company's main business is the wholesale of daily necessities, cosmetics and others, mainly to drugstores, home improvement centers, supermarkets, and general merchandise stores. Health and beauty products include cosmetics, shampoo, soap, bath additives, and oral care products. Household products include laundry detergent, kitchen detergent, dishwashing detergent, and household cleaners. Home care products include insecticides, air fresheners/deodorizers, and batteries. Paper products include household paper, tissues, toilet paper, and disposable diapers. Household goods include plastic wrap/toilet paper, sponges/scrubbing brushes, cooking utensils, and cleaning supplies. Pet supplies include pet food and pet supplies.

name: AMIYA CORP
businessSummary: Amiya Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the data security business and network security business. The Company operates two business segments. The Data Security segment is involved in the development, sale and maintenance of log management software products, as well as the construction, auditing and operation support of information security management systems. The Network Security segment is involved in the consulting, design, construction and operation agency of network security systems, as well as the development and sale of cloud network services. The segment is also involved in the sale and rental of network equipment to build network security systems and provide services.

name: AMANO CORP
businessSummary: Amano Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of time information systems and environment-related system equipment. The Company operates through two business segments. The Time Information System segment is involved in the manufacture, sale and export sale of information system equipment, mainly employment information systems and payroll systems, and time management equipment, mainly time clocks, the sale of parking system equipment, as well as parking lots operation management, software products development and others. The Environmental-related System segment provides dust collectors, powder and granular material pneumatic conveying systems, high-temperature poisonous gas removal systems and electrolyzed water generation equipment and cleaning equipment. This segment also provides welfare services, non-life insurance agency services, work environment measurement, environmental measurement certification business and related consulting services.

name: AMADA CO LTD
businessSummary: Amada Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of metal processing equipment and metal machine tools, as well as the provision of related services. The Company operates in two segments. The Metal Processing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of products such as laser machines, punch and laser combined processing equipment, press brakes, bending robots, shirring, plate processing system lines, factory automation (FA) computers and software, as well as welding equipment such as precision laser equipment and resistance welding equipment. The Metal Machine Tool segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cutting products such as metal cutting saws, shape steel cutting equipment, drilling equipment and metal cutting saws, press products such as mechanical presses, as well as machine tools such as grinding machines. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: ABEJA INC
businessSummary: ABEJA Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in digital platform business. The Company operates through the digital platform business. The Company is classified into two main areas base on ABEJA Platform. In the transformation area, introducing the ABEJA Platform and providing professional services that meet the digital transformation needs of companies. In the operation area, various systems built on the ABEJA Platform are provided as general mechanisms and services.

name: APPLIED CO LTD
businessSummary: Applied Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of personal computers (PCs). The Company operates in three business segments. The PC and Game segment is mainly involved in the sale of PCs and games; provision of support services and field services for PCs, as well as contract development of software. The Cosmetics and Sundries segment is involved in the retail of cosmetics and sundries. The Publication and Advertising segment is involved in the publication of information magazines and planning books, and the proposal of the whole advertisement and promotion services for companies.

name: AINAVO HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: AINAVO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., is a Japan-based company involved in the large-sized property business and the detached house business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Detached House segment is engaged in the sale and construction of various tile products such as interior and exterior tiles, floor tiles, exteriors and other related products, and housing related products such as bathtubs, water heaters, system kitchens, sanitary equipment, solar power generation systems and other products. The Large-sized Property segment is engaged in the interior tile, exterior tile and floor tile construction works, the housing equipment construction works such as unit baths, system kitchens, bathtubs and others, the large ceramic tile works made of stones and dry methods, and the air conditioning and sanitary equipment works.

name: ANEST IWATA CORP
businessSummary: ANEST IWATA Corporation is a Japan-based manufacturing company. The Company is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of compressors, vacuum equipment, as well as painting equipment and facilities. The Company mainly operates its businesses in Italy, France, Germany, China, India and Thailand.

name: ANICOM HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Anicom Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of non-life insurance, pet Internet services, veterinary clinic management, and health innovation businesses. The Company has four business segments. The Non-life Insurance Business segment includes pet insurance and pet liability insurance. The Pet Internet Services Business segment operates breeder matching sites and foster parent matching sites for adoptions. The Veterinary Clinic Management Business segment operates veterinary clinics. The Health Innovation Business segment promotes animal health checks and develops and sells oral and intestinal care products based on various tests. The Company also provides veterinary clinic support, insurance agency services, and genetic testing.

name: ADVANTEST CORP
businessSummary: Advantest Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor and component test system product lines and mechatronics-related product lines, as well as other related research and development, maintenance and service activities. The Company consists of three business segments. The Semiconductor and Component Test Systems Business segment provides test system products such as System on Chip (SoC) test systems and memory test systems for the semiconductor and electronic component industries. The Mechatronics-related Business segment provides test handlers for mechatronics-applied products that handle semiconductor devices, device interfaces that interface with the device under test, and nanotechnology-related products. The Services and Others segment provides comprehensive customer solutions, solutions for system-level testing of solid state drive (SSD) and other devices, support services, used equipment sales, and equipment leasing.

name: ADVANCED MEDIA INC
businessSummary: Advanced Media, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the voice recognition business. The Voice Recognition segment operates through three business divisions. The Solution division is engaged in the planning, design, development of voice recognition solutions embedded with voice-recognition technology. The Product division provides applications embedded with voice-recognition technology. The Service segment provides other services utilizing voice-recognition technology. The Company provides its solutions, applications and services to enterprises and institutions in a variety of industries, including call centers, manufacture and distribution, mobiles, entertainment and education, medical and conference recording, as well as individual customers.

name: ADVAN CO LTD
businessSummary: Advan Group Co Ltd, formerly Advan Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the import and sale of building finishing materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Construction Materials Related segment is engaged in the import and sale of construction materials such as stones, tiles, housing-related products, fireplaces and stoves, faucets, system kitchens and other building materials, as well as the related construction works. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing and management of distribution centers and other real estates. The Others segment is engaged in the wholesale of imported bricks, pots and other gardening-related products, as well as the logistics management business.

name: ATOM LIVIN TECH CO LTD
businessSummary: ATOM LIVIN TECH Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the planning, development and distribution of interior hardware products which focuses on furniture hardware and architectural hardware products. The Company sells its products to house makers, housing facility and equipment makers, architectural material manufacturers and architectural hardware stores under the brand name ATOM. The Company operates its business as a fabless manufacturer. The Company is engaged in the provision of door locks, hinges, sliding hinges, hinged doors, sliding door locks, sliding door hardware products, overhead hanging sliding door fittings, moving partition fittings, folding door fittings, indoor aluminum fittings, handles, slide rails, wire baskets, storage and hanging brackets and others. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: ADISH CO LTD
businessSummary: Adish Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of customer relations services, including support for social applications (Apps), social risk posting monitoring and cyber bullying countermeasures. The Company provides four kinds of services. Social app support provides customer support services that respond to inquiries from users on behalf of client companies. Internet monitoring provides a service that monitors posts made by users 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and responds to alerts, reports, warnings, non-display, when inappropriate posts are found. School guardian provides consulting services to monitor writing and potential personal information breaches on the Internet that could be an issue in school life and use them in student guidance. Front support provides services for companies to maintain and improve connections with users and form a fan community by interacting with users using social media.

name: ATSUGI CO LTD
businessSummary: ATSUGI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of socks and inner wear products. The Company has three business segments. The Textile segment is primarily involved in the manufacture, purchase and sale of textile products, as well as the provision of logistics services. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the sale and leasing of real estate properties. The Others segment is involved in the purchase and sale of nursing care products.

name: ICHIGO GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Ichigo Inc. is a real estate company. The Company has four business segments. The Asset Management segment involves in the sourcing of target real estate, funding, property management, facility management and others. The Shinchiku segment aims to improve asset value by maximizing the use of the Company’s real estate technology and know-how, and after the completion of value improvement of real estate. The Clean Energy segment involves in the effective utilization of real estate, as well as the solar business. The Others segment involves in the sales of investment securities, as well as other financial related business.

name: ASTI CORP
businessSummary: ASTI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of in-car electrical components, home electronics, communications and control equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The In-car Electrical Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronics control units, air condition control systems, in-car and marine wire harnesses. The Home Electronic segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale electronic control boards for washing machines, dish washers and drying tumblers. The Communications and Control Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of communication switch units and industrial robot controller boards. The Company is also engaged in the power electronics business and the medical business.

name: ASGENT INC
businessSummary: Asgent, Inc. is a Japan-based security solution vendor engaged in the distribution of network security related products and product combination services using consulting know-how. The Company is engaged in the import and sale of network security-related products, as well as the provision of related services.

name: AZOOM CO LTD
businessSummary: AZoom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in idle asset utilization business and visualization business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Idle Asset Utilization segment operates the monthly parking lot portal site CarParking and provides a monthly parking lot introduction service that introduce parking lots, as well as renting vacant parking lots from parking lot owners and subleasing them to users as monthly parking lots. The Company's business focuses on monthly parking sublease services. The Company also offer SMART KUKANYOYAKU, a Web reservation system that supports the operation of rental spaces such as conference rooms, gyms, studios and others, Coupa Search, a portal site for hourly parking lots, AdWall, a search site for outdoor advertising spaces. The Visualization segment utilizes specialized skills 3D computer graphics (3DCG) technology to help explain how buildings and spaces are used and how to visualize the finished product.

name: ASTROSCALE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: Astroscale Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in research and development of technologies related to on-orbit services such as debris removal, and in-space demonstrations. The Company provides four services, including end-of-life (EOL) service, active debris removal (ADR) service, life extension (LEX) service, and in-situ space situational awareness (ISSA) service. EOL service is a removal service to prevent satellites that have finished operating from becoming debris. ADR service is a service to remove existing debris by launching a servicer of the Company's group, capturing the existing debris, descending its orbit, and burning it in the atmosphere. LEX service is a service to extend the operational period of a satellite or to transfer it to another orbit. ISSA service launches observation satellites, safely approaches objects at close range, and acquires data on the target object, which can be used to analyze the cause of failures and to understand the target object.

name: A&A MATERIAL CORP
businessSummary: A&A Material Corporation is primarily engaged in manufacture and sale of building materials and various industrial products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction and Building Materials segment provides non-combustible materials and design and construction work, two-layer tubes, and design and construction work of steel frame refractory coating. The Industrials Products and Engineering segment manufactures and sells non-combustible textiles, equipment and materials for vessels, sound insulating materials, expansion joints and others, friction materials, seal materials, heat insulating materials, and design and construction work of thermal insulation, cold insulation, air conditioning, heat insulation, sound insulation, fireproofing. Additionally, the Company is also involved in real estate rental business.

name: ASUKANET CO LTD
businessSummary: Asukanet Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital processing and production of photos and images. The Company operates in three business segments. The Memorial Design Services segment is engaged in the provision of digital processing services for portraits of deceased persons, the provision of funeral-related production services. The Personal Publishing Services segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of individual photo albums targeting at the professional photography markets and general consumer markets. The Aerial Imaging segment is engaged in the research and marketing activities related to aerial imaging technology.

name: AJINOMOTO CO INC
businessSummary: Ajinomoto Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food business. The Company operates in three business segments. Seasonings & Foods segment is engaged in the provision of seasonings, nutritional and processed foods, and solutions & ingredients. The Frozen Foods segment is engaged in the provision of frozen foods. The Health Care and Other segment is engaged in the provision of pharmaceutical- and food-use amino acids, biopharmaceutical services, functional materials, and other products and services.

name: PRONEXUS INC
businessSummary: PRONEXUS INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production of corporate disclosure and investor relations (IR) related documents. The Company is involved in the provision of four kinds products. Listed companies disclosure-related products include the production support for the legal disclosure documents and contents of listed company. Listed companies IR-related products include the production support for the IR tools and contents of listed company. Financial products disclosure-related products include the production support for the legal disclosure documents and sales promotion tools for investment trust and real estate investment trust management companies. Database-related products include database for the searching of corporate information, financial information and legal information.

name: ASIAQUEST CO LTD
businessSummary: AsiaQuest Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital transformation (DX) business that supports system development, process improvement and business model transformation of client companies. The Company is engaged in the provision of Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, Web system and mobile application development services and cloud infrastructures. The IoT and AI solution service is engaged in the development of systems that utilize sensors, AI and big data. The Web system and mobile application development service is engaged in the development of Web systems and mobile applications, and the provision of interface design services, system architecture design services and others. The cloud infrastructure construction and operation service is engaged in the provision of cloud integration services such as migration works and cloud environment construction works, and the design, construction and operation of various cloud infrastructures.

name: ASIRO INC
businessSummary: Asiro Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of legal media sites for lawyer industry. The Company operates through two business segments. Legal Media-related Business segment is classified into legal media, which provides marketing support services to lawyers, and derivative media, which provides marketing support services to advertisers other than lawyers. Legal media includes divorce, traffic accident, inheritance, labor problem, criminal case, debt collection, debt consolidation, information technology (IT), and corporate legal lawyer navigations. Other derivative media include Carism, a career change agent media site, Uwaki Investigation Navigation, a field-specific detective media site, and Hitosagashi, a field-specific detective media site. The Legal Human Resources (HR) Business segment is engaged in the provision of job change support services for qualified lawyers, and operation of a specialized job change site NO-LIMIT for lawyers.

name: ASICS CORP
businessSummary: ASICS Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of sports products, such as sports shoes, sportswear, sports equipment and others. The Company operates through six business segments. The Japan Region, Americas Region, Europe Region (including the Middle East and Africa), Oceania/Southeast and South Asia Region, and the East Asia Region segment mainly sell sporting goods. The Others segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of HAGLOFS brand outdoor products.

name: MEBUKI FINANCIAL GROUP INC
businessSummary: Mebuki Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of comprehensive financial services centered on banking business. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of banking business, as well as other business related to financial services such as leasing business, securities business, credit guarantee business and credit card business.

name: ASAHI YUKIZAI CORP
businessSummary: ASAHI YUKIZAI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of industrial resin and plumbing equipment products. The Company operates its business through three business segments. The Pipe System segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of piping materials made of synthetic resin such as vinyl chloride, as well as the design and construction of piping works. The Resin segment manufactures and sells casting resins, resin coated sand for castings, resins for general industrial use, resins for foam materials, resins and derivatives for electronic materials, and resin molding materials. The Water Treatment & Resource Development segment is involved in the design, construction, maintenance and management of water treatment facilities, as well as the design and construction of drilling wells.

name: ARE HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: ARE Holdings Inc, formerly Asahi Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precious metals business and environmental conservation business. The Company operates two businesses. The Precious Metals segment is engaged in the recycling and sale of precious and rare metals such as gold, silver, palladium, and platinum from scrap metal containing precious metals, and refining and processing of precious metals, mainly gold and silver. The Environmental Conservation segment is mainly engaged in the collection, transportation, and intermediate treatment of industrial waste.

name: ASAHI GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Asahi Group Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages, beverage and food products in Japan and overseas. The Company operates through four regional segments: Japan, Europe, Oceania, and Southeast Asia. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages, beverages, foods, and pharmaceuticals. The Europe segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages. The Oceania segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages and beverages. The Southeast Asia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of beverages. The Company also operates a Korean alcoholic beverage business and a feed business.

name: ADEKA CORP
businessSummary: ADEKA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical products and food ingredients. The Company operates through three business segments. The Chemicals segment manufactures and sells resin additive products such as flame retardants; information and electric chemical products such as ultrapure semiconductor materials, light curing resin and others; functional chemical products such as additives, fire retardant, interfacial active agents and kitchen cleaning agents and others. The Life Sciences segment manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals, pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, veterinary medicines, wood medicines, and medical materials. The food segment manufactures and sells margarines, fats and oils for chocolate and others. The Company is also involved in the equipment plant design, construction and construction management, equipment maintenance, logistics, warehousing, leasing of vehicles, real estate, insurance agency and others.

name: ASAHI DIAMOND INDUSTRIAL CO LTD
businessSummary: Asahi Diamond Industrial Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of diamond tools, as well as related business. It manufactures and sells diamond tools (including cubic boron nitride (CBN) tools and grinding wheels) mainly for the electronics and semiconductor, transportation equipment, machinery, stone and construction industries. The types of tools include grinding tools, precision cutting tools, cutting tools, wear-resistant tools, wire drawing tools and dressers. It distributes products mainly to Japan, Asia & Oceania, Europe, North America and Central America.

name: ASAHI KOGYOSHA CO LTD
businessSummary: Asahi Kogyosha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, supervision, and construction of air conditioning and sanitary equipment. The Company has two business segments. The Equipment Construction Business segment focuses on the design, supervision, and construction of air conditioning and sanitary equipment, with its core technology. The Equipment Manufacturing and Sales Business segment, together with the Equipment Construction Business segment, utilizes its air conditioning and temperature and humidity control technologies to manufacture and sell environmental equipment, primarily precision environmental control equipment for semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment.

name: AGC INC
businessSummary: AGC Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of glasses. The Company operates through five segments. The Architectural Glass segment manufactures and sells products such as float plate glass, molded glass, and screened and polished plate glass. The Automotive segment provides automotive glass, cover glass for automotive displays, and other products. The Electronics segment manufactures and sells products such as glass substrates for liquid crystal displays, glass substrates for organic electroluminescence (EL), and peripheral materials for displays. The Chemicals segment manufactures and sells products such as vinyl chloride, raw materials for vinyl chloride, and caustic soda. The Life Science segment provides synthetic pharmaceutical and agrochemical intermediates, bulk pharmaceuticals, and biopharmaceuticals. The Ceramics & Others business handles ceramics products, logistics and financial services.

name: ASAHI KASEI CORP
businessSummary: Asahi Kasei Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the materials business, housing business and healthcare business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Materials segment provides styrene monomer, acrylonitrile, polyethylene, automotive-related fibers, electronic materials, mixed signal large scale integrated circuits (LSI), hall elements, deep ultraviolet light-emitting diodes (LEDs), pharmaceutical and food additives and others. The Housing segment provides construction contracting, renovation and other housing-related business, as well as lightweight aerated concrete (ALC), insulation materials and others. The Healthcare segment provides medical drugs, hemodialysis and apheresis related equipment, virus removal filters, cardiopulmonary resuscitation-related products and others. The Company also provides plant engineering, environmental engineering, various research and information provision businesses, and personnel dispatch and introduction services.

name: ASAHI KAGAKU KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: ASAHI KAGAKU KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company. Along with its subsidiary, the Company is engaged in the molding process of plastics products, the design and manufacture and molding dies for resins. The products of the Company are mainly used for electrical tools and automobiles. The Company operates its business in Japan, China and Thailand.

name: ASAHI INTECC CO LTD
businessSummary: ASAHI INTECC CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of products in the medical device field and industrial device field. The Company operates through two business segments. The Medical segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of private label products and OEM products in the medical device field.
