The Device segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of components in the medical device field and industrial device field.

name: ASAHI CO LTD
businessSummary: ASAHI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of bicycles, parts and accessories, as well as the provision of maintenance and repair services for bicycles. Its bicycle products include ordinary bicycles, sports bicycles, children bicycles, electric bicycles and foldable bicycles. It is also involved in the sale of bicycle parts and accessories through the Internet. The Company carries bicycles of original brands as well as private brands manufactured from overseas, and provides its products to home centers (HCs).

name: ASAKUMA CO LTD
businessSummary: ASAKUMA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Company is mainly engaged in the operation of Asakuma and Yappari-Asakuma restaurants which offer steaks and hamburgs. The Asakuma restaurants are mainly engaged in the provision of steaks, hamburgs and salads. The Yappari-Asakuma restaurants are mainly engaged in the provision of steaks and hamburgers as fast food. The Company is also engaged in the operation of various restaurants, including Farmers Garden, Yebisusan, Orandazaka Coffee, Surabaya and Wayang Bali.

name: ACOM CO LTD
businessSummary: Acom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in loan and credit card business, credit guarantee business, overseas financial business, debt management and collection business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Loan and Credit Card segment provides the unsecured loan business and the credit card business with MasterCard as the main product. The Credit Guarantee segment is engaged in credit guarantee business. The Overseas Financial segment includes unsecured loan business in Thailand and the Philippines, installation loan business in Thailand (individual credit purchase brokerage business), and banking business in Indonesia. The Debt Management and Collection segment provides servicer business including debt management and collection business. The others include contracting a contact center and dispatching human resources business.

name: AXELSPACE HOLDINGS CORPORATION
businessSummary: Axelspace Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of small satellites. The Company operates through two business segments. The AxelLiner Business segment provides development, manufacturing, and operation services for small satellites, as well as commissioned testing and research services related to space development from government agencies. The AxelGlobe Business segment provides image data of the earth's surface obtained from its small satellites, analysis services for that image data, and solution services based on the analysis results.

name: AXELL CORP
businessSummary: AXELL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sales of semiconductor products. The Company is engaged in the sale of light-emitting diode (LED) driver LSIs and memory modules while positioning graphic large-scale integration (LSI) as a core product for pachinko and pachislot machine market. The Company also sells graphics LSIs for liquid crystal display devices mounted on factory automation (FA) equipment, medical equipment, large construction equipment. The Company is also engaged in the development of evaluation boards and support software to reduce the development burden of customers. The Company is also engaged in the early commercialization activities in middleware, machine learning, blockchain and security four new areas.

name: AXYZ CO LTD
businessSummary: AXYZ Co.,Ltd. is a Japn-based company mainly engaged in the provision of chicken. The Company operates through two business segments. The Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed chicken products such as fried chicken, liver stewed chicken, and chicken nuggets, using chickens raised by non-medication and directly managed fattening facilities breeding. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of zeolite products and shirasu balloons, and the sale of non-chemical fertilizer-reduced pesticide vegetables. The Restaurant segment operates Kentucky Fried Chicken and Pizza Hut franchise stores.

name: AKATSUKI INC
businessSummary: Akatsuki Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the mobile game business and live experience (LX) business in the entertainment area. The Company has a single segment of the mobile game business. The Mobile Game business is engaged in the provision of mobile games in the platform operated by Japan social networking service (SNS) operator, as well as app market provided by Apple Inc., Google Inc. and other companies.

name: AOYAMA TRADING CO LTD
businessSummary: AOYAMA TRADING Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business related to clothing items. The Company operates in six business segments. The Business Wear business sells men's and women's business wear and related western goods, commissions correction processing of ready-made clothes, plans for in-store and outside performances, and plans sales consumables. The Casual business is engaged in the sale of casual clothing. The Card business is engaged in the provision of retail finance and credit services. The Printing and Media business is engaged in the printing various flyers and catalogs, publishing magazines, printing and sending direct mail. The Miscellaneous Goods Sales business sells daily miscellaneous goods and processed foods and operates Daiso & Aoyama 100 Yen Plaza. The Comprehensive Repair Service business provides comprehensive repair services such as shoe repair and key duplication. The Company is also engaged in reuse business and restaurant business.

name: AOKI HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: AOKI Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the sale of fashion products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Fashion segment is engaged in the operation of chain stores for men's apparel, women's apparel and accessories under the names of AOKI and ORIHICA. The Anniversaire Bridal segment is engaged in the operation of a wedding hall under the name ANNIVERSAIRE OMOTESANDO. The Karaoke Room Operation segment is engaged in the operation of karaoke bars under the name COTE D'AZUR. The Complex Cafe segment is engaged in the operation of cafes under the name KAIKATSU-CLUB. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate and non-life insurance agency business.

name: AVILEN INC
businessSummary: AVILEN Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the artificial intelligence (AI) solutions business. The AI Solutions Business segment provides two services: the AI Software Unit and the Build-up Unit. The AI Software Unit supports the implementation of AI and data utilization in business processes by utilizing AVILEN AI, a self-developed technology core module. The Build-up Unit supports organizational assessment, roadmap formulation, and organizational development through cross-functional AI human resource development for management, employees, corporate planning, engineers and others, and provides data and analytics (D&A) strategy consulting as a service that spans both units.

name: AOI ELECTRONICS CO LTD
businessSummary: AOI ELECTRONICS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The Integrated Circuit (IC) division is engaged in the production and sale of ICs, modules, IC cards, hybrid ICs, optical sensors and light-emitting diode (LED) products, as well as the plating processing of IC production. The Functional Parts division produces and sells print heads, various sensors and chip network resistors.

name: IRRC CORP
businessSummary: IRRC Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in insurance sales business, solution business and system business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Insurance Sales business segment is engaged in insurance sales for individuals and corporations. The Solution business segment is engaged in the provision of insurance solutions to insurance agencies and other insurance sales companies. The System business segment is engaged in development, maintenance and sales of software.

name: SEVEN BANK LTD
businessSummary: Seven Bank Ltd is engaged in the provision of financial services such as automatic teller machine (ATM) service, Internet banking service, and loan service. The Company operates its business through two business segments. Domestic Business segment is involved in the ATM platform business that installs ATMs at stores such as Seven-Eleven and Ito-Yokado, as well as at airports, stations, financial institution stores. The Segment also provides settlement account services including ordinary deposits, time deposits, loan services, overseas money transfer services, debit services, as well as the contract work from other financial institutions. The Overseas Business segment provides ATM services mainly in the United States and Indonesia. The Company also conducts investment advisory business.

name: TIS INC
businessSummary: TIS Inc mainly provides outsourcing business and cloud service related to IT investment, as well as software development and solutions. The Company operates in four business segments. The Service Information Technology (IT) segment provides knowledge-intensive IT services. The Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) segment provides business process outsourcing such as marketing and promotional work, clerical work and contract work utilizing a wealth of business and IT know-how. The Financial IT segment is engaged in the operation of high value-added businesses and IT-based business, based on specialized business and business know-how specialized in the financial industry. The Industrial IT segment is engaged in the operation of high value-added businesses and IT-based business, based on specialized business and business know-how specialized in the various fields other than finance. The other business provides real estate leasing and management business.

name: ITMEDIA INC
businessSummary: ITmedia Inc. is mainly engaged in the operation of media businesses. The Company provides media services in information technology (IT) area. It mainly operates through two business segments. The Lead Gen business consists of IT & business fields including TechTarget Japan, Keymanznet, order navigation and ITmedia marketing, as well as industrial technology fields including TechFactory. Media Advertising business includes IT & business fields including IT, IT Strategy Research Center, ITmedia NEWS, ITmedia Enterprise, ITmedia Executive, ITmedia Business Online, industrial technology field including MONOist, EE Times Japan, EDN Japan, Smart Japan, as well as consumer fields including ITmedia Mobile, ITmedia PC USER, ITmedia LifeStyle and Nogura.

name: ITBOOK HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: SAAF Holdings Co Ltd, formerly ITbook Holdings Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in the ground investigation and improvement business, human resources business, system development business. The Company operates in seven segments. The Ground Investigation and Improvement segment provides ground investigation and surveying, ground improvement, and real estate services. The Human Resources segment provides technician dispatch, human resources dispatch and teacher dispatch. The System Development segment provides new system development, hardware sales, and others. The Consulting segment provides reorganization and reconstruction of business and information systems. The Warranty and Inspection segment provides ground guarantee, housing completion guarantee. The Construction Tech segment is engaged in the rental and sale of geotechnical survey equipment. The Overseas segment is engaged in geotechnical surveys and ground improvement. Other businesses include financial services and others.

name: INTEGRATED DESIGN & ENGINEERING HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Integrated Design & Engineering Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consulting business related to civil engineering and construction, urban space development such as urban planning and architectural design. The Company operates three businesses. Consulting business is engaged in research, planning, evaluation, and design of rivers and water resources, water supply and sewerage, agricultural and rural development, dams and power generation, traffic and transportation, urban and regional development in Japan and overseas. Urban spatial business is engaged in business composition, planning, design, and operation in the formation of urban spaces. Energy business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of power equipment and control devices, and planning and design of mechanical and electrical equipment and communication facilities.

name: AICHI TOKEI DENKI CO LTD
businessSummary: Aichi Tokei Denki Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of measuring equipment and other special equipment. The Measuring Instrument segment carries four types of products: gas-related equipment, which include utility gas meters, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas meters, industrial meters, pressure equipment, gas meter systems and others; water work-related equipment, including various water supply meters, industrial water meters and sewage meters, bill management systems, emergency report systems for elderly housing and others; civil sensors and systems, including flow instrument and flow sensors, as well as instrumentation which include measuring, monitoring and control systems. The other businesses include the manufacture and sale of special equipment, such as precision molds.

name: AICHI STEEL CORP
businessSummary: Aichi Steel Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel materials, forged products, electronic functional materials and parts, and magnetic application products. The Company operates through five segments. The Steel (Hagane) Company segment manufactures and sells special steel, produces steelmaking materials, and transports and stores steel products. The Stainless Steel Company segment manufactures and sells stainless steel and titanium, processes and sells special steel and stainless steel, and rolls, processes, and sells stainless steel. The Forging (Kitaeru) Company segment manufactures and sells die-forged products and forging die processed products. The Smart Company segment manufactures and sells electronic functional materials and parts, magnetic application products, plant activators, and metal fibers. The Other Businesses segment provides computer software development, product sales and greening services.

name: ISPACE INC
businessSummary: ispace Inc is primarily engaged in lunar development business. The Company provides payload services, data services, and partnership services using its own landers and rovers. In the payload service, the Company loads the customer's cargo, which is the goods to be transported to the moon, onto the Group's landers and rovers, and provide transportation to the moon. In addition to direct data collection, the data service confirms the customer's need to collect data using the Company's payloads, send the results back to earth as data, analyze them, and utilize them in the next stage of research and development (R&D). The partnership service is a partnership program in which the Company sells a package that includes rights to use the Company group's activities as content, exposure of its logo in advertising media, and data usage rights, and collaborates in technological and business development.

name: AISIN CORP
businessSummary: Aisin Corp is a Japan-based company mainly manufactures and sells automotive parts. The Company manufactures and sells automotive parts through five geographical segments, including Japan, North America, Europe, China and Association of South-East Asian Nations (ASEAN) & India. The Japan segment also manufactures and sells energy solution-related equipment. The automotive parts include powertrain-related parts including automatic transmissions (AT) and manual transmissions (MT), driving safety-related parts including brake master cylinders and disc brakes, body-related parts including power sliding door systems and power back door systems, and sunroofs, as well as other connected and sharing solutions (CSS)-related parts including car navigation systems. The energy solution-related products include gas heat pump air conditioners (GHP), cogeneration systems and shower toilets, among others. The Company is also engaged in the automotive parts business in Brazil.

name: ICOM INC
businessSummary: ICOM INCORPORATED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wireless communication equipment and network equipment. The Company operates through four geographical business segments including Japan, North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania. The Company’s main product categories include land-based radio communication equipment, amateur radio communication equipment, marine radio communication equipment, other radio communication equipment, network equipment, among others. The Company is engaged in the provision of products including SATELLITE PTT, aviation radio, IC-M37J, IC-M36J and others for marine systems, IC-7851, IC-7700 and others for fixed equipment, wireless Local Area Network (LAN) terminals, communication function expansion units and other products.

name: IKK HOLDINGS INC
businessSummary: IKK Holdings Inc, formerly known as IKK Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wedding business, nursing care business, food business, photo business, and marriage brokerage business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Wedding segment provides planning and management services related to wedding ceremonies and receptions. The Nursing Care segment operates paid nursing homes and provides nursing care services. The Food segment is engaged in the planning, development, and sales of gifts, confectionery, and gift products. The Photo segment provides planning and operating services of photo weddings and photo studios. The Marriage Brokerage segment provides planning and management services related to marriage brokerage.

name: I CUBED SYSTEMS INC
businessSummary: i Cubed Systems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of management services for managing mobile terminals as Software as a Service (SaaS), and the investing activities. The Company operates through two business segments. The CLOMO business segment provides functions for visualizing the usage status of mobile terminals, setting and restricting functions, and security measures as licenses, centered on CLOMO MDM, a mobile device management (MDM) service that centrally manages and operates mobile terminals and mobile personal computers (PCs). The CLOMO business segment also sells licenses for CLOMO SECURED APPs, which are applications for mobile terminals. The main services include CLOMO service and SECURED APPs service. The Investment Business segment is engaged in investment activities through corporate venture capital (CVC) and mergers and acquisitions (M&A). The main investment targets include mobile, SaaS, security and others.

name: AICA KOGYO CO LTD
businessSummary: Aica Kogyo Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of chemical products and building materials. The Company operates in two segments. The Chemical Product segment offers interior and exterior finishing materials, flooring materials, adhesives and organic solids. The Construction Material and Equipment segment offers melamine facing plates, coated plywood boards, doors, interior materials, counters and nonflammable dressed lumbers. The Company operates its businesses in Japan and overseas.

name: ISB CORP
businessSummary: ISB CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in information service business and security system business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Information Service segment is engaged in development of embedded software for mobile, medical and automotive; verification of mobile equipment; software development in core system; data center service; the construction, operation, design and operation of infrastructure such as cloud; maintenance service; system operation service; the development and sale of commercial package products; the development of system and sale of equipment accompanying software development. The Security System segment is engaged in manufacture, sale and maintenance of access control system, electric lock and numeric keypad.

name: IR JAPAN HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: IR Japan Holdings, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consulting of investor relations (IR) and shareholder relations (SR) business. The Company provides three services. IR and SR Consulting service is involved in the provision of real shareholder investigation, voting rights simulation, proxy advisory, investment banking business, securities agency business, among others. Disclosure consulting service is involved in the provision of tool consulting to support planning and creation of various information disclosure materials, as well as the provision of legal documentation service to create various English disclosure documents and English translation of Japanese materials. Database and other service is involved in the provision of IR activity comprehensive support system named IR-Pro, the analyst network and others on the Website, as well as the provision of questionnaire service for individual shareholders named Kabunushi Hiroba.

name: ART VIVANT CO LTD
businessSummary: ART VIVANT CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchasing and sale of prints, paintings and art, the installment sale agency business (credit business), the installment loan secured financing business, as well as the operation of resort hotels, fitness clubs and hot yoga studios. The Company operates in four business segments. The Art-related segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of prints, paintings and art products. The Financial Services segment is engaged in the installment sale and brokerage and financing business. The Resort segment is engaged in the operation of resort hotels. The Health Industry segment is engaged in the operation of yoga studios and fitness clubs.

name: RS TECHNOLOGIES CO LTD
businessSummary: RS Technologies Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the silicon wafer reclamation business. It operates through three business segments. The Wafer Reclamation segment reclaims, processes, and sells semiconductor silicon wafers, as well as provides oxide film deposition processing services. The Prime Silicon Wafer Manufacturing and Sales segment manufactures and sells prime silicon wafers, as well as new monitor wafers, dummy wafers, and silicon ingots. The Semiconductor-Related Equipment and Materials segment sells semiconductor-related equipment and consumables, manufactures and sells storage battery electrolytes, and manufactures and sells in-vehicle camera modules. It also engages in solar power generation business and technical consulting business.

name: LIV-UP CO LTD
businessSummary: Livenup Group Co Ltd, formerly known as Liv-up Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company engaged in the real estate development and sale business. The main businesses are residential real estate business and income real estate business. The residential real estate business engages in the sale of detached houses and detached house land (residential land), including overall planning, building planning and design, construction supervision, sale, and after-sales maintenance of single-family homes, as well as the resale business. The income real estate business is engaged in the development and sale of apartments and the acquisition and resale of used income properties. The Company develops apartments as income-generating real estate and sells them to customers with investment purposes who collect rent from tenants. The Company also engages in rental sales and brokerage commission income collected from tenants, as well as rental management business.

name: CELSYS INC
businessSummary: CELSYS Inc, formerly ArtSpark Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business management of subsidiaries that plans, develops, sells, licenses, and maintains and manages computer software and peripherals, as well as related businesses. The Company operates through two segments. The Creator Support segment promotes the research and development and practical application of graphic technology, and expands the product lineup that supports new content production techniques and new devices. The User Interface (UI)/User Experience (UX) segment develops products centered on the in-vehicle software development platform CGI Studio and the UI authoring software group UIConductor, with a focus on the automotive (four-wheel and two-wheel) sector.

name: ARTNATURE INC
businessSummary: ARTNATURE INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of custom-made wigs. The Company operates in three business segments. The Men’s business segment is engaged in the provision of custom-made wigs and other products and services to male customers. The Women’s business segment is engaged in the provision of customized wigs and other products and services to female customers. The Women’s Ready-Made business segment is engaged in the provision of ready-made wigs and other products and services to female customers.

name: ARCLAND SAKAMOTO CO LTD
businessSummary: Arclands Corp, formerly Arcland Sakamoto Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in retail business, wholesale business, restaurant business and real estate business. The Company operates through four segments. The Retail segment sells household goods, household products, food products and other items to general consumers and professionals (contractors) through Home Centre Musashi, Super Center Musashi, Musashi Pro, NicoPet, Super Viva Home, Viva Home, arts and crafts specialist Ark Oasis, Vysees, and food specialty store Musashi Shokuhinkan. The Wholesale segment mainly sells do-it-yourself (DIY)-related products to home centers nationwide and group companies. The Restaurant segment operates restaurants such as Katsuya, a pork cutlet specialty restaurant. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate. In addition, the Company also operates a sports club JOYFIT and a fitness gym FIT365.

name: EARTH INFINITY CO LTD
businessSummary: Earth Infinity Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the energy business and electronic equipment businesses. The energy business outsources supply and demand management to intermediaries, and uses electricity procured from private power plants and electricity procured through market transactions with the Japan Electric Power Exchange using the power transmission and distribution network owned by general power transmission and distribution business operators, supplies electricity to customers in each business area. In addition, the business conducts sales activities centered on direct sales by employees. The electronic equipment business mainly offers energy cost reduction proposals and consulting by manufacturing, selling, and installing electronic breakers (breakers with built-in computers) for small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: SANKEI REAL ESTATE INC
businessSummary: SANKEI REAL ESTATE Inc is a closed-end real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid- to long-term perspectives. It invests in office buildings as a major investment objective and invests in the office building to the asset size of the portfolio at around 80%. The Fund expands the scale of the assets under management by practicing a growth strategy that makes use of the platform made up of the group companies of the Sankei Building Group. The asset manager of the Fund is K.K. Sankei Building Asset Management.

name: STAR ASIA INVESTMENT CORP
businessSummary: Star Asia Investment Corporation is a real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve internal and external growth in asset and maximize investors’ profit from mid-term to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in office buildings and residential condominium buildings. The Fund is a close-ended fund. Its properties included Minami-Azabu Shibuya building, Oak Minami-Azabu, Honmachibashi Tower, Urban Park Azabujuban, and others. The asset manager of the Fund is Star Asia Investment Management Co., Ltd.

name: NOMURA REAL ESTATE MASTER FUND INC
businessSummary: Nomura Real Estate Master Fund Inc is a real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid-term to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in commercial buildings and logistic facilities located in the three major metropolitan areas (metropolitan area, Chukyo area and Kinki area), other major cities including ordinance-designated cities or surrounding areas. The Fund manager is Nomura Real Estate Asset Management Co., Ltd.

name: SEKISUI HOUSE REIT INC
businessSummary: Sekisui House Reit,Inc. is a Japan-based real estate investment trust (REIT) company. The Fund aims at stable earnings from mid-term to long-term perspectives. It primarily invests in commercial facilities, including office buildings, commercial places and hotels, located in the Tokyo Metropolitan Areas, Osaka, and Nagoya areas. The asset manager of the Fund is Sekisui House Asset Management, Ltd.

name: NIPPON PROLOGIS REIT INC
businessSummary: Nippon Prologis REIT Inc. is a Japan-based real estate investment trust (REIT). It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid- to long-term perspectives. The REIT mainly invests in logistic facilities, focusing on A class logistic facilities. Its portfolio included Prologis Park Ichikawa 1, Prologis Park Zama 1 , Prologis Park Kawajima , Prologis Park Osaka 2, Prologis Park Maishima 3 , Prologis Park Kasugai, Prologis Park Maishima 4, Prologis Park Kitanagoya, Prologis Park Tagajo and Prologis Park Takatsuki, among others. The asset manager of the REIT is Prologis REIT Management K.K.

name: GLP J-REIT
businessSummary: GLP J-REIT is a Japan-based investment company. The Company aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid- to long-term perspectives. The Company invests in logistic facilities and related real estate properties mainly located in Kanto and Kansai regions and other areas. The asset manager of the Company is GLP Japan Advisors Co Ltd.

name: MORI HILLS REIT INVESTMENT CORP
businessSummary: Mori Hills Reit Investment Corp is real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid- to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in real estate asset like office building, housing and commercial facilities. Its property portfolio includes Roppongi Hills Mori Tower, Ark Mori Building, Roppongi Hills Mori Tower, Ark Mori Building, Koraku Mori Building, Akasaka Tameike Tower, Holland Hills Mori Tower And Roppongi view tower. The asset manager of the Fund is Mori Building Investment Management Co., Ltd.

name: JAPAN HOTEL REIT INVESTMENT CORP
businessSummary: Japan Hotel Reit Investment Corp is real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid-to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in hotel real estate. Its property portfolio includes Namba Oriental Hotel, Hotel Nikko Alivila, Ibis Tokyo Shinjuku, Dormy Inn Kumamoto, Chisun Inn Kamata. The asset manager of the Fund is Japan Hotel REIT Advisors Co., Ltd.

name: INVINCIBLE INVESTMENT CORP
businessSummary: Invincible Investment Corp is a closed-end real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid-to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in real estate in Tokyo city and major cities in Japan. Its property portfolio includes Route Tachikawa, Nisshin Palestage Daitabashi, Emerald House, Beler Meguro, Corp Higashitoin, Art Hotel Joetsu, Hotel MyStays Nayoro and others. The asset manager of the Fund is Consonant Investment Management Co Ltd.

name: ORIX JREIT INC
businessSummary: Orix JREIT Inc is real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid-to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in real estate-related assets that are used in offices located in major cities across the country. Its property portfolio includes Round Cross Mita, Shibuya Pine Building, Round Cross Akihabara, Orix Ikebukuro Building and Hamamatsu Act Tower, among others. The asset manager of the Fund is ORIX Asset Management Corporation.

name: TRUFIN PLC
businessSummary: TruFin plc is engaged in the provision of niche lending, early payment services and game publishing. The Company’s segments include Short term finance, Payment services, Publishing, and Other. Short term finance segment is engaged in the provision of distribution finance products and invoice discounting. Payment services segment is engaged in the provision of early payment programme services. Publishing segment is engaged in the publishing of video games. Its businesses include Oxygen Finance, Playstack, and Satago. Oxygen is a provider of early payment programmes and a specialist in payments control and market insights in the United Kingdom. Oxygen enables public and private organizations trade more effectively through progressive payment practices. Playstack is a games publisher that employs a diverse team of people globally. Satago’s technology provides a working capital solution built to help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) manage their cashflow in one simple integration.

name: IWG PLC
businessSummary: INTERNATIONAL WORKPLACE GROUP PLC is a Switzerland based Company operating in the real estate industry. The Company operates under the Regus, Signature, Spaces, HQ, Basepoint, Stop&Work, Too, The Clubhouse, Bizdojo, OpenOffice, No18, Central Working and Copernic brands. These brands provide a global network of places to work for various kinds of businesses ranging from home-based workers to corporations. The Company focuses not only on single location but also integrated national networks, also providing sales, management services, subscription services, virtual offices, meeting rooms, coworking spaces and workplace recovery services. The Company, with the brands it owns, is present around the globe.

name: NOVOCURE LTD
businessSummary: NovoCure Limited is a global oncology company with a proprietary platform technology called Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields), which are electric fields that exert physical forces to kill cancer cells via a variety of mechanisms. The Company's commercialized products are approved in certain countries for the treatment of adult patients with glioblastoma, non-small cell lung cancer, malignant pleural mesothelioma and pleural mesothelioma. Its Optune Gio is approved by the FDA under the Premarket Approval pathway for the treatment of adult patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma together with temozolomide, a chemotherapy drug, and for adult patients with GBM following confirmed recurrence after chemotherapy as monotherapy treatment. Its Optune Lua is approved by the FDA under the PMA pathway for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer concurrent with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors or docetaxel following progression on or after a platinum-based regimen.

name: JANUS HENDERSON GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Janus Henderson Group plc is a United Kingdom-based independent global asset manager, which is specializing in active investment across various asset classes. The Company manages a broad range of investment products for institutional and retail investors across four capabilities: equities, fixed income, multi-asset and alternatives. Its intermediary channel distributes United States mutual funds, separately managed accounts, exchange-traded funds and various others, through financial intermediaries, including banks, financial advisors and discretionary wealth managers. The self-directed channel serves individual investors who invest in its products through a mutual fund supermarket or directly with the Company. Its institutional channel serves corporations, endowments, pension funds and others, with distribution direct to the plan sponsor and through consultants. It has operations in North America, the United Kingdom, continental Europe, Latin America, Japan, Asia, and Australia.

name: ROYAL ROAD MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Royal Road Minerals Limited is a Jersey-based mineral exploration and development company. In Colombia, the Company operates through its wholly owned Colombian companies, Minerales Camino Real SAS and Exploraciones Northern Colombia SAS. In Saudi Arabia, it operates through its 50% owned Royal Road Arabia LLC. In Morocco, it operates through its 100% owned subsidiary Mineraux Chemin Reel SARL AU. Its projects include Jabal Sahabiyah Saudi Arabia, Lalla Aziza Morocco, and Guintar and Margaritas in Columbia. The Jabal Sahabiyah tender area consists of approximately three contiguous exploration licenses. The licenses cover over 284 square kilometers (kms) and are located in the Asir Province of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its Lalla Aziza is an underground copper mine located in Morocco’s Western High Atlas, approximately 90 kms southwest of Marrakesh. Its Guintar is an exploration project and Margaritas is a neighboring porphyry copper- gold system.

name: CLEANTECH LITHIUM PLC
businessSummary: CleanTech Lithium PLC is a Jersey-based exploration and development company advancing sustainable lithium projects in Chile. The Company’s assets consist of four lithium projects, spanning approximately 1,250 square kilometers (km2) in the lithium triangle in Chile. Its projects include Laguna Verde, Francisco Basin, Llamara, and Arenas Blancas. Its Laguna Verde and Francisco Basin projects are located 300 kilometers (km) by road from the mining center of Copiapo in the Atacama region of Chile. The Laguna Verde Project features a hypersaline lake covering approximately 15.2 km2 and consists of 108 mining licenses at the low point of the basin with a large sub-surface. Francisco Basin Project has a total exploration license area of over 127 km2. Llamara is a greenfield lithium exploration project with a license area totaling approximately 344 km2 located in the Pampa del Tamarugal basin. Arenas Blancas project covers a total area of over 377 km2.

name: APTIV PLC ORDINARY SHARES
businessSummary: Aptiv PLC is a global technology company that develops connected solutions enabling a more sustainable future of mobility. The Company delivers end-to-end mobility solutions enabling its customers’ transition to more electrified, software-defined vehicles. The Company’s segments include Signal and Power Solutions and Advanced Safety and User Experience. The Signal and Power Solutions segment includes complete electrical architecture and component products. The Advanced Safety and User Experience segment includes vehicle technology and services in advanced safety, user experience and smart vehicle compute and software, as well as cloud-native software platforms, autonomous driving technologies and DevOps tools. It designs and manufactures vehicle components and provides electrical, electronic and active safety technology solutions to the global automotive and commercial vehicle markets. It operates manufacturing facilities and technical centers utilizing a regional service model.

name: ROSEBANK INDUSTRIES PLC
businessSummary: Rosebank Industries plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is focused on buying, improving and selling business, which involves acquiring quality industrial or manufacturing businesses whose performance may be improved. The Company's subsidiary, Electrical Components International, is a supplier of electrical distribution systems, control box assemblies, and other critical engineered components for a range of diversified end markets ranging from consumer appliances to smart industrial equipment.

name: BIRKENSTOCK HOLDING PLC
businessSummary: Birkenstock Holding plc operates through Birkenstock Group B.V. & Co. KG and its subsidiaries. Birkenstock is a global brand, which has developed a unisex portfolio of footbed-based products that serve consumers of all geographies, genders, ages, and income levels. Its proprietary footbed, which reflects the anatomy of the human foot, represents the foundation of its brand and products. It operates a vertically integrated manufacturing base and produces all its footbeds in Germany. BIRKENSTOCK offers a wide range of products that go beyond footwear, including sleep systems and natural cosmetics, catering to both entry-level and luxury markets. The Company operates its channels, utilizing the business-to-business (B2B) channel to facilitate brand accessibility while fully engaging consumers in its direct-to-consumer (DTC) channel, which offers its complete product range and access to its silhouettes.

name: CVC CAPITAL PARTNERS PLC
businessSummary: CVC Capital Partners PLC is a private markets manager focused on private equity, secondaries, credit and infrastructure with a global network of approximately 30 local offices and 200 billion euros of assets under management. The principal activities of the Company and its subsidiaries are to provide management and adviser services to various investment funds and credit vehicles and to act as an investment holding group. Its segments include Private equity, Secondaries, Credit, Infrastructure, and Central. The Private equity segment consists of four private equity strategies: Europe / Americas, Asia, Strategic Opportunities, and Growth. The Credit segment invests in companies through dedicated vehicles and investment solutions for both Performing Credit and Private Credit. The Secondaries segment focuses on secondary markets globally. The Central segment reflects all non-investment staff costs and all non-staff costs of the business, including all costs related to business operations.

name: GOLDSTONE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: GoldStone Resources Limited is a Jersey-based gold producer and explorer in the Ashanti Gold Belt in Ghana. The Company’s projects include Akrokeri Project and Homase Project. The Company holds a 100% interest in the Akrokeri Licence. The Licence is located approximately six Kilometers (km) along the strike from AngloGold Ashanti’s Obuasi Mine, which has a total historical and current resource in excess of 70M oz Au. The Company also holds a 90% interest in the Homase Licence. The Homase Open Pit is located approximately 12 Kilometers along the strike from AngloGold Ashanti’s Obuasi Mine which has a total historical and current resource in excess of 70M oz Au. The Company operates through two segments: Exploration, Evaluation and production and Corporate. The Exploration, Evaluation and production segment is presented as an aggregation of the Homase and Akrokeri licences (Ghana).

name: WNS (HOLDINGS) LTD
businessSummary: WNS (Holdings) Limited is a digital-led business transformation and services company. It delivers a range of solutions, including industry-specific offerings, customer experience services, finance and accounting, human resources, procurement, and research and analytics to re-imagine the digital future of businesses. Its segments include Banking/Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI), Travel, Shipping/Logistics, and Utilities (TSLU), Manufacturing/Retail/Consumer, Hi-tech/Professional Services, and Procurement (MRHP), and Healthcare/Life Sciences (HCLS). The Company also provides data modernization and democratization services focused on the Snowflake platform. It offers strategy, execution, and managed service capabilities across data engineering, advanced analytics, and data science. Its financing and accounting services include Autonomous Accounting Platform (TRAC ONE-F), Financial Intelligence-in-a-Box (FIAB), and Sustainability and Technical Accounting and Reporting Consulting.

name: MURANO GLOBAL INVESTMENTS PLC
businessSummary: Murano Global Investments PLC is an international development corporate group. The Company is engaged in the structuring, development and assessment of industrial, residential, corporate office, and hotel projects in Mexico. The Company also provides comprehensive services, including the execution, construction, management, and operation of a wide variety of industrial, business, and tourism real estate projects, among others. Its portfolio of operational hotels consists of Andaz Hotel, Mondrian Hotel, and Vivid Hotel. Andaz Hotel has 213 rooms and several amenities, including a sky bar Cabuya Rooftop, multiple restaurants, an auditorium, breakout rooms, and others. The Mondrian Hotel has 183 rooms and several amenities, including a sky bar restaurant, a Terraza bar and a Flower Shop coffee shop. The Vivid Hotel is an adult-only brand all-inclusive hotel. The Company is also developing a leisure and residential complex in the GIC Complex. It also has various projects to be developed.

name: WALDENCAST PLC CLASS A
businessSummary: Waldencast plc is a global multi-brand beauty and wellness platform. It is focused on developing, acquiring, accelerating, and scaling conscious and purpose-driven brands. Its segments include Obagi Medical and Milk Makeup. The Obagi Medical segment sells advanced skincare products backed by science and formulated to minimize signs of skin aging, address dark spots, hyperpigmentation, fine lines and wrinkles, and to protect and enhance skin tone and texture. Its portfolio of medical-grade skincare with consumer-centric, in-office injectable procedures includes Saypha ChIQ, and MagIQ lines of injectable hyaluronic acid gels. The Milk Makeup segment consists of the business of Milk. Its Milk’s business activities include developing, marketing, and selling cosmetics, skincare, and other beauty products. Its Milk Makeup segment offers over 250 products through its United States Website www.MilkMakeup.com and retail partners include Sephora globally and Ulta Beauty in the United States.

name: WIZZ AIR HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Wizz Air Holdings Plc is a Hungary-based airline company. The Company provides low-cost low-fare passenger air transportation services on scheduled, short-haul and medium-haul point-to-point routes across Europe and into the Caucasus and the Middle East as well as North Africa and North-West Asia, connecting 155 destinations across 45 countries. Wizz Air Holdings Plc operates a fleet of more than 206 ultramodern Airbus A320 family aircraft. Airbus A321neo aircraft’s new generation engines offer environmental benefits with the lower environmental footprint per passenger. Wizz Air Holdings Plc works along with its subsidiaries: Wizz Air Hungary Ltd., Wizz Air UK Ltd., Wizz Air Abu Dhabi LLC, and Wizz Air Malta Ltd.

name: TP ICAP GROUP PLC
businessSummary: TP ICAP Group plc is a provider of financial markets infrastructure and data. It connects buyers and sellers in global financial, energy, and commodities markets. Its segments include Global Broking, Energy & Commodities, Liquidnet, Parameta Solutions, and corporate. The Global Broking division is an inter-dealer broker that services clients in rates, foreign exchange and money markets, equities and credit products. The Energy & Commodities division operates in all markets, including oil, gas, power, environmental tax credits and digital assets. The Liquidnet division is a multi-asset, agency execution specialist operating in 57 equity markets. The Parameta solutions division includes its data and analytics business, providing over-the-counter market data. It helps clients to make efficient investment, portfolio analysis, valuation, risk management and compliance decisions. The Company also delivers real-time pre-trade bond market data from many sell-side banks to buy-side clients.

name: DIGITAL 9 INFRASTRUCTURE PLC
businessSummary: Digital 9 Infrastructure plc is a United Kingdom-based investment trust. The Company's investment objective is to undertake a managed wind-down of the Company and realize all existing assets in the Company's portfolio in an orderly manner. Its portfolio consists of Arqiva and Elio Networks. Arqiva is the sole provider of national terrestrial TV and radio broadcasting infrastructure in the United Kingdom. Elio Networks owns and operates the highest capacity licensed microwave-based Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) network in metropolitan Dublin. The Company's investment manager is InfraRed Capital Partners Limited.

name: INTEGRATED DIAGNOSTICS HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Integrated Diagnostics Holdings PLC is a diagnostics services provider. The Company operates in the Middle East and Africa with operations in Egypt, Jordan, Nigeria, Saudi Arabia, and Sudan. The Company is engaged in offering services in immunology, microbiology, hematology, endocrinology, clinical chemistry, molecular biology, histopathology, genetics, radiology, and others. The Company’s brands include Al Borg, Al Borg Scan, Al Mokhtabar, Biolab, Echo-Lab, Ultralab, Al Mokhtabar Sudan and Biolab KSA. It operates through approximately 628 branches. It offers more than 3,000 diagnostics tests ranging from routine to advanced. Its common tests include those for cholesterol, diabetes, pregnancy, and substance abuse. Through Al Borg Scan, it offers a full range of radiology services, including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography (CT), electromyography, electrocardiogram (ECG), electroencephalogram (EEG), ultrasound, x-ray, mammograms and cath lab facilities, others.

name: COINSHARES INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: CoinShares International Limited is an investment company specializing in digital assets. The Company provides a range of financial services across investment management, trading, and securities to a range of clients that include corporations, financial institutions, and individuals. The Company operates three core operating segments: Asset Management, Capital Markets, and Principal Investments. The Company’s products include CoinShares Physical ETPs and XBT Provider ETPs. The Company’s subsidiaries include XBT Provider AB (pub), CoinShares GP II Limited, CoinShares Corporate Services (Jersey) Limited, CoinShares Co, Services (Jersey) Limited, CoinShares Digital Securities Limited, CoinShares (Jersey) Limited, GABI Trading Limited, CoinShares Capital Markets (Jersey) Limited, CoinShares Capital Markets (UK) Limited, CoinShares Capital, LLC, CoinShares GP I LLC, CoinShares France, CoinShares Asset Management, Larks Leaf Asset Management (Jersey) Limited, and among others.

name: GAMBLING.COM GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Gambling.com Group Limited is a provider of digital marketing services for the global online gambling industry. The Company is primarily operating in the United States and Ireland. The Company, through its technology platform, publishes a portfolio of premier branded websites including Gambling.com, Bookies.com, Casinos.com, and RotoWire.com. The Company owns and operates more than 50 websites in seven languages across 15 national markets covering all aspects of the online gambling industry, including iGaming and sports betting, and the fantasy sports industry. The Company's OddsJam platform provides a suite of tools and services to assist consumers and enterprises in sports betting. Each of its websites is tailored for different user interests and markets within the online gambling industry and includes original and curated news relating to the sector, such as odds, statistics, product reviews and product comparisons of online gambling services around the world.

name: T42 IOT TRACKING SOLUTIONS PLC
businessSummary: t42 IoT Tracking Solutions PLC provides real-time tracking, analysis, monitoring, and security Internet of things (IoT) solutions for the global container and freight market. The Company’s segments include Hardware and SaaS. It provides hardware and software solutions, shipping container tracking, transportation fleet management, smart padlock security, and central command systems. Its products include Tetis, Tetis R, Tetis R Hybrid, Lokies, WatchLock Cube, Kylos, Kylos Forever, and Kylos Air. Its multi-sensor IoT tracking devices use a range of detection capabilities with cloud-based analytics and alerts, with real-time data transmission, analysis, and actionable insights. Its devices are used by ports, cargo owners, shipping companies, freight forwarders, insurance companies, customs authorities, homeland security, and police for end-to-end global container tracking and digital transformation of shipments. Tetis provides a complete tracking and monitoring solution for dry containers.

name: AUDIOBOOM GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Audioboom Group plc is a Jersey-based podcast publisher. The Company’s advertising and monetization platform supports the content business, offering commercial, distribution, marketing, and production services for a network of top-tier podcasts. The platform distributes content via Apple Podcasts, YouTube, Spotify, Pandora, Amazon Music, Google Podcasts, iHeartRadio, Facebook, and Twitter, as well as partners' own websites and mobile apps. It operates internationally, with global partnerships across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. Through its production-as-a-service model, Audioboom Studios provides support to podcast creators. The company’s technology enables podcasters to manage content publishing, expand their audience, share episodes across listening platforms, and access insights into content consumption through a data and analytics dashboard. Its advertising product brand platform, Sonic, offers tools and services for podcast advertisers.

name: UPLAND RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Upland Resources Limited is a Jersey-based upstream oil and gas company. The company is primarily focused on developing opportunities in Sarawak, Malaysia. It operates in one business segment: the exploration and development of oil and gas assets. The company’s assets include Sarawak SK334, North Sea Inner Moray Firth, and Hardstoft. Its Block SK334, which has a size of approximately 6,685 square kilometers (km), is located in the northern region of onshore Sarawak, Malaysia. Its North Sea Inner Moray Firth is located in the North Sea and comprises the Dunrobin Prospect, which consists of a large, rotated fault block covering up to approximately 45 square kilometers (km). The company has a 25% interest in Hardstoft (Block SK46c), located in the East Midlands Oil Province. The company’s subsidiaries include Upland Resources (UK Onshore) Limited and Upland Resources (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd.

name: CLARIVATE PLC
businessSummary: Clarivate Plc is a global provider of transformative intelligence. The Company offers enriched data, insights and analytics, workflow solutions and expert services in the areas of Academia & Government (A&G), Intellectual Property (IP) and Life Sciences & Healthcare (LS&H). Within the A&G segment, the Company offers solutions across various areas, which include scientific and academic research, information solutions and library software. Its ProQuest One solutions provide access to multidisciplinary curated content across a variety of formats, including data bases, dissertations, news, primary sources, books, and video. Within the IP segment, the Company provides IP data, software, and expertise to other companies to manage and protect critical IP assets. This segment's service offerings include IP management software, Patent services and Brand IP solutions, among others. Within the LS&H segment, the Company offers solutions across research and development, commercial and Medtech.

name: AMCOR PLC
businessSummary: Amcor plc is engaged in packaging solutions for consumer and healthcare products. The Company develops sustainable packaging in flexible and rigid formats across multiple materials. The Company operates through two segments: Flexibles and Rigid Packaging. The Flexibles segment consists of operations that manufacture flexible and film packaging in the food and beverage, medical and pharmaceutical, fresh produce, snack food, personal care, and other industries. The Rigid Packaging segment consists of operations that manufacture rigid containers for a broad range of predominantly beverage and food products, including carbonated soft drinks, water, juices, sports drinks, milk-based beverages, spirits and wine, sauces, dressings, spreads and personal care items, and plastic caps for a wide variety of applications. The Company's subsidiaries include Berry Global Group Inc., Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc., Amcor UK Finance plc, Amcor Finance (USA), Inc., and others.

name: MAN GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Man Group plc is a United Kingdom-based technology-empowered active investment management company. The Company is focused on delivering performance and client portfolio solutions by deploying the latest technology across its business. It provides long-only, alternative and private market products on a single and multi-manager basis. It develops bespoke solutions and fund of hedge fund services which utilize the Company’s advanced technology, infrastructure and expertise. Its technology platform facilitates alpha generation, portfolio management, trade execution, operations, compliance, risk management and accounting, as well as providing firm-wide end user collaboration tools. Its platform is built to handle scale, complexity and customization. The Company offers its investors tailored investment programs, illustrating its commitment. The Company operates its investment management businesses through its investment managers, namely Man AHL, Man Numeric, Man GLG, Man GPM and Man Varagon.

name: BOOHOO GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Boohoo Group Plc is a holding company. The principal activity of its subsidiary undertakings is that of online clothing retailers. The Company designs, sources, markets and sells fashion clothing, home and beauty products to consumers globally. The diversity of its brands, including its five core brands, boohoo, boohooMAN, PrettyLittleThing, Karen Millen and Debenhams, enable it to serve a broad customer base, globally. Its segments include Youth Brands, Debenhams & Labels, and Karen Millen. Youth Brands include three online retail brands, such as boohoo, boohooMAN, and PrettyLittleThing. Karen Millen is a digital first, premium global brand. Debenhams is an online department store. Its portfolio of labels includes Nasty Gal, MissPap, Coast, Oasis, Warehouse, Burton Menswear, Dorothy Perkins, and Wallis. Its brands design, source, market and sell clothing, shoes, accessories and beauty products targeted at 16 to 60 plus year old consumers in the United Kingdom and internationally.

name: PREDATOR OIL & GAS HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Predator Oil & Gas Holdings Plc is a Jersey-based oil and gas company. It is engaged in the operation of an oil and gas development business in the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago and an exploration and appraisal portfolio in Ireland and Morocco. Its portfolio consists of upstream exploration, appraisal and development, and near-term producing assets onshore Morocco, offshore the Republic of Ireland and onshore Trinidad. It operates through the exploration, appraisal and development of oil and gas assets segment. It has interests in three geographical segments: Africa (Morocco), Europe (Ireland) and the Caribbean (Trinidad and Tobago). It has 75% interest in the Guercif License together with its partner ONHYM, the State oil company. In Trinidad, it has 100% interest in the Cory Moruga license. It is the operator of three producing fields, all onshore Trinidad. It has three subsidiaries: Predator Oil & Gas Trinidad Ltd, Predator Gas Ventures Ltd, and Predator Oil and Gas Ventures Ltd.

name: YELLOW CAKE PLC
businessSummary: Yellow Cake plc is a Jersey-based specialist company operating in the uranium sector holding physical uranium for the long term. It offers exposure to the uranium spot price. The Company is engaged in providing investors with direct exposure to the uranium market through its physical holding of uranium oxide concentrate (U3O8) and uranium-related commercial activities. Its physical uranium holdings provide an opportunity to profit from an anticipated rise in the uranium price arising from the short- and medium-term supply and demand asymmetry. Its operating segment is the holding of U3O8 for long-term capital appreciation. It holds 20.16 million pounds of U3O8, all of which is held in storage in Canada and France. It also has an agreement for the supply of U3O8 with JSC National Atomic Company Kazatomprom (Kazatomprom).

name: JTC PLC
businessSummary: JTC PLC is a Jersey-based company. The Company provides fund, corporate, and private wealth services to institutional and private clients. It has two segments: Institutional Client Services (ICS) and Private Client Services (PCS). ICS division provides fund, corporate, and banking services to institutional clients, primarily fund managers, listed companies, and multinationals. PCS division provides trust, corporate, and banking services for wealth management firms, family and private offices, ultra-high net worth individuals, and high net worth individuals. It provides a variety of fund types and services across a range of asset classes and fund jurisdictions. Its business activities include fund services, corporate services, and private client services. Its subsidiaries are JTC Group Holdings Limited, JTC (Jersey) Limited, JTC Employer Solutions Limited, JTC Signes Services SA, JTC Fund Solutions RSA (Pty) Ltd, JTC UK (Amsterdam) Limited, and JTC Trust Company (Delaware) Limited.

name: IMAGING BIOMETRICS LTD
businessSummary: Imaging Biometrics Limited is a Jersey-based company. The Company is engaged in the provision of clinical treatments to patients in the field of medical imaging diagnostics, based on technology. The Company’s segments include Holding company, Medical Software, and Oral gallium maltolate (GaM). Its subsidiaries include Imaging Biometrics, LLC and Stone Checker Software Limited. Imaging Biometrics LLC develops ready-to-use software applications for the healthcare industry. Stone Checker Software Limited is a supplier of technology solutions in the field of kidney stone analysis and kidney stone prevention. Its Kirkstall Limited has developed Quasi Vivo an advanced interconnected cell culture flow system, engineered to provide vivo-like conditions for cell growth.

name: WPP PLC
businessSummary: WPP plc is a United Kingdom-based creative transformation company. The Company offers national and multinational clients a comprehensive range of communications, experience, commerce, and technology services. Its segments include Global Integrated Agencies, Public Relations, and Specialist Agencies. The Global Integrated Agencies segment includes creative agencies and media agencies. Its creative agencies provide advertising campaigns, experiences, e-commerce strategies and platforms, technology services such as CRM implementation, and more. The Company's media agencies connect brands with consumers - planning, buying and activating the distribution of creative content across the full range of media channels including digital display, search, social, television, print and billboards. The Public Relations segment helps clients communicate with their stakeholders, build reputation and manage risk. The Specialist Agencies provide customized services, including branding and design.

name: CIRATA PLC
businessSummary: Cirata plc is engaged in automating Hadoop data transfer and integration to modern cloud analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) platforms without downtime or disruption. It specializes in enabling the flow of data to cloud platforms enabling AI and analytics. Its products consist of Data Migrator and Data Migrator for Hadoop. Data Migrator is a fully automated solution that moves on-premises HDFS data, Hive metadata, local filesystem, or cloud data sources to any cloud or on-premises environment, even while those datasets are under active change. Data Migrator requires zero changes to applications or business operations. Data Migrator for Hadoop is an advanced cloud migration solution that automates the transfer of HDFS data and Hive metadata to the cloud, even in the midst of active changes. This full-self-service tool ensures zero impact on applications or business operations. It serves various industries, including automotive, telecommunications, and financial services.

name: GCP INFRASTRUCTURE INVESTMENTS LTD
businessSummary: GCP Infrastructure Investments Limited is a closed-ended investment company. The Company’s purpose is to invest in UK infrastructure debt and/or similar assets. The Company’s investment objective is to provide shareholders with regular, sustained, long-term dividends and to preserve the capital value of its investment assets over the long term. The Company seeks to generate exposure to the debt of UK infrastructure project companies, their owners or their lenders and related and/or similar assets which provide regular and predictable long-term cash flows. The Company may invest at least 75% of its total assets, directly or indirectly, in investments with exposure to infrastructure projects. It has invested in a diversified, partially inflation-protected portfolio of investments, primarily in the renewable energy, social housing and PPP/PFI sectors. Gravis Capital Management Limited acts as investment adviser to the Company.

name: GENEL ENERGY PLC
businessSummary: Genel Energy plc is a United Kingdom-based independent oil and gas exploration and production company with production assets in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq and exploration assets in Oman and Somaliland. The Company operates through two segments: Production and Pre-production. The Production segment comprises the producing fields on the Tawke PSC (Tawke and Peshkabir), which are located in the KRI and make sales predominantly to the KRG. The Pre-production segment is comprised of exploration activities, principally located in Somaliland and Oman. The Company holds a 25% working interest in Tawke PSC, located in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. The Company holds approximately 51% and 50% working interests in SL10B13 and Odewayne blocks, all located in Somaliland. It holds a 40% working interest in Block 54 (the Karawan Concession), located on the eastern side of the South Oman Salt Basin and immediately adjacent to existing production activities.

name: GLENCORE PLC
businessSummary: Glencore PLC is a Switzerland-based producer and marketer of natural resources. The Company is a producer and marketer of coal, with mines in Australia, Africa and South America - and a marketer of crude oil, refined products and natural gas. The Company operates across two business segments: Industrial Activities and Marketing. Industrial Activities segment contains of producing a diverse range of metals and minerals - such as copper, cobalt, zinc, nickel, coal and ferroalloys. Marketing segment is responsible for physically sourcing commodities and products from its global supplier base and sell them to customers all over the world, transporting commodities by sea, rail and truck. The Company is also involved in the recycling of copper and precious metals.

name: JERSEY ELECTRICITY PLC
businessSummary: Jersey Electricity plc is a Jersey-based supplier of electricity in Jersey, serving over 54,000 residential and business customers. The Company's operations include the generation, importation, transmission, distribution and supply of electricity as well as a range of energy-related services and solutions. Its segments include Energy, Building Services, Retail, Property and Other. It is also involved in the generation and distribution of electricity and jointly invests in assets with Guernsey Electricity Limited importing power for both islands. It also engages in retailing, property management, and building services and has other business interests, including software configuration services and consulting.

name: TMT INVESTMENTS PLC
businessSummary: TMT Investments Plc is a venture capital company. The Company invests in technology companies across a number of core specialist sectors. The Company’s objective is to generate an attractive rate of return for shareholders, predominantly through capital appreciation, by investing in primarily venture capital and private equity opportunities in the technology, media and telecommunications (TMT) sector. The Company aims to provide equity, debt, and equity-related investment capital, such as convertible loans, primarily to small and mid-sized private companies, which are seeking capital for growth and development, consolidation or acquisition, or as pre-initial public offering (IPO) financing. It focuses on identifying attractive investment opportunities in the various segments of the TMT sector, such as Big Data/Cloud, software-as-a-service (SaaS), Mobility, EdTech, E-commerce, FinTech, Healthtech, and Other.

name: WEST CHINA CEMENT LTD
businessSummary: West China Cement Ltd is a company principally engaged in the manufacture and sales of cement and cement products. Along with its subsidiaries, The Company's cement is sold under the trademarks Yao Bai and Yaobaishuini. The Company's cement products are used in a variety of infrastructure projects including highways, railways, bridges, hydroelectric power stations, water conservancy and water transfer projects. The Company mainly conducts its businesses in the domestic market and overseas markets.

name: PHOENIX SPREE DEUTSCHLAND LTD
businessSummary: Phoenix Spree Deutschland Limited is a Jersey-based investment company specializing in Berlin residential real estate. The Company invests in residential and commercial property in Germany. The Company’s objective is to generate an attractive return for shareholders through the acquisition and active management of high-quality pre-let properties in Berlin, Germany. It is primarily investing in the residential market in Berlin, supplemented with selective investments in commercial property. The majority of commercial property within the portfolio is located within residential and mixed-use properties. Its portfolio consists of approximately 93 properties containing 2,472 residential units and 138 commercial units, with a total lettable area of around 186,500 square meters. Its subsidiaries include Phoenix Spree Deutschland I Limited, Phoenix Spree Deutschland VII Limited, Phoenix Spree Deutschland X Limited, and others. Its property advisor is QSix Residential Limited.

name: MOBILITYONE LTD
businessSummary: MobilityOne Limited is a solution provider for electronic transactions and payments in Malaysia. It is a virtual distributor of mobile prepaid reload and bill payment services in Malaysia. Its segments include telecommunication services, electronic commerce solutions and hardware, and remittance services and others. It operates through multiple distribution channels, including mobile wallets, e-commerce sites, EDC terminals, automated teller machines, kiosks, and Internet and mobile banking. It offers a range of services for the market, including wallet, Internet, and terminal-based payment services, white label e-money, remittance, lending, and custom fintech ecosystems for communities. Its technology platform enables cash, debit card, and credit card transactions from multiple devices while providing robust control and monitoring of product and service distribution. Its payment platform is developed with Microsoft technologies, which consists of OLTP Engine and Backoffice OSS.

name: ASEANA PROPERTIES LTD
businessSummary: Aseana Properties Limited is a Jersey-based property development company. The principal activities of the Company are the development of upscale residential and hospitality projects, sale of development land and operation and sale of hotel, mall and hospital assets in Malaysia and Vietnam. The Company’s segments include Investment Holding Companies; Ireka Land Sdn. Bhd.; ICSD Ventures Sdn. Bhd.; Amatir Resources Sdn. Bhd.; The RuMa Hotel KL Sdn. Bhd., and Urban DNA Sdn. Bhd. The Investment Holding Companies segment is engaged in investing activities. The Ireka Land Sdn. Bhd. segment develops Tiffani (Tiffani) by i-ZEN. The ICSD Ventures Sdn. Bhd. segment owns and operates the Harbour Mall Sandakan (HMS) and the Sandakan hotel asset. The Amatir Resources Sdn. Bhd. segment develops the SENI Mont' Kiara (SENI). The RuMa Hotel KL Sdn. Bhd. segment operates the RuMa Hotel. The Urban DNA Sdn. Bhd. segment develops and owns the RuMa Hotel and Residences (The RuMa).

name: TECNO
businessSummary: Tecno SpA Sb is an Italy-based company active in the consulting sector. The Company's main activities involve implementing solutions for integrating sustainability, digitalization, and business performance for other companies. Its core business is represented by three macro areas: Sustainable Transformation, dedicated to offer support for companies' sustainable development, to enhance and report on their efforts, and to define ESG-oriented methods and strategies; Transition Accounting, a solution for the effective management of customs procedures, excise duty refunds, and vehicle and fuel flow monitoring, gudiicng companies and SMEs through the energy transition; Digital Transformation, with the aim of fostering corporate digitalization with high-tech platforms and tools for measuring and monitoring data, costs, consumption and emissions.

name: FIDIA
businessSummary: Fidia SpA is an Italy-based company primarily engaged in the production of numerical controls and machine tools. The Company’s activities are divided into three main business lines. In the High-speed Milling Systems, it is involved in the production and sale of milling heads kits and cutting-edge equipment. Through the Numerical Controls, Dives and Software sector, it is active in the manufacture of numerical controls for milling systems, as well as in the development and distribution of computer-aided design (CAD) and computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) software. The After-sales Service sector includes the provision of technical services, sale of spare parts and scheduled maintenance contracts. The Company operates in Germany, France, Brazil, China, Poland and India, among others.

name: TRADELAB
businessSummary: TradeLab SpA is an Italy-based company active as a consulting and operational analysis company. Its main activities involve partnering with companies in managing market entry and presence processes (route-to-market) and in building partnership networks from a sustainable local development perspective.

name: OLIDATA
businessSummary: OLIDATA SpA is an Italy-based company engaged in the information technology sector. The Company focuses on operating as systems integrator and technology consultant. It designs and develops hardware and software solutions, produces, repairs and provides electronic products, mainly computers, manages IT projects and offers consultancy at various levels, as well as after sales service, among others. The Company focuses on areas such as Big Data & Analytics, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Gis & I.O.T., Software Development and ICT Infrastructure. It is involved in projects including an application framework focused on machine learning and deep learning Safemind, and Take Care, software focused on data analysis in the medical field. The Company operates locally.

name: LANDI RENZO SPA
businessSummary: Landi Renzo SpA is an Italy-based company engaged in the automotive sector. The Company is primarily involved in the manufacture of automotive fuel supply systems. The Company designs, produces and sells eco-compatible liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and compressed natural gas (CNG) fuel supply systems. It is also engaged in the installation of automotive fuel supply systems. Additionally, the Company manufactures audio systems, through its subsidiary AEB SpA, and alarm systems, through the MED brand. The Company sells its products to automobile manufacturers and to independent retailers and importers. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated through a number of subsidiaries, including Landi International BV, LR Industria e Comercio Ltda, Beijing Landi Renzo Autogas System Co Ltd, Landi Renzo RO srl and GNV Conversiones CA, among others. In March 2013, it acquired a 70% stake in Emmegas Srl, a producer of components, LPG and CNG fuel systems for motor vehicles.

name: BESTBE HOLDING
businessSummary: Bestbe Holding SpA, formally known as Gequity SpA and as Investimenti e Sviluppo SpA, is an Italy-based Holding Company engaged in the Professional & Business Education Industry. The Company is involved in the investment, through direct and indirect investments, majority, or minority interests, in small and medium-sized, public and private companies. The Firm, through its two subsidiaries HRD Training Group Srl and RR Brand Srl, operates in only one segment called Education. The Group's revenues and income originate from the provision of educational services and courses. HRD Training Group Srl (HRD) has been operating in Italy and has designed and implemented training courses and events in the behavioral, coaching, and personal growth fields, aimed at increasing the soft skills of participants. RR Brand Srl holds the 16 distinctive brands of HRD and its products.

name: DOVALUE
businessSummary: doValue SpA, formerly known as doBank SpA, is an Italy-based financial company. It provides services for the management of loans and real estate assets, primarily non-performing receivables, for banks, investors and public and private financial institutions. Its offering includes Servicing, Ancillary Services and Real Estate Services. Servicing includes debt collection and loan recovery, management of lease payments, due diligence, structuring, and co-investment. Ancillary Services provides ancillary services of commercial, property and legal nature through other companies or internal structures. Real Estate Services offers auction facilitation, borrower cooperation agreement, repossess real estate valuations, real estate valuations and technical and professional services, among others. The Company focuses on southern Europe.

name: FINCANTIERI SPA
businessSummary: Fincantieri SpA is an Italy-based company engaged in the industry sector. The Company is active in the shipbuilding constructions. The Company’s activities are divided into four business divisions. The Shipbuilding division produces cruise ships, ferries, naval vessels and mega yachts, as well as offers ship repair, conversion, refitting and refurbishment. The Offshore division focuses on the design and construction of support vessels for the oil and gas exploration and production market. The Equipment, Systems and Service division is engaged in the design and manufacture of systems and apparatus, and the provision of after sales service. The Other division provides costs for directing, controlling and coordinating the business.
