The Company’s subsidiaries are Olympic Air AE and Aegean Cyprus LTD.

name: AVE SA
businessSummary: Ave SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in home entertainment. The Company's main focus is the distribution and production of audiovisual media, including importing, manufacturing, and exporting digital video discs (DVDs) and other similar media, as well as trading video games and gaming consoles. Through its subsidiaries, each operating in different areas, the Company is also active in other sectors such as audio and music production, as well as consumer goods retail. More particularly, the Company offers audio and video production services, including dubbing and subtitling, and manages the Carrefour franchise in Greece, focusing on retail operations and Carrefour products promotion.

name: CARS MOTORCYCLES AND MARINE ENGINE TRADE
businessSummary: Cars Motorcycles and Marine Engine Trade and Import Company SA is a Greece-based commercial enterprise active in the retail sector. Its range of activities includes the representation, import and trade of motorcycles, scooters and mega scooters, snowmobiles, electric generators, outboard motors, wave runners and dinghies, four-wheeled vehicles, as well as electric and gasoline golf cars. It also offers the full range of the Yamaha Genuine accessories and spare parts, as well as motorcycle and ski jets lubricants. The Company offers all these products under the Yamaha brand name, as it is the exclusive representative of Yamaha in Greece. It also imports and trades products from other international companies including MBK, Alpinestars, Shark and Pirelli. As of April 2011, the Company is an exclusive representative of Porsche AG in Greece. On December 30, 2013, it announced the final solution of its subsidiary Motodiktyo Northern Greece SA, due to the termination of its liquidation.

name: SIDMA STEEL PRODUCTS SA
businessSummary: Sidma Steel SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the steel industry. The Company's main activities involve the trading and industrial processing of steel products. In this sector, the Company offers a wide range of products including hot-rolled, cold-rolled, galvanized, pre-painted and plastic-coated coils and sheets, as well as corrugated and trapezoidal galvanized sheets and construction hot-rolled sheets, merchant bars, beams, crane rails and railway tracks. In the pipe manufacturing sector, Sidma Steel SA produces hollow sections, construction and scaffolding pipes, galvanized construction pipes and formed pipes. The Company also offers wire products including galvanized and black wire and galvanized fencing mesh and supplies polyurethane and polyisocyanurate panels, cold room panels, mineral wool panels, galvanized and pre-painted trapezoidal sheets and light-gauge sections.

name: ELINOIL HELLENIC PETROLEUM COMPANY SA
businessSummary: Elinoil Hellenic Petroleum Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in energy-trading sector for the trade of fuel, lubricants and gas. The Company's range of activities includes the development of a petrol stations network, the production and trade of lubricants for petrol and diesel motors, agricultural machines, turbines, air compressors, heat transfer and industrial vehicles, as well as metal cutting and processing equipment. It is also engaged in the provision of marine lubricants, supply of fuel for vessels, production and trade of solid fuels, as well as the international trade of the aforementioned products. The Company's infrastructure consists of storage and liquid fuel distribution installations in Aspropyrgos, Volos and Porto Lagos, two solid fuel processing plants in Aspropyrgos and Volos, three liquid fuel processing plants, a fleet of 33 privately owned tanker vehicles, a fleet of three tanker vessels, as well as 580 Elin petrol stations in Greece.

name: ILYDA SA
businessSummary: Ilyda SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the information technology field. The Company's range of activities includes the design, development, distribution and support of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and the development of software for specialized vertical markets, which targets pharmacies and points of sale programs for retail chains of stores. It also develops tailor made software for applications in education, the public sector, financial institutions and banks. Ilyda SA also provides services including customer training, after-sales support and maintenance services for the full range of its products. Some of the Company’s products include MegaTron ERP system for business resources management, MegaTron Pharma for medicine warehouse management, VitaCard, which is a consumer privilege card, and software information systems for payroll and personnel management.

name: EVROPI HOLDINGS SA
businessSummary: Evropi Holdings SA, formerly known as I Kloukinas I Lappas Construction and Commercial Co SA is a Greece-based holding company. Through its subsidiaries, such as Sysmerom Com Srl, Klsal Ltd, Klser Commerce Ltd and Wonder Nest Retail SA, the Group is engaged in the exploitation and management of real estate as well as in the purchase, import, manufacture and trade of clothing, footwear, baby and children's goods, toys, furniture, cosmetics and household goods. The Group's activities are divided in two business areas: Commercial sector and Property Exploitation sector. Evropi Holdings SA is also engaged in the provision of commercial and technical advice and the management of investments in relation to real estate.

name: REVOIL PETROLEUM COMPANY SA
businessSummary: Revoil Petroleum Company SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the trade of petroleum products. The Company's products include different kinds of liquid gas, such as unleaded petrol of 95 and 100 octane, lead replacement petrol of 96 octane and other petroleum products, such as diesel, heating oil, kerosene and fuel oil. In addition the Company sells a range of Revoil branded lubricants. The Company owns and runs liquid fuel storage facilities, as well as operates refueling branches for its distribution of fuel. The Company's segments are: Petroleum Sector-Marketing of Biofuels; Lubricant Sector, and Investment Sector in Pontopore Shipping. The Company operates through a network of more than 500 service stations. Revoil Petroleum Company SA's subsidiary is Revoil SA of Trading Biofuels.

name: PROFILE SYSTEMS AND SOFTWARE SA
businessSummary: Profile Systems and Software SA is a Greece-based information technology (IT) company. The Company provides technology solutions to the Banking and Investment Management industries. The Company’s specialization lies in Private Wealth Management Software and Investment Portfolio Management Software, as well as a range of Banking Software solutions. It partners with global IT and software companies, providing integrated software solutions for the financial services sector covering banking, investment management, risk and compliance, and capital markets. In addition, the Company offers a range of services, including project management, consulting, customization, customer support and training. The Company operates offices in Geneva, Dubai, London, Singapore, Athens and Nicosia.

name: PIRAEUS PORT AUTHORITY SA
businessSummary: Piraeus Port Authority SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the management and operation of Piraeus port. The main activities of Piraeus Port Authority SA are ships’ anchoring services, handling cargo, loading and unloading services as well as goods storage and car transportation. The Company is also responsible for the maintenance of port facilities, the supply of port services (water, electric current and telephone connection, among others), for services provided to travelers and for renting space to third parties. Piraeus Port Authority SA has two wholly owned subsidiaries, Nafsolp SA and Logistics OLP SA. Nafsolp SA is mainly engaged in ship repairing services and Logistics OLP SA is mainly engaged in the development of combined transportations as well as port facilities and services.

name: KRI KRI MILK INDUSTRY SA
businessSummary: Kri Kri Milk Industry SA is a Greece-based company principally engaged in the production and trade of ice cream, yogurt and milk. The ice cream production includes five product lines: Cones, Ice Cream Cups, Scoop Ice Cream, Sticks, and Ice Cream Sandwiches. The yogurt production includes five product lines: Plain, Traditional, Catering, Fruit, and flavored yogurt for children under the brand name Scooby Doo. The milk production includes four products: Full cream pasteurized milk 3.5% Fat, Semi-skimmed pasteurized milk 1.5% Fat, Chocolate skimmed milk 0% Fat, and AYRAN (KEFIR) KRI-KRI. The Company also offers some of its products in family packs. KRI-KRI Milk S.A. is also active in the Balkans region through 71%-owned subsidiary KRI-KRI DOO Kumanovo, in Macedonia which has an autonomous production line of ice cream and yogurt, warehouses and cooling chambers. In February 2013, the Company dissolved its subsidiary in Bulgaria, KRI KRI BULGARIA A.D.

name: LOGISMOS INFORMATION SYSTEMS SA
businessSummary: Logismos Information Systems SA is a Greece-based company active in the information technology (IT) sector. The Company is mainly engaged in the development of business software applications and providing integration system services. Software applications include the Momentum enterprise resource planning applications with management systems for such business fields as human resources, payroll budget, customer relationship, retail, e-orders and information administration, as well as Nemo Supply Chain Management applications with management applications covering manufacturing, warehouse, product and project management, orders, procurements, demand planning, assets and supplies and information administration. Integration system services include services for business software development and also for the supply, configuration and installation of software from third parties. It has a number of deals for offering its system services, such as the optical system notices of Macedonia airport.

name: CENTRIC HOLDINGS SA
businessSummary: Centric Holdings SA, formerly Centric Multimedia SA, is a Greece-based enterprise that is active in the online gaming and entertainment software market. It has four product divisions: the Video Games division includes representation and official distribution of games from companies such as Microsoft and Sony, as well as the participation in companies operating sports book and gaming Websites; the Educational Games division includes the distribution of games and digital media of educational and encyclopedic content; the Language Learning Software division includes software that help the user learn a foreign language, and finally the Hardware/Accessories division deals with the distribution of console and computer peripherals for video games. The Company owns 51% of ECN Management Ltd, which owns online entertainment companies. Through its subsidiary SEE Sports Holdings, the Company is a Joint Venture Partner of Sportingbet PLC for the operation of the Sportingbet Website.

name: EINS SA
businessSummary: EInS SA (formerly Euroconsultants SA) is a Greece-based company engaged in the provision of business and management consulting services. The Company has eight project categories: Innovation and Technology projects include the establishment and operation of incubators and science parks; Socio-Economic and Regional Development for the provision of consulting services; Information and Communication Technology projects include services such as re-engineering and feasibility studies; projects for the Development of Small and Medium companies; Energy and Environment projects, such as energy management, and renewable resources; Government and Society projects include the provision of technical assistance; Health area projects include project management and business plans, and finally Project and Program Management projects include technical assistance for the management of complex projects. It is also involved in projects for the European Union, the World Bank and foreign governments.

name: PUBLIC POWER CORP SA
businessSummary: Public Power Corporation SA (PPC) is a Greece-based company, which is engaged in the generation, transmission and distribution of electricity. PPC Group generates electricity from the over 60 main power generating stations of the parent company as well as from additional stations, such as wind parks, small hydro stations and photovoltaic plants that belong to its wholly owned subsidiary PPC Renewables. Furthermore the Company transmits electricity through its approximately 12,000 kilometers long high voltage system, out of which approximately 11,000 kilometers are owned by its wholly owned subsidiary Independent Power Transmission Operator (IPTO SA). In addition the Company distributes electricity to consumers through its approximately 200,000 kilometers long distribution network of medium and low voltage, which are managed by its wholly owned subsidiary Hellenic Distribution Network Operator (HEDNO SA).

name: AKTOR SA HOLDING COMPANY TECHNICAL AND E
businessSummary: Aktor Holding Company Technical And Energy Projects SA is a Greece-based company primarily undertaking technical projects. The Company focuses on the design, construction, and supervision of public and private projects, including civil engineering, metal constructions and telecommunications infrastructure. The Company handles significant projects in Greece and other countries. In the field of Real Estate, the Company operates a five star hotel in Athens, develops office buildings and residential properties. In the field of Renewable Energy, the Company manages wind farms and collaborates on large-scale energy projects. The Company also engages in Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) and concessions, participating in numerous strategic infrastructure projects, enhancing its portfolio and market presence.

name: THESSALONIKI WATER AND SEWAGE CO SA
businessSummary: Thessaloniki Water Supply and Sewarage Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in water supply and sanitation sector. The Company's main activities consists of providing water and sewerage services, including the design, construction, installation, operation, management, maintenance, extension and renewal of water supply and sewage systems. The Company's projects encompass the pumping, desalination, treatment, storage, transportation, distribution and management of water, as well as the collection, treatment, storage and management of various types of wastewater. Additionally, the Company processes, distributes, disposes of and manages sewerage products. Thessaloniki Water Supply and Sewarage Company SA also engages in the exploitation of wastewater products, provision of telecommunications services through its networks and production and sale of electricity, primarily utilizing water from sources like springs, dams, aqueducts and pipelines.

name: THESSALONIKI PORT AUTHORITY SA
businessSummary: Thessaloniki Port Authority SA is a Greece-based company involved in the management and operation of Thessaloniki port. Its facilities include a conventional port, container terminal, passenger terminal, duty free commercial area and others. Services provided include unitized and conventional cargoes, coastal shipping and cruise liner passengers, ship anchoring, mooring and berthing, as well as car parking lots and links with the road and railway network. The conventional port is equipped with self-moving cranes, diesel skid units, derricks and tractors. The passenger terminal offers waiting rooms, cafeterias, card phones, trolleys for the luggage transportation, taxi station, parking areas and kiosks offering special services and tourist information. The Company’s main clients include industries, shipping and transit agents, and container transportation companies.

name: MOTOR OIL HELLAS
businessSummary: Motor Oil Hellas Corinth Refineries SA (Motor Oil Ellas Diylistiria Korinthou AE) is a Greece-based company, which operates in the oil sector with its main activities being oil refining and oil products trading. The Company operates within multiple business segments: Refinery’s Activities, Trading/Sales to Gas Stations and Services. It processes crude oils of various characteristics and produces a range of petroleum products serving petroleum marketing companies in Greece and abroad. Apart from fuels, the Company is also a lubricants producer and packager in Greece. Motor Oil Hellas Corinth Refineries SA’s subsidiaries include: Avin Oil Industrial, Commercial & Maritime Oil Company SA, Coral Gas Commercial and Industrial Gas Company, Coral AE Oil and Chemicals Company, LPC SA Processing & Trading of Lubricants & Petroleum Products, Motor Oil Cyprus Ltd, Motor Oil Finance PLC, and Building Facility Services AE.

name: MEDICON HELLAS SA
businessSummary: Medicon Hellas SA is a Greece-based company active in the health equipment sector. Its activities include research and development, production, and import and export of diagnostic products; the development of laboratory information systems; the import and distribution of in vitro diagnostics and automated analytical systems, such as Olympus for clinical chemistry, immunochemistry and lab automation, and Nihon Kohden for hematology, and the provision of cosmetic and body care products, such as make-up, anti-ageing and skin care products under the brand name Miss Beaute. Its laboratory information systems products include: Gi-Lab, which is a management system for medical laboratories; Gi-Maxima, a management program for medical centers, and Gi-Blood, which is an application that helps to connect various blood donation networks. On December 6, 2013, it merged by absorption of its subsidiary, Medicon Ltd.

name: GREEK ORGANISATION OF FOOTBALL PROGNOSTI
businessSummary: Organization of Football Prognostics SA is a Greece-based company, which conducts, manages, organizes and operates numerical lottery games, sports betting, passive and instant lotteries, horse races, online casinos and Video Lottery Terminals. The Company's games portfolio is divided into fixed odds betting games where final award is fixed and known to the players and mutual betting games where yield is calculated by distributing the contracted bets. The Company’s numerical lottery games include PAME STOIXIMA, POWERSPIN, KINO, TZOKER, LOTTO, PROTO, SUPER 3. The Company’s services are offered through retail network including OPAP Stores, PLAY Gaming Halls, street vendors and various other retailers as well as the horseracing venue in Markopoulo, or through online platforms.

name: DROMEAS OFFICE FURNITURE INDUSTRY SA
businessSummary: Dromeas Office Furniture Industry SA is a Greece-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and trade of home and office furniture, partition walls and filing systems. The Company’s home furniture offering includes sofas, wardrobes, ready-made kitchens, beds, bookcases and chairs with adjustable mechanisms. Its office furniture offering includes offices and chairs, furniture for waiting areas, auditorium seating systems, bookcases, as well as partition walls. It also has its own integrated tool making shop that produces various tools and high-pressure aluminum die casting parts. The Company’s customers include companies in the public and private sector such as banks and insurance companies, academic institutions and airports. The Company’s sales network consists of 32 stores located throughout the main cities of Greece and the Balkans, and exports its products to countries including the United Kingdom, Germany, Egypt, Cyprus, Russia, Saudi Arabia, and Australia.

name: VOGIATZOGLOU SYSTEMS SA
businessSummary: Voyatzoglou SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the trade and distribution of technical products and integrated fitting projects. The Company's technical products are divided into two areas: furniture fittings and do-it-yourself (DIY) products. Its furniture fittings offering includes furniture hinges, furniture mechanisms and fittings, small plastic and metal fittings, screws and systems for assembling furniture, furniture locks and other products. Its DIY products include shelving systems, table legs, kitchen and cabinet accessories, plastic storage systems, support arms for electrical appliances, and other products for household and professional use. The Company also offers integrated shop and warehouse fitting solutions, as well as merchandising and promotional display systems. It operates a logistics center in Inofita and has a branch in Thessaloniki. The Company has extended its activities to the Balkan region, where it has established a subsidiary in Romania.

name: AS COMPANY SA
businessSummary: AS Company SA is a Greece-based manufacturing and trading company that is active in the production and distribution of toys. The Company’s product categories are Educational, which includes scientific games, family board games and toy computers; Bebe, which consists of baby blocks, cotton dolls and rattles; Art/Creative Toys, which includes puzzles, karaoke kits and drawing sets; Boy, which includes sports games, Black and Decker sets, action figures and majorettes; Room Decoration, such as furniture, pillows, play tents and floor puzzles; Seasonal, such as school accessories, summer toys carnival costumes and toy vehicles, and Girl, which includes the Lilou doll range, the Tefal toy kitchen range and Disney accessories. It operates a network of approximately 1,800 points of sale and a logistic center and offers more than 1,500 products. The Company’s other activities include the import of toys through licensing agreements with companies such as Walt Disney and Warner Bros.

name: TECHNICAL OLYMPIC SA
businessSummary: Technical Olympic SA is a Greece-based holding company engaged in the construction, tourism and leisure, marina development and operation, wind energy, real estate and agriculture sectors. In the construction field, through Mochlos SA, it is active in the construction of public buildings and facilities, railroad and road projects, tunnels and bridges, electromechanical and irrigation projects, as well as the sale and production of ready-mix concrete; in the real estate sector, it is active in the development and exploitation of land in Greece and abroad; in the tourism sector, it owns Porto Carras resort and its offering includes accommodation in four hotels, casino, golf course, yacht marina, two spas, and conference centers; in the wind energy sector, it operates one wind park in Greece; in the agriculture sector, it operates vineyards and produces wines via Domain Porto Carras, and in the marina sector, via Delos Marinas SA, it operates four marinas in Greece.

name: SPACE HELLAS SA
businessSummary: Space Hellas SA is a Greece-based company that operates in the Information Technology (IT) and infrastructure telecommunications sectors. It is a system integrator, as well as a solution and service provider in the field of telecommunications, IT and security. Its products and services include: wire line, wireless and satellite data; provision of telecommunications services and lines at national and international level; solutions, applications and IT services for enterprises; call centers, corporate telephone networks and services; security information systems and networks, studies, applications and certifications; electromechanical and network infrastructure, computer rooms; physical security systems and surveillance facilities; network infrastructure and computer operators, and research and development programs at national and European level, among others. It serves customers in the financial, telecommunications, private, public and defense sectors.

name: ELTON INTERNATIONAL TRADING COMPANY SA
businessSummary: Elton International Trading Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the supply of chemical products. The Company's activities include the distribution of chemical raw materials and services across a wide range of industries. In agriculture, the Company offers a range of products and solutions, providing plant nutrition, crop protection, propagation materials, animal nutrition products. Other products include chemical reagents and laboratory instruments, paints, adhesives, construction materials, food supplements, functional foods, rubber, wax, food and beverage ingredients, industrial cleaning products, metal processing chemicals, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, plastics, polyurethane systems, refrigerants, lubricants, leather processing, textiles, water treatment, environmental technologies and winemaking. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is present in Southeast Europe, Ukraine and Turkey.

name: QUALITY AND RELIABILITY SA
businessSummary: Quality and Reliability SA, member of Pouliadis Group, is a Greece-based company engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) products and services. Its range of activities includes the provision of integrated IT solutions to businesses in both the public and the private sectors of the market, participation in research and development programs, as well as participation in activities and projects of European scope. Its product portfolio includes an enterprise resource planning (ERP) software package called Orama ERP; e-commerce and e-business software solutions for companies and organizations of various sizes, which include application service provision, Website design and hosting and the provision of consulting, training and support services; learning management systems and security solutions. In July 2013, it fully acquired DIGIBOOKS4ALL. In February 2014, The Company completed the liquidation of its subsidiary INTERNET STORE AE.

name: HELLENIC EXCHANGES SA
businessSummary: Hellenic Exchanges Athens Stock Exchange SA, formerly Hellenic Exchanges SA Holding Clearing Settlement and Registry, is a Greece-based company that provides support services for the operation of the Greek capital market. It operates through its subsidiaries Hellenic Central Securities Depository (ATHEXCSD) and Athens Exchange Clearing House (ATHEXClear) in the following segments: Trading, Clearing, Settlement, Data Feed, Information Technology (IT), Exchange Services, Depository Services, Clearing House Services, as well as Other. The Company’s purpose is the participation in companies and businesses having activities related to the support and operation of organized capital markets, as well as the development of activities and provision of services related to the support and operation of organized capital markets. Furthermore its purpose is the organization and support of the operation of a cash market, a derivatives market, as well as other financial means in Greece and abroad.

name: DUROS SA
businessSummary: Duros S.A. is a Greece-based company engaged in the apparel industry. The Company's range of activities includes the production and retail sale of menswear. The Company operates Dur Stores throughout Greece, as well as one store in Cyprus and one in the Czech Republic, Dur Outlets in Athens and Patras, as well as exclusive shops in Kefalonia, Kavala, Kilkis, Santorini and Athens. It also offers its products through the operation of an online shop. Duros S.A. is also engaged in the exclusive representation of foreign houses, as well as the participation in international fashion shows. It collaborates with the Italian house David Mayer.

name: EVROFARMA SA
businessSummary: Evrofarma Viomichania Galaktos Anonymi Viomichaniki & Emporiki Etaireia SA (Evrofarma SA) is a Greece-based company engaged in the dairy industry. The Company offers several ranges of products: Milk, including fresh whole, semi-skimmed and skimmed milk, highly pasteurized milk and chocolate flavored milk as well as airan and kefir milk drinks; Yogurts, including traditional, cow-milk and strained yogurts including flavoured yogurts; Cheese products, such as telemes cheese, goat cheese, organic feta cheese and anthotiro cheese. The Company’s milk supplies come from various farmers and associates in Macedonia and Thrace. Evrofarma SA has a wholly owned subsidiary, Campus SA, which deals mainly with cow milk production.

name: KORDELLOS CH BROS SA
businessSummary: Kordellou Bros SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the trade and processing of iron and steel products. The Company's main activities include the purchase, storage, processing and distribution of metallurgical products such as iron, steel, special steels and non-ferrous metals. Additional services include cold forming, sandblasting and painting of steel products. The Company operates steel service centers and distribution hubs in Attica and northern Greece. Their product range, among others, includes structural hollow sections, ERW structural hollow sections, galvanized welded pipes, water and gas pipes, cold formed circular welded hollow sections, hot rolled seamless pipes and hot rolled steel plates.

name: DAIOS PLASTICS SA
businessSummary: Daios Plastics SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the production and wholesale of plastic films for agricultural applications. Its product portfolio consists of Vineyard Films, a thick-thin plastic film, used for viticulture applications; Greenhouse Film, such as flat or tubular plastic films, which have ultraviolet filters, tear and puncture resistance, and stabilized plastic films utilized in permanent sun exposure; Tobacco Drying Film with stress and strain resistance properties, used for drying tobacco leaves; Dalin Watermelon Film, for covering linear cultivations of watermelon, melon and tomatoes under low tunnels, as well as Dalin Pocket portfolio of films, which are used in the asparagus cultivation. Furthermore the Company is engaged in the production and wholesale of polyethylene pipes drip irrigation, in trading raw materials for manufacturing plastics, as well as in the tourism sector through its subsidiary, Hellas Holiday Hotels SA, operating a hotel in Thessaloniki.

name: N VARVERIS MODA BAGNO SA
businessSummary: N Varveris Moda Bagno SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the trade of interior design products and home and office furniture. Its product range includes tiles for bathroom, kitchen and flooring; bathroom items, including sanitary pieces, accessories and furniture; kitchen appliances and furniture, as well as office, home and outdoor furniture. It offers its products through a network of 16 own stores across Greece and six agent stores and also operates a store with the exclusive representation of Armani Casa products. The Company is also active in the catering sector and operates two restaurants in Athens and Mykonos, as well as the real estate sector via land acquisition and building construction. It has undertaken various projects such as the furnishing and decoration of hotels, business centers, restaurants and super yachts, with clients such as Athens Hilton, Grande Bretagne, Ministry of Culture and National Bank of Greece. It has two subsidiaries in Cyprus and Turkey.

name: MATHIOS REFRACTORY SA
businessSummary: Mathios Refractory SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the production, processing and marketing of refractory, construction and related materials and the execution of construction contractors, subcontractors and industrial projects. The Company produces such products as shaped refractory products, like fire bricks, clinker bricks and decorative building components; refractory aggregates, mortars and insulation materials; furnace lining elements; ceramics, such as pots, tiles and roof tiles, as well as artificial stone veneers. It has established four subsidiaries: Bau Market SA, engaged in the construction, repairs, and maintenance or remodeling of houses and buildings; IDEAL Mathios Refractories active in the production and trade of various refractory materials; Mathios GmbH, which distributes Mathios products in Germany, and Mathios AD in Bulgaria, which is mainly engaged in the production and trade of artificial stone veneers.

name: AKRITAS SA
businessSummary: Akritas SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the wood and furniture industry. The Company's products include chipboards, melamine-faced boards, veneers and various ready-made components, as well as furniture. Its chipboard is made from 100% forest wood; its melamine-faced board is available in a wide range of colors and patterns, including monochrome tones, abstract geometrical patterns and imitation wood effects, and is available with a smooth or textured surface, in gloss or matt finish; its veneers are available in such colors as ash, oak, cherry and beech, while the ready-made wood components are used in office and home furniture making. Akritas SA Collection includes such furniture items as tables and bookcases. The Company also operates in Bulgaria through its subsidiary, Akritas Bulgaria EAD, formerly Emos Ltd. Its products are also exported abroad in such countries as Turkey, Bulgaria, Serbia, Albania and Cyprus.

name: IKTINOS HELLAS GREEK MARBLE INDUSTRY SA
businessSummary: Iktinos Hellas Greek Marble Industry SA is a Greece-based company active in the mining, cutting and trading of marble, granite and decorative stones. Its product range consists of decorative stones, including marble, granite, quarella, bisazza, glass stone and lime stone. Some of its projects are applications of marble, granite and decorative stone in bathrooms, such as shower trays, bath tubs and sinks, and kitchens, such as kitchens sinks. The Company’s production facilities comprise three quarries and two factories, and it operates four retail branches. The Company's subsidiaries include Greek Marble Industry Fidias Hellas ABEE, Iktinos Construction & Tourism S.A. and IKTINOS MARMARON SA.

name: DOMIKI KRITIS SA
businessSummary: Domiki Kritis SA is a Greece-based company active in the construction sector. Its range of activities includes plumbing, irrigation and underground projects, building constructions, port and road construction projects, as well as the management and exploitation of properties in the real estate sector. Its plumbing, irrigation and underground projects include excavation work, underground rainwater channel construction, flood protection works, and the construction of water supply and sewerage networks. The building projects include airport buildings, hotels and school complexes. The port construction works include ports, marinas and fishing shelters. The road projects include highways, junctions and bridges. Its subsidiaries are mainly active in the hotel and tourist sector, public works construction, production and trade of building materials, exploitation of quarries and quarry products, and in the real estate and energy sector. In April 2013, it divested its 50% stake in VEEK SA.

name: EYDAP S.A.
businessSummary: Athens Water Supply and Sewerage Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in water supply, sewerage and renewable energy sectors. The Company's main activity includes the delivery of drinking water, sourced from pristine areas free from agricultural and industrial activities. This water is transported using gravity, which minimizes energy consumption. In addition to water supply, the Company manages sewerage and wastewater treatment. For that end, the Company collects and treats wastewater, returning it to the environment free of pollutants, following international practices. Additionally, the Company is involved in renewable energy projects, including hydroelectric power generation, biogas and natural gas cogeneration and solar power projects.

name: KTIMA KOSTAS LAZARIDIS SA
businessSummary: Domaine Costa Lazaridi SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in wine production. The Company's main activities include the production of various types of wine and traditional distillates such as tsipouro and ouzo, as well as the production of aged balsamic vinegars. Domaine Costa Lazaridi SA operates a vineyard in Drama in northern Greece, cultivating both Greek and international grape varieties and an organic vineyard near Lake Marathon in Attica. The Company also operates an estate in the Attica region with facilities such as a winery, a wine museum and spaces for events and wine tastings. The customer network of Domaine Costa Lazaridi SA extends beyond Greece, with the majority of its products being exported to foreign countries.

name: HAIDEMENOS SA
businessSummary: Haidemenos S.A. is a Greece-based company active in the printing and graphic arts industry. Its product categories are Commercial printing, Digital printing, Silkscreen printing and Posters/banners. Commercial printing covers all types of commercial printing including magazines, company leaflets, newspaper and magazine inserts, advertisement leaflets, books, cards, calendars, boxes, travel information leaflets and maps. Digital printing uses modern methods to print on materials, such as paper, vinyl, canvass and carpets, and is used for various purposes, such as outdoor advertising, athletic installations and theatre and television sets. Silkscreen printing sector uses a five-color machine to print on materials, such as paper and cloth, mainly for advertising purposes. Posters/banners sector covers posters and banners of all sizes, including billboard posters.

name: FRIGOGLASS SAIC
businessSummary: Frigoglass SAIC is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the refrigeration industry. The Company's main activities include the manufacture and supply of refrigeration facilities, cooling systems and glass packaging solutions, as well as cooling products such as corner fridges, drawer fridges, wine cabinets and cold rooms. Additionally, Frigoglass SAIC offers asset performance services, including order management, field service, installations, refurbishment, equipment repair and maintenance, spare parts management and logistics solutions. Through its subsidiary, the Company is also involved in the production and trade of a range of glass containers, metal crowns and plastic crates, serving foreign markets in Africa, including Nigeria.

name: PETROS PETROPOULOS SA
businessSummary: Petros Petropoulos SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the manufacture, modification, marketing, distribution, and support of vehicles, automotive machinery, industrial and agricultural equipments, batteries and any similar or related to the above equipment components. It is structured in eight business units: Truck and Bus, Agricultural Equipment, Isuzu, Engines and Boats, Industrial Equipment, Petrogen, PMS and Shell Lubricants. Petros Petropoulos SA represents and distributes the products of such companies as Lombardini, Scania, Kogel, Isuzu, Allison Transmission, Perlini, Perkins, Abbriata, Ingersoll-Rand, McCormick, Exide and Hankook, among others. It also offers technical services for its Petrogen products, through a national network of authorized technicians. It operates through a number subsidiaries, and is present in Cyprus and Bulgaria through, PI Square Holdings Ltd and Petromotor Bulgaria EOOD, respectively. In the end of 2013, it merged by absorption of Petrosys SA.

name: INTRALOT-INTEGR.LOTT.SYS.&SER.
businessSummary: Intralot Integrated Lottery Systems and Services SA, is a Greece-based Company primarily engaged in the gaming sector. The company offers a wide range of products and services, including lottery, betting and gaming solutions, both online and offline: the Lottery Solution, which includes software for game management, content, player and device management, customer touchpoints and a governance suite; the Betting Solution, which provides an omnichannel player experience platform, Managed Trading Services, terminals and online touchpoints; Gaming solutions that adhere to regulation compliance, Digital Transformation services, which help businesses' performance improvement using technologies. Other services include Managed Trading Services and Betting Consultation. The Company operates in multiple countries across five continents, including the USA, Peru, Argentina, Chile, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Turkey, Taiwan and Morocco.

name: ATTICA PUBLICATIONS SA
businessSummary: Attica Publications SA is a Greece-based company active in the publication of magazines. Its other activities include the operation of the radio station, Athens Radio Dee Jay; the ownership of a record company; the ownership of a film distribution company, and the ownership of a press distribution company, Argos SA, which distributes magazines and newspapers across Greece. The Company publishes weekly, bi-monthly and monthly magazines. These magazines cover general and specialized interests for men and women and sectors such as health and fitness, television programs, decoration and others. It has alliances with global publishing houses such as Hearst SA, Figaro SA, Weider Publications SA, Playboy Enterprises SA and Mondadori SpA. It also has the exclusive distribution of Playboy Magazine for Greece and South Eastern Europe, and has subsidiaries in Hungary, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Romania and Serbia. On April 20, 2012, it sold its subsidiary, Map Magazine Publishing Commercial Company Ltd.

name: AUTOHELLAS SA
businessSummary: Autohellas SA is a Greece-based company that is engaged in the car, light truck and equipment rental and car import, distribution and sales sectors. More specifically, its services include Car Rentals (for under one year), and Operating Leasing and Fleet Management (for over one year). In Greece, as well as in Cyprus, Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia, Montenegro, Ukraine and Croatia it has the exclusive rights to use the Hertz and Thrifty, Dollar and Firefly brands. In the retail sector, it is the exclusive importer of SEAT, HYUNDAI and KIA cars in Greece and of SEAT cars in Bulgaria. The Company, through its VELMAR brand, also provides services as a licensed distributor and repairer of BMW, MINI, FORD, OPEL, SEAT, SAAB, HONDA, ALFA ROMEO, FIAT, ABARTH, MITSUBISHI, VOLVO, HYUNDAI and KIA cars and BMW MOTO motorcycles.

name: ALPHA ASTIKA AKINITA SA
businessSummary: Alpha Real Estate Services SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in real estate industry. The Company's main activities include the management and exploitation of all types of real estate properties, ranging from simple plots and agricultural land to complex industrial facilities, residential complexes, modern shopping centers and hotel units. The Company provides technical consulting on related matters, undertakes construction projects and develops and operates hotel and tourism facilities. Additionally, Alpha Real Estate Services SA engages in real estate and brokerage activities, conducts various studies and offers general consulting services as well as performs property and machinery valuations for third parties. Through its subsidiaries, the Company, is active in Southeast Europe.

name: EUROBANK ERGASIAS SERVICES AND HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Eurobank Ergasias Services and Holdings SA, formerly known as Eurobank Ergasias SA, is a Greece-based company, which is active in retail, corporate and private banking, asset management, treasury, capital markets and other services. The Bank operates in the following segments: Retail, incorporating customer current accounts, savings, as well as deposits and investment savings products, among others; Corporate, incorporating current accounts, deposits, loan and other credit facilities, foreign currency and derivative products to corporate entities, as well as equity brokerage, among others; Wealth Management, incorporating private banking services, including total wealth management, to medium and high net worth individuals, mutual fund and investment savings products, as well as institutional asset management; Global and Capital Markets, incorporating investment banking services, as well as specialized financial advice and intermediation, as well as International.

name: MEVACO METALLURGICAL INDUSTRIAL AND TRAD
businessSummary: Mevaco Metallurgical Industrial And Trading Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in metal fabrication and construction. The Company offers a variety of services and products, including sheet metal fabrication for carbon steel, stainless steel and aluminum, producing customized items. Additionally, the Company manufactures photovoltaic support structures with diverse configurations for global delivery and produces military hardware, including welded aluminum, high-grade steel and stainless steel structures. Other activities include the fabrication of intricate metal assemblies, electronic information boards for stadiums, components for household appliances, heating industry parts, advertising structures and facades and aesthetic improvement works.

name: QUEST HOLDINGS SA
businessSummary: Quest Holdings SA, formerly Info-Quest SA, is a Greece-based information technology (IT) and telecommunication solutions provider. Its main activities include the digital technology industry, with activities across the entire spectrum of the ICT market, from the manufacture and distribution of products to the design, application and support of Integrated IT Solutions for large organizations in the private and public sectors. Quest Holdings coordinates its activities in this market via the strongest companies in the field: Info Quest Technologies, Uni Systems and iSquare. In the Green Energy sector, the Group implements large investment projects on electricity production from renewable sources with licensed power exceeding 400 MW regarding more than 30 wind and photovoltaic parks. In this market, Quest Holdings is active through Quest Energy and its subsidiaries. At the same time, the Group is also active in the Courier Services sector, through ACS.

name: HELLENIQ ENERGY HOLDINGS SA
businessSummary: HELLENiQ ENERGY Holdings SA is a Greece-based company, which operates in the energy sector predominantly in Greece, South Eastern Europe and the East Mediterranean. The Group’s activities include refining and marketing of oil products, production and marketing of petrochemical products and exploration for hydrocarbons. The Group also provides engineering services. Through its investments in DEPA and Elpedison, the Group also operates in the sector of natural gas and in the production and trading of electric power. The Company’s main business segments include: Refining, Supply and Trading; Marketing (Domestic and International); Production and Trading of Petrochemicals; Exploration and Production of Hydrocarbons, as well as Electricity Generation and Trading and Natural Gas.

name: KIRIACOULIS MEDITERRANEAN CRUISES SHIPPI
businessSummary: Kiriacoulis Mediterranean Cruises Shipping SA is a Greece-based holding company mainly engaged in the provision of yachting services to the professional and tourist sectors. The Company is active in three sectors: the professional sea tourism with yachts; the marinas management through five subsidiaries, associates and other companies, as well as in the real estate and constructions sector through one subsidiary. The fleet consists of approximately 400 yachts of different kinds, such as sailing yachts and catamarans. The Company operates 26 yacht and customer service points, of which seven are located in Greece, six in Italy, seven in Croatia, two in Turkey, two in the Caribbean, one in France and one in Malta. On December 31, 2012, the Company divested K & G MEDITERRANEAN MARINAS MANAGEMENT SA To D - MARINE INVESTMENTS HOLDING BV.

name: ALUMIL ALUMINIUM INDUSTRY SA
businessSummary: Alumil Aluminium Industry SA is a Greece-based aluminum extrusion company and member of the Alumil Group. The Company’s range of activities includes the production and trade of aluminum billets, aluminum accessories, aluminum alloys, thermal processed products, mechanical equipment used in transforming billets into final products and trade of the mechanical and electrical equipment related to aluminum processing, as well as the participation in companies with similar purposes. Its product range includes architectural systems for architectural applications; automatic entrance door systems, automatic and folder doors for lifts, sliding, swing and curved automatic doors; solar protection products; security and resistant metal doors, and plastic products, as well as aluminum for industrial applications. On May 1, 2013, the Company closed and liquidated its subsidiary, Alumul Polska Srl and in October 2013, it established a new subsidiary in the United States, ALUMIL FABRICATION INC.

name: HOUSE OF AGRICULTURE SPIROU SA
businessSummary: Spirou House of Agriculture Commercial and Industrial SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the agriculture sector. The Company is active in the research, production, processing and marketing of plant propagation material, including seeds and seedlings. It produces seeds for corn, cotton, vegetables, and alfalfa plants. The customer network of the Company extends in both the Greek market and internationally, supplying products to the Balkans, Southern Europe, North Africa, Turkey, the Middle East and the former Soviet Union republics. The Company conducts research activities to develop new varieties and maintains substantial seed production operations in Greece and collaborates with international research institutions to adapt varieties to specific market conditions.

name: JUMBO SA
businessSummary: Jumbo SA is a Greece-based company, which is engaged in the retail trade of new items in specialized stores. It is mainly engaged in the retail sale of toys, baby items, seasonal items, decoration items, books and stationery. Furthermore a small part of the Company’s operations is the wholesale trade of toys and similar items to third parties. The Company operates in the following segments: Greece, Cyprus, Bulgaria and Romania. The Company’s subsidiaries include: Jumbo ECR SRL, based in Romania; Jumbo Trading Ltd, based in Cyprus, as well as Jumbo EC.B EOOD Sofia, based in Bulgaria. The Company operates more than 70 stores in Greece, Cyprus, Bulgaria and Romania, as well as an online store e-jumbo.

name: ELVALHALCOR HELLENIC COPPER AND ALUMINIU
businessSummary: Elvalhalcor Hellenic Copper and Aluminium Industry SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the non-ferrous metal processing industry. The Company operates under two segments: Aluminium and Copper. In the Aluminium segment, the Company, together with its subsidiaries Symetal, Elval Colour, Vepal, Anoxal, and Viomal, offers a wide range of rolled and extruded products, including coils, sheets, strips, foil, and aluminium profiles. In the Copper segment, the Company, along with its subsidiaries Sofia Med (Bulgaria), Epirus Metalworks (Greece), and HC Isitma, produces copper tubes for water supply and industrial applications, as well as copper and brass sheets and strips, operating facilities in Greece, Bulgaria, Turkey, and the Netherlands.

name: E PAIRIS SA
businessSummary: E Pairis SA is a Greece-based manufacturing company that is active in the production and trade of plastic products as well as in the logistics sector, where it stores merchandise on behalf of third parties. The Company’s product range includes plastic bottles with lids, which have a capacity ranging from 200 grams to five liters and are used in the detergents, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and food industries; plastic containers, which have a capacity ranging from 18 to 30 liters or larger containers of up to 120 liters, and are used in the detergents, mineral oils and food industries, and plastic litter bags, which are produced for both domestic and business use. Its products are categorized according to the raw material used for their production, which are: polyethylene, polyethylene terephthalate and polypropylene. The Company’s production unit has a total annual production capacity of 5,700 tons. The Company’s clients include companies such as Delta, Kraft, Cyclon, and Nestle.

name: NAFPAKTOS TEXTILE INDUSTRY SA
businessSummary: Nafpaktos Textile Industry SA is a Greece-based industrial and commercial enterprise. The Company's main activities include cotton ginning, the production of yarns and fabrics, as well as the production of ready-made clothing. Its product portfolio consists of cotton-combed yarns, used as raw material in knitting and weaving, slub yarns, and the design and production of stable fabrics used for making shirts and trousers. Its production units include two spinning mills that have a total annual production capacity of 1,360 tons of cotton-combed yarns and 1,250 tons of cotton by-products, as well as two weaving mills that have an annual production capacity of 1.2 million meters of fabric. The production facilities occupy an area of 20,590 square meters on privately owned land, plus storage facilities of 2,527 square meters in area. The Company’s main subsidiaries are Polaris SA and Sofadon Ginning Mills SA; it also has export operations with points of sale in Spain, Germany and Italy.

name: HELLENIC TELECOMMUNICATIONS ORGANIZATION
businessSummary: Hellenic Telecommunications Organization SA (OTE) is a Greece-based Company primarily engaged in the telecommunications industry. The Company offers a range of telecommunications services, including fixed-line and mobile telephony, broadband services, pay television and information and communications technology (ICT) solutions. Its segments include OTE, COSMOTE group, TELEKOM ROMANIA and Other. In Greece, the Company is also involved in maritime communications, real-estate and professional training. The Company's OTE segment provides fixed-line services, Internet access services, ICT services and television services in Greece. The COSMOTE group segment offers mobile telecommunications services in Greece, Albania and Romania. The TELEKOM ROMANIA segment provides fixed-line services, Internet access services, ICT services and television services in Romania. The Other segment consists of other operations of the Company.

name: FLEXOPACK SA
businessSummary: Flexopack SA is a Greece-based company, which is engaged in the manufacture of flexible plastic packaging materials. It mainly serves the food industry, with emphasis in meat, poultry, cheese and fish, as well as other markets, such as the printing/conversion and personal care packaging industries. Its product portfolio includes packaging materials, packaging equipment as well as technical films. Its range of products include: shrink bags, shrink films, skin films, thermoforming films, lid ding films, vacuum pouches, rotary vacuum systems, shrink units, chilling units, drying units, conveying/control systems, bag loading systems, lamination films, barrier liners, as well as customized/applications specific films.

name: INTERTECH SA
businessSummary: Intertech SA is a Greece-based commercial enterprise that operates mainly as the representative of Panasonic products in Greece. The Company has four main product categories: telecommunication equipment, including mobile, wireless and landline telephony devices; office automation applications, such as copy machines, fax and laser fax machines, and digital televisions; computer peripherals, including multimedia devices, pan boards, monitors, camera networks and printers, and audiovisual devices, such as professional video cameras, video and audio mixers, projectors and plasma displays, switchers, multiplexers and controllers. It also offers after sale technical support and services for its products.

name: LAVIPHARM SA
businessSummary: Lavipharm SA is a Greek commercial and industrial enterprise engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing and distribution of pharmaceutical, cosmetic and over-the-counter (OTC) products. Its main pharmaceutical products cover such categories as anti-inflammatory, asthma controlling, neurological, antiseptic, analgesic, dermatological and gastrointestinal therapies. Its cosmetic products are offered under the brand names of Castalia Soins Dermocosmetiques and Laviderm Active Technology and are used for skin, face and body care, as well as for scalp and hair problems. Its OTC products include cold and flu remedies, oral care, dermatological products, condoms, antiseptics, analgesics, laxatives and gynecology products. It is the parent company of Lavipharm Group of Companies. In January 2014, Robertet SA acquired together with CODIF the HITEX company, specialized in subcontracting of carbon dioxide extraction, from Lavipharm SA.

name: LAMDA DEVELOPMENT SA
businessSummary: Lamda Development SA is a Greece-based company engaged, together with its subsidiaries, in the investment, development, leasing and maintenance of real estate projects. The Company operates in Greece, as well as in other neighboring Balkan countries mainly Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Montenegro. The Company’s development portfolio includes: commercial and leisure centers, The Mall Athens and Golden Hall in Athens and Mediterranean Cosmos in Thessaloniki, office buildings, residential complexes and Flisvos Marina in Faliro. Its subsidiaries include: LAMDA Estate Development SA, LAMDA Prime Properties SA, LAMDA Erga Anaptyxis SA, LAMDA Domi SA, LD Trading SA, LAMDA Leisure SA and GEAKAT SA, among others.

name: ELVE SA
businessSummary: Elve SA is a Greece-based clothing company engaged in the design, production and retail of designer clothes. The Company’s product range mainly consists of women's clothing and includes the brands Arte Maxima, MyWay, OKS and Carisma. Its clothing range is sold through both Company-owned stores and through franchise stores. The Company’s subsidiaries are: Lito SA that specializes in baby wear; Harmony Cruises, which specializes in the travel industry, and Elve Bulgaria, which is also active in the clothing sector. The Company has an international sales network that includes England, France, Canada, Italy, Ireland, Ukraine, Russia, and Cyprus. In October 2013, the Company merged by absorption of its wholly owned subsidiary, ECOJOULE SOLAR SA. The Company wholly owns Company Accumulation Solar Energy SA, which features photovoltaic power stations.

name: THRACE PLASTICS HOLDING AND COMMERCIAL S
businessSummary: Thrace Plastics Holding and Commercial Societe Anonyme, formerly Thrace Plastics Co SA, is a Greece-based company engaged in the production and trade of plastic products, textiles and packaging materials. The Company's range of products are divided into three categories: Technical Fabrics & Fibers, which includes such products as woven and non-woven geotextiles, ground covers, crop covers, nets, roofing membranes, staple fibers, concrete reinforcement fibers, geogrids, Mega bag components and carpet and industrial yarns; Consumer Packaging, which offers plastic containers and lids, cups, tubs, bottles, bags for liquid packaging, as well as plastic packaging for food products, and Industrial Packaging, which includes ropes and twines, big bags, films, woven polypropylene bags, bags for heavy duty, pallet covers, and stretch hoods. The Company operates through its local and international subsidiaries.

name: MINERVA KNITWEAR SA
businessSummary: Minerva Knitwear SA is a Greece-based industrial and commercial enterprise engaged in the clothing field. Its main activities include the production and trade of blouses, pajamas and t-shirts, as well as underwear for men, women and children. The Company’s collection includes such brands as Minerva Classic, Minerva Lady Line, Minerva Fimelle, Minerva Underworld, Minerva Seamless, Minerva Forward, Minerva Pyjamas and Sporties, as well as such brands for children as Minervakia, Disney, Barbie, Superman and Flintstones. Minerva Knitwear SA has a production unit located in the Thessaloniki area, Greece. Its subsidiaries include: Eleten SA, engaged in the production and trade of clothes for babies and children; Minco Romania SRL, which operates a clothing factory in Romania, and a subsidiary in Cyprus. Its network is comprised of a number of outlets in Greece and it is present in all large department stores.

name: EKTER SA
businessSummary: Ekter Building Real Estate Hotel Commercial Industrial SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in constructions. The Company undertakes a variety of public and private infrastructure projects and technical works, including highway and road construction, bridge building, railways, industrial facilities, energy projects, hospitals, airports, museums and hotels. In the field of energy, the Company is engaged on wind energy projects, including the creation and operation of wind farms and the production of electricity from wind potential. In the field of real estate, the Company is operating hotels and engages on real-estate development. In the medical field, the Company is involved in the sale, representation, marketing, design, supply, and installation of medical equipment, materials, machinery, and tools for both the public and private sectors.

name: AVAX SA
businessSummary: Avax SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the construction industry. The Company operates in several key sectors. In the construction sector, Avax SA undertakes civil engineering projects such as hospitals, sports centers, hotels, banks, educational institutions, parking facilities, airports, and other related projects. The Company is active in concessions and public-private partnerships focusing on highway and bridge constructions. In the energy and industrial sector, Avax SA is involved in the construction of power plants, natural gas projects, liquefied natural gas stations, refineries, petrochemicals, and environmental projects. Additionally, through its subsidiaries, the Company is engaged in real estate development, vehicle technical inspections, and facility management, including cleaning, disinfection, and waste management services.

name: GR. SARANTIS S.A.
businessSummary: Gr Sarantis SA is a Greece-based company active in the manufacture and distribution of consumer products. Its product portfolio includes Fragrances and Cosmetics, like aftershave lotions and deodorants with brands such as Adidas and C-THRU; household products, like food packaging, cleaning and shoe care products of such brands as Sanitas and Camel and health and care products, which mainly comprise vitamins and food supplements. The Company has also formed joint-ventures and strategic alliances with international companies in the cosmetics, health and beauty sectors, such as Estee Lauder, Kolastyna, Domet, Topstar and Clinique, for exclusive distribution of their products in Greece and Eastern Europe. The Company’s subsidiaries include SARANTIS PORTUGAL, ASTRID S.R.O. and Polipak Sp. z.o.o.

name: ELLAKTOR
businessSummary: Ellaktor SA is a Greece-based company that operates, through its subsidiaries, mainly in constructions and quarrying, real estate development and management, wind power and environment, as well as concession sectors. The Company operates in the following business segments: construction and quarries, real estate development, concessions, wind farms, environment as well as other activities. The Company operates abroad in the Middle East countries, and more specifically in the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Jordan, as well as in other countries, such as Germany, Italy, Cyprus, Romania, Bulgaria, Albania, Serbia, Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia (FYROM), the United Kingdom, Cameroon, Ethiopia, Turkey, the United States, Chile and Panama. It subsidiaries include Aktor SA, Aktor Concessions SA, Andromachi SA, Yialou Anaptyxiaki SA and Reds Real Estate development SA, among others.

name: PROODEFTIKI TECHNICAL CO SA
businessSummary: Proodeftiki Technical Co SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in construction industry. The Company specializes in civil engineering and general construction, focusing on roads, reservoirs, railways, harbors, refineries and similar projects. Proodeftiki Technical Co SA undertakes various technical works, including road construction, building, hydraulic, industrial, tourism, railway, port, mining, shipyard, airport, and refinery projects for both public and private sectors, domestically and internationally. The Company also engages in purchasing land and properties for use or resale, and operates factories producing construction materials. Proodeftiki Technical Co SA holds all the necessary permissions allowing the undertaking of a wide range of public and private works.

name: BIOKARPET INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL ENTE
businessSummary: Biokarpet Industrial and Commercial Enterprises SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the textile, metallurgy and information technology (IT) sectors. In the textile sector, it is engaged in the production and trading of carpets, pile carpets, blankets and flokati rugs, as well as in the import and trade of hand tufted rugs, laminate flooring and products for contract business. In the metallurgy field, it is operational through its subsidiaries, Exalco SA, Exalco Bulgaria A.D. and Exalco Romania S.R.L., which are active in the production and trading of aluminum-extruded products, as well as the production, trading and installation of aluminum frames and glass panes. In the IT sector, it operates through Albio Data SA, which is engaged in the design and development of tailor-made integral information systems for enterprises and organizations; it also acts as a representative of Bull IT systems in central Greece.

name: IDEAL GROUP SA
businessSummary: Ideal Holdings SA is a Greece-based investment company. The Company invests in medium-sized enterprises domiciled in countries such as Greece and Cyprus, acquiring their majority stake. In particular, the Company invests in various sectors, including Information Technology (IT) and retail among others. Ideal Holdings SA focuses on its revenue growth through various means such as mergers and acquisitions, with a defined exit strategy. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is involved in trust services and cybersecurity, integrated IT solutions and technology hardware distribution, software development, customer communication management and the distribution of technology products, IT software and cybersecurity solutions as well the management of commercial department stores.

name: ATHENS MEDICAL CENTER
businessSummary: Athens Medical Center SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the healthcare industry. The Company is involved in the organization, operation and management of healthcare facilities, treatment centers and rehabilitation centers, either through property purchases or leases. Additionally, the Company provides training and selection of staff for healthcare units, imports and distributes medical tools and equipment, organizes supply services for necessary materials and offers financial and management consulting services. Other activities include the promotion of medical research and treatment methods, as well as the modernization of healthcare facilities. Besides its operations in Greece, Athens Medical Center SA is also active in Romania.

name: GEK TERNA S.A.
businessSummary: GEK Terna SA is a Greece-based company active in a number of sectors. The Company operates under the following segments: Construction, which refers to contracts for the construction of technical projects; Electricity from Renewable Sources of Energy, which refers to the electricity production from wind generators, from hydroelectric projects and other renewable energy sources; Electricity from Thermal Energy Sources and Trading of Electric Energy, which refers to the electricity production using natural gas as fuel, and to the trading of electric energy; Real Estate Development, which refers to the purchase, development and management of real estate; Industry, which refers to the production of quarry products and the exploitation of magnesite quarries; Concessions, which concerns the construction and operation of infrastructure, other public interest projects and other facilities, as well as Holdings.

name: ATTICA HOLDINGS SA
businessSummary: Attica Holdings S.A. is a Greece-based holding company that is active in passenger shipping, travel agency and cargo services. It offers shipping, transportation, leisure services and connections between Greece and Italy in the Adriatic Sea, and between mainland Greece and the Cycladic and Dodecanese islands of the Aegean Sea as well as the island of Crete. The Company operates through its subsidiaries: Superfast Ferries Maritime S.A., that operates a fleet of five vessels; Blue Star Maritime S.A., that operates a fleet of eight vessels; Attica Premium S.A., and Attica Ferries MC & Co Joint Venture, a company that is engaged in the management of all the ship-owning companies of the Group for a common service in international and domestic routes. On April 5, 2013, the Company sold RoPax vessel Superfast VI to Genting Group.

name: GENERAL COMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL SA
businessSummary: General Commercial and Industrial SA is a Greece-based company active in the field of industrial and hydraulic equipment trade. The Company is a supplier of piping materials, hand and power tools, hydraulic equipment and industrial tools. Its product range includes hand tools, such as axes, brooms and shovels; power tools, such as chain saws and hedge trimmers; fire fighting equipment; fittings and allied products; carbon and alloy steel flanges, household appliances, including irons, vacuum cleaners and kitchen equipment; industrial tools, such as air tools, glue guns and measuring instruments; machinery, including air compressors, battery chargers and generators; painting accessories, such as brushes, scarpers and sprays; tubes and pipes; stainless steel equipment; security products, including locks and cash boxes, and valves. The Company’s products are applied in the environmental projects, water supply, oil and gas, energy, marine, construction, chemical and petrochemical sectors.

name: BIOTER SA
businessSummary: Bioter S.A. is a Greece-based construction company, which mainly undertakes civil engineering projects for the public sector. The Company’s range of activities includes the construction of buildings, industrial infrastructure and networks, as well as public transportation infrastructure projects. The building construction sector includes sports facilities, exhibition centers, public and governmental buildings, hospitals, hotels, housing complexes, parking stations, shopping malls and office buildings, as well as landscaping. The industrial infrastructure and networks projects include factories, power and electromechanical projects, power and telecommunications networks, refineries, industrial complexes and warehouses, military projects and recycling plants, waste and water treatment facilities, as well as water supply networks. In the field of the public transportation infrastructure projects, the Company undertakes the construction of ports, roads, tunnels, bridges and metro stations.

name: LAMPSA HELLENIC HOTELS SA
businessSummary: Lampsa Hellenic Hotels SA (Lampsa) is a Greece-based company engaged in the establishment, operation and management of hotel complexes. The Company owns Grande Bretagne, a five-star hotel located in the city center of Athens. The hotel’s complex facilities include 262 luxury rooms and 59 suites, including a Presidential and Royal suite. The room features include cable television, direct dial telephone, Internet access and voice mail services. It offers restaurant and bar facilities, a business center, as well as sports and spa facilities. The hotel unit is managed by Starwood Hotels. Lampsa also owns 51% of the shares of Hyatt Regency Hotel in Belgrade. The hotel’s complex facilities include: 301 luxury rooms; a Presidential, Royal, Executive and Diplomatic Suite, and comprises luxury areas for recreation, dinning and support services. In 2008, it acquired 70% stake of Excelsior Hotel in Belgrade and 50% stake of Touristika Theretra SA, owning company of the Sheraton Rhodes Resort.

name: KARELIA TOBACCO COMPANY INC SA
businessSummary: Karelia Tobacco Company Inc SA is a Greece-based company, which is specialized in the production and sale of tobacco industry products. The principal activity of the Company and its subsidiaries is the wholesale of tobacco products, such as cigarettes, cigars, hand rolling cigarettes and other duty free tobacco products. It subsidiary companies are Karelia Belgium Limited SPRL, Karelia Tobacco Co UK Ltd, Karelia Tutun ve Ticaret AS, Meridian Duty Free Specialists SA, Karelia Investment SA and Karelia Bulgaria EOOD Sofia. The Company’s brands include: George Karelias and Sons, Karelia Slims, Ome, Karelia Blue, American Legend, Leader, Karelia Royal, Wellington and Karelia. The Company exports its products to over 60 countries around the world.

name: FLOUR MILLS C SARANTOPOULOS SA
businessSummary: Flour Mills C Sarantopoulos SA is a Greece-based industrial and commercial enterprise active in the production and trade of flour and semolina products. Its product portfolio consists of 25 different kinds of flour and includes five product ranges: bakery flour of different grinding levels, such as 70% simple flour and 70% confectionery flour; flour for confectionery and bread production; flour and semolina from hard wheat; flour for industrial companies, and various flour by-products that are sold at fodder cooperatives and feed industries. The Company mainly produces its products for the bakery, confectionary and pasta industries and has a sales network throughout Greece. Flour Mills C Sarantopoulos SA is also active in the real estate and tourism sector through its five subsidiary companies, namely Piraeus Mills SA, Mortgage Company C Sarantopoulos SA, State SA, Theodore SA and Stasis Stasinopoulos SA.

name: LOULIS MILLS SA
businessSummary: Loulis Food Ingredients SA is a Greece-based company that is engaged in the production and trade of flour and flour related products. The Company offers its products under two main categories: milling and consuming products. Its milling products include such industrial products as flours in sacks and in bulk, and such sub-products as bran. Its consuming products include long-life consumer goods, such as packs of flour, packaged pasta, cakes, bread products, biscuits and corn flakes, short-life products like fresh bread and cheese pies, as well as frozen products such as cheese pies. In addition, the Company also focuses on the provision of professional education and training services, through its subsidiary, Greek Baking School of long term learning. The Company's sales network consists of three sales branches in Athens, Thessaloniki and Kavalla, as well as of its main store in Volos which also serves other areas. The Company has three plants in Greece and operates also in Bulgaria.

name: FOURLIS SA
businessSummary: Fourlis SA is a Greece-based investment holding company. Along with its subsidiaries, the Company is active in two operating segments: Retail Trading of Home Furniture and Household Goods, through the franchise of IKEA stores in Greece, Cyprus and Bulgaria; Retail Trading of Sporting Goods, through the franchise of INTERSPORT stores in Greece, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Turkey and Romania and THE ATHLETE’S FOOT stores in Greece and Turkey. The Company’s direct subsidiaries include HOUSEMARKET SA, HM HOUSEMARKET CYPRUS LIMITED, HOUSE MARKET BULGARIA EAD, TRADE LOGISTICS SA, Intersport Athletics SA, Intersport Athletics Cyprus Limited, Genco Trade SRL (Romania), Genco Bulgaria EOOD and Intersport Atletik in Turkey.

name: PIPE WORKS L GIRAKIAN PROFIL SA
businessSummary: Pipe Works L Girakian Profil SA is a Greece-based steel manufacturing company. It is active in the production and wholesale distribution of steel pipes in various sizes and forms. Its product portfolio includes: steel pipes with structural hollow sections; pipes with galvanized structural hollow sections for the construction of prefabricated houses, metal building, scaffolding and lofts; metal sheets for the construction of all manner of tanks and also for lofts, merchant bars, as well as steel and galvanized pipes, including simple, reinforced, and heavy duty pipes for rafters, doors, windows and railings for houses. Its sales and distribution network covers the whole of Greece and consists of four salesmen and two representatives. The Company is affiliated to ALME ABEE, which is active in the production of metallic construction materials, EUROPA Aluminum Profil A.B.E, which is engaged in the production of aluminum accessories, and Technosol Ltd, which produces Dexion shelves.

name: BITROS HOLDING SA
businessSummary: Bitros Holding SA, is a Greece-based holding company. The Company, through its subsidiaries, is engaged in the metallurgy, real-estate development and energy sectors. Its segments include steel division, concrete reinforcement division, estate division, energy division and financial contributions. Its subsidiaries include Bitros Steele SA, a company engaged in the steel stockholding, processing and distribution; Bitros Rebar Center SA, a company offering products and services related to concrete reinforcement; Bitros Construction SA, a construction and real estate development company, and Nik. Kioleidis SA.

name: N LEVENTERIS SA
businessSummary: N Leventeris SA is Greece-based industrial and commercial enterprise active in the steel sector. The Company's activities include the production and trading of wires, wire ropes and accessories. Its product range consists of steel wires, steel wire ropes, combination ropes, steel wire rope slings, ropes and mooring ropes, fiber slings, chains, anchors and such accessories as hooks and shackles. The Company also represents the products of the houses Pfeifer, Crosby and Diepa in the Greek market. Its facilities are located in the industrial area of Volos, while its central warehouse is in the port of Piraeus, Greece.

name: ELASTRON SA
businessSummary: Elastron SA, is a Greece-based company engaged in the manufacture and trade of processed steel products. It operates two manufacturing plants and warehouses: the Agios Ioannis division, which includes offices, warehouses and industrial plants, and the Scaramagas division, housing industrial plants and warehouses. Its product lines are divided into three divisions: Steel Products, which includes hot and cold rolled steel plates, teary and chequered steel plates, corrugated and trapezoidal steel plates to cover buildings and aluminum plates; Longitudinal Steel Plates, which covers longitudinal products including iron sections such as hollow beams, corners, and bulbar blades, and Iron Pipes, which includes galvanized and non-galvanized iron pipes. In August 2012, it acquired 93% stake in Fotokypseli LTD and in Fotodiodos Ltd respectively, both engaged in electricity production and distribution. In March 2013, it established a new subsidiary, Elastron Agrotiki AVEE, based in Xanthi.

name: INTRACOM HOLDINGS SA
businessSummary: Intracom Holdings SA is a Greece-based company that operates, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, in the Information Technology (IT) solutions and services, construction projects and defense electronics systems sectors. Its IT Solutions and Services segment offers Information and Communications Technology (ICT) solutions and integration services to over 500 organizations, including European Union (EU) institutions, national governments, telecommunications companies, banks and private sector enterprises in over 60 countries.
