businessSummary: Pan African Resources PLC is a United Kingdom-based mid-tier, African-focused gold producer. The Company's segments include Barberton Mines, Evander Mines, Solar projects, MTR operation, TCMG, Exploration assets and Agricultural ESG projects. Its segments are all located in South Africa except for TCMG located in Australia and the exploration assets located in Sudan. Barberton Mines’ underground operations include Fairview, Sheba and Consort. Evander Mines’ underground operations include 7 Shaft, 8 Shaft and the RoM circuit at the Kinross metallurgical plant and 8 Shaft pillar mining, which are independent of Elikhulu and the Egoli project. Elikhulu, its flagship tailings retreatment operation, is located in Evander. TCMG business includes exploration assets in the Tennant Creek region in the Northern Territory of Australia. Its Agricultural ESG projects comprise Barberton Blueberries project, as well as other small-scale agricultural projects in Barberton Mines’ host community areas.

name: IOMART GROUP PLC
businessSummary: iomart group PLC is a United Kingdom-based cloud computing company. The Company operates as a cloud computing and information technology (IT) managed services business that is engaged in providing hybrid cloud infrastructure, network connectivity, security, and digital workplace capability. The Company operates through two segments: Cloud Services and Easyspace. Its Cloud Services segment provides managed cloud computing facilities and services, through a network of owned data centers, to small and medium enterprises (SME) and corporate markets. The segment uses several routes to market, including iomart Cloud, Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Rapidswitch, Cristie Data, Sonassi, LDeX, Bytemark, Memset, ORIIUM, Pavilion IT and P2. Its Easyspace segment provides a range of shared hosting and domain registration services to micro and SME companies. Its solutions include cloud services, data management, secure connectivity, digital workplace, cybersecurity, and consulting.

name: HILL & SMITH HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Hill & Smith PLC is a provider of sustainable infrastructure products and services. It operates through three divisions: Galvanizing Services, Engineered Solutions, and Roads & Security. Galvanizing Services division includes structural steel work, lighting, bridges and other products for industrial and infrastructure markets. Engineered Solutions division supplies engineered steel and composite solutions for a range of infrastructure markets, including power generation and distribution, marine, rail and housing. The division also supplies engineered pipe supports for the water, power and liquid natural gas markets and seismic protection solutions. It offers composite pipe, conduit, and bridge drain infrastructure systems. Roads & Security division supplies products and services to support road and highway infrastructure, including temporary and permanent road safety barriers, intelligent traffic solutions, street lighting columns, and bridge parapets.

name: HEAVITREE BREWERY 11.5 % CUM PREF
businessSummary: The Heavitree Brewery PLC is a United Kingdom-based independent, family-owned tenanted and leased pub company. The Company operates through its leased estates segment. Its business is engaged in the running and development of a leased and tenanted estate in the southwest of England. It operates approximately 64 leased and tenanted public houses along with non-core assets and a dormant managed estate. Its geographical segments include the United Kingdom and the United States. It provides facilities, including a beer garden/outside area, children's play area, parking, and accommodation. It owns over 50 pubs concentrated mainly in the Exeter and South Devon area. The Company's pubs include Anchor Inn, The Ashcott, The Atmospheric Railway, The Beach, Bell Inn, Brunswick Arms, Church House Inn, Claycutter's Arms, Court Farm Inn, The Cleave, The Clifton, The Cricket Inn, The Exeter Inn, The Green Dragon, Half Moon Inn, and Court Farm Inn.

name: HEAVITREE BREWERY PLC
businessSummary: The Heavitree Brewery PLC is a United Kingdom-based independent, family-owned tenanted and leased pub company. The Company operates through its leased estates segment. Its business is engaged in the running and development of a leased and tenanted estate in the southwest of England. It operates approximately 64 leased and tenanted public houses along with non-core assets and a dormant managed estate. Its geographical segments include the United Kingdom and the United States. It provides facilities, including a beer garden/outside area, children's play area, parking, and accommodation. It owns over 50 pubs concentrated mainly in the Exeter and South Devon area. The Company's pubs include Anchor Inn, The Ashcott, The Atmospheric Railway, The Beach, Bell Inn, Brunswick Arms, Church House Inn, Claycutter's Arms, Court Farm Inn, The Cleave, The Clifton, The Cricket Inn, The Exeter Inn, The Green Dragon, Half Moon Inn, and Court Farm Inn.

name: SAMUEL HEATH AND SONS PLC
businessSummary: Samuel Heath and Sons Plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing of a wide range of products in the builder’s hardware and bathroom field. The Company's collections include speed forme, classic forme, oriel forme, one hundred collection luxe, one hundred collection modern, landmark industrial, landmark pure, style moderne, fairfield, antique, and xenon. The Company's product categories include basin ancillaries, bath ancillaries, bath taps, bidet taps, generic roughs, kitchen taps, shower ancillaries, and toilet fittings. Its finishes product category includes amber brass, anthracite, antique brass gloss, antique brass matt, antique gold, brushed gold gloss, brushed gold matt, brushed gold unlacquered, chrome plate, city bronze, country bronze, matt black chrome, non lacquered brass, old brass matt, polished nickel, stainless steel finish, urban brass, and urban brass matt lacquered. Its product features include bidet sprays.

name: HEADLAM GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Headlam Group plc is a United Kingdom-based floorcoverings distributor. The principal activities of the Company and its subsidiaries are the sales, marketing, supply and distribution of floorcoverings and certain other ancillary products in the United Kingdom and certain Continental European territories. It has a customer base spanning independent and multiple retailers, small and large contractors, and housebuilders. The Company works with suppliers across the globe manufacturing the broadest range of products, and gives them a route to the market, selling their products to a large and diverse trade customer base. It provides its customers with a service through the product range, in-depth knowledge, e-commerce and marketing support, and nationwide next-day delivery service. It operates businesses and trade brands across the United Kingdom and Continental Europe (France and the Netherlands), which are supported by its network, central resources, and processes.

name: HAYS PLC
businessSummary: Hays plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in providing qualified, professional, and skilled recruitment. The Company operates through four geographic regions: Germany, United Kingdom & Ireland, Australia & New Zealand and the Rest of the World. The Company operates in 31 countries and has 21 areas of specialism and expertise. Its specialisms include accountancy and finance jobs, actuary jobs, asset management jobs, business support jobs, customer services jobs, company secretarial jobs, construction jobs, education jobs, engineering jobs, executive appointments jobs, human resources jobs, infrastructure jobs, legal jobs, life sciences jobs, logistics and supply chain jobs, manufacturing jobs, procurement jobs, property and design jobs, property services jobs, sales jobs, social care and social work jobs, sustainability jobs, tax jobs, technology jobs, personal and executive assistant jobs, and others.

name: EBIQUITY PLC
businessSummary: Ebiquity plc is an independent media and marketing consultancy. The Company helps advertisers make smarter media investment decisions by providing data-driven insights, auditing, and advisory services. It provides analysis and solutions through four Service Lines: Media management, Media performance, Marketing effectiveness and Contract Compliance. Its media management service provides guidance to global brands, offering an understanding of their digital media performance to help them make informed decisions about their media investments. The Company's media performance service helps brand owners drive efficiency and effectiveness from their media spend, eliminating wastage and creating value. Its marketing effectiveness service provides a picture of the true levels of business performance by using a suite of complementary methods. The Company's contract compliance division, FirmDecisions, provides contract compliance services.

name: MAVEN INCOME AND GROWTH VCT PLC
businessSummary: Maven Income and Growth VCT PLC is a United Kingdom-based generalist venture capital trust (VCT). The investment objective of the Company is to achieve long-term capital appreciation and generate income for its shareholders. The Company invests in a diversified portfolio of shares and securities in smaller, unquoted United Kingdom companies and AIM/AQSE quoted companies. It limits its investments to a maximum of £1.25 million in any business. The Company invests in various sectors, such as software and technology; business services; pharmaceuticals, biotechnology and healthcare; marketing and advertising technology; and learning and development recruitment technology, among others. Maven Capital Partners UK LLP acts as manager for the Company.

name: FIRST PROPERTY GROUP PLC
businessSummary: First Property Group plc is a United Kingdom-based property fund manager and investor with operations in the United Kingdom and Central Europe. The Company’s focus is on higher yielding commercial property with sustainable cash flows. The Company operates through two segments: Fund Management Division and Group Properties Division. The Fund Management Division operates through its subsidiary, First Property Asset Management Ltd (FPAM), which earns fees from investing for third parties in property. FPAM manages approximately 11 funds which are invested across the United Kingdom, Poland and Romania. The Group Properties Division, which consists of principal investments by the Company to earn a return on its own capital, usually in partnership with third parties. The investments comprise six directly held properties in Poland, and non-controlling interests in 9 of the 11 funds managed by FPAM.

name: STANDARD CHARTERED PLC
businessSummary: Standard Chartered PLC is an international banking company. The Company’s segments include Corporate, Commercial & Institutional Banking; Consumer, Private & Business Banking; Ventures, and Central & other items. The Corporate, Commercial and Institutional Banking segment supports companies across the world, from small and medium-sized enterprises to large corporates and institutions, both digitally and in person. The Consumer, Private & Business Banking segment supports small businesses and individuals, from mass retail clients to affluent and high-net-worth individuals, both digitally and in person. The Ventures segment includes financial technology and a pipeline of over thirty ventures, which includes two cloud-native digital banks. Its products and services include macro, commodities and credit trading; debt capital markets and leveraged finances; cash management; investments; trade finance; deposits; insurance; mortgages, and others. It has a presence in 52 markets.

name: JAMES HALSTEAD 5.5 % CUM PREF
businessSummary: James Halstead plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is a manufacturer and international distributor of floor coverings. The Company’s geographical area includes the United Kingdom, Europe and Scandinavia, Australasia and Asia, and the Rest of the World. The Company’s subsidiaries include Polyflor Limited, Riverside Flooring Limited, Polyflor Australia Pty Limited, Polyflor New Zealand Limited, Polyflor Canada Inc, Polyflor India Pvt Limited, Karndean International GmbH, James Halstead France SAS, Polyflor Nordic Sweden AB, and others. Polyflor Limited is engaged in flooring manufacturing and distribution. Riverside Flooring Limited is focused on flooring manufacturing. Polyflor Australia Pty Limited is engaged in flooring distribution.

name: HALMA
businessSummary: Halma plc is a life-saving technology company. Its segments include Safety, Environmental & Analysis and Healthcare. Safety segment provides products that protect people, assets and infrastructure in commercial, industrial and public spaces. This segment's solutions include fire safety solutions, public safety technologies, worker safety solutions, and infrastructure and asset safety technologies. Environmental & Analysis segment provides solutions that monitor the environment and improve the availability of life-critical natural resources, are used in materials analysis and optoelectronic applications. This segment includes optical analysis, water analysis & treatment systems, and environmental monitoring technologies. Healthcare segment provides technologies to help quality of life for patients and improve the quality of care delivered by healthcare providers. This segment includes healthcare assessment & analytics, therapeutic solutions technologies, and life sciences technologies.

name: SURGICAL INNOVATIONS GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Surgical Innovations Group Plc is a holding company that is involved in the design, manufacture, and sale of devices for use in minimally invasive surgery (SI Brand) along with its own label products through original equipment manufacturer (OEM) relationships including precision engineering markets. The Company’s segments include SI Brand, OEM, and Distribution. The SI Brand segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, and distribution of SI branded minimally invasive devices. The OEM segment includes research, development, manufacture, and distribution of minimally invasive devices for third party medical device companies through their own label or co-branding. It also includes research, development, manufacture, and sale of minimally invasive technology products for precision engineering applications. The Distribution segment is engaged in the distribution of specialist medical products sold by Elemental Healthcare Ltd.

name: GOODWIN PLC
businessSummary: Goodwin PLC is a mechanical and refractory engineering company. It specializes in the design, manufacture and supply of products and solutions. Its segments include Mechanical Engineering and Refractory Engineering. The Mechanical Engineering Division designs, manufactures and supplies high-technology metallic, composite and electronic products to industry sectors, including defense, surveillance, aerospace, mining and the oil, gas, water and power generation industries. The Refractory Engineering Division designs, manufactures and supplies formulated, mineral-based products and processed minerals to the jewelry, aerospace, automotive, horticultural and fire protection industry sectors. Its geographical areas include the United Kingdom, the United States, the Rest of Europe, the Pacific Basin and the Rest of World. It designs, manufactures and supplies a range of complete air traffic control, ground movement and surveillance radar systems for both military and civil applications.

name: ZIGUP PLC 5% PREFERRED
businessSummary: ZIGUP plc is an integrated mobility solutions provider, offering a platform that delivers services across the vehicle lifecycle. The Company provides mobility solutions to businesses, fleet operators, insurers, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), and other customers in a wide range of areas, including vehicle rental, fleet management, accident management, vehicle repairs, and service and maintenance. The Company supports its customers through a network and a diversified fleet of over 130,000 owned and leased vehicles, operating from approximately 180 branches across the United Kingdom, Ireland, and Spain. The Company serves corporate clients ranging from blue-chip companies to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) across various industries, from support services to infrastructure. Its business-to-business (B2B) offerings include rental and incident claims handling, delivered through both retail and partner channels.

name: GAMES WORKSHOP GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Games Workshop Group PLC designs and manufactures miniature figures and games and distributes these through its own network of retail stores, independent retailers and online via the global Web stores. The Company has manufacturing activities in the United Kingdom and sells mainly in the United Kingdom, Continental Europe, North America, Australia, New Zealand and Asia. It also grants licenses to third parties for the development of video games, personal computer games, media and other products utilizing the Company’s intellectual property. Its segments include Core and Licensing. Its Core segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and sales of its fantasy miniatures and related products. It also includes the revenue and expenditure related to Warhammer+. Its Core segment is divided into channels, such as Trade; Retail; Online; Design, manufacturing, logistics and operations, and Group. Its products include Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, among others.

name: FULLER SMITH & TURNER 8 % CUM PREF
businessSummary: Fuller, Smith & Turner PLC is a United Kingdom-based premium pubs and hotels business. The Company provides food and a range of drinks, bedrooms, and engaging services. It operates through two segments: Managed Pubs and Hotels, and Tenanted Inns. Its Managed Pubs and Hotels include Cotswold Inns & Hotels, which operates approximately seven hotels in the Cotswolds; Bel & The Dragon, which operates approximately six pubs with rooms in the Home Counties, and Lovely Pubs. Its Tenanted Inns segment comprises pubs operated by third parties under tenancy or lease agreements. The Company has approximately 185 managed pubs and hotels, 1,028 boutique bedrooms, and 153 tenanted inns. It provides a range of pub categories, including breakfast & brunch, ale, and pie pubs, pubs in Hampshire, live sports pubs, play areas, pub gardens, rugby pubs, and others. Its hotels include The Bear of Burton, Christchurch; The Blackbird, Earl's Court; The Bull Hotel, Bridport, and others.

name: FULLER SMITH & TURNER 4.2 % CUM PREF
businessSummary: Fuller, Smith & Turner PLC is a United Kingdom-based premium pubs and hotels business. The Company provides food and a range of drinks, bedrooms, and engaging services. It operates through two segments: Managed Pubs and Hotels, and Tenanted Inns. Its Managed Pubs and Hotels include Cotswold Inns & Hotels, which operates approximately seven hotels in the Cotswolds; Bel & The Dragon, which operates approximately six pubs with rooms in the Home Counties, and Lovely Pubs. Its Tenanted Inns segment comprises pubs operated by third parties under tenancy or lease agreements. The Company has approximately 185 managed pubs and hotels, 1,028 boutique bedrooms, and 153 tenanted inns. It provides a range of pub categories, including breakfast & brunch, ale, and pie pubs, pubs in Hampshire, live sports pubs, play areas, pub gardens, rugby pubs, and others. Its hotels include The Bear of Burton, Christchurch; The Blackbird, Earl's Court; The Bull Hotel, Bridport, and others.

name: FIRSTGROUP PLC
businessSummary: FirstGroup plc is a private sector provider of public transport services. The Company's divisions include First Bus and First Rail. First Bus is a bus operator in the United Kingdom with a fleet of approximately 5,800 buses. It provides tendered bus services for local authorities and is an operator in the majority of its local areas, including major urban centers such as Glasgow, Bristol and Leeds. Alongside the operation of its commercial networks, its adjacent services business provides a range of bus and coach services including schools, private tour operators, airports and airlines, distribution centers and major construction sites. First Rail is a rail operator, which operates a fleet of approximately 1,800 locomotives and rail carriages through two DfT contracted train operating companies: West Coast Partnership (WCP), (incorporating Avanti West Coast and West Coast Partnership Development) and Great Western Railway (GWR), and two open access routes (Hull Trains and Lumo).

name: FLETCHER KING PLC
businessSummary: Fletcher King Plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which provides a comprehensive range of property services and expert advice throughout the United Kingdom, including property fund management, property asset management, rating, valuations and investment broking. The Company offers a range of services, including asset and property management, co-investment and capital markets. Its asset and property management offers rent collection, service charge management, landlord and tenant, lettings, refurbishment / redevelopment, and building surveying.

name: JAMES FISHER AND SONS PLC
businessSummary: James Fisher and Sons plc is a United Kingdom-based global engineering services company. The Company’s divisions include Energy, Defence, and Maritime Transport. The Energy division serves the oil and gas and renewable energy sectors. It is engaged in the provision of specialist products and support services, and a provider of turnkey operations to the oil and gas industry. It assists offshore renewable energy developers with technical and operational aspects of site preparation, installation support, commissioning and specialist operation and maintenance. It is engaged in the provision of submarine rescue and technical solutions, special operations, diving equipment and marine engineering for the global defense industry. It provides a comprehensive range of products, services, and solutions for the global maritime transport industry. The Company serves customers in specialized segments of the marine market, including defense, oil and gas, ports, construction, and renewables.

name: FILTRONIC PLC
businessSummary: Filtronic plc develops and manufactures radio frequency (RF), microwave and millimeter wave (mmWave) technologies. The Company's products transmit, receive, and condition radio signals, particularly at microwave and mmWave frequencies. It designs and manufactures RF-to-mmWave components and subsystems for mission-critical communication networks. Its products include Morpheus X2, Morpheus II, Hades, Cerus, Tower top amplifiers, Switched filter banks, GaN amplifiers, Custom filters, Custom combiners, Interference mitigation filters, Transmit and receive modules, Transceivers, Front end modules, Ceramic filters, Combline filters, Lumped element filters, Metal cavity filters, Suspended substrate filters, Thin film filters, Small cell filters, Waveguide diplexer, Cross band combiners, and In band combiners. The Company’s technologies are applied in high-performance markets, including aerospace and defense, telecommunications infrastructure, critical communications, space, and other markets.

name: FISKE PLC
businessSummary: Fiske plc is a United Kingdom-based independent investment management and stockbroking company. The Company's principal activity is the provision of financial intermediation, which consists of private client and institutional stockbroking, and private client investment management. It offers services to individuals, professional advisers, and companies and trusts. It also operates Ocean Equity Fund. The Ocean Equity Fund does not have an objective linked to the oceans or marine biodiversity, but the Fund Manager may choose to invest in companies that derive their revenue from shipping and energy transition sectors. It offers three levels of investment service: discretionary investment management, advisory managed and execution only. Its discretionary investment management service is for people who wish to delegate decision-making on investment matters to a professional investment manager. It provides self-invested personal pensions (SIPPs) and small self-administered schemes (SSASs).

name: SPECTRIS PLC
businessSummary: Spectris plc is a United Kingdom-based company that provides critical insights to its customers through precision measurement, using technical expertise and deep domain knowledge. The Company provides high-tech instruments, test equipment and software for technically demanding industrial applications. Its segments include Spectris Scientific and Spectris Dynamics. Its Spectris Scientific provides advanced measurement and materials characterization, accelerating efficiency in research and development and manufacturing. Its Spectris Dynamics provides differentiated sensing, data acquisition, analysis modelling and simulation solutions to help customers accelerate product development and enhance product performance. The Company is also engaged in analytical instrumentation for the physical characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials.

name: INTERCEDE GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Intercede Group plc is a cybersecurity software company specializing in digital identities, and its solutions enable organizations to protect themselves against the cause of a data breach: compromised user credentials. The Company’s suite of products allows customers to choose the level of security that fits their needs, from secure registration and ID verification to password security management, one-time passwords, faster identity online (FIDO) and public key infrastructure (PKI). It provides the entire set of authentication options from passwords to PKI, supporting customers on their journey to password less and authentication environments. In addition to developing and supporting Intercede software, it offers professional services and custom development capabilities as well as managing the password breach database. Its products include MyiD PSM, MyiD MFA, MyiD IDV, MyID SecureVault and MyiD CMS. It serves various industries, including government, aerospace, defense, and others.

name: OXFORD TECHNOLOGY 2 VENTURE CAPITAL TRUS
businessSummary: Oxford Technology 2 Venture Capital Trust Plc is a United Kingdom-based venture capital trust. The Company’s objective is to maximize shareholder value and to continue to work with its investee companies to help them succeed and seek exits as and when appropriate. It primarily invests in unlisted companies based in the United Kingdom that operate within the fields of science, technology, and engineering. The Company focuses on early-stage businesses. Its investments are typically range between £100,000 and £500,000 and are generally made in companies located within approximately 60 miles of the Company. It also has investments in Scancell Holdings Plc, Arecor Therapeutics Plc and Mirriad Advertising Plc. The Company is managed by OT2 Managers Ltd with services subcontracted to Oxford Technology Management Ltd (OTM).

name: PROTEOME SCIENCES PLC
businessSummary: Proteome Sciences plc is a specialist provider of contract proteomics services. The Company’s services enable drug discovery, development and biomarker identification, and employs proprietary workflows for the optimum analysis of tissues, cells and body fluids. Its principal activities involve protein biomarker research and development. It uses high-sensitivity techniques to detect and characterize differentially expressed proteins in biological samples for diagnostic, prognostic and therapeutic applications. SysQuant and TMT MS2 are unbiased methods for identifying and contextualizing new targets and defining mechanisms of biological activity, while analysis using Super-Depletion and TMTcalibrator provides access to over 8,500 circulating plasma proteins for the discovery of disease-related biomarkers. In addition, it has invented and developed the technology for TMT and TMTpro, and manufactures these small, protein-reactive chemical reagents for multiplex quantitative proteomics.

name: RS GROUP
businessSummary: RS Group plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is a global omni-channel provider of product and service solutions for designers, builders and maintainers of industrial equipment and operations. The Company's segments include EMEA, Americas and Asia Pacific. It stocks more than 750,000 industrial and electronic products, sourced from over 2,500 suppliers, and provides a range of product and service solutions to customers. Its product solutions include automation and control; mechanical and fluid power; electronics; maintenance, and safety and protection. Its service solutions include design solutions, customer order solutions, procurement solutions, inventory solutions, maintenance solutions, safety solutions, integrated supply solutions and ESG solutions. RS PRO is its own-brand product range. Its OKdo brand is a technology solutions business focused on single-board computing (SBC), Internet of Things (IoT) and education. Better World is its sustainable product range.

name: ELECO PLC
businessSummary: Eleco plc is a specialist international provider of software and related services. It is focused on building the environment through its operating brands Elecosoft, BestOutcome, Vertical Digital and Veeuze from centers in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Romania and the United States. Its software solutions are trusted by international customers and used throughout the building lifecycle from early planning and design stages to construction, interior fit out, asset management and facilities management to support project management, estimation, visualization, building information modelling and property management. Elecosoft brand enables companies supporting the building lifecycle across a range of industries to drive operations using integrated software, professional support, training and consultancy. Veeuze offers personalized product visualization across a multitude of marketing channels with the support of its artificial intelligence tools and others.

name: TOWN CENTRE SECURITIES PLC
businessSummary: Town Centre Securities PLC is a United Kingdom-based real estate investment trust. The Company has built a diversified, mixed-use portfolio with a tenant base focused on regional centers, primarily Leeds and Manchester, where approximately 88% of its portfolio by value is based on property investment and car parking operators. The Company has a portfolio around the United Kingdom comprising over 2.5 meters square feet of prime commercial, residential, car parking, office, leisure and retail accommodation. The Company’s properties include 123 Albion Street (Leeds), 75 Dale Street (Manchester), Carvers Warehouse (Manchester), Ducie House (Manchester), Merrion House (Leeds), Town Centre House (Leeds), Vicar Lane (Leeds), Wade House (Leeds), Weymouth Street (London), Burlington House (Manchester), AVRO (Manchester), Bath Street (Glasgow), Eider House (Manchester), Vicar Lane (Leeds), Weymouth Street (London), Z (Leeds), CitiPark (Leeds, Manchester, London and Watford) and others.

name: SANDERSON DESIGN GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Sanderson Design Group PLC is a luxury interior furnishings company, which is engaged in the design, manufacture, and marketing of wallpapers, fabrics, and paints. It operates through three segments, namely Brands, Licensing, and Manufacturing. Its Brands segment includes around six brands: Sanderson, Morris & Co., Zoffany, Harlequin, Clarke & Clarke, and Scion, which offer wallpaper, fabrics, and paints. The Licensing segment involves the use of the Company’s designs on a wide range of products such as bedding, rugs, blinds, tableware and apparel through licensing arrangements. The Manufacturing segment includes the wallcovering and printed fabric manufacturing businesses operated by Anstey and Standfast & Barracks, respectively. It operates manufacturing facilities at Anstey Wallpaper factory in Loughborough and Standfast & Barracks fabric printing factory in Lancaster. Its subsidiaries include Sanderson Design Group Brands Limited, Anstey Wallpaper Company Limited, among others.

name: ECCLESIASTICAL INSURANCE OFFICE PLC 8.62
businessSummary: Ecclesiastical Insurance Office plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist financial services company. The Company is engaged in the general insurance and life insurance business. The Company operates its general insurance business in United Kingdom and Ireland, Australia, and Canada. It operates under Ecclesiastical and Ansvar brands in United Kingdom and Ansvar brand in Australia. It operates a general insurance Ecclesiastical branch in Canada. The Company also operates an Ecclesiastical branch in the Republic of Ireland underwriting general business across the whole of Ireland. Its general insurance business also includes its internal reinsurance function and adverse development cover. The Company's life insurance business provides long-term policies to support funeral planning products through its subsidiary, Ecclesiastical Life Limited. Its subsidiaries include Ecclesiastical Group Healthcare Trustees Limited, Ansvar Insurance Limited, and E.I.O. Trustees Limited.

name: PIPEHAWK PLC
businessSummary: PipeHawk plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which offers advanced engineering solutions to technical requirements across various industries. The Company is focused on providing technology solutions across a wide range of industries, but specialized in highways, automotive, rail, aerospace and slip test solutions. It operates from multiple locations across the United Kingdom and the goods and services provided by its businesses are supplied and utilised around the world. The Company's subsidiaries include Adien Limited, QM Systems Ltd, Thomson Engineering Design Ltd, Wessex Precision Instruments Ltd, and Utsi Electronics Ltd.

name: IDOX PLC
businessSummary: Idox plc is a supplier of specialist information management software and geospatial data solutions to the public and asset-intensive sectors. Its segments include Land, Property & Public Protection (LPPP), Assets, and Communities (COMM). The LPPP segment is engaged in delivering specialist information management solutions and services to the public and private sectors. The Assets segment is engaged in delivering engineering document management and control solutions to asset-intensive industry sectors. The COMM segment is engaged in delivering software solutions to customers with social value running through their core. Its solutions include regulatory services; built environment; public protection; electoral services; sexual health management; funding and information services; transport network management, and GIS & Geospatial. It serves various industries, including government, health, transport, engineering and construction, land and property, emergency services, and utilities.

name: RTC GROUP PLC
businessSummary: RTC Group Plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company's principal activity is the provision of recruitment services. It focuses on white and blue-collar recruitment, providing temporary and permanent labor to a range of industries and customers in both domestic and international markets. The Company's segments include Recruitment and Central Services. Through its Ganymede and ATA Recruitment brands, the Company provides a range of recruitment services in the United Kingdom. Ganymede specializes in recruiting technical and engineering talent and providing complete workforce solutions to help build and maintain infrastructure and transportation for a range of the United Kingdom and international clients. ATA Recruitment provides technical recruitment solutions to the manufacturing, engineering, and technology sectors. Internationally, through its GSS brand, it works with customers across the globe that are focused on delivering projects in a variety of sectors.

name: SURFACE TRANSFORMS PLC
businessSummary: Surface Transforms plc develops and produces carbon-ceramic material automotive brake discs. The Company is the manufacturer of carbon-ceramic brake discs and serves customers that include major original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in the global automotive markets. It also conducts research and development into better performing carbon ceramic products. The Company utilizes its carbon ceramic technology to create lightweight brake discs for high-performance road and track applications for both internal combustion engines and electric vehicles. It interweaves continuous carbon fiber to form a three-dimensional matrix, producing a product with improved heat conductivity; this reduces the brake system operating temperature, resulting in lighter and longer-life components with improved brake performance. It works with various automotive manufacturers, including OEMs and niche market/low-volume car builders, designing and supplying carbon-ceramic brakes for a wide range of applications.

name: BRITISH AMERICAN TOBACCO
businessSummary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. is a global multi-category consumer goods business company. The Company provides tobacco and nicotine products. Its segments include the United States, Asia Pacific Middle East and Africa, and Americas and Europe. Its product categories include Vapor, Heating Products (HPs), Modern Oral, Traditional Oral, and Combustible cigarettes. Vapor products are handheld, battery-powered devices that heat a liquid to produce an inhalable aerosol, known as vapor. HPs are devices that use heat to generate a nicotine-containing aerosol, which the user inhales. This category includes Tobacco Heated Products and Herbal Products for Heating (HPH). Modern Oral products are smoke-free oral nicotine products called nicotine pouches, designed for use in the mouth. Traditional oral products include snus and snuff. Its brands include Vuse, glo, Velo, Grizzly, Dunhill, Kent, Lucky Strike, Pall Mall, Rothmans, Newport, Natural American Spirit, Camel, and others.

name: BIG YELLOW GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Big Yellow Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based self-storage company. The Company provides secure and modern self-storage units for homes and businesses nationwide. It operates from a platform of 111 storage facilities, including 23 branded as Armadillo Self Storage. The Company's stores utilize technology for its digital and operating platforms, including security, and focus on locating its stores in high-profile, accessible, main road locations. Its subsidiaries include Big Yellow Self Storage Company Limited, which is engaged in self-storage; The Big Yellow Construction Company Limited, which is engaged in construction management; The Last Mile Company Limited, which is a holding company; BYRCo Limited, which is engaged in property management; Big Yellow Limited Partnership is engaged in self-storage; The Last Mile Company Limited, which is a holding company; Quickstore Storage Limited, which is engaged in self-storage operations, and more.

name: MOLTEN VENTURES VCT PLC
businessSummary: Molten Ventures VCT PLC is a United Kingdom-based investment company. The Company’s investment objectives are to provide long-term tax-free returns to shareholders through a combination of dividends and capital growth; invest in a diversified portfolio of smaller unquoted companies with a particular focus on the technology sector and target annual dividends of 5% of net asset value per share (subject to liquidity and regulatory factors). The Company invests in various sectors, such as enterprise and consumer technology, differentiated operating systems, machine learning and digital healthcare. The Company's investment manager is Elderstreet Investments Limited.

name: PERSONAL GROUP HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Personal Group Holdings PLC is a provider of workforce benefits and services. The Company is primarily engaged in delivering employee services, including short-term accident and health insurance, benefits and platform products, pay and reward consultancy, and salary sacrifice technology solutions in the United Kingdom. Its segments include Affordable Insurance, Benefits and Reward, and Other. The Affordable Insurance segment includes underwriting by Personal Assurance Plc (PA) and Personal Assurance (Guernsey) Limited (PAGL) of insurance policies purchased by employees of host companies through bespoke benefit programs. The Benefits and Reward segment comprises annual subscription income and other related revenue from licensing Hapi, the Company's employee benefits platform. This includes sales to both large corporates and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). It also encompasses consultancy services, surveys, and license income generated from digital platform subscriptions.

name: ANDREWS SYKES GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Andrews Sykes Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based specialist hire company. The Company's principal activity includes hire, sale and installation of a range of equipment. The Company's product categories include air conditioning, chillers, pumps, ventilation, heating, boilers, air quality, moisture control, and water treatment. Its air conditioning categories include exhaust tube air conditioners, split type air conditioners, evaporative coolers, cooling fans, and portable humidifiers. Its pumps categories include general purpose pumps, super silenced range, high performance and bentonite pumps. Its ventilation categories include ventilation fans, cooling fans, industrial fans, carpet dryers, air cleaner and air purifier. It serves various sectors, including agriculture, construction, healthcare, hospitality and events, manufacturing, public sector and government, retail, and sport and leisure. Its brands include Sykes Pumps and the Andrews family of climate control solutions.

name: DERWENT LONDON PLC
businessSummary: Derwent London plc is a United Kingdom-based real estate investment trust (REIT). The Company is an office specialist property regenerator and investor. It owns and manages an investment portfolio of over 5.3 million square feet, of which 99% is located in central London, with a specific focus on the West End and the areas bordering the City of London, with the latter principally in the Tech Belt. Its properties are in London (West End central, West End borders/other and City borders), with the remainder in Scotland (Provincial). Its portfolio includes 80 Charlotte Street, The Featherstone Building, Soho Place, Brunel Building, 25 Baker Street, White Collar Factory, Network, Tea Building, The White Chapel Building, Greencoat and Gordon House, Middlesex House, 25 Savile Row, Rathbone Studios, Morelands, Angel Building, Horseferry House, 50 Baker Street W1, and others. Its subsidiaries include Asta Commercial Limited, BBR (Commercial) Limited, Caledonian Properties Limited and others.

name: BAE SYSTEMS PLC
businessSummary: BAE Systems plc provides advanced, technology-led defense, aerospace, and security solutions. The Company is a provider of space, aircraft, weapon systems and munitions, Complex warships, Submarines, Embedding environmental considerations, Intelligence and cyber security, Naval ship repair and support, and Uncrewed and future air system capabilities. Its Electronic Systems segment comprises the United States and United Kingdom-based electronics activities, including electronic warfare systems, navigation systems, and others. Its Platforms & Services segment, with operations in the United States, Sweden and the United Kingdom, manufactures and upgrades combat vehicles, weapons and munitions, and delivers services and sustainment activities Its Air segment comprises air build and support activities. Its Maritime segment comprises maritime and land activities. Its Cyber & Intelligence segment comprises the Intelligence and Security business and the Digital Intelligence business.

name: PENNANT INTERNATIONAL GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Pennant International Group plc is a technology-driven company. The Company is a provider of systems support software and training solutions and technical services. It operates in the defense, space, aerospace, rail and shipping industries. Its segments include Training and Software & services. The Company’s business lines include systems support software, training solutions, and technical services. Systems support software includes integrated product support and integrated logistics support software and services equips customers with toolsets to manage, model and utilize complex equipment data. Training solutions provide hardware, software and virtual training solutions for maintainers and operators of aircraft, ships and land systems. Technical services support all software and training solutions, including consultancy, support and maintenance, training, and bespoke development.

name: ELEMENTIS PLC
businessSummary: Elementis plc is a global specialty chemicals company. The Company offers performance-driven additives that help create formulations for consumer and industrial applications. The Company operates through two segments: Performance Specialties, and Personal Care. The Performance Specialties segment consists of the Coatings business, which is engaged in the production of rheological modifiers and additives for decorative and industrial coatings. Its Personal Care segment is engaged in the production of rheological modifiers and compounded products, including active ingredients for AP antiperspirants, for supply to personal care manufacturers. It also supplies specialty ingredients to customers across the home care and institutional cleaning, agriculture and pharma industries.

name: DIAGEO PLC
businessSummary: Diageo plc is a United Kingdom-based international manufacturer and distributor of premium drinks. The Company offers beverage alcohol with a collection of brands across spirits and beer categories. Its segments include North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and Caribbean, Africa, and Corporate and other. The SC&P segment manufactures products and includes production sites in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Italy, Guatemala and Mexico, as well as comprises the global procurement function. Its principal products include scotch whisky, whisk(e)y, vodka, tequila, gin, rum, liqueurs, beer, wine, and non-alcoholic spirits. Its collection of brands includes Johnnie Walker, J&B and Buchanan's whiskies, Smirnoff, Ciroc and Ketel One vodkas, Captain Morgan, Don Julio, Guinness, and Tanqueray, among others. It offers Ritual Zero Proof Non-Alcoholic Spirits (Ritual). It owns manufacturing production facilities across the globe, including distilleries, breweries, and packaging plants.

name: R.E.A HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: R.E.A. Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in the cultivation of oil palms in the province of East Kalimantan in Indonesia and in the production and sale of crude palm oil and crude palm kernel oil. It operates through two segments: the cultivation of oil palms and stone and coal interests. It has interests in stone deposits and coal mining concessions, all of which are located in East Kalimantan in Indonesia. Its principal operating subsidiary, PT REA Kaltim Plantations, manages oil palm plantations in Belayan Ulu, a remote area on either side of the Belayan River, a tributary of the Mahakam River in East Kalimantan. It has two methane capture facilities that generate electricity for the majority of its operations and employee housing, as well as supplying power to the villages in the vicinity of the Company’s operations. Its subsidiaries include Makassar Investments Limited, KCC Resources Limited, REA Finance B.V., R.E.A. Services Limited, among others.

name: JAMES CROPPER PLC
businessSummary: James Cropper PLC is engaged in advanced materials and paper and packaging, centered around four market audiences: energy solutions, composite solutions, luxury packaging and creative papers. Its advanced materials incorporate pioneering nonwovens and electrochemical coatings for its customers globally, including components in fuel cells and hydrogen electrolysis. In paper and packaging, they range from luxury packaging and creative papers, including bespoke colors and textures in paper and molded fiber packaging designed. It offers composite solutions and energy solutions. Its products include Abrasion Resistance, Carrier, Corrosion Resistance, Catalysts, Cell Separators, Electrodes, GDL Substrate, and others. It serves various markets, including aerospace, automotive, batteries, consumer electronics, marine and others. Its portfolio of products is in use on commercial aircraft, delivering surface finish solutions, improved processing, light weighting efficiency solutions, and more.

name: CREIGHTONS PLC
businessSummary: Creightons Plc is engaged in the development, marketing, manufacture and supply of personal care, beauty and fragrance products, which includes the development of brands. The beauty products sector offers products for haircare, skincare, bath & body, male grooming and fine fragrances. Its operations are organized into three business streams: own branded business, private label business and contract manufacturing business. Its own branded business develops, markets, sells and distributes products developed and owns the rights to or brands it has licensed. The brands in the branded business include Feather and Down, Balance Active, The Curl Company, Emma Hardie and T-Zone. The private label business focuses on private-label products for high street retailers and supermarket chains, with most of the stock manufactured to forecast. Its contract manufacturing business develops and manufactures products on behalf of third-party brand owners and are typically manufactured to order.

name: CRANSWICK PLC
businessSummary: Cranswick plc is a United Kingdom-based vertically integrated supplier of premium, fresh and added-value food products. The Company’s segments include Food and Other. The Food' segment is engaged in manufacturing and supplying food products to the United Kingdom grocery retailers, the food service sector and other United Kingdom and global food producers. The Other segment represents all the activities of Cranswick Pet Products Limited. It offers a range of fresh products, including fresh pork, convenience, gourmet products and poultry. The Company’s food portfolio includes fresh pork, gourmet sausage, gourmet bacon and gammon, slow cook, fresh chicken, ready to eat chicken, coated chicken, gourmet pastry, charcuterie, houmous and dips, and cooked meats. Its brands include Ramona’s, Cypressa, and Bodega. It also produces pet food and supplies several brands, including own brands Vitalin and Alpha Feeds. It is also involved in the pig genetic business and pig farming operations.

name: GOOCH & HOUSEGO PLC
businessSummary: Gooch & Housego PLC is a United Kingdom-based specialist manufacturer of optical components & systems. Its segments include Industrial, Aerospace and Defense, and Life Sciences/ Biophotonics. Industrial segment comprises the Industrial laser market for use in the semiconductor and microelectronic industries, but also includes other Industrial applications such as metrology, telecommunications, and scientific research. Its products include Acousto-Optics, Crystal Optics, Electro-Optics, Fiber Optics, Precision Optics, Lens Systems, and Vision Systems. Its Aerospace and Defense solutions include satellite communications, optical imaging in harsh environments, airborne and spaceborne navigation, laser directed energy weapons, and laser protection in the field. Industrial and Telecom solutions include lidar systems, laser-based semiconductor manufacturing, and Quantum Technologies. Its life science solutions include Medical Device Design for Manufacture and Optical Coherence Tomography.

name: CORAL PRODUCTS PLC
businessSummary: Coral Products PLC is a United Kingdom-based specialist in the design, manufacturing and supply of plastic products. The Company, through its Flexibles and Rigids divisions, manufactures and distributes a range of specialized plastic products and services to a wide range of customers, across a diverse array of industries. Flexibles division manufactures and distributes extruded, thermoformed, and film/laminate products primarily in the food sector. The rigids division designs, manufactures and distributes plastic injection, vacuum-formed and extruded molded products into a diverse range of sectors, including personal care, food, household, healthcare, automotive, telecoms and rail. It provides customized solutions primarily for the food packaging, personal care, household, transport and communication sectors. Its subsidiaries include Tatra Rotalac Limited, Global One-Pak Limited, Film & Foil Solutions Limited, Alma Products Limited, Manplas Limited, Ecodeck Limited, and Ecodeck SL.

name: CONCURRENT TECHNOLOGIES PLC
businessSummary: Concurrent Technologies Plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which develops and manufactures high-end embedded Plug In Cards and Systems for use in a range of high-performance, long-life cycle applications within the telecommunications, defense, security, telemetry, scientific and aerospace markets, including applications within harsh environments. Its products include systems, VPX, sensor open systems architecture (SOSA) aligned VPX, AdvancedMC (AMC) modules, VME, CompactPCI, XMC, software and other accessories. The processor products feature Intel processors, including the latest generation embedded Intel Core processors, Intel Xeon and Intel Atom processors. The products are designed to be compliant with industry specifications and support embedded Operating Systems. Its products also support various operating systems, including Linux, Windows, and VxWorks. Its systems products include Hornet, Hermod II, Vulcan - VPX Development System, Helios - Rugged Vision System, and others.

name: RATHBONE BROTHERS
businessSummary: Rathbones Group Plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of investment and wealth management services for private clients, charities, trustees and professional partners. Its Wealth Management segment incorporates its core bespoke discretionary portfolio and managed portfolio services. It also includes direct sales into its range of risk-targeted multi-asset funds. Its Asset Management segment includes its focused range of specialist single-strategy funds, which are designed to act as individual holdings within investment portfolios. Its services include bespoke services, managed service, and select. The Company also offers its clients a range of banking services, including currency and payment services, fixed interest-term deposits and loans to existing clients. It provides financial planning and advisory services through Rathbones Financial Planning and Vision Independent Financial Planning. The Company also offers UK trust, tax and legal services through the Rathbones Trust Company.

name: COLEFAX GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Colefax Group plc is an international designer and distributor of furnishing fabrics and wallpapers, and an international decorating company. The Company trades under five brand names, serving different segments of the soft furnishings' marketplace; these are Colefax and Fowler, Cowtan & Tout, Jane Churchill, Manuel Canovas and Larsen. It has two divisions: the Product division, which includes the fabric division and furniture- Kingcome sofas, and the Interior decorating division. Colefax and Fowler is a luxury English brand renowned for its subtlety and classical elegance. Jane Churchill is also an English brand known for its contemporary elegance and artistic style, designed with modern living in mind. Larsen is a United States (US) brand known for its luxurious textural woven fabrics. Manuel Canovas is a French fabric known for its bold designs and vibrant color palette. Cowtan and Tout is a high-end luxury US brand, renowned for its elegant and colorful designs.

name: GENUS PLC
businessSummary: Genus plc is a United Kingdom-based global animal genetics company. The Company is advancing animal breeding and genetic improvement by applying biotechnology and selling added value products to livestock farming and food producers. It focuses on the dairy, beef and pork food production sectors, through two businesses: ABS (bovine genetics) and PIC (porcine genetics). Its segments include Genus PIC, Genus ABS and Genus Research and Development. Its bovine genetics business sells dairy and beef bull semen and embryos from its superior cattle, which are sold to farmers to breed their cows through artificial insemination. Its porcine genetics business sells genetically superior breeding pigs and semen to farmers, so they can breed commercial pigs with desirable characteristics for pork production. Its porcine and bovine divisions operate under the brand names PIC and ABS. It operates in 30 countries, across six continents, and reaches a further 50 markets through distribution partners.

name: MAVEN INCOME AND GROWTH VCT 5 PLC
businessSummary: Maven Income and Growth VCT 5 PLC is a United Kingdom-based company engaged in venture capital trust (VCT) activities. It operates with the primary objective of achieving long-term capital appreciation and generating income for shareholders. The Company invests in a diversified portfolio of shares and securities in smaller, unquoted United Kingdom (UK) companies and Alternative Investment Market (AIM)/ Aquis Stock Exchange (AQSE) quoted companies that meet the criteria for VCT qualifying investments. The Company offers investment opportunities across various sectors, including software and technology, business services, learning and development and recruitment technology, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology and healthcare, industrials and engineering, and marketing and advertising technology. It offers a range of investment opportunities and serves customers primarily in the United Kingdom. Its investment manager is Maven Capital Partners UK LLP.

name: CLARKSON PLC
businessSummary: Clarkson PLC is a United Kingdom-based provider of integrated services and investment banking capabilities to the shipping and offshore markets, facilitating global trade. The Company's segments include Broking, Financial, Support and Research. The Broking segment offers services to shipowners and charterers in the transportation by sea of a range of cargoes; to buyers and sellers/yards relating to sale and purchase transactions, and future broking operations. The Financial segment offers full-service investment banking, specializing in the maritime, oil services and natural resources sectors. The Company also provides structured asset finance services and structured projects in the shipping, offshore and real estate sectors. The Support segment includes port and agency services representing ship agency services provided throughout the United Kingdom and Egypt. The Research segment services encompass the provision of shipping-related information and publications.

name: CHURCHILL CHINA PLC
businessSummary: Churchill China plc is a United Kingdom-based manufacturer of performance ceramics. The Company’s principal business services hospitality market worldwide, providing tableware and other products to a number of sectors. Its brands include Ambience, Alchemy, Super Vitrified, Art de Cuisine, and Dudson. The Company’s product categories include plates, bowls, beverages, serveware, dip pots and side dishes, cutlery, accessories and cookware. It offers products for a range of sectors which include hotels, contract caterers, cafes, and restaurants. The Company operates in two segments: Ceramics and Materials. The Ceramics segment is engaged in the sale of ceramic tableware and complementary items. The Materials segment is engaged in the sale of materials for the production of ceramics, predominantly to the tableware industry. The Company’s subsidiaries include Churchill China (UK) Limited, Furlong Mills Ltd, Churchill China, Inc, Churchill Ceramica Iberia, S.L. and Churchill China RM S.R.L.

name: CHRISTIE GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Christie Group plc is a United Kingdom-based professional business services company. The Company operates approximately 32 offices across the United Kingdom and Europe, catering to its specialist markets in the hospitality, leisure, healthcare, medical, childcare and education and retail sectors. Its services include surveying, valuation, agency, consultancy, finance, insurance, stock control and business software solutions. The Company operates in two complementary business divisions: Professional & Financial Services (PFS) and Stock & Inventory Systems & Services (SISS). These divisions trade under the brand names: PFS - Christie & Co, Pinders, Christie Finance and Christie Insurance: SISS - Venners and Vennersys. The PFS division principally covers business valuation, consultancy and agency, business mortgages and insurance services and business appraisal. The SISS division covers stock audit and counting, consultancy, compliance and hospitality and software solutions.

name: CHEMRING GROUP 7 % (EX 4.9 %) CUM PREF
businessSummary: Chemring Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based technology solutions company. The Company operates through two segments: Sensors & Information and Countermeasures & Energetics. Its Sensors & Information segment is engaged in providing consulting and technology services to solve security-critical issues. Its Sensors & Information segment is also engaged in the development and manufacture of electronic countermeasures and biological threat detection equipment. Its Countermeasures & Energetics segment is engaged in the development and manufacture of expendable countermeasures for air and sea platforms, cartridge/propellant actuated devices, pyrotechnic devices for satellite launch and deployment, missile components, propellants, separation sub-systems, actuators and energetic materials. Its customer base spans national defense organizations, security and law enforcement agencies, as well as commercial markets such as space and transport.

name: VISTRY GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Vistry Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based company that develops new homes and communities across all sectors of the United Kingdom housing market. The Company develops sites across England, providing private and affordable housing on land owned by the Group or the Group’s joint ventures. The Company specializes in partnering with housing associations and other public sector businesses across England, including London, to deliver either the development of private, affordable, and private rental sector (PRS) housing on land owned by the Group or the Group’s joint ventures, or to provide contracting services for development. The Company sells a large proportion of the homes that it builds through its business-to-business brand. It sells homes on the open market across three brands: Bovis Homes, Linden Homes, and Countryside Homes. Its Countryside Partnerships division is a provider of affordable housing with capability across all housing tenures.

name: DIPLOMA PLC
businessSummary: Diploma PLC is a United Kingdom-based decentralized, value-add distribution company. The principal activity of the Company is the supply of specialized technical products and services. It operates through four segments: United Kingdom, Rest of Europe, United States of America, and Rest of world. The Company operates through three sectors: Controls, Seals, and Life Sciences. The Controls Sector offers wire & cables, interconnect solutions, specialty adhesives, specialty fasteners, and industrial automation. The Seals sector businesses supply sealing solutions and fluid power products to support aftermarket repairs, original equipment manufacturing and maintenance, repair, and overhaul projects. The Life Sciences Sector sources and supplies technology-driven, value-add solutions across the in vitro diagnostics, scientific and medtech segments of the global healthcare market. Its subsidiaries include HKX, Inc., Gremtek SAS, Acernis Medical Inc., Somagen Diagnostics Inc., and others.

name: CASTINGS PLC
businessSummary: Castings P.L.C. is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing iron castings and machining operations. Its segments include Foundry operations and Machining operations. It operates three iron foundries, such as Castings P.L.C. (Brownhills, West Midlands) and William Lee Limited (Dronfield, Derbyshire) and Castings Ductile Limited (Scunthorpe, North Lincolnshire) together with the CNC Speedwell Limited machining operation, which is also based in Brownhills. It produces Ductile iron, SG iron, Austempered ductile iron (ADI), SiMo, and Ni-resist castings over 7000 kilograms in weight. Its three Disamatic molding machines and three horizontal green sand molding machines provide a foundry capacity of over 70,000 tons per annum. Its machining operation is invested to support the capacity requirements of the foundry customer base. Its customer sector profile includes commercial vehicles, automotive, and others.

name: ACCESSO TECHNOLOGY GROUP PLC
businessSummary: accesso Technology Group plc is a United Kingdom-based technology provider to the leisure, entertainment, and cultural markets. The Company’s principal activities are the development and application of ticketing, mobile and eCommerce technologies, licensing and operation of virtual queuing solutions and providing a personalized experience to customers within the attractions and leisure industry. The Company's segments include Ticketing and Distribution, Guest Experience and Professional Services. The Ticketing and Distribution segment comprises products, including accesso Passport, accesso Siriusware, accesso ShoWare, Ingresso, accesso Paradox, and accesso Horizon. Its Guest Experience segment includes accesso LoQueue, Mobile Applications experience management platforms and accesso Freedom. The Professional Services segment is engaged in the delivery of bespoke professional services to large customers in the ski, theme park, and cruise ship markets.

name: CARDIFF PROPERTY PLC
businessSummary: The Cardiff Property plc is a United Kingdom-based company specializing in property investment and development in the Thames Valley. The Company operates through two segments: property and other investment and property development. Its freehold property portfolio, including those held by Campmoss Property Company Limited (Campmoss), remains located in the Thames Valley and in the adjoining counties of Surrey, Berkshire and Buckinghamshire. Its portfolio includes 1-10 Market Street, Bracknell; Alston House, Bracknell; Windsor Business Centre; Datchet Meadows; Maidenhead Enterprise Centre; Heritage Court, Egham; Highway House, Maidenhead; Gowring House Commercial; Gowring House Apartments; The Priory; The White House, Egham; Westview, Bracknell, and Tangley Place, Worplesdon.

name: CARCLO PLC
businessSummary: Carclo plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company’s segments include Carclo Technical Plastics (CTP) and Specialty Division. The CTP segment supplies value-adding engineered solutions from mold design, automation, and production to assembly and printing, for the life science and precision component industries. The Specialty segment delivers precise and durable components for the safety and performance of the aircraft manufacturing, aerospace and optical industries. This segment serves cables & wires and machined critical components markets, delivering precision-engineered solutions for Aerospace applications, ensuring reliability and performance in demanding environments; and light & motion markets providing light-emitting diode (LED) lighting solutions, including aftermarket for automotive lighting, Fresnel lenses for diverse applications, and visual aids under the Coil brand for eye care optics.

name: CAMELLIA PLC
businessSummary: Camellia Plc is a United Kingdom-based holding company with a portfolio of international businesses and assets, with its core operating companies focused on agriculture through the growing of tea, avocado, macadamia and arable crops. The principal activities of the Company are based on its core agriculture businesses: Bangladesh, India, EP Kenya, Kakuzi, Malawi, South Africa, Tanzania, Brazil, and Other - AJT Engineering, Jing Tea and EP Cape. AJT Engineering is a specialty engineering services company based in Aberdeen supporting the offshore oil industry, hydro-electricity providers and other industrial sectors. Eastern Produce Malawi (EPM) is a tea and macadamia business, being the producer of both crops in the country. EPM owns five macadamia estates and a cracking facility. Eastern Produce Kenya (EPK) is a tea production operation. Its other crops include arable, livestock, forestry and rubber. Its subsidiaries include Amgoorie India Limited, Amo Tea Company Limited, and others.

name: EDEN RESEARCH PLC
businessSummary: Eden Research plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is focused on biopesticides for sustainable agriculture. The Company develops and supplies biopesticide products and natural microencapsulation technologies to the global crop protection, animal health and consumer products industries. Its products include crop protection, animal health, and consumer products. Its crop protection includes Mevalone and Cedroz. Mevalone is a foliar, contact biofungicide which delivers a controlled release pattern of multiple terpene active ingredients. Cedroz is a terpene-based product developed in conjunction with Eastman Chemical Company as a post-planting solution to the problem of root-knot nematodes. The Company's Sustaine encapsulation technology is used to harness the biocidal activity of naturally occurring molecules produced by plants (terpenes) as part of their defence systems. Sustaine is used in a wide range of applications such as agricultural, animal health and consumer products

name: WETHERSPOON (JD)
businessSummary: J D Wetherspoon plc owns and operates pubs throughout the United Kingdom and Ireland. The Company provides the Wetherspoon application, which allows anyone with a phone to order food and drinks to their table, without leaving their seat. The Company operates hotels in England, Ireland, Scotland and Wales. The Company's hotel rooms come in a range of sizes, including some family rooms. Its hotel is also attached to a Wetherspoon pub, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, including its club deals, as well as its range of hot, soft, and alcoholic drinks. Each of its hotel rooms features a suite bathroom, complimentary tea- and coffee-making facilities, hair dryer, flat-screen television with Freeview TV and unlimited free Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi). Its hotels include The Castle Hotel, Ruthin; The Catherine Wheel, Henley-on-Thames; The Crown Hotel, Biggleswade; The Pilgrim’s Progress, Bedford, among others.

name: CAFFYNS PLC 11% REG CUM PREF
businessSummary: Caffyns plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which offers deals on new cars and used vehicles. The Company is a car dealer in the southeast of England. It offers a stock of new and used vehicles for sale at approximately 20 locations across Sussex and Kent, including brands such as Volkswagen, Audi, SEAT, Skoda, Vauxhall, CUPRA, Volvo, MG and Lotus. Its operations include the Audi business, Volkswagen business, Volvo business, MG business and Vauxhall business. It offers a range of electric and hybrid vehicles in Battery Electric Vehicles (BEV) and Plug - In Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV) types under the brands, including Audi, Volkswagen, Volvo, Skoda, CUPRA, SEAT, Vauxhall, MG and Lotus. It also provides a vehicle servicing facility offering fixed-price service, seasonal health checks, ministry of transport (MOT) test servicing, air conditioning service, battery checks & replacement, tire offers, service plans, and others. It also offers mobility services and accessories.

name: CML MICROSYSTEMS PLC
businessSummary: CML Microsystems Plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is engaged in developing mixed-signal, radio frequency (RF) and microwave semiconductors for global communications markets. It offers a range of products, including millimeter wave (mmWave) MMICs, RF transceivers, baseband processors, data controllers and interface devices, which are used in various applications such as critical communications, satellite and network infrastructure. The Company utilizes a combination of outsourced manufacturing and in-house testing with trading operations in the United Kingdom, Asia and the United States of America. It operates in the semiconductor segment. The Company offers services across markets, such as wireless digital transformation, network infrastructure, hybrid PMR-LTE systems, public safety, satellite, Internet of things (IoT), broadcast, and aerospace and defense. It has investments in fifth generation (5G) infrastructure, including small cells and beamforming technologies.

name: XAAR PLC
businessSummary: Xaar plc is engaged in the development of digital inkjet technology. It designs and manufactures printheads that it sells globally to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and user developer integrators (UDIs). Its segments include Printhead, Product Print Systems, Digital Imaging, and Ink Supply Systems. Printhead business unit focuses on the design, manufacture, marketing, and sales of printheads and associated products which are used in a variety of applications, such as ceramic tile decoration, graphics, decor, textiles, labels, and packaging as well as 3D printing and additive manufacturing. Engineered Print Systems manufactures a range of customized product print systems, involving printing all kinds of industrial and promotional objects such as medical equipment, automotive parts, tools, apparel, appliances, sports equipment, and toys. Digital Imaging business focuses on high-performance digital imaging solutions from digital inkjet label presses to digital pathology scanners.

name: TULLOW OIL PLC
businessSummary: Tullow Oil plc is a United Kingdom-based independent oil and gas, exploration and production company. The Company's primary activity is the discovery and production of oil and gas. The Company operates through four segments: Ghana, Non-operated, and Exploration. It has exploration, development and production assets across Africa and South America. Its Non-operated producing assets include Uganda. It has over licenses across countries including Africa and South America, which include Cote d’Ivoire, Ghana, the United Kingdom and Argentina. The Company's subsidiaries include Tullow Group Services Limited, Tullow Comoros Limited, Tullow New Ventures Limited, Tullow Oil Finance Limited, Tullow Oil Limited, Tullow Overseas Holdings BV, Tullow Zambia BV, Tullow Uganda Limited, Tullow Namibia Limited, Tullow Mauritania Limited, and others.

name: PEBBLE BEACH SYSTEMS GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Pebble Beach Systems Group plc is a United Kingdom-based global software company specializing in playout automation and content management solutions for the broadcast and streaming markets. The Company is engaged in designing and delivering automation, integrated channels and virtualized playout solutions, with scalable products designed for applications of all sizes. Its automation solution includes scalable enterprise-level software solutions for broadcasters or service providers with complex workflow requirements. Its scalable integrated channel device offers audio, video and graphics functionality in a compact, cost-effective format to meet their ingest, channel branding and frame-accurate multichannel playout requirements. The Company has commissioned systems in more than 70 countries, with installations ranging from single up to over 150 channels in operation, and around 2000 channels on air under the control of its automation technology.

name: BRITISH SMALLER COMPANIES VCT PLC
businessSummary: British Smaller Companies VCT plc is a venture capital trust. The Company’s objective is to maximize Total Return and provide investors with a long-term tax-free dividend yield whilst maintaining the Company’s status as a venture capital trust. It seeks to build a broad portfolio of investments in early-stage companies focused on growth, with the aim of spreading the maturity profiles and maximizing return, as well as ensuring compliance with VCT Regulations. The Company invests in United Kingdom-based businesses across a broad range of sectors that blends a mix of businesses operating in established and emerging industries that offer opportunities in the application and development of innovation in their products and services. It invests in the industry sectors, including application software, data, tech-enabled services, cloud & devops, new media, retail & brands, business services, and other sectors. YFM Private Equity Limited acts as a manager of the Company.

name: BP 9% CUM PREF
businessSummary: BP p.l.c. is a United Kingdom-based integrated energy company. The Company's segments include Gas & low carbon energy, Oil production & operations, Customers & products, and Other businesses & corporate. Its gas business includes regions with upstream activities that produce natural gas, integrated gas and power, and gas trading. Its low carbon business includes solar, offshore and onshore wind, hydrogen and carbon capture and storage and power trading. Oil production & operations segment comprises regions with upstream activities that predominantly produce crude oil, including bpx energy. Customers & products segment comprises its customer-focused businesses, which include convenience and retail fuels, electric vehicle charging, as well as Castrol, aviation and business to business and midstream. It also includes its products businesses, refining and oil trading, as well as its bioenergy businesses. Other businesses & corporate segment comprises technology and bp ventures.
