name: BRITISH LAND COMPANY PLC
businessSummary: The British Land Company PLC is a United Kingdom-based property company. The Company focused on real estate sectors with the operational fundamentals: London campuses, retail parks, and London urban logistics. Its segments include Campuses and Retail & London Urban Logistics. Its campuses are located in Central London which are designed to meet the needs of modern businesses. Campuses include Broadgate, Regent's Place, Paddington Central, and Canada Water. Its portfolio of shopping centers includes well-located open-air schemes, as well as traditional covered centers, offering a flexible mix of retail formats to meet diverse customer and occupier needs. Its retail parks include Whiteley, Fort Kinnaird, and Crownpoint. The London urban logistics includes The Box, Paddington, Southwark Urban Logistics, and Enfield Urban Logistics. Its residential locations include Canada Water and Aldgate Place.

name: CELEBRUS TECHNOLOGIES PLC
businessSummary: Celebrus Technologies PLC is a United Kingdom-based company, which provides a disruptive data technology platform. The Company is focused on improving the relationships between brands and consumers through better data. Its solutions include Celebrus Data Platform, Celebrus for Fraud, Celebrus Cloud, Celebrus Analytics and Reporting, Celebrus for Marketing, and Celebrus Digital Analytics. It is deployed across 30+ countries throughout the financial services, healthcare, retail, travel, and telecommunications sectors. It automatically captures, contextualizes, and activates consumer behavioral data in live time across all digital channels. Through the addition of behavioral biometrics and artificial intelligence, it enables brands to detect and prevent fraud before it occurs. Its data platform solutions include data capture, data model, single customer view, behavioral biometrics, mobile apps, marketing signals, sense and trace, anomaly detection, anonymized data collection, and others.

name: BRAIME GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Braime Group PLC manufactures deep-drawn metal presswork and distributes material handling components and monitoring equipment. Its manufacturing activity is delivered through Braime Pressings Limited, and the distribution activity is through the 4B division. Its electronics division specializes in level controls, intelligent sensors and safety control systems for bucket elevators and conveyors. Braime Pressings specializes in metal presswork, including deep drawing, multi-stage progression and transfer presswork. It manufactures precision stamped components for the automotive and industrial sectors, with automation capabilities such as pick and place, roll threading, washing and robotic welding. The 4B division develops material handling components for the agricultural and industrial sectors, from elevator buckets to forged conveyor chain and level monitors to hazard monitors. 4B works with its customers on new designs and on the upgrade of existing elevators and conveyor machines.

name: HENRY BOOT PLC PREF PERP
businessSummary: Henry Boot PLC is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in land promotion, property investment and development, and construction. The Company's property investment and development activities include property investment, property development, housebuilding and associated trading activities. Its land promotion activities include land management, development and trading activities. The Company's construction activities include its private finance initiative (PFI) company and plant hire activities. The Company operates within three key markets: industrial and logistics, residential and urban development. Its primary subsidiaries include Hallam Land Management Limited, Henry Boot Developments Limited, Henry Boot Construction Limited, Stonebridge Homes Limited and Banner Plant Limited. Banner Plant Limited offers a wide range of construction equipment and services for sale and hire, accommodation, power tools, powered access. big air, and training.

name: HENRY BOOT PLC

The Company's property investment and development activities include property investment, property development, housebuilding and associated trading activities. Its land promotion activities include land management, development and trading activities. The Company's construction activities include its private finance initiative (PFI) company and plant hire activities. The Company operates within three key markets: industrial and logistics, residential and urban development. Banner Plant Limited offers a wide range of construction equipment and services for sale and hire, accommodation, power tools, powered access. big air, and training.

name: BISICHI PLC
businessSummary: Bisichi PLC is a mining company. Its principal activity is coal mining and processing in South Africa. Its segments include South African mining operations and United Kingdom (UK) property. It holds Black Wattle Colliery, which is an opencast mining colliery, located in the Witbank Coalfield near Middelburg, Mpumalanga. Black Wattle produces low-phosphorous, low-sulphur bituminous coal, which is suitable for use as an export quality steam coal and as a feedstock for the Ferrochrome Industry South African domestic market. Its South African coal processing operation, Sisonke Coal Processing, is located about three kilometers south of Middelburg, Mpumulanga. It invests in UK retail property and residential property development. Its investment portfolio mainly consists of listed equities and equity-related funds involved or invested in extractive and energy-related business activities, including entities involved in the extraction of commodities needed for the clean energy transition.

name: BALFOUR BEATTY PLC
businessSummary: Balfour Beatty plc is a United Kingdom-based international infrastructure company. The Company finances, develops, builds, maintains, and operates the complex and critical infrastructure. It operates through three segments: Construction Services, Support Services, and Infrastructure Investments. The Construction Services segment includes activities resulting in the physical construction of an asset. The Support Services segment includes activities that support existing assets or functions, such as asset maintenance and refurbishment. The Infrastructure Investments segment is engaged in the acquisition, operation, and disposal of infrastructure assets, such as roads, hospitals, student accommodation, military housing, multifamily residences, offshore transmission networks, waste and biomass, and other concessions. This segment also includes the housing development division. Its projects include Swanswell Viaduct project, M60 Palatine Road Bridge project, Project Hercules, and others.

name: BELLWAY PLC
businessSummary: Bellway p.l.c. is a United Kingdom-based home construction company engaged in the building and selling of homes, ranging from one-bedroom apartments up to six-bedroom family homes, as well as providing social housing-to-housing associations. The Company operates in approximately 20 divisions, covering centers across England, Scotland and Wales. The Company's brands include Bellway, Ashberry brand and Bellway London. The Bellway brand is engaged in building quality homes in selected locations inspired by the needs of families. The Ashberry brand is offered on larger sites, and it also provides two differentiated outlets, offering choice to its customers. The Bellway London brand covers all developments in London boroughs and commuter towns. Its properties range from one-bedroom apartments to four-bedroom houses. The Company’s subsidiaries include Bellway Homes Limited, Bellway Housing Trust Limited, Bellway Properties Limited, Bellway (Services) Limited and Litrose Investments Limited.

name: BARRATT DEVELOPMENTS P L C
businessSummary: Barratt Redrow PLC is a United Kingdom-based company engaged in housebuilding and commercial development. Its three consumer brands, Barratt, David Wilson, Redrow, and Barratt London, are engaged in offering a variety of homes for people at all stages of life. Barratt Homes provides homes perfect for first-time buyers and families, offering a range of properties across England, Scotland and Wales. David Wilson Homes provides larger homes designed for mover-uppers and families. Redrow is ideal for premium purchasers and downsizers. Barratt London is a residential developer with a portfolio in diverse and ranges from state-of-the-art apartments and penthouses to riverside communities, and complex, mixed-use regeneration schemes.

name: AVON PROTECTION PLC
businessSummary: Avon Technologies PLC, formerly Avon Protection PLC, is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in providing protective equipment’s. The Company operates through two brands: Avon Protection, and Team Wendy. The Avon Protection is a provider of mission-critical protection for its customers' requirements. Its range of mission-critical protection products includes respirators, powered & supplied air, spares & accessories, chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear (CBRN) protective wear, and underwater systems. The Team Wendy's portfolio is focused on ballistic and bump protection helmets, and liner and retention systems. Its product portfolio includes ACH GEN II, NG IHPS, EPIC, EXFIL Ballistic SL, EXFIL LTP, SAR Backcountry, CAM FIT Retention System, ZORBIUM Action Pad (ZAP) 7-PAD NSN Liner System, EPIC Air Liner System, and EXFIL Maritime Liner System. The Company supplies its respiratory and head protection portfolio to customers across the globe.

name: AUKETT SWANKE GROUP PLC
businessSummary: Built Cybernetics PLC, formerly Aukett Swanke Group Plc, is a property technology company, which is engaged in delivering smart buildings and related services. The Company’s services range from the design, conception and implementation of new smart buildings to the reimagination and retrofit of existing spaces. Its portfolio includes Vanti, ecoDriver, Anders+Kern UK Ltd, Veretec, Aukett Swanke, Torpedo Factory Group-TFG Stage Technology, and Aukett + Heese. Vanti is a master systems integrator, working with property owners, building operators, and commercial tenants to create smart spaces and intelligent buildings. Vanti has developed Smart Core, an open-source building operating system that enables property owners and tenants to integrate all aspects of building technology. Veretec is an architecture studio, specialized in project delivery and provides detailed technical solutions that enhance buildability through design.

name: BRAEMAR SHIPPING SERVICES PLC
businessSummary: Braemar PLC is a provider of investment, chartering and risk management advice to the shipping and energy markets. The Company’s operations are diversified across tankers, dry cargo, sale and purchase, renewables, financial and offshore. It operates through three segments: Investment Advisory, Chartering and Risk Advisory. The Chartering segment includes the Company’s shipbroking business, the Risk Advisory segment includes its regulated securities business, and the Investment Advisory segment focuses on transactional services. It facilitates all stages of shipping purchases and sales, with a focus on both protecting and maximizing its clients’ investments. Its risk advisory business specializes in providing securities solutions that enable its clients to protect and hedge their positions in the volatile energy markets or trade speculatively. The Company’s main geographic markets comprise the United Kingdom, Singapore, the United States, Australia, Germany and the Rest of the World.

name: ASHTEAD GROUP
businessSummary: Ashtead Group plc is a United Kingdom-based international equipment rental company with national networks in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom under the brand name Sunbelt Rentals. The Company rents a range of construction and industrial equipment across a variety of applications to a diverse customer base. The Sunbelt US is construction and industrial equipment rental division which has around 1,157 stores. It rent a wide range of equipment from a network of stores clustered in major metropolitan areas from Washington DC, and Baltimore on the Atlantic Coast through Miami, Tampa and Orlando in Florida to Los Angeles and Seattle on the West Coast. The Company’s Canada division has its stores in Alberta, British Colombia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Quebec, and Saskatchewan. The Sunbelt UK rents a range of equipment and operates approximately 192 stores and various markets in the United Kingdom. Its equipment’s are used in lift, power, and more.

name: ANTOFAGASTA PLC
businessSummary: Antofagasta plc is a United Kingdom-based mining company based in Chile, focused on copper and its by-products. The Company has organized its business into two divisions based on its products: Mining and Transport. Through its Mining division, the Company owns and operates four mines: Los Pelambres primarily produces copper concentrate containing gold and silver as a by-product, and molybdenum concentrate; Centinela, which produces copper concentrate containing gold and silver as a by-product, molybdenum concentrates and copper cathodes; Antucoya and Zaldivar produce copper cathodes. Los Pelambres is located in the Coquimbo Region of central Chile, and Centinela, Antucoya and Zaldivar, which are in the Antofagasta Region of northern Chile. Its Transport Division is known as Ferrocarril de Antofagasta a Bolivia (FCAB) and provides rail and truck services to the mining industry in the Antofagasta Region, including the Company’s own mining operations.

name: ANTOFAGASTA PLC CUM PREF 5.5%
businessSummary: Antofagasta plc is a United Kingdom-based mining company based in Chile, focused on copper and its by-products. The Company has organized its business into two divisions based on its products: Mining and Transport. Through its Mining division, the Company owns and operates four mines: Los Pelambres primarily produces copper concentrate containing gold and silver as a by-product, and molybdenum concentrate; Centinela, which produces copper concentrate containing gold and silver as a by-product, molybdenum concentrates and copper cathodes; Antucoya and Zaldivar produce copper cathodes. Los Pelambres is located in the Coquimbo Region of central Chile, and Centinela, Antucoya and Zaldivar, which are in the Antofagasta Region of northern Chile. Its Transport Division is known as Ferrocarril de Antofagasta a Bolivia (FCAB) and provides rail and truck services to the mining industry in the Antofagasta Region, including the Company’s own mining operations.

name: ANGLO-EASTERN PLANTATIONS PLC
businessSummary: Anglo-Eastern Plantations Plc is a United Kingdom-based producer of palm oil and rubber with plantations across Indonesia and Malaysia. The Company operates a planted area of approximately 75,239 hectares (ha). The Company operates approximately six palm oil mills in Indonesia. The Company has its assets based on geographical location, including North Sumatera, Bengkulu, Riau, Bangka, Kalimantan, Plasma and Malaysia. Its fresh fruit bunches (FFB) production in North Sumatera, which aggregates the estates of Tasik, Anak Tasik, Labuhan Bilik (HPP), Blankahan, Rambung, Sg Musam and Cahaya Pelita (CPA) produced 423,900 metric ton (mt). Its FFB production in Bengkulu, which aggregates the estates of Puding Mas (MPM) and Alno produced 269,500 mt. Its FFB production in the Riau region, comprising Bina Pitri estates, produced 135,000 mt. Its FFB production in the Bangka region, comprising Bangka Malindo Lestari estates, produced 12,900 mt. Its FFB production in Malaysia is 9,300 mt.

name: CQS NATURAL RESOURCES GROWTH AND INCOME
businessSummary: CQS Natural Resources Growth and Income PLC is a United Kingdom-based investment company. The Company's investment objective is to provide shareholders with capital growth and income predominantly from a portfolio of mining and resource equities and of mining, resource and industrial fixed interest securities. The Company invests in global energy and mining companies, with a focus on total return. It also pays a regular quarterly dividend. The Company may invest in companies regardless of country, sector or size and its portfolio is constructed without reference to the composition of any stock market index or benchmark. Exposure to higher yielding securities may also be obtained by investing in other sectors, including closed-end investment companies and open-ended collective investment schemes. It may invest in derivatives, financial instruments, money market instruments and currencies for the purpose of efficient portfolio management. The Company’s investment manager is CQS (UK) LLP.

name: BILLINGTON HOLDINGS PLC
businessSummary: Billington Holdings Plc is a United Kingdom-based structural steel and construction safety solutions specialist, which is focused on structural steel and engineering activities throughout the United Kingdom and European markets. The Company's segments include Structural Steelwork and Safety Solutions. The Structural Steelwork segment includes the activities of Billington Structures Limited, Peter Marshall Steel Stairs Limited, and Specialist Protective Coatings Limited. The Safety Solutions segment includes the activities of Easi-Edge Limited and Hoard-It Limited. Specialist Protective Coatings Limited is a specialist treatment applicator. Easi-Edge Limited is engaged in the safety solutions business. Hoard-It Limited provides site hoarding solutions. The Company provides services across various sectors, including defense, commercial, education, health, industrial, infrastructure, leisure, residential, retail, distribution, energy, and data centers.

name: ANGLESEY MINING PLC
businessSummary: Anglesey Mining PLC is a mining company. The Company is engaged in developing the Parys Mountain volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) deposit. It also manages its interest in the Graengesberg properties and holds an investment in the Labrador iron project located in eastern Canada. Its business segment is mine exploration, evaluation, and development. The Parys Mountain project contains a polymetallic deposit comprising zinc, copper, lead, silver, and gold, and the Company holds 100% ownership of the project. The Company holds a 49.75% ownership interest in the Graengesberg Iron AB (GIAB) project. It also holds 12% of Labrador Iron Mines Holdings Limited, which, through its subsidiaries Labrador Iron Mines Limited (LIM) and Schefferville Mines Inc. (SMI), engages in exploration and development of direct shipping iron ore deposits. These deposits are situated in the Menihek area in the Province of Newfoundland and Labrador and in Quebec, centered near the town of Schefferville, Quebec.

name: ALUMASC GROUP PLC
businessSummary: The Alumasc Group plc is a United Kingdom-based supplier of building products, systems and solutions. The Company's segments include Building Envelope; Water Management; and Housebuilding Products. The Water Management segment manufactures sustainable rainwater goods, drainage products and gas and airtight inspection covers (known as Gatic). Under the Alumasc Water Management Solutions (AWMS) banner, customers benefit from rainwater and drainage products that capture, retain and control the flow of rainwater inside and outside buildings from origination source to water course, sewer or ground. The Building Envelope segment supplies a range of roofing products and provides technical advice, service and environmental credentials. The Housebuilding Products segment manufactures products for housebuilding made from recycled and recyclable materials. Its brands include Alumasc, Alumasc Skyline, Alumasc Rainwater, Harmer, Wade, Gatic, Roof-Pro, Alumasc Roofing, Blackdown and Timloc.

name: SPEEDY HIRE PLC
businessSummary: Speedy Hire Plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of tools and equipment hire services to a range of customers in the construction, infrastructure, industrial, and support services markets, as well as to local trade and retail. The Company's segments include Hire and Services. The Hire segment relates to hire of its core fleet of owned products, covering a range of product lines in categories such as small tools, access, power and battery storage, lifting, survey, powered access, welding and plant machinery. The Services segment predominantly relates to the re-hire of an extensive range of specialist equipment through partnerships with suppliers, referred to as Customer Solutions. This segment also includes fuel and energy sales and management, training, product sales, and test, inspection and certification services. The Company operates from 135 Service Centers and on-site locations across the United Kingdom and Ireland and through a joint venture in Kazakhstan.

name: NETCALL PLC
businessSummary: Netcall plc is a provider of intelligent automation and customer engagement software. The Company is engaged in the design, development, sale and support of software products and services. Its Liberty software platform with Intelligent Automation and Customer Engagement solutions helps organizations digitally transform their businesses faster and more efficiently, empowering them to create a leaner, more customer-centric organization. Its solutions include low-code application development, contact center solutions, process mapping and improvement, robotic process automation, intelligent document processing and artificial intelligence (AI) and intelligent automation. Through Liberty Create, one can design, launch and refine custom applications, which enables to build smarter workflows, automate tasks, and create solutions. Its customers span enterprise, healthcare and government sectors. Liberty Spark can map, visualize and optimize processes.

name: DISCOVERIE GROUP PLC
businessSummary: discoverIE Group plc is an international group of businesses that design and manufacture customized electronic components for industrial applications. The Company operates through its two divisions, Magnetics & Controls, and Sensing & Connectivity. The Magnetics & Controls division designs, manufactures and supplies highly differentiated magnetic and power components, embedded computing, and interface controls for industrial applications. The division operates across 16 countries and comprises two clusters (Magnetics and Embedded Systems) and four further businesses. The Sensing & Connectivity division designs, manufactures and supplies highly differentiated sensing and connectivity components for industrial applications. The division operates across nine countries and comprises four clusters and four further businesses. It serves a diverse range of industries, such as renewable energy, transportation, medical, security, and industrial & connectivity.

name: TOTALENERGIES EP GABON
businessSummary: TotalEnergies EP Gabon SA is a Gabon-based company engaged in the exploration and extraction of hydrocarbons. Its range of products includes natural gas and crude oil. The Company has numerous production licenses, production permits and exclusive authorizations to operate. Total Gabon SA has operations on various fields, including Torpille, Nitchengue Ocean, Pageau Marine, Barbier Marine, Girelle Marine, Grand Anguille Marine, Grondin-Mandaros Marine and Konzi Marine, among others. The Company's parent is is Elf Aquitaine, a subsidiary of Total SA.

name: EUROPLASMA
businessSummary: Europlasma SA is a France-based company that offers a range of solutions for hazardous waste treatment. The Company’s technology allows converting toxic waste into reusable materials. The Company is composed of four entities, such as Europlasma Torch & Process, which provides engineering consulting for hazardous waste treatment, and sells and licenses its plasma torches and technology; The Company also specializes in destruction and valorization of asbestos waste and operates ash melting units; It supplies technological solutions for the efficient transformation of biomass and waste into electric energy and Europe Environnement, which offers ventilation and air cleaning systems for industrial applications. The Company provides applications for industries keen to reduce their environmental footprint, by substituting fossil fuels or through recycling in a circular economy logic.

name: MONDO TV FRANCE
businessSummary: Mondo TV France SA is a France-based television production company. The Company's editorial line consists of working on programs imbued with originality, whether adaptations or original projects. It produces and distributes animated cartoons for television and film, which are judiciously, artistically and technically chosen mastered youth programs. It even presents groovy series like Disco Dragon and adventures in the modern world. It also operates in other related sectors such as music and audiovisual distribution, exploitation, media, publishing and merchandising by the group itself as well as by third parties.

name: SEMCO TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Semco Technologies SAS is a France- based company. The Company engages in the design and manufacturing of electrostatic chucks (eChucks) for wafer processing. It focuses on providing solutions for semiconductor processing, particularly in thin and ultra-thin wafers.

name: ATOS
businessSummary: Atos SE is a France-based company that provides digital transformation and IT services. The Company activity is organized around 3 poles, such as outsourcing services, systems integration and consulting services and transactional services. It offers processing of electronic payment transactions, remote payment management, development of payment solutions, etc. It provides secure and carbon-free digital technology. The Company offers its clients an end-to-end approach by offering them cutting-edge digital solutions, consulting services, as well as digital security and decarbonization solutions. It provides cloud and digital workplace solution and managed security services.

name: LOUIS HACHETTE GROUP
businessSummary: Louis Hachette Group SA is a France-based company. The Company is organized around three main activities: Lagardere Publishing, Lagardere Travel Retail and the Prisma Media Group. Lagardere Publishing is the book publishing and distribution business through its integrated publishing houses with brand names and the IP portfolio across the consumer book publishing market comprising the trade and K-12 education publishing markets with a focus on three main languages (French, English and Spanish). Lagardere Travel Retail involves in the travel retail business, comprising the Travel Essentials, Dining business divisions, Duty Free and Fashion, offering a wide range of retail services and dining to national and international travelers. The Prisma Media Group primarily includes magazine (print and digital) publishing and online media businesses.

name: CANAL+
businessSummary: CANAL+ SA, formerly known as Groupe Canal+ is a France-based media company. The principal activity of the company is to act as the ultimate holding company of the Group. It offers television channels and services. The Company provides subscription TV in France, handle distribution for other channels, and invest in film production through their subsidiary, StudioCanal. The Company operates approximately in 52 countries across Europe, Africa, Asia, United States and others. The Company’s various businesses include: subscription-TV (live and on-demand, mostly through Canal+ premium offers, including its Canal+ OTT platform, but also its stakes in MultiChoice in Africa, Viaplay in Europe, and Viu in Asia); advertising-supported television (through FTA channels) and video streaming (through Dailymotion and Viu); content production and distribution (mostly through Studiocanal, its in-house studio) and telecommunication services (through GVA and Canal+ Telecom in the Overseas Territories).

name: DRONE VOLT
businessSummary: Drone Volt SA is a France-based company principally engaged in the aerospace industry. The Company provides civilian drone manufacturing. It specializes in the production, integration and sale of drones for professionals. Drone Volt is a provider of the audiovisual market in the field of aerial photography by drone. The Company is also present in many other markets such as security and topography, among others. The Company's main product is the Pack PRO FOR GH4 S900. It cooperates with Ministry of Internal Affaires, Ministry of Defense, CERN, Gendarmerie Transports Aeriens (aerial transport police), Dakar 2015, Spie, TF1, Bouygues, CNRS, Bonne Pioche, RAID and GEDEON Programmes, among others. It operates through Dandrone.

name: MONCEY (FIN.) NOM.
businessSummary: Financiere Moncey SA is a France-based investment and holding company. The Company's portfolio of holdings includes Financiere de l'Odet, Financiere V, Omnium Bollore and Socphipard.

name: LDC
businessSummary: Societe LDC SA is a France-based company engaged in food processing specializing in the production, packaging, and marketing of poultry products. The Company provides poultry products, as well as a range of delicatessen food. It has two business lines: Poultry division, engaged in the poultry, pig and cattle farming, as well as egg production and others; catering products, offering ready-to-eat meals and snacks like pizzas, sandwiches, tarts and desserts and international division which focuses on international development with countries specific strategies. It markets its products under various brands, including Le Gaulois, Loue and Traditions d’Asie.

name: SOLOCAL GROUP
businessSummary: Solocal Group SE is a France-based company, which is engaged in local online communication. The Company provides digital content, advertising solutions and transactional services that connect people with local businesses. It operates in France, Spain, Austria and the United Kingdom and supports the online development of SMB and client accounts, mainly through its four flagship brands, such as PagesJaunes (engaged in local advertising and information on the Internet and in mobile and print media), Mappy (a portal of services relating to travel: maps, journey planners, local area information searches, before and during the journey), Ooreka (a database of content with practical guides, tutorials.

name: NETMEDIA GROUP
businessSummary: Netmedia Group SA formerly known as Makheia Group SA is a France-based company that specializes in the communication market. The Company imagines, optimizes, organizes, and deploys communication devices in all their forms and for all channels such as digital platforms, social media, brand content, marketing activations, print and video. It develops and manages corporate communication and communication strategies for large companies. It also allows firms to enhance their relationship to relevant audiences, like clients, partners, or shareholders. The Company operates on three strategic levels: corporate contents (SEQUOIA FRANKLIN), marketing contents (AFFINITY and PLACE DU MARCHE), and digital contents. It has across 200 collaborators.

name: EXOSENS S.A.
businessSummary: EXOSENS SAS is a France-based company which is a manufacturer and seller of technologies in the field of particles and photo detection and imaging intended to serve space, research, defense and commercial clients. The Company designs, produces and markets electro-optic components and devices including sensors and optics for the detection and amplification of low light, radiation, and emissions. It offers detectors and detection solutions: such as travelling wave tubes, advanced cameras, neutron & gamma detectors, instrument detectors and light intensifier tubes to respond to complex issues in environment.

name: VIRIDIEN SA
businessSummary: Viridian SA is a France-based company that engages in geophysical services and products to oil and gas companies. The Company provides the provision of geophysical services such as recording, processing and interpretation of land and marine seismic data. It provides manufacturing of seismic equipment like recording and transmission devices, seismic data acquisition vibrators, sensors, data processing, interpretation software. It is a global technology and High-Performance Computing (HPC) controller that provide data, products, services and solutions in Earth science, data science, sensing and monitoring. Its portfolio supports clients in sectors such as digital, energy transition, natural resource, and environmental. Along with the current business, it also concentrates on low carbon markets, minerals, mining, as well as the infrastructure monitoring and computing markets outside of oil and gas.

name: PLANISWARE SA
businessSummary: PLANISWARE SA is a France-based company. The Company is primarily engaged in providing cloud solutions and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) to business-to-business (B2B). It provides solutions to help organizations transform how companies strategize, plan and deliver their projects, project portfolios, programs and products. It has two software solutions: Planisware Enterprise and Planisware Orchestra. The Company’s offerings encompass three main dimensions: Strategy and Financial Planning; Project and Portfolio Management; and Engineering, Application, and Product Management. Its mission is to provide solutions that help organizations transform how they strategize, plan, and deliver their projects, project portfolios, programs, and products.

name: CASINO GUICHARD PERRACHON SA
businessSummary: Casino Guichard Perrachon SA is a France-based food retailer company that manages stores in France and abroad. The Company operates across all food and non-food formats: hypermarkets, supermarkets, convenience stores, discount stores and wholesale stores. In France, the Company operates under diversified brands such as: hypermarkets, Casino Supermarkets, Monoprix, Franprix, Leader Price, Spar, Vival, Le Petit Casino, Casino Restauration. Abroad, the Company operates in South America particularly in Brazil and Columbia. The Company is active in other sectors, such as energy where its subsidiary GreenYellow is engaged in energy production (particularly solar photovoltaic) and other energy services. In financial sector, its subsidiary Banque Casino is the retail bank that simplifies access to banking and insurance products.

name: EMEIS SA
businessSummary: EMEIS SA, formerly ORPEA SA is a France-based company which is specialized in administering personalized care and support for the vulnerable people. The Company is engaged in the operations of retirement homes, outpatient and rehabilitation clinics, and psychiatric care. It offers a range of other services, from outpatient treatment, post-operation care and physical therapy, to nursing, geriatric care, psychiatric services, and long-term care homes. The medical care and rehabilitation clinics offer patients who have undergone surgery or an episode of chronic disease. The nursing homes offer senior homes for living where older adults requiring personal attention can conduct their daily routines.

name: STIF FRANCE SAS
businessSummary: Stif France SAS is a France-based company that engages in the manufacturing of components handling bulk products. The Company’s products are distributed through its subsidiaries and independent local distributors. Some of the Company’s products are: Metal and plastic elevator buckets, Elevator belts, Lifting straps, Safety equipment for elevators, Compression couplings for pneumatic conveying, Metal piping for gravity flow, Watertight round access doors, Pressure/vacuum safety valves for silos and Explosion protection equipment. It also maintains technology and modern production equipment for the manufacture of mass-produced parts to complement its catalogue products which are supported by a team of methods and tooling technicians. It also exports its products across 60 countries.

name: LATECOERE SA
businessSummary: Latecoere SA is a France-based company engaged primarily in the aircraft equipment manufacturing. The Company produces aero-structures, such as fuselage sections, as well as passenger and baggage bay doors for Airbus, Boeing, Dassault, Bombardier and Embraer planes. It also supplies onboard electrical harness and avionics bays, as well as video camera systems. In addition, the Company provides design and engineering services for the clients. Latecoere SA has locations in France, the Czech Republic, Romania, the United States, Spain, the United Kingdom, Tunisia, Mexico and Brazil. Latecoere SA operates through a number of subsidiaries, including Letov s.r.o, specialized in the manufacture of mechanical pieces and door structures, Latecoere do Brasil, Letov LV, and LaTelec, among others.

name: AVERNE GROUP SA PREF PERPETUAL
businessSummary: ARVERNE GROUP SA is a France-based company that engages in energy recovery from underground resources, particularly in the geothermal and lithium extraction sectors. The Company is primarily delivering environmental services focused on harnessing geothermal energy. The Company also specializes in decarbonization and the production of renewable energy from the subsoil that provides the clients, the capability of geo-resources and development of the pragmatic energy transition. The energy transition involves the potential of geo-resources and the numerous virtues of different level enthalpy geothermal energy, associated with the extraction of certain metals needed for the industries.

name: AIR FRANCE KLM SA
businessSummary: Air France KLM-SA is France-based airline company. The Company is engaged in passenger transportation. Its activities also include cargo, aeronautics maintenance and other air-transport-related activities, including catering. The Company's two sub-groups Air France and KLM have a flyer program, Flying Blue, which enables members to acquire miles as they fly with airline partners or from transactions with non-airline partners. Its activities include Passenger transport, Cargo transport, Maintenance and Other activities. The Company's network is organized around the hubs at Paris-Charles de Gaulle and Amsterdam-Schiphol. With these two hubs, the Company links Europe to the rest of the world, with approximately 320 destinations in over 115 countries. Transavia, the Company's subsidiary, has operations in the Netherlands and France directed at medium-haul leisure customers, as well as through its charter flights and tour operators.

name: MON COURTIER ENERGIE SAS
businessSummary: Mon Courtier Energie Groupe SA is a France-based energy solutions provider that provides energy and brokerage services. It provides a tailor-made solution for different sector of activity such as farming, artisans, trade, condominium, desk, restaurant, camping, hotel, industry, multisite, network and a public market. It offers a non-binding study of energy needs. It is operating globally. Its specialization includes gas and electricity markets. It assists companies in all sectors in optimizing the energy and natural gas contracts. It organizes and ensures the administrative follow ups all stages include communication, registration, call for tenders and customer validation. It is operating globally and has 23 agencies in France.

name: FLORENTAISE SA
businessSummary: Florentaise SA is a France-based company that is specializes in manufacture and marketing of growing media and plant nutrition and protection products for professionals and individuals. The Company offers potting soils, organic amendments and mulches sold under the brands Silence, a pousse !, Vive le Vgtal, Terre & Nature, Terre au Naturel, Terre D'or, Mon Jardin en Ville, Fertil, Terre & Nature Pro and Florentaise Pro. It manufactures marketing complete ranges of potting soils, amendments and mulches for over 30 years. The Company products are intended for horticulturists, nurserymen, market gardeners, communities, and landscapers. Its ambition is to develop innovative products and components serving the cultivation, food and health of plants that are both environmentally friendly and effective.

name: ONCODESIGN PRECISION MEDICINE OPM SA
businessSummary: Oncodesign Precision Medicine SA is a France-based biopharmaceutical company specialized in precision medicine. It aims at providing effective diagnostic and therapeutic solutions for resistant and metastatic cancers. The Company’s technologies from Oncodesign, are OncoSNIPER for the selection of therapeutic targets using artificial intelligence; Nanocyclix for the design and selection of macrocyclic small molecule kinase inhibitors and Theranostics for the design and selection of radiolabeled biological molecules for systemic radiotherapy. It focuses on the research and development of therapeutic and diagnostic solutions in the clinical and preclinical areas of medical oncology.

name: TERACT SA
businessSummary: Teract SA, formerly known as 2MX Organic, is a France-based company that operates through Garden Centre Retailer and Marketer segments. The Company develops a brand platform that works for the business sectors like garden centres, pet stores, and agricultural food distribution networks. It includes the distribution of organic and local food products that personalize the French and European and consumer in the organic agricultural world. It acts as a major player in the distribution, combining tradition, modernity, production of agricultural products and food transition with know-how innovation, in store and online markets. It has more than 213 branches that establish a dynamic business in the distribution of organic and local food products.

name: DEEZER SA
businessSummary: Deezer SA, formerly known as I2po, is a France-based in on-demand audio streaming company. The Company offers independent music streaming platforms with access to a catalogue of more than 90 million tracks available in 180 countries. It provides access to lossless HiFi audio, recommendation technology and other features. The Company brings artists and fans together on a scalable and global platform, to unlock the potential of music through technology. It also offers news, entertainment and sport podcasts, via their laptops, tablets, smartphones, smart televisions and their wireless systems.

name: VINPAI SA
businessSummary: Vinpai SA is a France-based company that is engaged in the food industry. The Company specializes in the design, manufacture, and marketing of algae- and plant-based functional ingredients for the food and cosmetics industries. It involves in four business segments such as food industry, cosmetics, food supplementation and medical device. It also offers a wide range of standard and tailor-made products includes alternative cheeses, dressing sauces, dairy alternative products, biscuits, cakes, and flavours. VINPAI Cosmetics develops algae-mineral solutions for its peel-off masks, actives and ingredients ranges, and medical device solutions from dental to patch and moulding. It is present in more than 40 countries across the world.

name: BROADPEAK SA
businessSummary: Broadpeak SAS is a France-based company. The Company designs and manufactures video delivery components for Content Providers and Network Service Providers deploying IPTV, Cable, Satellite, OTT and mobile services. Its portfolio of solutions and technologies powers the delivery of movies, television programming and other content over managed networks and the internet for viewing on any type of device. The company’s systems and services help operators increase market share and improve subscriber loyalty with better quality of experience.

name: CHARWOOD ENERGY SA
industry: Biomass & Waste to Energy Electric Utili
businessSummary: Charwood Energy SA is a France-based company. The Company is primarily engaged in the production of electricity. It specializes in the design, construction, and exploitation of biomass recycling sites into decarbonized energy for local authorities, industry, companies, and farms. The company also transforms wood into synthesis gas. It has developed a dual business model that includes A service business for industrials, agricultural holdings and communities, through its subsidiary Energy&+ and an own-account renewable energy production and sales business through its dedicated subsidiary W&nergy, co-owned with the Eiffel Gaz Vert fund, which specializes in financing the renewable gas segment in France. The Company deploys the biomass recovery technologies such as biomass heating plants and heating networks, methanisation and pyro-gasification, which is an industrial tool sized for growth, and complete coverage of the value chain, from design or construction to operation and maintenance.

name: COMPAGNIE GENERALE DES ETABLISSEMENTS MI
businessSummary: Compagnie Generale des Etablissements Michelin SCA is a France-based mobility company. The Company operates through three segments: Automotive, Road Transportation and Specialty Businesses. Automotive, which comprises the business lines Automotive business to customers (B2C) Global Brands, Automotive B2C Regional Brands, Automotive Original Equipment and Mobility Experiences. Road Transportation comprises the business lines Long Distance Transportation, Urban Transportation and Services & Solutions. Specialty Businesses comprises the business lines Mining, Off-Highway Transportation, Two-Wheel, Aircraft and High-Tech Materials. It provides different kind of tires and related products and services through a dealership network. Its service offering includes truck driver assistance with Michelin Euro Assist, fleet tire advice, maintenance and management services and mobility assistance services, among others. Additionally, it provides branded lifestyle products and high-tech materials.

name: ICAPE HOLDING SA
businessSummary: Icape Holding SA is a France-based company that manufactures printed circuit boards and custom-made technical parts. The Company manufactures its products in Asia and more particularly in China. It owns more than 25 professional factories in the power circuit breaker (PCB) field and more than 50 factories in custom-made technical parts. Its portfolio of products includes single side and double side PCBs with polymer holes, double side PCBs with polymer, conductive holes, and special low-cost PCBs with polymer inks printing.

name: LHYFE SA
businessSummary: Lhyfe SA is a France-based public company which primarily involves in the production of 100% green hydrogen for mobility and industry. The Company designs, install and operates the green hydrogen production sites, that are tailored to the needs of Lhyfebox, Onshore production unit, On-site production unit and Offshore production unit. The hydrogen sold by Lhyfe is accessible and at a price comparable to that of fossil fuels. The production units also connect with nearby two resources: natural, renewable and water energy sources through which can produce the hydrogen directly while releasing only water and oxygen and zero carbon dioxide.

name: EUROAPI SA
businessSummary: Euroapi SAS is a France-based company. The Company is engaged in the development, manufacture and supply of active-ingredient solutions to its healthcare partners. It offers vitamin B12, prostaglandins, oligonucleotides, peptides, corticoids and hormones, anti-infectives, opiates (morphine, codeine, thebaine, etc.), analgesics, etc. The Company also provides technologies and develops molecules through it’s Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). It’s CDMO services include Tides, Prostaglandins, Particle Engineering, Microbial Fermentation, Small Molecules Synthesis, Steroids and Hormones and Opiates & Controlled Substances. It has production sites located in France, the United Kingdom, Germany, Italy and Hungary.

name: HAFFNER ENERGY SA
businessSummary: Haffner Energy SA is a France-based company. The Company is specialized in the development, project management and construction of turnkey renewable energy production stations for industrial and local authorities. The company offers the HYNOCA process for the production of green hydrogen from biomass by thermolysis and is protected by patent families, and other international patents. The Company has been specializing in energy engineering and biomass to energy projects and the first industrial and commercial HYNOCA installation started operation in 2001. This unit is operated by R-HYNOCA, a subsidiary of R-GDS, and is located in the heart of Strasbourg city.

name: CRYPTO BLOCKCHAIN INDUST. S.A.
businessSummary: Crypto Blockchain Industries SA is a France-based company which provides investment services in blockchain and crypto. The Company provides its services across multiple industries, which are sole operator, in partnership with co-founders, and financial investors. It has made investments in an array of companies which are AlphaVerse, Atari, OP Productions, Free Reign East, National Carrier Exchange, and Atari Token.

name: HUNYVERS SA
businessSummary: Hunyvers SA is a France-based company that operates as a recreational vehicle dealer. The Company specializes in the rental, lease and sale of new and used mobile homes, recreational vehicles, professional and boats. It offers equipment and spare parts, as well as overhaul, repair, custom fitting, installation of accessories and after-sales services. It also provides financing services in credits and insurance solution along with the appointment at the workshop for the maintenance service. The sale of new and used caravans and motorhomes are categorized by the types of vehicles, mark, location, budget, gearbox, and concessions. It has approximately 16 concessions (including 3 nautical vehicle concession) located in France.

name: GROLLEAU SA
businessSummary: Grolleau SA is a France-based company. The Company specializes in the design and manufacture of metal energy cabinets, shelters and innovative solutions for complex environments. The Company manufactures metal Cabinets for the Industrial, Telecommunication and Urban markets. Its applications include adjusting street lighting, avoid visual nuisance from urban light, illuminate a pedestrian crossing at night only when a person is present, optimizing the lighting of a football, rugby or tennis, and manage the lighting of a public space such as parking court.

name: FORSEE POWER SA
businessSummary: FORSEE POWER SAS is a France-based company specialized in the design, manufacture and marketing of smart battery systems for use in the electric mobility market. This company provides advanced lithium-ion battery systems for any mobility application despite of the charging infrastructure or hybrid mode. It is engaged in sale activation and installation of lithium-ion battery systems to be used in multiple vehicles including Autonomous vehicles & robotics, Light urban & utility vehicles, Agriculture, construction & industry, Bus and truck, Rail and Marine, among others. This company also provides battery rental services as well as battery life cycle management services and after-sales services.

name: SMAIO
businessSummary: SMAIO SA is a France-based company that specializes in the design, manufacture and marketing of implantable medical devices for the treatment of spinal pathologies. The Company provides control on a surgical procedure to spine physician through a wide range of solutions like surgical plan/ i-plan, surgical procedure i-perform, outcome data/ i-check, and education/ i-learn. It operates with the clinical data and imaging for specialists in spine surgery for transformation of the vertebral fusion. It also offers spine surgeons a complete solution, consisting of software, implantable devices, associated services, and treat spinal pathologies requiring surgery. It includes Kheiron Spinal Fixation System, a device that incorporates many implants, intended for the immobilization and stabilization of spinal segments as an adjunct to fusion of the thoracic, lumbar and/or sacral spine. It also develops the Keops and Balance Analyzer 3D surgical planning and patient database management software.

name: OVH GROUPE SA
businessSummary: Ovh Groupe SAS is a France-based company which is an Internet services provider. Its product and service portfolio comprises domain names, e-mail services, hosting, cloud solutions, telephony, and voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) solutions, among others. The Company also provides software solutions with focus on cloud operating and data processing. It provides cloud service which includes Compute solutions, Storage solutions, Big data and machine learning solutions, pay-as-you-go, Artificial Intelligence and machine learning. It offers enterprise solution which include Private cloud, Disaster recovery plan solutions, Migration from the data center to the cloud, Interconnection between the physical servers and a secure cloud, Certified solutions for hosting sensitive data and Managed VMware virtualization solution.

name: ANTIN INFRASTRUCTURE PARTNERS SAS
businessSummary: Antin Infrastructure Partners SAS is a France-based private equity firm specializes in in the management of investment funds. The Firm focuses on infrastructure businesses operating in the energy and environment, telecommunications, transportation and social infrastructure sectors. It generates risk-adjusted returns for investors through a combination of capital appreciation and cash yield.

name: AFYREN SA
businessSummary: AFYREN SA is a France-based company, which is primarily engaged in the environmental biotechnology. The Company focuses on the microbiology and bioprocess engineering that develops industrial process, named AFYNERIE, to convert non-food biomass to bioenergy. It provides measurement of the factory's methanogenic potential and laboratory analysis of waste, among others. It also allows to grow from a pilot stage to industrial-scale production that offers a wide panel of industries, bio sourced replacements with an environmentally friendly technology that uses natural microorganisms. AFYREN’s corporate culture works based on three core values that have driven the progress and laid the foundation for future achievements: commitment, agility and humility.

name: AUDACIA SA
businessSummary: Audacia SA is a France-based Investment and management company. The Company is primarily engaged in structuring investment solutions in Private Equity, Real Estate and Venture for individual and institutional investors, providing access to valuable and resilient assets. It has a portfolio of companies in different industries which include food industry, consumer goods, hotel and catering, industry, BTOB services, and BTOC services. The company also invests in innovation capital in quantum communication, quantum computing, innovative physics and quantum sensor.

name: DASSAULT AVIATION SA
businessSummary: Dassault Aviation SA is a France-based company that operates in the global civil and military aviation industry. The Company specializes in the design, manufacture and sale of combat aircrafts and executive jets. Its portfolio of products includes Falcon family for the civil aviation market, as well as Mirage 2000, Rafale and Neuron aircrafts for the military sector. It also offers spare parts, tools and a range of services, such as technical support, maintenance and repair of airframe equipment and parts, among others. The Company has its offices in Europe, Asia, South America and Middle East. Dassault Aviation SA has a number of subsidiaries, located in Europe and Northern America, including DFJ-Little Rock, Sogitec Industries, DFJ Wilmington Corp., DFJ Teterboro, Dassault Falcon Service - Le Bourget, Aero-Precision Repair & Overhaul Co., Inc, Dassault Procurement Services Inc., Dassault Aircraft Services and Midway Aircraft Instruments Company.

name: PRECIA SA
businessSummary: Precia SA is a France-based manufacturer of industrial weighing products. The Company’s operations include design, manufacture and distribution of weighing equipment, installation, repairing and inspection of products manufactured by the Company. Precia SA's products include scales and standard instruments, load indicators and transmitters, load receptors, load cells and accessories, printers, slave display systems, weighbridges for trucks and wagons and machinery for bulk weighing and batching. The group's activity is organized around two sectors: Sale of weighing equipment that includes standard weighing instruments, weigh bridges for trucks and freight cars, bulk batching instruments, etc. (Precia-Molen brand); Services that includes installation of new equipment, maintenance, and repair of all brands of weighing equipment, verification of equipment used in commerce. It operates through subsidiaries such as 3P Entreprise SARL, Vahorservis s.r.o., 3P Entreprise, among others.

name: IKONISYS SA
businessSummary: Ikonisys SA is a France-based that specialize in the design, manufacture and marketing of medical diagnostic equipment. The Company offers cell diagnostic products in the fields of cancer diagnosis, detection of genetic disorders, and fertility testing. It utilizes advanced molecular and immunological markers, Ikoniscope robotic components, software engine, image acquisition, digital microscope and cell detection to design and deliver accurate and reliable detection of rare cells. It includes clinical diagnostic applications for the diagnosis of different types of cancer, including bladder (oncoFISH bladder), breast (oncoFISH her2), cervical (oncoFISH cervical), prostate (oncoFISH PTEN), lung (oncoFISH ALK) and a variety of hematological cancers utilizing the Explorer applications.

name: SPARTOO SA
businessSummary: Spartoo SAS SA is a France-based company. With 10,000 brands and more than 1 million references, the Company offers a selection of fashion items, such as footwear, ready-to-wear and bags. The Company specializes in the online distribution of footwear, clothing and leather goods for women, men and children. Its fashion offer is distinguished in particular by the promotion of more than 16 proprietary brands, including 10 created in-house, such as Betty London, Citrouille & Compagnie, Dream in Green, Fericelli, Casual Attitude, Carlington or So Size or via acquisitions, such as GBB, JB Martin, Christian Pellet, Un matin d'ete, Little Mary and Easy Peasy. The Company is present in more than 30 countries, including France, Germany, England, Italy and Spain.

name: ENTECH SA
businessSummary: Entech SA is a France-based company that specializes in the design and manufacture of renewable energy such as solar and wind conversion and storage systems. The Company builds and commissions ground-level solutions for storage, energy conversion, and rooftop photovoltaic power stations. It includes On-Grid / Off-Grid services, photovoltaic plants and prototyping systems. The On-Grid / Off-Grid services includes energy conversion and storage systems that enable grid balancing or the electrification of isolated sites. The Photovoltaic plants are on the ground, on the roof, in shade houses, etc. The Prototyping systems is a complex conversion chain technologies such as tidal turbines, new battery technologies, etc.

name: E-PANGO SA
businessSummary: E-Pango SAS is a France-based company which provides Electricity distribution, Network balance, Self-production, and Optimization company. The Company offers an array of solutions which include savings on electricity bills, understanding and control on consumption, transition to renewable energies, digitalization and automation of commercial processes and customer relations and security of electricity supplies. It operates its business in many sectors which are collective housing, tertiary, industry, green electricity, self-consumption, electricity market, and distribution networks.

name: NFL BIOSCIENCES SAS
businessSummary: Nfl Biosciences SAS is a France-based company which provides botanical pharmaceutical services. The Company's products help cure addictions through an approach based on botanical pharmaceutical agents. It develops NFL-101, a patented, botanical drug candidate that aims at increasing the odds of quitting for smokers willing to quit. The Company applies scientific approach to other drug candidate with an initial focus targeting the growing addiction to cannabis.

name: HYDROGENE DE FRANCE SA
businessSummary: Hydrogene De France SA is a France-based company that engages in the renewable energy mainly of hydrogen power. The Company develops and operates hydrogen-to-power infrastructure to provide firm or on-demand electricity from renewable energy sources (wind or solar), combined with high power multi megawatt fuel cells. It develops two models of turnkey Hydrogen-to-Power plants: Renewstable (power to power) and Hypower (gas to power). It provides industrial facilities for multi-MW fuel cell mass production, HDF’s power plants, datacenter, railway vehicle, and vessel propulsion markets located in France. HDF Energy’s Renewstable power plants deliver firm, stable, and guaranteed electricity to grids and micro-grid operators.

name: GROUPE AIRWELL SA
businessSummary: Groupe Airwell SA is a France-based company. The Company is specialized in climate and thermal solutions. It offers a range of products which includes air conditioning systems, heating solutions, and solar energy systems, designed to meet the needs of residential, commercial, and industrial customers.

name: ARAMIS GROUP SAS
businessSummary: Aramis Group SAS is a France-based company which provides an online platform services to purchase used cars in Europe. The Company allows anyone to switch vehicle where, when and how they want within 48 hours. It works with an array of Brands which include Aramisauto, Cardoen, Clicars, and CarSupermarket. The Company focuses on 4 strategic orientations which include Continue, Consolidate, Deploy, and Develop. It also works towards on reducing the impact on the environment.

name: DASSAULT SYSTEMES SE
businessSummary: Dassault Systemes SE is a France-based software company, which provides different kind of three-dimensional (3D) solutions. Its product, 3DEXPERIENCE, is a business experience platform structured in four quadrants encompassing twelve brands: Social and Collaborative applications (including ENOVIA, 3DEXCITE, CENTRIC PLM), 3D Modeling applications (including SOLIDWORKS, CATIA, GEOVIA, BIOVIA); Simulation applications (including 3DVIA, DELMIA, SIMULIA) and Information Intelligence applications (including NETVIBES, EXALEAD,MEDIADATA). The Company's structure is divided into three sectors: Manufacturing Industries (Transportation & Mobility; Aerospace & Defense; Marine & Offshore; Industrial Equipment; High-Tech; Home & Lifestyle; Consumer Packaged Goods & Retail) Life Sciences & Healthcare (Life Sciences) - (Life Sciences) Infrastructure & Cities (Energy & Materials; Construction, Cities and Territories; Business Services).

name: OMER DECUGIS & CIE SA
businessSummary: Omer Decugis & Cie SA is a France-based company which provides production and import services of fruits and vegetables. The Company markets fruits, mainly from Latin America, Africa and Europe in all distribution networks (stores, catering collective and commercial, specialized distribution and fresh cuts). It's provides an array of products which include bananas, pineapple, mango and ripened fruits, exotic and ethnic, and wholesale of seasonal fruits and vegetables. The Company's activities are divided between subsidiaries SIIM, BRATIGNY and OD RESSOURCES which market brands DIBRA, DON ED'S LEGENDARY PINEAPPLE, ELIT, FINE, SELVATICA, TERRASOL, LE MARCHE, and CROQ'APY.

name: NAM.R SA
businessSummary: Nam.R SA is a France-based software publisher. The Company provides geo-localized and data platform to accelerate the tailor-made solutions involved in the ecological transition. It offers support to the real estate assets and programmers, banks, investment funds, local governments, regional engineering services, energy renovation companies and building services. It focuses on three sectors, mainly such as decarbonization, climate resilience and nature-friendly development along with structure examination of dimensions and roof materials. It develops database that helps to analysis the development and renovation of every building in nearly 34 buildings of France. It also enables individuals and entities involved in the building value chain to activate the ecological potential of the building, real estate portfolio or region.

name: SOC D EXPLOSIFS PRODUITS CHIMIQUES SA
businessSummary: Soc D Explosifs Produits Chimiques SA is a France-based company specializes in manufacturing and implementing explosives. Then Company provides fabrication of explosives for civil use. It provides explosive drilling and mining services. It offers demolition of explosives and primarily activities in the circular economy sector (non-hazardous waste management services, soil decontamination, collection and disposal of asbestos, etc.) and production of diesel additives for industrial use. The Company is provider of global drilling-mining services for the benefit of the bauxite mine in the world (CBG, Guinea). It offers ndependent service or integrated into a global mining service, drilling-blasting is a fundamental link in the production chain of a site, a mine or a quarry. Its drilling-blasting service also includes verification of the exact position of each hole (GPS location system, inclinometer probe).

name: OBIZ SA
businessSummary: Obiz SA is a France-based company which provides relationship marketing solution services. The Company provides an array of solutions which include tailor-made platform, data driven marketing, technology, and support & advice. It's Tailor-made web platform offers the beneficiaries benefits via a responsive web platform and tailor-made application. Data driven marketing improves customer knowledge and offer a more personalized experience. Technology takes advantage of agile technology resulting from 10 years of R&D in the service of the user experience. Support & advice lets the relationship marketing experts guide in the loyalty project.

name: NR 21 SA
businessSummary: NR 21 SA, formerly Arthur SA, is a France-based company. The Company is a limited partnership limited by shares, controlled since 1 August 2019 by Altarea, the parent company of the Altarea Group, which is present on the three main property markets (Retail, Housing and Business property) as a developer and investor, enabling it to be a player in major mixed-use urban renewal projects in France. In fiscal year 2022, NR21 had no activities. It has neither subsidiaries nor shareholdings and does not employ any employees.

name: HYDROGEN-REFUELING-SOLUTIONS SA
businessSummary: Hydrogen Refueling Solutions SA is France-based company specialized in the mass production of turnkey hydrogen refueling stations with capacities (100 kg to 1 ton) for heavy vehicle. The Company was founded in 2004.

name: WINFARM SA
businessSummary: Winfarm SA is a France-based company, which is specialized in the distance selling of agricultural products for breeders, farmers, horse specialists and green space professionals. The Company divides its activity into four business lines: Vital Concept, which specializes in distance selling in agriculture, horse trades and professionals in green space; Agri-Tech service, which offers consulting firm in plant production; Alphatech, which manufactures an array of solutions in animal health and hygiene; Bel-Orient, which is an experimental farm.

name: EUROFINS SCIENTIFIC SE
businessSummary: Eurofins Scientific SE is a Luxembourg-based company engaged in the business support services industry. The Company joins a part of international group of laboratories providing a range of analytical testing services to the pharmaceutical, food, environmental and, consumer products industries and to governments. It operates through a number of subsidiaries, such as VRL Laboratories in the United States, Institut Nehring GmbH in Germany, Agfirst Bay of Plenty, a fruit maturity testing laboratory in New Zealand, and Megalab SA, a clinical diagnostic laboratory in Spain.

name: ALCHIMIE SAS
businessSummary: Alchimie SAS, formerly known as Cellfish SAS, is a France-based company specialized in the development of technological platforms. The Company provides technical solution for distribution and monetization of content across all platforms, combined with curation and dynamic marketing to generate audiences. It designs to help players in audiovisual production and leaders in social media distribute their content and generate new revenue streams on digital platforms. The Company takes in video content, editorializes it and distributes it in the form of subscriptions to different distribution channels.

name: ECOMIAM SA
businessSummary: Ecomiam SA, formerly Ecomiam.Com is a French-based supermarket operator. The Company provides frozen products such as meat, seafood, vegetables breads, desserts and others. The Company has a network of shops in western France, mainly in Bretagne region. The Company provides also delivering services.

name: VEOM GROUP SA
businessSummary: VEOM Group SA formerly Cabasse Group SA (Ex-AwoX) and Awox SA (AwoX) is a France-based company engaged in the provision to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) network media solutions for consumer electronics products based on mediaCTRL, its Digital Living Network Alliance (DLNA)-certified middleware. The Company's products and solutions are used in products such as televisions, decoders, personal computers as others. It provides dynamic segments of the Smart Home market, such as high-fidelity audio home automation and home comfort solutions, under the Dio brand. It offers video security equipment and electrical accessories under the Chacon brand. The Company provides combination of product, industrial and commercial, with the ambition of facilitating the transition from households to smart homes. The Company uses its technologies to develop software and electronic products for the consumer market.

name: VALLOUREC SA
businessSummary: Vallourec SA is a France-based company specializes in production of non-welded steel tubes and specialized tube products for industrial applications. The Company operates through two segments: seamless tubes and specialty products. It designs and develops a comprehensive range of products including seamless tubes and connections for drilling operations, line pipes and well equipment. For the power generation market, it offers tubes that withstand severe temperature and pressure conditions. Its solutions enable power companies to meet the challenges of energy efficiency and reduce CO2 emissions in power plants. It also offers a wide range of tubes for petrochemical installations (refineries), for mechanical engineering applications (hydraulic cylinders and machine tools), for the automotive industry, for construction (stadiums, other complex buildings and structures) and for various other industrial sectors.

name: VANTIVA SA
businessSummary: Vantiva SA formerly Technicolor SA is France-based company that provides designing, developing, and supplying products and solutions. It is engaged in the development of technologies, and the supply of digital production (visual effects and animation), video and sound postproduction and distribution solutions and services for a range of content creators, pay-television operators, and over-the-top (OTT) and network service providers. The Company operates in the media and entertainment industry. Its activities are organized in three operating segments: Connected Home, Entertainment Services and Technology. The Connected Home segment includes design and supply of solutions enabling the delivery of digital video entertainment, data, as well as voice and Smart Home services to pay-television operators and network service providers. The Entertainment Services segment includes Production Services and DVD Services divisions.

name: NACON SAS
businessSummary: Nacon SAS is a France-based company. The Company specializes in two areas of the video game industry: video game publishing and gaming accessories. It is a pure play in video gaming, publishing, and developing video games as well as designing and distributing gaming accessories. It develops and publishes AA games for consoles and PC for four genres, namely, action-adventure games, racing games, sports games, and simulation games. It offers a wide range of accessories for both casual and hardcore gamers. It offers a range of products, including headsets, microphones, controllers, racing wheels and gaming chairs, available in Europe, Asia, Oceania, and parts of the African continent.

name: KLEA HOLDING
businessSummary: Klea Holding SA is a France-based holding company. The Company focus on acquiring, developing, and digitizing companies in various sectors to maximize their growth and value. It draws on its experience in developing Smart Salem, the network of digitalized medical analysis centers accredited by the Dubai Ministry of Health (DHA) in the United Arab Emirates. The Company Smart Health joint venture developed in Saudi Arabia, to extend this entrepreneurial approach to the four corners of the globe. It invests in companies from various sectors in the development phase, both in France and internationally.

name: PAULIC MEUNERIE SA
businessSummary: Paulic Meunerie SA is a France-based company active in the flour industry. It owns three mills providing different kind of labelled products from a variety of wheats. Its flour offering includes Bakery, Creperie, Industrial and Customized products. Additionally, it provides Qualista, a wheat obtained through the Oxygreen process, which does not alter the nutritional property of the grain during the decortication. The Company offers also advisory services, laboratory analysis, customizable communication services-market related and support activities related to acquisition and transfer of commerce funds. The Company is active mostly locally.

name: IMPLANET SA
businessSummary: Implanet SA is a France-based medical technology company. It is involved in the design, production and marketing of medical equipment, such as medical implants and devices used in orthopedic surgery. The Company's products include prosthetic knees, spinal bracing systems, intersomatic cages, pins, suture threads, screws, and anchors, among others. Its activities, and flagship products, include JAZZ (Spine System) and MADISON (Knee implant). JAZZ implant is designed to improve the treatment of spinal pathologies requiring vertebral fusion surgery. MADISON implant is designed for first-line prosthetic knee surgery.

name: CONSTELLIUM SE
businessSummary: Constellium SE is a France-based company. The Company is predominantly engaged in the development, manufacturing, and recycling of aluminum products and solutions. It focuses on the development of aluminum products for a broad scope of markets and applications, including aerospace, packaging and automotive. It operates through three segments: Aerospace & Transportation (A&T), Packaging & Automotive Rolled Products (P&ARP), and Automotive Structures & Industry (AS&I). A&T provides aluminum solutions for aircraft and transportation. P&ARP supplies rolled products for packaging and vehicles. AS&I focuses on structural components for automotive applications, including original equipment manufacturers.

name: MUNIC SA
businessSummary: Munic SA is a France-based technology company specialized in vehicle data collection, processing, and monetization. Its offering includes a portfolio of devices, a cloud-based platform, and an application store. The Company’s products, namely Munic Max, Munic V6, Munic V6+ and V7+ consist of in-vehicle terminals directly connected to the vehicle electronic network. They design and develops technological solutions, combining Smart Dongles, capable of collecting and decoding thousands of data from automobile vehicle sensors, and an artificial intelligence Edge Computing platform, Munic.io, to analyze and process them. Third party business to business customers can access these data for develop their own applications. The Company aims to provide useful information to all the stakeholders involved in the automotive industry, such as insurance, fuel, leasing and rental, and car sharing companies, among others. It operates in Europe and North America.

name: FONCIERE ATLAND SA
businessSummary: Atland SA is a France-based real estate player that operates in the corporate real estate and housing markets through its activities as an asset manager, real estate developer and digital platform. The Company covers the entire real estate value chain from design to distribution of investment products. It has built a solid economic model, with a distinctive positioning in the areas of asset management, the development of real estate operations and digital real estate investment. Its individuals and professional investors, have a range of physical (offices, housing, intergenerational residences, etc.) or dematerialized (SCPI, OPPCI, crowdfunding dedicated to real estate, etc.) short-term or long-term investment products.

name: AGRIPOWER FRANCE SASU
businessSummary: Agripower France SASU is a France-based company active in the green energy sector and specialized in the construction of anaerobic digestion units. Anaerobic digestion is used to produce renewable energies, for the treatment of organic waste, the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions and the integration of agroecology into practices. Anaerobic digestion is a technology based on the degradation by microorganisms of organic matter under controlled conditions and in the absence of oxygen. Part of the organic matter is degraded into biogas, mainly methane, which can then have multiple uses. Anaerobic digestion makes it possible to recover waste from agricultural operations, local authorities and agri-food industries.

name: FDJ UNITED
businessSummary: FDJ United is a France-based semi-public company, that operates lottery and online games. The Company operates under the commercial brand name, FDJ, and provides scratch games, sports betting and draw games via a network of 35,800 points of sale, including LOTO points of sale, tobacconists and newsagents. Its scratch games include 1, 2 and 3 euros games; sports betting include the brand names, ParionsSport and ParionsWeb; and draw-based games include LOTO, Euro Millions, Rapido, Keno and others. The Company is also active in the online poker market with the website Barrierepoker.fr, which is jointly-owned with Groupe Lucien Barriere.

name: HOFFMANN GREEN CEMENT TECHNOLOGIES SAS
businessSummary: Hoffmann Green Cement Technologies SA is a France-based company, that focuses on producing cement using processes that do not rely on clinker. It uses alternative raw materials and methods to reduce carbon emissions associated with cement production. It operates production sites in France and distributes its products both locally and internationally. Its offerings include cement for precast and ready-mix concrete. It also provides services related to construction materials.

name: VERALLIA SAS
businessSummary: Verallia SASU is a France-based company, which operates as a producer of glass packaging solutions. The Company manufactures a number of jars and bottles for various markets, including the still and sparkling wine, spirits, food, as well as the beer and nonalcoholic sectors.
