The group is also operating in trading and sea transport of crude oil and oil products.

name: CARREFOUR
businessSummary: Carrefour SA is a France-based retail distribution group, which operates through four geographical segments: France, Rest of Europe, Latin America and Asia. The Group operates more than 12,000 stores and e-commerce sites in more than 30 countries across the globe. Its stores come in a variety of formats and channels, such as hypermarkets, supermarkets, convenience stores, cash and carry stores, hyper cash stores, drive and e-commerce. Its product offering includes a wide range of local fresh produce, meats prepared on site, fresh fish, as well as bakery products, consumer goods and nonfood products. Additionally, the Group offers complementary services, including package pick-up points, key copying, vehicle hire, pharmacies and health/beauty care, fuel oil delivery, financial and insurance services, together with leisure services, such as travel agencies, tickets for shows and photo services, among others.

name: SAVENCIA
businessSummary: Savencia SA, formerly Savencia Fromage & Dairy, is a France-based company that is primarily engaged in the production of cheese and other dairy products. The Company produces a range of dairy products, such as cheese, butter and cream, for the retail market and food service professionals, as well as technical butters and specific dairy proteins for the food, dietetic and health industries. The Company’s brands include Aperivrais de Saint Moret, Boursault, Elle & Vire, Bakony, Chavrie and Saladena, among many others. The Company is present in Europe, North and South America, Middle East and Asia and operates through a number of subsidiaries, including, Bongrain Europe, Bongrain International, Les Fromagers de Thierache SAS, Pareco and Elvir SAS, among others. In July 2014, it acquired Sodilac SAS, a Puteaux-based producer of infant's Sodilac milk, from Laboratorios Ordesa SL.

name: L'AIR LIQUIDE SOCIETE ANONYME POUR L'ETU
businessSummary: L'Air Liquide Societe Anonyme Pour l'etude Et l'exploitation Des Procedes Georges Claude SA, formerly Air Liquide SA, is a France-based gas company, which provides gases-related technologies and services. It operates through two segments: Production of industrial and medical gases that include oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen, synthesis gas. In addition, the group provides equipment and services for fluid system control, chemical gas and liquid management, home care and hospital hygiene services and operating room equipment. Turnover by market is broken down between industries, health, and electronics; And Other that include engineering and construction activities of gas production plants and manufacturing of advanced technology products. The Company assist across the world many industries, such as aeronautics, automotive, beverage, chemicals, construction, electronics manufacturing, food, and glass, among others.

name: U10 CORP.
businessSummary: U10 Corp SA, formerly U10 SA is a France-based company engaged in the design and global distribution of specialized product lines developed around household, personal leisure goods and accessories. The Company has three product ranges: home textile, home utility and leisure goods and personal leisure goods and accessories. They include soft furnishings and decor, tableware, bed and bath linen, household goods, leisure items, fragrance and cosmetics, special occasion items like Christmas and party decorations, footwear, under garments and luggage. The Company operates through several subsidiaries, including L3C, a France-based company engaged in the production of textiles for home decoration; Smerwick Group, a China-based company engaged in tablecloths manufacturing, and ID World, a France-based company which designs leisure goods.

name: SODITECH SA
businessSummary: Soditech SA, formerly Soditech Ingenierie SA, is a France-based company that is primarily engaged in electronic and mechanical engineering services in various sectors. The Company’s activity is organized into two sectors: engineering services, research, and development services. It provides specialized services in four fields: aerospace, covering communication satellites, observation satellites and space stations; automotive, providing such services as engine design and plasturgy for equipment manufacturers; aeronautics, offering structural research for aircraft makers, instruments, or electro-mechanical systems for assisting pilots and others, and defense, providing engineering of numerous tests and trials systems, with or without implementations, among others. The Company also offers additional services, such as energy forecasting and environmental analysis, as well as environmental management system.

name: JCDECAUX SA
businessSummary: JCDecaux SE is a France-based outdoor advertising company. It divides its business into three main sectors: Advertising on Street Furniture, Billboards and Transport Advertising. The Company commissions and maintains a range of street furniture items, including bus and tram shelters, automatic outdoor toilets, self service bicycle racks, multi-service columns, newspaper kiosks, city light panels, public benches and public rubbish bins. Billboard advertising includes scrolling billboard panels, as well as traditional billboard systems. Transport advertising includes advertising on vehicles, airports and in railway transit stations. The Company has operations in Europe, Asia-Pacific region, Middle East and Russia, among others. It operates through JCDecaux-Top Media.

name: SOC INDUST FINANCIERE ARTOIS SA
businessSummary: Soc Indust Financiere Artois SA is a France-based financial holding company that invests in companies in the financial, commercial, industrial and fund management business sector. The Company specializes in manufacturing and marketing of terminals (access control systems, terminals, automated systems) and computer peripheral equipment. Its portfolio of assets comprises Financiere du Loch, Plantations des Terres Rouges, Rivaud Loisirs Communication, Compagnie de Pleuven and SAFA France, among others. It also operates its business through its subsidiaries, including Socarfi, Automatic Control Systems Inc, Automatic Systems Belgium SA, Automatic Systems Espanola SA, Automatic Systems France SA, IER GmbH, and IER Pte Ltd, among others.

name: ACTEOS
businessSummary: Acteos SA is a France-based company active in the computer logistics industry. The Company specializes in the manufacture of supply chain planning and execution software packages; the publishing of software for the synchronization, regulation, optimization and running of logistical flows, and the integration of supply chain solutions. Acteos’ portfolio of products includes Acteos WMS (Logidrive), which is a modular solution to manage customer warehouses and accelerate flows. Acteos WMS contains tools that manages warehouse activities with integrated technologies like barcode, voice recognition, conveyers and forklifts, among others; Acteos TMS (Logiroutes), which organizes and manages transport activities and Acteos FPS Forecasting & Procurement System, which provides forecast and point of sales and e-business procurement optimization, among others. It operates in a number of subsidiaries, which include Acteos GmbH & CO KG and Acteos Liban Sarl, among others.

name: ACTIA GROUP
businessSummary: Actia Group SA, formerly Actielec Technologies SA, is a France-based specializes in the design, manufacturing and marketing of electronic equipment company. The Company has two divisions, the Automotive Division, engaged in the design and distribution of electronic diagnostics systems for cars and trucks and vehicle testing equipment, the design and distribution of onboard electronics for industrial and military vehicles, as well as the development of complex electronic systems, and the Telecom Division, principally involved in the production of signal transmission and reception equipment, information transmission products and ground stations systems. The Company’s clients include Volvo, Somfy, Thales, Siemes, Airbus, France Telecom, Boeing, Media Broadcast and AFP, among others. As of December 31, 2013, Actia Group operated through offices located in the USA, Poland and China, among others. The Company also operates through several subsidiaries, including Actia Automotive, Mors Inc, A

name: RIBER
businessSummary: Riber SA is a France-based company engaged in the semiconductor industry. It manufactures and supplies front-end equipment for the semiconductors, oxides, novel devices, nitrides, solar cells and Organic Light-Emitting Diode (OLED) communities. It designs and develops the Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE) technology allowing for the creation of electronic and optoelectronic devices, such as monolithic microwave integrated circuits, pump lasers and Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser (VCSEL). It also provides a range of MBE-related components, such as effusion cells, valved crackers, gas flow control systems and computerized process controllers, and Ultra-High Vacuum (UHV) hardware components, including substrate heaters, among others. It also offers installation, maintenance, engineering and upgrading services for machines and equipment, and process training courses for its products. The Company has such subsidiaries as MBE Control Solutions and Addon SAS, among others.

name: GROUPE LDLC
businessSummary: Groupe LDLC SA formerly known as LDLC Com SA is a France-based company engaged in the sale and distribution of computer and multimedia equipment. Its product range includes electronic components, network equipment, software, connections, portable computers, hi-fis and videos, digital cameras, digital versatile discs (DVDs) and peripherals. The Company sells its products online and through two showrooms in Lyon and in Paris, as well as 11 branch offices. It also offers delivery services throughout France, Belgium and Switzerland. LDLC.Com SA's subsidiaries include Hardware.fr, Textorm Sarl, DLP-Connect, Plugsquare and Anikop, all operating in the information technology (IT) market. The Company operates various websites, including aideonline.com, fillspot.com, ldlc.com and maginea.com, among others. It merged with Domisys SAS. It operates through Domimo 2 SCI and Domimo 3 SCI.

name: EUROMEDIS GROUPE
businessSummary: Laboratoires Euromedis SA is a France-based company that is engaged in designing and distribution of medical services. The Company specializes in the manufacturing, import, and distribution of medical equipment intended primarily for hospitals, clinics, retirement homes, physicians, pharmacies, and individuals. It also leases the equipment and provides home maintenance and hospitalization services. through a network of outlets under the Paramat name.

name: ARTMARKET.COM
businessSummary: Artmarket.com SA, formerly Artprice.Com SA, is a France-based company active in the art market, with a focus on fine art, antiques (furniture and decorative arts) and design. The Company manages a database enabling electronic auction brokerages while producing econometrics data and reports upon request from the banking and insurance sectors and art investors. It provides decision tools and market analysis, both microeconomic (individual artists and movements) and macroeconomic (analysis of international art market), such as transactions volumes, turnover, buy-in ratios, rates of return, composition of the market and shifts in value, among others. The Company also offers art pricing and estimation consulting services. It is active globally.

name: STRADIM ESPACE FINANCES
businessSummary: Stradim Espace Finance SA is a France-based company, which specializes in the construction, development and sale of apartment buildings and individual houses. The Company is active domestically, mainly in Alsace, Champagne-Ardennes, Midi-Pyrenees and Pays de la Loire regions. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, including Espace Promotion SAS, Espace Foncier SARL, Habitat Services SARL, Espace Participations SARL and MC Bat SARL, among others.

name: FLEURY MICHON
businessSummary: Fleury Michon SA is a France-based company that is engaged in developing meal solutions in the self-service delicatessen and prepared meals segments in France. The Company has three segments: Pole GMS France, a fresh packed self-service of the radius catering and delicatessen - GMS branded Fleury, Michon a brand distributors, regulation, production and distribution in France; Pole International :a fresh packaged Self-Service - regulation of production and distribution outside France; and the Other Sectors segment: food and beverages services, excluding travel and home restoration, and are of business support and assistance to subsidiaries in logistics, human resources, and information system, finance. Fleury Michon SA delivers meals to businesses under the Fauchon and Flo Prestige brand names. It has various subsidiaries, including Fleury Michon Charcuterie and Fleury Michon Traiteur de la Mer; and it has presence in Canada, Poland, Switzerland, Italy, Spain and Norway, among others.

name: BOURSE DIRECT
businessSummary: Bourse Direct SA formerly Bourse Direct et Bourse Discount SA is a France-based company that specializes in the provision of online brokerage services and online financial information through its Websites, including www.boursedirect.fr, www.capitol.fr, www.absysteme.fr, www.wargny.com and www.mesactions.com. The Company's services and products are primarily aimed at individual clients who are active on the equity markets and are managing their own portfolio. The Company's three core business segments include online trading, asset management and back office services and order transmission, as well as product training. It provides online transmission and reception of orders in real time, trading and clearing, maintaining accounts and conserving securities for management companies, financial institutions, and online brokers.

name: UTI GROUP
businessSummary: Uti Group SA is a France-based family business company that engages in the digital service. The Company provides a wide range of activity in respect to social, economic, and business sector based on the needs of customers. It specializes in consulting, information technology, and engineering in the fields of banking, commerce, finance, insurance, medical, marketing, statistical computing, industry, and services. The information systems department works based on the five divisions: big data, back office, front office, mobility, MOA, and recipes. The consultants design and support projects to help the clients through the management team to work together through people management, performance management, functional and technical testing. It is located in Paris, Lyon, Strasbourg and Marrakech.

name: ASSYSTEM
businessSummary: Assystem SA is a France-based company that is principally engaged in engineering and innovation consultancy. The Company offers solutions within a number of sectors, such as Aerospace, Defence, Energy, Nuclear, Life Sciences, Infrastructure, Automotive and Transport. The Company develops the infrastructural engineering and externalized R&D services. It's activities include managing infrastructural investments, from conception to dismantling; aerospace mechanical engineering, providing technical services to aerospace, engine and automotive manufacturers and technology & product engineering, providing services in transport, defense, product hardware and software development. The Company is present Europe, North America and Asia. The main shareholder of the Company is HDL Developpement SAS. It operates through Onyx Promavi, Batir Group, Edison Technical Recruitment Ltd, Radicon Gulf Consult, Engineering Partner Automotive Nordic AB and The Biotech Quality Group, among others.

name: BIGBEN INTERACTIVE
businessSummary: Bigben Interactive SA is a France-based company primarily engaged in the design, manufacture and distribution of videogame software, as well as videogame console accessories. Its range of offering includes games for Nintendo DS and Nintendo Wii. The Company also offers to its customers various accessories for iPhone, such as silicon gloves and chargers, as well as accessories for Nintendo and Sony PlayStation, including steering wheels and carrying cases, among others. The Company is operational through four direct wholly owned subsidiaries: Games.FR SAS (France), Bigben Interactive Belgium (Belgium), Bigben Interactive GmbH (Germany) and Bigben Interactive HK Ltd (Hong Kong). It also holds stakes in other companies. In April 2014, it finalized sale of 51% of ModeLabs mobile distribution business.

name: IPSOS
businessSummary: Ipsos SA is a France-based research company. The Company uses global surveys and polls to explore market potential, test products and advertizing mediums, study audiences and audience perception, and measure public opinion trends. Ipsos SA operates via following brands: Ipsos ASI, which manages the Advertizing Research Specialists division; Ipsos Marketing, which manage sthe Innovation and Brand Research Specialists division; Ipsos MediaCT, which manages the Media, Content and Technology Research Specialists division; Ipsos Public Affairs, which manages the Social Research and Corporate Reputation Specialists division; Ipsos Loyalty, which manages the Customer and Employee Research Specialists division and Ipsos Observer for the Survey Management, Data Collection and Delivery Specialists division. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, such as Ipsos Mori UK Ltd, Ipsos Brasil Pesquias de Mercado Ltda and LT Participations SA, among others.

name: SAFRAN
businessSummary: Safran SA is a France-based high-technology company that carries out research, design, development, testing, manufacturing, sales, maintenance, and support operations for its high-technology activities. The Company’s segments are: Aerospace Propulsion, Aircraft Equipment and Aircraft Interiors. The Aerospace Propulsion segment designs, develops, produces, and markets, propulsion and mechanical power transmission systems for commercial aircraft, military transport, training and combat aircraft, civil and military helicopters, satellites, and drones. It also includes maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) activities and the sale of spare parts. The Aircraft Equipment segment operates in five main sectors: Landing and braking systems, Engine systems and equipment, Electrical systems, and engineering, Aerosystems, and Electronics & Defense. The Aircraft Interiors segment covers seats and cabin fittings, closets, in-flight entertainment systems and flight-deck equipment.

name: PIERRE VACANCES
businessSummary: Pierre Et Vacances SA is a France-based company engaged in the provision of holiday and entertainment villages, leisure activity residences and hotels. The properties are located in continental France, French Antilles, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, Italy and Spain. The Company's two main divisions are Pierre & Vacances Tourisme Europe and Center Parcs Europe and it provides tourism services through five brands: Adagio, Adagio Access, Maeva, Center Parcs and Sunpark. Pierre et Vacances SA is also active in the property development sector via the subsidiaries PV-CP Support Services BV, Pierre & Vacances Investissement XXXXVIII and Pierre & Vacances Investissement XXXXIX. On 15 May, 2013 it announced the off-plan sales agreement for sporting and leisure facilities was signed with a semi-public company for EUR 130 million.

name: IT LINK SA
businessSummary: IT Link SA is a France-based holding company primarily specialized in information technology (IT) engineering and on-board technologies. Its offering includes such segments as Defense & Cybersecurity, Environment & Energy, Auto Rail Aero, Industry & Administration and Smart System and Services. The Company provides its services to clients in various sectors, including telecommunications and multimedia, automobile, transport and aeronautics, energy and industry, as well as defense. IT Link SA operates through two subsidiaries: IT Link System SA, which offers IT consulting and technical assistance in the field of electronics and on-board technologies, and Ipsis SAS, specialized in IT solutions for telecommunications and automative engineering.

name: EGIDE
businessSummary: Egide SA is a France-based company engaged in the electrical components industry. The Company designs, produces and sells hermetic packages for the encapsulation and interconnection of electronic and optical components. These packages protect the electronic systems and chips from thermal, atmospheric or magnetic conditions. Its product portfolio encompasses a range of products, including aluminum hermetic packages, modulators, multi chip modules, relay headers, radio frequency packages, Tosa Rosa Packages, Infra-red Detector Packages and Metal Injection Molding (MIM). It supplies clients in various sectors, including aerospace, military, telecommunications, automotive, medical, security and aerospace, among others.

name: ALTEN
businessSummary: Alten SA is a France-based company that provides technology consulting and engineering services, as well as information technology (IT) and network services. The Company's activities include designing, developing and manufacturing new products and systems, as well as provision of services related to setting up and restructuring information systems and service platforms. The Company's main clients are the technical and IT divisions of telecommunications companies, telecom equipment makers, electrical and electronic equipment manufacturers, and companies in the aviation, aerospace, defense, transport, process, and services industries. The Company has such subsidiaries as Geci Engineering, CV CPrime and cPrime inc, among others.

name: INFOTEL
businessSummary: Infotel SA is a France-based company that specializes in information technology (IT) services and software solutions. In the field of Information Technology Services, the Company provides consultancy, analysis, IT system audits, third party application maintenance and software testing solutions. It designs and implements, as service contracts or service desk, management projects for businesses. In the field of Software Solutions, the Company developed software to assist businesses is areas such as DB2 operation (security, performance and management), data management and archiving, Web-enabled or quality applications and relational database performance. It serves companies in the industry, banking and finance, insurance and pensions, services, intellectual property and public sectors. The Company operates in France and the United Kingdom.

name: BERNARD LOISEAU
businessSummary: Bernard Loiseau SA is a France-based company engaged in the hotel and restaurant business. The Company operates two restaurants in Paris, Tante Louise and Tante Marguerite. It also operates Relais Bernard Loiseau, a hotel, restaurant and spa complex in Saulieu, Burgundy, and Loiseau des Vignes, a restaurant in Beaune. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, such as Loiseau des Vignes SA, Chez Tante Louise SAS, Chez Marius SA, SCI Du Maine, Au Pays de Bresse SARL and BL Organisation EURL. Bernard Loiseau SA has also established partnerships with Manotel Group for the provision of consulting services, including support in designing menus and training staff of Manotel hotels and with Agis SA for the creation of a line of fresh prepared dishes (vacuum-packed) that are sold by retail outlets. Bernard Loiseau SA has also entered into contracts of partnerships with Gabriel Boudier, Albert Bichot, Edmond Fallot and Societe immobiliere du Maine.

name: HAULOTTE GROUP
businessSummary: Haulotte Group SA is a France-based company engaged in the manufacture of lifting and earth moving equipment. It operates through three business divisions: manufacture and sale of lifting equipment, rental of lifting equipment and providing services such as financing, spare parts, repairs, training and technical assistance. The Company offers two main product categories: People lifting equipment, such as telescopic, scissors, articulating, masts, push around, trailers and truck-mounted booms; and Material lifting equipment and earth moving, such as backhoe loaders and telehandlers. Haulotte Group has six production plants: three in France, one in Romania, one in China and one in United States. It operates through subsidiaries, including Haulotte France Sarl and Telescopelle SAS, among others. It is present in over 100 countries worldwide.

name: GUILLEMOT CORPORATION SA
businessSummary: Guillemot Corporation SA is a France-based designer and manufacturer of interactive entertainment hardware and accessories for personal computers (PC) and game consoles. The Company distributes its products under two brand names: the Hercules range, comprising netbook products, audio and video products for PCs, such as audio boards and television tuners, and the Thrustmaster range, comprising PC and game console accessories, such as joysticks, racing wheels and game pads. Other products include DJing, Wifi and digital music products, Speaker kits, Webcams and UMPC range under the Hercules brand. Guillemot Corporation SA has a presence in several countries, including France, Germany, The United Kingdom, Canada, Italy, The United States, Spain, The Netherlands, Belgium, Hong-Kong and Romania. Guillemot Corporation SA operates through its subsidiaries, including Guillemot Administration et Logistique Sarl, Hercules Thrustmaster SAS and Guillemot Romania Srl, among others.

name: GL EVENTS
businessSummary: GL events SA, also known as GL events and GL, is a France-based company that provides event-related services and solutions. The Company supplies services through three divisions: GL Events Live, GL Events Exhibitions and GL Events Venues. The GL Events Live division brings together all the activities of corporate events, institutional and sports. The GL Events Exhibitions division manages, markets, and provides infrastructure maintenance services for five types of events: exhibition centers, convention centers, stadiums and sports halls, theatres and concert halls, and reception venues. The Events Venues division manages the network of over 30 event sites. The Company operates through the subsidiaries that include Altitude Expo, Wicked and Flow, Aganto Ltd, Fabric Expo, Secil and Maf Servizi, among others.

name: LACROIX
businessSummary: Lacroix Group SA, formerly knew as Lacroix SA, is a France-based industrial company primarily engaged in the design, manufacture and marketing of signaling and electronic control equipment. The Company has three divisions: LACROIX Electronics, which specializes in the provision of electronic subcontracting services, including the design, assembly and testing of electronic boards for the use in the industrial electronics, automobile, telecommunications, multimedia and electrical appliance sectors; LACROIX Sofrel, which is involved in the manufacture and sale of remote control and management products for technical installations and industrial sites through applications called Telemetry and SCADA, and LACROIX City, which designs smart road solutions for local governments and businesses. Lacroix SA is present in a number of European countries.

name: HERIGE
businessSummary: Herige SA, formerly VM Materiaux SA is a France-based company that is principally engaged in the manufacture, distribution, trading and installation of materials and equipment for the building and construction industries. The Company specializes in the trading of wholesale and finishing materials, and home furnishing products. It manufactures concrete and industrial joinery products. It provides activities such as materials trading, sale of industrial joinery, sale of concrete etc. It offers distribution of construction materials for building and public works. It provides exterior joinery (windows and doors in PVC, aluminum or wood), closures (roller shutters, gates and garage doors) and wooden structures (trusses, traditional frames and wooden panels). The Company offers ready-mixed, industrial and prefabricated concrete.

name: POUJOULAT SA
businessSummary: Poujoulat SA, (formerly Etablissements Poujoulat SA), is a France-based company that manufactures pre-fabricated chimneys and chimney-tops. The Company's range of products includes metal chimneys, flue liners and connections for heating apparatus, chimney tops, ventilation pipes and accessories. In addition, it offers installation services and contract management. It produces individual, collective or industrial chimney systems. Poujoulat SA is comprised of companies and branches in seven European countries, including France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Italy, the United Kingdom, Turkey and Poland. The Company operates through Dansk Shorstens Teknik (DST).

name: GRAINES VOLTZ
businessSummary: Graines Voltz SA is a France-based company that is engaged in the distribution of seeds. The Company sells a range of flower and vegetable seeds varieties; flower seeds mixtures and vegetable seeds for the hobby market and professional horticulturalists, truck farmers, supermarkets and Do it Yourself (DIY) stores. Additionally, Graines Voltz offers also communication tools for retailers to highlight their products and develop their customer sales. On June 3, 2013, Company announced that on December 8, 2012 it acquired 100% of the share capital of Agreva, a Turkish company. The financial terms of the deal were not disclosed. On August 26, 2013, the Company announced the acquisition of all Plan SAS's Plan Ornemental shares.

name: FONCIÈRE 7 INVESTISSEMENT
businessSummary: Fonciere 7 Investissement SA, formerly LCX - Leblanc Chromex SA, is a France-based real estate company engaged in the acquisition, construction and renting of real estate assets. As of February 24, 2012 Ingefin held a 98.48% stake in the Company’s shareholdings. In April 2014, the Company's subsidiary Immobiliere R Driguet sold two apartments in La Baule.

name: SOGECLAIR
businessSummary: Sogeclair SA is a French high-tech engineering company specialized in the design and development of industrial products and simulation solutions. The Company is established in three divisions: Aerospace division, providing services for aerostructure, systems installation, configuration and data product management and aerostructure subassemblies; Vehicle division providing engineering services for light industrial and military special vehicles; and Simulation division, which develops engineering and training simulators, as well as software for simulation purposes. Among the Company’s customers are Air France, Airbus, Thales, Aixam, Daimler, DGA, Technip, Renault, Technirail, SNCF and Neopost France, among others. Sogeclair SA offers solutions to three main market sectors: aeronautics and air traffic; automobile and rail, and defense and industry. It operates through subsidiaries, such as MSB Ressources Globales, among others.

name: LECTRA S.A.
businessSummary: Lectra SA is a France-based company that is active mainly in the provision of technology solutions. It offers integrated technology solutions, such as software and associated services, spare parts and consumables, trainings and consulting services, which are designed for industries using textiles, leather, industrial fabrics, or composites to manufacture their products. It serves markets such as fashion, automotive and furniture, as well as a broad array of other industries, including aeronautics, marine, wind turbine, and personal protective equipment. The Company develops its offers across. It is active in Europe, Asia-Pacific region, Americas, China, and Australia, among others. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, which include Lectra Systems Pty Ltd, and Lectra USA Inc., Lectra South Korea and Kubix Lab.

name: COURTOIS
businessSummary: Courtois SA, formerly known as Societe Courtois SA, is a France-based holding company, operating in the real estate business sector. The Company is engaged in the real estate sales, business real estate management and holding of interests in venture capital companies. The Company also purchases old buildings in Paris for sale by consignment, mainly with the purpose of repairing the common areas and installing elevators where appropriate, among others. As of December 31, 2013 the Company had 99,99% of stakes in SARL Fonciere Immobiliere Courtois Renovation Immuebles and 99,96% stakes in SARL STP Gestion de Portefeuille. The Company also holds direct and indirect stakes in companies, including SARL l'Ariege Renovation Immeubles, SCI Ampere Gestion d'Immeubles, SCI Caudra, SCI Port Invest Gestion d'Immeubles and SCI Nord Invest Gestion d'Immeubles, among others.

name: HOPSCOTCH GROUPE
businessSummary: Hopscotch Groupe SA, formerly Public Systeme Hopscotch SA, is a France-based company specialized in public relations and marketing services. The Company operates through such divisions as Public Realtions, Events, Digital and Social Web. It designs and coordinates corporate events, such as conventions, product launches, parties, financial events, seminars and offers tailor-made solutions on the business tourism market; operational and relation communication, that covers public relations, corporate public relations, public events and press relations; and communication and digital marketing, which handles online programs. The Company’s clients belong to the entertainment, sports, health, cinema, automobile, food, institution and tourism sectors, among others.

name: LES DOCKS DES PETROLES D AMBES SA
businessSummary: Les Docks des Petroles d Ambes SA is a France-based company engaged in the storage and logistics of petroleum products. The Company owns and manages depots and warehouses, which are used for the storage of motor fuel, diesel oil, domestic heating oil, petrochemicals, and heavy fuel oil, among others. It is also involved in the transportation and logistics of stored products. The Company operates a number of storage sites located in Bassens and Bayon, France. It also operates oil pipeline in Ambes Bayon. The Company is controlled by Entrepots Petroliers Regionaux SASU.

name: INTEXA
businessSummary: Intexa SA, formerly International Textiles Associes, is a France-based company controlled by Casino Guichard-Perrachon. The Company has at the moment no business activity but is to be used by the Casino group to develop projects in the renewable energy sector. Prior to its acquisition by Casino Guichard-Perrachon, the Company was engaged in the textiles sector. It provided design, manufacture and printing of fabrics, comprising solid-colored, flowered, striped or gusset fabrics. The Company is 90.35%-owned by Casino Guichard-Perrachon.

name: PEUGEOT INVEST SA
businessSummary: Peugeot Invest SA (formerly known as FFP SA) is a France-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in investment activities such as diversified assets, made up of direct minority holdings, private equity vehicles, co-investments and real estate. It operates it's business through it's direct and indirect holdings to make progress in the areas of governance, social work and environmental protection. The Company operates it's business through it's subsidiaries.

name: ACANTHE DEVELOPPEMENT
businessSummary: Acanthe Developpement SE is a France-based company specializes in the ownership and management of corporate real estate assets located mainly in the Central Business District of Paris. The Company rents by type of asset are distributed in offices, shops, habitations. It is a European real estate company eligible for SIIC status, the value of whose assets is more than 94.99% located in privileged areas of Paris. The Company strategy is based on the rigorous management of assets and the search for the signatures guaranteeing the valorization of its portfolio and securing the return on assets. It is is listed in compartment C of NYSE Euronext Paris and is part of the IEIF SIIC index.

name: COVIVIO SA
businessSummary: Covivio SA, formerly known as Fonciere des Regions SA, is a France-based real estate investment trust company with a diversified portfolio of office real estate assets. The Company leases property to manufacturers and service companies, including France Telecom, Thales, Edf, Accor, Dassault Systemes, Suez Environnement, IBM and Eiffage. The Company's assets are comprised of office premises in France, and in Italy via its subsidiary, Beni Stabili. Covivio SA is also active in the service sector property market via a shareholding in Fonciere des Murs, which specializes in leisure, restaurants and healthcare properties. In addition, its subsidiary, Fonciere Europe Logistique, invests in logistics real estate in France and Germany. The Company also has an interest in residential real estate via Fonciere Developpement Logements. It also operates through other subsidiaries, such as CB 21 and Urbis Park.

name: NSC GROUPE
businessSummary: NSC Groupe SA is a France-based company specializes in the design and manufacture of equipment for the packaging industry. The Company provides equipment for combing and spinning long textile fibers. It offers cast iron parts in small and medium series that is intended for the machine building, refrigeration, street furniture, hydraulics, transport, printing, etc. sectors. Its equipment for winding and unwinding packaging materials. It design and integration of complete production lines and for the management of complex industrial projects.

name: CATERING INTERNATIONAL SERVICES
businessSummary: Catering International & Services SA is a France-based company engaged in the catering and support services for companies that carry out projects in extreme conditions. The Company is primarily active in such regions as Middle-East, Africa, South America, Asia and Eastern Europe. Catering International & Services SA has three divisions: Catering, which is responsible for the organization and preparation of meals; Engineering, which organizes engineering work, provision of equipment, design and preparation of site facilities; and Services Support, which provides transportation, maintenance and leisure services. The Company's main clients are companies in the oil and gas sector, the public buildings and works sector and the engineering and mining industries. Catering International & Services SA operates through several subsidiaries, including Arctic Catering Services, CIS Sierra Leone and CIS TCHAD, among others. In September 2014, the Company acquired 70% of Top Service.

name: MEDIA 6
businessSummary: Media 6 SA is a France-based company that specializes in point-of-sale marketing and publicity. The Company's principal activities include POS Displays, Shop Fittings, Shop Fixtures and Merchandising.It takes care of commercial furniture and the design and arrangement of retail outlets. Its subsidiaries, including Media 6 Production, Media 6 Design, Media 6 Agencement Shop Fittings, Media 6 Pharmacie, Mediacolor Spain, Media 6 Installation, Prugent Ebenisterie, Media 6 Asia Production and Artium Production, are organized in two divisions: production and services. The Company is present in France, Spain, Romania, the Czech Republic and China.

name: INNELEC MULTIMEDIA
businessSummary: Innelec Multimedia SA, also known as Innelec Multimedia, is a France-based company that specializes in the distribution of leisure software and multimedia products for personal computers (PC) and media access control (MAC) devices. The Company’s range of products include gaming and educational accessories, office utility, graphic, communication, management and training software; consoles and accessories; digital versatile discs (DVDs), Blu-ray videos and audio compact discs (CDs) with movies, games and entertainment activities, among others. It also provides intermediation services among editors, specialized retailers, multispecialists and department stores. As of March 31, 2014, Innelec Multimedia SA operated seven subsidiaries: Innelec Technologies, Innelec Services, Jeux Video & Co, Innowear, Xandrie, Focus Home Interactive and Konix Ltd et MDA . As of March 31, 2014, Groupe Thebaud held a 64.17% stake in the Company’s shareholdings.

name: STEF S.A.
businessSummary: Stef SA, formerly known as STEF-TFE SA, is a France-based company primarily engaged in the transportation of refrigerated and frozen goods. The Company has three divisions: Transport unit, responsible for transportation of fresh and frozen products and seafood; Logistics unit, responsible for logistics of fresh and frozen goods for manufacturers, mass retailers, food service outlets and catering and IT Systems unit, which is responsible for STEF software and on customer-oriented software. STEF SA operates through subsidiaries, including STEF-TFE Transport, STEF-TFE International, Agrostar, among others. The Company is present in France, Italy, Switzerland, Spain, Portugal and Benelux, among others. It operates through Speksnijder Transport BV, Vers-Express Koel-Vries Logistiek BV and Transports Badosa, among others.

name: EXACOMPTA CLAIREFONTAINE
businessSummary: Exacompta Clairefontaine SA is a France-based manufacturer of paper products, stationery, and office supplies. The Company's primary brand names are Exacompta and Clairefontaine. The Exacompta brand offers a portfolio of record books, notebooks, copy pads, record cards, computer paper, pocket diaries and filing products, whereas exercise books, school paper, envelopes and copier paper are marketed under the Clairefontaine brand and manufactured by the Papeteries de Clairefontaine subsidiary. The Company manufactures diaries and luxury stationery products via the subsidiary, Ateliers de Fabrication d'Agendas (A.F.A.), and markets other exercise books, stationery, and artistic products through the subsidiary, Clairefontaine Rhodia. The Company operates in Europe, the United States, Canada, Japan, and Morocco. It’s stationery are also sold under the brands such as Quo Vadis and Rhodia.

name: BONDUELLE
businessSummary: Bonduelle SA is a France-based company primarily engaged in the processing and distribution of vegetables. It provides three types of products, such as canned, frozen and fresh processed vegetables, as well as ready-to-eat dishes. It offers its products under the Bonduelle, Cassegrain, Frudesa, Salto and Arctic Gardens brands, to the consumer markets in over 75 countries. The Company has its productions sites in several countries and has operations in more than 60 countries. The Company operates a number of subsidiaries.

name: AUBAY
businessSummary: Aubay SA is a France-based company engaged in the Information Technology (IT) industry. The Company designs architecture of information systems, develops and facilitates content management, designs and develops secured IT networks, offers consulting on telecommunication strategies, provides network engineering, handles engineering projects and outsourced research. It also develops projects and offers facilities management solutions, among others. The Company’s products are sold to the sectors of defense, aeronautics, energy, banking, insurance telecommunications, as well as transport and rail sectors. It has developed two service centers: The Dedicated Service Centre includes the technical platform, the premises and all the resources that are dedicated to a single customer; the Pooled Services Centre, which covers the resources, tools and processes pooled for a group of customers. It has such subsidiaries as Aedian SA and Aubay SA, Norma 4 Servicios Informaticos SA, among others.

name: ADL PARTNER SA
businessSummary: ADL Partner SA is a France-based company that specializes in loyalty marketing by press subscriptions. The Company designs, markets and implements customer relations loyalty and management services on its own behalf or on behalf of its partners. ADLPartner SA devises open-ended subscriptions (OES), which is a formula that helps recruiting subscribers using a direct-debit system; fixed-term subscriptions (FTS), which relates to the recruitment of subscribers for a fixed-term, usually one year, and books-items-audio-video (BIAV). The Company's principal clients are: banks, such as BNP Paribas; distribution companies, such as Printemps; service providers, including Amercan Express, and companies engaged in distant selling, such as La Redoute. It operates in Germany, Spain and Brazil. It has several wholly owned subsidiaries, including SCI de la Rue de Chartres and ADLPartner Hispania, among others. In September 2014, the Company launched its subsidiary ADLP Digital.

name: VRANKEN POMMERY MONOPOLE SA
businessSummary: Vranken Pommery Monopole SA is a France-based company engaged in the manufacture, commercialization and distribution of champagne, wine, and port wine. The Company's brands include Pommery Brut Royal, La Grande Reserve Brut de Vranken, La Cuvee Demoiselle de Vranken, POP Earth, Charles Lafitte, Sao Pedro, Terra do Grifo, and La Gordonne, among others. The Company distributes its products worldwide and has a network of international subsidiaries, including Rozes SA in Portugal, Vranken Japan, Vranken-Pommery Australia, Vranken-Pommery Belgium, Camarguaise de Participations and Vranken Monopole UK Ltd, among others. The Company’s net sales are distributed geographically as follows: France, Europe and other and has around five production sites located in France and Portugal.

name: BARBARA BUI
businessSummary: Barbara Bui SA, also known as Barbara Bui, is a France-based company that designs, manufactures and distributes women's fashion goods, ready-to-wear clothing and accessories, such as shoes and bags. The Company sells the products via boutiques in Paris, New York, Milan, Moscow, Ekaterinbourg and Seoul, and through a network of multi-brand shops and department stores in France, the USA, Canada, Africa and Asia, among others. It is also active in the perfume and cosmetics market with the fragrance named Barbara Bui Le Parfum. As of December 31, 2013, the Company operates through a subsidiary BBK Holding Etats-Unis, has 99.00% stake in Barbara Bui Srl Italie and 55.00% stake in Alain Tondowski Sarl France.

name: EXAIL TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Exail Technologies SA is a France-based industrial company that engages in the advanced technologies in the fields of autonomous robotics, navigation, aerospace and Photonics. The Company specializes in the high-tech businesses driven by an entrepreneurial culture that provides performance, reliability and safety to the civil and military customers operating in harsh environments. It supports to its long-term companies and entrepreneurs in the development of their know-how and the promotion of the cutting-edge activities. It also operates worldwide in the business sectors such as drones, robotics, engineering and protection systems.

name: ALAN ALLMAN ASSOCIATES SA
businessSummary: Alan Allman Associates SA, formerly known as Verneuil Finance SA, is a France-based company. The Company specializes in digital transformation and business consulting activities. Its business activities divided into four categories, such as high-tech consulting, industrial transformation consulting, digital marketing consulting and strategy and management consulting. High tech consulting offers an array of services such as cybersecurity, the cloud, data and big data processing, digitalization of tools and processes among others. Strategy consulting works on aspects of risk management, business intelligence, market finance, process management and change management. Industry consulting specializes in purchasing and supply chain, relocation, cost reduction, project management, materials and process experts among others.

name: COMPAGNIE DE L'ODET SE
businessSummary: Compagnie De l'odet SE, formerly known as Financiere de l'Odet SA is a France-based holding company with interest in Bollore Group. The Group’s operations are based on four areas: Transportation and Logistics, which includes services relating to the organization of sea and air transport networks, and logistics; Oil Logistics, which refers to the distribution and warehousing of oil products in Europe; Communication, which includes sales of recorded music on physical media or in digital form, exploitation of copyrights and services to artists, as well as publishing and distribution of free and pay television channels and production, sale and distribution of films, consulting in communication and advertising agencies, among others, and Electricity Storage and solutions, which encompasses activities related to the production and sale of electric batteries and their applications, such as electric vehicles, supercapacitors, dedicated terminals and systems and plastic films.

name: BLEECKER
businessSummary: Bleecker SA is a France-based company specialized in the real estate investments and management. The Company developed on the industrial premises, offices and logistics platforms market and leads, coordinates, administers and manages the subsidiaries. The Company's properties are located in Paris, Perigueux, Ormes, Saint Ouen and Gennevilliers, among others. As of August 31, 2013, Bleecker SA operated through its subsidiaries, including Anatole France SARL, Balzac SARL, Bartok SARL, Bellini SARL, Borodine SARL, Bossuet SARL, Carafa SARL, SCI Carre Bossuet, Moussorgski SARL, Vivaldi SARL, Mallarme SARL, Wagner SARL, among others. As of August 31, 2013, RGI Investissement SA held a 21.09% stake in the Company’s shareholdings.

name: FERMIERE DU CASINO MUNICIPAL CANNES SA
businessSummary: Fermiere du Casino Municipal de Cannes SA (SFCMC) is a France-based company that operates casinos, hotels and other leisure facilities found within vacation resorts. The Company, which leases its facilities and equipment from Group Lucien Barriere, operates two casinos: Barriere de Cannes Croisette, and Barriere les Princes, and two hotels: a five-star Majestic, and a four-star Gray d'Albion. The Company also operates other leisure facilities, both on-site and in other locations, including restaurants, function and meeting rooms, swimming pools, tennis courts and a discotheque, and offers rental of shops. The SFCMC has five subsidiaries: Hotel Majestic (SIEHM), Hotel Gray d’Albion SA (HGAC), CASINO BARRIERE LES PRINCES (SCLC), SOCIETE D’EXPLOITATION DE LA PLAGE MAJESTIC (SEPM) and SCI 8 Cannes Croisette.

name: AUGROS COSMETIC PACKAGING
businessSummary: Augros Cosmetic Packaging SA, also known as Augros Cosmetic Packaging, is a France-based company that designs and manufactures custom plastic, glass and metal packaging components for the fragrance, cosmetic and skin care industries. It produces moldings for cosmetics of such brands as Nivea, Hugo, Clarins, Soul, Star, Burberry and Emporio, among others. The products include mainly glass and plastic bottles, cardboard packages, perfume bottles, makeup compacts and containers. The technical solutions used in manufacturing are the packaging materials, including silk screen printing, lacquering, varnishing, dual injection, ultrasonic welding and metallization, among others. The Company focuses the activities on luxury packaging, conducted by two plants in Alencon, and decoration on plastic and glass, carried out in Le Theil sur Huisne. As of December 31, 2013 the Company had no subsidiaries.

name: PISCINES DESJOYAUX
businessSummary: Piscines Desjoyaux SA is a France-based company specializes in the manufacturing and marketing of swimming pools. Its activity is distributed as sale of swimming pools , property management. The Company provides private, collective and public swimming pools. It develops activities in the manufacturing of paving and coping and the production of associated equipment (roller shutters, robots, barriers, alarms, shelters, lighting, heat pumps, spas, saunas, water treatment systems, furniture). garden, etc.); It offers property management.

name: EURASIA FONCIERE INVESTISSEMENTS
businessSummary: Eurasia Fonciere Investissements SA, formerly MB Retail Europe SA, is a France-based property investment and development company. It is principally engaged in the development and investment in commercial shopping centers in France and the European Union. Eurasia Fonciere Investissements SA owns approximately over 3 million square meters of real estate assets. It has operations in the Netherlands, Great Britain, Germany, Belgium, Luxembourg, and France. In addition, the Company specializes in the property and asset management services. The Company’s turnover is generated real estate rental, real estate development and others.

name: GÉRARD PERRIER
businessSummary: Gerard Perrier Industrie SA is a France-based company that provides electrical and electronic automation solutions to industry including design and manufacturing, installation and maintenance. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, including SAS Geral, which designs and manufactures electronic and electrical automation and control equipment; SAS Soteb, which installs and maintains different types of electrical and automation equipment, SAS Ardatem, which specializes in the nuclear energy sector and ensure technical assistance, among others. Gerard Perrier Industrie's customers include manufacturers of machinery, professional equipment and capital goods, and electrical departments of industrial production sites in the chemical, mechanical and food processing sectors, among others. The Company’s activities also include provision of energy-related services, installation, and maintenance services, and construction of electrical and electronic assemblies.

name: FIDUCIAL OFFICE SOLUTIONS
businessSummary: Fiducial Office Solutions SA is a France-based holding company primarily engaged in the distribution of office stationery, furniture, and supplies. The Company offers a range of stationery products, including paper, filing solutions and correspondence supplies. It also offers a range of computing equipment, such as printers, faxes, scanners, video projectors and digital photography equipment. In terms of office equipment, Fiducial Office Solutions SA supplies companies with desks, tables, chairs, cupboards, and other office units. The Company also has a printing division producing letterheads, invoices, business cards, personalized envelopes, and brochures.

name: ALTHEORA SA
businessSummary: Altheora SA, formerly known as Mecelec Composites SA is a France-based company which provides industrial services. The Company's business lines include Altheora Composites, which is a division for processing of composite materials, and it provides support for projects from their creation to their end use application; Altheora Coating, which provides painting and industrial coatings and can improve end-use parts, whatever their application; and Altheora Shift, which is an innovation accelerator, and its mission is to inspire, accompany, and accelerate industrial projects. Its ecosystem involves sharing common or complementary needs, re-purposing by-products, exchanging raw materials, water, energy, services coming from different industrial activities, knowledge, technical processes, or eco-innovations.

name: BURELLE
businessSummary: Burelle SA is a France-based holding company active in three areas: Industry and Services, through its subsidiary Compagnie Plastic Omnium SA, investment in other businesses through Burelle Participations and Real Estate, through Sofiparc. Compagnie Plastic Omnium SA, operates through two segments. It specializes in the manufacture of automobile plastic body parts, fuel and pollution control and produces waste containers (waste management systems) and urban/street furniture, as well waste management services. Sofiparc SAS, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, manages an office complex in Levallois, and land in Lyon and its Region. Burelle Participations SA, Burelle's wholly owned subsidiary, is an investment company focusing on investment in medium-sized companies through minority or majority interest holdings. The Company is present in Europe, North America, South America, South Africa and Asia.

name: BOIRON
businessSummary: Boiron SA is a France-based pharmaceutical company engaged in the provision of homeopathic medicines. The Company develops, manufactures and markets single homeopathic medicines and drugs which are in the form of tablets, syrups, single-dose liquids and ointments. It also produces medicines based on trace elements, phytotherapy remedies, food supplements, as well as health and beauty care products. In addition, the Company owns a research center, which works for the development of homeopathy within the world of medicine. Boiron SA operates through a number of subsidiaries, which are based in Italy, Spain, Belgium, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Russia, Romania, Poland, Hungary, the United States, Canada and Brazil, among others.

name: LA CHAUSSERIA SA
businessSummary: La Chausseria SA is a France-based company that designs, manufactures, and distributes footwear for women. The Company distributes its products across France through its retail outlets: in Paris, Lyon, Nantes, Aix En Provence, Bordeaux, Lille, and Montpellier. Its products are sold under the La Chausseria and Janie Philip brands through a network of eleven stores located in France of which maximum turnover is made in France.

name: MARIE BRIZARD WINE AND SPIRITS SA
businessSummary: Marie Brizard Wine and Spirits SA is a France-based international company active in the alcoholic beverages sector. The Company groups its business activities under two segments: Brand business and Other business. Brand business includes wine and spirits production and/or marketing operations managed by the Company’s subsidiaries; Other business covers complementary production and/or marketing operations that enable the Company’s subsidiaries to optimize their performance and profitability. The Company boasts a wide portfolio of brands, such as WILLIAM PEEL, MARIE BRIZARD, FRUITS AND WINE, KRUPNIK and COGNAC GAUTIER, among others. The Group markets and distributes its products primarily in Europe and the United States.

name: DEVERNOIS
businessSummary: Devernois SA, also known as Devernois, is a France-based company specializing in design, production and marketing of women's apparel and accessories. The Company offers apparel and accessories for women, including suits, blouses, sweaters, skirts, pants, jackets, and dresses, among others. Its revenue is generated by the following segments: sales of company-owned magazines; sales to retailers: multi-brand stores, franchisees and department stores; sales to affiliates; The Company operates through subsidiaries: Sofrade SA, with its subsidiaries Italie 6 SARL and Devernois Belgique SARL; Devernois Espana SL, Socad SARL, Devernois Luxembourg SARL and Devernois Portugal LDA.

name: FINANCIÈRE MARJOS
businessSummary: Finaciere Marjos SA, formerly known as Clayeux SA, is a France-based company engaged in the apparel industry. The Company is active in the design, manufacture and distribution of clothing and accessories for children up to the age of twelve. The Company's offering includes Moi bebe Clayeux collection, which is designed for babies up to 18 months. The Company also produces and distributes its own range of children's perfumes. The Company distributes its products worldwide through its distribution network to trade name boutiques, online store, multi-brand stores, franchise stores, factory stores and affiliated stores. In November 2013, it sold all its outstanding property assets to SNC ROBOT COUPE TECHNOLOGIES.

name: SIGNAUX GIROD
businessSummary: Signaux Girod SA is a France-based company engaged in the design, development, installation, maintenance and lease of signs and associated products. The Company operates in nine product families: traffic signage, directional signage, signage for streets and sites, local information, temporary signage, roadway equipment, urban development, vehicle safety and marking and supports and accessories. Signaux Girod SA has 36 decentralized sites in France, responsible for vertical highway signage, horizontal signage and road zoning and worksite signage services. It also has five specialized subsidiaries in France, responsible for electronic signage, urban furniture, furniture for visual communication, floral decoration, and adhesive visual identity materials. The Company also leases safety and security products, such as temporary signs for working sites.

name: FIDUCIAL REAL ESTATE
businessSummary: Fiducial Real Estate SA, formerly Orial, is a France-based company engaged in the real estate operations, such as holding of real estate assets and the provision of services for them. The Company’s properties are divided into offices and residential buildings. The buildings are located in France, in such cities as Heyrieux, Lyon, Courbevoie and Paris, in Belgium, Luxembourg and others. Fiducial Real Estate SA operates through three subsidiaries: Escurial SAS, Immocial SAS and Fiducial Gerance SA.

name: INSTALLUX
businessSummary: Installux SA is a France-based company design and distribution of aluminum profiles and accessories. The Company develops activities in the design, assembly and marketing of one-piece blinds, fitting products and removable partitions. Its activity is organized organized around four families of products and services, such as aluminum profiles and accessories, fitting products and partitions, one-piece blinds (Store Roche), and notably lacquering services. The Company intended for the manufacture of windows, doors, facades, verandas, gates, canopies, etc. The products are marketed to finishing professionals (notably metalworkers, fitters, glaziers and carpenters). Its fitting products and partitions: tertiary and commercial fitting products (cladding, racks, display cases, notice boards, furniture, etc.; Sofadi), and removable aluminum partitions (Tiaso). It provides blinds for terraces, windows, verandas and specific blinds for balconies, shops and terraces, etc.

name: COVIVIO HOTELS
businessSummary: Covivio Hotels SCA, formerly known as Fonciere des Murs SCA, is a France-based company listed Real Estate Investment Company (SIIC) specializing in owning and managing service-sector of real estate assets in the hotel sector. The Company activity is organized around two types of assets hotels and operating businesses. It is a real estate partner of hotel operators in Europe (AccorInvest, IHG, NH Hotel Group, B&B HOTELS, Meininger Hotels, Radisson Hotel Group. The Company aims to favor the real estate investments in the hotel sector in Europe, while diversifying its methods of intervention, and at the same time continuing to support tenants in their development. It offers 80% of its hotel portfolio benefiting from environmental certification.

name: SAINT JEAN GROUPE
businessSummary: Saint Jean Groupe, formerly known as Sabeton SA, is a France-based holding company, primarily active in the food processing industry. The Company through its subsidiaries produces and markets under the brands Saint Jean, Royans, Ravioles de Romans and Quenelles La Royale, different type of food, such as ravioli, fresh pasta, quenelles and ready meals, among others. It also manages an online shop and is active locally.

name: SAMSE
businessSummary: Samse SA is a France-based company specialized in trading of construction material. The Company provides trading in construction materials, tiles, earthenware, joinery, floor coverings, parquet floors, sanitary ware, etc. aimed at professionals in the building, wood and public works sector. Its multi-specialist network represents a dense network which guarantees a close relationship with construction sites, craftsmen and construction companies. It provides storage capacities, logistics platforms and on-site delivery services provide customers with service and time savings.

name: TELEVISION FRANCAISE 1 SA
businessSummary: Television Francaise 1 SA, also known as TF1, is a France-based company primarily engaged in the television broadcasting and communication services. The Company is a French audiovisual sector, active in the publishing, production and broadcasting of content. It provides media a content offering and linear and digital advertising revenues, including 5 free-to-air channels (TF1, TMC, TFX, TF1 Sries Films and LCI), 4 theme channels (Ushuaia TV, Histoire TV, TV Breizh and Srie Club), 3 on-demand content platforms (MYTF1, TFOU MAX and Salto) and the TF1 PUB advertising airtime sales house. It offers audiovisual production ( Newen Studios): production of content according to a differentiating multi-genre strategy (TV films, daily, fiction, distribution, animation, documentaries, etc.).

name: BOURRELIER GROUP SA
businessSummary: Bourrelier Group SA, formerly Bricorama SA is a France-based company engaged in the do-it-yourself (DIY) market. The Company operates medium-sized stores specializing in interior/exterior home improvement projects and trades under several brand names, including Bricorama and Batkor for the French and Spanish markets, and Gamma and Karwei for the Benelux market. Bricorama distributes products for gardening, interior decorating and plumbing, among others, as well as a range of hardware and tools. Batkor specializes in household renovation and decoration, and it also provides products for gardening, construction and do-it-yourself activities. The Company operates over 90 shops across France, over 60 in the Benelux countries and eight in Spain. It also distributes its products via franchised outlets. Bourrelier Group SA operates through a number of subsidiaries, including wholly owned Bricorama BV, Brico 3 SAS and Eoliennes Bricorama 2 SAS, among others.

name: CIBOX INTERACTIVE
businessSummary: Cibox Inter@ctive SA is a France-based company that specializes in the design and sale of information technology (IT) peripheral devices. The Company’s range of offering includes flash drives, such as Cibox K2 and Cibox D-Cap with a bottle opener, the Cibox T701 touch pad with high definition media and Wi-Fi, an external hard drive, multimedia hard drives, such as Mini CINETV FullHD, CINETV HD, CINETV FullHD, Cinebox FullHD, Cinebox Premium Essential, Cinebox HD Mobile, Cinebox MZTV Recorder, Cinebox V2 and MZ Box, which give the possibility to read and copy the content in various video, music and photo formats, among others, as well as secure digital cards, including Cibox SD and Cibox Micro SD.

name: HIGH CO
businessSummary: High Co SA is a France-based marketing services group for mass-market retailers and consumer goods manufacturers. The Company offers marketing solutions, such as coupon issuing, a promotional technique that entitles the customer to a discount on a product; sampling, which consists in offering free samples to test a product; point-of sale, which ranges from shelf tags to in-store radio announcements, floor graphics and in-store field marketing; clearing, which consists of processing discount coupons and money-back offers; marketing communication agencies, which provide support for brands and retailers in their marketing campaigns, and digital services with the subsidiary, HighCo 3.0., which advises and assists clients on the integration of digital technologies for distributors and brands. The Company operates in France, Spain, United Kingdom, Poland, Russia and Turkey, among others.

name: S.T. DUPONT
businessSummary: St Dupont SA is a France-based company that is engaged in the manufacture, marketing, and sale of luxury goods for men and women. The Company's offerings range from accessories, such as lighters, pens, jewellery, leather goods, to eyewear, watches, belts, fragrances, and casual and formal attire. The Company's product portfolio also includes briefcases, mini notepads, Universal Serial Bus memory sticks, address books and cigar accessories. The Company has women’s line of products, including handbags, suitcases, travel cases and small leather goods. The Company distributes its products worldwide, and the majority of its products are sold in France, Europe, Asia and the United States. St Dupont SA operates several subsidiaries located notably in Asia, Europe and North America.

name: DELFINGEN INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Delfingen SA is a France-based company. The Company operates in the automotive sector and also in the building and electrical equipment industries. It provides solutions for electrical wiring and fluid networks in vehicles. It produces components for mobility markets in Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. Its products include wiring harness protection such as plastic tubing, textile sleeves, and shielding; hose and tube protection for various environments; and routing, fastening, and branching components. In automotive applications, it supplies systems for fuel tanks, engine compartments, washer systems, and interior trim fastening including seat retainers and felt stripes. It also offers tubing systems for conveying, filling, draining, and distributing low-pressure fluids in vehicles. Its services include product and packaging customization, delivery to production lines, multi-component assembly, and supply chain support.

name: FONCIÈRE VOLTA
businessSummary: Fonciere Volta SA is a France-based company that specializes in owning and managing diversified real estate assets, such as offices, warehouses, houses, shops and activity parks. It holds a majority stake in numerous companies, including SAS WGS, SCI Charonne, SCI Anatole, SARL J Hoche, SARL Jalmar, SARL Loc Guadeloupe, SCI Acajou, SCI Gourbeyre, SCI Paris 16, SCI Belvedere, SCI Louise Michel and SCI Kleber Cimarosa, among others. As of December 31, 2011, assets managed by the Company were located in Paris, the Paris Region, Israel and the French Overseas Departments, such as Guadeloupe and Martinique. In 2013, it sold properties in the Paris Region and signed a lease with the B&B group for its property in Lieusaint.

name: ALTAMIR
businessSummary: Altamir SCA is a France-based listed private equity company specialized in asset management. The Company operates in four sectors of specialization: Tech and Telecom, Consumer, Health, and Services that offers investors access to a portfolio of companies. Its partners with several private equity firms, which includes Apax Partners SAS (Paris) and Apax Partners LLP (London). The Company objective is to provide shareholders with continuing for many years capital appreciation and regular dividends by investing in a diversified portfolio of growing companies and for investment decisions in funds and co-investment, Altamir relies on the advice of the management company.

name: CEGEDIM SA
businessSummary: Cegedim SA is a France-based company that produces and distributes data and services linked to medical information and customer relationship management (CRM) activities for the Sales and Marketing Departments in the Healthcare and Life Sciences sectors. Cegedim is also a manufacturer of medical and para-medical management software, and designs management applications dedicated to the health insurance sector. The Company’s falls into three sectors: Life Sciences which comprises solutions specifically designed for pharmaceutical companies; Healthcare professionals designed for doctors, pharmacists and paramedics, and Healthcare Insurance, which is designed for health insurance providers and for companies of any sectors. The Company operates through Webstar Health and a number of subsidiaries. Cegedim SA is present in approximately 80 countries around the world.

name: DERICHEBOURG SA
businessSummary: Derichebourg SA is a France-based global operator that engages in the environmental, corporate, and airport services. The Company activities can be divided into two separate branches: the Environment division and the Multiservice division. Environmental services include recycling, waste management and industrial waste disposal produced by manufacturers, communities and individuals. Multiservice division plays important role in the European business and community services market that focus on the core business, improve organization and control the costs.

name: COMPAGNIE DES ALPES
businessSummary: Compagnie des Alpes SA is a France-based holding company active in the tourism and leisure industry in two distinct areas: the operation and maintenance of ski resorts and the operation of family leisure parks and attractions. It equips, maintains and operates ski resorts in the Alps region in France, Italy and Switzerland. Its activities include lift handling, trail maintenance, grooming and snowmaking, and operation of ticket booths. Compagnie des Alpes SA is active in the leisure park industry through its subsidiary, Grevin & Cie SA, which manages leisure sites in France, the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. It offers three types of activities: theme parks, nature and animal parks, and tourist attractions. It operates in France, Switzerland, Germany, Belgium, Russia and Luxembourg. In April 2014, it sold 30% stake in Groupe Looping to HIG Capital France, and announced the agreement with MacEarth and the aquisition of 2.5% stake in the company.

name: METROPOLE TELEVISION SA
businessSummary: Metropole Television SA is a France-based audiovisual company that specializes in the production, distribution and marketing of television (TV) programs. The Company activity is distributed as operation of TV channel, operation of radio stations, production of programs and marketing of audiovisual rights. It provides 4 free channels (M6, W9, 6ter and Gulli), 9 pay channels (Paris Premiere, Tva, M6 Music, Serie Club, Tiji, Canal J, RFM TV, MCM and MCM Top) and 4 digital channels (6play, 6play Max, Gulli Max and Gulli Replay). The Company offers ownership of RTL, RTL2 and Fun Radio radio stations and broadcast of podcasts; It provides marketing of derivative products, publication of magazines, organization of events, publishing of websites, teleshopping, etc.

name: ADVINI
businessSummary: Advini SA, (formerly known as Jeanjean SA), is a France-based company engaged in the production, vinification, maturing, packaging and sale of wine. The Company, which specializes in wines and has production sites in various regions in the south of France, such as the Languedoc, Roussillon, the Rhone Valley, Provence and the south-west Regions. It operates through a number of subsidiaries, including Jeanjean SA in Languedoc; Cazes SAS in Roussillon; Ogier SAS in Chateauneuf du Pape; Gassier SAS in Provence; Rigal SAS in Parnac; Club Francais du Vin; Chateau Patache d'Aux; Ken Forrester Vineyard, and Antoine Moueix SAS in Saint-Emilion, among others. In addition, Advini SA's sells its wines through three principal distribution points in France and are available in online stores and retail outlets.

name: GRENOBLOISE D'ELECTRONIQUE ET D'AUTOMATI
businessSummary: Gea Grenobloise Electronique Automatisme SA is a France-based manufacturer of toll collection systems and toll monitoring systems company. The Company is engaged in the design, manufacturing, installation, testing, commissioning and maintenance of computer and electronic toll collection systems. Its manufacturing equipment is used by all French highway companies. It offers a complete range of electronic and computer equipment for toll collection. The Company's range of products include Input terminals, Manual exit routes, Automatic exit lanes with magnetic card payment, Station computer systems and central systems, Dynamic toll systems, and Access control and toll systems for parking lots. Payment in exit lanes can be done in national currency, foreign currency, by credit cards (magnetic or smart cards), by fleet cards or subscription cards.

name: AKWEL SA
businessSummary: Akwel SA, formerly known as MGI Coutier SA, is a France-based company specializing in design, manufacturing, and marketing of automotive equipment. The Company’s activities are based on two main production lines: Fluid Transfer and Mechanisms. Fluid Transfer sector provides services in storage, treatment and diffusion of fluids and products include manifolds, ducts, air filters, cam covers, blow-by heating connectors and pipes, ventilation of battery compartment, cooling systems, fuel vapor pipe, dosing pumps, protective casings for additive systems and heated pipes for selective catalytic reduction systems, among others. Mechanisms sector manufactures opening, closing and articulation products such as doorstops and hinges, pedal boxes and under-bonnet mechanisms, locks & strikers and door handles and fuel caps, among others. The Company also has other divisions: Ability, Research & Development, Environment and Aftermarket.

name: OENEO
businessSummary: Oeneo SA is a France-based holding company that is primarily engaged in the manufacture of barrels for winemaking and wine corking products. The Company operates within two business areas, namely Closures and Barrels. The Closures business area is involved in the manufacturing and sale of closures, such as the DIAM closure. The Barrels business area is engaged in the provision of solutions, such as kegs and large oak containers, for ageing wines and spirits. The Company sells its products primarily in France, as well as in other European countries and the United States, among others. Andromede SA is a major shareholder of the Company. In August 2014, it announced the acquisition of Vivelys and Boise France.

name: HERMÈS INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Hermes International SCA is a France-based company. The Company is predominantly specialized in the designing, manufacturing, and marketing of luxury products. Its products are divided among leather and saddlery goods, such as purses, luggage, small leather goods, planners, writing items, saddles, bridles, riding objects and clothing, among others; clothes, shoes, and accessories; silk and textile products; clocks and watchmaking articles; perfumes and beauty products; and other products mainly includes jewelry and home decoration products. The subsidiaries of the Company are Castille Investissements, Compagnie Hermes de Participations, Comptoir Nouveau de la Parfumerie, and Grafton Immobilier, among others. The Company operates through stores worldwide.

name: TELEPERFORMANCE INH.EO2,5
businessSummary: Teleperformance SE, formerly Teleperformance SA is a France-based telemarketing and tele-services provider. The Company provides outsourced services and business consulting dedicated to customer relationship management. It specializes in the outsourcing of contact centers dedicated to customer relationship management. The Company offers customer experience management services, customer information services, technical assistance, customer acquisition, back-office services. It offers integrated business process management and digital transformation services and high value-added consulting services. The Company provides provision of specialized services, online interpreting, management of visa applications and debt collection.

name: IDI S.C.A.
businessSummary: IDI SCA is a France-based investment company. The Company specializes in capital investments in French and European small and mid-cap companies. The Company guides managers through the acquisition process, from identifying opportunities through to closing, and help them structure their group on a pan-European scale and enter new markets.
