It owns a 49% contributing interest in the Tandarra Gold Project, which contains three main prospects: Tomorrow, Macnaughtan and Lawry located only 50km northwest of Agnico Eagle’s world-class Fosterville Gold Mine, and 40km north of the 22-million-ounce Bendigo Goldfield.

name: NEW FRONTIER MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: New Frontier Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration company focused on the development of multicommodity assets, including uranium, niobium, copper, and heavy rare earth minerals. Its projects include the Harts Range Project and the NWQ Copper Project. The Harts Range Project comprises two granted tenements and an application license for a total of 135 square kilometers (km2), approximately 140 kilometers (km) north-east of Alice Springs, with mining infrastructure and access to a skilled labor pool. The Harts Range Project is situated northwest of the Entia Dome and lies within the Harts Range Group. The NWQ Copper Project comprises five mineral leases, covering a total area of 977 km2. The NWQ Copper Project is located approximately 150 km north of Mt Isa in Queensland, and hosts several historic / operating copper mines, including Lady Annie, Mt Oxide and Capricorn Copper. Its additional project, Mkushi Project, is located within the Mwembeshi Shear Zone (MSZ).

name: CLEVER CULTURE SYSTEMS LTD
businessSummary: Clever Culture Systems Limited, formerly LBT Innovations Limited, is an Australia-based company that provides intelligent automation solutions to microbiology laboratories. The Company has developed a technology, the Automated Plate Assessment System (APAS Independence), using artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning software to automate the imaging, analysis and interpretation of microbiology culture plates. The technology is a United States FDA-cleared AI technology for automated culture plate reading. The product is being sold to microbiology laboratories in the pharmaceutical manufacturing sector for the reading of environmental monitoring culture plates and to clinical laboratories as an in vitro diagnostic for infectious diseases. Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc is the exclusive distributor of the APAS Independence to clinical customers in the United States and selected countries in Europe.

name: AUSTRALIAN POTASH LTD
businessSummary: APC Minerals Limited, formerly Australian Potash Limited, is an Australia-based explorer, which holds three project areas, primarily in Western Australia’s north-eastern Goldfields. The Company’s projects include Lake Wells Gold Project, Laverton Downs Base Metals Project, and Nexus Project. The Nexus Project is located in the West Arunta of Western Australia’s Kimberley region. The project comprises one granted exploration license (E80/5917). The Lake Wells Gold Project is located approximately 60 kilometers (km) from Gold Road Resource’s tier 1 Gruyere Project. The Laverton Downs Project is located in the richly endowed Laverton region of Western Australia. The Laverton Downs Project (LDP) has demonstrated potential to host both gold and nickel sulphide mineralization. The LDP commences just 20 km north of Laverton in the north-eastern Goldfields, where it occupies some high potential mineralized real estate.

name: NEW MURCHISON GOLD LTD.
businessSummary: New Murchison Gold Limited, formerly Ora Gold Limited, is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company holds a substantial package of tenements in the prolific Murchison goldfield near Meekatharra, Western Australia. Its Murchison Project comprises approximately 14 exploration licenses and three applications for exploration licenses, encompassing over 460 square kilometers (km2) in the Murchison region of Western Australia. The Company is focused on the Garden Gully Gold Project, which comprises an approximately 677 square kilometers (km2) tenure package covering the Abbots Greenstone Belt (AGB) and other key regional structures. The project has multiple gold prospects along the belt, with the most advanced being the Crown Prince Prospect. Crown Prince Prospect is located within a granted mining lease and is advancing towards development.

name: SGH LTD
businessSummary: SGH Ltd is an Australia-based diversified operating company, with businesses across industrial services, energy and media. In industrial services, the Company owns WesTrac, Boral and Coates. WesTrac is an authorized Caterpillar dealer in Western Australia and New South Wales /Australian Capital Territory, providing heavy equipment sales and support to customers. Boral is an integrated construction materials business, producing and selling a broad range of materials, including quarry materials, cement, concrete, asphalt and recycled materials. Boral has operations in all the Australian States and Territories. Coates is an equipment hire business which provides a range of general and specialist equipment to a wide variety of markets including engineering, building construction and maintenance, mining and resources, manufacturing, government and events. It holds a 40.2% interest in Seven West Media, which is engaged in broadcast television, magazine and newspaper publishing and online.

name: NEURIZON THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Neurizon Therapeutics Ltd, formerly PharmAust Limited, is an Australia-based clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company is engaged in advancing treatments for neurodegenerative diseases. The Company is focused on developing its lead drug candidate, NUZ-001, for the treatment of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), which is the common form of motor neuron disease. ALS is a devastating neurodegenerative condition that primarily affects nerve cells that control voluntary muscles.

name: VAULT MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Vault Minerals Limited is an intermediate gold producer. The Company has three gold operations in Western Australia, plus an advanced gold production restart project in Ontario, Canada. The Leonora Operations are located approximately 900 kilometers (km) north-east of Perth and 25 km north of Leonora, within the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. The Leonora Operations comprise the King of the Hills (KOTH) open pit and underground mines, the Darlot satellite underground mine, and the KOTH processing facility. The Mount Monger Gold Operations are located approximately 580 km north-east of Perth and 50 km south-east of Kalgoorlie, within the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. The Deflector Gold-Copper Operations are located approximately 450 km north of Perth and 160 km east of Geraldton, within the Midwest Region of Western Australia. The Sugar Zone Gold Project is located in Ontario, Canada, over 30km north of White River and midway between Thunder Bay and Sault St. Marie.

name: CRITICA LTD
businessSummary: Critica Limited, formerly Venture Minerals Limited, is focused on discovering and developing critical mineral deposits. It is advancing Jupiter and the Brothers Project, which is strategically located in a mining precinct in Western Australia. Its flagship critical minerals project is Jupiter, which is part of the broader Brothers Project. The project is 250 kilometers (km) east of Geraldton on the Geraldton-Mount Magnet highway, with the mid-west gas pipeline running parallel to the highway. high-grade rare earth (REE) mineralization occurs across the entire 40 square kilometer area of Jupiter. The Brothers Project includes the Iron Duke joint venture (JV), which hosts the Jupiter Prospect and is a potential REE clay hosted discovery near Yalgoo in Western Australia. In addition to its primary project, Jupiter and the Brothers Project, it holds exploration licenses in several regions and those projects include Golden Grove North, Kulin, Livingstone, Mount Lindsay and the South West.

name: WEBJET GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Webjet Group Limited (Webjet B2C) is a digital consumer travel company. The Company operates the business-to-customer (B2C) business through two brands: Webjet OTA and GoSee brands. Webjet OTA is an online travel agency that operates in Australia and New Zealand. Webjet OTA enables customers to compare, combine and book the domestic and international travel flight deals, hotel accommodation, holiday package deals, travel insurance and car hire worldwide. Using Webjet OTA, travelers can book domestic and international travel flight deals to and from almost every destination around the world. GoSee is a global travel e-commerce group, enabling customers to search, compare and book rental cars and motorhomes via two websites, Airport Rentals and Motorhome Republic. Webjet B2C also owns technology company Trip Ninja, a provider of technology that automates the highly manual process of selling complex multi-stop travel itineraries for travel intermediaries.

name: PATRONUS RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Patronus Resources Limited is a gold, base metals and uranium development and exploration company. The Company has combined gold Mineral Resource of more than 1.2Moz gold. The Company’s key focus in Western Australia is its 100% owned Cardinia Gold Project (CGP) located in the highly prospective North-Eastern Goldfields region of Western Australia. The CGP has a 1.0 Moz gold Mineral Resource defined in both oxide and deeper primary mineralization at East Cardinia and Mertondale. The Northern Territory Project covers more than 1,500 square kilometers of prime tenure in the Pine Creek Orogen, which hosts significant gold and uranium deposits. It has gold MRE of 0.3Moz at its Fountain Head Project and 177kt zinc, 37kt lead,16Moz silver and 0.2Moz gold at its Iron Blow and Mt Bonnie base metals projects. It covers over 739 square kilometers of tenure in the highly prospective Leonora region of Western Australia. It also has an interest in the Tennant Creek area of the Northern Territory.

name: ANDEAN SILVER LTD
businessSummary: Andean Silver Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is focused on advancing its 100% owned Cerro Bayo Silver-Gold project in the Aysen region of Southern Chile. The Cerro Bayo Silver-Gold project covers 285 square kilometers (km2) and comprises over 70 contiguous exploration concessions as well as surface properties that cover the areas of the Laguna Verde mining district and processing facilities. The Cerro Bayo Silver-Gold Project hosts indicated and inferred mineral resources of 9.8 million tons at a grade of 353 grams per ton for 111 million ounces of contained silver equivalent (AgEq). Its other projects include Hillside Project, Mt Alexander Project and Araluen Project. The Mt Alexander Project (E29/1167) is located on the western margin of the prospective Mt Alexander greenstone belt. The Araluen Project area covers 230 km2 and abuts and covers the southern extents of the Braidwood Granodiorite, host of the Dargues Gold mine.

name: AMOTIV LIMITED
businessSummary: Amotiv Limited owns a portfolio of companies specializing in providing automotive products and solutions that meet the needs of its customers worldwide. The Company’s divisions include 4WD Accessories and Trailering; Lighting, Power and Electrical; and Powertrain and Undercar. Its 4WD Accessories and Trailering division encompasses various brands, including AutoPacific Group (APG), Hayman Reese, CruiseMaster, ECB, Rola, Parkside, Trojan, Trail Boss, Kaymar, TriMotive, BestBars, Fully Equipped, Crown Canopy, X-Bar, and Christine Products. Its Lighting, Power and Electrical division is engaged in delivering advanced lighting, power, and electrical solutions. The division includes various brands, including Brown & Watson International (BWI), Projecta, Big Red Gear, Twisted Throttle, and Caravan Electrical Solutions. Its Powertrain and Undercar division encompasses various brands, including Ryco Filters, AA Gaskets, Infinitev, and Australian Clutch Services (ACS).

name: BHAGWAN MARINE LTD
businessSummary: Bhagwan Marine Limited is an Australia-based marine services company. The Company provides a diverse range of marine solutions within ports, nearshore, offshore and subsea locations to industries including oil and gas, subsea, port, civil construction, renewables and defense. Its offshore services include dive support, ROV support, crew change operations, metocean equipment deployment, geophysical surveys, geotechnical surveys, offshore accommodation services, decommissioning support, pilot transfers, FPSO offtake assist, oil field support services, coastal towage, coastal freight and others. Its port services include wharf & jetty construction support, crew change/transfers, harbor towage, line boats, inshore survey and ship supply runs. It has a fleet of approximately 95+ vessels comprising various vessel types, including dive support vessels, tugboats, multi-cats, utility vessels, barges and crew transfer boats, as well as other specialist vessels.

name: AUMEGA METALS LTD
businessSummary: AuMEGA Metals Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company is focused on exploring its two properties, Cape Ray Shear Zone and Hermitage. It is focused on exploration to explore on its district scale land package that spans over 110 kilometers (Km) along the Cape Ray Shear Zone. This zone hosts EquinoxGold's Valentine Gold Project, a gold deposit with significant mineral resources. The Hermitage Project is highly prospective for gold exploration following a review of targets in Newfoundland that have exploration potential. The Blue Cove Copper Project is in southeastern Newfoundland, over 175 km to the east of its Hermitage Project and 260 km by road west of St. John’s. The Blue Cove option agreement covers over 78 non-contiguous claims covering 19.5 square kilometers (km2). In addition to the option agreement, it has staked 113 mineral claims covering an additional 28.25 km2 adjacent to the Blue Cove mineral claims.

name: GUZMAN Y GOMEZ LTD
businessSummary: Guzman Y Gomez Limited is a quick service restaurant (QSR) company. The Company delivers clean, fresh, made-to-order, Mexican-inspired food which is served to guests via multiple sales channels, restaurant formats and dayparts. It is a QSR business with over 200 restaurants. It operates a hybrid restaurant ownership model, with a mix of corporate and franchised restaurants. In Australia, the Company has over 194 restaurants, including 64 corporate owned and operated restaurants and 130 franchise owned and operated restaurants, of which 10 restaurants are owned and operated by a South Australian master franchisee. It also has over 17 restaurants in Singapore and five restaurants in Japan which are owned and operated by separate master franchisees. Its menu includes Entrees, Breakfast, Fillings, and Sides and Desserts. Its Entrees menu include Burritos, Bowls, Tacos, Cali Burritos, Nacho Fries, Enchiladas, Quesadillas, among others.

name: ALFABS AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Alfabs Australia Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company provides fabrication, construction and maintenance services, mining equipment and services, protective coatings, transport and logistics, and consumables. Its segments include Mining, Engineering, and Other. The Mining segment manufactures, repairs, overhaul servicing and hire of underground mining and ancillary equipment together with sales of mining related consumables and spare parts. The Engineering segment is engaged in heavy steel fabrication, site installation works and site-based maintenance. Its Other activities include ancillary businesses including protective coatings and transport. Its products include Structure Pod, Mesh Pod, Auger, Belt Splicing Pod, Bucket 2.1 Eject, Bucket 3.1 Eject, Bucket MH40 - The Hungry Hippo, CABA Quick Fill Pod, CABA Storage Pod, Cable Boat, Clan Clamp, Chain Locker, Concrete Kibble, and others.

name: SUN SILVER LTD
businessSummary: Sun Silver Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of silver resources in the Elko County and White Pine County regions of Nevada, United States of America. The Company’s Maverick Springs Project is located about 85 kilometers (km) from the fully serviced mining town of Elko in Nevada and is surrounded by several gold and silver mining operations, including Barrick’s Carlin Mine.

name: TASMEA LTD
businessSummary: Tasmea Limited is an Australia-based company, which provides maintenance, engineering and specialized project services and solutions. The Company serves mining and resources, oil and gas, waste and water, power and renewable energy, and defense and infrastructure industries. The Company’s Electrical business division comprises a group of companies specializing in industrial and commercial electrical and instrumentation services, maintenance and compliance of electrical assets, and indigenous trade services. Its Mechanical business division specialized in industrial and commercial refurbishment and repair, shutdown, and mechanical maintenance. Its Civil business division consists of North West Mining & Civil and M&B Civil. Both companies specialize in commercial earthworks, waste management and civil maintenance. Its Water and Fluids business division is specialized in industrial and commercial geomembrane solutions, lubrication solutions and maintenance, and drainage solutions.

name: BLINKLAB LTD
businessSummary: BlinkLab Limited is an Australia-based digital healthcare company focused on Artificial intelligence (AI) powered diagnostics. The Company has fully developed a smartphone based diagnostic platform for autism, Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), schizophrenia, and other neurodevelopmental conditions. Its product is an autism diagnostic test that leverages the power of smartphones, AI and machine learning to deliver screening tests specifically designed for children as young as over 18 months old. Its pipeline includes BlinkLab Dx 1 and BlinkLab Dx N. Its BlinkLab Dx 1 is an autism diagnostic adjunct. Its BlinkLab Dx N is an ADHD diagnostic adjunct.

name: 5G NETWORKS LTD
businessSummary: 5G Networks Limited is a digital services company. The Company’s principal activities include the supply of cloud-based solutions, managed services, and network services, the operation of fiber and wireless infrastructure and management of cloud computing environment, and the operation of data center facilities. The Company’s segments include Enterprise, Wholesale, and Retail. The Enterprise segment include cloud hosting, domain names, data center, networks, and voice, information technology (IT) managed services, hardware and software and digital marketing products and services provided to enterprise and government customers. The Wholesale segment include cloud hosting, data center, networks and voice products and services provided to wholesale telecommunications and Segment information is provided below in relation to these segments. The Retail segment include domains, Web hosting, email hosting and digital marketing services to consumer and small and medium enterprise customers.

name: PERCHERON THERAPEUTICS LTD
businessSummary: Percheron Therapeutics Limited, formerly Antisense Therapeutics Limited, is a biotechnology company. The Company is engaged in developing and commercializing antisense pharmaceuticals for large unmet markets in rare diseases. The Company’s products include ATL1102 for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), ATL1103 for Acromegaly, and ATL1102 for Multiple Sclerosis (MS). ATL1102, is an antisense inhibitor targeting very late antigen 4 (VLA-4), an immune cell molecule. ATL1103 is a second-generation antisense drug designed to block growth hormone receptor (GHr) expression thereby reducing levels of the hormone insulin-like growth factor-I (IGF-I) in the blood and is a potential treatment for diseases associated with excessive growth hormone action. By inhibiting GHr production, ATL1103 in turn reduces IGF-I levels in the blood (serum). The Company is conducting a Phase II clinical trial of ATL1102 in DMD patients.

name: BRAZILIAN CRITICAL MINERALS
businessSummary: Brazilian Critical Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company’s primary exploration focus is Brazil, in the Apui region. It is exploring for rare earth elements (REEs) and platinum group element (PGE) projects via the exploration, development of projects in Northern Brazil. Its flagship projects include EMA ionic REE and APUI ENE REE, which covers approximately 700 square kilometers (km2). The Ema ionic adsorbed clay (IAC) project is contained within the 781 km2 of exploration tenements within the Colider Group. The Apui project encompasses seven tenements spanning a total of over 510 km2. Its Tres Estados Project contains a total inferred resource of 725,230 ounces at 1,152g/t of 5E precious metals (platinum, palladium, iridium, rhodium, and gold).

name: SYNTARA LTD
businessSummary: Syntara Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage drug development company. The Company is targeting extracellular matrix dysfunction with its amine oxidase chemistry and other technologies to develop novel medicines for blood cancers and conditions linked to inflammation and fibrosis. The Company’s lead candidate SNT-5505 is for the bone marrow cancer myelofibrosis which causes a build-up of scar tissue that leads to loss of red and white blood cells and platelets. The Company is also advancing both oral and topical pan-LOX inhibitors in scar prevention and scar modification programs. Its product candidate, SNT-4728, is an inhibitor to treat sleep disorders and slow progression of neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson’s by reducing neuroinflammation. The Company’s other drug candidates target fibrotic and inflammatory diseases such as kidney fibrosis, NASH, pulmonary fibrosis and cardiac fibrosis.

name: VINYL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Vinyl Group Ltd is a music company, providing tech and media solutions that connect music creators, fans and brands. The Company’s diverse portfolio has touchpoints across all corners of the global music ecosystem, empowering everyone from creators to consumers. These include Vinyl.com, which offers an e-commerce experience, including over 50K titles for fans to support their favorite artists; Vampr, a social-professional networking platform and talent marketplace, allowing 1.4M creators to discover collaborators and monetize their work in over 180 countries; Jaxsta is a database of official music credits with over 380M verified credits, and Serenade, a Web3 pioneer in physical and digital collectible. The Company’s publishing arm, Vinyl Media, is home to a powerhouse of culture, premium content, and live experiences, operates Concrete Playground, a digital city guide, Mediaweek, Tone Deaf, and licenses the Rolling Stone, Refinery29, and Variety mastheads in Australia.

name: CADOUX LTD
businessSummary: Cadoux Limited is an Australia-based resources company, which is focused on the exploration and development of critical and strategic mineral projects. The Company’s segments include high purity alumina exploration and evaluation in Australia and potash exploration and evaluation in Asia. Its project includes High Purity Alumina (HPA) and Rare earths. HPA is a processed non-metallurgical alumina product characterized by its purity level. HPA is used for its properties and characteristics, such as corrosion and scratch resistance, high brightness, and its ability to withstand extreme temperatures. HPA is also used as a base material in the manufacture of sapphire substrates for applications, such as light emitting diodes (LEDs), in the manufacture of artificial sapphire glass and in certain battery and power storage components, artificial gemstones and special space, aeronautical and medical applications. Its Rare-Earths are a set of 17 metallic elements.

name: REDIVIUM LTD
businessSummary: Redivium Limited is an Australia-based company that offers sustainable resource solutions. The principal activity of the Company is implementation of the European battery recycling strategy. The Company is engaged in licensing recognized battery recycling technology (Technology) across the United Kingdom, the Nordics, and Central, South and East Europe. The Technology has been developed by Primobius, Neometals Ltd, and 50% owned by German engineering house SMS. Its recycling technology looks to eliminate lithium-ion battery (LiB) waste and closes the loop by returning high-value battery materials to LiB production, including lithium, nickel, copper, and anode materials.

name: G11 RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: G11 Resources Limited is a gold and copper development and exploration company. The Company’s wholly owned Koonenberry Project is located approximately 80 kilometers (km) east of Broken Hill, New South Wales. This Project is an exploration project spanning an area of approximately 3,300 square kilometers, located within the Koonenberry Belt. The area is prospective for copper, gold, lead, zinc, silver, and other base metals. Koonenberry Project includes four distinct corridors: The Wilandra Corridor, The Cymbric Vale Corridor, The Wertago Corridor and The Bilpa Corridor. The Wilandra Copper Corridor is adjacent to the Koonenberry Fault and forms a 75km long belt with outcropping Cu-Zn mineralization prospective for both syngenetic VMS and epigenetic Cu-rich base metal mineralization. The Cymbric Vale Corridor is a 50 km long belt located approximately 25 km west of Wilanda. The Wertago Corridor is a 30 km long mineralized belt located 40 km north of the Grasmere deposit in Wilandra.

name: JINDALEE LITHIUM LIMITED
businessSummary: Jindalee Lithium Limited, formerly Jindalee Resources Limited, is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is focused on lithium exploration and development. The Company’s projects include McDermitt Lithium and Clayton North. The Company’s flagship project is the McDermitt Lithium Project in south-east Oregon, USA. The McDermitt Lithium Project is located in Malheur County on the Oregon-Nevada border, 35 km west of the town of McDermitt at the northern end of the McDermitt volcanic caldera. The McDermitt Lithium Project is a sediment-hosted lithium deposit. The Clayton North project is located approximately 23 kilometers north of the only producing lithium operation in the United States at Silver Peak. The project is ideally located in close proximity to the only lithium producing operation in the United States of America.

name: HIGHCOM LIMITED
businessSummary: HighCom Limited is an Australia-based international defense industry company. The Company operates through two divisions: HighCom Armor and HighCom Technology. HighCom Armor division designs, manufactures, and supplies global military, law enforcement, and first responder customers with world-class, advanced personal protection ballistic products and solutions for body armor, ballistic helmets, and composite armor panels & platform structures. HighCom Technology division supplies Australian Defence and Security Agencies with world-leading small uncrewed arial systems (SUAS) and sensor payloads, and provides local program, project and engineering management, systems integration, maintenance, composite repairs, and logistics support services. Its HighCom Armor also designs, develops, tests, manufactures, and distributes dozens of National Institute of Justice (NIJ) compliant hard and soft armor products, as well as other composite armor panels and complex curved items.

name: GLOBAL URANIUM AND ENRICHMENT LTD
businessSummary: Global Uranium and Enrichment Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in providing exposure to not only uranium exploration and development but the uranium enrichment space. The Company is focused on developing a portfolio of advanced, high-grade uranium assets in uranium districts in the United States and Canada, and has established a cornerstone position in Ubaryon, an Australian uranium enrichment technology. Its asset portfolio includes Pine Ridge Uranium Project, Tallahassee Uranium Project, Athabasca Basin Projects, Ubaryon Investment, Maybell Uranium Project, and Rattler Uranium Project. Its Athabasca Basin Projects include a portfolio of six exploration assets in the Athabasca basin, Canada, such as Middle Lake, Newnham Lake, Perch, Lazy Edward Bay, Kelic Lake, and Argo. The Tallahassee Uranium Project is located in central Colorado, United States, approximately 140 kilometers (km) southwest of Denver and 30 km northwest of Canon City.

name: MANY PEAKS MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Many Peaks Minerals Limited is an Australia-based gold and copper focused exploration company. The Company’s projects include Ferke Gold Project, Odienne Gold Project, Oume Gold Project, Baga Gold Project and Aska Lithium Project. The Ferke Gold Project is located in northern Cote d’Ivoire covering 300 square kilometers (km2) in a granted exploration permit license. The Odienne Project is located in northwest Cote D’Ivoire and comprises two granted exploration permits covering a combined area of 758 km2. The Baga Gold Project is a 644 km2 land holding comprised of two recently granted exploration permits located 150 kilometers (km) east of the city of Bouake, Cote d’Ivoire and situated 80 km west of the border with Ghana. The Oume Gold Project is located in south-central Cote D’Ivoire. The Aska Lithium Project is located proximal to Newfoundland’s southwest coast over 45 km east of Cape Ray.

name: BRAZILIAN RARE EARTHS LTD
businessSummary: Brazilian Rare Earths Limited is a mineral exploration company. The principal activity of the Company is exploring for rare earth elements and other critical minerals in the Rocha da Rocha province in the state of Bahia in Brazil. Its segments include Brazil exploration and Corporate. The Rocha da Rocha Project is located in the state of Bahia in Northeast Brazil and is located over 200 kilometers (km) from a port. The Rocha da Rocha Project is comprised over 267 granted exploration permits registered with Brazil’s National Mining Agency. The Rare earths and critical minerals province with multiple discoveries over one million acres of highly prospective exploration ground. The Amargosa Bauxite-Gallium Project is an advanced exploration stage asset, located in the Tier one mining jurisdiction of Bahia, Brazil. The Sulista Project area is located over 80 km southwest of the Monte Alto project.

name: IONDRIVE LIMITED
businessSummary: Iondrive Limited is an Australia-based battery recycling technology company. The Company primarily focuses on developing and commercializing solutions for lithium battery recycling. Its Hydrometallurgical Battery Recycling project employs a patented, environmentally safe solvent to gently separate critical components from used batteries, providing a safer and more efficient alternative to traditional methods. The Company holds licenses from the University of Adelaide for next-generation battery technologies, including an enhanced performance non-flammable lithium-ion based battery and a low-cost, high-cycle life water-based battery. The Company holds prospective Lithium, rare-earth elements (REE) and precious metals projects. Its lithium projects include Samguen Li Project and Seobyeok Li Project, which has two highly prospective REE projects, including the Jangnam REE Project comprising 10 exploration license applications covering 24.7 square kilo meters (km2).

name: KALI METALS LTD.
businessSummary: Kali Metals Limited is an Australia-based lithium focused exploration company. The Company is engaged in minerals exploration with a focus on lithium, gold, tin and critical minerals. Its portfolio of assets includes Pilbara Projects: include DOM’s Hill Project, Marble Bar Project, and Pear Creek Project; Southern Lachlan Fold Belt Projects; include Jingellic Project and Tallangatta Project, and Higginsville Lithium District. Its DOM’s Hill Project comprises 125 square kilometers (km2) is located in the East Pilbara region of Western Australia and is 110 kilometers (km) southeast of Port Hedland and 52 km northwest of Marble Bar. The 100% owned Pear Creek Project consists of three exploration licences and is located between the DOM’s Hill Project and the Marble Bar Project in the East Pilbara region of Western Australia, approximately 140 km southeast of Port Hedland and 60 km northwest of Marble Bar. Its Jingellic Project is situated in southern New South Wales.

name: ARTICORE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Articore Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates the global online marketplaces, Redbubble.com, TeePublic.com and Dashery.com. These marketplaces facilitate artists’ design and sale of a range of products printed with the creators’ artwork to their customers worldwide. The products are produced and shipped by third party service providers, such as product manufacturers, printers and shipping companies referred to as fulfillers. The Company sells uncommon designs, everyday products, such as apparel, stationery, housewares, bags, and wall arts. Its segments include Redbubble and TeePublic. Redbubble and TeePublic segments are online marketplaces for print on demand products. The Redbubble product range includes clothing, stickers, phone cases, wall art, home & living, kids and babies, accessories, stationery and office, and gifts. Republic is a marketplace for independent creators to sell the merchandise bearing their art.

name: NOVIQTECH LIMITED
businessSummary: NoviqTech Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in development and delivery of carbon reporting and guarantee of origin solutions. The Company leverages artificial intelligence and distributed ledger technology to offer trusted solutions for supply chain reporting, carbon emissions tracking, and guarantee of origin. Through its platforms, the Company supports organizations worldwide in making data-driven decisions and driving sustainable growth. It consists of two brands, Carbon Central and NoviqAI. Carbon Central empowers businesses to seamlessly integrate carbon reporting, tokenization, or guarantee of origin initiatives into their operations. Its platform provides a comprehensive, adaptable solution designed to empower businesses to manage their sustainability projects, track emissions and energy use in real-time. NoviqAI offers end-to-end transparency and confirmation of product authenticity and processes throughout the entire value chain.

name: NEWMONT CORP CDI
businessSummary: Newmont Corporation is a gold company and a producer of copper, zinc, lead, and silver with operations and/or assets in the Africa, Australia, Latin America & Caribbean, North America, and Papua New Guinea regions. The Company's operations include Brucejack, Red Chris, Penasquito, Merian, Cerro Negro, Yanacocha, Boddington, Tanami, Cadia, Lihir, Ahafo, and NGM. The Brucejack operation includes four mining leases and six core mineral claims which cover 8,169 acres (3,306 hectares) and 337 mineral claims covering 298,795 acres (120,918 hectares). The Red Chris operation includes five mining leases which cover 12,703 acres and 199 mineral claims, encompassing an area of 164,903 acres (66,734 hectares). Penasquito includes 20 mining concessions for operations comprising 113,231 acres (45,823 hectares) and 60 mining concessions for exploration of 107,456 acres (43,486 hectares). The Merian operation includes one right of exploitation encompassing an area of 41,687 acres (16,870 hectares).

name: ALGORAE PHARMACEUTICALS LIMITED
businessSummary: Algorae Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based artificial-intelligence (AI) enabled drug discovery and development company. The Company is actively engaged in expanding its therapeutic pipeline using a proprietary artificial intelligence (AI) drug discovery and development platform, known as Algorae Operating System (AlgoraeOS). The AI platform leverages extensive medical and scientific databases from various disciplines within an advanced system at the intersection of AI and pharmaceutical research. By employing machine learning, deep learning, and neural networks, the AlgoraeOS is focused on uncovering synergistic fixed dose drug combinations that lead to the development of effective treatments for any medical condition. It is also focused on advancing its drug candidates, which include AI-116 for the treatment of neurodegenerative disorders and/or dementia, and AI-168 for cardiovascular disease and NTCELL for Parkinson’s disease.

name: EMBARK EARLY EDUCATION LTD
businessSummary: Embark Early Education Limited is an Australia-based provider of early childhood education and care. The Company owns and operates approximately 38 childcare centers with 3,476 licensed places. The Company operates over 23 centers in Queensland, 11 in Victoria, Two in New South Wales, One in Tasmania and One South Australia. It operates under brands such as Roseberry House, Brighthouse, Cubby care, Haven Early Learning, Kitiwah Place, Little Zebra, Carltron House, Moreton Drive Early Learning Centre, Youngstars Early Learning Centre, Kidsplay & learning centre, Edens Landing Childrens Centre, Imagination Garden, AppleBerries, Little Peanuts, and Peanut Kids.

name: REDOX LTD
businessSummary: Redox Limited is a global chemical, ingredient and raw material distributor focused on specialty and commodity products. The Company is focused on a variety of markets, including food and beverage, personal care, human health, animal health and nutrition, crop production and protection, detergents, water treatment, surface coatings, plastics and foam, rubber, mining, oil and gas, metals, building and construction, textile and leather, and lubricants. In the food and beverage market, it focuses on antioxidants, proteins and fibers, acidity regulators, vitamins, sweeteners, and other products. In the personal care market, it focuses on solvents, sunscreen, haircare products, among others. In the detergent market, it focuses on activated carbon, acetone, ammonium sulphate, butanol, calcium chloride, and other products. In the water treatment market, it focuses on swimming pool salt, water softening salt and others. It markets a range of over 1000 specialty and commodity products.

name: QORIA LTD
businessSummary: Qoria Limited is an Australia-based technology company. The principal activities of the Company include sales and distribution, marketing, and customer support of its suite of cyber safety products and services. It has four operating segments, being the provision of educational technology services in Australia and New Zealand (ANZ), the United Kingdom (UK), the United States of America (USA), and Europe. It offers a suite of cyber safety products and services through its key distribution channels, as well as the provision of ongoing customer support services and continual improvement and upgrade of its services. Its comprehensive suite of child digital safety and wellbeing solutions, including real-time technologies, advanced reporting and education and training programs. Its solutions include classroom Internet management, granular reporting, proactive risk monitoring, real-time wellbeing, student education, staff engagement, parental empowerment, content filtering, and firewall.

name: CALMER CO INTERNATIONAL LTD
businessSummary: The Calmer Co. International Limited is a health and wellness company with operations in Australia, Fiji, and the United States. The Company produces nutraceutical and functional beverage products designed to reduce anxiety, promote relaxation, improve sleep, and support sports recovery and performance. It works with farmers to source kava and hemp that is processed into active extracts for use in nutraceutical products, business to business (B2B) supply, and beverage applications. Its product range includes drinking powders, natural and flavored kava shots, concentrates and capsules, sold under the brands Fiji Kava, Taki Mai, and Danodan Hempworks. The Taki Mai and Fiji Kava brands are focused on expanding the distribution of kava as a natural alternative to alcohol and to synthetic sleep and anti-anxiety medicines. Its Danodan brand offers a patented range of certified organic tinctures and topicals, sold throughout the United States and online for relaxation, sleep, and recovery.

name: FUTURE BATTERY MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Future Battery Minerals Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company. The Company is focused on its gold and lithium projects in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. Its projects include Kangaroo Hills Lithium Project (KHLP), Miriam Lithium Project, Kalgoorlie North project, Saints Nickel Project, Leinster Nickel Project, and Arden Project. The KHLP is located in the Goldfield region of Western Australia, over 17 kilometers (km) south of the township of Coolgardie. The Miriam Lithium Project is located immediately north and contiguous with KHLP. It comprises thirteen discrete outcropping pegmatites across an area of over 6.0 km by 1.5 km. The Kalgoorlie North project consists of one exploration lease application totaling an area of 27.9 square kilometers (km2) located 45km north-east of Kalgoorlie. The Leinster Nickel Project is located over 40km southeast of the township of Leinster and approximately 60km north-northwest of Leonora in Western Australia.

name: UNICO SILVER LTD
businessSummary: Unico Silver Limited (USL) is a silver development company. The Company is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of mineral deposits. The Company operates in two segments: Australia projects and Argentina projects. It is focused on making new discoveries in the Santa Cruz gold and silver province, southern Argentina. It holds interest in a portfolio of exploration properties in the mining-friendly Santa Cruz province of Argentina, which is host to numerous multi-million-ounce precious metal epithermal vein deposits, such as Cerro Negro and Cerro Vanguardia. Its flagship Cerro Leon project is located within the mining friendly Santa Cruz province of Argentina, about 130 kilometers (km) northwest of the port town San Julian. Cerro Leon is made of two adjacent epithermal vein fields: the green fields Conserrat project (80% USL) and advanced Pinguino project, located 15 km apart. Its Pinguino Silver Gold Project is made up of four contiguous mining titles totaling 9,966 hectares.

name: WARRIEDAR RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Warriedar Resources Limited is an Australia-based advanced gold and copper exploration company. The Company’s projects include Western Australian Projects and Nevada Projects. Western Australian Projects include Golden Range and Fields Find Projects in Western Australia sit in the middle of the highly active Murchison exploration and mining province, which hosts substantial deposits of both gold and base metals. Fields Find project is located to the east of the Golden Range, and is also called a polymetallic enigma, given that it contains elevated levels of nickel, copper and gold. Nevada Projects includes Big Springs Gold Project in Nevada, United States, which is adjacent to First Majestic Silver’s Jerritt Canyon Gold Mine Complex. Big Springs Project has an existing resource base of approximately one Moz gold within a granted mining license, surrounded by approximately 93 square kilometers (km2) of prime exploration ground prospective for Carlin-style gold.

name: ALLIANCE NICKEL LTD
businessSummary: Alliance Nickel Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company with nickel and cobalt interests in Western Australia. The Company is focused on becoming a supplier of battery-grade nickel and cobalt products. The Company's principal asset is its 100% owned NiWest Nickel Cobalt Project situated adjacent to Glencore's Murrin Murrin Operations. NiWest hosts undeveloped nickel laterite resources in Australia, estimated to contain approximately 85.2 million tons averaging 1.03% Nickel and 0.06% Cobalt. The region is recognized for its well-established nickel and cobalt production and is well serviced with infrastructure such as public rail linked to ports, gas pipeline, arterial roads, optic fiber communications, a commercial airstrip and nearby mining towns.

name: TIVAN LTD
businessSummary: Tivan Limited is a critical minerals company primarily involved in the exploration, evaluation and development of mineral assets within Australia. The Company's Speewah Fluorite Project and Speewah Vanadium Project are located 100 km south of the port of Wyndham, and 110 km south-west of Kununurra, in the Kimberley region of north-east Western Australia. Its Sandover fluorite project is 8 km from its Sandover AI Project, which is located 100 km north of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory, covering an area of over 8,000 km2 across two contiguous blocks of exploration licenses within the Northern Arunta Pegmatite Province. Its Molyhil Tungsten-Molybdenum project is located over 220 km north-east of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory. Its Turiscai Project is a copper-gold exploration project, located over 40 km south of Dili, the capital of Timor-Leste. Covering an area of 344 km2, the project is situated within a geological setting that hosts significant copper-gold deposits.

name: BATTERY AGE MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Battery Age Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based mineral exploration company focused on the exploration of battery minerals, such as lithium, copper, germanium and zinc in Canada, Morocco and Austria. Its segments include Australia, Canada, Argentina, Austria, and Morocco. The Company's projects include Falcon Lake Lithium Project, Jesse Lake Lithium Project, Bleiberg Zinc Lead Germanium Project, Tidili Copper Gold Project, King Tut Project and Bloom Lake Project. The Falcon Lake Lithium Project covers a total 5,100 hectares (51 square kilometers (km2)) of ground in the east-west trending Caribou Lake-O’Sullivan Greenstone Belt which extends eastward into the Onamon-Tashota Greenstone Belt. The Jesse Lake Lithium Project comprises around 54 single cell mining claims, covering an area of over 1,350 hectares, in Ontario, Canada. The Bleiberg Project comprises 116 claims totalling an area of 65.8 km2, located approximately 130 km south of the city of Salzburg in southern Austria.

name: GREEN CRITICAL MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Green Critical Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company's projects include McIntosh - Graphite, Red Fox Resources - Base Metal, Hawkwood - nickel-copper-platinum group elements (Ni-Cu-PGE), North Barkly Project - Rare Earths and Torrington - Tungsten and Topaz. The Company holds earn-in rights for up to 80% of the advanced High Quality McIntosh Graphite Project. It holds an approximately 30.4% interest in Red Fox Resources Pty Ltd (Red Fox). The North Barkly Project is comprised of three Exploration License applications (33128/29/30) totaling approximately 1,950 square kilometers (sq km) over pastoral lands on the Barkly tablelands 500 kilometers (km) northwest of Mount Isa and 150 km southwest of McArthur River. The Boulia project area is comprised of two EPM applications - Canary (EPMA 28251) and Prickly Bush (EPMA 28253). The Company has an advanced Topaz-Tungsten project near Torrington, 60 km SSW of Tenterfield.

name: STREAMPLAY STUDIO LTD
businessSummary: Streamplay Studio Limited is a provider of competitive casual gaming and e-sports technology, music and sports streaming services, and telco value-added services. The Company offers a range of entertainment solutions for its users, including the ability to stream and play games, music, and access various telco services all in one place. Its ArcadeX platform supports skills-based tournaments, series, and live matches, where subscribers compete in sponsored tournaments to establish rankings, win prizes and earn participation rewards. Its Cloud Gaming platform allows players to stream premium games to their mobile devices without any download requirements and instant access to gaming content. It focuses on delivering its product, mGames, which is an immersive gaming platform that provides a selection of captivating and interactive gaming and competitive tournament experiences to the Palauan market. Its mjamsmusic is a platform that streams music and connects users with local artists.

name: SOLVAR LTD
businessSummary: Solvar Limited is an Australia-based consumer and commercial finance company, which is engaged in providing of automotive finance. The Company operates through two segments: Australia and New Zealand. The Australia segment provides lending facilities in Australia generally based on the provision of an underlying asset as security, generally referred through a broker or distributed directly through digital channels. The New Zealand segment provides lending facilities in New Zealand generally based on the provision of an underlying asset as security, generally referred through a dealer. The Company operates through three core brands: Money3 and Automotive Financial Services in Australia and Go Car Finance in New Zealand. It offers commercial loans to small businesses and sole traders for the purchase of a vehicle or piece of equipment to support their business operations. The Company also provides strategic corporate customers with fleet funding facilities.

name: UNITH LTD
businessSummary: Unith Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the business of developing digital human software. It unifies the research and development of facial movement, deep learning, audio, machine learning and conversational design to generate the first customizable, interactive avatar of its kind. Through its platform, businesses can create their own digital humans to immerse, assist, and educate customers in real time and in multiple languages. The Company’s segments include Mobile Content - Subscription, Digital Humans and Other Segments. Mobile Content - Subscription segment provides mobile subscription-based content offering of products, such as mobile security, games and video portals via a mobile payments network and the underlying artificial intelligence (AI)-driven technology platform. The Digital Humans business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) division creates and licenses engaging, user-centric conversations in real time with AI-powered digital humans.

name: EVION GROUP NL
businessSummary: Evion Group NL. is a vertically integrated graphite developer with projects being developed in Madagascar, India and Europe. The Company holds the flagship Maniry Graphite Project which is located in Southern Madagascar. It is involved in several downstream value-added graphite processing opportunities in both India and Europe prime locations for downstream graphite product. Its three core projects include Maniry Graphite Project in Madagascar, Panthera Expandable Graphite Joint Venture in India, and Battery Anode Materials Plant in Europe. The Company holds 50% interest in the joint venture project with Metachem Manufacturing Company Pvt. Ltd. Its subsidiaries include BlackEarth Australia Pty Ltd, Madagascar Graphite Ltd, and BlackEarth Minerals Madagascar SARL.

name: PIVOTAL METALS LTD
businessSummary: Pivotal Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is an explorer and developer of mineral deposits. The principal activity of the Company is exploration for and development of copper, nickel, and platinum group metals (PGM) deposits. The Company holds the flagship Horden Lake property, which contains a joint ore reserves committee (JORC) compliant Indicated and Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate of over 27.8Mt at 1.49% copper equivalent (CuEq), comprising copper, nickel, palladium, and gold. The property is located approximately 140km north of Matagami in northwest Quebec. Horden Lake is complemented by a battery metals exploration portfolio in Canada located within the Belleterre-Angliers Greenstone Belt (BAGB) comprised of the Midrim, Laforce, Alotta and Lorraine high-grade nickel copper PGM sulfide projects in Quebec. The BAGB Project covers approximately 157 square kilometers (km2) landholding in the prospective BAGB.

name: REGION GROUP
businessSummary: Region Re Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in investment and management of shopping centers. The Company is engaged in investing in a geographically diverse portfolio of convenience-based retail centers located across Australia. Its portfolio focuses on the non-discretionary retail sector (primarily convenience retailers and grocery outlets) and is anchored by long-term leases to tenants. The Company owns and manages approximately 92 convenience-based retail properties. The Company’s properties include Albury, Annandale Central, Auburn Central, AYR (Burdekin Plaza), Bakewell, Belmont Central, Bentons Square, Blakes Crossing, Brookwater Village, Burnie Plaza, Bushland Beach, Busselton, Cabarita, Cardiff, Central Highlands (Emerald), Chancellor Park Marketplace, Claremont Plaza, Cooloola Cove, Currambine Central, Delacombe Town Centre, Drayton Central, and Bentons Square, among others.

name: GOLD HYDROGEN LTD
businessSummary: Gold Hydrogen Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in discovery and development of natural hydrogen and helium gases in a potentially extensive province in South Australia. The Company holds one granted Petroleum Exploration License (PEL) in South Australia (PEL 687) that covers approximately 75,000- square kilometers (km2) of permitted tenement on the Yorke Peninsula and Kangaroo Island in South Australia. The Company through its subsidiary hold an additional seven applications for Natural Hydrogen and Helium exploration within South Australia. The Company is also the applicant for four gas storage exploration licenses applications (GSELA) covering an area of approximately 8,000 km2 within the Yorke Peninsula portion of PEL 687 in South Australia.

name: HELIA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Helia Group Limited is a provider of Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI). It also provides tailored risk and capital management solutions. Its LMI proposition protects lenders if a homeowner defaults on a home loan and the lender is unable to recover the outstanding loan amount from the sale of the secured property. Lender's purchase LMI for risk transfer and capital management purposes. LMI provides protection to a lender to help borrowers purchase a property with a smaller deposit. LMI protects the lender against the risk of potential losses, in case they are unable to make home loan repayments, and the lender is unable to recover the outstanding loan amount from the sale of the security property. This makes loans more accessible to people who are looking to buy a home with less than 20% deposit. Home buyers have a range of flexible options for paying the LMI cost to their lender. It also offers flexible solutions to support home ownership and provide options for covering the LMI cost.

name: GREENHY2 LTD
businessSummary: GreenHy2 Limited is an Australia-based clean energy company. The Company delivers engineering solutions for renewable energy. The Company has specific expertise in solid state hydrogen storage for use in fuel cells and as hydrogen gas. Its activities include solid state hydrogen storage batteries supported by 100% renewable generation, and construction across the infrastructure, telecommunications, power, renewable energy, industrial and commercial sectors. Its products include GKN products and GKN HY2 Connect. Its GKN products include MINI with 425 kilowatt hours (kWhrs) of Storage, MEDI with two megawatt hours (MWhrs) of Storage and MEGA with four MWhrs of Storage or 250 kilograms (kg) of Hydrogen. The Company's tower systems can be stacked to achieve any size of storage required. GKN HY2 Connect, its digital platform, provides big data and artificial intelligence (AI) control and simulation creating the modelling and predictive capacity required by customers.

name: ENERGY TRANSITION MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Energy Transition Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based exploration and development company focused on developing mineral projects globally. The Company manages exploration projects in Western Europe, North America and Greenland. Its Kvanefjeld project is located in an area of southern Greenland, which has approximately one billion tons of mineral resources (JORC-compliant). The project includes various large-scale multi-element resources, including Kvanefjeld, Sorensen and Zone 3. Its Kvanefjeld project remains subject to arbitration procedures in the Arbitration Tribunal in Copenhagen. Its Villasrubias project is located in the southwest corner of the province of Salamanca, close to the Portuguese border and 33 kilometers (km) away from Ciudad Rodrigo, the district capital. Its Good Setting and Solo lithium projects in James Bay, Quebec. It also owns the Penouta tin-tantalum-niobium mine and processing facility in Galicia, Spain (Penouta Mine).

name: KINATICO LIMITED
businessSummary: Kinatico Limited is an Australia-based provider of know-your-people solutions. The Company’s solutions comprise pre-employment screening, verification services and workforce compliance management internationally. It provides real-time workforce compliance management via its core software-as-a-service RegTech solution. By combining certifications and compliance data with business policy and legislative requirements, the Company enables scalable compliance monitoring spanning preemployment to real-time requirements related to geolocation, roles and tasks applicable across a range of industries. The Company also provides a range of pre-employment checks via its CVCheck solution. This is delivered via its proprietary technology platform, which includes an employment screening and verification offering. Its geographical segments include Australia and New Zealand. It serves various industries, including education, financial services, energy and resources, and insurance.

name: FINDI LTD
businessSummary: Findi Limited is an Australia-based financial technology company. The Company is a non-bank ATM operator. Its areas of focus include Payments and Digital Banking, Findi ATM Network, and Bank ATM Network. Under Payments and Digital Banking area of focus, it provides last-mile payments and digital banking solutions through its network of merchants facilitating banking and insurance services, utility payments, money transfers, e-commerce and train and airline tickets payments. Under Findi ATM Network area of focus, it operates its own branded network of ATMs which is integrated with its payments and digital banking merchant business. Under Bank ATM Network area of focus, it provides transaction payment solutions for both public and private sector banks across India with complete end-to-end ATM transaction processing and managed services capabilities. The Company is a Pan-Indian ATM operator and operates more than 14,000 branded ATMs and more than 189,000 active merchant outlets.

name: ATLANTIC LITHIUM LTD.
businessSummary: Atlantic Lithium Limited is an Australia-based lithium-focused exploration and development company with assets in Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire, West Africa. The Company is advancing its Ewoyaa Lithium Project. In Ghana the Company holds approximately 509 square kilometers (km2) of granted and under application tenure. In Cote d'Ivoire, the Company holds approximately 771 km2 of granted and under application tenure. The Ewoyaa Lithium project is located within one kilometer (km) of the Takoradi Accra N1 highway, 110 km from the Takoradi deep-sea port and adjacent to grid power. In Cote d'Ivoire, the Company through its wholly owned subsidiary Khaleesi Resources SARL, holds exploration permits over the highly prospective Rubino and Agboville exploration licenses, which cover over 374.18 km2 and 396.89 km2, respectively.

name: NT MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: NT Minerals Limited is an Australia-based exploration and minerals development company with projects in the Northern Territory and Western Australia. The Company is focusing on copper, bulk commodities and strategic minerals. Its projects include Redbank Project, Millers Creek Project, Wollogorang Project, Finniss River Critical Minerals Project and Twin Peaks Project. The Redbank Project is located in the east McArthur Basin and spans an area from the Northern Territory/Queensland border west towards Glencore’s McArthur Mine. The Millers Creek Project is located approximately 700 kilometers (kms) northwest of Adelaide and consists of real estate situated between mining companies OZ Minerals to the north and FMG to the east. The Wollogorang Project is located in the southeast McArthur Basin. The Finniss River Critical Minerals Project is located 70 kms southwest of Darwin. The Twin Peaks Project is 520 kilometers north of Perth and approximately 200 kms northeast of Geraldton.

name: CENTRAL IRON ORE LTD
businessSummary: Central Iron Ore Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company, which is engaged in the search for gold in Australia. The Company is mainly focused on exploration in the Darlot Region of Western Australia, within 10 kilometers from the Red 5 Darlot Mine. The Company's projects include South Darlot Gold Project, British King Mine and Red 5 Joint Venture. The Red 5 Joint Venture project’s 20-hole drill program, which included approximately 17 reverse circulations for 706 meters and three diamond core holes for 141 meters include a suite of narrow vein, high gold grades of up to 124.4 grams per ton. The British King Gold Mine is approximately five kilometers south-west from the Darlot Mine. The Company’s South Darlot Gold Project area is located approximately 320 km northwest of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia and includes British King Mine. Its tenement holdings cover an area of approximately 324 square kilometers.

name: WOODSIDE ENERGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd is a global energy company. Its segments include Australia, International and Marketing. The Australia segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of liquefied natural gas, pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids in Australia. International segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids in international jurisdictions outside of Australia. Marketing segment is engaged in the marketing, shipping and trading of its oil and gas portfolio. Its projects include Pluto LNG, the North West Shelf Project, Macedon, Sangomar, the lower carbon ammonia project in Texas, and others. It holds an interest in Woodside Louisiana LNG, which is an under-construction LNG production and export terminal in Calcasieu Parish, Louisiana. The Sangomar, containing both oil and gas, is located 100 kilometers south of Dakar.

name: PROVARIS ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Provaris Energy Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in developing a portfolio of integrated green hydrogen projects for the regional trade of Asia and Europe, leveraging its compressed hydrogen bulk storage and carrier. The Company is principally involved in the development of hydrogen production, storage and transport projects, including its 100% owned Tiwi Islands Hydrogen Export project in the Northern Territory, Australia, and export projects under collaboration with local Norway Partners. It is engaged in the approval and development processes for its H2Neo carrier and H2Leo Storage Barge for the marine storage and transportation of compressed hydrogen. Its projects include FjordH2 Project with Norwegian Hydrogen AS, Afjord Project with Gen2 Energy AS, Tiwi H2 Project and HyEnergy Export Project. The Company's carriers include H2Neo with approximately 430-ton and H2Max with 2,000-ton capacity, and the H2Leo storage barge with a capacity range of 300 - 600 ton.

name: SOUTHERN PALLADIUM LTD
businessSummary: Southern Palladium Limited is an Australia-based platinum group metal (PGM) company. The main business activity of the Company is the advancement of Bengwenyama PGM project, located in South Africa. The Bengwenyama Project is a large shallow advanced exploration and pre-development PGM opportunity situated on the Eastern Limb of the Bushveld Complex and south of the Anglo Platinum Modikwa property. The Project lies approximately five km west of the village of Steelpoort, 20 kilometers (km) west-southwest of the larger town of Burgersfort, and 250 km east-northeast of Pretoria. The Project has a total areal extent of 5,279.74 hectares. Two economic reefs, the Merensky and UG2 reefs, occur on the Properties, which extend from surface to a depth of 1,100 meters over 10 km downdip. Both these reefs are primary economic deposits exploited by other platinum mining companies for PGMs and base metals in the region.

name: LOTTERY CORPORATION
businessSummary: The Lottery Corporation Limited is a lottery and Keno operator with a portfolio of brands and games. It is engaged in the provision of gaming and entertainment services. The Lott is the brand that unites the Company’s licensed lottery operations in all states and territories of Australia, except Western Australia, under license arrangements. Its game brands include Set for Life, Powerball, Oz Lotto, TattsLotto, Saturday Lotto, Gold Lotto, X Lotto, Weekday Windfall lottery, Lucky Lotteries, Lotto Strike, Super 66, Instant Scratch-Its and Keno. Its lotteries products can be purchased in news agencies, convenience stores and other retail outlets, online at thelott.com and via its mobile app. Keno is an interactive social game played predominantly in venues, such as pubs, clubs, hotels, casinos and TABs, with games typically running every three minutes. It operates a Keno distribution network of 3,354 venues in New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland and the Australian Capital Territory.

name: ZIP CO LIMITED
businessSummary: Zip Co Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in digital retail finance and payments. The principal activity of the Company is offering point-of-sale credit and digital payment services to customers and providing integrated retail finance solutions to merchants, both online and in-store. The Company offers unsecured loans to consumers, both online and in-store, through the provision of line of credit and installment products. The Company provides services in four countries around the world, in Australia and New Zealand (ANZ), the United States and Canada (Americas). The Company’s segments include ANZ, Americas, Zip Business and Corporate. ANZ segment offers installment or line of credit products to consumers in Australia and New Zealand. Americas segment offers installment products to customers in the United States and Canada. Zip Business segment provides unsecured loans and lines of credit to small and medium-sized businesses in Australia and New Zealand.

name: CHRYSOS CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Chrysos Corporation Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is a provider of novel assay services to the global mining industry through its proprietary PhotonAssay technology. Assaying involves the analysis of ore or other materials to determine the presence and quantity of valuable metals or other constituents. The PhotonAssay technology causes excitation of atomic nuclei allowing enhanced analysis of gold, silver, copper and other elements in approximately two minutes. PhotonAssay units are deployed to mine sites and independent laboratories which provide assay services. The Company's segments include Asia Pacific (APAC), Europe, Middle East, and Americas. Its subsidiaries include Chrysos AU Operations Pty Ltd, Chrysos UK Services Ltd, PhotonAssay Mexico S.A. DE C.V, PhotonAssay Operations, and PhotonAssay New Zealand Pty Ltd, among others.

name: NEURIZER LTD
businessSummary: NeuRizer Ltd is an Australia-based carbon neutral company. The Company is focused on the development of its NeuRizer Urea Project (NRUP). The NRUP project is located in South Australia, 550 kilometers north of Adelaide. The Company produces approximately one million tons per annum (Mtpa) of urea fertilizer with the potential to increase to two Mtpa.

name: FINDER ENERGY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Finder Energy Holdings Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration company. The Company is involved in oil and gas exploration in the Northwest Shelf in Western Australia and the North Sea in the United Kingdom. Its portfolio comprises a mix of development, appraisal and exploration projects, namely North West Shelf - Australia, North Sea - the United Kingdom, and Timor-Leste - North West Shelf. Its Northwest Shelf in Western Australia permits include AC/P 61 and WA-547-P. The AC/P 61 exploration permit is located within the prolific Vulcan Sub-basin. It holds 100% equity in exploration permit WA-547-P comprising an area of around 7,260 square kilometers (km2). It has 76% interest in PSC 19-11, located within the prolific Laminaria High oil province in the Bonaparte Basin. Its North Sea permits include P2610, P2530, P2655 and P2656. The P2530 permit has an area of approximately 576 km2.

name: MICROBA LIFE SCIENCES LTD
businessSummary: Microba Life Sciences Limited is an Australia-based precision microbiome company. The Company is engaged in the discovery and development of therapeutics for chronic diseases and delivering gut microbiome testing services globally to researchers, clinicians, and consumers. It offers various platforms, such as Analysis, Discovery, and Therapeutic. Its Analysis platform is an end-to-end solution for microbiome analysis. Using advanced metagenomic sequencing technology and proprietary bioinformatic tools, it provides precise and comprehensive measurement of the human gut microbiome. Its Discovery Platform is a global databank for microbiome discovery and develops new health solutions from the gut microbiome. Its Therapeutic platform is a repeatable platform for microbial therapeutic leads. Its Diagnostic testing products are MetaXplore and MetaPanel. MetaXplore offers a comprehensive gastrointestinal testing solution. MetaPanel is an advanced gastrointestinal pathogen detection panel.

name: IPERIONX LTD
businessSummary: IperionX Limited is a titanium metal and critical materials company that uses patented metal technologies to produce high performance titanium alloys, from titanium minerals or scrap titanium, at lower energy and carbon emissions. It is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of its mineral properties in the United States and the research, development, and commercialization of its associated metals technologies to support an integrated titanium processing operation. It holds a 100% interest in the Titan Project, covering more than 11,000 acres of mineral properties in western Tennessee, which it considers prospective for critical minerals including titanium, rare earth elements, silica sand and zircon. Its titanium metal and critical minerals are essential for advanced United States industries including space, aerospace, defense, consumer electronics, hydrogen, electric vehicles and additive manufacturing. It has commissioned hydrogen assisted metallothermic reduction furnace.

name: FRONTIER ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Frontier Energy Limited is an Australia-based renewable energy company. The Company is developing the Waroona Renewable Energy Project, which is located strategically in the heart of the South-West of Western Australia. The Project is approximately 120 kilometers (km) south of the Perth, eight kilometers southwest of the Waroona townsite and five kilometers east of Forrest Highway, the traffic route linking Perth and Bunbury. The Company controls 868 hectares (ha) of adjoining freehold land whilst also having approvals in place for a connection onto the WA electricity network (SWIS) with a terminal adjacent to the Project. The nearby 330kV Landwehr Electricity Terminal will allow the Company to sell electricity via the Southwest Interconnected System. It is developing renewable energy hubs, incorporating multiple value-adding initiatives, including batteries and green hydrogen, with a full renewable energy potential of more than one GW based on connection capacity.

name: MORELLA CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Morella Corporation Limited is an Australia-based exploration and resource development company focused on lithium and battery minerals. The Company is engaged in exploration activities on multiple lithium project opportunities located in Tier 1 mining jurisdictions in both Australia and the United States. Its projects include Mallina Lithium Project and Fish Lake Valley Lithium Project. The Mallina Lithium Project is located within the Mallina Basin, a 70 kilometer (km) wide basin that extends in an east-west orientation for almost 140 km along the central Pilbara coast. The Mallina Lithium Project tenements are centered on the Pilgangoora, Wodgina, Tabba Tabba and Mallina mining districts. The Fish Lake Valley Lithium Project is over 60 km from the town of Tonopah and is an equal distance (around 280km) to the major Nevada cities of Las Vegas and Reno. Its tenements include E45/2778, COC 182 (Area 3) - Catanduanes, COC 200 (Area 4) - Rapu-Rapu and COC 202 (Area 17) - Surigao del Sur.

name: INTELLIGENT MONITORING GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Intelligent Monitoring Group Limited is an Australia-based security company. The Company is engaged in providing provision of security, monitoring and risk management services in Australia. The Company operates through three segments: Monitoring, Protective services and Service. Its Monitoring segment provides security alarm and video monitoring. Its Protective services segment provides security guarding and personnel services. Its Service segment provides alarm and video installation and maintenance services. The Company’s personal solutions include monitored security systems, intruder detection, safe at home, safe haven, high net worth family security and security response. The Company’s business solutions include business security, security and risk consultancy, monitored security systems, security personnel and case studies.

name: GREENX METALS LTD
businessSummary: GreenX Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in exploration and evaluation of Arctic Rift Copper (ARC) and the defense of its rights at Debiensko and Jan Karski projects through the Claim. The ARC project is the copper-silver bearing Discovery Zone, located at the northern end of Neergaard Dal. The Discovery Zone comprises at least three parallel breccia faults trending northwest-southeast. The mineralization is expressed in two main forms, within which there are two sub-forms: Breccia bound, and Stratiform. In Breccia bound, mineralization occurs in thin quartz-dominated veining within the fault breccia and contains disseminated copper sulfides. In Stratiform, mineralization occurs immediately adjacent to the faults and comprises lenses and blebs of chalcocite and bornite measuring from mm-scale to 15 centimeters long. The ARC mineral system is known to be prospective for basalt, fault, and sedimentary rock-hosted copper mineralization.

name: EDU HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: EDU Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates tertiary education businesses, with a focus on health and community services fields of study. The Company operates through two segments: Australian Learning Group (ALG) and Ikon Institute of Australia (Ikon). ALG offers a range of accredited certificate and diploma level courses in health and community services related fields of study from campuses across Australia. Ikon is a private institute of higher education (HE) in creative therapies, counseling and psychotherapy and early childhood education. Ikon has a focus around authentically connecting with and developing the potential in people. Ikon’s HE courses include Diploma of Arts Therapy, Bachelor of Arts Therapy, Diploma of Counseling and Psychotherapy, Bachelor of Counseling and Psychotherapy, Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Bachelor of Early Childhood Education.

name: CUFE LTD
businessSummary: CuFe Ltd is a mineral producer and explorer with holdings, or rights or interests in, various tenements prospective for copper, lithium, gold, rare earths and iron ore located in Western Australia and the Northern Territory. Its main focus is its mature iron ore assets in Western Australia (JWD Iron Ore Project) and the Northern Territory (Yarram Iron Ore Project) and copper asset (Tennant Creek Copper Project). The JWD Iron Ore Project is located in Western Australia, 700 kilometers from Geraldton Port. It holds a 50% interest in Gold Valley Iron and Manganese Pty Ltd, the owner of the iron ore rights over the Yarram project. It owns 55% interest in the Tennant Creek project. It owns West Arunta (niobium) and Tambourah (lithium) exploration tenure. It owns North Dam Lithium and Rare Earths Project- E 15/1495, M15/1893 (certain mineral rights), and M15/1495. Its other projects include Bryah Basin Joint Venture Projects, Morck Well Project, Peak Hill Project and Mt Ida Iron Ore Project.

name: WA1 RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: WA1 Resources Ltd is an Australia-based mineral company. The Company is primarily involved in the mineral exploration and project development in Western Australia. The Company owns 100% of two exploration projects in Western Australian. The West Arunta Project, which contains the Luni niobium deposit, is located in Western Australia, approximately 590 kilometers (km) west of Alice Springs. The Madura Project tenements are located approximately 540 km east of Kalgoorlie, with noncontiguous tenements extending to near the south coast of Western Australia. The exploration project comprises seven granted Exploration Licenses and two Exploration License applications in the Madura Province of southeastern Western Australia.

name: EV RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: EV Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in advancing critical minerals exploration in the Americas. Its projects include Los Lirios Antimony Project , Khartoum Project, and Don Enrique Copper Project. Its other investments include La Cienega Copper Project in Arizona, Coyote Creek Antimony Project, Utah, and Yanamina Gold and Silver project in Ancash State, Peru. It is focused on the high-grade Los Lirios Antimony Mine project in Oaxaca, Mexico, which consists of approximately three licenses covering 1,552 hectares (ha). The Khartoum Project consists of over five exploration permits covering an area of 98 square kilometers (km2). The Don Enrique Project consists of approximately four licenses covering 1,800ha, in an area 21km northeast of Jauja, and over 260km from the Nation’s capital, Lima. It also holds 100% ownership of the Dollar Antimony Project, which is comprises of over eight unpatented mining claims totaling 160 acres.

name: INOVIQ LTD
businessSummary: INOVIQ Ltd is an Australia-based biotechnology company developing diagnostics and therapeutics for cancer. The Company's commercialized products include EXO-NET exosome isolation technology for biomarker discovery and diagnostics development, and the hTERT test as an adjunct test for bladder cancer. The Company is also advancing clinical-stage diagnostics for the detection and monitoring of ovarian and breast cancers, and early-stage exosome therapeutics for solid tumors.

name: FELIX GOLD LTD
