businessSummary: Felix Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold discovery company operating in the Tintina Gold Province. The Company’s flagship asset is a substantial landholding in a Fairbanks Gold District, where historical gold production exceeds 16 million ounces. The Company holds an interest in gold projects within the Fairbanks District of the Tintina Gold Province. The Company's projects include Treasure Creek Project, Grant-Ester Project and NE Fairbanks Project. The Treasure Creek Project area consists of over 236 Alaska State Mining Claims that cover 11,573 hectares (ha). The Grant-Ester Project is comprised of over 154 Alaska State mining claims that total 3,397 ha. The NE Fairbanks Project is comprised of over 326 Alaska State mining claims that total 14,637 ha located approximately 25 kilometers (km) to the Northeast of the city of Fairbanks. The MHT Project comprises Alaskan State Mining claims of over 6,203 acres located only 20 km north of mining and logistics hub, Fairbanks City.

name: AUSTIN METALS LLD
businessSummary: Austin Metals Limited is an Australia-based base and precious metals explorer focused on the prolific mining districts of Broken Hill, the Cobar Basin and the Lachlan Fold Belt of New South Wales, Australia. Its flagship Austin Gold Project is located in the highly prospective Murchison greenstone province of Western Australia, directly adjacent to the Cue Gold Project owned by Musgrave Minerals Limited, which includes the high-grade Break of Day Deposit and Starlight discovery. The Company has also secured a significant ground holding of the Tallering Greenstone belt in the prolific Murchison gold mining region of Western Australia located approximately 150 kilometers (km) south of the Golden Grove deposit. Its Ashburton Project comprises around eight granted exploration tenements and one granted prospecting license covering 510 square kilometers (km2) and is located on Ashburton Downs Station, approximately 75 km SW of Paraburdoo in the Pilbara Region of Western Australia.

name: MEEKA GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Meeka Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration and development assessment of gold assets in Western Australia. The Company is focused on the exploration and evaluation of its mineral assets at the Murchison Gold Project and Circle Valley Project. Its flagship Murchison Gold Project covers approximately 281 square kilometers (km2) combined landholding in the prolific Murchison Gold Fields and hosts a 1.2-million-ounce (Moz) mineral resource. The Murchison Gold Project covers the northern extent of the highly prospective Mount Magnet and Youanmi Shear Zones in the prolific Murchison Gold Fields of Western Australia. In addition, the Company owns the Circle Valley Project, which covers approximately 222 km2 in the Albany-Fraser Mobile Belt. The Circle Valley Project is located 85 km south of Norseman in Western Australia.

name: WRKR LTD
businessSummary: Wrkr Ltd is an Australia-based regulatory technology company. The Company’s principal activities consist of operating Wrkr PLATFORM, Wrkr PAY, and Wrkr READY. The Wrkr PLATFORM is a cloud-based compliance platform for handling messaging with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO), SuperStream, Single Touch Payroll (STP) 2.0, Pan-European Public Procurement Online (PEPPOL), Standard Business Reporting (SBR) and State authorities, and orchestrating payment processing for worker pay and super contributions for fund administrators. Its Wrkr PAY is a superannuation gateway and clearing house and payment handling solution for processing of employee pay and super contributions for payrolls and superfunds. Its Wrkr READY is a white label employee onboarding solution to manage the compliant onboarding of full-time and casual workers.

name: VIRIDIS MINING AND MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Viridis Mining and Minerals Limited is an Australia-based resource exploration and development company with assets in Brazil, Canada and Australia. The Company’s projects comprises, the Colossus Project, which the Company considers to be prospective for Rare Earth Elements; the South Kitikmeot Project and the Boddington West Project, which are prospective for gold; The Bindoon Project, which the Company considers to be prospective for nickel, copper and platinum group elements, and the Poochera and Smoky Projects, which the Company considers to be prospective for kaolin-halloysite. The Colossus IAC REE Project is located in the State of Minas Gerais, Brazil and comprises a total of over 228.62km2 licenses within and around the prolific Pocos De Caldas Alkaline Complex. The South Kitikmeot Gold Project consists of seven properties (Hiqiniq, Ujaraq, Gold Bug, Esker, Bling, Uist and Qannituq) covering over 11,448 hectares within the Back River of Western Nunavut, Canada.

name: ATTURRA LTD
businessSummary: Atturra Limited is an Australia-based advisory and technology solutions provider. The Company is engaged in the technology business, providing a range of enterprise advisory, consulting, information technology (IT) services and solutions with a focus on local government, utilities, education, defense, federal government, financial services, and manufacturing industries. Its advisory and consulting capabilities across three areas include strategy and preparation, design and implementation, and realization and improvement. Its business applications capabilities include enterprise resource planning, process optimization for local government, professional services, safety solutions, and others. Its data and integration capabilities include intelligent integration and automation, enterprise data management, advanced analytics, middleware modernization, and others. Its managed services include cloud, modern workplace, among others.

name: BIRDDOG TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: BirdDog Technology Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the development and manufacturing of hardware and software video technology solutions industry. The principal activities of the Company consist of development and manufacturing of global video technology that enhances the quality, speed and flexibility of video through a range of solutions, augmented with network device interface (NDI). These solutions are then sold through a network of distributors and resellers and direct, to individuals and organizations within professional video, corporate audio-visual (AV) and digital signage markets who demand broadcast quality video content. The Company’s product portfolio includes converters, camera lines, AV section, software, and accessories. The Company’s NDI Bridge transports complete NDI streams over local area network (LAN), wide area network (WAN) or public Internet. Its NDI Audio Direct makes audio-over-IP available for software-based audio applications.

name: IPD GROUP LTD
businessSummary: IPD Group Ltd is an Australia-based automation and electrical distributor. The Company's Products division is engaged in the sale of electrical infrastructure products to customers, including switchboard manufacturers, electrical wholesalers, electrical contractors, power utilities, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and system integrators. Within the division there are five categories of products: power distribution, industrial and motor control, automation and industrial communication, power monitoring, and hazardous area equipment. In addition to selling products, it provides a range of value-added services, including custom assembly, sourcing, engineering design, technical compliance, procurement, transport, storage, regulatory management, technical support, packaging, labelling, inventory management and delivery. Its Services division is engaged in provision of services, including installation and commissioning, calibration and testing, maintenance, and repairs, and others.

name: SHAPE AUSTRALIA CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: SHAPE Australia Corporation Limited is an Australia-based national fitout and construction services specialist. The Company’s principal activities are construction, fitout, and refurbishment of commercial properties. Its capabilities include fitout and refurbishment, design and build, facade remediation, new build, modular construction, and aftercare and facilities maintenance. It offers across a range of industries, including commercial, government, defense, education, retail, healthcare, aged care, and hotels & hospitality. The Company provides fitout and refurbishment services, including high-end office fitout and a boutique hotel. It specializes in new build projects that include both traditional new construction and extensions to existing buildings. The Company also provides national facilities maintenance to clients with a property portfolio, large or small, to ensure the safe and operation of buildings, equipment, and systems.

name: NICO RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Nico Resources Limited is an Australia-based company focusing on Australian nickel projects. It owns a 100% legal and beneficial interest in nickel assets consisting of the Wingellina (WA) and Claude Hills (SA) nickel projects. The Wingellina Nickel-Cobalt Project (Wingellina) is an undeveloped nickel-cobalt project in Australia and part of NiCo Resources Central Musgrave Project (CMP), which straddles the triple-point of the Western Australia, Northern Territory and South Australia borders. The CMP has a Mineral Resource of approximately two million tons of nickel and 154,000 tons of cobalt. The Project covers approximately 1,756 square kilometers (km2) of the mid-Proterozoic Musgrave Block, an east-west trending belt of granulite-gneiss basement rocks approximately 500 kilometers long. The Company’s Claude Hills Project is located approximately 30 kilometers (km) to the east of Wingellina.

name: GROUP 6 METALS LLD
businessSummary: Group 6 Metals Limited is an Australia-based resource exploration and development company. The Company is focused on producing high-grade tungsten concentrate from its 100%-owned Dolphin Mine located on King Island, Tasmania. The Dolphin Tungsten Mine is located near the town of Grassy on the south-east coast of King Island, the most western large island in the Bass Strait between Victoria and Tasmania. The Dolphin Tungsten Mine hosts the highest-grade tungsten deposit of size in the western world. Scheelite (tungsten) within the Dolphin mining area occurs within carbonate-rich Mine Series rocks in close proximity to the Grassy Granite and against controlling faults. The Dolphin Tungsten Project has contracted to construct a processing plant on site with an annual capacity of 400,000 tons of feed ore. The Company holds the exploration license EL19/2001 at Grassy, King Island (63 square kilometers) and mining lease CML 2080P/M at Grassy, King Island (566 hectares).

name: FALCON METALS LTD
businessSummary: Falcon Metals Limited is a mineral exploration company. Its projects include the Pyramid Hill Gold Project, Mount Jackson Project, and Farrelly Mineral Sands Project. Its joint venture projects include Viking Project Joint Venture and Hawkstone Project Joint Venture. The Pyramid Hill Gold Project covers an area of more than 7,000 square kilometers predominately in the Bendigo region of Victoria. The Mt Jackson project area is located at the northern end of the Southern Cross Belt where it converges with the Koolyanobbing Shear Zone. The 100%-owned Farrelly Mineral Sands Project is located about 80 kilometers (km) northwest of Bendigo, near the town of Boort in Victoria. The Viking Project Joint Venture is located approximately 30 km east of the regional township of Norseman. The project consists of one granted exploration license (E63/1963) and one license application (E63/1994). The Hawkstone Project Joint Venture is located in the emerging West Kimberley magmatic nickel province.

name: AMERICAN WEST METALS LTD
businessSummary: American West Metals Limited is an Australia-based clean energy mining company. The Company is focused on the discovery and development of base metal mineral deposits in North America. Its projects include Storm Copper Project, Seal Project, West Desert, and Copper Warrior. The Storm Copper Project is located on Somerset Island, Nunavut, Canada and spans approximately 2,200 square kilometers in Polaris mineral district. The West Desert project is located in west-central Utah, over 160 kilometers (km) southwest of Salt Lake City. The Copper Warrior project is located over 45 km south of Moab, Utah, within the Paradox Basin, with sedimentary sequence of Vanadium, Uranium and Copper. The project lies along the Lisbon Valley Fault and within the same geological units as the Lisbon Valley copper mine. The Seal Project is located within the Storm Project claims, at the northern end of a regionally extensive zinc horizon.

name: KELSIAN GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Kelsian Group Limited is an integrated multi-modal transport provider and tourism operator. Its segments include Marine and Tourism, Australian Bus and International Bus. Marine and Tourism segment operates vehicle and passenger ferry services, barging, coach tours and package holidays, lunch, dinner and charter cruises and accommodation facilities throughout Australia. Australian Bus segment operates metropolitan public bus services on behalf of governments in Sydney, Melbourne, Perth, Adelaide, and Stradbroke Island, as well as regional and remote bus services supporting the resources sector in Western Australia. It also operates charter bus services in the Northern Territory. International Bus segment operates or participates in the operation of metropolitan public bus services on behalf of governments in the United Kingdom, Channel Islands and Singapore. It also operates charter motorcoaches for corporates, local and federal government and educational sectors in the United States.

name: CLOSE THE LOOP LTD
businessSummary: Close the Loop Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in creating products and packaging that include recyclable and made-from recycled content. The Company collects, sorts, reclaims and reuses resources that would otherwise go to landfills. The Company is primarily involved in collection and recycling of electronic equipment, imaging consumables, plastics, paper and cartons and any other activity incidental thereto as well as providing premium and innovative flexible and carton packaging, flexographic print packaging, seafood packaging, storage solutions and the supply of thermal paper and associated paper products. Its products include RFlex and TonerPlas. It offers end-to-end solutions across packaging and consumables to a variety of markets, with advanced innovation in product development, as well as end-of-life take-back and recovery systems for complex commodities to reduce waste to landfills. It also offers battery collection and recycling services.

name: IREN LIMITED
businessSummary: IREN Limited is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates data centers powered by 100% renewable energy. Its facilities are optimized for Bitcoin mining, artificial intelligence (AI) cloud services, and other power-dense compute. Its data center mining facilities are in Canal Flats, Mackenzie, Prince George and Childress. Bitcoin Mining provides security to the Bitcoin network. Al Cloud Services provides cloud compute to Al customers, approximately 1,896 NVIDIA H100 and H200 GPUs. Its Canal Flats facility is in the Canadian Rockies, 100 kilometers (km) from Cranbrook regional airport and 500km east of Vancouver. Its facility is in Prince George, the city in northern British Columbia, located 500 km north of Vancouver. Its facility is located in Childress County, Texas, over 250 miles northwest of Dallas and in close proximity to multiple wind and solar generating facilities in the region. Its Childress operations comprise 200 Mega Watt of operating data centers.

name: VENTIA SERVICES GROUP LLD
businessSummary: Ventia Services Group Limited is an infrastructure services provider in Australia and New Zealand. Its segments include defence and social infrastructure, infrastructure services, telecommunications, and transport. The defence and social infrastructure segment provides maintenance and support services to customers operating across defense, social infrastructure, housing and community, local government, and critical infrastructure. The infrastructure services segment supports the ongoing operation and maintenance of infrastructure. This segment also provides environmental remediation and rehabilitation services. The telecommunications segment provides end-to-end service capabilities that span design, supply, minor construction, installation, commissioning and maintenance of telecommunications networks and infrastructure. The transport segment provides maintenance, project delivery and technology solutions to owners and operators of road, motorway, tunnel, and rail networks.

name: SITEMINDER LTD
businessSummary: SiteMinder Limited offers a commerce platform for accommodation providers. It has two core subscription offerings in the form of the SiteMinder Platform (Platform) and Little Hotelier. The Platform supports accommodation providers with key tools to grow reservations through direct customer acquisition, distribution through global and regional travel channels, get insights on their performance and eliminate manual processes. Little Hotelier serves as an all-in-one technology solution for smaller accommodation providers by combining the Platform’s capabilities with a property management system (PMS), which has been designed specifically for their needs, to assist them with front-desk and other business operational functions. Its solutions are designed to support accommodation providers of all types and sizes in managing every stage of their customers’ journey. Its offices are in Bangalore, Bangkok, Barcelona, Berlin, Dallas, Galway, London, Sydney, Mexico City, and Manila.

name: LARVOTTO RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Larvotto Resources Limited is a resources company. The Company is advancing its portfolio of in-demand minerals projects, including the 1.7Moz AuEq high-grade Hillgrove Gold-Antimony Project in New South Wales (NSW), the Mt Isa copper, gold, and cobalt project adjacent to Mt Isa townsite in Queensland, the Eyre multi-metals and lithium project located 30 kilometers (km) east of Norseman in Western Australia and a gold exploration project at Ohakuri in New Zealand's North Island. The Hillgrove Gold-Antimony Project covers 254 square kilometers and comprises six key mining areas within 48 granted mining licenses. Mt Isa Project is located in northwest Queensland, Australia. The Eyre Project is located approximately 600 km east of Perth, Western Australia, and 200 km south of the major mining center of Kalgoorlie and covers an area of approximately 580 square kilometers. The Ohakuri Project is in the north island of New Zealand and consists of a partially explored epithermal gold system.

name: WINSOME RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Winsome Resources Limited is an Australia-based lithium focused exploration and development company with four project areas in Quebec, Canada. Its 100% owned projects include Cancet Lithium Project, Adina Lithium Project, Sirmac-Clappier Project, and Tilly Project. Its advanced projects - Cancet and Adina, provide shallow, high-grade lithium deposits. The Cancet Lithium Project comprises a substantial landholding of over 200 square kilometers (km2). The Sirmac-Clapier Project is located 30 kilometers (km) from the provincial road infrastructure between the regional centers of Chibougamau and Chapais. The Tilly Projects is 100% owned hard rock lithium project that covers 47 km2. It also owns 100% of the offtake rights for lithium, cesium and tantalum from Power Metals Corp's Case Lake Project in Eastern Ontari and also owns around a 19.6% interest in Power Metals Corp. The Company has an option over the 29 claims of the Jackpot Property, immediately north of Adina.

name: JUDO CAPITAL HOLDINGS LIMITED
businessSummary: Judo Capital Holdings Limited is an Australia-based holding company of Judo Bank Pty Ltd (Judo Bank). It offers term deposits directly and through intermediaries to retail and wholesale customers, including individuals, charities, universities, government bodies, self-managed super funds (SMSFs), and corporates. All deposits are term deposits, with limited overlap between the small and medium enterprises (SMEs) lending customers and the deposit customer base. It provides business lending solutions to SMEs. Its key services include business loans, asset finance, lines of credit, residential mortgages (business loan customers), and bank guarantees. Its other subsidiaries include Judo Securitisation Warehouse Trust 2020 - 1, Judo Securitisation Trust 2020 - 2, Judo Securitisation Trust 1R, Judo Capital Holdings Limited Employee Share Trust, Judo Securitisation Trust 2022 - 1, Judo Securitisation Trust 2023 - 1, Judo Securitisation Trust 2023 - 2, and Judo Capital Markets Trust 2023 - 1.

name: VULCAN STEEL LTD
businessSummary: Vulcan Steel Limited is a New Zealand-based company engaged in the sale and distribution of steel and metal products across New Zealand and Australia. The Company’s Steel business includes distribution of hollows, bars, beams, angles, channels, unprocessed coil and plate; plate processing services such as cutting, drilling, tapping, countersinking, and folding; and coil processing including sheeting and slitting to customer specifications. It also offers steel roofing and cladding products. Its Metals business covers stainless steel products like hollows, bars, fittings, and sheets, with similar processing services, along with processing services like cutting, drilling, tapping, countersinking, folding, sheeting, and slitting of stainless coils. It also includes engineering steel, offering high-performance products and cutting services, and aluminum, distributing extruded standard and customized products, as well as third-party sheet, plate, and coil.

name: FULLY PAID UNITS STAPLED SECURITIES (RAD
businessSummary: Radiopharm Theranostics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage radiotherapeutics company developing a platform of radiopharmaceutical products for diagnostic and therapeutic applications in areas of high unmet medical need. The Company has a pipeline of highly differentiated platform technologies spanning peptides, small molecules and monoclonal antibodies for use in cancer. The clinical program includes one Phase II and three Phase I trials in a variety of solid tumor cancers including lung, breast, and brain. Its technologies include Nano-mAbs, Pivalate, AVB6 Integrin, PSA-mAb, and PTPu. Nano-mAbs is a novel radiopharmaceutical platform made using genetic engineered camelid derived single domain antibodies (sdAb) labelled with a radioisotope of therapeutic radiation. Pivalate is an 18F-FPIA radiotracer, based on a short chain carbohydrate which utilizes the early steps of fatty acid oxidation.

name: STEP ONE CLOTHING LIMITED
businessSummary: Step One Clothing Limited is an Australia-based direct-to-consumer online retailer company that offers a range of organically grown and certified, sustainable, and manufactured innerwear. The Company offers a range of underwear that suits a range of body types. It owns the designs for its innerwear and contracts the manufacturing of its products in Asia for export to warehouses in Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States. The Company's product range also includes women's underwear. The Company's sales channels include Amazon and other retailers. The Company also conceives and produces its own advertising content. Its subsidiaries include Step One Clothing Australia Pty Ltd, Step One Production Pty Ltd, Step One Clothing UK Limited, and Step One Clothing USA Inc.

name: GQG PARTNERS CDI
businessSummary: GQG Partners Inc. is a global boutique asset management firm with a focus on active equity portfolios. The Company's subsidiary is GQG Partners LLC (GQG LLC). GQG LLC is an investment adviser, which provides investment advisory and asset management services to investment funds; separately managed accounts for United States and non-United States investors; mutual funds, and other structures, including pooled investment vehicles.

name: DEVELOP GLOBAL LTD
businessSummary: Develop Global Ltd is engaged in exploration and development of base metals and mining services. The Company is also involved in operations of its underground mining services division Develop Mining Services Its segments include mining services and mining and exploration. The Company’s projects include Sulphur Springs Project, Whim Creek Joint Venture, Woodlawn Project, Pioneer Dome, and Kangan Gold Project. The Sulphur Springs project is located 144 kilometers (km) to the southeast of Port Hedland and includes the Sulphur Springs and Kangaroo Caves deposits together with tenements along the 27 km Panorama Trend that contains six advanced targets that have returned intersections of commercial grade copper and zinc. The Whim Creek Joint Venture Project is located 115 km to the southwest of Port Hedland. The Woodlawn Project is a zinc-copper-lead-gold-silver project located in the Lachlan Fold belt in New South Wales, 250 km south-west of Sydney and 40 km south of Goulburn.

name: JADE GAS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Jade Gas Holdings Limited is an Australia-based gas exploration company. The Company is focused on the coal bed methane (CBM) potential of Mongolia. The Company’s flagship project is the Coal Bed Methane gas project over the Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) area of Tavantolgoi XXXIII unconventional oil basin, (TT CBM Project). It operates and manages the TT CBM Project through its subsidiary Methane Gas Resource LLC (MGR), a joint venture (JV) company partnering with Erdenes Methane LLC (EM). It also holds two prospective CBM permits: Shivee Gobi and Eastern Gobi. Together the permits cover an area of over 18,000 square kilometers (km2) and are located within existing coal basins and near coal deposits and mines. Its Shivee Gobi permit covers an area of over 8,317 km2 and is located approximately 300 km south of Ulaanbaatar. It also holds a prospecting agreement permit over the Baruun Naran coal field (BNG Project), which is located immediately adjacent and west of its TTCBM Project.

name: GREEN TECHNOLOGY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Green Technology Metals Limited is focused on the lithium exploration and development business. The Company’s main 100% owned Ontario lithium projects comprise high-grade, hard rock spodumene assets (Seymour, Root, Junior and Wisa) and lithium exploration claims (Allison, Falcon, Gathering, Pennock and Superb) located on prospective Archean Greenstone tenure in north-west Ontario, Canada. The Seymour Project is located near the township of Armstrong and approximately 230 kilometers (km) north of the city and the port of Thunder Bay. Its Junior Lithium Project covers over 10,856 hectares and is situated within the Eastern Hub, close to the proposed Seymour mine and concentrator. The Company’s 100% owned Root Lithium Project has revealed multiple stacked LCT pegmatites, and a maiden Inferred Mineral Resource estimate of over 14.6Mt @ 1.21% lithium oxide from the McCombe and Root Bay pegmatites. Its subsidiaries include Lithium Triangle Pty Ltd and Green TM Resources (Canada) Ltd.

name: ITECH MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: iTech Minerals is a mineral exploration company exploring for and developing battery materials and critical minerals within its 100% owned Australian projects. The Company is exploring for graphite and developing the Lacroma and Campoona Graphite Deposits in South Australia and copper-gold-antimony and lithium in the Reynolds Range Project. It is focused on developing the advanced Eyre Peninsula Graphite Project in South Australia and exploring the early-stage Reynolds Range Copper-GoldProject in the Northern Territory. The Reynolds Range project consists of three exploration licenses and covers a total of over 375 square kilometers (km2) of the Aileron Province, part of the Paleoproterozoic North Australian Craton. It owns 100% of the Eyre Peninsula Graphite Project (formerly the Campoona Project). It is an emerging graphite district, and close to established energy infrastructure, transportation routes, facilities and shipping options.

name: AUSTRAL RESOURCES AUSTRALIA LIMITED
businessSummary: Austral Resources Australia Ltd is an Australia-based copper cathode producer, developer and explorer located in the Mt Isa District of northwest Queensland. The Company’s projects include Anthill Project, Lady Annie Project, Cameron River Project, and Miranda Project. The Anthill Project area lies within the Lady Annie Project, and it is located 45 kilometers (km) from the Mt Kelly processing facility. The Lady Annie Project tenements are in the Western Fold Belt of the Mount Isa Inlier. The Cameron River Project tenements lie within the Eastern Fold Belt of the Mount Isa Inlier with the northern most tenement close to the boundary with the Central Kalkadoon-Leichardt Belt. The tenements are prospective for copper, gold and rare earths. The Miranda Project tenements lie predominantly within the Central Kalkadoon-Leichardt Belt of the Mount Isa Inlier. The Company has entered into an agreement to acquire the Rocklands Copper Mine located in North-West Queensland.

name: MINERALS 260 LTD
businessSummary: Minerals 260 Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company's projects include the Moora Project, Aston Project, and Bullabulling Project. The 100%-owned Moora Project is located 140km north-east of Perth in the Wheatbelt Region of Western Australia. The Moora Project consists of three granted exploration licenses and one exploration license application registered in the name of the Company’s subsidiary, ERL (Aust) Pty Ltd, covering approximately 371 sq km. The Aston Project is located in the Gascoyne Region of Western Australia, approximately 850 km north of Perth and 100 km northeast of the township of Gascoyne Junction. The Aston Project consists of 15 granted exploration licenses and two exploration license applications. The Bullabulling Project is an undeveloped gold deposit, located 25km south-west of Coolgardie in the Western Australian Goldfields. Its subsidiaries include ERL (Aust) Pty Ltd and Minerals 260 Holdings Pty Ltd.

name: AURUM RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Aurum Resources Limited is an Australian gold exploration company focused on the discovery and development of gold projects in Cote d'Ivoire, West Africa. The Company's projects include Napie Gold Project and Boundiali Gold Project. The Napie Gold Project covers approximately 224 square kilometers (km2) and consists of the Tchaga and Gogbala deposits located on the Napie shear. The Napie Gold Project is a shallow, open pittable, high-grade resource with a maximum resource depth between 160 meters and 195 meters across the two deposits and has access to hydroelectricity, bitumen road and water. It has 100% ownership of the Korhogo Project (manganese discovery) and the Brobo Project (lithium/rare earths). The Boundiali Gold Project is comprised of four neighboring exploration tenements: Boundiali Minex Tenement PR0893, Boundiali DS tenement PR808, Boundiali South tenement PR414 and Boundiali North tenement PR283. The Company owns and runs approximately eight diamond drill rigs.

name: WIDGIE NICKEL LTD
businessSummary: Win Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company holding 350 square kilometers (km2) of granted tenure in the Southern Goldfields and Kimberley regions of Western Australia. The Company possesses gold, nickel, and lithium resources within its tenure. Its Mt Edwards Nickel and Faraday-Trainline Lithium Projects are situated near Widgiemooltha, approximately 80 kilometer (km) south of the regional center of Kalgoorlie-Boulder and 30 km south of Kambalda. The Mt Edwards Nickel Project is a collection of eleven nickel deposits. The Faraday-Trainline Lithium Project is shovel-ready with an approved small mining proposal. The Butchers Creek Gold Project is located 30 km southeast of Halls Creek in the Kimberley region of Western Australia. The Company also owns the Radio Gold Mine, which is located 8 km north of Bullfinch, approximately 40 km northwest of Southern Cross and about 400 km east of Perth in the Yilgarn region of Western Australia.

name: HAWSONS IRON LTD
businessSummary: Hawsons Iron Limited is an Australia-based iron ore developer and producer. The Company is focused on developing its flagship Hawsons Iron Project near Broken Hill into a provider of high-quality iron ore products for the global steel industry. The Hawsons Iron Project is situated 60 kilometers (km) southwest of Broken Hill, New South Wales, Australia in the Braemar Iron Province. It is potentially capable of producing the highest-grade iron product (70% Fe). The Company's tenements include Redan, Burta, Little Peak, Wonga and Hawsons Iron, which cover approximately 180 square kilometers (km2), 290 km2, 41 km2, and 287 km2 respectively.

name: BEAMTREE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Beamtree Holdings Limited is an artificial intelligence decision support and data company. The Company provides automation technology and data analytics that support health care providers. The Company's segments include Diagnostic Technology, Clinical Decision Support, Coding Assistance and Data Quality, and Analytics and Knowledge Networks. The Diagnostic Technology which is engaged in Enabling the effective delivery of diagnostic services as they underpin the future of health and personalized medicine, and its product includes RippleDown. The Clinical Decision Support which is engaged in combining human and artificial expertise together to enhance decisions that improve care, value and experience and its product includes Ainsoff Deterioration Index. The Coding Assistance and Data Quality segment products are PICQ, RISQ, and Integrated Coding Platform. The Analytics and Knowledge Networks segment is engaged in combining data analytics solutions with peer-to-peer alliances.

name: LI S ENERGY LIMITED
businessSummary: Li-S Energy Limited is engaged in development and commercialization a new type of battery based on Lithium-Sulphur (Li-S) and using boron nitride nanotubes (BNNT) as both an integrated protective insulation layer and a component in composite anodes, which allows faster charging rates and increased battery cycle life. The Company produces batteries in pouch, cylinder and flexible battery formats to address the needs of partners and prospective customers who manufacture drones, electric cars, electric trucks, other electric vehicles, space and other applications. Its lithium sulfur batteries are lighter, cleaner and greener and deliver more than twice the energy density of lithium ion. BNNT is an advanced nanomaterial with physical properties. It takes advantage of its physical strength, thermal conductivity and electrical resistance as well as some electrochemical properties to enhance its lithium sulfur and lithium metal batteries.

name: MIDAS MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Midas Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based junior mineral exploration company with a primary focus on copper and precious metals. The Company’s projects include the Newington Project, Challa Gold, Nickel-Copper-PGE Project, Reid-Aylmer Project, Otavi Project, and Greenbush Lithium Project. The Reid-Aylmer Project has mineral claims totaling about 157 square kilometers (km2) located northeast of Yellowknife, in the Northwest Territories of Canada. The Greenbush lithium project covers over 102km2 and is located 12km east of Highway 599, about 95km north of Savant Lake and 70km south of Pickle Lake. The Newington Lithium-Gold Project has 212km2 of tenements located at the north end of the Southern Cross greenstone belt. Its Challa Gold, Nickel-Copper-PGE encompasses over two exploration licenses and three license applications totaling 860 km2. It has an agreement to acquire the 1,776km2 high-grade Otavi Copper Project and holds an option over the 194km2 South Otavi Project in Namibia.

name: IRIS METALS LTD
businessSummary: IRIS Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company has a suite of assets, which are highly prospective for hard rock lithium located in South Dakota, United States. Its projects include The Beecher Project, Tin Mountain and Leonora Project. The Beecher Project is located seven km from the township of Custer in the Black Hills of South Dakota. The Project is located on a 15-acre patented claim, surrounded by over 20,300 hectares (ha) of bureau of land management (BLM) staked claims. The Beecher Project includes the Longview, Beecher and Black Diamond mines. The Tin Mountain Mine includes crystals of lithium spodumene visible in the underground drives. The Leonora Project is located over 240 kilometers (km) north of Kalgoorlie. The Kookynie Project, located over 60 km southwest of Leonora.

name: CLARITY PHARMACEUTICALS LTD
businessSummary: Clarity Pharmaceuticals Ltd is an Australia-based clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company. The Company is focused on developing theranostic (therapy and imaging) products, based on its platform SAR Technology. It is progressing seven clinical trials with its three key products, SARTATE, SAR-bisPSMA, and SAR-Bombesin. SARTATE is developed for diagnosing, staging, and treating cancers that express somatostatin receptor 2 (SSTR2), including neuroblastoma and neuroendocrine tumors (NETs). SAR-bisPSMA is developed for diagnosing, staging, and treating cancers that express Prostate Specific Membrane Antigen (PSMA). SAR-Bombesin is developed for identifying and selecting patients for subsequent treatment of cancers that express a specific receptor called the gastrin releasing peptide receptor (GRPr), including breast cancer and prostate cancer. It has a diverse range of products in clinical trials, which address both large indications as well as rare and orphan indications of cancer.

name: AXP ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: AXP Energy Limited is engaged in oil and gas exploration, development and production in the United States of America. The Company’s segments are geographic areas within its Oil & Gas basins in the United States: Denver-Julesburg (DJ) Basin, and Corporate and Other. The Denver-Julesburg Basin assets are located in the historic Florence oilfield and are geologically defined by the Canon City Embayment. This area is an extension of the prolific DJ Basin which spans across Colorado, Kansas, Montana and Wyoming. Formations of interest in this area include the Pierre Shale, Niobrara Shale, Codell Sandstone and Greenhorn Limestone. It has 24 operating oil and gas wells at its Pathfinder Field.

name: WELLNEX LIFE LTD
businessSummary: Wellnex Life Limited is an Australia-based health and wellness company, which is engaged in the consumer healthcare business. The Company is developing, licensing, and marketing registered products and brands to customers in the healthcare market segment. Its brands include Wakey Wakey, Nighty Night, Pharmacy Own, Mr Bright and Pain Away. The Company has intellectual property (IP)-licensing agreements with Haleon and Arrotex. The Company, through a joint venture with OneLife Botanical and Chemist Warehouse for SAS-B medicinal cannabis under the Wellness Life brand. It has launched a Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA)-approved soft gel liquid paracetamol product in a jointly owned brand with retailer Chemist Warehouse under the Wagner Liquigesic brand. Mr Bright is a natural tooth whitening brand, which is being sold in the United Kingdom through Boots and TJ Maxx retail stores and is available online domestically.

name: KUNIKO LIMITED
businessSummary: Kuniko Limited is an Australia-based company, focused on the development of copper, nickel, cobalt and lithium projects in Scandinavia. Its key assets are located in Norway, which include Ertelien Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project,Ringerike Battery Metals Project, Skuterud Cobalt Project, Undal-Nyberget Copper Project, Vaga Copper Project and Gullvag Copper-Zinc Project. Its Sweden projects include Vane Ryr Pegmatite Project and Stora Flaten Greisen Project. The Ringerike Project covers over 405 square kilometers (km2) of exploration licenses in southern Norway, located 40 kilometers (kms) northwest of Oslo. Its Ertelien Project has over 10 km2 exclusive exploration license area. The Skuterud Cobalt Project has around 90 sq kms exclusive license area. The Undal-Nyberget Copper Project is located in the prolific Roros Copper region. The Vane Ryr Pegmatite Project is considered a potential site for LCT pegmatite-hosted mineralization.

name: PEXA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: PEXA Group Limited operates a digital property settlements platform company. Its segments are Exchange, Digital Solutions, and International. The exchange segment includes the operation of an Electronic Lodgement Network in Australia, across New South Wales, Victoria, Western Australia, South Australia, Queensland, the Australian Capital Territory and Tasmania. The Digital Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of property-related analytics and digital solutions to financial institutions, governments, property developers and related professionals, and practitioners in Australia. The International segment is engaged in the provision of digitalized property registration and settlement, and related services, in overseas Torrens Title jurisdictions, initially in the United Kingdom. Its Exchange facilitates providing a secure online workspace through which the parties preparing a property transaction collaborate to prepare for settlement, increasing the transparency between parties.

name: LUMOS DIAGNOSTICS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Lumos Diagnostics Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company specializes in point-of-care (POC) diagnostic test technology to help healthcare professionals diagnose and manage medical conditions. The Company offers customized assay development and manufacturing services for POC tests and digital reader platforms. It also directly develops, manufactures, and commercializes Lumos-branded POC tests that target infectious and inflammatory diseases. Its Products offering is based on developing and commercializing its own suite of POC diagnostic products which are primarily focused on the diagnosis and management of infectious diseases. These include FebriDx, a POC test for detecting and differentiating viral and bacterial respiratory infections, and ViraDx, a rapid point-of-care diagnostic product that simultaneously tests for acute respiratory infections caused by the COVID-19, influenza A, and influenza B viruses. It manages the full development program for POC assays.

name: BLUEBET HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: betr Entertainment Limited, formerly BlueBet Holdings Limited, is a pure-play digital wagering operator focusing solely on the Australian wagering market. The Company is engaged in offering sports and racing betting products and services to online and telephone clients through its advanced online wagering platform and mobile applications. The Company is powered by a highly scalable proprietary cloud-based technology platform that can also be delivered as a white-labelled technology solution for business to business (B2B) partners. The betr brand offers betting services for various sporting events, including American football, Australian rules, baseball, basketball, cricket, golf, ice hockey, motor racing, rugby league, rugby union, soccer, tennis, and others. Its product line includes horse racing, greyhound racing, and harness racing, among others.

name: 29METALS LTD
businessSummary: 29Metals Limited is a copper-focused base and precious metals mining company with producing and exploration assets in Australia and Chile. The principal activities of the Company are mining and mineral production, mineral concentrate sales, mineral exploration and development, and ancillary services. Its Golden Grove mine is a volcanic-hosted massive sulfide (VHMS) geological system. Its exploration activities include the Redhill exploration project located in Chile. The Redhill comprises historic mine site with significant known high grade copper, gold and silver mineralization and is a regional tenement position in Chile. The Company holds 100% of the Redhill exploration project. Its Cutters Cove project at Redhill includes the mineralized veins of Cristina, Gorda, Angelica, Cutters, and Franceses, and the Ingleses target area, as well as a regional tenement package within the surrounding province.

name: ELEVATE URANIUM LTD
businessSummary: Elevate Uranium Ltd is an Australia-based uranium exploration company. The Company is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of its mineral tenements in Namibia and Australia and enhancing the value through the potential application of the Company’s patented U-pgrade uranium beneficiation process to those mineral tenements. Its Namibia tenements include Koppies, Hirabeb, Namib IV, Marenica Uranium Project, and Capri. The Company holds around ten active tenements in the Erongo Region of Namibia, each at varying stages of exploration advancement. The Koppies tenement (EPL 6987) is located in the Namib Desert region of Namibia. The Capri tenement (EPL 7508) is located in the Erongo uranium province in Namibia. In Australia, the Company's tenements consist of the 100% owned Angela, Thatcher Soak, Oobagooma and Minerva Projects and holdings in the Bigrlyi, Malawiri, Walbiri and Areva Joint Ventures. The Angela tenement (EL25758) is a sandstone-hosted roll-front type uranium deposit.

name: MT MONGER RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Metallium Limited, formerly MTM Critical Metals Limited, is engaged in recovering critical and precious metals from mineral concentrates and high-grade waste streams. The Company is focused on deploying its patented Flash Joule Heating (FJH) technology for strategic metals recovery in the United States. The FJH process enables single-step extraction of critical, strategic, and precious metals, including antimony, gallium, germanium, indium, gold, and rare earths, from electronic waste and mineral concentrates, without smelting or acids. It also owns gold and rare-earth element projects in Canada and Australia, which include the Pomme Project, East Laverton Gold Project, Mt Monger Gold Project and West Arunta Project. The Pomme Project, located in Quebec, Canada, consists of over 43 mineral claims, covering approximately 2,400 hectares. The East Laverton Project covers over 1,900 square kilometers (km2) in the prolific Eastern Goldfields region of Western Australia.

name: ENDEAVOUR GROUP
businessSummary: Endeavour Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the retail drinks and hotels business. The Company’s segments include Retail, Hotels, and Other. The Retail segment is engaged in procurement and manufacturing of drinks for sale to customers in Australia. Its Hotels segment is engaged in provision of hotels-related goods and services, including food and drinks, accommodation, entertainment, and gaming in Australia. Its Other segment consists of various Company support functions, including corporate costs. Its brands include ALH, BWS, Dan Murphy's, endeavourX, Jimmy Brings, LANGTONS, MixIn, Paragon Wine Estates, and Pinnacle Drinks. It operates over 1,726 stores under the Dan Murphy’s and BWS brands, as well as Pinnacle Drinks, which creates and manages the Company’s portfolio of exclusive brands. It operates over 354 hotels, including food and drinks, accommodation, entertainment and gaming operations.

name: HARTSHEAD RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Hartshead Resources NL is an oil and gas exploration and development company. The Company has an interest in the Seaward Production License P2607 (60% owned RockRose Energy/40% Hartshead), comprising of five contiguous blocks (48/15c, 49/6c, 49/11c, 49/12d and 49/17b) which contain four existing gas fields in the United Kingdom Southern Gas Basin totaling approximately 440.5 billion cubic feet (Bcf) of 2C Contingent Resources. Its license area covers approximately 729.5 square kilometers. The license contains multiple gas fields and prospects, which are divided into three phases for workstreams and operations. Its Phase I consists of the Somerville and Anning Gas Fields. Its Phase II includes the Hodgkin and Lovelace Gas Fields. Its Phase III includes an exploration portfolio of new prospect inventory totaling approximately 14 prospects and leads with unrisked 2U Prospective Resources of 344 Bcf.

name: CAMPLIFY HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Camplify Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company that operates peer-to-peer digital marketplace platforms connecting recreational vehicle (RV) owners to hirers. The Company’s platform delivers a seamless and transparent experience for consumers (potential RV hirers) to connect with RV owners and SMEs with a fleet of RVs. Its segments include Hire, Membership and Other. It has a global family of RV rental marketplace brands. The brands include Camplify, PaulCamper, and MyWay. The Company provides a range of caravans, motorhomes, camper trailers and campervans for hire via the respective platforms. MyWay provides insurance solutions to RV marketplace customers, and PaulCamper is a peer-to-peer van-sharing platform connecting van owners with travelers. It operates in seven key markets, such as Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Spain, Germany, the Netherlands, and Austria. Its subsidiaries include Camplify Co (Australia) Pty Ltd, Camplify Co (NZ) Limited, and others.

name: SWOOP HOLDINGS LTD.
businessSummary: Swoop Holdings Limited is an Australia-based provider of data and voice services to wholesale, business and residential customers with a focus on its own fiber and fixed wireless infrastructure. The Company’s network is designed and scaled to deliver flexible telecom network services. The principal activities of the Company include fixed wireless access, as well as wholesale transit services to other Internet service providers (ISPs) and telecommunications companies; Internet and telecommunication services to small and medium-sized enterprises; fixed wireless broadband services to residential customers; services over the national broadband network (NBN) fixed line and fixed wireless networks to customers who cannot connect to the Company’s fixed wireless network; and fiber network management and construction. It also offers mobile virtual network services through Moose Mobile. Moose Mobile provides over 111,000 mobile services on the Optus Network to customers across Australia.

name: CLEAN TEQ WATER LTD
businessSummary: Clean TeQ Water Limited is an Australia-based water treatment company. It is a global technology company, specializing in providing economic and environmentally sustainable solutions to address critical issues related to freshwater scarcity, mine tailings, and metal recovery. Its technology solutions include desalination, nutrient removal, zero liquid discharge and hardness removal. Its core markets include water and wastewater recycling, lithium production, and the remining and rehabilitation of mine tailings. Its technologies include CIF (continuous ionic filtration), HIROX (ultra-high recovery RO), DESALX (membrane free desalination), BIOCLENS (lens encapsulated bacteria), BIONEX (complete nutrient removal), and EVAPX (low energy evaporation and crystallization), among others. Its solutions include ammonia removal, boron removal, hardness removal, sulphate removal, uranium removal, and others. It has a presence in locations, including Melbourne, Perth, Darwin, Beijing, and others.

name: BARTON GOLD HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Barton Gold Holdings Limited is an Australia-based gold developer. The Company is focused on the production of 150,000ozpa with 2.1Moz Au & 3.1Moz Ag JORC Mineral Resources (78.9Mt @ 0.85 g/t Au), brownfield mines, and 100% ownership of the single gold mill in the Gawler Craton of South Australia. Its projects include Challenger Gold Project, Tarcoola Gold Project, Tunkillia Gold Project and Wudinna Gold Project. The Challenger Project is located approximately 730 kilometers (km) northwest of Adelaide, South Australia and about 130 km northwest of the Tarcoola Project. It comprises the Challenger Mine, the Challenger Mill, a mine village and associated infrastructure. The Tunkillia Project is located about 70 km S/SE of the Tarcoola Project on a 1,360 square kilometer (km2) tenement package which hosts a 1.5Moz Au JORC Mineral Resource Estimate. The Tarcoola Project is located over 70km N/NW of the Tunkillia Project on about 1,640 km2 of tenements.

name: SOUTH HARZ POTASH LIMITED
businessSummary: South Harz Potash Limited is a potash exploration and development company with its flagship project located in the South Harz Potash District region of Germany, midway between Frankfurt and Berlin. The Company specializes in the development of potash mining projects. It holds three perpetual potash mining licenses, Ohmgebirge, Ebeleben and Muhlhausen-Nohra, and two potash exploration licenses, Kullstedt and Grafentonna, covering a total area of over 659 square kilometers (km2). The Ohmgebirge Project is located at the north-western extent of the South Harz sedimentary basin approximately 30 kilometers (km) west of Sondershausen and 65km northwest of the state capital, Erfurt. The Ebeleben mining license is in the north-western part of the Federal State of Thuringia. The Muhlhausen-Kullstedt area combines the southern portion of the Muhlhausen-Nohra Mining License with the Kullstedt exploration License. The Nohra-Elende is the three potash fields hosted by its Muhlhausen-Nohra licenses.

name: BERSA GOLD CDI
businessSummary: Besra Gold Inc. is an Australia-based gold mining company focused on exploration and development of the Bau Goldfield in East Malaysia. The Company controls, directly and indirectly, a 98.5% interest (93.8% on an equity-adjusted basis) in the Bau Gold Project located in Sarawak, East Malaysia. Its interests in mining tenements extend across four concessional areas, collectively covering around 1,340 square kilometers (km2) of Sarawak; the Bau Gold Project (consisting of Blocks A and B), Rawan and Serian (Block C) areas. Its development activities are focused on the Jugan Project located within the Bau Gold Project. Its Jugan Project is located approximately six kilometers (kms) northeast of the Bau township. Gold is associated with sulfide (refractory) mineralization within the shale dominated lithologies of the Pedawan Formation, locally outcropping as a topographic high at Jugan Hill. Its Bekajang Project lies along a prospective trend that includes two historical gold mines.

name: DGL GROUP LIMITED
businessSummary: DGL Group Limited is a diversified industrial company offering a full-service solution from manufacturing to recycling. The company’s segments include Environmental Solutions, Chemical Manufacturing, Logistics, and Corporate. The Environmental Solutions segment focuses on resource recovery and waste management. Its core activities comprise liquid waste treatment, end-of-life lead-acid battery (ULAB) recycling, and lead smelting and refining. The Chemical Manufacturing segment produces its own range of specialty chemicals and undertakes advanced formulation and contract manufacturing on behalf of third parties. Its operations focus on deriving chemicals from complex reactions in controlled environments. The Logistics segment offers transport, logistics, and warehousing services, focusing on dangerous and hazardous goods across Australia and New Zealand. The segment also manages logistics and distribution of other goods, including food and pharmaceutical products.

name: LUNNON METALS LIMITED
businessSummary: Lunnon Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mineral resource exploration and development, with a focus on nickel and gold. The Company's principal activities are on the Kambalda Nickel Project (KNP), which features approximately 47 square kilometers of tenements in the Kambalda Nickel District. KNP is located over 570 kilometers (kms) east of Perth and 50-70 km south-southeast of Kalgoorlie, in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. KNP comprises two project areas, Foster and Baker (19 contiguous mining leases), and Silver Lake and Fisher (20 contiguous mining leases). In the Foster and Baker project, the Company holds the tenure and associated mineral rights, including nickel and the majority of gold rights. Baker deposit is over 2.5 km distance from the Foster Nickel Mine (straight line). In the Silver Lake and Fisher Project, it holds only the nickel rights and minerals directly associated with nickel. Its projects also include Jan Nickel Mine.

name: AUSTRALIAN CLINICAL LABS LIMITED
businessSummary: Australian Clinical Labs Limited is a private provider of pathology services. Its laboratories perform a range of pathology tests each year for a range of clients, including doctors, specialists, patients, hospitals, and corporate clients. It performs a range of services for doctors, patients and corporate clients, including chemical pathology, hematology, histopathology & cytopathology, serology & microbiology, allergy & immunology, molecular cancer testing, genetic carrier screening & other antenatal testing, cardiac testing services, veterinary pathology, functional pathology, and pathology services for clinical trials, among others. Its specialist services include molecular cancer services, obstetrics and gynecology, pharmacogenetic testing, gastroenterology, and hospital services. It has operations in Victoria, New South Wales, Western Australia, South Australia, Queensland, and the Northern Territory. Its SunDoctors brand provides skin cancer care services.

name: POLARIS METALS NL
businessSummary: Polymetals Resources Ltd is a mining company developing the high-grade Endeavor silver zinc lead mine within one of Australia polymetallic mineral provinces, the Cobar Basin, New South Wales, Australia. The Company’s Endeavor Silver-Zinc-Lead Mine is situated in the Cobar structural zone and is located approximately 30 kilometers (km) north of the CSA Copper Mine and 40 km north-west of Cobar in central New South Wales (NSW). The Endeavor Project covers an area of approximately 1,107 square kilometers (km2) in the northern part of the Cobar Basin located in Central Western NSW. The Company’s tenements include approximately five mining leases, three exploration licences and a pastoral lease. Its mining lease tenements include ML 158, ML 159, ML 160, ML 161, and ML 930. Its exploration license tenement includes EL 5785, EL 8583, and EL 8752.

name: TORQUE METALS LIMITED
businessSummary: Torque Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company’s projects include Paris Gold Project, New Dawn Gold Project, Edleston Gold Project, and Penzance Gold Project. Its Paris Exploration Camp is the prime asset of the Company, which covers approximately 1,200 square kilometers (km2) of land, including 16 mining licenses, two prospecting licenses and 48 exploration licenses. The Paris Gold Project mineral resource estimate3 (MRE3) includes three deposits (Paris, HHH and Observation). The Edleston Gold Project is situated in the Abitibi Belt, approximately 60km via road to the south of Timmins, Ontario, Canada. Its over 310km2 land package is surrounded by numerous processing facilities including Alamos Gold, IAMGOLD and Newmont. New Dawn’s gold potential lies in the northernmost area of the project, also known as New Dawn North. The New Dawn Gold Project comprised of approximately four exploration licenses.

name: MLG OZ LIMITED
businessSummary: MLG Oz Limited is an Australia-based integrated mining services and resource asset management company. The Company delivers tailored solutions to mining operations, primarily focused on supporting its clients’ ore processing facilities across gold, iron ore and other base metals in Western Australia and the Northern Territory. It offers a comprehensive range of services under an integrated business model, often within a single contractual framework. These include Civil & Construction, Crushing & Screening, Bulk Haulage & Site Services, and the supply of Open Pit Mining & Construction Materials from the Company’s strategically located regional quarries. Its key capabilities include building, owning, and operating models, contract crushing and screening services, as well as crusher feed and material management. Its services include construction, road maintenance, rehabilitation work, vehicle maintenance, and machinery and labor hire.

name: SUNRISE ENERGY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Sunrise Energy Metals Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the development of its Sunrise Battery Materials Complex (Sunrise Project) in New South Wales (NSW). The Sunrise Project is a supplier of battery raw materials and aluminum-scandium alloys. It is utilizing its Clean-iX resin technology for extraction and purification of a range of metals and progressing exploration activities at its other mineral tenements. Its Clean-iX Continuous Resin-In-Column is a continuous counter-current process that extracts metals from clarified leach solutions. Its Clean-iX Continuous Resin-In-Pulp is a continuous countercurrent process that directly extracts metals from leached pulps. It is advancing activities across its range of exploration assets in NSW. Its limestone exploration includes Hunters (EL9627), EL8883 Meloola and EL8833 Boona Gap, Gleninga South (EL9598) and Gleninga (EL8882). It also focused on rare earth elements exploration, which includes Minore (EL9031 and EL8961).

name: LITHIUM ENERGY LIMITED
businessSummary: Lithium Energy Limited is an Australia-based battery minerals company. The Company is engaged in the exploration and development of sustainable minerals projects. The Company's projects include Capricorn Gold-Copper Belt Project, White Plains Lithium Brine Project, Solaroz Lithium Brine Project, Burke and Corella Graphite Projects, and Mt Dromedary Natural Graphite Project. Its Capricorn Gold-Copper Belt Project (Queensland) tenements cover an area of approximately 1,795 square kilometers (km2). The Company has staked 6,870 hectares of mineral claims in Utah, United States (White Plains Lithium Brine Project). Its Solaroz Lithium Brine Project comprises eight mineral concessions totaling approximately 12,000 hectares. It holds 100% of the Mt Dromedary Natural Graphite Project. Its Burke Graphite Project comprises EPM 25443, covering approximately 6.47 km2. Its Corella Graphite Project comprises EPM 25696, covering approximately 19.41 km2. It also holds Leichhardt Crossing Tenement.

name: GLOBAL LITHIUM RESOURCES LIMITED
businessSummary: Global Lithium Resources Limited is a diversified West Australian focused mining exploration company. The Company has multiple assets in key lithium branded jurisdictions with a primary focus on the 100%-owned Manna Lithium Project in the Goldfields and the Marble Bar Lithium Project (MBLP) in the Pilbara region, Western Australia. The Manna Lithium Project is an outcropping pegmatite exploration project located approximately 100 kilometers (km) east of Kalgoorlie in the Goldfields region of Western Australia. The tenements in Manna Lithium Project include E28/2551, E28/2522, M28/414, E28/3357, E28/3359,and others. The MBLP is located approximately 150 km south-east of Port Hedland and over 15 km north-east of Marble Bar in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The tenements in MBLP include E45/4309, E45/4328, E45/4361, E45/4724, E45/4669, E45/5812, E45/5843, E45/5871, E56/5873, and E45/5869.

name: LYNCH GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Lynch Group Holdings Limited is an Australia-based vertically integrated wholesale floral company. The Company is engaged in the horticultural production and wholesale of flowers and potted plants. Its farms and warehouses cover the entire process of planting, growing, merchandising, and selling flowers and plants to supermarket chains and commercial outlets throughout Australia and China. The Company’s segments include Australia and China. The Australian segment operates a vertically integrated production farm and wholesale operation in Australia. The China segment operates a production farm and distribution operation in China, primarily supplying the domestic China market as well as the Australian segment. Its products are developed to meet a range of customer demands from gifting, personal use, and functions, and include bouquets, arrangements, and potted plants. It also specializes in small indoor potted plants that are commonly purchased for personal use and gifting.

name: GRAPHENE MANUFACTURING GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Graphene Manufacturing Group Limited is a clean-technology company. The Company seeks to offer energy-saving and energy storage solutions enabled by graphene, including those manufactured in-house via a proprietary production process. It has developed a proprietary production process to decompose natural gas (methane) into its elements, carbon (as graphene), hydrogen and some residual hydrocarbon gases. This process produces scalable, tunable and low/no-contaminant graphene suitable for use in clean-technology and other applications. The Company focuses on de-risk and developing commercial scale-up capabilities and secure market applications. In the energy-savings segment, it has focused on graphene-enhanced heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC-R) coating (or energy-saving paint), lubricants and fluids. In the energy storage segment, the Company and the University of Queensland are working to progress the research and development and commercialization of G+AI batteries.

name: EPSILON HEALTHCARE LTD
businessSummary: Epsilon Healthcare Limited is an Australia-based global healthcare and pharmaceuticals company. The Company has a diversified and vertically integrated portfolio of assets, including healthcare, pharmaceutical contract development and manufacturing and pharmacy services. The Company’s segments include Telehealth Medical Practice and Contract Development and Manufacturing. The Company owns medicinal cannabis assets, including the GMP cannabis manufacturing facility in the Southern Hemisphere (the Southport Facility) in Southport, Australia, and the Tetra Health clinic group. Its subsidiaries include Epsilon Pharma Pty Ltd, Metra Holdings Pty Ltd, Epsilon Biotech Pty Ltd, among others.

name: MARINE PRODUCE AUSTRALIA LIMITED
businessSummary: Mad Paws Holdings Limited (Mad Paws) is an Australia-based company engaged in the pet services and products business. It offers an online pet platform, making the process of owning and caring for a pet more accessible. The Company’s segments are Marketplace and e-Commerce & Subscription. The Marketplace segment offers a pet services marketplace that matches and connects pet owners seeking pet care services, such as walking, day care and grooming, with pet-sitters, walkers and other pet service providers, vetted and registered by Mad Paws. e-Commerce & Subscription segments offer various pet product verticals, including medication, over the counter pet related products, pet food and toys and treats. It offers brands such as Pet Chemist, Waggly, Dinner Bowl, Mad Paws Pet Insurance and Sash beds. Its services include Day care, Dog training, House visiting, Dog walking, Hosting, Dog grooming, Dog Boarding, and others. The Mad Paws pet ecosystem supports over 300,000 active pet owners.

name: AIRTASKER LIMITED
businessSummary: Airtasker Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of technology-enabled online marketplaces for local services, connecting people and businesses who need work done with people and businesses who want to work. The Company operates through two segments: Established Marketplaces and New Marketplaces. The operations of both segments relate to online marketplace platforms enabling users to outsource everyday tasks. The Company offers a range of tasks around the home, such as deliveries, cleaning, gardening, and handyman work to tasks for businesses like office admin, promotional work or computer and information technology support. It provides a range of creative tasks like photography, graphic design and Website and blog support. The Company offers services in various categories, such as accounting, admin, lawn care, food delivery, photographers, cleaner, carpet cleaning, plumber, locksmith, auto electricians, mechanic, delivery, bakers, wedding, and others.

name: FIREBIRD METALS LTD
businessSummary: Firebird Metals Limited is an Australia-based advanced manganese developer. The Company is focused on combining mining and downstream processing for the advancement of the electric vehicle (EV) battery sector. Its projects include Oakover Manganese Project, China Battery Grade Manganese Plant, Wandanya Project and Hill 616 Manganese Project. The Oakover Manganese Project is located approximately 85 kilometers (kms) east of Newman in the Eastern Pilbara region of Western Australia. The Hill 616 Manganese Project is located over 85 kms southeast of Newman within the Peak Hill Mineral Field. Wandanya Project consists of two exploration license applications, E46/1456 and E46/1457, which cover an area of 51 square kilometers (Km2) located in the Eastern Pilbara Region of Western Australia. Its other projects include Disraeli Manganese Project, and Midgengadge Manganese Project.

name: BOAB METALS LTD
businessSummary: Boab Metals Limited is an Australia-based base and precious metals exploration and development company. The Company’s projects include The Sorby Hills, The Manbarrum Project, and The Eight Mile Creek Project. The Company is focused on the development of its 75% owned Sorby Hills Lead-Silver-Zinc Project (Sorby Hills), located within the Kimberley Region of Western Australia. The Project is located 50 kilometers (km) from Kununurra and 150km from Wyndham Port. Its Manbarrum Project is located within the Northern Territory, 25 km east of the Company’s flagship Sorby Hills Project. Its Eight Mile Creek exploration tenements cover 206 square kilometers of relatively under-explored tenure immediately south of Sorby Hills. The Company's subsidiaries include Pacifico Holdings SAS, Pacifico Minerals Sucursal Colombia, Sorby Hills Pty Ltd, Sorby Management Pty Ltd, West Rock Resources Panama Corp., West Rock Resources Pty Ltd, and Manbarrum Pty Ltd.

name: COMPLII FINTECH SOLUTIONS LTD
businessSummary: Complii FinTech Solutions Limited provides end-to-end compliance and risk management software as a service (SaaS) platform for equity capital markets participants, from dealers / brokers, financial advisers, financial planners, wealth advisers, to listed and unlisted companies and investors. The Company has five segments: Complii segment, a financial technology platform sector; the PrimaryMarkets segment, a trading platform sector; the Advisor Solutions Group segment, an Australian Financial Service Licence (AFSL) sector; the Registry Direct segment, a share register sector, and the MIntegrity segment, a compliance consulting sector. Its products and services include registry services from inception of a corporation or trust, trading facilities whilst unlisted (pre-IPO), new capital raising (pre-IPO rounds + IPO listing + placements post listing), administration tools and shareholder services plus all the compliance controls required for those AFSL holders and their registered users.

name: BRIGHTSTAR RESOURCES LIMITED
businessSummary: Brightstar Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold development company. The Company hosts a portfolio of assets hosted in the goldfield’s region of Western Australia. The Company mainly operates the underground Second Fortune Gold Mine and the Selkirk Mining joint venture. Second Fortune is located about 75 kilometers (km) south of the Beta Deposit and the adjacent Brightstar processing infrastructure. It has mining operations at the Selkirk Deposit at the Menzies Gold project via a profit share Joint Venture with BML Ventures Pty Ltd. Its other projects include Cork Tree Well Project, Jasper Hills Gold Project, Beta Project, Alpha Project, Menzies Gold Project, Montague East Gold Project, and others. The Cork Tree Well Project is located approximately 35 km north of Laverton on the Bandya Station Road. The Beta Project is located approximately 30 km south from Laverton. Menzies Gold Project is located about 130 km north of the globally significant gold deposits of Kalgoorlie.

name: VERBREC LTD
businessSummary: Verbrec Limited is an Australia-based engineering, asset management, project delivery, operations and maintenance, training and mining technology service provider that supports customers across Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea and beyond. The Company serves the energy, infrastructure, and mining industries through their technical specialties; asset management, automation and control, pipelines, power, process plant and training, with capabilities that span across the entire life cycle of an asset. It operates through two segments: Engineering services and Training services. The Company's services include engineering, asset management, infrastructure and industry training. It provides engineering and project delivery solutions to clients. Its infrastructure services offer full lifecycle services for project delivery from inception through procurement and/or construction, commissioning, operations and maintenance. Its StacksOn product is a digital twin for stockyards.

name: PACIFIC NICKEL MINES LTD
businessSummary: Pacific Nickel Mines Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company. The principal activity of the Company is the exploration and development of mineral deposits in Solomon Islands. It is engaged in advancing two medium/high-grade nickel projects, Kolosori and Jejevo, located on Isabel Island within the Solomons. The Kolosori Nickel Project is a direct shipping ore nickel laterite project on Isabel Island in the Solomon Islands. The Jejevo Nickel Project is an advanced stage direct shipping ore nickel laterite project progressing to development located on Isabel Island in the Solomon Islands. The Company's second project, Jejevo, is 70 kilometer (km) north-west (NW) of the Kolosori Project. The Company's subsidiaries include Conrad Silver Mines Pty Ltd, Pacific Nickel Mines International Pty Ltd, Pacific Nickel Mines (SI) Limited, Sunshine Nickel Limited, and Pacific Nickel Mines Moumolu Limited, among others.

name: EQ RESOURCES LIMITED
businessSummary: EQ Resources Limited is an Australia-based tungsten mining company. The Company is focused on expanding its tungsten assets at Mt Carbine in North Queensland (Australia) and at Barruecopardo in the Salamanca Province (Spain). It also holds gold exploration licenses in New South Wales, at Panama Hat (Broken Hill) and Crow Mountain. Its Mt Carbine Tungsten Project is located 120 kilometers (km) by sealed road, north-west of Cairns in Far North Queensland. The project is on granted mining leases with power, water, tailings storage and environmental approvals in place for tungsten production and quarrying. The Mt Carbine Tungsten Project tenements include ML4867, ML4919, EPM14871, EPM14872 and EPM27394. At the Mt Carbine site, in addition to the tailing’s retreatment project and the Mt Carbine Quarries business, it is pursuing further expansion and developments, namely in relation to a sorter plant expansion for the XRT Sorter Technology and developing an underground mine.

name: ZEOTECH LTD
businessSummary: Zeotech Limited is an Australia-based mineral processing technology company. The Company develops and commercializes zeolite mineral processing technology. The Company's projects include Toondoon Kaolin project (Toondoon) and Abercorn Kaolin project. The Toondoon Kaolin Project comprises an approved mining lease (ML80126) and two exploration permits for minerals (EPM 27395 & 27866), located approximately 20 kilometers south of Mundubbera, Queensland and spans over 28,000 hectares. The Abercorn Kaolin Project comprises four contiguous exploration permits for mineral (EPM) for a total of 50 sub-blocks, comprising EPM 26837 (33 sub-blocks), EPM 26903 (4 sub-blocks), EPM 19081 (1 sub-block) and EPM 27427 (12 sub-blocks), located 20 kilometers (km) north of Eidsvold and 70 km south of Monto in the North Burnett District of south-central Queensland, spanning circa 20,000 hectares. Its portfolio of zeolite synthesis technologies can produce a range of targeted grades and products.

name: QUEENSLAND PACIFIC METALS LTD
businessSummary: QPM Energy Limited, formerly Queensland Pacific Metals Limited, is an Australia-based company. The Company operates an integrated energy business comprising gas production, processing and compression, gas supply and electricity generation. It is the 100% owner of the Moranbah Gas Project (MGP), a mature producing asset. It is an independent gas producer, with production at the MGP around 30TJ/day. The MGP also has a reserve base-331 2P Reserves. It focuses on the strategic capture and beneficial use of waste coal mine gas. The MGP is connected to five operating coal mines, collecting waste gas from operations, including Anglo American’s Grosvenor mine, Anglo American’s Teviot Brook mine, Anglo American’s Moranbah North mine, Fitzroy Resources’ Carborough Downs mine, and Stanmore’s Isaac Plains mine. The MGP consists of four Petroleum Licenses (PL196, 191, 223, 224). Within these PLs, all gas rights are owned by the Company. It has operating control of two gas-fired power stations.

name: CETTIRE LTD
businessSummary: Cettire Limited is an Australia-based global online retailer. The Company is engaged in offering a selection of in demand personal luxury goods via its Website, cettire.com. It has access to an extensive catalogue of more than 2,500 luxury brands and 500,000 products of clothing, shoes, bags, and accessories. It sells a range of products from over 500 designers, which include a range of women's and men's wear from brands, such as Prada, Gucci, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, and Valentino, among others. The Company's product categories include clothing, shoes, bags, and accessories. Its clothing category offers activewear, coats, jackets, jeans, knitwear, pants, and various others. Its shoes category offers boots, espadrilles, lace-up shoes, loafers, and various others. The Company’s bags category offers bag accessories, belt bags, clutch bags, crossbody bags and various others. The Company also offers accessories, such as belts, glasses, gloves, hats, and various others.

name: HUMM GROUP LTD
businessSummary: humm Group Limited is an Australia-based diversified non-bank financial services company providing lending, directly and through a network of retailers and brokers. The Company’s products include asset finance, credit cards, Point of sale Payment Plans (PosPP) and other finance solutions designed around the core needs of shoppers, retailers, and small to medium enterprises. The Company’s brands include humm, humm90, Q Mastercard and FlexiCommercial. The Company operates through four segments: Commercial, New Zealand Cards, Australia Cards, and PosPP.
