Its Commercial segment consists of Australia and New Zealand Commercial. Its New Zealand Cards segment includes Farmers Finance Card, Farmers Mastercard, Q Card, Q Mastercard and Flight Centre Mastercard. Its Australia Cards segment includes humm90, Lombard and Once. Its PosPP segment includes a consolidation of humm Australia, Canada and Ireland. The Company operates in Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, the United Kingdom and Canada.

name: PLAYSIDE STUDIOS LTD
businessSummary: PlaySide Studios Limited is a video game developer and publishing studio. The Company develops video games for multiple platforms including mobile, personal computer/console, virtual reality and mixed reality, with a portfolio of approximately 60 titles. The Company publishes its own games based on original intellectual property, as well as providing end-to-end game development services in collaboration with AAA game studios and technology and entertainment companies, such as Activision Blizzard, Meta, Netflix Games and Take Two Interactive. The Company also has a Publishing arm which provides funding, development support, marketing and publishing of third-party games from smaller independent studios. Its games include Age of Darkness (PlaySide), Mouse (Fumi Games), Warcraft 3 (Blizzard Entertainment), The Walking Dead (Skydance Interactive), Kill Knight (PlaySide), Dumb Ways to Die (PlaySide Mobile), Dynasty of the Sands (Rocket Flair Studios) and Archangel (Skydance Interactive).

name: NUIX LTD
businessSummary: Nuix Limited is a provider of investigative analytics and intelligence software, which enables organizations to find insights from large amounts of unstructured data. The Company helps customers collect, process, and review large amounts of structured and unstructured data. Its segments include Software, Services, and Hardware. It offers a software platform (Nuix platform) comprising a data processing engine (Nuix Engine) and several software applications. The Nuix platform operates at a forensic level, providing users with a detailed, contextualized and legally defensible way of viewing and interacting with data. Its software platform is used for critical work, such as digital forensic investigation, financial crime, litigation support, employee and insider investigations, data protection and privacy, data governance and eDiscovery and regulatory compliance. Its software applications include Nuix Discover, Nuix Investigate, Nuix Enterprise Collection Center, Nuix NLP, and others.

name: MAAS GROUP HOLDINGS LIMITED
businessSummary: Maas Group Holdings Limited is an industrial service and real estate business with diversified exposures across the property, civil, infrastructure, renewable energy and mining sectors. The Company’s Residential Real Estate segment develops, invests, builds, and sells residential land and housing. Its Commercial Real Estate segment includes commercial construction that builds and constructs commercial developments; commercial development and investment that delivers commercial property and industrial developments, and investing in commercial real estate. Its Civil, Construction and Hire segment includes civil construction, electrical services, plant hire and sales, and underground equipment hire and repair. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacturing, sales and distribution of underground construction and mining equipment and parts. The Construction Materials segment consists of quarries that supply quarry materials for construction projects; and crushing and screening.

name: GENUSPLUS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: GenusPlus Group Ltd is an Australia-based specialist power and communications infrastructure and services provider. The Company and its subsidiaries' principal activities include the construction and maintenance of transmission and distribution power lines and substations servicing the Western Australian, Queensland, New South Wales and Tasmanian power networks, as well as providing specialist engineering, testing and commissioning services to the electrical and communications industries. Its segments include Infrastructure, Communications and Industrial Services. Its Infrastructure segment offers a range of services, including planning, designing, constructing, operating, testing, maintaining, managing and decommissioning power network assets. Its Communications segment is engaged in constructing networks, to maintain and upgrade existing infrastructure. Its Industrial Services segment provides fully integrated electrical and instrumentation (E&I) services.

name: DOCTOR CARE ANYWHERE CDI
businessSummary: Doctor Care Anywhere Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based private provider of telehealth services. The Company works with insurers, healthcare providers and corporate customers to connect patients to a range of digitally enabled telehealth services on its platform. It provides virtual healthcare services and technology platform licensing within the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. It offers private online general practitioner and advanced nurse practitioners appointments, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year via video and phone. It provides treatments for various medical conditions, such as allergies and intolerances, colds, flu, and minor illnesses, gut health, joints and muscles, mental health, sexual health, skin conditions, and stomach and digestive problems. Its services include appointments, patient records, prescriptions, and referrals and fit notes. The Company provides various lifestyle support treatments for alcohol consumption, healthy lifestyle and sleep advice.

name: SPARC TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED
businessSummary: Sparc Technologies Limited is engaged in developing new technologies to disrupt and transform industry while seeking to deliver a more sustainable world. It is focused on developing new technologies in graphene additive materials, photocatalytic green hydrogen and sodium-ion batteries, which have a positive impact on climate change and sustainability. It is developing a portfolio of sustainable technologies focused on the renewable energy sector. Its Graphene is a 2D material made of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal lattice which creates properties capable of transforming and disrupting global industries. Its renewable energy sector is pioneering a dynamic portfolio of sustainable technologies designed to reshape the future of energy production and storage. Its Graphene Based Additives are developed for targeted applications in the marine and protective coatings market. Its ecosparc products for anticorrosive epoxy coatings deliver a 40% improvement in anticorrosive performance.

name: WA KAOLIN LIMITED
businessSummary: WA Kaolin Limited is an Australia-based kaolin production company. The Company is engaged in mineral exploration, extraction and processing. The Company's principal activities are the exploration and development of an inferred mineral resource of high-grade premium kaolinized granite, proprietary production and value-adding processes. The Company holds the Wickepin Kaolin Project, approximately 220km south-east of Perth, Western Australia. The Wickepin Project produces high-quality kaolin for Tier one customers in Asia and around the world. The project comprises four retention licenses (R70/40, R70/42, R70/43 and R70/44) and a single mining lease (M70/1143). The Company has a two-stage ramp-up strategy at the Wickepin Kaolin Project. The stage one optimizes production to over 200,000 tons per annum (tpa) and Stage two will ramp up production to 400,000tpa.

name: CASPIN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Caspin Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company, which is engaged in early-stage exploration and development. Its projects include the Bygoo Project, Yarawindah Brook Project and the Mount Squires Project. The Bygoo Project is an advanced, high-grade tin project located in a prolific tin-producing region. The Bygoo Project is positioned within the Wagga Tin Granites, a mineralized belt with many occurrences of tin and associated metals, the project surrounds the Ardlethan Tin Mine. Its Yarawindah Brook Project is located in the West Yilgarn region, a new mineral province hosting the Gonneville PGE-Ni-Cu Deposit owned by Chalice Mining Limited, only 40km to the south. Mount Squires is a large-scale, greenfield gold, rare earths and base metal project located in the West Musgrave region of Western Australia. The project is located adjacent to the western border of the West Musgrave mine development, which hosts the Nebo-Babel Ni-Cu sulfide deposits.

name: CYCLONE METALS LTD
businessSummary: Cyclone Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral investment, exploration, and evaluation company. The Company’s portfolio of projects and investments provide exposure to cobalt, lithium, iron ore, copper, uranium, and lead-silver-zinc assets in Australia, Europe, Africa, and South America. Its projects include Wee MacGregor Copper Project, Nickol River Gold Project, and Kukuna Iron Ore Project. Its Nickol River Gold project is located approximately 13 kilometers (km) east of Karratha in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The Nickol River Project is within the Karratha Terrane on the north side of the Sholl Shear Zone, near the margin of the Karratha Granodiorite. The Company holds tenure to four mining leases at the Wee MacGregor project located approximately 40 km southeast of Mt Isa in Queensland. The Kukuna Iron Ore project is located 120 km northeast of Freetown in the northwest of Sierra Leone and consists of one exploration license (EL22/2012) covering 68 square km.

name: DUSK GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Dusk Group Limited is an Australia-based specialty retailer of home fragrance products. The principal activities of the Company comprise retailing of scented and unscented candles, home decor, home fragrance and gift solutions. Its product offering consists of candles & melts, diffusers and oils, bath & body, and home & living. Its candle products include novelty candles, pillar candles, scented candles, wax melts, tealight candles, and LED candles. The Company’s essential oils include essential oil blends, pure essential oils, and essential oil body care. Its diffuser products include glass diffusers, resin diffusers, ceramic diffusers, and mini diffusers. Its reed diffusers come in fruity, gourmand, fresh, woody, floral, or unscented options. Its bath & body collection includes bath bombs, perfumes, body care, and soaps & scrubs. Its home & living offers home cleaning products, room spray, lighting, plates, and glass and mug.

name: ADORE BEAUTY GROUP LIMITED
businessSummary: Adore Beauty Group Limited is an Australia-based beauty focused e-commerce Website. The Company provides an integrated content, marketing and e-commerce retail platform that partners with a portfolio of over 300 brands and 14,000 products. It sells beauty and personal care products to Australian and New Zealand consumers. It fulfils orders from its customer fulfilment center in Victoria. The Company's product categories include skin care, makeup, hair, body, fragrance, teen, men, Korean beauty, clean beauty, wellness, travel size, trending, gifts, subscribe and save, refills, specials, and bundles. It offers various brands, which include Aceology, Adore Beauty, AERIN Beauty, Aesop, Aesthetics Rx, Baebrow, Calvin Klein, Davines, Davroe, Denman Brushes, Embryolisse, Espoir, others. The Company's skin care products include cosmeceuticals, serums & treatments, moisturizers, cleansers & scrubs, and masks. Its hair products include hair bond repair, hair fall & thinning, and conditioners.

name: DURATEC LTD
businessSummary: Duratec Limited is an Australia-based contractor providing assessment, protection, remediation, and refurbishment services to a range of assets and infrastructure. The Company’s multidisciplined capabilities combine engineering experience with project delivery expertise and use a range of in-house assessment technologies, including 3D capture and modelling technology with predictive analysis tools. Its segments include Defence, Mining & Industrial, Building & Facade and Energy. The Defense segment is engaged in the delivery of capital facilities, infrastructure and estate works program projects. The Mining & Industrial segment is engaged in the provision of tailored preventative maintenance programs. The Buildings & Facades segment is engaged in the completion of facade condition assessments and facade restorations. The Energy segment offers non-defense capital facilities, remediation and refurbishment of critical assets. Its Other segments relate to ports, transport, marine and water.

name: RAGUSA MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Ragusa Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company holds interests in Burracoppin REE & Halloysite Project in Western Australia. The Burracoppin REE & Kaolin/Halloysite Project comprises granted exploration license E70/5708, located approximately 300 kilometers east of Perth in Western Australia, and is prospective for REE, halloysite and kaolinite. The Project is located near Merredin, with port access easily accessible via the Great Eastern Highway. The Company is also reviewing new projects across various commodities and jurisdictions.

name: CREDIT CLEAR LIMITED
businessSummary: Credit Clear Limited is a technology company. It has developed a digital billing and communication platform that helps organizations drive smarter, faster, and more efficient financial outcomes by changing the way customers manage their re-payments through a user experience that the market demands in a digital age. It manages customer accounts across a range of industries, including transport, financial services, government, and utilities. Its segments include Receivable Collections and Legal Services. Receivable Collections segment represents the provision of receivable collection services using a combination of technology solutions and traditional collection methods. Legal Services offers specialized credit legal services, which when combined with the Receivables Collections business, allows the Company to offer a full-service end to end offering for its clients. Its RepayTech technology allows customers to make re-payments through a variety of channels and with re-payment option.

name: DETERRA ROYALTIES LTD
businessSummary: Deterra Royalties Limited is an Australia-based diversified resource royalty company. The Company's key investment activities involve the acquisition of resource royalties from third parties and providing finance to resource companies through royalty funding. The Company's two flagship royalties are Mining Area C and Thacker Pass lithium project. The Mining Area C (MAC) iron ore mine is located in Pilbara, Western Australia. The Thacker Pass lithium project is located in Nevada, United States. The Company's assets cover bulk, base, battery and precious metals at various stages of the mine lifecycle. Its bulk assets include Mining Area C, Koolyanobbing, Kwale, Yoongarillup/Yalyalup, Wonnerup, and Yandanooka. The Company's base and battery assets include Mimbula, Thacker Pass, Sonora, Paradox, Antler, Pukaqaqa, and Big Kidd. The Company's Lincoln asset is located in United States. The Company offers opportunities for ASX investors to invest in the global resources sector.

name: AUSSIE BROADBAND LIMITED
businessSummary: Aussie Broadband Limited is an Australia-based operating as a national carrier of telecommunications and technology services in Australia, servicing residential, business, wholesale and enterprise and government customers. The Company provides a suite of data, voice, and managed solutions. The Company’s segments include Residential, Business, Wholesale, Enterprise and Government, and Symbio. The Residential segment provides telecommunications services to residential users. The Business segment provides telecommunications services to business users. The Wholesale segment provides telecommunication services to third-party resellers. The Enterprise and Government segment provides telecommunication services to large enterprises including those in the public sector. The Symbio segment provides telecommunication services to software companies, telecom providers and enterprise customers.

name: CODA MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Coda Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based exploration company focused on the exploration, discovery and development of minerals in the base metals, precious metals and battery minerals sector. The Company’s projects include the Elizabeth Creek Copper Cobalt Project, Cameron River Copper Gold Project, Kinloch (Boss Energy JV), and Booleroo. It owns a 100% interest in the Elizabeth Creek Copper Cobalt Project, which is centered over 30 kilometers (km) south-east of Woomera and 135 km north-west of Port Augusta in South Australia. It covers over 701 square kilometers (km2) in the Olympic Dam Copper Province. The Cameron River Copper Gold Project is located approximately 60 km east of Mt Isa in Queensland. The project consists of over two exploration permits (EPM 27042 and EPM 27053) and covers over 35 km2 in the highly prospective MT Isa Inlier. The Kinloch Project is located in eastern South Australia, is a collection of four tenements held in association with Boss Energy.

name: SIREN GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Siren Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold and antimony exploration company with three key projects in the upper South Island of New Zealand: Sams Creek gold project in Upper Takaka, Langdons antimony-gold project near Reefton and the Queen Charlotte antimony-gold project. The Company has seen high-grade gold and stibnite mineralization throughout tenements due to its position on the Lachlan Fold Belt. The Reefton Project is a significant gold exploration and mining venture in the South Island of New Zealand. The Langdons project prospecting permit (PP 60893) is located in the Paparoa goldfield, approximately 50 kilometers (km) SW of Reefton. The Queen Charlotte gold-antimony mineralization that contains the historic Endeavour antimony mine is 120kms to the east of Sams Creek. The Sams Creek Gold Project is located 140kms NE of Reefton and 100kms NE of Lyell. The mineralization is contained within a hydrothermally altered peralkaline granite porphyry dyke.

name: TEMPEST MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Tempest Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company with a diversified portfolio of projects in Western Australia prospective for precious, base and energy metals. The Company’s projects include Yalgoo, Mount Magnet, Five Wheels and Elephant Project. Its flagship project is its holding in the Yalgoo region of Western Australia totaling over 1,000 square kilometers (km2). The Remorse Deposit sits on the eastern side of the Yalgoo Project, near a number of historical gold, iron and base metal occurrences. The Sanity Target sits in the eastern portion of the Yalgoo project area. Mount Magnet project is a prolific multi-million-ounce gold mining center with numerous large-scale, long-life open pit and underground mines. The Five Wheels project is over 266 km2 of granted tenure in the Earaheedy region of Western Australia proximal to the high-profile Rumble Resources Ltd discoveries. The Elephant project comprises over 194 km2 of highly prospective exploration leases.

name: POLARTECHNICS LIMITED
businessSummary: Plenti Group Limited is an Australia-based fintech lending and investment company, which provides loans through leveraging its technology. The Company provides automotive, renewable energy and personal loans, and is focused on borrowers with a strong credit profile. Additionally, it seeks to provide retail investors with returns by investing in loans via its lending marketplace. The Company's activities include the facilitation of investment opportunities for investors (through the Plenti Lending Platform and Plenti Wholesale Lending Platform) and the funding of loans via the Company’s warehouse and asset backed securities (ABS) programs. The Company's loan types include personal loans, car loans, debt consolidation loans, holiday loans, electric vehicle loans, medical loans, wedding loans, renovation loans, motorbike loans, moving costs loans, boat loans, legal fee loans, solar and battery loans, and caravan loans. The Company operates primarily in Australia.

name: MARVEL GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Marvel Gold Ltd is a resource company. The Company is a gold explorer with advanced exploration projects and substantial landholdings in the country’s key gold-bearing regions. Its projects include Hanang Gold Project, Yanfolila Gold Project, and Kolondieba Gold Project. The Hanang Gold Project is a regional gold project, located within a highly prospective, underexplored greenstone belt on the Eastern Margin of the +70Moz gold endowed Lake Victoria Gold Field. The Yanfolila Project is in southern Mali, 45 kilometers north of Endeavour Mining’s Kalana gold project and 35 km east of the hummingbird resources Yanfolila gold mine. The 200 square kilometer Kolondieba Project is prospective for gold mineralization in a similar structural setting to the Morila mine and the Tabakorole deposit. Kolondieba Project is located 70 km north-west of Resolute Mining’s Syama gold mine and 50km south of Barrick Gold’s Morila gold mine.

name: WILDCAT RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Wildcat Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company focused on discovery. The Company’s projects include Tabba Tabba Lithium-Tantalum Project, Bolt Cutter Lithium Project, Mt Adrah Gold Project and Bolt Cutter Gold Project. Its 100 % owned Tabba Tabba Lithium-Tantalum Project is located just 50 kilometers (km) from Port Hedland, Western Australia. The Company has approximately 446 square kilometers (km2) land position with two 100% owned granted tenements (E45/5623 and E45/5612) and six 100% owned applications (E45/6201, E45/6202, E45/6302, E45/6303, E45/6304 & E45/6204) prospective for lithium and gold in the Mallina Province, Pilbara, Western Australia. The Mt Adrah Project comprises 493 km2 of tenements straddling 52km of strike of the Gilmore Suture Zone. The Project is prospective for intrusive-related gold systems (IRGS) such as Hobbs Pipe; narrow and stockwork gold veins; epithermal gold deposits; and volcanogenic massive sulfide (VMS) deposits.

name: DUG TECHNOLOGY LTD
businessSummary: DUG Technology Ltd is an Australia-based technology company. The Company specializes in seismic data analysis, analytical software development, and high-performance computing (HPC). The Company designs, owns, and operates a network of the greenest supercomputers. It operates in three segments: HPCaaS, Services, and Software. The HPCaaS segment allows clients to connect to the Company’s HPC and storage in a complete HPC environment. It also provides software and algorithm support and development. The Services segment provides clients with two types of services, such as data loading, quality control and management, and scientific data analysis. The Software segment has two main products, including DUG Insight, which is a modern, intuitive and interactive software package for scientific processing and visualizations, and DUG Cluster Software, which is a high-end algorithm for the processing of scientific data on HPC installations. It also provides geoscience services.

name: 4DMEDICAL LTD
businessSummary: 4DMedical Limited is an Australia-based medical technology company specializing in advanced diagnostic imaging solutions. Leveraging its proprietary XV Technology and Imbio Technology, the Company provides cutting-edge thoracic imaging that enhances physician diagnoses and management of respiratory conditions. XV technology delivers detailed insights to airflow, lung structure, and regional lung function through a patient’s complete breath cycle. It produces software and hardware products that enable new levels of non-invasive, quantitative analysis of lung function. Its products include CAC (Coronary Artery Calcification), CT-LVAS (Computed Tomography Lung Ventilation Analysis Software), IQ-UIP, LDAf (Functional Lung Density Analysis), LDAi (Lung Density Analysis-Inspiration), LTA (Lung Texture Analysis), PHA Analysis (Pulmonary Hypertension Assessment), XV LVAS (X-ray Velocimetry Lung Ventilation Analysis Software), and XV Scanner.

name: AUSTRALIAN STRATEGIC MATERIALS LTD
businessSummary: Australian Strategic Materials Ltd is an Australia-based vertically integrated producer of critical metals for advanced and clean technologies. The Company extracts, refines and manufactures high-purity metals, alloys and powders, supplying direct to global manufacturers in clean energy, electric vehicles, defense and aerospace, electronics and communications. The Company’s segments include Corporate, Dubbo Project, Korea. The Korea segment includes the Korean Metals Plant and research and development activities. The Korean Metals Plant is located in Ochang, Korea and focuses on neodymium and neodymium iron boron alloys. The Dubbo Project includes the evaluation and feasibility of the Dubbo project and the Toongi Pastoral Company. The Dubbo Project is located near the Australian town of Toongi, approximately 25 km south of Dubbo, in central-western New South Wales (NSW) and contains rare earths, zirconium, niobium, and hafnium materials.

name: MANUKA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Manuka Resources Limited is a mining and exploration company. The Company's principal activities include mine development, mining and processing of silver, gold and exploration activities. Its segments include Exploration - Australia, Exploration - New Zealand, and Operations. Exploration - Australia segment is engaged in exploration of existing gold and silver leases and exploration leases at Wonawinta and Mt Boppy projects. Exploration - New Zealand is engaged in exploration of acquired mining and exploration leases at the Taranaki VTM Project (New Zealand). Its Operations segment includes appraisal, development and processing of gold and silver deposits. Its 100% owned Taranaki VTM (vanadium titanomagnetite) iron sands Project is located over 22 kilometers (km) to 36 km offshore in New Zealand’s Exclusive Economic Zone. Its Mt Boppy gold project is located over 43 km east of Cobar. Its Wonawinta Silver and Base Metals Project is in the Cobar Basin, New South Wales.

name: TPG TELECOM LTD
businessSummary: TPG Telecom Limited is an Australia-based telecommunications company. The Company's principal activity is the provision of telecommunications services to consumers, business, enterprise, government and wholesale customers in Australia. The Company's businesses include mobile radio network infrastructure, consumer and enterprise, government and wholesale (EGW) mobile business, and its customer and small office/home office fixed retail business, including fixed wireless. Its mobility solutions include Mobile Plans, eSIM, Tech Fund, Managed Enterprise Mobility, Mobile Private Network and Messaging Hub. The Company's Internet of Things (IoT) solutions include network technologies, managed connectivity and device management. Its cellular and LPWA network technologies are designed to deliver managed connectivity for its customers assets to collect data and analyze performance to deliver business impact. The Company's Managed IoT Connectivity solution is powered by Vodafone IoT.

name: EUROPA METALS LTD
businessSummary: Europa Metals Ltd is an Australia-based lead, zinc and silver developer. The Company is focused exclusively on European projects. The Company has a proposed transaction to acquire the Tynagh brownfield Pb/Zn/Cu/Ag project in the Republic of Ireland. The Company’s subsidiary is Ferrum Metals Pty Ltd.

name: TINHO UNION GROUP AUSTRALIA LIMITED
businessSummary: Tuas Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is primarily involved in owning and operating a mobile network and providing telecommunications services in Singapore. The Company operates through the Singapore telecommunications segment. The Company’s subsidiaries include Simba Telecom Pte Ltd, Simba 5G Pte Ltd, Netco East Pte Ltd, Netco West Pte Ltd, and Tuas Solutions Sdn Bhd.

name: ANTERIS TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Anteris Technologies Ltd is an Australia-based structural heart company. The Company is engaged in designing, developing, and commercializing medical devices. The Company’s lead product, DurAVR, is a transcatheter heart valve (THV) for treating aortic stenosis. DurAVR THV is made using ADAPT tissue, its patented anti-calcification tissue technology. DurAVR THV is a novel first-in-class biomimetic valve made from a single piece of native-shaped tissue. It is designed to mimic the performance of a pre-disease human aortic valve. Its balloon expandable ComASUR Delivery System provides controlled deployment and accurate placement of the DurAVR THV valve, designed to achieve precise alignment with the heart’s native commissures to achieve ideal valve positioning.

name: AMPOL LIMITED
businessSummary: Ampol Limited is an Australia-based transport energy provider. The Company supplies petrol and a convenience network, as well as refining, importing and marketing fuels and lubricants. It also launched its electric vehicle charging and home electricity solutions. The Company supplies fuel to approximately 80,000 customers in diverse markets across the Australian economy, including defense, mining, transport, marine, agriculture, aviation and other commercial sectors. Across its retail network, the Company serves approximately three million customers every week with fuel and convenience products, as well as electric vehicle charging at selected locations. Its customer base is supported by its robust supply chain and strategic infrastructure positions across the country, which includes 16 terminals, six pipelines, 55 wet depots, over 1,800 branded sites and one refinery located in Lytton, Queensland. This network is supported by over 8,300 people across Australia and overseas.

name: LARK DISTILLING CO LTD
businessSummary: Lark Distilling Co. Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the production, marketing, selling and distribution of Australian craft spirits. The Company has three segments: whisky, gin, and other. It offers various Whisky products, such as Dark Lark Single Malt Whisky, Classic Cask, Boilermaker House Whisky Bar Limited Release, and Para 1992 Cask Finish with 100ml Tawny Liqueur, among others. It offers a range of Gin products, which include Forty Spotted Citrus & Pepperberry + Pinot Noir Gin, Forty Spotted Classic Gin & Raspberry + Rose, Forty Spotted Classic, Forty Spotted Tassie Bush Honey, Forty Spotted Wild Rose, Forty Spotted Citrus & Pepperberry, Forty Spotted Raspberry & Rose, and Forty Spotted Pinot Noir. It operates in Tasmania and Australia. It markets its products via traditional off-premise retailers and on-premises bars, and via its direct-to-consumer business, which is hospitality and online e-commerce. Its primary focus is Whisky and the Lark brand.

name: OMNI BRIDGEWAY LTD
businessSummary: Omni Bridgeway Limited is an Australia-based company involved in legal finance and risk management, including dispute and litigation finance, from case inception to post-judgment enforcement and recovery. The Company provides solutions, including arbitration financing, judgment enforcement, dispute funding, distressed asset recovery, bankruptcy, commercial, intellectual property, investor recoveries, class/group actions, appeals, and whistleblower. Arbitration financing analyzes factors impacting claims and advises on navigating the various arbitral institutions. Judgement enforcement advises clients on how to safeguard collectability and enforcement of judgments. The bankruptcy financing solutions include pre-litigation and pre-confirmation investigations, working capital, fees and credit funding and monetizing appeals. It assesses investment and enforcement opportunities in Africa, Asia, Australia, Canada, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, the United Kingdom, and others.

name: INTELICARE HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Intelicare Holdings Limited is an Australia-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) technology company that has created a predictive analytics hardware and software system for use in the care and health industries. The Company is commercializing its proprietary artificial intelligence (AI) driven InteliCare platform (InteliCare) in the aged care, disability and health sectors. InteliCare utilizes smart sensors and AI to empower care providers to tailor care solutions for their customers, delivering improved care outcomes and increasing client independence. The Company's smart home and predictive analytics platform combines discreet sensors, wearable technology and alert devices to create layers of client intelligence and insights. The Company's hardware solutions include smart home sensors, emergency alerts, and vitals and health metrics. The Company's smart platform offers unlimited users to access 24/7 live health and wellbeing data, receive alerts and daily summary notifications.

name: IONIC RARE EARTHS LTD
businessSummary: Ionic Rare Earths Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company that is focused on investment in the mining and resource sector. The Company is focused on developing its flagship Makuutu Rare Earths Project (Makuutu) towards production. The Makuutu comprises approximately six licenses covering approximately 298 square kilometers (km2) and is located over 40 kilometers east of the regional center of Jinja and approximately 120 kilometers east of the capital city of Kampala in eastern Uganda. The Company, through Ionic Technologies International Limited, has developed rare earth element (REE) separation and refining technology and applied this to the recovery and separation of individual rare earths from spent permanent magnets. The Company’s exploration license includes EL00257, EL00147 and EL00148. Its wholly owned subsidiary is Goldcap Resources Pty Limited. Its wholly owned subsidiary includes Ionic Technologies International Limited.

name: ATOMO DIAGNOSTICS LTD
businessSummary: Atomo Diagnostics Limited is an Australia-based medical device company. The Company supplies integrated rapid diagnostic test (RDT) devices to the global diagnostic market. The Company’s patented devices simplify testing procedures, enhance usability and improve reliability across rapid point-of-care (POC) and at-home testing applications. The Company has commercialized a number of products across international markets and has supply agreements in place for testing applications targeting infectious diseases, including COVID-19, HIV, viral vs bacterial differentiations as well as the early detection of pregnancy. Its products include Atomo HIV Self-Test, AtomoRapid Pascal and AtomoRapid Curie, among others. Its Atomo HIV Self-Test is an integrated, blood-based rapid diagnostic test (RDT) for HIV screening, which provides results in 15 minutes. The AtomoRapid Pascal platform offers improved performance and usability in point of care testing.

name: AML3D LTD
businessSummary: AML3D Limited is an Australia-based technology company. It is disrupting metal part supply chains using the Company’s patented wire additive manufacturing (WAM) process. WAM combines state-of-the-art welding science, robotics automation, materials engineering, and proprietary software to lead metal additive manufacturing globally. It is the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the ARCEMY industrial metal 3D printing systems. ARCEMY uses WAM to provide advanced, automated, point-of-need 3D manufacturing solutions that are efficient, cost-effective and have ESG outcomes compared to traditional casting, forging and billet machining processes. ARCEMY is the Internet of Things (IoT) and Industry 4.0 enabled to allow manufacturers across aerospace, defense, maritime, manufacturing, mining and oil & gas to become globally competitive. It also provides metal 3D printing design engineering services, software licensing, technical support, consumable sales and contract manufacturing services.

name: PYX RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: PYX Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral sands company. The Company is focused on identifying, developing and acquiring undervalued, mineral assets strategically located in countries participating in China’s Belt and Road initiative that possess resources and zircon assemblage in the world. The Company's key deposits, Mandiri and Tisma, are large-scale, near-surface open pit deposits both located in the alluvium-rich region of Central Kalimantan, Indonesia. The Mandiri Deposit is a licensed concession covering an area of approximately 2,032 hectares Kuala Kurun City in the Gunung Mas Regency of Central Kalimantan, Indonesia. Mandiri Deposit is focused on the exploration of mineral sands products and the production and export of premium 65.5 grade zircon. The Tisma Project is a licensed mineral sands deposit in Central Kalimantan Province, Indonesia. The Tisma Project is a licensed mineral sands asset consisting of a concession area of 1,500 hectares.

name: TESORO GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Tesoro Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company is focused on the acquisition, exploration and development of commercially significant resource projects in Chile, with a focus on gold. It is focused on the exploration and development of the El Zorro Gold Project in the Coastal Cordillera region of Chile. The Ternera Gold Deposit is situated within the El Zorro Gold Project, located 900km north of Santigo in Chile’s Atacama Region. The Ternera Gold Deposit occurs within the El Zorro Gold Project, which covers a total concession holding area of approximately 570 square kilometers, located 130 kilometers (km) north of Copiapo City, in Region III (Atacama) in northern Chile. The Ternera Deposit is over 13 km inland from the Pacific Ocean, 57 km by road from the port town of Caldera. Its subsidiaries include Tesoro Mining Chile SPA, El Zorro S.C.M, Tesoro Australia Pty Ltd, among others.

name: LCL RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: LCL Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration and mining company. The Company is a gold/copper/nickel explorer with multiple assets in Papua New Guinea (PNG) and the mid-Cauca Gold Belt of Colombia. The Company’s segments include Mineral Exploration Colombia and Mineral Exploration Papua New Guinea. It holds approximately 3890 square kilometers (Km2) of exploration titles in five regions of Papua New Guinea prospective for copper, gold, and nickel. The Company also holds position within the Quinchia region of the Mid-Cauca Gold Belt of Colombia. The Company is actively exploring in PNG while the 100% owned, 10,500 hectares (ha) Quinchia Gold Project in Colombia progresses through early-stage feasibility related studies. Its Quinchia Gold Project is located in central west Colombia, 100 kilometers (km) south of Medellin, in the department of Risaralda. Its Ono project consists of Kusi Target is prospective for high-grade gold skarn and copper/gold porphyry.

name: LITTLE GREEN PHARMA LTD
businessSummary: Little Green Pharma Ltd is a global, vertically integrated and geographically diverse medicinal cannabis business with operations from cultivation and production through to manufacturing and distribution. Its principal activities include the cultivation of medicinal cannabis, procurement of raw materials and production of medicinal cannabis medicines; the supply of medicinal cannabis products into Australia and Europe; the supply of medicinal cannabis products for observational and clinical studies and research and development of new medicinal cannabis products, and the development of a psychedelics business including sponsoring a clinical trial into the treatment of refractory depression with psilocybin assisted therapy, construction of a psilocybin mushroom cultivation facility, and establishment of a psychedelic treatment clinic. It has a diverse and growing portfolio of cannabis-based medicines, distributed across Australia and over 12 export markets.

name: COBRE LIMITED
businessSummary: Cobre Limited is a copper exploration and development company with a focus on the Kalahari Copper Belt (KCB) in Botswana. The Company is engaged in advanced exploration of 100%-owned assets in the Kalahari Copper Belt (KCB), Botswana which spans across an extensive licensed area of 5,393 square kilometers (km2), prospective for sedimentary hosted copper-silver mineralization. Its Botswana projects include Ngami Copper Project (NCP), Kitlanya West Copper Project, Okavango Copper Project and Kitlanya East Copper Silver Project. The NCP project covers an area of approximately 727 km2. Kitlanya West Copper Project straddles the northern margin of the KCB, including an estimated 500 km of prospective D’Kar / Ngwako Pan Formation contact. The Perrinvale Project covers over 306km2 of the Panhandle and Illaara Greenstone Belts in Western Australia. Its Sandiman Tenement is located in the Gascoyne Province, in Western Australia and spans across 202km2 on the eastern edge of the Carnarvon Basin.

name: ECOGRAF LTD
businessSummary: EcoGraf Limited is an Australia-based integrated battery anode materials developer. The Company is engaged in building a diversified battery anode material business to produce high-purity graphite products for the lithium-ion battery and advanced manufacturing markets. In Tanzania, it is developing the TanzGraphite natural flake graphite business, commencing with the Epanko Graphite Project, to provide a scalable supply of feedstock for EcoGraf battery anode material processing facilities, together with quality flake graphite products for specialized industrial applications. Using its EcoGraf HFfree purification technology, the Company seeks to upgrade the flake graphite to produce 99.95%C high performance battery anode material to supply electric vehicle, battery and anode manufacturers in Asia, Europe and North America. The Company’s EcoGraf purification process recycles battery anode materials to support customers to reduce carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions and lower battery costs.

name: RAREX LIMITED
businessSummary: RareX Limited is a critical minerals company specializing in rare earths and niobium in hard rock carbonatites. It is engaged in curating a portfolio of carbonatite related prospects within which the Khaleesi Project represents the exploration flagship. The exploration focus of the business is on the Khaleesi Project in the East Yilgarn which is a district-scale, elevated-niobium, and alkaline intrusive complex. The Company's engineering and commercial focus is on offtake and approvals at the mid-study-level, Cummins Range Project, a carbonatite hosted rare earth and phosphate project, containing magnet grade rare earths and battery grade phosphates and undeveloped rare earths project. The new Khaleesi Project is located along strike from Ponton Dyke, the Cundeelee carbonatite, and the Tropicana Gold mine. The Khaleesi Project is located adjacent to the Mulga Rocks deposits on the transition of the Yilgarn Craton to the Albany-Fraser Belt, specifically in the Northern Foreland Unit.

name: RESOLUTION MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Resolution Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based mineral exploration company engaged in the acquisition, exploration and development of precious and battery metals, such as antimony, gold, copper, and uranium. Its Horse Heaven Antimony-Gold-Tungsten Project is well-situated in Valley County, Idaho United States. The Horse Heaven Project comprises 699 federal lode mining claims covering over 5,644 hectares. Its George Project covers a large area prospective for roll-front style uranium (2,839km2) in central South Australia. The Company’s Drake East Project hosts fourteen known antimony occurrences, including the well-documented Mosquito Creek Antimony-Gold Reef and Ball & Smiths Lode. These antimony occurrences cover a large area with a NW-SE strike length of over 15 kilometers (km). Its Neardie Project hosts three past producing antimony mines. Its Spur South Gold-Copper Project is located within the highly mineralized Macquarie Arc region in NSW.

name: VECTION TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Vection Technologies Limited is an Australia-based enterprise-focused company that helps businesses bridge the physical and digital worlds. The Company helps organizations leverage their three-dimensional (3D) data through extended reality (XR) interfaces that foster collaboration and learning, grow sales and more. It is engaged in developing and commercializing integrated digital transformation technology solutions and services as part of its INTEGRATEDXR suite, including ICT infrastructure, kiosks, mixed reality (MR), augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), computer-aided design (CAD), 3D modeling and renderings, and artificial intelligence (AI). Its INTEGRATEDXR products include Mindesk, EnWorks, 3DFrame, Configurator, and XRKiosk. Mindesk is a solution to support design review and real-time rendering workflows. EnWorks is a solution that supports training, manufacturing and maintenance processes.

name: NUCHEV LTD
businessSummary: Nuchev Limited is an Australia-based nutritional and wellness business solutions company. The Company is engaged in the development, sales, and marketing of vitamins and dietary supplements. The Company’s products include those branded under Oli6, Bio Practica, and Medicine Tree and a number of globally recognized European brands sold under exclusive license in Australia and New Zealand by bWellness. The Company's primary products include its Oli6 branded goat infant formula and nutritional range, which are sold across Australian Pharmacy and Grocery channels, China and other overseas markets, online through the China Cross-Border e-commerce (CBEC), and general trade retail channels.

name: TYRO PAYMENTS LTD
businessSummary: Tyro Payments Limited is an Australia-based technology-focused and values-driven company. The Company is focused on providing Australian businesses with payment solutions and complementary business banking products. Its segments include Payments and Banking. The Company provides credit, debit and electronic funds transfer at point of sale (EFTPOS) card acquiring, Medicare and private health fund claiming and rebating services to Australian businesses. It takes money on deposit and offers unsecured cash-flow based lending to Australian EFTPOS merchants. The Company is focused on in-store payments through e-Commerce solutions. It also provides solutions, such as its loans in the form of merchant cash advances and its fee-free, interest-bearing merchant transaction accounts and term-deposit accounts. It offers Tyro Connect, which is an integration hub for applications and point of sale (POS) systems, a plug and play platform software solution.

name: VULCAN ENERGY RESOURCES LTD.
businessSummary: Vulcan Energy Resources Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in geothermal energy and lithium exploration and production. The Company’s segments include Germany, Other European (France and Italy) and Australia. The Germany segment is engaged in the supply of geothermal energy, exploration relating to the Zero Carbon Lithium Project and engineering services. The Other European segment is engaged in exploration relating to battery materials and geothermal lithium. The Australia segment is engaged in administration and corporate support services. Its products include Geothermal energy, Sustainable Lithium, and In-house sorbent: VULSORB. The Company’s Lionheart Project is located in the Upper Rhine Valley Brine Field bordering Germany and France, is the lithium resource in Europe and a tier-one lithium project globally. Its subsidiaries include Vulcan Energie Ressourcen GmbH, Vulcan Energy Europe Pty Limited, and Vulcan Energy Engineering GmbH, among others.

name: MONEYME LTD
businessSummary: MoneyMe Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in providing consumer and commercial finance. The Company uses smart technology to redefine the borrowing experience with easy and seamless credit products, from digital loans and credit cards to financial wellness tools. The Company’s proprietary technology platform, Horizon and its artificial intelligence (AI) engine, AIDEN with generative and agentic AI, driving improved customer experience, operational efficiency and credit decisioning. It targets customers with above average credit profiles through a range of fast, flexible, and competitively priced products, including car loans, personal loans, and credit cards. The Company’s products and services include personal loans, refinance loans, medical loans, autopay, renovation loans, wedding loans, travel loans, Freestyle credit card, debt consolidation, and credit scores.

name: GODOLPHIN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Godolphin Resources Limited is an Australia-based resources company. The Company’s projects located within the Lachlan Fold Belt, New South Wales (NSW), consisting of gold-copper and rare earth elements in the province of Australia. The Company’s tenements cover over 3,500 square kilometers (km2) of ground prospective for gold, silver, base metals and rare earths. The Company's projects include Narraburra Rare Earth Element Project, Yeoval Porphyry gold-copper-molybdenum-rhenium project, Lewis Ponds, Copper Hill East porphyry copper project, Gundagai gold-copper project, and Mt Aubrey epithermal gold-silver project. Its other rare earth element project consists of EL9506 - Bingara (New South Wales). The Narraburra Rare Earth Element Project is comprised of two tenements, EL 8420 and EL 9258, along with tenements EL 9628 and EL9258 for a total project area of 571 kilometers (km). The 100% owned Lewis Ponds project covers approximately 148 km2 located 15 km east of Orange (EL5583).

name: PERENTI LTD
businessSummary: Perenti Limited is an Australia-based diversified global mining services company with interests in contract mining, mining support services and future technology solutions. The Company’s segments include Contract Mining, Drilling Services and Mining Services and idoba. Its Contract Mining segment is engaged in the provision of underground and surface contract mining services in Australia, Africa and North America. Its Drilling Services is engaged in the provision of drilling services across all stages of the mine life cycle, including specialized deep hole multi-intersectional directional diamond core drilling, underground diamond core drilling, drilling and blasting and in-pit grade control in Australia, Europe and North America. Its Mining Services and idoba segment provides mining support services including equipment hire, equipment parts and sales, supply of equipment, logistics services and technology driven products and services.

name: HMC CAPITAL LIMITED
businessSummary: HMC Capital Limited is an Australia-based diversified alternative asset manager focused on real estate, private equity, energy transition and digital infrastructure. Its segments include Real Estate and Private Equity. Its Real Estate segment includes its HMC Capital managed HomeCo Daily Needs REIT, HealthCo Healthcare and Wellness REIT, HMC Wholesale Healthcare Fund and the Last Mile Logistics Fund. Its Private Equity segment comprises the HMC Capital Partners Fund I. HomeCo Daily Needs REIT invests in convenience-based assets across the target sub-sectors of neighborhood retail, large format retail and health and services. Healthcare and Wellness REIT invests in hospitals; aged care; childcare; government, life sciences and research; primary care and wellness property assets, and other healthcare and wellness property adjacencies. It also operates a Private Credit asset management platform over the medium-term spanning real estate, corporate, mezzanine, and infrastructure loans.

name: LOTUS RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Lotus Resources Limited is an advanced uranium company. The principal activities of the Company include exploration for uranium and the evaluation and development of uranium resources. The Company focuses on the Company’s advanced Kayelekera Uranium Project (Kayelekera), in Malawi. It has four business segments and two geographical locations, being the exploration, evaluation and development of Uranium assets in Africa (comprising the geographical locations Malawi and Botswana), nickel-cobalt exploration, evaluation and development in Australia, and corporate activities in Australia. The Kayelekera Uranium Project is located in northern Malawi, southern Africa, 52 kilometers (km) west by road from the town of Karonga. It also owns 100% interest in Letlhakane Uranium Project in Botswana and holds a 55% interest in the Wilconi Nickel Cobalt Project in Western Australia.

name: MADER GROUP LIMITED
businessSummary: Mader Group Limited is engaged in the provision of specialist technical services across multiple industries. The Company’s labor market platform allows it to connect a global network of over 490 customers to a skilled in-house workforce of more than 3,000 personnel on flexible, fit for purpose, and cost-effective terms. The Company is engaged in the provision of specialist technical services in the mining, energy and industrial sectors around the globe. The services provided include in-field technical support, major overhauls and repairs, preventative equipment maintenance, training of maintenance teams, and a range of ancillary services. The Company provides advanced tap on, tap off maintenance solutions across the mining regions of the world. The Company services earth moving machinery, excavators, wheel loaders, graders, water trucks, drilling rigs and more. It also specializes in providing quality maintenance solutions for the rail freight and transport industry.

name: IMRICOR MEDICAL SYSTEMS CDI
businessSummary: Imricor Medical Systems, Inc. is a developer of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-compatible medical devices which can be used to carry out real-time interventional cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (iCMR) cardiac ablation procedures. The Company develops MRI-compatible products for cardiac catheter ablation procedures. The Vision-MR Ablation Catheter is the Company’s prime product offering, specifically designed to work under real-time MRI guidance. Its other products include Advantage-MR EP Recorder/Stimulator System, the Vision-MR Diagnostic Catheter and Vision-MR Dispersive Electrode. Advantage-MR EP Recorder/Stimulator System provides technology that allows the physician to utilize both the EP recording system and a cardiac stimulator while ablating within the iCMR environment. It sells its capital and consumable products to hospitals and clinics for use in iCMR labs, in which ablation procedures using the Vision-MR Ablation Catheter can be performed.

name: STONEHORSE ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Stonehorse Energy Limited is an Australia-based exploration and production (E&P) company with a focus on onshore oil and gas in North America. The Company holds working interests in eight oil and gas wells located in Oklahoma and Texas with a pipeline of investment opportunities available through its step-in arrangement and joint venture partnership with Brookside Energy Limited and US Operations Manger Black Mesa Energy LLC. Its assets include Jewell, Burgess, Sutton, Bullard, Henry Federal, Randolph, Newberry, Mitchell, Thelma, Caroline, Wapiti and Myall Creek. The Company’s subsidiaries include Lone Star Energy Limited, LS Operating Pty Ltd, and Lonestar Exploration & Production Inc.

name: MANDRAKE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Mandrake Resources Limited is an Australia-based explorer focused on advancing its lithium project in the Paradox Basin in south-eastern Utah, United States. The Company’s segments include Utah Lithium Project, Jimperding Ni-Cu-PGE Project and Berinka Pine Creek Gold Project. The Utah Lithium Project is located in the Paradox Basin in south-eastern Utah and covers approximately 93,755 acres. The Utah Lithium Project also incorporates the Lisbon Valley uranium mining district. The Jimperding Project lies approximately 30 kilometers (km) east of Chalice Gold Mines Limited’s (Chalice) Julimar Ni-Cu-PGE discovery in the Jimperding Metamorphic Belt located 70 km northeast of Perth. Berinka Pine Creek Gold Project covers an approximately 289km2 exploration license in the under-explored western limb of the Pine Creek Orogen, Northern Territory, 180 km south of Darwin.

name: FINEOS CDI
businessSummary: FINEOS Corporation Holdings PLC is an Ireland-based software company. The Company is engaged in providing software solutions tailored to the employee benefits and life, accident, and health industry. The Company operates the FINEOS AdminSuite platform, which delivers functionalities across administration, including absence management, billing, claims, payments, policy administration, provider management, and new business and underwriting. Its offers FINEOS Absence (absence management software), FINEOS Billing (billing management solution), FINEOS Claims (claims management software), FINEOS Payments (payments management solution), FINEOS Policy (policy administration system), FINEOS Provider (provider management software), FINEOS Rate (group insurance rating software), and FINEOS Underwrite (group insurance underwriting software). The Company’s subsidiaries include FINEOS Corporation Limited, FINEOS UK Limited, FINEOS Corporation Inc., FINEOS Australia Pty Limited, and others.

name: VANADIUM RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Vanadium Resources Limited is an Australia-based vanadium producer. The Company is focused on developing its flagship project, the Steelpoortdrift Vanadium Project which is strategically located 15 kilometers (km) apart within the Bushveld Geological Complex in South Africa. The Steelpoortdrift Vanadium Project consists of the Steelpoortdrift Mine, Concentrator Plant, and Salt Roast Leach Processing Plant. Steelpoortdrift Vanadium Project boasts a substantial vanadium deposit for generations to come with a Mineral Resource of 680 million tons at an average in-situ grade of 0.70% V2O5 (equivalent to 4.74 million tons of contained metal) and a Proved and Probable Ore Reserve of 77 million tons at an average in-situ grade of 0.72% V2O5 (equivalent to 0.55 million tons of contained metal). The Company is engaged in transforming vanadium applications across various sectors, including energy storage, infrastructure development, and more.

name: HORIZON MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Horizon Minerals Limited is a mid-tier gold producer with projects located in the West Australian goldfields. The Company holds a 100% interest in gold projects in the Kalgoorlie and Coolgardie regions, including the 428,000 oz Boorara project and 1,372,000 oz in satellite projects in close proximity. Its Boorara project is located approximately 10 kilometers (km) east of the Kalgoorlie's Super Pit gold mine on the eastern edge of the city of Kalgoorlie-Boulder, Western Australia. Its Phillips Find Project is located approximately 45 km north-northwest of Coolgardie, Western Australia. The Company is also engaged in operating the Black Swan processing facility, which is a 2.2 million tons per annum (Mtpa) processing facility strategically located approximately 40km north of Kalgoorlie. Its Burbanks project is located on a granted mining lease 9 km south of Coolgardie.

name: ECS BOTANICS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: ECS Botanics Holdings Ltd is an Australia-based medicinal cannabis cultivator and manufacturer located in Northwest Victoria. The Company utilizes progressive and cultivation methodologies to produce medicine in a sustainable way, adopting regenerative and organic horticultural practices and renewable energy sources. The Company operates through two segments: ECS Botanics Pty Ltd (Botanics) and ECS Botanics MC Pty Ltd and Flowerday Farms Pty Ltd. Botanics is engaged in the sale of food and wellness products. ECS Botanics MC Pty Ltd and Flowerday Farms Pty Ltd are engaged in the sale of medicinal cannabis plant related products. It specializes in cultivating cannabis, which after drying and curing, is supplied as a trimmed flower for inhalation, or extracted into resin for further formulation or manufacturing. It cultivates a range of strains for extraction and inhalation. It also formulates a range of off the shelf and bespoke formulations to suite needs.

name: BETMAKERS TECHNOLOGY GROUP LTD
businessSummary: BetMakers Technology Group Ltd is an international provider of advanced wagering technology, data, content, and service solutions with a footprint that spans the racing and betting markets. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of software, data, and analytic products for the business-to-business (B2B) wagering market and the production and distribution of racing content. Its segments include Global Betting Services and Global Tote. The Global Betting Services segment provides customers with a variety of racing software, data, and analytical tools. This includes basic race data, such as pricing, runners, and form, as well as analytical tools to consume and leverage the data, and wagering tools, such as platforms and managed trading services. It also assists racing bodies and rights holders in producing and distributing race content. The Global Tote segment includes the provision of tote software and integrations to facilitate tote liquidity and resulting.

name: ORA BANDA MINING LTD
businessSummary: Ora Banda Mining Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mining operations and the sale of gold, mine development and exploration in Western Australia. The Company is the 100% owner of the Davyhurst Gold Project, which is located approximately 120 kilometers (kms) north-west of Kalgoorlie, within the Tier one gold mining province of the Eastern Goldfields. The Davyhurst Gold Project includes approximately 67 granted tenements that cover an area of 1,135 square kilometers (km2). The Company's projects include Central Davyhurst, Riverina-Mulline, Siberia, Callion and Walhalla. Its Central Davyhurst project area is located within a five kms radius of the Davyhurst Processing Plant. The Company's Riverina Underground gold deposits are hosted within three separate shear/mylonite zones, namely Reggie’s, Murchison, and Main Lode, all trending approximately north-south. The Company's Sand King (Siberia) is an underground mine at the Davyhurst Gold Project.

name: SKY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Sky Metals Limited is focused on the exploration and development of mineral resources in Australia. The Company’s project portfolio offers exposure to tin, gold, copper, and other critical metals projects in the mining jurisdiction of New South Wales. Its tin projects include Tallebung Tin Project, Doradilla Project and Narriah Project. Its gold projects include Cullarin Project, Caledonian Project, and Kangiara project. Its gold-copper projects include the Iron Duke Project and Galwadgere project. Its 100% owned flagship project is Tallebung project is located over 70 kilometers (km) north-west of Condobolin in central-western New South Wales. The Doradilla Project is located approximately 45 km south-east of Bourke in western New South Wales and is considered prospective for polymetallic tin, copper, silver, bismuth, indium and zinc mineralization. The Narriah Project (EL9524) is located approximately 10 km south-southeast of Rankin Springs in southwest New South Wales.

name: INVEX THERAPEUTICS LTD
businessSummary: Invex Therapeutics Ltd is an Australia-based biopharmaceutical company. The Company is focused on the repurposing of an already-approved drug, Exenatide, for the efficacious treatment of neurological conditions derived from or involving raised intracranial pressure (ICP). In addition, the Company has generated early-stage data on the use of Exenatide in the treatment of glaucoma, through the lowering of intraocular pressure in the eye. The principal activity of the Company is the development of Exenatide, including generating new pre-clinical data in Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) under a collaboration with Tessara Therapeutics. The Company has trademarked its repurposed Exenatide as Presendin. The Company is focused on managing the close out of the Phase III Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (IIH) EVOLVE clinical trial and explore new potential applications for Exenatide in TBI and other neurological disorders with raised ICP, consistent with its patents.

name: AF LEGAL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: AF Legal Group Limited is an Australia-based tech enabled law firm specializing in family and relationship law. The Company provides advice to clients in respect of divorce, separation, property, and children's matters together with related and ancillary services such as litigation. It is engaged in contested wills and estates practice, which includes all aspects of wills and estates disputes including contesting challenging and defending wills. Its subsidiaries include AF Legal Pty Ltd, Watts McCray (NSW) Pty Ltd, Withnall Cavanagh & Co Pty Ltd, AF Legal (Wollongong) Pty Ltd and AF Legal (Gold Coast) Pty Ltd. Watts McCray (NSW) Pty Ltd provides various legal services, including legal services, family law, dispute resolution, international law & expat services, Divorce.com.au and other legal services.

name: POINTSBET HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Pointsbet Holdings Limited is an Australia-based corporate bookmaker with operations in Australia and Canada. The Company has developed a cloud-based wagering platform through which it offers its clients advanced sports and racing wagering products, and iGaming. The Company’s segments include Australian Trading, Canadian Trading, and Corporate. The Australian Trading segment provides online sports and online fixed odds racing betting services to Australian customers. The Canadian trading segment offers online sports betting and iGaming services provided to Canadian customers. The Company’s products include Fixed Odds Sports, Fixed Odds Racing, PointsBetting, and iGaming (online casino). Its subsidiaries include PointsBet Australia Pty Ltd, PointsBet Pty Ltd, PBH Softech Private Limited, PointsBet Canada Operations 1 Inc., and others.

name: CARNABY RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Carnaby Resources Limited is an exploration and development company. The Company is focused on copper and gold projects in the Mount Isa Inlier of Queensland and the Pilbara’s Mallina Basin and Yilgarn Margin of Western Australia. Its flagship Greater Duchess Copper Gold Project is located approximately 70km southeast of Mount Isa in Queensland and centered around the historical Duchess copper mining district. The Greater Duchess Copper Gold project encompasses 1,921 square kilometers (km2) of Iron Oxide Copper-Gold (IOCG) prospective tenure, including its Mount Hope, Nil Desperandum and Lady Fanny deposits. The Company’s Pilbara Gold and Lithium Projects comprise the Strelley, Mt Grant and Goldsworthy Gold Projects and the Big Hill Lithium Project. Each of these projects are located in the prospective Mallina Basin of Western Australia, northeast of the Hemi gold deposit of De Grey Mining Ltd. Its Yilgarn Margin Projects comprise the Malmac and Throssel Projects.

name: TRIGG MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Trigg Minerals Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company. Its projects include Antimony Canyon; Achilles Antimony; Taylors Arm North Antimony; Taylors Arm South Antimony; Nundle Antimony-Gold; Spartan Antimony; Upper Hunter Antimony-Gold; Copeland & Cobark Gold-Antimony, and Drummond Epithermal & IRGS. Its flagship Antimony Canyon Project in Garfield County, Utah, holds approximately 49 unpatented lode mining claims and 20 patented mining claims. The Achilles Antimony project is an advanced-stage exploration/near-term development antimony project, which is located within Coffs Harbour Block of the New England Orogen. The Taylors Arm North Antimony Project is a high-grade, underexplored asset in the New England Orogen of northern New South Wales. The Drummond Project includes approximately 893 square kilometers across nine tenements in North Queensland’s prolific Drummond Basin, a Tier-one gold province.

name: LIFE360 CDI
businessSummary: Life360, Inc. is a provider of technology platform used to locate people, pets and things. The Company’s product offerings include Life360 Platform and Hardware Products. It offers four product features that make up the Life360 Platform: location coordination and safety; driving safety; digital safety; and emergency assistance. Its hardware products under the Tile brand integrate with the Life360 Platform. The Tile Bluetooth network leverages the installed base of Life360 members to scan for locations of devices, which can locate lost devices of Tile customers. Tile devices are sold through online and brick and mortar retail channels as well as directly via Tile.com, and are available in various shapes, sizes, and price points for different use cases. It has designed an end-to-end technology location solution that enables the Company to deliver real-time location-based experiences and includes functionality, such as storage, processing and communication of events, among others.

name: BLUE ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Blue Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration company. The Company is engaged in the exploration, evaluation and development of conventional and unconventional oil and gas resources. Its geographical segment is Australia, which includes Queensland and the Northern Territory. The Company’s projects include Bowen Basin (ATP814P), Carpentaria Basin (ATP1112A), Galilee Basin (ATP813P), South Georgina Basin (ATP1114A, ATP1117A and ATP1123A), Surat Basin (ATP854P) and Greater McArthur Basin (EP199A, EP200, EP205A, EP206, EP207, EP208A, EP209A, EP210A and EP211A). ATP814P consists of six disconnected blocks in the North Bowen Basin in an area ranging from south of Moranbah up to Newlands in the Northern Bowen Basin. ATP1112A is located in the Carpentaria Basin of northwestern Queensland. It is located south of the Gulf of Carpentaria region and approximately 40 kilometers (km) west of Normanton. ATP813P covers a large area in the Galilee Basin in Central West Queensland.

name: ALTERITY THERAPEUTICS LTD
businessSummary: Alterity Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company is focused on developing disease modifying treatments for neurodegenerative diseases. The Company's lead asset, ATH434, is to treat various Parkinsonian disorders. ATH434 is an oral agent designed to inhibit the aggregation of pathological proteins implicated in neurodegeneration. It has the potential to treat Parkinson's disease, as well as various Parkinsonian disorders, such as Multiple System Atrophy (MSA). The Company also has a drug discovery platform generating patentable chemical compounds to intercede in disease processes. ATH434 has been granted Orphan designation for the treatment of MSA. The Phase II clinical trial is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled investigation of ATH434 in patients with early-stage MSA.

name: READYTECH HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: ReadyTech Holdings Limited is an Australia-based provider of software as a service (SaaS) for the education, employment services, workforce management, government and justice sectors. The Company's segments include Education and Work Pathways, Workforce Solutions, and Government and Justice. Education and Work Pathways segment provides products and services to tertiary education providers. Its products include cloud-based student management systems and learning management systems for education and training providers. Workforce Solutions provides products and services to mid-sized companies across various industries with payroll software, outsourced payroll services, human resource management and recruitment software solutions to employers to assist them with payroll and the management of their employees. Government and Justice segment provides government and justice case management software as a service solution to local governments, state governments and justice departments.

name: MONT ROYAL RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Mont Royal Resources Limited is an Australia-based critical minerals development and exploration company with projects in Quebec, Canada. The Company is focused on advancing its 100%-owned Ashram Rare Earth and Fluorspar Deposit in Quebec, Canada, which is a monazite-dominant carbonatite hosted Rare Earth Elements deposits in North America. In addition, the Company owns 75% of Northern Lights Minerals approximately 536 square kilometers tenement package located in the Upper Eastmain Greenstone belt. The projects are located in the emerging James Bay area, a Tier-1 mining jurisdiction of Quebec, and are prospective for lithium, precious (Gold, Silver) and base metals mineralization (Copper, Nickel). The Northern Lights Projects are located approximately 300 kilometers (km) north-northeast of the town of Chibougamau and 56 km south of Renard Diamond mine. The projects include the Northern Lights Assets (75%-owned) and Eastmain Leran Project (Option to own 75%).

name: NEXT SCIENCE LTD
businessSummary: Next Science Limited is an Australia-based medical technology company. The Company focuses on enhancing patient outcomes, empowering physicians, and driving healthcare innovation through education, research, and cutting-edge product development. Its Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Wound Care includes advanced wound care solutions delivered through partnerships with DME providers, particularly in the United States home health and outpatient settings.

name: RICEGROWERS LTD
businessSummary: Ricegrowers Limited, doing business as The SunRice Group, is a rice food brand company. The Company's segments include Rice Pool, International Rice, Rice Food, Riviana Foods (Riviana), CopRice and Corporate. The Rice Pool segment is engaged in the receival, milling, marketing and distribution of Riverina rice, directly to customers across many channels. The International Rice segment is engaged in the purchasing (including from the Rice Pool), processing, manufacturing, marketing and distribution of bulk or branded rice products. The Rice Food segment is focused on importation, local manufacturing, marketing and distribution of value-added rice-based products, including snacks, ingredients and microwave products, both in domestic and global markets. The Riviana segment is focused on distribution of both imported and locally manufactured branded specialty gourmet and special occasion food products. The CopRice segment manufactures and distributes bulk stockfeed.

name: DREADNOUGHT RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Dreadnought Resources Limited is an exploration and development company focusing on acquiring and exploring quality projects within the state of Western Australia (WA). The Company's projects include Kimberley Project, Mangaroon Project, and Bresnahan Project. It controls approximately 420 square kilometers (km) in the highly prospective West Kimberley region of WA. The Tarraji-Yampi Copper-Silver-Gold-Cobalt Project is located only 85 km from the port of Derby. Its Mangaroon Project covers approximately 5,000 km2, located 250 km south-east of Exmouth in the underexplored Gascoyne Region of WA. Mangaroon has three focus areas, the Mangaroon Critical Metals, Mangaroon Gold and Base Metals. Bresnahan is located over 125km southwest of Newman in the Ashburton Basin. The project comprises over 3,700 km2 covering over 200kms strike along the Bresnahan Basin / Wyloo Group unconformity. Bresnahan is prospective for unconformity related heavy rare earth (HREE) deposits.

name: XREF LTD
businessSummary: Xref Limited is an Australia-based human resource (HR) and recruitment technology company that offers a range of reference and pre-employment checks, employee engagement and exit surveys. The Company operates through three segments: Xref Platform, Trust Marketplace and Xref Engage. The Xref Platform segment includes enterprise platform (pre-employment reference surveys, pulse and exit surveys) and recruiter platform (pre-employment reference surveys only). The Trust Marketplace segment includes ID verification, qualification checks and background checks. The Xref Engage segment includes engagement surveys. The Company's solutions by industry include not-for-profit, health and aged care, government, construction, retail, hospitality, and aged care QI surveys. Its platform's features include survey builder, people records, reporting and insights, integrations, security and compliance, and template builder. Its types of integration include background checks and applicant tracking system.

name: EXCELSIOR CAPITAL LTD
businessSummary: Excelsior Capital Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the design and distribution of electrical components and cables for resource infrastructure applications and the management of an investment portfolio. The Company's segments include electrical components and investment portfolio. The Company's electrical components segment includes two business areas: Electrical Cables, which includes brands, such as XLPE Cables, Hartland Cables and Aflex Cables, and Minto Industrial Products, which specializes in couplers and receptacle products in the mining and construction industry. It supplies electronic equipment for defense, aviation, electrical safety markets and consumer electronic equipment for home use. The Company's investment portfolio segment invests in listed and unlisted equity instruments, hybrid notes, quoted debt instruments and/or investment trusts to achieve long term dividend returns and capital appreciation.

name: AFRICAN GOLD LTD
businessSummary: African Gold Ltd is an Australia-based company. The principal activities of the Company consist of exploration and evaluation of mineral resources. It operates through two segments: Exploration and evaluation of Minerals in Cote d’Ivoire and Exploration and evaluation of Minerals in Mali. Its projects include Didievi Project, Agboville Project, Konahiri Project, Koyekro Project, Kedougou-Kenieba Project, and Syama Shear Zone Project. The Didievi Project located in central Cote d’Ivoire, approximately 35 kilometers (km) from the capital, Yamoussoukro, and 60km from operating low-grade mines. The Agboville Project covers an area of 1,400 square kilometer (km2) and is located in the southeast of the West African Craton. he Konahiri North (391 km2) and Konahiri South (354 km2) Applications are situated in the central portion of the NNW-trending Kotiola Marabadrassa Birimian Greenstone Belt, in central Cote d’Ivoire.

name: LAWFINANCE LTD
businessSummary: LawFinance Limited is an Australia-based provider of finance solutions for the legal industry in the United States. The Company, through its subsidiary, National Health Finance HoldCo, LLC (NHF), operates a medical lien funding business in the United States. NHF purchases medical liens generally related to the provision of medical services to individuals involved in motor vehicle accidents where the services are required due to an injury sustained in the accident and where those individuals were the not-at-fault party (except in Michigan, which is a not-at-fault state).
