NHF's funding solution enables medical providers to maintain liquidity and reduce the administrative burden by managing medical claims through the litigation process. NHF's funding solution is also of benefit to the lawyers acting on behalf of the injured party as it ensures there is no gap in medical care and the claim can be maximized. Its subsidiaries include JustKapital STL Pty and JustKapital NHF USA Holdings.

name: THETA GOLD MINES LTD.
businessSummary: Theta Gold Mines Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration and development company. The Company holds a range of prospective gold assets through its subsidiary, Transvaal Gold Mining Estate Ltd (TGME), in a South African gold mining region. TGME Project phase one consists of four existing mines, including Beta, Frankfort, CDM and the Rietfontein mine. The Project is located next to the historical gold mining town of Pilgrim’s Rest, in the Mpumalanga Province, some 370km northeast of Johannesburg or 95km north of Nelspruit (the Provincial Capital City) and includes more than 43 historical mines identified across the prospective gold field of 620 square kilometers (62,000 hectares). Beta Mine is a producing mine in the Pilgrim’s Rest area. Rietfontein quartz reef is near vertical, sitting in a 16 km long structure which has been mined and partly drilled over 3.5km. The Glynns Mine is located near the town of Sabie in northeast South Africa. Its subsidiary is Theta Gold SA (Pty) Ltd.

name: ADVERITAS LTD
businessSummary: Adveritas Limited is an Australia-based company, which creates software solutions that leverage big data to drive business performance. Its segments include Product and Engineering, Sales and marketing and Corporate. The Product and Engineering segment is engaged in the development and maintenance of the Company's proprietary software offerings. These activities are conducted in Australia and Croatia. The Sales and marketing segment is engaged in deploying its sales and marketing initiatives and in providing ongoing customer service. These activities are carried out by sales and marketing personnel and consultants located in the Australia Pacific region, Europe and South-east Asia. Its ad fraud prevention software, TrafficGuard, is available as a service. TrafficGuard is a full funnel measurement, verification and fraud prevention solution for digital advertising. TrafficGuard detects, mitigates and reports on ad fraud before it impacts digital advertising budgets.

name: ATOMOS LTD
businessSummary: Atomos Limited is an Australia-based holding company. The principal activities of the Company are the manufacture and wholesaling of video equipment. Its product categories include Monitors, Monitor-recorders, Accessories, Cables, Lights, and Wireless Sync. It offers a range of products which includes Sumo 19SE, Shogun Ultra, Shogun Classic, Ninja Phone, Ninja Ultra, Ninja, Shinobi, Shinobi 7, Shinobi II, Shinobi Go, and others. Through the Company’s range of hardware devices for monitoring and recording, software tools, and intelligent cloud services, it engineers best-in-class technologies and creates products for the next generation of filmmakers. The Company's subsidiaries include Atomos AU Pty Ltd, Atomos Engineering Pty Ltd, Atomos GmbH, Atomos Group Services Pty Ltd, Atomos Global Pty Ltd, Atomos IP Pty Ltd, Atomos China, Atomos Design kk, Atomos Japan Co. kk, Atomos Inc, Atomos Global (UK) Ltd, and Timecode Systems Limited.

name: IGNITE LTD
businessSummary: Ignite Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in the provision of contingent labor and permanent recruitment services (Specialist Recruitment), and on demand information technology services (On Demand IT Services). Its segments include Specialist Recruitment and On Demand IT Services. The Specialist Recruitment segment is engaged in providing temporary, contract, and permanent recruitment services at all levels of seniority for businesses in both the public and private sectors. Its expertise spans various industries, including IT and digital, government, business support, engineering, information management, and professional services recruitment. Its On Demand IT Services segment comprises the delivery of specified information technology skills.

name: HEALIUS LTD
businessSummary: Healius Limited is a healthcare company. The Company’s specialized pathology businesses deliver healthcare services across Australia. It provides pathology services, including specialty pathology and clinical trials. It offers its medical laboratory and pathology services through a variety of specialty brands. It provides medical laboratory and pathology services across key diagnostic activities. These include anatomical pathology (histopathology and cytology), clinical pathology (biochemistry, hematology, immunology and microbiology), genomic diagnostics and veterinary pathology. Its brands include QML, Laverty, Dorevitch, Western Diagnostic Pathology, TML, Agilex Biolabs, and Abbott Pathology, among others. These brands operate in Queensland, New South Wales (including the Australian Capital Territory), Victoria, Western Australia and Northern Territory, Tasmania, and South Australia. It provides specialty diagnostic services to consumers and their referring practitioners.

name: ALPHA HPA LTD
businessSummary: Alpha HPA Limited is an Australia-based specialty metals and technology company focused on the delivery of the high purity alumina (HPA) First and Alpha Sapphire Projects, in Gladstone, Queensland. The Company is engaged in the commercialization and production of critical HPA products driving de-carbonization utilizing its proprietary aluminum purification and refining technology. Its segments include HPA First Project and Alpha Sapphire Project. These projects deliver a range of ultra-HPA products that are critical materials to the supply chains of key de-carbonizing high-technology sectors, including light emitting diode (LED) lighting, lithium-ion batteries, semiconductors, and sapphire glass for smartwatches/smartphone screens and wafers for micro-LED technology. Its product range includes Ultra-High Purity Alumina (Al2O3) Powder, Ultra-High Purity Alumina (Al2O3) Tablets, Ultra-High Purity Nano-Alumina (Al2O3) Powder and Ultra Boehmite (Al-O-OH) Powder.

name: SRG GLOBAL LIMITED
businessSummary: SRG Global Limited is an Australia-based diversified infrastructure services company. The Company’s segment includes Maintenance and Industrial Services, and Engineering and Construction. The Maintenance and Industrial Services segment provides integrated asset program management, asset monitoring, inspection and testing, asset maintenance and remediation, specialist drill and blast and geotech, engineered products and access services that sustain and extend critical industries and infrastructure. These span multiple sectors, including oil and gas, energy, major infrastructure, offshore, mining, power generation, water treatment plants, commissioning, decommissioning, shutdowns, specialist testing, inspection, monitoring, and civil works. The Engineering and Construction segment provides specialist engineering and construction of critical infrastructure across a diverse range of sectors, including water, transport, defense, resources, energy, health and education.

name: CITY CHIC COLLECTIVE LIMITED
businessSummary: City Chic Collective Limited is a global omnichannel retailer specializing in dressing plus-size women’s apparel, footwear and accessories. Its omnichannel model comprises a network of approximately 76 stores across Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and Websites operating in ANZ, the United States of America, and third-party marketplaces and wholesale partners in Australia, New Zealand, United States of America, and Canada. Its brand, City Chic clothing and lingerie, is centered on beautiful design and its experience in the plus-size fashion industry. City Chic plus-size fashion includes plus-size dresses, plus-size denim, plus-size lingerie, plus-size tops, and plus-size clothing. City Chic brands shoe categories include boots, heels, flats, and wedges. Its geographical segments include ANZ and the Americas.

name: COLES GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Coles Group Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in the retail industry. The Company operates through two Supermarkets and Liquor. The Supermarkets segment includes fresh food, groceries, and general merchandise retailing, which includes Coles Online and Coles Financial Services. The Liquor segment includes liquor retailing, including online service. Its businesses include Coles Supermarkets, Coles Online, Coles Liquor, flybuys, and Coles Financial Services. Coles Supermarkets is a national full-service supermarket retailer operating more than 851 supermarkets. Coles Liquor business includes three trading banners: Liquorland, First Choice Liquor Market and Vintage Cellars. Coles Online provides its customers with a choice of home delivery, including same-day and overnight drop and go services, or pick up from click and collect locations. Coles Liquor offers a range of wines, spirits, beers, and Ready-to-Drink products. It also operates fresh milk processing facilities.

name: HYDRIX LTD
businessSummary: Hydrix Limited is an Australia-based specialist product designing, engineering and medical device distribution company. The Company is engaged in the development of comprehensive products. Its segments include Hydrix Services, Hydrix Medical and Hydrix Ventures. Hydrix Services segment offers a comprehensive range of engineering, development and regulatory consulting services, including software, electronics, mechanical, industrial design and general product development services. Hydrix Medical distributes disruptive cardiovascular technologies that address unmet needs of patients and healthcare providers. Products include the Guardian real-time heart attack warning system from Avertix Medical, Implicity’s cloud-based artificial intelligence (AI)-driven remote cardiac patient monitoring and data management solution, and Echo IQ’s AI technology. Hydrix Services segment’s portfolio companies include Gyder Surgical Pty Ltd, Avertix Medical Inc., Memphasys Limited, and Cyban Pty Ltd.

name: IONEER LTD
businessSummary: Ioneer Ltd is an Australia-based lithium-boron producer. The Company is engaged in developing lithium and boric acid that can be produced and delivered to customers domestically and internationally. The Company’s Rhyolite Ridge Lithium-Boron Project is located in Esmeralda County, Nevada, situated in the silver peak range, part of the larger geo-physiographic Basin and Range Province of western Nevada. Rhyolite Ridge is approximately 14 miles northeast of Dyer, Nevada. It is 65 miles southwest of Tonopah, Nevada, 215 miles from Reno, and 255 miles from Las Vegas. The Company operates through two segments: North America and Australia. The Rhyolite Ridge covers two separate lithium-boron deposits, which include North Basin and South Basin located approximately four kilometers apart.

name: YANDAL RESOURCES LIMITED
businessSummary: Yandal Resources Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is focused on exploring its portfolio of highly prospective 100% owned gold projects located in the Yandal and Norseman-Wiluna Greenstone Belts in Western Australia. The Company's projects include Ironstone Well and Barwidgee, Mt McClure, and Gordons. The Ironstone Well-Barwidgee Project covers approximately 370 square kilometers (km2) of prospective and under-explored tenure located between the Jundee and Bronzewing mines in the northern Yandal Greenstone Belt. The Mt McClure Project is located approximately 15 kilometers (km) south-west of the historic Bronzewing gold mine and 10 km from Orelia gold mine both owned by Northern Star Resources Ltd in the southern Yandal Belt. The project covers a total strike length of over 17 km of prospective stratigraphy and includes several shallow historical open-cut pits. The Gordons Project is located 30 km north of Kalgoorlie and 15km north of the Kanowna Belle Gold Mine.

name: HERAMED LIMITED
businessSummary: HeraMED Limited is an Australia-based medical data and technology company. The Company is engaged in the digital transformation of maternity care by transforming the prenatal and postpartum experience with its hybrid maternity care platform. The Company offers a proprietary platform that utilizes hardware and software to reshape the doctor/patient relationship using its clinically validated in-home fetal and maternal heart rate monitor, HeraBEAT, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and big data. The HeraBEAT medical device is used by pregnant women in Europe, the United States, Israel and Australia. The Company’s proprietary offering, HeraCARE, is engineered to offer a fully integrated maternal health ecosystem designed to deliver care to ensure expectant mothers are engaged, informed and well-supported, allowing healthcare professionals to provide quality care and enable early detection and prevention of potential risks.

name: CANTERBURY RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Canterbury Resources Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company is focused on exploring potential Tier-1 copper-gold projects in the Southwest Pacific. The Company has a portfolio of projects in Australia and Papua New Guinea that are prospective for porphyry copper-gold, epithermal gold-silver and intrusion-related Ni-Cu-PGM deposits. Its portfolio includes multiple projects that are at the advanced exploration phase. Each project provides potential for the discovery and/or delineation of large-scale copper, gold, and molybdenum resources. Its tenements in Australia include Briggs, Mannersley, Fig Tree Hill, Don River, Rocky Point, Ulam Range, and Peenam. Its tenements in Papua New Guinea include Bismarck, Ekuti Range, Wamum, Waits Creek, Waffa River, and Legusulum. It also has an agreement to acquire EPM 29106 (Jack Shay) in central Queensland, Australia. Briggs is located approximately 60 kilometers west of the deep-water port of Gladstone.

name: CORONADO GLOBAL RESOURCES CDI
businessSummary: Coronado Global Resources Inc. is a global producer, marketer, and exporter of a full range of metallurgical coals. The Company has a portfolio of operating mines and development projects in Queensland, Australia, and in the states of Pennsylvania, Virginia and West Virginia in the United States. It has operations in Australia and the United States. Its Australian Operations comprise the 100%-owned Curragh producing mine complex. Its Curragh complex is located in the Bowen Basin, approximately 14 kilometers (km) north of Blackwater in central Queensland. Curragh produces a variety of low-ash metallurgical coal products. The United States operations are located in the Central Appalachian region in Virginia and West Virginia and produce a suite of metallurgical coal products. It has two producing mining complexes in the United States, which include Buchanan Complex and Logan Complex. It also has two development properties in the United States, which include Mon Valley and Russell County.

name: NORWEST MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Norwest Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on exploration of highly prospective assets, including rare earth elements (REE), copper, gold and base metals. Its projects include Bulgera, Marymia East, Bali, Arunta West and Marriott. The Bulgera Gold Project is located approximately 200 kilometers (km) north of Meekatharra in the seven million ounces (moz) gold Plutonic Well greenstone belt. The Bali Copper Project is located 75 km west of Paraburdoo in Western Australia. The Bali Project includes an eight km long shear being a faulted zone proven to host copper, lead, zinc and silver mineralization. The Arunta West Rare Earth project is located in Western Australia, over 600 km west of Alice Springs. The tenements cover a ground holding of 1600 square kilometers (km2) along the Arunta belt. The Marriott Project is located 70 km southeast of the nickel mining and processing center of Leinster, and 80 km from Leonora.

name: FENIX RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Fenix Resources Limited is an Australia-based integrated mining, logistics and port services company with assets in the Mid-West region of Western Australia. The Company’s 100% owned, flagship Iron Ridge Iron Ore Mine, is a high-grade direct shipping iron ore operation located approximately 360 km northeast of Geraldton. Its segments include Mining, Haulage and Port Services. Its iron ore products are transported by road to Geraldton using its Fenix-Newhaul haulage and logistics business. Its Fenix Port Services business operates its own loading and storage facilities at the Geraldton Port. Its diversified mid-west iron ore, port and rail asset base includes Iron Ridge mine, the Beebyn W11 Deposit, the Twin Peaks Iron Ore Mine, the Shine Iron Ore Mine, the Fenix-Newhaul haulage business, which includes a road haulage fleet, two rail sidings at Ruvidini and Perenjori, as well as the Fenix Port Services business that operates three on-wharf bulk material storage sheds at Geraldton Port.

name: GOLDEN STATE MINING LTD
businessSummary: Golden State Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company's projects include Yule, Paynes Find, Southern Cross East, and Other Western Australia Projects. The Yule Project is located over 45 kilometers (km) southwest of Port Hedland in the northern Pilbara region of Western Australia and consists of approximately six granted exploration licenses and two exploration license applications covering approximately 730 square kilometers (km2). The Southern Cross East project is located approximately 60kms north-east of Southern Cross and 36kms east of Koolyanobbing in the central Yilgarn region of Western Australia and consists of three granted exploration licenses for a total of 620km2. The Canning Hill gold project consists of a single, granted exploration license (E59/2824) located approximately 80 kilometers south of Mt Magnet and 13 kilometers south of the Kirkalocka Gold mine in the Murchison region of Western Australia.

name: IMEXHS LTD
businessSummary: IMEXHS Limited is an Australia-based provider of medical imaging software and radiology services in 18 countries, including Colombia, the United States and Australia. The Company develops software-as-a-service imaging solutions that includes a Picture Archiving and Communications System (PACS), a Radiology Information System (RIS), a Cardiology Information System (CIS) and an Anatomical Pathology Laboratory Information System (APLIS). Its solutions are cloud-based, vendor neutral and zero footprint, with no need for installed software. Its radiology services provide radiological diagnostic services to hospitals and medical facilities in Colombia and Spain using IMEXHS medical imaging software. The Company's services business also provides it with medical images and radiologists interpretation and reports to develop artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Its solutions include AQUILA - Radiology, ALULA - Pathology, ANTEROS - cardiology, artificial intelligence and advanced visualization.

name: ALTHEA GROUP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Althea Group Holdings Limited is a fast-moving consumer goods company. The Company specializes in the manufacturing, sales, and distribution of THC beverages. Through its business unit, Peak Processing Solutions, it develops compliant products that resonate with adult consumers in regulated global markets, including the United States and Canada. Peak Processing Solutions, the Company’s recreational cannabis business, which produces legal cannabis products purchased by adult consumers in retail stores. Peak Processing Solutions manufactures, sells and distributes legal recreational cannabis products in Canada.

name: MOHO RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Moho Resources Ltd is an Australia-based exploration company exploring for gold and other minerals across Australia. The Company operates the Silver Swan North nickel-gold project (E27/623) located in the Western Australia (WA) Goldfield region, approximately 50km from the mining hub of Kalgoorlie. The Silver Swan Project sits on the eastern flank of the Kanowna/Scotia Dome within the Boorara Domain. Its Weld Range North Project is located in the Youanmi Terrain, which includes two distinct types of Archean terrain, namely, the predominant Yilgarn cratonic granitoids and the northern edge of the Weld Range Greenstone Belt. The Youanmi Terrane in the western Yilgarn Craton is unusual in that greenstone belts contain a large proportion of intrusive mafic-ultramafic rocks. Its 100% owned Peak Charles Project is an 874 square kilometer (km2) contiguous tenement package located 88km northwest of Esperance, WA. Its Burracoppin gold project is located near the town of Merredin in WA.

name: IDENTITII LTD
businessSummary: Identitii Limited is an Australia-based regulatory technology (RegTech) company. The Company helps financial services businesses and other regulated entities gain visibility into, and control over, the data needed to meet financial crime reporting obligations in Australia and around the world. It is engaged in developing and licensing software for regulated entities. It is focused on eliminating anti-money laundering (AML) and counter terrorist financing (CTF) compliance risk for financial services businesses. BNDRY is the Company’s flagship product that helps teams embed risk and compliance capability into their products and services. Its Payble's payment experience platform allows councils to customize their payment processes to improve cashflow, lift productivity, and optimize cost. The Company help organizations re-imagine how risk works by building connected ecosystems that provide a single, integrated view of customer risk and related activities.

name: ARCHTIS LTD
businessSummary: archTIS Limited is a global provider of data-centric software solutions for the secure collaboration of sensitive information. The Company’s information security solutions protect sensitive content in government, defense, supply chain, enterprises and regulated industries through attribute-based access and control (ABAC) policies. The Company’s products include archTIS Trusted Data Integration to simplify the complexity of structured data integration and security at scale; Kojensi, a multi-government certified platform for the secure access, sharing and collaboration of sensitive and classified information, and NC Protect for enhanced information protection for file access and sharing, messaging and emailing of sensitive and classified content across Microsoft 365 apps, SharePoint on-premises, NetApp ONTAP, Nutanix Files and Windows file shares. Its Spirion product specializes in sensitive data discovery, classification, and remediation, with a core focus on privacy and compliance.

name: BELLEVUE GOLD LTD
businessSummary: Bellevue Gold Limited is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of minerals and mining and processing of gold at its Bellevue Gold Project in Australia. The Bellevue Gold Project is located in the northern part of the Norseman Wiluna Greenstone belt in the Yilgarn Craton, Western Australia. The project is approximately 40 kilometers (km) north (by sealed highway) from the regional center of Leinster and covers approximately 1,930 square kilometers (km2) of mining and exploration licenses. The project represents one of Australia's highest-grade gold mines, with a Mineral Resource of approximately 3.1 million ounces (Moz) at 9.9 grams per ton (g/t) global grade resource.

name: NICKEL INDUSTRIES LTD
businessSummary: Nickel Industries Limited is a nickel pig iron (NPI) producer, which is a key input in the production of stainless steel. It is engaged in the production of nickel matte. The Company owns a portfolio of mining and low-cost downstream nickel processing assets in Indonesia. It holds interest in high pressure acid leach (HPAL) projects, producing mixed hydroxide precipitate (MHP) for use in the electric vehicle (EV) supply chain. Its segments include Nickel ore mining in Indonesia, Ranger Nickel rotary kiln electric furnace (RKEF) project in Indonesia and Singapore and the HPAL projects in Indonesia. Its principal operations, located in Indonesia, are the Hengjaya Nickel, Oracle Nickel and RKEF projects located within the Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP), the Angel Nickel RKEF Project within the Indonesia Weda Bay Industrial Park (IWIP) and the Hengjaya Mine, a large tonnage, high grade nickel laterite deposit in close proximity to the IMIP.

name: CALIX LTD
businessSummary: Calix Limited is an Australia-based environmental technology company. The Company is engaged in solving global challenges in industrial decarbonization and sustainability. Its segments include Leilac (a CO2 mitigation business), Sustainable Processing, Advanced Batteries and Magnesia. The Leilac segment is accelerating the transition to net-zero by providing the most compelling decarbonization solution for global cement and lime. The Sustainable Processing segment enables mineral processing to enter the electric age with applications targeting green iron and steel, zero emissions alumina, and sustainable lithium and other critical minerals. The Advanced Batteries segment is focused on the development of cathode materials. Magnesia segment offers safe and sustainable magnesium-based products solving global environmental challenges in water and agriculture. In addition, it develops and commercializes applications for antimicrobial resistance and sustainable processing of magnesium metal.

name: ALDORO RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Aldoro Resources Limited is a mineral exploration and development company. The Company has a portfolio of critical mineral projects, including rare earth, niobium, lithium, rubidium and base metal projects. Its project is the Kameelburg REE/Niobium Carbonatite Project in Namibia. Its other projects are based in Western Australia, including the Wyemandoo lithium-rubidium project, the Niobe lithium-rubidium-tantalum Project and the Narndee Igneous Complex in Western Australia. The Wyemandoo critical metal pegmatite project comprises four exploration licenses (E57/1017, E58/571, E58/555 and E59/2431) that overlie part of the Windimurra Igneous Complex. The Niobe Rb-Li Project consists of 195-ha mining lease application over part of the Dalgaranga-Mount Farmer pegmatite swarm located approximately 70-kilometer northwest of Mount Magnet. The Narndee Project covers a large portion of the ultramafic zone of the Narndee Igneous Complex.

name: GREAT SOUTHERN MINING LTD
businessSummary: Great Southern Mining Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company's projects are located within approximately 40 kilometers (km) of operating mills and major operations. It holds exploration licenses totaling 421 square kilometers (km2) in the Duketon Greenstone Belt located to the north of the town of Laverton in Western Australia. The Company is exploring primarily for gold with advanced exploration areas including Amy Clarke and Golden Boulder. The East Laverton Nickel Project comprises four granted exploration licenses covering an area of 405 km2, located approximately 35 km from the town of Laverton. The Mon Ami Project comprises five licenses centered on a permitted mining license, all located in Western Australia. The Edinburgh Park project is located approximately 100 km southeast of Townsville in Queensland and encompasses an area of approximately 1,750 km2 surrounding the high sulphuration epithermal Mt Carlton gold-silver-copper mine.

name: SULTAN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Sultan Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company has a portfolio of mineral exploration projects in Australia that are prospective for gold, copper, nickel and cobalt. Its projects include Lachlan Fold Belt, East Tallering Gold, Dalwallinu Gold, Thadunu Gold/Copper/Minerals, and Lake Grace Nickel/Cobalt/Gold. The Lachlan Fold Belt projects comprise granted exploration licenses, EL8734, EL8704 and EL8735, which together cover a total area of approximately 330 square kilometers (km2). The East Tallering project is prospective for gold mineralization and comprises one granted tenement covering approximately 67 km2. The project is 450 kilometers (km) northeast of Perth and 180 km northeast of Geraldton, Western Australia (WA). The Dalwallinu Gold project has the potential for the discovery of high-grade gold deposits, which comprise tenements covering approximately 167 km2. The project is approximately 250 km northeast of Perth, WA.

name: VIVA ENERGY GROUP LIMITED
businessSummary: Viva Energy Group Limited is an Australia-based convenience retailer, commercial services and energy infrastructure company. The Company’s segments include Convenience & Mobility (C&M), Commercial & Industrial (C&I) and Energy & Infrastructure (E&I). The Company operates a retail convenience and fuel network of approximately 900 stores across Australia and supplies fuels and lubricants to a total network of over 1,500 service stations. It owns and operates the Geelong Refinery located in Victoria, and operates bulk fuels, aviation, bitumen, marine, chemicals, polymers and lubricants businesses supported by more than 20 terminals and 79 airports and airfields across the country. The Company, through OTR Group, operates a fuel and convenience network of approximately 200 stores and 107 quick service restaurants, including Hungry Jacks, Guzman Y Gomez, Subway, Oporto, Wok in a Box, and Krispy Kreme SA. It operates in Australia, Singapore and Papua New Guinea.

name: INVICTUS ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Invictus Energy Limited is an Australia-based independent upstream oil and gas company. The Company is focused on energy resources in sub-Saharan Africa. Its asset portfolio consists of 360,000 hectares within the Cabora Bassa Basin in Zimbabwe, SG 4571 and EPOs 1848/49 contain the Mukuyu and multiple Basin Margin prospects. SG 4571 covers approximately 250,000 acres located in the prospective portion of the Cabora Bassa Basin in northern Zimbabwe. SG 4571 and EPOs 1848/49 contain the Mukuyu and multiple Basin Margin prospects. The Company’s subsidiaries include HIS Texas LLC, Invictus Energy Resources Pty Limited, Invictus Energy Mauritius Limited, Invictus Energy Resources Zimbabwe (Pvt) Ltd, Geo Associates (Pvt) Ltd, Miombo Forest Carbon Investments Pty Ltd, Miombo Forest Carbon Investments Mauritius Ltd, and Miombo Forest Carbon Investments Zimbabwe (Pvt) Ltd.

name: BLUE STAR HELIUM LTD
businessSummary: Blue Star Helium Limited is an Australia-based independent helium exploration and production company. The Company is engaged in finding and developing new supplies of high-grade helium in North America. The Company’s projects include Voyager Project and Galactica/Pegasus Projects. The Company has a landholding and prospect portfolio in the highly prospective Las Animas County area of Colorado, totaling approximately 312,042 acres gross (224,103) acres. It has an inventory of over 11 helium development well locations approved at Galactica/Pegasus Projects. Its portfolio comprises substantial shallow resources associated with the Lyons helium play.

name: RMA GLOBAL LTD
businessSummary: RMA Global Limited is an Australia-based online digital marketing company. The Company operates RateMyAgent, a review platform for client-centered Real Estate professionals. It is engaged in providing data on real estate agents, their active residential property listings and sale results, as well as reviews from vendors and buyers of residential real estate. It operates sales, leasing and mortgage broking across the United States of America, Australia, and New Zealand. Its business offers a way for agents to efficiently collect and promote client reviews, helping them stay top of mind with past clients and earn trust with prospective new clients. The primary streams for the business consist of subscription and promoter fees. Promoter is a product that enables agents and agencies to digitally promote their digital profiles through various third-party platforms. Its subsidiaries include RateMyAgent.com Pty Ltd, RateMyAgent Services Pty Ltd, RAdmin (Aus) Pty Ltd, and RateMyAgent Inc.

name: ATLAS ARTERIA GROUP
businessSummary: Atlas Arteria Group is an Australia-based global owner, operator, and developer of toll roads. The Company has a portfolio of five toll roads in France, Germany, and the United States. The Company owns a 31.14% interest in the Autoroutes Paris-Rhin-Rhone (APRR) toll road group in France. In addition to the APRR business is the smaller Autoroute des deux lacs (ADELAC) business, which connects to APRR in southeast France. Together APRR and ADELAC comprise approximately 2,424 kilometers of motorway network located in the East and Southeast of France. In the United States, it owns a 66.67% interest in the Chicago Skyway, a 12.5 kilometers toll road in Chicago and has 100% of the economic interest in the Dulles Greenway, a 22 kilometers toll road in the Commonwealth of Virginia. In Germany, it owns 100% of the Warnow Tunnel in the northeast city of Rostock.

name: NEUROSCIENTIFIC BIOPHARMACEUTICALS LTD
businessSummary: NeuroScientific Biopharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in developing peptide-based pharmaceutical drugs that target a number of neurodegenerative conditions with high unmet medical demand. The Company's product portfolio includes EmtinB, a therapeutic peptide initially targeting glaucoma, as well as other Emtin peptides (EmtinAc, EmtinAn and EmtinBn). EmtinB is a peptide-based compound that binds to surface-based cell receptors from the LDLR family, activating intracellular signalling pathways that stimulate neuroprotection, neuroregeneration and modulate neuroinflammation. EmtinB is modelled on a specific active domain of the complex human protein called Metallothionein-IIA, which is produced as part of the human body's innate immune response to cell injury. Its StemSmart is a global patented technology engaged in manufacturing cell products. The use of its proprietary StemSmart technology in a special access program for fistulising Crohn’s disease.

name: ELEMENT 25 LTD
businessSummary: Element 25 Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is the operator of the Butcherbird Manganese Project (Project), which hosts onshore manganese resources with Joint Ore Reserve Committee (JORC) resources of more than 260 million tons (Mt) of manganese ore. The Project is located approximately 1,050 kilometers (kms) north of Perth and over 130 kilometers south of Newman in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The Company is developing capabilities by producing high-purity manganese sulphate monohydrate (HPMSM) for sustainable lithium-ion battery cathode manufacture, with several production facilities planned. The Company’s other project include Lake Johnston Lithium Project, which is located approximately 500km east of Perth, Western Australia.

name: CHESS DEPOSITORY INTEREST (CIVMEC LIMITE
businessSummary: Civmec Limited is an Australia-based multidisciplinary construction and engineering services provider to the energy, resources, infrastructure, marine and defense sectors. The Company’s business activities include heavy engineering, shipbuilding, modularization, structural, mechanical, piping (SMP), electrical, instrumentation and control (EIC), precast concrete, site civil works, industrial insulation, maintenance, surface treatment, refractory and access solutions. In the energy sector, it provides solutions for upstream and downstream energy projects. Its vertically integrated operating model supports the delivery of projects in the resource sector, allowing the Company to develop solutions for small or large greenfield and brownfield projects. It delivers several infrastructure, marine and defense projects across Australia, which include Matagarup Bridge, Perth Stadium, Sydney Gateway Project, among others. Its facilities are in Henderson, Port Hedland, Gladstone, and Newcastle.

name: CONSTELLATION RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Constellation Resources Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in exploration for minerals and other commodities. Its projects include Edmund Collier, Yerrida and Ashburton Projects (natural hydrogen projects); Ularring Copper Gold Project; and Orpheus Project. Its natural hydrogen projects expand over a total area of 87,602 square kilometers (km2) in Western Australia across the Edmund-Collier, Yerrida and Ashburton Basins, intersecting and/or in proximity to the Goldfields gas transmission. The Ularring Copper Gold Project consists of tenements E70/4686, E70/4901, E70/6671 covering 222 km2, and is located 100 kilometers (km) northeast of Perth. The Orpheus joint operation area consists of a 70% interest in three mineral exploration licenses, E28/2403, E63/1281, E63/1282, and a 100% interest in E28/2738 and E28/2957, and one exploration license under application, E63/1695 all located in Fraser Range province and targets nickel-copper sulphide mineralization.

name: AVA RISK GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Ava Risk Group Ltd is an Australia-based company, which provides technologies and services to protect critical and high value assets and infrastructure. The Company is engaged in the provision of security technology products for perimeter intrusion detection solutions. The Company operate through three segments: Detect, Access, and Illuminate. Detect segment manufactures and markets smart fiber optic sensing systems for security and condition monitoring for a range of applications including perimeters, pipelines, conveyors, power cables and data networks. Access segment specializes in the development, manufacture and supply of high security biometric readers, security access control and electronic locking products. Illuminate segment specializes in the development and manufacture of illuminators, automatic number plate recognition (ANPR) cameras and perimeter detectors. Its subsidiaries include FFT MENA Pty Ltd, Future Fibre Technologies (US) Inc., and MaxSec Group Pty Ltd.

name: 1414 DEGREES LTD
businessSummary: 1414 Degrees Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in developing and commercializing its silicon-based thermal energy storage SiBrick to provide industrial high-temperature heat from low-cost electricity and biogas. The Company’s technologies include SiBrick, SiBox, and SiPHyR. SiBrick is a thermal energy storage technology that safely and efficiently stores renewable electricity as latent heat, available for use on demand. SiBox technology facilitates the transition to sustainable industrial processes, it delivers consistent, high-temperature heat. It can be seamlessly retrofitted into heavy industry processes, offering a viable alternative to conventional energy sources. SiPHyR is a methane pyrolysis reactor with integrated storage. SiPHyR produces low-emission hydrogen and solid carbon using renewable energy sources. Its SiBox modular product uses SiBrick to provide a scalable decarbonization pathway for diverse industrial energy users.

name: WIDE OPEN AGRICULTURE LTD
businessSummary: Wide Open Agriculture Ltd is an Australia-based ingredient company focusing on the next generation of plant protein ingredients for food and drink manufacturers globally. The Company focused on commercializing its lupin protein isolate products, along with research and product development activities. The Company’s flagship product, Buntine Protein, is a novel plant-based protein derived from lupins. Manufactured under a globally protected patent, Buntine Protein is a versatile ingredient that creates products across multiple categories, including plant-based dairy, meats, baked goods, and health foods. Its subsidiaries include Wide Open Land Pty Ltd, Wide Open Plant Protein Pty Ltd, and Wide Open Agriculture Germany GmbH.

name: ZOONO GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Zoono Group Limited is an Australia-based global biotech company that develops, manufactures and distributes a suite of antimicrobial solutions in multiple countries. The Company produces sprays, wipes and foams suited for skin care, surface sanitizers and mold remediation treatments. Its products are based on the ZOONO molecule, an antimicrobial molecule that bonds to any surface and kills pathogens including bacteria, viruses, algae, fungi and mold. The Company markets its products in various countries, including Australasia, Asia, United States, India, United Kingdom and Europe. Its subsidiaries include Zoono Group Limited (NZ), Zoono Limited, Zoono Holdings Limited (UK), Zoono EU Limited, Zoono (Shanghai) Biotech Co. Limited, Zoono Holdings USA LLC and Zoono South Africa (Pty) Ltd.

name: ZENITH MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Zenith Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration company. The Company is focused on minerals containing lithium and related metals required for rechargeable lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and renewable energy storage. It also has a portfolio of gold and base metal deposits located in Western Australia and Queensland. Its projects are Split Rocks Lithium-Tantalum Project, Waratah Well Lithium-Tantalum Project, Hayes Hill Lithium - Nickel Project, Split Rocks Gold Project, Red Mountain Gold-Silver Project and Earaheedy Zinc Project. The Split Rocks Project is located approximately 40 km south of the regional town of Marvel Loch in the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. The Waratah Well project is located over 20 km northwest of the regional town of Yalgoo in the Murchison Region of Western Australia. The Hayes Hill project consists of four granted exploration licenses in a highly mineral prospective corridor north of Norseman in Western Australia.

name: ZINC OF IRELAND NL
businessSummary: Zinc of Ireland NL is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company focused on its zinc/lead projects in the Republic of Ireland as well as at its Earaheedy zinc/lead/silver and Cascade rare earth element (REE) exploration projects in Western Australia (WA). Its 100%-owned Kildare Project is located approximately 40 kilometers (km) southwest of Dublin and comprises approximately 240 square kilometers (km2) of contiguous prospecting licenses. The Earaheedy license is located approximately 200 km east of Wiluna and 220 km southeast of the RTR Chinook and Magazine Pb-Zn discoveries. The Earaheedy license contains approximately 23 km of strike of the target unconformity between the Frere and Yelma formations. The Company also covers approximately 1380 km2 lithium exploration project in the Superior Province, Manitoba, Canada. Through its subsidiary Avignon Resources Pty Ltd, it has six mineral exploration licenses and seven mining claims in Manitoba.

name: ZEUS RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Zeus Resources Limited is a mineral exploration company. The Company holds 12 granted tenements and applications. These tenements include five granted tenements: one at Wiluna, two at Kalabity and two at Wydgee. There are seven applications for new tenements, including three adding to the Mortimer Hills Project, one adding to the Wiluna Project, one adding to the Blue Hill Project and two adding to the Kalabity Project. The Wiluna Project consists of one granted exploration license (EL), E53/1603, and one EL application, E53/2197, located near the township of Wiluna, approximately 540 km north of Kalgoorlie. The Mortimer Hills Project comprises three EL applications (E09/2791, E09/2798 and E09/2874), located over five kilometers (km) east southeast along the strike from DLI’s Yinnietharra Lithium Prospect. It also owns six exploration licenses with an area of approximately 79 square kilometers (km2) comprising the Casablanca Antimony Project located in central Morocco.

name: YOWIE GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Yowie Group Limited is a global brand licensing company. The Company specializes in the development of consumer products designed to promote learning, understanding and engagement with the natural world through the adventures and exploits of six endearing Yowie characters. The Company employs its Company-owned intellectual property rights to supply Yowie branded chocolate confectionery products, a digital platform and Yowie branded licensed consumer products. The Company operates through two geographical segments: United States, and Australia. The Company’s collections include Baby Animals, Animals with Super Powers, Blast from the Past, Wild Water, WCS, Rescue, All Americas, , Ranger, Premier, and more. Its Educator Zone includes activities, such as Yowie Endangered Videos, Student Affirmation Cards, Student Affirmation Cards, and others. Its subsidiaries include Yowie Enterprises Pty Ltd, Yowie North America, Inc., Yowie Natural World, Inc., and Yowie Hong Kong Holdings Limited.

name: YOJEE LTD
businessSummary: Yojee Limited is an Australia-based logistics technology company focused on simplifying freight operations through digital innovation. The Company is a developer and provider of software solutions to the Asian Pacific contracted road transportation industry. Its platform enables logistics providers to consolidate complex supply chain networks into a single, intuitive system. Its cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) logistics platform facilitates the flow of freight movements into a single ecosystem. Its Transport Carrier Management System (TCMS) platform enables real-time collaboration, execution, and visibility across transport operations. The Company is also developing its MOSAIC platform, the freight forwarding software that simplifies complex logistics with an intuitive user-focused interface. The Company serves third-party logistics providers (3PLs), global freight forwarders, major shipping lines, and large-scale manufacturers.

name: XRF SCIENTIFIC LTD
businessSummary: XRF Scientific Limited is an Australia-based company, which manufactures and sells chemicals, equipment and accessories to production mines, construction material companies and commercial analytical laboratories, in Australia and overseas. These finished goods are primarily used in the preparation of samples for analysis. The Company's segments include Capital Equipment, Precious Metals and Consumables. The Capital Equipment segment manufactures automated fusion equipment, high temperature test and production furnaces, laboratory jaw crushers and general laboratory equipment. The Precious Metals segment manufactures products for the laboratory and industrial platinum alloy markets. The Consumables segment manufactures chemicals and other supplies for analytical laboratories. Its products and services include Fusion Equipment, Flux & Chemicals, Platinum Labware, Precision Platinum and Lab Equipment. Its subsidiaries include XRF Chemicals Pty Ltd, XRF Labware Pty Ltd and others.

name: WEST WITS MINING LTD
businessSummary: West Wits Mining Limited is an Australia-based company focused on the exploration, development, and production of precious and base metals. The Company’s projects include Witwatersrand Basin project (WBP) and Mt Cecelia project. The Witwatersrand Basin project is located in the gold region of Central Rand Goldfield of South Africa boasts, a 4.28 million ounces (Moz) gold project. The Witwatersrand Basin is a largely underground geological formation which surfaces in the Witwatersrand. In Western Australia, the Company is exploring for gold and base metals at the Mt Cecelia project in a district that supports several projects, such as Woodie Woodie manganese mine, Nifty copper, and Telfer gold/copper/silver mines. The Mt Cecelia project is located on the border of the East Pilbara and Paterson Provinces of Western Australia and covers approximately 225 square kilometers (km2) of prospective ground, strategically located adjacent to tenements held by Rio Tinto Ltd.

name: WISETECH GLOBAL LTD
businessSummary: WiseTech Global Limited is a developer and provider of software solutions to the logistics execution industry globally. The Company develops, sells, and implements software solutions which enable logistics service providers to facilitate the storage of goods and information, domestically and internationally. It provides its solutions to approximately 17,000 customers in over 174 countries. The Company's technology, CargoWise, is an integrated, global software platform for logistics service providers. Its software enables logistics service providers to execute logistics transactions and manage their operations on one global database across multiple users, functions, offices, corporations, currencies, countries, and languages. Its main data centers in Australia, Europe and the United States deliver its CargoWise platform principally through the cloud, which customers access as needed and pay for usage as they execute on its platform.

name: WESTSTAR INDUSTRIAL LTD
businessSummary: WestStar Industrial Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of an industrial services company providing engineering, construction and mining services to the resources, energy and infrastructure sectors. Its segments include SIMPEC Pty Ltd and Alltype Engineering Pty Ltd. SIMPEC Pty Ltd is a construction contractor with specialist experience in both Structural Mechanical and Piping and Electrical and Instrumentation works. Alltype Engineering Pty Ltd provides workshop, site installation, construction and maintenance services to the oil and gas, water, power generation, infrastructure, mining, resources, utility, petrochemical and defense industries. Its services include multidiscipline construction contracting, structural mechanical piping (SMP), electrical and instrumentation, fabrication of pipe, plate and structural steel, rotating equipment installation, fluid systems solutions, equipment and services, and asset management services.

name: WOOLWORTHS GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Woolworths Group Limited is an Australia-based retailer. The Company's segments include Australian Food, Australian B2B, New Zealand Food, W Living, and Other. The Australian Food segment is engaged in procurement of food, drinks and related products for resale and provision of services (including eCommerce) to retail and business customers in Australia. The Australian B2B segment includes procurement and distribution of food and related products for resale to other businesses and provision of supply chain services to business customers in Australia. The New Zealand Food segment includes procurement of food, drinks and related products for resale and provision of services (including eCommerce) to retail and wholesale customers in New Zealand. The W Living segment includes procurement of discount general merchandise and pet products for resale to retail customers in Australia and New Zealand. The Other segment comprises Quantium and various support functions.

name: WORLEY LTD
businessSummary: Worley Limited is an Australia-based solutions provider for a diverse range of end markets in energy, chemicals, and resources. The Company provides its customers with data-driven and technology-driven solutions at every stage of the project lifecycle. It caters to various sectors, including energy, chemicals, and resources. In the energy sector, it produces energy from conventional, such as coal and oil, and low-carbon energy sources, such as gas, wind, solar and hydrogen, as well as undertaking projects related to power generation, transmission, and distribution. In the chemicals sector, it manufactures, processes, and refines chemicals and fuels, such as renewable fuels, petrochemicals, polymers, and specialty chemicals. In the resources sector, it processes mineral and metal resources, such as resources that are central to the energy transition and resource projects related to water use and re-use, the environment, transport, ports and site remediation and decommissioning.

name: WELLARD LTD
businessSummary: Wellard Limited is an Australia-based supplier of livestock vessels and livestock. The Company’s core business is chartering purpose-built, medium and large livestock vessels to international exporters and importers who want their livestock to arrive at their destination fit and healthy. Its segments include Chartering and Other segments. The Chartering segment is engaged in the business of livestock transportation required to deliver livestock globally. Other segments consist of corporate services. It also connects primary producers of cattle, sheep, and other livestock to customers globally. It designs and builds its own vessels to avoid the compromises in the design that retrofitting an existing ship requires.

name: WHITEHAVEN COAL LTD
businessSummary: Whitehaven Coal Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the production of coal. It is focused on the development and operation of coal mines in New South Wales (NSW) and Queensland (QLD). Its segments include NSW Operations and QLD Operations. It operates six mines (five open-cut and one large underground mine) in the Gunnedah Coal Basin of NSW and Bowen Basin of QLD. Its assets include Maules Creek Mine, Narrabri Mine, Vickery Extension Project, Werris Creek Mine, Gunnedah CHPP, Winchester South Project, Narrabri Stage-3 Extension Project, Rocglen Mine, Sunnyside Mine, Canyon Mine, Daunia Mine, and Blackwater Mine. Its development projects include the Vickery project, Winchester South project and the Narrabri Stage 3 Extension project. The Tarrawonga open cut mine produces high-quality thermal coal and semi-soft coking coal. Vickery Extension Project is a proposal to construct an open-cut coal mine and associated on-site infrastructure about 25 kilometers north of Gunnedah.

name: WESTGOLD RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Westgold Resources Limited is a gold producer with a large and strategic land package in the Murchison and Southern Goldfields of Western Australia. The Company’s operations within the Murchison incorporating four underground mines (Bluebird-South Junction, Starlight, Big Bell, and Fender) and three processing hubs (Fortnum, Tuckabianna and Bluebird). The Southern Goldfields Operations incorporate the Beta Hunt and Two Boys underground mines and one processing hub (Higginsville). Its operations around the regional town of Bluebird-South Junction Underground Mine (Meekatharra) encompass its central group of assets, including the historic gold mining centers of Meekatharra North, Paddy’s Flat, Yaloginda, Nannine and Reedy’s. Its operations at Fortnum are located in the Proterozoic age Bryah Basin stratigraphy about 150 kilometers (km) northwest of Meekatharra. The gold operations at Higginsville are located about 75 km south of the Beta Hunt Mine in Higginsville, Western Australia.

name: WESFARMERS LTD
businessSummary: Wesfarmers Ltd is engaged in various business operations, such as home improvement, outdoor living products and supply of building materials. Its Kmart segment is a retailer of apparel and general merchandise, including toys, leisure, entertainment, home and consumables. Its Energy and Fertilizers (WesCEF) segment is a manufacturer and marketer of chemicals for industry, mining and mineral processing. Its Officeworks segment is a retailer and supplier of office products and solutions for households and small-to-medium-sized businesses. Its Industrial and Safety segment is a supplier and distributor of maintenance, repair and operating products. Its Wesfarmers Health (Health) segment is a wholesaler and retailer of pharmaceutical goods, health, wellness and beauty products. Its Catch segment is an online retailer offering branded products on a first-party basis and a third-party online marketplace. Its Other segments include OneDigital, Forest products, and Property.

name: WINCHESTER ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Winchester Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas explorer and producer. The Company holds approximately 17,622 acres under lease in Nolan and Coke Counties in the East Permian Basin in Texas, United States. The East Permian Basin contains a number of stacked oil and gas reservoirs. The Project has significant oil resource potential across a host of historically productive formations such as the Fry/Strawn Sands as well as the thick Penn Carbonate, Wolfcamp D organic shales, Crystal Falls (Canyon) and Cisco formations. These are at depths ranging between 4,000 -7,500 feet and can be targeted with modest drilling and completion costs, with production supported by existing infrastructure. The Company is producing the majority of its oil from the Fry Member of the Strawn interval within the Mustang Oil Field. It develops the Fry Sand in the Mustang Oil Field with highly commercial, low-cost and low-risk wells designed to significantly increase oil production.

name: WEBJET LTD
businessSummary: WEB Travel Group Limited is an Australia-based global business to business (B2B) travel distribution company. The Company connects travel sellers with travel buyers across all major global markets. WebBeds, its brand, is a global online marketplace for the travel trade, an intermediary connecting hotels and other travel service suppliers to a distribution network of travel buyers all over the world. WebBeds sources room inventory from worldwide hotels, then connects, aggregates and merchandises that inventory as bookable product in its platform, the WebBeds Global Marketplace, and distributes it to a global network of travel trade buyers, who sell to the traveling public. Global and regional hotel chains, resorts, transfer and sightseeing companies and more - can sell their products through WebBeds by connecting to a diversified global network of over 50,000 travel buyers across more than 39,000 locations. It also offers application programming interface connectivity.

name: WEEBIT NANO LTD
businessSummary: Weebit Nano Ltd is an Australia-based developer and licensor of advanced semiconductor memory technology. The Company’s Resistive RAM (ReRAM) addresses the growing need for higher performance and lower power non-volatile memory (NVM) solutions in a range of new electronic products, such as Internet of Things (IoT) devices, smartphones, robotics, autonomous vehicles, fifth generation (5G) communications and artificial intelligence. Its ReRAM technology is based on fab-friendly materials and can be easily integrated with existing flows and processes. It is creating ReRAM IP that customers can embed in their system-on-chip (SoC) designs. It is also developing discrete (stand-alone) memory technology, targeting storage class memory, persistent memory and NOR flash replacement. Weebit ReRAM is ideal for applications requiring high temperature and endurance levels, offering a power efficient NVM that is easy to integrate and tolerant to radiation and electromagnetic fields.

name: WESTPAC BANKING CORP
businessSummary: Westpac Banking Corporation is an Australia-based company that provides banking and selected financial services, operating under multiple brands, and predominantly in Australia and New Zealand, with a small presence in Europe, North America, Asia and the Pacific. Its segments include Consumer, Business & Wealth, Westpac Institutional Bank (WIB), Westpac New Zealand and Group Businesses. The Consumer segment provides a full range of banking products and services to customers in Australia through three lines of business consisting of mortgages, consumer finance and cash and transactional banking. The Business & Wealth segment comprises business banking, wealth management, private wealth, and Westpac Pacific. The WIB segment delivers a range of financial products and services to corporate, institutional and government customers. The Westpac New Zealand segment provides banking, and wealth products and services for consumer, business and institutional customers in New Zealand.

name: WAM CAPITAL LTD
businessSummary: WAM Capital Limited (WAM) is an Australia-based investment company. WAM’s investment objectives are to deliver investors a stream of fully franked dividends, provide capital growth and preserve capital. It provides investors with exposure to an actively managed diversified portfolio of undervalued growth companies listed on the Australian Securities Exchange, with a focus on small-to-medium sized businesses. It also provides exposure to relative value arbitrage and market mispricing opportunities. Wilson Asset Management is the Company's investment manager.

name: WEST AFRICAN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: West African Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold mining company. The Company is engaged in mining, mineral processing, exploration, project development, community and social sustainability, and rehabilitation within the West African country of Burkina Faso. It operates through two segments: the Mining Operations, which comprises the Sanbrado Gold Project operations located in Burkina Faso, and Construction and Exploration & Evaluation (E&E) segment comprises mines under construction and exploration and evaluation projects in locations other than Sanbrado. Its Sanbrado Gold Project is located approximately 90 kilometers (kms) east-southeast of Ouagadougou, the capital of Burkina Faso. Its Kiaka Gold Project is approximately 45 km south of Sanbrado Gold Mine in Burkina Faso. Its Toega Gold Project is located 14 km southwest of the Company’s Sanbrado gold operation. Its tenement portfolio comprises over 1,334 km2 over the Markoye fault region in central and southern Burkina Faso.

name: VYSARN LIMITED
businessSummary: Vysarn Limited is a vertically integrated water service provider. The Company is engaged in hydrogeological drilling, test pumping, reinjection water services and water consultancy businesses predominately in Western Australia. Its segments include Industrial, Technologies, and Advisory. Its Industrial segment consisting of Pentium Hydro (PH) and Pentium Test Pumping (PTP). The Advisory segment consisting of Pentium Water (PW). The Technology segment consisting of Project Engineering (ProEng). The Company, through Waste Water Services Pty Ltd., is engaged in the design, manufacture, installation, and maintenance of waste water treatment plants, potable water treatment plants, and pumping stations. The Company’s subsidiaries include Pentium Hydro Pty Ltd, Pentium Test Pumping Pty Ltd, Pentium Water Pty Ltd, Project Engineering (WA) Pty Ltd, Vysarn Asset Management Pty Ltd, and CMP Consulting Group Pty Ltd.

name: VRX SILICA LTD
businessSummary: VRX Silica Limited is an Australia-based silica sand company. The Company is focused on developing its 100% owned silica sand projects at Arrowsmith (North, Brand and Central), Muchea and Boyatup in Western Australia. The Arrowsmith project includes Arrowsmith North, Brand Silica and Central Silica Sand projects, all located approximately 270 kilometers (km) north of Perth, Western Australia. Its 100%-owned Muchea Mining Lease is located approximately 50 km north of Perth, Western Australia. Muchea comprises one granted exploration license, two exploration license applications, one granted mining lease, three granted miscellaneous licenses and one miscellaneous license application for an area of 74.4 km2. The Company’s 100%-owned Boyatup Silica Sand Project is located about 125km east of Esperance in Western Australia and is connected by sealed road to the Esperance Port. Boyatup includes two tenements, E69/3560 and E69/3668, for a total project area of 124 km2.

name: VOLT POWER GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Volt Group Limited, formerly Volt Power Group Limited, is an industrial technology company, which develops and commercializes ESG focused, zero emission power generation and hydrogen production technologies and mining equipment. Its products include EcoQuip, ATEN, HYTEN and Wescone. EcoQuip offers mobile solar light and communications towers incorporating United States military spec build quality, superior illumination performance and advanced OEM power management, data and remote-control telemetry. ATEN Technology or System is a waste heat recovery, zero emission electricity generation technology. An installed ATEN system recovers open cycle gas turbine and reciprocating engine driven power station exhaust heat or industrial waste heat to generate zero emission, baseload electricity. The HYTEN technology is a waste heat to hydrogen production system. Wescone supplies sample crushers and sample crushing solutions to the mining, mineral processing and assay laboratory industries.

name: VMOTO LTD
businessSummary: Vmoto Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the development and manufacture, marketing and distribution of electric two-wheel vehicles (electric motorcycles and electric mopeds). It operates in four geographical segments: Australia, China, Europe and Singapore. Its Super Soco, a business to consumer (B2C) brand for which Vmoto holds international marketing rights outside of China. The Company manufactures and distributes a CUX Ducati Special Edition electric two-wheel vehicle. The Company’s fleet management platform allows businesses to track and monitor their vehicles in real-time. It has supplied samples to a range of B2C and B2B distributors and customers, which includes Austria, Belgium, Brazil, France, India, Greece, Paraguay, Portugal, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, Turkey, United Kingdom and the United States.

name: VITAL METALS LTD
businessSummary: Vital Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is primarily focused on developing and exploring the Nechalacho Rare Earth Project in Northwest Territories, Canada. The Nechalacho Project is a light rare earth (bastnaesite) project located in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories (NWT), Canada, where it commenced mining and development in the North T Zone. The Company’s second rare earth project, Wigu Hill, is located near the town of Kisaki in the Morogoro region of Tanzania. The Wigu Hill project is a light rare earth element deposit and consists of a carbonite complex with bastnaesite mineralization with a NI 43-101 Inferred resource estimate of 3.3Mt at 2.6% LREO5, including 510,000t @ 4.4% LREO5.

name: VIKING MINES LTD
businessSummary: Viking Mines Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in investing in mineral exploration projects. The Company’s projects include Canegrass Battery Minerals Project and First Hit Project. The Canegrass Battery Minerals Project is located in the Murchison region, approximately 620 kilometers (km) north-east of Perth, Western Australia. Its Canegrass Battery Minerals Project has three deposits at Fold Nose, Kinks and Kinks South. The First Hit Lithium and Gold Project is centered around the high-grade First Hit gold mine situated along the prospective Ida and Zuleika Shear zones in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The First Hit Project is located west of Menzies in the Western Australia Goldfields and is approximately 60 km south and along the strike of Delta Lithium’s Mount Ida Lithium Gold Project. The Company has a substantial landholding totaling approximately 493 square kilometers (km2). Its lithium targets include Odin, Thor, Mjolnir, Vidar and Heimdall.

name: VEEM LTD
businessSummary: VEEM Limited (VEEM) is an Australia-based company, which is a designer and manufacturer of high-technology marine propulsion and stabilization systems for the global luxury motor yacht, fast ferry, commercial workboat, and defense industries. The Company is also engaged in manufacturing engineered products and services for the marine, defense, and mining industries. It operates various businesses, including VEEM Marine Propellers, VEEM Marine Gyrostabilizers, VEEM 24-7 Engineering, Defense, Timcast Hollowbar, Conquest Propellers, and SHARROW by VEEM. VEEM is a producer of high-performance propellers for inboard powered vessels. It is a manufacturer of specialized fin systems and components for defense, including the US Navy's LCS ride control foils and submarine valves and mufflers. VEEM is a manufacturing demonstrator propeller blades for the BAE type-26 Hunter Class frigate program. VEEM was also involved in the Large Hadron Collider and the Atlas Detector's Radiation Shield Doors.

name: VICINITY CENTRES
businessSummary: Vicinity Centres is an Australia-based retail property company with a fully integrated asset management platform, and $24 billion in retail assets under management. The Company’s principal activities include investment in a portfolio of retail investment properties. It owns and manages retail destinations across Australia and offers a range of retail, residential, and office spaces. It has a direct portfolio with interests in approximately 51 shopping centers (including the DFO Brisbane business) and manages 26 assets on behalf of Strategic Partners. Its properties include Bankstown Central, Bayside, Buranda Village, Chadstone, DFO Perth, Emporium Melbourne, Queen Victoria Building, QueensPlaza, and The Glen. Its development properties include One Middle Road, Chadstone, Bankstown Central, Victoria Gardens, Box Hill Central, and Chatswood Chase Sydney. Its retail solutions include advertising, brand activations, leasing, and pop-up retail.

name: UNITED OVERSEAS AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: United Overseas Australia Ltd is a Malaysia-based property development and investment company. The Company's principal activities include land development and resale, the holding of investment properties to generate rental income, operations of hotel and food and beverage outlets, provision of facilities support services and carpark operations and provision of management services. Its segments include Investment, Land development and resale and Others. The investment segment is engaged in the holding of investment properties to generate rental income, capital appreciation or both. The land development and resale segment activities include development, construction and sale of residential and commercial properties. The other segment includes operations of hotel and food and beverage outlets, provision of facilities support services and carpark operations, revenue from money lending services and provision of management services.

name: TYRANNA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Tyranna Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral explorer primarily focused on lithium exploration in Angola, Africa. The Company's Muvero Lithium Project is located near the Port of Namibe (or Mocamedes), where drilling is targeting spodumene mineralization. The Muvero Lithium Project covers 207 square kilometers (km2) area targets the Giraul pegmatite field, in which at least-1000, pegmatites have been identified. The exposed pegmatites are up to 1,500m long and up to 100m wide, presenting as patches of outcrop surrounded by rubble and shallow soil derived from eroded rock. It also owns 72% the Namibe Lithium Project. The Namibe Lithium project is located in undeveloped land east of the city of Namibe, provincial capital of Namibe Province in southwest Angola. The Namibe Lithium Project is located approximately 25 kilometers (km) east of the Port of Namibe.

name: TREASURY WINE ESTATES LTD
businessSummary: Treasury Wine Estates Limited is an Australia-based wine company. The Company is involved in the production, marketing and sale of wine. The Company’s segments include Treasury Premium Brands, Penfolds, and Treasury Americas. The Treasury Premium Brands segment is responsible for the manufacture, sale and marketing of wine within Australia, Asia, Europe, Canada, the Middle East and Africa. The Penfolds segment is responsible for the manufacture, sale and marketing of Penfolds wine globally. The Treasury Americas segment is responsible for the manufacture, sale and marketing of wine within North American and Latin America regions. In Australia, it owns and operates six wineries and one packaging facility with wines primarily produced in South Australia and Victoria. In New Zealand, it owns one winery located in Marlborough. Its brands include Penfolds, DAOU Vineyards, 19 Crimes, Drop of Sunshine, Frank Family Vineyards, Etude, Beaulieu Vineyard, and Seppelt.

name: TAMAWOOD LTD
businessSummary: Tamawood Limited is an Australia-based systems company. The Company's principal activities consist of contract home construction, home design and other associated activities in Australia; franchising and licensing operations, and consumer durables. The Company's subsidiaries include AstiVita Limited, AstiVita Bathrooms and Kitchens Pty Ltd, Dixonbuild Pty Ltd, DixonConstruct Pty Ltd, DixonRes Pty Ltd, Dixon Systems Pty Ltd, Edesia Asti Pty Ltd, Indent Manufacturers Pty Ltd, Solarpower Pty Ltd, Rosieres Appliances Pty Ltd, SolarRex Pty Ltd and TamawoodL Pty Ltd.

name: TTA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: TTA Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company. The principal activity of the Company is trading via e-commerce and selling to retail customers through TEAC Store Website and various e-commerce platforms. The Company operates through a single segment, which is sale of electronic consumer goods via e-commerce in the Australian market.

name: TITANIUM SANDS LTD
businessSummary: Titanium Sands Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company, through its local partners, Orion Minerals (Private) Limited, Sanur Minerals (pvt) Ltd and Kilsythe Investments (Private) Limited, are developing a high grade mineable heavy mineral sands project at Mannar Island, Sri Lanka. The Mannar Island Heavy Mineral Sands Project is located in Northwest Sri Lanka and is an ilmenite feedstock project with minor credits from other mineral components. It holds five heavy mineral sands exploration licenses located in North West Sri Lanka on Mannar Island and the adjacent mainland coast. The exploration licenses include EL 370, EL 351, EL 425, EL 423, and EL 424. It is focused around Mannar Island, an island approximately 26 kilometers (km) long and six km wide, and 140 square kilometers in area, joined to the mainland shore by road and rail connections over a short causeway.

name: TEMPLE & WEBSTER GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Temple & Webster Group Ltd is an Australia-based pure play online retailer of furniture and homewares. The Company has over 200,000 products on sale from hundreds of suppliers. The Company runs a drop-shipping model whereby products are sent directly to customers by suppliers, enabling faster delivery times and reducing the need to hold inventory, allowing for a larger product range. The drop ship range is complemented by a private label range which is sourced directly by the Company from overseas suppliers. It operates in one segment being the sale of furniture, homewares, and home improvement products through its online platforms. Its Trade & Commercial division services the business-to-business (B2B) market, offering exclusive product ranges, procurement, styling, specialized delivery and installation services through a dedicated support team. It also offers a range of home improvement products that customers need to renovate and redecorate their homes.

name: TLOU ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Tlou Energy Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in developing energy solutions in Sub-Saharan Africa through gas-fired power and ancillary projects. The principal activity of the Company is to explore and evaluate power solutions in Sub-Saharan Africa through Coalbed Methane (CBM) gas-fired power. Its operations include Lesedi Project, Lesedi Gas-to-Power project, Mamba Project, and Boomslang Project. The Lesedi Project consists of four Prospecting Licenses (PL) and a Production License. The Lesedi Gas-to-Power Project (Lesedi) is 100% owned and is the Company's advanced project. At Lesedi, the Company is developing a proposed 10MW gas-to-power project. The Mamba area is situated adjacent to Lesedi. It consists of five Prospecting Licenses covering an area of approximately 4,500 square kilometers (Km2). Prospecting License, PL011/2019 designated Boomslang, is approximately 1,000 Km2 and is situated adjacent to the Company’s existing licenses.

name: TRITON MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Triton Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration and development company. The Company is focused on graphite projects. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiaries, has an interest in Grafex Limitada (Grafex). Its flagship Ancuabe Project is located approximately 45 kilometers (km) due west from the northern Mozambique coastal port of Pemba on the Indian Ocean shoreline. The project is located adjacent to the producing AMG Graphit Kropfmuhl (GK) graphite mine and nearby villages that provide a motivated local workforce. The project is approximately 80 km by sealed road from an operating container port in Pemba, with access to existing transport and power infrastructure and supportive local and national governments. Grafex is comprised of four exploration licenses, EL5305, EL5380, EL5365 and EL5304. The Company has also granted with mining concession for Cobra Plains Graphite Project located in northern Mozambique, within Neoproterozoic rocks of the Xixano Complex.

name: TORO ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Toro Energy Limited is an Australia-based uranium development and exploration company with projects in Western Australia. Its tenure in Western Australia is also prospective for gold and base metals. The Company’s Wiluna Uranium Project is centered on its planned processing facility located 30 kilometers (km) south of the town of Wiluna in the northern goldfields of Western Australia. The Project consists of the Centipede, Millipede, Lake Maitland, Lake Way uranium. Its Theseus project is located near Lake Mackay on the Western Australian/Northern Territory border. It owns a 100% interest in two exploration licenses making the Theseus Uranium Project in northern Western Australia with JORC Mineral Resources of 6.9Mlb U3O8; and interest in an incorporated joint venture with Deep Yellow Limited that owns prospective exploration tenure in Namibia, and equity and financial instruments in Strateco Resources Ltd, which owns the Matoush Uranium Project in Quebec, Canada.

name: TECHNOLOGYONE LTD
businessSummary: TechnologyOne Limited is an Australia-based enterprise software company. The Company is engaged in the development, marketing, sales, implementation, and support of fully integrated enterprise business software solutions. The Company's segments include Software and Consulting. The Software segment consists of sales and marketing, research and development, and a Software as a Service (SaaS) platform. The Consulting segment is responsible for services in relation to its software. The Company's enterprise business software solutions include Technology One Business Analytics, Technology One Corporate Performance Management, Technology One DXP Local Government, Technology One Enterprise Asset Management, Technology One Enterprise Budgeting, Technology One Enterprise Cash Receipting, Technology One Enterprise Content Management, Technology One Financials, Technology One Human Resource and Payroll, Technology One Performance Planning, and Technology One Property and Rating, among others.

name: TELSTRA CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Telstra Group Limited is an Australia-based telecommunications company, offering a full range of communications services.
