The Company's Telstra Consumer segment provides telecommunication and technology products and services to consumer customers in Australia using mobile and fixed network technologies. Its Telstra Business segment provides telecommunication and technology products and services to small and medium businesses. Its Telstra Enterprise Australia segment provides telecommunication services, advanced technology solutions and others. Its Telstra International segment provides telecommunication, media and technology products and services to consumer, business and government customers in the South Pacific through its Digicel Pacific business. Its Networks, IT and Product segment's operations include Global Networks and Technology, and Product and Technology. Its Telstra InfraCo segment provides telecommunication products and services delivered over its networks.

name: TALISMAN MINING LTD
businessSummary: Talisman Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral development and exploration company. The Company is engaged in the exploration, discovery and development of opportunities in base and precious metals. It has secured tenements in the Cobar/Mineral Hill region in Central New South Wales (NSW) through the grant of its own exploration licenses and through a joint venture agreement. Its projects include Lachlan Base Metal and Copper-Gold Project, Mabel Creek Project and Yarindury Porphyry Copper-Gold Project. Its Lachlan Project encompasses approximately 7,100 square kilometers (km2) land position in the highly prospective Lachlan Fold Belt of central New South Wales. It also has over 1040 km2 of highly prospective tenure in Mabel Creek Project, which is a prospective for iron oxide copper gold (IOCG) deposits and intrusion related rare earth and battery metals mineralization. Yarindury Project is located 30km east of Dubbo in the Macquarie Volcanic Arc of central-western NSW.

name: TALGA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Talga Group Ltd is an Australia-based battery materials and technology company. The Company is engaged in the development of sustainable battery materials via technology and vertical integration of its 100% owned Swedish graphite resources. Its flagship product, Talnode-C, is a natural graphite anode material made using renewable energy for a low emissions footprint. Its battery materials under development include an advanced silicon anode product and conductive additives for cathodes. It is also advancing the commercialization of its silicon anode, Talnode-Si. Its product portfolio also includes recycled graphite anode product, Talnode-R. It owns 100% of multiple mineral assets of graphite, copper, cobalt and iron in northern Sweden. Its projects include the Vittangi Anode Project, Vittangi Graphite Project, Jalkunen Graphite Project, Kiskama Copper-Cobalt Project, Raitajarvi Graphite Project, Masugnsbyn Iron Project, and Other Battery Metals Project.

name: TREK METALS CDI
businessSummary: Trek Metals Limited is engaged in the mining and exploration industry. The Company’s principal activity is to progress the exploration of its mineral properties and to identify acquisitions in the mineral resources sector. The Company’s projects include Christmas Creek, McEwen Hills, South Woodie Woodie, Tambourah, Pincunah, and Kingia. Christmas Creek Project includes high-grade gold interceptions and early-stage gold and rare earth element (REE) soil anomalies. McEwen Hills Project targets niobium and copper-gold deposits. South Woodie Woodie Project, in the Pilbara mining district of Western Australia, includes two manganese resources, open drill intercepts, and preliminary metallurgical test results. Tambourah Project involves gold and lithium exploration in a region with limited prior exploration. Pincunah Project involves gold and base metal exploration in an area with known mineralization trends. Kingia Project involves exploration of geothermal brine for lithium content.

name: TUNGSTEN MINING NL
businessSummary: Tungsten Mining NL is a resources company, which is primarily focused on the discovery and development of tungsten deposits in Australia. The Company's key projects are Mt Mulgine in Western Australia & Watershed in northeast Queensland and Hatches Creek in the Northern Territory. Mt Mulgine is located in the Murchison Region of Western Australia, approximately 350 kilometers (km) north northeast of Perth. The Watershed Project is located 130 km north of Cairns in a mining-friendly jurisdiction. The Hatches Creek Project is located 375 km northeast of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory of Australia. The Project consists of two granted exploration licenses' covering 31.4 km2 (EL22912 and EL23462), which cover the entire historic Hatches Creek tungsten mining center.

name: TRIANGLE ENERGY (GLOBAL) LTD
businessSummary: Triangle Energy (Global) Limited is an oil and gas production and exploration company. The Company’s projects include L 7 Mount Horner and UK Permits P2628 and P2650. The Company holds an approximately 50% interest in the Mt Horner L7 Production License (L7) and the EP 437 exploration license. The Mt Horner license overlies the Allanooka Terrace in the North Perth Basin and is adjacent to the prolific Dandaragan Trough, and south of Geraldton, located about five hours' drive north of Perth. The L7 Permit is situated just north of the large Waitsia, Senecio and Lockyer Deep gas fields. It holds a 50% interest in Permit P2628 in the West Shetlands Basin in the United Kingdom offshore. The permit is operated by Athena Exploration and includes the Cragganmore gas discovery. It also holds a 50% interest in Permit P2650 on the northern margin of the Mid-North Sea High. The permit is operated by Orcadian Exploration and includes gas exploration permits.

name: 3D ENERGI LTD
businessSummary: 3D Energi Limited is an Australia-based energy company. The Company is engaged in exploration and development of upstream oil and gas assets. It has developed a portfolio of highly prospective offshore exploration permits in the offshore Otway and Gippsland basins of Southeast Australia. Its project includes Offshore Otway, VIC/TAS; Offshore Gippsland, VIC; Onshore Otway, SA, and Offshore Bedout, WA. The Offshore Otway Project includes two offshore exploration permits in the offshore Otway Basin, VIC/P79 and T/49P. The VIC/P74 petroleum exploration permit covers an area of 1,006 square kilometer (km2) and lies within shallow Commonwealth waters of the Gippsland Basin, where water depths range up to 70 m. The Onshore Otway Project at GSEL 759 is exploring the feasibility of the abandoned Caroline carbon dioxide (CO2) field within the onshore Otway Basin as a gas storage site, with the depleted reservoir potentially suitable for the storage of hydrogen, natural gas, or carbon dioxide.

name: TRIBUNE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Tribune Resources Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in exploration, development and production activities at the Company’s East Kundana Joint Venture tenements (EKJV). EKJV is an operational underground gold mining project located in the Kundana area approximately 25 kilometers (km) west-northwest of Kalgoorlie and approximately 47 km northeast of Coolgardie, in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The project comprises two producing underground mines, Raleigh and Rubicon/Hornet /Pegasus (RHP). Its exploration projects include Diwalwal Gold Project, Philippines and Japa Gold Project, Ghana. The Diwalwal Gold Project is located approximately 120 km northeast of Davao City on Mindanao Island in the Philippines. The Japa Gold Project is located in the Western Region of Ghana, approximately 110 km southwest of Kumasi and 50 km north of Tarkwa, centered in the village of Gyapa in the Wassa Amenfi East District.

name: TASMAN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Tasman Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration company, focusing on exploration projects with potential to host mineral deposits in a wide range of precious and base metals including gold, silver, copper, zinc, lead, nickel, and uranium. The Company is a diversified, multi-commodity explorer with projects covering tenement holdings in South Australia. Its Lake Torrens Iron oxide-copper-gold (IOCG) Project tenement holding (Exploration license 6416, over 1,079 square kilometers) adjoining BHP Billiton’s world class Olympic Dam deposit in central South Australia. The Lake Torrens IOCG Project hosts the Vulcan and Titan IOCG prospects located approximately 30 kilometers (km) north of BHP’s Olympic Dam mine in South Australia. The Parkinson Dam Epithermal Gold-Silver (Lead-Zinc) Project is located over 60 km west of Port Augusta in South Australia. The Company also has investments in Conico Ltd and Eden Innovations Ltd.

name: TARUGA MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Taruga Minerals Limited is a mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on acquiring and developing gold, copper and precious metals exploration projects in Australia. Its projects include the Flinders Iron-Oxide-Copper-Gold (IOCG) Project, Mt Craig Copper Project, Manjimup Base Metal Project, and Torrens IOCG Project. The Flinders Iron-Oxide-Copper-Gold (IOCG) Project is located 80 kilometers (kms) from Carrapateena and 150 kms from the Olympic Dam. Its prospects include Woolshed, Main Lode, Jenkins North, Jenkins South and others. The Mt Craig Copper Project is located within the Adelaide Geosyncline, which lies within the G2 structural corridor. The Manjimup Base Metal Project is located approximately 300 km south of Perth in the southwest region of Western Australia. Its Exploration license E51/1832 is located 30 km southeast of the regional center of Meekatharra in the Murchison region of Western Australia. It also licensed Uaroo West and Uaroo East projects.

name: TABCORP HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Tabcorp Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of gambling, entertainment and integrity services. Its segments include Wagering and Media and Gaming Services. The Wagering and Media segment is engaged in the provision of totalizator and fixed odds betting and retail wagering networks, and global racing media business. It operates a diverse and complementary portfolio of operations, such as TAB, Sky Racing and Premier Gateway International (PGI). TAB is an omni-channel provider of wagering experiences. Sky Racing is a multi-venue, multi-channel racing and sports broadcasting. PGI operates an international wagering and tote pooling hub licensed and operating out of the Isle of Man. The Gaming Services segment is focused on gaming machine monitoring operations in New South Wales, Queensland, Tasmania and the Northern Territory and venue services nationwide. It operates the MAX business, such as MAX Regulatory Services and MAX Technical Services.

name: SYRAH RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Syrah Resources Limited is an Australia-based industrial minerals and technology company with its flagship Balama Graphite Operation in Mozambique and a downstream Active Anode Material Facility in the United States. The principal activities of the Company include sales of natural graphite and ongoing development of logistics, sales, and marketing arrangements with targeted customers. Its segments include Balama and Vidalia. The Balama segment is engaged in the production, distribution and sale of natural flake graphite from the Balama Graphite Operation in Mozambique. The Vidalia segment is engaged in the operation and expansion of the Vidalia AAM facility including operation of a qualification facility, the construction of the Vidalia Initial Expansion project, evaluation of the Vidalia Further Expansion project, customer engagement and commercial negotiations, and research and development. Its subsidiaries include Twigg Exploration and Mining Limitada, Syrah Plus LLC and others.

name: SOUTHERN CROSS ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING LT
businessSummary: Southern Cross Electrical Engineering Limited is an Australia-based electrical, instrumentation, communications and maintenance services company. Its businesses include SCEE Electrical, Heyday Group, Datatel, S.J. Electric, SEME Solutions and Trivantage Manufacturing. SCEE Electrical is focused on resources and industrial projects and is diversified into transport, infrastructure, defense, utilities and renewables. Datatel is an electrical contractor and communications specialist, delivering commercial fit-outs, and providing services to the corporate, retail, government, resources, transport and telecommunications sectors. Heyday is an ACT-based electrical contractor undertaking commercial building construction and fit-outs, and servicing the office, retail, hotel, high-rise residential, education, health, transport, industrial and data center sectors. S.J. Electric is a provider of electrical and maintenance services to supermarkets, and the retail, commercial and water sectors.

name: SEVEN WEST MEDIA LTD
businessSummary: Seven West Media Limited is an Australia-based media company with presence in content production across broadcast television, publishing and digital. The Company’s segments, includes Television, The West and Other Business and New Ventures. Television segment is engaged in production and operation of commercial television programming and stations, as well as distribution of programming content across platforms in Australia and around the world. The West segment is engaged in publishing newspapers and insert magazines in Western Australia, and it includes Colorpress, digital publishing, West Australian Publishers and Community Newspaper Group. Other Business and New Ventures segment is made up of equity accounted investees and other ventures investments. Its media businesses are comprised of Seven Network and its affiliate channels 7two, 7mate, 7flix and 7Bravo; the digital platform 7plus; 7NEWS.com.au; The West Australian; The Sunday Times; PerthNow; The Nightly, and Streamer.

name: STAVELY MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Stavely Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. It is focused on the exploring for copper, gold and silver at the Stavely and Ararat Projects in western Victoria, and nickel, copper and cobalt at the Hawkstone Project in west Kimberley, in northern Western Australia. The Stavely Project, covering an area of approximately 1,000 square kilometers (km2) over the prospective Stavely Volcanic Belt in western Victoria, includes a 100% owned retention license RL2017, 100% owned exploration licenses EL6870, EL7347, EL7921, EL7922, EL7923 and EL7924 and the Black Range Joint Venture license EL5425. The Ararat Project comprises a retention license, RL2020, covering an area of approximately 26km2. The Ararat Project is located on part of the western margin of the Stawell-Bendigo Zone, which is part of the western Lachlan Fold Belt. Its Hawkstone Project covers an area of 1,100 km2 over prospective stratigraphy in the west Kimberley, in northern Western Australia.

name: SOVEREIGN METALS LTD
businessSummary: Sovereign Metals Limited is an Australia-based company is focused on developing its Kasiya Rutile-Graphite Project (Kasiya) in Malawi. Kasiya is located in the Lilongwe District of the Southeastern African country of Malawi. Kasiya’s Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) is 1.8Bt at 1.0% rutile resulting in over18 Mt tons of contained natural rutile. The MRE has broad zones of very high-grade rutile, which occur contiguously across a very large area of over 200 square kilometers. Kasiya’s graphite by-product Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) is 1.8 Bt at 1.4% graphite, containing over 24.4 Mt tones of contained natural graphite. The Kasiya Rutile-Graphite deposit is in an area northwest of Malawi’s capital of Lilongwe called the Lilongwe Plain.

name: SILVER MINES LTD
businessSummary: Silver Mines Limited is an Australia-based silver exploration company. The Company’s projects include Bowdens Silver Project, Barabolar Project, Tuena Gold Project and Calico North Project. The Bowdens Silver Project is an undeveloped silver deposit in Australia and lies within Exploration License 5920, which is 100% held by the Company. The Bowdens Silver and Barabolar Projects are located in central New South Wales, approximately 26 kilometers east of Mudgee. The consolidated project area comprises 2,115 square kilometers (km2) of titles covering approximately 80 kilometers of strike of the highly mineralized Rylstone Volcanics and underlying sediments, intrusions and volcanics of the Macquarie Arc. The Tuena Gold Project is located 80 kilometers south of the city of Orange in New South Wales. It also holds a significant land position in the Orange/Blayney district covering 747 square kilometers. It also has the right to earn up to 80% interest in the Kramer Hills Project.

name: SUNCORP GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Suncorp Group Limited is an Australia-based Trans-Tasman insurance company. The Company’s segments include Consumer Insurance, Commercial and Personal Injury, Suncorp New Zealand, and Corporate and Internal Reinsurance. The Consumer Insurance segment is engaged in the provision of insurance products to customers in Australia, including home and contents, motor and boat. The Commercial and Personal Injury segment is engaged in the provision of insurance products to customers in Australia, including commercial motor, commercial property, marine, industrial special risks, public liability and professional indemnity, workers’ compensation and compulsory third party. The Suncorp New Zealand segment is involved in the provision of general and life insurance products to customers in New Zealand. Its products include home and contents, motor, commercial property, public liability and professional indemnity, life, trauma, total and permanent disablement and income protection.

name: SUPER RETAIL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Super Retail Group Limited is an Australia-based company primarily involved in the retail industry. The Company's principal activities include retailing of auto parts and accessories, tools and equipment, retailing of boating, camping, outdoor equipment, fishing equipment and apparel, and retailing of sporting equipment and apparel. Its segments include Supercheap Auto (SCA), rebel, BCF and Macpac. Its Supercheap Auto (SCA) segment is engaged in retailing auto parts and accessories, tools and equipment. Its rebel segment is engaged in the retailing of sporting equipment and apparel. Its BCF segment is retailing of boating, camping, outdoor equipment, fishing equipment and apparel. Its Macpac segment is engaged in retailing apparel, camping and outdoor equipment. The Company operates in Australia, New Zealand, and China.

name: STRIKE ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Strike Energy Limited is an Australia-based energy company. The Company is an independent gas producer, developer and explorer focused on its quality conventional gas resources in the Perth Basin. Its projects in the Perth Basin include the producing Walyering gas facility, South Erregulla peaking gas power project, West Erregulla and Ocean Hill. The Walyering gas field sits in production license L23. The field is situated approximately 150 km north of Perth near the town of Cataby in the Mid-West. The South Erregulla field sits within L 24 and EP 503. It is situated approximately 350 km north of Perth near the town of Dongara in the Mid-West. The West Erregulla field sits within EP 469 which is operated and owned 50% by the Company. The Ocean Hill sits within EP495, situated approximately 350km north of Perth near the town of Eneabba. The Company also owns 100% of the geothermal rights in the Perth Basin, covering approximately 3,500 square kilometers (km2), namely The Precinct.

name: SANTOS LTD
businessSummary: Santos Limited is focused on three regional business unit, including Cooper Basin, Queensland and New South Wales (NSW) and (PNG), now form the Eastern Australia and PNG Business Unit, Northern Australia and Timor-Leste, and Western Australia now form the Western Australia, Northern Australia and Timor-Leste Business Unit and Alaska is the third regional Business Unit. Supporting these three business units are two functional divisions: Santos Energy Solutions and Upstream Gas and Liquids. The Cooper Basin produces natural gas, gas liquids and crude oil. Gas is sold primarily to domestic retailers, industry and for the production of liquefied natural gas, while gas liquids and crude oil are sold in domestic and export markets. Its GLNG project in Queensland produces liquefied natural gas (LNG) for export to global markets from the LNG plant at Gladstone and is also sold to the domestic market. Northern Australia and Timor-Leste is centered on the Bayu-Undan/Darwin LNG (DLNG) project.

name: SUNSTONE METALS LTD
businessSummary: Sunstone Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company with gold and copper assets in Ecuador. The Company’s assets are the Bramaderos Gold-Copper Project and El Palmar Copper-Gold Project. The Bramaderos Gold-Copper Project is located in southern Ecuador and is centered approximately 69 kilometers (km) west-southwest of the provincial capital city of Loja, 213 km south-southeast of the coastal city of Guayaquil and 460 km south-southwest of Quito. The Bramaderos property covers approximately 4,959 hectares (ha). The El Palmar Copper-Gold Project is located in northern Ecuador and approximately 60 km northwest of Quito, Ecuador’s capital city and covers over 790 ha.

name: SPIRIT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS LTD
businessSummary: Spirit Technology Solutions Limited is an Australia-based technology company. The principal activities of the Company include provision of collaboration and communication services, cyber security services and managed information technology (IT) services. The Company operates through three segments: Collaboration and Communication, Cyber security, and Managed Services. The Collaboration and Communication segment offers voice solutions, managed service solutions, data, and office technology for small business. The Cyber Security segment offers specialist cyber managed services and industry solutions to corporate and enterprise customers delivered through a 24/7 Security Operations Centre and professional service teams. The Managed Services segment offers a range of managed IT and professional services including end-user, public cloud, infrastructure and networking, data, and voice solutions to small and midsize business (SMB) and mid-market customers.

name: SERVICE STREAM LTD
businessSummary: Service Stream Limited is a provider of essential network services to the telecommunications, utility and transport sectors. The Company designs, constructs, operates and maintains critical infrastructure networks. Its segments include Telecommunications, Utilities, and Transport. The Telecommunications segment offers a range of operations, maintenance, installation, design and construction services to the owners of fixed-line and wireless telecommunication networks in Australia. The Utilities offers a range of operations, maintenance, design and construction services to gas, water and electricity network owners, industrial asset owners and other customers in Australia. Service capability includes asset maintenance, engineering, design and construction of network assets. The Transport segment offers long-term operational support and maintenance services to public and private road and tunnel asset owners. Service capabilities include road network maintenance and control room operations.

name: SHAVER SHOP GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Shaver Shop Group Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in retailing of specialist personal care and grooming products both through its corporate-owned stores as well as online through its Websites and the online marketplaces it partners with. The Company offers its products under various categories, such as electric shavers, including replacement parts; beard trimmers, including grooming kits, nose and ear trimmers, and beard care; hair clippers; body groomers, including long-term hair removal, and manual shavers, including men's blades, men's razors, shave brushes, shave sets and accessories, and cutthroat razors. It also offers oral care, such as electric toothbrushes, oral irrigation and toothbrush refills; ladies' hair removal, including epilators and ladies' blades; hairstyling; massage, and skincare, and haircare products. The Company operates about 124 stores located across Australia and New Zealand.

name: SERVCORP LTD
businessSummary: Servcorp Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in provision of executive service and virtual offices, coworking and information technology (IT), communications, and secretarial services. The Company's segments include Australia, New Zealand and South East Asia (ANZ/SEA); United States of America (USA); Europe and Middle East (EME), and North Asia. Its office solutions include office spaces, virtual offices, coworking, meeting rooms, and remote team package. Its serviced offices can accommodate teams of any size and come with IT & Communications infrastructure with secure Internet and VPN to every desk, receptionists and secretarial/IT support. Virtual Office provides business address, phone numbers, call handling, mail forwarding, and access to other office facilities and services, such as meeting rooms, and secretarial and IT support, without renting a physical office. Its meeting facilities are available for all the meeting and conferencing requirements.

name: SUREFIRE RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Surefire Resources NL is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company holds mineral exploration licenses over Vanadium, Magnetite and Gold projects located in Western Australia. It is focused on Victory Bore Vanadium critical and battery minerals project. The Victory Bore project is located in the Mid-West region of Western Australia. Its Perenjori Iron Ore Project is located within 15 kilometers (km) of both the Morawa-Peronjori trunk rail line and the Karara rail spur. Its Yidby Gold Project is situated within the southern portion of the Yalgoo-Singleton Greenstone Belt, 40 km from Paynes Find and 400 km northeast of Perth. The project is also surrounded by several significant gold projects. Its Kooline Lead-Silver Project tenements cover almost 50 km strike length of mineralized Ashburton Formation and are located 55 km south of the one Moz Paulsen’s gold mine and 190 km northwest of Paraburdoo in the Ashburton province of Western Australia.

name: STRIKE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Strike Resources Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company owns the high-grade Apurimac Iron Ore Project in Peru. Its principal activities include the development of a small-scale direct shipping Iron Ore (DSO) operation in relation to the Apurimac Iron Ore Project. The Apurimac Iron Ore project is located in the Southern Highlands of Peru, which has concessions totaling approximately 72,800 hectares. Apurimac Iron Ore project contains a JORC mineral resource of 269 metric tons of Iron ore at Opaban of 57.3% Iron. The Company's mineralization include Iron, Silica, Alumina, Phosphorus, and Sulphur.

name: SAFEROADS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Saferoads Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the provision of road safety solutions throughout Australia, New Zealand, and North America. The Company provides state government departments, local councils, road construction companies and equipment hire companies with a range of products and services designed to direct, protect, and inform the public’s safety. Its products and services offering include solar lighting, electronic signs, temporary barriers, security bollards, traffic calming, guideposts, and work zone products. Its solar lighting products include permanent, including Roadway Solar V-LED Light, 30W Delta-Universal Pole, 30W Delta-Promenade Pole and 100W Ultra-Galvanised Pole; and portable, including 100W Ultra-Telescopic Pole and 100W Ultra-Hinged Pole. Its electronic signs include Zone VMS Essential and Zone VMS Classic. Its temporary barriers include BIG Blockout Barrier, SLED End Terminal, HV2 Barrier, Ironman Hybrid Barrier, and T-Lok Barrier.

name: SMART PARKING LTD
businessSummary: Smart Parking Limited is an Australia-based parking technology company. The Company operates in three segments: Parking Management, Technology, and Research & Development. The Parking Management segment is engaged in the provision of parking management solutions, predominantly servicing the retail sector, managing agents and landowners in the United Kingdom, New Zealand, Australia, and Germany. The Technology segment is engaged in the sale of technology, hardware, and software, predominantly for parking solutions around the world, and to support the parking management division. The Research & Development segment includes research, developing, and enhancing automatic number plate recognition (ANPR) software/hardware for both the Technology and Parking Management divisions. It serves various industries, such as Councils & Local Authorities, Hospitals & Medical Centers, Hotels & Hospitality, Leisure & Tourism, Property Managers & Agents, Residential, Restaurants & Pubs, and others.

name: SUPERIOR RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Superior Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in exploring for large copper, nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE, lead-zinc-silver and gold deposits in northern Queensland. It is focused on the exploration for copper-gold and magmatic nickel sulphide deposits in northern Queensland, Australia. Its projects include Greenvale Project, Nicholson Project, and Victor Project. The Greenvale Project is situated in North Queensland and fully owned by Superior, stands as the northernmost stretch of the Ordovician Macquarie Arc, dubbed the Lucky Creek Corridor. The Nicholson Project is located in the Carpentaria Zinc Province of north-west Queensland. The Victor Project encompasses four exploration permits that collectively span 438 square kilometers situated within the Carpentaria Zinc Province in northwest Queensland. The Victor Project is located 150 kilometers north-west of the prolific Mount Isa Mine. It also holds 100% interest in Hedleys Uranium Project.

name: STARPHARMA HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Starpharma Holdings Limited is an Australia-based biotechnology company. The principal activities of the Company consist of research, development and commercialization of dendrimer products for pharmaceutical and healthcare applications. Its portfolio of dendrimer-based products includes three clinical-stage DEP (dendrimer enhanced product) assets, preclinical radiopharmaceutical assets, research collaborations, and three commercially marketed over-the-counter (OTC) products. It has developed a pipeline of novel DEP oncology products. Its clinical-stage assets, DEP SN38, DEP cabazitaxel, and DEP docetaxel, are dendrimer-based chemotherapeutic drugs. Additionally, it has a preclinical pipeline of DEP radiopharmaceuticals and DEP Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs) in development. Its VIRALEZE Nasal Spray is a broad-spectrum nasal spray intended to provide a protective barrier in the nose that traps and blocks cold/respiratory viruses. It also offers VivaGel BV and VivaGel Condom products.

name: STRATEGIC ELEMENTS LTD
businessSummary: Strategic Elements Limited is an Australia-based pooled development fund (PDF). The Company’s segment includes Resources and Technology. The Company is managed primarily on the basis of its exploration projects (Resource segment) and research and development of the energy ink cell and robotics and AI solutions (technology segment). Its ventures include Australian Advanced Materials, Stealth Technologies and Other ventures. Energy Ink is a renewable energy technology that generates electrical energy from moisture in the air to power a device directly or provide energy for battery storage. Stealth Technologies is focused on developing autonomous security vehicles (ASV) for perimeter security. Stealth Technologies has also systematically advanced the application of key components of its ASV technology to develop a new product application.

name: SOMNOMED LTD
businessSummary: SomnoMed Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in producing and selling devices for the oral treatment of sleep-related disorders. It provides treatment solutions for sleep-related breathing disorders, including obstructive sleep apnea, snoring, and bruxism. It is focused on the commercialization of the SomnoDent Mandibular Advancement Splint and other oral devices for sleep related disorders. Its segments include North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, CORE, and RSS. Its SomnoDent product line includes SomnoDent Avant, SomnoDent Classic, SomnoDent Flex, SomnoDent Fusion, Herbst Advance Elite and Herbst Advance. Its SomMorning Repositioner is designed to help return their mandible back to its pre-treatment centric position. Its SomnoBrux Michigan splint is a custom fit, acrylic splint (dental guard) for upper teeth designed to protect the teeth from grinding and scraping during Bruxism. It also offers SomTabs, which are cleaning tablets that are developed to clean oral appliances.

name: WASHINGTON H SOUL PATTINSON AND COMPANY
businessSummary: Washington H. Soul Pattinson and Company Ltd., formerly First Services Company Ltd, is an Australia-based holding company. The Company’s subsidiaries include Brickworks Limited and WHSP Holdings Ltd. Brickworks Limited is a manufacturer and distributor of building products in Australia and North America, with operations spanning bricks, roofing, masonry, and property investments. Its operations are categorized into four segments: Building Products Australia, Building Products North America, Property, and Investments. WHSP Holdings Ltd is a diversified investment company with investments across a range of industries and asset classes. Its investment portfolios include Strategic Investments Portfolio, Large Caps Portfolio, Private Equity Portfolio, Credit Portfolio, Emerging Companies Portfolio, and Property Portfolio. It invests in multiple industries, including building materials, telecommunications, natural resources, pharmaceuticals, agriculture, property and financial services.

name: SENSEN NETWORKS LTD
businessSummary: Sensen Networks Limited is an Australia-based sensor artificial intelligence (AI) solutions provider. The principal activities of the Company include developing and selling SenDISA platform-based products and services into smart city and retail markets across three market segments: Smart Cities, Casinos, and Retail. Smart Cities include civic compliance, traffic data and law enforcement solutions to city councils, national parks, road authorities and transit agencies across the globe. Casinos include delivering actionable insights about casino table game occupancy, hands per hour, bet type and value for every bet placed on the gaming floor. Retail provides anti-theft and debt recovery services to fuel retailers. The Company’s geographical segments include Australia and New Zealand, North America (comprising USA and Canada), and Asia. SenDISA’s Live Awareness automates processes and ensures other decisions can be made more quickly and accurately.

name: SUPPLY NETWORK LTD
businessSummary: Supply Network Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of aftermarket parts to the commercial vehicle industry. The Company operates trading entities in Australia and New Zealand under the Multispares brand. Each trading entity has its own management team and its own operating focus within a market definition of replacement parts for road transport equipment. It sells truck and bus parts. It also sells a range of services, including parts interpreting, procurement, supply management, and problem-solving.

name: STANMORE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Stanmore Resources Limited is a resources company with operations and exploration projects in the Bowen and Surat basins. The Company controls and operates the South Walker Creek, Poitrel and Isaac Plains Complex metallurgical coal mines as well as the undeveloped Isaac Downs Extension, Eagle Downs, Lancewood and Isaac Plains underground projects, in Queensland’s prime Bowen Basin region. It holds several additional prospective coal tenements located in Queensland’s Bowen and Surat basins. South Walker Creek is an open-cut mine located approximately 35 kilometers (km) west of Nebo in Queensland's Bowen Basin. Poitrel is an open-cut mine located approximately 35 km east of Moranbah. Isaac Plains Complex is located approximately seven km east of Moranbah. Isaac Downs Extension is an undeveloped open-cut project situated immediately south of the Isaac Downs mine, across the Isaac River. Eagle Downs is a hard-coking coal development project located approximately 20 km from Moranbah.

name: STRUCTURAL MONITORING SYSTEMS CDI
businessSummary: Structural Monitoring Systems Plc is an Australia-based company engaged in the design and manufacture of electronic products and the provision of manufacturing services to the aviation industry. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiary, Anodyne Electronics Manufacturing Corp. (AEM), operates three business segments: Avionics, Contract Manufacturing and CVM. The Avionics segment provides customer-driven solutions designed to meet the requirements of the special mission aviation industry. The Contract manufacturing segment provides contract electronics manufacturing to a select group of aerospace customers. The CVM segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sales, and support of the Comparative Vacuum Monitoring (CVM) sensor technology and equipment for meeting crack detection and inspection requirements for certain metal structures of commercial airframes. The Company has operations in North America, Europe/ United Kingdom and others.

name: SILEX SYSTEMS LTD
businessSummary: Silex Systems Limited is a technology commercialization company. The Company is focused on the commercialization of its Separation of Isotopes by Laser EXcitation (SILEX) laser enrichment technology for application to uranium production and enrichment (nuclear power), silicon enrichment (silicon quantum computing) and medical isotope enrichment (new cancer therapies). Its segments include Silex Systems, Translucent and Silex USA. Silex Systems is based in New South Wales and Translucent and Silex USA are based in North Carolina. The SILEX technology has been under development for uranium enrichment jointly with exclusive licensee Global Laser Enrichment LLC. It is also focused on the development of additional commercial applications of the SILEX technology, including the production of Zero-Spin Silicon for the emerging technology of silicon-based quantum computing. It has an interest in a semiconductor technology known as cREO through its ownership of subsidiary Translucent Inc.

name: SUPERLOOP LTD
businessSummary: Superloop Limited is an Australia-based telecommunications company. The Company operates through three segments: Wholesale, Business and Consumer. The Wholesale segment is defined by large scale telecommunications, data and technology customers who purchase various connectivity services to support their core business services, as well as retail Internet service providers who do not have access to a connectivity network of their own. The Business segment is defined by small, medium and large corporate customers who purchase connectivity services to facilitate their core business. The Consumer segment is defined by customers who purchase basic Internet and mobile phone products for domestic residential use. Its products include national broadband network (NBN) access, NBN TC2, NBN Enterprise Ethernet, dark fiber, fixed wireless access, third party access, security, managed Wi-Fi, VoIP, international ethernet, wavelength and international (including Indigo) subsea cable capacity.

name: SIV CAPITAL LTD
businessSummary: SIV Capital Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in renting commercial equipment to businesses. The Company’s subsidiaries include SIV Finance Company Pty Ltd, and GoGetta Equipment Funding Pty Ltd.

name: SMARTGROUP CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Smartgroup Corporation Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in providing outsourced administration, fleet management, and software, distribution, and group services. The Company operates through three segments: Outsourced administration (OA), Vehicle services (VS), and Software, distribution, and group services (SDGS). The OA segment provides outsourced salary packaging services, novated leasing and associated products, and outsourced payroll services. The VS segment provides end-to-end fleet management services. The SDGS segment provides salary packaging software solutions, the marketing of salary packaging debit cards, distribution of vehicle insurance and workforce management software to the healthcare industry. The Company operates through a portfolio of brands including Smartsalary, Smartleasing, Smartfleet, Smartsalary Payroll Solutions, Autopia, Advantage Salary Packaging, AccessPay, PBI Solutions and Health-e Workforce Solutions.

name: SELECT HARVESTS LTD
businessSummary: Select Harvests Limited is an Australia-based vertically integrated almond food company. The Company manufactures, processes and markets almond products for the Australian retail and industrial markets, in addition to exporting almonds globally. It is engaged in growing, processing, packaging and sale of almonds and its by-products from Company-owned and leased almond orchards. It supplies a full range of value-added almond products (blanched, roasted, sliced, diced, meal and paste) in multiple customer categories, including beverage, bakery, confectionery, cereal, snacking, health, dairy (ice cream), re-packers and wholesalers. It supplies both branded and private label products to key retailers, distributors and industrial users. Its brands are Renshaw and Allinga Farms. Its geographically diverse almond orchards are located in Victoria, South Australia and New South Wales. Its portfolio includes over 9,262 hectares of Company-owned, leased and joint venture almond orchards.

name: SPORTSHERO LTD
businessSummary: SportsHero Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the development of sports gamification platforms. The Company has developed a white label digital solution, such as SportsHero. SportsHero offers its digital solutions across multiple sports to sporting groups and other partners globally. SportsHero’s strategy is to build a large and engaged user base of active sports fans utilizing its technologies. SportsHero operates in Indonesia. It has developed and owns Olahbola, the Indonesian local market version of SportsHero’s platform. Olahbola provides fanatical football fans with the opportunity to predict outcomes, compete with other users and climb the leaderboard and win prizes, including money cannot buy experiences, merchandise and entertainment products.

name: SONIC HEALTHCARE LTD
businessSummary: Sonic Healthcare Limited is a global provider of medical diagnostic services. The Company’s segments include Laboratory, Radiology, and Other. The Laboratory segment includes pathology/clinical laboratory services provided in Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, the United States of America, Germany, Switzerland and Belgium. The Radiology segment includes diagnostic imaging services provided in Australia. The Other segment includes corporate office functions, medical center operations (IPN), occupational health services (Sonic HealthPlus), and other minor operations. The Company’s Healthcare’s Australian Clinical Services division (Sonic Clinical Services) is a medical center operator (under the Independent Practitioner Network brand) and occupational health provider (under the Sonic HealthPlus brand). Sonic Clinical Services operates in partnership with approximately 2,000 general practitioners working in more than approximately 200 centers across Australia.

name: SHINE JUSTICE LTD
businessSummary: Shine Justice Ltd is the holding company of a stable of firms which provide legal services. These firms include Shine Lawyers, Sciaccas Lawyers, Stephen Browne Personal Injury Lawyers, Bradley Bayly Lawyers and Carr & Co Divorce and Family Lawyers. It specializes in plaintiff litigation services focused on damage-based claims, on personal injury matters, and class actions. It also offers national practice areas, which include superannuation and disability, dust disease litigation and medical negligence. The PI segment specializes in damage-based plaintiff litigation legal services, and consists of motor vehicle accidents, abuse law, workers' compensation, public liability, head trauma, disability insurance and superannuation claims, asbestos and dust disease, medical law and catastrophic injuries. The Class Actions segment includes work types that are not considered core personal injury, such as class actions, international mass torts, commercial disputes (in wind-down) and family law.

name: ST. GEORGE MINING LTD.
businessSummary: St George Mining Limited is focused on developing critical minerals projects in Brazil and Western Australia. The Company's projects include Araxa Project, Mt Alexander Project, Paterson Project, Broadview Project, Ajana Project, Lithium Star-WA Projects, and Destiny Project. Araxa is a niobium-rare earth element (REE) project in Minas Gerais, Brazil. The Mt Alexander Project is located about 120 kilometers (km) south-southwest of the Agnew-Wiluna belt, which hosts numerous nickel deposits. Its Paterson Project is an early-stage project with exploration upside. The Broadview Project is located in Western Australia’s Wheatbelt, approximately 150 km east of Perth. The 100% owned Ajana Project is located within the Meso-Proterozoic age Northampton mineral field, situated near the western margin of the Yilgarn Craton. The Lithium Star-WA Projects encompass 14 exploration licenses. The Destiny Project is located in the Eastern Goldfields region of Western Australia.

name: STOCKLAND CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Stockland Corporation Ltd is an Australia-based creator and curator of connected communities. The Company is a diversified property group in Australia. It owns, funds, develops and manages portfolios of residential and land lease communities, retail town centers, and workplace and logistics assets. The Company’s segments include Development, Investment Management, and Other. The Development segment develops a range of assets including residential properties, commercial properties and mixed-use assets. Investment Management segment invests in and manages commercial properties and residential investment properties, manages capital investments, and earns management income for services performed. It also creates communities and whole-of-life housing solutions across its master planned and land lease communities. Its focus is on leveraging its specialist end-to-end, multi-sector capability to create value at each stage of the real estate life cycle.

name: SIMS LTD
businessSummary: Sims Limited is engaged in metal recycling and the provision of circular solutions for technology. Its principal activities include the buying, processing, and selling of ferrous and non-ferrous recycled metals and the provision of environmentally responsible solutions for the recycling and repurposing of post-consumer electronic products and information technology (IT) assets. Its segments include North America Metal (NAM), Australia/New Zealand Metal (ANZ), Global Trading, Investment in SA Recycling (SAR) and Sims Lifecycle Services (SLS). The NAM segment comprises subsidiaries and joint ventures in the United States of America and Canada which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. The ANZ segment comprises subsidiaries in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. Global Trading segment coordinates sales of ferrous bulk cargo shipments and non-ferrous sales into China and Southeast Asia.

name: SHEFFIELD RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Sheffield Resources Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mineral sands evaluation and development in Australia and mineral sands evaluation in Brazil. The Company’s operating segments include South Atlantic project, Thunderbird project, and Other. The South Atlantic project consists of mineral sands tenements located in Southeast Brazil. The Thunderbird project consists of mineral sands tenements located in the Canning Basin that form part of the Thunderbird mineral sand mining operation held by Thunderbird Operations Pty Ltd, a subsidiary of Kimberley Mineral Sands Pty Ltd (KMS). The South Atlantic Project is located within the Rio Grande do Sul Coastal Plain, a region located in the southernmost state of Brazil, Rio Grande do Sul, along the coast of the Atlantic Ocean. The Thunderbird Mineral Sand Project lies 70 kilometers (km) west of Derby and 30 km north of the sealed Great Northern Highway (GNH) joining Derby and Broome.

name: SANDFIRE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Sandfire Resources Limited is a mining and exploration company with a focus on copper exploration. The Company’s segments include DeGrussa Copper Operations, Minas De Aguas Tenidas (MATSA) Copper Operations, Black Butte Project, Motheo Copper Project and Exploration and Other. DeGrussa Copper Operations segment consists of both the DeGrussa and Monty Copper-Gold Mines located in the Bryah Basin mineral province of Western Australia. MATSA Copper Operations consists of the Minas De Aguas Tenidas (MATSA) polymetallic mining complex in Spain, comprising three underground mines. Black Butte Project consists of the evaluation activities for the Black Butte Copper Project located in central Montana in the United States of America. Motheo Copper Project segment consists of its development of the Motheo Copper Mine, exploration and evaluation activities in Botswana and Namibia within the Kalahari Copper Belt. The Exploration and Other segment include its exploration and evaluation activities.

name: SCHAFFER CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Schaffer Corporation Limited is an Australia-based diversified industrial and investment company. The Company’s segments include Automotive Leather, Building Materials, and Group Investments. The Automotive Leather segment is a global manufacturer and supplier of leather to the automotive industry. The Building Materials segment comprises Delta Corporation Limited and sells precast and prestressed concrete elements. The Group Investments segment includes the Company’s share of syndicated property, 100% owned investment property, investments in managed equity funds and direct investment in global equity instruments. The activities of the segment include the leasing of office, industrial, residential and retail properties, and the development and sale of property assets, and general investing. Its property investments consists of a diversified portfolio of syndicate investment properties, property development projects, and wholly owned/operated properties.

name: SENETAS CORP LTD
businessSummary: Senetas Corporation Limited is an Australia-based cybersecurity solutions company. The Company is a developer and a manufacturer of certified, high-assurance encryption hardware; virtualized (software based) network encryption, and advanced encrypted file sharing application. It provides network independent encryption hardware and virtualized solutions. These share a crypto-agile and quantum resistant cybersecurity platform. Its segments include the product division (Senetas) and solutions technology division (Votiro). Its technology applications include cloud, data centre, big data encryption, branch office, and closed-circuit television (CCTV) cyber security. Its industry applications include commercial cyber security, government and defence, critical infrastructure, finance, gaming, and healthcare. Its solutions include CypherNET CN Series Network Encryption Hardware, CypherNET CV Series Virtual Network Encryption, SureDrop Secure File Sharing, and CM7 Network Encryption Manager.

name: SEEK LTD
businessSummary: SEEK Limited is an online employment marketplaces company. It operates a range of other businesses, including SEEK Learning, which gives clients the expert information clients need to find the right course for their career, SEEK Volunteer, which has been connecting Australians to volunteer opportunities, and SEEK Business is Australia’s online business-for-sale marketplace. Its segments include Australia and New Zealand (ANZ), Asia, Brasil Online, OCC, Platform support, Portfolio investments and SEEK Growth Fund. ANZ, Asia, Brasil Online and OCC segments are engaged in online employment marketplace services. Platform support segment includes JobAdder, which is a talent acquisition suite. Platform support also includes other businesses: Jora and Certsy. Jora is an online employment marketplace. Certsy is a platform to securely verify and share work credentials and to complete compliance checks. Portfolio Investments segment consists of a small portfolio of early-stage ventures.

name: SCIDEV LTD
businessSummary: SciDev Limited is an Australia-based environmental solutions company that is focused on water-intensive industries. The Company's primary business segment is the treatment of industrial waste. Its solutions allow clients to reuse water, improve operational efficiencies and reduce their environmental footprints. It works with clients across a range of industries, including mining, oil and gas, construction and infrastructure and water treatment. The Company's business includes chemical services and water technologies. Its chemical services business specializes in water chemistry and offers chemical solutions. It also provides tailored services, such as last mile delivery and process optimization to support its clients throughout the entire process. The Company's water technologies business specializes in designing and delivering customized water treatment solutions that remove harmful contaminants from groundwater, surface water and industrial liquid waste.

name: SDI LTD
businessSummary: SDI Limited is an Australia-based dental technology company that is involved in the research and development, manufacturing, and marketing of specialist dental materials. The principal activities of the Company include manufacture and distribution of dental restorative materials, tooth whitening systems, other dental materials and product research and development. Its segments include Australia, Europe, USA, and Brazil. The Australia segments include SDI Limited. The Europe segment include SDI Germany GmbH (Germany) and SDI Dental Innovations Limited (United Kingdom). The USA segment includes SDI (North America), Inc. The Brazil segment includes SDI Brasil Industria e Comercio Ltda and SDI Holdings Do Brazil Ltda. Its product categories include accessories, adhesives, alloys, cements, composites, equipment, etchants, glass ionomers, sealants, and tooth whitening. Its products are sold through distributors and retailers in over 100 countries throughout the world.

name: STEADFAST GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Steadfast Group Limited operates international general insurance broking and agency networks located across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and the United States. The principal activities of the Company include the provision of services to Steadfast Network brokers, the distribution of insurance policies via insurance brokerages and underwriting agencies, and related services. The Company offers business insurance and personal insurance. The Company provides products and services to support the broking and agency network businesses. It also operates as a co-owner through its equity interests in a number of broker businesses, underwriting agencies (also known as managing general agencies) and other complementary businesses. It owns a portfolio of about 30 underwriting agencies, and has a 60% equity stake in UnisonSteadfast, a global general insurance broker referral network with 295 brokers in 113 countries. The Company also owns a Lloyd's broking operation.

name: SCENTRE GROUP
businessSummary: Scentre Group is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates a portfolio of 42 Westfield destinations with 37 located in Australia and five in New Zealand encompassing. The Company's Westfield destinations are located across Australia and New Zealand. Its retail service includes marketing services, gift cards, center services and a marketing hub. Its BrandSpace gives businesses access to over 1,800 full motion SuperScreens and SmartScreens and various retail pop-up and promotional touchpoints, located to optimize customer connections. The Company operates through two segments: property investment, and property management and construction segments. The Property investments segment owns and operates shopping centers. The Company’s Property management and construction segment includes external fee from third parties, primarily property management and development fees, and associated business expenses.

name: ST BARBARA LTD
businessSummary: St Barbara Limited is an Australia-based gold mining company with operations in Canada and Papua New Guinea. The Company's operations include the Atlantic Operations and the Simberi Operations. Its Atlantic Operations in Nova Scotia, Canada consists of its open pit Touquoy mine, along with three additional planned projects nearby at Fifteen Mile Stream, Cochrane Hill and Beaver Dam. Its Atlantic Operations are located approximately 80 kilometers north-east of Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. The Company is also exploring the Moose River Corridor and elsewhere in Nova Scotia. Its Simberi Operations consists of an open cut mine on the northernmost island in the Tabar group of islands in the province of New Ireland in Papua New Guinea. Its Simberi Operations is located approximately 900 kilometers away from the capital of Papua New Guinea, Port Moresby.

name: SOUTH32 LTD
businessSummary: South32 Limited is a global mining and metals company. Its segments include Worsley Alumina, Brazil Alumina, Brazil Aluminium, Hillside Aluminium, Mozal Aluminium, Sierra Gorda, Cannington, Hermosa, Cerro Matoso, Australia Manganese and South Africa Manganese. Worsley Alumina segment includes an integrated bauxite mine and an alumina refinery in Australia. Brazil Alumina segment consists of an integrated bauxite mine and an alumina refinery in Brazil. Brazil Aluminium segment is engaged in aluminum smelter in Brazil. Hillside Aluminium segment is focused on aluminum smelter in South Africa. Mozal Aluminium segment is engaged in aluminum smelter in Mozambique. Sierra Gorda segment is focused on copper mine in Chile. Cannington segment includes silver, lead and zinc mines in Australia. Hermosa segment includes base metals exploration and development project in the United States. Cerro Matoso segment includes an integrated laterite ferronickel mine and smelting complex in Colombia.

name: RELIANCE WORLDWIDE CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Reliance Worldwide Corporation Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs, manufactures, and supplies water flow control and monitoring products and solutions for the plumbing and heating industry. Its principal product categories include plumbing solutions, appliance installation solutions, and Other products. Its plumbing solutions include brass and plastic push-to-connect plumbing fittings, other fittings, pipes, valves and integrated installation solutions. Its appliance installation solutions include fluid tech and appliance installation and repair. The Company's brands include JG Speedfit, HoldRite, and SharkBite. Its geographical segments include the Americas, Asia Pacific, and EMEA. The Asia Pacific segment includes Australia, New Zealand, Korea, and China. The EMEA segment includes the United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Italy, Poland, France, and the Czech Republic. The Americas segment includes the United States of America and Canada.

name: RPMGLOBAL HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: RPMGlobal Holdings Limited is an Australia-based professional development and software training provider for the mining industry. The Company provides all of its software offerings, including support (maintenance), training and implementation services to mining companies. Its software solutions include AMT, XECUTE, MinePlanner, AMT Mobile, Sustainable Technology, Mobile Technology, EmissionsManager, Enterprise Optimizer, EnviroDataVault, HAULSIM, SIMULATE, XERAS, ShiftManager, MinVu, IMAFS, HaaS - Haulage as a Service, TALPAC - Underground Coal and PO - Product Optimizer. The Company offers both classroom and online training. Its instructor-led training includes public training courses, and customized training. It offers public courses throughout the year in various regions. It delivers customized, private mining training sessions for its clients in person or remotely at a time that suits their business needs. Its clients can purchase online mining courses through its online stores.

name: RUMBLE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Rumble Resources Limited is engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of base and precious metal projects. Its Earaheedy project is located over 110 kilometers (km) north of Wiluna, Western Australia in the Earaheedy Basin. It owns 75% of E69/3464 and 100% of two contiguous exploration licenses, E69/3787, E69/3815, E69/3862 and applications for E69/4062, E69/4099, E69/4257, M69/150 and an application for miscellaneous license L69/58. Its projects include Western Queen, Fraser Range, Lamil, Munarra Gully, Braeside, Warroo and Wardawarra. The Western Queen Gold and Tungsten Project is located 90km northwest of Mt Magnet within Western Australia’s Yalgoo Mineral Field. The project comprises two mining leases, M59/45 and M59/208, one miscellaneous licence L59/40 and two exploration licences, E20/967 and E59/2816. Lamil Project is in Western Australia’s highly prospective Paterson Province, between two major mining operations-the Nifty Copper Mine and Telfer Gold-Copper Mine.

name: RESOLUTE MINING LTD
businessSummary: Resolute Mining Ltd is an Australia-based gold miner, developer, and explorer company. It owns two producing gold mines: the Syama Gold Mine in Mile (Syama) and the Mako Gold Mine in Senegal (Mako). Syama is in the southwest of Mali, over 30 kilometers (km) from the Cote d’Ivoire border and 300 km southeast of the capital Bamako. Syama Gold Mine is a large-scale operation, comprising the established Syama Underground Mine, the Tabakoroni Complex, Syama North Resource and several satellite oxide pits. The Mako Gold Mine, located in eastern Senegal, is an open-pit mine with potential life extension through several near-mine exploration opportunities. Its project also includes Doropo Project and ABC Project. The Doropo Gold Project, located in northeastern Cote d’Ivoire, comprises seven exploration permits covering an area of over 1,850 square kilometers (km2). The ABC Project, located in northwest Cote d’Ivoire, is over 550km northwest of Abidjan and 460km west of the Doropo project.

name: REGIS RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Regis Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold producer and explorer company. It operates in three segments: Duketon North (DNO), Duketon South (DSO) and Tropicana. DNO and DSO collectively comprise the Duketon Gold Project. The DNO segment consists of Moolart Well, Gloster, Anchor, Dogbolter-Coopers and Petra. The DSO segment consists of Garden Well, Rosemont, Rosemont Underground, Erlistoun, Tooheys Well and Baneygo. The Tropicana segment is operated by joint venture partner AngloGold Ashanti Australia Limited. Its Duketon Gold Project is in the northeastern Goldfields of Western Australia approximately 130 kilometers (km) north of Laverton. It focuses on high-grade gold mining opportunities in the mining region of Central Western New South Wales (NSW). Its Tropicana Gold Project is located approximately 330 km east-northeast (ENE) of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia. Its McPhillamys Gold Project is located about 250 km west of Sydney in the mining region of Central Western NSW.

name: RENASCOR RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Renascor Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the development of economically viable mineral deposits, including its Siviour BAM project in South Australia. The Company holds interests in various tenements, such as Carnding, Marree, Dutton Bay, Malbrom, Lipson Cove, Verran, Malbrom West, Cleve, Hincks, Outalpa, Cutana, Old Wartaka, Witchelina, Flat Hill, Malbooma Railway, Carnding, Iron Baron and Gregory Creek. The Siviour BAM Project comprises the Siviour Graphite Deposit, located near Arno Bay on the Eyre Peninsula in South Australia. Siviour BAM Project has a battery anode material production facility, located in Bolivar, where Siviour graphite concentrate is converted into purified spherical graphite (PSG). The Carnding Project contains several near-surface, high-grade gold prospects in South Australia's Central Gawler Craton. The Marree Project is a copper-prospective ground position within South Australia's Adelaide Fold Belt.

name: RAND MINING LTD
businessSummary: Rand Mining Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in exploration, development and production activities at the Company’s East Kundana Joint Venture tenements. The Company’s East Kundana Joint Venture (EKJV) is an operational underground gold mining project located in the Kundana area 25 kilometers (km) west northwest of Kalgoorlie and 47 km northeast of Coolgardie. The project comprises two producing underground mines Raleigh and Rubicon/Hornet /Pegasus (RHP). The Hornet orebody is located 600 meters (m) to the south of the Rubicon orebody. The Pegasus deposit is located approximately 480 m to the north of Rubicon and also accessed from the Rubicon decline.

name: RED MOUNTAIN MINING LTD
businessSummary: Red Mountain Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company has a portfolio of United States, Canada and Australia projects in Critical Minerals and Gold. The Company is advancing its Armidale Antimony-Gold Project in New South Wales, Utah Antimony Project in the Antimony Mining District of Utah, United States, Fry Lake Gold Project and United States Lithium projects. Its Armidale Antimony-Gold Project encompasses approximately 391 square kilometers (km2) of prospective ground within the Southern New England Orogen (SNEO) in northeastern New South Wales. The Company's Utah Antimony Project is located 11 km east of the town of Antimony, Utah and the project comprises 87 claims. Its Fry Lake Gold Project consists of four exploration licenses prospective for gold, within the Meen-Dempster Greenstone Belt (Ontario, Canada). Its other projects include Lithic Lithium, Mustang Lithium, Kiabye Gold, Yellow Pine Antimony, and Koonenberry Gold.

name: RAMELIUS RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Ramelius Resources Limited is a mid-tier gold mining and exploration company with operations in Western Australia. The Company’s project portfolio includes Edna May Gold, Mt Magnet Gold Mine, Penny Gold Mine, Symes Gold Mine, Tampia Gold Mine, Cue Gold, Mount Magnet Gold, Rebecca Gold, Roe Gold, Dalgaranga Gold, Never Never and Pepper Gold Deposits and Yalgoo Gold. The Edna May project is located within the Westonia Greenstone Belt, within the Southern Cross Province of Western Australia’s Archaean Yilgarn Craton. The Mt Magnet gold project is located adjacent to the town of Mt Magnet, 500 kilometers (kms) north-east of Perth in the Murchison Goldfield of the Western Australian Yilgarn Craton. The Penny Gold Mine is located approximately 150km south-east of Ramelius’ Mt Magnet mining and processing operations and approximately 550km north-east of Perth in Western Australia. The Symes’ Find prospect is located 60km south of the township of Moorine Rock, Western Australia.

name: RESOURCE MINING CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Resource Minerals International Ltd, formerly Resource Mining Corporation Limited, is an Australia-based company. In Tanzania, it has two exploration projects targeting Copper-Gold and six projects focused on nickel occurrences in sulphides within known and prolific mafic and ultramafic intrusions. In Finland, it has two projects, focusing on the exploration of lithium. Tanzanian Projects include Mpanda and Mbozi, Kabanga North Nickel, Kapalagulu, Kabulwanyele and Southern Projects (Liparamba, Kitai, Mbinga). Its Finnish Projects include Kola Lithium Project (Koyhajoki and Pikkukallio exploration permits) and Hirvikallio Lithium Project (Laitiainen permit application). The Mpanda and Mbozi projects are located within the Ubendian Orogenic Belt, a source of Ni, Cu and Au resources within Tanzania. Kabulwanyele Project is in the Mpanda District of Tanzania, covering over 20.5 square kilometers. The Kabanga North Nickel Project is situated along strike from the Kabanga Nickel Project.

name: REEDY LAGOON CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Reedy Lagoon Corporation Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company’s projects include the Nevada Lithium Projects, the Burracoppin Gold Project, and Burracoppin Iron Project. Its Nevada Lithium Projects include Alkali Lake North (ALN), and Clayton Valley (CV), which are located in two large and separate groundwater catchment areas in Nevada, United States of America. ALN comprises 334 placer claims and 157 lode claims, covering 3,908 hectares (9,657 acres). The Burracoppin Gold project is located in the central Wheatbelt of Western Australia roughly midway between Perth and Kalgoorlie on the Great Eastern Highway, Route 94. The Burracoppin Gold project comprises the Lady Janet, Windmills, Shear Luck and Zebra prospects. The Burracoppin magnetite deposit is located half-way between Perth and Kalgoorlie near the town of Burracoppin on the Great Eastern Highway, east of Merredin.

name: RECKON LTD
businessSummary: Reckon Limited is an Australia-based software company that provides software for accountants, bookkeepers, lawyers, small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and personal users. The Company’s divisions include Business Group and Legal Practice Management Group. Business Group provides accounting and payroll software for small to larger sized businesses and personal wealth management software branded as Reckon One, Reckon Mobile and Reckon Accounts Hosted (cloud products), Reckon Accounts Business and Reckon Accounts Personal respectively. The divisions operate predominantly in Australia and New Zealand. Legal Practice Management Group provides practice management software and workflow solutions to legal firms for document scanning and routing, print management and cost recovery solutions under the nQZebraworks brand, with a focus on releasing new cloud practice management products. It operates predominantly in the United States and United Kingdom, with re-sellers in other parts of the world.

name: RIO TINTO LTD
businessSummary: Rio Tinto Limited is a mining and materials company. It operates in 35 countries and produces iron ore, copper, aluminum, critical minerals and other materials needed for the global energy transition. Its segments include Iron Ore, Aluminum, Copper, and Minerals. The iron ore segment includes iron ore mining and salt and gypsum production in Western Australia. Its iron ore operations in the Pilbara comprise an integrated network of 18 iron ore mines and four independent port terminals. The aluminum segment includes bauxite mining, alumina refining, and aluminum smelting and recycling. The copper segment includes mining and refining of copper, gold, silver, molybdenum, other by-products and licensing of extraction technologies. The minerals segment includes mining and processing of borates, diamonds, iron concentrate and pellets from the Iron Ore Company of Canada, lithium and titanium dioxide feedstock.

name: RIMFIRE PACIFIC MINING LTD
businessSummary: Rimfire Pacific Mining Ltd is an Australia-based critical minerals exploration company, which is advancing a portfolio of projects within the highly prospective Lachlan Orogen and Broken Hill districts of New South Wales (NSW). The Company's 100% owned projects include Green View Cobalt Project, Valley Project and East Cowal Copper Gold Project. Its earn in projects include Avondale and Fifield. Green View Cobalt Project lies around 35 kilometers (km) west of Broken Hill, within the highly prospective Broken Hill geological district of NSW, and includes three high-grade cobalt targets: Bald Hill, Staurolite Ridge and Railway Extension. Valley Project is located five km west of Kincora Copper's Mordialloc porphyry copper gold discovery. East Cowal Copper Gold Project has around 500 square kilometers, which lies 60 km southwest of Parkes within the highly prospective Lachlan Orogen of NSW. Avondale and Fifield projects are being funded by its exploration partner, Golden Plains Resources.

name: RIDLEY CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Ridley Corporation Limited is an Australia-based provider of premium animal nutrition solutions. The Company operates through two segments: Packaged Feeds and Ingredients and Bulk Stockfeeds. The Packaged Feeds and Ingredients segment comprises animal nutrition feed and ingredient solutions delivered in packaged form, ranging from one ton down to three kilogram bags. It also includes the Aquafeed Business Unit. The Bulk Stockfeeds segment includes animal nutrition stockfeed solutions delivered in bulk. Its specialist areas include Aqua Feeds, Bulk Ruminant Stockfeeds, Bulk Monogastric Stockfeeds, Animal Proteins & Oils, Commodities, NovaqPro, and Primo Aquaculture. It manufactures and supplies a complete range of prawn/shrimp feeds and fish feeds for species, including Monodon, Vannamei, Banana, and Stylirostris prawns. It is also a provider of dairy feed, cattle feed, and sheep feed. It provides bulk stockfeed for monogastric animals, including layers, broilers, pigs, and ducks.

name: RHYTHM BIOSCIENCES LTD
businessSummary: Rhythm Biosciences Ltd is an Australia-based medical diagnostics company. The Company is engaged in delivering simple, affordable blood tests for accurate and early detection of cancers. It is focused on improving patient outcomes through detection at the earliest possible stage, reducing the global burden of cancer and saving lives. The Company’s blood-based technology, a blood test for the detection of Colorectal Cancer (CRC). The ColoSTAT Test-Kit measures five specific protein biomarkers that indicate the likelihood of CRC. The test is an alternative for individuals who are unable or unwilling to participate in current screening programs. It is being updated to meet the IVDR (In vitro diagnostic medical devices regulation) regulatory standards. Its geneType platform personalized predictive test portfolio that uses a combination of genomic and clinical information to predict risk of chronic disease development.

name: RAMSAY HEALTH CARE LTD
businessSummary: Ramsay Health Care Limited is a provider of hospital and healthcare services in Australia, Europe and the United Kingdom. Its segments include Australia, the UK, France and the Nordics. Its businesses include Ramsay Australia, Ramsay Sante, Ramsay UK, and Elysium Healthcare. Ramsay Health Care is Australia’s private hospital operator, with more than 70 modern hospitals, clinics and surgical centers in cities and towns across the country. Ramsay Sante is a private care provider in Europe with hundreds of modern hospitals, clinics, primary care and imaging centers across France, Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Italy. Ramsay UK has a network of hospitals and day surgeries across the UK providing a range of clinical specialties to private and self-insured patients. Elysium Healthcare is an independent provider of specialist health and care services. Elysium's four core service streams are mental health and wellbeing, learning disabilities and autism, neurological, and children and education.

name: RECTIFIER TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Rectifier Technologies Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs and manufactures high-efficiency power rectifiers and produces electronic and specialized magnetic components. The Company's segments include Electronic Components, Industrial Power Supplies (Electricity generation/distribution and Defence) (E&D), Industrial Power Supplies (Transport and Telecommunication) (T&T) and Industrial Power Supplies (Electric vehicles) (EV). Electronic Components segment is engaged in manufacturing electronic components. Industrial Power Supplies (E&D) segment manufactures and distributes rectifiers, controllers, accessories and complete systems for the power generation, distribution industries and defense. Industrial Power Supplies (T&T) segment manufactures and distributes power supplies for the transport industries and telecommunications. Industrial Power Supplies (EV) segment manufactures and distributes electric vehicle charges, battery charges and power supplies.

name: RETAIL FOOD GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Retail Food Group Limited is a food and beverage company. The Company is a multi-brand retail food franchise manager and is the owner of brands, including Gloria Jean’s, Donut King, Brumby’s Bakery, Crust Gourmet Pizza, CIBO Espresso, and Beefy’s Pies, among others. The Company is also a roaster and supplier of coffee products. Its principal activities include intellectual property ownership of the Donut King, Brumby’s Bakery, Crust Gourmet Pizza Bar, Rack ‘em Bones BBQ Ribs, Beefy’s Pies and Gloria Jean’s Coffees Brand Systems; development and or management of the Donut King, Brumby’s Bakery, Crust Gourmet Pizza Bar, Rack ‘em Bones BBQ Ribs, Beefy’s Pies and Gloria Jean’s Coffees Brand Systems throughout the world, whether directly managed and/or as licensor for all Brand Systems; and management of pie and baked product manufacturing facilities, and the wholesale supply of products to the group and third-parties. Its segments include Cafe, Coffee & Bakery Division; and QSR Division.

name: REGIONAL EXPRESS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Regional Express Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the provision of air services, including the transportation of passengers and freight, along with pilot training. The Company's segments include regular public transport, charter and other, and training. The Company has a regional and domestic airline, Rex, operating a fleet of approximately 57 Saab 340 and nine Boeing 737-800 NG aircraft to 56 destinations throughout all states in Australia. In addition to the airline Rex, the Company comprises wholly owned subsidiaries, including two pilot academies, Australian Airline Pilot Academy with campuses in Wagga Wagga and Ballarat, and a propeller maintenance organization, Australian Aerospace Propeller Maintenance.

name: REECE AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Reece Limited is a distributor of plumbing, waterworks and heating, ventilation, air-conditioning and refrigeration products to commercial and residential customers. The Company operates through two geographical segments: Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and the United States of America (United States).
