It sells a range of titanium dioxide feedstocks, zircon products and rare earth minerals. Its segments include Mineral Sands, Rare Earths (RE), and Idle. Mineral Sands segment includes mining operations at Jacinth-Ambrosia in South Australia, Cataby in Western Australia, and activities at Balranald in New South Wales. It also includes associated processing operations at the Narngulu mineral separation plant in mid-west Western Australia, and the processing of ilmenite at Synthetic Rutile Kilns, also located in Western Australia. RE segment comprises the Eneabba Rare Earths Refinery being constructed in Western Australia alongside Phase I and II of the Eneabba development, and the Group's investment in Northern Minerals Limited. Idle comprises rehabilitation obligations in the United States (Florida and Virginia).

name: IGO LTD
businessSummary: IGO Limited is a resources company that discovers, develops and produces products critical to the clean energy transition. Its segments include Nova Operation, Forrestania Operation, Cosmos Project, Lithium Business, and Growth. The Nova Operation comprises the Nova underground nickel mine and processing operation which produces nickel and copper concentrates. Forrestania Operation is located 400 kilometers east of Perth in Western Australia. Cosmos Project comprises the development of the Odysseus underground mine focused on the production of nickel concentrate, containing nickel and cobalt metal. The project is in care and maintenance. The Lithium Business represents its 49% share in the lithium joint venture, Tianqi Lithium Energy Australia Pty Ltd (TLEA), with Tianqi Lithium Corporation. The existing assets of TLEA include the Greenbushes Lithium Mine and the Kwinana Lithium Hydroxide Refinery. The Growth segment comprises exploration, business development and project evaluation.

name: INFOMEDIA LTD
businessSummary: Infomedia Ltd is an Australia-based company. The Company is a provider of data as a service (DaaS) and software as a service (SaaS) solution for the data-driven automotive ecosystem. Its segments include Asia Pacific; Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA), and Americas, representing the combined North, Central and South America. Its parts include Microcat EPC, Microcat Partsbridge, Microcat Market, and Microcat CRM. Its services include Superservice Menus, Superservice Triage, Superservice Platform, and Superservice Connect. Superservice Connect is the online service booking solution powered by VIN-specific original equipment manufacturer (OEM) data, ensuring customers see the precise service schedule for their vehicle. Its SimplePart is a data-driven e-commerce platform designed to help dealers and OEMs sell more parts and accessories. For dealers, SimplePart offers a turnkey solution that simplifies launching and managing an online store.

name: INSIGNIA FINANCIAL LTD
businessSummary: Insignia Financial Ltd is an Australia-based wealth manager, providing financial advice, superannuation, wrap platforms and asset management services to members, clients, financial advisers and corporate employers. Its segment includes Advice, Master Trust, Wrap, and Asset Management. The Advice segment includes the Company’s employed advice businesses, Bridges and Shadforth. These businesses provide comprehensive financial advice. The Master Trust segment offers solutions used by employers and independent advisers. The Wrap segment offers a technology platform and invests in technology and services to support the changing needs of advisers and their clients. The Asset Management segment offers access to a range of investment capabilities across a range of multi-asset and single asset classes, designed to suit a range of investor needs and risk profiles. Its subsidiaries include ACN 089 554 058 Pty Ltd, Australian Wealth Management Limited, and Consultum Financial Advisers Pty Ltd.

name: IDP EDUCATION LTD
businessSummary: IDP Education Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in international education services. The Company specializes in matching universities, colleges, and schools with the right students worldwide. Its segments include Asia, Australasia, and Rest of World. The principal activities of each segment are provision of student placement services, International English Language Testing (IELTS) and English language teaching services. It offers placement of international students into education institutions in Australia, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, New Zealand, and Ireland. The placement services include counselling, application processing and pre-departure guidance. It is engaged in the distribution and administration of IELTS tests. The Company is a co-owner of IELTS with the British Council and Cambridge Assessment. It is also engaged in the operation of English language schools in Vietnam and Cambodia and the operation of digital marketing and event services.

name: IDT AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: IDT Australia Limited is a pharmaceutical manufacturing company. The Company is engaged in the supply of products and provision of research and development and other technical services within the pharmaceutical and allied industries. Its business includes research and development, active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) and finished dosage form manufacture (FDF), clinical and commercial, project management, chemical services, analytical chemistry, pharmacy services, pharmaceutical development in all dosage forms, clinical packaging and regulatory affairs services. Its Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) manufacturing facilities produces both API and FDF across the medicinal cannabis manufacturing space. It also provides a full-scale service for new drug development and scale-up, commercial active drug manufacture as well as a variety of oral and injectable finished drug dose forms. Its analytical laboratories offer medicinal cannabis cGMP testing.

name: INSURANCE AUSTRALIA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Insurance Australia Group Limited is a general insurance company in Australia and New Zealand. The Company is engaged in underwriting of general insurance risks and investment management. Its segments include Direct Insurance Australia, Intermediated Insurance Australia and New Zealand. Direct Insurance Australia provides personal lines, and some commercial lines, general insurance products sold directly to customers primarily under the NRMA Insurance brand, SGIO and SGIC brands, the RACV brand in Victoria (via a distribution relationship and underwriting joint venture with RACV), as well as the CGU Insurance and ROLLiN’ Insurance brands. Intermediated Insurance Australia segment provides commercial lines, and some personal lines, general insurance products sold to customers through intermediaries primarily under the CGU Insurance and WFI brands, as well as the Coles Insurance brand via a distribution agreement with Coles. New Zealand segment includes NZI and Lumley Insurance brands.

name: HAZER GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Hazer Group Limited is an Australia-based technology company, driving global decarbonization efforts with the commercialization of its disruptive climate-tech. The principal activity of the Company is the research and development of hydrogen and graphitic carbon production technology. The Company’s advanced technology enables the production of clean and economically competitive hydrogen and graphite, using a natural gas (or biogas) feedstock and iron-ore as the process catalyst. The Company has intellectual property rights to a technology (the Hazer Process), which enables the production of hydrogen gas from the thermo-catalytic decomposition of methane (natural gas) with low carbon dioxide emissions and the co-production of a high-purity graphite product. The Company's markets include industrial hydrogen, hydrogen mobility and synthetic graphite. It has facilities, including a research and development lab and a fluid bed reactor pilot plant.

name: HORIZON OIL LTD
businessSummary: Horizon Oil Limited is an upstream oil and gas company. The principal activities of the Company is petroleum production, development, and exploration. It operates in three segments. Under China development segment, it is involved in developing and producing crude oil from the Block 22/12 - WZ6-12, WZ12-8W and WZ12-8E oil field developments and in the exploration and evaluation of hydrocarbons within Block 22/12. Under New Zealand development segment, it is involved in developing and producing crude oil from the Maari/Manaia oil field development. Under Australia development segment, it is involved in developing and producing oil and gas from the Mereenie OL4 and OL5 oil and gas fields. The Block 22/12 oil development comprises nine hydrocarbon pools across three different Production Licenses. It lies 35 kilometers (kms) southwest of Weizhou Island, China, in 30m water depth. The Maari oil field is a producing oil field. It lies 80 km off the south Taranaki coast in 100 m water depth.

name: HARVEY NORMAN HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Harvey Norman Holdings Limited is engaged in the integrated retail, franchise, property and digital system business. The Company’s principal activities include franchisor; omnichannel retailing of furniture, bedding, computers, communications and consumer electrical products in New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, Slovenia, Ireland, Northern Ireland and Croatia; property investment; lessor of premises to Harvey Norman, Domayne and Joyce Mayne franchisees and other third parties; media placement; and provision of consumer finance and other commercial loans and advances. Its segments include Franchising Operations, New Zealand (retail), Singapore & Malaysia (retail), Slovenia & Croatia (retail), Ireland (retail), United Kingdom (retail), Other Non-Franchised Retail, Retail Property, Retail Property Under Construction, Property Developments for Resale, Equity Investments, And Other. Its brands sell products under various categories, including electrical goods, furniture, and others.

name: HUB24 LTD
businessSummary: HUB24 Limited is an Australia-based provider of integrated platform, technology, and data solutions. The Company operates HUB24 Platform, HUBconnect, the Xplore Wealth platform, Class and myprosperity. The HUB24 Platform offers advisers and their clients a comprehensive range of investment options, including managed portfolio solutions, and enhanced transaction and reporting functionality. HUBconnect focuses on leveraging data and technology to provide solutions to common challenges for stockbrokers, licensees and advisers. Class is a cloud-based wealth accounting software that delivers self-managed superannuation fund (SMSF) administration, trust accounting, portfolio management, legal documentation and corporate compliance solutions to financial professionals. myprosperity is a provider of client portals for accountants and financial advisers, enabling streamlined service delivery, increased productivity and enhanced customer experience for finance professionals and their clients.

name: HARRIS TECHNOLOGY GROUP LIMITED
businessSummary: Harris Technology Group Limited is an Australia-based online retailing company. The Company is focused on providing information technology/consumer electronics (IT/CE) products for small and medium businesses in Australia. The Company’s main business is the eCommerce business of Harris Technology (HT). The Company’s business is conducted online both on www.ht.com.au and through the online platforms, such as Amazon, Kogan, Catch and eBay.

name: HANSEN TECHNOLOGIES LTD
businessSummary: Hansen Technologies Limited is a global provider of software and services to the energy, water and communications industries. The Company is engaged in the development, integration and support of software and services for the energy and utilities and communications and media sectors. Its segments include Energy & Utilities and Communications & Media. The Energy & Utilities segment encompasses the sale of software and the provision of consulting services for Energy & Utilities customers that primarily operate in electricity, gas and water. The Communications & Media segment encompasses the sale of software and the provision of consulting services for Communications & Media customers that primarily operate in telecommunications and pay-tv. Its services include software product services, cloud & hosting, managed services, and data protection and disaster recovery. Its software product services include architecture consulting, solution delivery, and systems integration.

name: HIGH PEAK ROYALTIES LTD
businessSummary: High Peak Royalties Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in building a portfolio of diversified high-value resource royalties around the world. The Company has royalties over 20 oil and gas permits in Australia, and over 2,000 wells in the United States. The Company’s portfolio includes PL 171 and ATP 574P; ATP 299P; Petroleum Leases: PL29, PL38, PL39, PL52, 3.6/4.0 Santos PL57, PL95, PL169, PL170, PL293, PL294, PL295 and PL298; Peat Gas Field (PL101); Surprise Oil Field (PL6); Longtom Gas Field (VIC/L29); WA-90-R / WA-91-R (formerly WA-315-P) Poseidon Field; EP(A)111, EP115, EP(A)120 and EP(A) 124; EP112, EP115NM and EP125; EP(A)155; Planet Gas USA Inc. Royalties; United States (Harrison County East Texas, Preston Spraberry Permian Basin and Willacy County Texas Gulf Coast Basin); United States (Burleson and Lee Counties, East Texas; ML 04/244 and ML 04/249 Admiral Bay, Canning Basin; and Royalty over Hydrogen Sales, including Catalysts.

name: HORSESHOE METALS LTD
businessSummary: Horseshoe Metals Limited is a mineral exploration and resource development company. The Company has a package of tenements covering approximately 500 square kilometers (km2) in the Peak Hill Mineral Field, located north of Meekatharra in Western Australia, and mineral interests in South Australia. Its projects include Horseshoe Lights Project and the Kumarina Project in Western Australia, and the Glenloth Gold Project in South Australia. The Horseshoe Lights Copper-Gold Project comprises a package of tenements in the Bryah Basin of Western Australia, located 800 km north-northeast of Perth and 140km north of Meekatharra. The project includes an open pit of the Horseshoe Lights copper-gold mine. The Kumarina Project consists of a mining lease and mining lease application covering approximately 3.2 km2. The Glenloth Project is located in the Central Gawler Craton of South Australia and consists of a single exploration license, EL 6301, which comprises two areas totaling 107 km2.

name: HAMMER METALS LTD
businessSummary: Hammer Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is involved in mineral exploration in Western Australia and Queensland. The Company’s projects include Bronzewing South Au/Li/Ni Project and Mount Isa Projects. The Bronzewing South Project is located in Western Australian within the heart of the highly prospective Yandal Belt. It holds a 100% interest in over 290 square kilometers (km2) of tenements, located within the Yandal greenstone belt in Western Australia. It holds a strategic tenement position covering approximately 2,800 km2 within the Mount Isa mining district, with 100% interests in the Kalman (Cu-Au-Mo-Re) deposit, the Overlander North and Overlander South (Cu-Co) deposits, the Lakeview (Cu-Au) deposit and the Elaine (Cu-Au) deposit. It also has a 51% interest in the Jubilee (Cu-Au) deposit. It is an active mineral explorer, focused on discovering large copper-gold deposits of Ernest Henry style and has a range of prospective targets at various stages of testing.

name: HELLOWORLD TRAVEL LTD
businessSummary: Helloworld Travel Limited is a travel-distribution company. It is engaged in selling of international and domestic travel products and services, the operation of retail distribution networks of travel agents and specialized freight operations. Its segments include Travel Operations and Transport, Logistics, and Warehousing. The Company offers retail leisure travel and business travel networks, travel broker networks, destination management services (inbound), air ticket consolidation, tourism transport operations, wholesale travel services, online operations and event-based freight operations, all supported by proprietary and non-proprietary distribution systems. Its brands include Helloworld Travel, Helloworld Business Travel, Magellan Travel, Mobile Travel Agent, My Travel Group, and Travel Brokers. Its wholesale travel businesses in Australia include Viva Holidays, Ultimate Journeys, ReadyRooms, and in New Zealand includes Go Holidays and Williment Travel.

name: HITECH GROUP AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: HiTech Group Australia Limited is an Australia-based specialist provider of recruitment and contracting services to the private and Australian government sectors. The Company specializes in sourcing and placing, information and communications technology (ICT), administrative and office support personnel for permanent and contract positions. It has a recruitment and consulting system supported by an extensive proprietary candidate and client database - HiBase. HiBase is a cloud-based platform that allows the Company to serve its clients. The Company also offers a comprehensive ICT Service that delivers IT solutions in a flexible and customized way. The employers it deals with are partners with the Company from a range of industries, including telco, finance, healthcare, consulting, information technology (IT) and fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG). As a candidate of the Company, it is focused on making its candidate job search easier and effective.

name: HILLGROVE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Hillgrove Resources Limited is an Australia-based mining company. The Company's flagship project The Kanmantoo Underground project is located approximately 55km from Adelaide. The Kanmantoo features the recently completed Giant, Nugent and Emily Star Open Pits, and a fully permitted and operational ore processing plant, and tailings storage facility with spare capacity. The Company's pipeline of exploration opportunities over more than 6,100 square kilometers (km2) of tenements. These tenements comprise three project areas: the Mine Lease Exploration, Near Mine Exploration and the Regional Exploration areas within the Kanmantoo Province in the south-east of South Australia. In addition to the Kanmantoo operation, The Company holds over 6,150 km2 of granted Exploration Licenses in South-eastern South Australia which are prospective for the discovery of economic copper deposits within a variety of geological settings (Southeastern Copper Project).

name: HIGHFIELD RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Highfield Resources Limited (Highfield) is an Australia-based company engaged in mineral exploration. The Company has around four potash projects. The Company's Muga, Vipasca, Izaga, Pintanos and Sierra del Perdon potash projects are located in the Ebro potash producing basin in northern Spain covering a project area of over 550 square kilometers. The Muga project targets the shallow sylvinite beds to the south east of the project area. The Muga project is located approximately 50 kilometers to the southeast of Pamplona. The Sierra del Perdon project is located approximately 10 kilometers from Pamplona. The Vipasca project area includes the Vipasca permit, the Borneau permit and the Osquia permit. The Pintanos project covers an area of around 125 square kilometers abutting the Muga-Vipasca project. The Izaga project is located in a syncline structure abutting the northern extent of the expanded Vipasca project.

name: HELIOS ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Helios Energy Ltd is an Australia-based onshore oil and gas exploration company. The Company’s principal activity includes the exploration activities in Presidio Oil and Gas Project located in Presidio County, Texas, United States. The Company is organized into two segments, being oil and gas exploration in the USA and helium in China. The Presidio Oil & Gas Project is comprised of a large wet gas resource. The Company has a 70% working interest (WI) in a total of approximately 66,776 acres (46,743 net acres). It has drilled two vertical wildcat wells into the Presidio Oil Project: Quinn Creek 141 and Quinn Mesa 113 (two miles apart). The Company’s subsidiaries include Helios Energy USA, Ltd, Helios Operating, LLC, Helios Energy (China) Ltd and Helios Energy Holdings Ltd.

name: HAWTHORN RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Hawthorn Resources Limited is an Australia-based diversified critical minerals and gold explorer with tenement holdings throughout Western Australia. The Company’s projects include Mount Bevan Magnetite Project, Mount Bevan Critical Minerals Project and Anglo Saxon Gold Mine. The Company has a joint venture with Hancock Magnetite Holdings Pty Ltd and Legacy Iron Ore Limited on the Mount Bevan Magnetite and Critical Minerals Project, which is located in South Yilgarn, southwest of Leonora. The Anglo-Saxon gold project is a joint venture between the Company (70%) and Gel Resources Pty Ltd (30%) located at Pinjin, approximately 140 kilometers northeast of Kalgoorlie. The Anglo-Saxon gold mine is located in the South Laverton Tectonic zone (SLTZ), 140 kilometers north-east of Kalgoorlie and 35 kilometers east of the Carosue Dam mill. The project is part of the Trouser Legs Joint Venture (TLJV) with Gel Resources Pty Ltd.

name: HAVILAH RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Havilah Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration for and evaluation of mineral resources (predominantly copper, gold, cobalt and iron ore) in South Australia. The Company’s projects include Kalkaroo, Mutooroo, Grants, Maldorky and Prospect Hill. The Kalkaroo Project is located in northeastern South Australia. The Mutooroo project is located within commuting distance of Broken Hill, and 16 kilometers (km) south of the Transcontinental railway line and Barrier Highway. The Grants iron ore project lies eight km south of the Barrier Highway and the Transcontinental Railway, and a one-hour drive southwest of Broken Hill. The Maldorky iron ore deposit lies approximately 26 km south of the Barrier Highway and the Transcontinental Railway, 300 km east of Port Pirie and a one-hour drive southwest of Broken Hill. The Prospect Hill tin project is located on the northern margins of the Flinders Ranges.

name: HASTINGS TECHNOLOGY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Hastings Technology Metals Limited is an Australia-based rare earths and gold company. The Company is focused on the development of its flagship Yangibana Rare Earths and Niobium Project and Whiteheads Gold Project in the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. Yangibana is located in the Gascoyne region of Western Australia and contains one of the highly valued deposits of NdPr in the world with an NdPr to Total Rare Earth Oxide ratio of up to 52% in some areas of the orebody. The Yangibana Project occupies 650 square kilometers and is located approximately 250 kilometers (km) northeast of Carnarvon in Western Australia. The projected is located on Gifford Creek Station, which covers Thiin-Mah, Warriyangka, Tharrkari and Jiwarli country. The Whiteheads Gold Project is strategically located approximately 80 km northeast of Kalgoorlie, offering access to existing infrastructure, operating mines and gold processing facilities. Its projects also include Brockman and Ark Gold.

name: GWR GROUP LTD
businessSummary: GWR Group Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company is focused on the development of mineral exploration and development projects. It is primarily focused on the exploration and development of its Prospect Ridge Project. It holds a 70% interest in the advanced Prospect Ridge Magnesite project located in northwest Tasmania. The Prospect Ridge Magnesite project area is located in northwest Tasmania, 40 kilometers (km) southwest of the Port of Burnie. It sits upon a granted exploration license (EL5/2016), and is 11 km long and covers approximately 51 square kilometers (km2) in area and contains two magnesite deposits, the Arthur River and Lyons River deposits containing the magnesite inventory in Australia.

name: GWA GROUP LTD
businessSummary: GWA Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which is a designer, importer and supplier of products and solutions, focused on the delivery of sustainable water solutions for bathrooms, kitchens and laundries. The principal activities of the Company include research, design, import and marketing of building fixtures and fittings to residential and commercial premises, including sanitaryware, tapware and showers, baths, intelligent water management solutions, and related kitchen, bathroom and laundry products/accessories. It distributes, installs, maintains and repairs various products through a range of distribution and customer channels in Australia, New Zealand and selected international markets. Its Water Solutions segment includes the sale of vitreous China toilet suites, basins, plastic cisterns, taps and showers, baths, kitchen sinks, laundry tubs, domestic water control valves, smart products and bathroom accessories. Its brands including CAROMA, METHVEN, dorf and CLARK.

name: GULLEWA LTD
businessSummary: Gullewa Limited is engaged in exploration and mining, investments in equities and property. The Company’s activities cover Gold in Western Australia, base metals, mineral royalties and land subdivision in New South Wales (NSW). The Company’s wholly owned subsidiary Central Iron Ore Limited (CIO) is an exploration and development company engaged in the search for gold in Australia. Its main focus of exploration is in the Darlot Region of Western Australia, within 10 kilometers from the Red 5 Darlot Mine. The two main projects are: Red 5 Joint Venture and British King Gold Mine. It has a 1% royalty in several ATW Venture (Australia) Pty Ltd Mining Tenement, which include the Deflector Gold-Copper Project, located in the Gullewa Project area. The Company’s Gullewa Project is located 450 kilometers (km) north of Perth, 160 km east of Geraldton. The Company, through its fully owned subsidiary Gullpro Pty Ltd holds a 69% interest in a land subdivision at Aberglassyn.

name: GENETIC SIGNATURES LTD
businessSummary: Genetic Signatures Limited is an Australia-based specialist molecular diagnostics (MDx) company. The Company's principal activities include research and commercialization of identifying individual genetic signatures to identify diseases and the sale of associated products into the diagnostic and research marketplaces. The Company is focused on the development and commercialization of its platform technology, 3base. Its MDx 3base platform technology provides high-volume hospitals and pathology laboratories with the ability to screen for an array of infectious pathogens, with a high degree of specificity, in a rapid throughput (time-to-result) environment. It designs and manufactures a suite of real-time Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) based products for the routine detection of infectious diseases under the EasyScreen brand. Its products include EasyScreen Pan-Enteric Detection Kit, EasyScreen STI Genital Pathogen Detection, EasyScreen Viral Meningitis Detection Kit, and others.

name: GRANGE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Grange Resources Limited is an Australia-based company that owns and operates an integrated iron ore mining and pellet production business located in the northwest region of Tasmania. The Company’s principal activities consist of the mining, processing and sale of iron ore, and the ongoing exploration, evaluation and development of mineral resources. Its projects include Savage River, Port Latta and Southdown. The Savage River magnetite iron ore mine, approximately 100 kilometers (km) southwest of the city of Burnie. The Port Latta project is located approximately 70 km northwest of Burnie, and its 100%-owned pellet plant and port facility at Port Latta produces over 2.5 million tons of iron ore products annually. The Southdown Magnetite Project is located over 90 km east-northeast of Albany, and 10 km south-west of Wellstead in the Great Southern region of Western Australia. It contains over 1.2 billion tons of mineral resources, including 388 million tons (Mt) of ore reserves.

name: GPT GROUP
businessSummary: The GPT Group is an Australia-based vertically integrated diversified property company that owns and actively manages a portfolio of Australian retail, office and logistics assets, with assets under management of approximately $32.2 billion. The Company utilizes its real estate management platform to enhance returns through property development and funds management. Its office portfolio includes 32 Smith, 4 Murray Rose Avenue, 580 George Street, 2 Park Street, Darling Park 1 & 2 And Cockle Bay Wharf, Darling Park 3, Eclipse Tower, Liberty Place, 150 Collins Street, and others. Its logistics portfolio includes 128 Andrews Road, 1 Huntingwood Drive, 10 Interchange Drive, 104 Vanessa Street, 16-34 Templar Road, 18-24 Abbott Road, 1B Huntingwood Drive and others. Its retail portfolio includes Charlestown Square, Macarthur Square, Rouse Hill Town Centre, Westfield Penrith, and Chirnside Park, among others. Its Funds Management platform is focused on the Australian retail and office sectors.

name: GROWTHPOINT PROPERTIES AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Growthpoint Properties Australia Limited is an Australia-based real estate investment trust (REIT). The Company invests in industrial and office properties across Australia. The Company operates through three segments: Industrial property investments, Office property investments and Funds management. The Company directly owns a portfolio of high-quality, modern office and industrial properties, and manages a portfolio of office, industrial, and retail assets for third-party wholesale syndicates and institutional investors through its fund management business. Its total property portfolio by value consists of approximately 27 high-quality office properties with a total lettable area of 347,763 square meters (sqm). Its industrial portfolio comprises 23 modern industrial properties. Its office properties include Building 3, 570 Swan Street, 2-6 Bowes Street, 100 Skyring Terrace, 1 Charles Street, 75 Dorcas Street, 109 Burwood Road, Building 2, 572-576 Swan Street, and others.

name: GOLD ROAD RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Gold Road Resources Limited is a mid-tier gold producer and explorer with tier one mine and exploration projects across Western Australia, South Australia and Queensland, covering more than 14,000 square kilometers. Its principal activities include mine operations through a joint venture, the sale of gold, and mineral exploration. Its segments include Operations, Exploration, and Investment. The Operations segment consists of all operating segments within Australia, consisting of the Gruyere joint operation with Gold Fields. The Exploration segment includes activities of all mineral exploration, including all joint venture tenements. The Investment segment includes the activities of equity securities investments. Its Gruyere (JV) Gold Mine, located approximately 1,200 kilometers north-east of Perth in Western Australia’s north-eastern Goldfields, is a 50:50 joint venture between Gold Road and Gruyere Mining Company Pty Ltd, a member of Gold Fields Ltd and the manager of operations.

name: GR ENGINEERING SERVICES LTD
businessSummary: GR Engineering Services Ltd is an Australia-based process engineering consulting and contracting company. The Company specializes in providing engineering design and construction services to the mining and mineral processing industries. Its segment includes Mineral Processing and Oil & Gas. The Mineral Processing segment includes engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracts and engineering, procurement and construction management (EPCM) contracts. Its Oil and Gas contracts comprise the delivery of operations and maintenance, well sites, engineering and production assurance services to the customer base. The Company’s services include feasibility studies, design and construction, project management, consulting, and asset management. Its projects include Abra Base Metals Project, Andy Well Gold Project, Bellevue Gold Project, Carosue Dam Expansion Project, Carosue Dam Paste Backfill Project, Cosmos Restart Project, Cosmic Boy Concentrator, Edna May Project, and others.

name: GRAINCORP LTD
businessSummary: GrainCorp Limited is engaged in the integrated grain and edible oils business with a presence in grain storage and handling business in East Coast Australia (ECA) and is an edible oil processor and oilseed crusher in Australia and New Zealand. It has created a global supply chain with infrastructure assets that store, process and facilitate the transportation of grains and edible oils. Its segments include Agribusiness and Nutrition & Energy. Agribusiness segment includes end-to-end grains supply chain business with diversified international grain origination and destination capabilities. The key commodities and products handled and traded by this segment include wheat, coarse grains (including barley, sorghum and corn), oilseeds, pulses and organics. Nutrition & Energy segment includes vertically integrated business comprising of edible oils crushing, processing, manufacturing, distribution and trading of animal fats, used cooking oils and vegetable oils for animal feed purposes.

name: GOODMAN GROUP
businessSummary: Goodman Group is an Australia-based industrial property and digital infrastructure specialist company. The Company is comprised of the stapled entities Goodman Limited, Goodman Industrial Trust and Goodman Logistics (HK) Limited. The Company provides infrastructure for the digital economy by owning, developing, and managing sustainable properties and data centers in major global cities. Its operating segments are Australia and New Zealand, Asia (Greater China (including the Hong Kong SAR) and Japan), Continental Europe (with assets located in Germany, France, Spain and the Netherlands), the United Kingdom and the Americas (principally North America and including Brazil). Its property portfolio includes logistics and distribution centers, warehouses, light industrial, multi-story industrial, business parks and data centers. It operates in key consumer markets in 15 countries across Asia Pacific, Australia, New Zealand, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the Americas.

name: GENESIS MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Genesis Minerals Limited is an Australia-based gold company, 100% focused on the prolific Leonora District in Western Australia. The Company's principal activities are gold mining, project development and exploration activities in Western Australia. Its operations include Leonora Operations and Laverton Operations. The Company's Leonora Operations include Admiral Operations, Gwalia Operations, Harbour Lights Project, Tower Hill Project and Ulysses Operations. The Gwalia Gold Mine is located at Gwalia, a few kilometers south of Leonora, Western Australia. Its Laverton Operations include Bruno-Lewis Project, Jupiter Project, Laverton Gold Project and Redcliffe Project. The Bruno-Lewis project is located within the northeastern goldfields in the Archaean Yilgarn Block. The Redcliffe Project includes the Redcliffe, Hub, GTS, Nambi, Kelly, Bindy and Mesa Westlode deposits. Genesis Mining Services is the inhouse mining services provider for the Company, providing Open Pit mining services.

name: GALILEE ENERGY LTD
businessSummary: Galilee Energy Limited is an integrated and diversified sustainable energy company and a key supplier of natural gas to the east coast market of Australia. The principal activity of the Company is oil and gas exploration and production. It has tenement interests and exploration and evaluation activities in Australia, the United States and Chile. The Company holds interests in a diversified exploration portfolio with coal seam gas and conventional oil and gas assets in three of Australia’s east coast basins. Its projects include Glenaras Gas Project, Kumbarilla Project, and Springsure Gas Project Denison. The Glenaras Gas Project is located in the western central Galilee Basin. The Galilee Basin is a sedimentary basin covering approximately 247,000 square kilometers (sq.km). The Kumbarilla Gas Project in ATP 2043 is located in southern Queensland. The Springsure Gas Project, which is located at ATP 2050 in central Queensland.

name: GLOBE INTERNATIONAL LIMITED
businessSummary: Globe International Limited is an Australia-based designer, producer and distributor in the board sports, street fashion, outdoor and work-wear markets. The Company's segments include Australasia, North America, and Europe. Its proprietary brands include Globe, Salty Crew, FXD, Impala Skate, Milkbar Bikes, Dot Boards, X/DMG, and It’s Now Cool. It maintains diverse licensing and distribution businesses of third party owned brands for the Australian and New Zealand market, operating under its Hardcore Distribution and 4Front divisions. Its third-party brands include XLarge, X-Girl, M/SF/T, Stance, Szade, OBEY, Pro-Tec, and others. Globe is premium board sports footwear and skateboard brand. Impala Skate offers roller skates, inline skates, skateboards. Milkbar Bikes provides bicycles, and accessories. Dot Boards offers electric skateboards. It has offices, distribution hubs, and manufacturing centers in Melbourne, Los Angeles, Newport Beach, San Diego, Hossegor and Shenzhen.

name: G8 EDUCATION LTD
businessSummary: G8 Education Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in operating childcare centers. The Company provides early learning education and care services. Its principal activities include the operation of early education centers owned by the Company and its subsidiaries, and ownership of franchised childcare centers. The Company operates through the management of childcare centers. The Company's portfolio consists of approximately 430 centers under 21 brands in Australia. Its centers provide a total combined licensed capacity of approximately 37,225 places. The Company offers brands include The Learning Sanctuary, buggles, Creative Garden, Great Beginnings, Leor, NutureOne, Penguin Childcare, and World of Learning. Its subsidiaries include Grasshoppers Early Learning Centres Pty Ltd, Togalog Pty Ltd, Bourne Learning Pty Ltd, Ramsay Bourne Licences Pty Ltd, World of Learning Licences Pty Ltd, Shemlex Investment Unit Trust, Kindy Kids Long Day Care and Preschool Trust.

name: GBM RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: GBM Resources Limited is a mineral exploration and development company focused on the discovery of gold and copper deposits in Eastern Australia. The Company has a project portfolio, hosting district scale mineral systems, located in several metallogenic terrains. Its projects include Mount Coolon Gold Project, Yandan Gold Project, Twin Hills Gold Project, White Dam Project, Mount Morgan Gold Copper Project, and Cloncurry Iron Copper Oxide Gold Project. The Mount Coolon Gold Project is located within the Drummond Basin and its tenement package covers a total area of over 2,613 square kilometers. The Yandan Gold Project is located approximately 40 kilometers (km) to the west of the township of Mount Coolon and 155 km southeast of Charters Towers, north Queensland. Its tenure covers an area of approximately 952 square kilometers. The Twin Hills Gold Project is a 1,102 square kilometers tenement package in the prospective Drummond Basin. The White Dam Gold Operation is in South Australia.

name: GALE PACIFIC LTD
businessSummary: GALE Pacific Limited is an Australia-based manufacturer of technical fabrics used for consumer and commercial applications around the world. The Company's segments include Americas (AMR), Australia/New Zealand (ANZ) and Developing Markets (DEV). The Company's retail brands include Coolaroo and Zone Interiors. Its commercial brand is GALE Pacific Commercial. The Company's consumer products, marketed under the Coolaroo brand, include outdoor roller shades, shade sails, shade and garden fabrics, shade structures and pet products. The Company's commercial products, marketed under the GALE Pacific Commercial brand, include knitted, coated, and advanced polymer fabrics used in a number of applications across the agricultural, horticultural, aquacultural, architectural, construction, mining, and packaging industries. Zone Interiors' do-it-yourself (DIY) window furnishings include a range of easy-to-install venetian and roller blinds in a range of standard sizes and modern colors.

name: GOLDEN MILE RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Golden Mile Resources Limited is an Australia-based project development company and mineral exploration company. The primary focus is on growing the Company with a multi asset and multi commodity strategy through advancement of core projects, acquisition of high-quality assets and tactical alliances with joint venture partners. Its projects include Pearl Copper Project, Quicksilver Nickel-Cobalt Project, Leonora Gold Joint Venture (JV) Project, Gidgee JV Project, Yuinmery Project, Yarrambee Project, Marble Bar Lithium-Gold Project, and Murchison Project. The Pearl Copper Project is situated in the San Manuel mining district, Pinal County, Arizona, over 40 kilometers (km) north-east of Tucson, near the town of Mammoth. The Quicksilver Project, located near the town of Lake Grace, is over 300 km south-east of Perth, Western Australia. The Quicksilver Project is centered over a narrow greenstone belt, the Project is prospective for nickel-cobalt, and gold.

name: FLEETWOOD LTD
businessSummary: Fleetwood Limited is an Australia-based provider of modular and accommodation solutions as well as recreational vehicle (RV) parts and accessories. The Company's segments include RV Solutions, Building Solutions and Community Solutions. The RV Solutions segment is engaged in manufacturing, installation and distribution of recreational vehicle parts and accessories. The RV Solutions segment is comprised of two RV brands operating in Australia and New Zealand: Camec and Northern RV. The Building Solutions segment is engaged in designing, manufacturing and sale of accommodation. The Building Solutions segment serves various sectors, including aged care, education, amenities, commercial, health, custodial and defense. The Community Solutions segment includes the operation of communities. The Community Solutions segment include Searipple Village, Osprey Village and Glyde Digital. Glyde Digital is an Internet of Things technology developed by the Company that makes accommodation smarter.

name: FLEXIROAM LTD
businessSummary: Flexiroam Limited is a Malaysia-based company, which is engaged in telecommunications and Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity. It provides a connectivity solution for travelers. Its technology includes a consumer embedded subscriber identity module (eSIM), eSIM for IoT, coverage, and a connectivity management platform. Its segment includes Travel and Solutions. Its Travel segment consists of different routes to market via direct to consumers, corporate loyalty and affiliates, as well as Business-to-Business (B2B), which encompasses its solutions products as well as services sold to B2B channels such as wholesale, product distribution, and white label partners. The Company is involved in the supply of eSIM & Physical SIM-based data solutions in the Global Roaming and Solutions segments. It offers a range of data plans, which include Local Data Plans, Regional Data Plans, Global Data Plans, inflight Data Plans, and Voice and Text Plans.

name: FOCUS MINERALS LTD
businessSummary: Focus Minerals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in gold exploration and production in Western Australia. The Company's Coolgardie Gold Project (Coolgardie) covers approximately 116.6 square kilometers (km2) of highly prospective tenements on the outskirts of the Coolgardie township in the Goldfields region. The Company is also engaged in the development of the Bonnie Vale Underground Mine.

name: FORTESCUE LTD
businessSummary: Fortescue Ltd is an Australia-based global green technology, energy and metals company. The Company's segments include Metals and Energy. Metals segment includes exploration, development, production, processing, sale and transportation of iron ore, and the exploration for other minerals. Its metals business comprises its iron ore operations in the Pilbara as well as a pipeline of exploration projects globally including in Gabon in Africa, Latin America and Australia. The Company's metals business includes Hedland operations, Chichester Hub, Western Hub, Iron Bridge, Green Metal Project, integrated operations, Belinga Project, Blacksmith Project and Pilbara Energy Connect (PEC) project. Energy segment undertakes activities in the global development of green electricity, green hydrogen, green ammonia projects, as well as green technology development and manufacturing. Its energy business includes Arizona Hydrogen project, Holmaneset project, Pecem project and Gladstone PEM50 Project.

name: FLIGHT CENTRE TRAVEL GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Flight Centre Travel Group Limited is a travel retailer and corporate travel manager. The Company's principal activities consist of leisure travel retailing and corporate travel management, plus in-destination travel experience businesses including tour operations, hotel management, destination management companies (DMCs) and wholesaling. Its segments include Leisure, Corporate, and Other. The Leisure segment combines the retail storefront and online brands for retail customers, luxury travel brands Travel Associates and Scott Dunn, independent agents and complementary offerings. The Corporate segment includes the FCM brand, corporate traveler and other corporate customer brands. The Other segment includes Brisbane-based and other support businesses, including Supply, that support the global network and also includes travel management services which incorporate touring, ground-handling and hotels. Its brands include Flight Centre, Aunt Betty, ignite, and Scott Dunn, among others.

name: FREELANCER LTD
businessSummary: Freelancer Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the provision of an online outsourcing marketplace and escrow payment services. The Company is involved in the freelancing and crowdsourcing marketplace. The Company operates through two segments: Online Marketplace and Online Payment. The Company owns Escrow.com, a provider of secure online payments and online transaction management for consumers and businesses on the Internet. It safeguards both the buyer and seller with all funds kept in trust that are transacted in escrow. The Company also owns Loadshift, a heavy haulage freight marketplace with over 750 million kilometers of freight posted. The Company has more than 80 million registered users and have posted over 25 million projects and contests in over 3,000 areas, as diverse as Website development, logo design, marketing, copywriting, astrophysics, aerospace engineering and manufacturing.

name: FLUENCE CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Fluence Corporation Limited provides decentralized water and wastewater treatment solutions. The Company is engaged in wastewater treatment and reuse, high-strength wastewater treatment, wastewater-to-energy, industrial and drinking water markets, with its pre-engineered, standardized smart products solutions (SPS), including Aspiral, NIROBOX, SUBRE and Nitro. Its segments include Decentralized Municipal Water and Wastewater treatment (DMWW), Specialized Industrial Water solutions (SIW), High-Strength Wastewater and Waste-to-Energy (HSWW), SEA & China, Ivory Coast project (IVC), and Build-Own-Operate (BOO) projects and O&M contracts for equipment sales. The DMWW segment includes MABR (Aspiral, SUBRE and Nitro), and Nirobox products. The SIW segment focuses on water reuse applications and high-growth markets such as lithium mining, which supports the trend toward electrification. The HSWW segment is providing solutions that support the shift to global decarbonization.

name: FIDUCIAN GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Fiducian Group Ltd is an end-to-end financial services company. The Company provides platforms for investment and superannuation, funds management and investment, financial planning and wealth management, and technology solutions for financial planners and their clients. Its segments include Funds Management, Financial Planning, Platform Administration and Corporate Services. In the Funds Management segment, the Company acts as a responsible entity for managed investment schemes and separately managed accounts through its subsidiary, Fiducian Investment Management Services Limited. Its Financial Planning segment is engaged in providing specialist financial planning services through its subsidiary, Fiducian Financial Services Pty Ltd. In the Platform Administration segment, the Company acts as a registrable superannuation entity (RSE) of a public offer superannuation fund, which is offered on its wrap platform through its subsidiary, Fiducian Portfolio Services Ltd.

name: FREEHILL MINING LTD
businessSummary: Freehill Mining Limited is a mining and exploration company. It is focused on the development of its 100%-owned, 478-hectare Yerbas Buenas magnetite and associated materials project in Chile. It also holds copper and gold exploration projects in Chile and is assessing other related investment opportunities. The Company, through its Chilean companies Yerbas Buenas SpA and San Patricio Mineria SpA, hold several concessions in an area just north of the city of Coquimbo-La Serena, Chile. These concessions are all located in one area in Region IV of Chile on the coast about 500 kilometers north of the capital Santiago. The concessions comprise a large JORC magnetite resource within the Yerbas Buenas and Arenas concession blocks and a magnetite-copper-gold exploration area on the northern boundary of Yerbas Buenas with eight blocks collectively known as the El Dorado project. The El Dorado project is located in the El Tofo fault and within the Atacama IOCG belt (Iron Oxide Copper Gold).

name: FUTURE GENERATION AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Future Generation Australia Limited is an Australia-based company, which gives investors the opportunity to gain unprecedented access to a group of prominent Australian fund managers in a single investment vehicle while supporting Australian not-for-profit organizations focused on children and youth at risk. The Company's investment objective is to provide shareholders with a stream of fully franked dividends, achieves long-term capital growth and preserves capital. It provides shareholders with access to a diversified investment portfolio managed by Australian fund managers, while supporting its Australian social impact partners focused on children and youth at risk. Its investment portfolio is formed with a focus on providing shareholders with reduced volatility compared to the market, capital preservation during market downturns and achieve capital growth. The Company also invests in Australian and international securities, derivatives and cash or near-term cash securities.

name: FATFISH GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Fatfish Group Limited is an Australia-based technology venture company. The Company is engaged in investing in technology and Internet companies. It is focused on offering opportunities to investors to invest in a diversified portfolio of early-stage and growth-stage Internet businesses. The Company’s segments include Incubator services, Digital currency mining, BNPL and Insurtech services, and All other operating segments. The Company invests in various sectors, such as fintech and consumer Internet technologies. It also owns Hibur.io, a social gaming platform. The Company’s subsidiaries include Fatfish Income Limited, Payslowslow Pte Ltd, Fatberry Pte Ltd, AFG Thailand Co Limited, and PT Fintech Group Indonesia, among others.

name: FRONTIER DIGITAL VENTURES LTD
businessSummary: Frontier Digital Ventures Limited(FDV) is a Malaysia-based company engaged in online marketplace businesses. The Company is an owner and operator of online classifieds marketplaces in fast growing emerging regions and operates across three regions: 360 LATAM, MENA Marketplaces Group, and FDV Asia. The Company works alongside local management teams across property, automotive, and general classifieds, providing strategic oversight and operational guidance. Its segments include Tayara, PropertyPro, Meqasa, LankaPropertyWeb, Infocasas, iMyanmarhouse, Fincaraiz, Encuentra24, CarsDB, vAvito, Autodeal, and Hoppler. Its property management marketplaces include iMyanmarHouse.com, LankaPropertyWeb.com, MeQasa.com, Zameen.com, Propertypro.ng, infocasas.com.uy, Hoppler.com.ph and Fincaraiz.com.co. Its automotive marketplace includes CarsDB.com, Moteur.ma, PakWheels.com, and Autodeal.com.ph. Its general marketplace includes Encuentra24.com, Avito.ma, Tayara.tn, and Yapo.cl.

name: FBR LIMITED
businessSummary: FBR Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs, develops, and builds dynamically stabilized robots to address global needs in a safer, efficient, and sustainable way. These robots are designed to work outdoors using the Company’s core Dynamic Stabilization Technology (DST). The application of DST includes the Hadrian X and Mantis. Hadrian X is a bricklaying robot that builds structural walls faster, safer, more accurately and with less wastage than traditional manual methods. The Hadrian X provides Wall as a Service, its commercial offering, to builders on demand. The Shuttle Block Delivery System is designed to lay existing commercially available blocks as well as have the ability to lay blocks. Mantis is a high deposition welding robot for the large-scale metal fabrication industries such as mining, shipbuilding and defense manufacture.

name: FAR LTD
businessSummary: FAR Limited is an independent, Africa focused, oil and gas exploration company. The principal activities of the Company are identifying and developing strategies to realize value from the consideration receivable for the sale of its interest in the RSSD Project in Senegal to Woodside Energy (Senegal) BV (Woodside Energy). The Company has rights to a contingent payment, as consideration for the sale of its interest in the RSSD Project. The contingent payment comprises 45% of entitlement barrels (being the share of oil relating to its previously held 13.67% of the RSSD Project comprising the Sangomar Field exploitation area of interest), multiplied by the excess of the crude oil price per barrel and US$58 per barrel (capped at US$70 per barrel).

name: ENERGY WORLD CORPORATION LTD
businessSummary: Energy World Corporation Limited is an Australia-based independent energy company, primarily engaged in the production and sale of power, and development of liquefied natural gas (LNG) projects. The Company operates through four segments: Oil and Gas in Australia, Oil and Gas in Indonesia, Power in Indonesia, and Project Development. The Company’s operations are in three countries: Philippines, Indonesia, and Australia. Its Philippines operations is engaged in the development of the LNG Hub terminal in the Philippines and development of 650 megawatts (MW) combined cycle gas fired power plant. Its Indonesia operations include a 315 MW Senkang combined cycle gas fired power plant, development of a 2 million tons per annum (mtpa) LNG liquification plant and Sengkang gas field. Its Australia operations include ownership interests in various gas fields, development of a 56,000 tpa LNG Liquification plant, an 8 MW Alice Springs power plant, and Alice Springs LNG plant.

name: ENVIROSUITE LTD
businessSummary: Envirosuite Limited is an environmental intelligence company. The principal activities of the Company include development and sale of environmental management technology solutions. The Company operates through three geographic operating segments: Asia Pacific (APAC), Americas and Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA). It combines science and technology to produce predictable and actionable insights, that allows customers to optimize their operations, remain compliant and manage their environmental impact. Its platforms include EVS Industrial, EVS Water, EVS Aviation, and EVS IoT. EVS Industrial is an integrated hardware and software emissions monitoring solutions to support data driven decisions at industrial and municipal operations. EVS Water is a suite of science-based design and asset management software for the water industry. EVS Aviation offers comprehensive airport environmental management software. It serves various industries, such as mining, airports, and waste treatment.

name: EVOLUTION MINING LTD
businessSummary: Evolution Mining Limited is an Australia-based gold mining company. The Company operates six mines, being five wholly owned mines: Cowal in New South Wales, Ernest Henry and Mt Rawdon in Queensland, Mungari in Western Australia, and Red Lake in Ontario, Canada, and an 80% share of Northparkes in New South Wales. The Cowal open pit and underground gold operations is located 350 kilometer (km) west of Sydney, New South Wales, on the lands of the Wiradjuri people. The Ernest Henry is a large-scale, long-life underground copper-gold asset located 38 km north-east of Cloncurry, Queensland. It holds 80% interest in Northparkes underground and open pit copper-gold mine located 27 km north-west of Parkes, New South Wales. The Red Lake is an underground gold mine in north-western Ontario. The Mungari is a gold mining hub located 600 km east of Perth and 20 km west of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia. The Mt Rawdon is an open pit gold mine located 75 km south-west of Bundaberg, Queensland.

name: EVE HEALTH GROUP LTD
businessSummary: EVE Health Group Limited is an Australia-based vertically integrated producer of branded nutrition, health and wellness products. The Company’s Meluka business provides branded wellness consumer products. Its Meluka business is focused on supporting sales of its digestive health products, in particular the P3 Gut Builder. It provides probiotic supplement powder system for improved digestive health. The functional gut nutrition solution is in the form of a three-step supplement powder system, each of which contain pre, pro and postbiotics as well as selected functional superfood ingredients in an easy to consume and versatile offering. The Company also offers honey and essential oil products. Its honey products include organic raw honey and raw honey probiotic concentrate. The Company has global reach and application to various markets across Australia and New Zealand, Asia Pacific and North America.

name: ESTRELLA RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Estrella Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the exploration and development of nickel projects. The Company’s projects include the Carr Boyd Nickel Project and the Spargoville Project. The Carr Boyd Nickel Project covers the Carr Boyd Layered Complex, 75 square kilometers (km2) mafic igneous complex which hosts several nickel and copper sulfide occurrences. The Carr Boyd Layered Complex is in a Tier 1 jurisdiction approximately 80 kilometers (km) north-north-east of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia. Carr Boyd Nickel Project, north of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia, is a focus for the Company-where it has recently made a nickel and copper discovery while drilling into the T5 electromagnetic target. Its two-reverse circulation (RC) drill holes, CBP042 and CBP043, were completed to test the T5 EM conductor plate. The Spargoville Project is located approximately 20 km southwest of Kambalda, Western Australia.

name: ETHERSTACK CDI
businessSummary: Etherstack plc is a United Kingdom-based wireless technology company specializing in developing, manufacturing and licensing radio technologies for wireless equipment manufacturers and network operators around the globe. The Company develops software for use in transceivers, which enables the transceiver to communicate with a radio network and other transceivers. It develops network soft switching software that allows network services to be deployed in data centers such as those used by telecommunications carriers. It also licenses its software and designs to companies who manufacture telecommunication equipment, primarily for government public safety agencies and utilities. Its technology and systems include cryptography and key management, defense waveforms, LMR - LTE Interworking, LMR Protocol Stacks, LMR Voice and Data Systems and Tactical and Satellite Systems. It provides a range of cryptographic solutions that include the FIPS 140-2 Cryptographic Module and P25 Security Dongle.

name: EMMERSON RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Emmerson Resources Limited is engaged in mineral exploration in Australia. The Company's projects include Tennant Creek and New South Wales (NSW). It has a commanding land position and is exploring the Tennant Creek Mineral Field (TCMF), one of Australia's highest-grade gold and copper fields that has produced over 5.5 million ounces (Moz) of gold and 470,000t of copper from deposits including Warrego, White Devil, Orlando, Gecko, Chariot, and Golden Forty. The Company holds approximately 1,800 square kilometers in the TCMF. It is exploring two early-stage gold-copper projects in NSW, identified from the application of two dimensional and three-dimensional predictive targeting models. The highly prospective Macquarie Arc in NSW hosts >80Moz gold and >13Mt copper with these resources heavily weighted to areas of outcrop or limited cover. Its exploration projects contain many attributes of the known deposits within the Macquarie Arc but remain underexplored due to historical impediments.

name: ENERGY RESOURCES OF AUSTRALIA LTD
businessSummary: Energy Resources of Australia Ltd is an Australia-based company. The principal activities of the Company consist of the site rehabilitation. The Company’s Ranger Mine area is located about eight kilometers (kms) east of Jabiru and approximately 260 kms east of Darwin, in Australia's Northern Territory. It also holds title to the Jabiluka mineral lease. The Ranger Mine area and the Jabiluka mineral lease are located on Aboriginal land and are surrounded by, but separate from, the Kakadu National Park. The Ranger uranium mine lies approximately 79 square kilometers and is surrounded by, but separate from the Kakadu National Park, which is approximately 20,000 square kilometers. The Jabiluka estimated mineral resource is approximately 137,100 tons of uranium oxide.

name: EQUATORIAL RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Equatorial Resources Limited is an Australia-based company primarily focusing on Africa. The Company is advancing its mineral assets, including the notable Nimba Alliance Iron Ore Project. Its projects also include Badondo Iron Project (Badondo) and Mayoko-Moussondji Iron Project. The Nimba Project covers a large landholding in Guinea's prolific Nimba Iron Ore Corridor and comprises majority ownership of two permits: 100% of the Nimba West permit covering approximately 198 square kilometers (km2), and 56% of the Nimba North permit covering around 107 km2. The Nimba Project is located within a cluster of major iron ore projects where the development of large-scale transport infrastructure to enable efficient economic production is ongoing. Badondo is a potentially large-scale iron project in the northwest of the Republic of Congo, situated within a cluster of world-class iron ore exploration projects. It has retained a 2% royalty on production from the Mayoko-Moussondji Iron Project.

name: ECLIPSE METALS LTD
businessSummary: Eclipse Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company focused on exploring south-western Greenland, Northern Territory and Queensland for multicommodity mineralization. The Company has a portfolio of assets prospective for cryolite, fluorite, siderite, quartz, rare earth elements (REE), gold, platinum group metals, manganese, palladium, vanadium and uranium mineralization. Its Ivigtut Project within mineral exploration license MEL2007-45 in southwest Greenland hosts the Ivigtut cryolite mine and a range of undeveloped mineral deposits. The Company holds two granted exploration licenses and six exploration license applications in the Ngalia Basin, with a combined area of approximately 7,550 square kilometers (km2) situated within this uranium mineralized region. The Devil’s Elbow uranium-gold-palladium prospect in the Northern Territory is covered by EL27584. Its tenements also include the Amamoor Manganese Project, Cusack's Bore Uranium Project and Yuendi Copper Project.

name: ELECTRO OPTIC SYSTEMS HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in designing, manufacturing, and exporting advanced technology systems. The Company operates in two segments: Defence Systems and Space Systems. The Defence Systems segment specializes in technology for weapon systems optimization and integration, as well as Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) and C4 systems for land warfare. The Company's key products include remote weapon systems, vehicle turrets, high-energy laser weapons (directed energy), as well as fully integrated and modular counter-UAS and C4 systems. The Space Systems segment specializes in applying EOS-developed optical sensors and effectors to detect, track and characterize objects in space. It includes capabilities in the domain of space control.

name: ENERGY ONE LTD
businessSummary: Energy One Limited is an Australia-based supplier of software products, outsourced operations and advisory services to wholesale energy, environmental and carbon trading markets. The Company’s principal activity is the development and supply of software and services as well as energy trading and associated advisory services to energy companies and utilities. The Company’s segments include Energy Software and Energy Trading Industry. Its geographical segments include Australasia, CQ Energy and the United Kingdom /Europe. The Company’s software and services include advisory services, demand-linked risk management solutions, egssPort, EnergyOffer, enFlow, enPrice, enTrader, enVoy, EOT, eZ-Ops, generation services, NemSight, managed services, pypIT, SimEnergy, plant outage insurance, weather-linked risk management solutions, and global 24/7 outsourced operations services. It serves a range of customers across the globe, including energy retailers, generators, users, customers.

name: ENTERPRISE METALS LTD
businessSummary: Enterprise Metals Limited is an Australia-based company and is focused on gold, lithium and base metals exploration in Australia. The Company's projects include the Fraser Range Project, Murchison Gold Project, Doolgunna Copper/Gold Project and Mandilla Gold Prospect. The Fraser Range Project is located within the Albany Fraser Orogen approximately 100 kilometers (km) east of Norseman and covers in excess of 500 square kilometers (km2) in a prospective portion of the Fraser Range. Its Murchison Project consists of E20/912, E20/913, E20/944, P20/2302 and P20/2303 and is centered approximately 30 km north of Cue and forms a landholding of approximately 197 km2 over a buried Archean greenstone belt. Its Doolgunna Project covers part of the southern boundary of the Bryah Basin and the northern part of the Yerrida Basin. Its Mandilla Gold Prospect (Exploration Licence 15/1437) is located approximately 20 km south of Kambalda on the eastern margin of the Mandilla Syenite.

name: ENCOUNTER RESOURCES LTD
businessSummary: Encounter Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on discovering major copper and niobium/ rare earth element (REE) deposits in Australia. It controls a portfolio of 100% owned projects in Australia's exciting mineral provinces that are prospective for copper and critical minerals. It has numerous large scale copper projects being advanced in partnership and funded through farm-in agreements with miners: South32 and IGO. Its projects include Aileron Critical Minerals Project, Sandover Copper Project, Beetaloo Basin Copper Projects, Junction Lithium Project, Irwin REE Projects, Lamil Copper-Gold Project, Jessica and Carrara Copper-Zinc Projects, Yeneena Copper Project and Elliott Copper Project. The 100% owned Aileron project covers around 1,765 square kilometers and is located in the West Arunta region of Western Australia. The Jessica and Carrara projects are being explored in partnership with South32 under farm-in agreements.

name: EMERALD OIL & GAS NL
businessSummary: Emerald Resources NL is an Australia-based gold exploration and mining company. The Company operates the Okvau Gold Deposit in the Mondulkiri province of eastern Cambodia and is exploring, with the view to developing other prospective gold projects in Cambodia. Its interest in its Cambodian Projects covers a combined area of over 1,428 square kilometers (km2). The Okvau Gold Mine is located over 275 km north-east of Cambodia’s capital city of Phnom Penh in the province of Mondulkiri. Its 100% owned Memot Gold Project is located over 100 km southwest of the Okvau Gold Mine and has approximately 107 km2 of a highly prospective area for gold exploration. Its Australian operations are focused on the North Laverton Gold Project’s tenements, in the Dingo Range greenstone belt. The North Laverton Gold Project consists of over 36 exploration licenses (including five applications) and four mining licenses covering most of the Dingo Range greenstone belt with more than 800 km2 of tenure.

name: EML PAYMENTS LTD
businessSummary: EML Payments Limited is an Australia-based company, which provides a global payment solutions platform. The Company offers program management and payments to create customizable solutions for businesses, brands and their customers. Its segment includes North America, Europe, and Asia Pac. The North America segment provides provision of prepaid payment services, predominantly with single-load card solutions, to its customers in North America. The Europe segment provides provision of reloadable and non-reloadable prepaid payment solutions to customers in Europe and the United Kingdom. The Asia Pac segment provides the provision of prepaid payment services to customers in Australia and New Zealand. It offers a range of products and payment options, including banking, credit, and disbursements services, earned wage access, gifts, incentives and rewards and FX solutions. Its products include Card Payments, Open Banking, Digital Account Payments and Seamless.

name: ENERGY METALS LTD
businessSummary: Energy Metals Limited is an Australia-based uranium exploration company. The Company has eight exploration projects located in the Northern Territory (NT) and Western Australia covering around 2,400 square kilometers (km2). Its projects include Bigrlyi, Ngalia Regional, Macallan, Anketell, Mopoke Well, Lakeside, Manyingee, and Lake Mason. The Bigrlyi deposit is a sandstone hosted uranium-vanadium deposit located on the northern margin of the Ngalia Basin, approximately 350 km northwest of Alice Springs. The Ngalia Regional Project is located in the Ngalia Basin, between 180 and 350 km northwest of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory. The Macallan project comprises a single exploration licence application (ELA27333), located 460 km northwest of Alice Springs and 140 km from Bigrlyi. The Anketell project is located 100 km east of Mt. Magnet and comprises retention licence R58/2. The Manyingee project (E08/1480 and R08/3) is located 85 km south of the port of Onslow.

name: ELEMENTOS LTD
businessSummary: Elementos Limited is an Australia-based tin company with two development assets in mining jurisdictions in Andalucia, Spain and Tasmania, Australia. The Company is focused on developing both the Oropesa Tin Project in Andalucia, Spain and the Cleveland Tin Project in Tasmania, Australia. The Oropesa Tin Project is located in the Guadiato Valley, in the Province of Cordoba, within the Andalucia autonomous region, Spain. The Oropesa Tin Project consists of an approximately 14.51 square kilometers concession package 75 kilometers (km) north-west of Cordoba and 180km north-east of Seville, in the Andalucia region of southern Spain. The Oropesa Tin Project contains a Joint Ore Reserve Committee (JORC) compliant Measured, indicated, and inferred resource of about 75,400 tons of tin. The Cleveland Tin Project is located approximately 80km southwest of Burnie in the mineral-rich northwest region of Tasmania, Australia.

name: ELSIGHT LTD
businessSummary: Elsight limited is engaged in providing ground-breaking hybrid (on-the-move or fixed) video/ data capturing, recording and transmission for various real- tactical security and surveillance purposes/applications. Its products include wearable and portable devices, vehicle mounted and fixed/wall mounted devices, including RiderM-04 mobile digital video recorder (DVR), command and control software, and multichannel-secure multi data link unit. RiderM-04 DVR offers encoding resolution (WD1) on all four channels (for transmission or recording), Wi-Fi automatic off load of recorded files, storage hard-disk shock vibration proof, two-way audio in between the command and control center and the vehicle where it is installed. Multichannel-secure multi data link unit is a technology, providing live video and audio transmission as well as recording capabilities through multiple 3G and 4G networks. Its solutions include first responders, intelligence, media and broadcast, telemedicine and transit.

name: ELDERS LTD
businessSummary: Elders Limited is an Australia-based agribusiness company. The Company’s business includes rural services, real estate, insurance and others. The Company’s segments include Branch Network, Wholesale Products, and Feed and Processing Services. The Branch Network segment includes the provision of a range of products and services through a common distribution channel, including agricultural retail products, agency services, real estate services and financial services. The Wholesale Products segment includes the Australian Independent Rural Retailers (AIRR) business based in Shepparton, Victoria, supported by a network of eight warehouses to supply independent retail stores throughout Australia. The Feed and Processing Services segment includes Killara feedlot, a beef cattle feedlot near Tamworth in New South Wales. The Company also offers livestock and wool agency services, storage and handling of wool feedlotting of cattle and the provision of real estate sales agency services.

name: EMECO HOLDINGS LTD
businessSummary: Emeco Holdings Limited is primarily involved in the provision of earthmoving equipment solutions and mining services solutions to its customers, as well as the maintenance and remanufacturing of major components of heavy earthmoving equipment. The Company is focused on surface and underground equipment rental. Its segments include Rental, Workshops and Pit N Portal. Rental segment provides a range of earthmoving equipment solutions to customers in Australia. Its additional technology platforms are developed to enable customers to improve the earthmoving efficiencies of their rental machines. Workshops segment provides maintenance and component rebuild services to customers in Australia. Its services include rentals, maintenance, fabrication, surface treatment, and others.

name: ENVIRONMENTAL GROUP LTD/THE
businessSummary: The Environmental Group Limited is engaged in the design, application and servicing of gas vapor and dust emission control systems, inlet and exhaust systems for gas turbines, engineering services, developing water treatment and service install provider for heat transfer plant and equipment primarily related to boilers, including 24/7 customer service for mechanical, electrical and automation support to a variety of industries. Its five business units include EGL Clean Air-Total Air Pollution Control and Airtight Solutions; Baltec IES; EGL Clean Energy-Tomlinson Energy Service and Ignite Services; EGL Water, and EGL Waste Services. Its Baltec IES produces inlet and exhaust systems for gas turbines, which are used to complement and augment solar and wind energy production. The EGL Water division continues to develop its patented technologies in conjunction with Victoria University. EGL Waste Services provides the sales and services platform for the Turmec Agency agreement in Australia.

name: ENERO GROUP LTD
businessSummary: Enero Group Limited is an Australia-based specialist portfolio of marketing, technology and communications businesses. The Company’s businesses include creative agency BMF, PR and integrated communications agencies, the Hotwire Group (Hotwire and ROI DNA), digital and experiential agency Orchard. Its specialist agencies provide progressive and integrated marketing services for global brands in technology, healthcare, and consumer verticals. Its integrated marketing and communication services include strategy, market research and insights, public relations, communications planning, design, events management, direct marketing, and programmatic media.

name: EDEN INNOVATIONS LTD
businessSummary: Eden Innovations Ltd produces and sells a high-performance concrete admixture, EdenCrete and retrofit dual fuel technology, OptiBlend developed for diesel generator sets. Its segments include Eden Innovations LLC and Eden Innovations India Pvt Ltd. Eden Innovations LLC segment includes EdenCrete sales and development and Optiblend sales, service, and manufacturing in United States. Eden Innovations India Pvt Ltd segment includes Optiblend sales, service, and manufacturing in India. The Company’s innovations include EdenCrete, OptiBlend, EdenPlast, and Other Technologies. Its EdenCrete is a carbon nanotube enriched admixture for concrete that improves tensile and flexural strength. Its OptiBlend technology allows a conventional diesel engine to run natural gas as its primary fuel without modifying the engine or the current diesel fuel system. Its EdenPlast is a CNT enriched polypropylene tape. Its other technologies are Pyrolysis Project and Hythane.

name: DEEP YELLOW LTD
businessSummary: Deep Yellow Limited is an Australia-based advanced uranium exploration and development company in Namibia and Australia. Its projects include Namibian project portfolio comprises of Tumas Project, Omahola Projects, Nova joint venture (JV) Project, Yellow Dune JV Project, Mulga Rock Project, and Alligator River Project. The Tumas Project comprises of a series of palaeochannel/calcrete-type uranium deposits. Omahola Project is located within the prospective Alaskite Alley corridor, within which uranium deposits, including Rossing, Husab, Etango and Valencia are located. The Nova joint venture (JV) Project includes two exclusive prospecting licenses (EPL) prospective for both basement and palaeochannel-type uranium mineralization. The Yellow Dune JV comprises one mineral deposit retention license (MDRL) covering a drilled-out uranium resource of the palaeochannel/calcrete-type at Aussinanis. The Mulga Rock consists of two separate mining areas over a total length of 30 kilometers.

name: DEXUS
businessSummary: Dexus is an Australia-based real estate company.
